verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:3
verses.text: Dominus ergo Deus tuus transibit ante te : ipse delebit omnes gentes has in conspectu tuo, et possidebis eas : et Josue iste transibit ante te, sicut locutus est Dominus.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:4
verses.text: Facietque Dominus eis sicut fecit Sehon et Og regibus Amorrhæorum, et terræ eorum, delebitque eos.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:5
verses.text: Cum ergo et hos tradiderit vobis, similiter facietis eis, sicut præcepi vobis.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:6
verses.text: Viriliter agite, et confortamini : nolite timere, nec paveatis ad conspectum eorum : quia Dominus Deus tuus ipse est ductor tuus, et non dimittet, nec derelinquet te.  <div eID="gen814" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv419"/><div sID="gen815" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv419"/>Vocavitque Moyses Josue, et dixit ei coram omni Israël : Confortare, et esto robustus : tu enim introduces populum istum in terram, quam daturum se patribus eorum juravit Dominus, et tu eam sorte divides.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:8
verses.text: Et Dominus qui ductor est vester, ipse erit tecum : non dimittet, nec derelinquet te : noli timere, nec paveas.  <div eID="gen815" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv420"/><div sID="gen816" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv420"/>Scripsit itaque Moyses legem hanc, et tradidit eam sacerdotibus filiis Levi, qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, et cunctis senioribus Israël.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:10
verses.text: Præcepitque eis, dicens : Post septem annos, anno remissionis, in solemnitate tabernaculorum,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:11
verses.text: convenientibus cunctis ex Israël, ut appareant in conspectu Domini Dei tui in loco quem elegerit Dominus, leges verba legis hujus coram omni Israël, audientibus eis,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:12
verses.text: et in unum omni populo congregato, tam viris quam mulieribus, parvulis, et advenis, qui sunt intra portas tuas : ut audientes discant, et timeant Dominum Deum vestrum, et custodiant, impleantque omnes sermones legis hujus.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:13
verses.text: Filii quoque eorum qui nunc ignorant, ut audire possint, et timeant Dominum Deum suum cunctis diebus quibus versantur in terra, ad quam vos, Jordane transmisso, pergitis obtinendam.  <div eID="gen816" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv421"/><div sID="gen817" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv421"/>Et ait Dominus ad Moysen : Ecce prope sunt dies mortis tuæ : voca Josue, et state in tabernaculo testimonii, ut præcipiam ei. Abierunt ergo Moyses et Josue, et steterunt in tabernaculo testimonii :

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:15
verses.text: apparuitque Dominus ibi in columna nubis, quæ stetit in introitu tabernaculi.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:16
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen : Ecce tu dormies cum patribus tuis, et populus iste consurgens fornicabitur post deos alienos in terra, ad quam ingreditur ut habitet in ea : ibi derelinquet me, et irritum faciet fœdus, quod pepigi cum eo.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:17
verses.text: Et irascetur furor meus contra eum in die illo : et derelinquam eum, et abscondam faciem meam ab eo, et erit in devorationem : invenient eum omnia mala et afflictiones, ita ut dicat in illo die : Vere quia non est Deus mecum, invenerunt me hæc mala.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:18
verses.text: Ego autem abscondam, et celabo faciem meam in die illo propter omnia mala, quæ fecit, quia secutus est deos alienos.  <div eID="gen817" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv422"/><div sID="gen818" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv422"/>Nunc itaque scribite vobis canticum istud, et docete filios Israël : ut memoriter teneant, et ore decantent, et sit mihi carmen istud pro testimonio inter filios Israël.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:20
verses.text: Introducam enim eum in terram, pro qua juravi patribus ejus, lacte et melle manantem. Cumque comederint, et saturati, crassique fuerint, avertentur ad deos alienos, et servient eis : detrahentque mihi, et irritum facient pactum meum.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:21
verses.text: Postquam invenerint eum mala multa et afflictiones, respondebit ei canticum istud pro testimonio, quod nulla delebit oblivio ex ore seminis sui. Scio enim cogitationes ejus, quæ facturus sit hodie, antequam introducam eum in terram, quam ei pollicitus sum.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:22
verses.text: Scripsit ergo Moyses canticum, et docuit filios Israël.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:23
verses.text: Præcepitque Dominus Josue filio Nun, et ait : Confortare, et esto robustus : tu enim introduces filios Israël in terram, quam pollicitus sum, et ego ero tecum.  <div eID="gen818" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv423"/><div sID="gen819" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv423"/>Postquam ergo scripsit Moyses verba legis hujus in volumine, atque complevit,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:25
verses.text: præcepit Levitis, qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, dicens :

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:26
verses.text: Tollite librum istum, et ponite eum in latere arcæ fœderis Domini Dei vestri : ut sit ibi contra te in testimonium.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:27
verses.text: Ego enim scio contentionem tuam, et cervicem tuam durissimam. Adhuc vivente me et ingrediente vobiscum, semper contentiose egistis contra Dominum : quanto magis cum mortuus fuero ?

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:28
verses.text: Congregate ad me omnes majores natu per tribus vestras, atque doctores, et loquar audientibus eis sermones istos, et invocabo contra eos cælum et terram.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:29
verses.text: Novi enim quod post mortem meam inique agetis, et declinabitis cito de via, quam præcepi vobis : et occurrent vobis mala in extremo tempore, quando feceritis malum in conspectu Domini, ut irritetis eum per opera manuum vestrarum.  <div eID="gen819" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 31:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv424"/><div sID="gen820" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv424"/>Locutus est ergo Moyses, audiente universo cœtu Israël, verba carminis hujus, et ad finem usque complevit.  <chapter eID="Deut.31"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:1
verses.text: Audite, cæli, quæ loquor : <l eID="gen822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen823"/>audiat terra verba oris mei. <l eID="gen823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv425"/><l level="1" sID="gen824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv425"/>Concrescat ut pluvia doctrina mea, <l eID="gen824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen825"/>fluat ut ros eloquium meum, <l eID="gen825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen826"/>quasi imber super herbam, <l eID="gen826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen827"/>et quasi stillæ super gramina. <l eID="gen827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv426"/><l level="1" sID="gen828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv426"/>Quia nomen Domini invocabo : <l eID="gen828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen829"/>date magnificentiam Deo nostro. <l eID="gen829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv427"/><l level="1" sID="gen830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv427"/>Dei perfecta sunt opera, <l eID="gen830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen831"/>et omnes viæ ejus judicia : <l eID="gen831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen832"/>Deus fidelis, et absque ulla iniquitate, <l eID="gen832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen833"/>justus et rectus. <l eID="gen833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv428"/><l level="1" sID="gen834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv428"/>Peccaverunt ei, et non filii ejus in sordibus : <l eID="gen834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen835"/>generatio prava atque perversa. <l eID="gen835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv429"/><l level="1" sID="gen836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv429"/>Hæccine reddis Domino, <l eID="gen836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen837"/>popule stulte et insipiens ? <l eID="gen837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen838"/>numquid non ipse est pater tuus, <l eID="gen838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen839"/>qui possedit te, et fecit, et creavit te ? <l eID="gen839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv430"/><l level="1" sID="gen840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv430"/>Memento dierum antiquorum, cogita generationes singulas : <l eID="gen840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen841"/>interroga patrem tuum, <l eID="gen841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen842"/>et annuntiabit tibi : <l eID="gen842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen843"/>majores tuos, et dicent tibi. <l eID="gen843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv431"/><l level="1" sID="gen844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv431"/>Quando dividebat Altissimus gentes, <l eID="gen844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen845"/>quando separabat filios Adam, <l eID="gen845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen846"/>constituit terminos populorum <l eID="gen846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen847"/>juxta numerum filiorum Israël. <l eID="gen847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv432"/><l level="1" sID="gen848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv432"/>Pars autem Domini, populus ejus : <l eID="gen848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen849"/>Jacob funiculus hæreditatis ejus. <l eID="gen849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv433"/><l level="1" sID="gen850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv433"/>Invenit eum in terra deserta, <l eID="gen850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen851"/>in loco horroris, et vastæ solitudinis : <l eID="gen851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen852"/>circumduxit eum, et docuit : <l eID="gen852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen853"/>et custodivit quasi pupillam oculi sui. <l eID="gen853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv434"/><l level="1" sID="gen854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv434"/>Sicut aquila provocans ad volandum pullos suos, <l eID="gen854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen855"/>et super eos volitans, <l eID="gen855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen856"/>expandit alas suas, et assumpsit eum, <l eID="gen856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen857"/>atque portavit in humeris suis. <l eID="gen857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv435"/><l level="1" sID="gen858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv435"/>Dominus solus dux ejus fuit, <l eID="gen858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen859"/>et non erat cum eo deus alienus : <l eID="gen859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv436"/><l level="1" sID="gen860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv436"/>constituit eum super excelsam terram, <l eID="gen860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen861"/>ut comederet fructus agrorum : <l eID="gen861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen862"/>ut sugeret mel de petra, <l eID="gen862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen863"/>oleumque de saxo durissimo ; <l eID="gen863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv437"/><l level="1" sID="gen864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv437"/>butyrum de armento, et lac de ovibus <l eID="gen864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen865"/>cum adipe agnorum, <l eID="gen865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen866"/>et arietum filiorum Basan : et hircos <l eID="gen866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen867"/>cum medulla tritici, <l eID="gen867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen868"/>et sanguinem uvæ biberet meracissimum. <l eID="gen868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv438"/><l level="1" sID="gen869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv438"/>Incrassatus est dilectus, et recalcitravit : <l eID="gen869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen870"/>incrassatus, impinguatus, dilatatus, <l eID="gen870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen871"/>dereliquit Deum factorem suum, <l eID="gen871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen872"/>et recessit a Deo salutari suo. <l eID="gen872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv439"/><l level="1" sID="gen873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv439"/>Provocaverunt eum in diis alienis, <l eID="gen873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen874"/>et in abominationibus ad iracundiam concitaverunt. <l eID="gen874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv440"/><l level="1" sID="gen875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv440"/>Immolaverunt dæmoniis et non Deo, <l eID="gen875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen876"/>diis quos ignorabant : <l eID="gen876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen877"/>novi recentesque venerunt, <l eID="gen877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen878"/>quos non coluerunt patres eorum : <l eID="gen878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv441"/><l level="1" sID="gen879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv441"/>Deum qui te genuit dereliquisti, <l eID="gen879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen880"/>et oblitus es Domini creatoris tui. <l eID="gen880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv442"/><l level="1" sID="gen881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv442"/>Vidit Dominus, et ad iracundiam concitatus est : <l eID="gen881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen882"/>quia provocaverunt eum filii sui et filiæ. <l eID="gen882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv443"/><l level="1" sID="gen883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv443"/>Et ait : Abscondam faciem meam ab eis, <l eID="gen883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen884"/>et considerabo novissima eorum : <l eID="gen884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen885"/>generatio enim perversa est, <l eID="gen885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen886"/>et infideles filii. <l eID="gen886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv444"/><l level="1" sID="gen887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv444"/>Ipsi me provocaverunt in eo qui non erat Deus, <l eID="gen887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen888"/>et irritaverunt in vanitatibus suis : <l eID="gen888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen889"/>et ego provocabo eos in eo qui non est populus, <l eID="gen889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen890"/>et in gente stulta irritabo illos. <l eID="gen890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv445"/><l level="1" sID="gen891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv445"/>Ignis succensus est in furore meo, <l eID="gen891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen892"/>et ardebit usque ad inferni novissima : <l eID="gen892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen893"/>devorabitque terram cum germine suo, <l eID="gen893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen894"/>et montium fundamenta comburet. <l eID="gen894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv446"/><l level="1" sID="gen895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv446"/>Congregabo super eos mala, <l eID="gen895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen896"/>et sagittas meas complebo in eis. <l eID="gen896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv447"/><l level="1" sID="gen897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv447"/>Consumentur fame, <l eID="gen897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen898"/>et devorabunt eos aves morsu amarissimo : <l eID="gen898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen899"/>dentes bestiarum immittam in eos, <l eID="gen899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen900"/>cum furore trahentium super terram, atque serpentium. <l eID="gen900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv448"/><l level="1" sID="gen901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv448"/>Foris vastabit eos gladius, <l eID="gen901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen902"/>et intus pavor, <l eID="gen902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen903"/>juvenem simul ac virginem, <l eID="gen903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen904"/>lactentem cum homine sene. <l eID="gen904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv449"/><l level="1" sID="gen905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv449"/>Dixi : Ubinam sunt ? <l eID="gen905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen906"/>cessare faciam ex hominibus memoriam eorum. <l eID="gen906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv450"/><l level="1" sID="gen907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv450"/>Sed propter iram inimicorum distuli : <l eID="gen907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen908"/>ne forte superbirent hostes eorum, <l eID="gen908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen909"/>et dicerent : Manus nostra excelsa, <l eID="gen909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen910"/>et non Dominus, fecit hæc omnia. <l eID="gen910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv451"/><l level="1" sID="gen911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv451"/>Gens absque consilio est, <l eID="gen911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen912"/>et sine prudentia. <l eID="gen912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv452"/><l level="1" sID="gen913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv452"/>Utinam saperent, et intelligerent, <l eID="gen913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen914"/>ac novissima providerent. <l eID="gen914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv453"/><l level="1" sID="gen915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv453"/>Quomodo persequatur unus mille, <l eID="gen915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen916"/>et duo fugent decem millia ? <l eID="gen916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen917"/>nonne ideo, quia Deus suus vendidit eos, <l eID="gen917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen918"/>et Dominus conclusit illos ? <l eID="gen918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv454"/><l level="1" sID="gen919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv454"/>Non enim est Deus noster ut dii eorum : <l eID="gen919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen920"/>et inimici nostri sunt judices. <l eID="gen920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv455"/><l level="1" sID="gen921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv455"/>De vinea Sodomorum, vinea eorum, <l eID="gen921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen922"/>et de suburbanis Gomorrhæ : <l eID="gen922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen923"/>uva eorum, uva fellis, <l eID="gen923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen924"/>et botri amarissimi. <l eID="gen924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv456"/><l level="1" sID="gen925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv456"/>Fel draconum vinum eorum, <l eID="gen925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen926"/>et venenum aspidum insanabile. <l eID="gen926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv457"/><l level="1" sID="gen927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv457"/>Nonne hæc condita sunt apud me, <l eID="gen927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen928"/>et signata in thesauris meis ? <l eID="gen928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv458"/><l level="1" sID="gen929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv458"/>Mea est ultio, et ego retribuam in tempore, <l eID="gen929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen930"/>ut labatur pes eorum : <l eID="gen930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen931"/>juxta est dies perditionis, <l eID="gen931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen932"/>et adesse festinant tempora. <l eID="gen932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv459"/><l level="1" sID="gen933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv459"/>Judicabit Dominus populum suum, <l eID="gen933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen934"/>et in servis suis miserebitur : <l eID="gen934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen935"/>videbit quod infirmata sit manus, <l eID="gen935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen936"/>et clausi quoque defecerunt, <l eID="gen936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen937"/>residuique consumpti sunt. <l eID="gen937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv460"/><l level="1" sID="gen938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv460"/>Et dicet : Ubi sunt dii eorum, <l eID="gen938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen939"/>in quibus habebant fiduciam ? <l eID="gen939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv461"/><l level="1" sID="gen940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv461"/>de quorum victimis comedebant adipes, <l eID="gen940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen941"/>et bibebant vinum libaminum : <l eID="gen941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen942"/>surgant, et opitulentur vobis, <l eID="gen942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen943"/>et in necessitate vos protegant. <l eID="gen943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv462"/><l level="1" sID="gen944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv462"/>Videte quod ego sim solus, <l eID="gen944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen945"/>et non sit alius deus præter me : <l eID="gen945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen946"/>ego occidam, et ego vivere faciam : <l eID="gen946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen947"/>percutiam, et ego sanabo, <l eID="gen947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen948"/>et non est qui de manu mea possit eruere. <l eID="gen948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv463"/><l level="1" sID="gen949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv463"/>Levabo ad cælum manum meam, <l eID="gen949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen950"/>et dicam : Vivo ego in æternum. <l eID="gen950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv464"/><l level="1" sID="gen951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv464"/>Si acuero ut fulgur gladium meum, <l eID="gen951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen952"/>et arripuerit judicium manus mea : <l eID="gen952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen953"/>reddam ultionem hostibus meis, <l eID="gen953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen954"/>et his qui oderunt me retribuam. <l eID="gen954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv465"/><l level="1" sID="gen955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv465"/>Inebriabo sagittas meas sanguine, <l eID="gen955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen956"/>et gladius meus devorabit carnes ; <l eID="gen956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen957"/>de cruore occisorum et de captivitate, <l eID="gen957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen958"/>nudati inimicorum capitis. <l eID="gen958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv466"/><l level="1" sID="gen959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv466"/>Laudate, gentes, populum ejus, <l eID="gen959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen960"/>quia sanguinem servorum suorum ulciscetur : <l eID="gen960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen961"/>et vindictam retribuet in hostes eorum, <l eID="gen961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen962"/>et propitius erit terræ populi sui. <l eID="gen962" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen821"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv467"/><div sID="gen963" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv467"/>Venit ergo Moyses, et locutus est omnia verba cantici hujus in auribus populi, ipse et Josue filius Nun.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:45
verses.text: Complevitque omnes sermones istos, loquens ad universum Israël,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:46
verses.text: et dixit ad eos : Ponite corda vestra in omnia verba, quæ ego testificor vobis hodie : ut mandetis ea filiis vestris custodire et facere, et implere universa quæ scripta sunt legis hujus :

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:47
verses.text: quia non incassum præcepta sunt vobis, sed ut singuli in eis viverent : quæ facientes longo perseveretis tempore in terra, ad quam, Jordane transmisso, ingredimini possidendam.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:48
verses.text: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in eadem die, dicens :

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:49
verses.text: Ascende in montem istum Abarim, id est, transitum, in montem Nebo, qui est in terra Moab contra Jericho : et vide terram Chanaan, quam ego tradam filiis Israël obtinendam, et morere in monte.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:50
verses.text: Quem conscendens jungeris populis tuis, sicut mortuus est Aaron frater tuus in monte Hor, et appositus populis suis :

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:51
verses.text: quia prævaricati estis contra me in medio filiorum Israël ad aquas contradictionis in Cades deserti Sin : et non sanctificastis me inter filios Israël.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 32:52
verses.text: E contra videbis terram, et non ingredieris in eam, quam ego dabo filiis Israël.  <chapter eID="Deut.32"/> <div eID="gen963" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:1
verses.text: Hæc est benedictio, qua benedixit Moyses, homo Dei, filiis Israël ante mortem suam.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:2
verses.text: Et ait : <div eID="gen964" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen965"/> <l level="1" sID="gen966"/>Dominus de Sinai venit, <l eID="gen966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen967"/>et de Seir ortus est nobis : <l eID="gen967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen968"/>apparuit de monte Pharan, <l eID="gen968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen969"/>et cum eo sanctorum millia. <l eID="gen969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen970"/>In dextera ejus ignea lex. <l eID="gen970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv468"/><l level="1" sID="gen971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv468"/>Dilexit populos, <l eID="gen971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen972"/>omnes sancti in manu illius sunt : <l eID="gen972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen973"/>et qui appropinquant pedibus ejus, <l eID="gen973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen974"/>accipient de doctrina illius. <l eID="gen974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv469"/><l level="1" sID="gen975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv469"/>Legem præcepit nobis Moyses, <l eID="gen975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen976"/>hæreditatem multitudinis Jacob. <l eID="gen976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv470"/><l level="1" sID="gen977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv470"/>Erit apud rectissimum rex, <l eID="gen977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen978"/>congregatis principibus populi cum tribubus Israël. <l eID="gen978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv471"/><l level="1" sID="gen979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv471"/>Vivat Ruben, et non moriatur, <l eID="gen979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen980"/>et sit parvus in numero.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:7
verses.text: Hæc est Judæ benedictio : <l eID="gen980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen981"/>Audi, Domine, vocem Judæ, <l eID="gen981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen982"/>et ad populum suum introduc eum : <l eID="gen982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen983"/>manus ejus pugnabunt pro eo, <l eID="gen983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen984"/>et adjutor illius contra adversarios ejus erit.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:8
verses.text: Levi quoque ait : <l eID="gen984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen985"/>Perfectio tua, et doctrina tua viro sancto tuo, <l eID="gen985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen986"/>quem probasti in tentatione, <l eID="gen986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen987"/>et judicasti ad aquas contradictionis. <l eID="gen987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv472"/><l level="1" sID="gen988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv472"/>Qui dixit patri suo et matri suæ : Nescio vos : <l eID="gen988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen989"/>et fratribus suis : Ignoro vos : <l eID="gen989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen990"/>et nescierunt filios suos. <l eID="gen990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen991"/>Hi custodierunt eloquium tuum, <l eID="gen991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen992"/>et pactum tuum servaverunt. <l eID="gen992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv473"/><l level="1" sID="gen993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv473"/>Judicia tua, o Jacob, <l eID="gen993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen994"/>et legem tuam, o Israël : <l eID="gen994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen995"/>ponent thymiama in furore tuo, <l eID="gen995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen996"/>et holocaustum super altare tuum. <l eID="gen996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv474"/><l level="1" sID="gen997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv474"/>Benedic, Domine, fortitudini ejus : <l eID="gen997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen998"/>et opera manuum illius suscipe. <l eID="gen998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen999"/>Percute dorsa inimicorum ejus : <l eID="gen999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1000"/>et qui oderunt eum, non consurgant.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:12
verses.text: Et Benjamin ait : <l eID="gen1000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1001"/>Amantissimus Domini habitabit confidenter in eo : <l eID="gen1001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1002"/>quasi in thalamo tota die morabitur, <l eID="gen1002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1003"/>et inter humeros illius requiescet.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:13
verses.text: Joseph quoque ait : <l eID="gen1003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1004"/>De benedictione Domini terra ejus, <l eID="gen1004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1005"/>de pomis cæli, et rore, atque abysso subjacente. <l eID="gen1005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv475"/><l level="1" sID="gen1006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv475"/>De pomis fructuum solis ac lunæ, <l eID="gen1006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv476"/><l level="1" sID="gen1007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv476"/>de vertice antiquorum montium, <l eID="gen1007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1008"/>de pomis collium æternorum : <l eID="gen1008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv477"/><l level="1" sID="gen1009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv477"/>et de frugibus terræ, et de plenitudine ejus. <l eID="gen1009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1010"/>Benedictio illius qui apparuit in rubo, <l eID="gen1010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1011"/>veniat super caput Joseph, <l eID="gen1011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1012"/>et super verticem nazaræi inter fratres suos. <l eID="gen1012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv478"/><l level="1" sID="gen1013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv478"/>Quasi primogeniti tauri pulchritudo ejus, <l eID="gen1013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1014"/>cornua rhinocerotis cornua illius : <l eID="gen1014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1015"/>in ipsis ventilabit gentes usque ad terminos terræ. <l eID="gen1015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1016"/>Hæ sunt multitudines Ephraim : <l eID="gen1016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1017"/>et hæc millia Manasse.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:18
verses.text: Et Zabulon ait : <l eID="gen1017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1018"/>Lætare, Zabulon, in exitu tuo, <l eID="gen1018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1019"/>et Issachar in tabernaculis tuis. <l eID="gen1019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv479"/><l level="1" sID="gen1020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv479"/>Populos vocabunt ad montem : <l eID="gen1020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1021"/>ibi immolabunt victimas justitiæ. <l eID="gen1021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1022"/>Qui inundationem maris quasi lac sugent, <l eID="gen1022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1023"/>et thesauros absconditos arenarum.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:20
verses.text: Et Gad ait : <l eID="gen1023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1024"/>Benedictus in latitudine Gad : <l eID="gen1024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1025"/>quasi leo requievit, <l eID="gen1025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1026"/>cepitque brachium et verticem. <l eID="gen1026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv480"/><l level="1" sID="gen1027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv480"/>Et vidit principatum suum, <l eID="gen1027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1028"/>quod in parte sua doctor esset repositus : <l eID="gen1028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1029"/>qui fuit cum principibus populi, <l eID="gen1029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1030"/>et fecit justitias Domini, <l eID="gen1030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1031"/>et judicium suum cum Israël.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:22
verses.text: Dan quoque ait : <l eID="gen1031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1032"/>Dan catulus leonis, fluet largiter de Basan.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:23
verses.text: Et Nephthali dixit : <l eID="gen1032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1033"/>Nephthali abundantia perfruetur, <l eID="gen1033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1034"/>et plenus erit benedictionibus Domini : <l eID="gen1034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1035"/>mare et meridiem possidebit.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:24
verses.text: Aser quoque ait : <l eID="gen1035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1036"/>Benedictus in filiis Aser, <l eID="gen1036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1037"/>sit placens fratribus suis, <l eID="gen1037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1038"/>et tingat in oleo pedem suum : <l eID="gen1038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv481"/><l level="1" sID="gen1039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv481"/>ferrum et æs calceamentum ejus. <l eID="gen1039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1040"/>Sicut dies juventutis tuæ, ita et senectus tua. <l eID="gen1040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv482"/><l level="1" sID="gen1041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv482"/>Non est deus alius ut Deus rectissimi, <l eID="gen1041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1042"/>ascensor cæli, auxiliator tuus. <l eID="gen1042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1043"/>Magnificentia ejus discurrunt nubes, <l eID="gen1043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv483"/><l level="1" sID="gen1044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv483"/>habitaculum ejus sursum, <l eID="gen1044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1045"/>et subter brachia sempiterna <l eID="gen1045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1046"/>ejiciet a facie tua inimicum, <l eID="gen1046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1047"/>dicetque : Conterere. <l eID="gen1047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv484"/><l level="1" sID="gen1048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv484"/>Habitabit Israël confidenter, et solus. <l eID="gen1048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1049"/>Oculus Jacob in terra frumenti et vini, <l eID="gen1049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1050"/>cælique caligabunt rore. <l eID="gen1050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 33:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv485"/><l level="1" sID="gen1051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv485"/>Beatus es tu, Israël : <l eID="gen1051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1052"/>quis similis tui, popule, qui salvaris in Domino ? <l eID="gen1052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1053"/>Scutum auxilii tui, <l eID="gen1053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1054"/>et gladius gloriæ tuæ : <l eID="gen1054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1055"/>negabunt te inimici tui, <l eID="gen1055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1056"/>et tu eorum colla calcabis. <l eID="gen1056" level="1"/><lg eID="gen965"/> <chapter eID="Deut.33"/>

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:1
verses.text: Ascendit ergo Moyses de campestribus Moab super montem Nebo, in verticem Phasga contra Jericho : ostenditque ei Dominus omnem terram Galaad usque Dan,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:2
verses.text: et universum Nephthali, terramque Ephraim et Manasse, et omnem terram Juda usque ad mare novissimum,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:3
verses.text: et australem partem, et latitudinem campi Jericho civitatis palmarum usque Segor.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:4
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus ad eum : Hæc est terra, pro qua juravi Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob, dicens : Semini tuo dabo eam. Vidisti eam oculis tuis, et non transibis ad illam.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:5
verses.text: Mortuusque est ibi Moyses servus Domini, in terra Moab, jubente Domino :

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:6
verses.text: et sepelivit eum in valle terræ Moab contra Phogor : et non cognovit homo sepulchrum ejus usque in præsentem diem.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:7
verses.text: Moyses centum et viginti annorum erat quando mortuus est : non caligavit oculus ejus, nec dentes illius moti sunt.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:8
verses.text: Fleveruntque eum filii Israël in campestribus Moab triginta diebus : et completi sunt dies planctus lugentium Moysen.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:9
verses.text: Josue vero filius Nun repletus est spiritu sapientiæ, quia Moyses posuit super eum manus suas. Et obedierunt ei filii Israël, feceruntque sicut præcepit Dominus Moysi.

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:10
verses.text: Et non surrexit ultra propheta in Israël sicut Moyses, quem nosset Dominus facie ad faciem,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:11
verses.text: in omnibus signis atque portentis, quæ misit per eum, ut faceret in terra Ægypti Pharaoni, et omnibus servis ejus, universæque terræ illius,

verses.name: Deuteronomy 34:12
verses.text: et cunctam manum robustam, magnaque mirabilia, quæ fecit Moyses coram universo Israël.  <div eID="gen1057" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="Deut.34"/> <div eID="gen711" osisID="Deut" type="book"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:1
verses.text: Et factum est post mortem Moysi servi Domini, ut loqueretur Dominus ad Josue filium Nun, ministrum Moysi, et diceret ei :

verses.name: Joshua 1:2
verses.text: Moyses servus meus mortuus est : surge, et transi Jordanem istum tu, et omnis populus tecum, in terram quam ego dabo filiis Israël.

verses.name: Joshua 1:3
verses.text: Omnem locum, quem calcaverit vestigium pedis vestri, vobis tradam, sicut locutus sum Moysi.

verses.name: Joshua 1:4
verses.text: A deserto et Libano usque ad fluvium magnum Euphraten, omnis terra Hethæorum usque ad mare magnum contra solis occasum erit terminus vester.

verses.name: Joshua 1:5
verses.text: Nullus poterit vobis resistere cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ : sicut fui cum Moyse, ita ero tecum : non dimittam, nec derelinquam te.

verses.name: Joshua 1:6
verses.text: Confortare, et esto robustus : tu enim sorte divides populo huic terram, pro qua juravi patribus suis, ut traderem eam illis.

verses.name: Joshua 1:7
verses.text: Confortare igitur, et esto robustus valde, ut custodias, et facias omnem legem, quam præcepit tibi Moyses servus meus : ne declines ab ea ad dexteram vel ad sinistram, ut intelligas cuncta quæ agis.

verses.name: Joshua 1:8
verses.text: Non recedat volumen legis hujus ab ore tuo : sed meditaberis in eo diebus ac noctibus, ut custodias et facias omnia quæ scripta sunt in eo : tunc diriges viam tuam, et intelliges eam.

verses.name: Joshua 1:9
verses.text: Ecce præcipio tibi : confortare, et esto robustus. Noli metuere, et noli timere : quoniam tecum est Dominus Deus tuus in omnibus ad quæcumque perrexeris.  <div eID="gen1059" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv486"/><div sID="gen1060" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv486"/>Præcepitque Josue principibus populi, dicens : Transite per medium castrorum, et imperate populo, ac dicite :

verses.name: Joshua 1:11
verses.text: Præparate vobis cibaria : quoniam post diem tertium transibitis Jordanem, et intrabitis ad possidendam terram quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est vobis.

verses.name: Joshua 1:12
verses.text: Rubenitis quoque et Gaditis, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse, ait :

verses.name: Joshua 1:13
verses.text: Mementote sermonis, quem præcepit vobis Moyses famulus Domini, dicens : Dominus Deus vester dedit vobis requiem, et omnem terram.

verses.name: Joshua 1:14
verses.text: Uxores vestræ, et filii, ac jumenta manebunt in terra, quam tradidit vobis Moyses trans Jordanem : vos autem transite armati ante fratres vestros, omnes fortes manu, et pugnate pro eis,

verses.name: Joshua 1:15
verses.text: donec det Dominus requiem fratribus vestris sicut et vobis dedit, et possideant ipsi quoque terram quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est eis : et sic revertimini in terram possessionis vestræ, et habitabitis in ea, quam vobis dedit Moyses famulus Domini trans Jordanem contra solis ortum.  <div eID="gen1060" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv487"/><div sID="gen1061" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv487"/>Responderuntque ad Josue, atque dixerunt : Omnia quæ præcepisti nobis, faciemus : et quocumque miseris, ibimus.

verses.name: Joshua 1:17
verses.text: Sicut obedivimus in cunctis Moysi, ita obediemus et tibi : tantum sit Dominus Deus tuus tecum, sicut fuit cum Moyse.

verses.name: Joshua 1:18
verses.text: Qui contradixerit ori tuo, et non obedierit cunctis sermonibus, quos præceperis ei, moriatur. Tu tantum confortare, et viriliter age.  <chapter eID="Josh.1"/> <div eID="gen1061" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:1
verses.text: Misit igitur Josue filius Nun de Setim duos viros exploratores in abscondito : et dixit eis : Ite, et considerate terram, urbemque Jericho. Qui pergentes ingressi sunt domum mulieris meretricis, nomine Rahab, et quieverunt apud eam.

verses.name: Joshua 2:2
verses.text: Nuntiatumque est regi Jericho, et dictum : Ecce viri ingressi sunt huc per noctem de filiis Israël, ut explorarent terram.

verses.name: Joshua 2:3
verses.text: Misitque rex Jericho ad Rahab, dicens : Educ viros, qui venerunt ad te, et ingressi sunt domum tuam : exploratores quippe sunt, et omnem terram considerare venerunt.

verses.name: Joshua 2:4
verses.text: Tollensque mulier viros, abscondit, et ait : Fateor, venerunt ad me, sed nesciebam unde essent :

verses.name: Joshua 2:5
verses.text: cumque porta clauderetur in tenebris, et illi pariter exierunt ; nescio quo abierunt : persequimini cito, et comprehendetis eos.

verses.name: Joshua 2:6
verses.text: Ipsa autem fecit ascendere viros in solarium domus suæ, operuitque eos stipula lini, quæ ibi erat.

verses.name: Joshua 2:7
verses.text: Hi autem, qui missi fuerant, secuti sunt eos per viam, quæ ducit ad vadum Jordanis : illisque egressis statim porta clausa est.  <div eID="gen1062" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv488"/><div sID="gen1063" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv488"/>Necdum obdormierant qui latebant, et ecce mulier ascendit ad eos, et ait :

verses.name: Joshua 2:9
verses.text: Novi quod Dominus tradiderit vobis terram : etenim irruit in nos terror vester, et elanguerunt omnes habitatores terræ.

verses.name: Joshua 2:10
verses.text: Audivimus quod siccaverit Dominus aquas maris Rubri ad vestrum introitum, quando egressi estis ex Ægypto : et quæ feceritis duobus Amorrhæorum regibus, qui erant trans Jordanem, Sehon et Og, quos interfecistis.

verses.name: Joshua 2:11
verses.text: Et hæc audientes pertimuimus, et elanguit cor nostrum, nec remansit in nobis spiritus ad introitum vestrum : Dominus enim Deus vester ipse est Deus in cælo sursum et in terra deorsum.

verses.name: Joshua 2:12
verses.text: Nunc ergo jurate mihi per Dominum, ut quomodo ego misericordiam feci vobiscum, ita et vos faciatis cum domo patris mei : detisque mihi verum signum,

verses.name: Joshua 2:13
verses.text: ut salvetis patrem meum et matrem, et fratres ac sorores meas, et omnia quæ illorum sunt, et eruatis animas nostras a morte.

verses.name: Joshua 2:14
verses.text: Qui responderunt ei : Anima nostra sit pro vobis in mortem, si tamen non prodideris nos : cumque tradiderit nobis Dominus terram, faciemus in te misericordiam et veritatem.

verses.name: Joshua 2:15
verses.text: Demisit ergo eos per funem de fenestra : domus enim ejus hærebat muro.

verses.name: Joshua 2:16
verses.text: Dixitque ad eos : Ad montana conscendite, ne forte occurrant vobis revertentes : ibique latitate tribus diebus, donec redeant, et sic ibitis per viam vestram.

verses.name: Joshua 2:17
verses.text: Qui dixerunt ad eam : Innoxii erimus a juramento hoc, quo adjurasti nos :

verses.name: Joshua 2:18
verses.text: si ingredientibus nobis terram, signum fuerit funiculus iste coccineus, et ligaveris eum in fenestra, per quam demisisti nos : et patrem tuum ac matrem, fratresque et omnem cognationem tuam congregaveris in domum tuam.

verses.name: Joshua 2:19
verses.text: Qui ostium domus tuæ egressus fuerit, sanguis ipsius erit in caput ejus, et nos erimus alieni. Cunctorum autem sanguis, qui tecum in domo fuerint, redundabit in caput nostrum, si eos aliquis tetigerit.

verses.name: Joshua 2:20
verses.text: Quod si nos prodere volueris, et sermonem istum proferre in medium, erimus mundi ab hoc juramento, quo adjurasti nos.

verses.name: Joshua 2:21
verses.text: Et illa respondit : Sicut locuti estis, ita fiat : dimittensque eos ut pergerent, appendit funiculum coccineum in fenestra.  <div eID="gen1063" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv489"/><div sID="gen1064" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv489"/>Illi vero ambulantes pervenerunt ad montana, et manserunt ibi tres dies, donec reverterentur qui fuerant persecuti : quærentes enim per omnem viam, non repererunt eos.

verses.name: Joshua 2:23
verses.text: Quibus urbem ingressis, reversi sunt, et descenderunt exploratores de monte : et, transmisso Jordane, venerunt ad Josue filium Nun, narraveruntque ei omnia quæ acciderant sibi,

verses.name: Joshua 2:24
verses.text: atque dixerunt : Tradidit Dominus omnem terram hanc in manus nostras, et timore prostrati sunt cuncti habitatores ejus.  <chapter eID="Josh.2"/> <div eID="gen1064" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:1
verses.text: Igitur Josue de nocte consurgens movit castra : egredientesque de Setim, venerunt ad Jordanem ipse et omnes filii Israël, et morati sunt ibi tres dies.

verses.name: Joshua 3:2
verses.text: Quibus evolutis transierunt præcones per castrorum medium,

verses.name: Joshua 3:3
verses.text: et clamare cœperunt : Quando videritis arcam fœderis Domini Dei vestri, et sacerdotes stirpis Leviticæ portantes eam, vos quoque consurgite, et sequimini præcedentes :

verses.name: Joshua 3:4
verses.text: sitque inter vos et arcam spatium cubitorum duum millium : ut procul videre possitis, et nosse per quam viam ingrediamini : quia prius non ambulastis per eam : et cavete ne appropinquetis ad arcam.

verses.name: Joshua 3:5
verses.text: Dixitque Josue ad populum : Sanctificamini : cras enim faciet Dominus inter vos mirabilia.

verses.name: Joshua 3:6
verses.text: Et ait ad sacerdotes : Tollite arcam fœderis, et præcedite populum. Qui jussa complentes, tulerunt, et ambulaverunt ante eos.

verses.name: Joshua 3:7
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Hodie incipiam exaltare te coram omni Israël : ut sciant quod sicut cum Moyse fui, ita et tecum sim.

verses.name: Joshua 3:8
verses.text: Tu autem præcipe sacerdotibus, qui portant arcam fœderis, et dic eis : Cum ingressi fueritis partem aquæ Jordanis, state in ea.

verses.name: Joshua 3:9
verses.text: Dixitque Josue ad filios Israël : Accedite huc, et audite verbum Domini Dei vestri.

verses.name: Joshua 3:10
verses.text: Et rursum : In hoc, inquit, scietis quod Dominus Deus vivens in medio vestri est, et disperdet in conspectu vestro Chananæum et Hethæum, Hevæum et Pherezæum, Gergesæum quoque et Jebusæum, et Amorrhæum.

verses.name: Joshua 3:11
verses.text: Ecce arca fœderis Domini omnis terræ antecedet vos per Jordanem.

verses.name: Joshua 3:12
verses.text: Parate duodecim viros de tribubus Israël, singulos per singulas tribus.

verses.name: Joshua 3:13
verses.text: Et cum posuerint vestigia pedum suorum sacerdotes qui portant arcam Domini Dei universæ terræ in aquis Jordanis, aquæ quæ inferiores sunt, decurrent atque deficient : quæ autem desuper veniunt, in una mole consistent.  <div eID="gen1065" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv490"/><div sID="gen1066" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv490"/>Igitur egressus est populus de tabernaculis suis, ut transiret Jordanem : et sacerdotes, qui portabant arcam fœderis, pergebant ante eum.

verses.name: Joshua 3:15
verses.text: Ingressisque eis Jordanem, et pedibus eorum in parte aquæ tinctis (Jordanis autem ripas alvei sui tempore messis impleverat),

verses.name: Joshua 3:16
verses.text: steterunt aquæ descendentes in loco uno, et ad instar montis intumescentes apparebant procul, ab urbe quæ vocatur Adom usque ad locum Sarthan : quæ autem inferiores erant, in mare Solitudinis (quod nunc vocatur Mortuum) descenderunt, usquequo omnino deficerent.

verses.name: Joshua 3:17
verses.text: Populus autem incedebat contra Jericho : et sacerdotes qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, stabant super siccam humum in medio Jordanis accincti, omnisque populus per arentem alveum transibat.  <chapter eID="Josh.3"/> <div eID="gen1066" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:1
verses.text: Quibus transgressis, dixit Dominus ad Josue :

verses.name: Joshua 4:2
verses.text: Elige duodecim viros singulos per singulas tribus :

verses.name: Joshua 4:3
verses.text: et præcipe eis ut tollant de medio Jordanis alveo, ubi steterunt pedes sacerdotum, duodecim durissimos lapides, quos ponetis in loco castrorum, ubi fixeritis hac nocte tentoria.

verses.name: Joshua 4:4
verses.text: Vocavitque Josue duodecim viros, quos elegerat de filiis Israël, singulos de singulis tribubus,

verses.name: Joshua 4:5
verses.text: et ait ad eos : Ite ante arcam Domini Dei vestri ad Jordanis medium, et portate inde singuli singulos lapides in humeris vestris, juxta numerum filiorum Israël,

verses.name: Joshua 4:6
verses.text: ut sit signum inter vos : et quando interrogaverint vos filii vestri cras, dicentes : Quid sibi volunt isti lapides ?

verses.name: Joshua 4:7
verses.text: respondebitis eis : Defecerunt aquæ Jordanis ante arcam fœderis Domini, cum transiret eum : idcirco positi sunt lapides isti in monimentum filiorum Israël usque in æternum.

verses.name: Joshua 4:8
verses.text: Fecerunt ergo filii Israël sicut præcepit eis Josue, portantes de medio Jordanis alveo duodecim lapides, ut Dominus ei imperarat, juxta numerum filiorum Israël, usque ad locum in quo castrametati sunt, ibique posuerunt eos.

verses.name: Joshua 4:9
verses.text: Alios quoque duodecim lapides posuit Josue in medio Jordanis alveo, ubi steterunt sacerdotes qui portabant arcam fœderis : et sunt ibi usque in præsentem diem.  <div eID="gen1067" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv491"/><div sID="gen1068" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv491"/>Sacerdotes autem qui portabant arcam, stabant in Jordanis medio, donec omnia complerentur, quæ Josue, ut loqueretur ad populum, præceperat Dominus, et dixerat ei Moyses. Festinavitque populus, et transiit.

verses.name: Joshua 4:11
verses.text: Cumque transissent omnes, transivit et arca Domini, sacerdotesque pergebant ante populum.

verses.name: Joshua 4:12
verses.text: Filii quoque Ruben, et Gad, et dimidia tribus Manasse, armati præcedebant filios Israël, sicut eis præceperat Moyses :

verses.name: Joshua 4:13
verses.text: et quadraginta pugnatorum millia per turmas, et cuneos, incedebant per plana atque campestria urbis Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 4:14
verses.text: In die illo magnificavit Dominus Josue coram omni Israël, ut timerent eum, sicut timuerant Moysen, dum adviveret.

verses.name: Joshua 4:15
verses.text: Dixitque ad eum :

verses.name: Joshua 4:16
verses.text: Præcipe sacerdotibus, qui portant arcam fœderis, ut ascendant de Jordane.

verses.name: Joshua 4:17
verses.text: Qui præcepit eis, dicens : Ascendite de Jordane.

verses.name: Joshua 4:18
verses.text: Cumque ascendissent portantes arcam fœderis Domini, et siccam humum calcare cœpissent, reversæ sunt aquæ in alveum suum, et fluebant sicut ante consueverant.  <div eID="gen1068" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv492"/><div sID="gen1069" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv492"/>Populus autem ascendit de Jordane decimo die mensis primi, et castrametati sunt in Galgalis contra orientalem plagam urbis Jericho.

verses.name: Joshua 4:20
verses.text: Duodecim quoque lapides, quos de Jordanis alveo sumpserant, posuit Josue in Galgalis,

verses.name: Joshua 4:21
verses.text: et dixit ad filios Israël : Quando interrogaverint filii vestri cras patres suos, et dixerint eis : Quid sibi volunt lapides isti ?

verses.name: Joshua 4:22
verses.text: docebitis eos, atque dicetis : Per arentem alveum transivit Israël Jordanem istum,

verses.name: Joshua 4:23
verses.text: siccante Domino Deo vestro aquas ejus in conspectu vestro, donec transiretis,

verses.name: Joshua 4:24
verses.text: sicut fecerat prius in mari Rubro, quod siccavit donec transiremus :

verses.name: Joshua 4:25
verses.text: ut discant omnes terrarum populi fortissimam Domini manum, ut et vos timeatis Dominum Deum vestrum omni tempore.  <chapter eID="Josh.4"/> <div eID="gen1069" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:1
verses.text: Postquam ergo audierunt omnes reges Amorrhæorum, qui habitabant trans Jordanem ad occidentalem plagam, et cuncti reges Chanaan, qui propinqua possidebant magni maris loca, quod siccasset Dominus fluenta Jordanis coram filiis Israël donec transirent, dissolutum est cor eorum, et non remansit in eis spiritus, timentium introitum filiorum Israël.  <div eID="gen1070" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv493"/><div sID="gen1071" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv493"/>Eo tempore ait Dominus ad Josue : Fac tibi cultros lapideos, et circumcide secundo filios Israël.

verses.name: Joshua 5:3
verses.text: Fecit quod jusserat Dominus, et circumcidit filios Israël in colle præputiorum.

verses.name: Joshua 5:4
verses.text: Hæc autem causa est secundæ circumcisionis : omnis populus, qui egressus est de Ægypto generis masculini, universi bellatores viri, mortui sunt in deserto per longissimos viæ circuitus,

verses.name: Joshua 5:5
verses.text: qui omnes circumcisi erant. Populus autem qui natus est in deserto,

verses.name: Joshua 5:6
verses.text: per quadraginta annos itineris latissimæ solitudinis incircumcisus fuit : donec consumerentur qui non audierant vocem Domini, et quibus ante juraverat ut non ostenderet eis terram lacte et melle manantem.

verses.name: Joshua 5:7
verses.text: Horum filii in locum successerunt patrum, et circumcisi sunt a Josue : quia sicut nati fuerant, in præputio erant, nec eos in via aliquis circumciderat.

verses.name: Joshua 5:8
verses.text: Postquam autem omnes circumcisi sunt, manserunt in eodem castrorum loco, donec sanarentur.

verses.name: Joshua 5:9
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Hodie abstuli opprobrium Ægypti a vobis. Vocatumque est nomen loci illius Galgala, usque in præsentem diem.  <div eID="gen1071" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv494"/><div sID="gen1072" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv494"/>Manseruntque filii Israël in Galgalis, et fecerunt Phase quartadecima die mensis ad vesperum in campestribus Jericho :

verses.name: Joshua 5:11
verses.text: et comederunt de frugibus terræ die altero, azymos panes, et polentam ejusdem anni.

verses.name: Joshua 5:12
verses.text: Defecitque manna postquam comederunt de frugibus terræ, nec usi sunt ultra cibo illo filii Israël, sed comederunt de frugibus præsentis anni terræ Chanaan.  <div eID="gen1072" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv495"/><div sID="gen1073" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv495"/>Cum autem esset Josue in agro urbis Jericho, levavit oculos, et vidit virum stantem contra se, evaginatum tenentem gladium : perrexitque ad eum, et ait : Noster es, an adversariorum ?

verses.name: Joshua 5:14
verses.text: Qui respondit : Nequaquam : sed sum princeps exercitus Domini, et nunc venio.

verses.name: Joshua 5:15
verses.text: Cecidit Josue pronus in terram, et adorans ait : Quid dominus meus loquitur ad servum suum ?

verses.name: Joshua 5:16
verses.text: Solve, inquit, calceamentum tuum de pedibus tuis : locus enim, in quo stas, sanctus est. Fecitque Josue ut sibi fuerat imperatum.  <chapter eID="Josh.5"/> <div eID="gen1073" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:1
verses.text: Jericho autem clausa erat atque munita, timore filiorum Israël, et nullus egredi audebat aut ingredi.

verses.name: Joshua 6:2
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Ecce dedi in manu tua Jericho, et regem ejus, omnesque fortes viros.

verses.name: Joshua 6:3
verses.text: Circuite urbem cuncti bellatores semel per diem : sic facietis sex diebus.

verses.name: Joshua 6:4
verses.text: Septimo autem die, sacerdotes tollant septem buccinas, quarum usus est in jubilæo, et præcedant arcam fœderis : septiesque circuibitis civitatem, et sacerdotes clangent buccinis.

verses.name: Joshua 6:5
verses.text: Cumque insonuerit vox tubæ longior atque concisior, et in auribus vestris increpuerit, conclamabit omnis populus vociferatione maxima, et muri funditus corruent civitatis, ingredienturque singuli per locum contra quem steterint.

verses.name: Joshua 6:6
verses.text: Vocavit ergo Josue filius Nun sacerdotes, et dixit ad eos : Tollite arcam fœderis : et septem alii sacerdotes tollant septem jubilæorum buccinas, et incedant ante arcam Domini.

verses.name: Joshua 6:7
verses.text: Ad populum quoque ait : Ite, et circuite civitatem, armati, præcedentes arcam Domini.  <div eID="gen1074" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv496"/><div sID="gen1075" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv496"/>Cumque Josue verba finisset, et septem sacerdotes septem buccinis clangerent ante arcam fœderis Domini,

verses.name: Joshua 6:9
verses.text: omnisque præcederet armatus exercitus, reliquum vulgus arcam sequebatur, ac buccinis omnia concrepabant.

verses.name: Joshua 6:10
verses.text: Præceperat autem Josue populo, dicens : Non clamabitis, nec audietur vox vestra, neque ullus sermo ex ore vestro egredietur, donec veniat dies in quo dicam vobis : Clamate, et vociferamini.

verses.name: Joshua 6:11
verses.text: Circuivit ergo arca Domini civitatem semel per diem, et reversa in castra mansit ibi.

verses.name: Joshua 6:12
verses.text: Igitur Josue de nocte consurgente, tulerunt sacerdotes arcam Domini,

verses.name: Joshua 6:13
verses.text: et septem ex eis septem buccinas, quarum in jubilæo usus est : præcedebantque arcam Domini ambulantes atque clangentes : et armatus populus ibat ante eos, vulgus autem reliquum sequebatur arcam, et buccinis personabat.

verses.name: Joshua 6:14
verses.text: Circuieruntque civitatem secundo die semel, et reversi sunt in castra. Sic fecerunt sex diebus.  <div eID="gen1075" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv497"/><div sID="gen1076" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv497"/>Dies autem septimo, diluculo consurgentes, circuierunt urbem, sicut dispositum erat, septies.

verses.name: Joshua 6:16
verses.text: Cumque septimo circuitu clangerent buccinis sacerdotes, dixit Josue ad omnem Israël : Vociferamini : tradidit enim vobis Dominus civitatem.

verses.name: Joshua 6:17
verses.text: Sitque civitas hæc anathema, et omnia quæ in ea sunt, Domino : sola Rahab meretrix vivat, cum universis qui cum ea in domo sunt : abscondit enim nuntios quos direximus.

verses.name: Joshua 6:18
verses.text: Vos autem cavete ne de his, quæ præcepta sunt, quippiam contingatis, et sitis prævaricationis rei, et omnia castra Israël sub peccato sint atque turbentur.

verses.name: Joshua 6:19
verses.text: Quidquid autem auri et argenti fuerit, et vasorum æneorum ac ferri, Domino consecretur, repositum in thesauris ejus.

verses.name: Joshua 6:20
verses.text: Igitur omni populo vociferante, et clangentibus tubis, postquam in aures multitudinis vox sonitusque increpuit, muri illico corruerunt : et ascendit unusquisque per locum qui contra se erat : ceperuntque civitatem,

verses.name: Joshua 6:21
verses.text: et interfecerunt omnia quæ erant in ea, a viro usque ad mulierem, ab infante usque ad senem. Boves quoque et oves et asinos in ore gladii percusserunt.  <div eID="gen1076" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv498"/><div sID="gen1077" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv498"/>Duobus autem viris, qui exploratores missi fuerant, dixit Josue : Ingredimini domum mulieris meretricis, et producite eam, et omnia quæ illius sunt, sicut illi juramento firmastis.

verses.name: Joshua 6:23
verses.text: Ingressique juvenes eduxerunt Rahab, et parentes ejus, fratres quoque, et cunctam supellectilem ac cognationem illius, et extra castra Israël manere fecerunt.

verses.name: Joshua 6:24
verses.text: Urbem autem, et omnia quæ erant in ea, succenderunt, absque auro et argento, et vasis æneis, ac ferro, quæ in ærarium Domini consecrarunt.

verses.name: Joshua 6:25
verses.text: Rahab vero meretricem, et domum patris ejus, et omnia quæ habebat, fecit Josue vivere, et habitaverunt in medio Israël, usque in præsentem diem : eo quod absconderit nuntios, quos miserat ut explorarent Jericho. In tempore illo, imprecatus est Josue, dicens :

verses.name: Joshua 6:26
verses.text: Maledictus vir coram Domino, qui suscitaverit et ædificaverit civitatem Jericho. In primogenito suo fundamenta illius jaciat, et in novissimo liberorum ponat portas ejus.

verses.name: Joshua 6:27
verses.text: Fuit ergo Dominus cum Josue, et nomen ejus vulgatum est in omni terra.  <chapter eID="Josh.6"/> <div eID="gen1077" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:1
verses.text: Filii autem Israël prævaricati sunt mandatum, et usurpaverunt de anathemate. Nam Achan filius Charmi filii Zabdi filii Zare de tribu Juda tulit aliquid de anathemate : iratusque est Dominus contra filios Israël.

verses.name: Joshua 7:2
verses.text: Cumque mitteret Josue de Jericho viros contra Hai, quæ est juxta Bethaven, ad orientalem plagam oppidi Bethel, dixit eis : Ascendite, et explorate terram. Qui præcepta complentes exploraverunt Hai.

verses.name: Joshua 7:3
verses.text: Et reversi dixerunt ei : Non ascendat omnis populus, sed duo vel tria millia virorum pergant, et deleant civitatem : quare omnis populus frustra vexabitur contra hostes paucissimos ?

verses.name: Joshua 7:4
verses.text: Ascenderunt ergo tria millia pugnatorum. Qui statim terga vertentes,

verses.name: Joshua 7:5
verses.text: percussi sunt a viris urbis Hai, et corruerunt ex eis triginta sex homines : persecutique sunt eos adversarii de porta usque ad Sabarim, et ceciderunt per prona fugientes : pertimuitque cor populi, et instar aquæ liquefactum est.  <div eID="gen1078" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv499"/><div sID="gen1079" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv499"/>Josue vero scidit vestimenta sua, et pronus cecidit in terram coram arca Domini usque ad vesperam, tam ipse quam omnes senes Israël : miseruntque pulverem super capita sua,

verses.name: Joshua 7:7
verses.text: et dixit Josue : Heu Domine Deus, quid voluisti traducere populum istum Jordanem fluvium, ut traderes nos in manus Amorrhæi, et perderes ? utinam ut cœpimus, mansissemus trans Jordanem.

verses.name: Joshua 7:8
verses.text: Mi Domine Deus, quid dicam, videns Israëlem hostibus suis terga vertentem ?

verses.name: Joshua 7:9
verses.text: Audient Chananæi, et omnes habitatores terræ, et pariter conglobati circumdabunt nos, atque delebunt nomen nostrum de terra : et quid facies magno nomini tuo ?  <div eID="gen1079" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv500"/><div sID="gen1080" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv500"/>Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Surge : cur jaces pronus in terra ?

verses.name: Joshua 7:11
verses.text: Peccavit Israël, et prævaricatus est pactum meum : tuleruntque de anathemate, et furati sunt atque mentiti, et absconderunt inter vasa sua.

verses.name: Joshua 7:12
verses.text: Nec poterit Israël stare ante hostes suos, eosque fugiet : quia pollutus est anathemate. Non ero ultra vobiscum, donec conteratis eum qui hujus sceleris reus est.

verses.name: Joshua 7:13
verses.text: Surge, sanctifica populum, et dic eis : Sanctificamini in crastinum : hæc enim dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Anathema in medio tui est, Israël : non poteris stare coram hostibus tuis, donec deleatur ex te qui hoc contaminatus est scelere.

verses.name: Joshua 7:14
verses.text: Accedetisque mane singuli per tribus vestras : et quamcumque tribum sors invenerit, accedet per cognationes suas, et cognatio per domos, domusque per viros.

verses.name: Joshua 7:15
verses.text: Et quicumque ille in hoc facinore fuerit deprehensus, comburetur igni cum omni substantia sua : quoniam prævaricatus est pactum Domini, et fecit nefas in Israël.  <div eID="gen1080" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv501"/><div sID="gen1081" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv501"/>Surgens itaque Josue mane, applicuit Israël per tribus suas, et inventa est tribus Juda.

verses.name: Joshua 7:17
verses.text: Quæ cum juxta familias suas esset oblata, inventa est familia Zare. Illam quoque per domos offerens, reperit Zabdi :

verses.name: Joshua 7:18
verses.text: cujus domum in singulos dividens viros, invenit Achan filium Charmi filii Zabdi filii Zare de tribu Juda.

verses.name: Joshua 7:19
verses.text: Et ait Josue ad Achan : Fili mi, da gloriam Domino Deo Israël, et confitere, atque indica mihi quid feceris, ne abscondas.

verses.name: Joshua 7:20
verses.text: Responditque Achan Josue, et dixit ei : Vere ego peccavi Domino Deo Israël, et sic et sic feci.

verses.name: Joshua 7:21
verses.text: Vidi enim inter spolia pallium coccineum valde bonum, et ducentos siclos argenti, regulamque auream quinquaginta siclorum : et concupiscens abstuli, et abscondi in terra contra medium tabernaculi mei, argentumque fossa humo operui.

verses.name: Joshua 7:22
verses.text: Misit ergo Josue ministros : qui currentes ad tabernaculum illius, repererunt cuncta abscondita in eodem loco, et argentum simul.

verses.name: Joshua 7:23
verses.text: Auferentesque de tentorio, tulerunt ea ad Josue, et ad omnes filios Israël, projeceruntque ante Dominum.

verses.name: Joshua 7:24
verses.text: Tollens itaque Josue Achan filium Zare, argentumque et pallium, et auream regulam, filios quoque et filias ejus, boves et asinos et oves, ipsumque tabernaculum, et cunctam supellectilem (et omnis Israël cum eo), duxerunt eos ad vallem Achor :

verses.name: Joshua 7:25
verses.text: ubi dixit Josue : Quia turbasti nos, exturbet te Dominus in die hac. Lapidavitque eum omnis Israël : et cuncta quæ illius erant, igne consumpta sunt.

verses.name: Joshua 7:26
verses.text: Congregaveruntque super eum acervum magnum lapidum, qui permanet usque in præsentem diem. Et aversus est furor Domini ab eis. Vocatumque est nomen loci illius, vallis Achor, usque hodie.  <chapter eID="Josh.7"/> <div eID="gen1081" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:1
verses.text: Dixit autem Dominus ad Josue : Ne timeas, neque formides : tolle tecum omnem multitudinem pugnatorum, et consurgens ascende in oppidum Hai. Ecce tradidi in manu tua regem ejus et populum, urbemque et terram.

verses.name: Joshua 8:2
verses.text: Faciesque urbi Hai, et regi ejus, sicut fecisti Jericho, et regi illius : prædam vero, et omnia animantia diripietis vobis : pone insidias urbi post eam.

verses.name: Joshua 8:3
verses.text: Surrexitque Josue, et omnis exercitus bellatorum cum eo, ut ascenderent in Hai : et electa triginta millia virorum fortium misit nocte,

verses.name: Joshua 8:4
verses.text: præcepitque eis, dicens : Ponite insidias post civitatem, nec longius recedatis : et eritis omnes parati.

verses.name: Joshua 8:5
verses.text: Ego autem, et reliqua multitudo, quæ mecum est, accedemus ex adverso contra urbem. Cumque exierint contra nos, sicut ante fecimus, fugiemus, et terga vertemus,

verses.name: Joshua 8:6
verses.text: donec persequentes ab urbe longius protrahantur : putabunt enim nos fugere sicut prius.

verses.name: Joshua 8:7
verses.text: Nobis ergo fugientibus, et illis persequentibus, consurgetis de insidiis, et vastabitis civitatem : tradetque eam Dominus Deus vester in manus vestras.

verses.name: Joshua 8:8
verses.text: Cumque ceperitis, succendite eam, et sic omnia facietis, ut jussi.  <div eID="gen1082" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv502"/><div sID="gen1083" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv502"/>Dimisitque eos, et perrexerunt ad locum insidiarum, sederuntque inter Bethel et Hai, ad occidentalem plagam urbis Hai : Josue autem nocte illa in medio mansit populi,

verses.name: Joshua 8:10
verses.text: surgensque diluculo recensuit socios, et ascendit cum senioribus in fronte exercitus, vallatus auxilio pugnatorum.

verses.name: Joshua 8:11
verses.text: Cumque venissent et ascendissent ex adverso civitatis, steterunt ad septentrionalem urbis plagam, inter quam et eos erat vallis media.

verses.name: Joshua 8:12
verses.text: Quinque autem millia viros elegerat, et posuerat in insidiis inter Bethel et Hai ex occidentali parte ejusdem civitatis :

verses.name: Joshua 8:13
verses.text: omnis vero reliquus exercitus ad aquilonem aciem dirigebat, ita ut novissimi illius multitudinis occidentalem plagam urbis attingerent. Abiit ergo Josue nocte illa, et stetit in vallis medio.  <div eID="gen1083" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv503"/><div sID="gen1084" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv503"/>Quod cum vidisset rex Hai, festinavit mane, et egressus est cum omni exercitu civitatis, direxitque aciem contra desertum, ignorans quod post tergum laterent insidiæ.

verses.name: Joshua 8:15
verses.text: Josue vero et omnis Israël cesserunt loco, simulantes metum, et fugientes per solitudinis viam.

verses.name: Joshua 8:16
verses.text: At illi vociferantes pariter, et se mutuo cohortantes, persecuti sunt eos. Cumque recessissent a civitate,

verses.name: Joshua 8:17
verses.text: et ne unus quidem in urbe Hai et Bethel remansisset qui non persequeretur Israël (sicut eruperant aperta oppida relinquentes),

verses.name: Joshua 8:18
verses.text: dixit Dominus ad Josue : Leva clypeum, qui in manu tua est, contra urbem Hai, quoniam tibi tradam eam.

verses.name: Joshua 8:19
verses.text: Cumque elevasset clypeum ex adverso civitatis, insidiæ, quæ latebant, surrexerunt confestim : et pergentes ad civitatem, ceperunt, et succenderunt eam.

verses.name: Joshua 8:20
verses.text: Viri autem civitatis, qui persequebantur Josue, respicientes et videntes fumum urbis ad cælum usque conscendere, non potuerunt ultra huc illucque diffugere : præsertim cum hi qui simulaverant fugam, et tendebant ad solitudinem, contra persequentes fortissime restitissent.

verses.name: Joshua 8:21
verses.text: Vidensque Josue et omnis Israël quod capta esset civitas, et fumus urbis ascenderet, reversus percussit viros Hai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:22
verses.text: Siquidem et illi qui ceperant et succenderant civitatem, egressi ex urbe contra suos, medios hostium ferire cœperunt. Cum ergo ex utraque parte adversarii cæderentur, ita ut nullus de tanta multitudine salvaretur,

verses.name: Joshua 8:23
verses.text: regem quoque urbis Hai apprehenderunt viventem, et obtulerunt Josue.  <div eID="gen1084" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv504"/><div sID="gen1085" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv504"/>Igitur omnibus interfectis, qui Israëlem ad deserta tendentem fuerant persecuti, et in eodem loco gladio corruentibus, reversi filii Israël percusserunt civitatem.

verses.name: Joshua 8:25
verses.text: Erant autem qui in eodem die conciderant a viro usque ad mulierem, duodecim millia hominum, omnes urbis Hai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:26
verses.text: Josue vero non contraxit manum, quam in sublime porrexerat, tenens clypeum donec interficerentur omnes habitatores Hai.

verses.name: Joshua 8:27
verses.text: Jumenta autem et prædam civitatis diviserunt sibi filii Israël, sicut præceperat Dominus Josue.

verses.name: Joshua 8:28
verses.text: Qui succendit urbem, et fecit eam tumulum sempiternum :

verses.name: Joshua 8:29
verses.text: regem quoque ejus suspendit in patibulo usque ad vesperam et solis occasum. Præcepitque Josue, et deposuerunt cadaver ejus de cruce : projeceruntque in ipso introitu civitatis, congesto super eum magno acervo lapidum, qui permanet usque in præsentem diem.  <div eID="gen1085" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv505"/><div sID="gen1086" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv505"/>Tunc ædificavit Josue altare Domino Deo Israël in monte Hebal,

verses.name: Joshua 8:31
verses.text: sicut præceperat Moyses famulus Domini filiis Israël, et scriptum est in volumine legis Moysi : altare vero de lapidibus impolitis, quos ferrum non tetigit : et obtulit super eo holocausta Domino, immolavitque pacificas victimas.

verses.name: Joshua 8:32
verses.text: Et scripsit super lapides Deuteronomium legis Moysi, quod ille digesserat coram filiis Israël.

verses.name: Joshua 8:33
verses.text: Omnis autem populus, et majores natu, ducesque ac judices, stabant ex utraque parte arcæ, in conspectu sacerdotum qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, ut advena, ita et indigena. Media pars eorum juxta montem Garizim, et media juxta montem Hebal, sicut præceperat Moyses famulus Domini. Et primum quidem benedixit populo Israël.

verses.name: Joshua 8:34
verses.text: Post hæc legit omnia verba benedictionis et maledictionis, et cuncta quæ scripta erant in legis volumine.

verses.name: Joshua 8:35
verses.text: Nihil ex his quæ Moyses jusserat, reliquit intactum, sed universa replicavit coram omni multitudine Israël, mulieribus ac parvulis, et advenis qui inter eos morabantur.  <chapter eID="Josh.8"/> <div eID="gen1086" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:1
verses.text: Quibus auditis, cuncti reges trans Jordanem, qui versabantur in montanis et campestribus, in maritimis ac littore magni maris, hi quoque qui habitabant juxta Libanum, Hethæus et Amorrhæus, Chananæus, Pherezæus, et Hevæus, et Jebusæus,

verses.name: Joshua 9:2
verses.text: congregati sunt pariter, ut pugnarent contra Josue et Israël uno animo, eademque sententia.  <div eID="gen1087" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv506"/><div sID="gen1088" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv506"/>At hi qui habitabant in Gabaon, audientes cuncta quæ fecerat Josue Jericho, et Hai,

verses.name: Joshua 9:4
