verses.text: Servivitque Israël Domino cunctis diebus Josue et seniorum, qui longo vixerunt tempore post Josue, et qui noverunt omnia opera Domini quæ fecerat in Israël.  <div eID="gen1137" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joshua 24:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv537"/><div sID="gen1138" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv537"/>Ossa quoque Joseph, quæ tulerant filii Israël de Ægypto, sepelierunt in Sichem, in parte agri quem emerat Jacob a filiis Hemor patris Sichem, centum novellis ovibus, et fuit in possessionem filiorum Joseph.

verses.name: Joshua 24:33
verses.text: Eleazar quoque filius Aaron mortuus est : et sepelierunt eum in Gabaath Phinees filii ejus, quæ data est ei in monte Ephraim.  <div eID="gen1138" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="Josh.24"/> <div eID="gen1058" osisID="Josh" type="book"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:1
verses.text: Post mortem Josue, consuluerunt filii Israël Dominum, dicentes : Quis ascendet ante nos contra Chananæum, et erit dux belli ?

verses.name: Judges 1:2
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus : Judas ascendet : ecce tradidi terram in manus ejus.

verses.name: Judges 1:3
verses.text: Et ait Judas Simeoni fratri suo : Ascende mecum in sortem meam, et pugna contra Chananæum, ut et ego pergam tecum in sortem tuam. Et abiit cum eo Simeon.  <div eID="gen1140" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv538"/><div sID="gen1141" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv538"/>Ascenditque Judas, et tradidit Dominus Chananæum ac Pherezæum in manus eorum : et percusserunt in Bezec decem millia virorum.

verses.name: Judges 1:5
verses.text: Inveneruntque Adonibezec in Bezec, et pugnaverunt contra eum, ac percusserunt Chananæum et Pherezæum.

verses.name: Judges 1:6
verses.text: Fugit autem Adonibezec : quem persecuti comprehenderunt, cæsis summitatibus manuum ejus ac pedum.

verses.name: Judges 1:7
verses.text: Dixitque Adonibezec : Septuaginta reges amputatis manuum ac pedum summitatibus colligebant sub mensa mea ciborum reliquias : sicut feci, ita reddidit mihi Deus. Adduxeruntque eum in Jerusalem, et ibi mortuus est.

verses.name: Judges 1:8
verses.text: Oppugnantes ergo filii Juda Jerusalem, ceperunt eam, et percusserunt in ore gladii, tradentes cunctam incendio civitatem.

verses.name: Judges 1:9
verses.text: Et postea descendentes pugnaverunt contra Chananæum, qui habitabat in montanis, et ad meridiem, et in campestribus.

verses.name: Judges 1:10
verses.text: Pergensque Judas contra Chananæum, qui habitabat in Hebron (cujus nomen fuit antiquitus Cariath Arbe), percussit Sesai, et Ahiman, et Tholmai :

verses.name: Judges 1:11
verses.text: atque inde profectus abiit ad habitatores Dabir, cujus nomen vetus erat Cariath Sepher, id est, civitas litterarum.  <div eID="gen1141" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv539"/><div sID="gen1142" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv539"/>Dixitque Caleb : Qui percusserit Cariath Sepher, et vastaverit eam, dabo ei Axam filiam meam uxorem.

verses.name: Judges 1:13
verses.text: Cumque cepisset eam Othoniel filius Cenez frater Caleb minor, dedit ei Axam filiam suam conjugem.

verses.name: Judges 1:14
verses.text: Quam pergentem in itinere monuit vir suus ut peteret a patre suo agrum. Quæ cum suspirasset sedens in asino, dixit ei Caleb : Quid habes ?

verses.name: Judges 1:15
verses.text: At illa respondit : Da mihi benedictionem, quia terram arentem dedisti mihi : da et irriguam aquis. Dedit ergo ei Caleb irriguum superius, et irriguum inferius.

verses.name: Judges 1:16
verses.text: Filii autem Cinæi cognati Moysi ascenderunt de civitate palmarum cum filiis Juda, in desertum sortis ejus, quod est ad meridiem Arad, et habitaverunt cum eo.

verses.name: Judges 1:17
verses.text: Abiit autem Judas cum Simeone fratre suo, et percusserunt simul Chananæum qui habitabat in Sephaath, et interfecerunt eum. Vocatumque est nomen urbis, Horma, id est, anathema.

verses.name: Judges 1:18
verses.text: Cepitque Judas Gazam cum finibus suis, et Ascalonem, atque Accaron cum terminis suis.

verses.name: Judges 1:19
verses.text: Fuitque Dominus cum Juda, et montana possedit : nec potuit delere habitatores vallis, quia falcatis curribus abundabant.

verses.name: Judges 1:20
verses.text: Dederuntque Caleb Hebron, sicut dixerat Moyses, qui delevit ex ea tres filios Enac.

verses.name: Judges 1:21
verses.text: Jebusæum autem habitatorem Jerusalem non deleverunt filii Benjamin : habitavitque Jebusæus cum filiis Benjamin in Jerusalem, usque in præsentem diem.  <div eID="gen1142" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv540"/><div sID="gen1143" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv540"/>Domus quoque Joseph ascendit in Bethel, fuitque Dominus cum eis.

verses.name: Judges 1:23
verses.text: Nam cum obsiderent urbem, quæ prius Luza vocabatur,

verses.name: Judges 1:24
verses.text: viderunt hominem egredientem de civitate, dixeruntque ad eum : Ostende nobis introitum civitatis, et faciemus tecum misericordiam.

verses.name: Judges 1:25
verses.text: Qui cum ostendisset eis, percusserunt urbem in ore gladii : hominem autem illum, et omnem cognationem ejus, dimiserunt.

verses.name: Judges 1:26
verses.text: Qui dimissus, abiit in terram Hetthim, et ædificavit ibi civitatem, vocavitque eam Luzam : quæ ita appellatur usque in præsentem diem.

verses.name: Judges 1:27
verses.text: Manasses quoque non delevit Bethsan, et Thanac cum viculis suis, et habitatores Dor, et Jeblaam, et Mageddo cum viculis suis, cœpitque Chananæus habitare cum eis.

verses.name: Judges 1:28
verses.text: Postquam autem confortatus est Israël, fecit eos tributarios, et delere noluit.

verses.name: Judges 1:29
verses.text: Ephraim etiam non interfecit Chananæum, qui habitabat in Gazer, sed habitavit cum eo.

verses.name: Judges 1:30
verses.text: Zabulon non delevit habitatores Cetron, et Naalol : sed habitavit Chananæus in medio ejus, factusque est ei tributarius.

verses.name: Judges 1:31
verses.text: Aser quoque non delevit habitatores Accho, et Sidonis, Ahalab, et Achazib, et Helba, et Aphec, et Rohob :

verses.name: Judges 1:32
verses.text: habitavitque in medio Chananæi habitatoris illius terræ, nec interfecit eum.

verses.name: Judges 1:33
verses.text: Nephthali quoque non delevit habitatores Bethsames, et Bethanath : et habitavit inter Chananæum habitatorem terræ, fueruntque ei Bethsamitæ et Bethanitæ tributarii.

verses.name: Judges 1:34
verses.text: Arctavitque Amorrhæus filios Dan in monte, nec dedit eis locum ut ad planiora descenderent :

verses.name: Judges 1:35
verses.text: habitavitque in monte Hares, quod interpretatur testaceo, in Ajalon et Salebim. Et aggravata est manus domus Joseph, factusque est ei tributarius.

verses.name: Judges 1:36
verses.text: Fuit autem terminus Amorrhæi ab ascensu Scorpionis, petra, et superiora loca.  <chapter eID="Judg.1"/> <div eID="gen1143" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:1
verses.text: Ascenditque angelus Domini de Galgalis ad Locum flentium, et ait : Eduxi vos de Ægypto, et introduxi in terram, pro qua juravi patribus vestris : et pollicitus sum ut non facerem irritum pactum meum vobiscum in sempiternum,

verses.name: Judges 2:2
verses.text: ita dumtaxat ut non feriretis fœdus cum habitatoribus terræ hujus, sed aras eorum subverteretis : et noluistis audire vocem meam : cur hoc fecistis ?

verses.name: Judges 2:3
verses.text: Quam ob rem nolui delere eos a facie vestra : ut habeatis hostes, et dii eorum sint vobis in ruinam.

verses.name: Judges 2:4
verses.text: Cumque loqueretur angelus Domini hæc verba ad omnes filios Israël, elevaverunt ipsi vocem suam, et fleverunt.

verses.name: Judges 2:5
verses.text: Et vocatum est nomen loci illius, Locus flentium, sive lacrimarum : immolaveruntque ibi hostias Domini.  <div eID="gen1144" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv541"/><div sID="gen1145" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv541"/>Dimisit ergo Josue populum, et abierunt filii Israël unusquisque in possessionem suam, ut obtinerent eam :

verses.name: Judges 2:7
verses.text: servieruntque Domino cunctis diebus ejus, et seniorum, qui longo post eum vixerunt tempore, et noverant omnia opera Domini quæ fecerat cum Israël.

verses.name: Judges 2:8
verses.text: Mortuus est autem Josue filius Nun, famulus Domini, centum et decem annorum,

verses.name: Judges 2:9
verses.text: et sepelierunt eum in finibus possessionis suæ in Thamnathsare in monte Ephraim, a septentrionali plaga montis Gaas.

verses.name: Judges 2:10
verses.text: Omnisque illa generatio congregata est ad patres suos : et surrexerunt alii, qui non noverant Dominum, et opera quæ fecerat cum Israël.  <div eID="gen1145" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv542"/><div sID="gen1146" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv542"/>Feceruntque filii Israël malum in conspectu Domini, et servierunt Baalim.

verses.name: Judges 2:12
verses.text: Ac dimiserunt Dominum Deum patrum suorum, qui eduxerat eos de terra Ægypti, et secuti sunt deos alienos, deosque populorum, qui habitabant in circuitu eorum, et adoraverunt eos : et ad iracundiam concitaverunt Dominum,

verses.name: Judges 2:13
verses.text: dimittentes eum, et servientes Baal et Astaroth.

verses.name: Judges 2:14
verses.text: Iratusque Dominus contra Israël, tradidit eos in manus diripientium : qui ceperunt eos, et vendiderunt hostibus qui habitabant per gyrum : nec potuerunt resistere adversariis suis,

verses.name: Judges 2:15
verses.text: sed quocumque pergere voluissent, manus Domini super eos erat, sicut locutus est, et juravit eis, et vehementer afflicti sunt.  <div eID="gen1146" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv543"/><div sID="gen1147" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv543"/>Suscitavitque Dominus judices, qui liberarent eos de vastantium manibus : sed nec eos audire voluerunt,

verses.name: Judges 2:17
verses.text: fornicantes cum diis alienis, et adorantes eos. Cito deseruerunt viam, per quam ingressi fuerant patres eorum : et audientes mandata Domini, omnia fecere contraria.

verses.name: Judges 2:18
verses.text: Cumque Dominus judices suscitaret, in diebus eorum flectebatur misericordia, et audiebat afflictorum gemitus, et liberabat eos de cæde vastantium.

verses.name: Judges 2:19
verses.text: Postquam autem mortuus esset judex, revertebantur, et multo faciebant pejora quam fecerant patres eorum, sequentes deos alienos, servientes eis, et adorantes illos. Non dimiserunt adinventiones suas, et viam durissimam per quam ambulare consueverunt.

verses.name: Judges 2:20
verses.text: Iratusque est furor Domini in Israël, et ait : Quia irritum fecit gens ista pactum meum, quod pepigeram cum patribus eorum, et vocem meam audire contempsit :

verses.name: Judges 2:21
verses.text: et ego non delebo gentes, quas dimisit Josue, et mortuus est :

verses.name: Judges 2:22
verses.text: ut in ipsis experiar Israël, utrum custodiant viam Domini, et ambulent in ea, sicut custodierunt patres eorum, an non.

verses.name: Judges 2:23
verses.text: Dimisit ergo Dominus omnes nationes has, et cito subvertere noluit, nec tradidit in manus Josue.  <chapter eID="Judg.2"/> <div eID="gen1147" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:1
verses.text: Hæ sunt gentes quas Dominus dereliquit, ut erudiret in eis Israëlem, et omnes qui non noverant bella Chananæorum :

verses.name: Judges 3:2
verses.text: ut postea discerent filii eorum certare cum hostibus, et habere consuetudinem præliandi :

verses.name: Judges 3:3
verses.text: quinque satrapas Philisthinorum, omnemque Chananæum, et Sidonium, atque Hevæum, qui habitabat in monte Libano, de monte Baal Hermon usque ad introitum Emath.

verses.name: Judges 3:4
verses.text: Dimisitque eos, ut in ipsis experiretur Israëlem, utrum audiret mandata Domini quæ præceperat patribus eorum per manum Moysi, an non.

verses.name: Judges 3:5
verses.text: Itaque filii Israël habitaverunt in medio Chananæi, et Hethæi, et Amorrhæi, et Pherezæi, et Hevæi, et Jebusæi :

verses.name: Judges 3:6
verses.text: et duxerunt uxores filias eorum, ipsique filias suas filiis eorum tradiderunt, et servierunt diis eorum.  <div eID="gen1148" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv544"/><div sID="gen1149" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv544"/>Feceruntque malum in conspectu Domini, et obliti sunt Dei sui, servientes Baalim et Astaroth.

verses.name: Judges 3:8
verses.text: Iratusque contra Israël Dominus, tradidit eos in manus Chusan Rasathaim regis Mesopotamiæ, servieruntque ei octo annis.

verses.name: Judges 3:9
verses.text: Et clamaverunt ad Dominum, qui suscitavit eis salvatorem, et liberavit eos, Othoniel videlicet filium Cenez, fratrem Caleb minorem :

verses.name: Judges 3:10
verses.text: fuitque in eo spiritus Domini, et judicavit Israël. Egressusque est ad pugnam, et tradidit Dominus in manus ejus Chusan Rasathaim regem Syriæ, et oppressit eum.

verses.name: Judges 3:11
verses.text: Quievitque terra quadraginta annis, et mortuus est Othoniel filius Cenez.  <div eID="gen1149" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv545"/><div sID="gen1150" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv545"/>Addiderunt autem filii Israël facere malum in conspectu Domini : qui confortavit adversum eos Eglon regem Moab, quia fecerunt malum in conspectu ejus.

verses.name: Judges 3:13
verses.text: Et copulavit ei filios Ammon, et Amalec : abiitque et percussit Israël, atque possedit urbem palmarum.

verses.name: Judges 3:14
verses.text: Servieruntque filii Israël Eglon regi Moab decem et octo annis.

verses.name: Judges 3:15
verses.text: Et postea clamaverunt ad Dominum, qui suscitavit eis salvatorem vocabulo Aod, filium Gera, filii Jemini, qui utraque manu pro dextera utebatur. Miseruntque filii Israël per illum munera Eglon regi Moab.

verses.name: Judges 3:16
verses.text: Qui fecit sibi gladium ancipitem, habentem in medio capulum longitudinis palmæ manus, et accinctus est eo subter sagum in dextro femore.

verses.name: Judges 3:17
verses.text: Obtulitque munera Eglon regi Moab. Erat autem Eglon crassus nimis.

verses.name: Judges 3:18
verses.text: Cumque obtulisset ei munera, prosecutus est socios, qui cum eo venerant.

verses.name: Judges 3:19
verses.text: Et reversus de Galgalis, ubi erant idola, dixit ad regem : Verbum secretum habeo ad te, o rex. Et ille imperavit silentium : egressisque omnibus qui circa eum erant,

verses.name: Judges 3:20
verses.text: ingressus est Aod ad eum : sedebat autem in æstivo cœnaculo solus : dixitque : Verbum Dei habeo ad te. Qui statim surrexit de throno.

verses.name: Judges 3:21
verses.text: Extenditque Aod sinistram manum, et tulit sicam de dextro femore suo, infixitque eam in ventre ejus

verses.name: Judges 3:22
verses.text: tam valide, ut capulus sequeretur ferrum in vulnere, ac pinguissimo adipe stringeretur. Nec eduxit gladium, sed ita ut percusserat, reliquit in corpore : statimque per secreta naturæ alvi stercora proruperunt.

verses.name: Judges 3:23
verses.text: Aod autem clausis diligentissime ostiis cœnaculi, et obfirmatis sera,

verses.name: Judges 3:24
verses.text: per posticum egressus est. Servique regis ingressi viderunt clausas fores cœnaculi, atque dixerunt : Forsitan purgat alvum in æstivo cubiculo.

verses.name: Judges 3:25
verses.text: Expectantesque diu donec erubescerent, et videntes quod nullus aperiret, tulerunt clavem : et aperientes invenerunt dominum suum in terra jacentem mortuum.  <div eID="gen1150" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv546"/><div sID="gen1151" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv546"/>Aod autem, dum illi turbarentur, effugit, et pertransiit locum idolorum, unde reversus fuerat. Venitque in Seirath :

verses.name: Judges 3:27
verses.text: et statim insonuit buccina in monte Ephraim, descenderuntque cum eo filii Israël, ipso in fronte gradiente.

verses.name: Judges 3:28
verses.text: Qui dixit ad eos : Sequimini me : tradidit enim Dominus inimicos nostros Moabitas in manus nostras. Descenderuntque post eum, et occupaverunt vada Jordanis quæ transmittunt in Moab : et non dimiserunt transire quemquam :

verses.name: Judges 3:29
verses.text: sed percusserunt Moabitas in tempore illo, circiter decem millia, omnes robustos et fortes viros. Nullus eorum evadere potuit.

verses.name: Judges 3:30
verses.text: Humiliatusque est Moab in die illo sub manu Israël : et quievit terra octoginta annis.  <div eID="gen1151" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv547"/><div sID="gen1152" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv547"/>Post hunc fuit Samgar filius Anath, qui percussit de Philisthiim sexcentos viros vomere : et ipse quoque defendit Israël.  <chapter eID="Judg.3"/> <div eID="gen1152" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:1
verses.text: Addideruntque filii Israël facere malum in conspectu Domini post mortem Aod,

verses.name: Judges 4:2
verses.text: et tradidit illos Dominus in manus Jabin regis Chanaan, qui regnavit in Asor : habuitque ducem exercitus sui nomine Sisaram, ipse autem habitabat in Haroseth gentium.

verses.name: Judges 4:3
verses.text: Clamaveruntque filii Israël ad Dominum : nongentos enim habebat falcatos currus, et per viginti annos vehementer oppresserat eos.

verses.name: Judges 4:4
verses.text: Erat autem Debbora prophetis uxor Lapidoth, quæ judicabat populum in illo tempore.

verses.name: Judges 4:5
verses.text: Et sedebat sub palma, quæ nomine illius vocabatur, inter Rama et Bethel in monte Ephraim : ascendebantque ad eam filii Israël in omne judicium.

verses.name: Judges 4:6
verses.text: Quæ misit et vocavit Barac filium Abinoëm de Cedes Nephthali : dixitque ad eum : Præcepit tibi Dominus Deus Israël : Vade, et duc exercitum in montem Thabor, tollesque tecum decem millia pugnatorum de filiis Nephthali, et de filiis Zabulon :

verses.name: Judges 4:7
verses.text: ego autem adducam ad te in loco torrentis Cison, Sisaram principem exercitus Jabin, et currus ejus, atque omnem multitudinem, et tradam eos in manu tua.

verses.name: Judges 4:8
verses.text: Dixitque ad eam Barac : Si venis mecum, vadam : si nolueris venire mecum, non pergam.

verses.name: Judges 4:9
verses.text: Quæ dixit ad eum : Ibo quidem tecum, sed in hac vice victoria non reputabitur tibi, quia in manu mulieris tradetur Sisara. Surrexit itaque Debbora, et perrexit cum Barac in Cedes.

verses.name: Judges 4:10
verses.text: Qui, accitis Zabulon et Nephthali, ascendit cum decem millibus pugnatorum, habens Debboram in comitatu suo.

verses.name: Judges 4:11
verses.text: Haber autem Cinæus recesserat quondam a ceteris Cinæis fratribus suis, filiis Hobab cognati Moysi : et tetenderat tabernacula usque ad vallem, quæ vocatur Sennim, et erat juxta Cedes.

verses.name: Judges 4:12
verses.text: Nuntiatumque est Sisaræ quod ascendisset Barac filius Abinoëm in montem Thabor :

verses.name: Judges 4:13
verses.text: et congregavit nongentos falcatos currus, et omnem exercitum de Haroseth gentium ad torrentem Cison.

verses.name: Judges 4:14
verses.text: Dixitque Debbora ad Barac : Surge, hæc est enim dies, in qua tradidit Dominus Sisaram in manus tuas : en ipse ductor est tuus. Descendit itaque Barac de monte Thabor, et decem millia pugnatorum cum eo.

verses.name: Judges 4:15
verses.text: Perterruitque Dominus Sisaram, et omnes currus ejus, universamque multitudinem in ore gladii ad conspectum Barac : in tantum, ut Sisara de curru desiliens, pedibus fugeret,

verses.name: Judges 4:16
verses.text: et Barac persequeretur fugientes currus, et exercitum usque ad Haroseth gentium, et omnis hostium multitudo usque ad internecionem caderet.  <div eID="gen1153" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv548"/><div sID="gen1154" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv548"/>Sisara autem fugiens pervenit ad tentorium Jahel uxoris Haber Cinæi. Erat enim pax inter Jabin regem Asor, et domum Haber Cinæi.

verses.name: Judges 4:18
verses.text: Egressa igitur Jahel in occursum Sisaræ, dixit ad eum : Intra ad me, domine mi : intra, ne timeas. Qui ingressus tabernaculum ejus, et opertus ab ea pallio,

verses.name: Judges 4:19
verses.text: dixit ad eam : Da mihi, obsecro, paululum aquæ, quia sitio valde. Quæ aperuit utrem lactis, et dedit ei bibere, et operuit illum.

verses.name: Judges 4:20
verses.text: Dixitque Sisara ad eam : Sta ante ostium tabernaculi : et cum venerit aliquis interrogans te, et dicens : Numquid hic est aliquis ? respondebis : Nullus est.

verses.name: Judges 4:21
verses.text: Tulit itaque Jahel uxor Haber clavum tabernaculi, assumens pariter et malleum : et ingressa abscondite et cum silentio, posuit supra tempus capitis ejus clavum, percussumque malleo defixit in cerebrum usque ad terram : qui soporem morti consocians defecit, et mortuus est.

verses.name: Judges 4:22
verses.text: Et ecce Barac sequens Sisaram veniebat : egressaque Jahel in occursum ejus, dixit ei : Veni, et ostendam tibi virum quem quæris. Qui cum intrasset ad eam, vidit Sisaram jacentem mortuum, et clavum infixum in tempore ejus.

verses.name: Judges 4:23
verses.text: Humiliavit ergo Deus in die illo Jabin regem Chanaan coram filiis Israël :

verses.name: Judges 4:24
verses.text: qui crescebant quotidie, et forti manu opprimebant Jabin regem Chanaan, donec delerent eum.  <chapter eID="Judg.4"/> <div eID="gen1154" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:1
verses.text: Cecineruntque Debbora et Barac filius Abinoëm in illo die, dicentes :  <div eID="gen1155" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv549"/><lg sID="gen1156"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv549"/>Qui sponte obtulistis de Israël animas vestras ad periculum, <l eID="gen1157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1158"/>benedicite Domino. <l eID="gen1158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv550"/><l level="1" sID="gen1159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv550"/>Audite, reges ; auribus percipite, principes : <l eID="gen1159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1160"/>ego sum, ego sum, quæ Domino canam, <l eID="gen1160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1161"/>psallam Domino Deo Israël. <l eID="gen1161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv551"/><l level="1" sID="gen1162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv551"/>Domine, cum exires de Seir, <l eID="gen1162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1163"/>et transires per regiones Edom, <l eID="gen1163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1164"/>terra mota est, <l eID="gen1164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1165"/>cælique ac nubes distillaverunt aquis. <l eID="gen1165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv552"/><l level="1" sID="gen1166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv552"/>Montes fluxerunt a facie Domini, <l eID="gen1166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1167"/>et Sinai a facie Domini Dei Israël. <l eID="gen1167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv553"/><l level="1" sID="gen1168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv553"/>In diebus Samgar filii Anath, <l eID="gen1168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1169"/>in diebus Jahel quieverunt semitæ : <l eID="gen1169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1170"/>et qui ingrediebantur per eas, <l eID="gen1170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1171"/>ambulaverunt per calles devios. <l eID="gen1171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv554"/><l level="1" sID="gen1172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv554"/>Cessaverunt fortes in Israël, et quieverunt : <l eID="gen1172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1173"/>donec surgeret Debbora, <l eID="gen1173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1174"/>surgeret mater in Israël. <l eID="gen1174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv555"/><l level="1" sID="gen1175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv555"/>Nova bella elegit Dominus, <l eID="gen1175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1176"/>et portas hostium ipse subvertit : <l eID="gen1176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1177"/>clypeus et hasta si apparuerint <l eID="gen1177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1178"/>in quadraginta millibus Israël. <l eID="gen1178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv556"/><l level="1" sID="gen1179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv556"/>Cor meum diligit principes Israël : <l eID="gen1179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1180"/>qui propria voluntate obtulistis vos discrimini, <l eID="gen1180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1181"/>benedicite Domino. <l eID="gen1181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv557"/><l level="1" sID="gen1182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv557"/>Qui ascenditis super nitentes asinos, <l eID="gen1182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1183"/>et sedetis in judicio, <l eID="gen1183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1184"/>et ambulatis in via, <l eID="gen1184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1185"/>loquimini. <l eID="gen1185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv558"/><l level="1" sID="gen1186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv558"/>Ubi collisi sunt currus, <l eID="gen1186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1187"/>et hostium suffocatus est exercitus, <l eID="gen1187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1188"/>ibi narrentur justitiæ Domini, <l eID="gen1188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1189"/>et clementia in fortes Israël : <l eID="gen1189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1190"/>tunc descendit populus Domini ad portas, <l eID="gen1190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1191"/>et obtinuit principatum. <l eID="gen1191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv559"/><l level="1" sID="gen1192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv559"/>Surge, surge Debbora ; <l eID="gen1192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1193"/>surge, surge, et loquere canticum : <l eID="gen1193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1194"/>surge Barac, et apprehende captivos tuos, fili Abinoëm. <l eID="gen1194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv560"/><l level="1" sID="gen1195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv560"/>Salvatæ sunt reliquiæ populi : <l eID="gen1195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1196"/>Dominus in fortibus dimicavit. <l eID="gen1196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv561"/><l level="1" sID="gen1197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv561"/>Ex Ephraim delevit eos in Amalec, <l eID="gen1197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1198"/>et post eum ex Benjamin in populos tuos, o Amalec : <l eID="gen1198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1199"/>de Machir principes descenderunt, <l eID="gen1199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1200"/>et de Zabulon qui exercitum ducerent ad bellandum. <l eID="gen1200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv562"/><l level="1" sID="gen1201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv562"/>Duces Issachar fuere cum Debbora, <l eID="gen1201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1202"/>et Barac vestigia sunt secuti, <l eID="gen1202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1203"/>qui quasi in præceps ac barathrum se discrimini dedit : <l eID="gen1203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1204"/>diviso contra se Ruben, <l eID="gen1204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1205"/>magnanimorum reperta est contentio. <l eID="gen1205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv563"/><l level="1" sID="gen1206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv563"/>Quare habitas inter duos terminos, <l eID="gen1206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1207"/>ut audias sibilos gregum ? <l eID="gen1207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1208"/>diviso contra se Ruben, <l eID="gen1208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1209"/>magnanimorum reperta est contentio. <l eID="gen1209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv564"/><l level="1" sID="gen1210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv564"/>Galaad trans Jordanem quiescebat, <l eID="gen1210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1211"/>et Dan vacabat navibus : <l eID="gen1211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1212"/>Aser habitabat in littore maris, <l eID="gen1212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1213"/>et in portubus morabatur. <l eID="gen1213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv565"/><l level="1" sID="gen1214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv565"/>Zabulon vero et Nephthali obtulerunt animas suas morti <l eID="gen1214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1215"/>in regione Merome. <l eID="gen1215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv566"/><l level="1" sID="gen1216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv566"/>Venerunt reges et pugnaverunt : <l eID="gen1216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1217"/>pugnaverunt reges Chanaan <l eID="gen1217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1218"/>in Thanach juxta aquas Mageddo, <l eID="gen1218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1219"/>et tamen nihil tulere prædantes. <l eID="gen1219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv567"/><l level="1" sID="gen1220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv567"/>De cælo dimicatum est contra eos : <l eID="gen1220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1221"/>stellæ manentes in ordine et cursu suo, <l eID="gen1221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1222"/>adversus Sisaram pugnaverunt. <l eID="gen1222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv568"/><l level="1" sID="gen1223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv568"/>Torrens Cison traxit cadavera eorum, <l eID="gen1223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1224"/>torrens Cadumim, torrens Cison : <l eID="gen1224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1225"/>conculca, anima mea, robustos. <l eID="gen1225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv569"/><l level="1" sID="gen1226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv569"/>Ungulæ equorum ceciderunt, fugientibus impetu, <l eID="gen1226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1227"/>et per præceps ruentibus fortissimis hostium. <l eID="gen1227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv570"/><l level="1" sID="gen1228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv570"/>Maledicite terræ Meroz, dixit angelus Domini : <l eID="gen1228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1229"/>maledicite habitatoribus ejus, <l eID="gen1229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1230"/>quia non venerunt ad auxilium Domini, <l eID="gen1230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1231"/>in adjutorium fortissimorum ejus. <l eID="gen1231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv571"/><l level="1" sID="gen1232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv571"/>Benedicta inter mulieres Jahel uxor Haber Cinæi, <l eID="gen1232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1233"/>et benedicatur in tabernaculo suo. <l eID="gen1233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv572"/><l level="1" sID="gen1234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv572"/>Aquam petenti lac dedit, <l eID="gen1234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1235"/>et in phiala principum obtulit butyrum. <l eID="gen1235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv573"/><l level="1" sID="gen1236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv573"/>Sinistram manum misit ad clavum, <l eID="gen1236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1237"/>et dexteram ad fabrorum malleos. <l eID="gen1237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1238"/>Percussitque Sisaram quærens in capite vulneri locum, <l eID="gen1238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1239"/>et tempus valide perforans : <l eID="gen1239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv574"/><l level="1" sID="gen1240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv574"/>inter pedes ejus ruit ; defecit, et mortuus est : <l eID="gen1240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1241"/>volvebatur ante pedes ejus, <l eID="gen1241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1242"/>et jacebat exanimis et miserabilis. <l eID="gen1242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv575"/><l level="1" sID="gen1243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv575"/>Per fenestram respiciens, ululabat mater ejus : <l eID="gen1243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1244"/>et de cœnaculo loquebatur : <l eID="gen1244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1245"/>Cur moratur regredi currus ejus ? <l eID="gen1245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1246"/>quare tardaverunt pedes quadrigarum illius ? <l eID="gen1246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv576"/><l level="1" sID="gen1247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv576"/>Una sapientior ceteris uxoribus ejus, <l eID="gen1247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1248"/>hæc socrui verba respondit : <l eID="gen1248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv577"/><l level="1" sID="gen1249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv577"/>Forsitan nunc dividit spolia, <l eID="gen1249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1250"/>et pulcherrima feminarum eligitur ei : <l eID="gen1250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1251"/>vestes diversorum colorum Sisaræ traduntur in prædam, <l eID="gen1251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1252"/>et supellex varia ad ornanda colla congeritur. <l eID="gen1252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Judges 5:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv578"/><l level="1" sID="gen1253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv578"/>Sic pereant omnes inimici tui, Domine : <l eID="gen1253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1254"/>qui autem diligunt te, sicut sol in ortu suo splendet, ita rutilent.

verses.name: Judges 5:32
verses.text: Quievitque terra per quadraginta annos. <l eID="gen1254" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1156"/> <chapter eID="Judg.5"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:1
verses.text: Fecerunt autem filii Israël malum in conspectu Domini : qui tradidit illos in manu Madian septem annis,

verses.name: Judges 6:2
verses.text: et oppressi sunt valde ab eis. Feceruntque sibi antra et speluncas in montibus, et munitissima ad repugnandum loca.

verses.name: Judges 6:3
verses.text: Cumque sevisset Israël, ascendebat Madian et Amalec, ceterique orientalium nationum :

verses.name: Judges 6:4
verses.text: et apud eos figentes tentoria, sicut erant in herbis cuncta vastabant usque ad introitum Gazæ : nihilque omnino ad vitam pertinens relinquebant in Israël, non oves, non boves, non asinos.

verses.name: Judges 6:5
verses.text: Ipsi enim et universi greges eorum veniebant cum tabernaculis suis, et instar locustarum universa complebant, innumera multitudo hominum et camelorum, quidquid tetigerant devastantes.

verses.name: Judges 6:6
verses.text: Humiliatusque est Israël valde in conspectu Madian.

verses.name: Judges 6:7
verses.text: Et clamavit ad Dominum postulans auxilium contra Madianitas.

verses.name: Judges 6:8
verses.text: Qui misit ad eos virum prophetam, et locutus est : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Ego vos feci conscendere de Ægypto, et eduxi vos de domo servitutis,

verses.name: Judges 6:9
verses.text: et liberavi de manu Ægyptiorum, et omnium inimicorum qui affligebant vos : ejecique eos ad introitum vestrum, et tradidi vobis terram eorum.

verses.name: Judges 6:10
verses.text: Et dixi : Ego Dominus Deus vester : ne timeatis deos Amorrhæorum, in quorum terra habitatis. Et noluistis audire vocem meam.  <div eID="gen1255" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv579"/><div sID="gen1256" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv579"/>Venit autem angelus Domini, et sedit sub quercu, quæ erat in Ephra, et pertinebat ad Joas patrem familiæ Ezri. Cumque Gedeon filius ejus excuteret atque purgaret frumenta in torculari, ut fugeret Madian,

verses.name: Judges 6:12
verses.text: apparuit ei angelus Domini, et ait : Dominus tecum, virorum fortissime.

verses.name: Judges 6:13
verses.text: Dixitque ei Gedeon : Obsecro, mi domine, si Dominus nobiscum est, cur apprehenderunt nos hæc omnia ? ubi sunt mirabilia ejus, quæ narraverunt patres nostri, atque dixerunt : De Ægypto eduxit nos Dominus ? nunc autem dereliquit nos Dominus, et tradidit in manu Madian.

verses.name: Judges 6:14
verses.text: Respexitque ad eum Dominus, et ait : Vade in hac fortitudine tua, et liberabis Israël de manu Madian : scito quod miserim te.

verses.name: Judges 6:15
verses.text: Qui respondens ait : Obsecro, mi domine, in quo liberabo Israël ? ecce familia mea infima est in Manasse, et ego minimus in domo patris mei.

verses.name: Judges 6:16
verses.text: Dixitque ei Dominus : Ego ero tecum : et percuties Madian quasi unum virum.

verses.name: Judges 6:17
verses.text: Et ille : Si inveni, inquit, gratiam coram te, da mihi signum quod tu sis qui loqueris ad me :

verses.name: Judges 6:18
verses.text: nec recedas hinc, donec revertar ad te, portans sacrificium, et offerens tibi. Qui respondit : Ego præstolabor adventum tuum.

verses.name: Judges 6:19
verses.text: Ingressus est itaque Gedeon, et coxit hædum, et de farinæ modio azymos panes : carnesque ponens in canistro, et jus carnium mittens in ollam, tulit omnia sub quercu, et obtulit ei.

verses.name: Judges 6:20
verses.text: Cui dixit angelus Domini : Tolle carnes et azymos panes, et pone supra petram illam, et jus desuper funde. Cumque fecisset ita,

verses.name: Judges 6:21
verses.text: extendit angelus Domini summitatem virgæ, quam tenebat in manu, et tetigit carnes et panes azymos : ascenditque ignis de petra, et carnes azymosque panes consumpsit : angelus autem Domini evanuit ex oculis ejus.  <div eID="gen1256" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv580"/><div sID="gen1257" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv580"/>Vidensque Gedeon quod esset angelus Domini, ait : Heu mi Domine Deus : quia vidi angelum Domini facie ad faciem.

verses.name: Judges 6:23
verses.text: Dixitque ei Dominus : Pax tecum : ne timeas, non morieris.

verses.name: Judges 6:24
verses.text: Ædificavit ergo ibi Gedeon altare Domino, vocavitque illud, Domini pax, usque in præsentem diem. Cumque adhuc esset in Ephra, quæ est familiæ Ezri,

verses.name: Judges 6:25
verses.text: nocte illa dixit Dominus ad eum : Tolle taurum patris tui, et alterum taurum annorum septem, destruesque aram Baal, quæ est patris tui, et nemus, quod circa aram est, succide.

verses.name: Judges 6:26
verses.text: Et ædificabis altare Domino Deo tuo in summitate petræ hujus, super quam ante sacrificium posuisti : tollesque taurum secundum, et offeres holocaustum super struem lignorum, quæ de nemore succideris.

verses.name: Judges 6:27
verses.text: Assumptis ergo Gedeon decem viris de servis suis, fecit sicut præceperat ei Dominus. Timens autem domum patris sui, et homines illius civitatis, per diem noluit id facere, sed omnia nocte complevit.

verses.name: Judges 6:28
verses.text: Cumque surrexissent viri oppidi ejus mane, viderunt destructam aram Baal, lucumque succisum, et taurum alterum impositum super altare, quod tunc ædificatum erat.

verses.name: Judges 6:29
verses.text: Dixeruntque ad invicem : Quis hoc fecit ? Cumque perquirerent auctorem facti, dictum est : Gedeon filius Joas fecit hæc omnia.

verses.name: Judges 6:30
verses.text: Et dixerunt ad Joas : Produc filium tuum huc, ut moriatur : quia destruxit aram Baal, et succidit nemus.

verses.name: Judges 6:31
verses.text: Quibus ille respondit : Numquid ultores estis Baal, ut pugnetis pro eo ? qui adversarius est ejus, moriatur antequam lux crastina veniat : si deus est, vindicet se de eo, qui suffodit aram ejus.

verses.name: Judges 6:32
verses.text: Ex illo die vocatus est Gedeon Jerobaal, eo quod dixisset Joas : Ulciscatur se de eo Baal, qui suffodit aram ejus.  <div eID="gen1257" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 6:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv581"/><div sID="gen1258" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv581"/>Igitur omnis Madian, et Amalec, et orientales populi, congregati sunt simul : et transeuntes Jordanem, castrametati sunt in valle Jezraël.

verses.name: Judges 6:34
verses.text: Spiritus autem Domini induit Gedeon, qui clangens buccina convocavit domum Abiezer, ut sequeretur se.

verses.name: Judges 6:35
verses.text: Misitque nuntios in universum Manassen, qui et ipse secutus est eum : et alios nuntios in Aser et Zabulon et Nephthali, qui occurrerunt ei.

verses.name: Judges 6:36
verses.text: Dixitque Gedeon ad Deum : Si salvum facis per manum meam Israël, sicut locutus es,

verses.name: Judges 6:37
verses.text: ponam hoc vellus lanæ in area : si ros in solo vellere fuerit, et in omni terra siccitas, sciam quod per manum meam, sicut locutus es, liberabis Israël.

verses.name: Judges 6:38
verses.text: Factumque est ita. Et de nocte consurgens expresso vellere, concham rore implevit.

verses.name: Judges 6:39
verses.text: Dixitque rursus ad Deum : Ne irascatur furor tuus contra me si adhuc semel tentavero, signum quærens in vellere. Oro ut solum vellus siccum sit, et omnis terra rore madens.

verses.name: Judges 6:40
verses.text: Fecitque Deus nocte illa ut postulaverat : et fuit siccitas in solo vellere, et ros in omni terra.  <chapter eID="Judg.6"/> <div eID="gen1258" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:1
verses.text: Igitur Jerobaal qui et Gedeon, de nocte consurgens, et omnis populus cum eo, venit ad fontem qui vocatur Harad. Erant autem castra Madian in valle ad septentrionalem plagam collis excelsi.

verses.name: Judges 7:2
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus ad Gedeon : Multus tecum est populus, nec tradetur Madian in manus ejus : ne glorietur contra me Israël, et dicat : Meis viribus liberatus sum.

verses.name: Judges 7:3
verses.text: Loquere ad populum, et cunctis audientibus prædica : Qui formidolosus et timidus est, revertatur. Recesseruntque de monte Galaad, et reversi sunt de populo viginti duo millia virorum, et tantum decem millia remanserunt.

verses.name: Judges 7:4
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus ad Gedeon : Adhuc populus multus est : duc eos ad aquas et ibi probabo illos : et de quo dixero tibi ut tecum vadat, ipse pergat ; quem ire prohibuero, revertatur.

verses.name: Judges 7:5
verses.text: Cumque descendisset populus ad aquas, dixit Dominus ad Gedeon : Qui lingua lambuerint aquas, sicut solent canes lambere, separabis eos seorsum : qui autem curvatis genibus biberint, in altera parte erunt.

verses.name: Judges 7:6
verses.text: Fuit itaque numerus eorum qui manu ad os projiciente lambuerunt aquas, trecenti viri : omnis autem reliqua multitudo flexo poplite biberat.

verses.name: Judges 7:7
verses.text: Et ait Dominus ad Gedeon : In trecentis viris qui lambuerunt aquas, liberabo vos, et tradam in manu tua Madian : omnis autem reliqua multitudo revertatur in locum suum.

verses.name: Judges 7:8
verses.text: Sumptis itaque pro numero cibariis et tubis, omnem reliquam multitudinem abire præcepit ad tabernacula sua : et ipse cum trecentis viris se certamini dedit. Castra autem Madian erant subter in valle.  <div eID="gen1259" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv582"/><div sID="gen1260" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv582"/>Eadem nocte dixit Dominus ad eum : Surge, et descende in castra : quia tradidi eos in manu tua.

verses.name: Judges 7:10
verses.text: Sin autem solus ire formidas, descendat tecum Phara puer tuus.

verses.name: Judges 7:11
verses.text: Et cum audieris quid loquantur, tunc confortabuntur manus tuæ, et securior ad hostium castra descendes. Descendit ergo ipse et Phara puer ejus in partem castrorum, ubi erant armatorum vigiliæ.

verses.name: Judges 7:12
verses.text: Madian autem et Amalec, et omnes orientales populi, fusi jacebant in valle, ut locustarum multitudo : cameli quoque innumerabiles erant, sicut arena quæ jacet in littore maris.

verses.name: Judges 7:13
verses.text: Cumque venisset Gedeon, narrabat aliquis somnium proximo suo : et in hunc modum referebat quod viderat : Vidi somnium, et videbatur mihi quasi subcinericius panis ex hordeo volvi, et in castra Madian descendere : cumque pervenisset ad tabernaculum, percussit illud, atque subvertit, et terræ funditus coæquavit.

verses.name: Judges 7:14
verses.text: Respondit is, cui loquebatur : Non est hoc aliud, nisi gladius Gedeonis filii Joas viri Israëlitæ : tradidit enim Dominus in manus ejus Madian, et omnia castra ejus.

verses.name: Judges 7:15
verses.text: Cumque audisset Gedeon somnium, et interpretationem ejus, adoravit : et reversus est ad castra Israël, et ait : Surgite, tradidit enim Dominus in manus nostras castra Madian.

verses.name: Judges 7:16
verses.text: Divisitque trecentos viros in tres partes, et dedit tubas in manibus eorum, lagenasque vacuas, ac lampades in medio lagenarum.

verses.name: Judges 7:17
verses.text: Et dixit ad eos : Quod me facere videritis, hoc facite : ingrediar partem castrorum, et quod fecero, sectamini.

verses.name: Judges 7:18
verses.text: Quando personuerit tuba in manu mea, vos quoque per castrorum circuitum clangite, et conclamate : Domino et Gedeoni.  <div eID="gen1260" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv583"/><div sID="gen1261" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv583"/>Ingressusque est Gedeon, et trecenti viri qui erant cum eo, in partem castrorum, incipientibus vigiliis noctis mediæ : et custodibus suscitatis, cœperunt buccinis clangere, et complodere inter se lagenas.

verses.name: Judges 7:20
verses.text: Cumque per gyrum castrorum in tribus personarent locis, et hydrias confregissent, tenuerunt sinistris manibus lampades, et dextris sonantes tubas, clamaveruntque : Gladius Domini et Gedeonis :

verses.name: Judges 7:21
verses.text: stantes singuli in loco suo per circuitum castrorum hostilium. Omnia itaque castra turbata sunt, et vociferantes ululantesque fugerunt :

verses.name: Judges 7:22
verses.text: et nihilominus insistebant trecenti viri buccinis personantes. Immisitque Dominus gladium omnibus castris, et mutua se cæde truncabant,

verses.name: Judges 7:23
verses.text: fugientes usque ad Bethsetta, et crepidinem Abelmehula in Tebbath. Conclamantes autem viri Israël de Nephthali, et Aser, et omni Manasse, persequebantur Madian.

verses.name: Judges 7:24
verses.text: Misitque Gedeon nuntios in omnem montem Ephraim, dicens : Descendite in occursum Madian, et occupate aquas usque Bethbera atque Jordanem. Clamavitque omnis Ephraim, et præoccupavit aquas atque Jordanem usque Bethbera.

verses.name: Judges 7:25
verses.text: Apprehensosque duos viros Madian, Oreb et Zeb, interfecit Oreb in petra Oreb, Zeb vero in torculari Zeb. Et persecuti sunt Madian, capita Oreb et Zeb portantes ad Gedeon trans fluenta Jordanis.  <chapter eID="Judg.7"/> <div eID="gen1261" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:1
verses.text: Dixeruntque ad eum viri Ephraim : Quid est hoc quod facere voluisti, ut nos non vocares, cum ad pugnam pergeres contra Madian ? jurgantes fortiter, et prope vim inferentes.

verses.name: Judges 8:2
verses.text: Quibus ille respondit : Quod enim tale facere potui, quale vos fecistis ? nonne melior est racemus Ephraim, vindemiis Abiezer ?

verses.name: Judges 8:3
verses.text: In manus vestras Dominus tradidit principes Madian, Oreb et Zeb : quid tale facere potui, quale vos fecistis ? Quod cum locutus esset, requievit spiritus eorum, quo tumebant contra eum.  <div eID="gen1262" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv584"/><div sID="gen1263" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv584"/>Cumque venisset Gedeon ad Jordanem, transivit eum cum trecentis viris, qui secum erant : et præ lassitudine, fugientes persequi non poterant.

verses.name: Judges 8:5
verses.text: Dixitque ad viros Soccoth : Date, obsecro, panes populo qui mecum est, quia valde defecerunt : ut possimus persequi Zebee et Salmana reges Madian.

verses.name: Judges 8:6
verses.text: Responderunt principes Soccoth : Forsitan palmæ manuum Zebee et Salmana in manu tua sunt, et idcirco postulas ut demus exercitui tuo panes.

verses.name: Judges 8:7
verses.text: Quibus ille ait : Cum ergo tradiderit Dominus Zebee et Salmana in manus meas, conteram carnes vestras cum spinis tribulisque deserti.

verses.name: Judges 8:8
verses.text: Et inde conscendens, venit in Phanuel : locutusque est ad viros loci illius similia. Cui et illi responderunt, sicut responderant viri Soccoth.

verses.name: Judges 8:9
verses.text: Dixit itaque et eis : Cum reversus fuero victor in pace, destruam turrim hanc.  <div eID="gen1263" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv585"/><div sID="gen1264" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv585"/>Zebee autem et Salmana requiescebant cum omni exercitu suo. Quindecim enim millia viri remanserant ex omnibus turmis orientalium populorum, cæsis centum viginti millibus bellatorum educentium gladium.

verses.name: Judges 8:11
verses.text: Ascendensque Gedeon per viam eorum, qui in tabernaculis morabantur, ad orientalem partem Nobe et Jegbaa, percussit castra hostium, qui securi erant, et nihil adversi suspicabantur.

verses.name: Judges 8:12
verses.text: Fugeruntque Zebee et Salmana, quos persequens Gedeon comprehendit, turbato omni exercitu eorum.

verses.name: Judges 8:13
verses.text: Revertensque de bello ante solis ortum,

verses.name: Judges 8:14
verses.text: apprehendit puerum de viris Soccoth : interrogavitque eum nomina principum et seniorum Soccoth, et descripsit septuaginta septem viros.

verses.name: Judges 8:15
verses.text: Venitque ad Soccoth, et dixit eis : En Zebee et Salmana, super quibus exprobrastis mihi, dicentes : Forsitan manus Zebee et Salmana in manibus tuis sunt, et idcirco postulas ut demus viris, qui lassi sunt et defecerunt, panes.

verses.name: Judges 8:16
verses.text: Tulit ergo seniores civitatis et spinas deserti ac tribulos, et contrivit cum eis atque comminuit viros Soccoth.

verses.name: Judges 8:17
verses.text: Turrim quoque Phanuel subvertit, occisis habitatoribus civitatis.

verses.name: Judges 8:18
verses.text: Dixitque ad Zebee et Salmana : Quales fuerunt viri, quos occidistis in Thabor ? Qui responderunt : Similes tui, et unus ex eis quasi filius regis.

verses.name: Judges 8:19
verses.text: Quibus ille respondit : Fratres mei fuerunt, filii matris meæ. Vivit Dominus, quia si servassetis eos, non vos occiderem.

verses.name: Judges 8:20
verses.text: Dixitque Jether primogenito suo : Surge, et interfice eos. Qui non eduxit gladium : timebat enim, quia adhuc puer erat.

verses.name: Judges 8:21
verses.text: Dixeruntque Zebee et Salmana : Tu surge, et irrue in nos : quia juxta ætatem robur est hominis. Surrexit Gedeon, et interfecit Zebee et Salmana : et tulit ornamenta ac bullas quibus colla regalium camelorum decorari solent.  <div eID="gen1264" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv586"/><div sID="gen1265" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv586"/>Dixeruntque omnes viri Israël ad Gedeon : Dominare nostri tu, et filius tuus, et filius filii tui : quia liberasti nos de manu Madian.

verses.name: Judges 8:23
verses.text: Quibus ille ait : Non dominabor vestri, nec dominabitur in vos filius meus, sed dominabitur vobis Dominus.

verses.name: Judges 8:24
verses.text: Dixitque ad eos : Unam petitionem postulo a vobis : date mihi inaures ex præda vestra. Inaures enim aureas Ismaëlitæ habere consueverant.

verses.name: Judges 8:25
verses.text: Qui responderunt : Libentissime dabimus. Expandentesque super terram pallium, projecerunt in eo inaures de præda :

verses.name: Judges 8:26
verses.text: et fuit pondus postulatarum inaurium, mille septingenti auri sicli, absque ornamentis, et monilibus, et veste purpurea, quibus reges Madian uti soliti erant, et præter torques aureas camelorum.

verses.name: Judges 8:27
verses.text: Fecitque ex eo Gedeon ephod, et posuit illud in civitate sua Ephra. Fornicatusque est omnis Israël in eo, et factum est Gedeoni et omni domui ejus in ruinam.

verses.name: Judges 8:28
verses.text: Humiliatus est autem Madian coram filiis Israël, nec potuerunt ultra cervices elevare : sed quievit terra per quadraginta annos, quibus Gedeon præfuit.  <div eID="gen1265" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 8:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv587"/><div sID="gen1266" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv587"/>Abiit itaque Jerobaal filius Joas, et habitavit in domo sua :

verses.name: Judges 8:30
verses.text: habuitque septuaginta filios, qui egressi sunt de femore ejus : eo quod plures haberet uxores.

verses.name: Judges 8:31
verses.text: Concubina autem illius, quam habebat in Sichem, genuit ei filium nomine Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 8:32
verses.text: Mortuusque est Gedeon filius Joas in senectute bona, et sepultus est in sepulchro Joas patris sui in Ephra de familia Ezri.

verses.name: Judges 8:33
verses.text: Postquam autem mortuus est Gedeon, aversi sunt filii Israël, et fornicati sunt cum Baalim. Percusseruntque cum Baal fœdus, ut esset eis in deum :

verses.name: Judges 8:34
verses.text: nec recordati sunt Domini Dei sui, qui eruit eos de manibus inimicorum suorum omnium per circuitum :

verses.name: Judges 8:35
verses.text: nec fecerunt misericordiam cum domo Jerobaal Gedeon, juxta omnia bona quæ fecerat Israëli.  <chapter eID="Judg.8"/> <div eID="gen1266" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:1
verses.text: Abiit autem Abimelech filius Jerobaal in Sichem ad fratres matris suæ, et locutus est ad eos, et ad omnem cognationem domus patris matris suæ, dicens :

verses.name: Judges 9:2
verses.text: Loquimini ad omnes viros Sichem : Quid vobis est melius, ut dominentur vestri septuaginta viri omnes filii Jerobaal, an ut dominetur unus vir ? simulque considerate quod os vestrum et caro vestra sum.

verses.name: Judges 9:3
verses.text: Locutique sunt fratres matris ejus de eo ad omnes viros Sichem universos sermones istos, et inclinaverunt cor eorum post Abimelech, dicentes : Frater noster est.

verses.name: Judges 9:4
verses.text: Dederuntque illi septuaginta pondo argenti de fano Baalberit. Qui conduxit sibi ex eo viros inopes et vagos, secutique sunt eum.

verses.name: Judges 9:5
verses.text: Et venit in domum patris sui in Ephra, et occidit fratres suos filios Jerobaal, septuaginta viros super lapidem unum : remansitque Joatham filius Jerobaal minimus, et absconditus est.  <div eID="gen1267" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv588"/><div sID="gen1268" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv588"/>Congregati sunt autem omnes viri Sichem, et universæ familiæ urbis Mello : abieruntque et constituerunt regem Abimelech, juxta quercum quæ stabat in Sichem.

verses.name: Judges 9:7
verses.text: Quod cum nuntiatum esset Joatham, ivit, et stetit in vertice montis Garizim : elevataque voce, clamavit, et dixit : Audite me, viri Sichem ; ita audiat vos Deus.

verses.name: Judges 9:8
verses.text: Ierunt ligna, ut ungerent super se regem : dixeruntque olivæ : Impera nobis.

verses.name: Judges 9:9
verses.text: Quæ respondit : Numquid possum deserere pinguedinem meam, qua et dii utuntur et homines, et venire ut inter ligna promovear ?

verses.name: Judges 9:10
verses.text: Dixeruntque ligna ad arborem ficum : Veni, et super nos regnum accipe.

verses.name: Judges 9:11
verses.text: Quæ respondit eis : Numquid possum deserere dulcedinem meam, fructusque suavissimos, et ire ut inter cetera ligna promovear ?

verses.name: Judges 9:12
verses.text: Locutaque sunt ligna ad vitem : Veni, et impera nobis.

verses.name: Judges 9:13
verses.text: Quæ respondit eis : Numquid possum deserere vinum meum, quod lætificat Deum et homines, et inter ligna cetera promoveri ?

verses.name: Judges 9:14
verses.text: Dixeruntque omnia ligna ad rhamnum : Veni, et impera super nos.

verses.name: Judges 9:15
verses.text: Quæ respondit eis : Si vere me regem vobis constituitis, venite, et sub umbra mea requiescite : si autem non vultis, egrediatur ignis de rhamno, et devoret cedros Libani.

verses.name: Judges 9:16
verses.text: Nunc igitur, si recte et absque peccato constituistis super vos regem Abimelech, et bene egistis cum Jerobaal, et cum domo ejus, et reddidistis vicem beneficiis ejus, qui pugnavit pro vobis,

verses.name: Judges 9:17
verses.text: et animam suam dedit periculis, ut erueret vos de manu Madian,

verses.name: Judges 9:18
verses.text: qui nunc surrexistis contra domum patris mei, et interfecistis filios ejus septuaginta viros super unum lapidem, et constituistis regem Abimelech filium ancillæ ejus super habitatores Sichem, eo quod frater vester sit :

verses.name: Judges 9:19
verses.text: si ergo recte et absque vitio egistis cum Jerobaal et domo ejus, hodie lætamini in Abimelech, et ille lætetur in vobis.

verses.name: Judges 9:20
verses.text: Sin autem perverse : egrediatur ignis ex eo, et consumat habitatores Sichem, et oppidum Mello : egrediaturque ignis de viris Sichem, et de oppido Mello, et devoret Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 9:21
verses.text: Quæ cum dixisset, fugit, et abiit in Bera : habitavitque ibi ob metum Abimelech fratris sui.  <div eID="gen1268" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv589"/><div sID="gen1269" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv589"/>Regnavit itaque Abimelech super Israël tribus annis.

verses.name: Judges 9:23
verses.text: Misitque Dominus spiritum pessimum inter Abimelech et habitatores Sichem : qui cœperunt eum detestari,

verses.name: Judges 9:24
verses.text: et scelus interfectionis septuaginta filiorum Jerobaal, et effusionem sanguinis eorum conferre in Abimelech fratrem suum, et in ceteros Sichimorum principes, qui eum adjuverant.

verses.name: Judges 9:25
verses.text: Posueruntque insidias adversus eum in summitate montium : et dum illius præstolabantur adventum, exercebant latrocinia, agentes prædas de prætereuntibus : nuntiatumque est Abimelech.

verses.name: Judges 9:26
verses.text: Venit autem Gaal filius Obed cum fratribus suis, et transivit in Sichimam. Ad cujus adventum erecti habitatores Sichem,

verses.name: Judges 9:27
verses.text: egressi sunt in agros, vastantes vineas, uvasque calcantes : et factis cantantium choris, ingressi sunt fanum dei sui, et inter epulas et pocula maledicebant Abimelech,

verses.name: Judges 9:28
verses.text: clamante Gaal filio Obed : Quis est Abimelech, et quæ est Sichem, ut serviamus ei ? numquid non est filius Jerobaal, et constituit principem Zebul servum suum super viros Emor patris Sichem ? cur ergo serviemus ei ?

verses.name: Judges 9:29
verses.text: utinam daret aliquis populum istum sub manu mea, ut auferrem de medio Abimelech. Dictumque est Abimelech : Congrega exercitus multitudinem, et veni.

verses.name: Judges 9:30
verses.text: Zebul enim princeps civitatis, auditis sermonibus Gaal filii Obed, iratus est valde,

verses.name: Judges 9:31
verses.text: et misit clam ad Abimelech nuntios, dicens : Ecce Gaal filius Obed venit in Sichimam cum fratribus suis, et oppugnat adversum te civitatem.

verses.name: Judges 9:32
verses.text: Surge itaque nocte cum populo qui tecum est, et latita in agro :

verses.name: Judges 9:33
verses.text: et primo mane, oriente sole, irrue super civitatem. Illo autem egrediente adversum te cum populo suo, fac ei quod potueris.  <div eID="gen1269" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv590"/><div sID="gen1270" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv590"/>Surrexit itaque Abimelech cum omni exercitu suo nocte, et tetendit insidias juxta Sichimam in quatuor locis.

verses.name: Judges 9:35
verses.text: Egressusque est Gaal filius Obed, et stetit in introitu portæ civitatis. Surrexit autem Abimelech, et omnis exercitus cum eo, de insidiarum loco.

verses.name: Judges 9:36
verses.text: Cumque vidisset populum Gaal, dixit ad Zebul : Ecce de montibus multitudo descendit. Cui ille respondit : Umbras montium vides quasi capita hominum, et hoc errore deciperis.

verses.name: Judges 9:37
verses.text: Rursumque Gaal ait : Ecce populus de umbilico terræ descendit, et unus cuneus venit per viam quæ respicit quercum.

verses.name: Judges 9:38
verses.text: Cui dixit Zebul : Ubi est nunc os tuum, quo loquebaris : Quis est Abimelech ut serviamus ei ? nonne hic populus est, quem despiciebas ? egredere, et pugna contra eum.

verses.name: Judges 9:39
verses.text: Abiit ergo Gaal, spectante Sichimorum populo, et pugnavit contra Abimelech,

verses.name: Judges 9:40
verses.text: qui persecutus est eum fugientem, et in urbem compulit : cecideruntque ex parte ejus plurimi, usque ad portam civitatis.

verses.name: Judges 9:41
verses.text: Et Abimelech sedit in Ruma : Zebul autem Gaal et socios ejus expulit de urbe, nec in ea passus est commorari.

verses.name: Judges 9:42
verses.text: Sequenti ergo die, egressus est populus in campum. Quod cum nuntiatum esset Abimelech,

verses.name: Judges 9:43
verses.text: tulit exercitum suum, et divisit in tres turmas, tendens insidias in agris. Vidensque quod egrederetur populus de civitate, surrexit, et irruit in eos

verses.name: Judges 9:44
verses.text: cum cuneo suo, oppugnans et obsidens civitatem : duæ autem turmæ palantes per campum adversarios persequebantur.

verses.name: Judges 9:45
verses.text: Porro Abimelech omni die illo oppugnabat urbem : quam cepit, interfectis habitatoribus ejus, ipsaque destructa, ita ut sal in ea dispergeret.  <div eID="gen1270" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv591"/><div sID="gen1271" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv591"/>Quod cum audissent qui habitabant in turre Sichimorum, ingressi sunt fanum dei sui Berith, ubi fœdus cum eo pepigerant, et ex eo locus nomen acceperat : qui erat munitus valde.

verses.name: Judges 9:47
verses.text: Abimelech quoque audiens viros turris Sichimorum pariter conglobatos,

verses.name: Judges 9:48
verses.text: ascendit in montem Selmon cum omni populo suo : et arrepta securi, præcidit arboris ramum, impositumque ferens humero, dixit ad socios : Quod me videtis facere, cito facite.

verses.name: Judges 9:49
verses.text: Igitur certatim ramos de arboribus præcidentes, sequebantur ducem. Qui circumdantes præsidium, succenderunt : atque ita factum est, ut fumo et igne mille homines necarentur, viri pariter et mulieres, habitatorum turris Sichem.  <div eID="gen1271" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 9:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv592"/><div sID="gen1272" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv592"/>Abimelech autem inde proficiscens venit ad oppidum Thebes, quod circumdans obsidebat exercitu.

verses.name: Judges 9:51
verses.text: Erat autem turris excelsa in media civitate, ad quam confugerant simul viri ac mulieres, et omnes principes civitatis, clausa firmissime janua, et super turris tectum stantes per propugnacula.

verses.name: Judges 9:52
verses.text: Accedensque Abimelech juxta turrim, pugnabat fortiter : et appropinquans ostio, ignem supponere nitebatur :

verses.name: Judges 9:53
verses.text: et ecce una mulier fragmen molæ desuper jaciens, illisit capiti Abimelech, et confregit cerebrum ejus.

verses.name: Judges 9:54
verses.text: Qui vocavit cito armigerum suum, et ait ad eum : Evagina gladium tuum, et percute me, ne forte dicatur quod a femina interfectus sim. Qui jussa perficiens, interfecit eum.

verses.name: Judges 9:55
verses.text: Illoque mortuo, omnes qui cum eo erant de Israël, reversi sunt in sedes suas :

verses.name: Judges 9:56
verses.text: et reddidit Deus malum quod fecerat Abimelech contra patrem suum, interfectis septuaginta fratribus suis.

verses.name: Judges 9:57
verses.text: Sichimitis quoque quod operati erant, retributum est, et venit super eos maledictio Joatham filii Jerobaal.  <chapter eID="Judg.9"/> <div eID="gen1272" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:1
verses.text: Post Abimelech surrexit dux in Israël Thola filius Phua patrui Abimelech, vir de Issachar, qui habitavit in Samir montis Ephraim :

verses.name: Judges 10:2
verses.text: et judicavit Israëlem viginti et tribus annis, mortuusque est, ac sepultus in Samir.

verses.name: Judges 10:3
verses.text: Huic successit Jair Galaadites, qui judicavit Israël per viginti et duos annos,

verses.name: Judges 10:4
verses.text: habens triginta filios sedentes super triginta pullos asinarum, et principes triginta civitatum, quæ ex nomine ejus sunt appellatæ Havoth Jair, id est, oppida Jair, usque in præsentem diem, in terra Galaad.

verses.name: Judges 10:5
verses.text: Mortuusque est Jair, ac sepultus in loco cui est vocabulum Camon.  <div eID="gen1273" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv593"/><div sID="gen1274" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv593"/>Filii autem Israël peccatis veteribus jungentes nova, fecerunt malum in conspectu Domini, et servierunt idolis, Baalim et Astaroth, et diis Syriæ ac Sidonis et Moab et filiorum Ammon et Philisthiim : dimiseruntque Dominum, et non coluerunt eum.

verses.name: Judges 10:7
verses.text: Contra quos Dominus iratus, tradidit eos in manus Philisthiim et filiorum Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 10:8
verses.text: Afflictique sunt, et vehementer oppressi per annos decem et octo, omnes qui habitabant trans Jordanem in terra Amorrhæi, qui est in Galaad :

verses.name: Judges 10:9
verses.text: in tantum ut filii Ammon, Jordane transmisso, vastarent Judam et Benjamin et Ephraim : afflictusque est Israël nimis.

verses.name: Judges 10:10
verses.text: Et clamantes ad Dominum, dixerunt : Peccavimus tibi, quia dereliquimus Dominum Deum nostrum, et servivimus Baalim.

verses.name: Judges 10:11
verses.text: Quibus locutus est Dominus : Numquid non Ægyptii et Amorrhæi, filiique Ammon et Philisthiim,

verses.name: Judges 10:12
verses.text: Sidonii quoque et Amalec et Chanaan oppresserunt vos, et clamastis ad me, et erui vos de manu eorum ?

verses.name: Judges 10:13
verses.text: Et tamen reliquistis me, et coluistis deos alienos : idcirco non addam ut ultra vos liberem :

verses.name: Judges 10:14
verses.text: ite, et invocate deos quos elegistis : ipsi vos liberent in tempore angustiæ.

verses.name: Judges 10:15
verses.text: Dixeruntque filii Israël ad Dominum : Peccavimus, redde tu nobis quidquid tibi placet : tantum nunc libera nos.

verses.name: Judges 10:16
verses.text: Quæ dicentes, omnia de finibus suis alienorum deorum idola projecerunt, et servierunt Domino Deo : qui doluit super miseriis eorum.

verses.name: Judges 10:17
verses.text: Itaque filii Ammon conclamantes in Galaad fixere tentoria, contra quos congregati filii Israël in Maspha castrametati sunt.

verses.name: Judges 10:18
verses.text: Dixeruntque principes Galaad singuli ad proximos suos : Qui primus ex nobis contra filios Ammon cœperit dimicare, erit dux populi Galaad.  <chapter eID="Judg.10"/> <div eID="gen1274" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:1
verses.text: Fuit illo tempore Jephte Galaadites vir fortissimus atque pugnator, filius mulieris meretricis, qui natus est de Galaad.

verses.name: Judges 11:2
verses.text: Habuit autem Galaad uxorem, de qua suscepit filios : qui postquam creverant, ejecerunt Jephte, dicentes : Hæres in domo patris nostri esse non poteris, quia de altera matre natus es.

verses.name: Judges 11:3
verses.text: Quos ille fugiens atque devitans, habitavit in terra Tob : congregatique sunt ad eum viri inopes, et latrocinantes, et quasi principem sequebantur.

verses.name: Judges 11:4
verses.text: In illis diebus pugnabant filii Ammon contra Israël.

verses.name: Judges 11:5
verses.text: Quibus acriter instantibus perrexerunt majores natu de Galaad, ut tollerent in auxilium sui Jephte de terra Tob :

verses.name: Judges 11:6
verses.text: dixeruntque ad eum : Veni et esto princeps noster, et pugna contra filios Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:7
verses.text: Quibus ille respondit : Nonne vos estis, qui odistis me, et ejecistis de domo patris mei ? et nunc venistis ad me necessitate compulsi.

verses.name: Judges 11:8
verses.text: Dixeruntque principes Galaad ad Jephte : Ob hanc igitur causam nunc ad te venimus, ut proficiscaris nobiscum, et pugnes contra filios Ammon, sisque dux omnium qui habitant in Galaad.

verses.name: Judges 11:9
verses.text: Jephte quoque dixit eis : Si vere venistis ad me, ut pugnem pro vobis contra filios Ammon, tradideritque eos Dominus in manus meas, ego ero vester princeps ?

verses.name: Judges 11:10
verses.text: Qui responderunt ei : Dominus, qui hæc audit, ipse mediator ac testis est quod nostra promissa faciemus.

verses.name: Judges 11:11
verses.text: Abiit itaque Jephte cum principibus Galaad, fecitque eum omnis populus principem sui. Locutusque est Jephte omnes sermones suos coram Domino in Maspha.  <div eID="gen1275" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv594"/><div sID="gen1276" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv594"/>Et misit nuntios ad regem filiorum Ammon, qui ex persona sua dicerent : Quid mihi et tibi est, quia venisti contra me, ut vastares terram meam ?

verses.name: Judges 11:13
verses.text: Quibus ille respondit : Quia tulit Israël terram meam, quando ascendit de Ægypto, a finibus Arnon usque Jaboc atque Jordanem : nunc ergo cum pace redde mihi eam.

verses.name: Judges 11:14
verses.text: Per quos rursum mandavit Jephte, et imperavit eis ut dicerent regi Ammon :

verses.name: Judges 11:15
verses.text: Hæc dicit Jephte : Non tulit Israël terram Moab, nec terram filiorum Ammon :

verses.name: Judges 11:16
verses.text: sed quando de Ægypto conscenderunt, ambulavit per solitudinem usque ad mare Rubrum, et venit in Cades.

verses.name: Judges 11:17
verses.text: Misitque nuntios ad regem Edom, dicens : Dimitte me ut transeam per terram tuam. Qui noluit acquiescere precibus ejus. Misit quoque ad regem Moab, qui et ipse transitum præbere contempsit. Mansit itaque in Cades,

verses.name: Judges 11:18
verses.text: et circuivit ex latere terram Edom et terram Moab : venitque contra orientalem plagam terræ Moab, et castrametatus est trans Arnon : nec voluit intrare terminos Moab. (Arnon quippe confinium est terræ Moab.)

verses.name: Judges 11:19
verses.text: Misit itaque Israël nuntios ad Sehon regem Amorrhæorum, qui habitabat in Hesebon, et dixerunt ei : Dimitte ut transeam per terram tuam usque ad fluvium.

verses.name: Judges 11:20
verses.text: Qui et ipse Israël verba despiciens, non dimisit eum transire per terminos suos : sed infinita multitudine congregata, egressus est contra eum in Jasa, et fortiter resistebat.

verses.name: Judges 11:21
verses.text: Tradiditque eum Dominus in manus Israël cum omni exercitu suo : qui percussit eum, et possedit omnem terram Amorrhæi habitatoris regionis illius,

verses.name: Judges 11:22
verses.text: et universos fines ejus, de Arnon usque Jaboc, et de solitudine usque ad Jordanem.

verses.name: Judges 11:23
verses.text: Dominus ergo Deus Israël subvertit Amorrhæum, pugnante contra illum populo suo Israël, et tu nunc vis possidere terram ejus ?

verses.name: Judges 11:24
verses.text: nonne ea quæ possidet Chamos deus tuus, tibi jure debentur ? quæ autem Dominus Deus noster victor obtinuit, in nostram cedent possessionem :

verses.name: Judges 11:25
verses.text: nisi forte melior es Balac filio Sephor rege Moab ; aut docere potes, quod jurgatus sit contra Israël, et pugnaverit contra eum,

verses.name: Judges 11:26
verses.text: quando habitavit in Hesebon et viculis ejus, et in Aroër et villis illius, vel in cunctis civitatibus juxta Jordanem, per trecentos annos. Quare tanto tempore nihil super hac repetitione tentastis ?

verses.name: Judges 11:27
verses.text: Igitur non ego pecco in te, sed tu contra me male agis, indicens mihi bella non justa. Judicet Dominus arbiter hujus diei inter Israël, et inter filios Ammon.

verses.name: Judges 11:28
verses.text: Noluitque acquiescere rex filiorum Ammon verbis Jephte, quæ per nuntios mandaverat.  <div eID="gen1276" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv595"/><div sID="gen1277" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv595"/>Factus est ergo super Jephte spiritus Domini, et circuiens Galaad et Manasse, Maspha quoque Galaad, et inde transiens ad filios Ammon,

verses.name: Judges 11:30
verses.text: votum vovit Domino, dicens : Si tradideris filios Ammon in manus meas,

verses.name: Judges 11:31
verses.text: quicumque primus fuerit egressus de foribus domus meæ, mihique occurrerit revertenti cum pace a filiis Ammon, eum holocaustum offeram Domino.

verses.name: Judges 11:32
verses.text: Transivitque Jephte ad filios Ammon, ut pugnaret contra eos : quos tradidit Dominus in manus ejus.

verses.name: Judges 11:33
verses.text: Percussitque ab Aroër usque dum venias in Mennith, viginti civitates, et usque ad Abel, quæ est vineis consita, plaga magna nimis : humiliatique sunt filii Ammon a filiis Israël.  <div eID="gen1277" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 11:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv596"/><div sID="gen1278" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv596"/>Revertente autem Jephte in Maspha domum suam, occurrit ei unigenita filia sua cum tympanis et choris : non enim habebat alios liberos.

verses.name: Judges 11:35
verses.text: Qua visa, scidit vestimenta sua, et ait : Heu me, filia mea ! decepisti me, et ipsa decepta es : aperui enim os meum ad Dominum, et aliud facere non potero.

verses.name: Judges 11:36
verses.text: Cui illa respondit : Pater mi, si aperuisti os tuum ad Dominum, fac mihi quodcumque pollicitus es, concessa tibi ultione atque victoria de hostibus tuis.

verses.name: Judges 11:37
verses.text: Dixitque ad patrem : Hoc solum mihi præsta quod deprecor : dimitte me ut duobus mensibus circumeam montes, et plangam virginitatem meam cum sodalibus meis.

verses.name: Judges 11:38
verses.text: Cui ille respondit : Vade. Et dimisit eam duobus mensibus. Cumque abiisset cum sociis ac sodalibus suis, flebat virginitatem suam in montibus.

verses.name: Judges 11:39
verses.text: Expletisque duobus mensibus, reversa est ad patrem suum, et fecit ei sicut voverat, quæ ignorabat virum. Exinde mos increbruit in Israël, et consuetudo servata est,

verses.name: Judges 11:40
verses.text: ut post anni circulum conveniant in unum filiæ Israël, et plangant filiam Jephte Galaaditæ diebus quatuor.  <chapter eID="Judg.11"/> <div eID="gen1278" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:1
verses.text: Ecce autem in Ephraim orta est seditio : nam transeuntes contra aquilonem, dixerunt ad Jephte : Quare vadens ad pugnam contra filios Ammon, vocare nos noluisti, ut pergeremus tecum ? igitur incendemus domum tuam.

verses.name: Judges 12:2
verses.text: Quibus ille respondit : Disceptatio erat mihi et populo meo contra filios Ammon vehemens : vocavique vos, ut præberetis mihi auxilium, et facere noluistis.

verses.name: Judges 12:3
verses.text: Quod cernens, posui animam meam in manibus meis, transivique ad filios Ammon, et tradidit eos Dominus in manus meas. Quid commerui, ut adversum me consurgatis in prælium ?

verses.name: Judges 12:4
verses.text: Vocatis itaque ad se cunctis viris Galaad, pugnabat contra Ephraim : percusseruntque viri Galaad Ephraim, quia dixerat : Fugitivus est Galaad de Ephraim, et habitat in medio Ephraim et Manasse.

verses.name: Judges 12:5
verses.text: Occupaveruntque Galaaditæ vada Jordanis, per quæ Ephraim reversurus erat. Cumque venisset ad ea de Ephraim numero, fugiens, atque dixisset : Obsecro ut me transire permittatis : dicebant ei Galaaditæ : Numquid Ephrathæus es ? quo dicente : Non sum :

verses.name: Judges 12:6
verses.text: interrogabant eum : Dic ergo Scibboleth, quod interpretatur Spica. Qui respondebat : Sibboleth : eadem littera spicam exprimere non valens. Statimque apprehensum jugulabant in ipso Jordanis transitu. Et ceciderunt in illo tempore de Ephraim quadraginta duo millia.  <div eID="gen1279" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv597"/><div sID="gen1280" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv597"/>Judicavit itaque Jephte Galaadites Israël sex annis : et mortuus est, ac sepultus in civitate sua Galaad.  <div eID="gen1280" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Judges 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv598"/><div sID="gen1281" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv598"/>Post hunc judicavit Israël Abesan de Bethlehem :

verses.name: Judges 12:9
verses.text: qui habuit triginta filios, et totidem filias, quas emittens foras, maritis dedit, et ejusdem numeri filiis suis accepit uxores, introducens in domum suam. Qui septem annis judicavit Israël :

verses.name: Judges 12:10
verses.text: mortuusque est, ac sepultus in Bethlehem.

verses.name: Judges 12:11
