verses.text: Dixit autem Absalom ad Achitophel : Inite consilium quid agere debeamus.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:21
verses.text: Et ait Achitophel ad Absalom : Ingredere ad concubinas patris tui, quas dimisit ad custodiendam domum : ut cum audierit omnis Israël quod fœdaveris patrem tuum, roborentur tecum manus eorum.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:22
verses.text: Tetenderunt ergo Absalom tabernaculum in solario, ingressusque est ad concubinas patris sui coram universo Israël.

verses.name: II Samuel 16:23
verses.text: Consilium autem Achitophel quod dabat in diebus illis, quasi si quis consuleret Deum : sic erat omne consilium Achitophel, et cum esset cum David, et cum esset cum Absalom.  <chapter eID="2Sam.16"/> <div eID="gen1553" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:1
verses.text: Dixit ergo Achitophel ad Absalom : Eligam mihi duodecim millia virorum, et consurgens persequar David hac nocte.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:2
verses.text: Et irruens super eum (quippe qui lassus est, et solutis manibus), percutiam eum : cumque fugerit omnis populus qui cum eo est, percutiam regem desolatum.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:3
verses.text: Et reducam universum populum, quomodo unus homo reverti solet : unum enim virum tu quæris : et omnis populus erit in pace.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:4
verses.text: Placuitque sermo ejus Absalom, et cunctis majoribus natu Israël.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:5
verses.text: Ait autem Absalom : Vocate Chusai Arachiten, et audiamus quid etiam ipse dicat.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:6
verses.text: Cumque venisset Chusai ad Absalom, ait Absalom ad eum : Hujuscemodi sermonem locutus est Achitophel : facere debemus an non ? quod das consilium ?

verses.name: II Samuel 17:7
verses.text: Et dixit Chusai ad Absalom : Non est bonum consilium quod dedit Achitophel hac vice.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:8
verses.text: Et rursum intulit Chusai : Tu nosti patrem tuum, et viros qui cum eo sunt, esse fortissimos et amaro animo, veluti si ursa raptis catulis in saltu sæviat : sed et pater tuus vir bellator est, nec morabitur cum populo.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:9
verses.text: Forsitan nunc latitat in foveis, aut in uno, quo voluerit, loco : et cum ceciderit unus quilibet in principio, audiet quicumque audierit, et dicet : Facta est plaga in populo qui sequebatur Absalom.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:10
verses.text: Et fortissimus quisque, cujus cor est quasi leonis, pavore solvetur : scit enim omnis populus Israël fortem esse patrem tuum, et robustos omnes qui cum eo sunt.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:11
verses.text: Sed hoc mihi videtur rectum esse consilium. Congregetur ad te universus Israël, a Dan usque Bersabee, quasi arena maris innumerabilis : et tu eris in medio eorum.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:12
verses.text: Et irruemus super eum in quocumque loco inventus fuerit, et operiemus eum, sicut cadere solet ros super terram : et non relinquemus de viris qui cum eo sunt, ne unum quidem.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:13
verses.text: Quod si urbem aliquam fuerit ingressus, circumdabit omnis Israël civitati illi funes, et trahemus eam in torrentem, ut non reperiatur ne calculus quidem ex ea.  <div eID="gen1554" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv731"/><div sID="gen1555" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv731"/>Dixitque Absalom, et omnes viri Israël : Melius est consilium Chusai Arachitæ, consilio Achitophel : Domini autem nutu dissipatum est consilium Achitophel utile, ut induceret Dominus super Absalom malum.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:15
verses.text: Et ait Chusai Sadoc et Abiathar sacerdotibus : Hoc et hoc modo consilium dedit Achitophel Absalom et senioribus Israël : et ego tale et tale dedi consilium.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:16
verses.text: Nunc ergo mittite cito, et nuntiate David, dicentes : Ne moreris nocte hac in campestribus deserti, sed absque dilatione transgredere : ne forte absorbeatur rex, et omnis populus qui cum eo est.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:17
verses.text: Jonathas autem et Achimaas stabant juxta fontem Rogel : abiit ancilla et nuntiavit eis. Et illi profecti sunt, ut referrent ad regem David nuntium : non enim poterant videri, aut introire civitatem.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:18
verses.text: Vidit autem eos quidam puer, et indicavit Absalom : illi vero concito gradu ingressi sunt domum cujusdam viri in Bahurim, qui habebat puteum in vestibulo suo : et descenderunt in eum.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:19
verses.text: Tulit autem mulier, et expandit velamen super os putei, quasi siccans ptisanas : et sic latuit res.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:20
verses.text: Cumque venissent servi Absalom in domum, ad mulierem dixerunt : Ubi est Achimaas et Jonathas ? Et respondit eis mulier : Transierunt festinanter, gustata paululum aqua. At hi qui quærebant, cum non reperissent, reversi sunt in Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:21
verses.text: Cumque abiissent, ascenderunt illi de puteo, et pergentes nuntiaverunt regi David, et dixerunt : Surgite, et transite cito fluvium : quoniam hujuscemodi dedit consilium contra vos Achitophel.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:22
verses.text: Surrexit ergo David, et omnis populus qui cum eo erat, et transierunt Jordanem, donec dilucesceret : et ne unus quidem residuus fuit, qui non transisset fluvium.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:23
verses.text: Porro Achitophel videns quod non fuisset factum consilium suum, stravit asinum suum, surrexitque, et abiit in domum suam et in civitatem suam : et disposita domo sua, suspendio interiit, et sepultus est in sepulchro patris sui.  <div eID="gen1555" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv732"/><div sID="gen1556" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv732"/>David autem venit in castra, et Absalom transivit Jordanem, ipse et omnes viri Israël cum eo.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:25
verses.text: Amasam vero constituit Absalom pro Joab super exercitum : Amasa autem erat filius viri qui vocabatur Jetra de Jezraëli, qui ingressus est ad Abigail filiam Naas, sororem Sarviæ, quæ fuit mater Joab.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:26
verses.text: Et castrametatus est Israël cum Absalom in terra Galaad.

verses.name: II Samuel 17:27
verses.text: Cumque venisset David in castra, Sobi filius Naas de Rabbath filiorum Ammon, et Machir filius Ammihel de Lodabar, et Berzellai Galaadites de Rogelim,

verses.name: II Samuel 17:28
verses.text: obtulerunt ei stratoria, et tapetia, et vasa fictilia, frumentum, et hordeum, et farinam, et polentam, et fabam, et lentem, et frixum cicer,

verses.name: II Samuel 17:29
verses.text: et mel, et butyrum, oves, et pingues vitulos : dederuntque David, et populo qui cum eo erat, ad vescendum : suspicati enim sunt populum fame et siti fatigari in deserto.  <chapter eID="2Sam.17"/> <div eID="gen1556" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:1
verses.text: Igitur considerato David populo suo, constituit super eos tribunos et centuriones,

verses.name: II Samuel 18:2
verses.text: et dedit populi tertiam partem sub manu Joab, et tertiam partem sub manu Abisai filii Sarviæ fratris Joab, et tertiam partem sub manu Ethai, qui erat de Geth. Dixitque rex ad populum : Egrediar et ego vobiscum.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:3
verses.text: Et respondit populus : Non exibis : sive enim fugerimus, non magnopere ad eos de nobis pertinebit : sive media pars ceciderit e nobis, non satis curabunt, quia tu unus pro decem millibus computaris : melius est igitur ut sis nobis in urbe præsidio.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:4
verses.text: Ad quos rex ait : Quod vobis videtur rectum, hoc faciam. Stetit ergo rex juxta portam : egrediebaturque populus per turmas suas centeni et milleni.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:5
verses.text: Et præcepit rex Joab, et Abisai, et Ethai, dicens : Servate mihi puerum Absalom. Et omnis populus audiebat præcipientem regem cunctis principibus pro Absalom.  <div eID="gen1557" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv733"/><div sID="gen1558" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv733"/>Itaque egressus est populus in campum contra Israël, et factum est prælium in saltu Ephraim.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:7
verses.text: Et cæsus est ibi populus Israël ab exercitu David, factaque est plaga magna in die illa, viginti millium.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:8
verses.text: Fuit autem ibi prælium dispersum super faciem omnis terræ, et multo plures erant quos saltus consumpserat de populo, quam hi quos voraverat gladius in die illa.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:9
verses.text: Accidit autem ut occurreret Absalom servis David, sedens mulo : cumque ingressus fuisset mulus subter condensam quercum et magnam, adhæsit caput ejus quercui : et illo suspenso inter cælum et terram, mulus cui insederat, pertransivit.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:10
verses.text: Vidit autem hoc quispiam, et nuntiavit Joab, dicens : Vidi Absalom pendere de quercu.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:11
verses.text: Et ait Joab viro qui nuntiaverat ei : Si vidisti, quare non confodisti eum cum terra, et ego dedissem tibi decem argenti siclos, et unum balteum ?

verses.name: II Samuel 18:12
verses.text: Qui dixit ad Joab : Si appenderes in manibus meis mille argenteos, nequaquam mitterem manum meam in filium regis : audientibus enim nobis præcepit rex tibi, et Abisai, et Ethai, dicens : Custodite mihi puerum Absalom.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:13
verses.text: Sed etsi fecissem contra animam meam audacter, nequaquam hoc regem latere potuisset, et tu stares ex adverso ?

verses.name: II Samuel 18:14
verses.text: Et ait Joab : Non sicut tu vis, sed aggrediar eum coram te. Tulit ergo tres lanceas in manu sua, et infixit eas in corde Absalom : cumque adhuc palpitaret hærens in quercu,

verses.name: II Samuel 18:15
verses.text: cucurrerunt decem juvenes armigeri Joab, et percutientes interfecerunt eum.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:16
verses.text: Cecinit autem Joab buccina, et retinuit populum, ne persequeretur fugientem Israël, volens parcere multitudini.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:17
verses.text: Et tulerunt Absalom, et projecerunt eum in saltu, in foveam grandem, et comportaverunt super eum acervum lapidum magnum nimis : omnis autem Israël fugit in tabernacula sua.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:18
verses.text: Porro Absalom erexerat sibi, cum adhuc viveret, titulum qui est in Valle regis : dixerat enim : Non habeo filium, et hoc erit monimentum nominis mei. Vocavitque titulum nomine suo, et appellatur Manus Absalom, usque ad hanc diem.  <div eID="gen1558" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv734"/><div sID="gen1559" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv734"/>Achimaas autem filius Sadoc, ait : Curram, et nuntiabo regi quia judicium fecerit ei Dominus de manu inimicorum ejus.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:20
verses.text: Ad quem Joab dixit : Non eris nuntius in hac die, sed nuntiabis in alia : hodie nolo te nuntiare : filius enim regis est mortuus.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:21
verses.text: Et ait Joab Chusi : Vade, et nuntia regi quæ vidisti. Adoravit Chusi Joab, et cucurrit.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:22
verses.text: Rursus autem Achimaas filius Sadoc dixit ad Joab : Quid impedit si etiam ego curram post Chusi ? Dixitque ei Joab : Quid vis currere, fili mi ? non eris boni nuntii bajulus.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:23
verses.text: Qui respondit : Quid enim si cucurrero ? Et ait ei : Curre. Currens ergo Achimaas per viam compendii, transivit Chusi.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:24
verses.text: David autem sedebat inter duas portas : speculator vero, qui erat in fastigio portæ super murum, elevans oculos, vidit hominem currentem solum.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:25
verses.text: Et exclamans indicavit regi : dixitque rex : Si solus est, bonus est nuntius in ore ejus. Properante autem illo, et accedente propius,

verses.name: II Samuel 18:26
verses.text: vidit speculator hominem alterum currentem, et vociferans in culmine, ait : Apparet mihi alter homo currens solus. Dixitque rex : Et iste bonus est nuntius.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:27
verses.text: Speculator autem : Contemplor, ait, cursum prioris, quasi cursum Achimaas filii Sadoc. Et ait rex : Vir bonus est, et nuntium portans bonum venit.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:28
verses.text: Clamans autem Achimaas, dixit ad regem : Salve rex. Et adorans regem coram eo pronus in terram, ait : Benedictus Dominus Deus tuus, qui conclusit homines qui levaverunt manus suas contra dominum meum regem.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:29
verses.text: Et ait rex : Estne pax puero Absalom ? Dixitque Achimaas : Vidi tumultum magnum cum mitteret Joab servus tuus, o rex, me servum tuum : nescio aliud.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:30
verses.text: Ad quem rex : Transi, ait, et sta hic. Cumque ille transisset, et staret,

verses.name: II Samuel 18:31
verses.text: apparuit Chusi : et veniens ait : Bonum apporto nuntium, domine mi rex : judicavit enim pro te Dominus hodie de manu omnium qui surrexerunt contra te.  <div eID="gen1559" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 18:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv735"/><div sID="gen1560" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv735"/>Dixit autem rex ad Chusi : Estne pax puero Absalom ? Cui respondens Chusi : Fiant, inquit, sicut puer, inimici domini mei regis, et universi qui consurgunt adversus eum in malum.

verses.name: II Samuel 18:33
verses.text: Contristatus itaque rex, ascendit cœnaculum portæ, et flevit. Et sic loquebatur, vadens : Fili mi Absalom, Absalom fili mi : quis mihi tribuat ut ego moriar pro te, Absalom fili mi, fili mi Absalom ?  <chapter eID="2Sam.18"/> <div eID="gen1560" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:1
verses.text: Nuntiatum est autem Joab quod rex fleret et lugeret filium suum,

verses.name: II Samuel 19:2
verses.text: et versa est victoria in luctum in die illa omni populo : audivit enim populus in die illa dici : Dolet rex super filio suo.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:3
verses.text: Et declinavit populus in die illa ingredi civitatem, quomodo declinare solet populus versus et fugiens de prælio.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:4
verses.text: Porro rex operuit caput suum, et clamabat voce magna : Fili mi Absalom, Absalom fili mi, fili mi.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:5
verses.text: Ingressus ergo Joab ad regem in domum, dixit : Confudisti hodie vultus omnium servorum tuorum, qui salvam fecerunt animam tuam, et animam filiorum tuorum et filiarum tuarum, et animam uxorum tuarum, et animam concubinarum tuarum.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:6
verses.text: Diligis odientes te, et odio habes diligentes te : et ostendisti hodie quia non curas de ducibus tuis et de servis tuis : et vere cognovi modo, quia si Absalom viveret, et omnes nos occubuissemus, tunc placeret tibi.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:7
verses.text: Nunc igitur surge, et procede, et alloquens satisfac servis tuis : juro enim tibi per Dominum quod si non exieris, ne unus quidem remansurus sit tecum nocte hac : et pejus erit hoc tibi quam omnia mala quæ venerunt super te ab adolescentia tua usque in præsens.  <div eID="gen1561" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv736"/><div sID="gen1562" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv736"/>Surrexit ergo rex et sedit in porta : et omni populo nuntiatum est quod rex sederet in porta. Venitque universa multitudo coram rege : Israël autem fugit in tabernacula sua.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:9
verses.text: Omnis quoque populus certabat in cunctis tribubus Israël, dicens : Rex liberavit nos de manu inimicorum nostrorum ; ipse salvavit nos de manu Philisthinorum : et nunc fugit de terra propter Absalom.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:10
verses.text: Absalom autem, quem unximus super nos, mortuus est in bello : usquequo siletis, et non reducitis regem ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:11
verses.text: Rex vero David misit ad Sadoc et Abiathar sacerdotes, dicens : Loquimini ad majores natu Juda, dicentes : Cur venitis novissimi ad reducendum regem in domum suam ? (Sermo autem omnis Israël pervenerat ad regem in domo ejus.)

verses.name: II Samuel 19:12
verses.text: Fratres mei vos, os meum, et caro mea vos, quare novissimi reducitis regem ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:13
verses.text: Et Amasæ dicite : Nonne os meum, et caro mea es ? hæc faciat mihi Deus, et hæc addat, si non magister militiæ fueris coram me omni tempore pro Joab.  <div eID="gen1562" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv737"/><div sID="gen1563" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv737"/>Et inclinavit cor omnium virorum Juda quasi viri unius : miseruntque ad regem, dicentes : Revertere tu, et omnes servi tui.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:15
verses.text: Et reversus est rex, et venit usque ad Jordanem : et omnis Juda venit usque in Galgalam ut occurreret regi, et traduceret eum Jordanem.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:16
verses.text: Festinavit autem Semei filius Gera filii Jemini de Bahurim, et descendit cum viris Juda in occursum regis David,

verses.name: II Samuel 19:17
verses.text: cum mille viris de Benjamin, et Siba puer de domo Saul : et quindecim filii ejus, ac viginti servi erant cum eo : et irrumpentes Jordanem, ante regem

verses.name: II Samuel 19:18
verses.text: transierunt vada, ut traducerent domum regis, et facerent juxta jussionem ejus : Semei autem filius Gera prostratus coram rege, cum jam transisset Jordanem,

verses.name: II Samuel 19:19
verses.text: dixit ad eum : Ne reputes mihi, domine mi, iniquitatem, neque memineris injuriarum servi tui in die qua egressus es, domine mi rex, de Jerusalem, neque ponas, rex, in corde tuo.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:20
verses.text: Agnosco enim servus tuus peccatum meum : et idcirco hodie primus veni de omni domo Joseph, descendique in occursum domini mei regis.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:21
verses.text: Respondens vero Abisai filius Sarviæ, dixit : Numquid pro his verbis non occidetur Semei, quia maledixit christo Domini ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:22
verses.text: Et ait David : Quid mihi et vobis, filii Sarviæ ? cur efficimini mihi hodie in satan ? ergone hodie interficietur vir in Israël ? an ignoro hodie me factum regem super Israël ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:23
verses.text: Et ait rex Semei : Non morieris. Juravitque ei.  <div eID="gen1563" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv738"/><div sID="gen1564" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv738"/>Miphiboseth quoque filius Saul descendit in occursum regis, illotis pedibus et intonsa barba : vestesque suas non laverat a die qua egressus fuerat rex, usque ad diem reversionis ejus in pace.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:25
verses.text: Cumque Jerusalem occurrisset regi, dixit ei rex : Quare non venisti mecum, Miphiboseth ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:26
verses.text: Et respondens ait : Domine mi rex, servus meus contempsit me : dixique ei ego famulus tuus ut sterneret mihi asinum, et ascendens abirem cum rege : claudus enim sum servus tuus.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:27
verses.text: Insuper et accusavit me servum tuum ad te dominum meum regem : tu autem, domine mi rex, sicut angelus Dei es : fac quod placitum est tibi.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:28
verses.text: Neque enim fuit domus patris mei, nisi morti obnoxia domino meo regi : tu autem posuisti me servum tuum inter convivas mensæ tuæ : quid ergo habeo justæ querelæ ? aut quid possum ultra vociferari ad regem ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:29
verses.text: Ait ergo ei rex : Quid ultra loqueris ? fixum est quod locutus sum : tu et Siba dividite possessiones.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:30
verses.text: Responditque Miphiboseth regi : Etiam cuncta accipiat, postquam reversus est dominus meus rex pacifice in domum suam.  <div eID="gen1564" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 19:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv739"/><div sID="gen1565" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv739"/>Berzellai quoque Galaadites, descendens de Rogelim, traduxit regem Jordanem, paratus etiam ultra fluvium prosequi eum.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:32
verses.text: Erat autem Berzellai Galaadites senex valde, id est, octogenarius, et ipse præbuit alimenta regi cum moraretur in castris : fuit quippe vir dives nimis.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:33
verses.text: Dixit itaque rex ad Berzellai : Veni mecum, ut requiescas securus mecum in Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:34
verses.text: Et ait Berzellai ad regem : Quot sunt dies annorum vitæ meæ, ut ascendam cum rege in Jerusalem ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:35
verses.text: Octogenarius sum hodie : numquid vigent sensus mei ad discernendum suave aut amarum ? aut delectare potest servum tuum cibus et potus ? vel audire possum ultra vocem cantorum atque cantatricum ? quare servus tuus sit oneri domino meo regi ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:36
verses.text: Paululum procedam famulus tuus ab Jordane tecum : non indigeo hac vicissitudine,

verses.name: II Samuel 19:37
verses.text: sed obsecro ut revertar servus tuus, et moriar in civitate mea, et sepeliar juxta sepulchrum patris mei et matris meæ. Est autem servus tuus Chamaam : ipse vadat tecum, domine mi rex, et fac ei quidquid tibi bonum videtur.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:38
verses.text: Dixit itaque ei rex : Mecum transeat Chamaam, et ego faciam ei quidquid tibi placuerit : et omne quod petieris a me, impetrabis.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:39
verses.text: Cumque transisset universus populus et rex Jordanem, osculatus est rex Berzellai, et benedixit ei : et ille reversus est in locum suum.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:40
verses.text: Transivit ergo rex in Galgalam, et Chamaam cum eo. <div eID="gen1565" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen1566" type="x-p"/> Omnis autem populus Juda traduxerat regem, et media tantum pars adfuerat de populo Israël.

verses.name: II Samuel 19:41
verses.text: Itaque omnes viri Israël concurrentes ad regem dixerunt ei : Quare te furati sunt fratres nostri viri Juda, et traduxerunt regem et domum ejus Jordanem, omnesque viros David cum eo ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:42
verses.text: Et respondit omnis vir Juda ad viros Israël : Quia mihi propior est rex : cur irasceris super hac re ? numquid comedimus aliquid ex rege, aut munera nobis data sunt ?

verses.name: II Samuel 19:43
verses.text: Et respondit vir Israël ad viros Juda, et ait : Decem partibus major ego sum apud regem, magisque ad me pertinet David quam ad te : cur fecisti mihi injuriam, et non mihi nuntiatum est priori, ut reducerem regem meum ? Durius autem responderunt viri Juda viris Israël.  <chapter eID="2Sam.19"/> <div eID="gen1566" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:1
verses.text: Accidit quoque ut ibi esset vir Belial, nomine Seba, filius Bochri, vir Jemineus : et cecinit buccina, et ait : Non est nobis pars in David, neque hæreditas in filio Isai : revertere in tabernacula tua, Israël.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:2
verses.text: Et separatus est omnis Israël a David, secutusque est Seba filium Bochri : viri autem Juda adhæserunt regi suo a Jordane usque Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:3
verses.text: Cumque venisset rex in domum suam in Jerusalem, tulit decem mulieres concubinas quas dereliquerat ad custodiendam domum, et tradidit eas in custodiam, alimenta eis præbens : et non est ingressus ad eas, sed erant clausæ usque in diem mortis suæ in viduitate viventes.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:4
verses.text: Dixit autem rex Amasæ : Convoca mihi omnes viros Juda in diem tertium, et tu adesto præsens.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:5
verses.text: Abiit ergo Amasa ut convocaret Judam, et moratus est extra placitum quod ei constituerat rex.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:6
verses.text: Ait autem David ad Abisai : Nunc magis afflicturus est nos Seba filius Bochri quam Absalom : tolle igitur servos domini tui, et persequere eum, ne forte inveniat civitates munitas, et effugiat nos.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:7
verses.text: Egressi sunt ergo cum eo viri Joab, Cerethi quoque et Phelethi : et omnes robusti exierunt de Jerusalem ad persequendum Seba filium Bochri.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:8
verses.text: Cumque illi essent juxta lapidem grandem qui est in Gabaon, Amasa veniens occurrit eis. Porro Joab vestitus erat tunica stricta ad mensuram habitus sui, et desuper accinctus gladio dependente usque ad ilia, in vagina, qui fabricatus levi motu egredi poterat, et percutere.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:9
verses.text: Dixit itaque Joab ad Amasam : Salve mi frater. Et tenuit manu dextera mentum Amasæ, quasi osculans eum.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:10
verses.text: Porro Amasa non observavit gladium quem habebat Joab : qui percussit eum in latere, et effudit intestina ejus in terram, nec secundum vulnus apposuit : et mortuus est. Joab autem, et Abisai frater ejus, persecuti sunt Seba filium Bochri.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:11
verses.text: Interea quidam viri, cum stetissent juxta cadaver Amasæ, de sociis Joab, dixerunt : Ecce qui esse voluit pro Joab comes David.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:12
verses.text: Amasa autem conspersus sanguine jacebat in media via. Vidit hoc quidam vir, quod subsisteret omnis populus ad videndum eum, et amovit Amasam de via in agrum, operuitque eum vestimento, ne subsisterent transeuntes propter eum.  <div eID="gen1567" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv740"/><div sID="gen1568" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv740"/>Amoto ergo illo de via, transibat omnis vir sequens Joab ad persequendum Seba filium Bochri.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:14
verses.text: Porro ille transierat per omnes tribus Israël in Abelam et Bethmaacha : omnesque viri electi congregati fuerant ad eum.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:15
verses.text: Venerunt itaque, et oppugnabant eum in Abela et in Bethmaacha, et circumdederunt munitionibus civitatem, et obsessa est urbs : omnis autem turba quæ erat cum Joab, moliebatur destruere muros.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:16
verses.text: Et exclamavit mulier sapiens de civitate : Audite, audite : dicite Joab : Appropinqua huc, et loquar tecum.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:17
verses.text: Qui cum accessisset ad eam, ait illi : Tu es Joab ? Et ille respondit : Ego. Ad quem sic locuta est : Audi sermones ancillæ tuæ. Qui respondit : Audio.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:18
verses.text: Rursumque illa : Sermo, inquit, dicebatur in veteri proverbio : Qui interrogant, interrogent in Abela : et sic perficiebant.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:19
verses.text: Nonne ego sum quæ respondeo veritatem in Israël, et tu quæris subvertere civitatem et evertere matrem in Israël ? quare præcipitas hæreditatem Domini ?

verses.name: II Samuel 20:20
verses.text: Respondensque Joab, ait : Absit, absit hoc a me : non præcipito, neque demolior.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:21
verses.text: Non sic se habet res, sed homo de monte Ephraim, Seba filius Bochri cognomine, levavit manum suam contra regem David : tradite illum solum, et recedemus a civitate. Et ait mulier ad Joab : Ecce caput ejus mittetur ad te per murum.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:22
verses.text: Ingressa est ergo ad omnem populum, et locuta est eis sapienter : qui abscissum caput Seba filii Bochri projecerunt ad Joab. Et ille cecinit tuba, et recesserunt ab urbe, unusquisque in tabernacula sua : Joab autem reversus est Jerusalem ad regem.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:23
verses.text: Fuit ergo Joab super omnem exercitum Israël : Banaias autem filius Jojadæ super Cerethæos et Phelethæos :

verses.name: II Samuel 20:24
verses.text: Aduram vero super tributa : porro Josaphat filius Ahilud, a commentariis :

verses.name: II Samuel 20:25
verses.text: Siva autem, scriba : Sadoc vero et Abiathar, sacerdotes.

verses.name: II Samuel 20:26
verses.text: Ira autem Jairites erat sacerdos David.  <chapter eID="2Sam.20"/> <div eID="gen1568" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:1
verses.text: Facta est quoque fames in diebus David tribus annis jugiter : et consuluit David oraculum Domini. Dixitque Dominus : Propter Saul, et domum ejus sanguinum, quia occidit Gabaonitas.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:2
verses.text: Vocatis ergo Gabaonitis rex, dixit ad eos (porro Gabaonitæ non erant de filiis Israël, sed reliquiæ Amorrhæorum : filii quippe Israël juraverant eis, et voluit Saul percutere eos zelo, quasi pro filiis Israël et Juda),

verses.name: II Samuel 21:3
verses.text: dixit ergo David ad Gabaonitas : Quid faciam vobis ? et quod erit vestri piaculum, ut benedicatis hæreditati Domini ?

verses.name: II Samuel 21:4
verses.text: Dixeruntque ei Gabaonitæ : Non est nobis super argento et auro quæstio, sed contra Saul, et contra domum ejus : neque volumus ut interficiatur homo de Israël. Ad quos rex ait : Quid ergo vultis ut faciam vobis ?

verses.name: II Samuel 21:5
verses.text: Qui dixerunt regi : Virum qui attrivit nos et oppressit inique, ita delere debemus, ut ne unus quidem residuus sit de stirpe ejus in cunctis finibus Israël.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:6
verses.text: Dentur nobis septem viri de filiis ejus, ut crucifigamus eos Domino in Gabaa Saul, quondam electi Domini. Et ait rex : Ego dabo.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:7
verses.text: Pepercitque rex Miphiboseth filio Jonathæ filii Saul, propter jusjurandum Domini quod fuerat inter David et inter Jonathan filium Saul.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:8
verses.text: Tulit itaque rex duos filios Respha filiæ Aja quos peperit Sauli, Armoni, et Miphiboseth : et quinque filios Michol filiæ Saul quos genuerat Hadrieli filio Berzellai, qui fuit de Molathi,

verses.name: II Samuel 21:9
verses.text: et dedit eos in manus Gabaonitarum : qui crucifixerunt eos in monte coram Domino : et ceciderunt hi septem simul occisi in diebus messis primis, incipiente messione hordei.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:10
verses.text: Tollens autem Respha filia Aja cilicium, substravit sibi supra petram ab initio messis, donec stillaret aqua super eos de cælo : et non dimisit aves lacerare eos per diem, neque bestias per noctem.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:11
verses.text: Et nuntiata sunt David quæ fecerat Respha filia Aja, concubina Saul.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:12
verses.text: Et abiit David, et tulit ossa Saul, et ossa Jonathæ filii ejus, a viris Jabes Galaad, qui furati fuerant ea de platea Bethsan in qua suspenderant eos Philisthiim cum interfecissent Saul in Gelboë :

verses.name: II Samuel 21:13
verses.text: et asportavit inde ossa Saul, et ossa Jonathæ filii ejus : et colligentes ossa eorum qui affixi fuerant,

verses.name: II Samuel 21:14
verses.text: sepelierunt ea cum ossibus Saul et Jonathæ filii ejus in terra Benjamin, in latere, in sepulchro Cis patris ejus : feceruntque omnia quæ præceperat rex, et repropitiatus est Deus terræ post hæc.  <div eID="gen1569" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv741"/><div sID="gen1570" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv741"/>Factum est autem rursum prælium Philisthinorum adversum Israël, et descendit David, et servi ejus cum eo, et pugnabant contra Philisthiim. Deficiente autem David,

verses.name: II Samuel 21:16
verses.text: Jesbibenob, qui fuit de genere Arapha, cujus ferrum hastæ trecentas uncias appendebat, et accinctus erat ense novo, nisus est percutere David.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:17
verses.text: Præsidioque ei fuit Abisai filius Sarviæ, et percussum Philisthæum interfecit. Tunc juraverunt viri David, dicentes : Jam non egredieris nobiscum in bellum, ne extinguas lucernam Israël.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:18
verses.text: Secundum quoque bellum fuit in Gob contra Philisthæos : tunc percussit Sobochai de Husati, Saph de stirpe Arapha de genere gigantum.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:19
verses.text: Tertium quoque fuit bellum in Gob contra Philisthæos, in quo percussit Adeodatus filius Saltus polymitarius Bethlehemites Goliath Gethæum, cujus hastile hastæ erat quasi liciatorium texentium.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:20
verses.text: Quartum bellum fuit in Geth : in quo vir fuit excelsus, qui senos in manibus pedibusque habebat digitos, id est, viginti quatuor : et erat de origine Arapha.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:21
verses.text: Et blasphemavit Israël : percussit autem eum Jonathan filius Samaa fratris David.

verses.name: II Samuel 21:22
verses.text: Hi quatuor nati sunt de Arapha in Geth, et ceciderunt in manu David et servorum ejus.  <chapter eID="2Sam.21"/> <div eID="gen1570" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:1
verses.text: Locutus est autem David Domino verba carminis hujus in die qua liberavit eum Dominus de manu omnium inimicorum suorum, et de manu Saul.

verses.name: II Samuel 22:2
verses.text: Et ait : <div eID="gen1571" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen1572"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1573"/>Dominus petra mea, et robur meum, et salvator meus. <l eID="gen1573" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv742"/><l level="1" sID="gen1574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv742"/>Deus fortis meus : sperabo in eum ; <l eID="gen1574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1575"/>scutum meum, et cornu salutis meæ : <l eID="gen1575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1576"/>elevator meus, et refugium meum ; <l eID="gen1576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1577"/>salvator meus : de iniquitate liberabis me. <l eID="gen1577" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv743"/><l level="1" sID="gen1578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv743"/>Laudabilem invocabo Dominum, <l eID="gen1578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1579"/>et ab inimicis meis salvus ero. <l eID="gen1579" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv744"/><l level="1" sID="gen1580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv744"/>Quia circumdederunt me contritiones mortis : <l eID="gen1580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1581"/>torrentes Belial terruerunt me. <l eID="gen1581" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv745"/><l level="1" sID="gen1582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv745"/>Funes inferni circumdederunt me : <l eID="gen1582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1583"/>prævenerunt me laquei mortis. <l eID="gen1583" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv746"/><l level="1" sID="gen1584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv746"/>In tribulatione mea invocabo Dominum, <l eID="gen1584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1585"/>et ad Deum meum clamabo : <l eID="gen1585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1586"/>et exaudiet de templo suo vocem meam, <l eID="gen1586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1587"/>et clamor meus veniet ad aures ejus. <l eID="gen1587" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv747"/><l level="1" sID="gen1588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv747"/>Commota est et contremuit terra ; <l eID="gen1588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1589"/>fundamenta montium concussa sunt, et conquassata : <l eID="gen1589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1590"/>quoniam iratus est eis. <l eID="gen1590" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv748"/><l level="1" sID="gen1591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv748"/>Ascendit fumus de naribus ejus, <l eID="gen1591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1592"/>et ignis de ore ejus vorabit : <l eID="gen1592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1593"/>carbones succensi sunt ab eo. <l eID="gen1593" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv749"/><l level="1" sID="gen1594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv749"/>Inclinavit cælos, et descendit : <l eID="gen1594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1595"/>et caligo sub pedibus ejus. <l eID="gen1595" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv750"/><l level="1" sID="gen1596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv750"/>Et ascendit super cherubim, et volavit : <l eID="gen1596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1597"/>et lapsus est super pennas venti. <l eID="gen1597" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv751"/><l level="1" sID="gen1598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv751"/>Posuit tenebras in circuitu suo latibulum, <l eID="gen1598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1599"/>cribrans aquas de nubibus cælorum. <l eID="gen1599" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv752"/><l level="1" sID="gen1600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv752"/>Præ fulgore in conspectu ejus, <l eID="gen1600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1601"/>succensi sunt carbones ignis. <l eID="gen1601" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv753"/><l level="1" sID="gen1602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv753"/>Tonabit de cælo Dominus, <l eID="gen1602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1603"/>et excelsus dabit vocem suam. <l eID="gen1603" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv754"/><l level="1" sID="gen1604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv754"/>Misit sagittas et dissipavit eos ; <l eID="gen1604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1605"/>fulgur, et consumpsit eos. <l eID="gen1605" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv755"/><l level="1" sID="gen1606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv755"/>Et apparuerunt effusiones maris, <l eID="gen1606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1607"/>et revelata sunt fundamenta orbis <l eID="gen1607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1608"/>ab increpatione Domini, <l eID="gen1608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1609"/>ab inspiratione spiritus furoris ejus. <l eID="gen1609" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv756"/><l level="1" sID="gen1610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv756"/>Misit de excelso, et assumpsit me, <l eID="gen1610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1611"/>et extraxit me de aquis multis. <l eID="gen1611" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv757"/><l level="1" sID="gen1612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv757"/>Liberavit me ab inimico meo potentissimo, <l eID="gen1612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1613"/>et ab his qui oderant me : <l eID="gen1613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1614"/>quoniam robustiores me erant. <l eID="gen1614" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv758"/><l level="1" sID="gen1615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv758"/>Prævenit me in die afflictionis meæ, <l eID="gen1615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1616"/>et factus est Dominus firmamentum meum. <l eID="gen1616" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv759"/><l level="1" sID="gen1617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv759"/>Et eduxit me in latitudinem : <l eID="gen1617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1618"/>liberavit me, quia complacui ei. <l eID="gen1618" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv760"/><l level="1" sID="gen1619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv760"/>Retribuet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam : <l eID="gen1619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1620"/>et secundum munditiam manuum mearum reddet mihi. <l eID="gen1620" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv761"/><l level="1" sID="gen1621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv761"/>Quia custodivi vias Domini, <l eID="gen1621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1622"/>et non egi impie a Deo meo. <l eID="gen1622" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv762"/><l level="1" sID="gen1623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv762"/>Omnia enim judicia ejus in conspectu meo, <l eID="gen1623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1624"/>et præcepta ejus non amovi a me. <l eID="gen1624" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv763"/><l level="1" sID="gen1625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv763"/>Et ero perfectus cum eo, <l eID="gen1625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1626"/>et custodiam me ab iniquitate mea. <l eID="gen1626" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv764"/><l level="1" sID="gen1627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv764"/>Et restituet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam, <l eID="gen1627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1628"/>et secundum munditiam manuum mearum in conspectu oculorum suorum. <l eID="gen1628" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv765"/><l level="1" sID="gen1629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv765"/>Cum sancto sanctus eris, <l eID="gen1629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1630"/>et cum robusto perfectus. <l eID="gen1630" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv766"/><l level="1" sID="gen1631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv766"/>Cum electo electus eris, <l eID="gen1631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1632"/>et cum perverso perverteris. <l eID="gen1632" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv767"/><l level="1" sID="gen1633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv767"/>Et populum pauperem salvum facies : <l eID="gen1633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1634"/>oculisque tuis excelsos humiliabis. <l eID="gen1634" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv768"/><l level="1" sID="gen1635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv768"/>Quia tu lucerna mea, Domine, <l eID="gen1635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1636"/>et tu, Domine, illuminabis tenebras meas. <l eID="gen1636" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv769"/><l level="1" sID="gen1637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv769"/>In te enim curram accinctus : <l eID="gen1637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1638"/>in Deo meo transiliam murum. <l eID="gen1638" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv770"/><l level="1" sID="gen1639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv770"/>Deus, immaculata via ejus ; <l eID="gen1639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1640"/>eloquium Domini igne examinatum : <l eID="gen1640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1641"/>scutum est omnium sperantium in se. <l eID="gen1641" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv771"/><l level="1" sID="gen1642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv771"/>Quis est Deus præter Dominum, <l eID="gen1642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1643"/>et quis fortis præter Deum nostrum ? <l eID="gen1643" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv772"/><l level="1" sID="gen1644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv772"/>Deus qui accinxit me fortitudine, <l eID="gen1644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1645"/>et complanavit perfectam viam meam. <l eID="gen1645" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv773"/><l level="1" sID="gen1646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv773"/>Coæquans pedes meos cervis, <l eID="gen1646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1647"/>et super excelsa mea statuens me ; <l eID="gen1647" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv774"/><l level="1" sID="gen1648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv774"/>docens manus meas ad prælium, <l eID="gen1648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1649"/>et componens quasi arcum æreum brachia mea. <l eID="gen1649" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv775"/><l level="1" sID="gen1650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv775"/>Dedisti mihi clypeum salutis tuæ, <l eID="gen1650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1651"/>et mansuetudo tua multiplicavit me. <l eID="gen1651" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv776"/><l level="1" sID="gen1652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv776"/>Dilatabis gressus meos subtus me, <l eID="gen1652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1653"/>et non deficient tali mei. <l eID="gen1653" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv777"/><l level="1" sID="gen1654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv777"/>Persequar inimicos meos, et conteram, <l eID="gen1654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1655"/>et non convertar donec consumam eos. <l eID="gen1655" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv778"/><l level="1" sID="gen1656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv778"/>Consumam eos et confringam, ut non consurgant : <l eID="gen1656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1657"/>cadent sub pedibus meis. <l eID="gen1657" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv779"/><l level="1" sID="gen1658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv779"/>Accinxisti me fortitudine ad prælium : <l eID="gen1658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1659"/>incurvasti resistentes mihi subtus me. <l eID="gen1659" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv780"/><l level="1" sID="gen1660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv780"/>Inimicos meos dedisti mihi dorsum ; <l eID="gen1660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1661"/>odientes me, et disperdam eos. <l eID="gen1661" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv781"/><l level="1" sID="gen1662"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv781"/>Clamabunt, et non erit qui salvet ; <l eID="gen1662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1663"/>ad Dominum, et non exaudiet eos. <l eID="gen1663" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv782"/><l level="1" sID="gen1664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv782"/>Delebo eos ut pulverem terræ ; <l eID="gen1664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1665"/>quasi lutum platearum comminuam eos atque confringam. <l eID="gen1665" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv783"/><l level="1" sID="gen1666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv783"/>Salvabis me a contradictionibus populi mei ; <l eID="gen1666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1667"/>custodies me in caput gentium : <l eID="gen1667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1668"/>populus quem ignoro serviet mihi. <l eID="gen1668" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv784"/><l level="1" sID="gen1669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv784"/>Filii alieni resistent mihi ; <l eID="gen1669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1670"/>auditu auris obedient mihi. <l eID="gen1670" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv785"/><l level="1" sID="gen1671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv785"/>Filii alieni defluxerunt, <l eID="gen1671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1672"/>et contrahentur in angustiis suis. <l eID="gen1672" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv786"/><l level="1" sID="gen1673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv786"/>Vivit Dominus, et benedictus Deus meus, <l eID="gen1673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1674"/>et exaltabitur Deus fortis salutis meæ. <l eID="gen1674" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv787"/><l level="1" sID="gen1675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv787"/>Deus qui das vindictas mihi, <l eID="gen1675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1676"/>et dejicis populos sub me. <l eID="gen1676" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv788"/><l level="1" sID="gen1677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv788"/>Qui educis me ab inimicis meis, <l eID="gen1677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1678"/>et a resistentibus mihi elevas me : <l eID="gen1678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1679"/>a viro iniquo liberabis me. <l eID="gen1679" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv789"/><l level="1" sID="gen1680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv789"/>Propterea confitebor tibi, Domine, in gentibus, <l eID="gen1680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1681"/>et nomini tuo cantabo : <l eID="gen1681" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 22:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv790"/><l level="1" sID="gen1682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv790"/>magnificans salutes regis sui, <l eID="gen1682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1683"/>et faciens misericordiam christo suo David, <l eID="gen1683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1684"/>et semini ejus in sempiternum. <l eID="gen1684" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1572"/> <chapter eID="2Sam.22"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:1
verses.text: Hæc autem sunt verba David novissima. Dixit David filius Isai : <div eID="gen1685" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen1686"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1687"/>Dixit vir, cui constitutum est de christo Dei Jacob, <l eID="gen1687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1688"/>egregius psaltes Israël : <l eID="gen1688" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv791"/><l level="1" sID="gen1689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv791"/>Spiritus Domini locutus est per me, <l eID="gen1689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1690"/>et sermo ejus per linguam meam. <l eID="gen1690" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv792"/><l level="1" sID="gen1691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv792"/>Dixit Deus Israël mihi, <l eID="gen1691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1692"/>locutus est fortis Israël : <l eID="gen1692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1693"/>Dominator hominum, <l eID="gen1693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1694"/>justus dominator in timore Dei, <l eID="gen1694" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv793"/><l level="1" sID="gen1695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv793"/>sicut lux auroræ, oriente sole, <l eID="gen1695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1696"/>mane absque nubibus rutilat : <l eID="gen1696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1697"/>et sicut pluviis germinat herba de terra. <l eID="gen1697" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv794"/><l level="1" sID="gen1698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv794"/>Nec tanta est domus mea apud Deum, <l eID="gen1698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1699"/>ut pactum æternum iniret mecum, <l eID="gen1699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1700"/>firmum in omnibus atque munitum. <l eID="gen1700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1701"/>Cuncta enim salus mea, et omnis voluntas, <l eID="gen1701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1702"/>nec est quidquam ex ea quod non germinet. <l eID="gen1702" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv795"/><l level="1" sID="gen1703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv795"/>Prævaricatores autem quasi spinæ evellentur universi, <l eID="gen1703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1704"/>quæ non tolluntur manibus. <l eID="gen1704" level="1"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv796"/><l level="1" sID="gen1705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv796"/>Et si quis tangere voluerit eas, <l eID="gen1705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1706"/>armabitur ferro et ligno lanceato, <l eID="gen1706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1707"/>igneque succensæ comburentur usque ad nihilum. <l eID="gen1707" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen1686"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv797"/><div sID="gen1708" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv797"/>Hæc nomina fortium David. Sedens in cathedra sapientissimus princeps inter tres, ipse est quasi tenerrimus ligni vermiculus, qui octingentos interfecit impetu uno.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:9
verses.text: Post hunc, Eleazar filius patrui ejus Ahohites inter tres fortes, qui erant cum David quando exprobraverunt Philisthiim, et congregati sunt illuc in prælium.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:10
verses.text: Cumque ascendissent viri Israël, ipse stetit et percussit Philisthæos donec deficeret manus ejus, et obrigesceret cum gladio : fecitque Dominus salutem magnam in die illa : et populus qui fugerat, reversus est ad cæsorum spolia detrahenda.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:11
verses.text: Et post hunc, Semma filius Age de Arari. Et congregati sunt Philisthiim in statione : erat quippe ibi ager lente plenus. Cumque fugisset populus a facie Philisthiim,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:12
verses.text: stetit ille in medio agri, et tuitus est eum, percussitque Philisthæos : et fecit Dominus salutem magnam.  <div eID="gen1708" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv798"/><div sID="gen1709" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv798"/>Necnon et ante descenderant tres qui erant principes inter triginta, et venerant tempore messis ad David in speluncam Odollam : castra autem Philisthinorum erant posita in Valle gigantum.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:14
verses.text: Et David erat in præsidio : porro statio Philisthinorum tunc erat in Bethlehem.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:15
verses.text: Desideravit ergo David, et ait : O si quis mihi daret potum aquæ de cisterna quæ est in Bethlehem juxta portam !

verses.name: II Samuel 23:16
verses.text: Irruperunt ergo tres fortes castra Philisthinorum, et hauserunt aquam de cisterna Bethlehem, quæ erat juxta portam, et attulerunt ad David : at ille noluit bibere, sed libavit eam Domino,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:17
verses.text: dicens : Propitius sit mihi Dominus, ne faciam hoc : num sanguinem hominum istorum qui profecti sunt, et animarum periculum bibam ? Noluit ergo bibere. Hæc fecerunt tres robustissimi.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:18
verses.text: Abisai quoque frater Joab filius Sarviæ, princeps erat de tribus : ipse est qui levavit hastam suam contra trecentos, quos interfecit : nominatus in tribus,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:19
verses.text: et inter tres nobilior, eratque eorum princeps, sed usque ad tres primos non pervenerat.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:20
verses.text: Et Banaias filius Jojadæ viri fortissimi, magnorum operum, de Cabseel. Ipse percussit duos leones Moab, et ipse descendit, et percussit leonem in media cisterna in diebus nivis.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:21
verses.text: Ipse quoque interfecit virum ægyptium, virum dignum spectaculo, habentem in manu hastam : itaque cum descendisset ad eum in virga, vi extorsit hastam de manu Ægyptii, et interfecit eum hasta sua.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:22
verses.text: Hæc fecit Banaias filius Jojadæ.

verses.name: II Samuel 23:23
verses.text: Et ipse nominatus inter tres robustos, qui erant inter triginta nobiliores : verumtamen usque ad tres non pervenerat : fecitque eum sibi David auricularium, a secreto.  <div eID="gen1709" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv799"/><div sID="gen1710" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv799"/>Asaël frater Joab inter triginta, Elehanan filius patrui ejus de Bethlehem,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:25
verses.text: Semma de Harodi, Elica de Harodi,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:26
verses.text: Heles de Phalti, Hira filius Acces de Thecua,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:27
verses.text: Abiezer de Anathoth, Mobonnai de Husati,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:28
verses.text: Selmon Ahohites, Maharai Netophathites,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:29
verses.text: Heled filius Baana, et ipse Netophathites, Ithai filius Ribai de Gabaath filiorum Benjamin,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:30
verses.text: Banaia Pharathonites, Heddai de torrente Gaas,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:31
verses.text: Abialbon Arbathites, Azmaveth de Beromi,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:32
verses.text: Eliaba de Salaboni. Filii Jassen, Jonathan,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:33
verses.text: Semma de Orori, Ajam filius Sarar Arorites,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:34
verses.text: Eliphelet filius Aasbai filii Machati, Eliam filius Achitophel Gelonites,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:35
verses.text: Hesrai de Carmelo, Pharai de Arbi,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:36
verses.text: Igaal filius Nathan de Soba, Bonni de Gadi,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:37
verses.text: Selec de Ammoni, Naharai Berothites armiger Joab filii Sarviæ,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:38
verses.text: Ira Jethrites, Gareb et ipse Jethrites,

verses.name: II Samuel 23:39
verses.text: Urias Hethæus : omnes triginta septem.  <chapter eID="2Sam.23"/> <div eID="gen1710" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:1
verses.text: Et addidit furor Domini irasci contra Israël, commovitque David in eis dicentem : Vade, numera Israël et Judam.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:2
verses.text: Dixitque rex ad Joab principem exercitus sui : Perambula omnes tribus Israël a Dan usque Bersabee, et numerate populum, ut sciam numerum ejus.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:3
verses.text: Dixitque Joab regi : Adaugeat Dominus Deus tuus ad populum tuum, quantus nunc est, iterumque centuplicet in conspectu domini mei regis : sed quid sibi dominus meus rex vult in re hujuscemodi ?

verses.name: II Samuel 24:4
verses.text: Obtinuit autem sermo regis verba Joab et principum exercitus : egressusque est Joab et princeps militum a facie regis, ut numerarent populum Israël.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:5
verses.text: Cumque pertransissent Jordanem, venerunt in Aroër ad dexteram urbis, quæ est in valle Gad :

verses.name: II Samuel 24:6
verses.text: et per Jazer transierunt in Galaad, et in terram inferiorem Hodsi, et venerunt in Dan silvestria. Circumeuntesque juxta Sidonem,

verses.name: II Samuel 24:7
verses.text: transierunt prope mœnia Tyri, et omnem terram Hevæi et Chananæi, veneruntque ad meridiem Juda in Bersabee :

verses.name: II Samuel 24:8
verses.text: et lustrata universa terra, affuerunt post novem menses et viginti dies in Jerusalem.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:9
verses.text: Dedit ergo Joab numerum descriptionis populi regi, et inventa sunt de Israël octingenta millia virorum fortium qui educerent gladium, et de Juda quingenta millia pugnatorum.  <div eID="gen1711" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv800"/><div sID="gen1712" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv800"/>Percussit autem cor David eum, postquam numeratus est populus : et dixit David ad Dominum : Peccavi valde in hoc facto : sed precor, Domine, ut transferas iniquitatem servi tui, quia stulte egi nimis.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:11
verses.text: Surrexit itaque David mane, et sermo Domini factus est ad Gad prophetam et videntem David, dicens :

verses.name: II Samuel 24:12
verses.text: Vade, et loquere ad David : Hæc dicit Dominus : Trium tibi datur optio : elige unum quod volueris ex his, ut faciam tibi.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:13
verses.text: Cumque venisset Gad ad David, nuntiavit ei, dicens : Aut septem annis veniet tibi fames in terra tua : aut tribus mensibus fugies adversarios tuos, et ille te persequentur : aut certe tribus diebus erit pestilentia in terra tua. Nunc ergo delibera, et vide quem respondeam ei qui me misit sermonem.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:14
verses.text: Dixit autem David ad Gad : Coarctor nimis : sed melius est ut incidam in manus Domini (multæ enim misericordiæ ejus sunt) quam in manus hominum.  <div eID="gen1712" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv801"/><div sID="gen1713" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv801"/>Immisitque Dominus pestilentiam in Israël, de mane usque ad tempus constitutum, et mortui sunt ex populo a Dan usque ad Bersabee septuaginta millia virorum.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:16
verses.text: Cumque extendisset manum suam angelus Domini super Jerusalem ut disperderet eam, misertus est Dominus super afflictione, et ait angelo percutienti populum : Sufficit : nunc contine manum tuam. Erat autem angelus Domini juxta aream Areuna Jebusæi.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:17
verses.text: Dixitque David ad Dominum cum vidisset angelum cædentem populum : Ego sum qui peccavi, ego inique egi : isti qui oves sunt, quid fecerunt ? vertatur, obsecro, manus tua contra me, et contra domum patris mei.  <div eID="gen1713" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: II Samuel 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv802"/><div sID="gen1714" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv802"/>Venit autem Gad ad David in die illa, et dixit ei : Ascende, et constitue altare Domino in area Areuna Jebusæi.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:19
verses.text: Et ascendit David juxta sermonem Gad, quem præceperat ei Dominus.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:20
verses.text: Conspiciensque Areuna, animadvertit regem et servos ejus transire ad se :

verses.name: II Samuel 24:21
verses.text: et egressus adoravit regem prono vultu in terram, et ait : Quid causæ est ut veniat dominus meus rex ad servum suum ? Cui David ait : Ut emam a te aream, et ædificem altare Domino, et cesset interfectio quæ grassatur in populo.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:22
verses.text: Et ait Areuna ad David : Accipiat, et offerat dominus meus rex sicut placet ei : habes boves in holocaustum, et plaustrum, et juga boum in usum lignorum.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:23
verses.text: Omnia dedit Areuna rex regi : dixitque Areuna ad regem : Dominus Deus tuus suscipiat votum tuum.

verses.name: II Samuel 24:24
verses.text: Cui respondens rex, ait : Nequaquam ut vis, sed emam pretio a te, et non offeram Domino Deo meo holocausta gratuita. Emit ergo David aream, et boves, argenti siclis quinquaginta :

verses.name: II Samuel 24:25
verses.text: et ædificavit ibi David altare Domino, et obtulit holocausta et pacifica : et propitiatus est Dominus terræ, et cohibita est plaga ab Israël.  <div eID="gen1714" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="2Sam.24"/> <div eID="gen1473" osisID="2Sam" type="book"/>

verses.name: I Kings 1:1
verses.text: Et rex David senuerat, habebatque ætatis plurimos dies : cumque operiretur vestibus, non calefiebat.

verses.name: I Kings 1:2
verses.text: Dixerunt ergo ei servi sui : Quæramus domino nostro regi adolescentulam virginem, et stet coram rege, et foveat eum, dormiatque in sinu suo, et calefaciat dominum nostrum regem.

verses.name: I Kings 1:3
verses.text: Quæsierunt igitur adolescentulam speciosam in omnibus finibus Israël, et invenerunt Abisag Sunamitidem, et adduxerunt eam ad regem.

verses.name: I Kings 1:4
verses.text: Erat autem puella pulchra nimis, dormiebatque cum rege, et ministrabat ei : rex vero non cognovit eam.  <div eID="gen1716" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Kings 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv803"/><div sID="gen1717" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv803"/>Adonias autem filius Haggith elevabatur, dicens : Ego regnabo. Fecitque sibi currus et equites, et quinquaginta viros qui currerent ante eum.

verses.name: I Kings 1:6
verses.text: Nec corripuit eum pater suus aliquando, dicens : Quare hoc fecisti ? Erat autem et ipse pulcher valde, secundus natu post Absalom.

verses.name: I Kings 1:7
verses.text: Et sermo ei cum Joab filio Sarviæ, et cum Abiathar sacerdote, qui adjuvabant partes Adoniæ.

verses.name: I Kings 1:8
verses.text: Sadoc vero sacerdos, et Banaias filius Jojadæ, et Nathan propheta, et Semei et Rei, et robur exercitus David, non erat cum Adonia.

verses.name: I Kings 1:9
verses.text: Immolatis ergo Adonias arietibus et vitulis, et universis pinguibus, juxta lapidem Zoheleth, qui erat vicinus fonti Rogel, vocavit universos fratres suos filios regis, et omnes viros Juda servos regis.

verses.name: I Kings 1:10
verses.text: Nathan autem prophetam, et Banaiam, et robustos quosque, et Salomonem fratrem suum non vocavit.  <div eID="gen1717" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Kings 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv804"/><div sID="gen1718" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv804"/>Dixit itaque Nathan ad Bethsabee matrem Salomonis : Num audisti quod regnaverit Adonias filius Haggith, et dominus noster David hoc ignorat ?

verses.name: I Kings 1:12
verses.text: Nunc ergo veni, accipe consilium a me, et salva animam tuam, filiique tui Salomonis.

verses.name: I Kings 1:13
verses.text: Vade, et ingredere ad regem David, et dic ei : Nonne tu, domine mi rex, jurasti mihi ancillæ tuæ, dicens : Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me, et ipse sedebit in solio meo ? quare ergo regnat Adonias ?

verses.name: I Kings 1:14
verses.text: Et adhuc ibi te loquente cum rege, ego veniam post te, et complebo sermones tuos.

verses.name: I Kings 1:15
verses.text: Ingressa est itaque Bethsabee ad regem in cubiculum : rex autem senuerat nimis, et Abisag Sunamitis ministrabat ei.

verses.name: I Kings 1:16
verses.text: Inclinavit se Bethsabee, et adoravit regem. Ad quam rex : Quid tibi, inquit, vis ?

verses.name: I Kings 1:17
verses.text: Quæ respondens, ait : Domine mi, tu jurasti per Dominum Deum tuum ancillæ tuæ : Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me, et ipse sedebit in solio meo.

verses.name: I Kings 1:18
verses.text: Et ecce nunc Adonias regnat, te, domine mi rex, ignorante.

verses.name: I Kings 1:19
verses.text: Mactavit boves, et pinguia quæque, et arietes plurimos, et vocavit omnes filios regis, Abiathar quoque sacerdotem, et Joab principem militiæ : Salomonem autem servum tuum non vocavit.

verses.name: I Kings 1:20
verses.text: Verumtamen, domine mi rex, in te oculi respiciunt totius Israël, ut indices eis quis sedere debeat in solio tuo, domine mi rex, post te.

verses.name: I Kings 1:21
verses.text: Eritque, cum dormierit dominus meus rex cum patribus suis, erimus ego et filius meus Salomon peccatores.  <div eID="gen1718" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Kings 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv805"/><div sID="gen1719" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv805"/>Adhuc illa loquente cum rege, Nathan propheta venit.

verses.name: I Kings 1:23
verses.text: Et nuntiaverunt regi, dicentes : Adest Nathan propheta. Cumque introisset in conspectu regis, et adorasset eum pronus in terram,

verses.name: I Kings 1:24
verses.text: dixit Nathan : Domine mi rex, tu dixisti : Adonias regnet post me, et ipse sedeat super thronum meum ?

verses.name: I Kings 1:25
verses.text: Quia descendit hodie, et immolavit boves, et pinguia, et arietes plurimos, et vocavit universos filios regis et principes exercitus, Abiathar quoque sacerdotem, illisque vescentibus et bibentibus coram eo, et dicentibus : Vivat rex Adonias :

verses.name: I Kings 1:26
verses.text: me servum tuum, et Sadoc sacerdotem, et Banaiam filium Jojadæ, et Salomonem famulum tuum non vocavit.

verses.name: I Kings 1:27
verses.text: Numquid a domino meo rege exivit hoc verbum, et mihi non indicasti servo tuo quis sessurus esset super thronum domini mei regis post eum ?

verses.name: I Kings 1:28
verses.text: Et respondit rex David, dicens : Vocate ad me Bethsabee. Quæ cum fuisset ingressa coram rege, et stetisset ante eum,

verses.name: I Kings 1:29
verses.text: juravit rex, et ait : Vivit Dominus, qui eruit animam meam de omni angustia,

verses.name: I Kings 1:30
verses.text: quia sicut juravi tibi per Dominum Deum Israël, dicens : Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me, et ipse sedebit super solium meum pro me : sic faciam hodie.

verses.name: I Kings 1:31
verses.text: Summissoque Bethsabee in terram vultu, adoravit regem, dicens : Vivat dominus meus David in æternum.  <div eID="gen1719" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Kings 1:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv806"/><div sID="gen1720" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv806"/>Dixit quoque rex David : Vocate mihi Sadoc sacerdotem, et Nathan prophetam, et Banaiam filium Jojadæ. Qui cum ingressi fuissent coram rege,

verses.name: I Kings 1:33
verses.text: dixit ad eos : Tollite vobiscum servos domini vestri, et imponite Salomonem filium meum super mulam meam, et ducite eum in Gihon.

verses.name: I Kings 1:34
verses.text: Et ungat eum ibi Sadoc sacerdos et Nathan propheta in regem super Israël : et canetis buccina, atque dicetis : Vivat rex Salomon.

verses.name: I Kings 1:35
verses.text: Et ascendetis post eum, et veniet, et sedebit super solium meum, et ipse regnabit pro me : illique præcipiam ut sit dux super Israël et super Judam.

verses.name: I Kings 1:36
verses.text: Et respondit Banaias filius Jojadæ regi, dicens : Amen : sic loquatur Dominus Deus domini mei regis.

verses.name: I Kings 1:37
verses.text: Quomodo fuit Dominus cum domino meo rege, sic sit cum Salomone, et sublimius faciat solium ejus a solio domini mei regis David.

verses.name: I Kings 1:38
verses.text: Descendit ergo Sadoc sacerdos, et Nathan propheta, et Banaias filius Jojadæ, et Cerethi, et Phelethi : et imposuerunt Salomonem super mulam regis David, et adduxerunt eum in Gihon.

verses.name: I Kings 1:39
verses.text: Sumpsitque Sadoc sacerdos cornu olei de tabernaculo, et unxit Salomonem : et cecinerunt buccina, et dixit omnis populus : Vivat rex Salomon.

verses.name: I Kings 1:40
verses.text: Et ascendit universa multitudo post eum, et populus canentium tibiis, et lætantium gaudio magno : et insonuit terra a clamore eorum.  <div eID="gen1720" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Kings 1:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv807"/><div sID="gen1721" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv807"/>Audivit autem Adonias, et omnes qui invitati fuerant ab eo : jamque convivium finitum erat : sed et Joab, audita voce tubæ, ait : Quid sibi vult clamor civitatis tumultuantis ?

verses.name: I Kings 1:42
verses.text: Adhuc illo loquente, Jonathas filius Abiathar sacerdotis venit : cui dixit Adonias : Ingredere, quia vir fortis es, et bona nuntians.

verses.name: I Kings 1:43
verses.text: Responditque Jonathas Adoniæ : Nequaquam : dominus enim noster rex David regem constituit Salomonem :

verses.name: I Kings 1:44
verses.text: misitque cum eo Sadoc sacerdotem, et Nathan prophetam, et Banaiam filium Jojadæ, et Cerethi, et Phelethi, et imposuerunt eum super mulam regis.

verses.name: I Kings 1:45
verses.text: Unxeruntque eum Sadoc sacerdos et Nathan propheta regem in Gihon : et ascenderunt inde lætantes, et insonuit civitas : hæc est vox quam audistis.

verses.name: I Kings 1:46
verses.text: Sed et Salomon sedet super solium regni.

verses.name: I Kings 1:47
verses.text: Et ingressi servi regis benedixerunt domino nostro regi David, dicentes : Amplificet Deus nomen Salomonis super nomen tuum, et magnificet thronus ejus super thronum tuum. Et adoravit rex in lectulo suo :

verses.name: I Kings 1:48
verses.text: et locutus est : Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, qui dedit hodie sedentem in solio meo, videntibus oculis meis.  <div eID="gen1721" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Kings 1:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv808"/><div sID="gen1722" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv808"/>Territi sunt ergo, et surrexerunt omnes qui invitati fuerant ab Adonia, et ivit unusquisque in viam suam.

verses.name: I Kings 1:50
verses.text: Adonias autem timens Salomonem, surrexit, et abiit, tenuitque cornu altaris.

verses.name: I Kings 1:51
verses.text: Et nuntiaverunt Salomoni, dicentes : Ecce Adonias timens regem Salomonem, tenuit cornu altaris, dicens : Juret mihi rex Salomon hodie, quod non interficiat servum suum gladio.

verses.name: I Kings 1:52
verses.text: Dixitque Salomon : Si fuerit vir bonus, non cadet ne unus quidem capillus ejus in terram : sin autem malum inventum fuerit in eo, morietur.

verses.name: I Kings 1:53
verses.text: Misit ergo rex Salomon, et eduxit eum ab altari : et ingressus adoravit regem Salomonem : dixitque ei Salomon : Vade in domum tuam.  <chapter eID="1Kgs.1"/> <div eID="gen1722" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Kings 2:1
verses.text: Appropinquaverunt autem dies David ut moreretur : præcepitque Salomoni filio suo, dicens :

verses.name: I Kings 2:2
verses.text: Ego ingredior viam universæ terræ : confortare, et esto vir.

verses.name: I Kings 2:3
verses.text: Et observa custodias Domini Dei tui, ut ambules in viis ejus : ut custodias cæremonias ejus, et præcepta ejus, et judicia, et testimonia, sicut scriptum est in lege Moysi : ut intelligas universa quæ facis, et quocumque te verteris :

verses.name: I Kings 2:4
verses.text: ut confirmet Dominus sermones suos quos locutus est de me, dicens : Si custodierint filii tui vias suas, et ambulaverint coram me in veritate, in omni corde suo et in omni anima sua, non auferetur tibi vir de solio Israël.

verses.name: I Kings 2:5
verses.text: Tu quoque nosti quæ fecerit mihi Joab filius Sarviæ, quæ fecerit duobus principibus exercitus Israël, Abner filio Ner, et Amasæ filio Jether : quos occidit, et effudit sanguinem belli in pace, et posuit cruorem prælii in balteo suo qui erat circa lumbos ejus, et in calceamento suo quod erat in pedibus ejus.

verses.name: I Kings 2:6
verses.text: Facies ergo juxta sapientiam tuam, et non deduces canitiem ejus pacifice ad inferos.

verses.name: I Kings 2:7
verses.text: Sed et filiis Berzellai Galaaditis reddes gratiam, eruntque comedentes in mensa tua : occurrerunt enim mihi quando fugiebam a facie Absalom fratris tui.

verses.name: I Kings 2:8
verses.text: Habes quoque apud te Semei filium Gera filii Jemini de Bahurim, qui maledixit mihi maledictione pessima quando ibam ad castra : sed quia descendit mihi in occursum cum transirem Jordanem, et juravi ei per Dominum, dicens : Non te interficiam gladio :

verses.name: I Kings 2:9
verses.text: tu noli pati eum esse innoxium. Vir autem sapiens es, ut scias quæ facies ei : deducesque canos ejus cum sanguine ad inferos.

verses.name: I Kings 2:10
verses.text: Dormivit igitur David cum patribus suis, et sepultus est in civitate David.

verses.name: I Kings 2:11
verses.text: Dies autem quibus regnavit David super Israël, quadraginta anni sunt : in Hebron regnavit septem annis ; in Jerusalem, triginta tribus.  <div eID="gen1723" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Kings 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv809"/><div sID="gen1724" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv809"/>Salomon autem sedit super thronum David patris sui, et firmatum est regnum ejus nimis.

verses.name: I Kings 2:13
verses.text: Et ingressus est Adonias filius Haggith ad Bethsabee matrem Salomonis. Quæ dixit ei : Pacificusne est ingressus tuus ? Qui respondit : Pacificus.

verses.name: I Kings 2:14
verses.text: Addiditque : Sermo mihi est ad te. Cui ait : Loquere. Et ille :

verses.name: I Kings 2:15
verses.text: Tu, inquit, nosti, quia meum erat regnum, et me præposuerat omnis Israël sibi in regem : sed translatum est regnum, et factum est fratris mei : a Domino enim constitutum est ei.

verses.name: I Kings 2:16
verses.text: Nunc ergo petitionem unam precor a te : ne confundas faciem meam. Quæ dixit ad eum : Loquere.

verses.name: I Kings 2:17
verses.text: Et ille ait : Precor ut dicas Salomoni regi (neque enim negare tibi quidquam potest) ut det mihi Abisag Sunamitidem uxorem.

verses.name: I Kings 2:18
verses.text: Et ait Bethsabee : Bene : ego loquar pro te regi.

verses.name: I Kings 2:19
verses.text: Venit ergo Bethsabee ad regem Salomonem ut loqueretur ei pro Adonia : et surrexit rex in occursum ejus, adoravitque eam, et sedit super thronum suum : positusque est thronus matri regis, quæ sedit ad dexteram ejus.

verses.name: I Kings 2:20
verses.text: Dixitque ei : Petitionem unam parvulam ego deprecor a te : ne confundas faciem meam. Et dixit ei rex : Pete, mater mea : neque enim fas est ut avertam faciem tuam.

verses.name: I Kings 2:21
verses.text: Quæ ait : Detur Abisag Sunamitis Adoniæ fratri tuo uxor.

verses.name: I Kings 2:22
verses.text: Responditque rex Salomon, et dixit matri suæ : Quare postulas Abisag Sunamitidem Adoniæ ? postula ei et regnum : ipse est enim frater meus major me, et habet Abiathar sacerdotem, et Joab filium Sarviæ.

verses.name: I Kings 2:23
verses.text: Juravit itaque rex Salomon per Dominum, dicens : Hæc faciat mihi Deus, et hæc addat, quia contra animam suam locutus est Adonias verbum hoc.

verses.name: I Kings 2:24
verses.text: Et nunc vivit Dominus, qui firmavit me, et collocavit me super solium David patris mei, et qui fecit mihi domum, sicut locutus est, quia hodie occidetur Adonias.

verses.name: I Kings 2:25
verses.text: Misitque rex Salomon per manum Banaiæ filii Jojadæ, qui interfecit eum, et mortuus est.

verses.name: I Kings 2:26
verses.text: Abiathar quoque sacerdoti dixit rex : Vade in Anathoth ad agrum tuum : equidem vir mortis es : sed hodie te non interficiam, quia portasti arcam Domini Dei coram David patre meo, et sustinuisti laborem in omnibus in quibus laboravit pater meus.

verses.name: I Kings 2:27
