verses.text: Porro Meraioth genuit Amariam, et Amarias genuit Achitob.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:8
verses.text: Achitob genuit Sadoc, et Sadoc genuit Achimaas,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:9
verses.text: Achimaas genuit Azariam, Azarias genuit Johanan,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:10
verses.text: Johanan genuit Azariam : ipse est qui sacerdotio functus est in domo quam ædificavit Salomon in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:11
verses.text: Genuit autem Azarias Amariam, et Amarias genuit Achitob,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:12
verses.text: Achitob genuit Sadoc, et Sadoc genuit Sellum,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:13
verses.text: Sellum genuit Helciam, et Helcias genuit Azariam,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:14
verses.text: Azarias genuit Saraiam, et Saraias genuit Josedec.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:15
verses.text: Porro Josedec egressus est, quando transtulit Dominus Judam et Jerusalem per manus Nabuchodonosor.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:16
verses.text: Filii ergo Levi : Gersom, Caath, et Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:17
verses.text: Et hæc nomina filiorum Gersom : Lobni, et Semei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:18
verses.text: Filii Caath : Amram, et Isaar, et Hebron, et Oziel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:19
verses.text: Filii Merari : Moholi et Musi. Hæ autem cognationes Levi secundum familias eorum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:20
verses.text: Gersom : Lobni filius ejus, Jahath filius ejus, Zamma filius ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:21
verses.text: Joah filius ejus, Addo filius ejus, Zara filius ejus, Jethrai filius ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:22
verses.text: Filii Caath : Aminadab filius ejus, Core filius ejus, Asir filius ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:23
verses.text: Elcana filius ejus, Abiasaph filius ejus, Asir filius ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:24
verses.text: Thahath filius ejus, Uriel filius ejus, Ozias filius ejus, Saul filius ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:25
verses.text: Filii Elcana, Amasai et Achimoth

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:26
verses.text: et Elcana. Filii Elcana : Sophai filius ejus, Nahath filius ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:27
verses.text: Eliab filius ejus, Jeroham filius ejus, Elcana filius ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:28
verses.text: Filii Samuel : primogenitus Vasseni, et Abia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:29
verses.text: Filii autem Merari, Moholi : Lobni filius ejus, Semei filius ejus, Oza filius ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:30
verses.text: Sammaa filius ejus, Haggia filius ejus, Asaia filius ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:31
verses.text: Isti sunt quos constituit David super cantores domus Domini, ex quo collocata est arca :

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:32
verses.text: et ministrabant coram tabernaculo testimonii, canentes donec ædificaret Salomon domum Domini in Jerusalem : stabant autem juxta ordinem suum in ministerio.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:33
verses.text: Hi vero sunt qui assistebant cum filiis suis, de filiis Caath, Hemam cantor filius Johel, filii Samuel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:34
verses.text: filii Elcana, filii Jeroham, filii Eliel, filii Thohu,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:35
verses.text: filii Suph, filii Elcana, filii Mahath, filii Amasai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:36
verses.text: filii Elcana, filii Johel, filii Azariæ, filii Sophoniæ,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:37
verses.text: filii Thahath, filii Asir, filii Abiasaph, filii Core,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:38
verses.text: filii Isaar, filii Caath, filii Levi, filii Israël.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:39
verses.text: Et frater ejus Asaph, qui stabat a dextris ejus, Asaph filius Barachiæ, filii Samaa,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:40
verses.text: filii Michaël, filii Basaiæ, filii Melchiæ,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:41
verses.text: filii Athanai, filii Zara, filii Adaia,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:42
verses.text: filii Ethan, filii Zamma, filii Semei,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:43
verses.text: filii Jeth, filii Gersom, filii Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:44
verses.text: Filii autem Merari fratres eorum, ad sinistram, Ethan filius Cusi, filii Abdi, filii Maloch,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:45
verses.text: filii Hasabiæ, filii Amasiæ, filii Helciæ,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:46
verses.text: filii Amasai, filii Boni, filii Somer,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:47
verses.text: filii Moholi, filii Musi, filii Merari, filii Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:48
verses.text: Fratres quoque eorum Levitæ, qui ordinati sunt in cunctum ministerium tabernaculi domus Domini.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:49
verses.text: Aaron vero et filii ejus adolebant incensum super altare holocausti, et super altare thymiamatis, in omne opus Sancti sanctorum : et ut precarentur pro Israël juxta omnia quæ præceperat Moyses servus Dei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:50
verses.text: Hi sunt autem filii Aaron : Eleazar filius ejus, Phinees filius ejus, Abisue filius ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:51
verses.text: Bocci filius ejus, Ozi filius ejus, Zarahia filius ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:52
verses.text: Meraioth filius ejus, Amarias filius ejus, Achitob filius ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:53
verses.text: Sadoc filius ejus, Achimaas filius ejus.  <div eID="gen1932" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv936"/><div sID="gen1933" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv936"/>Et hæc habitacula eorum per vicos atque confinia, filiorum scilicet Aaron, juxta cognationes Caathitarum : ipsis enim sorte contigerant.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:55
verses.text: Dederunt igitur eis Hebron in terra Juda, et suburbana ejus per circuitum :

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:56
verses.text: agros autem civitatis, et villas, Caleb filio Jephone.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:57
verses.text: Porro filiis Aaron dederunt civitates ad confugiendum Hebron, et Lobna, et suburbana ejus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:58
verses.text: Jether quoque, et Esthemo cum suburbanis suis, sed et Helon, et Dabir cum suburbanis suis,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:59
verses.text: Asan quoque, et Bethsemes, et suburbana earum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:60
verses.text: De tribu autem Benjamin, Gabee et suburbana ejus, et Almath cum suburbanis suis, Anathoth quoque cum suburbanis suis : omnes civitates, tredecim, per cognationes suas.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:61
verses.text: Filiis autem Caath residuis de cognatione sua dederunt ex dimidia tribu Manasse in possessionem urbes decem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:62
verses.text: Porro filiis Gersom per cognationes suas de tribu Issachar, et de tribu Aser, et de tribu Nephthali, et de tribu Manasse in Basan, urbes tredecim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:63
verses.text: Filiis autem Merari per cognationes suas de tribu Ruben, et de tribu Gad, et de tribu Zabulon, dederunt sorte civitates duodecim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:64
verses.text: Dederunt quoque filii Israël Levitis civitates, et suburbana earum :

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:65
verses.text: dederuntque per sortem, ex tribu filiorum Juda, et ex tribu filiorum Simeon, et ex tribu filiorum Benjamin urbes has, quas vocaverunt nominibus suis,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:66
verses.text: et his, qui erant de cognatione filiorum Caath, fueruntque civitates in terminis eorum de tribu Ephraim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:67
verses.text: Dederunt ergo eis urbes ad confugiendum, Sichem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim, et Gazer cum suburbanis suis,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:68
verses.text: Jecmaam quoque cum suburbanis suis, et Bethoron similiter,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:69
verses.text: necnon et Helon cum suburbanis suis, et Gethremmon in eumdem modum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:70
verses.text: Porro ex dimidia tribu Manasse, Aner et suburbana ejus, Balaam et suburbana ejus : his videlicet, qui de cognatione filiorum Caath reliqui erant.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:71
verses.text: Filiis autem Gersom de cognatione dimidiæ tribus Manasse, Gaulon in Basan, et suburbana ejus, et Astaroth cum suburbanis suis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:72
verses.text: De tribu Issachar, Cedes et suburbanis suis, et Dabereth cum suburbanis suis,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:73
verses.text: Ramoth quoque et suburbana ejus, et Anem cum suburbanis suis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:74
verses.text: De tribu vero Aser : Masal cum suburbanis suis, et Abdon similiter,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:75
verses.text: Hucac quoque et suburbana ejus, et Rohob cum suburbanis suis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:76
verses.text: Porro de tribu Nephthali, Cedes in Galilæa et suburbana ejus, Hamon cum suburbanis suis, et Cariathaim et suburbana ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:77
verses.text: Filiis autem Merari residuis : de tribu Zabulon, Remmono et suburbana ejus, et Thabor cum suburbanis sus :

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:78
verses.text: trans Jordanem quoque ex adverso Jericho contra orientem Jordanis, de tribu Ruben, Bosor in solitudine cum suburbanis suis, et Jassa cum suburbanis suis,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:79
verses.text: Cademoth quoque et suburbana ejus, et Mephaat cum suburbanis suis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:80
verses.text: Necnon et de tribu Gad, Ramoth in Galaad et suburbana ejus, et Manaim cum suburbanis suis,

verses.name: I Chronicles 6:81
verses.text: sed et Hesebon cum suburbanis suis, et Jezer cum suburbanis suis.  <chapter eID="1Chr.6"/> <div eID="gen1933" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:1
verses.text: Porro filii Issachar : Thola, et Phua, Jasub, et Simeron, quatuor.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:2
verses.text: Filii Thola : Ozi, et Raphaia, et Jeriel, et Jemai, et Jebsem, et Samuel, principes per domos cognationum suarum. De stirpe Thola viri fortissimi numerati sunt in diebus David, viginti duo millia sexcenti.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:3
verses.text: Filii Ozi : Izrahia, de quo nati sunt Michaël, et Obadia, et Joël, et Jesia, quinque omnes principes.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:4
verses.text: Cumque eis per familias et populos suos, accincti ad prælium, viri fortissimi, triginta sex millia : multas enim habuerunt uxores, et filios.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:5
verses.text: Fratres quoque eorum per omnem cognationem Issachar robustissimi ad pugnandum, octoginta septem millia numerati sunt.  <div eID="gen1934" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv937"/><div sID="gen1935" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv937"/>Filii Benjamin : Bela, et Bechor, et Jadihel, tres.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:7
verses.text: Filii Bela : Esbon, et Ozi, et Oziel, et Jerimoth, et Urai, quinque principes familiarum, et ad pugnandum robustissimi : numerus autem eorum, viginti duo millia et triginta quatuor.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:8
verses.text: Porro filii Bechor : Zamira, et Joas, et Eliezer, et Elioënai, et Amri, et Jerimoth, et Abia, et Anathoth, et Almath : omnes hi filii Bechor.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:9
verses.text: Numerati sunt autem per familias suas principes cognationum suarum ad bella fortissimi, viginti millia et ducenti.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:10
verses.text: Porro filii Jadihel : Balan. Filii autem Balan : Jehus, et Benjamin, et Aod, et Chanana, et Zethan, et Tharsis, et Ahisahar :

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:11
verses.text: omnes hi filii Jadihel, principes cognationum suarum viri fortissimi, decem et septem millia et ducenti ad prælium procedentes.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:12
verses.text: Sepham quoque et Hapham filii Hir : et Hasim filii Aher.  <div eID="gen1935" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv938"/><div sID="gen1936" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv938"/>Filii autem Nephthali : Jaziel, et Guni, et Jeser, et Sellum, filii Bala.  <div eID="gen1936" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv939"/><div sID="gen1937" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv939"/>Porro filius Manasse, Esriel : concubinaque ejus Syra peperit Machir patrem Galaad.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:15
verses.text: Machir autem accepit uxores filiis suis Happhim, et Saphan : et habuit sororem nomine Maacha : nomen autem secundi, Salphaad, natæque sunt Salphaad filiæ.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:16
verses.text: Et peperit Maacha uxor Machir filium, vocavitque nomen ejus Phares : porro nomen fratris ejus, Sares : et filii ejus, Ulam, et Recen.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:17
verses.text: Filius autem Ulam, Badan : hi sunt filii Galaad, filii Machir, filii Manasse.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:18
verses.text: Soror autem ejus Regina peperit Virum decorum, et Abiezer, et Mohola.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:19
verses.text: Erant autem filii Semida, Ahin, et Sechem, et Leci, et Aniam.  <div eID="gen1937" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv940"/><div sID="gen1938" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv940"/>Filii autem Ephraim : Suthala, Bared filius ejus, Thahath filius ejus, Elada filius ejus, Thahath filius ejus, hujus filius Zabad,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:21
verses.text: et hujus filius Suthula, et hujus filius Ezer et Elad : occiderunt autem eos viri Geth indigenæ, quia descenderant ut invaderent possessiones eorum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:22
verses.text: Luxit igitur Ephraim pater eorum multis diebus, et venerunt fratres ejus ut consolarentur eum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:23
verses.text: Ingressusque est ad uxorem suam : quæ concepit, et peperit filium, et vocavit nomen ejus Beria, eo quod in malis domus ejus ortus esset :

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:24
verses.text: filia autem ejus fuit Sara, quæ ædificavit Bethoron inferiorem et superiorem, et Ozensara.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:25
verses.text: Porro filius ejus Rapha, et Reseph, et Thale, de quo natus est Thaan,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:26
verses.text: qui genuit Laadan : hujus quoque filius Ammiud, qui genuit Elisama,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:27
verses.text: de quo ortus est Nun, qui habuit filium Josue.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:28
verses.text: Possessio autem eorum et habitatio, Bethel cum filiabus suis, et contra orientem Noran, ad occidentalem plagam Gazer et filiæ ejus, Sichem quoque cum filiabus suis, usque ad Aza cum filiabus ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:29
verses.text: Juxta filios quoque Manasse, Bethsan et filias ejus, Thanach et filias ejus, Mageddo et filias ejus, Dor et filias ejus : in his habitaverunt filii Joseph, filii Israël.  <div eID="gen1938" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv941"/><div sID="gen1939" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv941"/>Filii Aser : Jemna, et Jesua, et Jessui, et Baria, et Sara soror eorum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:31
verses.text: Filii autem Baria : Heber, et Melchiel : ipse est pater Barsaith.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:32
verses.text: Heber autem genuit Jephlat, et Somer, et Hotham, et Suaa sororem eorum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:33
verses.text: Filii Jephlat : Phosech, et Chamaal, et Asoth : hi filii Jephlat.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:34
verses.text: Porro filii Somer : Ahi, et Roaga, et Haba, et Aram.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:35
verses.text: Filii autem Helem fratris ejus : Supha, et Jemna, et Selles, et Amal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:36
verses.text: Filii Supha : Sue, Harnapher, et Sual, et Beri, et Jamra,

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:37
verses.text: Bosor, et Hod, et Samma, et Salusa, et Jethran, et Bera.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:38
verses.text: Filii Jether : Jephone, et Phaspha, et Ara.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:39
verses.text: Filii autem Olla : Aree, et Haniel, et Resia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 7:40
verses.text: Omnes hi filii Aser, principes cognationum, electi atque fortissimi duces ducum : numerus autem eorum ætatis quæ apta esset ad bellum, viginti sex millia.  <chapter eID="1Chr.7"/> <div eID="gen1939" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:1
verses.text: Benjamin autem genuit Bale primogenitum suum, Asbel secundum, Ahara tertium,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:2
verses.text: Nohaa quartum, et Rapha quintum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:3
verses.text: Fueruntque filii Bale : Addar, et Gera, et Abiud,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:4
verses.text: Abisue quoque et Naaman, et Ahoë,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:5
verses.text: sed et Gera, et Sephuphan, et Huram.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:6
verses.text: Hi sunt filii Ahod, principes cognationum habitantium in Gabaa, qui translati sunt in Manahath.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:7
verses.text: Naaman autem, et Achia, et Gera, ipse transtulit eos, et genuit Osa, et Ahiud.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:8
verses.text: Porro Saharaim genuit in regione Moab, postquam dimisit Husim et Bara uxores suas.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:9
verses.text: Genuit autem de Hodes uxore sua Jobab, et Sebia, et Mosa, et Molchom,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:10
verses.text: Jehus quoque, et Sechia, et Marma : hi sunt filii ejus principes in familiis suis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:11
verses.text: Mehusim vero genuit Abitob et Elphaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:12
verses.text: Porro filii Elphaal : Heber, et Misaam, et Samad : hic ædificavit Ono, et Lod, et filias ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:13
verses.text: Baria autem et Sama principes cognationum habitantium in Ajalon : hi fugaverunt habitatores Geth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:14
verses.text: Et Ahio, et Sesac, et Jerimoth,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:15
verses.text: et Zabadia, et Arod, et Heder,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:16
verses.text: Michaël quoque, et Jespha, et Joha filii Baria.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:17
verses.text: Et Zabadia, et Mosollam, et Hezeci, et Heber,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:18
verses.text: et Jesamari, et Jezlia, et Jobab filii Elphaal,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:19
verses.text: et Jacim, et Zechri, et Zabdi,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:20
verses.text: et Elioënai, et Selethai, et Eliel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:21
verses.text: et Adaia, et Baraia, et Samarath, filii Semei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:22
verses.text: Et Jespham, et Heber, et Eliel,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:23
verses.text: et Abdon, et Zechri, et Hanan,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:24
verses.text: et Hanania, et Ælam, et Anathothia,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:25
verses.text: et Jephdaia, et Phanuel, filii Sesac.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:26
verses.text: Et Samsari, et Sohoria, et Otholia,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:27
verses.text: et Jersia, et Elia, et Zechri, filii Jeroham.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:28
verses.text: Hi patriarchæ, et cognationum principes, qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:29
verses.text: In Gabaon autem habitaverunt Abigabaon, et nomen uxoris ejus Maacha :

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:30
verses.text: filiusque ejus primogenitus Abdon, et Sur, et Cis, et Baal, et Nadab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:31
verses.text: Gedor quoque, et Ahio, et Zacher, et Macelloth :

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:32
verses.text: et Macelloth genuit Samaa : habitaveruntque ex adverso fratrum suorum in Jerusalem cum fratribus suis.  <div eID="gen1940" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv942"/><div sID="gen1941" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv942"/>Ner autem genuit Cis, et Cis genuit Saul. Porro Saul genuit Jonathan, et Melchisua, et Abinadab, et Esbaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:34
verses.text: Filius autem Jonathan, Meribbaal : et Meribbaal genuit Micha.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:35
verses.text: Filii Micha, Phithon, et Melech, et Tharaa, et Ahaz.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:36
verses.text: Et Ahaz genuit Joada, et Joada genuit Alamath, et Azmoth, et Zamri : porro Zamri genuit Mosa,

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:37
verses.text: et Mosa genuit Banaa, cujus filius fuit Rapha, de quo ortus est Elasa, qui genuit Asel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:38
verses.text: Porro Asel sex filii fuerunt his nominibus : Ezricam, Bocru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, et Hanan : omnes hi filii Asel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:39
verses.text: Filii autem Esec fratris ejus, Ulam primogenitus, et Jehus secundus, et Eliphalet tertius.

verses.name: I Chronicles 8:40
verses.text: Fueruntque filii Ulam viri robustissimi, et magno robore tendentes arcum : et multos habentes filios ac nepotes, usque ad centum quinquaginta. Omnes hi filii Benjamin.  <chapter eID="1Chr.8"/> <div eID="gen1941" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:1
verses.text: Universus ergo Israël dinumeratus est, et summa eorum scripta est in libro regum Israël et Juda : translatique sunt in Babylonem propter delictum suum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:2
verses.text: Qui autem habitaverunt primi in possessionibus et in urbibus suis : Israël, et sacerdotes, et Levitæ, et Nathinæi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:3
verses.text: Commorati sunt in Jerusalem de filiis Juda, et de filiis Benjamin, de filiis quoque Ephraim, et Manasse.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:4
verses.text: Othei filius Ammiud, filii Amri, filii Omrai, filii Bonni, de filiis Phares filii Juda.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:5
verses.text: Et de Siloni : Asaia primogenitus, et filii ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:6
verses.text: De filiis autem Zara, Jehuel, et fratres eorum, sexcenti nonaginta.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:7
verses.text: Porro de filiis Benjamin : Salo filius Mosollam, filii Oduia, filii Asana,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:8
verses.text: et Jobania filius Jeroham, et Ela filius Ozi, filii Mochori, et Mosollam filius Saphatiæ, filii Rahuel, filii Jebaniæ,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:9
verses.text: et fratres eorum per familias suas, nongenti quinquaginta sex. Omnes hi principes cognationum per domos patrum suorum.  <div eID="gen1942" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv943"/><div sID="gen1943" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv943"/>De sacerdotibus autem : Jedaia, Jojarib, et Jachin :

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:11
verses.text: Azarias quoque filius Helciæ, filii Mosollam, filii Sadoc, filii Maraioth, filii Achitob, pontifex domus Dei.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:12
verses.text: Porro Adaias filius Jeroham, filii Phassur, filii Melchiæ, et Maasai filius Adiel filii Jezra, filii Mosollam, filii Mosollamith, filii Emmer.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:13
verses.text: Fratres quoque eorum principes per familias suas, mille septingenti sexaginta, fortissimi robore ad faciendum opus ministerii in domo Dei.  <div eID="gen1943" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv944"/><div sID="gen1944" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv944"/>De Levitis autem : Semeia filius Hassub filii Ezricam, filii Hasebia de filiis Merari.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:15
verses.text: Bacbacar quoque carpentarius, et Galal, et Mathania filius Micha, filii Zechri, filii Asaph :

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:16
verses.text: et Obdia filius Semeiæ, filii Galal, filii Idithun : et Barachia filius Asa, filii Elcana, qui habitavit in atriis Netophati.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:17
verses.text: Janitores autem : Sellum, et Accub, et Telmon, et Ahimam : et frater eorum Sellum princeps,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:18
verses.text: usque ad illud tempus, in porta regis ad orientem, observabant per vices suas de filiis Levi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:19
verses.text: Sellum vero filius Core filii Abiasaph, filii Core, cum fratribus suis, et domo patris sui, hi sunt Coritæ super opera ministerii, custodes vestibulorum tabernaculi : et familiæ eorum per vices castrorum Domini custodientes introitum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:20
verses.text: Phinees autem filius Eleazari erat dux eorum coram Domino.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:21
verses.text: Porro Zacharias filius Mosollamia, janitor portæ tabernaculi testimonii.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:22
verses.text: Omnes hi electi in ostiarios per portas, ducenti duodecim : et descripti in villis propriis, quos constituerunt David, et Samuel videns, in fide sua,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:23
verses.text: tam ipsos quam filios eorum, in ostiis domus Domini et in tabernaculo vicibus suis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:24
verses.text: Per quatuor ventos erant ostiarii : id est, ad orientem, et ad occidentem, et ad aquilonem, et ad austrum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:25
verses.text: Fratres autem eorum in viculis morabantur, et veniebant in sabbatis suis de tempore usque ad tempus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:26
verses.text: His quatuor Levitis creditus erat omnis numerus janitorum, et erant super exedras et thesauros domus Domini.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:27
verses.text: Per gyrum quoque templi Domini morabantur in custodiis suis : ut cum tempus fuisset, ipsi mane aperirent fores.  <div eID="gen1944" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv945"/><div sID="gen1945" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv945"/>De horum genere erant et super vasa ministerii : ad numerum enim et inferebantur vasa, et efferebantur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:29
verses.text: De ipsis et qui credita habebant utensilia sanctuarii, præerant similæ, et vino, et oleo, et thuri, et aromatibus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:30
verses.text: Filii autem sacerdotum unguenta ex aromatibus conficiebant.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:31
verses.text: Et Mathathias Levites primogenitus Sellum Coritæ, præfectus erat eorum quæ in sartagine frigebantur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:32
verses.text: Porro de filiis Caath fratribus eorum, super panes erant propositionis, ut semper novos per singula sabbata præpararent.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:33
verses.text: Hi sunt principes cantorum per familias Levitarum, qui in exedris morabantur, ut die ac nocte jugiter suo ministerio deservirent.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:34
verses.text: Capita Levitarum, per familias suas principes, manserunt in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:35
verses.text: In Gabaon autem commorati sunt pater Gabaon Jehiel, et nomen uxoris ejus Maacha.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:36
verses.text: Filius primogenitus ejus Abdon, et Sur, et Cis, et Baal, et Ner, et Nadab,

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:37
verses.text: Gedor quoque, et Ahio, et Zacharias, et Macelloth.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:38
verses.text: Porro Macelloth genuit Samaan : isti habitaverunt e regione fratrum suorum in Jerusalem cum fratribus suis.  <div eID="gen1945" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv946"/><div sID="gen1946" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv946"/>Ner autem genuit Cis, et Cis genuit Saul, et Saul genuit Jonathan, et Melchisua, et Abinadab, et Esbaal.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:40
verses.text: Filius autem Jonathan, Meribbaal : et Meribbaal genuit Micha.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:41
verses.text: Porro filii Micha, Phithon, et Melech, et Tharaa, et Ahaz.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:42
verses.text: Ahaz autem genuit Jara, et Jara genuit Alamath, et Azmoth, et Zamri. Zamri autem genuit Mosa.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:43
verses.text: Mosa vero genuit Banaa, cujus filius Raphaia, genuit Elasa, de quo ortus est Asel.

verses.name: I Chronicles 9:44
verses.text: Porro Asel sex filios habuit, his nominibus : Ezricam, Bocru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, Hanan : hi sunt filii Asel.  <chapter eID="1Chr.9"/> <div eID="gen1946" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:1
verses.text: Philisthiim autem pugnabant contra Israël, fugeruntque viri Israël Palæsthinos, et ceciderunt vulnerati in monte Gelboë.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:2
verses.text: Cumque appropinquassent Philisthæi, persequentes Saul et filios ejus, percusserunt Jonathan, et Abinadab, et Melchisua filios Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:3
verses.text: Et aggravatum est prælium contra Saul, inveneruntque eum sagittarii, et vulneraverunt jaculis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:4
verses.text: Et dixit Saul ad armigerum suum : Evagina gladium tuum, et interfice me, ne forte veniant incircumcisi isti, et illudant mihi. Noluit autem armiger ejus hoc facere, timore perterritus : arripuit ergo Saul ensem, et irruit in eum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:5
verses.text: Quod cum vidisset armiger ejus, videlicet mortuum esse Saul, irruit etiam ipse in gladium suum, et mortuus est.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:6
verses.text: Interiit ergo Saul : et tres filii ejus, et omnis domus illius pariter concidit.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:7
verses.text: Quod cum vidissent viri Israël qui habitabant in campestribus, fugerunt : et Saul ac filiis ejus mortuis, dereliquerunt urbes suas, et huc illucque dispersi sunt : veneruntque Philisthiim, et habitaverunt in eis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:8
verses.text: Die igitur altero detrahentes Philisthiim spolia cæsorum, invenerunt Saul et filios ejus jacentes in monte Gelboë.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:9
verses.text: Cumque spoliassent eum, et amputassent caput, armisque nudassent, miserunt in terram suam, ut circumferretur, et ostenderetur idolorum templis, et populis :

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:10
verses.text: arma autem ejus consecraverunt in fano dei sui, et caput affixerunt in templo Dagon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:11
verses.text: Hoc cum audissent viri Jabes Galaad, omnia scilicet quæ Philisthiim fecerant super Saul,

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:12
verses.text: consurrexerunt singuli virorum fortium, et tulerunt cadavera Saul et filiorum ejus : attuleruntque ea in Jabes, et sepelierunt ossa eorum subter quercum, quæ erat in Jabes, et jejunaverunt septem diebus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:13
verses.text: Mortuus est ergo Saul propter iniquitates suas, eo quod prævaricatus sit mandatum Domini quod præceperat, et non custodierit illud : sed insuper etiam pythonissam consuluerit,

verses.name: I Chronicles 10:14
verses.text: nec speraverit in Domino : propter quod interfecit eum, et transtulit regnum ejus ad David filium Isai.  <chapter eID="1Chr.10"/> <div eID="gen1947" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:1
verses.text: Congregatus est igitur omnis Israël ad David in Hebron, dicens : Os tuum sumus, et caro tua.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:2
verses.text: Heri quoque et nudiustertius cum adhuc regnaret Saul, tu eras qui educebas et introducebas Israël : tibi enim dixit Dominus Deus tuus : Tu pasces populum meum Israël, et tu eris princeps super eum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:3
verses.text: Venerunt ergo omnes majores natu Israël ad regem in Hebron, et iniit David cum eis fœdus coram Domino : unxeruntque eum regem super Israël, juxta sermonem Domini quem locutus est in manu Samuel.  <div eID="gen1948" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv947"/><div sID="gen1949" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv947"/>Abiit quoque David et omnis Israël in Jerusalem : hæc est Jebus, ubi erant Jebusæi habitatores terræ.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:5
verses.text: Dixeruntque qui habitabant in Jebus ad David : Non ingredieris huc. Porro David cepit arcem Sion, quæ est civitas David,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:6
verses.text: dixitque : Omnis qui percusserit Jebusæum in primis, erit princeps et dux. Ascendit igitur primus Joab filius Sarviæ, et factus est princeps.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:7
verses.text: Habitavit autem David in arce, et idcirco appellata est civitas David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:8
verses.text: Ædificavitque urbem in circuitu a Mello usque ad gyrum ; Joab autem reliqua urbis exstruxit.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:9
verses.text: Proficiebatque David vadens et crescens, et Dominus exercituum erat cum eo.  <div eID="gen1949" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv948"/><div sID="gen1950" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv948"/>Hi principes virorum fortium David, qui adjuverunt eum ut rex fieret super omnem Israël, juxta verbum Domini quod locutus est ad Israël.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:11
verses.text: Et iste numerus robustorum David : Jesbaam filius Hachamoni princeps inter triginta : iste levavit hastam suam super trecentos vulneratos una vice.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:12
verses.text: Et post eum Eleazar filius patrui ejus Ahohites, qui erat inter tres potentes.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:13
verses.text: Iste fuit cum David in Phesdomim, quando Philisthiim congregati sunt ad locum illum in prælium : et erat ager regionis illius plenus hordeo, fugeratque populus a facie Philisthinorum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:14
verses.text: Hi steterunt in medio agri, et defenderunt eum : cumque percussissent Philisthæos, dedit Dominus salutem magnam populo suo.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:15
verses.text: Descenderunt autem tres de triginta principibus ad petram, in qua erat David, ad speluncam Odollam, quando Philisthiim fuerant castrametati in valle Raphaim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:16
verses.text: Porro David erat in præsidio, et statio Philisthinorum in Bethlehem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:17
verses.text: Desideravit igitur David, et dixit : O si quis daret mihi aquam de cisterna Bethlehem, quæ est in porta !

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:18
verses.text: Tres ergo isti per media castra Philisthinorum perrexerunt, et hauserunt aquam de cisterna Bethlehem quæ erat in porta, et attulerunt ad David ut biberet. Qui noluit, sed magis libavit illam Domino,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:19
verses.text: dicens : Absit ut in conspectu Dei mei hoc faciam, et sanguinem istorum virorum bibam : quia in periculo animarum suarum attulerunt mihi aquam. Et ob hanc causam noluit bibere : hæc fecerunt tres robustissimi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:20
verses.text: Abisai quoque frater Joab ipse erat princeps trium, et ipse levavit hastam suam contra trecentos vulneratos, et ipse erat inter tres nominatissimus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:21
verses.text: et inter tres secundos inclytus, et princeps eorum : verumtamen usque ad tres primos non pervenerat.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:22
verses.text: Banaias filius Jojadæ viri robustissimi, qui multa opera perpetrarat, de Cabseel : ipse percussit duos ariel Moab, et ipse descendit et interfecit leonem in media cisterna tempore nivis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:23
verses.text: Et ipse percussit virum ægyptium, cujus statura erat quinque cubitorum, et habebat lanceam ut liciatorium texentium : descendit igitur ad eum cum virga, et rapuit hastam quam tenebat manu, et interfecit eum hasta sua.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:24
verses.text: Hæc fecit Banaias filius Jojadæ, qui erat inter tres robustos nominatissimus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:25
verses.text: inter triginta primus, verumtamen ad tres usque non pervenerat : posuit autem eum David ad auriculam suam.  <div eID="gen1950" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv949"/><div sID="gen1951" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv949"/>Porro fortissimi viri in exercitu, Asahel frater Joab, et Elchanan filius patrui ejus de Bethlehem,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:27
verses.text: Sammoth Arorites, Helles Pharonites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:28
verses.text: Ira filius Acces Thecuites, Abiezer Anathothites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:29
verses.text: Sobbochai Husathites, Ilai Ahohites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:30
verses.text: Maharai Netophathites, Heled filius Baana Netophathites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:31
verses.text: Ethai filius Ribai de Gabaath filiorum Benjamin, Banaia Pharatonites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:32
verses.text: Hurai de torrente Gaas, Abiel Arbathites, Azmoth Bauramites, Eliaba Salabonites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:33
verses.text: Filii Assem Gezonites, Jonathan filius Sage Ararites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:34
verses.text: Ahiam filius Sachar Ararites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:35
verses.text: Eliphal filius Ur,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:36
verses.text: Hepher Mecherathites, Ahia Phelonites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:37
verses.text: Hesro Carmelites, Naarai filius Asbai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:38
verses.text: Joël frater Nathan, Mibahar filius Agarai,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:39
verses.text: Selec Ammonites, Naharai Berothites armiger Joab filii Sarviæ,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:40
verses.text: Ira Jethræus, Gareb Jethræus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:41
verses.text: Urias Hethæus, Zabad filius Oholi,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:42
verses.text: Adina filius Siza Rubenites princeps Rubenitarum, et cum eo triginta :

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:43
verses.text: Hanan filius Maacha, et Josaphat Mathanites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:44
verses.text: Ozia Astarothites, Samma, et Jehiel filii Hotham Arorites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:45
verses.text: Jedihel filius Samri, et Joha frater ejus Thosaites,

verses.name: I Chronicles 11:46
verses.text: Eliel Mahumites, et Jeribai, et Josaia filii Elnaëm, et Jethma Moabites, Eliel, et Obed, et Jasiel de Masobia.  <chapter eID="1Chr.11"/> <div eID="gen1951" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:1
verses.text: Hi quoque venerunt ad David in Siceleg, cum adhuc fugeret Saul filium Cis, qui erant fortissimi et egregii pugnatores,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:2
verses.text: tendentes arcum, et utraque manu fundis saxa jacientes, et dirigentes sagittas, de fratribus Saul ex Benjamin.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:3
verses.text: Princeps Ahiecer, et Joas filii Samaa Gabaathites, et Jaziel, et Phallet filii Azmoth, et Baracha, et Jehu Anathotites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:4
verses.text: Samaias quoque Gabaonites fortissimus inter triginta et super triginta. Jeremias, et Jeheziel, et Johanan, et Jezabad Gaderothites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:5
verses.text: Et Eluzai, et Jerimuth, et Baalia, et Samaria, et Saphatia Haruphites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:6
verses.text: Elcana, et Jesia, et Azareel, et Joëzer, et Jesbaam de Carehim :

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:7
verses.text: Joëla quoque, et Zabadia filii Jeroham de Gedor.  <div eID="gen1952" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv950"/><div sID="gen1953" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv950"/>Sed et de Gaddi transfugerunt ad David cum lateret in deserto, viri robustissimi, et pugnatores optimi, tenentes clypeum et hastam : facies eorum quasi facies leonis, et veloces quasi capreæ in montibus :

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:9
verses.text: Ezer princeps, Obdias secundus, Eliab tertius,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:10
verses.text: Masmana quartus, Jeremias quintus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:11
verses.text: Ethi sextus, Eliel septimus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:12
verses.text: Johanan octavus, Elzebad nonus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:13
verses.text: Jeremias decimus, Machbanai undecimus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:14
verses.text: Hi de filiis Gad principes exercitus : novissimus centum militibus præerat, et maximus mille.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:15
verses.text: Isti sunt qui transierunt Jordanem mense primo, quando inundare consuevit super ripas suas : et omnes fugaverunt qui morabantur in vallibus ad orientalem plagam et occidentalem.  <div eID="gen1953" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv951"/><div sID="gen1954" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv951"/>Venerunt autem et de Benjamin et de Juda ad præsidium in quo morabatur David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:17
verses.text: Egressusque est David obviam eis, et ait : Si pacifice venistis ad me ut auxiliemini mihi, cor meum jungatur vobis : si autem insidiamini mihi pro adversariis meis, cum ego iniquitatem in manibus non habeam, videat Deus patrum nostrorum, et judicet.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:18
verses.text: Spiritus vero induit Amasai principem inter triginta, et ait : Tui sumus, o David, et tecum, fili Isai. Pax, pax tibi, et pax adjutoribus tuis : te enim adjuvat Deus tuus. Suscepit ergo eos David, et constituit principes turmæ.  <div eID="gen1954" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv952"/><div sID="gen1955" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv952"/>Porro de Manasse transfugerunt ad David, quando veniebat cum Philisthiim adversus Saul ut pugnaret : et non dimicavit cum eis, quia inito consilio remiserunt eum principes Philisthinorum, dicentes : Periculo capitis nostri revertetur ad dominum suum Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:20
verses.text: Quando igitur reversus est in Siceleg, transfugerunt ad eum de Manasse, Ednas, et Jozabad, et Jedihel, et Michaël, et Ednas, et Jozabad, et Eliu, et Salathi, principes millium in Manasse.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:21
verses.text: Hi præbuerunt auxilium David adversus latrunculos : omnes enim erant viri fortissimi, et facti sunt principes in exercitu.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:22
verses.text: Sed et per singulos dies veniebant ad David ad auxiliandum ei, usque dum fieret grandis numerus, quasi exercitus Dei.  <div eID="gen1955" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv953"/><div sID="gen1956" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv953"/>Iste quoque est numerus principum exercitus qui venerunt ad David cum esset in Hebron, ut transferrent regnum Saul ad eum, juxta verbum Domini.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:24
verses.text: Filii Juda portantes clypeum et hastam, sex millia octingenti expediti ad prælium.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:25
verses.text: De filiis Simeon virorum fortissimorum ad pugnandum, septem millia centum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:26
verses.text: De filiis Levi, quatuor millia sexcenti.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:27
verses.text: Jojoda quoque princeps de stirpe Aaron, et cum eo tria millia septingenti.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:28
verses.text: Sadoc etiam puer egregiæ indolis, et domus patris ejus, principes viginti duo.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:29
verses.text: De filiis autem Benjamin fratribus Saul, tria millia : magna enim pars eorum adhuc sequebatur domum Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:30
verses.text: Porro de filiis Ephraim viginti millia octingenti, fortissimi robore, viri nominati in cognationibus suis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:31
verses.text: Et ex dimidia tribu Manasse, decem et octo millia, singuli per nomina sua, venerunt ut constituerent regem David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:32
verses.text: De filiis quoque Issachar viri eruditi, qui noverant singula tempora ad præcipiendum quid facere deberet Israël, principes ducenti : omnis autem reliqua tribus eorum consilium sequebatur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:33
verses.text: Porro de Zabulon qui egrediebantur ad prælium, et stabant in acie instructi armis bellicis, quinquaginta millia venerunt in auxilium, non in corde duplici.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:34
verses.text: Et de Nephthali, principes mille, et cum eis instructi clypeo et hasta, triginta et septem millia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:35
verses.text: De Dan etiam præparati ad prælium, viginti octo millia sexcenti.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:36
verses.text: Et de Aser egredientes ad pugnam, et in acie provocantes, quadraginta millia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:37
verses.text: Trans Jordanem autem de filiis Ruben, et de Gad, et dimidia parte tribus Manasse, instructi armis bellicis, centum viginti millia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:38
verses.text: Omnes isti viri bellatores expediti ad pugnandum, corde perfecto venerunt in Hebron, ut constituerent regem David super universum Israël : sed et omnes reliqui ex Israël uno corde erant, ut rex fieret David.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:39
verses.text: Fueruntque ibi apud David tribus diebus comedentes et bibentes : præparaverant enim eis fratres sui.

verses.name: I Chronicles 12:40
verses.text: Sed et qui juxta eos erant, usque ad Issachar, et Zabulon, et Nephthali, afferebant panes in asinis, et camelis, et mulis, et bobus ad vescendum : farinam, palathas, uvam passam, vinum, oleum, boves, arietes ad omnem copiam : gaudium quippe erat in Israël.  <chapter eID="1Chr.12"/> <div eID="gen1956" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:1
verses.text: Iniit autem consilium David cum tribunis, et centurionibus, et universis principibus,

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:2
verses.text: et ait ad omnem cœtum Israël : Si placet vobis, et a Domino Deo nostro egreditur sermo quem loquor, mittamus ad fratres nostros reliquos in universas regiones Israël, et ad sacerdotes et Levitas qui habitant in suburbanis urbium, ut congregentur ad nos,

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:3
verses.text: et reducamus arcam Dei nostri ad nos : non enim requisivimus eam in diebus Saul.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:4
verses.text: Et respondit universa multitudo ut ita fieret : placuerat enim sermo omni populo.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:5
verses.text: Congregavit ergo David cunctum Israël, a Sihor Ægypti usque dum ingrediaris Emath, ut adduceret arcam Dei de Cariathiarim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:6
verses.text: Et ascendit David, et omnis vir Israël, ad collem Cariathiarim, qui est in Juda, ut afferret inde arcam Domini Dei sedentis super cherubim, ubi invocatum est nomen ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:7
verses.text: Imposueruntque arcam Dei super plaustrum novum, de domo Abinadab : Oza autem, et frater ejus minabant plaustrum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:8
verses.text: Porro David, et universus Israël, ludebant coram Deo omni virtute in canticis, et in citharis, et psalteriis, et tympanis, et cymbalis, et tubis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:9
verses.text: Cum autem pervenisset ad aream Chidon, tetendit Oza manum suam, ut sustentaret arcam : bos quippe lasciviens paululum inclinaverat eam.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:10
verses.text: Iratus est itaque Dominus contra Ozam, et percussit eum, eo quod tetigisset arcam : et mortuus est ibi coram Domino.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:11
verses.text: Contristatusque est David, eo quod divisisset Dominus Ozam : vocavitque locum illum Divisio Ozæ, usque in præsentem diem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:12
verses.text: Et timuit Deum tunc temporis, dicens : Quomodo possum ad me introducere arcam Dei ?

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:13
verses.text: et ob hanc causam non adduxit eam ad se, hoc est, in civitatem David, sed avertit in domum Obededom Gethæi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 13:14
verses.text: Mansit ergo arca Dei in domo Obededom tribus mensibus : et benedixit Dominus domui ejus, et omnibus quæ habebat.  <chapter eID="1Chr.13"/> <div eID="gen1957" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:1
verses.text: Misit quoque Hiram rex Tyri nuntios ad David, et ligna cedrina, et artifices parietum, lignorumque, ut ædificarent ei domum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:2
verses.text: Cognovitque David quod confirmasset eum Dominus in regem super Israël, et sublevatum esset regnum suum super populum ejus Israël.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:3
verses.text: Accepit quoque David alias uxores in Jerusalem, genuitque filios et filias.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:4
verses.text: Et hæc nomina eorum, qui nati sunt ei in Jerusalem : Samua, et Sobab, Nathan, et Salomon,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:5
verses.text: Jebahar, et Elisua, et Eliphalet,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:6
verses.text: Noga quoque, et Napheg, et Japhia,

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:7
verses.text: Elisama, et Baaliada, et Eliphalet.  <div eID="gen1958" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv954"/><div sID="gen1959" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv954"/>Audientes autem Philisthiim eo quod unctus esset David regem super universum Israël, ascenderunt omnes ut quærerent eum : quod cum audisset David, egressus est obviam eis.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:9
verses.text: Porro Philisthiim venientes, diffusi sunt in valle Raphaim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:10
verses.text: Consuluitque David Dominum, dicens : Si ascendam ad Philisthæos, et si trades eos in manu mea ? Et dixit ei Dominus : Ascende, et tradam eos in manu tua.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:11
verses.text: Cumque illi ascendissent in Baalpharasim, percussit eos ibi David, et dixit : Divisit Deus inimicos meos per manum meam, sicut dividuntur aquæ : et idcirco vocatum est nomen illius loci Baalpharasim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:12
verses.text: Dereliqueruntque ibi deos suos, quos David jussit exuri.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:13
verses.text: Alia etiam vice Philisthiim irruerunt, et diffusi sunt in valle.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:14
verses.text: Consuluitque rursum David Deum, et dixit ei Deus : Non ascendas post eos : recede ab eis, et venies contra illos ex adverso pyrorum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:15
verses.text: Cumque audieris sonitum gradientis in cacumine pyrorum, tunc egredieris ad bellum : egressus est enim Deus ante te, ut percutiat castra Philisthiim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:16
verses.text: Fecit ergo David sicut præceperat ei Deus, et percussit castra Philisthinorum, de Gabaon usque Gazera.

verses.name: I Chronicles 14:17
verses.text: Divulgatumque est nomen David in universis regionibus, et Dominus dedit pavorem ejus super omnes gentes.  <chapter eID="1Chr.14"/> <div eID="gen1959" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:1
verses.text: Fecit quoque sibi domos in civitate David : et ædificavit locum arcæ Dei, tetenditque ei tabernaculum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:2
verses.text: Tunc dixit David : Illicitum est ut a quocumque portetur arca Dei nisi a Levitis, quos elegit Dominus ad portandum eam, et ad ministrandum sibi usque in æternum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:3
verses.text: Congregavitque universum Israël in Jerusalem, ut afferretur arca Dei in locum suum, quem præparaverat ei :

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:4
verses.text: necnon et filios Aaron, et Levitas.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:5
verses.text: De filiis Caath, Uriel princeps fuit, et fratres ejus centum viginti.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:6
verses.text: De filiis Merari, Asaia princeps : et fratres ejus ducenti viginti.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:7
verses.text: De filiis Gersom, Joël princeps : et fratres ejus centum triginta.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:8
verses.text: De filiis Elisaphan, Semeias princeps : et fratres ejus ducenti.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:9
verses.text: De filiis Hebron, Eliel princeps : et fratres ejus octoginta.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:10
verses.text: De filiis Oziel, Aminadab princeps : et fratres ejus centum duodecim.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:11
verses.text: Vocavitque David Sadoc et Abiathar sacerdotes, et Levitas, Uriel, Asaiam, Joël, Semeiam, Eliel, et Aminadab :

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:12
verses.text: et dixit ad eos : Vos, qui estis principes familiarum Leviticarum, sanctificamini cum fratribus vestris, et afferte arcam Domini Dei Israël ad locum qui ei præparatus est :

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:13
verses.text: ne ut a principio, quia non eratis præsentes, percussit nos Dominus ; sic et nunc fiat, illicitum quid nobis agentibus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:14
verses.text: Sanctificati sunt ergo sacerdotes et Levitæ ut portarent arcam Domini Dei Israël.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:15
verses.text: Et tulerunt filii Levi arcam Dei, sicut præceperat Moyses juxta verbum Domini, humeris suis in vectibus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:16
verses.text: Dixitque David principibus Levitarum, ut constituerent de fratribus suis cantores in organis musicorum, nablis videlicet, et lyris, et cymbalis, ut resonaret in excelsis sonitus lætitiæ.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:17
verses.text: Constitueruntque Levitas : Heman filium Joël, et de fratribus ejus Asaph filium Barachiæ : de filiis vero Merari, fratribus eorum : Ethan filium Casaiæ.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:18
verses.text: Et cum eis fratres eorum : in secundo ordine, Zachariam, et Ben, et Jaziel, et Semiramoth, et Jahiel, et Ani, Eliab, et Banaiam, et Maasiam, et Mathathiam, et Eliphalu, et Maceniam, et Obededom, et Jehiel, janitores.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:19
verses.text: Porro cantores, Heman, Asaph, et Ethan, in cymbalis æneis concrepantes.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:20
verses.text: Zacharias autem, et Oziel, et Semiramoth, et Jahiel, et Ani, et Eliab, et Maasias, et Banaias in nablis arcana cantabant.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:21
verses.text: Porro Mathathias, et Eliphalu, et Macenias, et Obededom, et Jehiel, et Ozaziu, in citharis pro octava canebant epinicion.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:22
verses.text: Chonenias autem princeps Levitarum, prophetiæ præerat, ad præcinendam melodiam : erat quippe valde sapiens.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:23
verses.text: Et Barachias, et Elcana, janitores arcæ.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:24
verses.text: Porro Sebenias, et Josaphat, et Nathanaël, et Amasai, et Zacharias, et Banaias, et Eliezer sacerdotes, clangebant tubis coram arca Dei : et Obededom et Jehias erant janitores arcæ.  <div eID="gen1960" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv955"/><div sID="gen1961" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv955"/>Igitur David, et omnes majores natu Israël, et tribuni, ierunt ad deportandam arcam fœderis Domini de domo Obededom cum lætitia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:26
verses.text: Cumque adjuvisset Deus Levitas qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, immolabantur septem tauri, et septem arietes.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:27
verses.text: Porro David erat indutus stola byssina, et universi Levitæ qui portabant arcam, cantoresque, et Chonenias princeps prophetiæ inter cantores : David autem etiam indutus erat ephod lineo.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:28
verses.text: Universusque Israël deducebant arcam fœderis Domini in jubilo, et sonitu buccinæ, et tubis, et cymbalis, et nablis, et citharis concrepantes.

verses.name: I Chronicles 15:29
verses.text: Cumque pervenisset arca fœderis Domini usque ad civitatem David, Michol filia Saul prospiciens per fenestram vidit regem David saltantem atque ludentem, et despexit eum in corde suo.  <chapter eID="1Chr.15"/> <div eID="gen1961" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:1
verses.text: Attulerunt igitur arcam Dei, et constituerunt eam in medio tabernaculi quod tetenderat ei David : et obtulerunt holocausta et pacifica coram Deo.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:2
verses.text: Cumque complesset David offerens holocausta et pacifica, benedixit populo in nomine Domini.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:3
verses.text: Et divisit universis per singulos, a viro usque ad mulierem, tortam panis, et partem assæ carnis bubalæ, et frixam oleo similam.  <div eID="gen1962" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv956"/><div sID="gen1963" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv956"/>Constituitque coram arca Domini de Levitis, qui ministrarent, et recordarentur operum ejus, et glorificarent atque laudarent Dominum Deum Israël :

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:5
verses.text: Asaph principem, et secundum ejus Zachariam : porro Jahiel, et Semiramoth, et Jehiel, et Mathathiam, et Eliab, et Banaiam, et Obededom : Jehiel super organa psalterii et lyras : Asaph autem ut cymbalis personaret :

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:6
verses.text: Banaiam vero et Jaziel sacerdotes canere tuba jugiter coram arca fœderis Domini.  <div eID="gen1963" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv957"/><div sID="gen1964" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv957"/>In illo die fecit David principem ad confitendum Domino Asaph et fratres ejus :  <div eID="gen1964" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv958"/><lg sID="gen1965"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv958"/>Confitemini Domino, et invocate nomen ejus : <l eID="gen1966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1967"/>notas facite in populis adinventiones ejus. <l eID="gen1967" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv959"/><l level="1" sID="gen1968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv959"/>Cantate ei, et psallite ei, <l eID="gen1968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1969"/>et narrate omnia mirabilia ejus. <l eID="gen1969" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv960"/><l level="1" sID="gen1970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv960"/>Laudate nomen sanctum ejus : <l eID="gen1970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1971"/>lætetur cor quærentium Dominum. <l eID="gen1971" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv961"/><l level="1" sID="gen1972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv961"/>Quærite Dominum, et virtutem ejus : <l eID="gen1972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1973"/>quærite faciem ejus semper. <l eID="gen1973" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv962"/><l level="1" sID="gen1974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv962"/>Recordamini mirabilium ejus quæ fecit ; <l eID="gen1974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1975"/>signorum illius, et judiciorum oris ejus, <l eID="gen1975" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv963"/><l level="1" sID="gen1976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv963"/>semen Israël servi ejus, <l eID="gen1976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1977"/>filii Jacob electi ejus. <l eID="gen1977" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv964"/><l level="1" sID="gen1978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv964"/>Ipse Dominus Deus noster : <l eID="gen1978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1979"/>in universa terra judicia ejus. <l eID="gen1979" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv965"/><l level="1" sID="gen1980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv965"/>Recordamini in sempiternum pacti ejus : <l eID="gen1980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1981"/>sermonis quem præcepit in mille generationes, <l eID="gen1981" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv966"/><l level="1" sID="gen1982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv966"/>quem pepigit cum Abraham, <l eID="gen1982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1983"/>et juramenti illius cum Isaac. <l eID="gen1983" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv967"/><l level="1" sID="gen1984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv967"/>Et constituit illud Jacob in præceptum, <l eID="gen1984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1985"/>et Israël in pactum sempiternum, <l eID="gen1985" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv968"/><l level="1" sID="gen1986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv968"/>dicens : Tibi dabo terram Chanaan, <l eID="gen1986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1987"/>funiculum hæreditatis vestræ : <l eID="gen1987" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv969"/><l level="1" sID="gen1988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv969"/>cum essent pauci numero, <l eID="gen1988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1989"/>parvi et coloni ejus. <l eID="gen1989" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv970"/><l level="1" sID="gen1990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv970"/>Et transierunt de gente in gentem, <l eID="gen1990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1991"/>et de regno ad populum alterum. <l eID="gen1991" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv971"/><l level="1" sID="gen1992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv971"/>Non dimisit quemquam calumniari eos, <l eID="gen1992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1993"/>sed increpavit pro eis reges. <l eID="gen1993" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv972"/><l level="1" sID="gen1994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv972"/>Nolite tangere christos meos, <l eID="gen1994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1995"/>et in prophetis meis nolite malignari. <l eID="gen1995" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv973"/><l level="1" sID="gen1996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv973"/>Cantate Domino omnis terra ; <l eID="gen1996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1997"/>annuntiate ex die in diem salutare ejus : <l eID="gen1997" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv974"/><l level="1" sID="gen1998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv974"/>narrate in gentibus gloriam ejus ; <l eID="gen1998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen1999"/>in cunctis populis mirabilia ejus. <l eID="gen1999" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv975"/><l level="1" sID="gen2000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv975"/>Quia magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis, <l eID="gen2000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2001"/>et horribilis super omnes deos. <l eID="gen2001" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv976"/><l level="1" sID="gen2002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv976"/>Omnes enim dii populorum idola : <l eID="gen2002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2003"/>Dominus autem cælos fecit. <l eID="gen2003" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv977"/><l level="1" sID="gen2004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv977"/>Confessio et magnificentia coram eo : <l eID="gen2004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2005"/>fortitudo et gaudium in loco ejus. <l eID="gen2005" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv978"/><l level="1" sID="gen2006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv978"/>Afferte Domino, familiæ populorum : <l eID="gen2006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2007"/>afferte Domino gloriam et imperium. <l eID="gen2007" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv979"/><l level="1" sID="gen2008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv979"/>Date Domino gloriam ; <l eID="gen2008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2009"/>nomini ejus levate sacrificium, <l eID="gen2009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2010"/>et venite in conspectu ejus : <l eID="gen2010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2011"/>et adorate Dominum in decore sancto. <l eID="gen2011" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv980"/><l level="1" sID="gen2012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv980"/>Commoveatur a facie ejus omnis terra : <l eID="gen2012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2013"/>ipse enim fundavit orbem immobilem. <l eID="gen2013" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv981"/><l level="1" sID="gen2014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv981"/>Lætentur cæli, et exultet terra, <l eID="gen2014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2015"/>et dicant in nationibus : Dominus regnavit. <l eID="gen2015" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv982"/><l level="1" sID="gen2016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv982"/>Tonet mare et plenitudo ejus ; <l eID="gen2016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2017"/>exultent agri, et omnia quæ in eis sunt. <l eID="gen2017" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv983"/><l level="1" sID="gen2018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv983"/>Tunc laudabunt ligna saltus coram Domino : <l eID="gen2018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2019"/>quia venit judicare terram. <l eID="gen2019" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv984"/><l level="1" sID="gen2020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv984"/>Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus : <l eID="gen2020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2021"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen2021" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv985"/><l level="1" sID="gen2022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv985"/>Et dicite : Salva nos, Deus salvator noster, <l eID="gen2022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2023"/>et congrega nos, et erue de gentibus : <l eID="gen2023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2024"/>ut confiteamur nomini sancto tuo, <l eID="gen2024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2025"/>et exultemus in carminibus tuis. <l eID="gen2025" level="1"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv986"/><l level="1" sID="gen2026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv986"/>Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, <l eID="gen2026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2027"/>ab æterno usque in æternum. Et dicat omnis populo : Amen, et hymnum Domino.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:37
verses.text: Reliquit itaque ibi coram arca fœderis Domini Asaph et fratres ejus, ut ministrarent in conspectu arcæ jugiter per singulos dies, et vices suas.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:38
verses.text: Porro Obededom, et fratres ejus sexaginta octo : et Obededom filium Idithun, et Hosa, constituit janitores ;

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:39
verses.text: Sadoc autem sacerdotem, et fratres ejus sacerdotes, coram tabernaculo Domini in excelso quod erat in Gabaon,

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:40
verses.text: ut offerrent holocausta Domino super altare holocautomatis jugiter, mane et vespere, juxta omnia quæ scripta sunt in lege Domini, quam præcepit Israëli.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:41
verses.text: Et post eum Heman, et Idithun, et reliquos electos, unumquemque vocabulo suo ad confitendum Domino, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:42
verses.text: Heman quoque et Idithun canentes tuba, et quatientes cymbala et omnia musicorum organa ad canendum Deo : filios autem Idithun fecit esse portarios.

verses.name: I Chronicles 16:43
verses.text: Reversusque est omnis populus in domum suam : et David, ut benediceret etiam domui suæ. <l eID="gen2027" level="1"/><lg eID="gen1965"/> <chapter eID="1Chr.16"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:1
verses.text: Cum autem habitaret David in domo sua, dixit ad Nathan prophetam : Ecce ego habito in domo cedrina : arca autem fœderis Domini sub pellibus est.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:2
verses.text: Et ait Nathan ad David : Omnia quæ in corde tuo sunt, fac : Deus enim tecum est.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:3
verses.text: Igitur nocte illa factus est sermo Dei ad Nathan, dicens :

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:4
verses.text: Vade, et loquere David servo meo : Hæc dicit Dominus : Non ædificabis tu mihi domum ad habitandum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:5
verses.text: Neque enim mansi in domo ex eo tempore quo eduxi Israël usque ad diem hanc : sed fui semper mutans loca tabernaculi, et in tentorio

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:6
verses.text: manens cum omni Israël. Numquid locutus sum saltem uni judicum Israël, quibus præceperam ut pascerent populum meum, et dixi : Quare non ædificastis mihi domum cedrinam ?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:7
verses.text: Nunc itaque sic loqueris ad servum meum David : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ego tuli te, cum in pascuis sequereris gregem, ut esses dux populi mei Israël :

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:8
verses.text: et fui tecum quocumque perrexisti, et interfeci omnes inimicos tuos coram te, fecique tibi nomen quasi unius magnorum qui celebrantur in terra.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:9
verses.text: Et dedi locum populo meo Israël : plantabitur, et habitabit in eo, et ultra non commovebitur : nec filii iniquitatis atterent eos, sicut a principio,

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:10
verses.text: ex diebus quibus dedi judices populo meo Israël, et humiliavi universos inimicos tuos. Annuntio ergo tibi, quod ædificaturus sit tibi Dominus domum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:11
verses.text: Cumque impleveris dies tuos ut vadas ad patres tuos, suscitabo semen tuum post te, quod erit de filiis tuis : et stabiliam regnum ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:12
verses.text: Ipse ædificabit mihi domum, et firmabo solium ejus usque in æternum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:13
verses.text: Ego ero ei in patrem, et ipse erit mihi in filium : et misericordiam meam non auferam ab eo, sicut abstuli ab eo qui ante te fuit.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:14
verses.text: Et statuam eum in domo mea, et in regno meo usque in sempiternum : et thronus ejus erit firmissimus in perpetuum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:15
verses.text: Juxta omnia verba hæc, et juxta universam visionem istam, sic locutus est Nathan ad David.  <div eID="gen2028" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv987"/><div sID="gen2029" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv987"/>Cumque venisset rex David, et sedisset coram Domino, dixit : Quis ego sum, Domine Deus, et quæ domus mea, ut præstares mihi talia ?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:17
verses.text: sed et hoc parum visum est in conspectu tuo, ideoque locutus es super domum servi tui etiam in futurum : et fecisti me spectabilem super omnes homines, Domine Deus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:18
verses.text: Quid ultra addere potest David, cum ita glorificaveris servum tuum, et cognoveris eum ?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:19
verses.text: Domine, propter famulum tuum juxta cor tuum fecisti omnem magnificentiam hanc, et nota esse voluisti universa magnalia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:20
verses.text: Domine, non est similis tui, et non est alius deus absque te, ex omnibus quos audivimus auribus nostris.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:21
verses.text: Quis enim est alius, ut populus tuus Israël, gens una in terra, ad quam perrexit Deus ut liberaret et faceret populum sibi, et magnitudine sua atque terroribus ejiceret nationes a facie ejus, quem de Ægypto liberarat ?

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:22
verses.text: Et posuisti populum tuum Israël tibi in populum usque in æternum, et tu, Domine, factus es Deus ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:23
verses.text: Nunc igitur Domine, sermo quem locutus es famulo tuo et super domum ejus confirmetur in perpetuum, et fac sicut locutus es.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:24
verses.text: Permaneatque et magnificetur nomen tuum usque in sempiternum, et dicatur : Dominus exercituum Deus Israël, et domus David servi ejus permanens coram eo.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:25
verses.text: Tu enim, Domine Deus meus, revelasti auriculam servi tui, ut ædificares ei domum : et idcirco invenit servus tuus fiduciam, ut oret coram te.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:26
verses.text: Nunc ergo Domine, tu es Deus, et locutus es ad servum tuum tanta beneficia.

verses.name: I Chronicles 17:27
verses.text: Et cœpisti benedicere domui servi tui, ut sit semper coram te : te enim, Domine, benedicente, benedicta erit in perpetuum.  <chapter eID="1Chr.17"/> <div eID="gen2029" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:1
verses.text: Factum est autem post hæc, ut percuteret David Philisthiim, et humiliaret eos, et tolleret Geth et filias ejus de manu Philisthiim,

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:2
verses.text: percuteretque Moab, et fierent Moabitæ servi David, offerentes ei munera.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:3
verses.text: Eo tempore percussit David etiam Adarezer regem Soba regionis Hemath, quando perrexit ut dilataret imperium suum usque ad flumen Euphraten.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:4
verses.text: Cepit ergo David mille quadrigas ejus, et septem millia equitum, ac viginti millia virorum peditum, subnervavitque omnes equos curruum, exceptis centum quadrigis, quas reservavit sibi.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:5
verses.text: Supervenit autem et Syrus Damascenus, ut auxilium præberet Adarezer regi Soba : sed et hujus percussit David viginti duo millia virorum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:6
verses.text: Et posuit milites in Damasco, ut Syria quoque serviret sibi, et offerret munera. Adjuvitque eum Dominus in cunctis ad quæ perrexerat.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:7
verses.text: Tulit quoque David pharetras aureas, quas habuerant servi Adarezer, et attulit eas in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:8
verses.text: Necnon de Thebath et Chun urbibus Adarezer æris plurimum, de quo fecit Salomon mare æneum, et columnas, et vasa ænea.  <div eID="gen2030" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv988"/><div sID="gen2031" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv988"/>Quod cum audisset Thou rex Hemath, percussisse videlicet David omnem exercitum Adarezer regis Soba,

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:10
verses.text: misit Adoram filium suum ad regem David, ut postularet ab eo pacem, et congratularetur ei quod percussisset et expugnasset Adarezer : adversarius quippe erat Thou Adarezer.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:11
verses.text: Sed et omnia vasa aurea, et argentea, et ænea consecravit David rex Domino, cum argento et auro quod tulerat ex universis gentibus, tam de Idumæa, et Moab, et filiis Ammon, quam de Philisthiim et Amalec.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:12
verses.text: Abisai vero filius Sarviæ percussit Edom in valle Salinarum, decem et octo millia :

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:13
verses.text: et constituit in Edom præsidium, ut serviret Idumæa David : salvavitque Dominus David in cunctis ad quæ perrexerat.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:14
verses.text: Regnavit ergo David super universum Israël, et faciebat judicium atque justitiam cuncto populo suo.

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:15
verses.text: Porro Joab filius Sarviæ erat super exercitum, et Josaphat filius Ahilud a commentariis :

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:16
verses.text: Sadoc autem filius Achitob, et Ahimelech filius Abiathar, sacerdotes : et Susa, scriba :

verses.name: I Chronicles 18:17
verses.text: Banaias quoque filius Jojadæ super legiones Cerethi et Phelethi : porro filii David, primi ad manum regis.  <chapter eID="1Chr.18"/> <div eID="gen2031" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:1
verses.text: Accidit autem ut moreretur Naas rex filiorum Ammon, et regnaret filius ejus pro eo.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:2
verses.text: Dixitque David : Faciam misericordiam cum Hanon filio Naas : præstitit enim mihi pater ejus gratiam. Misitque David nuntios ad consolandum eum super morte patris sui. Qui cum pervenissent in terram filiorum Ammon ut consolarentur Hanon,

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:3
verses.text: dixerunt principes filiorum Ammon ad Hanon : Tu forsitan putas, quod David honoris causa in patrem tuum miserit qui consolentur te : nec animadvertis quod ut explorent, et investigent, et scrutentur terram tuam, venerint ad te servi ejus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:4
verses.text: Igitur Hanon pueros David decalvavit, et rasit, et præcidit tunicas eorum a natibus usque ad pedes, et dimisit eos.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:5
verses.text: Qui cum abiissent, et hoc mandassent David, misit in occursum eorum (grandem enim contumeliam sustinuerant) et præcepit ut manerent in Jericho, donec cresceret barba eorum, et tunc reverterentur.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:6
verses.text: Videntes autem filii Ammon quod injuriam fecissent David, tam Hanon quam reliquus populus, miserunt mille talenta argenti, ut conducerent sibi de Mesopotamia, et de Syria Maacha, et de Soba currus et equites.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:7
verses.text: Conduxeruntque triginta duo millia curruum, et regem Maacha cum populo ejus. Qui cum venissent, castrametati sunt e regione Medaba. Filii quoque Ammon congregati de urbibus suis venerunt ad bellum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:8
verses.text: Quod cum audisset David, misit Joab, et omnem exercitum virorum fortium :

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:9
verses.text: egressique filii Ammon, direxerunt aciem juxta portam civitatis ; reges autem, qui ad auxilium ejus venerant, separatim in agro steterunt.  <div eID="gen2032" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv989"/><div sID="gen2033" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv989"/>Igitur Joab, intelligens bellum ex adverso et post tergum contra se fieri, elegit viros fortissimos de universo Israël, et perrexit contra Syrum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:11
verses.text: Reliquam autem partem populi dedit sub manu Abisai fratris sui : et perrexerunt contra filios Ammon.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:12
verses.text: Dixitque : Si vicerit me Syrus, auxilio eris mihi : si autem superaverint te filii Ammon, ero tibi in præsidium.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:13
verses.text: Confortare, et agamus viriliter pro populo nostro, et pro urbibus Dei nostri : Dominus autem, quod in conspectu suo bonum est, faciet.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:14
verses.text: Perrexit ergo Joab et populus qui cum eo erat, contra Syrum ad prælium : et fugavit eos.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:15
verses.text: Porro filii Ammon videntes quod fugisset Syrus, ipsi quoque fugerunt Abisai fratrem ejus, et ingressi sunt civitatem : reversusque est etiam Joab in Jerusalem.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:16
verses.text: Videns autem Syrus quod cecidisset coram Israël, misit nuntios, et adduxit Syrum, qui erat trans fluvium : Sophach autem princeps militiæ Adarezer erat dux eorum.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:17
verses.text: Quod cum nuntiatum esset David, congregavit universum Israël, et transivit Jordanem, irruitque in eos et direxit ex adverso aciem, illis contra pugnantibus.

verses.name: I Chronicles 19:18
