verses.text: Respondensque rex Assuerus, ait : Quis est iste, et cujus potentiæ, ut hæc audeat facere ?

verses.name: Esther 7:6
verses.text: Dixitque Esther : Hostis et inimicus noster pessimus iste est Aman. Quod ille audiens, illico obstupuit, vultum regis ac reginæ ferre non sustinens.

verses.name: Esther 7:7
verses.text: Rex autem iratus surrexit, et de loco convivii intravit in hortum arboribus consitum. Aman quoque surrexit ut rogaret Esther reginam pro anima sua : intellexit enim a rege sibi paratum malum.

verses.name: Esther 7:8
verses.text: Qui cum reversus esset de horto nemoribus consito, et intrasset convivii locum, reperit Aman super lectulum corruisse in quo jacebat Esther, et ait : Etiam reginam vult opprimere, me præsente, in domo mea. Necdum verbum de ore regis exierat, et statim operuerunt faciem ejus.

verses.name: Esther 7:9
verses.text: Dixitque Harbona, unus de eunuchis, qui stabant in ministerio regis : En lignum quod paraverat Mardochæo, qui locutus est pro rege, stat in domo Aman, habens altitudinis quinquaginta cubitos. Cui dixit rex : Appendite eum in eo.

verses.name: Esther 7:10
verses.text: Suspensus est itaque Aman in patibulo quod paraverat Mardochæo : et regis ira quievit.  <chapter eID="Esth.7"/> <div eID="gen2406" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:1
verses.text: Die illo dedit rex Assuerus Esther reginæ domum Aman adversarii Judæorum, et Mardochæus ingressus est ante faciem regis. Confessa est enim ei Esther quod esset patruus suus.

verses.name: Esther 8:2
verses.text: Tulitque rex annulum, quem ab Aman recipi jusserat, et tradidit Mardochæo. Esther autem constituit Mardochæum super domum suam.

verses.name: Esther 8:3
verses.text: Nec his contenta, procidit ad pedes regis, flevitque, et locuta ad eum oravit ut malitiam Aman Agagitæ, et machinationes ejus pessimas quas excogitaverat contra Judæos, juberet irritas fieri.

verses.name: Esther 8:4
verses.text: At ille ex more sceptrum aureum protendit manu, quo signum clementiæ monstrabatur : illaque consurgens stetit ante eum,

verses.name: Esther 8:5
verses.text: et ait : Si placet regi, et si inveni gratiam in oculis ejus, et deprecatio mea non ei videtur esse contraria, obsecro ut novis epistolis, veteres Aman litteræ, insidiatoris et hostis Judæorum, quibus eos in cunctis regis provinciis perire præceperat, corrigantur.

verses.name: Esther 8:6
verses.text: Quomodo enim potero sustinere necem et interfectionem populi mei ?

verses.name: Esther 8:7
verses.text: Responditque rex Assuerus Esther reginæ, et Mardochæo Judæo : Domum Aman concessi Esther, et ipsum jussi affigi cruci, quia ausus est manum mittere in Judæos.

verses.name: Esther 8:8
verses.text: Scribite ergo Judæis, sicut vobis placet, regis nomine, signantes litteras annulo meo. Hæc enim consuetudo erat, ut epistolis, quæ ex regis nomine mittebantur et illius annulo signatæ erant, nemo auderet contradicere.

verses.name: Esther 8:9
verses.text: Accitisque scribis et librariis regis (erat autem tempus tertii mensis, qui appellatur Siban) vigesima et tertia die illius scriptæ sunt epistolæ, ut Mardochæus voluerat, ad Judæos, et ad principes, procuratoresque et judices, qui centum viginti septem provinciis ab India usque ad Æthiopiam præsidebant : provinciæ atque provinciæ, populo et populo juxta linguas et litteras suas, et Judæis, prout legere poterant et audire.  <div eID="gen2407" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1163"/><div sID="gen2408" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1163"/>Ipsæque epistolæ, quæ regis nomine mittebantur, annulo ipsius obsignatæ sunt, et missæ per veredarios : qui per omnes provincias discurrentes, veteres litteras novis nuntiis prævenirent.

verses.name: Esther 8:11
verses.text: Quibus imperavit rex, ut convenirent Judæos per singulas civitates, et in unum præciperent congregari ut starent pro animabus suis, et omnes inimicos suos cum conjugibus ac liberis et universis domibus, interficerent atque delerent, et spolia eorum diriperent.

verses.name: Esther 8:12
verses.text: Et constituta est per omnes provincias una ultionis dies, id est tertiadecima mensis duodecimi Adar.

verses.name: Esther 8:13
verses.text: Summaque epistolæ hæc fuit, ut in omnibus terris ac populis qui regis Assueri subjacebant imperio, notum fieret paratos esse Judæos ad capiendam vindictam de hostibus suis.

verses.name: Esther 8:14
verses.text: Egressique sunt veredarii celeres nuntia perferentes, et edictum regis pependit in Susan.

verses.name: Esther 8:15
verses.text: Mardochæus autem de palatio et de conspectu regis egrediens, fulgebat vestibus regiis, hyacinthinis videlicet et æriis, coronam auream portans in capite, et amictus serico pallio atque purpureo. Omnisque civitas exultavit atque lætata est.

verses.name: Esther 8:16
verses.text: Judæis autem nova lux oriri visa est, gaudium, honor, et tripudium.

verses.name: Esther 8:17
verses.text: Apud omnes populos, urbes, atque provincias, quocumque regis jussa veniebant, mira exultatio, epulæ atque convivia, et festus dies : in tantum ut plures alterius gentis et sectæ eorum religioni et cæremoniis jungerentur. Grandis enim cunctos judaici nominis terror invaserat.  <chapter eID="Esth.8"/> <div eID="gen2408" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:1
verses.text: Igitur duodecimi mensis, quem Adar vocari ante jam diximus, tertiadecima die, quando cunctis Judæis interfectio parabatur, et hostes eorum inhiabant sanguini, versa vice Judæi superiores esse cœperunt, et se de adversariis vindicare.

verses.name: Esther 9:2
verses.text: Congregatique sunt per singulas civitates, oppida, et loca, ut extenderent manum contra inimicos, et persecutores suos. Nullusque ausus est resistere, eo quod omnes populos magnitudinis eorum formido penetrarat.

verses.name: Esther 9:3
verses.text: Nam et provinciarum judices, et duces, et procuratores, omnisque dignitas quæ singulis locis ac operibus præerat, extollebant Judæos timore Mardochæi,

verses.name: Esther 9:4
verses.text: quem principem esse palatii, et plurimum posse cognoverant : fama quoque nominis ejus crescebat quotidie, et per cunctorum ora volitabat.

verses.name: Esther 9:5
verses.text: Itaque percusserunt Judæi inimicos suos plaga magna, et occiderunt eos, reddentes eis quod sibi paraverant facere :

verses.name: Esther 9:6
verses.text: in tantum ut etiam in Susan quingentos viros interficerent, extra decem filios Aman Agagitæ hostis Judæorum : quorum ista sunt nomina :

verses.name: Esther 9:7
verses.text: Pharsandatha, et Delphon, et Esphatha,

verses.name: Esther 9:8
verses.text: et Phoratha, et Adalia, et Aridatha,

verses.name: Esther 9:9
verses.text: et Phermesta, et Arisai, et Aridai, et Jezatha.

verses.name: Esther 9:10
verses.text: Quos cum occidissent, prædas de substantiis eorum tangere noluerunt.

verses.name: Esther 9:11
verses.text: Statimque numerus eorum, qui occisi erant in Susan, ad regem relatus est.

verses.name: Esther 9:12
verses.text: Qui dixit reginæ : In urbe Susan interfecerunt Judæi quingentos viros, et alios decem filios Aman : quantam putas eos exercere cædem in universis provinciis ? quid ultra postulas, et quid vis ut fieri jubeam ?

verses.name: Esther 9:13
verses.text: Cui illa respondit : Si regi placet, detur potestas Judæis, ut sicut fecerunt hodie in Susan, sic et cras faciant, et decem filii Aman in patibulis suspendantur.

verses.name: Esther 9:14
verses.text: Præcepitque rex ut ita fieret. Statimque in Susan pependit edictum, et decem filii Aman suspensi sunt.

verses.name: Esther 9:15
verses.text: Congregatis Judæis quartadecima die mensis Adar, interfecti sunt in Susan trecenti viri : nec eorum ab illis direpta substantia est.

verses.name: Esther 9:16
verses.text: Sed et per omnes provincias quæ ditioni regis subjacebant, pro animabus suis steterunt Judæi, interfectis hostibus ac persecutoribus suis : in tantum ut septuaginta quinque millia occisorum implerentur, et nullus de substantiis eorum quidquam contingeret.

verses.name: Esther 9:17
verses.text: Dies autem tertiusdecimus mensis Adar primus apud omnes interfectionis fuit, et quartadecima die cædere desierunt. Quem constituerunt esse solemnem, ut in eo omni tempore deinceps vacarent epulis, gaudio, atque conviviis.

verses.name: Esther 9:18
verses.text: At hi, qui in urbe Susan cædem exercuerant, tertiodecimo et quartodecimo die ejusdem mensis in cæde versati sunt : quintodecimo autem die percutere desierunt. Et idcirco eumdem diem constituerunt solemnem epularum atque lætitiæ.

verses.name: Esther 9:19
verses.text: Hi vero Judæi, qui in oppidis non muratis ac villis morabantur, quartumdecimum diem mensis Adar conviviorum et gaudii decreverunt, ita ut exultent in eo, et mittant sibi mutuo partes epularum et ciborum.  <div eID="gen2409" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1164"/><div sID="gen2410" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1164"/>Scripsit itaque Mardochæus omnia hæc, et litteris comprehensa misit ad Judæos qui in omnibus regis provinciis morabantur, tam in vicino positis, quam procul,

verses.name: Esther 9:21
verses.text: ut quartamdecimam et quintamdecimam diem mensis Adar pro festis susciperent, et revertente semper anno solemni celebrarent honore :

verses.name: Esther 9:22
verses.text: quia in ipsis diebus se ulti sunt Judæi de inimicis suis, et luctus atque tristitia in hilaritatem gaudiumque conversa sunt, essentque dies isti epularum atque lætitiæ, et mitterent sibi invicem ciborum partes, et pauperibus munuscula largirentur.

verses.name: Esther 9:23
verses.text: Susceperuntque Judæi in solemnem ritum cuncta quæ eo tempore facere cœperant, et quæ Mardochæus litteris facienda mandaverat.

verses.name: Esther 9:24
verses.text: Aman enim, filius Amadathi stirpis Agag, hostis et adversarius Judæorum, cogitavit contra eos malum, ut occideret illos atque deleret : et misit phur, quod nostra lingua vertitur in sortem.

verses.name: Esther 9:25
verses.text: Et postea ingressa est Esther ad regem, obsecrans ut conatus ejus litteris regis irriti fierent, et malum quod contra Judæos cogitaverat, reverteretur in caput ejus. Denique et ipsum et filios ejus affixerunt cruci,

verses.name: Esther 9:26
verses.text: atque ex illo tempore dies isti appellati sunt phurim, id est sortium : eo quod phur, id est sors, in urnam missa fuerit. Et cuncta quæ gesta sunt, epistolæ, id est, libri hujus volumine, continentur :

verses.name: Esther 9:27
verses.text: quæque sustinuerunt, et quæ deinceps immutata sunt, susceperunt Judæi super se et semen suum, et super cunctos qui religioni eorum voluerunt copulari, ut nulli liceat duos hos dies absque solemnitate transigere, quos scriptura testatur, et certa expetunt tempora, annis sibi jugiter succedentibus.

verses.name: Esther 9:28
verses.text: Isti sunt dies, quos nulla umquam delebit oblivio, et per singulas generationes cunctæ in toto orbe provinciæ celebrabunt : nec est ulla civitas, in qua dies phurim, id est sortium, non observentur a Judæis, et ab eorum progenie, quæ his cæremoniis obligata est.

verses.name: Esther 9:29
verses.text: Scripseruntque Esther regina filia Abihail, et Mardochæus Judæus, etiam secundam epistolam, ut omni studio dies ista solemnis sanciretur in posterum :

verses.name: Esther 9:30
verses.text: et miserunt ad omnes Judæos qui in centum viginti septem provinciis regis Assueri versabantur, ut haberent pacem, et susciperent veritatem,

verses.name: Esther 9:31
verses.text: observantes dies sortium, et suo tempore cum gaudio celebrarent : sicut constituerant Mardochæus et Esther, et illi observanda susceperunt a se, et a semine suo, jejunia, et clamores, et sortium dies,

verses.name: Esther 9:32
verses.text: et omnia quæ libri hujus, qui vocatur Esther, historia continentur.  <chapter eID="Esth.9"/> <div eID="gen2410" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 10:1
verses.text: Rex vero Assuerus omnem terram et cunctas maris insulas fecit tributarias :

verses.name: Esther 10:2
verses.text: cujus fortitudo et imperium, et dignitas atque sublimitas, qua exaltavit Mardochæum, scripta sunt in libris Medorum, atque Persarum :

verses.name: Esther 10:3
verses.text: et quomodo Mardochæus judaici generis secundus a rege Assuero fuerit, et magnus apud Judæos, et acceptabilis plebi fratrum suorum, quærens bona populo suo, et loquens ea quæ ad pacem seminis sui pertinerent.  <div eID="gen2411" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1165"/><div sID="gen2412" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1165"/>Dixitque Mardochæus : A Deo facta sunt ista.

verses.name: Esther 10:5
verses.text: Recordatus sum somnii quod videram, hæc eadem significantis : nec eorum quidquam irritum fuit.

verses.name: Esther 10:6
verses.text: Parvus fons, qui crevit in fluvium, et in lucem solemque conversus est, et in aquas plurimas redundavit : Esther est quam rex accepit uxorem, et voluit esse reginam.

verses.name: Esther 10:7
verses.text: Duo autem dracones : ego sum, et Aman.

verses.name: Esther 10:8
verses.text: Gentes, quæ convenerant : hi sunt, qui conati sunt delere nomen Judæorum.

verses.name: Esther 10:9
verses.text: Gens autem mea Israël est, quæ clamavit ad Dominum, et salvum fecit Dominus populum suum : liberavitque nos ab omnibus malis, et fecit signa magna atque portenta inter gentes :

verses.name: Esther 10:10
verses.text: et duas sortes esse præcepit, unam populi Dei, et alteram cunctarum gentium.

verses.name: Esther 10:11
verses.text: Venitque utraque sors in statutum ex illo jam tempore diem coram Deo universis gentibus :

verses.name: Esther 10:12
verses.text: et recordatus est Dominus populi sui, ac misertus est hæreditatis suæ.

verses.name: Esther 10:13
verses.text: Et observabuntur dies isti in mense Adar quartadecima et quintadecima die ejusdem mensis, cum omni studio et gaudio, in unum cœtum populi congregati, in cunctas deinceps generationes populi Israël.  <chapter eID="Esth.10"/> <div eID="gen2412" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 11:1
verses.text: Anno quarto regnantibus Ptolemæo et Cleopatra, attulerunt Dosithæus, qui se sacerdotem et Levitici generis ferebat, et Ptolemæus filius ejus, hanc epistolam phurim, quam dixerunt interpretatum esse Lysimachum Ptolemæi filium in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Esther 11:2
verses.text: Anno secundo, regnante Artaxerxe maximo, prima die mensis Nisan, vidit somnium Mardochæus filius Jairi, filii Semei, filii Cis, de tribu Benjamin :

verses.name: Esther 11:3
verses.text: homo Judæus, qui habitabat in urbe Susis, vir magnus, et inter primos aulæ regiæ.

verses.name: Esther 11:4
verses.text: Erat autem de eo numero captivorum, quos transtulerat Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis de Jerusalem cum Jechonia rege Juda.

verses.name: Esther 11:5
verses.text: Et hoc ejus somnium fuit : apparuerunt voces, et tumultus, et tonitrua, et terræmotus, et conturbatio super terram :

verses.name: Esther 11:6
verses.text: et ecce duo dracones magni, paratique contra se in prælium.

verses.name: Esther 11:7
verses.text: Ad quorum clamorem cunctæ concitatæ sunt nationes, ut pugnarent contra gentem justorum.

verses.name: Esther 11:8
verses.text: Fuitque dies illa tenebrarum et discriminis, tribulationis et angustiæ, et ingens formido super terram.

verses.name: Esther 11:9
verses.text: Conturbataque est gens justorum timentium mala sua, et præparata ad mortem.

verses.name: Esther 11:10
verses.text: Clamaveruntque ad Deum : et illis vociferantibus, fons parvus creavit in fluvium maximum, et in aquas plurimas redundavit.

verses.name: Esther 11:11
verses.text: Lux et sol ortus est, et humiles exaltati sunt, et devoraverunt inclytos.

verses.name: Esther 11:12
verses.text: Quod cum vidisset Mardochæus, et surrexisset de strato, cogitabat quid Deus facere vellet : et fixum habebat in animo, scire cupiens quid significaret somnium.  <chapter eID="Esth.11"/> <div eID="gen2413" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 12:1
verses.text: Morabatur autem eo tempore in aula regis cum Bagatha et Thara eunuchis regis, qui janitores erant palatii.

verses.name: Esther 12:2
verses.text: Cumque intellexisset cogitationes eorum, et curas diligentius pervidisset, didicit quod conarentur in regem Artaxerxem manus mittere, et nuntiavit super eo regi.

verses.name: Esther 12:3
verses.text: Qui de utroque, habita quæstione, confessos jussit duci ad mortem.

verses.name: Esther 12:4
verses.text: Rex autem quod gestum erat, scripsit in commentariis : sed et Mardochæus rei memoriam litteris tradidit.

verses.name: Esther 12:5
verses.text: Præcepitque ei rex, ut in aula palatii moraretur, datis ei pro delatione muneribus.

verses.name: Esther 12:6
verses.text: Aman vero filius Amadathi Bugæus erat gloriosissimus coram rege, et voluit nocere Mardochæo et populo ejus pro duobus eunuchis regis qui fuerant interfecti. Et diripuerunt bona, vel substantias eorum. Epistolæ autem hoc exemplar fuit.  <chapter eID="Esth.12"/> <div eID="gen2414" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 13:1
verses.text: Rex maximus Artaxerxes ab India usque Æthiopiam, centum viginti septem provinciarum principibus et ducibus qui ejus imperio subjecti sunt, salutem.

verses.name: Esther 13:2
verses.text: Cum plurimis gentibus imperarem, et universum orbem meæ ditioni subjugassem, volui nequaquam abuti potentiæ magnitudine, sed clementia et lenitate gubernare subjectos, ut absque ullo terrore vitam silentio transigentes, optata cunctis mortalibus pace fruerentur.

verses.name: Esther 13:3
verses.text: Quærente autem me a consiliariis meis quomodo posset hoc impleri, unus qui sapientia et fide ceteros præcellebat, et erat post regem secundus, Aman nomine,

verses.name: Esther 13:4
verses.text: indicavit mihi in toto orbe terrarum populum esse dispersum, qui novis uteretur legibus, et, contra omnium gentium consuetudinem faciens, regum jussa contemneret, et universarum concordiam nationum sua dissensione violaret.

verses.name: Esther 13:5
verses.text: Quod cum didicissemus, videntes unam gentem rebellem adversus omne hominum genus perversis uti legibus, nostrisque jussionibus contraire, et turbare subjectarum nobis provinciarum pacem atque concordiam,

verses.name: Esther 13:6
verses.text: jussimus ut quoscumque Aman, qui omnibus provinciis præpositus est et secundus a rege, et quem patris loco colimus, monstraverit, cum conjugibus ac liberis deleantur ab inimicis suis, nullusque eorum misereatur, quartadecima die duodecimi mensis Adar anni præsentis :

verses.name: Esther 13:7
verses.text: ut nefarii homines uno die ad inferos descendentes, reddant imperio nostro pacem, quam turbaverant. Pergensque Mardochæus, fecit omnia quæ ei mandaverat Esther.  <div eID="gen2415" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1166"/><div sID="gen2416" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1166"/>Mardochæus autem deprecatus est Dominum, memor omnium operum ejus,

verses.name: Esther 13:9
verses.text: et dixit : Domine, Domine rex omnipotens, in ditione enim tua cuncta sunt posita, et non est qui possit tuæ resistere voluntati, si decreveris salvare Israël.

verses.name: Esther 13:10
verses.text: Tu fecisti cælum et terram, et quidquid cæli ambitu continetur.

verses.name: Esther 13:11
verses.text: Dominus omnium es, nec est qui resistat majestati tuæ.

verses.name: Esther 13:12
verses.text: Cuncta nosti, et scis quia non pro superbia et contumelia, et aliqua gloriæ cupiditate, fecerim hoc, ut non adorarem Aman superbissimum

verses.name: Esther 13:13
verses.text: (libenter enim pro salute Israël etiam vestigia pedum ejus deosculari paratus essem),

verses.name: Esther 13:14
verses.text: sed timui ne honorem Dei mei transferrem ad hominem, et ne quemquam adorarem, excepto Deo meo.

verses.name: Esther 13:15
verses.text: Et nunc, Domine rex, Deus Abraham, miserere populi tui, quia volunt nos inimici nostri perdere, et hæreditatem tuam delere.

verses.name: Esther 13:16
verses.text: Ne despicias partem tuam, quam redemisti tibi de Ægypto.

verses.name: Esther 13:17
verses.text: Exaudi deprecationem meam, et propitius esto sorti et funiculo tuo, et converte luctum nostrum in gaudium, ut viventes laudemus nomen tuum, Domine : et ne claudas ora te canentium.

verses.name: Esther 13:18
verses.text: Omnis quoque Israël pari mente et obsecratione clamavit ad Dominum, eo quod eis certa mors impenderet.  <chapter eID="Esth.13"/> <div eID="gen2416" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 14:1
verses.text: Esther quoque regina confugit ad Dominum, pavens periculum quod imminebat.

verses.name: Esther 14:2
verses.text: Cumque deposuisset vestes regias, fletibus et luctui apta indumenta suscepit, et pro unguentis variis, cinere et stercore implevit caput, et corpus suum humiliavit jejuniis : omniaque loca, in quibus antea lætari consueverat, crinium laceratione complevit.

verses.name: Esther 14:3
verses.text: Et deprecabatur Dominum Deum Israël, dicens : Domine mi, qui rex noster es solus, adjuva me solitariam, et cujus præter te nullus est auxiliator alius.

verses.name: Esther 14:4
verses.text: Periculum meum in manibus meis est.

verses.name: Esther 14:5
verses.text: Audivi a patre meo quod tu, Domine, tulisses Israël de cunctis gentibus, et patres nostros ex omnibus retro majoribus suis, ut possideres hæreditatem sempiternam, fecistique eis sicut locutus es.

verses.name: Esther 14:6
verses.text: Peccavimus in conspectu tuo, et idcirco tradidisti nos in manus inimicorum nostrorum :

verses.name: Esther 14:7
verses.text: coluimus enim deos eorum. Justus es Domine :

verses.name: Esther 14:8
verses.text: et nunc non eis sufficit, quod durissima nos opprimunt servitute, sed robur manuum suarum, idolorum potentiæ deputantes,

verses.name: Esther 14:9
verses.text: volunt tua mutare promissa, et delere hæreditatem tuam, et claudere ora laudantium te, atque extinguere gloriam templi et altaris tui,

verses.name: Esther 14:10
verses.text: ut aperiant ora gentium, et laudent idolorum fortitudinem, et prædicent carnalem regem in sempiternum.

verses.name: Esther 14:11
verses.text: Ne tradas, Domine, sceptrum tuum his, qui non sunt, ne rideant ad ruinam nostram : sed converte consilium eorum super eos, et eum qui in nos cœpit sævire, disperde.

verses.name: Esther 14:12
verses.text: Memento, Domine, et ostende te nobis in tempore tribulationis nostræ, et da mihi fiduciam, Domine rex deorum, et universæ potestatis :

verses.name: Esther 14:13
verses.text: tribue sermonem compositum in ore meo in conspectu leonis, et transfer cor illius in odium hostis nostri, ut et ipse pereat, et ceteri qui ei consentiunt.

verses.name: Esther 14:14
verses.text: Nos autem libera manu tua, et adjuva me, nullum aliud auxilium habentem nisi te, Domine, qui habes omnium scientiam,

verses.name: Esther 14:15
verses.text: et nosti quia oderim gloriam iniquorum, et detester cubile incircumcisorum, et omnis alienigenæ.

verses.name: Esther 14:16
verses.text: Tu scis necessitatem meam, quod abominer signum superbiæ et gloriæ meæ, quod est super caput meum in diebus ostentationis meæ, et detester illud quasi pannum menstruatæ, et non portem in diebus silentii mei,

verses.name: Esther 14:17
verses.text: et quod non comederim in mensa Aman, nec mihi placuerit convivium regis, et non biberim vinum libaminum :

verses.name: Esther 14:18
verses.text: et numquam lætata sit ancilla tua, ex quo huc translata sum usque in præsentem diem, nisi in te, Domine Deus Abraham.

verses.name: Esther 14:19
verses.text: Deus fortis super omnes, exaudi vocem eorum qui nullam aliam spem habent, et libera nos de manu iniquorum, et erue me a timore meo.  <chapter eID="Esth.14"/> <div eID="gen2417" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 15:1
verses.text: Et mandavit ei (haud dubium quin esset Mardochæus) ut ingrederetur ad regem, et rogaret pro populo suo et pro patria sua.

verses.name: Esther 15:2
verses.text: Memorare, inquit, dierum humilitatis tuæ, quomodo nutrita sis in manu mea, quia Aman secundus a rege locutus est contra nos in mortem :

verses.name: Esther 15:3
verses.text: et tu invoca Dominum, et loquere regi pro nobis, et libera nos de morte.  <div eID="gen2418" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1167"/><div sID="gen2419" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1167"/>Die autem tertio deposuit vestimenta ornatus sui, et circumdata est gloria sua.

verses.name: Esther 15:5
verses.text: Cumque regio fulgeret habitu, et invocasset omnium rectorem et salvatorem Deum, assumpsit duas famulas,

verses.name: Esther 15:6
verses.text: et super unam quidem innitebatur, quasi præ deliciis et nimia teneritudine corpus suum ferre non sustinens :

verses.name: Esther 15:7
verses.text: altera autem famularum sequebatur dominam, defluentia in humum indumenta sustentans.

verses.name: Esther 15:8
verses.text: Ipsa autem roseo colore vultum perfusa, et gratis ac nitentibus oculis, tristem celabat animum, et nimio timore contractum.

verses.name: Esther 15:9
verses.text: Ingressa igitur cuncta per ordinem ostia, stetit contra regem, ubi ille residebat super solium regni sui, indutus vestibus regiis, auroque fulgens, et pretiosis lapidibus : eratque terribilis aspectu.

verses.name: Esther 15:10
verses.text: Cumque elevasset faciem, et ardentibus oculis furorem pectoris indicasset, regina corruit, et in pallorem colore mutato, lassum super ancillulam reclinavit caput.

verses.name: Esther 15:11
verses.text: Convertitque Deus spiritum regis in mansuetudinem, et festinus ac metuens exilivit de solio, et sustentans eam ulnis suis donec rediret ad se, his verbis blandiebatur :

verses.name: Esther 15:12
verses.text: Quid habes, Esther ? ego sum frater tuus : noli metuere.

verses.name: Esther 15:13
verses.text: Non morieris : non enim pro te, sed pro omnibus hæc lex constituta est.

verses.name: Esther 15:14
verses.text: Accede igitur, et tange sceptrum.

verses.name: Esther 15:15
verses.text: Cumque illa reticeret, tulit auream virgam, et posuit super collum ejus, et osculatus est eam, et ait : Cur mihi non loqueris ?

verses.name: Esther 15:16
verses.text: Quæ respondit : Vidi te, domine, quasi angelum Dei, et conturbatum est cor meum præ timore gloriæ tuæ.

verses.name: Esther 15:17
verses.text: Valde enim mirabilis es, domine, et facies tua plena est gratiarum.

verses.name: Esther 15:18
verses.text: Cumque loqueretur, rursus corruit, et pene exanimata est.

verses.name: Esther 15:19
verses.text: Rex autem turbabatur, et omnes ministri ejus consolabantur eam.  <chapter eID="Esth.15"/> <div eID="gen2419" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 16:1
verses.text: Rex magnus Artaxerxes ab India usque Æthiopiam, centum viginti septem provinciarum ducibus ac principibus qui nostræ jussioni obediunt, salutem dicit.

verses.name: Esther 16:2
verses.text: Multi bonitate principum et honore, qui in eos collatus est, abusi sunt in superbiam :

verses.name: Esther 16:3
verses.text: et non solum subjectos regibus nituntur opprimere, sed datam sibi gloriam non ferentes, in ipsos qui dederunt, moliuntur insidias.

verses.name: Esther 16:4
verses.text: Nec contenti sunt gratias non agere beneficiis, et humanitatis in se jura violare, sed Dei quoque cuncta cernentis arbitrantur se posse fugere sententiam.

verses.name: Esther 16:5
verses.text: Et in tantum vesaniæ proruperunt, ut eos qui credita sibi officia diligenter observant, et ita cuncta agunt ut omnium laude digni sint, mendaciorum cuniculis conentur subvertere,

verses.name: Esther 16:6
verses.text: dum aures principum simplices, et ex sua natura alios æstimantes, callida fraude decipiunt.

verses.name: Esther 16:7
verses.text: Quæ res et ex veteribus probatur historiis, et ex his quæ geruntur quotidie, quomodo malis quorumdam suggestionibus regum studia depraventur.

verses.name: Esther 16:8
verses.text: Unde providendum est paci omnium provinciarum.

verses.name: Esther 16:9
verses.text: Nec putare debetis, si diversa jubeamus, ex animi nostri venire levitate, sed pro qualitate et necessitate temporum, ut reipublicæ poscit utilitas, ferre sententiam.  <div eID="gen2420" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Esther 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1168"/><div sID="gen2421" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1168"/>Et ut manifestius quod dicimus intelligatis, Aman filius Amadathi, et animo et gente Macedo, alienusque a Persarum sanguine, et pietatem nostram sua crudelitate commaculans, peregrinus a nobis susceptus est :

verses.name: Esther 16:11
verses.text: et tantam in se expertus humanitatem, ut pater noster vocaretur, et adoraretur ab omnibus post regem secundus :

verses.name: Esther 16:12
verses.text: qui in tantum arrogantiæ tumorem sublatus est, ut regno privare nos niteretur et spiritu.

verses.name: Esther 16:13
verses.text: Nam Mardochæum, cujus fide et beneficiis vivimus, et consortem regni nostri Esther cum omni gente sua, novis quibusdam atque inauditis machinis expetivit in mortem :

verses.name: Esther 16:14
verses.text: hoc cogitans ut illis interfectis, insidiaretur nostræ solitudini, et regnum Persarum transferret in Macedonas.

verses.name: Esther 16:15
verses.text: Nos autem a pessimo mortalium Judæos neci destinatos, in nulla penitus culpa reperimus, sed e contrario justis utentes legibus,

verses.name: Esther 16:16
verses.text: et filios altissimi et maximi semperque viventis Dei, cujus beneficio et patribus nostris et nobis regnum est traditum, et usque hodie custoditur.

verses.name: Esther 16:17
verses.text: Unde eas litteras, quas sub nomine nostro ille direxerat, sciatis esse irritas.

verses.name: Esther 16:18
verses.text: Pro quo scelere ante portas hujus urbis, id est, Susan, et ipse qui machinatus est, et omnis cognatio ejus pendet in patibulis : non nobis, sed Deo reddente ei quod meruit.

verses.name: Esther 16:19
verses.text: Hoc autem edictum, quod nunc mittimus, in cunctis urbibus proponatur, ut liceat Judæis uti legibus suis.

verses.name: Esther 16:20
verses.text: Quibus debetis esse adminiculo, ut eos qui se ad necem eorum paraverant, possint interficere tertiadecima die mensis duodecimi, qui vocatur Adar.

verses.name: Esther 16:21
verses.text: Hanc enim diem, Deus omnipotens, mœroris et luctus, eis vertit in gaudium.

verses.name: Esther 16:22
verses.text: Unde et vos inter ceteros festos dies, hanc habetote diem, et celebrate eam cum omni lætitia, ut et in posterum cognoscatur,

verses.name: Esther 16:23
verses.text: omnes qui fideliter Persis obediunt, dignam pro fide recipere mercedem ; qui autem insidiantur regno eorum, perire pro scelere.

verses.name: Esther 16:24
verses.text: Omnis autem provincia et civitas quæ noluerit solemnitatis hujus esse particeps, gladio et igne pereat, et sic deleatur, ut non solum hominibus, sed etiam bestiis invia sit in sempiternum, pro exemplo contemptus et inobedientiæ.  <div eID="gen2421" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="Esth.16"/> <div eID="gen2393" osisID="Esth" type="book"/>

verses.name: Job 1:1
verses.text: Vir erat in terra Hus, nomine Job : et erat vir ille simplex, et rectus, ac timens Deum, et recedens a malo.

verses.name: Job 1:2
verses.text: Natique sunt ei septem filii, et tres filiæ.

verses.name: Job 1:3
verses.text: Et fuit possessio ejus septem millia ovium, et tria millia camelorum, quingenta quoque juga boum, et quingentæ asinæ, ac familia multa nimis : eratque vir ille magnus inter omnes orientales.

verses.name: Job 1:4
verses.text: Et ibant filii ejus, et faciebant convivium per domos, unusquisque in die suo. Et mittentes vocabant tres sorores suas, ut comederent et biberent cum eis.

verses.name: Job 1:5
verses.text: Cumque in orbem transissent dies convivii, mittebat ad eos Job, et sanctificabat illos : consurgensque diluculo, offerebat holocausta pro singulis. Dicebat enim : Ne forte peccaverint filii mei, et benedixerint Deo in cordibus suis. Sic faciebat Job cunctis diebus.  <div eID="gen2423" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1169"/><div sID="gen2424" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1169"/>Quadam autem die, cum venissent filii Dei ut assisterent coram Domino, affuit inter eos etiam Satan.

verses.name: Job 1:7
verses.text: Cui dixit Dominus : Unde venis ? Qui respondens, ait : Circuivi terram, et perambulavi eam.

verses.name: Job 1:8
verses.text: Dixitque Dominus ad eum : Numquid considerasti servum meum Job, quod non sit ei similis in terra, homo simplex et rectus, ac timens Deum, et recedens a malo ?

verses.name: Job 1:9
verses.text: Cui respondens Satan, ait : Numquid Job frustra timet Deum ?

verses.name: Job 1:10
verses.text: nonne tu vallasti eum, ac domum ejus, universamque substantiam per circuitum ; operibus manuum ejus benedixisti, et possessio ejus crevit in terra ?

verses.name: Job 1:11
verses.text: sed extende paululum manum tuam et tange cuncta quæ possidet, nisi in faciem benedixerit tibi.

verses.name: Job 1:12
verses.text: Dixit ergo Dominus ad Satan : Ecce universa quæ habet in manu tua sunt : tantum in eum ne extendas manum tuam. Egressusque est Satan a facie Domini.

verses.name: Job 1:13
verses.text: Cum autem quadam die filii et filiæ ejus comederent et biberent vinum in domo fratris sui primogeniti,

verses.name: Job 1:14
verses.text: nuntius venit ad Job, qui diceret : Boves arabant, et asinæ pascebantur juxta eos :

verses.name: Job 1:15
verses.text: et irruerunt Sabæi, tuleruntque omnia, et pueros percusserunt gladio : et evasi ego solus, ut nuntiarem tibi.

verses.name: Job 1:16
verses.text: Cumque adhuc ille loqueretur, venit alter, et dixit : Ignis Dei cecidit e cælo, et tactas oves puerosque consumpsit : et effugi ego solus, ut nuntiarem tibi.

verses.name: Job 1:17
verses.text: Sed et illo adhuc loquente, venit alius, et dixit : Chaldæi fecerunt tres turmas, et invaserunt camelos, et tulerunt eos, necnon et pueros percusserunt gladio : et ego fugi solus, ut nuntiarem tibi.

verses.name: Job 1:18
verses.text: Adhuc loquebatur ille, et ecce alius intravit, et dixit : Filiis tuis et filiabus vescentibus et bibentibus vinum in domo fratris sui primogeniti,

verses.name: Job 1:19
verses.text: repente ventus vehemens irruit a regione deserti, et concussit quatuor angulos domus : quæ corruens oppressit liberos tuos, et mortui sunt : et effugi ego solus, ut nuntiarem tibi.

verses.name: Job 1:20
verses.text: Tunc surrexit Job, et scidit vestimenta sua : et tonso capite corruens in terram, adoravit,

verses.name: Job 1:21
verses.text: et dixit : Nudus egressus sum de utero matris meæ, et nudus revertar illuc. Dominus dedit, Dominus abstulit ; sicut Domino placuit, ita factum est. Sit nomen Domini benedictum.

verses.name: Job 1:22
verses.text: In omnibus his non peccavit Job labiis suis, neque stultum quid contra Deum locutus est.  <chapter eID="Job.1"/> <div eID="gen2424" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 2:1
verses.text: Factum est autem, cum quadam die venissent filii Dei, et starent coram Domino, venisset quoque Satan inter eos, et staret in conspectu ejus,

verses.name: Job 2:2
verses.text: ut diceret Dominus ad Satan : Unde venis ? Qui respondens ait : Circuivi terram, et perambulavi eam.

verses.name: Job 2:3
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad Satan : Numquid considerasti servum meum Job, quod non sit ei similis in terra, vir simplex et rectus, ac timens Deum, et recedens a malo, et adhuc retinens innocentiam ? tu autem commovisti me adversus eum, ut affligerem eum frustra.

verses.name: Job 2:4
verses.text: Cui respondens Satan, ait : Pellem pro pelle, et cuncta quæ habet homo dabit pro anima sua ;

verses.name: Job 2:5
verses.text: alioquin mitte manum tuam, et tange os ejus et carnem, et tunc videbis quod in faciem benedicat tibi.

verses.name: Job 2:6
verses.text: Dixit ergo Dominus ad Satan : Ecce in manu tua est : verumtamen animam illius serva.

verses.name: Job 2:7
verses.text: Egressus igitur Satan a facie Domini, percussit Job ulcere pessimo, a planta pedis usque ad verticem ejus ;

verses.name: Job 2:8
verses.text: qui testa saniem radebat, sedens in sterquilinio.

verses.name: Job 2:9
verses.text: Dixit autem illi uxor sua : Adhuc tu permanes in simplicitate tua ? Benedic Deo, et morere.

verses.name: Job 2:10
verses.text: Qui ait ad illam : Quasi una de stultis mulieribus locuta es : si bona suscepimus de manu Dei, mala quare non suscipiamus ? In omnibus his non peccavit Job labiis suis.  <div eID="gen2425" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1170"/><div sID="gen2426" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1170"/>Igitur audientes tres amici Job omne malum quod accidisset ei, venerunt singuli de loco suo, Eliphaz Themanites, et Baldad Suhites, et Sophar Naamathites. Condixerant enim ut pariter venientes visitarent eum, et consolarentur.

verses.name: Job 2:12
verses.text: Cumque elevassent procul oculos suos, non cognoverunt eum, et exclamantes ploraverunt, scissisque vestibus sparserunt pulverem super caput suum in cælum.

verses.name: Job 2:13
verses.text: Et sederunt cum eo in terra septem diebus et septem noctibus : et nemo loquebatur ei verbum : videbant enim dolorem esse vehementem.  <chapter eID="Job.2"/> <div eID="gen2426" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 3:1
verses.text: Post hæc aperuit Job os suum, et maledixit diei suo,

verses.name: Job 3:2
verses.text: et locutus est :  <div eID="gen2427" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1171"/><lg sID="gen2428"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1171"/>Pereat dies in qua natus sum, <l eID="gen2429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2430"/>et nox in qua dictum est : Conceptus est homo. <l eID="gen2430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1172"/><l level="1" sID="gen2431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1172"/>Dies ille vertatur in tenebras : <l eID="gen2431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2432"/>non requirat eum Deus desuper, <l eID="gen2432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2433"/>et non illustretur lumine. <l eID="gen2433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1173"/><l level="1" sID="gen2434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1173"/>Obscurent eum tenebræ et umbra mortis ; <l eID="gen2434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2435"/>occupet eum caligo, <l eID="gen2435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2436"/>et involvatur amaritudine. <l eID="gen2436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1174"/><l level="1" sID="gen2437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1174"/>Noctem illam tenebrosus turbo possideat ; <l eID="gen2437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2438"/>non computetur in diebus anni, <l eID="gen2438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2439"/>nec numeretur in mensibus. <l eID="gen2439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1175"/><l level="1" sID="gen2440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1175"/>Sit nox illa solitaria, <l eID="gen2440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2441"/>nec laude digna. <l eID="gen2441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1176"/><l level="1" sID="gen2442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1176"/>Maledicant ei qui maledicunt diei, <l eID="gen2442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2443"/>qui parati sunt suscitare Leviathan. <l eID="gen2443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1177"/><l level="1" sID="gen2444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1177"/>Obtenebrentur stellæ caligine ejus ; <l eID="gen2444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2445"/>expectet lucem, et non videat, <l eID="gen2445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2446"/>nec ortum surgentis auroræ. <l eID="gen2446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1178"/><l level="1" sID="gen2447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1178"/>Quia non conclusit ostia ventris qui portavit me, <l eID="gen2447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2448"/>nec abstulit mala ab oculis meis. <l eID="gen2448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1179"/><l level="1" sID="gen2449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1179"/>Quare non in vulva mortuus sum ? <l eID="gen2449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2450"/>egressus ex utero non statim perii ? <l eID="gen2450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1180"/><l level="1" sID="gen2451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1180"/>Quare exceptus genibus ? <l eID="gen2451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2452"/>cur lactatus uberibus ? <l eID="gen2452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1181"/><l level="1" sID="gen2453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1181"/>Nunc enim dormiens silerem, <l eID="gen2453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2454"/>et somno meo requiescerem <l eID="gen2454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1182"/><l level="1" sID="gen2455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1182"/>cum regibus et consulibus terræ, <l eID="gen2455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2456"/>qui ædificant sibi solitudines ; <l eID="gen2456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1183"/><l level="1" sID="gen2457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1183"/>aut cum principibus qui possident aurum, <l eID="gen2457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2458"/>et replent domos suas argento ; <l eID="gen2458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1184"/><l level="1" sID="gen2459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1184"/>aut sicut abortivum absconditum non subsisterem, <l eID="gen2459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2460"/>vel qui concepti non viderunt lucem. <l eID="gen2460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1185"/><l level="1" sID="gen2461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1185"/>Ibi impii cessaverunt a tumultu, <l eID="gen2461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2462"/>et ibi requieverunt fessi robore. <l eID="gen2462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1186"/><l level="1" sID="gen2463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1186"/>Et quondam vincti pariter sine molestia, <l eID="gen2463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2464"/>non audierunt vocem exactoris. <l eID="gen2464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1187"/><l level="1" sID="gen2465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1187"/>Parvus et magnus ibi sunt, <l eID="gen2465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2466"/>et servus liber a domino suo. <l eID="gen2466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1188"/><l level="1" sID="gen2467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1188"/>Quare misero data est lux, <l eID="gen2467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2468"/>et vita his qui in amaritudine animæ sunt : <l eID="gen2468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1189"/><l level="1" sID="gen2469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1189"/>qui expectant mortem, et non venit, <l eID="gen2469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2470"/>quasi effodientes thesaurum ; <l eID="gen2470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1190"/><l level="1" sID="gen2471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1190"/>gaudentque vehementer <l eID="gen2471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2472"/>cum invenerint sepulchrum ? <l eID="gen2472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1191"/><l level="1" sID="gen2473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1191"/>viro cujus abscondita est via <l eID="gen2473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2474"/>et circumdedit eum Deus tenebris ? <l eID="gen2474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1192"/><l level="1" sID="gen2475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1192"/>Antequam comedam, suspiro ; <l eID="gen2475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2476"/>et tamquam inundantes aquæ, sic rugitus meus : <l eID="gen2476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1193"/><l level="1" sID="gen2477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1193"/>quia timor quem timebam evenit mihi, <l eID="gen2477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2478"/>et quod verebar accidit. <l eID="gen2478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1194"/><l level="1" sID="gen2479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1194"/>Nonne dissimulavi ? nonne silui ? nonne quievi ? <l eID="gen2479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2480"/>et venit super me indignatio. <l eID="gen2480" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2428"/> <chapter eID="Job.3"/>

verses.name: Job 4:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Eliphaz Themanites, dixit :  <div eID="gen2481" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1195"/><lg sID="gen2482"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1195"/>Si cœperimus loqui tibi, forsitan moleste accipies ; <l eID="gen2483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2484"/>sed conceptum sermonem tenere quis poterit ? <l eID="gen2484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1196"/><l level="1" sID="gen2485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1196"/>Ecce docuisti multos, <l eID="gen2485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2486"/>et manus lassas roborasti ; <l eID="gen2486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1197"/><l level="1" sID="gen2487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1197"/>vacillantes confirmaverunt sermones tui, <l eID="gen2487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2488"/>et genua trementia confortasti. <l eID="gen2488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1198"/><l level="1" sID="gen2489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1198"/>Nunc autem venit super te plaga, et defecisti ; <l eID="gen2489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2490"/>tetigit te, et conturbatus es. <l eID="gen2490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1199"/><l level="1" sID="gen2491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1199"/>Ubi est timor tuus, fortitudo tua, <l eID="gen2491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2492"/>patientia tua, et perfectio viarum tuarum ? <l eID="gen2492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1200"/><l level="1" sID="gen2493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1200"/>Recordare, obsecro te, quis umquam innocens periit ? <l eID="gen2493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2494"/>aut quando recti deleti sunt ? <l eID="gen2494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1201"/><l level="1" sID="gen2495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1201"/>Quin potius vidi eos qui operantur iniquitatem, <l eID="gen2495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2496"/>et seminant dolores, et metunt eos, <l eID="gen2496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1202"/><l level="1" sID="gen2497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1202"/>flante Deo perisse, <l eID="gen2497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2498"/>et spiritu iræ ejus esse consumptos. <l eID="gen2498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1203"/><l level="1" sID="gen2499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1203"/>Rugitus leonis, et vox leænæ, <l eID="gen2499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2500"/>et dentes catulorum leonum contriti sunt. <l eID="gen2500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1204"/><l level="1" sID="gen2501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1204"/>Tigris periit, eo quod non haberet prædam, <l eID="gen2501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2502"/>et catuli leonis dissipati sunt. <l eID="gen2502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1205"/><l level="1" sID="gen2503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1205"/>Porro ad me dictum est verbum absconditum, <l eID="gen2503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2504"/>et quasi furtive suscepit auris mea venas susurri ejus. <l eID="gen2504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1206"/><l level="1" sID="gen2505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1206"/>In horrore visionis nocturnæ, <l eID="gen2505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2506"/>quando solet sopor occupare homines, <l eID="gen2506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1207"/><l level="1" sID="gen2507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1207"/>pavor tenuit me, et tremor, <l eID="gen2507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2508"/>et omnia ossa mea perterrita sunt ; <l eID="gen2508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1208"/><l level="1" sID="gen2509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1208"/>et cum spiritus, me præsente, transiret, <l eID="gen2509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2510"/>inhorruerunt pili carnis meæ. <l eID="gen2510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1209"/><l level="1" sID="gen2511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1209"/>Stetit quidam, cujus non agnoscebam vultum, <l eID="gen2511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2512"/>imago coram oculis meis, <l eID="gen2512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2513"/>et vocem quasi auræ lenis audivi. <l eID="gen2513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1210"/><l level="1" sID="gen2514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1210"/>Numquid homo, Dei comparatione, justificabitur ? <l eID="gen2514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2515"/>aut factore suo purior erit vir ? <l eID="gen2515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1211"/><l level="1" sID="gen2516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1211"/>Ecce qui serviunt ei, non sunt stabiles, <l eID="gen2516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2517"/>et in angelis suis reperit pravitatem ; <l eID="gen2517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1212"/><l level="1" sID="gen2518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1212"/>quanto magis hi qui habitant domos luteas, <l eID="gen2518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2519"/>qui terrenum habent fundamentum, <l eID="gen2519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2520"/>consumentur velut a tinea ? <l eID="gen2520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1213"/><l level="1" sID="gen2521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1213"/>De mane usque ad vesperam succidentur ; <l eID="gen2521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2522"/>et quia nullus intelligit, in æternum peribunt. <l eID="gen2522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1214"/><l level="1" sID="gen2523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1214"/>Qui autem reliqui fuerint, auferentur ex eis ; <l eID="gen2523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2524"/>morientur, et non in sapientia.  <chapter eID="Job.4"/>

verses.name: Job 5:1
verses.text: Voca ergo, si est qui tibi respondeat, <l eID="gen2525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2526"/>et ad aliquem sanctorum convertere. <l eID="gen2526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1215"/><l level="1" sID="gen2527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1215"/>Vere stultum interficit iracundia, <l eID="gen2527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2528"/>et parvulum occidit invidia. <l eID="gen2528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1216"/><l level="1" sID="gen2529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1216"/>Ego vidi stultum firma radice, <l eID="gen2529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2530"/>et maledixi pulchritudini ejus statim. <l eID="gen2530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1217"/><l level="1" sID="gen2531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1217"/>Longe fient filii ejus a salute, <l eID="gen2531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2532"/>et conterentur in porta, <l eID="gen2532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2533"/>et non erit qui eruat. <l eID="gen2533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1218"/><l level="1" sID="gen2534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1218"/>Cujus messem famelicus comedet, <l eID="gen2534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2535"/>et ipsum rapiet armatus, <l eID="gen2535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2536"/>et bibent sitientes divitias ejus. <l eID="gen2536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1219"/><l level="1" sID="gen2537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1219"/>Nihil in terra sine causa fit, <l eID="gen2537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2538"/>et de humo non oritur dolor. <l eID="gen2538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1220"/><l level="1" sID="gen2539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1220"/>Homo nascitur ad laborem, <l eID="gen2539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2540"/>et avis ad volatum. <l eID="gen2540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1221"/><l level="1" sID="gen2541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1221"/>Quam ob rem ego deprecabor Dominum, <l eID="gen2541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2542"/>et ad Deum ponam eloquium meum : <l eID="gen2542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1222"/><l level="1" sID="gen2543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1222"/>qui facit magna et inscrutabilia, <l eID="gen2543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2544"/>et mirabilia absque numero ; <l eID="gen2544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1223"/><l level="1" sID="gen2545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1223"/>qui dat pluviam super faciem terræ, <l eID="gen2545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2546"/>et irrigat aquis universa ; <l eID="gen2546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1224"/><l level="1" sID="gen2547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1224"/>qui ponit humiles in sublime, <l eID="gen2547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2548"/>et mœrentes erigit sospitate ; <l eID="gen2548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1225"/><l level="1" sID="gen2549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1225"/>qui dissipat cogitationes malignorum, <l eID="gen2549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2550"/>ne possint implere manus eorum quod cœperant ; <l eID="gen2550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1226"/><l level="1" sID="gen2551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1226"/>qui apprehendit sapientes in astutia eorum, <l eID="gen2551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2552"/>et consilium pravorum dissipat. <l eID="gen2552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1227"/><l level="1" sID="gen2553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1227"/>Per diem incurrent tenebras, <l eID="gen2553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2554"/>et quasi in nocte, sic palpabunt in meridie. <l eID="gen2554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1228"/><l level="1" sID="gen2555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1228"/>Porro salvum faciet egenum a gladio oris eorum, <l eID="gen2555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2556"/>et de manu violenti pauperem. <l eID="gen2556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1229"/><l level="1" sID="gen2557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1229"/>Et erit egeno spes ; <l eID="gen2557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2558"/>iniquitas autem contrahet os suum. <l eID="gen2558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1230"/><l level="1" sID="gen2559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1230"/>Beatus homo qui corripitur a Deo : <l eID="gen2559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2560"/>increpationem ergo Domini ne reprobes : <l eID="gen2560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1231"/><l level="1" sID="gen2561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1231"/>quia ipse vulnerat, et medetur ; <l eID="gen2561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2562"/>percutit, et manus ejus sanabunt. <l eID="gen2562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1232"/><l level="1" sID="gen2563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1232"/>In sex tribulationibus liberabit te, <l eID="gen2563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2564"/>et in septima non tanget te malum. <l eID="gen2564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1233"/><l level="1" sID="gen2565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1233"/>In fame eruet te de morte, <l eID="gen2565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2566"/>et in bello de manu gladii. <l eID="gen2566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1234"/><l level="1" sID="gen2567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1234"/>A flagello linguæ absconderis, <l eID="gen2567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2568"/>et non timebis calamitatem cum venerit. <l eID="gen2568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1235"/><l level="1" sID="gen2569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1235"/>In vastitate et fame ridebis, <l eID="gen2569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2570"/>et bestias terræ non formidabis. <l eID="gen2570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1236"/><l level="1" sID="gen2571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1236"/>Sed cum lapidibus regionum pactum tuum, <l eID="gen2571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2572"/>et bestiæ terræ pacificæ erunt tibi. <l eID="gen2572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1237"/><l level="1" sID="gen2573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1237"/>Et scies quod pacem habeat tabernaculum tuum ; <l eID="gen2573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2574"/>et visitans speciem tuam, non peccabis. <l eID="gen2574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1238"/><l level="1" sID="gen2575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1238"/>Scies quoque quoniam multiplex erit semen tuum, <l eID="gen2575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2576"/>et progenies tua quasi herba terræ. <l eID="gen2576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1239"/><l level="1" sID="gen2577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1239"/>Ingredieris in abundantia sepulchrum, <l eID="gen2577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2578"/>sicut infertur acervus tritici in tempore suo. <l eID="gen2578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1240"/><l level="1" sID="gen2579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1240"/>Ecce hoc, ut investigavimus, ita est : <l eID="gen2579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2580"/>quod auditum, mente pertracta. <l eID="gen2580" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2482"/> <chapter eID="Job.5"/>

verses.name: Job 6:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Job, dixit :  <div eID="gen2581" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1241"/><lg sID="gen2582"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1241"/>Utinam appenderentur peccata mea quibus iram merui, <l eID="gen2583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2584"/>et calamitas quam patior, in statera ! <l eID="gen2584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1242"/><l level="1" sID="gen2585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1242"/>Quasi arena maris hæc gravior appareret ; <l eID="gen2585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2586"/>unde et verba mea dolore sunt plena : <l eID="gen2586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1243"/><l level="1" sID="gen2587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1243"/>quia sagittæ Domini in me sunt, <l eID="gen2587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2588"/>quarum indignatio ebibit spiritum meum ; <l eID="gen2588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2589"/>et terrores Domini militant contra me. <l eID="gen2589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1244"/><l level="1" sID="gen2590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1244"/>Numquid rugiet onager cum habuerit herbam ? <l eID="gen2590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2591"/>aut mugiet bos cum ante præsepe plenum steterit ? <l eID="gen2591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1245"/><l level="1" sID="gen2592"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1245"/>aut poterit comedi insulsum, quod non est sale conditum ? <l eID="gen2592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2593"/>aut potest aliquis gustare quod gustatum affert mortem ? <l eID="gen2593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1246"/><l level="1" sID="gen2594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1246"/>Quæ prius nolebat tangere anima mea, <l eID="gen2594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2595"/>nunc, præ angustia, cibi mei sunt. <l eID="gen2595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1247"/><l level="1" sID="gen2596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1247"/>Quis det ut veniat petitio mea, <l eID="gen2596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2597"/>et quod expecto tribuat mihi Deus ? <l eID="gen2597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1248"/><l level="1" sID="gen2598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1248"/>et qui cœpit, ipse me conterat ; <l eID="gen2598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2599"/>solvat manum suam, et succidat me ? <l eID="gen2599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1249"/><l level="1" sID="gen2600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1249"/>Et hæc mihi sit consolatio, ut affligens me dolore, non parcat, <l eID="gen2600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2601"/>nec contradicam sermonibus Sancti. <l eID="gen2601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1250"/><l level="1" sID="gen2602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1250"/>Quæ est enim fortitudo mea, ut sustineam ? <l eID="gen2602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2603"/>aut quis finis meus, ut patienter agam ? <l eID="gen2603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1251"/><l level="1" sID="gen2604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1251"/>Nec fortitudo lapidum fortitudo mea, <l eID="gen2604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2605"/>nec caro mea ænea est. <l eID="gen2605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1252"/><l level="1" sID="gen2606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1252"/>Ecce non est auxilium mihi in me, <l eID="gen2606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2607"/>et necessarii quoque mei recesserunt a me. <l eID="gen2607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1253"/><l level="1" sID="gen2608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1253"/>Qui tollit ab amico suo misericordiam, <l eID="gen2608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2609"/>timorem Domini derelinquit. <l eID="gen2609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1254"/><l level="1" sID="gen2610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1254"/>Fratres mei præterierunt me, <l eID="gen2610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2611"/>sicut torrens qui raptim transit in convallibus. <l eID="gen2611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1255"/><l level="1" sID="gen2612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1255"/>Qui timent pruinam, <l eID="gen2612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2613"/>irruet super eos nix. <l eID="gen2613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1256"/><l level="1" sID="gen2614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1256"/>Tempore quo fuerint dissipati, peribunt ; <l eID="gen2614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2615"/>et ut incaluerit, solventur de loco suo. <l eID="gen2615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1257"/><l level="1" sID="gen2616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1257"/>Involutæ sunt semitæ gressuum eorum ; <l eID="gen2616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2617"/>ambulabunt in vacuum, et peribunt. <l eID="gen2617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1258"/><l level="1" sID="gen2618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1258"/>Considerate semitas Thema, itinera Saba, <l eID="gen2618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2619"/>et expectate paulisper. <l eID="gen2619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1259"/><l level="1" sID="gen2620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1259"/>Confusi sunt, quia speravi : <l eID="gen2620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2621"/>venerunt quoque usque ad me, et pudore cooperti sunt. <l eID="gen2621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1260"/><l level="1" sID="gen2622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1260"/>Nunc venistis ; <l eID="gen2622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2623"/>et modo videntes plagam meam, timetis. <l eID="gen2623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1261"/><l level="1" sID="gen2624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1261"/>Numquid dixi : Afferte mihi, <l eID="gen2624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2625"/>et de substantia vestra donate mihi ? <l eID="gen2625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1262"/><l level="1" sID="gen2626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1262"/>vel : Liberate me de manu hostis, <l eID="gen2626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2627"/>et de manu robustorum eruite me ? <l eID="gen2627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1263"/><l level="1" sID="gen2628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1263"/>Docete me, et ego tacebo : <l eID="gen2628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2629"/>et si quid forte ignoravi, instruite me. <l eID="gen2629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1264"/><l level="1" sID="gen2630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1264"/>Quare detraxistis sermonibus veritatis, <l eID="gen2630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2631"/>cum e vobis nullus sit qui possit arguere me ? <l eID="gen2631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1265"/><l level="1" sID="gen2632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1265"/>Ad increpandum tantum eloquia concinnatis, <l eID="gen2632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2633"/>et in ventum verba profertis. <l eID="gen2633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1266"/><l level="1" sID="gen2634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1266"/>Super pupillum irruitis, <l eID="gen2634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2635"/>et subvertere nitimini amicum vestrum. <l eID="gen2635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1267"/><l level="1" sID="gen2636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1267"/>Verumtamen quod cœpistis explete : <l eID="gen2636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2637"/>præbete aurem, et videte an mentiar. <l eID="gen2637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1268"/><l level="1" sID="gen2638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1268"/>Respondete, obsecro, absque contentione ; <l eID="gen2638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2639"/>et loquentes id quod justum est, judicate. <l eID="gen2639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1269"/><l level="1" sID="gen2640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1269"/>Et non invenietis in lingua mea iniquitatem, <l eID="gen2640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2641"/>nec in faucibus meis stultitia personabit.  <chapter eID="Job.6"/>

verses.name: Job 7:1
verses.text: Militia est vita hominis super terram, <l eID="gen2642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2643"/>et sicut dies mercenarii dies ejus. <l eID="gen2643" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1270"/><l level="1" sID="gen2644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1270"/>Sicut servus desiderat umbram, <l eID="gen2644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2645"/>et sicut mercenarius præstolatur finem operis sui, <l eID="gen2645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1271"/><l level="1" sID="gen2646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1271"/>sic et ego habui menses vacuos, <l eID="gen2646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2647"/>et noctes laboriosas enumeravi mihi. <l eID="gen2647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1272"/><l level="1" sID="gen2648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1272"/>Si dormiero, dicam : Quando consurgam ? <l eID="gen2648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2649"/>et rursum expectabo vesperam, <l eID="gen2649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2650"/>et replebor doloribus usque ad tenebras. <l eID="gen2650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1273"/><l level="1" sID="gen2651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1273"/>Induta est caro mea putredine, <l eID="gen2651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2652"/>et sordibus pulveris cutis mea aruit et contracta est. <l eID="gen2652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1274"/><l level="1" sID="gen2653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1274"/>Dies mei velocius transierunt quam a texente tela succiditur, <l eID="gen2653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2654"/>et consumpti sunt absque ulla spe. <l eID="gen2654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1275"/><l level="1" sID="gen2655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1275"/>Memento quia ventus est vita mea, <l eID="gen2655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2656"/>et non revertetur oculus meus ut videat bona. <l eID="gen2656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1276"/><l level="1" sID="gen2657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1276"/>Nec aspiciet me visus hominis ; <l eID="gen2657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2658"/>oculi tui in me, et non subsistam. <l eID="gen2658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1277"/><l level="1" sID="gen2659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1277"/>Sicut consumitur nubes, et pertransit, <l eID="gen2659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2660"/>sic qui descenderit ad inferos, non ascendet. <l eID="gen2660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1278"/><l level="1" sID="gen2661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1278"/>Nec revertetur ultra in domum suam, <l eID="gen2661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2662"/>neque cognoscet eum amplius locus ejus. <l eID="gen2662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1279"/><l level="1" sID="gen2663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1279"/>Quapropter et ego non parcam ori meo : <l eID="gen2663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2664"/>loquar in tribulatione spiritus mei ; <l eID="gen2664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2665"/>confabulabor cum amaritudine animæ meæ. <l eID="gen2665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1280"/><l level="1" sID="gen2666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1280"/>Numquid mare ego sum, aut cetus, <l eID="gen2666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2667"/>quia circumdedisti me carcere ? <l eID="gen2667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1281"/><l level="1" sID="gen2668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1281"/>Si dixero : Consolabitur me lectulus meus, <l eID="gen2668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2669"/>et relevabor loquens mecum in strato meo : <l eID="gen2669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1282"/><l level="1" sID="gen2670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1282"/>terrebis me per somnia, <l eID="gen2670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2671"/>et per visiones horrore concuties. <l eID="gen2671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1283"/><l level="1" sID="gen2672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1283"/>Quam ob rem elegit suspendium anima mea, <l eID="gen2672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2673"/>et mortem ossa mea. <l eID="gen2673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1284"/><l level="1" sID="gen2674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1284"/>Desperavi : nequaquam ultra jam vivam : <l eID="gen2674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2675"/>parce mihi, nihil enim sunt dies mei. <l eID="gen2675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1285"/><l level="1" sID="gen2676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1285"/>Quid est homo, quia magnificas eum ? <l eID="gen2676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2677"/>aut quid apponis erga eum cor tuum ? <l eID="gen2677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1286"/><l level="1" sID="gen2678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1286"/>Visitas eum diluculo, <l eID="gen2678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2679"/>et subito probas illum. <l eID="gen2679" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1287"/><l level="1" sID="gen2680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1287"/>Usquequo non parcis mihi, <l eID="gen2680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2681"/>nec dimittis me ut glutiam salivam meam ? <l eID="gen2681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1288"/><l level="1" sID="gen2682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1288"/>Peccavi ; quid faciam tibi, o custos hominum ? <l eID="gen2682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2683"/>quare posuisti me contrarium tibi, <l eID="gen2683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2684"/>et factus sum mihimetipsi gravis ? <l eID="gen2684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 7:21
