verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1289"/><l level="1" sID="gen2685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1289"/>Cur non tollis peccatum meum, <l eID="gen2685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2686"/>et quare non aufers iniquitatem meam ? <l eID="gen2686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2687"/>ecce nunc in pulvere dormiam, <l eID="gen2687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2688"/>et si mane me quæsieris, non subsistam. <l eID="gen2688" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2582"/> <chapter eID="Job.7"/>

verses.name: Job 8:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Baldad Suhites, dixit :  <div eID="gen2689" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1290"/><lg sID="gen2690"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1290"/>Usquequo loqueris talia, <l eID="gen2691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2692"/>et spiritus multiplex sermones oris tui ? <l eID="gen2692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1291"/><l level="1" sID="gen2693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1291"/>Numquid Deus supplantat judicium ? <l eID="gen2693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2694"/>aut Omnipotens subvertit quod justum est ? <l eID="gen2694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1292"/><l level="1" sID="gen2695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1292"/>Etiam si filii tui peccaverunt ei, <l eID="gen2695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2696"/>et dimisit eos in manu iniquitatis suæ : <l eID="gen2696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1293"/><l level="1" sID="gen2697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1293"/>tu tamen si diluculo consurrexeris ad Deum, <l eID="gen2697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2698"/>et Omnipotentem fueris deprecatus ; <l eID="gen2698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1294"/><l level="1" sID="gen2699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1294"/>si mundus et rectus incesseris : <l eID="gen2699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2700"/>statim evigilabit ad te, <l eID="gen2700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2701"/>et pacatum reddet habitaculum justitiæ tuæ, <l eID="gen2701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1295"/><l level="1" sID="gen2702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1295"/>in tantum ut si priora tua fuerint parva, <l eID="gen2702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2703"/>et novissima tua multiplicentur nimis. <l eID="gen2703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1296"/><l level="1" sID="gen2704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1296"/>Interroga enim generationem pristinam, <l eID="gen2704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2705"/>et diligenter investiga patrum memoriam <l eID="gen2705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1297"/><l level="1" sID="gen2706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1297"/>(hesterni quippe sumus, et ignoramus, <l eID="gen2706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2707"/>quoniam sicut umbra dies nostri sunt super terram), <l eID="gen2707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1298"/><l level="1" sID="gen2708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1298"/>et ipsi docebunt te, loquentur tibi, <l eID="gen2708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2709"/>et de corde suo proferent eloquia. <l eID="gen2709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1299"/><l level="1" sID="gen2710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1299"/>Numquid vivere potest scirpus absque humore ? <l eID="gen2710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2711"/>aut crescere carectum sine aqua ? <l eID="gen2711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1300"/><l level="1" sID="gen2712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1300"/>Cum adhuc sit in flore, nec carpatur manu, <l eID="gen2712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2713"/>ante omnes herbas arescit. <l eID="gen2713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1301"/><l level="1" sID="gen2714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1301"/>Sic viæ omnium qui obliviscuntur Deum, <l eID="gen2714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2715"/>et spes hypocritæ peribit. <l eID="gen2715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1302"/><l level="1" sID="gen2716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1302"/>Non ei placebit vecordia sua, <l eID="gen2716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2717"/>et sicut tela aranearum fiducia ejus. <l eID="gen2717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1303"/><l level="1" sID="gen2718"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1303"/>Innitetur super domum suam, et non stabit ; <l eID="gen2718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2719"/>fulciet eam, et non consurget. <l eID="gen2719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1304"/><l level="1" sID="gen2720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1304"/>Humectus videtur antequam veniat sol, <l eID="gen2720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2721"/>et in ortu suo germen ejus egredietur. <l eID="gen2721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1305"/><l level="1" sID="gen2722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1305"/>Super acervum petrarum radices ejus densabuntur, <l eID="gen2722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2723"/>et inter lapides commorabitur. <l eID="gen2723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1306"/><l level="1" sID="gen2724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1306"/>Si absorbuerit eum de loco suo, <l eID="gen2724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2725"/>negabit eum, et dicet : Non novi te. <l eID="gen2725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1307"/><l level="1" sID="gen2726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1307"/>Hæc est enim lætitia viæ ejus, <l eID="gen2726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2727"/>ut rursum de terra alii germinentur. <l eID="gen2727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1308"/><l level="1" sID="gen2728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1308"/>Deus non projiciet simplicem, <l eID="gen2728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2729"/>nec porriget manum malignis, <l eID="gen2729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1309"/><l level="1" sID="gen2730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1309"/>donec impleatur risu os tuum, <l eID="gen2730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2731"/>et labia tua jubilo. <l eID="gen2731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1310"/><l level="1" sID="gen2732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1310"/>Qui oderunt te induentur confusione, <l eID="gen2732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2733"/>et tabernaculum impiorum non subsistet. <l eID="gen2733" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2690"/> <chapter eID="Job.8"/>

verses.name: Job 9:1
verses.text: Et respondens Job, ait :  <div eID="gen2734" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1311"/><lg sID="gen2735"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1311"/>Vere scio quod ita sit, <l eID="gen2736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2737"/>et quod non justificetur homo compositus Deo. <l eID="gen2737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1312"/><l level="1" sID="gen2738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1312"/>Si voluerit contendere cum eo, <l eID="gen2738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2739"/>non poterit ei respondere unum pro mille. <l eID="gen2739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1313"/><l level="1" sID="gen2740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1313"/>Sapiens corde est, et fortis robore : <l eID="gen2740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2741"/>quis restitit ei, et pacem habuit ? <l eID="gen2741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1314"/><l level="1" sID="gen2742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1314"/>Qui transtulit montes, et nescierunt <l eID="gen2742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2743"/>hi quos subvertit in furore suo. <l eID="gen2743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1315"/><l level="1" sID="gen2744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1315"/>Qui commovet terram de loco suo, <l eID="gen2744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2745"/>et columnæ ejus concutiuntur. <l eID="gen2745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1316"/><l level="1" sID="gen2746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1316"/>Qui præcipit soli, et non oritur, <l eID="gen2746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2747"/>et stellas claudit quasi sub signaculo. <l eID="gen2747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1317"/><l level="1" sID="gen2748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1317"/>Qui extendit cælos solus, <l eID="gen2748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2749"/>et graditur super fluctus maris. <l eID="gen2749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1318"/><l level="1" sID="gen2750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1318"/>Qui facit Arcturum et Oriona, <l eID="gen2750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2751"/>et Hyadas et interiora austri. <l eID="gen2751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1319"/><l level="1" sID="gen2752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1319"/>Qui facit magna, et incomprehensibilia, <l eID="gen2752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2753"/>et mirabilia, quorum non est numerus. <l eID="gen2753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1320"/><l level="1" sID="gen2754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1320"/>Si venerit ad me, non videbo eum ; <l eID="gen2754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2755"/>si abierit, non intelligam. <l eID="gen2755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1321"/><l level="1" sID="gen2756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1321"/>Si repente interroget, quis respondebit ei ? <l eID="gen2756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2757"/>vel quis dicere potest : Cur ita facis ? <l eID="gen2757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1322"/><l level="1" sID="gen2758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1322"/>Deus, cujus iræ nemo resistere potest, <l eID="gen2758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2759"/>et sub quo curvantur qui portant orbem. <l eID="gen2759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1323"/><l level="1" sID="gen2760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1323"/>Quantus ergo sum ego, ut respondeam ei, <l eID="gen2760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2761"/>et loquar verbis meis cum eo ? <l eID="gen2761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1324"/><l level="1" sID="gen2762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1324"/>qui etiam si habuero quippiam justum, non respondebo : <l eID="gen2762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2763"/>sed meum judicem deprecabor. <l eID="gen2763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1325"/><l level="1" sID="gen2764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1325"/>Et cum invocantem exaudierit me, <l eID="gen2764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2765"/>non credo quod audierit vocem meam. <l eID="gen2765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1326"/><l level="1" sID="gen2766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1326"/>In turbine enim conteret me, <l eID="gen2766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2767"/>et multiplicabit vulnera mea, etiam sine causa. <l eID="gen2767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1327"/><l level="1" sID="gen2768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1327"/>Non concedit requiescere spiritum meum, <l eID="gen2768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2769"/>et implet me amaritudinibus. <l eID="gen2769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1328"/><l level="1" sID="gen2770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1328"/>Si fortitudo quæritur, robustissimus est ; <l eID="gen2770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2771"/>si æquitas judicii, nemo audet pro me testimonium dicere. <l eID="gen2771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1329"/><l level="1" sID="gen2772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1329"/>Si justificare me voluero, os meum condemnabit me ; <l eID="gen2772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2773"/>si innocentem ostendero, pravum me comprobabit. <l eID="gen2773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1330"/><l level="1" sID="gen2774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1330"/>Etiam si simplex fuero, hoc ipsum ignorabit anima mea, <l eID="gen2774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2775"/>et tædebit me vitæ meæ. <l eID="gen2775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1331"/><l level="1" sID="gen2776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1331"/>Unum est quod locutus sum : <l eID="gen2776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2777"/>et innocentem et impium ipse consumit. <l eID="gen2777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1332"/><l level="1" sID="gen2778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1332"/>Si flagellat, occidat semel, <l eID="gen2778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2779"/>et non de pœnis innocentum rideat. <l eID="gen2779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1333"/><l level="1" sID="gen2780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1333"/>Terra data est in manus impii ; <l eID="gen2780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2781"/>vultum judicum ejus operit. <l eID="gen2781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2782"/>Quod si non ille est, quis ergo est ? <l eID="gen2782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1334"/><l level="1" sID="gen2783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1334"/>Dies mei velociores fuerunt cursore ; <l eID="gen2783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2784"/>fugerunt, et non viderunt bonum. <l eID="gen2784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1335"/><l level="1" sID="gen2785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1335"/>Pertransierunt quasi naves poma portantes ; <l eID="gen2785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2786"/>sicut aquila volans ad escam. <l eID="gen2786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1336"/><l level="1" sID="gen2787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1336"/>Cum dixero : Nequaquam ita loquar : <l eID="gen2787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2788"/>commuto faciem meam, et dolore torqueor. <l eID="gen2788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1337"/><l level="1" sID="gen2789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1337"/>Verebar omnia opera mea, <l eID="gen2789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2790"/>sciens quod non parceres delinquenti. <l eID="gen2790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1338"/><l level="1" sID="gen2791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1338"/>Si autem et sic impius sum, <l eID="gen2791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2792"/>quare frustra laboravi ? <l eID="gen2792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1339"/><l level="1" sID="gen2793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1339"/>Si lotus fuero quasi aquis nivis, <l eID="gen2793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2794"/>et fulserint velut mundissimæ manus meæ, <l eID="gen2794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1340"/><l level="1" sID="gen2795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1340"/>tamen sordibus intinges me, <l eID="gen2795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2796"/>et abominabuntur me vestimenta mea. <l eID="gen2796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1341"/><l level="1" sID="gen2797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1341"/>Neque enim viro qui similis mei est, respondebo ; <l eID="gen2797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2798"/>nec qui mecum in judicio ex æquo possit audiri. <l eID="gen2798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1342"/><l level="1" sID="gen2799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1342"/>Non est qui utrumque valeat arguere, <l eID="gen2799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2800"/>et ponere manum suam in ambobus. <l eID="gen2800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1343"/><l level="1" sID="gen2801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1343"/>Auferat a me virgam suam, <l eID="gen2801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2802"/>et pavor ejus non me terreat. <l eID="gen2802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 9:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1344"/><l level="1" sID="gen2803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1344"/>Loquar, et non timebo eum ; <l eID="gen2803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2804"/>neque enim possum metuens respondere.  <chapter eID="Job.9"/>

verses.name: Job 10:1
verses.text: Tædet animam meam vitæ meæ ; <l eID="gen2805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2806"/>dimittam adversum me eloquium meum : <l eID="gen2806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2807"/>loquar in amaritudine animæ meæ. <l eID="gen2807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1345"/><l level="1" sID="gen2808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1345"/>Dicam Deo : Noli me condemnare ; <l eID="gen2808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2809"/>indica mihi cur me ita judices. <l eID="gen2809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1346"/><l level="1" sID="gen2810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1346"/>Numquid bonum tibi videtur, si calumnieris me, <l eID="gen2810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2811"/>et opprimas me opus manuum tuarum, <l eID="gen2811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2812"/>et consilium impiorum adjuves ? <l eID="gen2812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1347"/><l level="1" sID="gen2813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1347"/>Numquid oculi carnei tibi sunt ? <l eID="gen2813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2814"/>aut sicut videt homo, et tu videbis ? <l eID="gen2814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1348"/><l level="1" sID="gen2815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1348"/>Numquid sicut dies hominis dies tui, <l eID="gen2815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2816"/>et anni tui sicut humana sunt tempora, <l eID="gen2816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1349"/><l level="1" sID="gen2817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1349"/>ut quæras iniquitatem meam, <l eID="gen2817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2818"/>et peccatum meum scruteris, <l eID="gen2818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1350"/><l level="1" sID="gen2819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1350"/>et scias quia nihil impium fecerim, <l eID="gen2819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2820"/>cum sit nemo qui de manu tua possit eruere ? <l eID="gen2820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1351"/><l level="1" sID="gen2821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1351"/>Manus tuæ fecerunt me, <l eID="gen2821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2822"/>et plasmaverunt me totum in circuitu : <l eID="gen2822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2823"/>et sic repente præcipitas me ? <l eID="gen2823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1352"/><l level="1" sID="gen2824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1352"/>Memento, quæso, quod sicut lutum feceris me, <l eID="gen2824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2825"/>et in pulverem reduces me. <l eID="gen2825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1353"/><l level="1" sID="gen2826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1353"/>Nonne sicut lac mulsisti me, <l eID="gen2826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2827"/>et sicut caseum me coagulasti ? <l eID="gen2827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1354"/><l level="1" sID="gen2828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1354"/>Pelle et carnibus vestisti me ; <l eID="gen2828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2829"/>ossibus et nervis compegisti me. <l eID="gen2829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1355"/><l level="1" sID="gen2830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1355"/>Vitam et misericordiam tribuisti mihi, <l eID="gen2830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2831"/>et visitatio tua custodivit spiritum meum. <l eID="gen2831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1356"/><l level="1" sID="gen2832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1356"/>Licet hæc celes in corde tuo, <l eID="gen2832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2833"/>tamen scio quia universorum memineris. <l eID="gen2833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1357"/><l level="1" sID="gen2834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1357"/>Si peccavi, et ad horam pepercisti mihi, <l eID="gen2834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2835"/>cur ab iniquitate mea mundum me esse non pateris ? <l eID="gen2835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1358"/><l level="1" sID="gen2836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1358"/>Et si impius fuero, væ mihi est ; <l eID="gen2836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2837"/>et si justus, non levabo caput, <l eID="gen2837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2838"/>saturatus afflictione et miseria. <l eID="gen2838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1359"/><l level="1" sID="gen2839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1359"/>Et propter superbiam quasi leænam capies me, <l eID="gen2839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2840"/>reversusque mirabiliter me crucias. <l eID="gen2840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1360"/><l level="1" sID="gen2841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1360"/>Instauras testes tuos contra me, <l eID="gen2841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2842"/>et multiplicas iram tuam adversum me, <l eID="gen2842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2843"/>et pœnæ militant in me. <l eID="gen2843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1361"/><l level="1" sID="gen2844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1361"/>Quare de vulva eduxisti me ? <l eID="gen2844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2845"/>qui utinam consumptus essem, ne oculus me videret. <l eID="gen2845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1362"/><l level="1" sID="gen2846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1362"/>Fuissem quasi non essem, <l eID="gen2846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2847"/>de utero translatus ad tumulum. <l eID="gen2847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1363"/><l level="1" sID="gen2848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1363"/>Numquid non paucitas dierum meorum finietur brevi ? <l eID="gen2848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2849"/>dimitte ergo me, ut plangam paululum dolorem meum, <l eID="gen2849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1364"/><l level="1" sID="gen2850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1364"/>antequam vadam, et non revertar, <l eID="gen2850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2851"/>ad terram tenebrosam, et opertam mortis caligine : <l eID="gen2851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1365"/><l level="1" sID="gen2852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1365"/>terram miseriæ et tenebrarum, <l eID="gen2852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2853"/>ubi umbra mortis et nullus ordo, <l eID="gen2853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2854"/>sed sempiternus horror inhabitat. <l eID="gen2854" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2735"/> <chapter eID="Job.10"/>

verses.name: Job 11:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Sophar Naamathites, dixit :  <div eID="gen2855" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1366"/><lg sID="gen2856"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1366"/>Numquid qui multa loquitur, non et audiet ? <l eID="gen2857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2858"/>aut vir verbosus justificabitur ? <l eID="gen2858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1367"/><l level="1" sID="gen2859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1367"/>Tibi soli tacebunt homines ? <l eID="gen2859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2860"/>et cum ceteros irriseris, a nullo confutaberis ? <l eID="gen2860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1368"/><l level="1" sID="gen2861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1368"/>Dixisti enim : Purus est sermo meus, <l eID="gen2861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2862"/>et mundus sum in conspectu tuo. <l eID="gen2862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1369"/><l level="1" sID="gen2863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1369"/>Atque utinam Deus loqueretur tecum, <l eID="gen2863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2864"/>et aperiret labia sua tibi, <l eID="gen2864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1370"/><l level="1" sID="gen2865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1370"/>ut ostenderet tibi secreta sapientiæ, <l eID="gen2865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2866"/>et quod multiplex esset lex ejus : <l eID="gen2866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2867"/>et intelligeres quod multo minora exigaris ab eo <l eID="gen2867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2868"/>quam meretur iniquitas tua ! <l eID="gen2868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1371"/><l level="1" sID="gen2869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1371"/>Forsitan vestigia Dei comprehendes, <l eID="gen2869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2870"/>et usque ad perfectum Omnipotentem reperies ? <l eID="gen2870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1372"/><l level="1" sID="gen2871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1372"/>Excelsior cælo est, et quid facies ? <l eID="gen2871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2872"/>profundior inferno, et unde cognosces ? <l eID="gen2872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1373"/><l level="1" sID="gen2873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1373"/>Longior terra mensura ejus, <l eID="gen2873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2874"/>et latior mari. <l eID="gen2874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1374"/><l level="1" sID="gen2875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1374"/>Si subverterit omnia, vel in unum coarctaverit, <l eID="gen2875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2876"/>quis contradicet ei ? <l eID="gen2876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1375"/><l level="1" sID="gen2877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1375"/>Ipse enim novit hominum vanitatem ; <l eID="gen2877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2878"/>et videns iniquitatem, nonne considerat ? <l eID="gen2878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1376"/><l level="1" sID="gen2879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1376"/>Vir vanus in superbiam erigitur, <l eID="gen2879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2880"/>et tamquam pullum onagri se liberum natum putat. <l eID="gen2880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1377"/><l level="1" sID="gen2881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1377"/>Tu autem firmasti cor tuum, <l eID="gen2881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2882"/>et expandisti ad eum manus tuas. <l eID="gen2882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1378"/><l level="1" sID="gen2883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1378"/>Si iniquitatem quæ est in manu tua abstuleris a te, <l eID="gen2883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2884"/>et non manserit in tabernaculo tuo injustitia, <l eID="gen2884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1379"/><l level="1" sID="gen2885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1379"/>tunc levare poteris faciem tuam absque macula ; <l eID="gen2885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2886"/>et eris stabilis, et non timebis. <l eID="gen2886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1380"/><l level="1" sID="gen2887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1380"/>Miseriæ quoque oblivisceris, <l eID="gen2887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2888"/>et quasi aquarum quæ præterierunt recordaberis. <l eID="gen2888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1381"/><l level="1" sID="gen2889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1381"/>Et quasi meridianus fulgor consurget tibi ad vesperam ; <l eID="gen2889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2890"/>et cum te consumptum putaveris, orieris ut lucifer. <l eID="gen2890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1382"/><l level="1" sID="gen2891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1382"/>Et habebis fiduciam, proposita tibi spe : <l eID="gen2891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2892"/>et defossus securus dormies. <l eID="gen2892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1383"/><l level="1" sID="gen2893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1383"/>Requiesces, et non erit qui te exterreat ; <l eID="gen2893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2894"/>et deprecabuntur faciem tuam plurimi. <l eID="gen2894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1384"/><l level="1" sID="gen2895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1384"/>Oculi autem impiorum deficient, <l eID="gen2895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2896"/>et effugium peribit ab eis : <l eID="gen2896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2897"/>et spes illorum abominatio animæ. <l eID="gen2897" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2856"/> <chapter eID="Job.11"/>

verses.name: Job 12:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Job, dixit :  <div eID="gen2898" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1385"/><lg sID="gen2899"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1385"/>Ergo vos estis soli homines, <l eID="gen2900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2901"/>et vobiscum morietur sapientia ? <l eID="gen2901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1386"/><l level="1" sID="gen2902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1386"/>Et mihi est cor sicut et vobis, nec inferior vestri sum ; <l eID="gen2902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2903"/>quis enim hæc quæ nostis ignorat ? <l eID="gen2903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1387"/><l level="1" sID="gen2904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1387"/>Qui deridetur ab amico suo, sicut ego, <l eID="gen2904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2905"/>invocabit Deum, et exaudiet eum : <l eID="gen2905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2906"/>deridetur enim justi simplicitas. <l eID="gen2906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1388"/><l level="1" sID="gen2907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1388"/>Lampas contempta apud cogitationes divitum <l eID="gen2907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2908"/>parata ad tempus statutum. <l eID="gen2908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1389"/><l level="1" sID="gen2909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1389"/>Abundant tabernacula prædonum, <l eID="gen2909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2910"/>et audacter provocant Deum, <l eID="gen2910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2911"/>cum ipse dederit omnia in manus eorum. <l eID="gen2911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1390"/><l level="1" sID="gen2912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1390"/>Nimirum interroga jumenta, et docebunt te ; <l eID="gen2912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2913"/>et volatilia cæli, et indicabunt tibi. <l eID="gen2913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1391"/><l level="1" sID="gen2914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1391"/>Loquere terræ, et respondebit tibi, <l eID="gen2914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2915"/>et narrabunt pisces maris. <l eID="gen2915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1392"/><l level="1" sID="gen2916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1392"/>Quis ignorat quod omnia hæc manus Domini fecerit ? <l eID="gen2916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1393"/><l level="1" sID="gen2917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1393"/>In cujus manu anima omnis viventis, <l eID="gen2917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2918"/>et spiritus universæ carnis hominis. <l eID="gen2918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1394"/><l level="1" sID="gen2919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1394"/>Nonne auris verba dijudicat ? <l eID="gen2919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2920"/>et fauces comedentis, saporem ? <l eID="gen2920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1395"/><l level="1" sID="gen2921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1395"/>In antiquis est sapientia, <l eID="gen2921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2922"/>et in multo tempore prudentia. <l eID="gen2922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1396"/><l level="1" sID="gen2923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1396"/>Apud ipsum est sapientia et fortitudo ; <l eID="gen2923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2924"/>ipse habet consilium et intelligentiam. <l eID="gen2924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1397"/><l level="1" sID="gen2925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1397"/>Si destruxerit, nemo est qui ædificet ; <l eID="gen2925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2926"/>si incluserit hominem, nullus est qui aperiat. <l eID="gen2926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1398"/><l level="1" sID="gen2927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1398"/>Si continuerit aquas, omnia siccabuntur ; <l eID="gen2927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2928"/>et si emiserit eas, subvertent terram. <l eID="gen2928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1399"/><l level="1" sID="gen2929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1399"/>Apud ipsum est fortitudo et sapientia ; <l eID="gen2929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2930"/>ipse novit et decipientem, et eum qui decipitur. <l eID="gen2930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1400"/><l level="1" sID="gen2931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1400"/>Adducit consiliarios in stultum finem, <l eID="gen2931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2932"/>et judices in stuporem. <l eID="gen2932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1401"/><l level="1" sID="gen2933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1401"/>Balteum regum dissolvit, <l eID="gen2933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2934"/>et præcingit fune renes eorum. <l eID="gen2934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1402"/><l level="1" sID="gen2935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1402"/>Ducit sacerdotes inglorios, <l eID="gen2935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2936"/>et optimates supplantat : <l eID="gen2936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1403"/><l level="1" sID="gen2937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1403"/>commutans labium veracium, <l eID="gen2937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2938"/>et doctrinam senum auferens. <l eID="gen2938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1404"/><l level="1" sID="gen2939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1404"/>Effundit despectionem super principes, <l eID="gen2939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2940"/>eos qui oppressi fuerant relevans. <l eID="gen2940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1405"/><l level="1" sID="gen2941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1405"/>Qui revelat profunda de tenebris, <l eID="gen2941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2942"/>et producit in lucem umbram mortis. <l eID="gen2942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1406"/><l level="1" sID="gen2943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1406"/>Qui multiplicat gentes, et perdit eas, <l eID="gen2943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2944"/>et subversas in integrum restituit. <l eID="gen2944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1407"/><l level="1" sID="gen2945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1407"/>Qui immutat cor principum populi terræ, <l eID="gen2945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2946"/>et decipit eos ut frustra incedant per invium : <l eID="gen2946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 12:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1408"/><l level="1" sID="gen2947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1408"/>palpabunt quasi in tenebris, et non in luce, <l eID="gen2947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2948"/>et errare eos faciet quasi ebrios.  <chapter eID="Job.12"/>

verses.name: Job 13:1
verses.text: Ecce omnia hæc vidit oculus meus, <l eID="gen2949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2950"/>et audivit auris mea, et intellexi singula. <l eID="gen2950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1409"/><l level="1" sID="gen2951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1409"/>Secundum scientiam vestram et ego novi : <l eID="gen2951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2952"/>nec inferior vestri sum. <l eID="gen2952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1410"/><l level="1" sID="gen2953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1410"/>Sed tamen ad Omnipotentem loquar, <l eID="gen2953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2954"/>et disputare cum Deo cupio : <l eID="gen2954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1411"/><l level="1" sID="gen2955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1411"/>prius vos ostendens fabricatores mendacii, <l eID="gen2955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2956"/>et cultores perversorum dogmatum. <l eID="gen2956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1412"/><l level="1" sID="gen2957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1412"/>Atque utinam taceretis, <l eID="gen2957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2958"/>ut putaremini esse sapientes. <l eID="gen2958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1413"/><l level="1" sID="gen2959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1413"/>Audite ergo correptionem meam, <l eID="gen2959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2960"/>et judicium labiorum meorum attendite. <l eID="gen2960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1414"/><l level="1" sID="gen2961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1414"/>Numquid Deus indiget vestro mendacio, <l eID="gen2961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2962"/>ut pro illo loquamini dolos ? <l eID="gen2962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1415"/><l level="1" sID="gen2963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1415"/>numquid faciem ejus accipitis, <l eID="gen2963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2964"/>et pro Deo judicare nitimini ? <l eID="gen2964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1416"/><l level="1" sID="gen2965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1416"/>aut placebit ei quem celare nihil potest ? <l eID="gen2965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2966"/>aut decipietur, ut homo, vestris fraudulentiis ? <l eID="gen2966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1417"/><l level="1" sID="gen2967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1417"/>Ipse vos arguet, <l eID="gen2967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2968"/>quoniam in abscondito faciem ejus accipitis. <l eID="gen2968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1418"/><l level="1" sID="gen2969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1418"/>Statim ut se commoverit, turbabit vos, <l eID="gen2969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2970"/>et terror ejus irruet super vos. <l eID="gen2970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1419"/><l level="1" sID="gen2971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1419"/>Memoria vestra comparabitur cineri, <l eID="gen2971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2972"/>et redigentur in lutum cervices vestræ. <l eID="gen2972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1420"/><l level="1" sID="gen2973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1420"/>Tacete paulisper, ut loquar <l eID="gen2973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2974"/>quodcumque mihi mens suggesserit. <l eID="gen2974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1421"/><l level="1" sID="gen2975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1421"/>Quare lacero carnes meas dentibus meis, <l eID="gen2975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2976"/>et animam meam porto in manibus meis ? <l eID="gen2976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1422"/><l level="1" sID="gen2977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1422"/>Etiam si occiderit me, in ipso sperabo : <l eID="gen2977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2978"/>verumtamen vias meas in conspectu ejus arguam. <l eID="gen2978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1423"/><l level="1" sID="gen2979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1423"/>Et ipse erit salvator meus : <l eID="gen2979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2980"/>non enim veniet in conspectu ejus omnis hypocrita. <l eID="gen2980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1424"/><l level="1" sID="gen2981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1424"/>Audite sermonem meum, <l eID="gen2981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2982"/>et ænigmata percipite auribus vestris. <l eID="gen2982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1425"/><l level="1" sID="gen2983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1425"/>Si fuero judicatus, <l eID="gen2983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2984"/>scio quod justus inveniar. <l eID="gen2984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1426"/><l level="1" sID="gen2985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1426"/>Quis est qui judicetur mecum ? <l eID="gen2985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2986"/>veniat : quare tacens consumor ? <l eID="gen2986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1427"/><l level="1" sID="gen2987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1427"/>Duo tantum ne facias mihi, <l eID="gen2987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2988"/>et tunc a facie tua non abscondar : <l eID="gen2988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1428"/><l level="1" sID="gen2989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1428"/>manum tuam longe fac a me, <l eID="gen2989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2990"/>et formido tua non me terreat. <l eID="gen2990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1429"/><l level="1" sID="gen2991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1429"/>Voca me, et ego respondebo tibi : <l eID="gen2991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2992"/>aut certe loquar, et tu responde mihi. <l eID="gen2992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1430"/><l level="1" sID="gen2993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1430"/>Quantas habeo iniquitates et peccata ? <l eID="gen2993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2994"/>scelera mea et delicta ostende mihi. <l eID="gen2994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1431"/><l level="1" sID="gen2995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1431"/>Cur faciem tuam abscondis, <l eID="gen2995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2996"/>et arbitraris me inimicum tuum ? <l eID="gen2996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1432"/><l level="1" sID="gen2997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1432"/>Contra folium, quod vento rapitur, ostendis potentiam tuam, <l eID="gen2997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen2998"/>et stipulam siccam persequeris : <l eID="gen2998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1433"/><l level="1" sID="gen2999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1433"/>scribis enim contra me amaritudines, <l eID="gen2999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3000"/>et consumere me vis peccatis adolescentiæ meæ. <l eID="gen3000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1434"/><l level="1" sID="gen3001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1434"/>Posuisti in nervo pedem meum, <l eID="gen3001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3002"/>et observasti omnes semitas meas, <l eID="gen3002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3003"/>et vestigia pedum meorum considerasti : <l eID="gen3003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 13:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1435"/><l level="1" sID="gen3004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1435"/>qui quasi putredo consumendus sum, <l eID="gen3004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3005"/>et quasi vestimentum quod comeditur a tinea.  <chapter eID="Job.13"/>

verses.name: Job 14:1
verses.text: Homo natus de muliere, brevi vivens tempore, <l eID="gen3006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3007"/>repletur multis miseriis. <l eID="gen3007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1436"/><l level="1" sID="gen3008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1436"/>Qui quasi flos egreditur et conteritur, <l eID="gen3008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3009"/>et fugit velut umbra, et numquam in eodem statu permanet. <l eID="gen3009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1437"/><l level="1" sID="gen3010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1437"/>Et dignum ducis super hujuscemodi aperire oculos tuos, <l eID="gen3010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3011"/>et adducere eum tecum in judicium ? <l eID="gen3011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1438"/><l level="1" sID="gen3012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1438"/>Quis potest facere mundum de immundo conceptum semine ? <l eID="gen3012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3013"/>nonne tu qui solus es ? <l eID="gen3013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1439"/><l level="1" sID="gen3014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1439"/>Breves dies hominis sunt : <l eID="gen3014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3015"/>numerus mensium ejus apud te est : <l eID="gen3015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3016"/>constituisti terminos ejus, qui præteriri non poterunt. <l eID="gen3016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1440"/><l level="1" sID="gen3017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1440"/>Recede paululum ab eo, ut quiescat, <l eID="gen3017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3018"/>donec optata veniat, sicut mercenarii, dies ejus. <l eID="gen3018" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1441"/><l level="1" sID="gen3019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1441"/>Lignum habet spem : <l eID="gen3019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3020"/>si præcisum fuerit, rursum virescit, <l eID="gen3020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3021"/>et rami ejus pullulant. <l eID="gen3021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1442"/><l level="1" sID="gen3022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1442"/>Si senuerit in terra radix ejus, <l eID="gen3022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3023"/>et in pulvere emortuus fuerit truncus illius, <l eID="gen3023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1443"/><l level="1" sID="gen3024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1443"/>ad odorem aquæ germinabit, <l eID="gen3024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3025"/>et faciet comam, quasi cum primum plantatum est. <l eID="gen3025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1444"/><l level="1" sID="gen3026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1444"/>Homo vero cum mortuus fuerit, et nudatus, <l eID="gen3026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3027"/>atque consumptus, ubi, quæso, est ? <l eID="gen3027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1445"/><l level="1" sID="gen3028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1445"/>Quomodo si recedant aquæ de mari, <l eID="gen3028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3029"/>et fluvius vacuefactus arescat : <l eID="gen3029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1446"/><l level="1" sID="gen3030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1446"/>sic homo, cum dormierit, non resurget : <l eID="gen3030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3031"/>donec atteratur cælum, non evigilabit, <l eID="gen3031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3032"/>nec consurget de somno suo. <l eID="gen3032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1447"/><l level="1" sID="gen3033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1447"/>Quis mihi hoc tribuat, ut in inferno protegas me, <l eID="gen3033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3034"/>et abscondas me donec pertranseat furor tuus, <l eID="gen3034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3035"/>et constituas mihi tempus in quo recorderis mei ? <l eID="gen3035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1448"/><l level="1" sID="gen3036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1448"/>Putasne mortuus homo rursum vivat ? <l eID="gen3036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3037"/>cunctis diebus quibus nunc milito, expecto <l eID="gen3037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3038"/>donec veniat immutatio mea. <l eID="gen3038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1449"/><l level="1" sID="gen3039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1449"/>Vocabis me, et ego respondebo tibi : <l eID="gen3039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3040"/>operi manuum tuarum porriges dexteram. <l eID="gen3040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1450"/><l level="1" sID="gen3041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1450"/>Tu quidem gressus meos dinumerasti : <l eID="gen3041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3042"/>sed parce peccatis meis. <l eID="gen3042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1451"/><l level="1" sID="gen3043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1451"/>Signasti quasi in sacculo delicta mea, <l eID="gen3043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3044"/>sed curasti iniquitatem meam. <l eID="gen3044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1452"/><l level="1" sID="gen3045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1452"/>Mons cadens defluit, <l eID="gen3045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3046"/>et saxum transfertur de loco suo : <l eID="gen3046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1453"/><l level="1" sID="gen3047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1453"/>lapides excavant aquæ, <l eID="gen3047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3048"/>et alluvione paulatim terra consumitur : <l eID="gen3048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3049"/>et hominem ergo similiter perdes. <l eID="gen3049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1454"/><l level="1" sID="gen3050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1454"/>Roborasti eum paululum, ut in perpetuum transiret : <l eID="gen3050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3051"/>immutabis faciem ejus, et emittes eum. <l eID="gen3051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1455"/><l level="1" sID="gen3052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1455"/>Sive nobiles fuerint filii ejus, <l eID="gen3052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3053"/>sive ignobiles, non intelliget. <l eID="gen3053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1456"/><l level="1" sID="gen3054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1456"/>Attamen caro ejus, dum vivet, dolebit, <l eID="gen3054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3055"/>et anima illius super semetipso lugebit. <l eID="gen3055" level="1"/><lg eID="gen2899"/> <chapter eID="Job.14"/>

verses.name: Job 15:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Eliphaz Themanites, dixit :  <div eID="gen3056" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1457"/><lg sID="gen3057"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1457"/>Numquid sapiens respondebit quasi in ventum loquens, <l eID="gen3058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3059"/>et implebit ardore stomachum suum ? <l eID="gen3059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1458"/><l level="1" sID="gen3060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1458"/>Arguis verbis eum qui non est æqualis tibi, <l eID="gen3060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3061"/>et loqueris quod tibi non expedit. <l eID="gen3061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1459"/><l level="1" sID="gen3062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1459"/>Quantum in te est, evacuasti timorem, <l eID="gen3062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3063"/>et tulisti preces coram Deo. <l eID="gen3063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1460"/><l level="1" sID="gen3064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1460"/>Docuit enim iniquitas tua os tuum, <l eID="gen3064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3065"/>et imitaris linguam blasphemantium. <l eID="gen3065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1461"/><l level="1" sID="gen3066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1461"/>Condemnabit te os tuum, et non ego : <l eID="gen3066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3067"/>et labia tua respondebunt tibi. <l eID="gen3067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1462"/><l level="1" sID="gen3068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1462"/>Numquid primus homo tu natus es, <l eID="gen3068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3069"/>et ante colles formatus ? <l eID="gen3069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1463"/><l level="1" sID="gen3070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1463"/>numquid consilium Dei audisti, <l eID="gen3070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3071"/>et inferior te erit ejus sapientia ? <l eID="gen3071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1464"/><l level="1" sID="gen3072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1464"/>Quid nosti quod ignoremus ? <l eID="gen3072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3073"/>quid intelligis quod nesciamus ? <l eID="gen3073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1465"/><l level="1" sID="gen3074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1465"/>Et senes et antiqui sunt in nobis, <l eID="gen3074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3075"/>multo vetustiores quam patres tui. <l eID="gen3075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1466"/><l level="1" sID="gen3076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1466"/>Numquid grande est ut consoletur te Deus ? <l eID="gen3076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3077"/>sed verba tua prava hoc prohibent. <l eID="gen3077" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1467"/><l level="1" sID="gen3078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1467"/>Quid te elevat cor tuum, <l eID="gen3078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3079"/>et quasi magna cogitans attonitos habes oculos ? <l eID="gen3079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1468"/><l level="1" sID="gen3080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1468"/>Quid tumet contra Deum spiritus tuus, <l eID="gen3080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3081"/>ut proferas de ore tuo hujuscemodi sermones ? <l eID="gen3081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1469"/><l level="1" sID="gen3082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1469"/>Quid est homo ut immaculatus sit, <l eID="gen3082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3083"/>et ut justus appareat natus de muliere ? <l eID="gen3083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1470"/><l level="1" sID="gen3084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1470"/>Ecce inter sanctos ejus nemo immutabilis, <l eID="gen3084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3085"/>et cæli non sunt mundi in conspectu ejus. <l eID="gen3085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1471"/><l level="1" sID="gen3086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1471"/>Quanto magis abominabilis et inutilis homo, <l eID="gen3086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3087"/>qui bibit quasi aquam iniquitatem ? <l eID="gen3087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1472"/><l level="1" sID="gen3088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1472"/>Ostendam tibi : audi me : <l eID="gen3088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3089"/>quod vidi, narrabo tibi. <l eID="gen3089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1473"/><l level="1" sID="gen3090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1473"/>Sapientes confitentur, <l eID="gen3090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3091"/>et non abscondunt patres suos : <l eID="gen3091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1474"/><l level="1" sID="gen3092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1474"/>quibus solis data est terra, <l eID="gen3092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3093"/>et non transivit alienus per eos. <l eID="gen3093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1475"/><l level="1" sID="gen3094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1475"/>Cunctis diebus suis impius superbit, <l eID="gen3094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3095"/>et numerus annorum incertus est tyrannidis ejus. <l eID="gen3095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1476"/><l level="1" sID="gen3096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1476"/>Sonitus terroris semper in auribus illius : <l eID="gen3096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3097"/>et cum pax sit, ille semper insidias suspicatur. <l eID="gen3097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1477"/><l level="1" sID="gen3098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1477"/>Non credit quod reverti possit de tenebris ad lucem, <l eID="gen3098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3099"/>circumspectans undique gladium. <l eID="gen3099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1478"/><l level="1" sID="gen3100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1478"/>Cum se moverit ad quærendum panem, <l eID="gen3100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3101"/>novit quod paratus sit in manu ejus tenebrarum dies. <l eID="gen3101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1479"/><l level="1" sID="gen3102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1479"/>Terrebit eum tribulatio, <l eID="gen3102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3103"/>et angustia vallabit eum, <l eID="gen3103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3104"/>sicut regem qui præparatur ad prælium. <l eID="gen3104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1480"/><l level="1" sID="gen3105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1480"/>Tetendit enim adversus Deum manum suam, <l eID="gen3105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3106"/>et contra Omnipotentem roboratus est. <l eID="gen3106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1481"/><l level="1" sID="gen3107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1481"/>Cucurrit adversus eum erecto collo, <l eID="gen3107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3108"/>et pingui cervice armatus est. <l eID="gen3108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1482"/><l level="1" sID="gen3109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1482"/>Operuit faciem ejus crassitudo, <l eID="gen3109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3110"/>et de lateribus ejus arvina dependet. <l eID="gen3110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1483"/><l level="1" sID="gen3111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1483"/>Habitavit in civitatibus desolatis, <l eID="gen3111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3112"/>et in domibus desertis, quæ in tumulos sunt redactæ. <l eID="gen3112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1484"/><l level="1" sID="gen3113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1484"/>Non ditabitur, nec perseverabit substantia ejus, <l eID="gen3113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3114"/>nec mittet in terra radicem suam. <l eID="gen3114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1485"/><l level="1" sID="gen3115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1485"/>Non recedet de tenebris : <l eID="gen3115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3116"/>ramos ejus arefaciet flamma, <l eID="gen3116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3117"/>et auferetur spiritu oris sui. <l eID="gen3117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1486"/><l level="1" sID="gen3118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1486"/>Non credet, frustra errore deceptus, <l eID="gen3118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3119"/>quod aliquo pretio redimendus sit. <l eID="gen3119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1487"/><l level="1" sID="gen3120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1487"/>Antequam dies ejus impleantur peribit, <l eID="gen3120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3121"/>et manus ejus arescent. <l eID="gen3121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1488"/><l level="1" sID="gen3122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1488"/>Lædetur quasi vinea in primo flore botrus ejus, <l eID="gen3122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3123"/>et quasi oliva projiciens florem suum. <l eID="gen3123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1489"/><l level="1" sID="gen3124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1489"/>Congregatio enim hypocritæ sterilis, <l eID="gen3124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3125"/>et ignis devorabit tabernacula eorum qui munera libenter accipiunt. <l eID="gen3125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 15:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1490"/><l level="1" sID="gen3126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1490"/>Concepit dolorem, et peperit iniquitatem, <l eID="gen3126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3127"/>et uterus ejus præparat dolos. <l eID="gen3127" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3057"/> <chapter eID="Job.15"/>

verses.name: Job 16:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Job, dixit :  <div eID="gen3128" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1491"/><lg sID="gen3129"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1491"/>Audivi frequenter talia : <l eID="gen3130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3131"/>consolatores onerosi omnes vos estis. <l eID="gen3131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1492"/><l level="1" sID="gen3132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1492"/>Numquid habebunt finem verba ventosa ? <l eID="gen3132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3133"/>aut aliquid tibi molestum est, si loquaris ? <l eID="gen3133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1493"/><l level="1" sID="gen3134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1493"/>Poteram et ego similia vestri loqui, <l eID="gen3134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3135"/>atque utinam esset anima vestra pro anima mea : <l eID="gen3135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1494"/><l level="1" sID="gen3136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1494"/>consolarer et ego vos sermonibus, <l eID="gen3136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3137"/>et moverem caput meum super vos ; <l eID="gen3137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1495"/><l level="1" sID="gen3138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1495"/>roborarem vos ore meo, <l eID="gen3138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3139"/>et moverem labia mea, quasi parcens vobis. <l eID="gen3139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1496"/><l level="1" sID="gen3140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1496"/>Sed quid agam ? Si locutus fuero, non quiescet dolor meus, <l eID="gen3140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3141"/>et si tacuero, non recedet a me. <l eID="gen3141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1497"/><l level="1" sID="gen3142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1497"/>Nunc autem oppressit me dolor meus, <l eID="gen3142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3143"/>et in nihilum redacti sunt omnes artus mei. <l eID="gen3143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1498"/><l level="1" sID="gen3144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1498"/>Rugæ meæ testimonium dicunt contra me, <l eID="gen3144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3145"/>et suscitatur falsiloquus adversus faciem meam, contradicens mihi. <l eID="gen3145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1499"/><l level="1" sID="gen3146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1499"/>Collegit furorem suum in me, <l eID="gen3146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3147"/>et comminans mihi, infremuit contra me dentibus suis : <l eID="gen3147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3148"/>hostis meus terribilibus oculis me intuitus est. <l eID="gen3148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1500"/><l level="1" sID="gen3149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1500"/>Aperuerunt super me ora sua, <l eID="gen3149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3150"/>et exprobrantes percusserunt maxillam meam : <l eID="gen3150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3151"/>satiati sunt pœnis meis. <l eID="gen3151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1501"/><l level="1" sID="gen3152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1501"/>Conclusit me Deus apud iniquum, <l eID="gen3152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3153"/>et manibus impiorum me tradidit. <l eID="gen3153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1502"/><l level="1" sID="gen3154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1502"/>Ego ille quondam opulentus, repente contritus sum : <l eID="gen3154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3155"/>tenuit cervicem meam, confregit me, <l eID="gen3155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3156"/>et posuit me sibi quasi in signum. <l eID="gen3156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1503"/><l level="1" sID="gen3157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1503"/>Circumdedit me lanceis suis ; <l eID="gen3157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3158"/>convulneravit lumbos meos : <l eID="gen3158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3159"/>non pepercit, et effudit in terra viscera mea. <l eID="gen3159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1504"/><l level="1" sID="gen3160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1504"/>Concidit me vulnere super vulnus : <l eID="gen3160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3161"/>irruit in me quasi gigas. <l eID="gen3161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1505"/><l level="1" sID="gen3162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1505"/>Saccum consui super cutem meam, <l eID="gen3162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3163"/>et operui cinere carnem meam. <l eID="gen3163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1506"/><l level="1" sID="gen3164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1506"/>Facies mea intumuit a fletu, <l eID="gen3164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3165"/>et palpebræ meæ caligaverunt. <l eID="gen3165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1507"/><l level="1" sID="gen3166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1507"/>Hæc passus sum absque iniquitate manus meæ, <l eID="gen3166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3167"/>cum haberem mundas ad Deum preces. <l eID="gen3167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1508"/><l level="1" sID="gen3168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1508"/>Terra, ne operias sanguinem meum, <l eID="gen3168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3169"/>neque inveniat in te locum latendi clamor meus : <l eID="gen3169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1509"/><l level="1" sID="gen3170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1509"/>ecce enim in cælo testis meus, <l eID="gen3170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3171"/>et conscius meus in excelsis. <l eID="gen3171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:21
