verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1510"/><l level="1" sID="gen3172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1510"/>Verbosi amici mei : <l eID="gen3172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3173"/>ad Deum stillat oculus meus : <l eID="gen3173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1511"/><l level="1" sID="gen3174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1511"/>atque utinam sic judicaretur vir cum Deo, <l eID="gen3174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3175"/>quomodo judicatur filius hominis cum collega suo. <l eID="gen3175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1512"/><l level="1" sID="gen3176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1512"/>Ecce enim breves anni transeunt, <l eID="gen3176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3177"/>et semitam per quam non revertar ambulo.  <chapter eID="Job.16"/>

verses.name: Job 17:1
verses.text: Spiritus meus attenuabitur ; <l eID="gen3178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3179"/>dies mei breviabuntur : <l eID="gen3179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3180"/>et solum mihi superest sepulchrum. <l eID="gen3180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1513"/><l level="1" sID="gen3181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1513"/>Non peccavi, <l eID="gen3181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3182"/>et in amaritudinibus moratur oculus meus. <l eID="gen3182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1514"/><l level="1" sID="gen3183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1514"/>Libera me, Domine, et pone me juxta te, <l eID="gen3183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3184"/>et cujusvis manus pugnet contra me. <l eID="gen3184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1515"/><l level="1" sID="gen3185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1515"/>Cor eorum longe fecisti a disciplina : <l eID="gen3185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3186"/>propterea non exaltabuntur. <l eID="gen3186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1516"/><l level="1" sID="gen3187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1516"/>Prædam pollicetur sociis, <l eID="gen3187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3188"/>et oculi filiorum ejus deficient. <l eID="gen3188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1517"/><l level="1" sID="gen3189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1517"/>Posuit me quasi in proverbium vulgi, <l eID="gen3189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3190"/>et exemplum sum coram eis. <l eID="gen3190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1518"/><l level="1" sID="gen3191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1518"/>Caligavit ab indignatione oculus meus, <l eID="gen3191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3192"/>et membra mea quasi in nihilum redacta sunt. <l eID="gen3192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1519"/><l level="1" sID="gen3193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1519"/>Stupebunt justi super hoc, <l eID="gen3193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3194"/>et innocens contra hypocritam suscitabitur. <l eID="gen3194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1520"/><l level="1" sID="gen3195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1520"/>Et tenebit justus viam suam, <l eID="gen3195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3196"/>et mundis manibus addet fortitudinem. <l eID="gen3196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1521"/><l level="1" sID="gen3197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1521"/>Igitur omnes vos convertimini, et venite, <l eID="gen3197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3198"/>et non inveniam in vobis ullum sapientem. <l eID="gen3198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1522"/><l level="1" sID="gen3199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1522"/>Dies mei transierunt ; <l eID="gen3199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3200"/>cogitationes meæ dissipatæ sunt, <l eID="gen3200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3201"/>torquentes cor meum. <l eID="gen3201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1523"/><l level="1" sID="gen3202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1523"/>Noctem verterunt in diem, <l eID="gen3202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3203"/>et rursum post tenebras spero lucem. <l eID="gen3203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1524"/><l level="1" sID="gen3204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1524"/>Si sustinuero, infernus domus mea est, <l eID="gen3204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3205"/>et in tenebris stravi lectulum meum. <l eID="gen3205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1525"/><l level="1" sID="gen3206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1525"/>Putredini dixi : Pater meus es ; <l eID="gen3206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3207"/>Mater mea, et soror mea, vermibus. <l eID="gen3207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1526"/><l level="1" sID="gen3208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1526"/>Ubi est ergo nunc præstolatio mea ? <l eID="gen3208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3209"/>et patientiam meam quis considerat ? <l eID="gen3209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1527"/><l level="1" sID="gen3210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1527"/>In profundissimum infernum descendent omnia mea : <l eID="gen3210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3211"/>putasne saltem ibi erit requies mihi ? <l eID="gen3211" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3129"/> <chapter eID="Job.17"/>

verses.name: Job 18:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Baldad Suhites, dixit :  <div eID="gen3212" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1528"/><lg sID="gen3213"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1528"/>Usque ad quem finem verba jactabitis ? <l eID="gen3214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3215"/>intelligite prius, et sic loquamur. <l eID="gen3215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1529"/><l level="1" sID="gen3216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1529"/>Quare reputati sumus ut jumenta, <l eID="gen3216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3217"/>et sorduimus coram vobis ? <l eID="gen3217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1530"/><l level="1" sID="gen3218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1530"/>Qui perdis animam tuam in furore tuo, <l eID="gen3218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3219"/>numquid propter te derelinquetur terra, <l eID="gen3219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3220"/>et transferentur rupes de loco suo ? <l eID="gen3220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1531"/><l level="1" sID="gen3221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1531"/>Nonne lux impii extinguetur, <l eID="gen3221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3222"/>nec splendebit flamma ignis ejus ? <l eID="gen3222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1532"/><l level="1" sID="gen3223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1532"/>Lux obtenebrescet in tabernaculo illius, <l eID="gen3223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3224"/>et lucerna quæ super eum est extinguetur. <l eID="gen3224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1533"/><l level="1" sID="gen3225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1533"/>Arctabuntur gressus virtutis ejus, <l eID="gen3225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3226"/>et præcipitabit eum consilium suum. <l eID="gen3226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1534"/><l level="1" sID="gen3227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1534"/>Immisit enim in rete pedes suos, <l eID="gen3227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3228"/>et in maculis ejus ambulat. <l eID="gen3228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1535"/><l level="1" sID="gen3229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1535"/>Tenebitur planta illius laqueo, <l eID="gen3229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3230"/>et exardescet contra eum sitis. <l eID="gen3230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1536"/><l level="1" sID="gen3231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1536"/>Abscondita est in terra pedica ejus, <l eID="gen3231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3232"/>et decipula illius super semitam. <l eID="gen3232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1537"/><l level="1" sID="gen3233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1537"/>Undique terrebunt eum formidines, <l eID="gen3233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3234"/>et involvent pedes ejus. <l eID="gen3234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1538"/><l level="1" sID="gen3235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1538"/>Attenuetur fame robur ejus, <l eID="gen3235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3236"/>et inedia invadat costas illius. <l eID="gen3236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1539"/><l level="1" sID="gen3237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1539"/>Devoret pulchritudinem cutis ejus ; <l eID="gen3237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3238"/>consumat brachia illius primogenita mors. <l eID="gen3238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1540"/><l level="1" sID="gen3239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1540"/>Avellatur de tabernaculo suo fiducia ejus, <l eID="gen3239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3240"/>et calcet super eum, quasi rex, interitus. <l eID="gen3240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1541"/><l level="1" sID="gen3241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1541"/>Habitent in tabernaculo illius socii ejus qui non est ; <l eID="gen3241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3242"/>aspergatur in tabernaculo ejus sulphur. <l eID="gen3242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1542"/><l level="1" sID="gen3243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1542"/>Deorsum radices ejus siccentur : <l eID="gen3243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3244"/>sursum autem atteratur messis ejus. <l eID="gen3244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1543"/><l level="1" sID="gen3245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1543"/>Memoria illius pereat de terra, <l eID="gen3245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3246"/>et non celebretur nomen ejus in plateis. <l eID="gen3246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1544"/><l level="1" sID="gen3247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1544"/>Expellet eum de luce in tenebras, <l eID="gen3247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3248"/>et de orbe transferet eum. <l eID="gen3248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1545"/><l level="1" sID="gen3249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1545"/>Non erit semen ejus, neque progenies in populo suo, <l eID="gen3249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3250"/>nec ullæ reliquiæ in regionibus ejus. <l eID="gen3250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1546"/><l level="1" sID="gen3251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1546"/>In die ejus stupebunt novissimi, <l eID="gen3251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3252"/>et primos invadet horror. <l eID="gen3252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1547"/><l level="1" sID="gen3253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1547"/>Hæc sunt ergo tabernacula iniqui, <l eID="gen3253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3254"/>et iste locus ejus qui ignorat Deum. <l eID="gen3254" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3213"/> <chapter eID="Job.18"/>

verses.name: Job 19:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Job, dixit :  <div eID="gen3255" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1548"/><lg sID="gen3256"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1548"/>Usquequo affligitis animam meam, <l eID="gen3257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3258"/>et atteritis me sermonibus ? <l eID="gen3258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1549"/><l level="1" sID="gen3259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1549"/>En decies confunditis me, <l eID="gen3259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3260"/>et non erubescitis opprimentes me. <l eID="gen3260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1550"/><l level="1" sID="gen3261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1550"/>Nempe etsi ignoravi, <l eID="gen3261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3262"/>mecum erit ignorantia mea. <l eID="gen3262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1551"/><l level="1" sID="gen3263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1551"/>At vos contra me erigimini, <l eID="gen3263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3264"/>et arguitis me opprobriis meis. <l eID="gen3264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1552"/><l level="1" sID="gen3265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1552"/>Saltem nunc intelligite quia Deus non æquo judicio afflixerit me, <l eID="gen3265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3266"/>et flagellis suis me cinxerit. <l eID="gen3266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1553"/><l level="1" sID="gen3267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1553"/>Ecce clamabo, vim patiens, et nemo audiet ; <l eID="gen3267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3268"/>vociferabor, et non est qui judicet. <l eID="gen3268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1554"/><l level="1" sID="gen3269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1554"/>Semitam meam circumsepsit, et transire non possum : <l eID="gen3269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3270"/>et in calle meo tenebras posuit. <l eID="gen3270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1555"/><l level="1" sID="gen3271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1555"/>Spoliavit me gloria mea, <l eID="gen3271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3272"/>et abstulit coronam de capite meo. <l eID="gen3272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1556"/><l level="1" sID="gen3273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1556"/>Destruxit me undique, et pereo : <l eID="gen3273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3274"/>et quasi evulsæ arbori abstulit spem meam. <l eID="gen3274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1557"/><l level="1" sID="gen3275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1557"/>Iratus est contra me furor ejus, <l eID="gen3275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3276"/>et sic me habuit quasi hostem suum. <l eID="gen3276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1558"/><l level="1" sID="gen3277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1558"/>Simul venerunt latrones ejus, <l eID="gen3277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3278"/>et fecerunt sibi viam per me, <l eID="gen3278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3279"/>et obsederunt in gyro tabernaculum meum. <l eID="gen3279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1559"/><l level="1" sID="gen3280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1559"/>Fratres meos longe fecit a me, <l eID="gen3280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3281"/>et noti mei quasi alieni recesserunt a me. <l eID="gen3281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1560"/><l level="1" sID="gen3282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1560"/>Dereliquerunt me propinqui mei, <l eID="gen3282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3283"/>et qui me noverant obliti sunt mei. <l eID="gen3283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1561"/><l level="1" sID="gen3284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1561"/>Inquilini domus meæ et ancillæ meæ sicut alienum habuerunt me, <l eID="gen3284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3285"/>et quasi peregrinus fui in oculis eorum. <l eID="gen3285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1562"/><l level="1" sID="gen3286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1562"/>Servum meum vocavi, et non respondit : <l eID="gen3286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3287"/>ore proprio deprecabar illum. <l eID="gen3287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1563"/><l level="1" sID="gen3288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1563"/>Halitum meum exhorruit uxor mea, <l eID="gen3288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3289"/>et orabam filios uteri mei. <l eID="gen3289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1564"/><l level="1" sID="gen3290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1564"/>Stulti quoque despiciebant me : <l eID="gen3290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3291"/>et cum ab eis recessissem, detrahebant mihi. <l eID="gen3291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1565"/><l level="1" sID="gen3292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1565"/>Abominati sunt me quondam consiliarii mei, <l eID="gen3292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3293"/>et quem maxime diligebam, aversatus est me. <l eID="gen3293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1566"/><l level="1" sID="gen3294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1566"/>Pelli meæ, consumptis carnibus, adhæsit os meum, <l eID="gen3294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3295"/>et derelicta sunt tantummodo labia circa dentes meos. <l eID="gen3295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1567"/><l level="1" sID="gen3296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1567"/>Miseremini mei, miseremini mei saltem vos, amici mei, <l eID="gen3296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3297"/>quia manus Domini tetigit me. <l eID="gen3297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1568"/><l level="1" sID="gen3298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1568"/>Quare persequimini me sicut Deus, <l eID="gen3298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3299"/>et carnibus meis saturamini ? <l eID="gen3299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1569"/><l level="1" sID="gen3300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1569"/>Quis mihi tribuat ut scribantur sermones mei ? <l eID="gen3300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3301"/>quis mihi det ut exarentur in libro <l eID="gen3301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1570"/><l level="1" sID="gen3302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1570"/>stylo ferreo et plumbi lamina, <l eID="gen3302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3303"/>vel celte sculpantur in silice ? <l eID="gen3303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1571"/><l level="1" sID="gen3304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1571"/>Scio enim quod redemptor meus vivit, <l eID="gen3304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3305"/>et in novissimo die de terra surrecturus sum : <l eID="gen3305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1572"/><l level="1" sID="gen3306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1572"/>et rursum circumdabor pelle mea, <l eID="gen3306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3307"/>et in carne mea videbo Deum meum : <l eID="gen3307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1573"/><l level="1" sID="gen3308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1573"/>quem visurus sum ego ipse, <l eID="gen3308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3309"/>et oculi mei conspecturi sunt, et non alius : <l eID="gen3309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3310"/>reposita est hæc spes mea in sinu meo. <l eID="gen3310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1574"/><l level="1" sID="gen3311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1574"/>Quare ergo nunc dicitis : Persequamur eum, <l eID="gen3311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3312"/>et radicem verbi inveniamus contra eum ? <l eID="gen3312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 19:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1575"/><l level="1" sID="gen3313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1575"/>Fugite ergo a facie gladii, <l eID="gen3313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3314"/>quoniam ultor iniquitatum gladius est : <l eID="gen3314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3315"/>et scitote esse judicium. <l eID="gen3315" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3256"/> <chapter eID="Job.19"/>

verses.name: Job 20:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Sophar Naamathites, dixit :  <div eID="gen3316" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 20:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1576"/><lg sID="gen3317"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1576"/>Idcirco cogitationes meæ variæ succedunt sibi, <l eID="gen3318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3319"/>et mens in diversa rapitur. <l eID="gen3319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1577"/><l level="1" sID="gen3320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1577"/>Doctrinam qua me arguis audiam, <l eID="gen3320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3321"/>et spiritus intelligentiæ meæ respondebit mihi. <l eID="gen3321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1578"/><l level="1" sID="gen3322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1578"/>Hoc scio a principio, <l eID="gen3322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3323"/>ex quo positus est homo super terram, <l eID="gen3323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1579"/><l level="1" sID="gen3324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1579"/>quod laus impiorum brevis sit, <l eID="gen3324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3325"/>et gaudium hypocritæ ad instar puncti. <l eID="gen3325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1580"/><l level="1" sID="gen3326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1580"/>Si ascenderit usque ad cælum superbia ejus, <l eID="gen3326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3327"/>et caput ejus nubes tetigerit, <l eID="gen3327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1581"/><l level="1" sID="gen3328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1581"/>quasi sterquilinium in fine perdetur, <l eID="gen3328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3329"/>et qui eum viderant, dicent : Ubi est ? <l eID="gen3329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1582"/><l level="1" sID="gen3330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1582"/>Velut somnium avolans non invenietur : <l eID="gen3330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3331"/>transiet sicut visio nocturna. <l eID="gen3331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1583"/><l level="1" sID="gen3332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1583"/>Oculus qui eum viderat non videbit, <l eID="gen3332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3333"/>neque ultra intuebitur eum locus suus. <l eID="gen3333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1584"/><l level="1" sID="gen3334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1584"/>Filii ejus atterentur egestate, <l eID="gen3334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3335"/>et manus illius reddent ei dolorem suum. <l eID="gen3335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1585"/><l level="1" sID="gen3336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1585"/>Ossa ejus implebuntur vitiis adolescentiæ ejus, <l eID="gen3336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3337"/>et cum eo in pulvere dormient. <l eID="gen3337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1586"/><l level="1" sID="gen3338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1586"/>Cum enim dulce fuerit in ore ejus malum, <l eID="gen3338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3339"/>abscondet illud sub lingua sua. <l eID="gen3339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1587"/><l level="1" sID="gen3340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1587"/>Parcet illi, et non derelinquet illud, <l eID="gen3340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3341"/>et celabit in gutture suo. <l eID="gen3341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1588"/><l level="1" sID="gen3342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1588"/>Panis ejus in utero illius <l eID="gen3342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3343"/>vertetur in fel aspidum intrinsecus. <l eID="gen3343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1589"/><l level="1" sID="gen3344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1589"/>Divitias quas devoravit evomet, <l eID="gen3344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3345"/>et de ventre illius extrahet eas Deus. <l eID="gen3345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1590"/><l level="1" sID="gen3346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1590"/>Caput aspidum suget, <l eID="gen3346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3347"/>et occidet eum lingua viperæ. <l eID="gen3347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1591"/><l level="1" sID="gen3348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1591"/>(Non videat rivulos fluminis, <l eID="gen3348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3349"/>torrentes mellis et butyri.) <l eID="gen3349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1592"/><l level="1" sID="gen3350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1592"/>Luet quæ fecit omnia, nec tamen consumetur : <l eID="gen3350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3351"/>juxta multitudinem adinventionum suarum, sic et sustinebit. <l eID="gen3351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1593"/><l level="1" sID="gen3352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1593"/>Quoniam confringens nudavit pauperes : <l eID="gen3352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3353"/>domum rapuit, et non ædificavit eam. <l eID="gen3353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1594"/><l level="1" sID="gen3354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1594"/>Nec est satiatus venter ejus : <l eID="gen3354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3355"/>et cum habuerit quæ concupierat, possidere non poterit. <l eID="gen3355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1595"/><l level="1" sID="gen3356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1595"/>Non remansit de cibo ejus, <l eID="gen3356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3357"/>et propterea nihil permanebit de bonis ejus. <l eID="gen3357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1596"/><l level="1" sID="gen3358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1596"/>Cum satiatus fuerit, arctabitur : <l eID="gen3358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3359"/>æstuabit, et omnis dolor irruet super eum. <l eID="gen3359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1597"/><l level="1" sID="gen3360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1597"/>Utinam impleatur venter ejus, <l eID="gen3360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3361"/>ut emittat in eum iram furoris sui, <l eID="gen3361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3362"/>et pluat super illum bellum suum. <l eID="gen3362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1598"/><l level="1" sID="gen3363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1598"/>Fugiet arma ferrea, <l eID="gen3363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3364"/>et irruet in arcum æreum. <l eID="gen3364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1599"/><l level="1" sID="gen3365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1599"/>Eductus, et egrediens de vagina sua, <l eID="gen3365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3366"/>et fulgurans in amaritudine sua : <l eID="gen3366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3367"/>vadent et venient super eum horribiles. <l eID="gen3367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1600"/><l level="1" sID="gen3368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1600"/>Omnes tenebræ absconditæ sunt in occultis ejus ; <l eID="gen3368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3369"/>devorabit eum ignis qui non succenditur : <l eID="gen3369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3370"/>affligetur relictus in tabernaculo suo. <l eID="gen3370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1601"/><l level="1" sID="gen3371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1601"/>Revelabunt cæli iniquitatem ejus, <l eID="gen3371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3372"/>et terra consurget adversus eum. <l eID="gen3372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1602"/><l level="1" sID="gen3373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1602"/>Apertum erit germen domus illius : <l eID="gen3373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3374"/>detrahetur in die furoris Dei. <l eID="gen3374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 20:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1603"/><l level="1" sID="gen3375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1603"/>Hæc est pars hominis impii a Deo, <l eID="gen3375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3376"/>et hæreditas verborum ejus a Domino. <l eID="gen3376" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3317"/> <chapter eID="Job.20"/>

verses.name: Job 21:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Job, dixit :  <div eID="gen3377" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1604"/><lg sID="gen3378"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1604"/>Audite, quæso, sermones meos, <l eID="gen3379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3380"/>et agite pœnitentiam. <l eID="gen3380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1605"/><l level="1" sID="gen3381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1605"/>Sustinete me, et ego loquar : <l eID="gen3381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3382"/>et post mea, si videbitur, verba, ridete. <l eID="gen3382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1606"/><l level="1" sID="gen3383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1606"/>Numquid contra hominem disputatio mea est, <l eID="gen3383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3384"/>ut merito non debeam contristari ? <l eID="gen3384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1607"/><l level="1" sID="gen3385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1607"/>Attendite me et obstupescite, <l eID="gen3385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3386"/>et superponite digitum ori vestro. <l eID="gen3386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1608"/><l level="1" sID="gen3387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1608"/>Et ego, quando recordatus fuero, pertimesco, <l eID="gen3387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3388"/>et concutit carnem meam tremor. <l eID="gen3388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1609"/><l level="1" sID="gen3389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1609"/>Quare ergo impii vivunt, <l eID="gen3389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3390"/>sublevati sunt, confortatique divitiis ? <l eID="gen3390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1610"/><l level="1" sID="gen3391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1610"/>Semen eorum permanet coram eis : <l eID="gen3391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3392"/>propinquorum turba et nepotum in conspectu eorum. <l eID="gen3392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1611"/><l level="1" sID="gen3393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1611"/>Domus eorum securæ sunt et pacatæ, <l eID="gen3393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3394"/>et non est virga Dei super illos. <l eID="gen3394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1612"/><l level="1" sID="gen3395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1612"/>Bos eorum concepit, et non abortivit : <l eID="gen3395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3396"/>vacca peperit, et non est privata fœtu suo. <l eID="gen3396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1613"/><l level="1" sID="gen3397"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1613"/>Egrediuntur quasi greges parvuli eorum, <l eID="gen3397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3398"/>et infantes eorum exultant lusibus. <l eID="gen3398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1614"/><l level="1" sID="gen3399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1614"/>Tenent tympanum et citharam, <l eID="gen3399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3400"/>et gaudent ad sonitum organi. <l eID="gen3400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1615"/><l level="1" sID="gen3401"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1615"/>Ducunt in bonis dies suos, <l eID="gen3401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3402"/>et in puncto ad inferna descendunt. <l eID="gen3402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1616"/><l level="1" sID="gen3403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1616"/>Qui dixerunt Deo : Recede a nobis, <l eID="gen3403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3404"/>et scientiam viarum tuarum nolumus. <l eID="gen3404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1617"/><l level="1" sID="gen3405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1617"/>Quis est Omnipotens, ut serviamus ei ? <l eID="gen3405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3406"/>et quid nobis prodest si oraverimus illum ? <l eID="gen3406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1618"/><l level="1" sID="gen3407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1618"/>Verumtamen quia non sunt in manu eorum bona sua, <l eID="gen3407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3408"/>consilium impiorum longe sit a me. <l eID="gen3408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1619"/><l level="1" sID="gen3409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1619"/>Quoties lucerna impiorum extinguetur, <l eID="gen3409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3410"/>et superveniet eis inundatio, <l eID="gen3410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3411"/>et dolores dividet furoris sui ? <l eID="gen3411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1620"/><l level="1" sID="gen3412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1620"/>Erunt sicut paleæ ante faciem venti, <l eID="gen3412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3413"/>et sicut favilla quam turbo dispergit. <l eID="gen3413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1621"/><l level="1" sID="gen3414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1621"/>Deus servabit filiis illius dolorem patris, <l eID="gen3414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3415"/>et cum reddiderit, tunc sciet. <l eID="gen3415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1622"/><l level="1" sID="gen3416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1622"/>Videbunt oculi ejus interfectionem suam, <l eID="gen3416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3417"/>et de furore Omnipotentis bibet. <l eID="gen3417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1623"/><l level="1" sID="gen3418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1623"/>Quid enim ad eum pertinet de domo sua post se, <l eID="gen3418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3419"/>et si numerus mensium ejus dimidietur ? <l eID="gen3419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1624"/><l level="1" sID="gen3420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1624"/>Numquid Deus docebit quispiam scientiam, <l eID="gen3420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3421"/>qui excelsos judicat ? <l eID="gen3421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1625"/><l level="1" sID="gen3422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1625"/>Iste moritur robustus et sanus, <l eID="gen3422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3423"/>dives et felix : <l eID="gen3423" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1626"/><l level="1" sID="gen3424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1626"/>viscera ejus plena sunt adipe, <l eID="gen3424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3425"/>et medullis ossa illius irrigantur : <l eID="gen3425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1627"/><l level="1" sID="gen3426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1627"/>alius vero moritur in amaritudine animæ <l eID="gen3426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3427"/>absque ullis opibus : <l eID="gen3427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1628"/><l level="1" sID="gen3428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1628"/>et tamen simul in pulvere dormient, <l eID="gen3428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3429"/>et vermes operient eos. <l eID="gen3429" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1629"/><l level="1" sID="gen3430"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1629"/>Certe novi cogitationes vestras, <l eID="gen3430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3431"/>et sententias contra me iniquas. <l eID="gen3431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1630"/><l level="1" sID="gen3432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1630"/>Dicitis enim : Ubi est domus principis ? <l eID="gen3432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3433"/>et ubi tabernacula impiorum ? <l eID="gen3433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1631"/><l level="1" sID="gen3434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1631"/>Interrogate quemlibet de viatoribus, <l eID="gen3434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3435"/>et hæc eadem illum intelligere cognoscetis : <l eID="gen3435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1632"/><l level="1" sID="gen3436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1632"/>quia in diem perditionis servatur malus, <l eID="gen3436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3437"/>et ad diem furoris ducetur. <l eID="gen3437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1633"/><l level="1" sID="gen3438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1633"/>Quis arguet coram eo viam ejus ? <l eID="gen3438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3439"/>et quæ fecit, quis reddet illi ? <l eID="gen3439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1634"/><l level="1" sID="gen3440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1634"/>Ipse ad sepulchra ducetur, <l eID="gen3440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3441"/>et in congerie mortuorum vigilabit. <l eID="gen3441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1635"/><l level="1" sID="gen3442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1635"/>Dulcis fuit glareis Cocyti, <l eID="gen3442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3443"/>et post se omnem hominem trahet, <l eID="gen3443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3444"/>et ante se innumerabiles. <l eID="gen3444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 21:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1636"/><l level="1" sID="gen3445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1636"/>Quomodo igitur consolamini me frustra, <l eID="gen3445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3446"/>cum responsio vestra repugnare ostensa sit veritati ? <l eID="gen3446" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3378"/> <chapter eID="Job.21"/>

verses.name: Job 22:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Eliphaz Themanites, dixit :  <div eID="gen3447" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1637"/><lg sID="gen3448"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1637"/>Numquid Deo potest comparari homo, <l eID="gen3449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3450"/>etiam cum perfectæ fuerit scientiæ ? <l eID="gen3450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1638"/><l level="1" sID="gen3451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1638"/>Quid prodest Deo, si justus fueris ? <l eID="gen3451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3452"/>aut quid ei confers, si immaculata fuerit via tua ? <l eID="gen3452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1639"/><l level="1" sID="gen3453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1639"/>Numquid timens arguet te, <l eID="gen3453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3454"/>et veniet tecum in judicium, <l eID="gen3454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1640"/><l level="1" sID="gen3455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1640"/>et non propter malitiam tuam plurimam, <l eID="gen3455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3456"/>et infinitas iniquitates tuas ? <l eID="gen3456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1641"/><l level="1" sID="gen3457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1641"/>Abstulisti enim pignus fratrum tuorum sine causa, <l eID="gen3457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3458"/>et nudos spoliasti vestibus. <l eID="gen3458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1642"/><l level="1" sID="gen3459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1642"/>Aquam lasso non dedisti, <l eID="gen3459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3460"/>et esurienti subtraxisti panem. <l eID="gen3460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1643"/><l level="1" sID="gen3461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1643"/>In fortitudine brachii tui possidebas terram, <l eID="gen3461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3462"/>et potentissimus obtinebas eam. <l eID="gen3462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1644"/><l level="1" sID="gen3463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1644"/>Viduas dimisisti vacuas, <l eID="gen3463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3464"/>et lacertos pupillorum comminuisti. <l eID="gen3464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1645"/><l level="1" sID="gen3465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1645"/>Propterea circumdatus es laqueis, <l eID="gen3465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3466"/>et conturbat te formido subita. <l eID="gen3466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1646"/><l level="1" sID="gen3467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1646"/>Et putabas te tenebras non visurum, <l eID="gen3467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3468"/>et impetu aquarum inundantium non oppressum iri ? <l eID="gen3468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1647"/><l level="1" sID="gen3469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1647"/>an non cogitas quod Deus excelsior cælo sit, <l eID="gen3469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3470"/>et super stellarum verticem sublimetur ? <l eID="gen3470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1648"/><l level="1" sID="gen3471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1648"/>Et dicis : Quid enim novit Deus ? <l eID="gen3471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3472"/>et quasi per caliginem judicat. <l eID="gen3472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1649"/><l level="1" sID="gen3473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1649"/>Nubes latibulum ejus, nec nostra considerat, <l eID="gen3473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3474"/>et circa cardines cæli perambulat. <l eID="gen3474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1650"/><l level="1" sID="gen3475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1650"/>Numquid semitam sæculorum custodire cupis, <l eID="gen3475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3476"/>quam calcaverunt viri iniqui, <l eID="gen3476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1651"/><l level="1" sID="gen3477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1651"/>qui sublati sunt ante tempus suum, <l eID="gen3477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3478"/>et fluvius subvertit fundamentum eorum ? <l eID="gen3478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1652"/><l level="1" sID="gen3479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1652"/>Qui dicebant Deo : Recede a nobis : <l eID="gen3479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3480"/>et quasi nihil posset facere Omnipotens, æstimabant eum, <l eID="gen3480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1653"/><l level="1" sID="gen3481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1653"/>cum ille implesset domos eorum bonis : <l eID="gen3481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3482"/>quorum sententia procul sit a me. <l eID="gen3482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1654"/><l level="1" sID="gen3483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1654"/>Videbunt justi, et lætabuntur, <l eID="gen3483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3484"/>et innocens subsannabit eos : <l eID="gen3484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1655"/><l level="1" sID="gen3485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1655"/>nonne succisa est erectio eorum ? <l eID="gen3485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3486"/>et reliquias eorum devoravit ignis ? <l eID="gen3486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1656"/><l level="1" sID="gen3487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1656"/>Acquiesce igitur ei, et habeto pacem, <l eID="gen3487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3488"/>et per hæc habebis fructus optimos. <l eID="gen3488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1657"/><l level="1" sID="gen3489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1657"/>Suscipe ex ore illius legem, <l eID="gen3489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3490"/>et pone sermones ejus in corde tuo. <l eID="gen3490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1658"/><l level="1" sID="gen3491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1658"/>Si reversus fueris ad Omnipotentem, ædificaberis, <l eID="gen3491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3492"/>et longe facies iniquitatem a tabernaculo tuo. <l eID="gen3492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1659"/><l level="1" sID="gen3493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1659"/>Dabit pro terra silicem, <l eID="gen3493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3494"/>et pro silice torrentes aureos. <l eID="gen3494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1660"/><l level="1" sID="gen3495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1660"/>Eritque Omnipotens contra hostes tuos, <l eID="gen3495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3496"/>et argentum coacervabitur tibi. <l eID="gen3496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1661"/><l level="1" sID="gen3497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1661"/>Tunc super Omnipotentem deliciis afflues, <l eID="gen3497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3498"/>et elevabis ad Deum faciem tuam. <l eID="gen3498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1662"/><l level="1" sID="gen3499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1662"/>Rogabis eum, et exaudiet te, <l eID="gen3499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3500"/>et vota tua reddes. <l eID="gen3500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1663"/><l level="1" sID="gen3501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1663"/>Decernes rem, et veniet tibi, <l eID="gen3501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3502"/>et in viis tuis splendebit lumen. <l eID="gen3502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1664"/><l level="1" sID="gen3503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1664"/>Qui enim humiliatus fuerit, erit in gloria, <l eID="gen3503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3504"/>et qui inclinaverit oculos, ipse salvabitur. <l eID="gen3504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 22:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1665"/><l level="1" sID="gen3505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1665"/>Salvabitur innocens : <l eID="gen3505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3506"/>salvabitur autem in munditia manuum suarum. <l eID="gen3506" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3448"/> <chapter eID="Job.22"/>

verses.name: Job 23:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Job, ait :  <div eID="gen3507" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1666"/><lg sID="gen3508"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1666"/>Nunc quoque in amaritudine est sermo meus, <l eID="gen3509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3510"/>et manus plagæ meæ aggravata est super gemitum meum. <l eID="gen3510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1667"/><l level="1" sID="gen3511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1667"/>Quis mihi tribuat ut cognoscam et inveniam illum, <l eID="gen3511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3512"/>et veniam usque ad solium ejus ? <l eID="gen3512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1668"/><l level="1" sID="gen3513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1668"/>Ponam coram eo judicium, <l eID="gen3513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3514"/>et os meum replebo increpationibus : <l eID="gen3514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1669"/><l level="1" sID="gen3515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1669"/>ut sciam verba quæ mihi respondeat, <l eID="gen3515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3516"/>et intelligam quid loquatur mihi. <l eID="gen3516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1670"/><l level="1" sID="gen3517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1670"/>Nolo multa fortitudine contendat mecum, <l eID="gen3517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3518"/>nec magnitudinis suæ mole me premat. <l eID="gen3518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1671"/><l level="1" sID="gen3519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1671"/>Proponat æquitatem contra me, <l eID="gen3519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3520"/>et perveniat ad victoriam judicium meum. <l eID="gen3520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1672"/><l level="1" sID="gen3521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1672"/>Si ad orientem iero, non apparet ; <l eID="gen3521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3522"/>si ad occidentem, non intelligam eum. <l eID="gen3522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1673"/><l level="1" sID="gen3523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1673"/>Si ad sinistram, quid agam ? non apprehendam eum ; <l eID="gen3523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3524"/>si me vertam ad dexteram, non videbo illum. <l eID="gen3524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1674"/><l level="1" sID="gen3525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1674"/>Ipse vero scit viam meam, <l eID="gen3525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3526"/>et probavit me quasi aurum quod per ignem transit. <l eID="gen3526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1675"/><l level="1" sID="gen3527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1675"/>Vestigia ejus secutus est pes meus : <l eID="gen3527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3528"/>viam ejus custodivi, et non declinavi ex ea. <l eID="gen3528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1676"/><l level="1" sID="gen3529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1676"/>A mandatis labiorum ejus non recessi, <l eID="gen3529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3530"/>et in sinu meo abscondi verba oris ejus. <l eID="gen3530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1677"/><l level="1" sID="gen3531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1677"/>Ipse enim solus est, et nemo avertere potest cogitationem ejus : <l eID="gen3531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3532"/>et anima ejus quodcumque voluit, hoc fecit. <l eID="gen3532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1678"/><l level="1" sID="gen3533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1678"/>Cum expleverit in me voluntatem suam, <l eID="gen3533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3534"/>et alia multa similia præsto sunt ei. <l eID="gen3534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1679"/><l level="1" sID="gen3535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1679"/>Et idcirco a facie ejus turbatus sum, <l eID="gen3535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3536"/>et considerans eum, timore sollicitor. <l eID="gen3536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1680"/><l level="1" sID="gen3537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1680"/>Deus mollivit cor meum, <l eID="gen3537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3538"/>et Omnipotens conturbavit me. <l eID="gen3538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1681"/><l level="1" sID="gen3539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1681"/>Non enim perii propter imminentes tenebras, <l eID="gen3539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3540"/>nec faciem meam operuit caligo.  <chapter eID="Job.23"/>

verses.name: Job 24:1
verses.text: Ab Omnipotente non sunt abscondita tempora : <l eID="gen3541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3542"/>qui autem noverunt eum, <l eID="gen3542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3543"/>ignorant dies illius. <l eID="gen3543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1682"/><l level="1" sID="gen3544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1682"/>Alii terminos transtulerunt ; <l eID="gen3544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3545"/>diripuerunt greges, et paverunt eos. <l eID="gen3545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1683"/><l level="1" sID="gen3546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1683"/>Asinum pupillorum abegerunt, <l eID="gen3546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3547"/>et abstulerunt pro pignore bovem viduæ. <l eID="gen3547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1684"/><l level="1" sID="gen3548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1684"/>Subverterunt pauperum viam, <l eID="gen3548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3549"/>et oppresserunt pariter mansuetos terræ. <l eID="gen3549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1685"/><l level="1" sID="gen3550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1685"/>Alii quasi onagri in deserto egrediuntur ad opus suum : <l eID="gen3550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3551"/>vigilantes ad prædam, præparant panem liberis. <l eID="gen3551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1686"/><l level="1" sID="gen3552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1686"/>Agrum non suum demetunt, <l eID="gen3552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3553"/>et vineam ejus, quem vi oppresserint, vindemiant. <l eID="gen3553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1687"/><l level="1" sID="gen3554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1687"/>Nudos dimittunt homines, indumenta tollentes, <l eID="gen3554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3555"/>quibus non est operimentum in frigore : <l eID="gen3555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1688"/><l level="1" sID="gen3556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1688"/>quos imbres montium rigant, <l eID="gen3556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3557"/>et non habentes velamen, amplexantur lapides. <l eID="gen3557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1689"/><l level="1" sID="gen3558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1689"/>Vim fecerunt deprædantes pupillos, <l eID="gen3558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3559"/>et vulgum pauperem spoliaverunt. <l eID="gen3559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1690"/><l level="1" sID="gen3560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1690"/>Nudis et incedentibus absque vestitu, <l eID="gen3560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3561"/>et esurientibus tulerunt spicas. <l eID="gen3561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1691"/><l level="1" sID="gen3562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1691"/>Inter acervos eorum meridiati sunt, <l eID="gen3562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3563"/>qui calcatis torcularibus sitiunt. <l eID="gen3563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1692"/><l level="1" sID="gen3564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1692"/>De civitatibus fecerunt viros gemere, <l eID="gen3564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3565"/>et anima vulneratorum clamavit : <l eID="gen3565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3566"/>et Deus inultum abire non patitur. <l eID="gen3566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1693"/><l level="1" sID="gen3567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1693"/>Ipsi fuerunt rebelles lumini : <l eID="gen3567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3568"/>nescierunt vias ejus, <l eID="gen3568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3569"/>nec reversi sunt per semitas ejus. <l eID="gen3569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1694"/><l level="1" sID="gen3570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1694"/>Mane primo consurgit homicida ; <l eID="gen3570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3571"/>interficit egenum et pauperem : <l eID="gen3571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3572"/>per noctem vero erit quasi fur. <l eID="gen3572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1695"/><l level="1" sID="gen3573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1695"/>Oculus adulteri observat caliginem, <l eID="gen3573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3574"/>dicens : Non me videbit oculus : <l eID="gen3574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3575"/>et operiet vultum suum. <l eID="gen3575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1696"/><l level="1" sID="gen3576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1696"/>Perfodit in tenebris domos, <l eID="gen3576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3577"/>sicut in die condixerant sibi, <l eID="gen3577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3578"/>et ignoraverunt lucem. <l eID="gen3578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1697"/><l level="1" sID="gen3579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1697"/>Si subito apparuerit aurora, arbitrantur umbram mortis : <l eID="gen3579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3580"/>et sic in tenebris quasi in luce ambulant. <l eID="gen3580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1698"/><l level="1" sID="gen3581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1698"/>Levis est super faciem aquæ : <l eID="gen3581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3582"/>maledicta sit pars ejus in terra, <l eID="gen3582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3583"/>nec ambulet per viam vinearum. <l eID="gen3583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1699"/><l level="1" sID="gen3584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1699"/>Ad nimium calorem transeat ab aquis nivium, <l eID="gen3584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3585"/>et usque ad inferos peccatum illius. <l eID="gen3585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1700"/><l level="1" sID="gen3586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1700"/>Obliviscatur ejus misericordia ; dulcedo illius vermes : <l eID="gen3586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3587"/>non sit in recordatione, <l eID="gen3587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3588"/>sed conteratur quasi lignum infructuosum. <l eID="gen3588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1701"/><l level="1" sID="gen3589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1701"/>Pavit enim sterilem quæ non parit, <l eID="gen3589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3590"/>et viduæ bene non fecit. <l eID="gen3590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1702"/><l level="1" sID="gen3591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1702"/>Detraxit fortes in fortitudine sua, <l eID="gen3591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3592"/>et cum steterit, non credet vitæ suæ. <l eID="gen3592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1703"/><l level="1" sID="gen3593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1703"/>Dedit ei Deus locum pœnitentiæ, <l eID="gen3593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3594"/>et ille abutitur eo in superbiam : <l eID="gen3594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3595"/>oculi autem ejus sunt in viis illius. <l eID="gen3595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1704"/><l level="1" sID="gen3596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1704"/>Elevati sunt ad modicum, et non subsistent : <l eID="gen3596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3597"/>et humiliabuntur sicut omnia, et auferentur, <l eID="gen3597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3598"/>et sicut summitates spicarum conterentur. <l eID="gen3598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 24:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1705"/><l level="1" sID="gen3599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1705"/>Quod si non est ita, quis me potest arguere esse mentitum, <l eID="gen3599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3600"/>et ponere ante Deum verba mea ? <l eID="gen3600" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3508"/> <chapter eID="Job.24"/>

verses.name: Job 25:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Baldad Suhites, dixit :  <div eID="gen3601" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1706"/><lg sID="gen3602"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1706"/>Potestas et terror apud eum est, <l eID="gen3603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3604"/>qui facit concordiam in sublimibus suis. <l eID="gen3604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1707"/><l level="1" sID="gen3605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1707"/>Numquid est numerus militum ejus ? <l eID="gen3605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3606"/>et super quem non surget lumen illius ? <l eID="gen3606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1708"/><l level="1" sID="gen3607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1708"/>Numquid justificari potest homo comparatus Deo ? <l eID="gen3607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3608"/>aut apparere mundus natus de muliere ? <l eID="gen3608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1709"/><l level="1" sID="gen3609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1709"/>Ecce luna etiam non splendet, <l eID="gen3609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3610"/>et stellæ non sunt mundæ in conspectu ejus : <l eID="gen3610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1710"/><l level="1" sID="gen3611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1710"/>quanto magis homo putredo, <l eID="gen3611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3612"/>et filius hominis vermis ? <l eID="gen3612" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3602"/> <chapter eID="Job.25"/>

verses.name: Job 26:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Job dixit :  <div eID="gen3613" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1711"/><lg sID="gen3614"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1711"/>Cujus adjutor es ? numquid imbecillis ? <l eID="gen3615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3616"/>et sustentas brachium ejus qui non est fortis ? <l eID="gen3616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1712"/><l level="1" sID="gen3617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1712"/>Cui dedisti consilium ? <l eID="gen3617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3618"/>forsitan illi qui non habet sapientiam : <l eID="gen3618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3619"/>et prudentiam tuam ostendisti plurimam. <l eID="gen3619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1713"/><l level="1" sID="gen3620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1713"/>Quem docere voluisti ? <l eID="gen3620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3621"/>nonne eum qui fecit spiramentum ? <l eID="gen3621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1714"/><l level="1" sID="gen3622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1714"/>Ecce gigantes gemunt sub aquis, <l eID="gen3622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3623"/>et qui habitant cum eis. <l eID="gen3623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1715"/><l level="1" sID="gen3624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1715"/>Nudus est infernus coram illo, <l eID="gen3624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3625"/>et nullum est operimentum perditioni. <l eID="gen3625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1716"/><l level="1" sID="gen3626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1716"/>Qui extendit aquilonem super vacuum, <l eID="gen3626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3627"/>et appendit terram super nihilum. <l eID="gen3627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1717"/><l level="1" sID="gen3628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1717"/>Qui ligat aquas in nubibus suis, <l eID="gen3628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3629"/>ut non erumpant pariter deorsum. <l eID="gen3629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1718"/><l level="1" sID="gen3630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1718"/>Qui tenet vultum solii sui, <l eID="gen3630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3631"/>et expandit super illud nebulam suam. <l eID="gen3631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1719"/><l level="1" sID="gen3632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1719"/>Terminum circumdedit aquis, <l eID="gen3632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3633"/>usque dum finiantur lux et tenebræ. <l eID="gen3633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1720"/><l level="1" sID="gen3634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1720"/>Columnæ cæli contremiscunt, <l eID="gen3634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3635"/>et pavent ad nutum ejus. <l eID="gen3635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1721"/><l level="1" sID="gen3636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1721"/>In fortitudine illius repente maria congregata sunt, <l eID="gen3636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3637"/>et prudentia ejus percussit superbum. <l eID="gen3637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1722"/><l level="1" sID="gen3638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1722"/>Spiritus ejus ornavit cælos, <l eID="gen3638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3639"/>et obstetricante manu ejus, eductus est coluber tortuosus. <l eID="gen3639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1723"/><l level="1" sID="gen3640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1723"/>Ecce hæc ex parte dicta sunt viarum ejus : <l eID="gen3640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3641"/>et cum vix parvam stillam sermonis ejus audierimus, <l eID="gen3641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3642"/>quis poterit tonitruum magnitudinis illius intueri ? <l eID="gen3642" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3614"/> <chapter eID="Job.26"/>

verses.name: Job 27:1
verses.text: Addidit quoque Job, assumens parabolam suam, et dixit :  <div eID="gen3643" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1724"/><lg sID="gen3644"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1724"/>Vivit Deus, qui abstulit judicium meum, <l eID="gen3645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3646"/>et Omnipotens, qui ad amaritudinem adduxit animam meam. <l eID="gen3646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1725"/><l level="1" sID="gen3647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1725"/>Quia donec superest halitus in me, <l eID="gen3647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3648"/>et spiritus Dei in naribus meis, <l eID="gen3648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1726"/><l level="1" sID="gen3649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1726"/>non loquentur labia mea iniquitatem, <l eID="gen3649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3650"/>nec lingua mea meditabitur mendacium. <l eID="gen3650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1727"/><l level="1" sID="gen3651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1727"/>Absit a me ut justos vos esse judicem : <l eID="gen3651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3652"/>donec deficiam, non recedam ab innocentia mea. <l eID="gen3652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1728"/><l level="1" sID="gen3653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1728"/>Justificationem meam, quam cœpi tenere, non deseram : <l eID="gen3653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3654"/>neque enim reprehendit me cor meum in omni vita mea. <l eID="gen3654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1729"/><l level="1" sID="gen3655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1729"/>Sit ut impius, inimicus meus, <l eID="gen3655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3656"/>et adversarius meus quasi iniquus. <l eID="gen3656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1730"/><l level="1" sID="gen3657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1730"/>Quæ est enim spes hypocritæ, si avare rapiat, <l eID="gen3657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3658"/>et non liberet Deus animam ejus ? <l eID="gen3658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:9
