verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1731"/><l level="1" sID="gen3659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1731"/>Numquid Deus audiet clamorem ejus, <l eID="gen3659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3660"/>cum venerit super eum angustia ? <l eID="gen3660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1732"/><l level="1" sID="gen3661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1732"/>aut poterit in Omnipotente delectari, <l eID="gen3661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3662"/>et invocare Deum omni tempore ? <l eID="gen3662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1733"/><l level="1" sID="gen3663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1733"/>Docebo vos per manum Dei quæ Omnipotens habeat, <l eID="gen3663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3664"/>nec abscondam. <l eID="gen3664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1734"/><l level="1" sID="gen3665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1734"/>Ecce vos omnes nostis : <l eID="gen3665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3666"/>et quid sine causa vana loquimini ? <l eID="gen3666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1735"/><l level="1" sID="gen3667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1735"/>Hæc est pars hominis impii apud Deum, <l eID="gen3667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3668"/>et hæreditas violentorum, quam ob Omnipotente suscipient. <l eID="gen3668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1736"/><l level="1" sID="gen3669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1736"/>Si multiplicati fuerint filii ejus, in gladio erunt, <l eID="gen3669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3670"/>et nepotes ejus non saturabuntur pane : <l eID="gen3670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1737"/><l level="1" sID="gen3671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1737"/>qui reliqui fuerint ex eo sepelientur in interitu, <l eID="gen3671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3672"/>et viduæ illius non plorabunt. <l eID="gen3672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1738"/><l level="1" sID="gen3673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1738"/>Si comportaverit quasi terram argentum, <l eID="gen3673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3674"/>et sicut lutum præparaverit vestimenta : <l eID="gen3674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1739"/><l level="1" sID="gen3675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1739"/>præparabit quidem, sed justus vestietur illis, <l eID="gen3675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3676"/>et argentum innocens dividet. <l eID="gen3676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1740"/><l level="1" sID="gen3677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1740"/>Ædificavit sicut tinea domum suam, <l eID="gen3677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3678"/>et sicut custos fecit umbraculum. <l eID="gen3678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1741"/><l level="1" sID="gen3679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1741"/>Dives, cum dormierit, nihil secum auferet : <l eID="gen3679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3680"/>aperiet oculos suos, et nihil inveniet. <l eID="gen3680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1742"/><l level="1" sID="gen3681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1742"/>Apprehendet eum quasi aqua inopia : <l eID="gen3681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3682"/>nocte opprimet eum tempestas. <l eID="gen3682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1743"/><l level="1" sID="gen3683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1743"/>Tollet eum ventus urens, et auferet, <l eID="gen3683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3684"/>et velut turbo rapiet eum de loco suo. <l eID="gen3684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1744"/><l level="1" sID="gen3685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1744"/>Et mittet super eum, et non parcet : <l eID="gen3685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3686"/>de manu ejus fugiens fugiet. <l eID="gen3686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 27:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1745"/><l level="1" sID="gen3687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1745"/>Stringet super eum manus suas, <l eID="gen3687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3688"/>et sibilabit super illum, intuens locum ejus.  <chapter eID="Job.27"/>

verses.name: Job 28:1
verses.text: Habet argentum venarum suarum principia, <l eID="gen3689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3690"/>et auro locus est in quo conflatur. <l eID="gen3690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1746"/><l level="1" sID="gen3691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1746"/>Ferrum de terra tollitur, <l eID="gen3691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3692"/>et lapis solutus calore in æs vertitur. <l eID="gen3692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1747"/><l level="1" sID="gen3693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1747"/>Tempus posuit tenebris, <l eID="gen3693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3694"/>et universorum finem ipse considerat : <l eID="gen3694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3695"/>lapidem quoque caliginis et umbram mortis. <l eID="gen3695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1748"/><l level="1" sID="gen3696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1748"/>Dividit torrens a populo peregrinante <l eID="gen3696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3697"/>eos quos oblitus est pes egentis hominis, et invios. <l eID="gen3697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1749"/><l level="1" sID="gen3698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1749"/>Terra de qua oriebatur panis, <l eID="gen3698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3699"/>in loco suo igni subversa est. <l eID="gen3699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1750"/><l level="1" sID="gen3700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1750"/>Locus sapphiri lapides ejus, <l eID="gen3700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3701"/>et glebæ illius aurum. <l eID="gen3701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1751"/><l level="1" sID="gen3702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1751"/>Semitam ignoravit avis, <l eID="gen3702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3703"/>nec intuitus est eam oculus vulturis. <l eID="gen3703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1752"/><l level="1" sID="gen3704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1752"/>Non calcaverunt eam filii institorum, <l eID="gen3704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3705"/>nec pertransivit per eam leæna. <l eID="gen3705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1753"/><l level="1" sID="gen3706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1753"/>Ad silicem extendit manum suam : <l eID="gen3706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3707"/>subvertit a radicibus montes. <l eID="gen3707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1754"/><l level="1" sID="gen3708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1754"/>In petris rivos excidit, <l eID="gen3708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3709"/>et omne pretiosum vidit oculus ejus. <l eID="gen3709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1755"/><l level="1" sID="gen3710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1755"/>Profunda quoque fluviorum scrutatus est, <l eID="gen3710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3711"/>et abscondita in lucem produxit. <l eID="gen3711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1756"/><l level="1" sID="gen3712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1756"/>Sapientia vero ubi invenitur ? <l eID="gen3712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3713"/>et quis est locus intelligentiæ ? <l eID="gen3713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1757"/><l level="1" sID="gen3714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1757"/>Nescit homo pretium ejus, <l eID="gen3714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3715"/>nec invenitur in terra suaviter viventium. <l eID="gen3715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1758"/><l level="1" sID="gen3716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1758"/>Abyssus dicit : Non est in me, <l eID="gen3716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3717"/>et mare loquitur : Non est mecum. <l eID="gen3717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1759"/><l level="1" sID="gen3718"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1759"/>Non dabitur aurum obrizum pro ea, <l eID="gen3718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3719"/>nec appendetur argentum in commutatione ejus. <l eID="gen3719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1760"/><l level="1" sID="gen3720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1760"/>Non conferetur tinctis Indiæ coloribus, <l eID="gen3720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3721"/>nec lapidi sardonycho pretiosissimo vel sapphiro. <l eID="gen3721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1761"/><l level="1" sID="gen3722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1761"/>Non adæquabitur ei aurum vel vitrum, <l eID="gen3722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3723"/>nec commutabuntur pro ea vasa auri. <l eID="gen3723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1762"/><l level="1" sID="gen3724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1762"/>Excelsa et eminentia non memorabuntur comparatione ejus : <l eID="gen3724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3725"/>trahitur autem sapientia de occultis. <l eID="gen3725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1763"/><l level="1" sID="gen3726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1763"/>Non adæquabitur ei topazius de Æthiopia, <l eID="gen3726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3727"/>nec tincturæ mundissimæ componetur. <l eID="gen3727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1764"/><l level="1" sID="gen3728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1764"/>Unde ergo sapientia venit ? <l eID="gen3728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3729"/>et quis est locus intelligentiæ ? <l eID="gen3729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1765"/><l level="1" sID="gen3730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1765"/>Abscondita est ab oculis omnium viventium : <l eID="gen3730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3731"/>volucres quoque cæli latet. <l eID="gen3731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1766"/><l level="1" sID="gen3732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1766"/>Perditio et mors dixerunt : <l eID="gen3732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3733"/>Auribus nostris audivimus famam ejus. <l eID="gen3733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1767"/><l level="1" sID="gen3734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1767"/>Deus intelligit viam ejus, <l eID="gen3734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3735"/>et ipse novit locum illius. <l eID="gen3735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1768"/><l level="1" sID="gen3736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1768"/>Ipse enim fines mundi intuetur, <l eID="gen3736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3737"/>et omnia quæ sub cælo sunt respicit. <l eID="gen3737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1769"/><l level="1" sID="gen3738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1769"/>Qui fecit ventis pondus, <l eID="gen3738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3739"/>et aquas appendit in mensura. <l eID="gen3739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1770"/><l level="1" sID="gen3740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1770"/>Quando ponebat pluviis legem, <l eID="gen3740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3741"/>et viam procellis sonantibus : <l eID="gen3741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1771"/><l level="1" sID="gen3742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1771"/>tunc vidit illam et enarravit, <l eID="gen3742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3743"/>et præparavit, et investigavit. <l eID="gen3743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 28:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1772"/><l level="1" sID="gen3744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1772"/>Et dixit homini : Ecce timor Domini, ipsa est sapientia ; <l eID="gen3744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3745"/>et recedere a malo, intelligentia. <l eID="gen3745" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3644"/> <chapter eID="Job.28"/>

verses.name: Job 29:1
verses.text: Addidit quoque Job, assumens parabolam suam, et dixit :  <div eID="gen3746" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1773"/><lg sID="gen3747"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1773"/>Quis mihi tribuat ut sim juxta menses pristinos, <l eID="gen3748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3749"/>secundum dies quibus Deus custodiebat me ? <l eID="gen3749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1774"/><l level="1" sID="gen3750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1774"/>Quando splendebat lucerna ejus super caput meum, <l eID="gen3750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3751"/>et ad lumen ejus ambulabam in tenebris : <l eID="gen3751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1775"/><l level="1" sID="gen3752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1775"/>sicut fui in diebus adolescentiæ meæ, <l eID="gen3752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3753"/>quando secreto Deus erat in tabernaculo meo : <l eID="gen3753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1776"/><l level="1" sID="gen3754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1776"/>quando erat Omnipotens mecum, <l eID="gen3754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3755"/>et in circuitu meo pueri mei : <l eID="gen3755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1777"/><l level="1" sID="gen3756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1777"/>quando lavabam pedes meos butyro, <l eID="gen3756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3757"/>et petra fundebat mihi rivos olei : <l eID="gen3757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1778"/><l level="1" sID="gen3758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1778"/>quando procedebam ad portam civitatis, <l eID="gen3758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3759"/>et in platea parabant cathedram mihi. <l eID="gen3759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1779"/><l level="1" sID="gen3760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1779"/>Videbant me juvenes, et abscondebantur : <l eID="gen3760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3761"/>et senes assurgentes stabant. <l eID="gen3761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1780"/><l level="1" sID="gen3762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1780"/>Principes cessabant loqui, <l eID="gen3762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3763"/>et digitum superponebant ori suo. <l eID="gen3763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1781"/><l level="1" sID="gen3764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1781"/>Vocem suam cohibebant duces, <l eID="gen3764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3765"/>et lingua eorum gutturi suo adhærebat. <l eID="gen3765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1782"/><l level="1" sID="gen3766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1782"/>Auris audiens beatificabat me, <l eID="gen3766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3767"/>et oculus videns testimonium reddebat mihi : <l eID="gen3767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1783"/><l level="1" sID="gen3768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1783"/>eo quod liberassem pauperem vociferantem, <l eID="gen3768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3769"/>et pupillum cui non esset adjutor. <l eID="gen3769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1784"/><l level="1" sID="gen3770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1784"/>Benedictio perituri super me veniebat, <l eID="gen3770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3771"/>et cor viduæ consolatus sum. <l eID="gen3771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1785"/><l level="1" sID="gen3772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1785"/>Justitia indutus sum, <l eID="gen3772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3773"/>et vestivi me, sicut vestimento et diademate, judicio meo. <l eID="gen3773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1786"/><l level="1" sID="gen3774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1786"/>Oculus fui cæco, et pes claudo. <l eID="gen3774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1787"/><l level="1" sID="gen3775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1787"/>Pater eram pauperum, <l eID="gen3775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3776"/>et causam quam nesciebam diligentissime investigabam. <l eID="gen3776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1788"/><l level="1" sID="gen3777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1788"/>Conterebam molas iniqui, <l eID="gen3777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3778"/>et de dentibus illius auferebam prædam. <l eID="gen3778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1789"/><l level="1" sID="gen3779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1789"/>Dicebamque : In nidulo meo moriar, <l eID="gen3779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3780"/>et sicut palma multiplicabo dies. <l eID="gen3780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1790"/><l level="1" sID="gen3781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1790"/>Radix mea aperta est secus aquas, <l eID="gen3781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3782"/>et ros morabitur in messione mea. <l eID="gen3782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1791"/><l level="1" sID="gen3783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1791"/>Gloria mea semper innovabitur, <l eID="gen3783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3784"/>et arcus meus in manu mea instaurabitur. <l eID="gen3784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1792"/><l level="1" sID="gen3785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1792"/>Qui me audiebant, expectabant sententiam, <l eID="gen3785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3786"/>et intenti tacebant ad consilium meum. <l eID="gen3786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1793"/><l level="1" sID="gen3787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1793"/>Verbis meis addere nihil audebant, <l eID="gen3787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3788"/>et super illos stillabat eloquium meum. <l eID="gen3788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1794"/><l level="1" sID="gen3789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1794"/>Expectabant me sicut pluviam, <l eID="gen3789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3790"/>et os suum aperiebant quasi ad imbrem serotinum. <l eID="gen3790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1795"/><l level="1" sID="gen3791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1795"/>Siquando ridebam ad eos, non credebant : <l eID="gen3791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3792"/>et lux vultus mei non cadebat in terram. <l eID="gen3792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 29:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1796"/><l level="1" sID="gen3793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1796"/>Si voluissem ire ad eos, sedebam primus : <l eID="gen3793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3794"/>cumque sederem quasi rex, circumstante exercitu, <l eID="gen3794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3795"/>eram tamen mœrentium consolator.  <chapter eID="Job.29"/>

verses.name: Job 30:1
verses.text: Nunc autem derident me juniores tempore, <l eID="gen3796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3797"/>quorum non dignabar patres ponere cum canibus gregis mei : <l eID="gen3797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1797"/><l level="1" sID="gen3798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1797"/>quorum virtus manuum mihi erat pro nihilo, <l eID="gen3798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3799"/>et vita ipsa putabantur indigni : <l eID="gen3799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1798"/><l level="1" sID="gen3800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1798"/>egestate et fame steriles, qui rodebant in solitudine, <l eID="gen3800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3801"/>squallentes calamitate et miseria. <l eID="gen3801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1799"/><l level="1" sID="gen3802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1799"/>Et mandebant herbas, et arborum cortices, <l eID="gen3802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3803"/>et radix juniperorum erat cibus eorum : <l eID="gen3803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1800"/><l level="1" sID="gen3804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1800"/>qui de convallibus ista rapientes, <l eID="gen3804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3805"/>cum singula reperissent, ad ea cum clamore currebant. <l eID="gen3805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1801"/><l level="1" sID="gen3806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1801"/>In desertis habitabant torrentium, <l eID="gen3806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3807"/>et in cavernis terræ, vel super glaream : <l eID="gen3807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1802"/><l level="1" sID="gen3808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1802"/>qui inter hujuscemodi lætabantur, <l eID="gen3808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3809"/>et esse sub sentibus delicias computabant : <l eID="gen3809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1803"/><l level="1" sID="gen3810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1803"/>filii stultorum et ignobilium, <l eID="gen3810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3811"/>et in terra penitus non parentes. <l eID="gen3811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1804"/><l level="1" sID="gen3812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1804"/>Nunc in eorum canticum versus sum, <l eID="gen3812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3813"/>et factus sum eis in proverbium. <l eID="gen3813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1805"/><l level="1" sID="gen3814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1805"/>Abominantur me, et longe fugiunt a me, <l eID="gen3814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3815"/>et faciem meam conspuere non verentur. <l eID="gen3815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1806"/><l level="1" sID="gen3816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1806"/>Pharetram enim suam aperuit, et afflixit me, <l eID="gen3816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3817"/>et frenum posuit in os meum. <l eID="gen3817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1807"/><l level="1" sID="gen3818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1807"/>Ad dexteram orientis calamitates meæ illico surrexerunt : <l eID="gen3818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3819"/>pedes meos subverterunt, <l eID="gen3819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3820"/>et oppresserunt quasi fluctibus semitis suis. <l eID="gen3820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1808"/><l level="1" sID="gen3821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1808"/>Dissipaverunt itinera mea ; <l eID="gen3821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3822"/>insidiati sunt mihi, et prævaluerunt : <l eID="gen3822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3823"/>et non fuit qui ferret auxilium. <l eID="gen3823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1809"/><l level="1" sID="gen3824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1809"/>Quasi rupto muro, et aperta janua, irruerunt super me, <l eID="gen3824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3825"/>et ad meas miserias devoluti sunt. <l eID="gen3825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1810"/><l level="1" sID="gen3826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1810"/>Redactus sum in nihilum : <l eID="gen3826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3827"/>abstulisti quasi ventus desiderium meum, <l eID="gen3827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3828"/>et velut nubes pertransiit salus mea. <l eID="gen3828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1811"/><l level="1" sID="gen3829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1811"/>Nunc autem in memetipso marcescit anima mea, <l eID="gen3829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3830"/>et possident me dies afflictionis. <l eID="gen3830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1812"/><l level="1" sID="gen3831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1812"/>Nocte os meum perforatur doloribus, <l eID="gen3831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3832"/>et qui me comedunt, non dormiunt. <l eID="gen3832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1813"/><l level="1" sID="gen3833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1813"/>In multitudine eorum consumitur vestimentum meum, <l eID="gen3833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3834"/>et quasi capitio tunicæ succinxerunt me. <l eID="gen3834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1814"/><l level="1" sID="gen3835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1814"/>Comparatus sum luto, <l eID="gen3835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3836"/>et assimilatus sum favillæ et cineri. <l eID="gen3836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1815"/><l level="1" sID="gen3837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1815"/>Clamo ad te, et non exaudis me : <l eID="gen3837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3838"/>sto, et non respicis me. <l eID="gen3838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1816"/><l level="1" sID="gen3839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1816"/>Mutatus es mihi in crudelem, <l eID="gen3839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3840"/>et in duritia manus tuæ adversaris mihi. <l eID="gen3840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1817"/><l level="1" sID="gen3841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1817"/>Elevasti me, et quasi super ventum ponens ; <l eID="gen3841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3842"/>elisisti me valide. <l eID="gen3842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1818"/><l level="1" sID="gen3843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1818"/>Scio quia morti trades me, <l eID="gen3843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3844"/>ubi constituta est domus omni viventi. <l eID="gen3844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1819"/><l level="1" sID="gen3845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1819"/>Verumtamen non ad consumptionem eorum emittis manum tuam : <l eID="gen3845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3846"/>et si corruerint, ipse salvabis. <l eID="gen3846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1820"/><l level="1" sID="gen3847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1820"/>Flebam quondam super eo qui afflictus erat, <l eID="gen3847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3848"/>et compatiebatur anima mea pauperi. <l eID="gen3848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1821"/><l level="1" sID="gen3849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1821"/>Expectabam bona, et venerunt mihi mala : <l eID="gen3849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3850"/>præstolabar lucem, et eruperunt tenebræ. <l eID="gen3850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1822"/><l level="1" sID="gen3851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1822"/>Interiora mea efferbuerunt absque ulla requie : <l eID="gen3851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3852"/>prævenerunt me dies afflictionis. <l eID="gen3852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1823"/><l level="1" sID="gen3853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1823"/>Mœrens incedebam sine furore ; <l eID="gen3853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3854"/>consurgens, in turba clamabam. <l eID="gen3854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1824"/><l level="1" sID="gen3855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1824"/>Frater fui draconum, <l eID="gen3855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3856"/>et socius struthionum. <l eID="gen3856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1825"/><l level="1" sID="gen3857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1825"/>Cutis mea denigrata est super me, <l eID="gen3857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3858"/>et ossa mea aruerunt præ caumate. <l eID="gen3858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 30:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1826"/><l level="1" sID="gen3859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1826"/>Versa est in luctum cithara mea, <l eID="gen3859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3860"/>et organum meum in vocem flentium.  <chapter eID="Job.30"/>

verses.name: Job 31:1
verses.text: Pepigi fœdus cum oculis meis, <l eID="gen3861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3862"/>ut ne cogitarem quidem de virgine. <l eID="gen3862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1827"/><l level="1" sID="gen3863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1827"/>Quam enim partem haberet in me Deus desuper, <l eID="gen3863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3864"/>et hæreditatem Omnipotens de excelsis ? <l eID="gen3864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1828"/><l level="1" sID="gen3865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1828"/>Numquid non perditio est iniquo, <l eID="gen3865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3866"/>et alienatio operantibus injustitiam ? <l eID="gen3866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1829"/><l level="1" sID="gen3867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1829"/>Nonne ipse considerat vias meas, <l eID="gen3867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3868"/>et cunctos gressus meos dinumerat ? <l eID="gen3868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1830"/><l level="1" sID="gen3869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1830"/>Si ambulavi in vanitate, <l eID="gen3869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3870"/>et festinavit in dolo pes meus, <l eID="gen3870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1831"/><l level="1" sID="gen3871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1831"/>appendat me in statera justa, <l eID="gen3871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3872"/>et sciat Deus simplicitatem meam. <l eID="gen3872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1832"/><l level="1" sID="gen3873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1832"/>Si declinavit gressus meus de via, <l eID="gen3873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3874"/>et si secutum est oculos meos cor meum, <l eID="gen3874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3875"/>et si manibus meis adhæsit macula, <l eID="gen3875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1833"/><l level="1" sID="gen3876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1833"/>seram, et alius comedat, <l eID="gen3876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3877"/>et progenies mea eradicetur. <l eID="gen3877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1834"/><l level="1" sID="gen3878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1834"/>Si deceptum est cor meum super muliere, <l eID="gen3878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3879"/>et si ad ostium amici mei insidiatus sum, <l eID="gen3879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1835"/><l level="1" sID="gen3880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1835"/>scortum alterius sit uxor mea, <l eID="gen3880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3881"/>et super illam incurventur alii. <l eID="gen3881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1836"/><l level="1" sID="gen3882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1836"/>Hoc enim nefas est, <l eID="gen3882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3883"/>et iniquitas maxima. <l eID="gen3883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1837"/><l level="1" sID="gen3884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1837"/>Ignis est usque ad perditionem devorans, <l eID="gen3884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3885"/>et omnia eradicans genimina. <l eID="gen3885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1838"/><l level="1" sID="gen3886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1838"/>Si contempsi subire judicium cum servo meo et ancilla mea, <l eID="gen3886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3887"/>cum disceptarent adversum me : <l eID="gen3887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1839"/><l level="1" sID="gen3888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1839"/>quid enim faciam cum surrexerit ad judicandum Deus ? <l eID="gen3888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3889"/>et cum quæsierit, quid respondebo illi ? <l eID="gen3889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1840"/><l level="1" sID="gen3890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1840"/>Numquid non in utero fecit me, qui et illum operatus est, <l eID="gen3890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3891"/>et formavit me in vulva unus ? <l eID="gen3891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1841"/><l level="1" sID="gen3892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1841"/>Si negavi quod volebant pauperibus, <l eID="gen3892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3893"/>et oculos viduæ expectare feci ; <l eID="gen3893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1842"/><l level="1" sID="gen3894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1842"/>si comedi buccellam meam solus, <l eID="gen3894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3895"/>et non comedit pupillus ex ea <l eID="gen3895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1843"/><l level="1" sID="gen3896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1843"/>(quia ab infantia mea crevit mecum miseratio, <l eID="gen3896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3897"/>et de utero matris meæ egressa est mecum) ; <l eID="gen3897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1844"/><l level="1" sID="gen3898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1844"/>si despexi pereuntem, eo quod non habuerit indumentum, <l eID="gen3898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3899"/>et absque operimento pauperem ; <l eID="gen3899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1845"/><l level="1" sID="gen3900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1845"/>si non benedixerunt mihi latera ejus, <l eID="gen3900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3901"/>et de velleribus ovium mearum calefactus est ; <l eID="gen3901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1846"/><l level="1" sID="gen3902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1846"/>si levavi super pupillum manum meam, <l eID="gen3902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3903"/>etiam cum viderem me in porta superiorem : <l eID="gen3903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1847"/><l level="1" sID="gen3904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1847"/>humerus meus a junctura sua cadat, <l eID="gen3904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3905"/>et brachium meum cum suis ossibus confringatur. <l eID="gen3905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1848"/><l level="1" sID="gen3906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1848"/>Semper enim quasi tumentes super me fluctus timui Deum, <l eID="gen3906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3907"/>et pondus ejus ferre non potui. <l eID="gen3907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1849"/><l level="1" sID="gen3908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1849"/>Si putavi aurum robur meum, <l eID="gen3908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3909"/>et obrizo dixi : Fiducia mea ; <l eID="gen3909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1850"/><l level="1" sID="gen3910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1850"/>si lætatus sum super multis divitiis meis, <l eID="gen3910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3911"/>et quia plurima reperit manus mea ; <l eID="gen3911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1851"/><l level="1" sID="gen3912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1851"/>si vidi solem cum fulgeret, <l eID="gen3912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3913"/>et lunam incedentem clare, <l eID="gen3913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1852"/><l level="1" sID="gen3914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1852"/>et lætatum est in abscondito cor meum, <l eID="gen3914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3915"/>et osculatus sum manum meam ore meo : <l eID="gen3915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1853"/><l level="1" sID="gen3916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1853"/>quæ est iniquitas maxima, <l eID="gen3916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3917"/>et negatio contra Deum altissimum. <l eID="gen3917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1854"/><l level="1" sID="gen3918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1854"/>Si gavisus sum ad ruinam ejus qui me oderat, <l eID="gen3918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3919"/>et exsultavi quod invenisset eum malum : <l eID="gen3919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1855"/><l level="1" sID="gen3920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1855"/>non enim dedi ad peccandum guttur meum, <l eID="gen3920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3921"/>ut expeterem maledicens animam ejus. <l eID="gen3921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1856"/><l level="1" sID="gen3922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1856"/>Si non dixerunt viri tabernaculi mei : <l eID="gen3922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3923"/>Quis det de carnibus ejus, ut saturemur ? <l eID="gen3923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1857"/><l level="1" sID="gen3924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1857"/>foris non mansit peregrinus : <l eID="gen3924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3925"/>ostium meum viatori patuit. <l eID="gen3925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1858"/><l level="1" sID="gen3926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1858"/>Si abscondi quasi homo peccatum meum, <l eID="gen3926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3927"/>et celavi in sinu meo iniquitatem meam ; <l eID="gen3927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1859"/><l level="1" sID="gen3928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1859"/>si expavi ad multitudinem nimiam, <l eID="gen3928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3929"/>et despectio propinquorum terruit me : <l eID="gen3929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3930"/>et non magis tacui, nec egressus sum ostium. <l eID="gen3930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1860"/><l level="1" sID="gen3931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1860"/>Quis mihi tribuat auditorem, <l eID="gen3931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3932"/>ut desiderium meum audiat Omnipotens, <l eID="gen3932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3933"/>et librum scribat ipse qui judicat, <l eID="gen3933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1861"/><l level="1" sID="gen3934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1861"/>ut in humero meo portem illum, <l eID="gen3934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3935"/>et circumdem illum quasi coronam mihi ? <l eID="gen3935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1862"/><l level="1" sID="gen3936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1862"/>Per singulos gradus meos pronuntiabo illum, <l eID="gen3936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3937"/>et quasi principi offeram eum. <l eID="gen3937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1863"/><l level="1" sID="gen3938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1863"/>Si adversum me terra mea clamat, <l eID="gen3938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3939"/>et cum ipsa sulci ejus deflent : <l eID="gen3939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1864"/><l level="1" sID="gen3940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1864"/>si fructus ejus comedi absque pecunia, <l eID="gen3940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3941"/>et animam agricolarum ejus afflixi : <l eID="gen3941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 31:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1865"/><l level="1" sID="gen3942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1865"/>pro frumento oriatur mihi tribulus, <l eID="gen3942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3943"/>et pro hordeo spina. Finita sunt verba Job. <l eID="gen3943" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3747"/> <chapter eID="Job.31"/>

verses.name: Job 32:1
verses.text: Omiserunt autem tres viri isti respondere Job, eo quod justus sibi videretur.

verses.name: Job 32:2
verses.text: Et iratus indignatusque est Eliu filius Barachel Buzites, de cognatione Ram : iratus est autem adversum Job, eo quod justum se esse diceret coram Deo.

verses.name: Job 32:3
verses.text: Porro adversum amicos ejus indignatus est, eo quod non invenissent responsionem rationabilem, sed tantummodo condemnassent Job.

verses.name: Job 32:4
verses.text: Igitur Eliu expectavit Job loquentem, eo quod seniores essent qui loquebantur.

verses.name: Job 32:5
verses.text: Cum autem vidisset quod tres respondere non potuissent, iratus est vehementer.

verses.name: Job 32:6
verses.text: Respondensque Eliu filius Barachel Buzites, dixit : <div eID="gen3944" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen3945"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3946"/>Junior sum tempore, vos autem antiquiores : <l eID="gen3946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3947"/>idcirco, demisso capite, <l eID="gen3947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3948"/>veritus sum vobis indicare meam sententiam. <l eID="gen3948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1866"/><l level="1" sID="gen3949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1866"/>Sperabam enim quod ætas prolixior loqueretur, <l eID="gen3949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3950"/>et annorum multitudo doceret sapientiam. <l eID="gen3950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1867"/><l level="1" sID="gen3951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1867"/>Sed, ut video, spiritus est in hominibus, <l eID="gen3951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3952"/>et inspiratio Omnipotentis dat intelligentiam. <l eID="gen3952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1868"/><l level="1" sID="gen3953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1868"/>Non sunt longævi sapientes, <l eID="gen3953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3954"/>nec senes intelligunt judicium. <l eID="gen3954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1869"/><l level="1" sID="gen3955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1869"/>Ideo dicam : Audite me : <l eID="gen3955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3956"/>ostendam vobis etiam ego meam sapientiam. <l eID="gen3956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1870"/><l level="1" sID="gen3957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1870"/>Expectavi enim sermones vestros ; <l eID="gen3957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3958"/>audivi prudentiam vestram, <l eID="gen3958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3959"/>donec disceptaremini sermonibus ; <l eID="gen3959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1871"/><l level="1" sID="gen3960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1871"/>et donec putabam vos aliquid dicere, considerabam : <l eID="gen3960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3961"/>sed, ut video, non est qui possit arguere Job, <l eID="gen3961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3962"/>et respondere ex vobis sermonibus ejus. <l eID="gen3962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1872"/><l level="1" sID="gen3963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1872"/>Ne forte dicatis : Invenimus sapientiam : <l eID="gen3963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3964"/>Deus projecit eum, non homo. <l eID="gen3964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1873"/><l level="1" sID="gen3965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1873"/>Nihil locutus est mihi : <l eID="gen3965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3966"/>et ego non secundum sermones vestros respondebo illi. <l eID="gen3966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1874"/><l level="1" sID="gen3967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1874"/>Extimuerunt, nec responderunt ultra, <l eID="gen3967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3968"/>abstuleruntque a se eloquia. <l eID="gen3968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1875"/><l level="1" sID="gen3969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1875"/>Quoniam igitur expectavi, et non sunt locuti : <l eID="gen3969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3970"/>steterunt, nec ultra responderunt : <l eID="gen3970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1876"/><l level="1" sID="gen3971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1876"/>respondebo et ego partem meam, <l eID="gen3971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3972"/>et ostendam scientiam meam. <l eID="gen3972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1877"/><l level="1" sID="gen3973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1877"/>Plenus sum enim sermonibus, <l eID="gen3973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3974"/>et coarctat me spiritus uteri mei. <l eID="gen3974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1878"/><l level="1" sID="gen3975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1878"/>En venter meus quasi mustum absque spiraculo, <l eID="gen3975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3976"/>quod lagunculas novas disrumpit. <l eID="gen3976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1879"/><l level="1" sID="gen3977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1879"/>Loquar, et respirabo paululum : <l eID="gen3977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3978"/>aperiam labia mea, et respondebo. <l eID="gen3978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1880"/><l level="1" sID="gen3979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1880"/>Non accipiam personam viri, <l eID="gen3979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3980"/>et Deum homini non æquabo. <l eID="gen3980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1881"/><l level="1" sID="gen3981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1881"/>Nescio enim quamdiu subsistam, <l eID="gen3981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3982"/>et si post modicum tollat me factor meus.  <chapter eID="Job.32"/>

verses.name: Job 33:1
verses.text: Audi igitur, Job, eloquia mea, <l eID="gen3983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3984"/>et omnes sermones meos ausculta. <l eID="gen3984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1882"/><l level="1" sID="gen3985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1882"/>Ecce aperui os meum : <l eID="gen3985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3986"/>loquatur lingua mea in faucibus meis. <l eID="gen3986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1883"/><l level="1" sID="gen3987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1883"/>Simplici corde meo sermones mei, <l eID="gen3987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3988"/>et sententiam puram labia mea loquentur. <l eID="gen3988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1884"/><l level="1" sID="gen3989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1884"/>Spiritus Dei fecit me, <l eID="gen3989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3990"/>et spiraculum Omnipotentis vivificavit me. <l eID="gen3990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1885"/><l level="1" sID="gen3991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1885"/>Si potes, responde mihi, <l eID="gen3991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3992"/>et adversus faciem meam consiste. <l eID="gen3992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1886"/><l level="1" sID="gen3993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1886"/>Ecce, et me sicut et te fecit Deus, <l eID="gen3993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3994"/>et de eodem luto ego quoque formatus sum. <l eID="gen3994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1887"/><l level="1" sID="gen3995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1887"/>Verumtamen miraculum meum non te terreat, <l eID="gen3995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3996"/>et eloquentia mea non sit tibi gravis. <l eID="gen3996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1888"/><l level="1" sID="gen3997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1888"/>Dixisti ergo in auribus meis, <l eID="gen3997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen3998"/>et vocem verborum tuorum audivi : <l eID="gen3998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1889"/><l level="1" sID="gen3999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1889"/>Mundus sum ego, et absque delicto : <l eID="gen3999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4000"/>immaculatus, et non est iniquitas in me. <l eID="gen4000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1890"/><l level="1" sID="gen4001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1890"/>Quia querelas in me reperit, <l eID="gen4001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4002"/>ideo arbitratus est me inimicum sibi. <l eID="gen4002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1891"/><l level="1" sID="gen4003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1891"/>Posuit in nervo pedes meos ; <l eID="gen4003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4004"/>custodivit omnes semitas meas. <l eID="gen4004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1892"/><l level="1" sID="gen4005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1892"/>Hoc est ergo in quo non es justificatus : <l eID="gen4005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4006"/>respondebo tibi, quia major sit Deus homine. <l eID="gen4006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1893"/><l level="1" sID="gen4007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1893"/>Adversus eum contendis, <l eID="gen4007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4008"/>quod non ad omnia verba responderit tibi ? <l eID="gen4008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1894"/><l level="1" sID="gen4009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1894"/>Semel loquitur Deus, <l eID="gen4009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4010"/>et secundo idipsum non repetit. <l eID="gen4010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1895"/><l level="1" sID="gen4011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1895"/>Per somnium, in visione nocturna, <l eID="gen4011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4012"/>quando irruit sopor super homines, <l eID="gen4012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4013"/>et dormiunt in lectulo, <l eID="gen4013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1896"/><l level="1" sID="gen4014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1896"/>tunc aperit aures virorum, <l eID="gen4014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4015"/>et erudiens eos instruit disciplina, <l eID="gen4015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1897"/><l level="1" sID="gen4016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1897"/>ut avertat hominem ab his quæ facit, <l eID="gen4016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4017"/>et liberet eum de superbia, <l eID="gen4017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1898"/><l level="1" sID="gen4018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1898"/>eruens animam ejus a corruptione, <l eID="gen4018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4019"/>et vitam illius ut non transeat in gladium. <l eID="gen4019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1899"/><l level="1" sID="gen4020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1899"/>Increpat quoque per dolorem in lectulo, <l eID="gen4020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4021"/>et omnia ossa ejus marcescere facit. <l eID="gen4021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1900"/><l level="1" sID="gen4022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1900"/>Abominabilis ei fit in vita sua panis, <l eID="gen4022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4023"/>et animæ illius cibus ante desiderabilis. <l eID="gen4023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1901"/><l level="1" sID="gen4024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1901"/>Tabescet caro ejus, <l eID="gen4024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4025"/>et ossa, quæ tecta fuerant, nudabuntur. <l eID="gen4025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1902"/><l level="1" sID="gen4026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1902"/>Appropinquavit corruptioni anima ejus, <l eID="gen4026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4027"/>et vita illius mortiferis. <l eID="gen4027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1903"/><l level="1" sID="gen4028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1903"/>Si fuerit pro eo angelus loquens, <l eID="gen4028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4029"/>unus de millibus, ut annuntiet hominis æquitatem, <l eID="gen4029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1904"/><l level="1" sID="gen4030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1904"/>miserebitur ejus, et dicet : <l eID="gen4030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4031"/>Libera eum, ut non descendat in corruptionem : <l eID="gen4031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4032"/>inveni in quo ei propitier. <l eID="gen4032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1905"/><l level="1" sID="gen4033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1905"/>Consumpta est caro ejus a suppliciis : <l eID="gen4033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4034"/>revertatur ad dies adolescentiæ suæ. <l eID="gen4034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1906"/><l level="1" sID="gen4035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1906"/>Deprecabitur Deum, et placabilis ei erit : <l eID="gen4035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4036"/>et videbit faciem ejus in jubilo, <l eID="gen4036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4037"/>et reddet homini justitiam suam. <l eID="gen4037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1907"/><l level="1" sID="gen4038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1907"/>Respiciet homines, et dicet : Peccavi, <l eID="gen4038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4039"/>et vere deliqui, et ut eram dignus, non recepi. <l eID="gen4039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1908"/><l level="1" sID="gen4040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1908"/>Liberavit animam suam, ne pergeret in interitum, <l eID="gen4040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4041"/>sed vivens lucem videret. <l eID="gen4041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1909"/><l level="1" sID="gen4042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1909"/>Ecce hæc omnia operatur Deus <l eID="gen4042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4043"/>tribus vicibus per singulos, <l eID="gen4043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1910"/><l level="1" sID="gen4044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1910"/>ut revocet animas eorum a corruptione, <l eID="gen4044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4045"/>et illuminet luce viventium. <l eID="gen4045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1911"/><l level="1" sID="gen4046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1911"/>Attende, Job, et audi me : <l eID="gen4046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4047"/>et tace, dum ego loquor. <l eID="gen4047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1912"/><l level="1" sID="gen4048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1912"/>Si autem habes quod loquaris, responde mihi : <l eID="gen4048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4049"/>loquere, volo enim te apparere justum. <l eID="gen4049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 33:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1913"/><l level="1" sID="gen4050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1913"/>Quod si non habes, audi me : <l eID="gen4050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4051"/>tace, et docebo te sapientiam. <l eID="gen4051" level="1"/><lg eID="gen3945"/> <chapter eID="Job.33"/>

verses.name: Job 34:1
verses.text: Pronuntians itaque Eliu, etiam hæc locutus est :  <div eID="gen4052" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 34:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1914"/><lg sID="gen4053"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1914"/>Audite, sapientes, verba mea : <l eID="gen4054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4055"/>et eruditi, auscultate me. <l eID="gen4055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1915"/><l level="1" sID="gen4056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1915"/>Auris enim verba probat, <l eID="gen4056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4057"/>et guttur escas gustu dijudicat. <l eID="gen4057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1916"/><l level="1" sID="gen4058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1916"/>Judicium eligamus nobis, <l eID="gen4058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4059"/>et inter nos videamus quid sit melius. <l eID="gen4059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1917"/><l level="1" sID="gen4060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1917"/>Quia dixit Job : Justus sum, <l eID="gen4060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4061"/>et Deus subvertit judicium meum. <l eID="gen4061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1918"/><l level="1" sID="gen4062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1918"/>In judicando enim me mendacium est : <l eID="gen4062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4063"/>violenta sagitta mea absque ullo peccato. <l eID="gen4063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1919"/><l level="1" sID="gen4064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1919"/>Quis est vir ut est Job, <l eID="gen4064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4065"/>qui bibit subsannationem quasi aquam : <l eID="gen4065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1920"/><l level="1" sID="gen4066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1920"/>qui graditur cum operantibus iniquitatem, <l eID="gen4066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4067"/>et ambulat cum viris impiis ? <l eID="gen4067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1921"/><l level="1" sID="gen4068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1921"/>Dixit enim : Non placebit vir Deo, <l eID="gen4068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4069"/>etiam si cucurrerit cum eo. <l eID="gen4069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1922"/><l level="1" sID="gen4070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1922"/>Ideo, viri cordati, audite me : <l eID="gen4070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4071"/>absit a Deo impietas, <l eID="gen4071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4072"/>et ab Omnipotente iniquitas. <l eID="gen4072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1923"/><l level="1" sID="gen4073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1923"/>Opus enim hominis reddet ei, <l eID="gen4073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4074"/>et juxta vias singulorum restituet eis. <l eID="gen4074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1924"/><l level="1" sID="gen4075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1924"/>Vere enim Deus non condemnabit frustra, <l eID="gen4075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4076"/>nec Omnipotens subvertet judicium. <l eID="gen4076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1925"/><l level="1" sID="gen4077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1925"/>Quem constituit alium super terram ? <l eID="gen4077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4078"/>aut quem posuit super orbem quem fabricatus est ? <l eID="gen4078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1926"/><l level="1" sID="gen4079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1926"/>Si direxerit ad eum cor suum, <l eID="gen4079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4080"/>spiritum illius et flatum ad se trahet. <l eID="gen4080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1927"/><l level="1" sID="gen4081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1927"/>Deficiet omnis caro simul, <l eID="gen4081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4082"/>et homo in cinerem revertetur. <l eID="gen4082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1928"/><l level="1" sID="gen4083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1928"/>Si habes ergo intellectum, audi quod dicitur, <l eID="gen4083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4084"/>et ausculta vocem eloquii mei : <l eID="gen4084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1929"/><l level="1" sID="gen4085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1929"/>numquid qui non amat judicium sanari potest ? <l eID="gen4085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4086"/>et quomodo tu eum qui justus est in tantum condemnas ? <l eID="gen4086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1930"/><l level="1" sID="gen4087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1930"/>Qui dicit regi : Apostata ; <l eID="gen4087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4088"/>qui vocat duces impios ; <l eID="gen4088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1931"/><l level="1" sID="gen4089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1931"/>qui non accipit personas principum, <l eID="gen4089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4090"/>nec cognovit tyrannum cum disceptaret contra pauperem : <l eID="gen4090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4091"/>opus enim manuum ejus sunt universi. <l eID="gen4091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1932"/><l level="1" sID="gen4092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1932"/>Subito morientur, et in media nocte turbabuntur populi : <l eID="gen4092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4093"/>et pertransibunt, et auferent violentum absque manu. <l eID="gen4093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1933"/><l level="1" sID="gen4094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1933"/>Oculi enim ejus super vias hominum, <l eID="gen4094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4095"/>et omnes gressus eorum considerat. <l eID="gen4095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1934"/><l level="1" sID="gen4096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1934"/>Non sunt tenebræ, et non est umbra mortis, <l eID="gen4096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4097"/>ut abscondantur ibi qui operantur iniquitatem, <l eID="gen4097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1935"/><l level="1" sID="gen4098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1935"/>neque enim ultra in hominis potestate est, <l eID="gen4098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4099"/>ut veniat ad Deum in judicium. <l eID="gen4099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1936"/><l level="1" sID="gen4100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1936"/>Conteret multos, et innumerabiles, <l eID="gen4100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4101"/>et stare faciet alios pro eis. <l eID="gen4101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1937"/><l level="1" sID="gen4102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1937"/>Novit enim opera eorum, <l eID="gen4102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4103"/>et idcirco inducet noctem, et conterentur. <l eID="gen4103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1938"/><l level="1" sID="gen4104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1938"/>Quasi impios percussit eos <l eID="gen4104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4105"/>in loco videntium : <l eID="gen4105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1939"/><l level="1" sID="gen4106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1939"/>qui quasi de industria recesserunt ab eo, <l eID="gen4106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4107"/>et omnes vias ejus intelligere noluerunt : <l eID="gen4107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1940"/><l level="1" sID="gen4108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1940"/>ut pervenire facerent ad eum clamorem egeni, <l eID="gen4108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4109"/>et audiret vocem pauperum. <l eID="gen4109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1941"/><l level="1" sID="gen4110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1941"/>Ipso enim concedente pacem, quis est qui condemnet ? <l eID="gen4110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4111"/>ex quo absconderit vultum, quis est qui contempletur eum, <l eID="gen4111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4112"/>et super gentes, et super omnes homines ? <l eID="gen4112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1942"/><l level="1" sID="gen4113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1942"/>Qui regnare facit hominem hypocritam <l eID="gen4113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4114"/>propter peccata populi. <l eID="gen4114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1943"/><l level="1" sID="gen4115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1943"/>Quia ergo ego locutus sum ad Deum, <l eID="gen4115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4116"/>te quoque non prohibebo. <l eID="gen4116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1944"/><l level="1" sID="gen4117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1944"/>Si erravi, tu doce me ; <l eID="gen4117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4118"/>si iniquitatem locutus sum, ultra non addam. <l eID="gen4118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1945"/><l level="1" sID="gen4119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1945"/>Numquid a te Deus expetit eam, quia displicuit tibi ? <l eID="gen4119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4120"/>tu enim cœpisti loqui, et non ego : <l eID="gen4120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4121"/>quod si quid nosti melius, loquere. <l eID="gen4121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1946"/><l level="1" sID="gen4122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1946"/>Viri intelligentes loquantur mihi, <l eID="gen4122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4123"/>et vir sapiens audiat me. <l eID="gen4123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1947"/><l level="1" sID="gen4124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1947"/>Job autem stulte locutus est, <l eID="gen4124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4125"/>et verba illius non sonant disciplinam. <l eID="gen4125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1948"/><l level="1" sID="gen4126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1948"/>Pater mi, probetur Job usque ad finem : <l eID="gen4126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4127"/>ne desinas ab homine iniquitatis : <l eID="gen4127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 34:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1949"/><l level="1" sID="gen4128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1949"/>quia addit super peccata sua blasphemiam, <l eID="gen4128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4129"/>inter nos interim constringatur : <l eID="gen4129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4130"/>et tunc ad judicium provocet sermonibus suis Deum. <l eID="gen4130" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4053"/> <chapter eID="Job.34"/>

verses.name: Job 35:1
verses.text: Igitur Eliu hæc rursum locutus est :  <div eID="gen4131" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 35:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1950"/><lg sID="gen4132"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1950"/>Numquid æqua tibi videtur tua cogitatio, <l eID="gen4133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4134"/>ut diceres : Justior sum Deo ? <l eID="gen4134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1951"/><l level="1" sID="gen4135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1951"/>Dixisti enim : Non tibi placet quod rectum est : <l eID="gen4135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4136"/>vel quid tibi proderit, si ego peccavero ? <l eID="gen4136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:4
