verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1952"/><l level="1" sID="gen4137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1952"/>Itaque ego respondebo sermonibus tuis, <l eID="gen4137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4138"/>et amicis tuis tecum. <l eID="gen4138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1953"/><l level="1" sID="gen4139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1953"/>Suspice cælum, et intuere : <l eID="gen4139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4140"/>et contemplare æthera quod altior te sit. <l eID="gen4140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1954"/><l level="1" sID="gen4141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1954"/>Si peccaveris, quid ei nocebis ? <l eID="gen4141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4142"/>et si multiplicatæ fuerint iniquitates tuæ, quid facies contra eum ? <l eID="gen4142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1955"/><l level="1" sID="gen4143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1955"/>Porro si juste egeris, quid donabis ei ? <l eID="gen4143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4144"/>aut quid de manu tua accipiet ? <l eID="gen4144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1956"/><l level="1" sID="gen4145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1956"/>Homini qui similis tui est, nocebit impietas tua : <l eID="gen4145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4146"/>et filium hominis adjuvabit justitia tua. <l eID="gen4146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1957"/><l level="1" sID="gen4147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1957"/>Propter multitudinem calumniatorum clamabunt, <l eID="gen4147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4148"/>et ejulabunt propter vim brachii tyrannorum. <l eID="gen4148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1958"/><l level="1" sID="gen4149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1958"/>Et non dixit : Ubi est Deus qui fecit me, <l eID="gen4149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4150"/>qui dedit carmina in nocte ; <l eID="gen4150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1959"/><l level="1" sID="gen4151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1959"/>qui docet nos super jumenta terræ, <l eID="gen4151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4152"/>et super volucres cæli erudit nos ? <l eID="gen4152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1960"/><l level="1" sID="gen4153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1960"/>Ibi clamabunt, et non exaudiet, <l eID="gen4153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4154"/>propter superbiam malorum. <l eID="gen4154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1961"/><l level="1" sID="gen4155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1961"/>Non ergo frustra audiet Deus, <l eID="gen4155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4156"/>et Omnipotens causas singulorum intuebitur. <l eID="gen4156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1962"/><l level="1" sID="gen4157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1962"/>Etiam cum dixeris : Non considerat : <l eID="gen4157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4158"/>judicare coram illo, et expecta eum. <l eID="gen4158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1963"/><l level="1" sID="gen4159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1963"/>Nunc enim non infert furorem suum, <l eID="gen4159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4160"/>nec ulciscitur scelus valde. <l eID="gen4160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 35:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1964"/><l level="1" sID="gen4161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1964"/>Ergo Job frustra aperit os suum, <l eID="gen4161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4162"/>et absque scientia verba multiplicat. <l eID="gen4162" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4132"/> <chapter eID="Job.35"/>

verses.name: Job 36:1
verses.text: Addens quoque Eliu, hæc locutus est :  <div eID="gen4163" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 36:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1965"/><lg sID="gen4164"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1965"/>Sustine me paululum, et indicabo tibi : <l eID="gen4165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4166"/>adhuc enim habeo quod pro Deo loquar. <l eID="gen4166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1966"/><l level="1" sID="gen4167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1966"/>Repetam scientiam meam a principio, <l eID="gen4167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4168"/>et operatorem meum probabo justum. <l eID="gen4168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1967"/><l level="1" sID="gen4169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1967"/>Vere enim absque mendacio sermones mei, <l eID="gen4169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4170"/>et perfecta scientia probabitur tibi. <l eID="gen4170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1968"/><l level="1" sID="gen4171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1968"/>Deus potentes non abjicit, <l eID="gen4171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4172"/>cum et ipse sit potens : <l eID="gen4172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1969"/><l level="1" sID="gen4173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1969"/>sed non salvat impios, <l eID="gen4173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4174"/>et judicium pauperibus tribuit. <l eID="gen4174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1970"/><l level="1" sID="gen4175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1970"/>Non auferet a justo oculos suos : <l eID="gen4175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4176"/>et reges in solio collocat in perpetuum, <l eID="gen4176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4177"/>et illi eriguntur. <l eID="gen4177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1971"/><l level="1" sID="gen4178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1971"/>Et si fuerint in catenis, <l eID="gen4178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4179"/>et vinciantur funibus paupertatis, <l eID="gen4179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1972"/><l level="1" sID="gen4180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1972"/>indicabit eis opera eorum, <l eID="gen4180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4181"/>et scelera eorum, quia violenti fuerunt. <l eID="gen4181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1973"/><l level="1" sID="gen4182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1973"/>Revelabit quoque aurem eorum, ut corripiat : <l eID="gen4182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4183"/>et loquetur, ut revertantur ab iniquitate. <l eID="gen4183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1974"/><l level="1" sID="gen4184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1974"/>Si audierint et observaverint, complebunt dies suos in bono, <l eID="gen4184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4185"/>et annos suos in gloria : <l eID="gen4185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1975"/><l level="1" sID="gen4186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1975"/>si autem non audierint, <l eID="gen4186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4187"/>transibunt per gladium, <l eID="gen4187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4188"/>et consumentur in stultitia. <l eID="gen4188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1976"/><l level="1" sID="gen4189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1976"/>Simulatores et callidi provocant iram Dei, <l eID="gen4189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4190"/>neque clamabunt cum vincti fuerint. <l eID="gen4190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1977"/><l level="1" sID="gen4191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1977"/>Morietur in tempestate anima eorum, <l eID="gen4191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4192"/>et vita eorum inter effeminatos. <l eID="gen4192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1978"/><l level="1" sID="gen4193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1978"/>Eripiet de angustia sua pauperem, <l eID="gen4193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4194"/>et revelabit in tribulatione aurem ejus. <l eID="gen4194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1979"/><l level="1" sID="gen4195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1979"/>Igitur salvabit te de ore angusto latissime, <l eID="gen4195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4196"/>et non habente fundamentum subter se : <l eID="gen4196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4197"/>requies autem mensæ tuæ erit plena pinguedine. <l eID="gen4197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1980"/><l level="1" sID="gen4198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1980"/>Causa tua quasi impii judicata est : <l eID="gen4198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4199"/>causam judiciumque recipies. <l eID="gen4199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1981"/><l level="1" sID="gen4200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1981"/>Non te ergo superet ira ut aliquem opprimas : <l eID="gen4200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4201"/>nec multitudo donorum inclinet te. <l eID="gen4201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1982"/><l level="1" sID="gen4202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1982"/>Depone magnitudinem tuam absque tribulatione, <l eID="gen4202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4203"/>et omnes robustos fortitudine. <l eID="gen4203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1983"/><l level="1" sID="gen4204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1983"/>Ne protrahas noctem, <l eID="gen4204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4205"/>ut ascendant populi pro eis. <l eID="gen4205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1984"/><l level="1" sID="gen4206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1984"/>Cave ne declines ad iniquitatem : <l eID="gen4206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4207"/>hanc enim cœpisti sequi post miseriam. <l eID="gen4207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1985"/><l level="1" sID="gen4208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1985"/>Ecce Deus excelsus in fortitudine sua, <l eID="gen4208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4209"/>et nullus ei similis in legislatoribus. <l eID="gen4209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1986"/><l level="1" sID="gen4210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1986"/>Quis poterit scrutari vias ejus ? <l eID="gen4210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4211"/>aut quis potest ei dicere : Operatus es iniquitatem ? <l eID="gen4211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1987"/><l level="1" sID="gen4212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1987"/>Memento quod ignores opus ejus, <l eID="gen4212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4213"/>de quo cecinerunt viri. <l eID="gen4213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1988"/><l level="1" sID="gen4214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1988"/>Omnes homines vident eum : <l eID="gen4214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4215"/>unusquisque intuetur procul. <l eID="gen4215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1989"/><l level="1" sID="gen4216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1989"/>Ecce Deus magnus vincens scientiam nostram : <l eID="gen4216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4217"/>numerus annorum ejus inæstimabilis. <l eID="gen4217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1990"/><l level="1" sID="gen4218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1990"/>Qui aufert stillas pluviæ, <l eID="gen4218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4219"/>et effundit imbres ad instar gurgitum, <l eID="gen4219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1991"/><l level="1" sID="gen4220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1991"/>qui de nubibus fluunt <l eID="gen4220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4221"/>quæ prætexunt cuncta desuper. <l eID="gen4221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1992"/><l level="1" sID="gen4222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1992"/>Si voluerit extendere nubes quasi tentorium suum, <l eID="gen4222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1993"/><l level="1" sID="gen4223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1993"/>et fulgurare lumine suo desuper, <l eID="gen4223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4224"/>cardines quoque maris operiet. <l eID="gen4224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1994"/><l level="1" sID="gen4225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1994"/>Per hæc enim judicat populos, <l eID="gen4225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4226"/>et dat escas multis mortalibus. <l eID="gen4226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1995"/><l level="1" sID="gen4227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1995"/>In manibus abscondit lucem, <l eID="gen4227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4228"/>et præcepit ei ut rursus adveniat. <l eID="gen4228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 36:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1996"/><l level="1" sID="gen4229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1996"/>Annuntiat de ea amico suo, quod possessio ejus sit, <l eID="gen4229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4230"/>et ad eam possit ascendere.  <chapter eID="Job.36"/>

verses.name: Job 37:1
verses.text: Super hoc expavit cor meum, <l eID="gen4231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4232"/>et emotum est de loco suo. <l eID="gen4232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1997"/><l level="1" sID="gen4233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1997"/>Audite auditionem in terrore vocis ejus, <l eID="gen4233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4234"/>et sonum de ore illius procedentem. <l eID="gen4234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1998"/><l level="1" sID="gen4235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1998"/>Subter omnes cælos ipse considerat, <l eID="gen4235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4236"/>et lumen illius super terminos terræ. <l eID="gen4236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv1999"/><l level="1" sID="gen4237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv1999"/>Post eum rugiet sonitus ; <l eID="gen4237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4238"/>tonabit voce magnitudinis suæ : <l eID="gen4238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4239"/>et non investigabitur, cum audita fuerit vox ejus. <l eID="gen4239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2000"/><l level="1" sID="gen4240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2000"/>Tonabit Deus in voce sua mirabiliter, <l eID="gen4240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4241"/>qui facit magna et inscrutabilia ; <l eID="gen4241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2001"/><l level="1" sID="gen4242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2001"/>qui præcipit nivi ut descendat in terram, <l eID="gen4242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4243"/>et hiemis pluviis, et imbri fortitudinis suæ ; <l eID="gen4243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2002"/><l level="1" sID="gen4244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2002"/>qui in manu omnium hominum signat, <l eID="gen4244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4245"/>ut noverint singuli opera sua. <l eID="gen4245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2003"/><l level="1" sID="gen4246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2003"/>Ingredietur bestia latibulum, <l eID="gen4246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4247"/>et in antro suo morabitur. <l eID="gen4247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2004"/><l level="1" sID="gen4248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2004"/>Ab interioribus egredietur tempestas, <l eID="gen4248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4249"/>et ab Arcturo frigus. <l eID="gen4249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2005"/><l level="1" sID="gen4250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2005"/>Flante Deo, concrescit gelu, <l eID="gen4250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4251"/>et rursum latissimæ funduntur aquæ. <l eID="gen4251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2006"/><l level="1" sID="gen4252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2006"/>Frumentum desiderat nubes, <l eID="gen4252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4253"/>et nubes spargunt lumen suum. <l eID="gen4253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2007"/><l level="1" sID="gen4254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2007"/>Quæ lustrant per circuitum, <l eID="gen4254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4255"/>quocumque eas voluntas gubernantis duxerit, <l eID="gen4255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4256"/>ad omne quod præceperit illis super faciem orbis terrarum : <l eID="gen4256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2008"/><l level="1" sID="gen4257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2008"/>sive in una tribu, sive in terra sua, <l eID="gen4257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4258"/>sive in quocumque loco misericordiæ suæ <l eID="gen4258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4259"/>eas jusserit inveniri. <l eID="gen4259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2009"/><l level="1" sID="gen4260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2009"/>Ausculta hæc, Job : <l eID="gen4260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4261"/>sta, et considera mirabilia Dei. <l eID="gen4261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2010"/><l level="1" sID="gen4262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2010"/>Numquid scis quando præceperit Deus pluviis, <l eID="gen4262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4263"/>ut ostenderent lucem nubium ejus ? <l eID="gen4263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2011"/><l level="1" sID="gen4264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2011"/>Numquid nosti semitas nubium magnas, <l eID="gen4264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4265"/>et perfectas scientias ? <l eID="gen4265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2012"/><l level="1" sID="gen4266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2012"/>Nonne vestimenta tua calida sunt, <l eID="gen4266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4267"/>cum perflata fuerit terra austro ? <l eID="gen4267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2013"/><l level="1" sID="gen4268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2013"/>Tu forsitan cum eo fabricatus es cælos, <l eID="gen4268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4269"/>qui solidissimi quasi ære fusi sunt. <l eID="gen4269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2014"/><l level="1" sID="gen4270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2014"/>Ostende nobis quid dicamus illi : <l eID="gen4270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4271"/>nos quippe involvimur tenebris. <l eID="gen4271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2015"/><l level="1" sID="gen4272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2015"/>Quis narrabit ei quæ loquor ? <l eID="gen4272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4273"/>etiam si locutus fuerit homo, devorabitur. <l eID="gen4273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2016"/><l level="1" sID="gen4274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2016"/>At nunc non vident lucem : <l eID="gen4274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4275"/>subito aër cogetur in nubes, <l eID="gen4275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4276"/>et ventus transiens fugabit eas. <l eID="gen4276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2017"/><l level="1" sID="gen4277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2017"/>Ab aquilone aurum venit, <l eID="gen4277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4278"/>et ad Deum formidolosa laudatio. <l eID="gen4278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2018"/><l level="1" sID="gen4279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2018"/>Digne eum invenire non possumus : <l eID="gen4279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4280"/>magnus fortitudine, et judicio, et justitia : <l eID="gen4280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4281"/>et enarrari non potest. <l eID="gen4281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 37:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2019"/><l level="1" sID="gen4282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2019"/>Ideo timebunt eum viri, <l eID="gen4282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4283"/>et non audebunt contemplari omnes qui sibi videntur esse sapientes. <l eID="gen4283" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4164"/> <chapter eID="Job.37"/>

verses.name: Job 38:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Dominus Job de turbine, dixit :  <div eID="gen4284" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 38:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2020"/><lg sID="gen4285"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2020"/>Quis est iste involvens sententias <l eID="gen4286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4287"/>sermonibus imperitis ? <l eID="gen4287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2021"/><l level="1" sID="gen4288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2021"/>Accinge sicut vir lumbos tuos : <l eID="gen4288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4289"/>interrogabo te, et responde mihi. <l eID="gen4289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2022"/><l level="1" sID="gen4290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2022"/>Ubi eras quando ponebam fundamenta terræ ? <l eID="gen4290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4291"/>indica mihi, si habes intelligentiam. <l eID="gen4291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2023"/><l level="1" sID="gen4292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2023"/>Quis posuit mensuras ejus, si nosti ? <l eID="gen4292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4293"/>vel quis tetendit super eam lineam ? <l eID="gen4293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2024"/><l level="1" sID="gen4294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2024"/>Super quo bases illius solidatæ sunt ? <l eID="gen4294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4295"/>aut quis demisit lapidem angularem ejus, <l eID="gen4295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2025"/><l level="1" sID="gen4296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2025"/>cum me laudarent simul astra matutina, <l eID="gen4296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4297"/>et jubilarent omnes filii Dei ? <l eID="gen4297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2026"/><l level="1" sID="gen4298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2026"/>Quis conclusit ostiis mare, <l eID="gen4298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4299"/>quando erumpebat quasi de vulva procedens ; <l eID="gen4299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2027"/><l level="1" sID="gen4300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2027"/>cum ponerem nubem vestimentum ejus, <l eID="gen4300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4301"/>et caligine illud quasi pannis infantiæ obvolverem ? <l eID="gen4301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2028"/><l level="1" sID="gen4302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2028"/>Circumdedi illud terminis meis, <l eID="gen4302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4303"/>et posui vectem et ostia, <l eID="gen4303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2029"/><l level="1" sID="gen4304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2029"/>et dixi : Usque huc venies, et non procedes amplius, <l eID="gen4304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4305"/>et hic confringes tumentes fluctus tuos. <l eID="gen4305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2030"/><l level="1" sID="gen4306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2030"/>Numquid post ortum tuum præcepisti diluculo, <l eID="gen4306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4307"/>et ostendisti auroræ locum suum ? <l eID="gen4307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2031"/><l level="1" sID="gen4308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2031"/>Et tenuisti concutiens extrema terræ, <l eID="gen4308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4309"/>et excussisti impios ex ea ? <l eID="gen4309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2032"/><l level="1" sID="gen4310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2032"/>Restituetur ut lutum signaculum, <l eID="gen4310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4311"/>et stabit sicut vestimentum : <l eID="gen4311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2033"/><l level="1" sID="gen4312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2033"/>auferetur ab impiis lux sua, <l eID="gen4312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4313"/>et brachium excelsum confringetur. <l eID="gen4313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2034"/><l level="1" sID="gen4314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2034"/>Numquid ingressus es profunda maris, <l eID="gen4314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4315"/>et in novissimis abyssi deambulasti ? <l eID="gen4315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2035"/><l level="1" sID="gen4316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2035"/>Numquid apertæ sunt tibi portæ mortis, <l eID="gen4316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4317"/>et ostia tenebrosa vidisti ? <l eID="gen4317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2036"/><l level="1" sID="gen4318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2036"/>Numquid considerasti latitudinem terræ ? <l eID="gen4318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4319"/>indica mihi, si nosti, omnia : <l eID="gen4319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2037"/><l level="1" sID="gen4320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2037"/>in qua via lux habitet, <l eID="gen4320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4321"/>et tenebrarum quis locus sit : <l eID="gen4321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2038"/><l level="1" sID="gen4322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2038"/>ut ducas unumquodque ad terminos suos, <l eID="gen4322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4323"/>et intelligas semitas domus ejus. <l eID="gen4323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2039"/><l level="1" sID="gen4324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2039"/>Sciebas tunc quod nasciturus esses, <l eID="gen4324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4325"/>et numerum dierum tuorum noveras ? <l eID="gen4325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2040"/><l level="1" sID="gen4326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2040"/>Numquid ingressus es thesauros nivis, <l eID="gen4326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4327"/>aut thesauros grandinis aspexisti, <l eID="gen4327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2041"/><l level="1" sID="gen4328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2041"/>quæ præparavi in tempus hostis, <l eID="gen4328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4329"/>in diem pugnæ et belli ? <l eID="gen4329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2042"/><l level="1" sID="gen4330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2042"/>Per quam viam spargitur lux, <l eID="gen4330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4331"/>dividitur æstus super terram ? <l eID="gen4331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2043"/><l level="1" sID="gen4332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2043"/>Quis dedit vehementissimo imbri cursum, <l eID="gen4332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4333"/>et viam sonantis tonitrui, <l eID="gen4333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2044"/><l level="1" sID="gen4334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2044"/>ut plueret super terram absque homine in deserto, <l eID="gen4334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4335"/>ubi nullus mortalium commoratur ; <l eID="gen4335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2045"/><l level="1" sID="gen4336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2045"/>ut impleret inviam et desolatam, <l eID="gen4336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4337"/>et produceret herbas virentes ? <l eID="gen4337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2046"/><l level="1" sID="gen4338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2046"/>Quis est pluviæ pater ? <l eID="gen4338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4339"/>vel quis genuit stillas roris ? <l eID="gen4339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2047"/><l level="1" sID="gen4340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2047"/>De cujus utero egressa est glacies ? <l eID="gen4340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4341"/>et gelu de cælo quis genuit ? <l eID="gen4341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2048"/><l level="1" sID="gen4342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2048"/>In similitudinem lapidis aquæ durantur, <l eID="gen4342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4343"/>et superficies abyssi constringitur. <l eID="gen4343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2049"/><l level="1" sID="gen4344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2049"/>Numquid conjungere valebis micantes stellas Pleiadas, <l eID="gen4344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4345"/>aut gyrum Arcturi poteris dissipare ? <l eID="gen4345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2050"/><l level="1" sID="gen4346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2050"/>Numquid producis luciferum in tempore suo, <l eID="gen4346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4347"/>et vesperum super filios terræ consurgere facis ? <l eID="gen4347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2051"/><l level="1" sID="gen4348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2051"/>Numquid nosti ordinem cæli, <l eID="gen4348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4349"/>et pones rationem ejus in terra ? <l eID="gen4349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2052"/><l level="1" sID="gen4350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2052"/>Numquid elevabis in nebula vocem tuam, <l eID="gen4350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4351"/>et impetus aquarum operiet te ? <l eID="gen4351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2053"/><l level="1" sID="gen4352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2053"/>Numquid mittes fulgura, et ibunt, <l eID="gen4352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4353"/>et revertentia dicent tibi : Adsumus ? <l eID="gen4353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2054"/><l level="1" sID="gen4354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2054"/>Quis posuit in visceribus hominis sapientiam ? <l eID="gen4354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4355"/>vel quis dedit gallo intelligentiam ? <l eID="gen4355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2055"/><l level="1" sID="gen4356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2055"/>Quis enarrabit cælorum rationem ? <l eID="gen4356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4357"/>et concentum cæli quis dormire faciet ? <l eID="gen4357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2056"/><l level="1" sID="gen4358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2056"/>Quando fundebatur pulvis in terra, <l eID="gen4358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4359"/>et glebæ compingebantur ? <l eID="gen4359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2057"/><l level="1" sID="gen4360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2057"/>Numquid capies leænæ prædam, <l eID="gen4360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4361"/>et animam catulorum ejus implebis, <l eID="gen4361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2058"/><l level="1" sID="gen4362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2058"/>quando cubant in antris, <l eID="gen4362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4363"/>et in specubus insidiantur ? <l eID="gen4363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 38:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2059"/><l level="1" sID="gen4364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2059"/>Quis præparat corvo escam suam, <l eID="gen4364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4365"/>quando pulli ejus clamant ad Deum, <l eID="gen4365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4366"/>vagantes, eo quod non habeant cibos ?  <chapter eID="Job.38"/>

verses.name: Job 39:1
verses.text: Numquid nosti tempus partus ibicum in petris, <l eID="gen4367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4368"/>vel parturientes cervas observasti ? <l eID="gen4368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2060"/><l level="1" sID="gen4369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2060"/>Dinumerasti menses conceptus earum, <l eID="gen4369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4370"/>et scisti tempus partus earum ? <l eID="gen4370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2061"/><l level="1" sID="gen4371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2061"/>Incurvantur ad fœtum, et pariunt, <l eID="gen4371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4372"/>et rugitus emittunt. <l eID="gen4372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2062"/><l level="1" sID="gen4373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2062"/>Separantur filii earum, et pergunt ad pastum : <l eID="gen4373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4374"/>egrediuntur, et non revertuntur ad eas. <l eID="gen4374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2063"/><l level="1" sID="gen4375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2063"/>Quis dimisit onagrum liberum, <l eID="gen4375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4376"/>et vincula ejus quis solvit ? <l eID="gen4376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2064"/><l level="1" sID="gen4377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2064"/>cui dedi in solitudine domum, <l eID="gen4377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4378"/>et tabernacula ejus in terra salsuginis. <l eID="gen4378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2065"/><l level="1" sID="gen4379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2065"/>Contemnit multitudinem civitatis : <l eID="gen4379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4380"/>clamorem exactoris non audit. <l eID="gen4380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2066"/><l level="1" sID="gen4381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2066"/>Circumspicit montes pascuæ suæ, <l eID="gen4381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4382"/>et virentia quæque perquirit. <l eID="gen4382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2067"/><l level="1" sID="gen4383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2067"/>Numquid volet rhinoceros servire tibi, <l eID="gen4383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4384"/>aut morabitur ad præsepe tuum ? <l eID="gen4384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2068"/><l level="1" sID="gen4385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2068"/>Numquid alligabis rhinocerota ad arandum loro tuo, <l eID="gen4385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4386"/>aut confringet glebas vallium post te ? <l eID="gen4386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2069"/><l level="1" sID="gen4387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2069"/>Numquid fiduciam habebis in magna fortitudine ejus, <l eID="gen4387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4388"/>et derelinques ei labores tuos ? <l eID="gen4388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2070"/><l level="1" sID="gen4389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2070"/>Numquid credes illi quod sementem reddat tibi, <l eID="gen4389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4390"/>et aream tuam congreget ? <l eID="gen4390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2071"/><l level="1" sID="gen4391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2071"/>Penna struthionis similis est <l eID="gen4391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4392"/>pennis herodii et accipitris. <l eID="gen4392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2072"/><l level="1" sID="gen4393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2072"/>Quando derelinquit ova sua in terra, <l eID="gen4393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4394"/>tu forsitan in pulvere calefacies ea ? <l eID="gen4394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2073"/><l level="1" sID="gen4395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2073"/>Obliviscitur quod pes conculcet ea, <l eID="gen4395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4396"/>aut bestia agri conterat. <l eID="gen4396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2074"/><l level="1" sID="gen4397"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2074"/>Duratur ad filios suos, quasi non sint sui : <l eID="gen4397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4398"/>frustra laboravit, nullo timore cogente. <l eID="gen4398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2075"/><l level="1" sID="gen4399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2075"/>Privavit enim eam Deus sapientia, <l eID="gen4399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4400"/>nec dedit illi intelligentiam. <l eID="gen4400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2076"/><l level="1" sID="gen4401"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2076"/>Cum tempus fuerit, in altum alas erigit : <l eID="gen4401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4402"/>deridet equum et ascensorem ejus. <l eID="gen4402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2077"/><l level="1" sID="gen4403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2077"/>Numquid præbebis equo fortitudinem, <l eID="gen4403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4404"/>aut circumdabis collo ejus hinnitum ? <l eID="gen4404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2078"/><l level="1" sID="gen4405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2078"/>Numquid suscitabis eum quasi locustas ? <l eID="gen4405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4406"/>gloria narium ejus terror. <l eID="gen4406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2079"/><l level="1" sID="gen4407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2079"/>Terram ungula fodit ; exultat audacter : <l eID="gen4407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4408"/>in occursum pergit armatis. <l eID="gen4408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2080"/><l level="1" sID="gen4409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2080"/>Contemnit pavorem, <l eID="gen4409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4410"/>nec cedit gladio. <l eID="gen4410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2081"/><l level="1" sID="gen4411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2081"/>Super ipsum sonabit pharetra ; <l eID="gen4411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4412"/>vibrabit hasta et clypeus : <l eID="gen4412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2082"/><l level="1" sID="gen4413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2082"/>fervens et fremens sorbet terram, <l eID="gen4413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4414"/>nec reputat tubæ sonare clangorem. <l eID="gen4414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2083"/><l level="1" sID="gen4415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2083"/>Ubi audierit buccinam, dicit : Vah ! <l eID="gen4415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4416"/>procul odoratur bellum : <l eID="gen4416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4417"/>exhortationem ducum, et ululatum exercitus. <l eID="gen4417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2084"/><l level="1" sID="gen4418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2084"/>Numquid per sapientiam tuam plumescit accipiter, <l eID="gen4418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4419"/>expandens alas suas ad austrum ? <l eID="gen4419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2085"/><l level="1" sID="gen4420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2085"/>Numquid ad præceptum tuum elevabitur aquila, <l eID="gen4420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4421"/>et in arduis ponet nidum suum ? <l eID="gen4421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2086"/><l level="1" sID="gen4422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2086"/>In petris manet, <l eID="gen4422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4423"/>et in præruptis silicibus commoratur, <l eID="gen4423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4424"/>atque inaccessis rupibus. <l eID="gen4424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2087"/><l level="1" sID="gen4425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2087"/>Inde contemplatur escam, <l eID="gen4425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4426"/>et de longe oculi ejus prospiciunt. <l eID="gen4426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2088"/><l level="1" sID="gen4427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2088"/>Pulli ejus lambent sanguinem : <l eID="gen4427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4428"/>et ubicumque cadaver fuerit, statim adest.

verses.name: Job 39:31
verses.text: Et adjecit Dominus, et locutus est ad Job : <l eID="gen4428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2089"/><l level="1" sID="gen4429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2089"/>Numquid qui contendit cum Deo, tam facile conquiescit ? <l eID="gen4429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4430"/>utique qui arguit Deum, debet respondere ei.

verses.name: Job 39:33
verses.text: Respondens autem Job Domino, dixit : <l eID="gen4430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2090"/><l level="1" sID="gen4431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2090"/>Qui leviter locutus sum, respondere quid possum ? <l eID="gen4431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4432"/>manum meam ponam super os meum. <l eID="gen4432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 39:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2091"/><l level="1" sID="gen4433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2091"/>Unum locutus sum, quod utinam non dixissem : <l eID="gen4433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4434"/>et alterum, quibus ultra non addam. <l eID="gen4434" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4285"/> <chapter eID="Job.39"/>

verses.name: Job 40:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Dominus Job de turbine, dixit :  <div eID="gen4435" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 40:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2092"/><lg sID="gen4436"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2092"/>Accinge sicut vir lumbos tuos : <l eID="gen4437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4438"/>interrogabo te, et indica mihi. <l eID="gen4438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2093"/><l level="1" sID="gen4439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2093"/>Numquid irritum facies judicium meum, <l eID="gen4439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4440"/>et condemnabis me, ut tu justificeris ? <l eID="gen4440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2094"/><l level="1" sID="gen4441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2094"/>Et si habes brachium sicut Deus ? <l eID="gen4441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4442"/>et si voce simili tonas ? <l eID="gen4442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2095"/><l level="1" sID="gen4443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2095"/>Circumda tibi decorem, et in sublime erigere, <l eID="gen4443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4444"/>et esto gloriosus, et speciosis induere vestibus. <l eID="gen4444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2096"/><l level="1" sID="gen4445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2096"/>Disperge superbos in furore tuo, <l eID="gen4445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4446"/>et respiciens omnem arrogantem humilia. <l eID="gen4446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2097"/><l level="1" sID="gen4447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2097"/>Respice cunctos superbos, et confunde eos, <l eID="gen4447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4448"/>et contere impios in loco suo. <l eID="gen4448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2098"/><l level="1" sID="gen4449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2098"/>Absconde eos in pulvere simul, <l eID="gen4449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4450"/>et facies eorum demerge in foveam. <l eID="gen4450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2099"/><l level="1" sID="gen4451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2099"/>Et ego confitebor <l eID="gen4451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4452"/>quod salvare te possit dextera tua. <l eID="gen4452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2100"/><l level="1" sID="gen4453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2100"/>Ecce behemoth quem feci tecum, <l eID="gen4453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4454"/>fœnum quasi bos comedet. <l eID="gen4454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2101"/><l level="1" sID="gen4455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2101"/>Fortitudo ejus in lumbis ejus, <l eID="gen4455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4456"/>et virtus illius in umbilico ventris ejus. <l eID="gen4456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2102"/><l level="1" sID="gen4457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2102"/>Stringit caudam suam quasi cedrum ; <l eID="gen4457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4458"/>nervi testiculorum ejus perplexi sunt. <l eID="gen4458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2103"/><l level="1" sID="gen4459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2103"/>Ossa ejus velut fistulæ æris ; <l eID="gen4459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4460"/>cartilago illius quasi laminæ ferreæ. <l eID="gen4460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2104"/><l level="1" sID="gen4461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2104"/>Ipse est principium viarum Dei : <l eID="gen4461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4462"/>qui fecit eum applicabit gladium ejus. <l eID="gen4462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2105"/><l level="1" sID="gen4463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2105"/>Huic montes herbas ferunt : <l eID="gen4463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4464"/>omnes bestiæ agri ludent ibi. <l eID="gen4464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2106"/><l level="1" sID="gen4465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2106"/>Sub umbra dormit in secreto calami, <l eID="gen4465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4466"/>et in locis humentibus. <l eID="gen4466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2107"/><l level="1" sID="gen4467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2107"/>Protegunt umbræ umbram ejus : <l eID="gen4467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4468"/>circumdabunt eum salices torrentis. <l eID="gen4468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2108"/><l level="1" sID="gen4469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2108"/>Ecce absorbebit fluvium, et non mirabitur, <l eID="gen4469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4470"/>et habet fiduciam quod influat Jordanis in os ejus. <l eID="gen4470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2109"/><l level="1" sID="gen4471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2109"/>In oculis ejus quasi hamo capiet eum, <l eID="gen4471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4472"/>et in sudibus perforabit nares ejus. <l eID="gen4472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2110"/><l level="1" sID="gen4473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2110"/>An extrahere poteris Leviathan hamo, <l eID="gen4473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4474"/>et fune ligabis linguam ejus ? <l eID="gen4474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2111"/><l level="1" sID="gen4475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2111"/>Numquid pones circulum in naribus ejus, <l eID="gen4475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4476"/>aut armilla perforabis maxillam ejus ? <l eID="gen4476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2112"/><l level="1" sID="gen4477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2112"/>Numquid multiplicabit ad te preces, <l eID="gen4477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4478"/>aut loquetur tibi mollia ? <l eID="gen4478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2113"/><l level="1" sID="gen4479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2113"/>Numquid feriet tecum pactum, <l eID="gen4479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4480"/>et accipies eum servum sempiternum ? <l eID="gen4480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2114"/><l level="1" sID="gen4481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2114"/>Numquid illudes ei quasi avi, <l eID="gen4481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4482"/>aut ligabis eum ancillis tuis ? <l eID="gen4482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2115"/><l level="1" sID="gen4483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2115"/>Concident eum amici ? <l eID="gen4483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4484"/>divident illum negotiatores ? <l eID="gen4484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2116"/><l level="1" sID="gen4485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2116"/>Numquid implebis sagenas pelle ejus, <l eID="gen4485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4486"/>et gurgustium piscium capite illius ? <l eID="gen4486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2117"/><l level="1" sID="gen4487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2117"/>Pone super eum manum tuam : <l eID="gen4487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4488"/>memento belli, nec ultra addas loqui. <l eID="gen4488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 40:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2118"/><l level="1" sID="gen4489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2118"/>Ecce spes ejus frustrabitur eum, <l eID="gen4489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4490"/>et videntibus cunctis præcipitabitur.  <chapter eID="Job.40"/>

verses.name: Job 41:1
verses.text: Non quasi crudelis suscitabo eum : <l eID="gen4491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4492"/>quis enim resistere potest vultui meo ? <l eID="gen4492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2119"/><l level="1" sID="gen4493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2119"/>Quis ante dedit mihi, ut reddam ei ? <l eID="gen4493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4494"/>omnia quæ sub cælo sunt, mea sunt. <l eID="gen4494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2120"/><l level="1" sID="gen4495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2120"/>Non parcam ei, et verbis potentibus, <l eID="gen4495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4496"/>et ad deprecandum compositis. <l eID="gen4496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2121"/><l level="1" sID="gen4497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2121"/>Quis revelabit faciem indumenti ejus ? <l eID="gen4497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4498"/>et in medium oris ejus quis intrabit ? <l eID="gen4498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2122"/><l level="1" sID="gen4499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2122"/>Portas vultus ejus quis aperiet ? <l eID="gen4499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4500"/>per gyrum dentium ejus formido. <l eID="gen4500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2123"/><l level="1" sID="gen4501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2123"/>Corpus illius quasi scuta fusilia, <l eID="gen4501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4502"/>compactum squamis se prementibus. <l eID="gen4502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2124"/><l level="1" sID="gen4503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2124"/>Una uni conjungitur, <l eID="gen4503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4504"/>et ne spiraculum quidem incedit per eas. <l eID="gen4504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2125"/><l level="1" sID="gen4505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2125"/>Una alteri adhærebit, <l eID="gen4505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4506"/>et tenentes se nequaquam separabuntur. <l eID="gen4506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2126"/><l level="1" sID="gen4507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2126"/>Sternutatio ejus splendor ignis, <l eID="gen4507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4508"/>et oculi ejus ut palpebræ diluculi. <l eID="gen4508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2127"/><l level="1" sID="gen4509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2127"/>De ore ejus lampades procedunt, <l eID="gen4509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4510"/>sicut tædæ ignis accensæ. <l eID="gen4510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2128"/><l level="1" sID="gen4511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2128"/>De naribus ejus procedit fumus, <l eID="gen4511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4512"/>sicut ollæ succensæ atque ferventis. <l eID="gen4512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2129"/><l level="1" sID="gen4513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2129"/>Halitus ejus prunas ardere facit, <l eID="gen4513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4514"/>et flamma de ore ejus egreditur. <l eID="gen4514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2130"/><l level="1" sID="gen4515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2130"/>In collo ejus morabitur fortitudo, <l eID="gen4515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4516"/>et faciem ejus præcedit egestas. <l eID="gen4516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2131"/><l level="1" sID="gen4517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2131"/>Membra carnium ejus cohærentia sibi : <l eID="gen4517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4518"/>mittet contra eum fulmina, et ad locum alium non ferentur. <l eID="gen4518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2132"/><l level="1" sID="gen4519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2132"/>Cor ejus indurabitur tamquam lapis, <l eID="gen4519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4520"/>et stringetur quasi malleatoris incus. <l eID="gen4520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2133"/><l level="1" sID="gen4521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2133"/>Cum sublatus fuerit, timebunt angeli, <l eID="gen4521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4522"/>et territi purgabuntur. <l eID="gen4522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2134"/><l level="1" sID="gen4523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2134"/>Cum apprehenderit eum gladius, subsistere non poterit, <l eID="gen4523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4524"/>neque hasta, neque thorax : <l eID="gen4524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2135"/><l level="1" sID="gen4525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2135"/>reputabit enim quasi paleas ferrum, <l eID="gen4525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4526"/>et quasi lignum putridum æs. <l eID="gen4526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2136"/><l level="1" sID="gen4527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2136"/>Non fugabit eum vir sagittarius : <l eID="gen4527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4528"/>in stipulam versi sunt ei lapides fundæ. <l eID="gen4528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2137"/><l level="1" sID="gen4529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2137"/>Quasi stipulam æstimabit malleum, <l eID="gen4529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4530"/>et deridebit vibrantem hastam. <l eID="gen4530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2138"/><l level="1" sID="gen4531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2138"/>Sub ipso erunt radii solis, <l eID="gen4531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4532"/>et sternet sibi aurum quasi lutum. <l eID="gen4532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2139"/><l level="1" sID="gen4533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2139"/>Fervescere faciet quasi ollam profundum mare, <l eID="gen4533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4534"/>et ponet quasi cum unguenta bulliunt. <l eID="gen4534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2140"/><l level="1" sID="gen4535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2140"/>Post eum lucebit semita : <l eID="gen4535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4536"/>æstimabit abyssum quasi senescentem. <l eID="gen4536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2141"/><l level="1" sID="gen4537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2141"/>Non est super terram potestas quæ comparetur ei, <l eID="gen4537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4538"/>qui factus est ut nullum timeret. <l eID="gen4538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 41:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2142"/><l level="1" sID="gen4539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2142"/>Omne sublime videt : <l eID="gen4539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4540"/>ipse est rex super universos filios superbiæ. <l eID="gen4540" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4436"/> <chapter eID="Job.41"/>

verses.name: Job 42:1
verses.text: Respondens autem Job Domino, dixit :  <div eID="gen4541" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Job 42:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2143"/><lg sID="gen4542"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2143"/>Scio quia omnia potes, <l eID="gen4543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4544"/>et nulla te latet cogitatio. <l eID="gen4544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 42:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2144"/><l level="1" sID="gen4545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2144"/>Quis est iste qui celat consilium absque scientia ? <l eID="gen4545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4546"/>ideo insipienter locutus sum, <l eID="gen4546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4547"/>et quæ ultra modum excederent scientiam meam. <l eID="gen4547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 42:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2145"/><l level="1" sID="gen4548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2145"/>Audi, et ego loquar : <l eID="gen4548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4549"/>interrogabo te, et responde mihi. <l eID="gen4549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 42:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2146"/><l level="1" sID="gen4550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2146"/>Auditu auris audivi te : <l eID="gen4550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4551"/>nunc autem oculus meus videt te. <l eID="gen4551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Job 42:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2147"/><l level="1" sID="gen4552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2147"/>Idcirco ipse me reprehendo, <l eID="gen4552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4553"/>et ago pœnitentiam in favilla et cinere. <l eID="gen4553" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen4542"/>

verses.name: Job 42:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2148"/><div sID="gen4554" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2148"/>Postquam autem locutus est Dominus verba hæc ad Job, dixit ad Eliphaz Themanitem : Iratus est furor meus in te, et in duos amicos tuos, quoniam non estis locuti coram me rectum, sicut servus meus Job.

verses.name: Job 42:8
verses.text: Sumite ergo vobis septem tauros et septem arietes, et ite ad servum meum Job, et offerte holocaustum pro vobis : Job autem servus meus orabit pro vobis. Faciem ejus suscipiam, ut non vobis imputetur stultitia : neque enim locuti estis ad me recta, sicut servus meus Job.

verses.name: Job 42:9
verses.text: Abierunt ergo Eliphaz Themanites, et Baldad Suhites, et Sophar Naamathites, et fecerunt sicut locutus fuerat Dominus ad eos : et suscepit Dominus faciem Job.

verses.name: Job 42:10
verses.text: Dominus quoque conversus est ad pœnitentiam Job, cum oraret ille pro amicis suis : et addidit Dominus omnia quæcumque fuerant Job, duplicia.

verses.name: Job 42:11
verses.text: Venerunt autem ad eum omnes fratres sui, et universæ sorores suæ, et cuncti qui noverant eum prius, et comederunt cum eo panem in domo ejus : et moverunt super eum caput, et consolati sunt eum super omni malo quod intulerat Dominus super eum : et dederunt ei unusquisque ovem unam, et inaurem auream unam.

verses.name: Job 42:12
verses.text: Dominus autem benedixit novissimis Job magis quam principio ejus : et facta sunt ei quatuordecim millia ovium, et sex millia camelorum, et mille juga boum, et mille asinæ.

verses.name: Job 42:13
verses.text: Et fuerunt ei septem filii, et tres filiæ.

verses.name: Job 42:14
verses.text: Et vocavit nomen unius Diem, et nomen secundæ Cassiam, et nomen tertiæ Cornustibii.

verses.name: Job 42:15
verses.text: Non sunt autem inventæ mulieres speciosæ sicut filiæ Job in universa terra : deditque eis pater suus hæreditatem inter fratres earum.

verses.name: Job 42:16
verses.text: Vixit autem Job post hæc centum quadraginta annis, et vidit filios suos, et filios filiorum suorum usque ad quartam generationem : et mortuus est senex, et plenus dierum.  <div eID="gen4554" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="Job.42"/> <div eID="gen2422" osisID="Job" type="book"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:1
verses.text: Beatus vir qui non abiit in consilio impiorum, <l eID="gen4557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4558"/>et in via peccatorum non stetit, <l eID="gen4558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4559"/>et in cathedra pestilentiæ non sedit ; <l eID="gen4559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2149"/><l level="1" sID="gen4560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2149"/>sed in lege Domini voluntas ejus, <l eID="gen4560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4561"/>et in lege ejus meditabitur die ac nocte. <l eID="gen4561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2150"/><l level="1" sID="gen4562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2150"/>Et erit tamquam lignum quod plantatum est secus decursus aquarum, <l eID="gen4562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4563"/>quod fructum suum dabit in tempore suo : <l eID="gen4563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4564"/>et folium ejus non defluet ; <l eID="gen4564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4565"/>et omnia quæcumque faciet prosperabuntur. <l eID="gen4565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2151"/><l level="1" sID="gen4566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2151"/>Non sic impii, non sic ; <l eID="gen4566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4567"/>sed tamquam pulvis quem projicit ventus a facie terræ. <l eID="gen4567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2152"/><l level="1" sID="gen4568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2152"/>Ideo non resurgent impii in judicio, <l eID="gen4568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4569"/>neque peccatores in concilio justorum : <l eID="gen4569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2153"/><l level="1" sID="gen4570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2153"/>quoniam novit Dominus viam justorum, <l eID="gen4570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4571"/>et iter impiorum peribit.  <chapter eID="Ps.1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:1
verses.text: Quare fremuerunt gentes, <l eID="gen4572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4573"/>et populi meditati sunt inania ? <l eID="gen4573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2154"/><l level="1" sID="gen4574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2154"/>Astiterunt reges terræ, <l eID="gen4574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4575"/>et principes convenerunt in unum <l eID="gen4575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4576"/>adversus Dominum, et adversus christum ejus. <l eID="gen4576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2155"/><l level="1" sID="gen4577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2155"/>Dirumpamus vincula eorum, <l eID="gen4577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4578"/>et projiciamus a nobis jugum ipsorum. <l eID="gen4578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2156"/><l level="1" sID="gen4579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2156"/>Qui habitat in cælis irridebit eos, <l eID="gen4579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4580"/>et Dominus subsannabit eos. <l eID="gen4580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2157"/><l level="1" sID="gen4581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2157"/>Tunc loquetur ad eos in ira sua, <l eID="gen4581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4582"/>et in furore suo conturbabit eos. <l eID="gen4582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2158"/><l level="1" sID="gen4583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2158"/>Ego autem constitutus sum rex ab eo <l eID="gen4583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4584"/>super Sion, montem sanctum ejus, <l eID="gen4584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4585"/>prædicans præceptum ejus. <l eID="gen4585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2159"/><l level="1" sID="gen4586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2159"/>Dominus dixit ad me : Filius meus es tu ; <l eID="gen4586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4587"/>ego hodie genui te. <l eID="gen4587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2160"/><l level="1" sID="gen4588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2160"/>Postula a me, et dabo tibi gentes hæreditatem tuam, <l eID="gen4588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4589"/>et possessionem tuam terminos terræ. <l eID="gen4589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2161"/><l level="1" sID="gen4590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2161"/>Reges eos in virga ferrea, <l eID="gen4590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4591"/>et tamquam vas figuli confringes eos. <l eID="gen4591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2162"/><l level="1" sID="gen4592"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2162"/>Et nunc, reges, intelligite ; <l eID="gen4592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4593"/>erudimini, qui judicatis terram. <l eID="gen4593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2163"/><l level="1" sID="gen4594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2163"/>Servite Domino in timore, <l eID="gen4594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4595"/>et exsultate ei cum tremore. <l eID="gen4595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2164"/><l level="1" sID="gen4596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2164"/>Apprehendite disciplinam, nequando irascatur Dominus, <l eID="gen4596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4597"/>et pereatis de via justa. <l eID="gen4597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2165"/><l level="1" sID="gen4598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2165"/>Cum exarserit in brevi ira ejus, <l eID="gen4598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4599"/>beati omnes qui confidunt in eo. <l eID="gen4599" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4556"/> <chapter eID="Ps.2"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, cum fugeret a facie Absalom filii sui.  <div eID="gen4600" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2166"/><lg sID="gen4601"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2166"/>Domine, quid multiplicati sunt qui tribulant me ? <l eID="gen4602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4603"/>Multi insurgunt adversum me ; <l eID="gen4603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2167"/><l level="1" sID="gen4604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2167"/>multi dicunt animæ meæ : <l eID="gen4604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4605"/>Non est salus ipsi in Deo ejus. <l eID="gen4605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2168"/><l level="1" sID="gen4606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2168"/>Tu autem Domine, susceptor meus es, <l eID="gen4606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4607"/>gloria mea, et exaltans caput meum. <l eID="gen4607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2169"/><l level="1" sID="gen4608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2169"/>Voce mea ad Dominum clamavi ; <l eID="gen4608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4609"/>et exaudivit me de monte sancto suo. <l eID="gen4609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2170"/><l level="1" sID="gen4610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2170"/>Ego dormivi, et soporatus sum ; <l eID="gen4610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4611"/>et exsurrexi, quia Dominus suscepit me. <l eID="gen4611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:7
