verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2171"/><l level="1" sID="gen4612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2171"/>Non timebo millia populi circumdantis me. <l eID="gen4612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4613"/>Exsurge, Domine ; salvum me fac, Deus meus. <l eID="gen4613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2172"/><l level="1" sID="gen4614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2172"/>Quoniam tu percussisti omnes adversantes mihi sine causa ; <l eID="gen4614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4615"/>dentes peccatorum contrivisti. <l eID="gen4615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2173"/><l level="1" sID="gen4616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2173"/>Domini est salus ; <l eID="gen4616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4617"/>et super populum tuum benedictio tua. <l eID="gen4617" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4601"/> <chapter eID="Ps.3"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:1
verses.text: In finem, in carminibus. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen4618" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2174"/><lg sID="gen4619"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2174"/>Cum invocarem exaudivit me Deus justitiæ meæ, <l eID="gen4620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4621"/>in tribulatione dilatasti mihi. <l eID="gen4621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4622"/>Miserere mei, et exaudi orationem meam. <l eID="gen4622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2175"/><l level="1" sID="gen4623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2175"/>Filii hominum, usquequo gravi corde ? <l eID="gen4623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4624"/>ut quid diligitis vanitatem, et quæritis mendacium ? <l eID="gen4624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2176"/><l level="1" sID="gen4625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2176"/>Et scitote quoniam mirificavit Dominus sanctum suum ; <l eID="gen4625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4626"/>Dominus exaudiet me cum clamavero ad eum. <l eID="gen4626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2177"/><l level="1" sID="gen4627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2177"/>Irascimini, et nolite peccare ; <l eID="gen4627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4628"/>quæ dicitis in cordibus vestris, in cubilibus vestris compungimini. <l eID="gen4628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2178"/><l level="1" sID="gen4629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2178"/>Sacrificate sacrificium justitiæ, et sperate in Domino. <l eID="gen4629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4630"/>Multi dicunt : Quis ostendit nobis bona ? <l eID="gen4630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2179"/><l level="1" sID="gen4631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2179"/>Signatum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Domine : <l eID="gen4631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4632"/>dedisti lætitiam in corde meo. <l eID="gen4632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2180"/><l level="1" sID="gen4633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2180"/>A fructu frumenti, vini, et olei sui, multiplicati sunt. <l eID="gen4633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2181"/><l level="1" sID="gen4634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2181"/>In pace in idipsum dormiam, et requiescam ; <l eID="gen4634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2182"/><l level="1" sID="gen4635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2182"/>quoniam tu, Domine, singulariter in spe constituisti me. <l eID="gen4635" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4619"/> <chapter eID="Ps.4"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:1
verses.text: In finem, pro ea quæ hæreditatem consequitur. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen4636" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2183"/><lg sID="gen4637"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2183"/>Verba mea auribus percipe, Domine ; <l eID="gen4638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4639"/>intellige clamorem meum. <l eID="gen4639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2184"/><l level="1" sID="gen4640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2184"/>Intende voci orationis meæ, <l eID="gen4640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4641"/>rex meus et Deus meus. <l eID="gen4641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2185"/><l level="1" sID="gen4642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2185"/>Quoniam ad te orabo, Domine : <l eID="gen4642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4643"/>mane exaudies vocem meam. <l eID="gen4643" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2186"/><l level="1" sID="gen4644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2186"/>Mane astabo tibi, et videbo <l eID="gen4644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4645"/>quoniam non Deus volens iniquitatem tu es. <l eID="gen4645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2187"/><l level="1" sID="gen4646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2187"/>Neque habitabit juxta te malignus, <l eID="gen4646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4647"/>neque permanebunt injusti ante oculos tuos. <l eID="gen4647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2188"/><l level="1" sID="gen4648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2188"/>Odisti omnes qui operantur iniquitatem ; <l eID="gen4648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4649"/>perdes omnes qui loquuntur mendacium. <l eID="gen4649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4650"/>Virum sanguinum et dolosum abominabitur Dominus. <l eID="gen4650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2189"/><l level="1" sID="gen4651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2189"/>Ego autem in multitudine misericordiæ tuæ <l eID="gen4651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4652"/>introibo in domum tuam ; <l eID="gen4652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4653"/>adorabo ad templum sanctum tuum in timore tuo. <l eID="gen4653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2190"/><l level="1" sID="gen4654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2190"/>Domine, deduc me in justitia tua : <l eID="gen4654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4655"/>propter inimicos meos dirige in conspectu tuo viam meam. <l eID="gen4655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2191"/><l level="1" sID="gen4656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2191"/>Quoniam non est in ore eorum veritas ; <l eID="gen4656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4657"/>cor eorum vanum est. <l eID="gen4657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2192"/><l level="1" sID="gen4658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2192"/>Sepulchrum patens est guttur eorum ; <l eID="gen4658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4659"/>linguis suis dolose agebant : <l eID="gen4659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4660"/>judica illos, Deus. <l eID="gen4660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4661"/>Decidant a cogitationibus suis ; <l eID="gen4661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4662"/>secundum multitudinem impietatum eorum expelle eos, <l eID="gen4662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4663"/>quoniam irritaverunt te, Domine. <l eID="gen4663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2193"/><l level="1" sID="gen4664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2193"/>Et lætentur omnes qui sperant in te ; <l eID="gen4664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4665"/>in æternum exsultabunt, et habitabis in eis. <l eID="gen4665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4666"/>Et gloriabuntur in te omnes qui diligunt nomen tuum, <l eID="gen4666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2194"/><l level="1" sID="gen4667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2194"/>quoniam tu benedices justo. <l eID="gen4667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4668"/>Domine, ut scuto bonæ voluntatis tuæ coronasti nos. <l eID="gen4668" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4637"/> <chapter eID="Ps.5"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:1
verses.text: In finem, in carminibus. Psalmus David. Pro octava.  <div eID="gen4669" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2195"/><lg sID="gen4670"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2195"/>Domine, ne in furore tuo arguas me, <l eID="gen4671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4672"/>neque in ira tua corripias me. <l eID="gen4672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2196"/><l level="1" sID="gen4673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2196"/>Miserere mei, Domine, quoniam infirmus sum ; <l eID="gen4673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4674"/>sana me, Domine, quoniam conturbata sunt ossa mea. <l eID="gen4674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2197"/><l level="1" sID="gen4675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2197"/>Et anima mea turbata est valde ; <l eID="gen4675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4676"/>sed tu, Domine, usquequo ? <l eID="gen4676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2198"/><l level="1" sID="gen4677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2198"/>Convertere, Domine, et eripe animam meam ; <l eID="gen4677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4678"/>salvum me fac propter misericordiam tuam. <l eID="gen4678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2199"/><l level="1" sID="gen4679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2199"/>Quoniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui ; <l eID="gen4679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4680"/>in inferno autem quis confitebitur tibi ? <l eID="gen4680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2200"/><l level="1" sID="gen4681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2200"/>Laboravi in gemitu meo ; <l eID="gen4681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4682"/>lavabo per singulas noctes lectum meum : <l eID="gen4682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4683"/>lacrimis meis stratum meum rigabo. <l eID="gen4683" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2201"/><l level="1" sID="gen4684"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2201"/>Turbatus est a furore oculus meus ; <l eID="gen4684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4685"/>inveteravi inter omnes inimicos meos. <l eID="gen4685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2202"/><l level="1" sID="gen4686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2202"/>Discedite a me omnes qui operamini iniquitatem, <l eID="gen4686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4687"/>quoniam exaudivit Dominus vocem fletus mei. <l eID="gen4687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2203"/><l level="1" sID="gen4688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2203"/>Exaudivit Dominus deprecationem meam ; <l eID="gen4688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4689"/>Dominus orationem meam suscepit. <l eID="gen4689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2204"/><l level="1" sID="gen4690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2204"/>Erubescant, et conturbentur vehementer, omnes inimici mei ; <l eID="gen4690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4691"/>convertantur, et erubescant valde velociter. <l eID="gen4691" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4670"/> <chapter eID="Ps.6"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, quem cantavit Domino pro verbis Chusi, filii Jemini.  <div eID="gen4692" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2205"/><lg sID="gen4693"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2205"/>Domine Deus meus, in te speravi ; <l eID="gen4694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4695"/>salvum me fac ex omnibus persequentibus me, et libera me : <l eID="gen4695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2206"/><l level="1" sID="gen4696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2206"/>nequando rapiat ut leo animam meam, <l eID="gen4696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4697"/>dum non est qui redimat, neque qui salvum faciat. <l eID="gen4697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2207"/><l level="1" sID="gen4698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2207"/>Domine Deus meus, si feci istud, <l eID="gen4698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4699"/>si est iniquitas in manibus meis, <l eID="gen4699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2208"/><l level="1" sID="gen4700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2208"/>si reddidi retribuentibus mihi mala, <l eID="gen4700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4701"/>decidam merito ab inimicis meis inanis. <l eID="gen4701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2209"/><l level="1" sID="gen4702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2209"/>Persequatur inimicus animam meam, et comprehendat ; <l eID="gen4702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4703"/>et conculcet in terra vitam meam, <l eID="gen4703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4704"/>et gloriam meam in pulverem deducat. <l eID="gen4704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2210"/><l level="1" sID="gen4705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2210"/>Exsurge, Domine, in ira tua, <l eID="gen4705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4706"/>et exaltare in finibus inimicorum meorum : <l eID="gen4706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4707"/>et exsurge, Domine Deus meus, in præcepto quod mandasti, <l eID="gen4707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2211"/><l level="1" sID="gen4708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2211"/>et synagoga populorum circumdabit te : <l eID="gen4708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4709"/>et propter hanc in altum regredere : <l eID="gen4709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2212"/><l level="1" sID="gen4710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2212"/>Dominus judicat populos. <l eID="gen4710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4711"/>Judica me, Domine, secundum justitiam meam, <l eID="gen4711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4712"/>et secundum innocentiam meam super me. <l eID="gen4712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2213"/><l level="1" sID="gen4713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2213"/>Consumetur nequitia peccatorum, et diriges justum, <l eID="gen4713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4714"/>scrutans corda et renes, Deus. <l eID="gen4714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2214"/><l level="1" sID="gen4715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2214"/>Justum adjutorium meum a Domino, <l eID="gen4715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4716"/>qui salvos facit rectos corde. <l eID="gen4716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2215"/><l level="1" sID="gen4717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2215"/>Deus judex justus, fortis, et patiens ; <l eID="gen4717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4718"/>numquid irascitur per singulos dies ? <l eID="gen4718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2216"/><l level="1" sID="gen4719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2216"/>Nisi conversi fueritis, gladium suum vibrabit ; <l eID="gen4719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4720"/>arcum suum tetendit, et paravit illum. <l eID="gen4720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2217"/><l level="1" sID="gen4721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2217"/>Et in eo paravit vasa mortis, <l eID="gen4721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4722"/>sagittas suas ardentibus effecit. <l eID="gen4722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2218"/><l level="1" sID="gen4723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2218"/>Ecce parturiit injustitiam ; <l eID="gen4723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4724"/>concepit dolorem, et peperit iniquitatem. <l eID="gen4724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2219"/><l level="1" sID="gen4725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2219"/>Lacum aperuit, et effodit eum ; <l eID="gen4725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4726"/>et incidit in foveam quam fecit. <l eID="gen4726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2220"/><l level="1" sID="gen4727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2220"/>Convertetur dolor ejus in caput ejus, <l eID="gen4727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4728"/>et in verticem ipsius iniquitas ejus descendet. <l eID="gen4728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2221"/><l level="1" sID="gen4729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2221"/>Confitebor Domino secundum justitiam ejus, <l eID="gen4729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4730"/>et psallam nomini Domini altissimi. <l eID="gen4730" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4693"/> <chapter eID="Ps.7"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:1
verses.text: In finem, pro torcularibus. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen4731" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2222"/><lg sID="gen4732"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2222"/>Domine, Dominus noster, <l eID="gen4733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4734"/>quam admirabile est nomen tuum in universa terra ! <l eID="gen4734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4735"/>quoniam elevata est magnificentia tua super cælos. <l eID="gen4735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2223"/><l level="1" sID="gen4736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2223"/>Ex ore infantium et lactentium perfecisti laudem propter inimicos tuos, <l eID="gen4736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4737"/>ut destruas inimicum et ultorem. <l eID="gen4737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2224"/><l level="1" sID="gen4738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2224"/>Quoniam videbo cælos tuos, opera digitorum tuorum, <l eID="gen4738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4739"/>lunam et stellas quæ tu fundasti. <l eID="gen4739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2225"/><l level="1" sID="gen4740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2225"/>Quid est homo, quod memor es ejus ? <l eID="gen4740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4741"/>aut filius hominis, quoniam visitas eum ? <l eID="gen4741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2226"/><l level="1" sID="gen4742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2226"/>Minuisti eum paulominus ab angelis ; <l eID="gen4742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4743"/>gloria et honore coronasti eum ; <l eID="gen4743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2227"/><l level="1" sID="gen4744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2227"/>et constituisti eum super opera manuum tuarum. <l eID="gen4744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2228"/><l level="1" sID="gen4745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2228"/>Omnia subjecisti sub pedibus ejus, <l eID="gen4745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4746"/>oves et boves universas, <l eID="gen4746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4747"/>insuper et pecora campi, <l eID="gen4747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2229"/><l level="1" sID="gen4748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2229"/>volucres cæli, et pisces maris <l eID="gen4748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4749"/>qui perambulant semitas maris. <l eID="gen4749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2230"/><l level="1" sID="gen4750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2230"/>Domine, Dominus noster, <l eID="gen4750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4751"/>quam admirabile est nomen tuum in universa terra ! <l eID="gen4751" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4732"/> <chapter eID="Ps.8"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:1
verses.text: In finem, pro occultis filii. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen4752" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2231"/><lg sID="gen4753"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2231"/>Confitebor tibi, Domine, in toto corde meo ; <l eID="gen4754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4755"/>narrabo omnia mirabilia tua. <l eID="gen4755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2232"/><l level="1" sID="gen4756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2232"/>Lætabor et exsultabo in te ; <l eID="gen4756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4757"/>psallam nomini tuo, Altissime. <l eID="gen4757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2233"/><l level="1" sID="gen4758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2233"/>In convertendo inimicum meum retrorsum ; <l eID="gen4758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4759"/>infirmabuntur, et peribunt a facie tua. <l eID="gen4759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2234"/><l level="1" sID="gen4760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2234"/>Quoniam fecisti judicium meum et causam meam ; <l eID="gen4760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4761"/>sedisti super thronum, qui judicas justitiam. <l eID="gen4761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2235"/><l level="1" sID="gen4762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2235"/>Increpasti gentes, et periit impius : <l eID="gen4762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4763"/>nomen eorum delesti in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen4763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2236"/><l level="1" sID="gen4764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2236"/>Inimici defecerunt frameæ in finem, <l eID="gen4764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4765"/>et civitates eorum destruxisti. <l eID="gen4765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4766"/>Periit memoria eorum cum sonitu ; <l eID="gen4766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2237"/><l level="1" sID="gen4767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2237"/>et Dominus in æternum permanet. <l eID="gen4767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4768"/>Paravit in judicio thronum suum, <l eID="gen4768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2238"/><l level="1" sID="gen4769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2238"/>et ipse judicabit orbem terræ in æquitate : <l eID="gen4769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4770"/>judicabit populos in justitia. <l eID="gen4770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2239"/><l level="1" sID="gen4771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2239"/>Et factus est Dominus refugium pauperi ; <l eID="gen4771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4772"/>adjutor in opportunitatibus, in tribulatione. <l eID="gen4772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2240"/><l level="1" sID="gen4773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2240"/>Et sperent in te qui noverunt nomen tuum, <l eID="gen4773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4774"/>quoniam non dereliquisti quærentes te, Domine. <l eID="gen4774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2241"/><l level="1" sID="gen4775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2241"/>Psallite Domino qui habitat in Sion ; <l eID="gen4775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4776"/>annuntiate inter gentes studia ejus : <l eID="gen4776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2242"/><l level="1" sID="gen4777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2242"/>quoniam requirens sanguinem eorum recordatus est ; <l eID="gen4777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4778"/>non est oblitus clamorem pauperum. <l eID="gen4778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2243"/><l level="1" sID="gen4779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2243"/>Miserere mei, Domine : <l eID="gen4779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4780"/>vide humilitatem meam de inimicis meis, <l eID="gen4780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2244"/><l level="1" sID="gen4781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2244"/>qui exaltas me de portis mortis, <l eID="gen4781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4782"/>ut annuntiem omnes laudationes tuas in portis filiæ Sion : <l eID="gen4782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2245"/><l level="1" sID="gen4783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2245"/>exultabo in salutari tuo. <l eID="gen4783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4784"/>Infixæ sunt gentes in interitu quem fecerunt ; <l eID="gen4784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4785"/>in laqueo isto quem absconderunt <l eID="gen4785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4786"/>comprehensus est pes eorum. <l eID="gen4786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2246"/><l level="1" sID="gen4787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2246"/>Cognoscetur Dominus judicia faciens ; <l eID="gen4787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4788"/>in operibus manuum suarum comprehensus est peccator. <l eID="gen4788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2247"/><l level="1" sID="gen4789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2247"/>Convertantur peccatores in infernum, <l eID="gen4789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4790"/>omnes gentes quæ obliviscuntur Deum. <l eID="gen4790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2248"/><l level="1" sID="gen4791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2248"/>Quoniam non in finem oblivio erit pauperis ; <l eID="gen4791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4792"/>patientia pauperum non peribit in finem. <l eID="gen4792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2249"/><l level="1" sID="gen4793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2249"/>Exsurge, Domine ; non confortetur homo : <l eID="gen4793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4794"/>judicentur gentes in conspectu tuo. <l eID="gen4794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2250"/><l level="1" sID="gen4795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2250"/>Constitue, Domine, legislatorem super eos, <l eID="gen4795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4796"/>ut sciant gentes quoniam homines sunt. <l eID="gen4796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2251"/><l level="1" sID="gen4797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2251"/>Ut quid, Domine, recessisti longe ; <l eID="gen4797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4798"/>despicis in opportunitatibus, in tribulatione ? <l eID="gen4798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2252"/><l level="1" sID="gen4799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2252"/>Dum superbit impius, incenditur pauper : <l eID="gen4799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4800"/>comprehenduntur in consiliis quibus cogitant. <l eID="gen4800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2253"/><l level="1" sID="gen4801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2253"/>Quoniam laudatur peccator in desideriis animæ suæ, <l eID="gen4801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4802"/>et iniquus benedicitur. <l eID="gen4802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2254"/><l level="1" sID="gen4803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2254"/>Exacerbavit Dominum peccator : <l eID="gen4803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4804"/>secundum multitudinem iræ suæ, non quæret. <l eID="gen4804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2255"/><l level="1" sID="gen4805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2255"/>Non est Deus in conspectu ejus ; <l eID="gen4805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4806"/>inquinatæ sunt viæ illius in omni tempore. <l eID="gen4806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4807"/>Auferuntur judicia tua a facie ejus ; <l eID="gen4807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4808"/>omnium inimicorum suorum dominabitur. <l eID="gen4808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2256"/><l level="1" sID="gen4809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2256"/>Dixit enim in corde suo : Non movebor <l eID="gen4809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4810"/>a generatione in generationem, sine malo. <l eID="gen4810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2257"/><l level="1" sID="gen4811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2257"/>Cujus maledictione os plenum est, et amaritudine, et dolo ; <l eID="gen4811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4812"/>sub lingua ejus labor et dolor. <l eID="gen4812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2258"/><l level="1" sID="gen4813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2258"/>Sedet in insidiis cum divitibus in occultis, <l eID="gen4813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4814"/>ut interficiat innocentem. <l eID="gen4814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2259"/><l level="1" sID="gen4815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2259"/>Oculi ejus in pauperem respiciunt ; <l eID="gen4815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4816"/>insidiatur in abscondito, quasi leo in spelunca sua. <l eID="gen4816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4817"/>Insidiatur ut rapiat pauperem ; <l eID="gen4817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4818"/>rapere pauperem dum attrahit eum. <l eID="gen4818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2260"/><l level="1" sID="gen4819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2260"/>In laqueo suo humiliabit eum ; <l eID="gen4819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4820"/>inclinabit se, et cadet cum dominatus fuerit pauperum. <l eID="gen4820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2261"/><l level="1" sID="gen4821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2261"/>Dixit enim in corde suo : Oblitus est Deus ; <l eID="gen4821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4822"/>avertit faciem suam, ne videat in finem. <l eID="gen4822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2262"/><l level="1" sID="gen4823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2262"/>Exsurge, Domine Deus, exaltetur manus tua ; <l eID="gen4823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4824"/>ne obliviscaris pauperum. <l eID="gen4824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2263"/><l level="1" sID="gen4825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2263"/>Propter quid irritavit impius Deum ? <l eID="gen4825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4826"/>dixit enim in corde suo : Non requiret. <l eID="gen4826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2264"/><l level="1" sID="gen4827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2264"/>Vides, quoniam tu laborem et dolorem consideras, <l eID="gen4827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4828"/>ut tradas eos in manus tuas. <l eID="gen4828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4829"/>Tibi derelictus est pauper ; <l eID="gen4829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4830"/>orphano tu eris adjutor. <l eID="gen4830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2265"/><l level="1" sID="gen4831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2265"/>Contere brachium peccatoris et maligni ; <l eID="gen4831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4832"/>quæretur peccatum illius, et non invenietur. <l eID="gen4832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2266"/><l level="1" sID="gen4833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2266"/>Dominus regnabit in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi ; <l eID="gen4833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4834"/>peribitis, gentes, de terra illius. <l eID="gen4834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2267"/><l level="1" sID="gen4835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2267"/>Desiderium pauperum exaudivit Dominus ; <l eID="gen4835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4836"/>præparationem cordis eorum audivit auris tua : <l eID="gen4836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 9:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2268"/><l level="1" sID="gen4837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2268"/>judicare pupillo et humili, <l eID="gen4837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4838"/>ut non apponat ultra magnificare se homo super terram. <l eID="gen4838" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4753"/> <chapter eID="Ps.9"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen4839" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2269"/><lg sID="gen4840"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2269"/>In Domino confido ; quomodo dicitis animæ meæ : <l eID="gen4841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4842"/>Transmigra in montem sicut passer ? <l eID="gen4842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2270"/><l level="1" sID="gen4843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2270"/>Quoniam ecce peccatores intenderunt arcum ; <l eID="gen4843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4844"/>paraverunt sagittas suas in pharetra, <l eID="gen4844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4845"/>ut sagittent in obscuro rectos corde : <l eID="gen4845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2271"/><l level="1" sID="gen4846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2271"/>quoniam quæ perfecisti destruxerunt ; <l eID="gen4846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4847"/>justus autem, quid fecit ? <l eID="gen4847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2272"/><l level="1" sID="gen4848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2272"/>Dominus in templo sancto suo ; <l eID="gen4848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4849"/>Dominus in cælo sedes ejus. <l eID="gen4849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4850"/>Oculi ejus in pauperem respiciunt ; <l eID="gen4850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4851"/>palpebræ ejus interrogant filios hominum. <l eID="gen4851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2273"/><l level="1" sID="gen4852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2273"/>Dominus interrogat justum et impium ; <l eID="gen4852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4853"/>qui autem diligit iniquitatem, odit animam suam. <l eID="gen4853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2274"/><l level="1" sID="gen4854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2274"/>Pluet super peccatores laqueos ; <l eID="gen4854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4855"/>ignis et sulphur, et spiritus procellarum, pars calicis eorum. <l eID="gen4855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2275"/><l level="1" sID="gen4856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2275"/>Quoniam justus Dominus, et justitias dilexit : <l eID="gen4856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4857"/>æquitatem vidit vultus ejus. <l eID="gen4857" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4840"/> <chapter eID="Ps.10"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:1
verses.text: In finem, pro octava. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen4858" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2276"/><lg sID="gen4859"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2276"/>Salvum me fac, Domine, quoniam defecit sanctus, <l eID="gen4860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4861"/>quoniam diminutæ sunt veritates a filiis hominum. <l eID="gen4861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2277"/><l level="1" sID="gen4862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2277"/>Vana locuti sunt unusquisque ad proximum suum ; <l eID="gen4862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4863"/>labia dolosa, in corde et corde locuti sunt. <l eID="gen4863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2278"/><l level="1" sID="gen4864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2278"/>Disperdat Dominus universa labia dolosa, <l eID="gen4864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4865"/>et linguam magniloquam. <l eID="gen4865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2279"/><l level="1" sID="gen4866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2279"/>Qui dixerunt : Linguam nostram magnificabimus ; <l eID="gen4866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4867"/>labia nostra a nobis sunt. <l eID="gen4867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4868"/>Quis noster dominus est ? <l eID="gen4868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2280"/><l level="1" sID="gen4869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2280"/>Propter miseriam inopum, et gemitum pauperum, <l eID="gen4869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4870"/>nunc exsurgam, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen4870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4871"/>Ponam in salutari ; <l eID="gen4871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4872"/>fiducialiter agam in eo. <l eID="gen4872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2281"/><l level="1" sID="gen4873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2281"/>Eloquia Domini, eloquia casta ; argentum igne examinatum, <l eID="gen4873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4874"/>probatum terræ, purgatum septuplum. <l eID="gen4874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2282"/><l level="1" sID="gen4875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2282"/>Tu, Domine, servabis nos, <l eID="gen4875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4876"/>et custodies nos a generatione hac in æternum. <l eID="gen4876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2283"/><l level="1" sID="gen4877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2283"/>In circuitu impii ambulant : <l eID="gen4877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4878"/>secundum altitudinem tuam multiplicasti filios hominum. <l eID="gen4878" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4859"/> <chapter eID="Ps.11"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David. <div eID="gen4879" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4880"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4881"/>Usquequo, Domine, oblivisceris me in finem ? <l eID="gen4881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4882"/>usquequo avertis faciem tuam a me ? <l eID="gen4882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2284"/><l level="1" sID="gen4883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2284"/>quamdiu ponam consilia in anima mea ; <l eID="gen4883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4884"/>dolorem in corde meo per diem ? <l eID="gen4884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2285"/><l level="1" sID="gen4885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2285"/>usquequo exaltabitur inimicus meus super me ? <l eID="gen4885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2286"/><l level="1" sID="gen4886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2286"/>Respice, et exaudi me, Domine Deus meus. <l eID="gen4886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4887"/>Illumina oculos meos, ne umquam obdormiam in morte ; <l eID="gen4887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2287"/><l level="1" sID="gen4888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2287"/>nequando dicat inimicus meus : Prævalui adversus eum. <l eID="gen4888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4889"/>Qui tribulant me exsultabunt si motus fuero ; <l eID="gen4889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2288"/><l level="1" sID="gen4890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2288"/>ego autem in misericordia tua speravi. <l eID="gen4890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4891"/>Exsultabit cor meum in salutari tuo. <l eID="gen4891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4892"/>Cantabo Domino qui bona tribuit mihi ; <l eID="gen4892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4893"/>et psallam nomini Domini altissimi. <l eID="gen4893" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4880"/> <chapter eID="Ps.12"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David. <div eID="gen4894" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4895"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4896"/>Dixit insipiens in corde suo : Non est Deus. <l eID="gen4896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4897"/>Corrupti sunt, et abominabiles facti sunt in studiis suis ; <l eID="gen4897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4898"/>non est qui faciat bonum, non est usque ad unum. <l eID="gen4898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2289"/><l level="1" sID="gen4899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2289"/>Dominus de cælo prospexit super filios hominum, <l eID="gen4899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4900"/>ut videat si est intelligens, aut requirens Deum. <l eID="gen4900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2290"/><l level="1" sID="gen4901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2290"/>Omnes declinaverunt, simul inutiles facti sunt. <l eID="gen4901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4902"/>Non est qui faciat bonum, non est usque ad unum. <l eID="gen4902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4903"/>Sepulchrum patens est guttur eorum ; <l eID="gen4903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4904"/>linguis suis dolose agebant. <l eID="gen4904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4905"/>Venenum aspidum sub labiis eorum, <l eID="gen4905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4906"/>quorum os maledictione et amaritudine plenum est ; <l eID="gen4906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4907"/>veloces pedes eorum ad effundendum sanguinem. <l eID="gen4907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4908"/>Contritio et infelicitas in viis eorum, <l eID="gen4908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4909"/>et viam pacis non cognoverunt ; <l eID="gen4909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4910"/>non est timor Dei ante oculos eorum. <l eID="gen4910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2291"/><l level="1" sID="gen4911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2291"/>Nonne cognoscent omnes qui operantur iniquitatem, <l eID="gen4911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4912"/>qui devorant plebem meam sicut escam panis ? <l eID="gen4912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2292"/><l level="1" sID="gen4913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2292"/>Dominum non invocaverunt ; <l eID="gen4913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4914"/>illic trepidaverunt timore, ubi non erat timor. <l eID="gen4914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2293"/><l level="1" sID="gen4915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2293"/>Quoniam Dominus in generatione justa est : <l eID="gen4915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4916"/>consilium inopis confudistis, <l eID="gen4916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4917"/>quoniam Dominus spes ejus est. <l eID="gen4917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2294"/><l level="1" sID="gen4918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2294"/>Quis dabit ex Sion salutare Israël ? <l eID="gen4918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4919"/>Cum averterit Dominus captivitatem plebis suæ, <l eID="gen4919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4920"/>exsultabit Jacob, et lætabitur Israël. <l eID="gen4920" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4895"/> <chapter eID="Ps.13"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:1
verses.text: Psalmus David. <div eID="gen4921" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4922"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4923"/>Domine, quis habitabit in tabernaculo tuo ? <l eID="gen4923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4924"/>aut quis requiescet in monte sancto tuo ? <l eID="gen4924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2295"/><l level="1" sID="gen4925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2295"/>Qui ingreditur sine macula, <l eID="gen4925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4926"/>et operatur justitiam ; <l eID="gen4926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2296"/><l level="1" sID="gen4927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2296"/>qui loquitur veritatem in corde suo : <l eID="gen4927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4928"/>qui non egit dolum in lingua sua, <l eID="gen4928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4929"/>nec fecit proximo suo malum, <l eID="gen4929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4930"/>et opprobrium non accepit adversus proximos suos. <l eID="gen4930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2297"/><l level="1" sID="gen4931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2297"/>Ad nihilum deductus est in conspectu ejus malignus ; <l eID="gen4931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4932"/>timentes autem Dominum glorificat. <l eID="gen4932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4933"/>Qui jurat proximo suo, et non decipit ; <l eID="gen4933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2298"/><l level="1" sID="gen4934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2298"/>qui pecuniam suam non dedit ad usuram, <l eID="gen4934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4935"/>et munera super innocentem non accepit : <l eID="gen4935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4936"/>qui facit hæc non movebitur in æternum. <l eID="gen4936" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4922"/> <chapter eID="Ps.14"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:1
verses.text: Tituli inscriptio, ipsi David. <div eID="gen4937" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4938"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4939"/>Conserva me, Domine, quoniam speravi in te. <l eID="gen4939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2299"/><l level="1" sID="gen4940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2299"/>Dixi Domino : Deus meus es tu, <l eID="gen4940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4941"/>quoniam bonorum meorum non eges. <l eID="gen4941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2300"/><l level="1" sID="gen4942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2300"/>Sanctis qui sunt in terra ejus, <l eID="gen4942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4943"/>mirificavit omnes voluntates meas in eis. <l eID="gen4943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2301"/><l level="1" sID="gen4944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2301"/>Multiplicatæ sunt infirmitates eorum : <l eID="gen4944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4945"/>postea acceleraverunt. <l eID="gen4945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4946"/>Non congregabo conventicula eorum de sanguinibus, <l eID="gen4946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4947"/>nec memor ero nominum eorum per labia mea. <l eID="gen4947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2302"/><l level="1" sID="gen4948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2302"/>Dominus pars hæreditatis meæ, et calicis mei : <l eID="gen4948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4949"/>tu es qui restitues hæreditatem meam mihi. <l eID="gen4949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2303"/><l level="1" sID="gen4950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2303"/>Funes ceciderunt mihi in præclaris ; <l eID="gen4950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4951"/>etenim hæreditas mea præclara est mihi. <l eID="gen4951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2304"/><l level="1" sID="gen4952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2304"/>Benedicam Dominum qui tribuit mihi intellectum ; <l eID="gen4952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4953"/>insuper et usque ad noctem increpuerunt me renes mei. <l eID="gen4953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2305"/><l level="1" sID="gen4954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2305"/>Providebam Dominum in conspectu meo semper : <l eID="gen4954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4955"/>quoniam a dextris est mihi, ne commovear. <l eID="gen4955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2306"/><l level="1" sID="gen4956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2306"/>Propter hoc lætatum est cor meum, et exsultavit lingua mea ; <l eID="gen4956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4957"/>insuper et caro mea requiescet in spe. <l eID="gen4957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2307"/><l level="1" sID="gen4958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2307"/>Quoniam non derelinques animam meam in inferno, <l eID="gen4958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4959"/>nec dabis sanctum tuum videre corruptionem. <l eID="gen4959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4960"/>Notas mihi fecisti vias vitæ ; <l eID="gen4960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4961"/>adimplebis me lætitia cum vultu tuo : <l eID="gen4961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4962"/>delectationes in dextera tua usque in finem. <l eID="gen4962" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4938"/> <chapter eID="Ps.15"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:1
verses.text: Oratio David. <div eID="gen4963" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen4964"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4965"/>Exaudi, Domine, justitiam meam ; <l eID="gen4965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4966"/>intende deprecationem meam. <l eID="gen4966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4967"/>Auribus percipe orationem meam, <l eID="gen4967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4968"/>non in labiis dolosis. <l eID="gen4968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2308"/><l level="1" sID="gen4969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2308"/>De vultu tuo judicium meum prodeat ; <l eID="gen4969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4970"/>oculi tui videant æquitates. <l eID="gen4970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2309"/><l level="1" sID="gen4971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2309"/>Probasti cor meum, et visitasti nocte ; <l eID="gen4971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4972"/>igne me examinasti, et non est inventa in me iniquitas. <l eID="gen4972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2310"/><l level="1" sID="gen4973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2310"/>Ut non loquatur os meum opera hominum : <l eID="gen4973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4974"/>propter verba labiorum tuorum, ego custodivi vias duras. <l eID="gen4974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2311"/><l level="1" sID="gen4975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2311"/>Perfice gressus meos in semitis tuis, <l eID="gen4975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4976"/>ut non moveantur vestigia mea. <l eID="gen4976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2312"/><l level="1" sID="gen4977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2312"/>Ego clamavi, quoniam exaudisti me, Deus ; <l eID="gen4977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4978"/>inclina aurem tuam mihi, et exaudi verba mea. <l eID="gen4978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2313"/><l level="1" sID="gen4979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2313"/>Mirifica misericordias tuas, <l eID="gen4979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4980"/>qui salvos facis sperantes in te. <l eID="gen4980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2314"/><l level="1" sID="gen4981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2314"/>A resistentibus dexteræ tuæ custodi me <l eID="gen4981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4982"/>ut pupillam oculi. <l eID="gen4982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4983"/>Sub umbra alarum tuarum protege me <l eID="gen4983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2315"/><l level="1" sID="gen4984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2315"/>a facie impiorum qui me afflixerunt. <l eID="gen4984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4985"/>Inimici mei animam meam circumdederunt ; <l eID="gen4985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2316"/><l level="1" sID="gen4986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2316"/>adipem suum concluserunt : <l eID="gen4986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4987"/>os eorum locutum est superbiam. <l eID="gen4987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2317"/><l level="1" sID="gen4988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2317"/>Projicientes me nunc circumdederunt me ; <l eID="gen4988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4989"/>oculos suos statuerunt declinare in terram. <l eID="gen4989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2318"/><l level="1" sID="gen4990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2318"/>Susceperunt me sicut leo paratus ad prædam, <l eID="gen4990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4991"/>et sicut catulus leonis habitans in abditis. <l eID="gen4991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2319"/><l level="1" sID="gen4992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2319"/>Exsurge, Domine : præveni eum, et supplanta eum : <l eID="gen4992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4993"/>eripe animam meam ab impio ; <l eID="gen4993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4994"/>frameam tuam

verses.name: Psalms 16:14
verses.text: ab inimicis manus tuæ. <l eID="gen4994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4995"/>Domine, a paucis de terra divide eos in vita eorum ; <l eID="gen4995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4996"/>de absconditis tuis adimpletus est venter eorum. <l eID="gen4996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4997"/>Saturati sunt filiis, <l eID="gen4997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen4998"/>et dimiserunt reliquias suas parvulis suis. <l eID="gen4998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2320"/><l level="1" sID="gen4999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2320"/>Ego autem in justitia apparebo conspectui tuo ; <l eID="gen4999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5000"/>satiabor cum apparuerit gloria tua. <l eID="gen5000" level="1"/><lg eID="gen4964"/> <chapter eID="Ps.16"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:1
verses.text: In finem. Puero Domini David, qui locutus est Domino verba cantici hujus, in die qua eripuit eum Dominus de manu omnium inimicorum ejus, et de manu Saul, et dixit :  <div eID="gen5001" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2321"/><lg sID="gen5002"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2321"/>Diligam te, Domine, fortitudo mea. <l eID="gen5003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2322"/><l level="1" sID="gen5004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2322"/>Dominus firmamentum meum, et refugium meum, et liberator meus. <l eID="gen5004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5005"/>Deus meus adjutor meus, et sperabo in eum ; <l eID="gen5005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5006"/>protector meus, et cornu salutis meæ, et susceptor meus. <l eID="gen5006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2323"/><l level="1" sID="gen5007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2323"/>Laudans invocabo Dominum, <l eID="gen5007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5008"/>et ab inimicis meis salvus ero. <l eID="gen5008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2324"/><l level="1" sID="gen5009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2324"/>Circumdederunt me dolores mortis, <l eID="gen5009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5010"/>et torrentes iniquitatis conturbaverunt me. <l eID="gen5010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2325"/><l level="1" sID="gen5011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2325"/>Dolores inferni circumdederunt me ; <l eID="gen5011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5012"/>præoccupaverunt me laquei mortis. <l eID="gen5012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2326"/><l level="1" sID="gen5013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2326"/>In tribulatione mea invocavi Dominum, <l eID="gen5013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5014"/>et ad Deum meum clamavi : <l eID="gen5014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5015"/>et exaudivit de templo sancto suo vocem meam ; <l eID="gen5015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5016"/>et clamor meus in conspectu ejus introivit in aures ejus. <l eID="gen5016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2327"/><l level="1" sID="gen5017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2327"/>Commota est, et contremuit terra ; <l eID="gen5017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5018"/>fundamenta montium conturbata sunt, et commota sunt : <l eID="gen5018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5019"/>quoniam iratus est eis. <l eID="gen5019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2328"/><l level="1" sID="gen5020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2328"/>Ascendit fumus in ira ejus, <l eID="gen5020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5021"/>et ignis a facie ejus exarsit ; <l eID="gen5021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5022"/>carbones succensi sunt ab eo. <l eID="gen5022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2329"/><l level="1" sID="gen5023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2329"/>Inclinavit cælos, et descendit, <l eID="gen5023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5024"/>et caligo sub pedibus ejus. <l eID="gen5024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2330"/><l level="1" sID="gen5025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2330"/>Et ascendit super cherubim, et volavit ; <l eID="gen5025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5026"/>volavit super pennas ventorum. <l eID="gen5026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2331"/><l level="1" sID="gen5027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2331"/>Et posuit tenebras latibulum suum ; <l eID="gen5027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5028"/>in circuitu ejus tabernaculum ejus, <l eID="gen5028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5029"/>tenebrosa aqua in nubibus aëris. <l eID="gen5029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2332"/><l level="1" sID="gen5030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2332"/>Præ fulgore in conspectu ejus nubes transierunt ; <l eID="gen5030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5031"/>grando et carbones ignis. <l eID="gen5031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2333"/><l level="1" sID="gen5032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2333"/>Et intonuit de cælo Dominus, <l eID="gen5032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5033"/>et Altissimus dedit vocem suam : <l eID="gen5033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5034"/>grando et carbones ignis. <l eID="gen5034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2334"/><l level="1" sID="gen5035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2334"/>Et misit sagittas suas, et dissipavit eos ; <l eID="gen5035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5036"/>fulgura multiplicavit, et conturbavit eos. <l eID="gen5036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2335"/><l level="1" sID="gen5037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2335"/>Et apparuerunt fontes aquarum, <l eID="gen5037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5038"/>et revelata sunt fundamenta orbis terrarum, <l eID="gen5038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5039"/>ab increpatione tua, Domine, <l eID="gen5039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5040"/>ab inspiratione spiritus iræ tuæ. <l eID="gen5040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2336"/><l level="1" sID="gen5041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2336"/>Misit de summo, et accepit me ; <l eID="gen5041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5042"/>et assumpsit me de aquis multis. <l eID="gen5042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2337"/><l level="1" sID="gen5043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2337"/>Eripuit me de inimicis meis fortissimis, et ab his qui oderunt me. <l eID="gen5043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5044"/>Quoniam confortati sunt super me ; <l eID="gen5044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2338"/><l level="1" sID="gen5045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2338"/>prævenerunt me in die afflictionis meæ : <l eID="gen5045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5046"/>et factus est Dominus protector meus. <l eID="gen5046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2339"/><l level="1" sID="gen5047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2339"/>Et eduxit me in latitudinem ; <l eID="gen5047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5048"/>salvum me fecit, quoniam voluit me, <l eID="gen5048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2340"/><l level="1" sID="gen5049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2340"/>et retribuet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam, <l eID="gen5049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5050"/>et secundum puritatem manuum mearum retribuet mihi : <l eID="gen5050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2341"/><l level="1" sID="gen5051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2341"/>quia custodivi vias Domini, <l eID="gen5051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5052"/>nec impie gessi a Deo meo ; <l eID="gen5052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2342"/><l level="1" sID="gen5053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2342"/>quoniam omnia judicia ejus in conspectu meo, <l eID="gen5053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5054"/>et justitias ejus non repuli a me. <l eID="gen5054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2343"/><l level="1" sID="gen5055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2343"/>Et ero immaculatus cum eo ; <l eID="gen5055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5056"/>et observabo me ab iniquitate mea. <l eID="gen5056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2344"/><l level="1" sID="gen5057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2344"/>Et retribuet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam, <l eID="gen5057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5058"/>et secundum puritatem manuum mearum in conspectu oculorum ejus. <l eID="gen5058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2345"/><l level="1" sID="gen5059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2345"/>Cum sancto sanctus eris, <l eID="gen5059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5060"/>et cum viro innocente innocens eris, <l eID="gen5060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2346"/><l level="1" sID="gen5061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2346"/>et cum electo electus eris, <l eID="gen5061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5062"/>et cum perverso perverteris. <l eID="gen5062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2347"/><l level="1" sID="gen5063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2347"/>Quoniam tu populum humilem salvum facies, <l eID="gen5063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5064"/>et oculos superborum humiliabis. <l eID="gen5064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2348"/><l level="1" sID="gen5065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2348"/>Quoniam tu illuminas lucernam meam, Domine ; <l eID="gen5065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5066"/>Deus meus, illumina tenebras meas. <l eID="gen5066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2349"/><l level="1" sID="gen5067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2349"/>Quoniam in te eripiar a tentatione ; <l eID="gen5067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5068"/>et in Deo meo transgrediar murum. <l eID="gen5068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2350"/><l level="1" sID="gen5069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2350"/>Deus meus, impolluta via ejus ; <l eID="gen5069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5070"/>eloquia Domini igne examinata : <l eID="gen5070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5071"/>protector est omnium sperantium in se. <l eID="gen5071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2351"/><l level="1" sID="gen5072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2351"/>Quoniam quis deus præter Dominum ? <l eID="gen5072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5073"/>aut quis deus præter Deum nostrum ? <l eID="gen5073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2352"/><l level="1" sID="gen5074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2352"/>Deus qui præcinxit me virtute, <l eID="gen5074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5075"/>et posuit immaculatam viam meam ; <l eID="gen5075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2353"/><l level="1" sID="gen5076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2353"/>qui perfecit pedes meos tamquam cervorum, <l eID="gen5076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5077"/>et super excelsa statuens me ; <l eID="gen5077" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2354"/><l level="1" sID="gen5078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2354"/>qui docet manus meas ad prælium. <l eID="gen5078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5079"/>Et posuisti, ut arcum æreum, brachia mea, <l eID="gen5079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2355"/><l level="1" sID="gen5080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2355"/>et dedisti mihi protectionem salutis tuæ : <l eID="gen5080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5081"/>et dextera tua suscepit me, <l eID="gen5081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5082"/>et disciplina tua correxit me in finem, <l eID="gen5082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5083"/>et disciplina tua ipsa me docebit. <l eID="gen5083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2356"/><l level="1" sID="gen5084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2356"/>Dilatasti gressus meos subtus me, <l eID="gen5084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5085"/>et non sunt infirmata vestigia mea. <l eID="gen5085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2357"/><l level="1" sID="gen5086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2357"/>Persequar inimicos meos, et comprehendam illos ; <l eID="gen5086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5087"/>et non convertar donec deficiant. <l eID="gen5087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2358"/><l level="1" sID="gen5088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2358"/>Confringam illos, nec poterunt stare ; <l eID="gen5088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5089"/>cadent subtus pedes meos. <l eID="gen5089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2359"/><l level="1" sID="gen5090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2359"/>Et præcinxisti me virtute ad bellum, <l eID="gen5090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5091"/>et supplantasti insurgentes in me subtus me. <l eID="gen5091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2360"/><l level="1" sID="gen5092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2360"/>Et inimicos meos dedisti mihi dorsum, <l eID="gen5092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5093"/>et odientes me disperdidisti. <l eID="gen5093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2361"/><l level="1" sID="gen5094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2361"/>Clamaverunt, nec erat qui salvos faceret ; <l eID="gen5094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5095"/>ad Dominum, nec exaudivit eos. <l eID="gen5095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2362"/><l level="1" sID="gen5096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2362"/>Et comminuam eos ut pulverem ante faciem venti ; <l eID="gen5096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5097"/>ut lutum platearum delebo eos. <l eID="gen5097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2363"/><l level="1" sID="gen5098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2363"/>Eripies me de contradictionibus populi ; <l eID="gen5098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5099"/>constitues me in caput gentium. <l eID="gen5099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2364"/><l level="1" sID="gen5100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2364"/>Populus quem non cognovi servivit mihi ; <l eID="gen5100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5101"/>in auditu auris obedivit mihi. <l eID="gen5101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2365"/><l level="1" sID="gen5102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2365"/>Filii alieni mentiti sunt mihi, <l eID="gen5102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5103"/>filii alieni inveterati sunt, <l eID="gen5103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5104"/>et claudicaverunt a semitis suis. <l eID="gen5104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2366"/><l level="1" sID="gen5105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2366"/>Vivit Dominus, et benedictus Deus meus, <l eID="gen5105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5106"/>et exaltetur Deus salutis meæ. <l eID="gen5106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2367"/><l level="1" sID="gen5107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2367"/>Deus qui das vindictas mihi, <l eID="gen5107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5108"/>et subdis populos sub me ; <l eID="gen5108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5109"/>liberator meus de inimicis meis iracundis. <l eID="gen5109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2368"/><l level="1" sID="gen5110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2368"/>Et ab insurgentibus in me exaltabis me ; <l eID="gen5110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5111"/>a viro iniquo eripies me. <l eID="gen5111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2369"/><l level="1" sID="gen5112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2369"/>Propterea confitebor tibi in nationibus, Domine, <l eID="gen5112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5113"/>et nomini tuo psalmum dicam ; <l eID="gen5113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 17:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2370"/><l level="1" sID="gen5114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2370"/>magnificans salutes regis ejus, <l eID="gen5114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5115"/>et faciens misericordiam christo suo David, <l eID="gen5115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5116"/>et semini ejus usque in sæculum. <l eID="gen5116" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5002"/> <chapter eID="Ps.17"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen5117" type="x-p"/>
