verses.name: Psalms 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2371"/><lg sID="gen5118"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2371"/>Cæli enarrant gloriam Dei, <l eID="gen5119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5120"/>et opera manuum ejus annuntiat firmamentum. <l eID="gen5120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2372"/><l level="1" sID="gen5121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2372"/>Dies diei eructat verbum, <l eID="gen5121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5122"/>et nox nocti indicat scientiam. <l eID="gen5122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2373"/><l level="1" sID="gen5123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2373"/>Non sunt loquelæ, neque sermones, <l eID="gen5123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5124"/>quorum non audiantur voces eorum. <l eID="gen5124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2374"/><l level="1" sID="gen5125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2374"/>In omnem terram exivit sonus eorum, <l eID="gen5125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5126"/>et in fines orbis terræ verba eorum. <l eID="gen5126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2375"/><l level="1" sID="gen5127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2375"/>In sole posuit tabernaculum suum ; <l eID="gen5127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5128"/>et ipse tamquam sponsus procedens de thalamo suo. <l eID="gen5128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5129"/>Exsultavit ut gigas ad currendam viam ; <l eID="gen5129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2376"/><l level="1" sID="gen5130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2376"/>a summo cælo egressio ejus. <l eID="gen5130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5131"/>Et occursus ejus usque ad summum ejus ; <l eID="gen5131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5132"/>nec est qui se abscondat a calore ejus. <l eID="gen5132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2377"/><l level="1" sID="gen5133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2377"/>Lex Domini immaculata, convertens animas ; <l eID="gen5133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5134"/>testimonium Domini fidele, sapientiam præstans parvulis. <l eID="gen5134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2378"/><l level="1" sID="gen5135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2378"/>Justitiæ Domini rectæ, lætificantes corda ; <l eID="gen5135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5136"/>præceptum Domini lucidum, illuminans oculos. <l eID="gen5136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2379"/><l level="1" sID="gen5137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2379"/>Timor Domini sanctus, permanens in sæculum sæculi ; <l eID="gen5137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5138"/>judicia Domini vera, justificata in semetipsa, <l eID="gen5138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2380"/><l level="1" sID="gen5139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2380"/>desiderabilia super aurum et lapidem pretiosum multum, <l eID="gen5139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5140"/>et dulciora super mel et favum. <l eID="gen5140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2381"/><l level="1" sID="gen5141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2381"/>Etenim servus tuus custodit ea ; <l eID="gen5141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5142"/>in custodiendis illis retributio multa. <l eID="gen5142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2382"/><l level="1" sID="gen5143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2382"/>Delicta quis intelligit ? <l eID="gen5143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5144"/>ab occultis meis munda me ; <l eID="gen5144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2383"/><l level="1" sID="gen5145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2383"/>et ab alienis parce servo tuo. <l eID="gen5145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5146"/>Si mei non fuerint dominati, tunc immaculatus ero, <l eID="gen5146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5147"/>et emundabor a delicto maximo. <l eID="gen5147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2384"/><l level="1" sID="gen5148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2384"/>Et erunt ut complaceant eloquia oris mei, <l eID="gen5148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5149"/>et meditatio cordis mei in conspectu tuo semper. <l eID="gen5149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5150"/>Domine, adjutor meus, et redemptor meus. <l eID="gen5150" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5118"/> <chapter eID="Ps.18"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen5151" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2385"/><lg sID="gen5152"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2385"/>Exaudiat te Dominus in die tribulationis ; <l eID="gen5153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5154"/>protegat te nomen Dei Jacob. <l eID="gen5154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2386"/><l level="1" sID="gen5155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2386"/>Mittat tibi auxilium de sancto, <l eID="gen5155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5156"/>et de Sion tueatur te. <l eID="gen5156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2387"/><l level="1" sID="gen5157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2387"/>Memor sit omnis sacrificii tui, <l eID="gen5157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5158"/>et holocaustum tuum pingue fiat. <l eID="gen5158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2388"/><l level="1" sID="gen5159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2388"/>Tribuat tibi secundum cor tuum, <l eID="gen5159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5160"/>et omne consilium tuum confirmet. <l eID="gen5160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2389"/><l level="1" sID="gen5161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2389"/>Lætabimur in salutari tuo ; <l eID="gen5161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5162"/>et in nomine Dei nostri magnificabimur. <l eID="gen5162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2390"/><l level="1" sID="gen5163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2390"/>Impleat Dominus omnes petitiones tuas ; <l eID="gen5163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5164"/>nunc cognovi quoniam salvum fecit Dominus christum suum. <l eID="gen5164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5165"/>Exaudiet illum de cælo sancto suo, <l eID="gen5165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5166"/>in potentatibus salus dexteræ ejus. <l eID="gen5166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2391"/><l level="1" sID="gen5167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2391"/>Hi in curribus, et hi in equis ; <l eID="gen5167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5168"/>nos autem in nomine Domini Dei nostri invocabimus. <l eID="gen5168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2392"/><l level="1" sID="gen5169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2392"/>Ipsi obligati sunt, et ceciderunt ; <l eID="gen5169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5170"/>nos autem surreximus, et erecti sumus. <l eID="gen5170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2393"/><l level="1" sID="gen5171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2393"/>Domine, salvum fac regem, <l eID="gen5171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5172"/>et exaudi nos in die qua invocaverimus te. <l eID="gen5172" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5152"/> <chapter eID="Ps.19"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen5173" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2394"/><lg sID="gen5174"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2394"/>Domine, in virtute tua lætabitur rex, <l eID="gen5175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5176"/>et super salutare tuum exsultabit vehementer. <l eID="gen5176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2395"/><l level="1" sID="gen5177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2395"/>Desiderium cordis ejus tribuisti ei, <l eID="gen5177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5178"/>et voluntate labiorum ejus non fraudasti eum. <l eID="gen5178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2396"/><l level="1" sID="gen5179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2396"/>Quoniam prævenisti eum in benedictionibus dulcedinis ; <l eID="gen5179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5180"/>posuisti in capite ejus coronam de lapide pretioso. <l eID="gen5180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2397"/><l level="1" sID="gen5181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2397"/>Vitam petiit a te, et tribuisti ei longitudinem dierum, <l eID="gen5181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5182"/>in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen5182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2398"/><l level="1" sID="gen5183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2398"/>Magna est gloria ejus in salutari tuo ; <l eID="gen5183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5184"/>gloriam et magnum decorem impones super eum. <l eID="gen5184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2399"/><l level="1" sID="gen5185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2399"/>Quoniam dabis eum in benedictionem in sæculum sæculi ; <l eID="gen5185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5186"/>lætificabis eum in gaudio cum vultu tuo. <l eID="gen5186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2400"/><l level="1" sID="gen5187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2400"/>Quoniam rex sperat in Domino, <l eID="gen5187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5188"/>et in misericordia Altissimi non commovebitur. <l eID="gen5188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2401"/><l level="1" sID="gen5189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2401"/>Inveniatur manus tua omnibus inimicis tuis ; <l eID="gen5189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5190"/>dextera tua inveniat omnes qui te oderunt. <l eID="gen5190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2402"/><l level="1" sID="gen5191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2402"/>Pones eos ut clibanum ignis in tempore vultus tui : <l eID="gen5191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5192"/>Dominus in ira sua conturbabit eos, <l eID="gen5192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5193"/>et devorabit eos ignis. <l eID="gen5193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2403"/><l level="1" sID="gen5194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2403"/>Fructum eorum de terra perdes, <l eID="gen5194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5195"/>et semen eorum a filiis hominum, <l eID="gen5195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2404"/><l level="1" sID="gen5196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2404"/>quoniam declinaverunt in te mala ; <l eID="gen5196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5197"/>cogitaverunt consilia quæ non potuerunt stabilire. <l eID="gen5197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2405"/><l level="1" sID="gen5198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2405"/>Quoniam pones eos dorsum ; <l eID="gen5198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5199"/>in reliquiis tuis præparabis vultum eorum. <l eID="gen5199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2406"/><l level="1" sID="gen5200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2406"/>Exaltare, Domine, in virtute tua ; <l eID="gen5200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5201"/>cantabimus et psallemus virtutes tuas. <l eID="gen5201" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5174"/> <chapter eID="Ps.20"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:1
verses.text: In finem, pro susceptione matutina. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen5202" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2407"/><lg sID="gen5203"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2407"/>Deus, Deus meus, respice in me : quare me dereliquisti ? <l eID="gen5204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5205"/>longe a salute mea verba delictorum meorum. <l eID="gen5205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2408"/><l level="1" sID="gen5206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2408"/>Deus meus, clamabo per diem, et non exaudies ; <l eID="gen5206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5207"/>et nocte, et non ad insipientiam mihi. <l eID="gen5207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2409"/><l level="1" sID="gen5208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2409"/>Tu autem in sancto habitas, laus Israël. <l eID="gen5208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2410"/><l level="1" sID="gen5209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2410"/>In te speraverunt patres nostri ; <l eID="gen5209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5210"/>speraverunt, et liberasti eos. <l eID="gen5210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2411"/><l level="1" sID="gen5211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2411"/>Ad te clamaverunt, et salvi facti sunt ; <l eID="gen5211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5212"/>in te speraverunt, et non sunt confusi. <l eID="gen5212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2412"/><l level="1" sID="gen5213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2412"/>Ego autem sum vermis, et non homo ; <l eID="gen5213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5214"/>opprobrium hominum, et abjectio plebis. <l eID="gen5214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2413"/><l level="1" sID="gen5215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2413"/>Omnes videntes me deriserunt me ; <l eID="gen5215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5216"/>locuti sunt labiis, et moverunt caput. <l eID="gen5216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2414"/><l level="1" sID="gen5217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2414"/>Speravit in Domino, eripiat eum : <l eID="gen5217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5218"/>salvum faciat eum, quoniam vult eum. <l eID="gen5218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2415"/><l level="1" sID="gen5219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2415"/>Quoniam tu es qui extraxisti me de ventre, <l eID="gen5219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5220"/>spes mea ab uberibus matris meæ. <l eID="gen5220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2416"/><l level="1" sID="gen5221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2416"/>In te projectus sum ex utero ; <l eID="gen5221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5222"/>de ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu : <l eID="gen5222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2417"/><l level="1" sID="gen5223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2417"/>ne discesseris a me, <l eID="gen5223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5224"/>quoniam tribulatio proxima est, <l eID="gen5224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5225"/>quoniam non est qui adjuvet. <l eID="gen5225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2418"/><l level="1" sID="gen5226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2418"/>Circumdederunt me vituli multi ; <l eID="gen5226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5227"/>tauri pingues obsederunt me. <l eID="gen5227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2419"/><l level="1" sID="gen5228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2419"/>Aperuerunt super me os suum, <l eID="gen5228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5229"/>sicut leo rapiens et rugiens. <l eID="gen5229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2420"/><l level="1" sID="gen5230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2420"/>Sicut aqua effusus sum, <l eID="gen5230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5231"/>et dispersa sunt omnia ossa mea : <l eID="gen5231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5232"/>factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquescens in medio ventris mei. <l eID="gen5232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2421"/><l level="1" sID="gen5233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2421"/>Aruit tamquam testa virtus mea, <l eID="gen5233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5234"/>et lingua mea adhæsit faucibus meis : <l eID="gen5234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5235"/>et in pulverem mortis deduxisti me. <l eID="gen5235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2422"/><l level="1" sID="gen5236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2422"/>Quoniam circumdederunt me canes multi ; <l eID="gen5236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5237"/>concilium malignantium obsedit me. <l eID="gen5237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5238"/>Foderunt manus meas et pedes meos ; <l eID="gen5238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2423"/><l level="1" sID="gen5239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2423"/>dinumeraverunt omnia ossa mea. <l eID="gen5239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5240"/>Ipsi vero consideraverunt et inspexerunt me. <l eID="gen5240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2424"/><l level="1" sID="gen5241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2424"/>Diviserunt sibi vestimenta mea, <l eID="gen5241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5242"/>et super vestem meam miserunt sortem. <l eID="gen5242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2425"/><l level="1" sID="gen5243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2425"/>Tu autem, Domine, ne elongaveris auxilium tuum a me ; <l eID="gen5243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5244"/>ad defensionem meam conspice. <l eID="gen5244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2426"/><l level="1" sID="gen5245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2426"/>Erue a framea, Deus, animam meam, <l eID="gen5245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5246"/>et de manu canis unicam meam. <l eID="gen5246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2427"/><l level="1" sID="gen5247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2427"/>Salva me ex ore leonis, <l eID="gen5247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5248"/>et a cornibus unicornium humilitatem meam. <l eID="gen5248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2428"/><l level="1" sID="gen5249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2428"/>Narrabo nomen tuum fratribus meis ; <l eID="gen5249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5250"/>in medio ecclesiæ laudabo te. <l eID="gen5250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2429"/><l level="1" sID="gen5251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2429"/>Qui timetis Dominum, laudate eum ; <l eID="gen5251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5252"/>universum semen Jacob, glorificate eum. <l eID="gen5252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2430"/><l level="1" sID="gen5253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2430"/>Timeat eum omne semen Israël, <l eID="gen5253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5254"/>quoniam non sprevit, neque despexit deprecationem pauperis, <l eID="gen5254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5255"/>nec avertit faciem suam a me : <l eID="gen5255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5256"/>et cum clamarem ad eum, exaudivit me. <l eID="gen5256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2431"/><l level="1" sID="gen5257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2431"/>Apud te laus mea in ecclesia magna ; <l eID="gen5257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5258"/>vota mea reddam in conspectu timentium eum. <l eID="gen5258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2432"/><l level="1" sID="gen5259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2432"/>Edent pauperes, et saturabuntur, <l eID="gen5259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5260"/>et laudabunt Dominum qui requirunt eum : <l eID="gen5260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5261"/>vivent corda eorum in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen5261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2433"/><l level="1" sID="gen5262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2433"/>Reminiscentur et convertentur ad Dominum universi fines terræ ; <l eID="gen5262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5263"/>et adorabunt in conspectu ejus universæ familiæ gentium : <l eID="gen5263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2434"/><l level="1" sID="gen5264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2434"/>quoniam Domini est regnum, <l eID="gen5264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5265"/>et ipse dominabitur gentium. <l eID="gen5265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2435"/><l level="1" sID="gen5266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2435"/>Manducaverunt et adoraverunt omnes pingues terræ ; <l eID="gen5266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5267"/>in conspectu ejus cadent omnes qui descendunt in terram. <l eID="gen5267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2436"/><l level="1" sID="gen5268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2436"/>Et anima mea illi vivet ; <l eID="gen5268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5269"/>et semen meum serviet ipsi. <l eID="gen5269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 21:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2437"/><l level="1" sID="gen5270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2437"/>Annuntiabitur Domino generatio ventura ; <l eID="gen5270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5271"/>et annuntiabunt cæli justitiam ejus <l eID="gen5271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5272"/>populo qui nascetur, quem fecit Dominus. <l eID="gen5272" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5203"/> <chapter eID="Ps.21"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:1
verses.text: Psalmus David. <div eID="gen5273" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5274"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5275"/>Dominus regit me, et nihil mihi deerit : <l eID="gen5275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2438"/><l level="1" sID="gen5276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2438"/>in loco pascuæ, ibi me collocavit. <l eID="gen5276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5277"/>Super aquam refectionis educavit me ; <l eID="gen5277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2439"/><l level="1" sID="gen5278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2439"/>animam meam convertit. <l eID="gen5278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5279"/>Deduxit me super semitas justitiæ <l eID="gen5279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5280"/>propter nomen suum. <l eID="gen5280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2440"/><l level="1" sID="gen5281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2440"/>Nam etsi ambulavero in medio umbræ mortis, <l eID="gen5281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5282"/>non timebo mala, quoniam tu mecum es. <l eID="gen5282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5283"/>Virga tua, et baculus tuus, <l eID="gen5283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5284"/>ipsa me consolata sunt. <l eID="gen5284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2441"/><l level="1" sID="gen5285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2441"/>Parasti in conspectu meo mensam <l eID="gen5285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5286"/>adversus eos qui tribulant me ; <l eID="gen5286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5287"/>impinguasti in oleo caput meum : <l eID="gen5287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5288"/>et calix meus inebrians, quam præclarus est ! <l eID="gen5288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2442"/><l level="1" sID="gen5289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2442"/>Et misericordia tua subsequetur me <l eID="gen5289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5290"/>omnibus diebus vitæ meæ ; <l eID="gen5290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5291"/>et ut inhabitem in domo Domini <l eID="gen5291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5292"/>in longitudinem dierum. <l eID="gen5292" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5274"/> <chapter eID="Ps.22"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:1
verses.text: Prima sabbati. Psalmus David. <div eID="gen5293" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5294"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5295"/>Domini est terra, et plenitudo ejus ; <l eID="gen5295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5296"/>orbis terrarum, et universi qui habitant in eo. <l eID="gen5296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2443"/><l level="1" sID="gen5297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2443"/>Quia ipse super maria fundavit eum, <l eID="gen5297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5298"/>et super flumina præparavit eum. <l eID="gen5298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2444"/><l level="1" sID="gen5299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2444"/>Quis ascendet in montem Domini ? <l eID="gen5299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5300"/>aut quis stabit in loco sancto ejus ? <l eID="gen5300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2445"/><l level="1" sID="gen5301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2445"/>Innocens manibus et mundo corde, <l eID="gen5301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5302"/>qui non accepit in vano animam suam, <l eID="gen5302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5303"/>nec juravit in dolo proximo suo : <l eID="gen5303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2446"/><l level="1" sID="gen5304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2446"/>hic accipiet benedictionem a Domino, <l eID="gen5304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5305"/>et misericordiam a Deo salutari suo. <l eID="gen5305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2447"/><l level="1" sID="gen5306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2447"/>Hæc est generatio quærentium eum, <l eID="gen5306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5307"/>quærentium faciem Dei Jacob. <l eID="gen5307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2448"/><l level="1" sID="gen5308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2448"/>Attollite portas, principes, vestras, <l eID="gen5308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5309"/>et elevamini, portæ æternales, <l eID="gen5309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5310"/>et introibit rex gloriæ. <l eID="gen5310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2449"/><l level="1" sID="gen5311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2449"/>Quis est iste rex gloriæ ? <l eID="gen5311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5312"/>Dominus fortis et potens, <l eID="gen5312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5313"/>Dominus potens in prælio. <l eID="gen5313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2450"/><l level="1" sID="gen5314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2450"/>Attollite portas, principes, vestras, <l eID="gen5314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5315"/>et elevamini, portæ æternales, <l eID="gen5315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5316"/>et introibit rex gloriæ. <l eID="gen5316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2451"/><l level="1" sID="gen5317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2451"/>Quis est iste rex gloriæ ? <l eID="gen5317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5318"/>Dominus virtutum ipse est rex gloriæ. <l eID="gen5318" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5294"/> <chapter eID="Ps.23"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David. <div eID="gen5319" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5320"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5321"/>Ad te, Domine, levavi animam meam : <l eID="gen5321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2452"/><l level="1" sID="gen5322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2452"/>Deus meus, in te confido ; non erubescam. <l eID="gen5322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2453"/><l level="1" sID="gen5323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2453"/>Neque irrideant me inimici mei : <l eID="gen5323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5324"/>etenim universi qui sustinent te, non confundentur. <l eID="gen5324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2454"/><l level="1" sID="gen5325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2454"/>Confundantur omnes iniqua agentes supervacue. <l eID="gen5325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5326"/>Vias tuas, Domine, demonstra mihi, <l eID="gen5326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5327"/>et semitas tuas edoce me. <l eID="gen5327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2455"/><l level="1" sID="gen5328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2455"/>Dirige me in veritate tua, et doce me, <l eID="gen5328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5329"/>quia tu es Deus salvator meus, <l eID="gen5329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5330"/>et te sustinui tota die. <l eID="gen5330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2456"/><l level="1" sID="gen5331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2456"/>Reminiscere miserationum tuarum, Domine, <l eID="gen5331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5332"/>et misericordiarum tuarum quæ a sæculo sunt. <l eID="gen5332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2457"/><l level="1" sID="gen5333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2457"/>Delicta juventutis meæ, et ignorantias meas, ne memineris. <l eID="gen5333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5334"/>Secundum misericordiam tuam memento mei tu, <l eID="gen5334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5335"/>propter bonitatem tuam, Domine. <l eID="gen5335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2458"/><l level="1" sID="gen5336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2458"/>Dulcis et rectus Dominus ; <l eID="gen5336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5337"/>propter hoc legem dabit delinquentibus in via. <l eID="gen5337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2459"/><l level="1" sID="gen5338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2459"/>Diriget mansuetos in judicio ; <l eID="gen5338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5339"/>docebit mites vias suas. <l eID="gen5339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2460"/><l level="1" sID="gen5340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2460"/>Universæ viæ Domini, misericordia et veritas, <l eID="gen5340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5341"/>requirentibus testamentum ejus et testimonia ejus. <l eID="gen5341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2461"/><l level="1" sID="gen5342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2461"/>Propter nomen tuum, Domine, <l eID="gen5342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5343"/>propitiaberis peccato meo ; multum est enim. <l eID="gen5343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2462"/><l level="1" sID="gen5344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2462"/>Quis est homo qui timet Dominum ? <l eID="gen5344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5345"/>legem statuit ei in via quam elegit. <l eID="gen5345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2463"/><l level="1" sID="gen5346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2463"/>Anima ejus in bonis demorabitur, <l eID="gen5346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5347"/>et semen ejus hæreditabit terram. <l eID="gen5347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2464"/><l level="1" sID="gen5348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2464"/>Firmamentum est Dominus timentibus eum ; <l eID="gen5348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5349"/>et testamentum ipsius ut manifestetur illis. <l eID="gen5349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2465"/><l level="1" sID="gen5350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2465"/>Oculi mei semper ad Dominum, <l eID="gen5350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5351"/>quoniam ipse evellet de laqueo pedes meos. <l eID="gen5351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2466"/><l level="1" sID="gen5352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2466"/>Respice in me, et miserere mei, <l eID="gen5352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5353"/>quia unicus et pauper sum ego. <l eID="gen5353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2467"/><l level="1" sID="gen5354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2467"/>Tribulationes cordis mei multiplicatæ sunt : <l eID="gen5354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5355"/>de necessitatibus meis erue me. <l eID="gen5355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2468"/><l level="1" sID="gen5356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2468"/>Vide humilitatem meam et laborem meum, <l eID="gen5356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5357"/>et dimitte universa delicta mea. <l eID="gen5357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2469"/><l level="1" sID="gen5358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2469"/>Respice inimicos meos, quoniam multiplicati sunt, <l eID="gen5358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5359"/>et odio iniquo oderunt me. <l eID="gen5359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2470"/><l level="1" sID="gen5360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2470"/>Custodi animam meam, et erue me : <l eID="gen5360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5361"/>non erubescam, quoniam speravi in te. <l eID="gen5361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2471"/><l level="1" sID="gen5362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2471"/>Innocentes et recti adhæserunt mihi, <l eID="gen5362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5363"/>quia sustinui te. <l eID="gen5363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2472"/><l level="1" sID="gen5364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2472"/>Libera, Deus, Israël <l eID="gen5364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5365"/>ex omnibus tribulationibus suis. <l eID="gen5365" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5320"/> <chapter eID="Ps.24"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David. <div eID="gen5366" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5367"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5368"/>Judica me, Domine, quoniam ego in innocentia mea ingressus sum, <l eID="gen5368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5369"/>et in Domino sperans non infirmabor. <l eID="gen5369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2473"/><l level="1" sID="gen5370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2473"/>Proba me, Domine, et tenta me ; <l eID="gen5370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5371"/>ure renes meos et cor meum. <l eID="gen5371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2474"/><l level="1" sID="gen5372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2474"/>Quoniam misericordia tua ante oculos meos est, <l eID="gen5372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5373"/>et complacui in veritate tua. <l eID="gen5373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2475"/><l level="1" sID="gen5374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2475"/>Non sedi cum concilio vanitatis, <l eID="gen5374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5375"/>et cum iniqua gerentibus non introibo. <l eID="gen5375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2476"/><l level="1" sID="gen5376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2476"/>Odivi ecclesiam malignantium, <l eID="gen5376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5377"/>et cum impiis non sedebo. <l eID="gen5377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2477"/><l level="1" sID="gen5378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2477"/>Lavabo inter innocentes manus meas, <l eID="gen5378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5379"/>et circumdabo altare tuum, Domine : <l eID="gen5379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2478"/><l level="1" sID="gen5380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2478"/>ut audiam vocem laudis, <l eID="gen5380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5381"/>et enarrem universa mirabilia tua. <l eID="gen5381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2479"/><l level="1" sID="gen5382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2479"/>Domine, dilexi decorem domus tuæ, <l eID="gen5382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5383"/>et locum habitationis gloriæ tuæ. <l eID="gen5383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2480"/><l level="1" sID="gen5384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2480"/>Ne perdas cum impiis, Deus, animam meam, <l eID="gen5384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5385"/>et cum viris sanguinum vitam meam : <l eID="gen5385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2481"/><l level="1" sID="gen5386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2481"/>in quorum manibus iniquitates sunt ; <l eID="gen5386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5387"/>dextera eorum repleta est muneribus. <l eID="gen5387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2482"/><l level="1" sID="gen5388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2482"/>Ego autem in innocentia mea ingressus sum ; <l eID="gen5388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5389"/>redime me, et miserere mei. <l eID="gen5389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2483"/><l level="1" sID="gen5390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2483"/>Pes meus stetit in directo ; <l eID="gen5390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5391"/>in ecclesiis benedicam te, Domine. <l eID="gen5391" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5367"/> <chapter eID="Ps.25"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, priusquam liniretur. <div eID="gen5392" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5393"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5394"/>Dominus illuminatio mea et salus mea : quem timebo ? <l eID="gen5394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5395"/>Dominus protector vitæ meæ : <l eID="gen5395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5396"/>a quo trepidabo ? <l eID="gen5396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2484"/><l level="1" sID="gen5397"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2484"/>Dum appropiant super me nocentes ut edant carnes meas, <l eID="gen5397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5398"/>qui tribulant me inimici mei, <l eID="gen5398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5399"/>ipsi infirmati sunt et ceciderunt. <l eID="gen5399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2485"/><l level="1" sID="gen5400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2485"/>Si consistant adversum me castra, non timebit cor meum ; <l eID="gen5400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5401"/>si exsurgat adversum me prælium, in hoc ego sperabo. <l eID="gen5401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2486"/><l level="1" sID="gen5402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2486"/>Unam petii a Domino, hanc requiram, <l eID="gen5402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5403"/>ut inhabitem in domo Domini omnibus diebus vitæ meæ ; <l eID="gen5403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5404"/>ut videam voluptatem Domini, et visitem templum ejus. <l eID="gen5404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2487"/><l level="1" sID="gen5405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2487"/>Quoniam abscondit me in tabernaculo suo ; <l eID="gen5405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5406"/>in die malorum protexit me in abscondito tabernaculi sui. <l eID="gen5406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2488"/><l level="1" sID="gen5407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2488"/>In petra exaltavit me, <l eID="gen5407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5408"/>et nunc exaltavit caput meum super inimicos meos. <l eID="gen5408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5409"/>Circuivi, et immolavi in tabernaculo ejus hostiam vociferationis ; <l eID="gen5409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5410"/>cantabo, et psalmum dicam Domino. <l eID="gen5410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2489"/><l level="1" sID="gen5411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2489"/>Exaudi, Domine, vocem meam, qua clamavi ad te ; <l eID="gen5411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5412"/>miserere mei, et exaudi me. <l eID="gen5412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2490"/><l level="1" sID="gen5413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2490"/>Tibi dixit cor meum : Exquisivit te facies mea ; <l eID="gen5413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5414"/>faciem tuam, Domine, requiram. <l eID="gen5414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2491"/><l level="1" sID="gen5415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2491"/>Ne avertas faciem tuam a me ; <l eID="gen5415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5416"/>ne declines in ira a servo tuo. <l eID="gen5416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5417"/>Adjutor meus esto ; ne derelinquas me, <l eID="gen5417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5418"/>neque despicias me, Deus salutaris meus. <l eID="gen5418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2492"/><l level="1" sID="gen5419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2492"/>Quoniam pater meus et mater mea dereliquerunt me ; <l eID="gen5419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5420"/>Dominus autem assumpsit me. <l eID="gen5420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2493"/><l level="1" sID="gen5421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2493"/>Legem pone mihi, Domine, in via tua, <l eID="gen5421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5422"/>et dirige me in semitam rectam, propter inimicos meos. <l eID="gen5422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2494"/><l level="1" sID="gen5423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2494"/>Ne tradideris me in animas tribulantium me, <l eID="gen5423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5424"/>quoniam insurrexerunt in me testes iniqui, <l eID="gen5424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5425"/>et mentita est iniquitas sibi. <l eID="gen5425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2495"/><l level="1" sID="gen5426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2495"/>Credo videre bona Domini in terra viventium. <l eID="gen5426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2496"/><l level="1" sID="gen5427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2496"/>Expecta Dominum, viriliter age : <l eID="gen5427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5428"/>et confortetur cor tuum, et sustine Dominum. <l eID="gen5428" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5393"/> <chapter eID="Ps.26"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:1
verses.text: Psalmus ipsi David. <div eID="gen5429" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5430"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5431"/>Ad te, Domine, clamabo ; Deus meus, ne sileas a me : <l eID="gen5431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5432"/>nequando taceas a me, et assimilabor descendentibus in lacum. <l eID="gen5432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2497"/><l level="1" sID="gen5433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2497"/>Exaudi, Domine, vocem deprecationis meæ dum oro ad te ; <l eID="gen5433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5434"/>dum extollo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum. <l eID="gen5434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2498"/><l level="1" sID="gen5435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2498"/>Ne simul trahas me cum peccatoribus, <l eID="gen5435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5436"/>et cum operantibus iniquitatem ne perdas me ; <l eID="gen5436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5437"/>qui loquuntur pacem cum proximo suo, <l eID="gen5437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5438"/>mala autem in cordibus eorum. <l eID="gen5438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2499"/><l level="1" sID="gen5439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2499"/>Da illis secundum opera eorum, <l eID="gen5439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5440"/>et secundum nequitiam adinventionum ipsorum. <l eID="gen5440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5441"/>Secundum opera manuum eorum tribue illis ; <l eID="gen5441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5442"/>redde retributionem eorum ipsis. <l eID="gen5442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2500"/><l level="1" sID="gen5443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2500"/>Quoniam non intellexerunt opera Domini, <l eID="gen5443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5444"/>et in opera manuum ejus destrues illos, <l eID="gen5444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5445"/>et non ædificabis eos. <l eID="gen5445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2501"/><l level="1" sID="gen5446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2501"/>Benedictus Dominus, <l eID="gen5446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5447"/>quoniam exaudivit vocem deprecationis meæ. <l eID="gen5447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2502"/><l level="1" sID="gen5448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2502"/>Dominus adjutor meus et protector meus ; <l eID="gen5448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5449"/>in ipso speravit cor meum, et adjutus sum : <l eID="gen5449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5450"/>et refloruit caro mea, <l eID="gen5450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5451"/>et ex voluntate mea confitebor ei. <l eID="gen5451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2503"/><l level="1" sID="gen5452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2503"/>Dominus fortitudo plebis suæ, <l eID="gen5452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5453"/>et protector salvationum christi sui est. <l eID="gen5453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2504"/><l level="1" sID="gen5454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2504"/>Salvum fac populum tuum, Domine, et benedic hæreditati tuæ ; <l eID="gen5454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5455"/>et rege eos, et extolle illos usque in æternum. <l eID="gen5455" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5430"/> <chapter eID="Ps.27"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, in consummatione tabernaculi. <div eID="gen5456" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5457"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5458"/>Afferte Domino, filii Dei, <l eID="gen5458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5459"/>afferte Domino filios arietum. <l eID="gen5459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2505"/><l level="1" sID="gen5460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2505"/>Afferte Domino gloriam et honorem ; <l eID="gen5460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5461"/>afferte Domino gloriam nomini ejus ; <l eID="gen5461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5462"/>adorate Dominum in atrio sancto ejus. <l eID="gen5462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2506"/><l level="1" sID="gen5463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2506"/>Vox Domini super aquas ; <l eID="gen5463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5464"/>Deus majestatis intonuit : <l eID="gen5464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5465"/>Dominus super aquas multas. <l eID="gen5465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2507"/><l level="1" sID="gen5466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2507"/>Vox Domini in virtute ; <l eID="gen5466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5467"/>vox Domini in magnificentia. <l eID="gen5467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2508"/><l level="1" sID="gen5468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2508"/>Vox Domini confringentis cedros, <l eID="gen5468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5469"/>et confringet Dominus cedros Libani : <l eID="gen5469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2509"/><l level="1" sID="gen5470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2509"/>et comminuet eas, tamquam vitulum Libani, <l eID="gen5470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5471"/>et dilectus quemadmodum filius unicornium. <l eID="gen5471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2510"/><l level="1" sID="gen5472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2510"/>Vox Domini intercidentis flammam ignis ; <l eID="gen5472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2511"/><l level="1" sID="gen5473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2511"/>vox Domini concutientis desertum : <l eID="gen5473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5474"/>et commovebit Dominus desertum Cades. <l eID="gen5474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2512"/><l level="1" sID="gen5475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2512"/>Vox Domini præparantis cervos : <l eID="gen5475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5476"/>et revelabit condensa, <l eID="gen5476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5477"/>et in templo ejus omnes dicent gloriam. <l eID="gen5477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2513"/><l level="1" sID="gen5478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2513"/>Dominus diluvium inhabitare facit, <l eID="gen5478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5479"/>et sedebit Dominus rex in æternum. <l eID="gen5479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2514"/><l level="1" sID="gen5480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2514"/>Dominus virtutem populo suo dabit ; <l eID="gen5480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5481"/>Dominus benedicet populo suo in pace. <l eID="gen5481" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5457"/> <chapter eID="Ps.28"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:1
verses.text: Psalmus cantici, in dedicatione domus David.  <div eID="gen5482" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2515"/><lg sID="gen5483"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2515"/>Exaltabo te, Domine, quoniam suscepisti me, <l eID="gen5484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5485"/>nec delectasti inimicos meos super me. <l eID="gen5485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2516"/><l level="1" sID="gen5486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2516"/>Domine Deus meus, clamavi ad te, et sanasti me. <l eID="gen5486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2517"/><l level="1" sID="gen5487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2517"/>Domine, eduxisti ab inferno animam meam ; <l eID="gen5487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5488"/>salvasti me a descendentibus in lacum. <l eID="gen5488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2518"/><l level="1" sID="gen5489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2518"/>Psallite Domino, sancti ejus ; <l eID="gen5489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5490"/>et confitemini memoriæ sanctitatis ejus. <l eID="gen5490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2519"/><l level="1" sID="gen5491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2519"/>Quoniam ira in indignatione ejus, <l eID="gen5491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5492"/>et vita in voluntate ejus : <l eID="gen5492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5493"/>ad vesperum demorabitur fletus, <l eID="gen5493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5494"/>et ad matutinum lætitia. <l eID="gen5494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2520"/><l level="1" sID="gen5495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2520"/>Ego autem dixi in abundantia mea : <l eID="gen5495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5496"/>Non movebor in æternum. <l eID="gen5496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2521"/><l level="1" sID="gen5497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2521"/>Domine, in voluntate tua præstitisti decori meo virtutem ; <l eID="gen5497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5498"/>avertisti faciem tuam a me, et factus sum conturbatus. <l eID="gen5498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2522"/><l level="1" sID="gen5499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2522"/>Ad te, Domine, clamabo, <l eID="gen5499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5500"/>et ad Deum meum deprecabor. <l eID="gen5500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2523"/><l level="1" sID="gen5501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2523"/>Quæ utilitas in sanguine meo, <l eID="gen5501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5502"/>dum descendo in corruptionem ? <l eID="gen5502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5503"/>numquid confitebitur tibi pulvis, <l eID="gen5503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5504"/>aut annuntiabit veritatem tuam ? <l eID="gen5504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2524"/><l level="1" sID="gen5505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2524"/>Audivit Dominus, et misertus est mei ; <l eID="gen5505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5506"/>Dominus factus est adjutor meus. <l eID="gen5506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2525"/><l level="1" sID="gen5507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2525"/>Convertisti planctum meum in gaudium mihi ; <l eID="gen5507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5508"/>conscidisti saccum meum, et circumdedisti me lætitia : <l eID="gen5508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2526"/><l level="1" sID="gen5509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2526"/>ut cantet tibi gloria mea, et non compungar. <l eID="gen5509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5510"/>Domine Deus meus, in æternum confitebor tibi. <l eID="gen5510" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5483"/> <chapter eID="Ps.29"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David, pro extasi.  <div eID="gen5511" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2527"/><lg sID="gen5512"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2527"/>In te, Domine, speravi ; <l eID="gen5513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5514"/>non confundar in æternum : <l eID="gen5514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5515"/>in justitia tua libera me. <l eID="gen5515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2528"/><l level="1" sID="gen5516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2528"/>Inclina ad me aurem tuam ; <l eID="gen5516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5517"/>accelera ut eruas me. <l eID="gen5517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5518"/>Esto mihi in Deum protectorem, <l eID="gen5518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5519"/>et in domum refugii, ut salvum me facias : <l eID="gen5519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2529"/><l level="1" sID="gen5520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2529"/>quoniam fortitudo mea et refugium meum es tu ; <l eID="gen5520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5521"/>et propter nomen tuum deduces me et enutries me. <l eID="gen5521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2530"/><l level="1" sID="gen5522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2530"/>Educes me de laqueo hoc quem absconderunt mihi, <l eID="gen5522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5523"/>quoniam tu es protector meus. <l eID="gen5523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2531"/><l level="1" sID="gen5524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2531"/>In manus tuas commendo spiritum meum ; <l eID="gen5524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5525"/>redemisti me, Domine Deus veritatis. <l eID="gen5525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2532"/><l level="1" sID="gen5526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2532"/>Odisti observantes vanitates supervacue ; <l eID="gen5526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5527"/>ego autem in Domino speravi. <l eID="gen5527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2533"/><l level="1" sID="gen5528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2533"/>Exsultabo, et lætabor in misericordia tua, <l eID="gen5528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5529"/>quoniam respexisti humilitatem meam ; <l eID="gen5529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5530"/>salvasti de necessitatibus animam meam. <l eID="gen5530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2534"/><l level="1" sID="gen5531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2534"/>Nec conclusisti me in manibus inimici : <l eID="gen5531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5532"/>statuisti in loco spatioso pedes meos. <l eID="gen5532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2535"/><l level="1" sID="gen5533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2535"/>Miserere mei, Domine, quoniam tribulor ; <l eID="gen5533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5534"/>conturbatus est in ira oculus meus, anima mea, et venter meus. <l eID="gen5534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2536"/><l level="1" sID="gen5535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2536"/>Quoniam defecit in dolore vita mea, <l eID="gen5535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5536"/>et anni mei in gemitibus. <l eID="gen5536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5537"/>Infirmata est in paupertate virtus mea, <l eID="gen5537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5538"/>et ossa mea conturbata sunt. <l eID="gen5538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2537"/><l level="1" sID="gen5539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2537"/>Super omnes inimicos meos factus sum opprobrium, <l eID="gen5539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5540"/>et vicinis meis valde, et timor notis meis ; <l eID="gen5540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5541"/>qui videbant me foras fugerunt a me. <l eID="gen5541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2538"/><l level="1" sID="gen5542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2538"/>Oblivioni datus sum, tamquam mortuus a corde ; <l eID="gen5542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5543"/>factus sum tamquam vas perditum : <l eID="gen5543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2539"/><l level="1" sID="gen5544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2539"/>quoniam audivi vituperationem multorum commorantium in circuitu. <l eID="gen5544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5545"/>In eo dum convenirent simul adversum me, <l eID="gen5545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5546"/>accipere animam meam consiliati sunt. <l eID="gen5546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2540"/><l level="1" sID="gen5547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2540"/>Ego autem in te speravi, Domine ; <l eID="gen5547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5548"/>dixi : Deus meus es tu ; <l eID="gen5548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2541"/><l level="1" sID="gen5549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2541"/>in manibus tuis sortes meæ : <l eID="gen5549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5550"/>eripe me de manu inimicorum meorum, et a persequentibus me. <l eID="gen5550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2542"/><l level="1" sID="gen5551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2542"/>Illustra faciem tuam super servum tuum ; <l eID="gen5551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5552"/>salvum me fac in misericordia tua. <l eID="gen5552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2543"/><l level="1" sID="gen5553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2543"/>Domine, non confundar, quoniam invocavi te. <l eID="gen5553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5554"/>Erubescant impii, et deducantur in infernum ; <l eID="gen5554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2544"/><l level="1" sID="gen5555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2544"/>muta fiant labia dolosa, <l eID="gen5555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5556"/>quæ loquuntur adversus justum iniquitatem, <l eID="gen5556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5557"/>in superbia, et in abusione. <l eID="gen5557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2545"/><l level="1" sID="gen5558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2545"/>Quam magna multitudo dulcedinis tuæ, Domine, <l eID="gen5558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5559"/>quam abscondisti timentibus te ; <l eID="gen5559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5560"/>perfecisti eis qui sperant in te in conspectu filiorum hominum ! <l eID="gen5560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2546"/><l level="1" sID="gen5561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2546"/>Abscondes eos in abscondito faciei tuæ a conturbatione hominum ; <l eID="gen5561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5562"/>proteges eos in tabernaculo tuo, a contradictione linguarum. <l eID="gen5562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2547"/><l level="1" sID="gen5563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2547"/>Benedictus Dominus, <l eID="gen5563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5564"/>quoniam mirificavit misericordiam suam mihi in civitate munita. <l eID="gen5564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2548"/><l level="1" sID="gen5565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2548"/>Ego autem dixi in excessu mentis meæ : <l eID="gen5565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5566"/>Projectus sum a facie oculorum tuorum : <l eID="gen5566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5567"/>ideo exaudisti vocem orationis meæ, dum clamarem ad te. <l eID="gen5567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2549"/><l level="1" sID="gen5568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2549"/>Diligite Dominum, omnes sancti ejus, <l eID="gen5568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5569"/>quoniam veritatem requiret Dominus, <l eID="gen5569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5570"/>et retribuet abundanter facientibus superbiam. <l eID="gen5570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2550"/><l level="1" sID="gen5571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2550"/>Viriliter agite, et confortetur cor vestrum, <l eID="gen5571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5572"/>omnes qui speratis in Domino. <l eID="gen5572" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5512"/> <chapter eID="Ps.30"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:1
verses.text: Ipsi David intellectus. <div eID="gen5573" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5574"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5575"/>Beati quorum remissæ sunt iniquitates, <l eID="gen5575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5576"/>et quorum tecta sunt peccata. <l eID="gen5576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2551"/><l level="1" sID="gen5577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2551"/>Beatus vir cui non imputavit Dominus peccatum, <l eID="gen5577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5578"/>nec est in spiritu ejus dolus. <l eID="gen5578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2552"/><l level="1" sID="gen5579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2552"/>Quoniam tacui, inveteraverunt ossa mea, <l eID="gen5579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5580"/>dum clamarem tota die. <l eID="gen5580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2553"/><l level="1" sID="gen5581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2553"/>Quoniam die ac nocte gravata est super me manus tua, <l eID="gen5581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5582"/>conversus sum in ærumna mea, dum configitur spina. <l eID="gen5582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2554"/><l level="1" sID="gen5583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2554"/>Delictum meum cognitum tibi feci, <l eID="gen5583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5584"/>et injustitiam meam non abscondi. <l eID="gen5584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5585"/>Dixi : Confitebor adversum me injustitiam meam Domino ; <l eID="gen5585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5586"/>et tu remisisti impietatem peccati mei. <l eID="gen5586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2555"/><l level="1" sID="gen5587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2555"/>Pro hac orabit ad te omnis sanctus <l eID="gen5587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5588"/>in tempore opportuno. <l eID="gen5588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5589"/>Verumtamen in diluvio aquarum multarum, <l eID="gen5589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5590"/>ad eum non approximabunt. <l eID="gen5590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2556"/><l level="1" sID="gen5591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2556"/>Tu es refugium meum a tribulatione quæ circumdedit me ; <l eID="gen5591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5592"/>exsultatio mea, erue me a circumdantibus me. <l eID="gen5592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2557"/><l level="1" sID="gen5593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2557"/>Intellectum tibi dabo, et instruam te in via hac qua gradieris ; <l eID="gen5593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5594"/>firmabo super te oculos meos. <l eID="gen5594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2558"/><l level="1" sID="gen5595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2558"/>Nolite fieri sicut equus et mulus, <l eID="gen5595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5596"/>quibus non est intellectus. <l eID="gen5596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5597"/>In camo et freno maxillas eorum constringe, <l eID="gen5597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5598"/>qui non approximant ad te. <l eID="gen5598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2559"/><l level="1" sID="gen5599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2559"/>Multa flagella peccatoris ; <l eID="gen5599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5600"/>sperantem autem in Domino misericordia circumdabit. <l eID="gen5600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2560"/><l level="1" sID="gen5601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2560"/>Lætamini in Domino, et exsultate, justi ; <l eID="gen5601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5602"/>et gloriamini, omnes recti corde. <l eID="gen5602" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5574"/> <chapter eID="Ps.31"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:1
verses.text: Psalmus David. <div eID="gen5603" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5604"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5605"/>Exsultate, justi, in Domino ; <l eID="gen5605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5606"/>rectos decet collaudatio. <l eID="gen5606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2561"/><l level="1" sID="gen5607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2561"/>Confitemini Domino in cithara ; <l eID="gen5607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5608"/>in psalterio decem chordarum psallite illi. <l eID="gen5608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2562"/><l level="1" sID="gen5609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2562"/>Cantate ei canticum novum ; <l eID="gen5609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5610"/>bene psallite ei in vociferatione. <l eID="gen5610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2563"/><l level="1" sID="gen5611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2563"/>Quia rectum est verbum Domini, <l eID="gen5611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5612"/>et omnia opera ejus in fide. <l eID="gen5612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2564"/><l level="1" sID="gen5613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2564"/>Diligit misericordiam et judicium ; <l eID="gen5613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5614"/>misericordia Domini plena est terra. <l eID="gen5614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2565"/><l level="1" sID="gen5615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2565"/>Verbo Domini cæli firmati sunt, <l eID="gen5615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5616"/>et spiritu oris ejus omnis virtus eorum. <l eID="gen5616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2566"/><l level="1" sID="gen5617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2566"/>Congregans sicut in utre aquas maris ; <l eID="gen5617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5618"/>ponens in thesauris abyssos. <l eID="gen5618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2567"/><l level="1" sID="gen5619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2567"/>Timeat Dominum omnis terra ; <l eID="gen5619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5620"/>ab eo autem commoveantur omnes inhabitantes orbem. <l eID="gen5620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2568"/><l level="1" sID="gen5621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2568"/>Quoniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt ; <l eID="gen5621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5622"/>ipse mandavit et creata sunt. <l eID="gen5622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2569"/><l level="1" sID="gen5623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2569"/>Dominus dissipat consilia gentium ; <l eID="gen5623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5624"/>reprobat autem cogitationes populorum, <l eID="gen5624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5625"/>et reprobat consilia principum. <l eID="gen5625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2570"/><l level="1" sID="gen5626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2570"/>Consilium autem Domini in æternum manet ; <l eID="gen5626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5627"/>cogitationes cordis ejus in generatione et generationem. <l eID="gen5627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2571"/><l level="1" sID="gen5628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2571"/>Beata gens cujus est Dominus Deus ejus ; <l eID="gen5628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5629"/>populus quem elegit in hæreditatem sibi. <l eID="gen5629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:13
