verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2572"/><l level="1" sID="gen5630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2572"/>De cælo respexit Dominus ; <l eID="gen5630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5631"/>vidit omnes filios hominum. <l eID="gen5631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2573"/><l level="1" sID="gen5632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2573"/>De præparato habitaculo suo <l eID="gen5632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5633"/>respexit super omnes qui habitant terram : <l eID="gen5633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2574"/><l level="1" sID="gen5634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2574"/>qui finxit sigillatim corda eorum ; <l eID="gen5634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5635"/>qui intelligit omnia opera eorum. <l eID="gen5635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2575"/><l level="1" sID="gen5636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2575"/>Non salvatur rex per multam virtutem, <l eID="gen5636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5637"/>et gigas non salvabitur in multitudine virtutis suæ. <l eID="gen5637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2576"/><l level="1" sID="gen5638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2576"/>Fallax equus ad salutem ; <l eID="gen5638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5639"/>in abundantia autem virtutis suæ non salvabitur. <l eID="gen5639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2577"/><l level="1" sID="gen5640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2577"/>Ecce oculi Domini super metuentes eum, <l eID="gen5640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5641"/>et in eis qui sperant super misericordia ejus : <l eID="gen5641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2578"/><l level="1" sID="gen5642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2578"/>ut eruat a morte animas eorum, <l eID="gen5642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5643"/>et alat eos in fame. <l eID="gen5643" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2579"/><l level="1" sID="gen5644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2579"/>Anima nostra sustinet Dominum, <l eID="gen5644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5645"/>quoniam adjutor et protector noster est. <l eID="gen5645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2580"/><l level="1" sID="gen5646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2580"/>Quia in eo lætabitur cor nostrum, <l eID="gen5646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5647"/>et in nomine sancto ejus speravimus. <l eID="gen5647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2581"/><l level="1" sID="gen5648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2581"/>Fiat misericordia tua, Domine, super nos, <l eID="gen5648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5649"/>quemadmodum speravimus in te. <l eID="gen5649" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5604"/> <chapter eID="Ps.32"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:1
verses.text: Davidi, cum immutavit vultum suum coram Achimelech, et dimisit eum, et abiit.  <div eID="gen5650" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2582"/><lg sID="gen5651"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2582"/>Benedicam Dominum in omni tempore ; <l eID="gen5652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5653"/>semper laus ejus in ore meo. <l eID="gen5653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2583"/><l level="1" sID="gen5654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2583"/>In Domino laudabitur anima mea : <l eID="gen5654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5655"/>audiant mansueti, et lætentur. <l eID="gen5655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2584"/><l level="1" sID="gen5656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2584"/>Magnificate Dominum mecum, <l eID="gen5656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5657"/>et exaltemus nomen ejus in idipsum. <l eID="gen5657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2585"/><l level="1" sID="gen5658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2585"/>Exquisivi Dominum, et exaudivit me ; <l eID="gen5658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5659"/>et ex omnibus tribulationibus meis eripuit me. <l eID="gen5659" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2586"/><l level="1" sID="gen5660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2586"/>Accedite ad eum, et illuminamini ; <l eID="gen5660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5661"/>et facies vestræ non confundentur. <l eID="gen5661" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2587"/><l level="1" sID="gen5662"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2587"/>Iste pauper clamavit, et Dominus exaudivit eum, <l eID="gen5662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5663"/>et de omnibus tribulationibus ejus salvavit eum. <l eID="gen5663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2588"/><l level="1" sID="gen5664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2588"/>Immittet angelus Domini in circuitu timentium eum, <l eID="gen5664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5665"/>et eripiet eos. <l eID="gen5665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2589"/><l level="1" sID="gen5666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2589"/>Gustate et videte quoniam suavis est Dominus ; <l eID="gen5666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5667"/>beatus vir qui sperat in eo. <l eID="gen5667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2590"/><l level="1" sID="gen5668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2590"/>Timete Dominum, omnes sancti ejus, <l eID="gen5668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5669"/>quoniam non est inopia timentibus eum. <l eID="gen5669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2591"/><l level="1" sID="gen5670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2591"/>Divites eguerunt, et esurierunt ; <l eID="gen5670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5671"/>inquirentes autem Dominum non minuentur omni bono. <l eID="gen5671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2592"/><l level="1" sID="gen5672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2592"/>Venite, filii ; audite me : <l eID="gen5672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5673"/>timorem Domini docebo vos. <l eID="gen5673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2593"/><l level="1" sID="gen5674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2593"/>Quis est homo qui vult vitam ; <l eID="gen5674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5675"/>diligit dies videre bonos ? <l eID="gen5675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2594"/><l level="1" sID="gen5676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2594"/>Prohibe linguam tuam a malo, <l eID="gen5676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5677"/>et labia tua ne loquantur dolum. <l eID="gen5677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2595"/><l level="1" sID="gen5678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2595"/>Diverte a malo, et fac bonum ; <l eID="gen5678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5679"/>inquire pacem, et persequere eam. <l eID="gen5679" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2596"/><l level="1" sID="gen5680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2596"/>Oculi Domini super justos, <l eID="gen5680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5681"/>et aures ejus in preces eorum. <l eID="gen5681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2597"/><l level="1" sID="gen5682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2597"/>Vultus autem Domini super facientes mala, <l eID="gen5682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5683"/>ut perdat de terra memoriam eorum. <l eID="gen5683" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2598"/><l level="1" sID="gen5684"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2598"/>Clamaverunt justi, et Dominus exaudivit eos ; <l eID="gen5684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5685"/>et ex omnibus tribulationibus eorum liberavit eos. <l eID="gen5685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2599"/><l level="1" sID="gen5686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2599"/>Juxta est Dominus iis qui tribulato sunt corde, <l eID="gen5686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5687"/>et humiles spiritu salvabit. <l eID="gen5687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2600"/><l level="1" sID="gen5688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2600"/>Multæ tribulationes justorum ; <l eID="gen5688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5689"/>et de omnibus his liberabit eos Dominus. <l eID="gen5689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2601"/><l level="1" sID="gen5690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2601"/>Custodit Dominus omnia ossa eorum : <l eID="gen5690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5691"/>unum ex his non conteretur. <l eID="gen5691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2602"/><l level="1" sID="gen5692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2602"/>Mors peccatorum pessima ; <l eID="gen5692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5693"/>et qui oderunt justum delinquent. <l eID="gen5693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 33:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2603"/><l level="1" sID="gen5694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2603"/>Redimet Dominus animas servorum suorum, <l eID="gen5694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5695"/>et non delinquent omnes qui sperant in eo. <l eID="gen5695" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5651"/> <chapter eID="Ps.33"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:1
verses.text: Ipsi David. <div eID="gen5696" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5697"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5698"/>Judica, Domine, nocentes me ; <l eID="gen5698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5699"/>expugna impugnantes me. <l eID="gen5699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2604"/><l level="1" sID="gen5700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2604"/>Apprehende arma et scutum, <l eID="gen5700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5701"/>et exsurge in adjutorium mihi. <l eID="gen5701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2605"/><l level="1" sID="gen5702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2605"/>Effunde frameam, et conclude adversus eos qui persequuntur me ; <l eID="gen5702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5703"/>dic animæ meæ : Salus tua ego sum. <l eID="gen5703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2606"/><l level="1" sID="gen5704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2606"/>Confundantur et revereantur quærentes animam meam ; <l eID="gen5704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5705"/>avertantur retrorsum et confundantur cogitantes mihi mala. <l eID="gen5705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2607"/><l level="1" sID="gen5706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2607"/>Fiant tamquam pulvis ante faciem venti, <l eID="gen5706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5707"/>et angelus Domini coarctans eos. <l eID="gen5707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2608"/><l level="1" sID="gen5708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2608"/>Fiat via illorum tenebræ et lubricum, <l eID="gen5708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5709"/>et angelus Domini persequens eos. <l eID="gen5709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2609"/><l level="1" sID="gen5710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2609"/>Quoniam gratis absconderunt mihi interitum laquei sui ; supervacue exprobraverunt animam meam. <l eID="gen5710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2610"/><l level="1" sID="gen5711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2610"/>Veniat illi laqueus quem ignorat, <l eID="gen5711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5712"/>et captio quam abscondit apprehendat eum, <l eID="gen5712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5713"/>et in laqueum cadat in ipsum. <l eID="gen5713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2611"/><l level="1" sID="gen5714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2611"/>Anima autem mea exsultabit in Domino, <l eID="gen5714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5715"/>et delectabitur super salutari suo. <l eID="gen5715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2612"/><l level="1" sID="gen5716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2612"/>Omnia ossa mea dicent : <l eID="gen5716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5717"/>Domine, quis similis tibi ? <l eID="gen5717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5718"/>eripiens inopem de manu fortiorum ejus ; <l eID="gen5718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5719"/>egenum et pauperem a diripientibus eum. <l eID="gen5719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2613"/><l level="1" sID="gen5720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2613"/>Surgentes testes iniqui, <l eID="gen5720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5721"/>quæ ignorabam interrogabant me. <l eID="gen5721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2614"/><l level="1" sID="gen5722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2614"/>Retribuebant mihi mala pro bonis, <l eID="gen5722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5723"/>sterilitatem animæ meæ. <l eID="gen5723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2615"/><l level="1" sID="gen5724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2615"/>Ego autem, cum mihi molesti essent, induebar cilicio ; <l eID="gen5724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5725"/>humiliabam in jejunio animam meam, <l eID="gen5725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5726"/>et oratio mea in sinu meo convertetur. <l eID="gen5726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2616"/><l level="1" sID="gen5727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2616"/>Quasi proximum et quasi fratrem nostrum sic complacebam ; <l eID="gen5727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5728"/>quasi lugens et contristatus sic humiliabar. <l eID="gen5728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2617"/><l level="1" sID="gen5729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2617"/>Et adversum me lætati sunt, et convenerunt ; <l eID="gen5729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5730"/>congregata sunt super me flagella, et ignoravi. <l eID="gen5730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2618"/><l level="1" sID="gen5731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2618"/>Dissipati sunt, nec compuncti ; <l eID="gen5731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5732"/>tentaverunt me, subsannaverunt me subsannatione ; <l eID="gen5732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5733"/>frenduerunt super me dentibus suis. <l eID="gen5733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2619"/><l level="1" sID="gen5734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2619"/>Domine, quando respicies ? <l eID="gen5734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5735"/>Restitue animam meam a malignitate eorum ; <l eID="gen5735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5736"/>a leonibus unicam meam. <l eID="gen5736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2620"/><l level="1" sID="gen5737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2620"/>Confitebor tibi in ecclesia magna ; in populo gravi laudabo te. <l eID="gen5737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2621"/><l level="1" sID="gen5738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2621"/>Non supergaudeant mihi qui adversantur mihi inique, <l eID="gen5738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5739"/>qui oderunt me gratis, et annuunt oculis. <l eID="gen5739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2622"/><l level="1" sID="gen5740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2622"/>Quoniam mihi quidem pacifice loquebantur ; <l eID="gen5740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5741"/>et in iracundia terræ loquentes, dolos cogitabant. <l eID="gen5741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2623"/><l level="1" sID="gen5742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2623"/>Et dilataverunt super me os suum ; <l eID="gen5742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5743"/>dixerunt : Euge, euge ! viderunt oculi nostri. <l eID="gen5743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2624"/><l level="1" sID="gen5744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2624"/>Vidisti, Domine : ne sileas ; <l eID="gen5744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5745"/>Domine, ne discedas a me. <l eID="gen5745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2625"/><l level="1" sID="gen5746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2625"/>Exsurge et intende judicio meo, Deus meus ; <l eID="gen5746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5747"/>et Dominus meus, in causam meam. <l eID="gen5747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2626"/><l level="1" sID="gen5748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2626"/>Judica me secundum justitiam tuam, Domine Deus meus, <l eID="gen5748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5749"/>et non supergaudeant mihi. <l eID="gen5749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2627"/><l level="1" sID="gen5750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2627"/>Non dicant in cordibus suis : Euge, euge, animæ nostræ ; <l eID="gen5750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5751"/>nec dicant : Devoravimus eum. <l eID="gen5751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2628"/><l level="1" sID="gen5752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2628"/>Erubescant et revereantur simul qui gratulantur malis meis ; <l eID="gen5752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5753"/>induantur confusione et reverentia qui magna loquuntur super me. <l eID="gen5753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2629"/><l level="1" sID="gen5754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2629"/>Exsultent et lætentur qui volunt justitiam meam ; <l eID="gen5754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5755"/>et dicant semper : Magnificetur Dominus, qui volunt pacem servi ejus. <l eID="gen5755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 34:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2630"/><l level="1" sID="gen5756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2630"/>Et lingua mea meditabitur justitiam tuam ; <l eID="gen5756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5757"/>tota die laudem tuam. <l eID="gen5757" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5697"/> <chapter eID="Ps.34"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:1
verses.text: In finem. Servo Domini ipsi David.  <div eID="gen5758" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2631"/><lg sID="gen5759"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2631"/>Dixit injustus ut delinquat in semetipso : <l eID="gen5760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5761"/>non est timor Dei ante oculos ejus. <l eID="gen5761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2632"/><l level="1" sID="gen5762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2632"/>Quoniam dolose egit in conspectu ejus, <l eID="gen5762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5763"/>ut inveniatur iniquitas ejus ad odium. <l eID="gen5763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2633"/><l level="1" sID="gen5764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2633"/>Verba oris ejus iniquitas, et dolus ; <l eID="gen5764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5765"/>noluit intelligere ut bene ageret. <l eID="gen5765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2634"/><l level="1" sID="gen5766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2634"/>Iniquitatem meditatus est in cubili suo ; <l eID="gen5766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5767"/>astitit omni viæ non bonæ : <l eID="gen5767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5768"/>malitiam autem non odivit. <l eID="gen5768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2635"/><l level="1" sID="gen5769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2635"/>Domine, in cælo misericordia tua, <l eID="gen5769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5770"/>et veritas tua usque ad nubes. <l eID="gen5770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2636"/><l level="1" sID="gen5771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2636"/>Justitia tua sicut montes Dei ; <l eID="gen5771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5772"/>judicia tua abyssus multa. <l eID="gen5772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5773"/>Homines et jumenta salvabis, Domine, <l eID="gen5773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2637"/><l level="1" sID="gen5774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2637"/>quemadmodum multiplicasti misericordiam tuam, Deus. <l eID="gen5774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5775"/>Filii autem hominum in tegmine alarum tuarum sperabunt. <l eID="gen5775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2638"/><l level="1" sID="gen5776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2638"/>Inebriabuntur ab ubertate domus tuæ, <l eID="gen5776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5777"/>et torrente voluptatis tuæ potabis eos : <l eID="gen5777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2639"/><l level="1" sID="gen5778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2639"/>quoniam apud te est fons vitæ, <l eID="gen5778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5779"/>et in lumine tuo videbimus lumen. <l eID="gen5779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2640"/><l level="1" sID="gen5780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2640"/>Prætende misericordiam tuam scientibus te, <l eID="gen5780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5781"/>et justitiam tuam his qui recto sunt corde. <l eID="gen5781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2641"/><l level="1" sID="gen5782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2641"/>Non veniat mihi pes superbiæ, <l eID="gen5782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5783"/>et manus peccatoris non moveat me. <l eID="gen5783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 35:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2642"/><l level="1" sID="gen5784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2642"/>Ibi ceciderunt qui operantur iniquitatem ; <l eID="gen5784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5785"/>expulsi sunt, nec potuerunt stare. <l eID="gen5785" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5759"/> <chapter eID="Ps.35"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:1
verses.text: Psalmus ipsi David. <div eID="gen5786" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen5787"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5788"/>Noli æmulari in malignantibus, <l eID="gen5788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5789"/>neque zelaveris facientes iniquitatem : <l eID="gen5789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2643"/><l level="1" sID="gen5790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2643"/>quoniam tamquam fœnum velociter arescent, <l eID="gen5790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5791"/>et quemadmodum olera herbarum cito decident. <l eID="gen5791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2644"/><l level="1" sID="gen5792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2644"/>Spera in Domino, et fac bonitatem ; <l eID="gen5792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5793"/>et inhabita terram, et pasceris in divitiis ejus. <l eID="gen5793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2645"/><l level="1" sID="gen5794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2645"/>Delectare in Domino, <l eID="gen5794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5795"/>et dabit tibi petitiones cordis tui. <l eID="gen5795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2646"/><l level="1" sID="gen5796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2646"/>Revela Domino viam tuam, <l eID="gen5796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5797"/>et spera in eo, et ipse faciet. <l eID="gen5797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2647"/><l level="1" sID="gen5798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2647"/>Et educet quasi lumen justitiam tuam, <l eID="gen5798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5799"/>et judicium tuum tamquam meridiem. <l eID="gen5799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2648"/><l level="1" sID="gen5800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2648"/>Subditus esto Domino, et ora eum. <l eID="gen5800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5801"/>Noli æmulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua ; <l eID="gen5801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5802"/>in homine faciente injustitias. <l eID="gen5802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2649"/><l level="1" sID="gen5803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2649"/>Desine ab ira, et derelinque furorem ; <l eID="gen5803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5804"/>noli æmulari ut maligneris. <l eID="gen5804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2650"/><l level="1" sID="gen5805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2650"/>Quoniam qui malignantur exterminabuntur ; <l eID="gen5805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5806"/>sustinentes autem Dominum, ipsi hæreditabunt terram. <l eID="gen5806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2651"/><l level="1" sID="gen5807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2651"/>Et adhuc pusillum, et non erit peccator ; <l eID="gen5807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5808"/>et quæres locum ejus, et non invenies. <l eID="gen5808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2652"/><l level="1" sID="gen5809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2652"/>Mansueti autem hæreditabunt terram, <l eID="gen5809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5810"/>et delectabuntur in multitudine pacis. <l eID="gen5810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2653"/><l level="1" sID="gen5811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2653"/>Observabit peccator justum, <l eID="gen5811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5812"/>et stridebit super eum dentibus suis. <l eID="gen5812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2654"/><l level="1" sID="gen5813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2654"/>Dominus autem irridebit eum, <l eID="gen5813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5814"/>quoniam prospicit quod veniet dies ejus. <l eID="gen5814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2655"/><l level="1" sID="gen5815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2655"/>Gladium evaginaverunt peccatores ; <l eID="gen5815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5816"/>intenderunt arcum suum : <l eID="gen5816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5817"/>ut dejiciant pauperem et inopem, <l eID="gen5817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5818"/>ut trucident rectos corde. <l eID="gen5818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2656"/><l level="1" sID="gen5819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2656"/>Gladius eorum intret in corda ipsorum, <l eID="gen5819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5820"/>et arcus eorum confringatur. <l eID="gen5820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2657"/><l level="1" sID="gen5821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2657"/>Melius est modicum justo, <l eID="gen5821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5822"/>super divitias peccatorum multas : <l eID="gen5822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2658"/><l level="1" sID="gen5823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2658"/>quoniam brachia peccatorum conterentur : <l eID="gen5823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5824"/>confirmat autem justos Dominus. <l eID="gen5824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2659"/><l level="1" sID="gen5825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2659"/>Novit Dominus dies immaculatorum, <l eID="gen5825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5826"/>et hæreditas eorum in æternum erit. <l eID="gen5826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2660"/><l level="1" sID="gen5827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2660"/>Non confundentur in tempore malo, <l eID="gen5827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5828"/>et in diebus famis saturabuntur : <l eID="gen5828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2661"/><l level="1" sID="gen5829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2661"/>quia peccatores peribunt. <l eID="gen5829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5830"/>Inimici vero Domini mox ut honorificati fuerint et exaltati, <l eID="gen5830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5831"/>deficientes quemadmodum fumus deficient. <l eID="gen5831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2662"/><l level="1" sID="gen5832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2662"/>Mutuabitur peccator, et non solvet ; <l eID="gen5832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5833"/>justus autem miseretur et tribuet : <l eID="gen5833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2663"/><l level="1" sID="gen5834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2663"/>quia benedicentes ei hæreditabunt terram ; <l eID="gen5834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5835"/>maledicentes autem ei disperibunt. <l eID="gen5835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2664"/><l level="1" sID="gen5836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2664"/>Apud Dominum gressus hominis dirigentur, <l eID="gen5836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5837"/>et viam ejus volet. <l eID="gen5837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2665"/><l level="1" sID="gen5838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2665"/>Cum ceciderit, non collidetur, <l eID="gen5838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5839"/>quia Dominus supponit manum suam. <l eID="gen5839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2666"/><l level="1" sID="gen5840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2666"/>Junior fui, etenim senui ; <l eID="gen5840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5841"/>et non vidi justum derelictum, <l eID="gen5841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5842"/>nec semen ejus quærens panem. <l eID="gen5842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2667"/><l level="1" sID="gen5843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2667"/>Tota die miseretur et commodat ; <l eID="gen5843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5844"/>et semen illius in benedictione erit. <l eID="gen5844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2668"/><l level="1" sID="gen5845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2668"/>Declina a malo, et fac bonum, <l eID="gen5845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5846"/>et inhabita in sæculum sæculi : <l eID="gen5846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2669"/><l level="1" sID="gen5847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2669"/>quia Dominus amat judicium, <l eID="gen5847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5848"/>et non derelinquet sanctos suos : <l eID="gen5848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5849"/>in æternum conservabuntur. <l eID="gen5849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5850"/>Injusti punientur, <l eID="gen5850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5851"/>et semen impiorum peribit. <l eID="gen5851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2670"/><l level="1" sID="gen5852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2670"/>Justi autem hæreditabunt terram, <l eID="gen5852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5853"/>et inhabitabunt in sæculum sæculi super eam. <l eID="gen5853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2671"/><l level="1" sID="gen5854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2671"/>Os justi meditabitur sapientiam, <l eID="gen5854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5855"/>et lingua ejus loquetur judicium. <l eID="gen5855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2672"/><l level="1" sID="gen5856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2672"/>Lex Dei ejus in corde ipsius, <l eID="gen5856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5857"/>et non supplantabuntur gressus ejus. <l eID="gen5857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2673"/><l level="1" sID="gen5858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2673"/>Considerat peccator justum, <l eID="gen5858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5859"/>et quærit mortificare eum. <l eID="gen5859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2674"/><l level="1" sID="gen5860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2674"/>Dominus autem non derelinquet eum in manibus ejus, <l eID="gen5860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5861"/>nec damnabit eum cum judicabitur illi. <l eID="gen5861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2675"/><l level="1" sID="gen5862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2675"/>Exspecta Dominum, et custodi viam ejus, <l eID="gen5862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5863"/>et exaltabit te ut hæreditate capias terram : <l eID="gen5863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5864"/>cum perierint peccatores, videbis. <l eID="gen5864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2676"/><l level="1" sID="gen5865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2676"/>Vidi impium superexaltatum, <l eID="gen5865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5866"/>et elevatum sicut cedros Libani : <l eID="gen5866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2677"/><l level="1" sID="gen5867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2677"/>et transivi, et ecce non erat ; <l eID="gen5867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5868"/>et quæsivi eum, et non est inventus locus ejus. <l eID="gen5868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2678"/><l level="1" sID="gen5869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2678"/>Custodi innocentiam, et vide æquitatem, <l eID="gen5869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5870"/>quoniam sunt reliquiæ homini pacifico. <l eID="gen5870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2679"/><l level="1" sID="gen5871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2679"/>Injusti autem disperibunt simul ; <l eID="gen5871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5872"/>reliquiæ impiorum interibunt. <l eID="gen5872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2680"/><l level="1" sID="gen5873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2680"/>Salus autem justorum a Domino ; <l eID="gen5873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5874"/>et protector eorum in tempore tribulationis. <l eID="gen5874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 36:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2681"/><l level="1" sID="gen5875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2681"/>Et adjuvabit eos Dominus, et liberabit eos ; <l eID="gen5875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5876"/>et eruet eos a peccatoribus, et salvabit eos, <l eID="gen5876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5877"/>quia speraverunt in eo. <l eID="gen5877" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5787"/> <chapter eID="Ps.36"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, in rememorationem de sabbato.  <div eID="gen5878" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2682"/><lg sID="gen5879"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2682"/>Domine, ne in furore tuo arguas me, <l eID="gen5880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5881"/>neque in ira tua corripias me : <l eID="gen5881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2683"/><l level="1" sID="gen5882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2683"/>quoniam sagittæ tuæ infixæ sunt mihi, <l eID="gen5882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5883"/>et confirmasti super me manum tuam. <l eID="gen5883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2684"/><l level="1" sID="gen5884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2684"/>Non est sanitas in carne mea, a facie iræ tuæ ; <l eID="gen5884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5885"/>non est pax ossibus meis, a facie peccatorum meorum : <l eID="gen5885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2685"/><l level="1" sID="gen5886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2685"/>quoniam iniquitates meæ supergressæ sunt caput meum, <l eID="gen5886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5887"/>et sicut onus grave gravatæ sunt super me. <l eID="gen5887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2686"/><l level="1" sID="gen5888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2686"/>Putruerunt et corruptæ sunt cicatrices meæ, <l eID="gen5888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5889"/>a facie insipientiæ meæ. <l eID="gen5889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2687"/><l level="1" sID="gen5890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2687"/>Miser factus sum et curvatus sum usque in finem ; <l eID="gen5890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5891"/>tota die contristatus ingrediebar. <l eID="gen5891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2688"/><l level="1" sID="gen5892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2688"/>Quoniam lumbi mei impleti sunt illusionibus, <l eID="gen5892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5893"/>et non est sanitas in carne mea. <l eID="gen5893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2689"/><l level="1" sID="gen5894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2689"/>Afflictus sum, et humiliatus sum nimis ; <l eID="gen5894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5895"/>rugiebam a gemitu cordis mei. <l eID="gen5895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2690"/><l level="1" sID="gen5896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2690"/>Domine, ante te omne desiderium meum, <l eID="gen5896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5897"/>et gemitus meus a te non est absconditus. <l eID="gen5897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2691"/><l level="1" sID="gen5898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2691"/>Cor meum conturbatum est ; <l eID="gen5898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5899"/>dereliquit me virtus mea, et lumen oculorum meorum, <l eID="gen5899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5900"/>et ipsum non est mecum. <l eID="gen5900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2692"/><l level="1" sID="gen5901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2692"/>Amici mei et proximi mei adversum me appropinquaverunt, et steterunt ; <l eID="gen5901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5902"/>et qui juxta me erant, de longe steterunt : <l eID="gen5902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5903"/>et vim faciebant qui quærebant animam meam. <l eID="gen5903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2693"/><l level="1" sID="gen5904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2693"/>Et qui inquirebant mala mihi, locuti sunt vanitates, <l eID="gen5904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5905"/>et dolos tota die meditabantur. <l eID="gen5905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2694"/><l level="1" sID="gen5906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2694"/>Ego autem, tamquam surdus, non audiebam ; <l eID="gen5906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5907"/>et sicut mutus non aperiens os suum. <l eID="gen5907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2695"/><l level="1" sID="gen5908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2695"/>Et factus sum sicut homo non audiens, <l eID="gen5908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5909"/>et non habens in ore suo redargutiones. <l eID="gen5909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2696"/><l level="1" sID="gen5910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2696"/>Quoniam in te, Domine, speravi ; <l eID="gen5910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5911"/>tu exaudies me, Domine Deus meus. <l eID="gen5911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2697"/><l level="1" sID="gen5912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2697"/>Quia dixi : Nequando supergaudeant mihi inimici mei ; <l eID="gen5912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5913"/>et dum commoventur pedes mei, super me magna locuti sunt. <l eID="gen5913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2698"/><l level="1" sID="gen5914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2698"/>Quoniam ego in flagella paratus sum, <l eID="gen5914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5915"/>et dolor meus in conspectu meo semper. <l eID="gen5915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2699"/><l level="1" sID="gen5916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2699"/>Quoniam iniquitatem meam annuntiabo, <l eID="gen5916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5917"/>et cogitabo pro peccato meo. <l eID="gen5917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2700"/><l level="1" sID="gen5918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2700"/>Inimici autem mei vivunt, et confirmati sunt super me : <l eID="gen5918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5919"/>et multiplicati sunt qui oderunt me inique. <l eID="gen5919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2701"/><l level="1" sID="gen5920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2701"/>Qui retribuunt mala pro bonis detrahebant mihi, <l eID="gen5920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5921"/>quoniam sequebar bonitatem. <l eID="gen5921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2702"/><l level="1" sID="gen5922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2702"/>Ne derelinquas me, Domine Deus meus ; <l eID="gen5922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5923"/>ne discesseris a me. <l eID="gen5923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2703"/><l level="1" sID="gen5924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2703"/>Intende in adjutorium meum, <l eID="gen5924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5925"/>Domine Deus salutis meæ. <l eID="gen5925" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5879"/> <chapter eID="Ps.37"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:1
verses.text: In finem, ipsi Idithun. Canticum David.  <div eID="gen5926" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2704"/><lg sID="gen5927"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2704"/>Dixi : Custodiam vias meas : <l eID="gen5928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5929"/>ut non delinquam in lingua mea. <l eID="gen5929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5930"/>Posui ori meo custodiam, <l eID="gen5930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5931"/>cum consisteret peccator adversum me. <l eID="gen5931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2705"/><l level="1" sID="gen5932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2705"/>Obmutui, et humiliatus sum, et silui a bonis ; <l eID="gen5932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5933"/>et dolor meus renovatus est. <l eID="gen5933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2706"/><l level="1" sID="gen5934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2706"/>Concaluit cor meum intra me ; <l eID="gen5934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5935"/>et in meditatione mea exardescet ignis. <l eID="gen5935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2707"/><l level="1" sID="gen5936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2707"/>Locutus sum in lingua mea : <l eID="gen5936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5937"/>Notum fac mihi, Domine, finem meum, <l eID="gen5937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5938"/>et numerum dierum meorum quis est, <l eID="gen5938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5939"/>ut sciam quid desit mihi. <l eID="gen5939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2708"/><l level="1" sID="gen5940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2708"/>Ecce mensurabiles posuisti dies meos, <l eID="gen5940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5941"/>et substantia mea tamquam nihilum ante te. <l eID="gen5941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5942"/>Verumtamen universa vanitas, omnis homo vivens. <l eID="gen5942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2709"/><l level="1" sID="gen5943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2709"/>Verumtamen in imagine pertransit homo ; <l eID="gen5943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5944"/>sed et frustra conturbatur : <l eID="gen5944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5945"/>thesaurizat, et ignorat cui congregabit ea. <l eID="gen5945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2710"/><l level="1" sID="gen5946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2710"/>Et nunc quæ est exspectatio mea : nonne Dominus ? <l eID="gen5946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5947"/>et substantia mea apud te est. <l eID="gen5947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2711"/><l level="1" sID="gen5948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2711"/>Ab omnibus iniquitatibus meis erue me : <l eID="gen5948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5949"/>opprobrium insipienti dedisti me. <l eID="gen5949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2712"/><l level="1" sID="gen5950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2712"/>Obmutui, et non aperui os meum, <l eID="gen5950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5951"/>quoniam tu fecisti ; <l eID="gen5951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2713"/><l level="1" sID="gen5952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2713"/>amove a me plagas tuas. <l eID="gen5952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2714"/><l level="1" sID="gen5953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2714"/>A fortitudine manus tuæ ego defeci in increpationibus : <l eID="gen5953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5954"/>propter iniquitatem corripuisti hominem. <l eID="gen5954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5955"/>Et tabescere fecisti sicut araneam animam ejus : <l eID="gen5955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5956"/>verumtamen vane conturbatur omnis homo. <l eID="gen5956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2715"/><l level="1" sID="gen5957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2715"/>Exaudi orationem meam, Domine, et deprecationem meam ; <l eID="gen5957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5958"/>auribus percipe lacrimas meas. <l eID="gen5958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5959"/>Ne sileas, quoniam advena ego sum apud te, <l eID="gen5959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5960"/>et peregrinus sicut omnes patres mei. <l eID="gen5960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2716"/><l level="1" sID="gen5961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2716"/>Remitte mihi, ut refrigerer <l eID="gen5961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5962"/>priusquam abeam et amplius non ero. <l eID="gen5962" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5927"/> <chapter eID="Ps.38"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus ipsi David.  <div eID="gen5963" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2717"/><lg sID="gen5964"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2717"/>Exspectans exspectavi Dominum, <l eID="gen5965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5966"/>et intendit mihi. <l eID="gen5966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2718"/><l level="1" sID="gen5967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2718"/>Et exaudivit preces meas, <l eID="gen5967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5968"/>et eduxit me de lacu miseriæ et de luto fæcis. <l eID="gen5968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5969"/>Et statuit super petram pedes meos, <l eID="gen5969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5970"/>et direxit gressus meos. <l eID="gen5970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2719"/><l level="1" sID="gen5971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2719"/>Et immisit in os meum canticum novum, <l eID="gen5971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5972"/>carmen Deo nostro. <l eID="gen5972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5973"/>Videbunt multi, et timebunt, <l eID="gen5973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5974"/>et sperabunt in Domino. <l eID="gen5974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2720"/><l level="1" sID="gen5975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2720"/>Beatus vir cujus est nomen Domini spes ejus, <l eID="gen5975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5976"/>et non respexit in vanitates et insanias falsas. <l eID="gen5976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2721"/><l level="1" sID="gen5977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2721"/>Multa fecisti tu, Domine Deus meus, mirabilia tua ; <l eID="gen5977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5978"/>et cogitationibus tuis non est qui similis sit tibi. <l eID="gen5978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5979"/>Annuntiavi et locutus sum : <l eID="gen5979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5980"/>multiplicati sunt super numerum. <l eID="gen5980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2722"/><l level="1" sID="gen5981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2722"/>Sacrificium et oblationem noluisti ; <l eID="gen5981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5982"/>aures autem perfecisti mihi. <l eID="gen5982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5983"/>Holocaustum et pro peccato non postulasti ; <l eID="gen5983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2723"/><l level="1" sID="gen5984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2723"/>tunc dixi : Ecce venio. <l eID="gen5984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5985"/>In capite libri scriptum est de me, <l eID="gen5985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2724"/><l level="1" sID="gen5986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2724"/>ut facerem voluntatem tuam. <l eID="gen5986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5987"/>Deus meus, volui, <l eID="gen5987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5988"/>et legem tuam in medio cordis mei. <l eID="gen5988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2725"/><l level="1" sID="gen5989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2725"/>Annuntiavi justitiam tuam in ecclesia magna ; <l eID="gen5989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5990"/>ecce labia mea non prohibebo : Domine, tu scisti. <l eID="gen5990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2726"/><l level="1" sID="gen5991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2726"/>Justitiam tuam non abscondi in corde meo ; <l eID="gen5991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5992"/>veritatem tuam et salutare tuum dixi ; <l eID="gen5992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5993"/>non abscondi misericordiam tuam et veritatem tuam a concilio multo. <l eID="gen5993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2727"/><l level="1" sID="gen5994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2727"/>Tu autem, Domine, ne longe facias miserationes tuas a me ; <l eID="gen5994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5995"/>misericordia tua et veritas tua semper susceperunt me. <l eID="gen5995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2728"/><l level="1" sID="gen5996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2728"/>Quoniam circumdederunt me mala quorum non est numerus ; <l eID="gen5996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5997"/>comprehenderunt me iniquitates meæ, et non potui ut viderem. <l eID="gen5997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5998"/>Multiplicatæ sunt super capillos capitis mei, <l eID="gen5998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen5999"/>et cor meum dereliquit me. <l eID="gen5999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2729"/><l level="1" sID="gen6000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2729"/>Complaceat tibi, Domine, ut eruas me ; <l eID="gen6000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6001"/>Domine, ad adjuvandum me respice. <l eID="gen6001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2730"/><l level="1" sID="gen6002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2730"/>Confundantur et revereantur simul, <l eID="gen6002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6003"/>qui quærunt animam meam ut auferant eam ; <l eID="gen6003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6004"/>convertantur retrorsum et revereantur, <l eID="gen6004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6005"/>qui volunt mihi mala. <l eID="gen6005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2731"/><l level="1" sID="gen6006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2731"/>Ferant confestim confusionem suam, <l eID="gen6006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6007"/>qui dicunt mihi : Euge, euge ! <l eID="gen6007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2732"/><l level="1" sID="gen6008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2732"/>Exsultent et lætentur super te omnes quærentes te ; <l eID="gen6008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6009"/>et dicant semper : Magnificetur Dominus, qui diligunt salutare tuum. <l eID="gen6009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 39:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2733"/><l level="1" sID="gen6010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2733"/>Ego autem mendicus sum et pauper ; <l eID="gen6010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6011"/>Dominus sollicitus est mei. <l eID="gen6011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6012"/>Adjutor meus et protector meus tu es ; <l eID="gen6012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6013"/>Deus meus, ne tardaveris. <l eID="gen6013" level="1"/><lg eID="gen5964"/> <chapter eID="Ps.39"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus ipsi David.  <div eID="gen6014" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2734"/><lg sID="gen6015"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2734"/>Beatus qui intelligit super egenum et pauperem : <l eID="gen6016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6017"/>in die mala liberabit eum Dominus. <l eID="gen6017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2735"/><l level="1" sID="gen6018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2735"/>Dominus conservet eum, et vivificet eum, <l eID="gen6018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6019"/>et beatum faciat eum in terra, <l eID="gen6019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6020"/>et non tradat eum in animam inimicorum ejus. <l eID="gen6020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2736"/><l level="1" sID="gen6021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2736"/>Dominus opem ferat illi super lectum doloris ejus ; <l eID="gen6021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6022"/>universum stratum ejus versasti in infirmitate ejus. <l eID="gen6022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2737"/><l level="1" sID="gen6023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2737"/>Ego dixi : Domine, miserere mei ; <l eID="gen6023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6024"/>sana animam meam, quia peccavi tibi. <l eID="gen6024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2738"/><l level="1" sID="gen6025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2738"/>Inimici mei dixerunt mala mihi : <l eID="gen6025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6026"/>Quando morietur, et peribit nomen ejus ? <l eID="gen6026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2739"/><l level="1" sID="gen6027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2739"/>Et si ingrediebatur ut videret, vana loquebatur ; <l eID="gen6027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6028"/>cor ejus congregavit iniquitatem sibi. <l eID="gen6028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6029"/>Egrediebatur foras et loquebatur. <l eID="gen6029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2740"/><l level="1" sID="gen6030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2740"/>In idipsum adversum me susurrabant omnes inimici mei ; <l eID="gen6030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6031"/>adversum me cogitabant mala mihi. <l eID="gen6031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2741"/><l level="1" sID="gen6032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2741"/>Verbum iniquum constituerunt adversum me : <l eID="gen6032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6033"/>Numquid qui dormit non adjiciet ut resurgat ? <l eID="gen6033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2742"/><l level="1" sID="gen6034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2742"/>Etenim homo pacis meæ in quo speravi, <l eID="gen6034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6035"/>qui edebat panes meos, <l eID="gen6035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6036"/>magnificavit super me supplantationem. <l eID="gen6036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2743"/><l level="1" sID="gen6037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2743"/>Tu autem, Domine, miserere mei, <l eID="gen6037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6038"/>et resuscita me ; et retribuam eis. <l eID="gen6038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2744"/><l level="1" sID="gen6039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2744"/>In hoc cognovi quoniam voluisti me, <l eID="gen6039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6040"/>quoniam non gaudebit inimicus meus super me. <l eID="gen6040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2745"/><l level="1" sID="gen6041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2745"/>Me autem propter innocentiam suscepisti ; <l eID="gen6041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6042"/>et confirmasti me in conspectu tuo in æternum. <l eID="gen6042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 40:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2746"/><l level="1" sID="gen6043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2746"/>Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël <l eID="gen6043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6044"/>a sæculo et usque in sæculum. Fiat, fiat. <l eID="gen6044" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6015"/> <chapter eID="Ps.40"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:1
verses.text: In finem. Intellectus filiis Core.  <div eID="gen6045" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2747"/><lg sID="gen6046"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2747"/>Quemadmodum desiderat cervus ad fontes aquarum, <l eID="gen6047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6048"/>ita desiderat anima mea ad te, Deus. <l eID="gen6048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2748"/><l level="1" sID="gen6049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2748"/>Sitivit anima mea ad Deum fortem, vivum ; <l eID="gen6049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6050"/>quando veniam, et apparebo ante faciem Dei ? <l eID="gen6050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2749"/><l level="1" sID="gen6051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2749"/>Fuerunt mihi lacrimæ meæ panes die ac nocte, <l eID="gen6051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6052"/>dum dicitur mihi quotidie : Ubi est Deus tuus ? <l eID="gen6052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2750"/><l level="1" sID="gen6053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2750"/>Hæc recordatus sum, et effudi in me animam meam, <l eID="gen6053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6054"/>quoniam transibo in locum tabernaculi admirabilis, usque ad domum Dei, <l eID="gen6054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6055"/>in voce exsultationis et confessionis, sonus epulantis. <l eID="gen6055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2751"/><l level="1" sID="gen6056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2751"/>Quare tristis es, anima mea ? <l eID="gen6056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6057"/>et quare conturbas me ? <l eID="gen6057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6058"/>Spera in Deo, quoniam adhuc confitebor illi, <l eID="gen6058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6059"/>salutare vultus mei, <l eID="gen6059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2752"/><l level="1" sID="gen6060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2752"/>et Deus meus. <l eID="gen6060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6061"/>Ad meipsum anima mea conturbata est : <l eID="gen6061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6062"/>propterea memor ero tui de terra Jordanis et Hermoniim a monte modico. <l eID="gen6062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2753"/><l level="1" sID="gen6063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2753"/>Abyssus abyssum invocat, in voce cataractarum tuarum ; <l eID="gen6063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6064"/>omnia excelsa tua, et fluctus tui super me transierunt. <l eID="gen6064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2754"/><l level="1" sID="gen6065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2754"/>In die mandavit Dominus misericordiam suam, <l eID="gen6065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6066"/>et nocte canticum ejus ; <l eID="gen6066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6067"/>apud me oratio Deo vitæ meæ. <l eID="gen6067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2755"/><l level="1" sID="gen6068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2755"/>Dicam Deo : Susceptor meus es ; <l eID="gen6068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6069"/>quare oblitus es mei ? <l eID="gen6069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6070"/>et quare contristatus incedo, dum affligit me inimicus ? <l eID="gen6070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2756"/><l level="1" sID="gen6071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2756"/>Dum confringuntur ossa mea, <l eID="gen6071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6072"/>exprobraverunt mihi qui tribulant me inimici mei, <l eID="gen6072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6073"/>dum dicunt mihi per singulos dies : Ubi est Deus tuus ? <l eID="gen6073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 41:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2757"/><l level="1" sID="gen6074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2757"/>Quare tristis es, anima mea ? <l eID="gen6074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6075"/>et quare conturbas me ? <l eID="gen6075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6076"/>Spera in Deo, quoniam adhuc confitebor illi, <l eID="gen6076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6077"/>salutare vultus mei, et Deus meus. <l eID="gen6077" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6046"/> <chapter eID="Ps.41"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:1
verses.text: Psalmus David. <div eID="gen6078" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6079"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6080"/>Judica me, Deus, et discerne causam meam de gente non sancta : <l eID="gen6080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6081"/>ab homine iniquo et doloso erue me. <l eID="gen6081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2758"/><l level="1" sID="gen6082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2758"/>Quia tu es, Deus, fortitudo mea : quare me repulisti ? <l eID="gen6082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6083"/>et quare tristis incedo, dum affligit me inimicus ? <l eID="gen6083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2759"/><l level="1" sID="gen6084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2759"/>Emitte lucem tuam et veritatem tuam : <l eID="gen6084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6085"/>ipsa me deduxerunt, et adduxerunt <l eID="gen6085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6086"/>in montem sanctum tuum, et in tabernacula tua. <l eID="gen6086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2760"/><l level="1" sID="gen6087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2760"/>Et introibo ad altare Dei, <l eID="gen6087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6088"/>ad Deum qui lætificat juventutem meam. <l eID="gen6088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6089"/>Confitebor tibi in cithara, Deus, Deus meus. <l eID="gen6089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 42:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2761"/><l level="1" sID="gen6090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2761"/>Quare tristis es, anima mea ? <l eID="gen6090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6091"/>et quare conturbas me ? <l eID="gen6091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6092"/>Spera in Deo, quoniam adhuc confitebor illi, <l eID="gen6092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6093"/>salutare vultus mei, et Deus meus. <l eID="gen6093" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6079"/> <chapter eID="Ps.42"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:1
verses.text: In finem. Filiis Core ad intellectum.  <div eID="gen6094" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2762"/><lg sID="gen6095"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2762"/>Deus, auribus nostris audivimus, <l eID="gen6096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6097"/>patres nostri annuntiaverunt nobis, <l eID="gen6097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6098"/>opus quod operatus es in diebus eorum, <l eID="gen6098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6099"/>et in diebus antiquis. <l eID="gen6099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2763"/><l level="1" sID="gen6100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2763"/>Manus tua gentes disperdidit, et plantasti eos ; <l eID="gen6100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6101"/>afflixisti populos, et expulisti eos. <l eID="gen6101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2764"/><l level="1" sID="gen6102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2764"/>Nec enim in gladio suo possederunt terram, <l eID="gen6102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6103"/>et brachium eorum non salvavit eos : <l eID="gen6103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6104"/>sed dextera tua et brachium tuum, <l eID="gen6104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6105"/>et illuminatio vultus tui, quoniam complacuisti in eis. <l eID="gen6105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2765"/><l level="1" sID="gen6106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2765"/>Tu es ipse rex meus et Deus meus, <l eID="gen6106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6107"/>qui mandas salutes Jacob. <l eID="gen6107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2766"/><l level="1" sID="gen6108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2766"/>In te inimicos nostros ventilabimus cornu, <l eID="gen6108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6109"/>et in nomine tuo spernemus insurgentes in nobis. <l eID="gen6109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2767"/><l level="1" sID="gen6110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2767"/>Non enim in arcu meo sperabo, <l eID="gen6110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6111"/>et gladius meus non salvabit me : <l eID="gen6111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2768"/><l level="1" sID="gen6112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2768"/>salvasti enim nos de affligentibus nos, <l eID="gen6112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6113"/>et odientes nos confudisti. <l eID="gen6113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2769"/><l level="1" sID="gen6114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2769"/>In Deo laudabimur tota die, <l eID="gen6114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6115"/>et in nomine tuo confitebimur in sæculum. <l eID="gen6115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2770"/><l level="1" sID="gen6116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2770"/>Nunc autem repulisti et confudisti nos, <l eID="gen6116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6117"/>et non egredieris, Deus, in virtutibus nostris. <l eID="gen6117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2771"/><l level="1" sID="gen6118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2771"/>Avertisti nos retrorsum post inimicos nostros, <l eID="gen6118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6119"/>et qui oderunt nos diripiebant sibi. <l eID="gen6119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2772"/><l level="1" sID="gen6120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2772"/>Dedisti nos tamquam oves escarum, <l eID="gen6120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6121"/>et in gentibus dispersisti nos. <l eID="gen6121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2773"/><l level="1" sID="gen6122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2773"/>Vendidisti populum tuum sine pretio, <l eID="gen6122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6123"/>et non fuit multitudo in commutationibus eorum. <l eID="gen6123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2774"/><l level="1" sID="gen6124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2774"/>Posuisti nos opprobrium vicinis nostris ; <l eID="gen6124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6125"/>subsannationem et derisum his qui sunt in circuitu nostro. <l eID="gen6125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2775"/><l level="1" sID="gen6126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2775"/>Posuisti nos in similitudinem gentibus ; <l eID="gen6126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6127"/>commotionem capitis in populis. <l eID="gen6127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2776"/><l level="1" sID="gen6128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2776"/>Tota die verecundia mea contra me est, <l eID="gen6128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6129"/>et confusio faciei meæ cooperuit me : <l eID="gen6129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:17
