verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2777"/><l level="1" sID="gen6130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2777"/>a voce exprobrantis et obloquentis, <l eID="gen6130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6131"/>a facie inimici et persequentis. <l eID="gen6131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2778"/><l level="1" sID="gen6132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2778"/>Hæc omnia venerunt super nos ; nec obliti sumus te, <l eID="gen6132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6133"/>et inique non egimus in testamento tuo. <l eID="gen6133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2779"/><l level="1" sID="gen6134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2779"/>Et non recessit retro cor nostrum ; <l eID="gen6134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6135"/>et declinasti semitas nostras a via tua : <l eID="gen6135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2780"/><l level="1" sID="gen6136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2780"/>quoniam humiliasti nos in loco afflictionis, <l eID="gen6136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6137"/>et cooperuit nos umbra mortis. <l eID="gen6137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2781"/><l level="1" sID="gen6138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2781"/>Si obliti sumus nomen Dei nostri, <l eID="gen6138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6139"/>et si expandimus manus nostras ad deum alienum, <l eID="gen6139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2782"/><l level="1" sID="gen6140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2782"/>nonne Deus requiret ista ? <l eID="gen6140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6141"/>ipse enim novit abscondita cordis. <l eID="gen6141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6142"/>Quoniam propter te mortificamur tota die ; <l eID="gen6142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6143"/>æstimati sumus sicut oves occisionis. <l eID="gen6143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2783"/><l level="1" sID="gen6144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2783"/>Exsurge ; quare obdormis, Domine ? <l eID="gen6144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6145"/>exsurge, et ne repellas in finem. <l eID="gen6145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2784"/><l level="1" sID="gen6146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2784"/>Quare faciem tuam avertis ? <l eID="gen6146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6147"/>oblivisceris inopiæ nostræ et tribulationis nostræ ? <l eID="gen6147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2785"/><l level="1" sID="gen6148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2785"/>Quoniam humiliata est in pulvere anima nostra ; <l eID="gen6148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6149"/>conglutinatus est in terra venter noster. <l eID="gen6149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 43:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2786"/><l level="1" sID="gen6150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2786"/>Exsurge, Domine, adjuva nos, <l eID="gen6150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6151"/>et redime nos propter nomen tuum. <l eID="gen6151" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6095"/> <chapter eID="Ps.43"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:1
verses.text: In finem, pro iis qui commutabuntur. Filiis Core, ad intellectum. Canticum pro dilecto.  <div eID="gen6152" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2787"/><lg sID="gen6153"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2787"/>Eructavit cor meum verbum bonum : <l eID="gen6154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6155"/>dico ego opera mea regi. <l eID="gen6155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6156"/>Lingua mea calamus scribæ <l eID="gen6156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6157"/>velociter scribentis. <l eID="gen6157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2788"/><l level="1" sID="gen6158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2788"/>Speciosus forma præ filiis hominum, <l eID="gen6158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6159"/>diffusa est gratia in labiis tuis : <l eID="gen6159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6160"/>propterea benedixit te Deus in æternum. <l eID="gen6160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2789"/><l level="1" sID="gen6161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2789"/>Accingere gladio tuo super femur tuum, potentissime. <l eID="gen6161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2790"/><l level="1" sID="gen6162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2790"/>Specie tua et pulchritudine tua <l eID="gen6162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6163"/>intende, prospere procede, et regna, <l eID="gen6163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6164"/>propter veritatem, et mansuetudinem, et justitiam ; <l eID="gen6164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6165"/>et deducet te mirabiliter dextera tua. <l eID="gen6165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2791"/><l level="1" sID="gen6166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2791"/>Sagittæ tuæ acutæ : <l eID="gen6166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6167"/>populi sub te cadent, <l eID="gen6167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6168"/>in corda inimicorum regis. <l eID="gen6168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2792"/><l level="1" sID="gen6169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2792"/>Sedes tua, Deus, in sæculum sæculi ; <l eID="gen6169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6170"/>virga directionis virga regni tui. <l eID="gen6170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2793"/><l level="1" sID="gen6171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2793"/>Dilexisti justitiam, et odisti iniquitatem ; <l eID="gen6171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6172"/>propterea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, <l eID="gen6172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6173"/>oleo lætitiæ, præ consortibus tuis. <l eID="gen6173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2794"/><l level="1" sID="gen6174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2794"/>Myrrha, et gutta, et casia a vestimentis tuis, <l eID="gen6174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6175"/>a domibus eburneis ; ex quibus delectaverunt te <l eID="gen6175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2795"/><l level="1" sID="gen6176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2795"/>filiæ regum in honore tuo. <l eID="gen6176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6177"/>Astitit regina a dextris tuis <l eID="gen6177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6178"/>in vestitu deaurato, circumdata varietate. <l eID="gen6178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2796"/><l level="1" sID="gen6179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2796"/>Audi, filia, et vide, et inclina aurem tuam ; <l eID="gen6179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6180"/>et obliviscere populum tuum, et domum patris tui. <l eID="gen6180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2797"/><l level="1" sID="gen6181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2797"/>Et concupiscet rex decorem tuum, <l eID="gen6181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6182"/>quoniam ipse est Dominus Deus tuus, et adorabunt eum. <l eID="gen6182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2798"/><l level="1" sID="gen6183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2798"/>Et filiæ Tyri in muneribus vultum tuum deprecabuntur ; <l eID="gen6183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6184"/>omnes divites plebis. <l eID="gen6184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2799"/><l level="1" sID="gen6185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2799"/>Omnis gloria ejus filiæ regis ab intus, <l eID="gen6185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6186"/>in fimbriis aureis, <l eID="gen6186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2800"/><l level="1" sID="gen6187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2800"/>circumamicta varietatibus. <l eID="gen6187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6188"/>Adducentur regi virgines post eam ; <l eID="gen6188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6189"/>proximæ ejus afferentur tibi. <l eID="gen6189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2801"/><l level="1" sID="gen6190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2801"/>Afferentur in lætitia et exsultatione ; <l eID="gen6190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6191"/>adducentur in templum regis. <l eID="gen6191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2802"/><l level="1" sID="gen6192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2802"/>Pro patribus tuis nati sunt tibi filii ; <l eID="gen6192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6193"/>constitues eos principes super omnem terram. <l eID="gen6193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 44:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2803"/><l level="1" sID="gen6194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2803"/>Memores erunt nominis tui in omni generatione et generationem : <l eID="gen6194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6195"/>propterea populi confitebuntur tibi in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen6195" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6153"/> <chapter eID="Ps.44"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:1
verses.text: In finem, filiis Core, pro arcanis. Psalmus.  <div eID="gen6196" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2804"/><lg sID="gen6197"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2804"/>Deus noster refugium et virtus ; <l eID="gen6198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6199"/>adjutor in tribulationibus quæ invenerunt nos nimis. <l eID="gen6199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2805"/><l level="1" sID="gen6200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2805"/>Propterea non timebimus dum turbabitur terra, <l eID="gen6200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6201"/>et transferentur montes in cor maris. <l eID="gen6201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2806"/><l level="1" sID="gen6202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2806"/>Sonuerunt, et turbatæ sunt aquæ eorum ; <l eID="gen6202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6203"/>conturbati sunt montes in fortitudine ejus. <l eID="gen6203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2807"/><l level="1" sID="gen6204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2807"/>Fluminis impetus lætificat civitatem Dei : <l eID="gen6204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6205"/>sanctificavit tabernaculum suum Altissimus. <l eID="gen6205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2808"/><l level="1" sID="gen6206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2808"/>Deus in medio ejus, non commovebitur ; <l eID="gen6206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6207"/>adjuvabit eam Deus mane diluculo. <l eID="gen6207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2809"/><l level="1" sID="gen6208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2809"/>Conturbatæ sunt gentes, et inclinata sunt regna : <l eID="gen6208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6209"/>dedit vocem suam, mota est terra. <l eID="gen6209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2810"/><l level="1" sID="gen6210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2810"/>Dominus virtutum nobiscum ; <l eID="gen6210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6211"/>susceptor noster Deus Jacob. <l eID="gen6211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2811"/><l level="1" sID="gen6212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2811"/>Venite, et videte opera Domini, <l eID="gen6212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6213"/>quæ posuit prodigia super terram, <l eID="gen6213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2812"/><l level="1" sID="gen6214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2812"/>auferens bella usque ad finem terræ. <l eID="gen6214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6215"/>Arcum conteret, et confringet arma, <l eID="gen6215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6216"/>et scuta comburet igni. <l eID="gen6216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2813"/><l level="1" sID="gen6217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2813"/>Vacate, et videte quoniam ego sum Deus ; <l eID="gen6217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6218"/>exaltabor in gentibus, et exaltabor in terra. <l eID="gen6218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 45:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2814"/><l level="1" sID="gen6219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2814"/>Dominus virtutum nobiscum ; <l eID="gen6219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6220"/>susceptor noster Deus Jacob. <l eID="gen6220" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6197"/> <chapter eID="Ps.45"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:1
verses.text: In finem, pro filiis Core. Psalmus.  <div eID="gen6221" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2815"/><lg sID="gen6222"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2815"/>Omnes gentes, plaudite manibus ; <l eID="gen6223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6224"/>jubilate Deo in voce exsultationis : <l eID="gen6224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2816"/><l level="1" sID="gen6225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2816"/>quoniam Dominus excelsus, terribilis, <l eID="gen6225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6226"/>rex magnus super omnem terram. <l eID="gen6226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2817"/><l level="1" sID="gen6227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2817"/>Subjecit populos nobis, <l eID="gen6227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6228"/>et gentes sub pedibus nostris. <l eID="gen6228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2818"/><l level="1" sID="gen6229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2818"/>Elegit nobis hæreditatem suam ; <l eID="gen6229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6230"/>speciem Jacob quam dilexit. <l eID="gen6230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2819"/><l level="1" sID="gen6231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2819"/>Ascendit Deus in jubilo, <l eID="gen6231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6232"/>et Dominus in voce tubæ. <l eID="gen6232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2820"/><l level="1" sID="gen6233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2820"/>Psallite Deo nostro, psallite ; <l eID="gen6233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6234"/>psallite regi nostro, psallite : <l eID="gen6234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2821"/><l level="1" sID="gen6235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2821"/>quoniam rex omnis terræ Deus, <l eID="gen6235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6236"/>psallite sapienter. <l eID="gen6236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2822"/><l level="1" sID="gen6237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2822"/>Regnabit Deus super gentes ; <l eID="gen6237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6238"/>Deus sedet super sedem sanctam suam. <l eID="gen6238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 46:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2823"/><l level="1" sID="gen6239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2823"/>Principes populorum congregati sunt cum Deo Abraham, <l eID="gen6239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6240"/>quoniam dii fortes terræ vehementer elevati sunt. <l eID="gen6240" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6222"/> <chapter eID="Ps.46"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:1
verses.text: Psalmus cantici. Filiis Core, secunda sabbati.  <div eID="gen6241" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2824"/><lg sID="gen6242"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2824"/>Magnus Dominus et laudabilis nimis, <l eID="gen6243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6244"/>in civitate Dei nostri, in monte sancto ejus. <l eID="gen6244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2825"/><l level="1" sID="gen6245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2825"/>Fundatur exsultatione universæ terræ mons Sion ; <l eID="gen6245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6246"/>latera aquilonis, civitas regis magni. <l eID="gen6246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2826"/><l level="1" sID="gen6247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2826"/>Deus in domibus ejus cognoscetur <l eID="gen6247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6248"/>cum suscipiet eam. <l eID="gen6248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2827"/><l level="1" sID="gen6249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2827"/>Quoniam ecce reges terræ congregati sunt ; <l eID="gen6249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6250"/>convenerunt in unum. <l eID="gen6250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2828"/><l level="1" sID="gen6251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2828"/>Ipsi videntes, sic admirati sunt, <l eID="gen6251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6252"/>conturbati sunt, commoti sunt. <l eID="gen6252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2829"/><l level="1" sID="gen6253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2829"/>Tremor apprehendit eos ; <l eID="gen6253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6254"/>ibi dolores ut parturientis : <l eID="gen6254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2830"/><l level="1" sID="gen6255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2830"/>in spiritu vehementi conteres naves Tharsis. <l eID="gen6255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2831"/><l level="1" sID="gen6256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2831"/>Sicut audivimus, sic vidimus, <l eID="gen6256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6257"/>in civitate Domini virtutum, in civitate Dei nostri : <l eID="gen6257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6258"/>Deus fundavit eam in æternum. <l eID="gen6258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2832"/><l level="1" sID="gen6259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2832"/>Suscepimus, Deus, misericordiam tuam <l eID="gen6259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6260"/>in medio templi tui. <l eID="gen6260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2833"/><l level="1" sID="gen6261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2833"/>Secundum nomen tuum, Deus, <l eID="gen6261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6262"/>sic et laus tua in fines terræ ; <l eID="gen6262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6263"/>justitia plena est dextera tua. <l eID="gen6263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2834"/><l level="1" sID="gen6264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2834"/>Lætetur mons Sion, <l eID="gen6264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6265"/>et exsultent filiæ Judæ, <l eID="gen6265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6266"/>propter judicia tua, Domine. <l eID="gen6266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2835"/><l level="1" sID="gen6267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2835"/>Circumdate Sion, et complectimini eam ; <l eID="gen6267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6268"/>narrate in turribus ejus. <l eID="gen6268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2836"/><l level="1" sID="gen6269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2836"/>Ponite corda vestra in virtute ejus, <l eID="gen6269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6270"/>et distribuite domos ejus, ut enarretis in progenie altera. <l eID="gen6270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 47:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2837"/><l level="1" sID="gen6271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2837"/>Quoniam hic est Deus, <l eID="gen6271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6272"/>Deus noster in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi : <l eID="gen6272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6273"/>ipse reget nos in sæcula. <l eID="gen6273" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6242"/> <chapter eID="Ps.47"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:1
verses.text: In finem, filiis Core. Psalmus.  <div eID="gen6274" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2838"/><lg sID="gen6275"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2838"/>Audite hæc, omnes gentes ; <l eID="gen6276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6277"/>auribus percipite, omnes qui habitatis orbem : <l eID="gen6277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2839"/><l level="1" sID="gen6278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2839"/>quique terrigenæ et filii hominum, <l eID="gen6278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6279"/>simul in unum dives et pauper. <l eID="gen6279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2840"/><l level="1" sID="gen6280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2840"/>Os meum loquetur sapientiam, <l eID="gen6280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6281"/>et meditatio cordis mei prudentiam. <l eID="gen6281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2841"/><l level="1" sID="gen6282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2841"/>Inclinabo in parabolam aurem meam ; <l eID="gen6282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6283"/>aperiam in psalterio propositionem meam. <l eID="gen6283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2842"/><l level="1" sID="gen6284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2842"/>Cur timebo in die mala ? <l eID="gen6284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6285"/>iniquitas calcanei mei circumdabit me. <l eID="gen6285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2843"/><l level="1" sID="gen6286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2843"/>Qui confidunt in virtute sua, <l eID="gen6286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6287"/>et in multitudine divitiarum suarum, gloriantur. <l eID="gen6287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2844"/><l level="1" sID="gen6288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2844"/>Frater non redimit, redimet homo : <l eID="gen6288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6289"/>non dabit Deo placationem suam, <l eID="gen6289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2845"/><l level="1" sID="gen6290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2845"/>et pretium redemptionis animæ suæ. <l eID="gen6290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6291"/>Et laborabit in æternum ; <l eID="gen6291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2846"/><l level="1" sID="gen6292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2846"/>et vivet adhuc in finem. <l eID="gen6292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2847"/><l level="1" sID="gen6293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2847"/>Non videbit interitum, <l eID="gen6293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6294"/>cum viderit sapientes morientes : <l eID="gen6294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6295"/>simul insipiens et stultus peribunt. <l eID="gen6295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6296"/>Et relinquent alienis divitias suas, <l eID="gen6296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2848"/><l level="1" sID="gen6297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2848"/>et sepulchra eorum domus illorum in æternum ; <l eID="gen6297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6298"/>tabernacula eorum in progenie et progenie : <l eID="gen6298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6299"/>vocaverunt nomina sua in terris suis. <l eID="gen6299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2849"/><l level="1" sID="gen6300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2849"/>Et homo, cum in honore esset, non intellexit. <l eID="gen6300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6301"/>Comparatus est jumentis insipientibus, <l eID="gen6301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6302"/>et similis factus est illis. <l eID="gen6302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2850"/><l level="1" sID="gen6303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2850"/>Hæc via illorum scandalum ipsis ; <l eID="gen6303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6304"/>et postea in ore suo complacebunt. <l eID="gen6304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2851"/><l level="1" sID="gen6305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2851"/>Sicut oves in inferno positi sunt : <l eID="gen6305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6306"/>mors depascet eos. <l eID="gen6306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6307"/>Et dominabuntur eorum justi in matutino ; <l eID="gen6307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6308"/>et auxilium eorum veterascet in inferno a gloria eorum. <l eID="gen6308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2852"/><l level="1" sID="gen6309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2852"/>Verumtamen Deus redimet animam meam de manu inferi, <l eID="gen6309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6310"/>cum acceperit me. <l eID="gen6310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2853"/><l level="1" sID="gen6311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2853"/>Ne timueris cum dives factus fuerit homo, <l eID="gen6311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6312"/>et cum multiplicata fuerit gloria domus ejus : <l eID="gen6312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2854"/><l level="1" sID="gen6313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2854"/>quoniam, cum interierit, non sumet omnia, <l eID="gen6313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6314"/>neque descendet cum eo gloria ejus. <l eID="gen6314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2855"/><l level="1" sID="gen6315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2855"/>Quia anima ejus in vita ipsius benedicetur ; <l eID="gen6315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6316"/>confitebitur tibi cum benefeceris ei. <l eID="gen6316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2856"/><l level="1" sID="gen6317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2856"/>Introibit usque in progenies patrum suorum ; <l eID="gen6317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6318"/>et usque in æternum non videbit lumen. <l eID="gen6318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 48:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2857"/><l level="1" sID="gen6319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2857"/>Homo, cum in honore esset, non intellexit. <l eID="gen6319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6320"/>Comparatus est jumentis insipientibus, <l eID="gen6320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6321"/>et similis factus est illis. <l eID="gen6321" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6275"/> <chapter eID="Ps.48"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:1
verses.text: Psalmus Asaph. <div eID="gen6322" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6323"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6324"/>Deus deorum Dominus locutus est, <l eID="gen6324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6325"/>et vocavit terram a solis ortu usque ad occasum. <l eID="gen6325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2858"/><l level="1" sID="gen6326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2858"/>Ex Sion species decoris ejus : <l eID="gen6326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2859"/><l level="1" sID="gen6327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2859"/>Deus manifeste veniet ; <l eID="gen6327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6328"/>Deus noster, et non silebit. <l eID="gen6328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6329"/>Ignis in conspectu ejus exardescet ; <l eID="gen6329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6330"/>et in circuitu ejus tempestas valida. <l eID="gen6330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2860"/><l level="1" sID="gen6331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2860"/>Advocabit cælum desursum, et terram, <l eID="gen6331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6332"/>discernere populum suum. <l eID="gen6332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2861"/><l level="1" sID="gen6333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2861"/>Congregate illi sanctos ejus, <l eID="gen6333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6334"/>qui ordinant testamentum ejus super sacrificia. <l eID="gen6334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2862"/><l level="1" sID="gen6335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2862"/>Et annuntiabunt cæli justitiam ejus, <l eID="gen6335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6336"/>quoniam Deus judex est. <l eID="gen6336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2863"/><l level="1" sID="gen6337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2863"/>Audi, populus meus, et loquar ; <l eID="gen6337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6338"/>Israël, et testificabor tibi : <l eID="gen6338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6339"/>Deus, Deus tuus ego sum. <l eID="gen6339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2864"/><l level="1" sID="gen6340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2864"/>Non in sacrificiis tuis arguam te ; <l eID="gen6340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6341"/>holocausta autem tua in conspectu meo sunt semper. <l eID="gen6341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2865"/><l level="1" sID="gen6342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2865"/>Non accipiam de domo tua vitulos, <l eID="gen6342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6343"/>neque de gregibus tuis hircos : <l eID="gen6343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2866"/><l level="1" sID="gen6344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2866"/>quoniam meæ sunt omnes feræ silvarum, <l eID="gen6344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6345"/>jumenta in montibus, et boves. <l eID="gen6345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2867"/><l level="1" sID="gen6346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2867"/>Cognovi omnia volatilia cæli, <l eID="gen6346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6347"/>et pulchritudo agri mecum est. <l eID="gen6347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2868"/><l level="1" sID="gen6348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2868"/>Si esuriero, non dicam tibi : <l eID="gen6348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6349"/>meus est enim orbis terræ et plenitudo ejus. <l eID="gen6349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2869"/><l level="1" sID="gen6350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2869"/>Numquid manducabo carnes taurorum ? <l eID="gen6350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6351"/>aut sanguinem hircorum potabo ? <l eID="gen6351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2870"/><l level="1" sID="gen6352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2870"/>Immola Deo sacrificium laudis, <l eID="gen6352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6353"/>et redde Altissimo vota tua. <l eID="gen6353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2871"/><l level="1" sID="gen6354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2871"/>Et invoca me in die tribulationis : <l eID="gen6354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6355"/>eruam te, et honorificabis me. <l eID="gen6355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2872"/><l level="1" sID="gen6356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2872"/>Peccatori autem dixit Deus : Quare tu enarras justitias meas ? <l eID="gen6356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6357"/>et assumis testamentum meum per os tuum ? <l eID="gen6357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2873"/><l level="1" sID="gen6358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2873"/>Tu vero odisti disciplinam, <l eID="gen6358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6359"/>et projecisti sermones meos retrorsum. <l eID="gen6359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2874"/><l level="1" sID="gen6360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2874"/>Si videbas furem, currebas cum eo ; <l eID="gen6360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6361"/>et cum adulteris portionem tuam ponebas. <l eID="gen6361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2875"/><l level="1" sID="gen6362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2875"/>Os tuum abundavit malitia, <l eID="gen6362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6363"/>et lingua tua concinnabat dolos. <l eID="gen6363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2876"/><l level="1" sID="gen6364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2876"/>Sedens adversus fratrem tuum loquebaris, <l eID="gen6364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6365"/>et adversus filium matris tuæ ponebas scandalum. <l eID="gen6365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2877"/><l level="1" sID="gen6366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2877"/>Hæc fecisti, et tacui. <l eID="gen6366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6367"/>Existimasti inique quod ero tui similis : <l eID="gen6367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6368"/>arguam te, et statuam contra faciem tuam. <l eID="gen6368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2878"/><l level="1" sID="gen6369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2878"/>Intelligite hæc, qui obliviscimini Deum, <l eID="gen6369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6370"/>nequando rapiat, et non sit qui eripiat. <l eID="gen6370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 49:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2879"/><l level="1" sID="gen6371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2879"/>Sacrificium laudis honorificabit me, <l eID="gen6371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6372"/>et illic iter quo ostendam illi salutare Dei. <l eID="gen6372" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6323"/> <chapter eID="Ps.49"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David,

verses.name: Psalms 50:2
verses.text: cum venit ad eum Nathan propheta, quando intravit ad Bethsabee.  <div eID="gen6373" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2880"/><lg sID="gen6374"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2880"/>Miserere mei, Deus, secundum magnam misericordiam tuam ; <l eID="gen6375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6376"/>et secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum, dele iniquitatem meam. <l eID="gen6376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2881"/><l level="1" sID="gen6377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2881"/>Amplius lava me ab iniquitate mea, <l eID="gen6377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6378"/>et a peccato meo munda me. <l eID="gen6378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2882"/><l level="1" sID="gen6379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2882"/>Quoniam iniquitatem meam ego cognosco, <l eID="gen6379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6380"/>et peccatum meum contra me est semper. <l eID="gen6380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2883"/><l level="1" sID="gen6381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2883"/>Tibi soli peccavi, et malum coram te feci ; <l eID="gen6381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6382"/>ut justificeris in sermonibus tuis, <l eID="gen6382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6383"/>et vincas cum judicaris. <l eID="gen6383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2884"/><l level="1" sID="gen6384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2884"/>Ecce enim in iniquitatibus conceptus sum, <l eID="gen6384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6385"/>et in peccatis concepit me mater mea. <l eID="gen6385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2885"/><l level="1" sID="gen6386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2885"/>Ecce enim veritatem dilexisti ; <l eID="gen6386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6387"/>incerta et occulta sapientiæ tuæ manifestasti mihi. <l eID="gen6387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2886"/><l level="1" sID="gen6388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2886"/>Asperges me hyssopo, et mundabor ; <l eID="gen6388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6389"/>lavabis me, et super nivem dealbabor. <l eID="gen6389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2887"/><l level="1" sID="gen6390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2887"/>Auditui meo dabis gaudium et lætitiam, <l eID="gen6390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6391"/>et exsultabunt ossa humiliata. <l eID="gen6391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2888"/><l level="1" sID="gen6392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2888"/>Averte faciem tuam a peccatis meis, <l eID="gen6392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6393"/>et omnes iniquitates meas dele. <l eID="gen6393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2889"/><l level="1" sID="gen6394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2889"/>Cor mundum crea in me, Deus, <l eID="gen6394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6395"/>et spiritum rectum innova in visceribus meis. <l eID="gen6395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2890"/><l level="1" sID="gen6396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2890"/>Ne projicias me a facie tua, <l eID="gen6396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6397"/>et spiritum sanctum tuum ne auferas a me. <l eID="gen6397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2891"/><l level="1" sID="gen6398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2891"/>Redde mihi lætitiam salutaris tui, <l eID="gen6398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6399"/>et spiritu principali confirma me. <l eID="gen6399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2892"/><l level="1" sID="gen6400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2892"/>Docebo iniquos vias tuas, <l eID="gen6400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6401"/>et impii ad te convertentur. <l eID="gen6401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2893"/><l level="1" sID="gen6402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2893"/>Libera me de sanguinibus, Deus, Deus salutis meæ, <l eID="gen6402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6403"/>et exsultabit lingua mea justitiam tuam. <l eID="gen6403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2894"/><l level="1" sID="gen6404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2894"/>Domine, labia mea aperies, <l eID="gen6404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6405"/>et os meum annuntiabit laudem tuam. <l eID="gen6405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2895"/><l level="1" sID="gen6406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2895"/>Quoniam si voluisses sacrificium, dedissem utique ; <l eID="gen6406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6407"/>holocaustis non delectaberis. <l eID="gen6407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2896"/><l level="1" sID="gen6408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2896"/>Sacrificium Deo spiritus contribulatus ; <l eID="gen6408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6409"/>cor contritum et humiliatum, Deus, non despicies. <l eID="gen6409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2897"/><l level="1" sID="gen6410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2897"/>Benigne fac, Domine, in bona voluntate tua Sion, <l eID="gen6410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6411"/>ut ædificentur muri Jerusalem. <l eID="gen6411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 50:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2898"/><l level="1" sID="gen6412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2898"/>Tunc acceptabis sacrificium justitiæ, oblationes et holocausta ; <l eID="gen6412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6413"/>tunc imponent super altare tuum vitulos. <l eID="gen6413" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6374"/> <chapter eID="Ps.50"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:1
verses.text: In finem. Intellectus David,

verses.name: Psalms 51:2
verses.text: cum venit Doëg Idumæus, et nuntiavit Sauli : Venit David in domum Achimelech.  <div eID="gen6414" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2899"/><lg sID="gen6415"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2899"/>Quid gloriaris in malitia, <l eID="gen6416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6417"/>qui potens es in iniquitate ? <l eID="gen6417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2900"/><l level="1" sID="gen6418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2900"/>Tota die injustitiam cogitavit lingua tua ; <l eID="gen6418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6419"/>sicut novacula acuta fecisti dolum. <l eID="gen6419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2901"/><l level="1" sID="gen6420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2901"/>Dilexisti malitiam super benignitatem ; <l eID="gen6420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6421"/>iniquitatem magis quam loqui æquitatem. <l eID="gen6421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2902"/><l level="1" sID="gen6422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2902"/>Dilexisti omnia verba præcipitationis ; <l eID="gen6422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6423"/>lingua dolosa. <l eID="gen6423" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2903"/><l level="1" sID="gen6424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2903"/>Propterea Deus destruet te in finem ; <l eID="gen6424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6425"/>evellet te, et emigrabit te de tabernaculo tuo, <l eID="gen6425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6426"/>et radicem tuam de terra viventium. <l eID="gen6426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2904"/><l level="1" sID="gen6427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2904"/>Videbunt justi, et timebunt ; <l eID="gen6427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6428"/>et super eum ridebunt, et dicent : <l eID="gen6428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2905"/><l level="1" sID="gen6429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2905"/>Ecce homo qui non posuit Deum adjutorem suum ; <l eID="gen6429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6430"/>sed speravit in multitudine divitiarum suarum, <l eID="gen6430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6431"/>et prævaluit in vanitate sua. <l eID="gen6431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2906"/><l level="1" sID="gen6432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2906"/>Ego autem, sicut oliva fructifera in domo Dei ; <l eID="gen6432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6433"/>speravi in misericordia Dei, in æternum et in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen6433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 51:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2907"/><l level="1" sID="gen6434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2907"/>Confitebor tibi in sæculum, quia fecisti ; <l eID="gen6434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6435"/>et exspectabo nomen tuum, <l eID="gen6435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6436"/>quoniam bonum est in conspectu sanctorum tuorum. <l eID="gen6436" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6415"/> <chapter eID="Ps.51"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:1
verses.text: In finem, pro Maëleth intelligentiæ David. <div eID="gen6437" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6438"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6439"/>Dixit insipiens in corde suo : Non est Deus. <l eID="gen6439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2908"/><l level="1" sID="gen6440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2908"/>Corrupti sunt, et abominabiles facti sunt in iniquitatibus ; <l eID="gen6440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6441"/>non est qui faciat bonum. <l eID="gen6441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2909"/><l level="1" sID="gen6442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2909"/>Deus de cælo prospexit super filios hominum, <l eID="gen6442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6443"/>ut videat si est intelligens, aut requirens Deum. <l eID="gen6443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2910"/><l level="1" sID="gen6444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2910"/>Omnes declinaverunt ; simul inutiles facti sunt : <l eID="gen6444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6445"/>non est qui faciat bonum, non est usque ad unum. <l eID="gen6445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2911"/><l level="1" sID="gen6446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2911"/>Nonne scient omnes qui operantur iniquitatem, <l eID="gen6446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6447"/>qui devorant plebem meam ut cibum panis ? <l eID="gen6447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2912"/><l level="1" sID="gen6448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2912"/>Deum non invocaverunt ; <l eID="gen6448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6449"/>illic trepidaverunt timore, ubi non erat timor. <l eID="gen6449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6450"/>Quoniam Deus dissipavit ossa eorum qui hominibus placent : <l eID="gen6450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6451"/>confusi sunt, quoniam Deus sprevit eos. <l eID="gen6451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 52:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2913"/><l level="1" sID="gen6452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2913"/>Quis dabit ex Sion salutare Israël ? <l eID="gen6452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6453"/>cum converterit Deus captivitatem plebis suæ, <l eID="gen6453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6454"/>exsultabit Jacob, et lætabitur Israël. <l eID="gen6454" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6438"/> <chapter eID="Ps.52"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:1
verses.text: In finem, in carminibus. Intellectus David,

verses.name: Psalms 53:2
verses.text: cum venissent Ziphæi, et dixissent ad Saul : Nonne David absconditus est apud nos ?  <div eID="gen6455" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2914"/><lg sID="gen6456"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2914"/>Deus, in nomine tuo salvum me fac, <l eID="gen6457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6458"/>et in virtute tua judica me. <l eID="gen6458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2915"/><l level="1" sID="gen6459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2915"/>Deus, exaudi orationem meam ; <l eID="gen6459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6460"/>auribus percipe verba oris mei. <l eID="gen6460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2916"/><l level="1" sID="gen6461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2916"/>Quoniam alieni insurrexerunt adversum me, <l eID="gen6461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6462"/>et fortes quæsierunt animam meam, <l eID="gen6462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6463"/>et non proposuerunt Deum ante conspectum suum. <l eID="gen6463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2917"/><l level="1" sID="gen6464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2917"/>Ecce enim Deus adjuvat me, <l eID="gen6464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6465"/>et Dominus susceptor est animæ meæ. <l eID="gen6465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2918"/><l level="1" sID="gen6466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2918"/>Averte mala inimicis meis ; <l eID="gen6466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6467"/>et in veritate tua disperde illos. <l eID="gen6467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2919"/><l level="1" sID="gen6468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2919"/>Voluntarie sacrificabo tibi, <l eID="gen6468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6469"/>et confitebor nomini tuo, Domine, quoniam bonum est. <l eID="gen6469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 53:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2920"/><l level="1" sID="gen6470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2920"/>Quoniam ex omni tribulatione eripuisti me, <l eID="gen6470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6471"/>et super inimicos meos despexit oculus meus. <l eID="gen6471" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6456"/> <chapter eID="Ps.53"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:1
verses.text: In finem, in carminibus. Intellectus David.  <div eID="gen6472" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2921"/><lg sID="gen6473"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2921"/>Exaudi, Deus, orationem meam, <l eID="gen6474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6475"/>et ne despexeris deprecationem meam : <l eID="gen6475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2922"/><l level="1" sID="gen6476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2922"/>intende mihi, et exaudi me. <l eID="gen6476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6477"/>Contristatus sum in exercitatione mea, <l eID="gen6477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6478"/>et conturbatus sum <l eID="gen6478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2923"/><l level="1" sID="gen6479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2923"/>a voce inimici, et a tribulatione peccatoris. <l eID="gen6479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6480"/>Quoniam declinaverunt in me iniquitates, <l eID="gen6480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6481"/>et in ira molesti erant mihi. <l eID="gen6481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2924"/><l level="1" sID="gen6482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2924"/>Cor meum conturbatum est in me, <l eID="gen6482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6483"/>et formido mortis cecidit super me. <l eID="gen6483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2925"/><l level="1" sID="gen6484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2925"/>Timor et tremor venerunt super me, <l eID="gen6484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6485"/>et contexerunt me tenebræ. <l eID="gen6485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2926"/><l level="1" sID="gen6486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2926"/>Et dixi : Quis dabit mihi pennas sicut columbæ, <l eID="gen6486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6487"/>et volabo, et requiescam ? <l eID="gen6487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2927"/><l level="1" sID="gen6488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2927"/>Ecce elongavi fugiens, <l eID="gen6488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6489"/>et mansi in solitudine. <l eID="gen6489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2928"/><l level="1" sID="gen6490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2928"/>Exspectabam eum qui salvum me fecit <l eID="gen6490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6491"/>a pusillanimitate spiritus, et tempestate. <l eID="gen6491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2929"/><l level="1" sID="gen6492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2929"/>Præcipita, Domine ; divide linguas eorum : <l eID="gen6492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6493"/>quoniam vidi iniquitatem et contradictionem in civitate. <l eID="gen6493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2930"/><l level="1" sID="gen6494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2930"/>Die ac nocte circumdabit eam super muros ejus iniquitas ; <l eID="gen6494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6495"/>et labor in medio ejus, <l eID="gen6495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2931"/><l level="1" sID="gen6496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2931"/>et injustitia : <l eID="gen6496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6497"/>et non defecit de plateis ejus usura et dolus. <l eID="gen6497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2932"/><l level="1" sID="gen6498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2932"/>Quoniam si inimicus meus maledixisset mihi, <l eID="gen6498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6499"/>sustinuissem utique. <l eID="gen6499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6500"/>Et si is qui oderat me super me magna locutus fuisset, <l eID="gen6500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6501"/>abscondissem me forsitan ab eo. <l eID="gen6501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2933"/><l level="1" sID="gen6502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2933"/>Tu vero homo unanimis, <l eID="gen6502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6503"/>dux meus, et notus meus : <l eID="gen6503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2934"/><l level="1" sID="gen6504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2934"/>qui simul mecum dulces capiebas cibos ; <l eID="gen6504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6505"/>in domo Dei ambulavimus cum consensu. <l eID="gen6505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2935"/><l level="1" sID="gen6506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2935"/>Veniat mors super illos, <l eID="gen6506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6507"/>et descendant in infernum viventes : <l eID="gen6507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6508"/>quoniam nequitiæ in habitaculis eorum, in medio eorum. <l eID="gen6508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2936"/><l level="1" sID="gen6509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2936"/>Ego autem ad Deum clamavi, <l eID="gen6509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6510"/>et Dominus salvabit me. <l eID="gen6510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2937"/><l level="1" sID="gen6511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2937"/>Vespere, et mane, et meridie, narrabo, et annuntiabo ; <l eID="gen6511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6512"/>et exaudiet vocem meam. <l eID="gen6512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2938"/><l level="1" sID="gen6513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2938"/>Redimet in pace animam meam ab his qui appropinquant mihi : <l eID="gen6513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6514"/>quoniam inter multos erant mecum. <l eID="gen6514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2939"/><l level="1" sID="gen6515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2939"/>Exaudiet Deus, et humiliabit illos, <l eID="gen6515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6516"/>qui est ante sæcula. <l eID="gen6516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6517"/>Non enim est illis commutatio, <l eID="gen6517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6518"/>et non timuerunt Deum. <l eID="gen6518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2940"/><l level="1" sID="gen6519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2940"/>Extendit manum suam in retribuendo ; <l eID="gen6519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6520"/>contaminaverunt testamentum ejus : <l eID="gen6520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2941"/><l level="1" sID="gen6521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2941"/>divisi sunt ab ira vultus ejus, <l eID="gen6521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6522"/>et appropinquavit cor illius. <l eID="gen6522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6523"/>Molliti sunt sermones ejus super oleum ; <l eID="gen6523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6524"/>et ipsi sunt jacula. <l eID="gen6524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2942"/><l level="1" sID="gen6525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2942"/>Jacta super Dominum curam tuam, et ipse te enutriet ; <l eID="gen6525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6526"/>non dabit in æternum fluctuationem justo. <l eID="gen6526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 54:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2943"/><l level="1" sID="gen6527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2943"/>Tu vero, Deus, deduces eos in puteum interitus. <l eID="gen6527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6528"/>Viri sanguinum et dolosi non dimidiabunt dies suos ; <l eID="gen6528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6529"/>ego autem sperabo in te, Domine. <l eID="gen6529" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6473"/> <chapter eID="Ps.54"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:1
verses.text: In finem, pro populo qui a sanctis longe factus est. David in tituli inscriptionem, cum tenuerunt eum Allophyli in Geth.  <div eID="gen6530" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2944"/><lg sID="gen6531"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2944"/>Miserere mei, Deus, quoniam conculcavit me homo ; <l eID="gen6532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6533"/>tota die impugnans, tribulavit me. <l eID="gen6533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2945"/><l level="1" sID="gen6534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2945"/>Conculcaverunt me inimici mei tota die, <l eID="gen6534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6535"/>quoniam multi bellantes adversum me. <l eID="gen6535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2946"/><l level="1" sID="gen6536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2946"/>Ab altitudine diei timebo : <l eID="gen6536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6537"/>ego vero in te sperabo. <l eID="gen6537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2947"/><l level="1" sID="gen6538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2947"/>In Deo laudabo sermones meos ; <l eID="gen6538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6539"/>in Deo speravi : <l eID="gen6539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6540"/>non timebo quid faciat mihi caro. <l eID="gen6540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2948"/><l level="1" sID="gen6541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2948"/>Tota die verba mea execrabantur ; <l eID="gen6541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6542"/>adversum me omnes cogitationes eorum in malum. <l eID="gen6542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2949"/><l level="1" sID="gen6543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2949"/>Inhabitabunt, et abscondent ; <l eID="gen6543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6544"/>ipsi calcaneum meum observabunt. <l eID="gen6544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6545"/>Sicut sustinuerunt animam meam, <l eID="gen6545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2950"/><l level="1" sID="gen6546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2950"/>pro nihilo salvos facies illos ; <l eID="gen6546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6547"/>in ira populos confringes. <l eID="gen6547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2951"/><l level="1" sID="gen6548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2951"/>Deus, vitam meam annuntiavi tibi ; <l eID="gen6548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6549"/>posuisti lacrimas meas in conspectu tuo, <l eID="gen6549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6550"/>sicut et in promissione tua : <l eID="gen6550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2952"/><l level="1" sID="gen6551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2952"/>tunc convertentur inimici mei retrorsum. <l eID="gen6551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6552"/>In quacumque die invocavero te, <l eID="gen6552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6553"/>ecce cognovi quoniam Deus meus es. <l eID="gen6553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2953"/><l level="1" sID="gen6554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2953"/>In Deo laudabo verbum ; <l eID="gen6554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6555"/>in Domino laudabo sermonem. <l eID="gen6555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6556"/>In Deo speravi : <l eID="gen6556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6557"/>non timebo quid faciat mihi homo. <l eID="gen6557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2954"/><l level="1" sID="gen6558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2954"/>In me sunt, Deus, vota tua, <l eID="gen6558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6559"/>quæ reddam, laudationes tibi : <l eID="gen6559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 55:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2955"/><l level="1" sID="gen6560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2955"/>quoniam eripuisti animam meam de morte, <l eID="gen6560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6561"/>et pedes meos de lapsu, <l eID="gen6561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6562"/>ut placeam coram Deo in lumine viventium. <l eID="gen6562" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6531"/> <chapter eID="Ps.55"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:1
verses.text: In finem, ne disperdas. David in tituli inscriptionem, cum fugeret a facie Saul in speluncam.  <div eID="gen6563" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2956"/><lg sID="gen6564"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2956"/>Miserere mei, Deus, miserere mei, <l eID="gen6565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6566"/>quoniam in te confidit anima mea. <l eID="gen6566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6567"/>Et in umbra alarum tuarum sperabo, <l eID="gen6567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6568"/>donec transeat iniquitas. <l eID="gen6568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2957"/><l level="1" sID="gen6569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2957"/>Clamabo ad Deum altissimum, <l eID="gen6569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6570"/>Deum qui benefecit mihi. <l eID="gen6570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2958"/><l level="1" sID="gen6571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2958"/>Misit de cælo, et liberavit me ; <l eID="gen6571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6572"/>dedit in opprobrium conculcantes me. <l eID="gen6572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6573"/>Misit Deus misericordiam suam et veritatem suam, <l eID="gen6573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2959"/><l level="1" sID="gen6574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2959"/>et eripuit animam meam de medio catulorum leonum. <l eID="gen6574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6575"/>Dormivi conturbatus. <l eID="gen6575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6576"/>Filii hominum dentes eorum arma et sagittæ, <l eID="gen6576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6577"/>et lingua eorum gladius acutus. <l eID="gen6577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2960"/><l level="1" sID="gen6578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2960"/>Exaltare super cælos, Deus, <l eID="gen6578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6579"/>et in omnem terram gloria tua. <l eID="gen6579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2961"/><l level="1" sID="gen6580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2961"/>Laqueum paraverunt pedibus meis, <l eID="gen6580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6581"/>et incurvaverunt animam meam. <l eID="gen6581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6582"/>Foderunt ante faciem meam foveam, <l eID="gen6582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6583"/>et inciderunt in eam.

verses.name: Psalms 56:8
verses.text: Paratum cor meum, Deus, paratum cor meum ; <l eID="gen6583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6584"/>cantabo, et psalmum dicam. <l eID="gen6584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2962"/><l level="1" sID="gen6585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2962"/>Exsurge, gloria mea ; <l eID="gen6585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6586"/>exsurge, psalterium et cithara : <l eID="gen6586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6587"/>exsurgam diluculo. <l eID="gen6587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2963"/><l level="1" sID="gen6588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2963"/>Confitebor tibi in populis, Domine, <l eID="gen6588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6589"/>et psalmum dicam tibi in gentibus : <l eID="gen6589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2964"/><l level="1" sID="gen6590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2964"/>quoniam magnificata est usque ad cælos misericordia tua, <l eID="gen6590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6591"/>et usque ad nubes veritas tua. <l eID="gen6591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 56:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2965"/><l level="1" sID="gen6592"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2965"/>Exaltare super cælos, Deus, <l eID="gen6592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6593"/>et super omnem terram gloria tua. <l eID="gen6593" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6564"/> <chapter eID="Ps.56"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:1
verses.text: In finem, ne disperdas. David in tituli inscriptionem.  <div eID="gen6594" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2966"/><lg sID="gen6595"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2966"/>Si vere utique justitiam loquimini, <l eID="gen6596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6597"/>recta judicate, filii hominum. <l eID="gen6597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2967"/><l level="1" sID="gen6598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2967"/>Etenim in corde iniquitates operamini ; <l eID="gen6598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6599"/>in terra injustitias manus vestræ concinnant. <l eID="gen6599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2968"/><l level="1" sID="gen6600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2968"/>Alienati sunt peccatores a vulva ; <l eID="gen6600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6601"/>erraverunt ab utero : <l eID="gen6601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6602"/>locuti sunt falsa. <l eID="gen6602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2969"/><l level="1" sID="gen6603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2969"/>Furor illis secundum similitudinem serpentis, <l eID="gen6603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6604"/>sicut aspidis surdæ et obturantis aures suas, <l eID="gen6604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2970"/><l level="1" sID="gen6605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2970"/>quæ non exaudiet vocem incantantium, <l eID="gen6605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6606"/>et venefici incantantis sapienter. <l eID="gen6606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2971"/><l level="1" sID="gen6607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2971"/>Deus conteret dentes eorum in ore ipsorum ; <l eID="gen6607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6608"/>molas leonum confringet Dominus. <l eID="gen6608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2972"/><l level="1" sID="gen6609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2972"/>Ad nihilum devenient tamquam aqua decurrens ; <l eID="gen6609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6610"/>intendit arcum suum donec infirmentur. <l eID="gen6610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2973"/><l level="1" sID="gen6611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2973"/>Sicut cera quæ fluit auferentur ; <l eID="gen6611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6612"/>supercecidit ignis, et non viderunt solem. <l eID="gen6612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2974"/><l level="1" sID="gen6613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2974"/>Priusquam intelligerent spinæ vestræ rhamnum, <l eID="gen6613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6614"/>sicut viventes sic in ira absorbet eos. <l eID="gen6614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2975"/><l level="1" sID="gen6615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2975"/>Lætabitur justus cum viderit vindictam ; <l eID="gen6615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6616"/>manus suas lavabit in sanguine peccatoris. <l eID="gen6616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 57:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2976"/><l level="1" sID="gen6617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2976"/>Et dicet homo : Si utique est fructus justo, <l eID="gen6617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6618"/>utique est Deus judicans eos in terra. <l eID="gen6618" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6595"/> <chapter eID="Ps.57"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:1
verses.text: In finem, ne disperdas. David in tituli inscriptionem, quando misit Saul et custodivit domum ejus ut eum interficeret.  <div eID="gen6619" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2977"/><lg sID="gen6620"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2977"/>Eripe me de inimicis meis, Deus meus, <l eID="gen6621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6622"/>et ab insurgentibus in me libera me. <l eID="gen6622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2978"/><l level="1" sID="gen6623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2978"/>Eripe me de operantibus iniquitatem, <l eID="gen6623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6624"/>et de viris sanguinum salva me. <l eID="gen6624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2979"/><l level="1" sID="gen6625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2979"/>Quia ecce ceperunt animam meam ; <l eID="gen6625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6626"/>irruerunt in me fortes. <l eID="gen6626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2980"/><l level="1" sID="gen6627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2980"/>Neque iniquitas mea, neque peccatum meum, Domine ; <l eID="gen6627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6628"/>sine iniquitate cucurri, et direxi. <l eID="gen6628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2981"/><l level="1" sID="gen6629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2981"/>Exsurge in occursum meum, et vide : <l eID="gen6629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6630"/>et tu, Domine Deus virtutum, Deus Israël, <l eID="gen6630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6631"/>intende ad visitandas omnes gentes : <l eID="gen6631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6632"/>non miserearis omnibus qui operantur iniquitatem. <l eID="gen6632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:7
