verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2982"/><l level="1" sID="gen6633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2982"/>Convertentur ad vesperam, et famem patientur ut canes : <l eID="gen6633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6634"/>et circuibunt civitatem. <l eID="gen6634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2983"/><l level="1" sID="gen6635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2983"/>Ecce loquentur in ore suo, <l eID="gen6635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6636"/>et gladius in labiis eorum : quoniam quis audivit ? <l eID="gen6636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2984"/><l level="1" sID="gen6637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2984"/>Et tu, Domine, deridebis eos ; <l eID="gen6637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6638"/>ad nihilum deduces omnes gentes. <l eID="gen6638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2985"/><l level="1" sID="gen6639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2985"/>Fortitudinem meam ad te custodiam, <l eID="gen6639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6640"/>quia, Deus, susceptor meus es : <l eID="gen6640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2986"/><l level="1" sID="gen6641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2986"/>Deus meus misericordia ejus præveniet me. <l eID="gen6641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2987"/><l level="1" sID="gen6642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2987"/>Deus ostendet mihi super inimicos meos : <l eID="gen6642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6643"/>ne occidas eos, nequando obliviscantur populi mei. <l eID="gen6643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6644"/>Disperge illos in virtute tua, <l eID="gen6644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6645"/>et depone eos, protector meus, Domine : <l eID="gen6645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2988"/><l level="1" sID="gen6646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2988"/>delictum oris eorum, sermonem labiorum ipsorum ; <l eID="gen6646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6647"/>et comprehendantur in superbia sua. <l eID="gen6647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6648"/>Et de execratione et mendacio annuntiabuntur

verses.name: Psalms 58:14
verses.text: in consummatione : <l eID="gen6648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6649"/>in ira consummationis, et non erunt. <l eID="gen6649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6650"/>Et scient quia Deus dominabitur Jacob, et finium terræ. <l eID="gen6650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2989"/><l level="1" sID="gen6651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2989"/>Convertentur ad vesperam, et famem patientur ut canes : <l eID="gen6651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6652"/>et circuibunt civitatem.

verses.name: Psalms 58:16
verses.text: Ipsi dispergentur ad manducandum ; <l eID="gen6652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6653"/>si vero non fuerint saturati, et murmurabunt. <l eID="gen6653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2990"/><l level="1" sID="gen6654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2990"/>Ego autem cantabo fortitudinem tuam, <l eID="gen6654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6655"/>et exsultabo mane misericordiam tuam : <l eID="gen6655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6656"/>quia factus es susceptor meus, <l eID="gen6656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6657"/>et refugium meum in die tribulationis meæ. <l eID="gen6657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 58:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2991"/><l level="1" sID="gen6658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2991"/>Adjutor meus, tibi psallam, <l eID="gen6658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6659"/>quia Deus susceptor meus es ; <l eID="gen6659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6660"/>Deus meus, misericordia mea. <l eID="gen6660" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6620"/> <chapter eID="Ps.58"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:1
verses.text: In finem, pro his qui immutabuntur, in tituli inscriptionem ipsi David, in doctrinam,

verses.name: Psalms 59:2
verses.text: cum succendit Mesopotamiam Syriæ et Sobal, et convertit Joab, et percussit Idumæam in valle Salinarum duodecim millia.  <div eID="gen6661" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2992"/><lg sID="gen6662"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2992"/>Deus, repulisti nos, et destruxisti nos ; <l eID="gen6663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6664"/>iratus es, et misertus es nobis. <l eID="gen6664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2993"/><l level="1" sID="gen6665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2993"/>Commovisti terram, et conturbasti eam ; <l eID="gen6665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6666"/>sana contritiones ejus, quia commota est. <l eID="gen6666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2994"/><l level="1" sID="gen6667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2994"/>Ostendisti populo tuo dura ; <l eID="gen6667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6668"/>potasti nos vino compunctionis. <l eID="gen6668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2995"/><l level="1" sID="gen6669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2995"/>Dedisti metuentibus te significationem, <l eID="gen6669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6670"/>ut fugiant a facie arcus ; <l eID="gen6670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6671"/>ut liberentur dilecti tui. <l eID="gen6671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2996"/><l level="1" sID="gen6672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2996"/>Salvum fac dextera tua, et exaudi me. <l eID="gen6672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2997"/><l level="1" sID="gen6673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2997"/>Deus locutus est in sancto suo : <l eID="gen6673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6674"/>lætabor, et partibor Sichimam ; <l eID="gen6674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6675"/>et convallem tabernaculorum metibor. <l eID="gen6675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2998"/><l level="1" sID="gen6676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2998"/>Meus est Galaad, et meus est Manasses ; <l eID="gen6676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6677"/>et Ephraim fortitudo capitis mei. <l eID="gen6677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6678"/>Juda rex meus ; <l eID="gen6678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv2999"/><l level="1" sID="gen6679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv2999"/>Moab olla spei meæ. <l eID="gen6679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6680"/>In Idumæam extendam calceamentum meum : <l eID="gen6680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6681"/>mihi alienigenæ subditi sunt. <l eID="gen6681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3000"/><l level="1" sID="gen6682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3000"/>Quis deducet me in civitatem munitam ? <l eID="gen6682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6683"/>quis deducet me usque in Idumæam ? <l eID="gen6683" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3001"/><l level="1" sID="gen6684"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3001"/>nonne tu, Deus, qui repulisti nos ? <l eID="gen6684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6685"/>et non egredieris, Deus, in virtutibus nostris ? <l eID="gen6685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3002"/><l level="1" sID="gen6686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3002"/>Da nobis auxilium de tribulatione, <l eID="gen6686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6687"/>quia vana salus hominis. <l eID="gen6687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 59:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3003"/><l level="1" sID="gen6688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3003"/>In Deo faciemus virtutem ; <l eID="gen6688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6689"/>et ipse ad nihilum deducet tribulantes nos. <l eID="gen6689" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6662"/> <chapter eID="Ps.59"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:1
verses.text: In finem. In hymnis David.  <div eID="gen6690" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3004"/><lg sID="gen6691"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3004"/>Exaudi, Deus, deprecationem meam ; <l eID="gen6692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6693"/>intende orationi meæ. <l eID="gen6693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3005"/><l level="1" sID="gen6694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3005"/>A finibus terræ ad te clamavi, dum anxiaretur cor meum ; <l eID="gen6694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6695"/>in petra exaltasti me. <l eID="gen6695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6696"/>Deduxisti me,

verses.name: Psalms 60:4
verses.text: quia factus es spes mea : <l eID="gen6696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6697"/>turris fortitudinis a facie inimici. <l eID="gen6697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3006"/><l level="1" sID="gen6698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3006"/>Inhabitabo in tabernaculo tuo in sæcula ; <l eID="gen6698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6699"/>protegar in velamento alarum tuarum. <l eID="gen6699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3007"/><l level="1" sID="gen6700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3007"/>Quoniam tu, Deus meus, exaudisti orationem meam ; <l eID="gen6700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6701"/>dedisti hæreditatem timentibus nomen tuum. <l eID="gen6701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3008"/><l level="1" sID="gen6702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3008"/>Dies super dies regis adjicies ; <l eID="gen6702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6703"/>annos ejus usque in diem generationis et generationis. <l eID="gen6703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3009"/><l level="1" sID="gen6704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3009"/>Permanet in æternum in conspectu Dei : <l eID="gen6704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6705"/>misericordiam et veritatem ejus quis requiret ? <l eID="gen6705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 60:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3010"/><l level="1" sID="gen6706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3010"/>Sic psalmum dicam nomini tuo in sæculum sæculi, <l eID="gen6706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6707"/>ut reddam vota mea de die in diem. <l eID="gen6707" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6691"/> <chapter eID="Ps.60"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:1
verses.text: In finem, pro Idithun. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen6708" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3011"/><lg sID="gen6709"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3011"/>Nonne Deo subjecta erit anima mea ? <l eID="gen6710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6711"/>ab ipso enim salutare meum. <l eID="gen6711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3012"/><l level="1" sID="gen6712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3012"/>Nam et ipse Deus meus et salutaris meus ; <l eID="gen6712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6713"/>susceptor meus, non movebor amplius. <l eID="gen6713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3013"/><l level="1" sID="gen6714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3013"/>Quousque irruitis in hominem ? <l eID="gen6714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6715"/>interficitis universi vos, <l eID="gen6715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6716"/>tamquam parieti inclinato et maceriæ depulsæ. <l eID="gen6716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3014"/><l level="1" sID="gen6717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3014"/>Verumtamen pretium meum cogitaverunt repellere ; <l eID="gen6717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6718"/>cucurri in siti : <l eID="gen6718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6719"/>ore suo benedicebant, <l eID="gen6719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6720"/>et corde suo maledicebant. <l eID="gen6720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3015"/><l level="1" sID="gen6721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3015"/>Verumtamen Deo subjecta esto, anima mea, <l eID="gen6721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6722"/>quoniam ab ipso patientia mea : <l eID="gen6722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3016"/><l level="1" sID="gen6723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3016"/>quia ipse Deus meus et salvator meus, <l eID="gen6723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6724"/>adjutor meus, non emigrabo. <l eID="gen6724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3017"/><l level="1" sID="gen6725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3017"/>In Deo salutare meum et gloria mea ; <l eID="gen6725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6726"/>Deus auxilii mei, et spes mea in Deo est. <l eID="gen6726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3018"/><l level="1" sID="gen6727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3018"/>Sperate in eo, omnis congregatio populi ; <l eID="gen6727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6728"/>effundite coram illo corda vestra : <l eID="gen6728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6729"/>Deus adjutor noster in æternum. <l eID="gen6729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3019"/><l level="1" sID="gen6730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3019"/>Verumtamen vani filii hominum, <l eID="gen6730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6731"/>mendaces filii hominum in stateris, <l eID="gen6731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6732"/>ut decipiant ipsi de vanitate in idipsum. <l eID="gen6732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3020"/><l level="1" sID="gen6733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3020"/>Nolite sperare in iniquitate, <l eID="gen6733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6734"/>et rapinas nolite concupiscere ; <l eID="gen6734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6735"/>divitiæ si affluant, nolite cor apponere. <l eID="gen6735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 61:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3021"/><l level="1" sID="gen6736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3021"/>Semel locutus est Deus ; <l eID="gen6736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6737"/>duo hæc audivi : <l eID="gen6737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6738"/>quia potestas Dei est,

verses.name: Psalms 61:13
verses.text: et tibi, Domine, misericordia : <l eID="gen6738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6739"/>quia tu reddes unicuique juxta opera sua. <l eID="gen6739" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6709"/> <chapter eID="Ps.61"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, cum esset in deserto Idumææ.  <div eID="gen6740" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3022"/><lg sID="gen6741"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3022"/>Deus, Deus meus, ad te de luce vigilo. <l eID="gen6742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6743"/>Sitivit in te anima mea ; quam multipliciter tibi caro mea ! <l eID="gen6743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3023"/><l level="1" sID="gen6744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3023"/>In terra deserta, et invia, et inaquosa, <l eID="gen6744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6745"/>sic in sancto apparui tibi, <l eID="gen6745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6746"/>ut viderem virtutem tuam et gloriam tuam. <l eID="gen6746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3024"/><l level="1" sID="gen6747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3024"/>Quoniam melior est misericordia tua super vitas, <l eID="gen6747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6748"/>labia mea laudabunt te. <l eID="gen6748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3025"/><l level="1" sID="gen6749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3025"/>Sic benedicam te in vita mea, <l eID="gen6749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6750"/>et in nomine tuo levabo manus meas. <l eID="gen6750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3026"/><l level="1" sID="gen6751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3026"/>Sicut adipe et pinguedine repleatur anima mea, <l eID="gen6751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6752"/>et labiis exsultationis laudabit os meum. <l eID="gen6752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3027"/><l level="1" sID="gen6753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3027"/>Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, <l eID="gen6753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6754"/>in matutinis meditabor in te. <l eID="gen6754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3028"/><l level="1" sID="gen6755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3028"/>Quia fuisti adjutor meus, <l eID="gen6755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6756"/>et in velamento alarum tuarum exsultabo. <l eID="gen6756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3029"/><l level="1" sID="gen6757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3029"/>Adhæsit anima mea post te ; <l eID="gen6757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6758"/>me suscepit dextera tua. <l eID="gen6758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3030"/><l level="1" sID="gen6759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3030"/>Ipsi vero in vanum quæsierunt animam meam : <l eID="gen6759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6760"/>introibunt in inferiora terræ ; <l eID="gen6760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3031"/><l level="1" sID="gen6761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3031"/>tradentur in manus gladii : <l eID="gen6761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6762"/>partes vulpium erunt. <l eID="gen6762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 62:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3032"/><l level="1" sID="gen6763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3032"/>Rex vero lætabitur in Deo ; <l eID="gen6763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6764"/>laudabuntur omnes qui jurant in eo : <l eID="gen6764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6765"/>quia obstructum est os loquentium iniqua. <l eID="gen6765" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6741"/> <chapter eID="Ps.62"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen6766" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3033"/><lg sID="gen6767"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3033"/>Exaudi, Deus, orationem meam cum deprecor ; <l eID="gen6768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6769"/>a timore inimici eripe animam meam. <l eID="gen6769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3034"/><l level="1" sID="gen6770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3034"/>Protexisti me a conventu malignantium, <l eID="gen6770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6771"/>a multitudine operantium iniquitatem. <l eID="gen6771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3035"/><l level="1" sID="gen6772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3035"/>Quia exacuerunt ut gladium linguas suas ; <l eID="gen6772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6773"/>intenderunt arcum rem amaram, <l eID="gen6773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3036"/><l level="1" sID="gen6774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3036"/>ut sagittent in occultis immaculatum. <l eID="gen6774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3037"/><l level="1" sID="gen6775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3037"/>Subito sagittabunt eum, et non timebunt ; <l eID="gen6775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6776"/>firmaverunt sibi sermonem nequam. <l eID="gen6776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6777"/>Narraverunt ut absconderent laqueos ; <l eID="gen6777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6778"/>dixerunt : Quis videbit eos ? <l eID="gen6778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3038"/><l level="1" sID="gen6779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3038"/>Scrutati sunt iniquitates ; <l eID="gen6779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6780"/>defecerunt scrutantes scrutinio. <l eID="gen6780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6781"/>Accedet homo ad cor altum, <l eID="gen6781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3039"/><l level="1" sID="gen6782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3039"/>et exaltabitur Deus. <l eID="gen6782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6783"/>Sagittæ parvulorum factæ sunt plagæ eorum, <l eID="gen6783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3040"/><l level="1" sID="gen6784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3040"/>et infirmatæ sunt contra eos linguæ eorum. <l eID="gen6784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6785"/>Conturbati sunt omnes qui videbant eos, <l eID="gen6785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3041"/><l level="1" sID="gen6786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3041"/>et timuit omnis homo. <l eID="gen6786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6787"/>Et annuntiaverunt opera Dei, <l eID="gen6787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6788"/>et facta ejus intellexerunt. <l eID="gen6788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 63:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3042"/><l level="1" sID="gen6789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3042"/>Lætabitur justus in Domino, et sperabit in eo, <l eID="gen6789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6790"/>et laudabuntur omnes recti corde. <l eID="gen6790" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6767"/> <chapter eID="Ps.63"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David, canticum Jeremiæ et Ezechielis populo transmigrationis, cum inciperent exire.  <div eID="gen6791" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3043"/><lg sID="gen6792"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3043"/>Te decet hymnus, Deus, in Sion, <l eID="gen6793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6794"/>et tibi reddetur votum in Jerusalem. <l eID="gen6794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3044"/><l level="1" sID="gen6795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3044"/>Exaudi orationem meam ; <l eID="gen6795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6796"/>ad te omnis caro veniet. <l eID="gen6796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3045"/><l level="1" sID="gen6797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3045"/>Verba iniquorum prævaluerunt super nos, <l eID="gen6797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6798"/>et impietatibus nostris tu propitiaberis. <l eID="gen6798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3046"/><l level="1" sID="gen6799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3046"/>Beatus quem elegisti et assumpsisti : <l eID="gen6799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6800"/>inhabitabit in atriis tuis. <l eID="gen6800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6801"/>Replebimur in bonis domus tuæ ; <l eID="gen6801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6802"/>sanctum est templum tuum, <l eID="gen6802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3047"/><l level="1" sID="gen6803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3047"/>mirabile in æquitate. <l eID="gen6803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6804"/>Exaudi nos, Deus, salutaris noster, <l eID="gen6804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6805"/>spes omnium finium terræ, et in mari longe. <l eID="gen6805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3048"/><l level="1" sID="gen6806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3048"/>Præparans montes in virtute tua, <l eID="gen6806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6807"/>accinctus potentia ; <l eID="gen6807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3049"/><l level="1" sID="gen6808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3049"/>qui conturbas profundum maris, <l eID="gen6808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6809"/>sonum fluctuum ejus. <l eID="gen6809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6810"/>Turbabuntur gentes, <l eID="gen6810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3050"/><l level="1" sID="gen6811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3050"/>et timebunt qui habitant terminos a signis tuis ; <l eID="gen6811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6812"/>exitus matutini et vespere delectabis. <l eID="gen6812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3051"/><l level="1" sID="gen6813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3051"/>Visitasti terram, et inebriasti eam ; <l eID="gen6813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6814"/>multiplicasti locupletare eam. <l eID="gen6814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6815"/>Flumen Dei repletum est aquis ; parasti cibum illorum : <l eID="gen6815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6816"/>quoniam ita est præparatio ejus. <l eID="gen6816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3052"/><l level="1" sID="gen6817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3052"/>Rivos ejus inebria ; <l eID="gen6817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6818"/>multiplica genimina ejus : <l eID="gen6818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6819"/>in stillicidiis ejus lætabitur germinans. <l eID="gen6819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3053"/><l level="1" sID="gen6820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3053"/>Benedices coronæ anni benignitatis tuæ, <l eID="gen6820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6821"/>et campi tui replebuntur ubertate. <l eID="gen6821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3054"/><l level="1" sID="gen6822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3054"/>Pinguescent speciosa deserti, <l eID="gen6822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6823"/>et exsultatione colles accingentur. <l eID="gen6823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 64:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3055"/><l level="1" sID="gen6824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3055"/>Induti sunt arietes ovium, <l eID="gen6824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6825"/>et valles abundabunt frumento ; <l eID="gen6825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6826"/>clamabunt, etenim hymnum dicent. <l eID="gen6826" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6792"/> <chapter eID="Ps.64"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:1
verses.text: In finem. Canticum psalmi resurrectionis. <div eID="gen6827" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen6828"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6829"/>Jubilate Deo, omnis terra ; <l eID="gen6829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3056"/><l level="1" sID="gen6830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3056"/>psalmum dicite nomini ejus ; <l eID="gen6830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6831"/>date gloriam laudi ejus. <l eID="gen6831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3057"/><l level="1" sID="gen6832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3057"/>Dicite Deo : Quam terribilia sunt opera tua, Domine ! <l eID="gen6832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6833"/>in multitudine virtutis tuæ mentientur tibi inimici tui. <l eID="gen6833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3058"/><l level="1" sID="gen6834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3058"/>Omnis terra adoret te, et psallat tibi ; <l eID="gen6834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6835"/>psalmum dicat nomini tuo. <l eID="gen6835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3059"/><l level="1" sID="gen6836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3059"/>Venite, et videte opera Dei : <l eID="gen6836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6837"/>terribilis in consiliis super filios hominum. <l eID="gen6837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3060"/><l level="1" sID="gen6838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3060"/>Qui convertit mare in aridam ; <l eID="gen6838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6839"/>in flumine pertransibunt pede : <l eID="gen6839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6840"/>ibi lætabimur in ipso. <l eID="gen6840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3061"/><l level="1" sID="gen6841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3061"/>Qui dominatur in virtute sua in æternum ; <l eID="gen6841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6842"/>oculi ejus super gentes respiciunt : <l eID="gen6842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6843"/>qui exasperant non exaltentur in semetipsis. <l eID="gen6843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3062"/><l level="1" sID="gen6844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3062"/>Benedicite, gentes, Deum nostrum, <l eID="gen6844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6845"/>et auditam facite vocem laudis ejus : <l eID="gen6845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3063"/><l level="1" sID="gen6846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3063"/>qui posuit animam meam ad vitam, <l eID="gen6846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6847"/>et non dedit in commotionem pedes meos. <l eID="gen6847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3064"/><l level="1" sID="gen6848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3064"/>Quoniam probasti nos, Deus ; <l eID="gen6848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6849"/>igne nos examinasti, sicut examinatur argentum. <l eID="gen6849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3065"/><l level="1" sID="gen6850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3065"/>Induxisti nos in laqueum ; <l eID="gen6850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6851"/>posuisti tribulationes in dorso nostro ; <l eID="gen6851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3066"/><l level="1" sID="gen6852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3066"/>imposuisti homines super capita nostra. <l eID="gen6852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6853"/>Transivimus per ignem et aquam, <l eID="gen6853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6854"/>et eduxisti nos in refrigerium. <l eID="gen6854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3067"/><l level="1" sID="gen6855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3067"/>Introibo in domum tuam in holocaustis ; <l eID="gen6855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6856"/>reddam tibi vota mea

verses.name: Psalms 65:14
verses.text: quæ distinxerunt labia mea : <l eID="gen6856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6857"/>et locutum est os meum in tribulatione mea. <l eID="gen6857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3068"/><l level="1" sID="gen6858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3068"/>Holocausta medullata offeram tibi, cum incenso arietum ; <l eID="gen6858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6859"/>offeram tibi boves cum hircis. <l eID="gen6859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3069"/><l level="1" sID="gen6860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3069"/>Venite, audite, et narrabo, omnes qui timetis Deum, <l eID="gen6860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6861"/>quanta fecit animæ meæ. <l eID="gen6861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3070"/><l level="1" sID="gen6862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3070"/>Ad ipsum ore meo clamavi, <l eID="gen6862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6863"/>et exaltavi sub lingua mea. <l eID="gen6863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3071"/><l level="1" sID="gen6864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3071"/>Iniquitatem si aspexi in corde meo, <l eID="gen6864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6865"/>non exaudiet Dominus. <l eID="gen6865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3072"/><l level="1" sID="gen6866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3072"/>Propterea exaudivit Deus, <l eID="gen6866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6867"/>et attendit voci deprecationis meæ. <l eID="gen6867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 65:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3073"/><l level="1" sID="gen6868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3073"/>Benedictus Deus, qui non amovit orationem meam, <l eID="gen6868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6869"/>et misericordiam suam a me. <l eID="gen6869" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6828"/> <chapter eID="Ps.65"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:1
verses.text: In finem, in hymnis. Psalmus cantici David.  <div eID="gen6870" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3074"/><lg sID="gen6871"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3074"/>Deus misereatur nostri, et benedicat nobis ; <l eID="gen6872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6873"/>illuminet vultum suum super nos, et misereatur nostri : <l eID="gen6873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3075"/><l level="1" sID="gen6874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3075"/>ut cognoscamus in terra viam tuam, <l eID="gen6874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6875"/>in omnibus gentibus salutare tuum. <l eID="gen6875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3076"/><l level="1" sID="gen6876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3076"/>Confiteantur tibi populi, Deus : <l eID="gen6876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6877"/>confiteantur tibi populi omnes. <l eID="gen6877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3077"/><l level="1" sID="gen6878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3077"/>Lætentur et exsultent gentes, <l eID="gen6878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6879"/>quoniam judicas populos in æquitate, <l eID="gen6879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6880"/>et gentes in terra dirigis. <l eID="gen6880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3078"/><l level="1" sID="gen6881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3078"/>Confiteantur tibi populi, Deus : <l eID="gen6881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6882"/>confiteantur tibi populi omnes. <l eID="gen6882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3079"/><l level="1" sID="gen6883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3079"/>Terra dedit fructum suum : <l eID="gen6883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6884"/>benedicat nos Deus, Deus noster ! <l eID="gen6884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 66:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3080"/><l level="1" sID="gen6885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3080"/>Benedicat nos Deus, <l eID="gen6885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6886"/>et metuant eum omnes fines terræ. <l eID="gen6886" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6871"/> <chapter eID="Ps.66"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus cantici ipsi David.  <div eID="gen6887" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3081"/><lg sID="gen6888"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3081"/>Exsurgat Deus, et dissipentur inimici ejus ; <l eID="gen6889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6890"/>et fugiant qui oderunt eum a facie ejus. <l eID="gen6890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3082"/><l level="1" sID="gen6891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3082"/>Sicut deficit fumus, deficiant ; <l eID="gen6891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6892"/>sicut fluit cera a facie ignis, sic pereant peccatores a facie Dei. <l eID="gen6892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3083"/><l level="1" sID="gen6893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3083"/>Et justi epulentur, et exsultent in conspectu Dei, <l eID="gen6893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6894"/>et delectentur in lætitia. <l eID="gen6894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3084"/><l level="1" sID="gen6895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3084"/>Cantate Deo ; psalmum dicite nomini ejus : <l eID="gen6895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6896"/>iter facite ei qui ascendit super occasum. <l eID="gen6896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6897"/>Dominus nomen illi ; exsultate in conspectu ejus. <l eID="gen6897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6898"/>Turbabuntur a facie ejus, <l eID="gen6898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3085"/><l level="1" sID="gen6899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3085"/>patris orphanorum, et judicis viduarum ; <l eID="gen6899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6900"/>Deus in loco sancto suo. <l eID="gen6900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3086"/><l level="1" sID="gen6901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3086"/>Deus qui inhabitare facit unius moris in domo ; <l eID="gen6901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6902"/>qui educit vinctos in fortitudine, <l eID="gen6902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6903"/>similiter eos qui exasperant, qui habitant in sepulchris. <l eID="gen6903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3087"/><l level="1" sID="gen6904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3087"/>Deus, cum egredereris in conspectu populi tui, <l eID="gen6904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6905"/>cum pertransires in deserto, <l eID="gen6905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3088"/><l level="1" sID="gen6906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3088"/>terra mota est, etenim cæli distillaverunt, <l eID="gen6906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6907"/>a facie Dei Sinai, a facie Dei Israël. <l eID="gen6907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3089"/><l level="1" sID="gen6908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3089"/>Pluviam voluntariam segregabis, Deus, hæreditati tuæ ; <l eID="gen6908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6909"/>et infirmata est, tu vero perfecisti eam. <l eID="gen6909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3090"/><l level="1" sID="gen6910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3090"/>Animalia tua habitabunt in ea ; <l eID="gen6910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6911"/>parasti in dulcedine tua pauperi, Deus. <l eID="gen6911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3091"/><l level="1" sID="gen6912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3091"/>Dominus dabit verbum evangelizantibus, virtute multa. <l eID="gen6912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3092"/><l level="1" sID="gen6913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3092"/>Rex virtutum dilecti, dilecti ; <l eID="gen6913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6914"/>et speciei domus dividere spolia. <l eID="gen6914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3093"/><l level="1" sID="gen6915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3093"/>Si dormiatis inter medios cleros, <l eID="gen6915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6916"/>pennæ columbæ deargentatæ, <l eID="gen6916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6917"/>et posteriora dorsi ejus in pallore auri. <l eID="gen6917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3094"/><l level="1" sID="gen6918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3094"/>Dum discernit cælestis reges super eam, <l eID="gen6918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6919"/>nive dealbabuntur in Selmon. <l eID="gen6919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3095"/><l level="1" sID="gen6920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3095"/>Mons Dei, mons pinguis : <l eID="gen6920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6921"/>mons coagulatus, mons pinguis. <l eID="gen6921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3096"/><l level="1" sID="gen6922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3096"/>Ut quid suspicamini, montes coagulatos ? <l eID="gen6922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6923"/>mons in quo beneplacitum est Deo habitare in eo ; <l eID="gen6923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6924"/>etenim Dominus habitabit in finem. <l eID="gen6924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3097"/><l level="1" sID="gen6925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3097"/>Currus Dei decem millibus multiplex, millia lætantium ; <l eID="gen6925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6926"/>Dominus in eis in Sina, in sancto. <l eID="gen6926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3098"/><l level="1" sID="gen6927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3098"/>Ascendisti in altum, cepisti captivitatem, <l eID="gen6927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6928"/>accepisti dona in hominibus ; <l eID="gen6928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6929"/>etenim non credentes inhabitare Dominum Deum. <l eID="gen6929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3099"/><l level="1" sID="gen6930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3099"/>Benedictus Dominus die quotidie : <l eID="gen6930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6931"/>prosperum iter faciet nobis Deus salutarium nostrorum. <l eID="gen6931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3100"/><l level="1" sID="gen6932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3100"/>Deus noster, Deus salvos faciendi ; <l eID="gen6932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6933"/>et Domini, Domini exitus mortis. <l eID="gen6933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3101"/><l level="1" sID="gen6934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3101"/>Verumtamen Deus confringet capita inimicorum suorum, <l eID="gen6934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6935"/>verticem capilli perambulantium in delictis suis. <l eID="gen6935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3102"/><l level="1" sID="gen6936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3102"/>Dixit Dominus : Ex Basan convertam, <l eID="gen6936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6937"/>convertam in profundum maris : <l eID="gen6937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3103"/><l level="1" sID="gen6938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3103"/>ut intingatur pes tuus in sanguine ; <l eID="gen6938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6939"/>lingua canum tuorum ex inimicis, ab ipso. <l eID="gen6939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3104"/><l level="1" sID="gen6940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3104"/>Viderunt ingressus tuos, Deus, <l eID="gen6940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6941"/>ingressus Dei mei, regis mei, qui est in sancto. <l eID="gen6941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3105"/><l level="1" sID="gen6942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3105"/>Prævenerunt principes conjuncti psallentibus, <l eID="gen6942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6943"/>in medio juvencularum tympanistriarum. <l eID="gen6943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3106"/><l level="1" sID="gen6944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3106"/>In ecclesiis benedicite Deo Domino de fontibus Israël. <l eID="gen6944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3107"/><l level="1" sID="gen6945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3107"/>Ibi Benjamin adolescentulus, in mentis excessu ; <l eID="gen6945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6946"/>principes Juda, duces eorum ; <l eID="gen6946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6947"/>principes Zabulon, principes Nephthali. <l eID="gen6947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3108"/><l level="1" sID="gen6948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3108"/>Manda, Deus, virtuti tuæ ; <l eID="gen6948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6949"/>confirma hoc, Deus, quod operatus es in nobis. <l eID="gen6949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3109"/><l level="1" sID="gen6950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3109"/>A templo tuo in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen6950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6951"/>tibi offerent reges munera. <l eID="gen6951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3110"/><l level="1" sID="gen6952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3110"/>Increpa feras arundinis ; <l eID="gen6952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6953"/>congregatio taurorum in vaccis populorum : <l eID="gen6953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6954"/>ut excludant eos qui probati sunt argento. <l eID="gen6954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6955"/>Dissipa gentes quæ bella volunt. <l eID="gen6955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3111"/><l level="1" sID="gen6956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3111"/>Venient legati ex Ægypto ; <l eID="gen6956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6957"/>Æthiopia præveniet manus ejus Deo. <l eID="gen6957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3112"/><l level="1" sID="gen6958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3112"/>Regna terræ, cantate Deo ; <l eID="gen6958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6959"/>psallite Domino ; psallite Deo. <l eID="gen6959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3113"/><l level="1" sID="gen6960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3113"/>Qui ascendit super cælum cæli, ad orientem : <l eID="gen6960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6961"/>ecce dabit voci suæ vocem virtutis. <l eID="gen6961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3114"/><l level="1" sID="gen6962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3114"/>Date gloriam Deo super Israël ; <l eID="gen6962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6963"/>magnificentia ejus et virtus ejus in nubibus. <l eID="gen6963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 67:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3115"/><l level="1" sID="gen6964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3115"/>Mirabilis Deus in sanctis suis ; <l eID="gen6964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6965"/>Deus Israël ipse dabit virtutem et fortitudinem plebi suæ. <l eID="gen6965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6966"/>Benedictus Deus ! <l eID="gen6966" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6888"/> <chapter eID="Ps.67"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:1
verses.text: In finem, pro iis qui commutabuntur. David.  <div eID="gen6967" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3116"/><lg sID="gen6968"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3116"/>Salvum me fac, Deus, <l eID="gen6969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6970"/>quoniam intraverunt aquæ usque ad animam meam. <l eID="gen6970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3117"/><l level="1" sID="gen6971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3117"/>Infixus sum in limo profundi et non est substantia. <l eID="gen6971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6972"/>Veni in altitudinem maris, et tempestas demersit me. <l eID="gen6972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3118"/><l level="1" sID="gen6973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3118"/>Laboravi clamans, raucæ factæ sunt fauces meæ ; <l eID="gen6973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6974"/>defecerunt oculi mei, dum spero in Deum meum. <l eID="gen6974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3119"/><l level="1" sID="gen6975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3119"/>Multiplicati sunt super capillos capitis mei <l eID="gen6975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6976"/>qui oderunt me gratis. <l eID="gen6976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6977"/>Confortati sunt qui persecuti sunt me <l eID="gen6977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6978"/>inimici mei injuste ; <l eID="gen6978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6979"/>quæ non rapui, tunc exsolvebam. <l eID="gen6979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3120"/><l level="1" sID="gen6980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3120"/>Deus, tu scis insipientiam meam ; <l eID="gen6980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6981"/>et delicta mea a te non sunt abscondita. <l eID="gen6981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3121"/><l level="1" sID="gen6982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3121"/>Non erubescant in me qui exspectant te, Domine, Domine virtutum ; <l eID="gen6982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6983"/>non confundantur super me qui quærunt te, Deus Israël. <l eID="gen6983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3122"/><l level="1" sID="gen6984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3122"/>Quoniam propter te sustinui opprobrium ; <l eID="gen6984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6985"/>operuit confusio faciem meam. <l eID="gen6985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3123"/><l level="1" sID="gen6986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3123"/>Extraneus factus sum fratribus meis, <l eID="gen6986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6987"/>et peregrinus filiis matris meæ. <l eID="gen6987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3124"/><l level="1" sID="gen6988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3124"/>Quoniam zelus domus tuæ comedit me, <l eID="gen6988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6989"/>et opprobria exprobrantium tibi ceciderunt super me. <l eID="gen6989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3125"/><l level="1" sID="gen6990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3125"/>Et operui in jejunio animam meam, <l eID="gen6990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6991"/>et factum est in opprobrium mihi. <l eID="gen6991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3126"/><l level="1" sID="gen6992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3126"/>Et posui vestimentum meum cilicium ; <l eID="gen6992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6993"/>et factus sum illis in parabolam. <l eID="gen6993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3127"/><l level="1" sID="gen6994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3127"/>Adversum me loquebantur qui sedebant in porta, <l eID="gen6994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6995"/>et in me psallebant qui bibebant vinum. <l eID="gen6995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3128"/><l level="1" sID="gen6996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3128"/>Ego vero orationem meam ad te, Domine ; <l eID="gen6996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6997"/>tempus beneplaciti, Deus. <l eID="gen6997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6998"/>In multitudine misericordiæ tuæ, <l eID="gen6998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen6999"/>exaudi me in veritate salutis tuæ. <l eID="gen6999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3129"/><l level="1" sID="gen7000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3129"/>Eripe me de luto, ut non infigar ; <l eID="gen7000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7001"/>libera me ab iis qui oderunt me, et de profundis aquarum. <l eID="gen7001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3130"/><l level="1" sID="gen7002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3130"/>Non me demergat tempestas aquæ, <l eID="gen7002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7003"/>neque absorbeat me profundum, <l eID="gen7003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7004"/>neque urgeat super me puteus os suum. <l eID="gen7004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3131"/><l level="1" sID="gen7005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3131"/>Exaudi me, Domine, quoniam benigna est misericordia tua ; <l eID="gen7005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7006"/>secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum respice in me. <l eID="gen7006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3132"/><l level="1" sID="gen7007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3132"/>Et ne avertas faciem tuam a puero tuo ; <l eID="gen7007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7008"/>quoniam tribulor, velociter exaudi me. <l eID="gen7008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3133"/><l level="1" sID="gen7009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3133"/>Intende animæ meæ, et libera eam ; <l eID="gen7009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7010"/>propter inimicos meos, eripe me. <l eID="gen7010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3134"/><l level="1" sID="gen7011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3134"/>Tu scis improperium meum, et confusionem meam, et reverentiam meam ; <l eID="gen7011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3135"/><l level="1" sID="gen7012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3135"/>in conspectu tuo sunt omnes qui tribulant me. <l eID="gen7012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7013"/>Improperium exspectavit cor meum et miseriam : <l eID="gen7013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7014"/>et sustinui qui simul contristaretur, et non fuit ; <l eID="gen7014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7015"/>et qui consolaretur, et non inveni. <l eID="gen7015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3136"/><l level="1" sID="gen7016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3136"/>Et dederunt in escam meam fel, <l eID="gen7016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7017"/>et in siti mea potaverunt me aceto. <l eID="gen7017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3137"/><l level="1" sID="gen7018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3137"/>Fiat mensa eorum coram ipsis in laqueum, <l eID="gen7018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7019"/>et in retributiones, et in scandalum. <l eID="gen7019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3138"/><l level="1" sID="gen7020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3138"/>Obscurentur oculi eorum, ne videant, <l eID="gen7020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7021"/>et dorsum eorum semper incurva. <l eID="gen7021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3139"/><l level="1" sID="gen7022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3139"/>Effunde super eos iram tuam, <l eID="gen7022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7023"/>et furor iræ tuæ comprehendat eos. <l eID="gen7023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3140"/><l level="1" sID="gen7024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3140"/>Fiat habitatio eorum deserta, <l eID="gen7024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7025"/>et in tabernaculis eorum non sit qui inhabitet. <l eID="gen7025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3141"/><l level="1" sID="gen7026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3141"/>Quoniam quem tu percussisti persecuti sunt, <l eID="gen7026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7027"/>et super dolorem vulnerum meorum addiderunt. <l eID="gen7027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3142"/><l level="1" sID="gen7028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3142"/>Appone iniquitatem super iniquitatem eorum, <l eID="gen7028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7029"/>et non intrent in justitiam tuam. <l eID="gen7029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3143"/><l level="1" sID="gen7030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3143"/>Deleantur de libro viventium, <l eID="gen7030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7031"/>et cum justis non scribantur. <l eID="gen7031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3144"/><l level="1" sID="gen7032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3144"/>Ego sum pauper et dolens ; <l eID="gen7032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7033"/>salus tua, Deus, suscepit me. <l eID="gen7033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3145"/><l level="1" sID="gen7034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3145"/>Laudabo nomen Dei cum cantico, <l eID="gen7034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7035"/>et magnificabo eum in laude : <l eID="gen7035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3146"/><l level="1" sID="gen7036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3146"/>et placebit Deo super vitulum novellum, <l eID="gen7036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7037"/>cornua producentem et ungulas. <l eID="gen7037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3147"/><l level="1" sID="gen7038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3147"/>Videant pauperes, et lætentur ; <l eID="gen7038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7039"/>quærite Deum, et vivet anima vestra : <l eID="gen7039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3148"/><l level="1" sID="gen7040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3148"/>quoniam exaudivit pauperes Dominus, <l eID="gen7040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7041"/>et vinctos suos non despexit. <l eID="gen7041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3149"/><l level="1" sID="gen7042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3149"/>Laudent illum cæli et terra ; <l eID="gen7042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7043"/>mare, et omnia reptilia in eis. <l eID="gen7043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3150"/><l level="1" sID="gen7044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3150"/>Quoniam Deus salvam faciet Sion, <l eID="gen7044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7045"/>et ædificabuntur civitates Juda, <l eID="gen7045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7046"/>et inhabitabunt ibi, et hæreditate acquirent eam. <l eID="gen7046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 68:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3151"/><l level="1" sID="gen7047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3151"/>Et semen servorum ejus possidebit eam ; <l eID="gen7047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7048"/>et qui diligunt nomen ejus habitabunt in ea. <l eID="gen7048" level="1"/><lg eID="gen6968"/> <chapter eID="Ps.68"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David in rememorationem, quod salvum fecerit eum Dominus.  <div eID="gen7049" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3152"/><lg sID="gen7050"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3152"/>Deus, in adjutorium meum intende ; <l eID="gen7051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7052"/>Domine, ad adjuvandum me festina. <l eID="gen7052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3153"/><l level="1" sID="gen7053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3153"/>Confundantur, et revereantur, qui quærunt animam meam. <l eID="gen7053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3154"/><l level="1" sID="gen7054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3154"/>Avertantur retrorsum, et erubescant, qui volunt mihi mala ; <l eID="gen7054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7055"/>avertantur statim erubescentes qui dicunt mihi : Euge, euge ! <l eID="gen7055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3155"/><l level="1" sID="gen7056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3155"/>Exsultent et lætentur in te omnes qui quærunt te ; <l eID="gen7056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7057"/>et dicant semper : Magnificetur Dominus, qui diligunt salutare tuum. <l eID="gen7057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 69:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3156"/><l level="1" sID="gen7058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3156"/>Ego vero egenus et pauper sum ; <l eID="gen7058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7059"/>Deus, adjuva me. <l eID="gen7059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7060"/>Adjutor meus et liberator meus es tu ; <l eID="gen7060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7061"/>Domine, ne moreris. <l eID="gen7061" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7050"/> <chapter eID="Ps.69"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, filiorum Jonadab, et priorum captivorum. <div eID="gen7062" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7063"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7064"/>In te, Domine, speravi ; non confundar in æternum. <l eID="gen7064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3157"/><l level="1" sID="gen7065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3157"/>In justitia tua libera me, et eripe me : <l eID="gen7065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7066"/>inclina ad me aurem tuam, et salva me. <l eID="gen7066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3158"/><l level="1" sID="gen7067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3158"/>Esto mihi in Deum protectorem, <l eID="gen7067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7068"/>et in locum munitum, ut salvum me facias : <l eID="gen7068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7069"/>quoniam firmamentum meum et refugium meum es tu. <l eID="gen7069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3159"/><l level="1" sID="gen7070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3159"/>Deus meus, eripe me de manu peccatoris, <l eID="gen7070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7071"/>et de manu contra legem agentis, et iniqui : <l eID="gen7071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3160"/><l level="1" sID="gen7072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3160"/>quoniam tu es patientia mea, Domine ; <l eID="gen7072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7073"/>Domine, spes mea a juventute mea. <l eID="gen7073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3161"/><l level="1" sID="gen7074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3161"/>In te confirmatus sum ex utero ; <l eID="gen7074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7075"/>de ventre matris meæ tu es protector meus ; <l eID="gen7075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7076"/>in te cantatio mea semper. <l eID="gen7076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3162"/><l level="1" sID="gen7077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3162"/>Tamquam prodigium factus sum multis ; <l eID="gen7077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7078"/>et tu adjutor fortis. <l eID="gen7078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3163"/><l level="1" sID="gen7079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3163"/>Repleatur os meum laude, <l eID="gen7079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7080"/>ut cantem gloriam tuam, <l eID="gen7080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7081"/>tota die magnitudinem tuam. <l eID="gen7081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3164"/><l level="1" sID="gen7082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3164"/>Ne projicias me in tempore senectutis ; <l eID="gen7082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7083"/>cum defecerit virtus mea, ne derelinquas me. <l eID="gen7083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3165"/><l level="1" sID="gen7084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3165"/>Quia dixerunt inimici mei mihi, <l eID="gen7084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7085"/>et qui custodiebant animam meam consilium fecerunt in unum, <l eID="gen7085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3166"/><l level="1" sID="gen7086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3166"/>dicentes : Deus dereliquit eum : <l eID="gen7086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7087"/>persequimini et comprehendite eum, <l eID="gen7087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7088"/>quia non est qui eripiat. <l eID="gen7088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3167"/><l level="1" sID="gen7089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3167"/>Deus, ne elongeris a me ; <l eID="gen7089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7090"/>Deus meus, in auxilium meum respice. <l eID="gen7090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3168"/><l level="1" sID="gen7091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3168"/>Confundantur et deficiant detrahentes animæ meæ ; <l eID="gen7091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7092"/>operiantur confusione et pudore qui quærunt mala mihi. <l eID="gen7092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3169"/><l level="1" sID="gen7093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3169"/>Ego autem semper sperabo, <l eID="gen7093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7094"/>et adjiciam super omnem laudem tuam. <l eID="gen7094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3170"/><l level="1" sID="gen7095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3170"/>Os meum annuntiabit justitiam tuam, <l eID="gen7095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7096"/>tota die salutare tuum. <l eID="gen7096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7097"/>Quoniam non cognovi litteraturam, <l eID="gen7097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3171"/><l level="1" sID="gen7098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3171"/>introibo in potentias Domini ; <l eID="gen7098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7099"/>Domine, memorabor justitiæ tuæ solius. <l eID="gen7099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3172"/><l level="1" sID="gen7100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3172"/>Deus, docuisti me a juventute mea ; <l eID="gen7100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7101"/>et usque nunc pronuntiabo mirabilia tua. <l eID="gen7101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3173"/><l level="1" sID="gen7102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3173"/>Et usque in senectam et senium, <l eID="gen7102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7103"/>Deus, ne derelinquas me, <l eID="gen7103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7104"/>donec annuntiem brachium tuum generationi omni quæ ventura est, <l eID="gen7104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7105"/>potentiam tuam,

verses.name: Psalms 70:19
verses.text: et justitiam tuam, Deus, usque in altissima ; <l eID="gen7105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7106"/>quæ fecisti magnalia, Deus : quis similis tibi ? <l eID="gen7106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3174"/><l level="1" sID="gen7107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3174"/>Quantas ostendisti mihi tribulationes multas et malas ! <l eID="gen7107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7108"/>et conversus vivificasti me, <l eID="gen7108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7109"/>et de abyssis terræ iterum reduxisti me. <l eID="gen7109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3175"/><l level="1" sID="gen7110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3175"/>Multiplicasti magnificentiam tuam ; <l eID="gen7110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7111"/>et conversus consolatus es me. <l eID="gen7111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3176"/><l level="1" sID="gen7112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3176"/>Nam et ego confitebor tibi in vasis psalmi veritatem tuam, Deus ; <l eID="gen7112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7113"/>psallam tibi in cithara, sanctus Israël. <l eID="gen7113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3177"/><l level="1" sID="gen7114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3177"/>Exsultabunt labia mea cum cantavero tibi ; <l eID="gen7114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7115"/>et anima mea quam redemisti. <l eID="gen7115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 70:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3178"/><l level="1" sID="gen7116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3178"/>Sed et lingua mea tota die meditabitur justitiam tuam, <l eID="gen7116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7117"/>cum confusi et reveriti fuerint qui quærunt mala mihi. <l eID="gen7117" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7063"/> <chapter eID="Ps.70"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:1
verses.text: Psalmus, in Salomonem.  <div eID="gen7118" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3179"/><lg sID="gen7119"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3179"/>Deus, judicium tuum regi da, <l eID="gen7120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7121"/>et justitiam tuam filio regis ; <l eID="gen7121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7122"/>judicare populum tuum in justitia, <l eID="gen7122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7123"/>et pauperes tuos in judicio. <l eID="gen7123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3180"/><l level="1" sID="gen7124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3180"/>Suscipiant montes pacem populo, <l eID="gen7124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7125"/>et colles justitiam. <l eID="gen7125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3181"/><l level="1" sID="gen7126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3181"/>Judicabit pauperes populi, <l eID="gen7126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7127"/>et salvos faciet filios pauperum, <l eID="gen7127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7128"/>et humiliabit calumniatorem. <l eID="gen7128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3182"/><l level="1" sID="gen7129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3182"/>Et permanebit cum sole, et ante lunam, <l eID="gen7129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7130"/>in generatione et generationem. <l eID="gen7130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3183"/><l level="1" sID="gen7131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3183"/>Descendet sicut pluvia in vellus, <l eID="gen7131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7132"/>et sicut stillicidia stillantia super terram. <l eID="gen7132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3184"/><l level="1" sID="gen7133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3184"/>Orietur in diebus ejus justitia, et abundantia pacis, <l eID="gen7133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7134"/>donec auferatur luna. <l eID="gen7134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:8
