verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3185"/><l level="1" sID="gen7135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3185"/>Et dominabitur a mari usque ad mare, <l eID="gen7135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7136"/>et a flumine usque ad terminos orbis terrarum. <l eID="gen7136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3186"/><l level="1" sID="gen7137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3186"/>Coram illo procident Æthiopes, <l eID="gen7137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7138"/>et inimici ejus terram lingent. <l eID="gen7138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3187"/><l level="1" sID="gen7139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3187"/>Reges Tharsis et insulæ munera offerent ; <l eID="gen7139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7140"/>reges Arabum et Saba dona adducent : <l eID="gen7140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3188"/><l level="1" sID="gen7141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3188"/>et adorabunt eum omnes reges terræ ; <l eID="gen7141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7142"/>omnes gentes servient ei. <l eID="gen7142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3189"/><l level="1" sID="gen7143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3189"/>Quia liberabit pauperem a potente, <l eID="gen7143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7144"/>et pauperem cui non erat adjutor. <l eID="gen7144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3190"/><l level="1" sID="gen7145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3190"/>Parcet pauperi et inopi, <l eID="gen7145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7146"/>et animas pauperum salvas faciet. <l eID="gen7146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3191"/><l level="1" sID="gen7147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3191"/>Ex usuris et iniquitate redimet animas eorum, <l eID="gen7147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7148"/>et honorabile nomen eorum coram illo. <l eID="gen7148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3192"/><l level="1" sID="gen7149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3192"/>Et vivet, et dabitur ei de auro Arabiæ ; <l eID="gen7149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7150"/>et adorabunt de ipso semper, <l eID="gen7150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7151"/>tota die benedicent ei. <l eID="gen7151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3193"/><l level="1" sID="gen7152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3193"/>Et erit firmamentum in terra in summis montium ; <l eID="gen7152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7153"/>superextolletur super Libanum fructus ejus, <l eID="gen7153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7154"/>et florebunt de civitate sicut fœnum terræ. <l eID="gen7154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3194"/><l level="1" sID="gen7155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3194"/>Sit nomen ejus benedictum in sæcula ; <l eID="gen7155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7156"/>ante solem permanet nomen ejus. <l eID="gen7156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7157"/>Et benedicentur in ipso omnes tribus terræ ; <l eID="gen7157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7158"/>omnes gentes magnificabunt eum. <l eID="gen7158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3195"/><l level="1" sID="gen7159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3195"/>Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, <l eID="gen7159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7160"/>qui facit mirabilia solus. <l eID="gen7160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 71:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3196"/><l level="1" sID="gen7161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3196"/>Et benedictum nomen majestatis ejus in æternum, <l eID="gen7161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7162"/>et replebitur majestate ejus omnis terra. Fiat, fiat.

verses.name: Psalms 71:20
verses.text: Defecerunt laudes David, filii Jesse. <l eID="gen7162" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7119"/> <chapter eID="Ps.71"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:1
verses.text: Psalmus Asaph. <div eID="gen7163" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7164"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7165"/>Quam bonus Israël Deus, <l eID="gen7165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7166"/>his qui recto sunt corde ! <l eID="gen7166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3197"/><l level="1" sID="gen7167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3197"/>Mei autem pene moti sunt pedes, <l eID="gen7167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7168"/>pene effusi sunt gressus mei : <l eID="gen7168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3198"/><l level="1" sID="gen7169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3198"/>quia zelavi super iniquos, <l eID="gen7169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7170"/>pacem peccatorum videns. <l eID="gen7170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3199"/><l level="1" sID="gen7171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3199"/>Quia non est respectus morti eorum, <l eID="gen7171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7172"/>et firmamentum in plaga eorum. <l eID="gen7172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3200"/><l level="1" sID="gen7173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3200"/>In labore hominum non sunt, <l eID="gen7173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7174"/>et cum hominibus non flagellabuntur. <l eID="gen7174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3201"/><l level="1" sID="gen7175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3201"/>Ideo tenuit eos superbia ; <l eID="gen7175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7176"/>operti sunt iniquitate et impietate sua. <l eID="gen7176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3202"/><l level="1" sID="gen7177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3202"/>Prodiit quasi ex adipe iniquitas eorum ; <l eID="gen7177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7178"/>transierunt in affectum cordis. <l eID="gen7178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3203"/><l level="1" sID="gen7179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3203"/>Cogitaverunt et locuti sunt nequitiam ; <l eID="gen7179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7180"/>iniquitatem in excelso locuti sunt. <l eID="gen7180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3204"/><l level="1" sID="gen7181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3204"/>Posuerunt in cælum os suum, <l eID="gen7181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7182"/>et lingua eorum transivit in terra. <l eID="gen7182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3205"/><l level="1" sID="gen7183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3205"/>Ideo convertetur populus meus hic, <l eID="gen7183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7184"/>et dies pleni invenientur in eis. <l eID="gen7184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3206"/><l level="1" sID="gen7185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3206"/>Et dixerunt : Quomodo scit Deus, <l eID="gen7185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7186"/>et si est scientia in excelso ? <l eID="gen7186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3207"/><l level="1" sID="gen7187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3207"/>Ecce ipsi peccatores, et abundantes in sæculo <l eID="gen7187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7188"/>obtinuerunt divitias. <l eID="gen7188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3208"/><l level="1" sID="gen7189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3208"/>Et dixi : Ergo sine causa justificavi cor meum, <l eID="gen7189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7190"/>et lavi inter innocentes manus meas, <l eID="gen7190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3209"/><l level="1" sID="gen7191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3209"/>et fui flagellatus tota die, <l eID="gen7191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7192"/>et castigatio mea in matutinis. <l eID="gen7192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3210"/><l level="1" sID="gen7193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3210"/>Si dicebam : Narrabo sic ; <l eID="gen7193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7194"/>ecce nationem filiorum tuorum reprobavi. <l eID="gen7194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3211"/><l level="1" sID="gen7195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3211"/>Existimabam ut cognoscerem hoc ; <l eID="gen7195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7196"/>labor est ante me : <l eID="gen7196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3212"/><l level="1" sID="gen7197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3212"/>donec intrem in sanctuarium Dei, <l eID="gen7197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7198"/>et intelligam in novissimis eorum. <l eID="gen7198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3213"/><l level="1" sID="gen7199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3213"/>Verumtamen propter dolos posuisti eis ; <l eID="gen7199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7200"/>dejecisti eos dum allevarentur. <l eID="gen7200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3214"/><l level="1" sID="gen7201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3214"/>Quomodo facti sunt in desolationem ? <l eID="gen7201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7202"/>subito defecerunt : perierunt propter iniquitatem suam. <l eID="gen7202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3215"/><l level="1" sID="gen7203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3215"/>Velut somnium surgentium, Domine, <l eID="gen7203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7204"/>in civitate tua imaginem ipsorum ad nihilum rediges. <l eID="gen7204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3216"/><l level="1" sID="gen7205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3216"/>Quia inflammatum est cor meum, <l eID="gen7205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7206"/>et renes mei commutati sunt ; <l eID="gen7206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3217"/><l level="1" sID="gen7207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3217"/>et ego ad nihilum redactus sum, et nescivi : <l eID="gen7207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3218"/><l level="1" sID="gen7208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3218"/>ut jumentum factus sum apud te, <l eID="gen7208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7209"/>et ego semper tecum. <l eID="gen7209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3219"/><l level="1" sID="gen7210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3219"/>Tenuisti manum dexteram meam, <l eID="gen7210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7211"/>et in voluntate tua deduxisti me, <l eID="gen7211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7212"/>et cum gloria suscepisti me. <l eID="gen7212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3220"/><l level="1" sID="gen7213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3220"/>Quid enim mihi est in cælo ? <l eID="gen7213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7214"/>et a te quid volui super terram ? <l eID="gen7214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3221"/><l level="1" sID="gen7215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3221"/>Defecit caro mea et cor meum ; <l eID="gen7215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7216"/>Deus cordis mei, et pars mea, Deus in æternum. <l eID="gen7216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3222"/><l level="1" sID="gen7217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3222"/>Quia ecce qui elongant se a te peribunt ; <l eID="gen7217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7218"/>perdidisti omnes qui fornicantur abs te. <l eID="gen7218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 72:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3223"/><l level="1" sID="gen7219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3223"/>Mihi autem adhærere Deo bonum est ; <l eID="gen7219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7220"/>ponere in Domino Deo spem meam : <l eID="gen7220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7221"/>ut annuntiem omnes prædicationes tuas <l eID="gen7221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7222"/>in portis filiæ Sion. <l eID="gen7222" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7164"/> <chapter eID="Ps.72"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:1
verses.text: Intellectus Asaph. <div eID="gen7223" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7224"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7225"/>Ut quid, Deus, repulisti in finem, <l eID="gen7225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7226"/>iratus est furor tuus super oves pascuæ tuæ ? <l eID="gen7226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3224"/><l level="1" sID="gen7227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3224"/>Memor esto congregationis tuæ, <l eID="gen7227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7228"/>quam possedisti ab initio. <l eID="gen7228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7229"/>Redemisti virgam hæreditatis tuæ, <l eID="gen7229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7230"/>mons Sion, in quo habitasti in eo. <l eID="gen7230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3225"/><l level="1" sID="gen7231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3225"/>Leva manus tuas in superbias eorum in finem : <l eID="gen7231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7232"/>quanta malignatus est inimicus in sancto ! <l eID="gen7232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3226"/><l level="1" sID="gen7233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3226"/>Et gloriati sunt qui oderunt te in medio solemnitatis tuæ ; <l eID="gen7233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7234"/>posuerunt signa sua, signa : <l eID="gen7234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3227"/><l level="1" sID="gen7235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3227"/>et non cognoverunt sicut in exitu super summum. <l eID="gen7235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7236"/>Quasi in silva lignorum securibus <l eID="gen7236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3228"/><l level="1" sID="gen7237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3228"/>exciderunt januas ejus in idipsum ; <l eID="gen7237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7238"/>in securi et ascia dejecerunt eam. <l eID="gen7238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3229"/><l level="1" sID="gen7239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3229"/>Incenderunt igni sanctuarium tuum ; <l eID="gen7239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7240"/>in terra polluerunt tabernaculum nominis tui. <l eID="gen7240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3230"/><l level="1" sID="gen7241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3230"/>Dixerunt in corde suo cognatio eorum simul : <l eID="gen7241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7242"/>Quiescere faciamus omnes dies festos Dei a terra. <l eID="gen7242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3231"/><l level="1" sID="gen7243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3231"/>Signa nostra non vidimus ; <l eID="gen7243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7244"/>jam non est propheta ; <l eID="gen7244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7245"/>et nos non cognoscet amplius. <l eID="gen7245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3232"/><l level="1" sID="gen7246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3232"/>Usquequo, Deus, improperabit inimicus ? <l eID="gen7246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7247"/>irritat adversarius nomen tuum in finem ? <l eID="gen7247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3233"/><l level="1" sID="gen7248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3233"/>Ut quid avertis manum tuam, <l eID="gen7248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7249"/>et dexteram tuam de medio sinu tuo in finem ? <l eID="gen7249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3234"/><l level="1" sID="gen7250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3234"/>Deus autem rex noster ante sæcula : <l eID="gen7250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7251"/>operatus est salutem in medio terræ. <l eID="gen7251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3235"/><l level="1" sID="gen7252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3235"/>Tu confirmasti in virtute tua mare ; <l eID="gen7252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7253"/>contribulasti capita draconum in aquis. <l eID="gen7253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3236"/><l level="1" sID="gen7254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3236"/>Tu confregisti capita draconis ; <l eID="gen7254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7255"/>dedisti eum escam populis Æthiopum. <l eID="gen7255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3237"/><l level="1" sID="gen7256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3237"/>Tu dirupisti fontes et torrentes ; <l eID="gen7256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7257"/>tu siccasti fluvios Ethan. <l eID="gen7257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3238"/><l level="1" sID="gen7258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3238"/>Tuus est dies, et tua est nox ; <l eID="gen7258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7259"/>tu fabricatus es auroram et solem. <l eID="gen7259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3239"/><l level="1" sID="gen7260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3239"/>Tu fecisti omnes terminos terræ ; <l eID="gen7260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7261"/>æstatem et ver tu plasmasti ea. <l eID="gen7261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3240"/><l level="1" sID="gen7262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3240"/>Memor esto hujus : inimicus improperavit Domino, <l eID="gen7262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7263"/>et populus insipiens incitavit nomen tuum. <l eID="gen7263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3241"/><l level="1" sID="gen7264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3241"/>Ne tradas bestiis animas confitentes tibi, <l eID="gen7264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7265"/>et animas pauperum tuorum ne obliviscaris in finem. <l eID="gen7265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3242"/><l level="1" sID="gen7266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3242"/>Respice in testamentum tuum, <l eID="gen7266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7267"/>quia repleti sunt qui obscurati sunt terræ domibus iniquitatum. <l eID="gen7267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3243"/><l level="1" sID="gen7268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3243"/>Ne avertatur humilis factus confusus ; <l eID="gen7268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7269"/>pauper et inops laudabunt nomen tuum. <l eID="gen7269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3244"/><l level="1" sID="gen7270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3244"/>Exsurge, Deus, judica causam tuam ; <l eID="gen7270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7271"/>memor esto improperiorum tuorum, <l eID="gen7271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7272"/>eorum quæ ab insipiente sunt tota die. <l eID="gen7272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 73:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3245"/><l level="1" sID="gen7273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3245"/>Ne obliviscaris voces inimicorum tuorum : <l eID="gen7273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7274"/>superbia eorum qui te oderunt ascendit semper. <l eID="gen7274" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7224"/> <chapter eID="Ps.73"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:1
verses.text: In finem, ne corrumpas. Psalmus cantici Asaph.  <div eID="gen7275" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3246"/><lg sID="gen7276"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3246"/>Confitebimur tibi, Deus, confitebimur, <l eID="gen7277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7278"/>et invocabimus nomen tuum ; <l eID="gen7278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7279"/>narrabimus mirabilia tua. <l eID="gen7279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3247"/><l level="1" sID="gen7280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3247"/>Cum accepero tempus, <l eID="gen7280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7281"/>ego justitias judicabo. <l eID="gen7281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3248"/><l level="1" sID="gen7282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3248"/>Liquefacta est terra et omnes qui habitant in ea : <l eID="gen7282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7283"/>ego confirmavi columnas ejus. <l eID="gen7283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3249"/><l level="1" sID="gen7284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3249"/>Dixi iniquis : Nolite inique agere : <l eID="gen7284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7285"/>et delinquentibus : Nolite exaltare cornu : <l eID="gen7285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3250"/><l level="1" sID="gen7286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3250"/>nolite extollere in altum cornu vestrum ; <l eID="gen7286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7287"/>nolite loqui adversus Deum iniquitatem. <l eID="gen7287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3251"/><l level="1" sID="gen7288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3251"/>Quia neque ab oriente, neque ab occidente, <l eID="gen7288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7289"/>neque a desertis montibus : <l eID="gen7289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3252"/><l level="1" sID="gen7290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3252"/>quoniam Deus judex est. <l eID="gen7290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7291"/>Hunc humiliat, et hunc exaltat : <l eID="gen7291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3253"/><l level="1" sID="gen7292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3253"/>quia calix in manu Domini vini meri, plenus misto. <l eID="gen7292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7293"/>Et inclinavit ex hoc in hoc ; <l eID="gen7293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7294"/>verumtamen fæx ejus non est exinanita : <l eID="gen7294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7295"/>bibent omnes peccatores terræ. <l eID="gen7295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3254"/><l level="1" sID="gen7296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3254"/>Ego autem annuntiabo in sæculum ; <l eID="gen7296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7297"/>cantabo Deo Jacob : <l eID="gen7297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 74:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3255"/><l level="1" sID="gen7298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3255"/>et omnia cornua peccatorum confringam, <l eID="gen7298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7299"/>et exaltabuntur cornua justi. <l eID="gen7299" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7276"/> <chapter eID="Ps.74"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:1
verses.text: In finem, in laudibus. Psalmus Asaph, canticum ad Assyrios.  <div eID="gen7300" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3256"/><lg sID="gen7301"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3256"/>Notus in Judæa Deus ; <l eID="gen7302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7303"/>in Israël magnum nomen ejus. <l eID="gen7303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3257"/><l level="1" sID="gen7304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3257"/>Et factus est in pace locus ejus, <l eID="gen7304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7305"/>et habitatio ejus in Sion. <l eID="gen7305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3258"/><l level="1" sID="gen7306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3258"/>Ibi confregit potentias arcuum, <l eID="gen7306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7307"/>scutum, gladium, et bellum. <l eID="gen7307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3259"/><l level="1" sID="gen7308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3259"/>Illuminans tu mirabiliter a montibus æternis ; <l eID="gen7308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3260"/><l level="1" sID="gen7309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3260"/>turbati sunt omnes insipientes corde. <l eID="gen7309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7310"/>Dormierunt somnum suum, <l eID="gen7310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7311"/>et nihil invenerunt omnes viri divitiarum in manibus suis. <l eID="gen7311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3261"/><l level="1" sID="gen7312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3261"/>Ab increpatione tua, Deus Jacob, <l eID="gen7312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7313"/>dormitaverunt qui ascenderunt equos. <l eID="gen7313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3262"/><l level="1" sID="gen7314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3262"/>Tu terribilis es ; et quis resistet tibi ? <l eID="gen7314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7315"/>ex tunc ira tua. <l eID="gen7315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3263"/><l level="1" sID="gen7316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3263"/>De cælo auditum fecisti judicium : <l eID="gen7316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7317"/>terra tremuit et quievit

verses.name: Psalms 75:10
verses.text: cum exsurgeret in judicium Deus, <l eID="gen7317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7318"/>ut salvos faceret omnes mansuetos terræ. <l eID="gen7318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3264"/><l level="1" sID="gen7319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3264"/>Quoniam cogitatio hominis confitebitur tibi, <l eID="gen7319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7320"/>et reliquiæ cogitationis diem festum agent tibi. <l eID="gen7320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 75:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3265"/><l level="1" sID="gen7321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3265"/>Vovete et reddite Domino Deo vestro, <l eID="gen7321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7322"/>omnes qui in circuitu ejus affertis munera : <l eID="gen7322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7323"/>terribili,

verses.name: Psalms 75:13
verses.text: et ei qui aufert spiritum principum : <l eID="gen7323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7324"/>terribili apud reges terræ. <l eID="gen7324" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7301"/> <chapter eID="Ps.75"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:1
verses.text: In finem, pro Idithun. Psalmus Asaph.  <div eID="gen7325" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3266"/><lg sID="gen7326"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3266"/>Voce mea ad Dominum clamavi ; <l eID="gen7327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7328"/>voce mea ad Deum, et intendit mihi. <l eID="gen7328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3267"/><l level="1" sID="gen7329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3267"/>In die tribulationis meæ Deum exquisivi ; <l eID="gen7329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7330"/>manibus meis nocte contra eum, et non sum deceptus. <l eID="gen7330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7331"/>Renuit consolari anima mea ; <l eID="gen7331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3268"/><l level="1" sID="gen7332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3268"/>memor fui Dei, et delectatus sum, <l eID="gen7332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7333"/>et exercitatus sum, et defecit spiritus meus. <l eID="gen7333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3269"/><l level="1" sID="gen7334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3269"/>Anticipaverunt vigilias oculi mei ; <l eID="gen7334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7335"/>turbatus sum, et non sum locutus. <l eID="gen7335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3270"/><l level="1" sID="gen7336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3270"/>Cogitavi dies antiquos, <l eID="gen7336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7337"/>et annos æternos in mente habui. <l eID="gen7337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3271"/><l level="1" sID="gen7338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3271"/>Et meditatus sum nocte cum corde meo, <l eID="gen7338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7339"/>et exercitabar, et scopebam spiritum meum. <l eID="gen7339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3272"/><l level="1" sID="gen7340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3272"/>Numquid in æternum projiciet Deus ? <l eID="gen7340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7341"/>aut non apponet ut complacitior sit adhuc ? <l eID="gen7341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3273"/><l level="1" sID="gen7342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3273"/>aut in finem misericordiam suam abscindet, <l eID="gen7342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7343"/>a generatione in generationem ? <l eID="gen7343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3274"/><l level="1" sID="gen7344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3274"/>aut obliviscetur misereri Deus ? <l eID="gen7344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7345"/>aut continebit in ira sua misericordias suas ? <l eID="gen7345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3275"/><l level="1" sID="gen7346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3275"/>Et dixi : Nunc cœpi ; <l eID="gen7346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7347"/>hæc mutatio dexteræ Excelsi. <l eID="gen7347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3276"/><l level="1" sID="gen7348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3276"/>Memor fui operum Domini, <l eID="gen7348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7349"/>quia memor ero ab initio mirabilium tuorum : <l eID="gen7349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3277"/><l level="1" sID="gen7350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3277"/>et meditabor in omnibus operibus tuis, <l eID="gen7350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7351"/>et in adinventionibus tuis exercebor. <l eID="gen7351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3278"/><l level="1" sID="gen7352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3278"/>Deus, in sancto via tua : <l eID="gen7352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7353"/>quis deus magnus sicut Deus noster ? <l eID="gen7353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3279"/><l level="1" sID="gen7354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3279"/>Tu es Deus qui facis mirabilia : <l eID="gen7354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7355"/>notam fecisti in populis virtutem tuam. <l eID="gen7355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3280"/><l level="1" sID="gen7356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3280"/>Redemisti in brachio tuo populum tuum, <l eID="gen7356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7357"/>filios Jacob et Joseph. <l eID="gen7357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3281"/><l level="1" sID="gen7358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3281"/>Viderunt te aquæ, Deus ; <l eID="gen7358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7359"/>viderunt te aquæ, et timuerunt : <l eID="gen7359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7360"/>et turbatæ sunt abyssi. <l eID="gen7360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3282"/><l level="1" sID="gen7361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3282"/>Multitudo sonitus aquarum ; <l eID="gen7361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7362"/>vocem dederunt nubes. <l eID="gen7362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7363"/>Etenim sagittæ tuæ transeunt ; <l eID="gen7363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3283"/><l level="1" sID="gen7364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3283"/>vox tonitrui tui in rota. <l eID="gen7364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7365"/>Illuxerunt coruscationes tuæ orbi terræ ; <l eID="gen7365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7366"/>commota est, et contremuit terra. <l eID="gen7366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3284"/><l level="1" sID="gen7367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3284"/>In mari via tua, et semitæ tuæ in aquis multis, <l eID="gen7367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7368"/>et vestigia tua non cognoscentur. <l eID="gen7368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 76:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3285"/><l level="1" sID="gen7369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3285"/>Deduxisti sicut oves populum tuum, <l eID="gen7369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7370"/>in manu Moysi et Aaron. <l eID="gen7370" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7326"/> <chapter eID="Ps.76"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:1
verses.text: Intellectus Asaph. <div eID="gen7371" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7372"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7373"/>Attendite, popule meus, legem meam ; <l eID="gen7373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7374"/>inclinate aurem vestram in verba oris mei. <l eID="gen7374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3286"/><l level="1" sID="gen7375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3286"/>Aperiam in parabolis os meum ; <l eID="gen7375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7376"/>loquar propositiones ab initio. <l eID="gen7376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3287"/><l level="1" sID="gen7377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3287"/>Quanta audivimus, et cognovimus ea, <l eID="gen7377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7378"/>et patres nostri narraverunt nobis. <l eID="gen7378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3288"/><l level="1" sID="gen7379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3288"/>Non sunt occultata a filiis eorum in generatione altera, <l eID="gen7379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7380"/>narrantes laudes Domini et virtutes ejus, <l eID="gen7380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7381"/>et mirabilia ejus quæ fecit. <l eID="gen7381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3289"/><l level="1" sID="gen7382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3289"/>Et suscitavit testimonium in Jacob, <l eID="gen7382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7383"/>et legem posuit in Israël, <l eID="gen7383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7384"/>quanta mandavit patribus nostris <l eID="gen7384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7385"/>nota facere ea filiis suis : <l eID="gen7385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3290"/><l level="1" sID="gen7386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3290"/>ut cognoscat generatio altera : <l eID="gen7386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7387"/>filii qui nascentur et exsurgent, <l eID="gen7387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7388"/>et narrabunt filiis suis, <l eID="gen7388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3291"/><l level="1" sID="gen7389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3291"/>ut ponant in Deo spem suam, <l eID="gen7389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7390"/>et non obliviscantur operum Dei, <l eID="gen7390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7391"/>et mandata ejus exquirant : <l eID="gen7391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3292"/><l level="1" sID="gen7392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3292"/>ne fiant, sicut patres eorum, <l eID="gen7392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7393"/>generatio prava et exasperans ; <l eID="gen7393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7394"/>generatio quæ non direxit cor suum, <l eID="gen7394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7395"/>et non est creditus cum Deo spiritus ejus. <l eID="gen7395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3293"/><l level="1" sID="gen7396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3293"/>Filii Ephrem, intendentes et mittentes arcum, <l eID="gen7396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7397"/>conversi sunt in die belli. <l eID="gen7397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3294"/><l level="1" sID="gen7398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3294"/>Non custodierunt testamentum Dei, <l eID="gen7398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7399"/>et in lege ejus noluerunt ambulare. <l eID="gen7399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3295"/><l level="1" sID="gen7400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3295"/>Et obliti sunt benefactorum ejus, <l eID="gen7400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7401"/>et mirabilium ejus quæ ostendit eis. <l eID="gen7401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3296"/><l level="1" sID="gen7402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3296"/>Coram patribus eorum fecit mirabilia <l eID="gen7402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7403"/>in terra Ægypti, in campo Taneos. <l eID="gen7403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3297"/><l level="1" sID="gen7404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3297"/>Interrupit mare, et perduxit eos, <l eID="gen7404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7405"/>et statuit aquas quasi in utre : <l eID="gen7405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3298"/><l level="1" sID="gen7406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3298"/>et deduxit eos in nube diei, <l eID="gen7406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7407"/>et tota nocte in illuminatione ignis. <l eID="gen7407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3299"/><l level="1" sID="gen7408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3299"/>Interrupit petram in eremo, <l eID="gen7408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7409"/>et adaquavit eos velut in abysso multa. <l eID="gen7409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3300"/><l level="1" sID="gen7410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3300"/>Et eduxit aquam de petra, <l eID="gen7410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7411"/>et deduxit tamquam flumina aquas. <l eID="gen7411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3301"/><l level="1" sID="gen7412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3301"/>Et apposuerunt adhuc peccare ei ; <l eID="gen7412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7413"/>in iram excitaverunt Excelsum in inaquoso. <l eID="gen7413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3302"/><l level="1" sID="gen7414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3302"/>Et tentaverunt Deum in cordibus suis, <l eID="gen7414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7415"/>ut peterent escas animabus suis. <l eID="gen7415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3303"/><l level="1" sID="gen7416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3303"/>Et male locuti sunt de Deo ; <l eID="gen7416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7417"/>dixerunt : Numquid poterit Deus parare mensam in deserto ? <l eID="gen7417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3304"/><l level="1" sID="gen7418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3304"/>quoniam percussit petram, et fluxerunt aquæ, <l eID="gen7418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7419"/>et torrentes inundaverunt. <l eID="gen7419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7420"/>Numquid et panem poterit dare, <l eID="gen7420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7421"/>aut parare mensam populo suo ? <l eID="gen7421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3305"/><l level="1" sID="gen7422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3305"/>Ideo audivit Dominus et distulit ; <l eID="gen7422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7423"/>et ignis accensus est in Jacob, <l eID="gen7423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7424"/>et ira ascendit in Israël : <l eID="gen7424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3306"/><l level="1" sID="gen7425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3306"/>quia non crediderunt in Deo, <l eID="gen7425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7426"/>nec speraverunt in salutari ejus. <l eID="gen7426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3307"/><l level="1" sID="gen7427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3307"/>Et mandavit nubibus desuper, <l eID="gen7427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7428"/>et januas cæli aperuit. <l eID="gen7428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3308"/><l level="1" sID="gen7429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3308"/>Et pluit illis manna ad manducandum, <l eID="gen7429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7430"/>et panem cæli dedit eis. <l eID="gen7430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3309"/><l level="1" sID="gen7431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3309"/>Panem angelorum manducavit homo ; <l eID="gen7431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7432"/>cibaria misit eis in abundantia. <l eID="gen7432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3310"/><l level="1" sID="gen7433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3310"/>Transtulit austrum de cælo, <l eID="gen7433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7434"/>et induxit in virtute sua africum. <l eID="gen7434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3311"/><l level="1" sID="gen7435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3311"/>Et pluit super eos sicut pulverem carnes, <l eID="gen7435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7436"/>et sicut arenam maris volatilia pennata. <l eID="gen7436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3312"/><l level="1" sID="gen7437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3312"/>Et ceciderunt in medio castrorum eorum, <l eID="gen7437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7438"/>circa tabernacula eorum. <l eID="gen7438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3313"/><l level="1" sID="gen7439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3313"/>Et manducaverunt, et saturati sunt nimis, <l eID="gen7439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7440"/>et desiderium eorum attulit eis : <l eID="gen7440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3314"/><l level="1" sID="gen7441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3314"/>non sunt fraudati a desiderio suo. <l eID="gen7441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7442"/>Adhuc escæ eorum erant in ore ipsorum, <l eID="gen7442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3315"/><l level="1" sID="gen7443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3315"/>et ira Dei ascendit super eos : <l eID="gen7443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7444"/>et occidit pingues eorum, <l eID="gen7444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7445"/>et electos Israël impedivit. <l eID="gen7445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3316"/><l level="1" sID="gen7446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3316"/>In omnibus his peccaverunt adhuc, <l eID="gen7446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7447"/>et non crediderunt in mirabilibus ejus. <l eID="gen7447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3317"/><l level="1" sID="gen7448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3317"/>Et defecerunt in vanitate dies eorum, <l eID="gen7448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7449"/>et anni eorum cum festinatione. <l eID="gen7449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3318"/><l level="1" sID="gen7450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3318"/>Cum occideret eos, quærebant eum et revertebantur, <l eID="gen7450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7451"/>et diluculo veniebant ad eum. <l eID="gen7451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3319"/><l level="1" sID="gen7452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3319"/>Et rememorati sunt quia Deus adjutor est eorum, <l eID="gen7452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7453"/>et Deus excelsus redemptor eorum est. <l eID="gen7453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3320"/><l level="1" sID="gen7454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3320"/>Et dilexerunt eum in ore suo, <l eID="gen7454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7455"/>et lingua sua mentiti sunt ei ; <l eID="gen7455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3321"/><l level="1" sID="gen7456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3321"/>cor autem eorum non erat rectum cum eo, <l eID="gen7456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7457"/>nec fideles habiti sunt in testamento ejus. <l eID="gen7457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3322"/><l level="1" sID="gen7458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3322"/>Ipse autem est misericors, <l eID="gen7458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7459"/>et propitius fiet peccatis eorum, <l eID="gen7459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7460"/>et non disperdet eos. <l eID="gen7460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7461"/>Et abundavit ut averteret iram suam, <l eID="gen7461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7462"/>et non accendit omnem iram suam. <l eID="gen7462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3323"/><l level="1" sID="gen7463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3323"/>Et recordatus est quia caro sunt, <l eID="gen7463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7464"/>spiritus vadens et non rediens. <l eID="gen7464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3324"/><l level="1" sID="gen7465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3324"/>Quoties exacerbaverunt eum in deserto ; <l eID="gen7465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7466"/>in iram concitaverunt eum in inaquoso ? <l eID="gen7466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3325"/><l level="1" sID="gen7467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3325"/>Et conversi sunt, et tentaverunt Deum, <l eID="gen7467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7468"/>et sanctum Israël exacerbaverunt. <l eID="gen7468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3326"/><l level="1" sID="gen7469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3326"/>Non sunt recordati manus ejus, <l eID="gen7469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7470"/>die qua redemit eos de manu tribulantis : <l eID="gen7470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3327"/><l level="1" sID="gen7471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3327"/>sicut posuit in Ægypto signa sua, <l eID="gen7471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7472"/>et prodigia sua in campo Taneos ; <l eID="gen7472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3328"/><l level="1" sID="gen7473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3328"/>et convertit in sanguinem flumina eorum, <l eID="gen7473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7474"/>et imbres eorum, ne biberent. <l eID="gen7474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3329"/><l level="1" sID="gen7475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3329"/>Misit in eos cœnomyiam, et comedit eos, <l eID="gen7475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7476"/>et ranam, et disperdidit eos ; <l eID="gen7476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3330"/><l level="1" sID="gen7477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3330"/>et dedit ærugini fructus eorum, <l eID="gen7477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7478"/>et labores eorum locustæ ; <l eID="gen7478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3331"/><l level="1" sID="gen7479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3331"/>et occidit in grandine vineas eorum, <l eID="gen7479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7480"/>et moros eorum in pruina ; <l eID="gen7480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3332"/><l level="1" sID="gen7481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3332"/>et tradidit grandini jumenta eorum, <l eID="gen7481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7482"/>et possessionem eorum igni ; <l eID="gen7482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3333"/><l level="1" sID="gen7483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3333"/>misit in eos iram indignationis suæ, <l eID="gen7483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7484"/>indignationem, et iram, et tribulationem, <l eID="gen7484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7485"/>immissiones per angelos malos. <l eID="gen7485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3334"/><l level="1" sID="gen7486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3334"/>Viam fecit semitæ iræ suæ : <l eID="gen7486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7487"/>non pepercit a morte animabus eorum, <l eID="gen7487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7488"/>et jumenta eorum in morte conclusit : <l eID="gen7488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3335"/><l level="1" sID="gen7489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3335"/>et percussit omne primogenitum in terra Ægypti ; <l eID="gen7489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7490"/>primitias omnis laboris eorum in tabernaculis Cham : <l eID="gen7490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3336"/><l level="1" sID="gen7491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3336"/>et abstulit sicut oves populum suum, <l eID="gen7491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7492"/>et perduxit eos tamquam gregem in deserto : <l eID="gen7492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3337"/><l level="1" sID="gen7493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3337"/>et deduxit eos in spe, et non timuerunt, <l eID="gen7493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7494"/>et inimicos eorum operuit mare. <l eID="gen7494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3338"/><l level="1" sID="gen7495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3338"/>Et induxit eos in montem sanctificationis suæ, <l eID="gen7495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7496"/>montem quem acquisivit dextera ejus ; <l eID="gen7496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7497"/>et ejecit a facie eorum gentes, <l eID="gen7497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7498"/>et sorte divisit eis terram in funiculo distributionis ; <l eID="gen7498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3339"/><l level="1" sID="gen7499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3339"/>et habitare fecit in tabernaculis eorum tribus Israël. <l eID="gen7499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3340"/><l level="1" sID="gen7500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3340"/>Et tentaverunt, et exacerbaverunt Deum excelsum, <l eID="gen7500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7501"/>et testimonia ejus non custodierunt. <l eID="gen7501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3341"/><l level="1" sID="gen7502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3341"/>Et averterunt se, et non servaverunt pactum : <l eID="gen7502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7503"/>quemadmodum patres eorum, conversi sunt in arcum pravum. <l eID="gen7503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3342"/><l level="1" sID="gen7504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3342"/>In iram concitaverunt eum in collibus suis, <l eID="gen7504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7505"/>et in sculptilibus suis ad æmulationem eum provocaverunt. <l eID="gen7505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3343"/><l level="1" sID="gen7506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3343"/>Audivit Deus, et sprevit, <l eID="gen7506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7507"/>et ad nihilum redegit valde Israël. <l eID="gen7507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3344"/><l level="1" sID="gen7508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3344"/>Et repulit tabernaculum Silo, <l eID="gen7508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7509"/>tabernaculum suum, ubi habitavit in hominibus. <l eID="gen7509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3345"/><l level="1" sID="gen7510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3345"/>Et tradidit in captivitatem virtutem eorum, <l eID="gen7510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7511"/>et pulchritudinem eorum in manus inimici. <l eID="gen7511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3346"/><l level="1" sID="gen7512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3346"/>Et conclusit in gladio populum suum, <l eID="gen7512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7513"/>et hæreditatem suam sprevit. <l eID="gen7513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3347"/><l level="1" sID="gen7514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3347"/>Juvenes eorum comedit ignis, <l eID="gen7514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7515"/>et virgines eorum non sunt lamentatæ. <l eID="gen7515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:64
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3348"/><l level="1" sID="gen7516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3348"/>Sacerdotes eorum in gladio ceciderunt, <l eID="gen7516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7517"/>et viduæ eorum non plorabantur. <l eID="gen7517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3349"/><l level="1" sID="gen7518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3349"/>Et excitatus est tamquam dormiens Dominus, <l eID="gen7518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7519"/>tamquam potens crapulatus a vino. <l eID="gen7519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3350"/><l level="1" sID="gen7520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3350"/>Et percussit inimicos suos in posteriora ; <l eID="gen7520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7521"/>opprobrium sempiternum dedit illis. <l eID="gen7521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:67
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3351"/><l level="1" sID="gen7522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3351"/>Et repulit tabernaculum Joseph, <l eID="gen7522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7523"/>et tribum Ephraim non elegit : <l eID="gen7523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:68
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3352"/><l level="1" sID="gen7524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3352"/>sed elegit tribum Juda, <l eID="gen7524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7525"/>montem Sion, quem dilexit. <l eID="gen7525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:69
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3353"/><l level="1" sID="gen7526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3353"/>Et ædificavit sicut unicornium sanctificium suum, <l eID="gen7526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7527"/>in terra quam fundavit in sæcula. <l eID="gen7527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3354"/><l level="1" sID="gen7528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3354"/>Et elegit David, servum suum, <l eID="gen7528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7529"/>et sustulit eum de gregibus ovium ; <l eID="gen7529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7530"/>de post fœtantes accepit eum : <l eID="gen7530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:71
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3355"/><l level="1" sID="gen7531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3355"/>pascere Jacob servum suum, <l eID="gen7531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7532"/>et Israël hæreditatem suam. <l eID="gen7532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 77:72
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3356"/><l level="1" sID="gen7533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3356"/>Et pavit eos in innocentia cordis sui, <l eID="gen7533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7534"/>et in intellectibus manuum suarum deduxit eos. <l eID="gen7534" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7372"/> <chapter eID="Ps.77"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:1
verses.text: Psalmus Asaph. <div eID="gen7535" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7536"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7537"/>Deus, venerunt gentes in hæreditatem tuam ; <l eID="gen7537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7538"/>polluerunt templum sanctum tuum ; <l eID="gen7538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7539"/>posuerunt Jerusalem in pomorum custodiam. <l eID="gen7539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3357"/><l level="1" sID="gen7540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3357"/>Posuerunt morticina servorum tuorum escas volatilibus cæli ; <l eID="gen7540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7541"/>carnes sanctorum tuorum bestiis terræ. <l eID="gen7541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3358"/><l level="1" sID="gen7542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3358"/>Effuderunt sanguinem eorum tamquam aquam in circuitu Jerusalem, <l eID="gen7542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7543"/>et non erat qui sepeliret. <l eID="gen7543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3359"/><l level="1" sID="gen7544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3359"/>Facti sumus opprobrium vicinis nostris ; <l eID="gen7544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7545"/>subsannatio et illusio his qui in circuitu nostro sunt. <l eID="gen7545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3360"/><l level="1" sID="gen7546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3360"/>Usquequo, Domine, irasceris in finem ? <l eID="gen7546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7547"/>accendetur velut ignis zelus tuus ? <l eID="gen7547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3361"/><l level="1" sID="gen7548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3361"/>Effunde iram tuam in gentes quæ te non noverunt, <l eID="gen7548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7549"/>et in regna quæ nomen tuum non invocaverunt : <l eID="gen7549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3362"/><l level="1" sID="gen7550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3362"/>quia comederunt Jacob, <l eID="gen7550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7551"/>et locum ejus desolaverunt. <l eID="gen7551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3363"/><l level="1" sID="gen7552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3363"/>Ne memineris iniquitatum nostrarum antiquarum ; <l eID="gen7552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7553"/>cito anticipent nos misericordiæ tuæ, <l eID="gen7553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7554"/>quia pauperes facti sumus nimis. <l eID="gen7554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3364"/><l level="1" sID="gen7555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3364"/>Adjuva nos, Deus salutaris noster, <l eID="gen7555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7556"/>et propter gloriam nominis tui, Domine, libera nos : <l eID="gen7556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7557"/>et propitius esto peccatis nostris, propter nomen tuum. <l eID="gen7557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3365"/><l level="1" sID="gen7558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3365"/>Ne forte dicant in gentibus : Ubi est Deus eorum ? <l eID="gen7558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7559"/>et innotescat in nationibus coram oculis nostris <l eID="gen7559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7560"/>ultio sanguinis servorum tuorum qui effusus est. <l eID="gen7560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3366"/><l level="1" sID="gen7561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3366"/>Introëat in conspectu tuo gemitus compeditorum ; <l eID="gen7561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7562"/>secundum magnitudinem brachii tui posside filios mortificatorum : <l eID="gen7562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3367"/><l level="1" sID="gen7563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3367"/>et redde vicinis nostris septuplum in sinu eorum ; <l eID="gen7563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7564"/>improperium ipsorum quod exprobraverunt tibi, Domine. <l eID="gen7564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 78:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3368"/><l level="1" sID="gen7565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3368"/>Nos autem populus tuus, et oves pascuæ tuæ, <l eID="gen7565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7566"/>confitebimur tibi in sæculum ; <l eID="gen7566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7567"/>in generationem et generationem annuntiabimus laudem tuam. <l eID="gen7567" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7536"/> <chapter eID="Ps.78"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:1
verses.text: In finem, pro iis qui commutabuntur. Testimonium Asaph, psalmus.  <div eID="gen7568" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3369"/><lg sID="gen7569"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3369"/>Qui regis Israël, intende ; <l eID="gen7570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7571"/>qui deducis velut ovem Joseph. <l eID="gen7571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7572"/>Qui sedes super cherubim, manifestare <l eID="gen7572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3370"/><l level="1" sID="gen7573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3370"/>coram Ephraim, Benjamin, et Manasse. <l eID="gen7573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7574"/>Excita potentiam tuam, et veni, <l eID="gen7574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7575"/>ut salvos facias nos. <l eID="gen7575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3371"/><l level="1" sID="gen7576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3371"/>Deus, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, <l eID="gen7576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7577"/>et salvi erimus. <l eID="gen7577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3372"/><l level="1" sID="gen7578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3372"/>Domine Deus virtutum, <l eID="gen7578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7579"/>quousque irasceris super orationem servi tui ? <l eID="gen7579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3373"/><l level="1" sID="gen7580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3373"/>cibabis nos pane lacrimarum, <l eID="gen7580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7581"/>et potum dabis nobis in lacrimis in mensura ? <l eID="gen7581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3374"/><l level="1" sID="gen7582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3374"/>Posuisti nos in contradictionem vicinis nostris, <l eID="gen7582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7583"/>et inimici nostri subsannaverunt nos. <l eID="gen7583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3375"/><l level="1" sID="gen7584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3375"/>Deus virtutum, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, <l eID="gen7584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7585"/>et salvi erimus. <l eID="gen7585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3376"/><l level="1" sID="gen7586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3376"/>Vineam de Ægypto transtulisti : <l eID="gen7586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7587"/>ejecisti gentes, et plantasti eam. <l eID="gen7587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3377"/><l level="1" sID="gen7588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3377"/>Dux itineris fuisti in conspectu ejus ; <l eID="gen7588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7589"/>plantasti radices ejus, et implevit terram. <l eID="gen7589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3378"/><l level="1" sID="gen7590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3378"/>Operuit montes umbra ejus, <l eID="gen7590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7591"/>et arbusta ejus cedros Dei. <l eID="gen7591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3379"/><l level="1" sID="gen7592"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3379"/>Extendit palmites suos usque ad mare, <l eID="gen7592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7593"/>et usque ad flumen propagines ejus. <l eID="gen7593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3380"/><l level="1" sID="gen7594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3380"/>Ut quid destruxisti maceriam ejus, <l eID="gen7594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7595"/>et vindemiant eam omnes qui prætergrediuntur viam ? <l eID="gen7595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3381"/><l level="1" sID="gen7596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3381"/>Exterminavit eam aper de silva, <l eID="gen7596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7597"/>et singularis ferus depastus est eam. <l eID="gen7597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3382"/><l level="1" sID="gen7598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3382"/>Deus virtutum, convertere, <l eID="gen7598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7599"/>respice de cælo, et vide, <l eID="gen7599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7600"/>et visita vineam istam : <l eID="gen7600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3383"/><l level="1" sID="gen7601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3383"/>et perfice eam quam plantavit dextera tua, <l eID="gen7601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7602"/>et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi. <l eID="gen7602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3384"/><l level="1" sID="gen7603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3384"/>Incensa igni et suffossa, <l eID="gen7603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7604"/>ab increpatione vultus tui peribunt. <l eID="gen7604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3385"/><l level="1" sID="gen7605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3385"/>Fiat manus tua super virum dexteræ tuæ, <l eID="gen7605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7606"/>et super filium hominis quem confirmasti tibi. <l eID="gen7606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3386"/><l level="1" sID="gen7607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3386"/>Et non discedimus a te : <l eID="gen7607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7608"/>vivificabis nos, et nomen tuum invocabimus. <l eID="gen7608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 79:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3387"/><l level="1" sID="gen7609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3387"/>Domine Deus virtutum, converte nos, et ostende faciem tuam, <l eID="gen7609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7610"/>et salvi erimus. <l eID="gen7610" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7569"/> <chapter eID="Ps.79"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:1
verses.text: In finem, pro torcularibus. Psalmus ipsi Asaph.  <div eID="gen7611" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3388"/><lg sID="gen7612"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3388"/>Exsultate Deo adjutori nostro ; <l eID="gen7613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7614"/>jubilate Deo Jacob. <l eID="gen7614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3389"/><l level="1" sID="gen7615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3389"/>Sumite psalmum, et date tympanum ; <l eID="gen7615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7616"/>psalterium jucundum cum cithara. <l eID="gen7616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3390"/><l level="1" sID="gen7617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3390"/>Buccinate in neomenia tuba, <l eID="gen7617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7618"/>in insigni die solemnitatis vestræ : <l eID="gen7618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3391"/><l level="1" sID="gen7619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3391"/>quia præceptum in Israël est, <l eID="gen7619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7620"/>et judicium Deo Jacob. <l eID="gen7620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3392"/><l level="1" sID="gen7621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3392"/>Testimonium in Joseph posuit illud, <l eID="gen7621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7622"/>cum exiret de terra Ægypti ; <l eID="gen7622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7623"/>linguam quam non noverat, audivit. <l eID="gen7623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3393"/><l level="1" sID="gen7624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3393"/>Divertit ab oneribus dorsum ejus ; <l eID="gen7624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7625"/>manus ejus in cophino servierunt. <l eID="gen7625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3394"/><l level="1" sID="gen7626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3394"/>In tribulatione invocasti me, et liberavi te. <l eID="gen7626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7627"/>Exaudivi te in abscondito tempestatis ; <l eID="gen7627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7628"/>probavi te apud aquam contradictionis. <l eID="gen7628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3395"/><l level="1" sID="gen7629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3395"/>Audi, populus meus, et contestabor te. <l eID="gen7629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7630"/>Israël, si audieris me, <l eID="gen7630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:10
