verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3396"/><l level="1" sID="gen7631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3396"/>non erit in te deus recens, <l eID="gen7631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7632"/>neque adorabis deum alienum. <l eID="gen7632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3397"/><l level="1" sID="gen7633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3397"/>Ego enim sum Dominus Deus tuus, <l eID="gen7633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7634"/>qui eduxi te de terra Ægypti. <l eID="gen7634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7635"/>Dilata os tuum, et implebo illud. <l eID="gen7635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3398"/><l level="1" sID="gen7636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3398"/>Et non audivit populus meus vocem meam, <l eID="gen7636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7637"/>et Israël non intendit mihi. <l eID="gen7637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3399"/><l level="1" sID="gen7638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3399"/>Et dimisi eos secundum desideria cordis eorum ; <l eID="gen7638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7639"/>ibunt in adinventionibus suis. <l eID="gen7639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3400"/><l level="1" sID="gen7640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3400"/>Si populus meus audisset me, <l eID="gen7640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7641"/>Israël si in viis meis ambulasset, <l eID="gen7641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3401"/><l level="1" sID="gen7642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3401"/>pro nihilo forsitan inimicos eorum humiliassem, <l eID="gen7642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7643"/>et super tribulantes eos misissem manum meam. <l eID="gen7643" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3402"/><l level="1" sID="gen7644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3402"/>Inimici Domini mentiti sunt ei, <l eID="gen7644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7645"/>et erit tempus eorum in sæcula. <l eID="gen7645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 80:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3403"/><l level="1" sID="gen7646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3403"/>Et cibavit eos ex adipe frumenti, <l eID="gen7646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7647"/>et de petra melle saturavit eos. <l eID="gen7647" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7612"/> <chapter eID="Ps.80"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:1
verses.text: Psalmus Asaph. <div eID="gen7648" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7649"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7650"/>Deus stetit in synagoga deorum ; <l eID="gen7650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7651"/>in medio autem deos dijudicat. <l eID="gen7651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3404"/><l level="1" sID="gen7652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3404"/>Usquequo judicatis iniquitatem, <l eID="gen7652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7653"/>et facies peccatorum sumitis ? <l eID="gen7653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3405"/><l level="1" sID="gen7654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3405"/>Judicate egeno et pupillo ; <l eID="gen7654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7655"/>humilem et pauperem justificate. <l eID="gen7655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3406"/><l level="1" sID="gen7656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3406"/>Eripite pauperem, <l eID="gen7656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7657"/>et egenum de manu peccatoris liberate. <l eID="gen7657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3407"/><l level="1" sID="gen7658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3407"/>Nescierunt, neque intellexerunt ; <l eID="gen7658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7659"/>in tenebris ambulant : <l eID="gen7659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7660"/>movebuntur omnia fundamenta terræ. <l eID="gen7660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3408"/><l level="1" sID="gen7661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3408"/>Ego dixi : Dii estis, <l eID="gen7661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7662"/>et filii Excelsi omnes. <l eID="gen7662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3409"/><l level="1" sID="gen7663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3409"/>Vos autem sicut homines moriemini, <l eID="gen7663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7664"/>et sicut unus de principibus cadetis. <l eID="gen7664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 81:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3410"/><l level="1" sID="gen7665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3410"/>Surge, Deus, judica terram, <l eID="gen7665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7666"/>quoniam tu hæreditabis in omnibus gentibus. <l eID="gen7666" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7649"/> <chapter eID="Ps.81"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:1
verses.text: Canticum Psalmi Asaph.  <div eID="gen7667" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3411"/><lg sID="gen7668"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3411"/>Deus, quis similis erit tibi ? <l eID="gen7669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7670"/>ne taceas, neque compescaris, Deus : <l eID="gen7670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3412"/><l level="1" sID="gen7671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3412"/>quoniam ecce inimici tui sonuerunt, <l eID="gen7671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7672"/>et qui oderunt te extulerunt caput. <l eID="gen7672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3413"/><l level="1" sID="gen7673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3413"/>Super populum tuum malignaverunt consilium, <l eID="gen7673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7674"/>et cogitaverunt adversus sanctos tuos. <l eID="gen7674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3414"/><l level="1" sID="gen7675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3414"/>Dixerunt : Venite, et disperdamus eos de gente, <l eID="gen7675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7676"/>et non memoretur nomen Israël ultra. <l eID="gen7676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3415"/><l level="1" sID="gen7677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3415"/>Quoniam cogitaverunt unanimiter ; <l eID="gen7677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7678"/>simul adversum te testamentum disposuerunt : <l eID="gen7678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3416"/><l level="1" sID="gen7679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3416"/>tabernacula Idumæorum et Ismahelitæ, <l eID="gen7679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7680"/>Moab et Agareni, <l eID="gen7680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3417"/><l level="1" sID="gen7681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3417"/>Gebal, et Ammon, et Amalec ; <l eID="gen7681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7682"/>alienigenæ cum habitantibus Tyrum. <l eID="gen7682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3418"/><l level="1" sID="gen7683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3418"/>Etenim Assur venit cum illis : <l eID="gen7683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7684"/>facti sunt in adjutorium filiis Lot. <l eID="gen7684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3419"/><l level="1" sID="gen7685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3419"/>Fac illis sicut Madian et Sisaræ, <l eID="gen7685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7686"/>sicut Jabin in torrente Cisson. <l eID="gen7686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3420"/><l level="1" sID="gen7687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3420"/>Disperierunt in Endor ; <l eID="gen7687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7688"/>facti sunt ut stercus terræ. <l eID="gen7688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3421"/><l level="1" sID="gen7689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3421"/>Pone principes eorum sicut Oreb, <l eID="gen7689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7690"/>et Zeb, et Zebee, et Salmana : <l eID="gen7690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7691"/>omnes principes eorum, <l eID="gen7691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3422"/><l level="1" sID="gen7692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3422"/>qui dixerunt : Hæreditate possideamus sanctuarium Dei. <l eID="gen7692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3423"/><l level="1" sID="gen7693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3423"/>Deus meus, pone illos ut rotam, <l eID="gen7693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7694"/>et sicut stipulam ante faciem venti. <l eID="gen7694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3424"/><l level="1" sID="gen7695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3424"/>Sicut ignis qui comburit silvam, <l eID="gen7695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7696"/>et sicut flamma comburens montes, <l eID="gen7696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3425"/><l level="1" sID="gen7697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3425"/>ita persequeris illos in tempestate tua, <l eID="gen7697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7698"/>et in ira tua turbabis eos. <l eID="gen7698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3426"/><l level="1" sID="gen7699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3426"/>Imple facies eorum ignominia, <l eID="gen7699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7700"/>et quærent nomen tuum, Domine. <l eID="gen7700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3427"/><l level="1" sID="gen7701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3427"/>Erubescant, et conturbentur in sæculum sæculi, <l eID="gen7701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7702"/>et confundantur, et pereant. <l eID="gen7702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 82:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3428"/><l level="1" sID="gen7703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3428"/>Et cognoscant quia nomen tibi Dominus : <l eID="gen7703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7704"/>tu solus Altissimus in omni terra. <l eID="gen7704" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7668"/> <chapter eID="Ps.82"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:1
verses.text: In finem, pro torcularibus filiis Core. Psalmus.  <div eID="gen7705" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3429"/><lg sID="gen7706"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3429"/>Quam dilecta tabernacula tua, Domine virtutum ! <l eID="gen7707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3430"/><l level="1" sID="gen7708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3430"/>Concupiscit, et deficit anima mea in atria Domini ; <l eID="gen7708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7709"/>cor meum et caro mea exsultaverunt in Deum vivum. <l eID="gen7709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3431"/><l level="1" sID="gen7710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3431"/>Etenim passer invenit sibi domum, <l eID="gen7710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7711"/>et turtur nidum sibi, ubi ponat pullos suos : <l eID="gen7711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7712"/>altaria tua, Domine virtutum, <l eID="gen7712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7713"/>rex meus, et Deus meus. <l eID="gen7713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3432"/><l level="1" sID="gen7714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3432"/>Beati qui habitant in domo tua, Domine ; <l eID="gen7714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7715"/>in sæcula sæculorum laudabunt te. <l eID="gen7715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3433"/><l level="1" sID="gen7716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3433"/>Beatus vir cujus est auxilium abs te : <l eID="gen7716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7717"/>ascensiones in corde suo disposuit, <l eID="gen7717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3434"/><l level="1" sID="gen7718"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3434"/>in valle lacrimarum, in loco quem posuit. <l eID="gen7718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3435"/><l level="1" sID="gen7719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3435"/>Etenim benedictionem dabit legislator ; <l eID="gen7719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7720"/>ibunt de virtute in virtutem : <l eID="gen7720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7721"/>videbitur Deus deorum in Sion. <l eID="gen7721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3436"/><l level="1" sID="gen7722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3436"/>Domine Deus virtutum, exaudi orationem meam ; <l eID="gen7722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7723"/>auribus percipe, Deus Jacob. <l eID="gen7723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3437"/><l level="1" sID="gen7724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3437"/>Protector noster, aspice, Deus, <l eID="gen7724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7725"/>et respice in faciem christi tui. <l eID="gen7725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3438"/><l level="1" sID="gen7726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3438"/>Quia melior est dies una in atriis tuis super millia ; <l eID="gen7726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7727"/>elegi abjectus esse in domo Dei mei <l eID="gen7727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7728"/>magis quam habitare in tabernaculis peccatorum. <l eID="gen7728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3439"/><l level="1" sID="gen7729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3439"/>Quia misericordiam et veritatem diligit Deus : <l eID="gen7729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7730"/>gratiam et gloriam dabit Dominus. <l eID="gen7730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 83:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3440"/><l level="1" sID="gen7731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3440"/>Non privabit bonis eos qui ambulant in innocentia : <l eID="gen7731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7732"/>Domine virtutum, beatus homo qui sperat in te. <l eID="gen7732" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7706"/> <chapter eID="Ps.83"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:1
verses.text: In finem, filiis Core. Psalmus.  <div eID="gen7733" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3441"/><lg sID="gen7734"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3441"/>Benedixisti, Domine, terram tuam ; <l eID="gen7735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7736"/>avertisti captivitatem Jacob. <l eID="gen7736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3442"/><l level="1" sID="gen7737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3442"/>Remisisti iniquitatem plebis tuæ ; <l eID="gen7737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7738"/>operuisti omnia peccata eorum. <l eID="gen7738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3443"/><l level="1" sID="gen7739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3443"/>Mitigasti omnem iram tuam ; <l eID="gen7739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7740"/>avertisti ab ira indignationis tuæ. <l eID="gen7740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3444"/><l level="1" sID="gen7741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3444"/>Converte nos, Deus salutaris noster, <l eID="gen7741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7742"/>et averte iram tuam a nobis. <l eID="gen7742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3445"/><l level="1" sID="gen7743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3445"/>Numquid in æternum irasceris nobis ? <l eID="gen7743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7744"/>aut extendes iram tuam a generatione in generationem ? <l eID="gen7744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3446"/><l level="1" sID="gen7745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3446"/>Deus, tu conversus vivificabis nos, <l eID="gen7745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7746"/>et plebs tua lætabitur in te. <l eID="gen7746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3447"/><l level="1" sID="gen7747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3447"/>Ostende nobis, Domine, misericordiam tuam, <l eID="gen7747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7748"/>et salutare tuum da nobis. <l eID="gen7748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3448"/><l level="1" sID="gen7749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3448"/>Audiam quid loquatur in me Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen7749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7750"/>quoniam loquetur pacem in plebem suam, <l eID="gen7750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7751"/>et super sanctos suos, <l eID="gen7751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7752"/>et in eos qui convertuntur ad cor. <l eID="gen7752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3449"/><l level="1" sID="gen7753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3449"/>Verumtamen prope timentes eum salutare ipsius, <l eID="gen7753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7754"/>ut inhabitet gloria in terra nostra. <l eID="gen7754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3450"/><l level="1" sID="gen7755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3450"/>Misericordia et veritas obviaverunt sibi ; <l eID="gen7755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7756"/>justitia et pax osculatæ sunt. <l eID="gen7756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3451"/><l level="1" sID="gen7757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3451"/>Veritas de terra orta est, <l eID="gen7757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7758"/>et justitia de cælo prospexit. <l eID="gen7758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3452"/><l level="1" sID="gen7759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3452"/>Etenim Dominus dabit benignitatem, <l eID="gen7759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7760"/>et terra nostra dabit fructum suum. <l eID="gen7760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 84:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3453"/><l level="1" sID="gen7761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3453"/>Justitia ante eum ambulabit, <l eID="gen7761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7762"/>et ponet in via gressus suos. <l eID="gen7762" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7734"/> <chapter eID="Ps.84"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:1
verses.text: Oratio ipsi David. <div eID="gen7763" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7764"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7765"/>Inclina, Domine, aurem tuam et exaudi me, <l eID="gen7765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7766"/>quoniam inops et pauper sum ego. <l eID="gen7766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3454"/><l level="1" sID="gen7767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3454"/>Custodi animam meam, quoniam sanctus sum ; <l eID="gen7767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7768"/>salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperantem in te. <l eID="gen7768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3455"/><l level="1" sID="gen7769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3455"/>Miserere mei, Domine, <l eID="gen7769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7770"/>quoniam ad te clamavi tota die ; <l eID="gen7770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3456"/><l level="1" sID="gen7771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3456"/>lætifica animam servi tui, <l eID="gen7771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7772"/>quoniam ad te, Domine, animam meam levavi. <l eID="gen7772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3457"/><l level="1" sID="gen7773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3457"/>Quoniam tu, Domine, suavis et mitis, <l eID="gen7773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7774"/>et multæ misericordiæ omnibus invocantibus te. <l eID="gen7774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3458"/><l level="1" sID="gen7775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3458"/>Auribus percipe, Domine, orationem meam, <l eID="gen7775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7776"/>et intende voci deprecationis meæ. <l eID="gen7776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3459"/><l level="1" sID="gen7777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3459"/>In die tribulationis meæ clamavi ad te, <l eID="gen7777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7778"/>quia exaudisti me. <l eID="gen7778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3460"/><l level="1" sID="gen7779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3460"/>Non est similis tui in diis, Domine, <l eID="gen7779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7780"/>et non est secundum opera tua. <l eID="gen7780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3461"/><l level="1" sID="gen7781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3461"/>Omnes gentes quascumque fecisti venient, <l eID="gen7781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7782"/>et adorabunt coram te, Domine, <l eID="gen7782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7783"/>et glorificabunt nomen tuum. <l eID="gen7783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3462"/><l level="1" sID="gen7784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3462"/>Quoniam magnus es tu, et faciens mirabilia ; <l eID="gen7784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7785"/>tu es Deus solus. <l eID="gen7785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3463"/><l level="1" sID="gen7786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3463"/>Deduc me, Domine, in via tua, et ingrediar in veritate tua ; <l eID="gen7786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7787"/>lætetur cor meum, ut timeat nomen tuum. <l eID="gen7787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3464"/><l level="1" sID="gen7788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3464"/>Confitebor tibi, Domine Deus meus, in toto corde meo, <l eID="gen7788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7789"/>et glorificabo nomen tuum in æternum : <l eID="gen7789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3465"/><l level="1" sID="gen7790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3465"/>quia misericordia tua magna est super me, <l eID="gen7790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7791"/>et eruisti animam meam ex inferno inferiori. <l eID="gen7791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3466"/><l level="1" sID="gen7792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3466"/>Deus, iniqui insurrexerunt super me, <l eID="gen7792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7793"/>et synagoga potentium quæsierunt animam meam : <l eID="gen7793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7794"/>et non proposuerunt te in conspectu suo. <l eID="gen7794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3467"/><l level="1" sID="gen7795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3467"/>Et tu, Domine Deus, miserator et misericors ; <l eID="gen7795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7796"/>patiens, et multæ misericordiæ, et verax. <l eID="gen7796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3468"/><l level="1" sID="gen7797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3468"/>Respice in me, et miserere mei ; <l eID="gen7797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7798"/>da imperium tuum puero tuo, <l eID="gen7798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7799"/>et salvum fac filium ancillæ tuæ. <l eID="gen7799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 85:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3469"/><l level="1" sID="gen7800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3469"/>Fac mecum signum in bonum, <l eID="gen7800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7801"/>ut videant qui oderunt me, et confundantur : <l eID="gen7801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7802"/>quoniam tu, Domine, adjuvisti me, et consolatus es me. <l eID="gen7802" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7764"/> <chapter eID="Ps.85"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:1
verses.text: Filiis Core. Psalmus cantici. <div eID="gen7803" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7804"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7805"/>Fundamenta ejus in montibus sanctis ; <l eID="gen7805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3470"/><l level="1" sID="gen7806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3470"/>diligit Dominus portas Sion super omnia tabernacula Jacob. <l eID="gen7806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3471"/><l level="1" sID="gen7807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3471"/>Gloriosa dicta sunt de te, civitas Dei ! <l eID="gen7807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3472"/><l level="1" sID="gen7808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3472"/>Memor ero Rahab et Babylonis, scientium me ; <l eID="gen7808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7809"/>ecce alienigenæ, et Tyrus, et populus Æthiopum, <l eID="gen7809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7810"/>hi fuerunt illic. <l eID="gen7810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3473"/><l level="1" sID="gen7811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3473"/>Numquid Sion dicet : Homo et homo natus est in ea, <l eID="gen7811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7812"/>et ipse fundavit eam Altissimus ? <l eID="gen7812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3474"/><l level="1" sID="gen7813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3474"/>Dominus narrabit in scripturis populorum et principum, <l eID="gen7813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7814"/>horum qui fuerunt in ea. <l eID="gen7814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 86:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3475"/><l level="1" sID="gen7815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3475"/>Sicut lætantium omnium <l eID="gen7815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7816"/>habitatio est in te. <l eID="gen7816" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7804"/> <chapter eID="Ps.86"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:1
verses.text: Canticum Psalmi, filiis Core, in finem, pro Maheleth ad respondendum. Intellectus Eman Ezrahitæ.  <div eID="gen7817" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3476"/><lg sID="gen7818"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3476"/>Domine, Deus salutis meæ, <l eID="gen7819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7820"/>in die clamavi et nocte coram te. <l eID="gen7820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3477"/><l level="1" sID="gen7821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3477"/>Intret in conspectu tuo oratio mea, <l eID="gen7821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7822"/>inclina aurem tuam ad precem meam. <l eID="gen7822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3478"/><l level="1" sID="gen7823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3478"/>Quia repleta est malis anima mea, <l eID="gen7823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7824"/>et vita mea inferno appropinquavit. <l eID="gen7824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3479"/><l level="1" sID="gen7825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3479"/>Æstimatus sum cum descendentibus in lacum, <l eID="gen7825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7826"/>factus sum sicut homo sine adjutorio, <l eID="gen7826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3480"/><l level="1" sID="gen7827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3480"/>inter mortuos liber ; <l eID="gen7827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7828"/>sicut vulnerati dormientes in sepulchris, <l eID="gen7828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7829"/>quorum non es memor amplius, <l eID="gen7829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7830"/>et ipsi de manu tua repulsi sunt. <l eID="gen7830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3481"/><l level="1" sID="gen7831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3481"/>Posuerunt me in lacu inferiori, <l eID="gen7831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7832"/>in tenebrosis, et in umbra mortis. <l eID="gen7832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3482"/><l level="1" sID="gen7833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3482"/>Super me confirmatus est furor tuus, <l eID="gen7833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7834"/>et omnes fluctus tuos induxisti super me. <l eID="gen7834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3483"/><l level="1" sID="gen7835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3483"/>Longe fecisti notos meos a me ; <l eID="gen7835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7836"/>posuerunt me abominationem sibi. <l eID="gen7836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7837"/>Traditus sum, et non egrediebar ; <l eID="gen7837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3484"/><l level="1" sID="gen7838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3484"/>oculi mei languerunt præ inopia. <l eID="gen7838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7839"/>Clamavi ad te, Domine, tota die ; <l eID="gen7839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7840"/>expandi ad te manus meas. <l eID="gen7840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3485"/><l level="1" sID="gen7841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3485"/>Numquid mortuis facies mirabilia ? <l eID="gen7841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7842"/>aut medici suscitabunt, et confitebuntur tibi ? <l eID="gen7842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3486"/><l level="1" sID="gen7843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3486"/>Numquid narrabit aliquis in sepulchro misericordiam tuam, <l eID="gen7843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7844"/>et veritatem tuam in perditione ? <l eID="gen7844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3487"/><l level="1" sID="gen7845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3487"/>Numquid cognoscentur in tenebris mirabilia tua ? <l eID="gen7845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7846"/>et justitia tua in terra oblivionis ? <l eID="gen7846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3488"/><l level="1" sID="gen7847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3488"/>Et ego ad te, Domine, clamavi, <l eID="gen7847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7848"/>et mane oratio mea præveniet te. <l eID="gen7848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3489"/><l level="1" sID="gen7849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3489"/>Ut quid, Domine, repellis orationem meam ; <l eID="gen7849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7850"/>avertis faciem tuam a me ? <l eID="gen7850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3490"/><l level="1" sID="gen7851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3490"/>Pauper sum ego, et in laboribus a juventute mea ; <l eID="gen7851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7852"/>exaltatus autem, humiliatus sum et conturbatus. <l eID="gen7852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3491"/><l level="1" sID="gen7853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3491"/>In me transierunt iræ tuæ, <l eID="gen7853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7854"/>et terrores tui conturbaverunt me : <l eID="gen7854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3492"/><l level="1" sID="gen7855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3492"/>circumdederunt me sicut aqua tota die ; <l eID="gen7855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7856"/>circumdederunt me simul. <l eID="gen7856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 87:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3493"/><l level="1" sID="gen7857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3493"/>Elongasti a me amicum et proximum, <l eID="gen7857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7858"/>et notos meos a miseria. <l eID="gen7858" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7818"/> <chapter eID="Ps.87"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:1
verses.text: Intellectus Ethan Ezrahitæ.  <div eID="gen7859" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3494"/><lg sID="gen7860"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3494"/>Misericordias Domini in æternum cantabo ; <l eID="gen7861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7862"/>in generationem et generationem annuntiabo veritatem tuam in ore meo. <l eID="gen7862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3495"/><l level="1" sID="gen7863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3495"/>Quoniam dixisti : In æternum misericordia ædificabitur in cælis ; <l eID="gen7863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7864"/>præparabitur veritas tua in eis. <l eID="gen7864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3496"/><l level="1" sID="gen7865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3496"/>Disposui testamentum electis meis ; <l eID="gen7865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7866"/>juravi David servo meo : <l eID="gen7866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3497"/><l level="1" sID="gen7867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3497"/>Usque in æternum præparabo semen tuum, <l eID="gen7867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7868"/>et ædificabo in generationem et generationem sedem tuam. <l eID="gen7868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3498"/><l level="1" sID="gen7869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3498"/>Confitebuntur cæli mirabilia tua, Domine ; <l eID="gen7869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7870"/>etenim veritatem tuam in ecclesia sanctorum. <l eID="gen7870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3499"/><l level="1" sID="gen7871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3499"/>Quoniam quis in nubibus æquabitur Domino ; <l eID="gen7871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7872"/>similis erit Deo in filiis Dei ? <l eID="gen7872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3500"/><l level="1" sID="gen7873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3500"/>Deus, qui glorificatur in consilio sanctorum, <l eID="gen7873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7874"/>magnus et terribilis super omnes qui in circuitu ejus sunt. <l eID="gen7874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3501"/><l level="1" sID="gen7875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3501"/>Domine Deus virtutum, quis similis tibi ? <l eID="gen7875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7876"/>potens es, Domine, et veritas tua in circuitu tuo. <l eID="gen7876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3502"/><l level="1" sID="gen7877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3502"/>Tu dominaris potestati maris ; <l eID="gen7877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7878"/>motum autem fluctuum ejus tu mitigas. <l eID="gen7878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3503"/><l level="1" sID="gen7879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3503"/>Tu humiliasti, sicut vulneratum, superbum ; <l eID="gen7879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7880"/>in brachio virtutis tuæ dispersisti inimicos tuos. <l eID="gen7880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3504"/><l level="1" sID="gen7881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3504"/>Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra : <l eID="gen7881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7882"/>orbem terræ, et plenitudinem ejus tu fundasti ; <l eID="gen7882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3505"/><l level="1" sID="gen7883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3505"/>aquilonem et mare tu creasti. <l eID="gen7883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7884"/>Thabor et Hermon in nomine tuo exsultabunt : <l eID="gen7884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3506"/><l level="1" sID="gen7885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3506"/>tuum brachium cum potentia. <l eID="gen7885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7886"/>Firmetur manus tua, et exaltetur dextera tua : <l eID="gen7886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3507"/><l level="1" sID="gen7887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3507"/>justitia et judicium præparatio sedis tuæ : <l eID="gen7887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7888"/>misericordia et veritas præcedent faciem tuam. <l eID="gen7888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3508"/><l level="1" sID="gen7889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3508"/>Beatus populus qui scit jubilationem : <l eID="gen7889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7890"/>Domine, in lumine vultus tui ambulabunt, <l eID="gen7890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3509"/><l level="1" sID="gen7891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3509"/>et in nomine tuo exsultabunt tota die, <l eID="gen7891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7892"/>et in justitia tua exaltabuntur. <l eID="gen7892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3510"/><l level="1" sID="gen7893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3510"/>Quoniam gloria virtutis eorum tu es, <l eID="gen7893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7894"/>et in beneplacito tuo exaltabitur cornu nostrum. <l eID="gen7894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3511"/><l level="1" sID="gen7895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3511"/>Quia Domini est assumptio nostra, <l eID="gen7895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7896"/>et sancti Israël regis nostri. <l eID="gen7896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3512"/><l level="1" sID="gen7897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3512"/>Tunc locutus es in visione sanctis tuis, <l eID="gen7897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7898"/>et dixisti : Posui adjutorium in potente, <l eID="gen7898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7899"/>et exaltavi electum de plebe mea. <l eID="gen7899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3513"/><l level="1" sID="gen7900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3513"/>Inveni David, servum meum ; <l eID="gen7900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7901"/>oleo sancto meo unxi eum. <l eID="gen7901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3514"/><l level="1" sID="gen7902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3514"/>Manus enim mea auxiliabitur ei, <l eID="gen7902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7903"/>et brachium meum confortabit eum. <l eID="gen7903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3515"/><l level="1" sID="gen7904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3515"/>Nihil proficiet inimicus in eo, <l eID="gen7904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7905"/>et filius iniquitatis non apponet nocere ei. <l eID="gen7905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3516"/><l level="1" sID="gen7906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3516"/>Et concidam a facie ipsius inimicos ejus, <l eID="gen7906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7907"/>et odientes eum in fugam convertam. <l eID="gen7907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3517"/><l level="1" sID="gen7908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3517"/>Et veritas mea et misericordia mea cum ipso, <l eID="gen7908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7909"/>et in nomine meo exaltabitur cornu ejus. <l eID="gen7909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3518"/><l level="1" sID="gen7910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3518"/>Et ponam in mari manum ejus, <l eID="gen7910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7911"/>et in fluminibus dexteram ejus. <l eID="gen7911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3519"/><l level="1" sID="gen7912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3519"/>Ipse invocabit me : Pater meus es tu, <l eID="gen7912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7913"/>Deus meus, et susceptor salutis meæ. <l eID="gen7913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3520"/><l level="1" sID="gen7914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3520"/>Et ego primogenitum ponam illum, <l eID="gen7914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7915"/>excelsum præ regibus terræ. <l eID="gen7915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3521"/><l level="1" sID="gen7916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3521"/>In æternum servabo illi misericordiam meam, <l eID="gen7916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7917"/>et testamentum meum fidele ipsi. <l eID="gen7917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3522"/><l level="1" sID="gen7918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3522"/>Et ponam in sæculum sæculi semen ejus, <l eID="gen7918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7919"/>et thronum ejus sicut dies cæli. <l eID="gen7919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3523"/><l level="1" sID="gen7920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3523"/>Si autem dereliquerint filii ejus legem meam, <l eID="gen7920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7921"/>et in judiciis meis non ambulaverint ; <l eID="gen7921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3524"/><l level="1" sID="gen7922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3524"/>si justitias meas profanaverint, <l eID="gen7922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7923"/>et mandata mea non custodierint : <l eID="gen7923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3525"/><l level="1" sID="gen7924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3525"/>visitabo in virga iniquitates eorum, <l eID="gen7924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7925"/>et in verberibus peccata eorum ; <l eID="gen7925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3526"/><l level="1" sID="gen7926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3526"/>misericordiam autem meam non dispergam ab eo, <l eID="gen7926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7927"/>neque nocebo in veritate mea, <l eID="gen7927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3527"/><l level="1" sID="gen7928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3527"/>neque profanabo testamentum meum : <l eID="gen7928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7929"/>et quæ procedunt de labiis meis non faciam irrita. <l eID="gen7929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3528"/><l level="1" sID="gen7930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3528"/>Semel juravi in sancto meo, si David mentiar : <l eID="gen7930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3529"/><l level="1" sID="gen7931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3529"/>semen ejus in æternum manebit. <l eID="gen7931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7932"/>Et thronus ejus sicut sol in conspectu meo, <l eID="gen7932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3530"/><l level="1" sID="gen7933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3530"/>et sicut luna perfecta in æternum, <l eID="gen7933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7934"/>et testis in cælo fidelis. <l eID="gen7934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3531"/><l level="1" sID="gen7935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3531"/>Tu vero repulisti et despexisti ; <l eID="gen7935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7936"/>distulisti christum tuum. <l eID="gen7936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3532"/><l level="1" sID="gen7937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3532"/>Evertisti testamentum servi tui ; <l eID="gen7937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7938"/>profanasti in terra sanctuarium ejus. <l eID="gen7938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3533"/><l level="1" sID="gen7939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3533"/>Destruxisti omnes sepes ejus ; <l eID="gen7939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7940"/>posuisti firmamentum ejus formidinem. <l eID="gen7940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3534"/><l level="1" sID="gen7941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3534"/>Diripuerunt eum omnes transeuntes viam ; <l eID="gen7941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7942"/>factus est opprobrium vicinis suis. <l eID="gen7942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3535"/><l level="1" sID="gen7943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3535"/>Exaltasti dexteram deprimentium eum ; <l eID="gen7943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7944"/>lætificasti omnes inimicos ejus. <l eID="gen7944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3536"/><l level="1" sID="gen7945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3536"/>Avertisti adjutorium gladii ejus, <l eID="gen7945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7946"/>et non es auxiliatus ei in bello. <l eID="gen7946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3537"/><l level="1" sID="gen7947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3537"/>Destruxisti eum ab emundatione, <l eID="gen7947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7948"/>et sedem ejus in terram collisisti. <l eID="gen7948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3538"/><l level="1" sID="gen7949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3538"/>Minorasti dies temporis ejus ; <l eID="gen7949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7950"/>perfudisti eum confusione. <l eID="gen7950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3539"/><l level="1" sID="gen7951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3539"/>Usquequo, Domine, avertis in finem ? <l eID="gen7951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7952"/>exardescet sicut ignis ira tua ? <l eID="gen7952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3540"/><l level="1" sID="gen7953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3540"/>Memorare quæ mea substantia : <l eID="gen7953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7954"/>numquid enim vane constituisti omnes filios hominum ? <l eID="gen7954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3541"/><l level="1" sID="gen7955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3541"/>Quis est homo qui vivet et non videbit mortem ? <l eID="gen7955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7956"/>eruet animam suam de manu inferi ? <l eID="gen7956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3542"/><l level="1" sID="gen7957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3542"/>Ubi sunt misericordiæ tuæ antiquæ, Domine, <l eID="gen7957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7958"/>sicut jurasti David in veritate tua ? <l eID="gen7958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3543"/><l level="1" sID="gen7959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3543"/>Memor esto, Domine, opprobrii servorum tuorum, <l eID="gen7959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7960"/>quod continui in sinu meo, multarum gentium : <l eID="gen7960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3544"/><l level="1" sID="gen7961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3544"/>quod exprobraverunt inimici tui, Domine ; <l eID="gen7961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7962"/>quod exprobraverunt commutationem christi tui. <l eID="gen7962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 88:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3545"/><l level="1" sID="gen7963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3545"/>Benedictus Dominus in æternum. Fiat, fiat. <l eID="gen7963" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7860"/> <chapter eID="Ps.88"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:1
verses.text: Oratio Moysi, hominis Dei. <div eID="gen7964" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen7965"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7966"/>Domine, refugium factus es nobis <l eID="gen7966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7967"/>a generatione in generationem. <l eID="gen7967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3546"/><l level="1" sID="gen7968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3546"/>Priusquam montes fierent, <l eID="gen7968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7969"/>aut formaretur terra et orbis, <l eID="gen7969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7970"/>a sæculo et usque in sæculum tu es, Deus. <l eID="gen7970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3547"/><l level="1" sID="gen7971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3547"/>Ne avertas hominem in humilitatem : <l eID="gen7971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7972"/>et dixisti : Convertimini, filii hominum. <l eID="gen7972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3548"/><l level="1" sID="gen7973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3548"/>Quoniam mille anni ante oculos tuos <l eID="gen7973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7974"/>tamquam dies hesterna quæ præteriit : <l eID="gen7974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7975"/>et custodia in nocte

verses.name: Psalms 89:5
verses.text: quæ pro nihilo habentur, <l eID="gen7975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7976"/>eorum anni erunt. <l eID="gen7976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3549"/><l level="1" sID="gen7977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3549"/>Mane sicut herba transeat ; <l eID="gen7977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7978"/>mane floreat, et transeat ; <l eID="gen7978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7979"/>vespere decidat, induret, et arescat. <l eID="gen7979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3550"/><l level="1" sID="gen7980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3550"/>Quia defecimus in ira tua, <l eID="gen7980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7981"/>et in furore tuo turbati sumus. <l eID="gen7981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3551"/><l level="1" sID="gen7982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3551"/>Posuisti iniquitates nostras in conspectu tuo ; <l eID="gen7982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7983"/>sæculum nostrum in illuminatione vultus tui. <l eID="gen7983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3552"/><l level="1" sID="gen7984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3552"/>Quoniam omnes dies nostri defecerunt, <l eID="gen7984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7985"/>et in ira tua defecimus. <l eID="gen7985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7986"/>Anni nostri sicut aranea meditabuntur ; <l eID="gen7986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3553"/><l level="1" sID="gen7987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3553"/>dies annorum nostrorum in ipsis septuaginta anni. <l eID="gen7987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7988"/>Si autem in potentatibus octoginta anni, <l eID="gen7988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7989"/>et amplius eorum labor et dolor ; <l eID="gen7989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7990"/>quoniam supervenit mansuetudo, et corripiemur. <l eID="gen7990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3554"/><l level="1" sID="gen7991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3554"/>Quis novit potestatem iræ tuæ, <l eID="gen7991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7992"/>et præ timore tuo iram tuam

verses.name: Psalms 89:12
verses.text: dinumerare ? <l eID="gen7992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7993"/>Dexteram tuam sic notam fac, <l eID="gen7993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7994"/>et eruditos corde in sapientia. <l eID="gen7994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3555"/><l level="1" sID="gen7995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3555"/>Convertere, Domine ; usquequo ? <l eID="gen7995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7996"/>et deprecabilis esto super servos tuos. <l eID="gen7996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3556"/><l level="1" sID="gen7997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3556"/>Repleti sumus mane misericordia tua ; <l eID="gen7997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen7998"/>et exsultavimus, et delectati sumus omnibus diebus nostris. <l eID="gen7998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3557"/><l level="1" sID="gen7999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3557"/>Lætati sumus pro diebus quibus nos humiliasti ; <l eID="gen7999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8000"/>annis quibus vidimus mala. <l eID="gen8000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3558"/><l level="1" sID="gen8001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3558"/>Respice in servos tuos et in opera tua, <l eID="gen8001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8002"/>et dirige filios eorum. <l eID="gen8002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 89:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3559"/><l level="1" sID="gen8003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3559"/>Et sit splendor Domini Dei nostri super nos, <l eID="gen8003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8004"/>et opera manuum nostrarum dirige super nos, <l eID="gen8004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8005"/>et opus manuum nostrarum dirige. <l eID="gen8005" level="1"/><lg eID="gen7965"/> <chapter eID="Ps.89"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:1
verses.text: Laus cantici David. <div eID="gen8006" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8007"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8008"/>Qui habitat in adjutorio Altissimi, <l eID="gen8008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8009"/>in protectione Dei cæli commorabitur. <l eID="gen8009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3560"/><l level="1" sID="gen8010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3560"/>Dicet Domino : Susceptor meus es tu, et refugium meum ; <l eID="gen8010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8011"/>Deus meus, sperabo in eum. <l eID="gen8011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3561"/><l level="1" sID="gen8012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3561"/>Quoniam ipse liberavit me de laqueo venantium, <l eID="gen8012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8013"/>et a verbo aspero. <l eID="gen8013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3562"/><l level="1" sID="gen8014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3562"/>Scapulis suis obumbrabit tibi, <l eID="gen8014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8015"/>et sub pennis ejus sperabis. <l eID="gen8015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3563"/><l level="1" sID="gen8016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3563"/>Scuto circumdabit te veritas ejus : <l eID="gen8016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8017"/>non timebis a timore nocturno ; <l eID="gen8017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3564"/><l level="1" sID="gen8018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3564"/>a sagitta volante in die, <l eID="gen8018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8019"/>a negotio perambulante in tenebris, <l eID="gen8019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8020"/>ab incursu, et dæmonio meridiano. <l eID="gen8020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3565"/><l level="1" sID="gen8021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3565"/>Cadent a latere tuo mille, et decem millia a dextris tuis ; <l eID="gen8021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8022"/>ad te autem non appropinquabit. <l eID="gen8022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3566"/><l level="1" sID="gen8023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3566"/>Verumtamen oculis tuis considerabis, <l eID="gen8023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8024"/>et retributionem peccatorum videbis. <l eID="gen8024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3567"/><l level="1" sID="gen8025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3567"/>Quoniam tu es, Domine, spes mea ; <l eID="gen8025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8026"/>Altissimum posuisti refugium tuum. <l eID="gen8026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3568"/><l level="1" sID="gen8027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3568"/>Non accedet ad te malum, <l eID="gen8027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8028"/>et flagellum non appropinquabit tabernaculo tuo. <l eID="gen8028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3569"/><l level="1" sID="gen8029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3569"/>Quoniam angelis suis mandavit de te, <l eID="gen8029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8030"/>ut custodiant te in omnibus viis tuis. <l eID="gen8030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3570"/><l level="1" sID="gen8031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3570"/>In manibus portabunt te, <l eID="gen8031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8032"/>ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum. <l eID="gen8032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3571"/><l level="1" sID="gen8033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3571"/>Super aspidem et basiliscum ambulabis, <l eID="gen8033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8034"/>et conculcabis leonem et draconem. <l eID="gen8034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3572"/><l level="1" sID="gen8035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3572"/>Quoniam in me speravit, liberabo eum ; <l eID="gen8035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8036"/>protegam eum, quoniam cognovit nomen meum. <l eID="gen8036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3573"/><l level="1" sID="gen8037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3573"/>Clamabit ad me, et ego exaudiam eum ; <l eID="gen8037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8038"/>cum ipso sum in tribulatione : <l eID="gen8038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8039"/>eripiam eum, et glorificabo eum. <l eID="gen8039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 90:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3574"/><l level="1" sID="gen8040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3574"/>Longitudine dierum replebo eum, <l eID="gen8040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8041"/>et ostendam illi salutare meum. <l eID="gen8041" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8007"/> <chapter eID="Ps.90"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:1
verses.text: Psalmus cantici, in die sabbati.  <div eID="gen8042" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3575"/><lg sID="gen8043"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3575"/>Bonum est confiteri Domino, <l eID="gen8044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8045"/>et psallere nomini tuo, Altissime : <l eID="gen8045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3576"/><l level="1" sID="gen8046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3576"/>ad annuntiandum mane misericordiam tuam, <l eID="gen8046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8047"/>et veritatem tuam per noctem, <l eID="gen8047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3577"/><l level="1" sID="gen8048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3577"/>in decachordo, psalterio ; <l eID="gen8048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8049"/>cum cantico, in cithara. <l eID="gen8049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3578"/><l level="1" sID="gen8050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3578"/>Quia delectasti me, Domine, in factura tua ; <l eID="gen8050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8051"/>et in operibus manuum tuarum exsultabo. <l eID="gen8051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3579"/><l level="1" sID="gen8052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3579"/>Quam magnificata sunt opera tua, Domine ! <l eID="gen8052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8053"/>nimis profundæ factæ sunt cogitationes tuæ. <l eID="gen8053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3580"/><l level="1" sID="gen8054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3580"/>Vir insipiens non cognoscet, <l eID="gen8054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8055"/>et stultus non intelliget hæc. <l eID="gen8055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3581"/><l level="1" sID="gen8056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3581"/>Cum exorti fuerint peccatores sicut fœnum, <l eID="gen8056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8057"/>et apparuerint omnes qui operantur iniquitatem, <l eID="gen8057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8058"/>ut intereant in sæculum sæculi : <l eID="gen8058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3582"/><l level="1" sID="gen8059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3582"/>tu autem Altissimus in æternum, Domine. <l eID="gen8059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3583"/><l level="1" sID="gen8060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3583"/>Quoniam ecce inimici tui, Domine, <l eID="gen8060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8061"/>quoniam ecce inimici tui peribunt ; <l eID="gen8061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8062"/>et dispergentur omnes qui operantur iniquitatem. <l eID="gen8062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3584"/><l level="1" sID="gen8063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3584"/>Et exaltabitur sicut unicornis cornu meum, <l eID="gen8063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8064"/>et senectus mea in misericordia uberi. <l eID="gen8064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3585"/><l level="1" sID="gen8065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3585"/>Et despexit oculus meus inimicos meos, <l eID="gen8065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8066"/>et in insurgentibus in me malignantibus audiet auris mea. <l eID="gen8066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3586"/><l level="1" sID="gen8067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3586"/>Justus ut palma florebit ; <l eID="gen8067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8068"/>sicut cedrus Libani multiplicabitur. <l eID="gen8068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3587"/><l level="1" sID="gen8069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3587"/>Plantati in domo Domini, <l eID="gen8069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8070"/>in atriis domus Dei nostri florebunt. <l eID="gen8070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3588"/><l level="1" sID="gen8071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3588"/>Adhuc multiplicabuntur in senecta uberi, <l eID="gen8071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8072"/>et bene patientes erunt : <l eID="gen8072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 91:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3589"/><l level="1" sID="gen8073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3589"/>ut annuntient quoniam rectus Dominus Deus noster, <l eID="gen8073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8074"/>et non est iniquitas in eo. <l eID="gen8074" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8043"/> <chapter eID="Ps.91"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:1
verses.text: Laus cantici ipsi David, in die ante sabbatum, quando fundata est terra. <div eID="gen8075" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8076"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8077"/>Dominus regnavit, decorem indutus est : <l eID="gen8077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8078"/>indutus est Dominus fortitudinem, et præcinxit se. <l eID="gen8078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8079"/>Etenim firmavit orbem terræ, qui non commovebitur. <l eID="gen8079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3590"/><l level="1" sID="gen8080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3590"/>Parata sedes tua ex tunc ; <l eID="gen8080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8081"/>a sæculo tu es. <l eID="gen8081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3591"/><l level="1" sID="gen8082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3591"/>Elevaverunt flumina, Domine, <l eID="gen8082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8083"/>elevaverunt flumina vocem suam ; <l eID="gen8083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8084"/>elevaverunt flumina fluctus suos, <l eID="gen8084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3592"/><l level="1" sID="gen8085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3592"/>a vocibus aquarum multarum. <l eID="gen8085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8086"/>Mirabiles elationes maris ; <l eID="gen8086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8087"/>mirabilis in altis Dominus. <l eID="gen8087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 92:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3593"/><l level="1" sID="gen8088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3593"/>Testimonia tua credibilia facta sunt nimis ; <l eID="gen8088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8089"/>domum tuam decet sanctitudo, Domine, <l eID="gen8089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8090"/>in longitudinem dierum. <l eID="gen8090" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8076"/> <chapter eID="Ps.92"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:1
verses.text: Psalmus ipsi David, quarta sabbati. <div eID="gen8091" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8092"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8093"/>Deus ultionum Dominus ; <l eID="gen8093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8094"/>Deus ultionum libere egit. <l eID="gen8094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3594"/><l level="1" sID="gen8095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3594"/>Exaltare, qui judicas terram ; <l eID="gen8095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8096"/>redde retributionem superbis. <l eID="gen8096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3595"/><l level="1" sID="gen8097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3595"/>Usquequo peccatores, Domine, <l eID="gen8097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8098"/>usquequo peccatores gloriabuntur ; <l eID="gen8098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3596"/><l level="1" sID="gen8099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3596"/>effabuntur et loquentur iniquitatem ; <l eID="gen8099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8100"/>loquentur omnes qui operantur injustitiam ? <l eID="gen8100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3597"/><l level="1" sID="gen8101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3597"/>Populum tuum, Domine, humiliaverunt, <l eID="gen8101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8102"/>et hæreditatem tuam vexaverunt. <l eID="gen8102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3598"/><l level="1" sID="gen8103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3598"/>Viduam et advenam interfecerunt, <l eID="gen8103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8104"/>et pupillos occiderunt. <l eID="gen8104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3599"/><l level="1" sID="gen8105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3599"/>Et dixerunt : Non videbit Dominus, <l eID="gen8105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8106"/>nec intelliget Deus Jacob. <l eID="gen8106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3600"/><l level="1" sID="gen8107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3600"/>Intelligite, insipientes in populo ; <l eID="gen8107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8108"/>et stulti, aliquando sapite. <l eID="gen8108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3601"/><l level="1" sID="gen8109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3601"/>Qui plantavit aurem non audiet ? <l eID="gen8109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8110"/>aut qui finxit oculum non considerat ? <l eID="gen8110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3602"/><l level="1" sID="gen8111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3602"/>Qui corripit gentes non arguet, <l eID="gen8111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8112"/>qui docet hominem scientiam ? <l eID="gen8112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3603"/><l level="1" sID="gen8113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3603"/>Dominus scit cogitationes hominum, <l eID="gen8113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8114"/>quoniam vanæ sunt. <l eID="gen8114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3604"/><l level="1" sID="gen8115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3604"/>Beatus homo quem tu erudieris, Domine, <l eID="gen8115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8116"/>et de lege tua docueris eum : <l eID="gen8116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3605"/><l level="1" sID="gen8117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3605"/>ut mitiges ei a diebus malis, <l eID="gen8117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8118"/>donec fodiatur peccatori fovea. <l eID="gen8118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3606"/><l level="1" sID="gen8119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3606"/>Quia non repellet Dominus plebem suam, <l eID="gen8119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8120"/>et hæreditatem suam non derelinquet, <l eID="gen8120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3607"/><l level="1" sID="gen8121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3607"/>quoadusque justitia convertatur in judicium : <l eID="gen8121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8122"/>et qui juxta illam, omnes qui recto sunt corde. <l eID="gen8122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3608"/><l level="1" sID="gen8123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3608"/>Quis consurget mihi adversus malignantes ? <l eID="gen8123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8124"/>aut quis stabit mecum adversus operantes iniquitatem ? <l eID="gen8124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:17
