verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3609"/><l level="1" sID="gen8125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3609"/>Nisi quia Dominus adjuvit me, <l eID="gen8125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8126"/>paulominus habitasset in inferno anima mea. <l eID="gen8126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3610"/><l level="1" sID="gen8127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3610"/>Si dicebam : Motus est pes meus : <l eID="gen8127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8128"/>misericordia tua, Domine, adjuvabat me. <l eID="gen8128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3611"/><l level="1" sID="gen8129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3611"/>Secundum multitudinem dolorum meorum in corde meo, <l eID="gen8129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8130"/>consolationes tuæ lætificaverunt animam meam. <l eID="gen8130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3612"/><l level="1" sID="gen8131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3612"/>Numquid adhæret tibi sedes iniquitatis, <l eID="gen8131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8132"/>qui fingis laborem in præcepto ? <l eID="gen8132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3613"/><l level="1" sID="gen8133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3613"/>Captabunt in animam justi, <l eID="gen8133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8134"/>et sanguinem innocentem condemnabunt. <l eID="gen8134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3614"/><l level="1" sID="gen8135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3614"/>Et factus est mihi Dominus in refugium, <l eID="gen8135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8136"/>et Deus meus in adjutorium spei meæ. <l eID="gen8136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 93:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3615"/><l level="1" sID="gen8137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3615"/>Et reddet illis iniquitatem ipsorum, <l eID="gen8137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8138"/>et in malitia eorum disperdet eos : <l eID="gen8138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8139"/>disperdet illos Dominus Deus noster. <l eID="gen8139" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8092"/> <chapter eID="Ps.93"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:1
verses.text: Laus cantici ipsi David. <div eID="gen8140" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8141"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8142"/>Venite, exsultemus Domino ; <l eID="gen8142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8143"/>jubilemus Deo salutari nostro ; <l eID="gen8143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3616"/><l level="1" sID="gen8144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3616"/>præoccupemus faciem ejus in confessione, <l eID="gen8144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8145"/>et in psalmis jubilemus ei : <l eID="gen8145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3617"/><l level="1" sID="gen8146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3617"/>quoniam Deus magnus Dominus, <l eID="gen8146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8147"/>et rex magnus super omnes deos. <l eID="gen8147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3618"/><l level="1" sID="gen8148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3618"/>Quia in manu ejus sunt omnes fines terræ, <l eID="gen8148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8149"/>et altitudines montium ipsius sunt ; <l eID="gen8149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3619"/><l level="1" sID="gen8150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3619"/>quoniam ipsius est mare, et ipse fecit illud, <l eID="gen8150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8151"/>et siccam manus ejus formaverunt. <l eID="gen8151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3620"/><l level="1" sID="gen8152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3620"/>Venite, adoremus, et procidamus, <l eID="gen8152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8153"/>et ploremus ante Dominum qui fecit nos : <l eID="gen8153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3621"/><l level="1" sID="gen8154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3621"/>quia ipse est Dominus Deus noster, <l eID="gen8154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8155"/>et nos populus pascuæ ejus, et oves manus ejus. <l eID="gen8155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3622"/><l level="1" sID="gen8156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3622"/>Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis, <l eID="gen8156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8157"/>nolite obdurare corda vestra

verses.name: Psalms 94:9
verses.text: sicut in irritatione, <l eID="gen8157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8158"/>secundum diem tentationis in deserto, <l eID="gen8158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8159"/>ubi tentaverunt me patres vestri : <l eID="gen8159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8160"/>probaverunt me, et viderunt opera mea. <l eID="gen8160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3623"/><l level="1" sID="gen8161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3623"/>Quadraginta annis offensus fui generationi illi, <l eID="gen8161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8162"/>et dixi : Semper hi errant corde. <l eID="gen8162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 94:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3624"/><l level="1" sID="gen8163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3624"/>Et isti non cognoverunt vias meas : <l eID="gen8163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8164"/>ut juravi in ira mea : <l eID="gen8164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8165"/>Si introibunt in requiem meam. <l eID="gen8165" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8141"/> <chapter eID="Ps.94"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:1
verses.text: Canticum ipsi David, quando domus ædificabatur post captivitatem. <div eID="gen8166" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8167"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8168"/>Cantate Domino canticum novum ; <l eID="gen8168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8169"/>cantate Domino omnis terra. <l eID="gen8169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3625"/><l level="1" sID="gen8170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3625"/>Cantate Domino, et benedicite nomini ejus ; <l eID="gen8170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8171"/>annuntiate de die in diem salutare ejus. <l eID="gen8171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3626"/><l level="1" sID="gen8172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3626"/>Annuntiate inter gentes gloriam ejus ; <l eID="gen8172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8173"/>in omnibus populis mirabilia ejus. <l eID="gen8173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3627"/><l level="1" sID="gen8174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3627"/>Quoniam magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis : <l eID="gen8174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8175"/>terribilis est super omnes deos. <l eID="gen8175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3628"/><l level="1" sID="gen8176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3628"/>Quoniam omnes dii gentium dæmonia ; <l eID="gen8176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8177"/>Dominus autem cælos fecit. <l eID="gen8177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3629"/><l level="1" sID="gen8178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3629"/>Confessio et pulchritudo in conspectu ejus ; <l eID="gen8178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8179"/>sanctimonia et magnificentia in sanctificatione ejus. <l eID="gen8179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3630"/><l level="1" sID="gen8180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3630"/>Afferte Domino, patriæ gentium, <l eID="gen8180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8181"/>afferte Domino gloriam et honorem ; <l eID="gen8181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3631"/><l level="1" sID="gen8182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3631"/>afferte Domino gloriam nomini ejus. <l eID="gen8182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8183"/>Tollite hostias, et introite in atria ejus ; <l eID="gen8183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3632"/><l level="1" sID="gen8184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3632"/>adorate Dominum in atrio sancto ejus. <l eID="gen8184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8185"/>Commoveatur a facie ejus universa terra ; <l eID="gen8185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3633"/><l level="1" sID="gen8186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3633"/>dicite in gentibus, quia Dominus regnavit. <l eID="gen8186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8187"/>Etenim correxit orbem terræ, qui non commovebitur ; <l eID="gen8187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8188"/>judicabit populos in æquitate. <l eID="gen8188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3634"/><l level="1" sID="gen8189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3634"/>Lætentur cæli, et exsultet terra ; <l eID="gen8189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8190"/>commoveatur mare et plenitudo ejus ; <l eID="gen8190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3635"/><l level="1" sID="gen8191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3635"/>gaudebunt campi, et omnia quæ in eis sunt. <l eID="gen8191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8192"/>Tunc exsultabunt omnia ligna silvarum <l eID="gen8192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 95:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3636"/><l level="1" sID="gen8193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3636"/>a facie Domini, quia venit, <l eID="gen8193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8194"/>quoniam venit judicare terram. <l eID="gen8194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8195"/>Judicabit orbem terræ in æquitate, <l eID="gen8195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8196"/>et populos in veritate sua. <l eID="gen8196" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8167"/> <chapter eID="Ps.95"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:1
verses.text: Huic David, quando terra ejus restituta est. <div eID="gen8197" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8198"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8199"/>Dominus regnavit : exsultet terra ; <l eID="gen8199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8200"/>lætentur insulæ multæ. <l eID="gen8200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3637"/><l level="1" sID="gen8201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3637"/>Nubes et caligo in circuitu ejus ; <l eID="gen8201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8202"/>justitia et judicium correctio sedis ejus. <l eID="gen8202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3638"/><l level="1" sID="gen8203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3638"/>Ignis ante ipsum præcedet, <l eID="gen8203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8204"/>et inflammabit in circuitu inimicos ejus. <l eID="gen8204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3639"/><l level="1" sID="gen8205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3639"/>Illuxerunt fulgura ejus orbi terræ ; <l eID="gen8205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8206"/>vidit, et commota est terra. <l eID="gen8206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3640"/><l level="1" sID="gen8207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3640"/>Montes sicut cera fluxerunt a facie Domini ; <l eID="gen8207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8208"/>a facie Domini omnis terra. <l eID="gen8208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3641"/><l level="1" sID="gen8209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3641"/>Annuntiaverunt cæli justitiam ejus, <l eID="gen8209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8210"/>et viderunt omnes populi gloriam ejus. <l eID="gen8210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3642"/><l level="1" sID="gen8211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3642"/>Confundantur omnes qui adorant sculptilia, <l eID="gen8211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8212"/>et qui gloriantur in simulacris suis. <l eID="gen8212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8213"/>Adorate eum omnes angeli ejus. <l eID="gen8213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3643"/><l level="1" sID="gen8214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3643"/>Audivit, et lætata est Sion, <l eID="gen8214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8215"/>et exsultaverunt filiæ Judæ <l eID="gen8215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8216"/>propter judicia tua, Domine. <l eID="gen8216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3644"/><l level="1" sID="gen8217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3644"/>Quoniam tu Dominus altissimus super omnem terram ; <l eID="gen8217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8218"/>nimis exaltatus es super omnes deos. <l eID="gen8218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3645"/><l level="1" sID="gen8219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3645"/>Qui diligitis Dominum, odite malum : <l eID="gen8219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8220"/>custodit Dominus animas sanctorum suorum ; <l eID="gen8220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8221"/>de manu peccatoris liberabit eos. <l eID="gen8221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3646"/><l level="1" sID="gen8222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3646"/>Lux orta est justo, <l eID="gen8222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8223"/>et rectis corde lætitia. <l eID="gen8223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 96:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3647"/><l level="1" sID="gen8224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3647"/>Lætamini, justi, in Domino, <l eID="gen8224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8225"/>et confitemini memoriæ sanctificationis ejus. <l eID="gen8225" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8198"/> <chapter eID="Ps.96"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:1
verses.text: Psalmus ipsi David. <div eID="gen8226" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8227"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8228"/>Cantate Domino canticum novum, <l eID="gen8228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8229"/>quia mirabilia fecit. <l eID="gen8229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8230"/>Salvavit sibi dextera ejus, <l eID="gen8230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8231"/>et brachium sanctum ejus. <l eID="gen8231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3648"/><l level="1" sID="gen8232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3648"/>Notum fecit Dominus salutare suum ; <l eID="gen8232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8233"/>in conspectu gentium revelavit justitiam suam. <l eID="gen8233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3649"/><l level="1" sID="gen8234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3649"/>Recordatus est misericordiæ suæ, <l eID="gen8234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8235"/>et veritatis suæ domui Israël. <l eID="gen8235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8236"/>Viderunt omnes termini terræ <l eID="gen8236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8237"/>salutare Dei nostri. <l eID="gen8237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3650"/><l level="1" sID="gen8238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3650"/>Jubilate Deo, omnis terra ; <l eID="gen8238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8239"/>cantate, et exsultate, et psallite. <l eID="gen8239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3651"/><l level="1" sID="gen8240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3651"/>Psallite Domino in cithara ; <l eID="gen8240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8241"/>in cithara et voce psalmi ; <l eID="gen8241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3652"/><l level="1" sID="gen8242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3652"/>in tubis ductilibus, et voce tubæ corneæ. <l eID="gen8242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8243"/>Jubilate in conspectu regis Domini : <l eID="gen8243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3653"/><l level="1" sID="gen8244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3653"/>moveatur mare, et plenitudo ejus ; <l eID="gen8244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8245"/>orbis terrarum, et qui habitant in eo. <l eID="gen8245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 97:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3654"/><l level="1" sID="gen8246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3654"/>Flumina plaudent manu ; <l eID="gen8246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8247"/>simul montes exsultabunt

verses.name: Psalms 97:9
verses.text: a conspectu Domini : <l eID="gen8247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8248"/>quoniam venit judicare terram. <l eID="gen8248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8249"/>Judicabit orbem terrarum in justitia, <l eID="gen8249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8250"/>et populos in æquitate. <l eID="gen8250" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8227"/> <chapter eID="Ps.97"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:1
verses.text: Psalmus ipsi David. <div eID="gen8251" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8252"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8253"/>Dominus regnavit : irascantur populi ; <l eID="gen8253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8254"/>qui sedet super cherubim : moveatur terra. <l eID="gen8254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3655"/><l level="1" sID="gen8255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3655"/>Dominus in Sion magnus, <l eID="gen8255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8256"/>et excelsus super omnes populos. <l eID="gen8256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3656"/><l level="1" sID="gen8257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3656"/>Confiteantur nomini tuo magno, <l eID="gen8257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8258"/>quoniam terribile et sanctum est, <l eID="gen8258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3657"/><l level="1" sID="gen8259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3657"/>et honor regis judicium diligit. <l eID="gen8259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8260"/>Tu parasti directiones ; <l eID="gen8260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8261"/>judicium et justitiam in Jacob tu fecisti. <l eID="gen8261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3658"/><l level="1" sID="gen8262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3658"/>Exaltate Dominum Deum nostrum, <l eID="gen8262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8263"/>et adorate scabellum pedum ejus, <l eID="gen8263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8264"/>quoniam sanctum est. <l eID="gen8264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3659"/><l level="1" sID="gen8265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3659"/>Moyses et Aaron in sacerdotibus ejus, <l eID="gen8265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8266"/>et Samuel inter eos qui invocant nomen ejus : <l eID="gen8266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8267"/>invocabant Dominum, et ipse exaudiebat eos ; <l eID="gen8267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3660"/><l level="1" sID="gen8268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3660"/>in columna nubis loquebatur ad eos. <l eID="gen8268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8269"/>Custodiebant testimonia ejus, <l eID="gen8269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8270"/>et præceptum quod dedit illis. <l eID="gen8270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3661"/><l level="1" sID="gen8271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3661"/>Domine Deus noster, tu exaudiebas eos ; <l eID="gen8271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8272"/>Deus, tu propitius fuisti eis, <l eID="gen8272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8273"/>et ulciscens in omnes adinventiones eorum. <l eID="gen8273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 98:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3662"/><l level="1" sID="gen8274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3662"/>Exaltate Dominum Deum nostrum, <l eID="gen8274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8275"/>et adorate in monte sancto ejus, <l eID="gen8275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8276"/>quoniam sanctus Dominus Deus noster. <l eID="gen8276" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8252"/> <chapter eID="Ps.98"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:1
verses.text: Psalmus in confessione.  <div eID="gen8277" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3663"/><lg sID="gen8278"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3663"/>Jubilate Deo, omnis terra ; <l eID="gen8279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8280"/>servite Domino in lætitia. <l eID="gen8280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8281"/>Introite in conspectu ejus in exsultatione. <l eID="gen8281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3664"/><l level="1" sID="gen8282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3664"/>Scitote quoniam Dominus ipse est Deus ; <l eID="gen8282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8283"/>ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos : <l eID="gen8283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8284"/>populus ejus, et oves pascuæ ejus. <l eID="gen8284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 99:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3665"/><l level="1" sID="gen8285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3665"/>Introite portas ejus in confessione ; <l eID="gen8285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8286"/>atria ejus in hymnis : <l eID="gen8286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8287"/>confitemini illi. <l eID="gen8287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8288"/>Laudate nomen ejus,

verses.name: Psalms 99:5
verses.text: quoniam suavis est Dominus, <l eID="gen8288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8289"/>in æternum misericordia ejus, <l eID="gen8289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8290"/>et usque in generationem et generationem veritas ejus. <l eID="gen8290" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8278"/> <chapter eID="Ps.99"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:1
verses.text: Psalmus ipsi David. <div eID="gen8291" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8292"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8293"/>Misericordiam et judicium cantabo tibi, Domine ; <l eID="gen8293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8294"/>psallam,

verses.name: Psalms 100:2
verses.text: et intelligam in via immaculata : quando venies ad me ? <l eID="gen8294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8295"/>Perambulabam in innocentia cordis mei, in medio domus meæ. <l eID="gen8295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3666"/><l level="1" sID="gen8296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3666"/>Non proponebam ante oculos meos rem injustam ; <l eID="gen8296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8297"/>facientes prævaricationes odivi ; <l eID="gen8297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8298"/>non adhæsit mihi

verses.name: Psalms 100:4
verses.text: cor pravum ; <l eID="gen8298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8299"/>declinantem a me malignum non cognoscebam. <l eID="gen8299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3667"/><l level="1" sID="gen8300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3667"/>Detrahentem secreto proximo suo, hunc persequebar : <l eID="gen8300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8301"/>superbo oculo, et insatiabili corde, cum hoc non edebam. <l eID="gen8301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3668"/><l level="1" sID="gen8302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3668"/>Oculi mei ad fideles terræ, ut sedeant mecum ; <l eID="gen8302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8303"/>ambulans in via immaculata, hic mihi ministrabat. <l eID="gen8303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3669"/><l level="1" sID="gen8304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3669"/>Non habitabit in medio domus meæ qui facit superbiam ; <l eID="gen8304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8305"/>qui loquitur iniqua non direxit in conspectu oculorum meorum. <l eID="gen8305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 100:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3670"/><l level="1" sID="gen8306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3670"/>In matutino interficiebam omnes peccatores terræ, <l eID="gen8306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8307"/>ut disperderem de civitate Domini omnes operantes iniquitatem. <l eID="gen8307" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8292"/> <chapter eID="Ps.100"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:1
verses.text: Oratio pauperis, cum anxius fuerit, et in conspectu Domini effuderit precem suam.  <div eID="gen8308" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3671"/><lg sID="gen8309"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3671"/>Domine, exaudi orationem meam, <l eID="gen8310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8311"/>et clamor meus ad te veniat. <l eID="gen8311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3672"/><l level="1" sID="gen8312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3672"/>Non avertas faciem tuam a me : <l eID="gen8312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8313"/>in quacumque die tribulor, inclina ad me aurem tuam ; <l eID="gen8313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8314"/>in quacumque die invocavero te, velociter exaudi me. <l eID="gen8314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3673"/><l level="1" sID="gen8315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3673"/>Quia defecerunt sicut fumus dies mei, <l eID="gen8315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8316"/>et ossa mea sicut cremium aruerunt. <l eID="gen8316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3674"/><l level="1" sID="gen8317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3674"/>Percussus sum ut fœnum, et aruit cor meum, <l eID="gen8317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8318"/>quia oblitus sum comedere panem meum. <l eID="gen8318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3675"/><l level="1" sID="gen8319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3675"/>A voce gemitus mei <l eID="gen8319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8320"/>adhæsit os meum carni meæ. <l eID="gen8320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3676"/><l level="1" sID="gen8321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3676"/>Similis factus sum pellicano solitudinis ; <l eID="gen8321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8322"/>factus sum sicut nycticorax in domicilio. <l eID="gen8322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3677"/><l level="1" sID="gen8323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3677"/>Vigilavi, et factus sum sicut passer solitarius in tecto. <l eID="gen8323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3678"/><l level="1" sID="gen8324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3678"/>Tota die exprobrabant mihi inimici mei, <l eID="gen8324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8325"/>et qui laudabant me adversum me jurabant : <l eID="gen8325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3679"/><l level="1" sID="gen8326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3679"/>quia cinerem tamquam panem manducabam, <l eID="gen8326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8327"/>et potum meum cum fletu miscebam, <l eID="gen8327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3680"/><l level="1" sID="gen8328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3680"/>a facie iræ et indignationis tuæ : <l eID="gen8328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8329"/>quia elevans allisisti me. <l eID="gen8329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3681"/><l level="1" sID="gen8330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3681"/>Dies mei sicut umbra declinaverunt, <l eID="gen8330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8331"/>et ego sicut fœnum arui. <l eID="gen8331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3682"/><l level="1" sID="gen8332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3682"/>Tu autem, Domine, in æternum permanes, <l eID="gen8332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8333"/>et memoriale tuum in generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen8333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3683"/><l level="1" sID="gen8334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3683"/>Tu exsurgens misereberis Sion, <l eID="gen8334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8335"/>quia tempus miserendi ejus, quia venit tempus : <l eID="gen8335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3684"/><l level="1" sID="gen8336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3684"/>quoniam placuerunt servis tuis lapides ejus, <l eID="gen8336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8337"/>et terræ ejus miserebuntur. <l eID="gen8337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3685"/><l level="1" sID="gen8338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3685"/>Et timebunt gentes nomen tuum, Domine, <l eID="gen8338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8339"/>et omnes reges terræ gloriam tuam : <l eID="gen8339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3686"/><l level="1" sID="gen8340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3686"/>quia ædificavit Dominus Sion, <l eID="gen8340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8341"/>et videbitur in gloria sua. <l eID="gen8341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3687"/><l level="1" sID="gen8342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3687"/>Respexit in orationem humilium <l eID="gen8342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8343"/>et non sprevit precem eorum. <l eID="gen8343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3688"/><l level="1" sID="gen8344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3688"/>Scribantur hæc in generatione altera, <l eID="gen8344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8345"/>et populus qui creabitur laudabit Dominum. <l eID="gen8345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3689"/><l level="1" sID="gen8346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3689"/>Quia prospexit de excelso sancto suo ; <l eID="gen8346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8347"/>Dominus de cælo in terram aspexit : <l eID="gen8347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3690"/><l level="1" sID="gen8348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3690"/>ut audiret gemitus compeditorum ; <l eID="gen8348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8349"/>ut solveret filios interemptorum : <l eID="gen8349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3691"/><l level="1" sID="gen8350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3691"/>ut annuntient in Sion nomen Domini, <l eID="gen8350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8351"/>et laudem ejus in Jerusalem : <l eID="gen8351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3692"/><l level="1" sID="gen8352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3692"/>in conveniendo populos in unum, et reges, <l eID="gen8352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8353"/>ut serviant Domino. <l eID="gen8353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3693"/><l level="1" sID="gen8354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3693"/>Respondit ei in via virtutis suæ : <l eID="gen8354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8355"/>Paucitatem dierum meorum nuntia mihi : <l eID="gen8355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3694"/><l level="1" sID="gen8356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3694"/>ne revoces me in dimidio dierum meorum, <l eID="gen8356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8357"/>in generationem et generationem anni tui. <l eID="gen8357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3695"/><l level="1" sID="gen8358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3695"/>Initio tu, Domine, terram fundasti, <l eID="gen8358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8359"/>et opera manuum tuarum sunt cæli. <l eID="gen8359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3696"/><l level="1" sID="gen8360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3696"/>Ipsi peribunt, tu autem permanes ; <l eID="gen8360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8361"/>et omnes sicut vestimentum veterascent. <l eID="gen8361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8362"/>Et sicut opertorium mutabis eos, et mutabuntur ; <l eID="gen8362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3697"/><l level="1" sID="gen8363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3697"/>tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non deficient. <l eID="gen8363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 101:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3698"/><l level="1" sID="gen8364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3698"/>Filii servorum tuorum habitabunt, <l eID="gen8364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8365"/>et semen eorum in sæculum dirigetur. <l eID="gen8365" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8309"/> <chapter eID="Ps.101"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:1
verses.text: Ipsi David. <div eID="gen8366" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8367"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8368"/>Benedic, anima mea, Domino, <l eID="gen8368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8369"/>et omnia quæ intra me sunt nomini sancto ejus. <l eID="gen8369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3699"/><l level="1" sID="gen8370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3699"/>Benedic, anima mea, Domino, <l eID="gen8370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8371"/>et noli oblivisci omnes retributiones ejus. <l eID="gen8371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3700"/><l level="1" sID="gen8372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3700"/>Qui propitiatur omnibus iniquitatibus tuis ; <l eID="gen8372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8373"/>qui sanat omnes infirmitates tuas : <l eID="gen8373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3701"/><l level="1" sID="gen8374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3701"/>qui redimit de interitu vitam tuam ; <l eID="gen8374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8375"/>qui coronat te in misericordia et miserationibus : <l eID="gen8375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3702"/><l level="1" sID="gen8376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3702"/>qui replet in bonis desiderium tuum ; <l eID="gen8376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8377"/>renovabitur ut aquilæ juventus tua : <l eID="gen8377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3703"/><l level="1" sID="gen8378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3703"/>faciens misericordias Dominus, <l eID="gen8378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8379"/>et judicium omnibus injuriam patientibus. <l eID="gen8379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3704"/><l level="1" sID="gen8380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3704"/>Notas fecit vias suas Moysi ; <l eID="gen8380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8381"/>filiis Israël voluntates suas. <l eID="gen8381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3705"/><l level="1" sID="gen8382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3705"/>Miserator et misericors Dominus : <l eID="gen8382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8383"/>longanimis, et multum misericors. <l eID="gen8383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3706"/><l level="1" sID="gen8384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3706"/>Non in perpetuum irascetur, <l eID="gen8384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8385"/>neque in æternum comminabitur. <l eID="gen8385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3707"/><l level="1" sID="gen8386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3707"/>Non secundum peccata nostra fecit nobis, <l eID="gen8386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8387"/>neque secundum iniquitates nostras retribuit nobis. <l eID="gen8387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3708"/><l level="1" sID="gen8388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3708"/>Quoniam secundum altitudinem cæli a terra, <l eID="gen8388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8389"/>corroboravit misericordiam suam super timentes se ; <l eID="gen8389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3709"/><l level="1" sID="gen8390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3709"/>quantum distat ortus ab occidente, <l eID="gen8390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8391"/>longe fecit a nobis iniquitates nostras. <l eID="gen8391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3710"/><l level="1" sID="gen8392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3710"/>Quomodo miseretur pater filiorum, <l eID="gen8392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8393"/>misertus est Dominus timentibus se. <l eID="gen8393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3711"/><l level="1" sID="gen8394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3711"/>Quoniam ipse cognovit figmentum nostrum ; <l eID="gen8394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8395"/>recordatus est quoniam pulvis sumus. <l eID="gen8395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3712"/><l level="1" sID="gen8396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3712"/>Homo, sicut fœnum dies ejus ; <l eID="gen8396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8397"/>tamquam flos agri, sic efflorebit : <l eID="gen8397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3713"/><l level="1" sID="gen8398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3713"/>quoniam spiritus pertransibit in illo, et non subsistet, <l eID="gen8398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8399"/>et non cognoscet amplius locum suum. <l eID="gen8399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3714"/><l level="1" sID="gen8400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3714"/>Misericordia autem Domini ab æterno, <l eID="gen8400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8401"/>et usque in æternum super timentes eum. <l eID="gen8401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8402"/>Et justitia illius in filios filiorum, <l eID="gen8402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3715"/><l level="1" sID="gen8403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3715"/>his qui servant testamentum ejus, <l eID="gen8403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8404"/>et memores sunt mandatorum ipsius ad faciendum ea. <l eID="gen8404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3716"/><l level="1" sID="gen8405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3716"/>Dominus in cælo paravit sedem suam, <l eID="gen8405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8406"/>et regnum ipsius omnibus dominabitur. <l eID="gen8406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3717"/><l level="1" sID="gen8407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3717"/>Benedicite Domino, omnes angeli ejus : <l eID="gen8407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8408"/>potentes virtute, facientes verbum illius, <l eID="gen8408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8409"/>ad audiendam vocem sermonum ejus. <l eID="gen8409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3718"/><l level="1" sID="gen8410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3718"/>Benedicite Domino, omnes virtutes ejus ; <l eID="gen8410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8411"/>ministri ejus, qui facitis voluntatem ejus. <l eID="gen8411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 102:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3719"/><l level="1" sID="gen8412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3719"/>Benedicite Domino, omnia opera ejus : <l eID="gen8412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8413"/>in omni loco dominationis ejus, <l eID="gen8413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8414"/>benedic, anima mea, Domino. <l eID="gen8414" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8367"/> <chapter eID="Ps.102"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:1
verses.text: Ipsi David. <div eID="gen8415" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8416"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8417"/>Benedic, anima mea, Domino : <l eID="gen8417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8418"/>Domine Deus meus, magnificatus es vehementer. <l eID="gen8418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8419"/>Confessionem et decorem induisti, <l eID="gen8419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3720"/><l level="1" sID="gen8420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3720"/>amictus lumine sicut vestimento. <l eID="gen8420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8421"/>Extendens cælum sicut pellem, <l eID="gen8421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3721"/><l level="1" sID="gen8422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3721"/>qui tegis aquis superiora ejus : <l eID="gen8422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8423"/>qui ponis nubem ascensum tuum ; <l eID="gen8423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8424"/>qui ambulas super pennas ventorum : <l eID="gen8424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3722"/><l level="1" sID="gen8425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3722"/>qui facis angelos tuos spiritus, <l eID="gen8425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8426"/>et ministros tuos ignem urentem. <l eID="gen8426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3723"/><l level="1" sID="gen8427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3723"/>Qui fundasti terram super stabilitatem suam : <l eID="gen8427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8428"/>non inclinabitur in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen8428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3724"/><l level="1" sID="gen8429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3724"/>Abyssus sicut vestimentum amictus ejus ; <l eID="gen8429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8430"/>super montes stabunt aquæ. <l eID="gen8430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3725"/><l level="1" sID="gen8431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3725"/>Ab increpatione tua fugient ; <l eID="gen8431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8432"/>a voce tonitrui tui formidabunt. <l eID="gen8432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3726"/><l level="1" sID="gen8433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3726"/>Ascendunt montes, et descendunt campi, <l eID="gen8433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8434"/>in locum quem fundasti eis. <l eID="gen8434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3727"/><l level="1" sID="gen8435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3727"/>Terminum posuisti quem non transgredientur, <l eID="gen8435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8436"/>neque convertentur operire terram. <l eID="gen8436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3728"/><l level="1" sID="gen8437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3728"/>Qui emittis fontes in convallibus ; <l eID="gen8437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8438"/>inter medium montium pertransibunt aquæ. <l eID="gen8438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3729"/><l level="1" sID="gen8439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3729"/>Potabunt omnes bestiæ agri ; <l eID="gen8439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8440"/>expectabunt onagri in siti sua. <l eID="gen8440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3730"/><l level="1" sID="gen8441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3730"/>Super ea volucres cæli habitabunt ; <l eID="gen8441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8442"/>de medio petrarum dabunt voces. <l eID="gen8442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3731"/><l level="1" sID="gen8443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3731"/>Rigans montes de superioribus suis ; <l eID="gen8443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8444"/>de fructu operum tuorum satiabitur terra : <l eID="gen8444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3732"/><l level="1" sID="gen8445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3732"/>producens fœnum jumentis, <l eID="gen8445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8446"/>et herbam servituti hominum, <l eID="gen8446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8447"/>ut educas panem de terra, <l eID="gen8447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3733"/><l level="1" sID="gen8448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3733"/>et vinum lætificet cor hominis : <l eID="gen8448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8449"/>ut exhilaret faciem in oleo, <l eID="gen8449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8450"/>et panis cor hominis confirmet. <l eID="gen8450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3734"/><l level="1" sID="gen8451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3734"/>Saturabuntur ligna campi, <l eID="gen8451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8452"/>et cedri Libani quas plantavit : <l eID="gen8452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3735"/><l level="1" sID="gen8453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3735"/>illic passeres nidificabunt : <l eID="gen8453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8454"/>herodii domus dux est eorum. <l eID="gen8454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3736"/><l level="1" sID="gen8455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3736"/>Montes excelsi cervis ; <l eID="gen8455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8456"/>petra refugium herinaciis. <l eID="gen8456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3737"/><l level="1" sID="gen8457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3737"/>Fecit lunam in tempora ; <l eID="gen8457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8458"/>sol cognovit occasum suum. <l eID="gen8458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3738"/><l level="1" sID="gen8459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3738"/>Posuisti tenebras, et facta est nox ; <l eID="gen8459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8460"/>in ipsa pertransibunt omnes bestiæ silvæ : <l eID="gen8460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3739"/><l level="1" sID="gen8461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3739"/>catuli leonum rugientes ut rapiant, <l eID="gen8461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8462"/>et quærant a Deo escam sibi. <l eID="gen8462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3740"/><l level="1" sID="gen8463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3740"/>Ortus est sol, et congregati sunt, <l eID="gen8463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8464"/>et in cubilibus suis collocabuntur. <l eID="gen8464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3741"/><l level="1" sID="gen8465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3741"/>Exibit homo ad opus suum, <l eID="gen8465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8466"/>et ad operationem suam usque ad vesperum. <l eID="gen8466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3742"/><l level="1" sID="gen8467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3742"/>Quam magnificata sunt opera tua, Domine ! <l eID="gen8467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8468"/>omnia in sapientia fecisti ; <l eID="gen8468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8469"/>impleta est terra possessione tua. <l eID="gen8469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3743"/><l level="1" sID="gen8470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3743"/>Hoc mare magnum et spatiosum manibus ; <l eID="gen8470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8471"/>illic reptilia quorum non est numerus : <l eID="gen8471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8472"/>animalia pusilla cum magnis. <l eID="gen8472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3744"/><l level="1" sID="gen8473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3744"/>Illic naves pertransibunt ; <l eID="gen8473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8474"/>draco iste quem formasti ad illudendum ei. <l eID="gen8474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3745"/><l level="1" sID="gen8475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3745"/>Omnia a te expectant <l eID="gen8475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8476"/>ut des illis escam in tempore. <l eID="gen8476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3746"/><l level="1" sID="gen8477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3746"/>Dante te illis, colligent ; <l eID="gen8477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8478"/>aperiente te manum tuam, omnia implebuntur bonitate. <l eID="gen8478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3747"/><l level="1" sID="gen8479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3747"/>Avertente autem te faciem, turbabuntur ; <l eID="gen8479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8480"/>auferes spiritum eorum, et deficient, <l eID="gen8480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8481"/>et in pulverem suum revertentur. <l eID="gen8481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3748"/><l level="1" sID="gen8482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3748"/>Emittes spiritum tuum, et creabuntur, <l eID="gen8482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8483"/>et renovabis faciem terræ. <l eID="gen8483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3749"/><l level="1" sID="gen8484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3749"/>Sit gloria Domini in sæculum ; <l eID="gen8484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8485"/>lætabitur Dominus in operibus suis. <l eID="gen8485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3750"/><l level="1" sID="gen8486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3750"/>Qui respicit terram, et facit eam tremere ; <l eID="gen8486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8487"/>qui tangit montes, et fumigant. <l eID="gen8487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3751"/><l level="1" sID="gen8488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3751"/>Cantabo Domino in vita mea ; <l eID="gen8488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8489"/>psallam Deo meo quamdiu sum. <l eID="gen8489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3752"/><l level="1" sID="gen8490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3752"/>Jucundum sit ei eloquium meum ; <l eID="gen8490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8491"/>ego vero delectabor in Domino. <l eID="gen8491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 103:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3753"/><l level="1" sID="gen8492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3753"/>Deficiant peccatores a terra, <l eID="gen8492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8493"/>et iniqui, ita ut non sint. <l eID="gen8493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8494"/>Benedic, anima mea, Domino. <l eID="gen8494" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8416"/> <chapter eID="Ps.103"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen8495" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8496"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8497"/>Confitemini Domino, et invocate nomen ejus ; <l eID="gen8497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8498"/>annuntiate inter gentes opera ejus. <l eID="gen8498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3754"/><l level="1" sID="gen8499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3754"/>Cantate ei, et psallite ei ; <l eID="gen8499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8500"/>narrate omnia mirabilia ejus. <l eID="gen8500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3755"/><l level="1" sID="gen8501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3755"/>Laudamini in nomine sancto ejus ; <l eID="gen8501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8502"/>lætetur cor quærentium Dominum. <l eID="gen8502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3756"/><l level="1" sID="gen8503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3756"/>Quærite Dominum, et confirmamini ; <l eID="gen8503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8504"/>quærite faciem ejus semper. <l eID="gen8504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3757"/><l level="1" sID="gen8505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3757"/>Mementote mirabilium ejus quæ fecit ; <l eID="gen8505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8506"/>prodigia ejus, et judicia oris ejus : <l eID="gen8506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3758"/><l level="1" sID="gen8507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3758"/>semen Abraham servi ejus ; <l eID="gen8507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8508"/>filii Jacob electi ejus. <l eID="gen8508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3759"/><l level="1" sID="gen8509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3759"/>Ipse Dominus Deus noster ; <l eID="gen8509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8510"/>in universa terra judicia ejus. <l eID="gen8510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3760"/><l level="1" sID="gen8511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3760"/>Memor fuit in sæculum testamenti sui ; <l eID="gen8511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8512"/>verbi quod mandavit in mille generationes : <l eID="gen8512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3761"/><l level="1" sID="gen8513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3761"/>quod disposuit ad Abraham, <l eID="gen8513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8514"/>et juramenti sui ad Isaac : <l eID="gen8514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3762"/><l level="1" sID="gen8515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3762"/>et statuit illud Jacob in præceptum, <l eID="gen8515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8516"/>et Israël in testamentum æternum, <l eID="gen8516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3763"/><l level="1" sID="gen8517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3763"/>dicens : Tibi dabo terram Chanaan, <l eID="gen8517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8518"/>funiculum hæreditatis vestræ : <l eID="gen8518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3764"/><l level="1" sID="gen8519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3764"/>cum essent numero brevi, <l eID="gen8519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8520"/>paucissimi, et incolæ ejus. <l eID="gen8520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3765"/><l level="1" sID="gen8521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3765"/>Et pertransierunt de gente in gentem, <l eID="gen8521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8522"/>et de regno ad populum alterum. <l eID="gen8522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3766"/><l level="1" sID="gen8523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3766"/>Non reliquit hominem nocere eis : <l eID="gen8523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8524"/>et corripuit pro eis reges. <l eID="gen8524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3767"/><l level="1" sID="gen8525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3767"/>Nolite tangere christos meos, <l eID="gen8525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8526"/>et in prophetis meis nolite malignari. <l eID="gen8526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3768"/><l level="1" sID="gen8527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3768"/>Et vocavit famem super terram, <l eID="gen8527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8528"/>et omne firmamentum panis contrivit. <l eID="gen8528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3769"/><l level="1" sID="gen8529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3769"/>Misit ante eos virum : <l eID="gen8529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8530"/>in servum venumdatus est, Joseph. <l eID="gen8530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3770"/><l level="1" sID="gen8531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3770"/>Humiliaverunt in compedibus pedes ejus ; <l eID="gen8531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8532"/>ferrum pertransiit animam ejus : <l eID="gen8532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3771"/><l level="1" sID="gen8533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3771"/>donec veniret verbum ejus. <l eID="gen8533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8534"/>Eloquium Domini inflammavit eum. <l eID="gen8534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3772"/><l level="1" sID="gen8535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3772"/>Misit rex, et solvit eum ; <l eID="gen8535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8536"/>princeps populorum, et dimisit eum. <l eID="gen8536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3773"/><l level="1" sID="gen8537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3773"/>Constituit eum dominum domus suæ, <l eID="gen8537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8538"/>et principem omnis possessionis suæ : <l eID="gen8538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3774"/><l level="1" sID="gen8539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3774"/>ut erudiret principes ejus sicut semetipsum, <l eID="gen8539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8540"/>et senes ejus prudentiam doceret. <l eID="gen8540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3775"/><l level="1" sID="gen8541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3775"/>Et intravit Israël in Ægyptum, <l eID="gen8541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8542"/>et Jacob accola fuit in terra Cham. <l eID="gen8542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3776"/><l level="1" sID="gen8543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3776"/>Et auxit populum suum vehementer, <l eID="gen8543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8544"/>et firmavit eum super inimicos ejus. <l eID="gen8544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3777"/><l level="1" sID="gen8545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3777"/>Convertit cor eorum, ut odirent populum ejus, <l eID="gen8545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8546"/>et dolum facerent in servos ejus. <l eID="gen8546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3778"/><l level="1" sID="gen8547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3778"/>Misit Moysen servum suum ; <l eID="gen8547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8548"/>Aaron quem elegit ipsum. <l eID="gen8548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3779"/><l level="1" sID="gen8549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3779"/>Posuit in eis verba signorum suorum, <l eID="gen8549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8550"/>et prodigiorum in terra Cham. <l eID="gen8550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3780"/><l level="1" sID="gen8551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3780"/>Misit tenebras, et obscuravit ; <l eID="gen8551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8552"/>et non exacerbavit sermones suos. <l eID="gen8552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3781"/><l level="1" sID="gen8553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3781"/>Convertit aquas eorum in sanguinem, <l eID="gen8553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8554"/>et occidit pisces eorum. <l eID="gen8554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3782"/><l level="1" sID="gen8555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3782"/>Edidit terra eorum ranas <l eID="gen8555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8556"/>in penetralibus regum ipsorum. <l eID="gen8556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3783"/><l level="1" sID="gen8557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3783"/>Dixit, et venit cœnomyia et ciniphes <l eID="gen8557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8558"/>in omnibus finibus eorum. <l eID="gen8558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3784"/><l level="1" sID="gen8559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3784"/>Posuit pluvias eorum grandinem : <l eID="gen8559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8560"/>ignem comburentem in terra ipsorum. <l eID="gen8560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3785"/><l level="1" sID="gen8561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3785"/>Et percussit vineas eorum, et ficulneas eorum, <l eID="gen8561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8562"/>et contrivit lignum finium eorum. <l eID="gen8562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3786"/><l level="1" sID="gen8563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3786"/>Dixit, et venit locusta, <l eID="gen8563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8564"/>et bruchus cujus non erat numerus : <l eID="gen8564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3787"/><l level="1" sID="gen8565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3787"/>et comedit omne fœnum in terra eorum, <l eID="gen8565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8566"/>et comedit omnem fructum terræ eorum. <l eID="gen8566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3788"/><l level="1" sID="gen8567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3788"/>Et percussit omne primogenitum in terra eorum, <l eID="gen8567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8568"/>primitias omnis laboris eorum. <l eID="gen8568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3789"/><l level="1" sID="gen8569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3789"/>Et eduxit eos cum argento et auro, <l eID="gen8569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8570"/>et non erat in tribubus eorum infirmus. <l eID="gen8570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3790"/><l level="1" sID="gen8571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3790"/>Lætata est Ægyptus in profectione eorum, <l eID="gen8571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8572"/>quia incubuit timor eorum super eos. <l eID="gen8572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3791"/><l level="1" sID="gen8573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3791"/>Expandit nubem in protectionem eorum, <l eID="gen8573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8574"/>et ignem ut luceret eis per noctem. <l eID="gen8574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3792"/><l level="1" sID="gen8575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3792"/>Petierunt, et venit coturnix, <l eID="gen8575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8576"/>et pane cæli saturavit eos. <l eID="gen8576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3793"/><l level="1" sID="gen8577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3793"/>Dirupit petram, et fluxerunt aquæ : <l eID="gen8577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8578"/>abierunt in sicco flumina. <l eID="gen8578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3794"/><l level="1" sID="gen8579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3794"/>Quoniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui, <l eID="gen8579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8580"/>quod habuit ad Abraham puerum suum. <l eID="gen8580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3795"/><l level="1" sID="gen8581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3795"/>Et eduxit populum suum in exsultatione, <l eID="gen8581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8582"/>et electos suos in lætitia. <l eID="gen8582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3796"/><l level="1" sID="gen8583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3796"/>Et dedit illis regiones gentium, <l eID="gen8583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8584"/>et labores populorum possederunt : <l eID="gen8584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 104:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3797"/><l level="1" sID="gen8585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3797"/>ut custodiant justificationes ejus, <l eID="gen8585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8586"/>et legem ejus requirant. <l eID="gen8586" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8496"/> <chapter eID="Ps.104"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen8587" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8588"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8589"/>Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, <l eID="gen8589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8590"/>quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen8590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3798"/><l level="1" sID="gen8591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3798"/>Quis loquetur potentias Domini ; <l eID="gen8591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8592"/>auditas faciet omnes laudes ejus ? <l eID="gen8592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3799"/><l level="1" sID="gen8593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3799"/>Beati qui custodiunt judicium, <l eID="gen8593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8594"/>et faciunt justitiam in omni tempore. <l eID="gen8594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3800"/><l level="1" sID="gen8595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3800"/>Memento nostri, Domine, in beneplacito populi tui ; <l eID="gen8595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8596"/>visita nos in salutari tuo : <l eID="gen8596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3801"/><l level="1" sID="gen8597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3801"/>ad videndum in bonitate electorum tuorum ; <l eID="gen8597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8598"/>ad lætandum in lætitia gentis tuæ : <l eID="gen8598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8599"/>ut lauderis cum hæreditate tua. <l eID="gen8599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3802"/><l level="1" sID="gen8600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3802"/>Peccavimus cum patribus nostris : <l eID="gen8600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8601"/>injuste egimus ; iniquitatem fecimus. <l eID="gen8601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3803"/><l level="1" sID="gen8602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3803"/>Patres nostri in Ægypto non intellexerunt mirabilia tua ; <l eID="gen8602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8603"/>non fuerunt memores multitudinis misericordiæ tuæ. <l eID="gen8603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8604"/>Et irritaverunt ascendentes in mare, mare Rubrum ; <l eID="gen8604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3804"/><l level="1" sID="gen8605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3804"/>et salvavit eos propter nomen suum, <l eID="gen8605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8606"/>ut notam faceret potentiam suam. <l eID="gen8606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3805"/><l level="1" sID="gen8607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3805"/>Et increpuit mare Rubrum et exsiccatum est, <l eID="gen8607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8608"/>et deduxit eos in abyssis sicut in deserto. <l eID="gen8608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3806"/><l level="1" sID="gen8609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3806"/>Et salvavit eos de manu odientium, <l eID="gen8609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8610"/>et redemit eos de manu inimici. <l eID="gen8610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3807"/><l level="1" sID="gen8611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3807"/>Et operuit aqua tribulantes eos ; <l eID="gen8611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8612"/>unus ex eis non remansit. <l eID="gen8612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3808"/><l level="1" sID="gen8613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3808"/>Et crediderunt verbis ejus, <l eID="gen8613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8614"/>et laudaverunt laudem ejus. <l eID="gen8614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3809"/><l level="1" sID="gen8615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3809"/>Cito fecerunt ; obliti sunt operum ejus : <l eID="gen8615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8616"/>et non sustinuerunt consilium ejus. <l eID="gen8616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3810"/><l level="1" sID="gen8617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3810"/>Et concupierunt concupiscentiam in deserto, <l eID="gen8617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8618"/>et tentaverunt Deum in inaquoso. <l eID="gen8618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3811"/><l level="1" sID="gen8619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3811"/>Et dedit eis petitionem ipsorum, <l eID="gen8619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8620"/>et misit saturitatem in animas eorum. <l eID="gen8620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3812"/><l level="1" sID="gen8621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3812"/>Et irritaverunt Moysen in castris ; <l eID="gen8621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8622"/>Aaron, sanctum Domini. <l eID="gen8622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3813"/><l level="1" sID="gen8623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3813"/>Aperta est terra, et deglutivit Dathan, <l eID="gen8623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8624"/>et operuit super congregationem Abiron. <l eID="gen8624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3814"/><l level="1" sID="gen8625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3814"/>Et exarsit ignis in synagoga eorum : <l eID="gen8625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8626"/>flamma combussit peccatores. <l eID="gen8626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3815"/><l level="1" sID="gen8627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3815"/>Et fecerunt vitulum in Horeb, <l eID="gen8627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8628"/>et adoraverunt sculptile. <l eID="gen8628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:20
