verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3816"/><l level="1" sID="gen8629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3816"/>Et mutaverunt gloriam suam <l eID="gen8629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8630"/>in similitudinem vituli comedentis fœnum. <l eID="gen8630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3817"/><l level="1" sID="gen8631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3817"/>Obliti sunt Deum qui salvavit eos ; <l eID="gen8631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8632"/>qui fecit magnalia in Ægypto, <l eID="gen8632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3818"/><l level="1" sID="gen8633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3818"/>mirabilia in terra Cham, <l eID="gen8633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8634"/>terribilia in mari Rubro. <l eID="gen8634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3819"/><l level="1" sID="gen8635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3819"/>Et dixit ut disperderet eos, <l eID="gen8635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8636"/>si non Moyses, electus ejus, <l eID="gen8636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8637"/>stetisset in confractione in conspectu ejus, <l eID="gen8637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8638"/>ut averteret iram ejus, ne disperderet eos. <l eID="gen8638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3820"/><l level="1" sID="gen8639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3820"/>Et pro nihilo habuerunt terram desiderabilem ; <l eID="gen8639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8640"/>non crediderunt verbo ejus. <l eID="gen8640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3821"/><l level="1" sID="gen8641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3821"/>Et murmuraverunt in tabernaculis suis ; <l eID="gen8641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8642"/>non exaudierunt vocem Domini. <l eID="gen8642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3822"/><l level="1" sID="gen8643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3822"/>Et elevavit manum suam super eos <l eID="gen8643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8644"/>ut prosterneret eos in deserto : <l eID="gen8644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3823"/><l level="1" sID="gen8645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3823"/>et ut dejiceret semen eorum in nationibus, <l eID="gen8645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8646"/>et dispergeret eos in regionibus. <l eID="gen8646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3824"/><l level="1" sID="gen8647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3824"/>Et initiati sunt Beelphegor, <l eID="gen8647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8648"/>et comederunt sacrificia mortuorum. <l eID="gen8648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3825"/><l level="1" sID="gen8649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3825"/>Et irritaverunt eum in adinventionibus suis, <l eID="gen8649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8650"/>et multiplicata est in eis ruina. <l eID="gen8650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3826"/><l level="1" sID="gen8651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3826"/>Et stetit Phinees, et placavit, <l eID="gen8651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8652"/>et cessavit quassatio. <l eID="gen8652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3827"/><l level="1" sID="gen8653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3827"/>Et reputatum est ei in justitiam, <l eID="gen8653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8654"/>in generationem et generationem usque in sempiternum. <l eID="gen8654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3828"/><l level="1" sID="gen8655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3828"/>Et irritaverunt eum ad aquas contradictionis, <l eID="gen8655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8656"/>et vexatus est Moyses propter eos : <l eID="gen8656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3829"/><l level="1" sID="gen8657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3829"/>quia exacerbaverunt spiritum ejus, <l eID="gen8657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8658"/>et distinxit in labiis suis. <l eID="gen8658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3830"/><l level="1" sID="gen8659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3830"/>Non disperdiderunt gentes <l eID="gen8659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8660"/>quas dixit Dominus illis : <l eID="gen8660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3831"/><l level="1" sID="gen8661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3831"/>et commisti sunt inter gentes, <l eID="gen8661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8662"/>et didicerunt opera eorum ; <l eID="gen8662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3832"/><l level="1" sID="gen8663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3832"/>et servierunt sculptilibus eorum, <l eID="gen8663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8664"/>et factum est illis in scandalum. <l eID="gen8664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3833"/><l level="1" sID="gen8665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3833"/>Et immolaverunt filios suos et filias suas dæmoniis. <l eID="gen8665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3834"/><l level="1" sID="gen8666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3834"/>Et effuderunt sanguinem innocentem, <l eID="gen8666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8667"/>sanguinem filiorum suorum et filiarum suarum, <l eID="gen8667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8668"/>quas sacrificaverunt sculptilibus Chanaan. <l eID="gen8668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8669"/>Et infecta est terra in sanguinibus, <l eID="gen8669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3835"/><l level="1" sID="gen8670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3835"/>et contaminata est in operibus eorum : <l eID="gen8670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8671"/>et fornicati sunt in adinventionibus suis. <l eID="gen8671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3836"/><l level="1" sID="gen8672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3836"/>Et iratus est furore Dominus in populum suum, <l eID="gen8672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8673"/>et abominatus est hæreditatem suam. <l eID="gen8673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3837"/><l level="1" sID="gen8674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3837"/>Et tradidit eos in manus gentium ; <l eID="gen8674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8675"/>et dominati sunt eorum qui oderunt eos. <l eID="gen8675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3838"/><l level="1" sID="gen8676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3838"/>Et tribulaverunt eos inimici eorum, <l eID="gen8676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8677"/>et humiliati sunt sub manibus eorum ; <l eID="gen8677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3839"/><l level="1" sID="gen8678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3839"/>sæpe liberavit eos. <l eID="gen8678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8679"/>Ipsi autem exacerbaverunt eum in consilio suo, <l eID="gen8679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8680"/>et humiliati sunt in iniquitatibus suis. <l eID="gen8680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3840"/><l level="1" sID="gen8681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3840"/>Et vidit cum tribularentur, <l eID="gen8681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8682"/>et audivit orationem eorum. <l eID="gen8682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3841"/><l level="1" sID="gen8683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3841"/>Et memor fuit testamenti sui, <l eID="gen8683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8684"/>et pœnituit eum secundum multitudinem misericordiæ suæ : <l eID="gen8684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3842"/><l level="1" sID="gen8685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3842"/>et dedit eos in misericordias, <l eID="gen8685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8686"/>in conspectu omnium qui ceperant eos. <l eID="gen8686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3843"/><l level="1" sID="gen8687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3843"/>Salvos nos fac, Domine Deus noster, <l eID="gen8687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8688"/>et congrega nos de nationibus : <l eID="gen8688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8689"/>ut confiteamur nomini sancto tuo, <l eID="gen8689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8690"/>et gloriemur in laude tua. <l eID="gen8690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 105:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3844"/><l level="1" sID="gen8691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3844"/>Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, a sæculo et usque in sæculum ; <l eID="gen8691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8692"/>et dicet omnis populus : Fiat, fiat. <l eID="gen8692" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8588"/> <chapter eID="Ps.105"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen8693" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8694"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8695"/>Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, <l eID="gen8695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8696"/>quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen8696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3845"/><l level="1" sID="gen8697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3845"/>Dicant qui redempti sunt a Domino, <l eID="gen8697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8698"/>quos redemit de manu inimici, <l eID="gen8698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8699"/>et de regionibus congregavit eos, <l eID="gen8699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3846"/><l level="1" sID="gen8700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3846"/>a solis ortu, et occasu, ab aquilone, et mari. <l eID="gen8700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3847"/><l level="1" sID="gen8701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3847"/>Erraverunt in solitudine, in inaquoso ; <l eID="gen8701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8702"/>viam civitatis habitaculi non invenerunt. <l eID="gen8702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3848"/><l level="1" sID="gen8703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3848"/>Esurientes et sitientes, <l eID="gen8703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8704"/>anima eorum in ipsis defecit. <l eID="gen8704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3849"/><l level="1" sID="gen8705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3849"/>Et clamaverunt ad Dominum cum tribularentur, <l eID="gen8705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8706"/>et de necessitatibus eorum eripuit eos ; <l eID="gen8706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3850"/><l level="1" sID="gen8707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3850"/>et deduxit eos in viam rectam, <l eID="gen8707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8708"/>ut irent in civitatem habitationis. <l eID="gen8708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3851"/><l level="1" sID="gen8709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3851"/>Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, <l eID="gen8709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8710"/>et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum. <l eID="gen8710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3852"/><l level="1" sID="gen8711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3852"/>Quia satiavit animam inanem, <l eID="gen8711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8712"/>et animam esurientem satiavit bonis. <l eID="gen8712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3853"/><l level="1" sID="gen8713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3853"/>Sedentes in tenebris et umbra mortis ; <l eID="gen8713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8714"/>vinctos in mendicitate et ferro. <l eID="gen8714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3854"/><l level="1" sID="gen8715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3854"/>Quia exacerbaverunt eloquia Dei, <l eID="gen8715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8716"/>et consilium Altissimi irritaverunt. <l eID="gen8716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3855"/><l level="1" sID="gen8717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3855"/>Et humiliatum est in laboribus cor eorum ; <l eID="gen8717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8718"/>infirmati sunt, nec fuit qui adjuvaret. <l eID="gen8718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3856"/><l level="1" sID="gen8719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3856"/>Et clamaverunt ad Dominum cum tribularentur ; <l eID="gen8719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8720"/>et de necessitatibus eorum liberavit eos. <l eID="gen8720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3857"/><l level="1" sID="gen8721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3857"/>Et eduxit eos de tenebris et umbra mortis, <l eID="gen8721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8722"/>et vincula eorum dirupit. <l eID="gen8722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3858"/><l level="1" sID="gen8723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3858"/>Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, <l eID="gen8723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8724"/>et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum. <l eID="gen8724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3859"/><l level="1" sID="gen8725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3859"/>Quia contrivit portas æreas, <l eID="gen8725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8726"/>et vectes ferreos confregit. <l eID="gen8726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3860"/><l level="1" sID="gen8727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3860"/>Suscepit eos de via iniquitatis eorum ; <l eID="gen8727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8728"/>propter injustitias enim suas humiliati sunt. <l eID="gen8728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3861"/><l level="1" sID="gen8729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3861"/>Omnem escam abominata est anima eorum, <l eID="gen8729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8730"/>et appropinquaverunt usque ad portas mortis. <l eID="gen8730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3862"/><l level="1" sID="gen8731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3862"/>Et clamaverunt ad Dominum cum tribularentur, <l eID="gen8731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8732"/>et de necessitatibus eorum liberavit eos. <l eID="gen8732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3863"/><l level="1" sID="gen8733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3863"/>Misit verbum suum, et sanavit eos, <l eID="gen8733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8734"/>et eripuit eos de interitionibus eorum. <l eID="gen8734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3864"/><l level="1" sID="gen8735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3864"/>Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, <l eID="gen8735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8736"/>et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum. <l eID="gen8736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3865"/><l level="1" sID="gen8737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3865"/>Et sacrificent sacrificium laudis, <l eID="gen8737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8738"/>et annuntient opera ejus in exsultatione. <l eID="gen8738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3866"/><l level="1" sID="gen8739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3866"/>Qui descendunt mare in navibus, <l eID="gen8739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8740"/>facientes operationem in aquis multis : <l eID="gen8740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3867"/><l level="1" sID="gen8741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3867"/>ipsi viderunt opera Domini, <l eID="gen8741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8742"/>et mirabilia ejus in profundo. <l eID="gen8742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3868"/><l level="1" sID="gen8743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3868"/>Dixit, et stetit spiritus procellæ, <l eID="gen8743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8744"/>et exaltati sunt fluctus ejus. <l eID="gen8744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3869"/><l level="1" sID="gen8745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3869"/>Ascendunt usque ad cælos, et descendunt usque ad abyssos ; <l eID="gen8745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8746"/>anima eorum in malis tabescebat. <l eID="gen8746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3870"/><l level="1" sID="gen8747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3870"/>Turbati sunt, et moti sunt sicut ebrius, <l eID="gen8747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8748"/>et omnis sapientia eorum devorata est. <l eID="gen8748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3871"/><l level="1" sID="gen8749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3871"/>Et clamaverunt ad Dominum cum tribularentur ; <l eID="gen8749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8750"/>et de necessitatibus eorum eduxit eos. <l eID="gen8750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3872"/><l level="1" sID="gen8751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3872"/>Et statuit procellam ejus in auram, <l eID="gen8751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8752"/>et siluerunt fluctus ejus. <l eID="gen8752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3873"/><l level="1" sID="gen8753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3873"/>Et lætati sunt quia siluerunt ; <l eID="gen8753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8754"/>et deduxit eos in portum voluntatis eorum. <l eID="gen8754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3874"/><l level="1" sID="gen8755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3874"/>Confiteantur Domino misericordiæ ejus, <l eID="gen8755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8756"/>et mirabilia ejus filiis hominum. <l eID="gen8756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3875"/><l level="1" sID="gen8757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3875"/>Et exaltent eum in ecclesia plebis, <l eID="gen8757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8758"/>et in cathedra seniorum laudent eum. <l eID="gen8758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3876"/><l level="1" sID="gen8759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3876"/>Posuit flumina in desertum, <l eID="gen8759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8760"/>et exitus aquarum in sitim ; <l eID="gen8760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3877"/><l level="1" sID="gen8761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3877"/>terram fructiferam in salsuginem, <l eID="gen8761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8762"/>a malitia inhabitantium in ea. <l eID="gen8762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3878"/><l level="1" sID="gen8763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3878"/>Posuit desertum in stagna aquarum, <l eID="gen8763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8764"/>et terram sine aqua in exitus aquarum. <l eID="gen8764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3879"/><l level="1" sID="gen8765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3879"/>Et collocavit illic esurientes, <l eID="gen8765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8766"/>et constituerunt civitatem habitationis : <l eID="gen8766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3880"/><l level="1" sID="gen8767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3880"/>et seminaverunt agros et plantaverunt vineas, <l eID="gen8767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8768"/>et fecerunt fructum nativitatis. <l eID="gen8768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3881"/><l level="1" sID="gen8769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3881"/>Et benedixit eis, et multiplicati sunt nimis ; <l eID="gen8769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8770"/>et jumenta eorum non minoravit. <l eID="gen8770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3882"/><l level="1" sID="gen8771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3882"/>Et pauci facti sunt et vexati sunt, <l eID="gen8771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8772"/>a tribulatione malorum et dolore. <l eID="gen8772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3883"/><l level="1" sID="gen8773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3883"/>Effusa est contemptio super principes : <l eID="gen8773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8774"/>et errare fecit eos in invio, et non in via. <l eID="gen8774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3884"/><l level="1" sID="gen8775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3884"/>Et adjuvit pauperem de inopia, <l eID="gen8775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8776"/>et posuit sicut oves familias. <l eID="gen8776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3885"/><l level="1" sID="gen8777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3885"/>Videbunt recti, et lætabuntur ; <l eID="gen8777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8778"/>et omnis iniquitas oppilabit os suum. <l eID="gen8778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 106:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3886"/><l level="1" sID="gen8779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3886"/>Quis sapiens, et custodiet hæc, <l eID="gen8779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8780"/>et intelliget misericordias Domini ? <l eID="gen8780" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8694"/> <chapter eID="Ps.106"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:1
verses.text: Canticum Psalmi, ipsi David.  <div eID="gen8781" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3887"/><lg sID="gen8782"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3887"/>Paratum cor meum, Deus, paratum cor meum ; <l eID="gen8783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8784"/>cantabo, et psallam in gloria mea. <l eID="gen8784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3888"/><l level="1" sID="gen8785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3888"/>Exsurge, gloria mea ; exsurge, psalterium et cithara ; <l eID="gen8785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8786"/>exsurgam diluculo. <l eID="gen8786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3889"/><l level="1" sID="gen8787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3889"/>Confitebor tibi in populis, Domine, <l eID="gen8787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8788"/>et psallam tibi in nationibus : <l eID="gen8788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3890"/><l level="1" sID="gen8789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3890"/>quia magna est super cælos misericordia tua, <l eID="gen8789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8790"/>et usque ad nubes veritas tua. <l eID="gen8790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3891"/><l level="1" sID="gen8791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3891"/>Exaltare super cælos, Deus, <l eID="gen8791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8792"/>et super omnem terram gloria tua : <l eID="gen8792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3892"/><l level="1" sID="gen8793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3892"/>ut liberentur dilecti tui. <l eID="gen8793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8794"/>Salvum fac dextera tua, et exaudi me. <l eID="gen8794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3893"/><l level="1" sID="gen8795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3893"/>Deus locutus est in sancto suo : <l eID="gen8795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8796"/>Exsultabo, et dividam Sichimam ; <l eID="gen8796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8797"/>et convallem tabernaculorum dimetiar. <l eID="gen8797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3894"/><l level="1" sID="gen8798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3894"/>Meus est Galaad, et meus est Manasses, <l eID="gen8798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8799"/>et Ephraim susceptio capitis mei. <l eID="gen8799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8800"/>Juda rex meus ;

verses.name: Psalms 107:10
verses.text: Moab lebes spei meæ : <l eID="gen8800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8801"/>in Idumæam extendam calceamentum meum ; <l eID="gen8801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8802"/>mihi alienigenæ amici facti sunt. <l eID="gen8802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3895"/><l level="1" sID="gen8803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3895"/>Quis deducet me in civitatem munitam ? <l eID="gen8803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8804"/>quis deducet me usque in Idumæam ? <l eID="gen8804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3896"/><l level="1" sID="gen8805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3896"/>nonne tu, Deus, qui repulisti nos ? <l eID="gen8805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8806"/>et non exibis, Deus, in virtutibus nostris ? <l eID="gen8806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3897"/><l level="1" sID="gen8807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3897"/>Da nobis auxilium de tribulatione, <l eID="gen8807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8808"/>quia vana salus hominis. <l eID="gen8808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 107:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3898"/><l level="1" sID="gen8809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3898"/>In Deo faciemus virtutem ; <l eID="gen8809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8810"/>et ipse ad nihilum deducet inimicos nostros. <l eID="gen8810" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8782"/> <chapter eID="Ps.107"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen8811" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3899"/><lg sID="gen8812"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3899"/>Deus, laudem meam ne tacueris, <l eID="gen8813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8814"/>quia os peccatoris et os dolosi super me apertum est. <l eID="gen8814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3900"/><l level="1" sID="gen8815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3900"/>Locuti sunt adversum me lingua dolosa, <l eID="gen8815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8816"/>et sermonibus odii circumdederunt me : <l eID="gen8816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8817"/>et expugnaverunt me gratis. <l eID="gen8817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3901"/><l level="1" sID="gen8818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3901"/>Pro eo ut me diligerent, detrahebant mihi ; <l eID="gen8818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8819"/>ego autem orabam. <l eID="gen8819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3902"/><l level="1" sID="gen8820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3902"/>Et posuerunt adversum me mala pro bonis, <l eID="gen8820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8821"/>et odium pro dilectione mea. <l eID="gen8821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3903"/><l level="1" sID="gen8822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3903"/>Constitue super eum peccatorem, <l eID="gen8822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8823"/>et diabolus stet a dextris ejus. <l eID="gen8823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3904"/><l level="1" sID="gen8824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3904"/>Cum judicatur, exeat condemnatus ; <l eID="gen8824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8825"/>et oratio ejus fiat in peccatum. <l eID="gen8825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3905"/><l level="1" sID="gen8826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3905"/>Fiant dies ejus pauci, <l eID="gen8826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8827"/>et episcopatum ejus accipiat alter. <l eID="gen8827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3906"/><l level="1" sID="gen8828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3906"/>Fiant filii ejus orphani, <l eID="gen8828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8829"/>et uxor ejus vidua. <l eID="gen8829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3907"/><l level="1" sID="gen8830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3907"/>Nutantes transferantur filii ejus et mendicent, <l eID="gen8830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8831"/>et ejiciantur de habitationibus suis. <l eID="gen8831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3908"/><l level="1" sID="gen8832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3908"/>Scrutetur fœnerator omnem substantiam ejus, <l eID="gen8832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8833"/>et diripiant alieni labores ejus. <l eID="gen8833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3909"/><l level="1" sID="gen8834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3909"/>Non sit illi adjutor, <l eID="gen8834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8835"/>nec sit qui misereatur pupillis ejus. <l eID="gen8835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3910"/><l level="1" sID="gen8836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3910"/>Fiant nati ejus in interitum ; <l eID="gen8836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8837"/>in generatione una deleatur nomen ejus. <l eID="gen8837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3911"/><l level="1" sID="gen8838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3911"/>In memoriam redeat iniquitas patrum ejus in conspectu Domini, <l eID="gen8838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8839"/>et peccatum matris ejus non deleatur. <l eID="gen8839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3912"/><l level="1" sID="gen8840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3912"/>Fiant contra Dominum semper, <l eID="gen8840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8841"/>et dispereat de terra memoria eorum : <l eID="gen8841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3913"/><l level="1" sID="gen8842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3913"/>pro eo quod non est recordatus facere misericordiam, <l eID="gen8842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3914"/><l level="1" sID="gen8843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3914"/>et persecutus est hominem inopem et mendicum, <l eID="gen8843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8844"/>et compunctum corde, mortificare. <l eID="gen8844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3915"/><l level="1" sID="gen8845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3915"/>Et dilexit maledictionem, et veniet ei ; <l eID="gen8845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8846"/>et noluit benedictionem, et elongabitur ab eo. <l eID="gen8846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8847"/>Et induit maledictionem sicut vestimentum ; <l eID="gen8847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8848"/>et intravit sicut aqua in interiora ejus, <l eID="gen8848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8849"/>et sicut oleum in ossibus ejus. <l eID="gen8849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3916"/><l level="1" sID="gen8850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3916"/>Fiat ei sicut vestimentum quo operitur, <l eID="gen8850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8851"/>et sicut zona qua semper præcingitur. <l eID="gen8851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3917"/><l level="1" sID="gen8852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3917"/>Hoc opus eorum qui detrahunt mihi apud Dominum, <l eID="gen8852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8853"/>et qui loquuntur mala adversus animam meam. <l eID="gen8853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3918"/><l level="1" sID="gen8854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3918"/>Et tu, Domine, Domine, fac mecum propter nomen tuum, <l eID="gen8854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8855"/>quia suavis est misericordia tua. <l eID="gen8855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3919"/><l level="1" sID="gen8856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3919"/>Libera me, quia egenus et pauper ego sum, <l eID="gen8856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8857"/>et cor meum conturbatum est intra me. <l eID="gen8857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3920"/><l level="1" sID="gen8858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3920"/>Sicut umbra cum declinat ablatus sum, <l eID="gen8858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8859"/>et excussus sum sicut locustæ. <l eID="gen8859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3921"/><l level="1" sID="gen8860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3921"/>Genua mea infirmata sunt a jejunio, <l eID="gen8860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8861"/>et caro mea immutata est propter oleum. <l eID="gen8861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3922"/><l level="1" sID="gen8862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3922"/>Et ego factus sum opprobrium illis ; <l eID="gen8862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8863"/>viderunt me, et moverunt capita sua. <l eID="gen8863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3923"/><l level="1" sID="gen8864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3923"/>Adjuva me, Domine Deus meus ; <l eID="gen8864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8865"/>salvum me fac secundum misericordiam tuam. <l eID="gen8865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3924"/><l level="1" sID="gen8866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3924"/>Et sciant quia manus tua hæc, <l eID="gen8866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8867"/>et tu, Domine, fecisti eam. <l eID="gen8867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3925"/><l level="1" sID="gen8868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3925"/>Maledicent illi, et tu benedices : <l eID="gen8868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8869"/>qui insurgunt in me confundantur ; <l eID="gen8869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8870"/>servus autem tuus lætabitur. <l eID="gen8870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3926"/><l level="1" sID="gen8871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3926"/>Induantur qui detrahunt mihi pudore, <l eID="gen8871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8872"/>et operiantur sicut diploide confusione sua. <l eID="gen8872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3927"/><l level="1" sID="gen8873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3927"/>Confitebor Domino nimis in ore meo, <l eID="gen8873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8874"/>et in medio multorum laudabo eum : <l eID="gen8874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 108:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3928"/><l level="1" sID="gen8875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3928"/>quia astitit a dextris pauperis, <l eID="gen8875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8876"/>ut salvam faceret a persequentibus animam meam. <l eID="gen8876" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8812"/> <chapter eID="Ps.108"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:1
verses.text: Psalmus David. <div eID="gen8877" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8878"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8879"/>Dixit Dominus Domino meo : <l eID="gen8879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8880"/>Sede a dextris meis, <l eID="gen8880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8881"/>donec ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum. <l eID="gen8881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3929"/><l level="1" sID="gen8882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3929"/>Virgam virtutis tuæ emittet Dominus ex Sion : <l eID="gen8882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8883"/>dominare in medio inimicorum tuorum. <l eID="gen8883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3930"/><l level="1" sID="gen8884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3930"/>Tecum principium in die virtutis tuæ <l eID="gen8884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8885"/>in splendoribus sanctorum : <l eID="gen8885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8886"/>ex utero, ante luciferum, genui te. <l eID="gen8886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3931"/><l level="1" sID="gen8887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3931"/>Juravit Dominus, et non pœnitebit eum : <l eID="gen8887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8888"/>Tu es sacerdos in æternum <l eID="gen8888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8889"/>secundum ordinem Melchisedech. <l eID="gen8889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3932"/><l level="1" sID="gen8890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3932"/>Dominus a dextris tuis ; <l eID="gen8890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8891"/>confregit in die iræ suæ reges. <l eID="gen8891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3933"/><l level="1" sID="gen8892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3933"/>Judicabit in nationibus, implebit ruinas ; <l eID="gen8892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8893"/>conquassabit capita in terra multorum. <l eID="gen8893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 109:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3934"/><l level="1" sID="gen8894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3934"/>De torrente in via bibet ; <l eID="gen8894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8895"/>propterea exaltabit caput. <l eID="gen8895" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8878"/> <chapter eID="Ps.109"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen8896" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8897"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8898"/>Confitebor tibi, Domine, in toto corde meo, <l eID="gen8898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8899"/>in consilio justorum, et congregatione. <l eID="gen8899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3935"/><l level="1" sID="gen8900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3935"/>Magna opera Domini : <l eID="gen8900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8901"/>exquisita in omnes voluntates ejus. <l eID="gen8901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3936"/><l level="1" sID="gen8902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3936"/>Confessio et magnificentia opus ejus, <l eID="gen8902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8903"/>et justitia ejus manet in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen8903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3937"/><l level="1" sID="gen8904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3937"/>Memoriam fecit mirabilium suorum, <l eID="gen8904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8905"/>misericors et miserator Dominus. <l eID="gen8905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3938"/><l level="1" sID="gen8906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3938"/>Escam dedit timentibus se ; <l eID="gen8906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8907"/>memor erit in sæculum testamenti sui. <l eID="gen8907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3939"/><l level="1" sID="gen8908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3939"/>Virtutem operum suorum annuntiabit populo suo, <l eID="gen8908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3940"/><l level="1" sID="gen8909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3940"/>ut det illis hæreditatem gentium. <l eID="gen8909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8910"/>Opera manuum ejus veritas et judicium. <l eID="gen8910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3941"/><l level="1" sID="gen8911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3941"/>Fidelia omnia mandata ejus, <l eID="gen8911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8912"/>confirmata in sæculum sæculi, <l eID="gen8912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8913"/>facta in veritate et æquitate. <l eID="gen8913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3942"/><l level="1" sID="gen8914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3942"/>Redemptionem misit populo suo ; <l eID="gen8914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8915"/>mandavit in æternum testamentum suum. <l eID="gen8915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8916"/>Sanctum et terribile nomen ejus. <l eID="gen8916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 110:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3943"/><l level="1" sID="gen8917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3943"/>Initium sapientiæ timor Domini ; <l eID="gen8917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8918"/>intellectus bonus omnibus facientibus eum : <l eID="gen8918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8919"/>laudatio ejus manet in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen8919" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8897"/> <chapter eID="Ps.110"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:1
verses.text: Alleluja, reversionis Aggæi et Zachariæ. <div eID="gen8920" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8921"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8922"/>Beatus vir qui timet Dominum : <l eID="gen8922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8923"/>in mandatis ejus volet nimis. <l eID="gen8923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3944"/><l level="1" sID="gen8924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3944"/>Potens in terra erit semen ejus ; <l eID="gen8924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8925"/>generatio rectorum benedicetur. <l eID="gen8925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3945"/><l level="1" sID="gen8926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3945"/>Gloria et divitiæ in domo ejus, <l eID="gen8926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8927"/>et justitia ejus manet in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen8927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3946"/><l level="1" sID="gen8928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3946"/>Exortum est in tenebris lumen rectis : <l eID="gen8928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8929"/>misericors, et miserator, et justus. <l eID="gen8929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3947"/><l level="1" sID="gen8930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3947"/>Jucundus homo qui miseretur et commodat ; <l eID="gen8930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8931"/>disponet sermones suos in judicio : <l eID="gen8931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3948"/><l level="1" sID="gen8932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3948"/>quia in æternum non commovebitur. <l eID="gen8932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3949"/><l level="1" sID="gen8933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3949"/>In memoria æterna erit justus ; <l eID="gen8933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8934"/>ab auditione mala non timebit. <l eID="gen8934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8935"/>Paratum cor ejus sperare in Domino, <l eID="gen8935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3950"/><l level="1" sID="gen8936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3950"/>confirmatum est cor ejus ; <l eID="gen8936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8937"/>non commovebitur donec despiciat inimicos suos. <l eID="gen8937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3951"/><l level="1" sID="gen8938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3951"/>Dispersit, dedit pauperibus ; <l eID="gen8938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8939"/>justitia ejus manet in sæculum sæculi : <l eID="gen8939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8940"/>cornu ejus exaltabitur in gloria. <l eID="gen8940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 111:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3952"/><l level="1" sID="gen8941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3952"/>Peccator videbit, et irascetur ; <l eID="gen8941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8942"/>dentibus suis fremet et tabescet : <l eID="gen8942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8943"/>desiderium peccatorum peribit. <l eID="gen8943" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8921"/> <chapter eID="Ps.111"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen8944" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8945"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8946"/>Laudate, pueri, Dominum ; <l eID="gen8946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8947"/>laudate nomen Domini. <l eID="gen8947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3953"/><l level="1" sID="gen8948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3953"/>Sit nomen Domini benedictum <l eID="gen8948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8949"/>ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum. <l eID="gen8949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3954"/><l level="1" sID="gen8950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3954"/>A solis ortu usque ad occasum <l eID="gen8950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8951"/>laudabile nomen Domini. <l eID="gen8951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3955"/><l level="1" sID="gen8952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3955"/>Excelsus super omnes gentes Dominus, <l eID="gen8952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8953"/>et super cælos gloria ejus. <l eID="gen8953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3956"/><l level="1" sID="gen8954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3956"/>Quis sicut Dominus Deus noster, qui in altis habitat, <l eID="gen8954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3957"/><l level="1" sID="gen8955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3957"/>et humilia respicit in cælo et in terra ? <l eID="gen8955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3958"/><l level="1" sID="gen8956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3958"/>Suscitans a terra inopem, <l eID="gen8956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8957"/>et de stercore erigens pauperem : <l eID="gen8957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3959"/><l level="1" sID="gen8958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3959"/>ut collocet eum cum principibus, <l eID="gen8958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8959"/>cum principibus populi sui. <l eID="gen8959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 112:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3960"/><l level="1" sID="gen8960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3960"/>Qui habitare facit sterilem in domo, <l eID="gen8960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8961"/>matrem filiorum lætantem. <l eID="gen8961" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8945"/> <chapter eID="Ps.112"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen8962" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen8963"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8964"/>In exitu Israël de Ægypto, <l eID="gen8964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8965"/>domus Jacob de populo barbaro, <l eID="gen8965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3961"/><l level="1" sID="gen8966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3961"/>facta est Judæa sanctificatio ejus ; <l eID="gen8966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8967"/>Israël potestas ejus. <l eID="gen8967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3962"/><l level="1" sID="gen8968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3962"/>Mare vidit, et fugit ; <l eID="gen8968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8969"/>Jordanis conversus est retrorsum. <l eID="gen8969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3963"/><l level="1" sID="gen8970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3963"/>Montes exsultaverunt ut arietes, <l eID="gen8970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8971"/>et colles sicut agni ovium. <l eID="gen8971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3964"/><l level="1" sID="gen8972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3964"/>Quid est tibi, mare, quod fugisti ? <l eID="gen8972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8973"/>et tu, Jordanis, quia conversus es retrorsum ? <l eID="gen8973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3965"/><l level="1" sID="gen8974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3965"/>montes, exsultastis sicut arietes ? <l eID="gen8974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8975"/>et colles, sicut agni ovium ? <l eID="gen8975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3966"/><l level="1" sID="gen8976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3966"/>A facie Domini mota est terra, <l eID="gen8976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8977"/>a facie Dei Jacob : <l eID="gen8977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3967"/><l level="1" sID="gen8978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3967"/>qui convertit petram in stagna aquarum, <l eID="gen8978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8979"/>et rupem in fontes aquarum. <l eID="gen8979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3968"/><l level="1" sID="gen8980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3968"/>Non nobis, Domine, non nobis, <l eID="gen8980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8981"/>sed nomini tuo da gloriam : <l eID="gen8981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3969"/><l level="1" sID="gen8982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3969"/>super misericordia tua et veritate tua ; <l eID="gen8982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8983"/>nequando dicant gentes : <l eID="gen8983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8984"/>Ubi est Deus eorum ? <l eID="gen8984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3970"/><l level="1" sID="gen8985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3970"/>Deus autem noster in cælo ; <l eID="gen8985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8986"/>omnia quæcumque voluit fecit. <l eID="gen8986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3971"/><l level="1" sID="gen8987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3971"/>Simulacra gentium argentum et aurum, <l eID="gen8987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8988"/>opera manuum hominum. <l eID="gen8988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3972"/><l level="1" sID="gen8989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3972"/>Os habent, et non loquentur ; <l eID="gen8989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8990"/>oculos habent, et non videbunt. <l eID="gen8990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3973"/><l level="1" sID="gen8991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3973"/>Aures habent, et non audient ; <l eID="gen8991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8992"/>nares habent, et non odorabunt. <l eID="gen8992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3974"/><l level="1" sID="gen8993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3974"/>Manus habent, et non palpabunt ; <l eID="gen8993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8994"/>pedes habent, et non ambulabunt ; <l eID="gen8994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8995"/>non clamabunt in gutture suo. <l eID="gen8995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3975"/><l level="1" sID="gen8996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3975"/>Similes illis fiant qui faciunt ea, <l eID="gen8996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8997"/>et omnes qui confidunt in eis. <l eID="gen8997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3976"/><l level="1" sID="gen8998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3976"/>Domus Israël speravit in Domino ; <l eID="gen8998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen8999"/>adjutor eorum et protector eorum est. <l eID="gen8999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3977"/><l level="1" sID="gen9000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3977"/>Domus Aaron speravit in Domino ; <l eID="gen9000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9001"/>adjutor eorum et protector eorum est. <l eID="gen9001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3978"/><l level="1" sID="gen9002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3978"/>Qui timent Dominum speraverunt in Domino ; adjutor eorum et protector eorum est. <l eID="gen9002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3979"/><l level="1" sID="gen9003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3979"/>Dominus memor fuit nostri, <l eID="gen9003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9004"/>et benedixit nobis. <l eID="gen9004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9005"/>Benedixit domui Israël ; <l eID="gen9005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9006"/>benedixit domui Aaron. <l eID="gen9006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3980"/><l level="1" sID="gen9007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3980"/>Benedixit omnibus qui timent Dominum, <l eID="gen9007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9008"/>pusillis cum majoribus. <l eID="gen9008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3981"/><l level="1" sID="gen9009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3981"/>Adjiciat Dominus super vos, <l eID="gen9009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9010"/>super vos et super filios vestros. <l eID="gen9010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3982"/><l level="1" sID="gen9011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3982"/>Benedicti vos a Domino, <l eID="gen9011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9012"/>qui fecit cælum et terram. <l eID="gen9012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3983"/><l level="1" sID="gen9013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3983"/>Cælum cæli Domino ; <l eID="gen9013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9014"/>terram autem dedit filiis hominum. <l eID="gen9014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3984"/><l level="1" sID="gen9015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3984"/>Non mortui laudabunt te, Domine, <l eID="gen9015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9016"/>neque omnes qui descendunt in infernum : <l eID="gen9016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 113:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3985"/><l level="1" sID="gen9017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3985"/>sed nos qui vivimus, benedicimus Domino, <l eID="gen9017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9018"/>ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum. <l eID="gen9018" level="1"/><lg eID="gen8963"/> <chapter eID="Ps.113"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen9019" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9020"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9021"/>Dilexi, quoniam exaudiet Dominus <l eID="gen9021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9022"/>vocem orationis meæ. <l eID="gen9022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3986"/><l level="1" sID="gen9023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3986"/>Quia inclinavit aurem suam mihi, <l eID="gen9023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9024"/>et in diebus meis invocabo. <l eID="gen9024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3987"/><l level="1" sID="gen9025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3987"/>Circumdederunt me dolores mortis ; <l eID="gen9025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9026"/>et pericula inferni invenerunt me. <l eID="gen9026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9027"/>Tribulationem et dolorem inveni, <l eID="gen9027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3988"/><l level="1" sID="gen9028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3988"/>et nomen Domini invocavi : <l eID="gen9028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9029"/>o Domine, libera animam meam. <l eID="gen9029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3989"/><l level="1" sID="gen9030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3989"/>Misericors Dominus et justus, <l eID="gen9030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9031"/>et Deus noster miseretur. <l eID="gen9031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3990"/><l level="1" sID="gen9032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3990"/>Custodiens parvulos Dominus ; <l eID="gen9032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9033"/>humiliatus sum, et liberavit me. <l eID="gen9033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3991"/><l level="1" sID="gen9034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3991"/>Convertere, anima mea, in requiem tuam, <l eID="gen9034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9035"/>quia Dominus benefecit tibi : <l eID="gen9035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3992"/><l level="1" sID="gen9036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3992"/>quia eripuit animam meam de morte, <l eID="gen9036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9037"/>oculos meos a lacrimis, <l eID="gen9037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9038"/>pedes meos a lapsu. <l eID="gen9038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 114:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3993"/><l level="1" sID="gen9039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3993"/>Placebo Domino in regione vivorum. <l eID="gen9039" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9020"/> <chapter eID="Ps.114"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen9040" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9041"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9042"/>Credidi, propter quod locutus sum ; <l eID="gen9042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9043"/>ego autem humiliatus sum nimis. <l eID="gen9043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3994"/><l level="1" sID="gen9044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3994"/>Ego dixi in excessu meo : <l eID="gen9044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9045"/>Omnis homo mendax. <l eID="gen9045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3995"/><l level="1" sID="gen9046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3995"/>Quid retribuam Domino <l eID="gen9046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9047"/>pro omnibus quæ retribuit mihi ? <l eID="gen9047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3996"/><l level="1" sID="gen9048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3996"/>Calicem salutaris accipiam, <l eID="gen9048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9049"/>et nomen Domini invocabo. <l eID="gen9049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3997"/><l level="1" sID="gen9050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3997"/>Vota mea Domino reddam <l eID="gen9050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9051"/>coram omni populo ejus. <l eID="gen9051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3998"/><l level="1" sID="gen9052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3998"/>Pretiosa in conspectu Domini <l eID="gen9052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9053"/>mors sanctorum ejus. <l eID="gen9053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv3999"/><l level="1" sID="gen9054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv3999"/>O Domine, quia ego servus tuus ; <l eID="gen9054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9055"/>ego servus tuus, et filius ancillæ tuæ. <l eID="gen9055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9056"/>Dirupisti vincula mea : <l eID="gen9056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4000"/><l level="1" sID="gen9057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4000"/>tibi sacrificabo hostiam laudis, <l eID="gen9057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9058"/>et nomen Domini invocabo. <l eID="gen9058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4001"/><l level="1" sID="gen9059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4001"/>Vota mea Domino reddam <l eID="gen9059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9060"/>in conspectu omnis populi ejus ; <l eID="gen9060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 115:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4002"/><l level="1" sID="gen9061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4002"/>in atriis domus Domini, <l eID="gen9061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9062"/>in medio tui, Jerusalem. <l eID="gen9062" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9041"/> <chapter eID="Ps.115"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen9063" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9064"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9065"/>Laudate Dominum, omnes gentes ; <l eID="gen9065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9066"/>laudate eum, omnes populi. <l eID="gen9066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 116:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4003"/><l level="1" sID="gen9067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4003"/>Quoniam confirmata est super nos misericordia ejus, <l eID="gen9067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9068"/>et veritas Domini manet in æternum. <l eID="gen9068" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9064"/> <chapter eID="Ps.116"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen9069" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9070"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9071"/>Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, <l eID="gen9071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9072"/>quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4004"/><l level="1" sID="gen9073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4004"/>Dicat nunc Israël : Quoniam bonus, <l eID="gen9073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9074"/>quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4005"/><l level="1" sID="gen9075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4005"/>Dicat nunc domus Aaron : <l eID="gen9075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9076"/>Quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4006"/><l level="1" sID="gen9077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4006"/>Dicant nunc qui timent Dominum : <l eID="gen9077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9078"/>Quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4007"/><l level="1" sID="gen9079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4007"/>De tribulatione invocavi Dominum, <l eID="gen9079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9080"/>et exaudivit me in latitudine Dominus. <l eID="gen9080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4008"/><l level="1" sID="gen9081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4008"/>Dominus mihi adjutor ; <l eID="gen9081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9082"/>non timebo quid faciat mihi homo. <l eID="gen9082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4009"/><l level="1" sID="gen9083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4009"/>Dominus mihi adjutor, <l eID="gen9083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9084"/>et ego despiciam inimicos meos. <l eID="gen9084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4010"/><l level="1" sID="gen9085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4010"/>Bonum est confidere in Domino, <l eID="gen9085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9086"/>quam confidere in homine. <l eID="gen9086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4011"/><l level="1" sID="gen9087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4011"/>Bonum est sperare in Domino, <l eID="gen9087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9088"/>quam sperare in principibus. <l eID="gen9088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4012"/><l level="1" sID="gen9089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4012"/>Omnes gentes circuierunt me, <l eID="gen9089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9090"/>et in nomine Domini, quia ultus sum in eos. <l eID="gen9090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4013"/><l level="1" sID="gen9091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4013"/>Circumdantes circumdederunt me, <l eID="gen9091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9092"/>et in nomine Domini, quia ultus sum in eos. <l eID="gen9092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4014"/><l level="1" sID="gen9093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4014"/>Circumdederunt me sicut apes, <l eID="gen9093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9094"/>et exarserunt sicut ignis in spinis : <l eID="gen9094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9095"/>et in nomine Domini, quia ultus sum in eos. <l eID="gen9095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4015"/><l level="1" sID="gen9096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4015"/>Impulsus eversus sum, ut caderem, <l eID="gen9096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9097"/>et Dominus suscepit me. <l eID="gen9097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4016"/><l level="1" sID="gen9098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4016"/>Fortitudo mea et laus mea Dominus, <l eID="gen9098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9099"/>et factus est mihi in salutem. <l eID="gen9099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4017"/><l level="1" sID="gen9100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4017"/>Vox exsultationis et salutis <l eID="gen9100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9101"/>in tabernaculis justorum. <l eID="gen9101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4018"/><l level="1" sID="gen9102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4018"/>Dextera Domini fecit virtutem ; <l eID="gen9102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9103"/>dextera Domini exaltavit me : <l eID="gen9103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9104"/>dextera Domini fecit virtutem. <l eID="gen9104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4019"/><l level="1" sID="gen9105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4019"/>Non moriar, sed vivam, <l eID="gen9105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9106"/>et narrabo opera Domini. <l eID="gen9106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4020"/><l level="1" sID="gen9107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4020"/>Castigans castigavit me Dominus, <l eID="gen9107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9108"/>et morti non tradidit me. <l eID="gen9108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4021"/><l level="1" sID="gen9109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4021"/>Aperite mihi portas justitiæ : <l eID="gen9109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9110"/>ingressus in eas confitebor Domino. <l eID="gen9110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4022"/><l level="1" sID="gen9111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4022"/>Hæc porta Domini : <l eID="gen9111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9112"/>justi intrabunt in eam. <l eID="gen9112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4023"/><l level="1" sID="gen9113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4023"/>Confitebor tibi quoniam exaudisti me, <l eID="gen9113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9114"/>et factus es mihi in salutem. <l eID="gen9114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4024"/><l level="1" sID="gen9115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4024"/>Lapidem quem reprobaverunt ædificantes, <l eID="gen9115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9116"/>hic factus est in caput anguli. <l eID="gen9116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4025"/><l level="1" sID="gen9117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4025"/>A Domino factum est istud, <l eID="gen9117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9118"/>et est mirabile in oculis nostris. <l eID="gen9118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4026"/><l level="1" sID="gen9119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4026"/>Hæc est dies quam fecit Dominus ; <l eID="gen9119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9120"/>exsultemus, et lætemur in ea. <l eID="gen9120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4027"/><l level="1" sID="gen9121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4027"/>O Domine, salvum me fac ; <l eID="gen9121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9122"/>o Domine, bene prosperare. <l eID="gen9122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4028"/><l level="1" sID="gen9123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4028"/>Benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini : <l eID="gen9123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9124"/>benediximus vobis de domo Domini. <l eID="gen9124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4029"/><l level="1" sID="gen9125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4029"/>Deus Dominus, et illuxit nobis. <l eID="gen9125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9126"/>Constituite diem solemnem in condensis, <l eID="gen9126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9127"/>usque ad cornu altaris. <l eID="gen9127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4030"/><l level="1" sID="gen9128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4030"/>Deus meus es tu, et confitebor tibi ; <l eID="gen9128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9129"/>Deus meus es tu, et exaltabo te. <l eID="gen9129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9130"/>Confitebor tibi quoniam exaudisti me, <l eID="gen9130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9131"/>et factus es mihi in salutem. <l eID="gen9131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 117:29
