verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4031"/><l level="1" sID="gen9132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4031"/>Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, <l eID="gen9132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9133"/>quoniam in sæculum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9133" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9070"/> <chapter eID="Ps.117"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen9134" type="x-p"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Aleph</foreign></title> <lg sID="gen9135"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9136"/>Beati immaculati in via, <l eID="gen9136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9137"/>qui ambulant in lege Domini. <l eID="gen9137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4032"/><l level="1" sID="gen9138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4032"/>Beati qui scrutantur testimonia ejus ; <l eID="gen9138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9139"/>in toto corde exquirunt eum. <l eID="gen9139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4033"/><l level="1" sID="gen9140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4033"/>Non enim qui operantur iniquitatem <l eID="gen9140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9141"/>in viis ejus ambulaverunt. <l eID="gen9141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4034"/><l level="1" sID="gen9142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4034"/>Tu mandasti mandata tua <l eID="gen9142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9143"/>custodiri nimis. <l eID="gen9143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4035"/><l level="1" sID="gen9144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4035"/>Utinam dirigantur viæ meæ <l eID="gen9144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9145"/>ad custodiendas justificationes tuas. <l eID="gen9145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4036"/><l level="1" sID="gen9146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4036"/>Tunc non confundar, <l eID="gen9146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9147"/>cum perspexero in omnibus mandatis tuis. <l eID="gen9147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4037"/><l level="1" sID="gen9148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4037"/>Confitebor tibi in directione cordis, <l eID="gen9148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9149"/>in eo quod didici judicia justitiæ tuæ. <l eID="gen9149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4038"/><l level="1" sID="gen9150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4038"/>Justificationes tuas custodiam ; <l eID="gen9150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9151"/>non me derelinquas usquequaque. <l eID="gen9151" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9135"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Beth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4039"/><lg sID="gen9152"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4039"/>In quo corrigit adolescentior viam suam ? <l eID="gen9153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9154"/>in custodiendo sermones tuos. <l eID="gen9154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4040"/><l level="1" sID="gen9155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4040"/>In toto corde meo exquisivi te ; <l eID="gen9155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9156"/>ne repellas me a mandatis tuis. <l eID="gen9156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4041"/><l level="1" sID="gen9157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4041"/>In corde meo abscondi eloquia tua, <l eID="gen9157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9158"/>ut non peccem tibi. <l eID="gen9158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4042"/><l level="1" sID="gen9159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4042"/>Benedictus es, Domine ; <l eID="gen9159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9160"/>doce me justificationes tuas. <l eID="gen9160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4043"/><l level="1" sID="gen9161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4043"/>In labiis meis pronuntiavi omnia judicia oris tui. <l eID="gen9161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4044"/><l level="1" sID="gen9162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4044"/>In via testimoniorum tuorum delectatus sum, <l eID="gen9162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9163"/>sicut in omnibus divitiis. <l eID="gen9163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4045"/><l level="1" sID="gen9164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4045"/>In mandatis tuis exercebor, <l eID="gen9164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9165"/>et considerabo vias tuas. <l eID="gen9165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4046"/><l level="1" sID="gen9166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4046"/>In justificationibus tuis meditabor : <l eID="gen9166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9167"/>non obliviscar sermones tuos. <l eID="gen9167" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9152"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ghimel</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4047"/><lg sID="gen9168"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4047"/>Retribue servo tuo, vivifica me, <l eID="gen9169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9170"/>et custodiam sermones tuos. <l eID="gen9170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4048"/><l level="1" sID="gen9171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4048"/>Revela oculos meos, <l eID="gen9171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9172"/>et considerabo mirabilia de lege tua. <l eID="gen9172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4049"/><l level="1" sID="gen9173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4049"/>Incola ego sum in terra : <l eID="gen9173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9174"/>non abscondas a me mandata tua. <l eID="gen9174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4050"/><l level="1" sID="gen9175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4050"/>Concupivit anima mea <l eID="gen9175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9176"/>desiderare justificationes tuas in omni tempore. <l eID="gen9176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4051"/><l level="1" sID="gen9177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4051"/>Increpasti superbos ; <l eID="gen9177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9178"/>maledicti qui declinant a mandatis tuis. <l eID="gen9178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4052"/><l level="1" sID="gen9179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4052"/>Aufer a me opprobrium et contemptum, <l eID="gen9179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9180"/>quia testimonia tua exquisivi. <l eID="gen9180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4053"/><l level="1" sID="gen9181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4053"/>Etenim sederunt principes, et adversum me loquebantur ; <l eID="gen9181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9182"/>servus autem tuus exercebatur in justificationibus tuis. <l eID="gen9182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4054"/><l level="1" sID="gen9183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4054"/>Nam et testimonia tua meditatio mea est, <l eID="gen9183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9184"/>et consilium meum justificationes tuæ. <l eID="gen9184" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9168"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Daleth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4055"/><lg sID="gen9185"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4055"/>Adhæsit pavimento anima mea : <l eID="gen9186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9187"/>vivifica me secundum verbum tuum. <l eID="gen9187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4056"/><l level="1" sID="gen9188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4056"/>Vias meas enuntiavi, et exaudisti me ; <l eID="gen9188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9189"/>doce me justificationes tuas. <l eID="gen9189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4057"/><l level="1" sID="gen9190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4057"/>Viam justificationum tuarum instrue me, <l eID="gen9190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9191"/>et exercebor in mirabilibus tuis. <l eID="gen9191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4058"/><l level="1" sID="gen9192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4058"/>Dormitavit anima mea præ tædio : <l eID="gen9192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9193"/>confirma me in verbis tuis. <l eID="gen9193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4059"/><l level="1" sID="gen9194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4059"/>Viam iniquitatis amove a me, <l eID="gen9194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9195"/>et de lege tua miserere mei. <l eID="gen9195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4060"/><l level="1" sID="gen9196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4060"/>Viam veritatis elegi ; <l eID="gen9196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9197"/>judicia tua non sum oblitus. <l eID="gen9197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4061"/><l level="1" sID="gen9198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4061"/>Adhæsi testimoniis tuis, Domine ; <l eID="gen9198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9199"/>noli me confundere. <l eID="gen9199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4062"/><l level="1" sID="gen9200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4062"/>Viam mandatorum tuorum cucurri, <l eID="gen9200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9201"/>cum dilatasti cor meum. <l eID="gen9201" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9185"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">He</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4063"/><lg sID="gen9202"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4063"/>Legem pone mihi, Domine, viam justificationum tuarum, <l eID="gen9203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9204"/>et exquiram eam semper. <l eID="gen9204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4064"/><l level="1" sID="gen9205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4064"/>Da mihi intellectum, et scrutabor legem tuam, <l eID="gen9205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9206"/>et custodiam illam in toto corde meo. <l eID="gen9206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4065"/><l level="1" sID="gen9207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4065"/>Deduc me in semitam mandatorum tuorum, <l eID="gen9207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9208"/>quia ipsam volui. <l eID="gen9208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4066"/><l level="1" sID="gen9209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4066"/>Inclina cor meum in testimonia tua, <l eID="gen9209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9210"/>et non in avaritiam. <l eID="gen9210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4067"/><l level="1" sID="gen9211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4067"/>Averte oculos meos, ne videant vanitatem ; <l eID="gen9211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9212"/>in via tua vivifica me. <l eID="gen9212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4068"/><l level="1" sID="gen9213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4068"/>Statue servo tuo eloquium tuum <l eID="gen9213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9214"/>in timore tuo. <l eID="gen9214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4069"/><l level="1" sID="gen9215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4069"/>Amputa opprobrium meum quod suspicatus sum, <l eID="gen9215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9216"/>quia judicia tua jucunda. <l eID="gen9216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4070"/><l level="1" sID="gen9217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4070"/>Ecce concupivi mandata tua : <l eID="gen9217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9218"/>in æquitate tua vivifica me. <l eID="gen9218" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9202"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Vau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4071"/><lg sID="gen9219"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4071"/>Et veniat super me misericordia tua, Domine ; <l eID="gen9220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9221"/>salutare tuum secundum eloquium tuum. <l eID="gen9221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4072"/><l level="1" sID="gen9222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4072"/>Et respondebo exprobrantibus mihi verbum, <l eID="gen9222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9223"/>quia speravi in sermonibus tuis. <l eID="gen9223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4073"/><l level="1" sID="gen9224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4073"/>Et ne auferas de ore meo verbum veritatis usquequaque, <l eID="gen9224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9225"/>quia in judiciis tuis supersperavi. <l eID="gen9225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4074"/><l level="1" sID="gen9226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4074"/>Et custodiam legem tuam semper, <l eID="gen9226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9227"/>in sæculum et in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen9227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4075"/><l level="1" sID="gen9228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4075"/>Et ambulabam in latitudine, <l eID="gen9228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9229"/>quia mandata tua exquisivi. <l eID="gen9229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4076"/><l level="1" sID="gen9230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4076"/>Et loquebar in testimoniis tuis in conspectu regum, <l eID="gen9230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9231"/>et non confundebar. <l eID="gen9231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4077"/><l level="1" sID="gen9232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4077"/>Et meditabar in mandatis tuis, <l eID="gen9232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9233"/>quæ dilexi. <l eID="gen9233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4078"/><l level="1" sID="gen9234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4078"/>Et levavi manus meas ad mandata tua, quæ dilexi, <l eID="gen9234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9235"/>et exercebar in justificationibus tuis. <l eID="gen9235" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9219"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Zain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4079"/><lg sID="gen9236"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4079"/>Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo, <l eID="gen9237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9238"/>in quo mihi spem dedisti. <l eID="gen9238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4080"/><l level="1" sID="gen9239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4080"/>Hæc me consolata est in humilitate mea, <l eID="gen9239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9240"/>quia eloquium tuum vivificavit me. <l eID="gen9240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4081"/><l level="1" sID="gen9241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4081"/>Superbi inique agebant usquequaque ; <l eID="gen9241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9242"/>a lege autem tua non declinavi. <l eID="gen9242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4082"/><l level="1" sID="gen9243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4082"/>Memor fui judiciorum tuorum a sæculo, Domine, <l eID="gen9243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9244"/>et consolatus sum. <l eID="gen9244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4083"/><l level="1" sID="gen9245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4083"/>Defectio tenuit me, <l eID="gen9245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9246"/>pro peccatoribus derelinquentibus legem tuam. <l eID="gen9246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4084"/><l level="1" sID="gen9247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4084"/>Cantabiles mihi erant justificationes tuæ <l eID="gen9247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9248"/>in loco peregrinationis meæ. <l eID="gen9248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4085"/><l level="1" sID="gen9249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4085"/>Memor fui nocte nominis tui, Domine, <l eID="gen9249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9250"/>et custodivi legem tuam. <l eID="gen9250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4086"/><l level="1" sID="gen9251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4086"/>Hæc facta est mihi, <l eID="gen9251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9252"/>quia justificationes tuas exquisivi. <l eID="gen9252" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9236"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Heth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4087"/><lg sID="gen9253"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4087"/>Portio mea, Domine, <l eID="gen9254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9255"/>dixi custodire legem tuam. <l eID="gen9255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4088"/><l level="1" sID="gen9256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4088"/>Deprecatus sum faciem tuam in toto corde meo ; <l eID="gen9256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9257"/>miserere mei secundum eloquium tuum. <l eID="gen9257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4089"/><l level="1" sID="gen9258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4089"/>Cogitavi vias meas, <l eID="gen9258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9259"/>et converti pedes meos in testimonia tua. <l eID="gen9259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4090"/><l level="1" sID="gen9260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4090"/>Paratus sum, et non sum turbatus, <l eID="gen9260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9261"/>ut custodiam mandata tua. <l eID="gen9261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4091"/><l level="1" sID="gen9262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4091"/>Funes peccatorum circumplexi sunt me, <l eID="gen9262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9263"/>et legem tuam non sum oblitus. <l eID="gen9263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4092"/><l level="1" sID="gen9264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4092"/>Media nocte surgebam ad confitendum tibi, <l eID="gen9264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9265"/>super judicia justificationis tuæ. <l eID="gen9265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4093"/><l level="1" sID="gen9266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4093"/>Particeps ego sum omnium timentium te, <l eID="gen9266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9267"/>et custodientium mandata tua. <l eID="gen9267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:64
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4094"/><l level="1" sID="gen9268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4094"/>Misericordia tua, Domine, plena est terra ; <l eID="gen9268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9269"/>justificationes tuas doce me. <l eID="gen9269" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9253"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Teth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4095"/><lg sID="gen9270"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4095"/>Bonitatem fecisti cum servo tuo, Domine, <l eID="gen9271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9272"/>secundum verbum tuum. <l eID="gen9272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4096"/><l level="1" sID="gen9273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4096"/>Bonitatem, et disciplinam, et scientiam doce me, <l eID="gen9273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9274"/>quia mandatis tuis credidi. <l eID="gen9274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:67
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4097"/><l level="1" sID="gen9275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4097"/>Priusquam humiliarer ego deliqui : <l eID="gen9275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9276"/>propterea eloquium tuum custodivi. <l eID="gen9276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:68
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4098"/><l level="1" sID="gen9277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4098"/>Bonus es tu, et in bonitate tua <l eID="gen9277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9278"/>doce me justificationes tuas. <l eID="gen9278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:69
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4099"/><l level="1" sID="gen9279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4099"/>Multiplicata est super me iniquitas superborum ; <l eID="gen9279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9280"/>ego autem in toto corde meo scrutabor mandata tua. <l eID="gen9280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:70
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4100"/><l level="1" sID="gen9281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4100"/>Coagulatum est sicut lac cor eorum ; <l eID="gen9281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9282"/>ego vero legem tuam meditatus sum. <l eID="gen9282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:71
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4101"/><l level="1" sID="gen9283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4101"/>Bonum mihi quia humiliasti me, <l eID="gen9283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9284"/>ut discam justificationes tuas. <l eID="gen9284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:72
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4102"/><l level="1" sID="gen9285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4102"/>Bonum mihi lex oris tui, <l eID="gen9285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9286"/>super millia auri et argenti. <l eID="gen9286" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9270"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Jod</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:73
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4103"/><lg sID="gen9287"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4103"/>Manus tuæ fecerunt me, et plasmaverunt me : <l eID="gen9288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9289"/>da mihi intellectum, et discam mandata tua. <l eID="gen9289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:74
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4104"/><l level="1" sID="gen9290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4104"/>Qui timent te videbunt me et lætabuntur, <l eID="gen9290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9291"/>quia in verba tua supersperavi. <l eID="gen9291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:75
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4105"/><l level="1" sID="gen9292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4105"/>Cognovi, Domine, quia æquitas judicia tua, <l eID="gen9292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9293"/>et in veritate tua humiliasti me. <l eID="gen9293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:76
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4106"/><l level="1" sID="gen9294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4106"/>Fiat misericordia tua ut consoletur me, <l eID="gen9294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9295"/>secundum eloquium tuum servo tuo. <l eID="gen9295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:77
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4107"/><l level="1" sID="gen9296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4107"/>Veniant mihi miserationes tuæ, et vivam, <l eID="gen9296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9297"/>quia lex tua meditatio mea est. <l eID="gen9297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:78
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4108"/><l level="1" sID="gen9298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4108"/>Confundantur superbi, quia injuste iniquitatem fecerunt in me ; <l eID="gen9298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9299"/>ego autem exercebor in mandatis tuis. <l eID="gen9299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:79
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4109"/><l level="1" sID="gen9300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4109"/>Convertantur mihi timentes te, <l eID="gen9300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9301"/>et qui noverunt testimonia tua. <l eID="gen9301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:80
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4110"/><l level="1" sID="gen9302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4110"/>Fiat cor meum immaculatum in justificationibus tuis, <l eID="gen9302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9303"/>ut non confundar. <l eID="gen9303" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9287"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Caph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:81
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4111"/><lg sID="gen9304"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4111"/>Defecit in salutare tuum anima mea, <l eID="gen9305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9306"/>et in verbum tuum supersperavi. <l eID="gen9306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:82
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4112"/><l level="1" sID="gen9307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4112"/>Defecerunt oculi mei in eloquium tuum, <l eID="gen9307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9308"/>dicentes : Quando consolaberis me ? <l eID="gen9308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:83
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4113"/><l level="1" sID="gen9309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4113"/>Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruina ; <l eID="gen9309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9310"/>justificationes tuas non sum oblitus. <l eID="gen9310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:84
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4114"/><l level="1" sID="gen9311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4114"/>Quot sunt dies servi tui ? <l eID="gen9311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9312"/>quando facies de persequentibus me judicium ? <l eID="gen9312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:85
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4115"/><l level="1" sID="gen9313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4115"/>Narraverunt mihi iniqui fabulationes, <l eID="gen9313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9314"/>sed non ut lex tua. <l eID="gen9314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:86
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4116"/><l level="1" sID="gen9315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4116"/>Omnia mandata tua veritas : <l eID="gen9315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9316"/>inique persecuti sunt me, adjuva me. <l eID="gen9316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:87
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4117"/><l level="1" sID="gen9317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4117"/>Paulominus consummaverunt me in terra ; <l eID="gen9317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9318"/>ego autem non dereliqui mandata tua. <l eID="gen9318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:88
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4118"/><l level="1" sID="gen9319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4118"/>Secundum misericordiam tuam vivifica me, <l eID="gen9319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9320"/>et custodiam testimonia oris tui. <l eID="gen9320" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9304"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Lamed</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:89
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4119"/><lg sID="gen9321"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4119"/>In æternum, Domine, <l eID="gen9322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9323"/>verbum tuum permanet in cælo. <l eID="gen9323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:90
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4120"/><l level="1" sID="gen9324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4120"/>In generationem et generationem veritas tua ; <l eID="gen9324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9325"/>fundasti terram, et permanet. <l eID="gen9325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:91
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4121"/><l level="1" sID="gen9326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4121"/>Ordinatione tua perseverat dies, <l eID="gen9326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9327"/>quoniam omnia serviunt tibi. <l eID="gen9327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:92
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4122"/><l level="1" sID="gen9328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4122"/>Nisi quod lex tua meditatio mea est, <l eID="gen9328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9329"/>tunc forte periissem in humilitate mea. <l eID="gen9329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:93
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4123"/><l level="1" sID="gen9330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4123"/>In æternum non obliviscar justificationes tuas, <l eID="gen9330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9331"/>quia in ipsis vivificasti me. <l eID="gen9331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:94
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4124"/><l level="1" sID="gen9332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4124"/>Tuus sum ego ; salvum me fac : <l eID="gen9332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9333"/>quoniam justificationes tuas exquisivi. <l eID="gen9333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:95
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4125"/><l level="1" sID="gen9334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4125"/>Me exspectaverunt peccatores ut perderent me ; <l eID="gen9334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9335"/>testimonia tua intellexi. <l eID="gen9335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:96
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4126"/><l level="1" sID="gen9336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4126"/>Omnis consummationis vidi finem, <l eID="gen9336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9337"/>latum mandatum tuum nimis. <l eID="gen9337" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9321"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Mem</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:97
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4127"/><lg sID="gen9338"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4127"/>Quomodo dilexi legem tuam, Domine ! <l eID="gen9339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9340"/>tota die meditatio mea est. <l eID="gen9340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:98
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4128"/><l level="1" sID="gen9341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4128"/>Super inimicos meos prudentem me fecisti mandato tuo, <l eID="gen9341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9342"/>quia in æternum mihi est. <l eID="gen9342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:99
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4129"/><l level="1" sID="gen9343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4129"/>Super omnes docentes me intellexi, <l eID="gen9343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9344"/>quia testimonia tua meditatio mea est. <l eID="gen9344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:100
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4130"/><l level="1" sID="gen9345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4130"/>Super senes intellexi, <l eID="gen9345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9346"/>quia mandata tua quæsivi. <l eID="gen9346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:101
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4131"/><l level="1" sID="gen9347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4131"/>Ab omni via mala prohibui pedes meos, <l eID="gen9347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9348"/>ut custodiam verba tua. <l eID="gen9348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:102
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4132"/><l level="1" sID="gen9349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4132"/>A judiciis tuis non declinavi, <l eID="gen9349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9350"/>quia tu legem posuisti mihi. <l eID="gen9350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:103
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4133"/><l level="1" sID="gen9351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4133"/>Quam dulcia faucibus meis eloquia tua ! <l eID="gen9351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9352"/>super mel ori meo. <l eID="gen9352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:104
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4134"/><l level="1" sID="gen9353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4134"/>A mandatis tuis intellexi ; <l eID="gen9353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9354"/>propterea odivi omnem viam iniquitatis. <l eID="gen9354" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9338"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Nun</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:105
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4135"/><lg sID="gen9355"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4135"/>Lucerna pedibus meis verbum tuum, <l eID="gen9356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9357"/>et lumen semitis meis. <l eID="gen9357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:106
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4136"/><l level="1" sID="gen9358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4136"/>Juravi et statui <l eID="gen9358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9359"/>custodire judicia justitiæ tuæ. <l eID="gen9359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:107
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4137"/><l level="1" sID="gen9360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4137"/>Humiliatus sum usquequaque, Domine ; <l eID="gen9360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9361"/>vivifica me secundum verbum tuum. <l eID="gen9361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:108
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4138"/><l level="1" sID="gen9362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4138"/>Voluntaria oris mei beneplacita fac, Domine, <l eID="gen9362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9363"/>et judicia tua doce me. <l eID="gen9363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:109
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4139"/><l level="1" sID="gen9364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4139"/>Anima mea in manibus meis semper, <l eID="gen9364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9365"/>et legem tuam non sum oblitus. <l eID="gen9365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:110
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4140"/><l level="1" sID="gen9366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4140"/>Posuerunt peccatores laqueum mihi, <l eID="gen9366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9367"/>et de mandatis tuis non erravi. <l eID="gen9367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:111
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4141"/><l level="1" sID="gen9368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4141"/>Hæreditate acquisivi testimonia tua in æternum, <l eID="gen9368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9369"/>quia exsultatio cordis mei sunt. <l eID="gen9369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:112
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4142"/><l level="1" sID="gen9370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4142"/>Inclinavi cor meum ad faciendas justificationes tuas in æternum, <l eID="gen9370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9371"/>propter retributionem. <l eID="gen9371" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9355"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Samech</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:113
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4143"/><lg sID="gen9372"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4143"/>Iniquos odio habui, <l eID="gen9373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9374"/>et legem tuam dilexi. <l eID="gen9374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:114
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4144"/><l level="1" sID="gen9375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4144"/>Adjutor et susceptor meus es tu, <l eID="gen9375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9376"/>et in verbum tuum supersperavi. <l eID="gen9376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:115
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4145"/><l level="1" sID="gen9377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4145"/>Declinate a me, maligni, <l eID="gen9377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9378"/>et scrutabor mandata Dei mei. <l eID="gen9378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:116
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4146"/><l level="1" sID="gen9379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4146"/>Suscipe me secundum eloquium tuum, et vivam, <l eID="gen9379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9380"/>et non confundas me ab exspectatione mea. <l eID="gen9380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:117
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4147"/><l level="1" sID="gen9381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4147"/>Adjuva me, et salvus ero, <l eID="gen9381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9382"/>et meditabor in justificationibus tuis semper. <l eID="gen9382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:118
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4148"/><l level="1" sID="gen9383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4148"/>Sprevisti omnes discedentes a judiciis tuis, <l eID="gen9383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9384"/>quia injusta cogitatio eorum. <l eID="gen9384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:119
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4149"/><l level="1" sID="gen9385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4149"/>Prævaricantes reputavi omnes peccatores terræ ; <l eID="gen9385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9386"/>ideo dilexi testimonia tua. <l eID="gen9386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:120
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4150"/><l level="1" sID="gen9387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4150"/>Confige timore tuo carnes meas ; <l eID="gen9387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9388"/>a judiciis enim tuis timui. <l eID="gen9388" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9372"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:121
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4151"/><lg sID="gen9389"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4151"/>Feci judicium et justitiam : <l eID="gen9390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9391"/>non tradas me calumniantibus me. <l eID="gen9391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:122
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4152"/><l level="1" sID="gen9392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4152"/>Suscipe servum tuum in bonum : <l eID="gen9392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9393"/>non calumnientur me superbi. <l eID="gen9393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:123
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4153"/><l level="1" sID="gen9394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4153"/>Oculi mei defecerunt in salutare tuum, <l eID="gen9394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9395"/>et in eloquium justitiæ tuæ. <l eID="gen9395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:124
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4154"/><l level="1" sID="gen9396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4154"/>Fac cum servo tuo secundum misericordiam tuam, <l eID="gen9396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9397"/>et justificationes tuas doce me. <l eID="gen9397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:125
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4155"/><l level="1" sID="gen9398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4155"/>Servus tuus sum ego : da mihi intellectum, <l eID="gen9398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9399"/>ut sciam testimonia tua. <l eID="gen9399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:126
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4156"/><l level="1" sID="gen9400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4156"/>Tempus faciendi, Domine : <l eID="gen9400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9401"/>dissipaverunt legem tuam. <l eID="gen9401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:127
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4157"/><l level="1" sID="gen9402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4157"/>Ideo dilexi mandata tua <l eID="gen9402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9403"/>super aurum et topazion. <l eID="gen9403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:128
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4158"/><l level="1" sID="gen9404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4158"/>Propterea ad omnia mandata tua dirigebar ; <l eID="gen9404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9405"/>omnem viam iniquam odio habui. <l eID="gen9405" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9389"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Phe</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:129
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4159"/><lg sID="gen9406"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4159"/>Mirabilia testimonia tua : <l eID="gen9407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9408"/>ideo scrutata est ea anima mea. <l eID="gen9408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:130
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4160"/><l level="1" sID="gen9409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4160"/>Declaratio sermonum tuorum illuminat, <l eID="gen9409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9410"/>et intellectum dat parvulis. <l eID="gen9410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:131
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4161"/><l level="1" sID="gen9411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4161"/>Os meum aperui, et attraxi spiritum : <l eID="gen9411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9412"/>quia mandata tua desiderabam. <l eID="gen9412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:132
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4162"/><l level="1" sID="gen9413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4162"/>Aspice in me, et miserere mei, <l eID="gen9413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9414"/>secundum judicium diligentium nomen tuum. <l eID="gen9414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:133
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4163"/><l level="1" sID="gen9415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4163"/>Gressus meos dirige secundum eloquium tuum, <l eID="gen9415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9416"/>et non dominetur mei omnis injustitia. <l eID="gen9416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:134
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4164"/><l level="1" sID="gen9417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4164"/>Redime me a calumniis hominum <l eID="gen9417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9418"/>ut custodiam mandata tua. <l eID="gen9418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:135
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4165"/><l level="1" sID="gen9419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4165"/>Faciem tuam illumina super servum tuum, <l eID="gen9419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9420"/>et doce me justificationes tuas. <l eID="gen9420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:136
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4166"/><l level="1" sID="gen9421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4166"/>Exitus aquarum deduxerunt oculi mei, <l eID="gen9421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9422"/>quia non custodierunt legem tuam. <l eID="gen9422" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9406"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sade</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:137
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4167"/><lg sID="gen9423"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4167"/>Justus es, Domine, <l eID="gen9424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9425"/>et rectum judicium tuum. <l eID="gen9425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:138
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4168"/><l level="1" sID="gen9426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4168"/>Mandasti justitiam testimonia tua, <l eID="gen9426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9427"/>et veritatem tuam nimis. <l eID="gen9427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:139
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4169"/><l level="1" sID="gen9428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4169"/>Tabescere me fecit zelus meus, <l eID="gen9428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9429"/>quia obliti sunt verba tua inimici mei. <l eID="gen9429" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:140
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4170"/><l level="1" sID="gen9430"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4170"/>Ignitum eloquium tuum vehementer, <l eID="gen9430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9431"/>et servus tuus dilexit illud. <l eID="gen9431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:141
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4171"/><l level="1" sID="gen9432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4171"/>Adolescentulus sum ego et contemptus ; <l eID="gen9432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9433"/>justificationes tuas non sum oblitus. <l eID="gen9433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:142
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4172"/><l level="1" sID="gen9434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4172"/>Justitia tua, justitia in æternum, <l eID="gen9434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9435"/>et lex tua veritas. <l eID="gen9435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:143
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4173"/><l level="1" sID="gen9436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4173"/>Tribulatio et angustia invenerunt me ; <l eID="gen9436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9437"/>mandata tua meditatio mea est. <l eID="gen9437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:144
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4174"/><l level="1" sID="gen9438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4174"/>Æquitas testimonia tua in æternum : <l eID="gen9438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9439"/>intellectum da mihi, et vivam. <l eID="gen9439" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9423"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Coph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:145
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4175"/><lg sID="gen9440"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4175"/>Clamavi in toto corde meo : exaudi me, Domine ; <l eID="gen9441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9442"/>justificationes tuas requiram. <l eID="gen9442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:146
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4176"/><l level="1" sID="gen9443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4176"/>Clamavi ad te ; salvum me fac : <l eID="gen9443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9444"/>ut custodiam mandata tua. <l eID="gen9444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:147
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4177"/><l level="1" sID="gen9445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4177"/>Præveni in maturitate, et clamavi : <l eID="gen9445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9446"/>quia in verba tua supersperavi. <l eID="gen9446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:148
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4178"/><l level="1" sID="gen9447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4178"/>Prævenerunt oculi mei ad te diluculo, <l eID="gen9447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9448"/>ut meditarer eloquia tua. <l eID="gen9448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:149
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4179"/><l level="1" sID="gen9449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4179"/>Vocem meam audi secundum misericordiam tuam, Domine, <l eID="gen9449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9450"/>et secundum judicium tuum vivifica me. <l eID="gen9450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:150
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4180"/><l level="1" sID="gen9451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4180"/>Appropinquaverunt persequentes me iniquitati : <l eID="gen9451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9452"/>a lege autem tua longe facti sunt. <l eID="gen9452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:151
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4181"/><l level="1" sID="gen9453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4181"/>Prope es tu, Domine, <l eID="gen9453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9454"/>et omnes viæ tuæ veritas. <l eID="gen9454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:152
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4182"/><l level="1" sID="gen9455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4182"/>Initio cognovi de testimoniis tuis, <l eID="gen9455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9456"/>quia in æternum fundasti ea. <l eID="gen9456" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9440"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Res</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:153
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4183"/><lg sID="gen9457"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4183"/>Vide humilitatem meam, et eripe me, <l eID="gen9458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9459"/>quia legem tuam non sum oblitus. <l eID="gen9459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:154
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4184"/><l level="1" sID="gen9460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4184"/>Judica judicium meum, et redime me : <l eID="gen9460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9461"/>propter eloquium tuum vivifica me. <l eID="gen9461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:155
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4185"/><l level="1" sID="gen9462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4185"/>Longe a peccatoribus salus, <l eID="gen9462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9463"/>quia justificationes tuas non exquisierunt. <l eID="gen9463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:156
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4186"/><l level="1" sID="gen9464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4186"/>Misericordiæ tuæ multæ, Domine ; <l eID="gen9464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9465"/>secundum judicium tuum vivifica me. <l eID="gen9465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:157
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4187"/><l level="1" sID="gen9466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4187"/>Multi qui persequuntur me, et tribulant me ; <l eID="gen9466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9467"/>a testimoniis tuis non declinavi. <l eID="gen9467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:158
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4188"/><l level="1" sID="gen9468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4188"/>Vidi prævaricantes et tabescebam, <l eID="gen9468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9469"/>quia eloquia tua non custodierunt. <l eID="gen9469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:159
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4189"/><l level="1" sID="gen9470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4189"/>Vide quoniam mandata tua dilexi, Domine : <l eID="gen9470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9471"/>in misericordia tua vivifica me. <l eID="gen9471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:160
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4190"/><l level="1" sID="gen9472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4190"/>Principium verborum tuorum veritas ; <l eID="gen9472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9473"/>in æternum omnia judicia justitiæ tuæ. <l eID="gen9473" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9457"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sin</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:161
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4191"/><lg sID="gen9474"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4191"/>Principes persecuti sunt me gratis, <l eID="gen9475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9476"/>et a verbis tuis formidavit cor meum. <l eID="gen9476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:162
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4192"/><l level="1" sID="gen9477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4192"/>Lætabor ego super eloquia tua, <l eID="gen9477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9478"/>sicut qui invenit spolia multa. <l eID="gen9478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:163
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4193"/><l level="1" sID="gen9479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4193"/>Iniquitatem odio habui, et abominatus sum, <l eID="gen9479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9480"/>legem autem tuam dilexi. <l eID="gen9480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:164
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4194"/><l level="1" sID="gen9481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4194"/>Septies in die laudem dixi tibi, <l eID="gen9481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9482"/>super judicia justitiæ tuæ. <l eID="gen9482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:165
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4195"/><l level="1" sID="gen9483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4195"/>Pax multa diligentibus legem tuam, <l eID="gen9483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9484"/>et non est illis scandalum. <l eID="gen9484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:166
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4196"/><l level="1" sID="gen9485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4196"/>Exspectabam salutare tuum, Domine, <l eID="gen9485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9486"/>et mandata tua dilexi. <l eID="gen9486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:167
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4197"/><l level="1" sID="gen9487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4197"/>Custodivit anima mea testimonia tua, <l eID="gen9487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9488"/>et dilexit ea vehementer. <l eID="gen9488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:168
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4198"/><l level="1" sID="gen9489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4198"/>Servavi mandata tua et testimonia tua, <l eID="gen9489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9490"/>quia omnes viæ meæ in conspectu tuo. <l eID="gen9490" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen9474"/> <lb type="x-p"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Tau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Psalms 118:169
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4199"/><lg sID="gen9491"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4199"/>Appropinquet deprecatio mea in conspectu tuo, Domine ; <l eID="gen9492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9493"/>juxta eloquium tuum da mihi intellectum. <l eID="gen9493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:170
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4200"/><l level="1" sID="gen9494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4200"/>Intret postulatio mea in conspectu tuo ; <l eID="gen9494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9495"/>secundum eloquium tuum eripe me. <l eID="gen9495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:171
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4201"/><l level="1" sID="gen9496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4201"/>Eructabunt labia mea hymnum, <l eID="gen9496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9497"/>cum docueris me justificationes tuas. <l eID="gen9497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:172
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4202"/><l level="1" sID="gen9498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4202"/>Pronuntiabit lingua mea eloquium tuum, <l eID="gen9498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9499"/>quia omnia mandata tua æquitas. <l eID="gen9499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:173
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4203"/><l level="1" sID="gen9500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4203"/>Fiat manus tua ut salvet me, <l eID="gen9500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9501"/>quoniam mandata tua elegi. <l eID="gen9501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:174
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4204"/><l level="1" sID="gen9502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4204"/>Concupivi salutare tuum, Domine, <l eID="gen9502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9503"/>et lex tua meditatio mea est. <l eID="gen9503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:175
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4205"/><l level="1" sID="gen9504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4205"/>Vivet anima mea, et laudabit te, <l eID="gen9504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9505"/>et judicia tua adjuvabunt me. <l eID="gen9505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 118:176
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4206"/><l level="1" sID="gen9506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4206"/>Erravi sicut ovis quæ periit : quære servum tuum, <l eID="gen9506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9507"/>quia mandata tua non sum oblitus. <l eID="gen9507" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9491"/> <chapter eID="Ps.118"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9508" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9509"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9510"/>Ad Dominum cum tribularer clamavi, <l eID="gen9510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9511"/>et exaudivit me. <l eID="gen9511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4207"/><l level="1" sID="gen9512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4207"/>Domine, libera animam meam a labiis iniquis <l eID="gen9512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9513"/>et a lingua dolosa. <l eID="gen9513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4208"/><l level="1" sID="gen9514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4208"/>Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponatur tibi <l eID="gen9514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9515"/>ad linguam dolosam ? <l eID="gen9515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4209"/><l level="1" sID="gen9516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4209"/>Sagittæ potentis acutæ, <l eID="gen9516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9517"/>cum carbonibus desolatoriis. <l eID="gen9517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4210"/><l level="1" sID="gen9518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4210"/>Heu mihi, quia incolatus meus prolongatus est ! <l eID="gen9518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9519"/>habitavi cum habitantibus Cedar ; <l eID="gen9519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4211"/><l level="1" sID="gen9520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4211"/>multum incola fuit anima mea. <l eID="gen9520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 119:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4212"/><l level="1" sID="gen9521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4212"/>Cum his qui oderunt pacem eram pacificus ; <l eID="gen9521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9522"/>cum loquebar illis, impugnabant me gratis. <l eID="gen9522" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9509"/> <chapter eID="Ps.119"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9523" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9524"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9525"/>Levavi oculos meos in montes, <l eID="gen9525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9526"/>unde veniet auxilium mihi. <l eID="gen9526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4213"/><l level="1" sID="gen9527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4213"/>Auxilium meum a Domino, <l eID="gen9527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9528"/>qui fecit cælum et terram. <l eID="gen9528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4214"/><l level="1" sID="gen9529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4214"/>Non det in commotionem pedem tuum, <l eID="gen9529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9530"/>neque dormitet qui custodit te. <l eID="gen9530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4215"/><l level="1" sID="gen9531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4215"/>Ecce non dormitabit neque dormiet <l eID="gen9531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9532"/>qui custodit Israël. <l eID="gen9532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4216"/><l level="1" sID="gen9533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4216"/>Dominus custodit te ; <l eID="gen9533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9534"/>Dominus protectio tua super manum dexteram tuam. <l eID="gen9534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4217"/><l level="1" sID="gen9535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4217"/>Per diem sol non uret te, <l eID="gen9535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9536"/>neque luna per noctem. <l eID="gen9536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4218"/><l level="1" sID="gen9537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4218"/>Dominus custodit te ab omni malo ; <l eID="gen9537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9538"/>custodiat animam tuam Dominus. <l eID="gen9538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 120:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4219"/><l level="1" sID="gen9539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4219"/>Dominus custodiat introitum tuum et exitum tuum, <l eID="gen9539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9540"/>ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum. <l eID="gen9540" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9524"/> <chapter eID="Ps.120"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9541" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9542"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9543"/>Lætatus sum in his quæ dicta sunt mihi : <l eID="gen9543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9544"/>In domum Domini ibimus. <l eID="gen9544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4220"/><l level="1" sID="gen9545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4220"/>Stantes erant pedes nostri <l eID="gen9545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9546"/>in atriis tuis, Jerusalem. <l eID="gen9546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4221"/><l level="1" sID="gen9547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4221"/>Jerusalem, quæ ædificatur ut civitas, <l eID="gen9547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9548"/>cujus participatio ejus in idipsum. <l eID="gen9548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4222"/><l level="1" sID="gen9549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4222"/>Illuc enim ascenderunt tribus, tribus Domini : <l eID="gen9549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9550"/>testimonium Israël, <l eID="gen9550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9551"/>ad confitendum nomini Domini. <l eID="gen9551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4223"/><l level="1" sID="gen9552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4223"/>Quia illic sederunt sedes in judicio, <l eID="gen9552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9553"/>sedes super domum David. <l eID="gen9553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4224"/><l level="1" sID="gen9554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4224"/>Rogate quæ ad pacem sunt Jerusalem, <l eID="gen9554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9555"/>et abundantia diligentibus te. <l eID="gen9555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4225"/><l level="1" sID="gen9556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4225"/>Fiat pax in virtute tua, <l eID="gen9556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9557"/>et abundantia in turribus tuis. <l eID="gen9557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4226"/><l level="1" sID="gen9558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4226"/>Propter fratres meos et proximos meos, <l eID="gen9558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9559"/>loquebar pacem de te. <l eID="gen9559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 121:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4227"/><l level="1" sID="gen9560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4227"/>Propter domum Domini Dei nostri, <l eID="gen9560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9561"/>quæsivi bona tibi. <l eID="gen9561" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9542"/> <chapter eID="Ps.121"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9562" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9563"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9564"/>Ad te levavi oculos meos, <l eID="gen9564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9565"/>qui habitas in cælis. <l eID="gen9565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4228"/><l level="1" sID="gen9566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4228"/>Ecce sicut oculi servorum <l eID="gen9566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9567"/>in manibus dominorum suorum ; <l eID="gen9567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9568"/>sicut oculi ancillæ <l eID="gen9568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9569"/>in manibus dominæ suæ : <l eID="gen9569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9570"/>ita oculi nostri ad Dominum Deum nostrum, <l eID="gen9570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9571"/>donec misereatur nostri. <l eID="gen9571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4229"/><l level="1" sID="gen9572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4229"/>Miserere nostri, Domine, miserere nostri, <l eID="gen9572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9573"/>quia multum repleti sumus despectione ; <l eID="gen9573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 122:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4230"/><l level="1" sID="gen9574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4230"/>quia multum repleta est anima nostra <l eID="gen9574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9575"/>opprobrium abundantibus, et despectio superbis. <l eID="gen9575" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9563"/> <chapter eID="Ps.122"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9576" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9577"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9578"/>Nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis, <l eID="gen9578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9579"/>dicat nunc Israël, <l eID="gen9579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4231"/><l level="1" sID="gen9580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4231"/>nisi quia Dominus erat in nobis : <l eID="gen9580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9581"/>cum exsurgerent homines in nos, <l eID="gen9581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4232"/><l level="1" sID="gen9582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4232"/>forte vivos deglutissent nos ; <l eID="gen9582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9583"/>cum irasceretur furor eorum in nos, <l eID="gen9583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4233"/><l level="1" sID="gen9584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4233"/>forsitan aqua absorbuisset nos ; <l eID="gen9584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4234"/><l level="1" sID="gen9585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4234"/>torrentem pertransivit anima nostra ; <l eID="gen9585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9586"/>forsitan pertransisset anima nostra <l eID="gen9586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9587"/>aquam intolerabilem. <l eID="gen9587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4235"/><l level="1" sID="gen9588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4235"/>Benedictus Dominus, qui non dedit nos <l eID="gen9588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9589"/>in captionem dentibus eorum. <l eID="gen9589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4236"/><l level="1" sID="gen9590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4236"/>Anima nostra sicut passer erepta est <l eID="gen9590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9591"/>de laqueo venantium ; <l eID="gen9591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9592"/>laqueus contritus est, <l eID="gen9592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9593"/>et nos liberati sumus. <l eID="gen9593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 123:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4237"/><l level="1" sID="gen9594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4237"/>Adjutorium nostrum in nomine Domini, <l eID="gen9594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9595"/>qui fecit cælum et terram. <l eID="gen9595" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9577"/> <chapter eID="Ps.123"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9596" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9597"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9598"/>Qui confidunt in Domino, sicut mons Sion : <l eID="gen9598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9599"/>non commovebitur in æternum, <l eID="gen9599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9600"/>qui habitat

verses.name: Psalms 124:2
verses.text: in Jerusalem. <l eID="gen9600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9601"/>Montes in circuitu ejus ; <l eID="gen9601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9602"/>et Dominus in circuitu populi sui, <l eID="gen9602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9603"/>ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum. <l eID="gen9603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4238"/><l level="1" sID="gen9604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4238"/>Quia non relinquet Dominus virgam peccatorum <l eID="gen9604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9605"/>super sortem justorum : <l eID="gen9605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9606"/>ut non extendant justi <l eID="gen9606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9607"/>ad iniquitatem manus suas, <l eID="gen9607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4239"/><l level="1" sID="gen9608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4239"/>benefac, Domine, bonis, <l eID="gen9608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9609"/>et rectis corde. <l eID="gen9609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 124:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4240"/><l level="1" sID="gen9610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4240"/>Declinantes autem in obligationes, <l eID="gen9610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9611"/>adducet Dominus cum operantibus iniquitatem. <l eID="gen9611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9612"/>Pax super Israël ! <l eID="gen9612" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9597"/> <chapter eID="Ps.124"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9613" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9614"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9615"/>In convertendo Dominus captivitatem Sion, <l eID="gen9615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9616"/>facti sumus sicut consolati. <l eID="gen9616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4241"/><l level="1" sID="gen9617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4241"/>Tunc repletum est gaudio os nostrum, <l eID="gen9617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9618"/>et lingua nostra exsultatione. <l eID="gen9618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9619"/>Tunc dicent inter gentes : <l eID="gen9619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9620"/>Magnificavit Dominus facere cum eis. <l eID="gen9620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4242"/><l level="1" sID="gen9621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4242"/>Magnificavit Dominus facere nobiscum ; <l eID="gen9621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9622"/>facti sumus lætantes. <l eID="gen9622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4243"/><l level="1" sID="gen9623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4243"/>Converte, Domine, captivitatem nostram, <l eID="gen9623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9624"/>sicut torrens in austro. <l eID="gen9624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4244"/><l level="1" sID="gen9625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4244"/>Qui seminant in lacrimis, <l eID="gen9625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9626"/>in exsultatione metent. <l eID="gen9626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 125:6
