verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4245"/><l level="1" sID="gen9627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4245"/>Euntes ibant et flebant, <l eID="gen9627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9628"/>mittentes semina sua. <l eID="gen9628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9629"/>Venientes autem venient cum exsultatione, <l eID="gen9629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9630"/>portantes manipulos suos. <l eID="gen9630" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9614"/> <chapter eID="Ps.125"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum Salomonis. <div eID="gen9631" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9632"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9633"/>Nisi Dominus ædificaverit domum, <l eID="gen9633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9634"/>in vanum laboraverunt qui ædificant eam. <l eID="gen9634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9635"/>Nisi Dominus custodierit civitatem, <l eID="gen9635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9636"/>frustra vigilat qui custodit eam. <l eID="gen9636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4246"/><l level="1" sID="gen9637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4246"/>Vanum est vobis ante lucem surgere : <l eID="gen9637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9638"/>surgite postquam sederitis, <l eID="gen9638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9639"/>qui manducatis panem doloris. <l eID="gen9639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9640"/>Cum dederit dilectis suis somnum, <l eID="gen9640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4247"/><l level="1" sID="gen9641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4247"/>ecce hæreditas Domini, filii ; <l eID="gen9641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9642"/>merces, fructus ventris. <l eID="gen9642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4248"/><l level="1" sID="gen9643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4248"/>Sicut sagittæ in manu potentis, <l eID="gen9643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9644"/>ita filii excussorum. <l eID="gen9644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 126:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4249"/><l level="1" sID="gen9645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4249"/>Beatus vir qui implevit desiderium suum ex ipsis : <l eID="gen9645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9646"/>non confundetur cum loquetur inimicis suis in porta. <l eID="gen9646" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9632"/> <chapter eID="Ps.126"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9647" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9648"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9649"/>Beati omnes qui timent Dominum, <l eID="gen9649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9650"/>qui ambulant in viis ejus. <l eID="gen9650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4250"/><l level="1" sID="gen9651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4250"/>Labores manuum tuarum quia manducabis : <l eID="gen9651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9652"/>beatus es, et bene tibi erit. <l eID="gen9652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4251"/><l level="1" sID="gen9653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4251"/>Uxor tua sicut vitis abundans <l eID="gen9653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9654"/>in lateribus domus tuæ ; <l eID="gen9654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9655"/>filii tui sicut novellæ olivarum <l eID="gen9655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9656"/>in circuitu mensæ tuæ. <l eID="gen9656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4252"/><l level="1" sID="gen9657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4252"/>Ecce sic benedicetur homo <l eID="gen9657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9658"/>qui timet Dominum. <l eID="gen9658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4253"/><l level="1" sID="gen9659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4253"/>Benedicat tibi Dominus ex Sion, <l eID="gen9659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9660"/>et videas bona Jerusalem omnibus diebus vitæ tuæ. <l eID="gen9660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 127:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4254"/><l level="1" sID="gen9661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4254"/>Et videas filios filiorum tuorum : <l eID="gen9661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9662"/>pacem super Israël. <l eID="gen9662" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9648"/> <chapter eID="Ps.127"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9663" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9664"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9665"/>Sæpe expugnaverunt me a juventute mea, <l eID="gen9665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9666"/>dicat nunc Israël ; <l eID="gen9666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4255"/><l level="1" sID="gen9667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4255"/>sæpe expugnaverunt me a juventute mea : <l eID="gen9667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9668"/>etenim non potuerunt mihi. <l eID="gen9668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4256"/><l level="1" sID="gen9669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4256"/>Supra dorsum meum fabricaverunt peccatores ; <l eID="gen9669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9670"/>prolongaverunt iniquitatem suam. <l eID="gen9670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4257"/><l level="1" sID="gen9671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4257"/>Dominus justus <l eID="gen9671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9672"/>concidit cervices peccatorum. <l eID="gen9672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4258"/><l level="1" sID="gen9673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4258"/>Confundantur, et convertantur retrorsum <l eID="gen9673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9674"/>omnes qui oderunt Sion. <l eID="gen9674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4259"/><l level="1" sID="gen9675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4259"/>Fiant sicut fœnum tectorum, <l eID="gen9675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9676"/>quod priusquam evellatur exaruit : <l eID="gen9676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4260"/><l level="1" sID="gen9677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4260"/>de quo non implevit manum suam qui metit, <l eID="gen9677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9678"/>et sinum suum qui manipulos colligit. <l eID="gen9678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 128:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4261"/><l level="1" sID="gen9679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4261"/>Et non dixerunt qui præteribant : <l eID="gen9679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9680"/>Benedictio Domini super vos. <l eID="gen9680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9681"/>Benediximus vobis in nomine Domini. <l eID="gen9681" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9664"/> <chapter eID="Ps.128"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9682" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9683"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9684"/>De profundis clamavi ad te, Domine ; <l eID="gen9684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4262"/><l level="1" sID="gen9685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4262"/>Domine, exaudi vocem meam. <l eID="gen9685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9686"/>Fiant aures tuæ intendentes in vocem deprecationis meæ. <l eID="gen9686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4263"/><l level="1" sID="gen9687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4263"/>Si iniquitates observaveris, Domine, <l eID="gen9687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9688"/>Domine, quis sustinebit ? <l eID="gen9688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4264"/><l level="1" sID="gen9689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4264"/>Quia apud te propitiatio est ; <l eID="gen9689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9690"/>et propter legem tuam sustinui te, Domine. <l eID="gen9690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9691"/>Sustinuit anima mea in verbo ejus : <l eID="gen9691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4265"/><l level="1" sID="gen9692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4265"/>speravit anima mea in Domino. <l eID="gen9692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4266"/><l level="1" sID="gen9693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4266"/>A custodia matutina usque ad noctem, <l eID="gen9693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9694"/>speret Israël in Domino. <l eID="gen9694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4267"/><l level="1" sID="gen9695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4267"/>Quia apud Dominum misericordia, <l eID="gen9695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9696"/>et copiosa apud eum redemptio. <l eID="gen9696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 129:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4268"/><l level="1" sID="gen9697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4268"/>Et ipse redimet Israël <l eID="gen9697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9698"/>ex omnibus iniquitatibus ejus. <l eID="gen9698" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9683"/> <chapter eID="Ps.129"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum David. <div eID="gen9699" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9700"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9701"/>Domine, non est exaltatum cor meum, <l eID="gen9701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9702"/>neque elati sunt oculi mei, <l eID="gen9702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9703"/>neque ambulavi in magnis, <l eID="gen9703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9704"/>neque in mirabilibus super me. <l eID="gen9704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4269"/><l level="1" sID="gen9705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4269"/>Si non humiliter sentiebam, <l eID="gen9705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9706"/>sed exaltavi animam meam : <l eID="gen9706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9707"/>sicut ablactatus est super matre sua, <l eID="gen9707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9708"/>ita retributio in anima mea. <l eID="gen9708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 130:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4270"/><l level="1" sID="gen9709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4270"/>Speret Israël in Domino, <l eID="gen9709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9710"/>ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum. <l eID="gen9710" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9700"/> <chapter eID="Ps.130"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9711" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9712"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9713"/>Memento, Domine, David, <l eID="gen9713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9714"/>et omnis mansuetudinis ejus : <l eID="gen9714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4271"/><l level="1" sID="gen9715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4271"/>sicut juravit Domino ; <l eID="gen9715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9716"/>votum vovit Deo Jacob : <l eID="gen9716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4272"/><l level="1" sID="gen9717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4272"/>Si introiero in tabernaculum domus meæ ; <l eID="gen9717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9718"/>si ascendero in lectum strati mei ; <l eID="gen9718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4273"/><l level="1" sID="gen9719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4273"/>si dedero somnum oculis meis, <l eID="gen9719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9720"/>et palpebris meis dormitationem, <l eID="gen9720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4274"/><l level="1" sID="gen9721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4274"/>et requiem temporibus meis, <l eID="gen9721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9722"/>donec inveniam locum Domino, <l eID="gen9722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9723"/>tabernaculum Deo Jacob. <l eID="gen9723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4275"/><l level="1" sID="gen9724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4275"/>Ecce audivimus eam in Ephrata ; <l eID="gen9724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9725"/>invenimus eam in campis silvæ. <l eID="gen9725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4276"/><l level="1" sID="gen9726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4276"/>Introibimus in tabernaculum ejus ; <l eID="gen9726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9727"/>adorabimus in loco ubi steterunt pedes ejus. <l eID="gen9727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4277"/><l level="1" sID="gen9728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4277"/>Surge, Domine, in requiem tuam, <l eID="gen9728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9729"/>tu et arca sanctificationis tuæ. <l eID="gen9729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4278"/><l level="1" sID="gen9730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4278"/>Sacerdotes tui induantur justitiam, <l eID="gen9730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9731"/>et sancti tui exsultent. <l eID="gen9731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4279"/><l level="1" sID="gen9732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4279"/>Propter David servum tuum <l eID="gen9732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9733"/>non avertas faciem christi tui. <l eID="gen9733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4280"/><l level="1" sID="gen9734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4280"/>Juravit Dominus David veritatem, <l eID="gen9734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9735"/>et non frustrabitur eam : <l eID="gen9735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9736"/>De fructu ventris tui <l eID="gen9736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9737"/>ponam super sedem tuam. <l eID="gen9737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4281"/><l level="1" sID="gen9738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4281"/>Si custodierint filii tui testamentum meum, <l eID="gen9738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9739"/>et testimonia mea hæc quæ docebo eos, <l eID="gen9739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9740"/>et filii eorum usque in sæculum <l eID="gen9740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9741"/>sedebunt super sedem tuam. <l eID="gen9741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4282"/><l level="1" sID="gen9742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4282"/>Quoniam elegit Dominus Sion : <l eID="gen9742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9743"/>elegit eam in habitationem sibi. <l eID="gen9743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4283"/><l level="1" sID="gen9744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4283"/>Hæc requies mea in sæculum sæculi ; <l eID="gen9744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9745"/>hic habitabo, quoniam elegi eam. <l eID="gen9745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4284"/><l level="1" sID="gen9746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4284"/>Viduam ejus benedicens benedicam ; <l eID="gen9746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9747"/>pauperes ejus saturabo panibus. <l eID="gen9747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4285"/><l level="1" sID="gen9748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4285"/>Sacerdotes ejus induam salutari, <l eID="gen9748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9749"/>et sancti ejus exsultatione exsultabunt. <l eID="gen9749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4286"/><l level="1" sID="gen9750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4286"/>Illuc producam cornu David ; <l eID="gen9750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9751"/>paravi lucernam christo meo. <l eID="gen9751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 131:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4287"/><l level="1" sID="gen9752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4287"/>Inimicos ejus induam confusione ; <l eID="gen9752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9753"/>super ipsum autem efflorebit sanctificatio mea. <l eID="gen9753" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9712"/> <chapter eID="Ps.131"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum David. <div eID="gen9754" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9755"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9756"/>Ecce quam bonum et quam jucundum, <l eID="gen9756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9757"/>habitare fratres in unum ! <l eID="gen9757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4288"/><l level="1" sID="gen9758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4288"/>Sicut unguentum in capite, <l eID="gen9758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9759"/>quod descendit in barbam, barbam Aaron, <l eID="gen9759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9760"/>quod descendit in oram vestimenti ejus ; <l eID="gen9760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 132:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4289"/><l level="1" sID="gen9761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4289"/>sicut ros Hermon, <l eID="gen9761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9762"/>qui descendit in montem Sion. <l eID="gen9762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9763"/>Quoniam illic mandavit Dominus benedictionem, <l eID="gen9763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9764"/>et vitam usque in sæculum. <l eID="gen9764" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9755"/> <chapter eID="Ps.132"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:1
verses.text: Canticum graduum. <div eID="gen9765" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9766"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9767"/>Ecce nunc benedicite Dominum, omnes servi Domini : <l eID="gen9767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9768"/>qui statis in domo Domini, <l eID="gen9768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9769"/>in atriis domus Dei nostri. <l eID="gen9769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4290"/><l level="1" sID="gen9770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4290"/>In noctibus extollite manus vestras in sancta, <l eID="gen9770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9771"/>et benedicite Dominum. <l eID="gen9771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 133:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4291"/><l level="1" sID="gen9772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4291"/>Benedicat te Dominus ex Sion, <l eID="gen9772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9773"/>qui fecit cælum et terram. <l eID="gen9773" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9766"/> <chapter eID="Ps.133"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen9774" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9775"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9776"/>Laudate nomen Domini ; <l eID="gen9776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9777"/>laudate, servi, Dominum : <l eID="gen9777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4292"/><l level="1" sID="gen9778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4292"/>qui statis in domo Domini, <l eID="gen9778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9779"/>in atriis domus Dei nostri. <l eID="gen9779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4293"/><l level="1" sID="gen9780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4293"/>Laudate Dominum, quia bonus Dominus ; <l eID="gen9780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9781"/>psallite nomini ejus, quoniam suave. <l eID="gen9781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4294"/><l level="1" sID="gen9782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4294"/>Quoniam Jacob elegit sibi Dominus ; <l eID="gen9782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9783"/>Israël in possessionem sibi. <l eID="gen9783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4295"/><l level="1" sID="gen9784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4295"/>Quia ego cognovi quod magnus est Dominus, <l eID="gen9784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9785"/>et Deus noster præ omnibus diis. <l eID="gen9785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4296"/><l level="1" sID="gen9786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4296"/>Omnia quæcumque voluit Dominus fecit, <l eID="gen9786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9787"/>in cælo, in terra, in mari et in omnibus abyssis. <l eID="gen9787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4297"/><l level="1" sID="gen9788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4297"/>Educens nubes ab extremo terræ, <l eID="gen9788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9789"/>fulgura in pluviam fecit ; <l eID="gen9789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9790"/>qui producit ventos de thesauris suis. <l eID="gen9790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4298"/><l level="1" sID="gen9791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4298"/>Qui percussit primogenita Ægypti, <l eID="gen9791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9792"/>ab homine usque ad pecus. <l eID="gen9792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4299"/><l level="1" sID="gen9793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4299"/>Et misit signa et prodigia in medio tui, Ægypte : <l eID="gen9793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9794"/>in Pharaonem, et in omnes servos ejus. <l eID="gen9794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4300"/><l level="1" sID="gen9795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4300"/>Qui percussit gentes multas, <l eID="gen9795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9796"/>et occidit reges fortes : <l eID="gen9796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4301"/><l level="1" sID="gen9797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4301"/>Sehon, regem Amorrhæorum, et Og, regem Basan, <l eID="gen9797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9798"/>et omnia regna Chanaan : <l eID="gen9798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4302"/><l level="1" sID="gen9799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4302"/>et dedit terram eorum hæreditatem, <l eID="gen9799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9800"/>hæreditatem Israël populo suo. <l eID="gen9800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4303"/><l level="1" sID="gen9801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4303"/>Domine, nomen tuum in æternum ; <l eID="gen9801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9802"/>Domine, memoriale tuum in generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen9802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4304"/><l level="1" sID="gen9803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4304"/>Quia judicabit Dominus populum suum, <l eID="gen9803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9804"/>et in servis suis deprecabitur. <l eID="gen9804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4305"/><l level="1" sID="gen9805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4305"/>Simulacra gentium argentum et aurum, <l eID="gen9805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9806"/>opera manuum hominum. <l eID="gen9806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4306"/><l level="1" sID="gen9807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4306"/>Os habent, et non loquentur ; <l eID="gen9807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9808"/>oculos habent, et non videbunt. <l eID="gen9808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4307"/><l level="1" sID="gen9809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4307"/>Aures habent, et non audient ; <l eID="gen9809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9810"/>neque enim est spiritus in ore ipsorum. <l eID="gen9810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4308"/><l level="1" sID="gen9811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4308"/>Similes illis fiant qui faciunt ea, <l eID="gen9811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9812"/>et omnes qui confidunt in eis. <l eID="gen9812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4309"/><l level="1" sID="gen9813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4309"/>Domus Israël, benedicite Domino ; <l eID="gen9813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9814"/>domus Aaron, benedicite Domino. <l eID="gen9814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4310"/><l level="1" sID="gen9815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4310"/>Domus Levi, benedicite Domino ; <l eID="gen9815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9816"/>qui timetis Dominum, benedicite Domino. <l eID="gen9816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 134:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4311"/><l level="1" sID="gen9817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4311"/>Benedictus Dominus ex Sion, <l eID="gen9817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9818"/>qui habitat in Jerusalem. <l eID="gen9818" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9775"/> <chapter eID="Ps.134"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen9819" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9820"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9821"/>Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus, <l eID="gen9821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9822"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4312"/><l level="1" sID="gen9823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4312"/>Confitemini Deo deorum, <l eID="gen9823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9824"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4313"/><l level="1" sID="gen9825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4313"/>Confitemini Domino dominorum, <l eID="gen9825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9826"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4314"/><l level="1" sID="gen9827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4314"/>Qui facit mirabilia magna solus, <l eID="gen9827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9828"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4315"/><l level="1" sID="gen9829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4315"/>Qui fecit cælos in intellectu, <l eID="gen9829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9830"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4316"/><l level="1" sID="gen9831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4316"/>Qui firmavit terram super aquas, <l eID="gen9831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9832"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4317"/><l level="1" sID="gen9833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4317"/>Qui fecit luminaria magna, <l eID="gen9833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9834"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus : <l eID="gen9834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4318"/><l level="1" sID="gen9835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4318"/>solem in potestatem diei, <l eID="gen9835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9836"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus ; <l eID="gen9836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4319"/><l level="1" sID="gen9837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4319"/>lunam et stellas in potestatem noctis, <l eID="gen9837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9838"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4320"/><l level="1" sID="gen9839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4320"/>Qui percussit Ægyptum cum primogenitis eorum, <l eID="gen9839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9840"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4321"/><l level="1" sID="gen9841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4321"/>Qui eduxit Israël de medio eorum, <l eID="gen9841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9842"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus, <l eID="gen9842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4322"/><l level="1" sID="gen9843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4322"/>in manu potenti et brachio excelso, <l eID="gen9843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9844"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4323"/><l level="1" sID="gen9845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4323"/>Qui divisit mare Rubrum in divisiones, <l eID="gen9845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9846"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus ; <l eID="gen9846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4324"/><l level="1" sID="gen9847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4324"/>et eduxit Israël per medium ejus, <l eID="gen9847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9848"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus ; <l eID="gen9848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4325"/><l level="1" sID="gen9849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4325"/>et excussit Pharaonem et virtutem ejus in mari Rubro, <l eID="gen9849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9850"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4326"/><l level="1" sID="gen9851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4326"/>Qui traduxit populum suum per desertum, <l eID="gen9851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9852"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4327"/><l level="1" sID="gen9853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4327"/>Qui percussit reges magnos, <l eID="gen9853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9854"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus ; <l eID="gen9854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4328"/><l level="1" sID="gen9855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4328"/>et occidit reges fortes, <l eID="gen9855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9856"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus : <l eID="gen9856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4329"/><l level="1" sID="gen9857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4329"/>Sehon, regem Amorrhæorum, <l eID="gen9857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9858"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus ; <l eID="gen9858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4330"/><l level="1" sID="gen9859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4330"/>et Og, regem Basan, <l eID="gen9859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9860"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus : <l eID="gen9860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4331"/><l level="1" sID="gen9861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4331"/>et dedit terram eorum hæreditatem, <l eID="gen9861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9862"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus ; <l eID="gen9862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4332"/><l level="1" sID="gen9863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4332"/>hæreditatem Israël, servo suo, <l eID="gen9863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9864"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4333"/><l level="1" sID="gen9865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4333"/>Quia in humilitate nostra memor fuit nostri, <l eID="gen9865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9866"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus ; <l eID="gen9866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4334"/><l level="1" sID="gen9867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4334"/>et redemit nos ab inimicis nostris, <l eID="gen9867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9868"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4335"/><l level="1" sID="gen9869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4335"/>Qui dat escam omni carni, <l eID="gen9869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9870"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 135:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4336"/><l level="1" sID="gen9871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4336"/>Confitemini Deo cæli, <l eID="gen9871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9872"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9873"/>Confitemini Domino dominorum, <l eID="gen9873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9874"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen9874" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9820"/> <chapter eID="Ps.135"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, Jeremiæ. <div eID="gen9875" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9876"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9877"/>Super flumina Babylonis illic sedimus et flevimus, <l eID="gen9877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9878"/>cum recordaremur Sion. <l eID="gen9878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4337"/><l level="1" sID="gen9879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4337"/>In salicibus in medio ejus <l eID="gen9879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9880"/>suspendimus organa nostra : <l eID="gen9880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4338"/><l level="1" sID="gen9881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4338"/>quia illic interrogaverunt nos, qui captivos duxerunt nos, <l eID="gen9881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9882"/>verba cantionum ; <l eID="gen9882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9883"/>et qui abduxerunt nos : <l eID="gen9883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9884"/>Hymnum cantate nobis de canticis Sion. <l eID="gen9884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4339"/><l level="1" sID="gen9885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4339"/>Quomodo cantabimus canticum Domini <l eID="gen9885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9886"/>in terra aliena ? <l eID="gen9886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4340"/><l level="1" sID="gen9887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4340"/>Si oblitus fuero tui, Jerusalem, <l eID="gen9887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9888"/>oblivioni detur dextera mea. <l eID="gen9888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4341"/><l level="1" sID="gen9889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4341"/>Adhæreat lingua mea faucibus meis, <l eID="gen9889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9890"/>si non meminero tui ; <l eID="gen9890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9891"/>si non proposuero Jerusalem <l eID="gen9891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9892"/>in principio lætitiæ meæ. <l eID="gen9892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4342"/><l level="1" sID="gen9893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4342"/>Memor esto, Domine, filiorum Edom, <l eID="gen9893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9894"/>in die Jerusalem : <l eID="gen9894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9895"/>qui dicunt : Exinanite, exinanite <l eID="gen9895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9896"/>usque ad fundamentum in ea. <l eID="gen9896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4343"/><l level="1" sID="gen9897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4343"/>Filia Babylonis misera ! beatus qui retribuet tibi <l eID="gen9897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9898"/>retributionem tuam quam retribuisti nobis. <l eID="gen9898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 136:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4344"/><l level="1" sID="gen9899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4344"/>Beatus qui tenebit, <l eID="gen9899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9900"/>et allidet parvulos tuos ad petram. <l eID="gen9900" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9876"/> <chapter eID="Ps.136"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:1
verses.text: Ipsi David. <div eID="gen9901" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9902"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9903"/>Confitebor tibi, Domine, in toto corde meo, <l eID="gen9903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9904"/>quoniam audisti verba oris mei. <l eID="gen9904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9905"/>In conspectu angelorum psallam tibi ; <l eID="gen9905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4345"/><l level="1" sID="gen9906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4345"/>adorabo ad templum sanctum tuum, <l eID="gen9906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9907"/>et confitebor nomini tuo : <l eID="gen9907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9908"/>super misericordia tua et veritate tua ; <l eID="gen9908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9909"/>quoniam magnificasti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum. <l eID="gen9909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4346"/><l level="1" sID="gen9910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4346"/>In quacumque die invocavero te, exaudi me ; <l eID="gen9910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9911"/>multiplicabis in anima mea virtutem. <l eID="gen9911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4347"/><l level="1" sID="gen9912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4347"/>Confiteantur tibi, Domine, omnes reges terræ, <l eID="gen9912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9913"/>quia audierunt omnia verba oris tui. <l eID="gen9913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4348"/><l level="1" sID="gen9914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4348"/>Et cantent in viis Domini, <l eID="gen9914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9915"/>quoniam magna est gloria Domini ; <l eID="gen9915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4349"/><l level="1" sID="gen9916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4349"/>quoniam excelsus Dominus, et humilia respicit, <l eID="gen9916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9917"/>et alta a longe cognoscit. <l eID="gen9917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4350"/><l level="1" sID="gen9918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4350"/>Si ambulavero in medio tribulationis, vivificabis me ; <l eID="gen9918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9919"/>et super iram inimicorum meorum extendisti manum tuam, <l eID="gen9919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9920"/>et salvum me fecit dextera tua. <l eID="gen9920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 137:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4351"/><l level="1" sID="gen9921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4351"/>Dominus retribuet pro me. <l eID="gen9921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9922"/>Domine, misericordia tua in sæculum ; <l eID="gen9922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9923"/>opera manuum tuarum ne despicias. <l eID="gen9923" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9902"/> <chapter eID="Ps.137"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:1
verses.text: In finem, psalmus David. <div eID="gen9924" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen9925"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9926"/>Domine, probasti me, et cognovisti me ; <l eID="gen9926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4352"/><l level="1" sID="gen9927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4352"/>tu cognovisti sessionem meam et resurrectionem meam. <l eID="gen9927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4353"/><l level="1" sID="gen9928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4353"/>Intellexisti cogitationes meas de longe ; <l eID="gen9928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9929"/>semitam meam et funiculum meum investigasti : <l eID="gen9929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4354"/><l level="1" sID="gen9930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4354"/>et omnes vias meas prævidisti, <l eID="gen9930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9931"/>quia non est sermo in lingua mea. <l eID="gen9931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4355"/><l level="1" sID="gen9932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4355"/>Ecce, Domine, tu cognovisti omnia, <l eID="gen9932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9933"/>novissima et antiqua. <l eID="gen9933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9934"/>Tu formasti me, et posuisti super me manum tuam. <l eID="gen9934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4356"/><l level="1" sID="gen9935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4356"/>Mirabilis facta est scientia tua ex me ; <l eID="gen9935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9936"/>confortata est, et non potero ad eam. <l eID="gen9936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4357"/><l level="1" sID="gen9937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4357"/>Quo ibo a spiritu tuo ? <l eID="gen9937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9938"/>et quo a facie tua fugiam ? <l eID="gen9938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4358"/><l level="1" sID="gen9939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4358"/>Si ascendero in cælum, tu illic es ; <l eID="gen9939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9940"/>si descendero in infernum, ades. <l eID="gen9940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4359"/><l level="1" sID="gen9941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4359"/>Si sumpsero pennas meas diluculo, <l eID="gen9941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9942"/>et habitavero in extremis maris, <l eID="gen9942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4360"/><l level="1" sID="gen9943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4360"/>etenim illuc manus tua deducet me, <l eID="gen9943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9944"/>et tenebit me dextera tua. <l eID="gen9944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4361"/><l level="1" sID="gen9945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4361"/>Et dixi : Forsitan tenebræ conculcabunt me ; <l eID="gen9945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9946"/>et nox illuminatio mea in deliciis meis. <l eID="gen9946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4362"/><l level="1" sID="gen9947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4362"/>Quia tenebræ non obscurabuntur a te, <l eID="gen9947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9948"/>et nox sicut dies illuminabitur : <l eID="gen9948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9949"/>sicut tenebræ ejus, ita et lumen ejus. <l eID="gen9949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4363"/><l level="1" sID="gen9950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4363"/>Quia tu possedisti renes meos ; <l eID="gen9950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9951"/>suscepisti me de utero matris meæ. <l eID="gen9951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4364"/><l level="1" sID="gen9952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4364"/>Confitebor tibi, quia terribiliter magnificatus es ; <l eID="gen9952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9953"/>mirabilia opera tua, et anima mea cognoscit nimis. <l eID="gen9953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4365"/><l level="1" sID="gen9954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4365"/>Non est occultatum os meum a te, quod fecisti in occulto ; <l eID="gen9954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9955"/>et substantia mea in inferioribus terræ. <l eID="gen9955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4366"/><l level="1" sID="gen9956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4366"/>Imperfectum meum viderunt oculi tui, <l eID="gen9956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9957"/>et in libro tuo omnes scribentur. <l eID="gen9957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9958"/>Dies formabuntur, et nemo in eis. <l eID="gen9958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4367"/><l level="1" sID="gen9959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4367"/>Mihi autem nimis honorificati sunt amici tui, Deus ; <l eID="gen9959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9960"/>nimis confortatus est principatus eorum. <l eID="gen9960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4368"/><l level="1" sID="gen9961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4368"/>Dinumerabo eos, et super arenam multiplicabuntur. <l eID="gen9961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9962"/>Exsurrexi, et adhuc sum tecum. <l eID="gen9962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4369"/><l level="1" sID="gen9963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4369"/>Si occideris, Deus, peccatores, <l eID="gen9963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9964"/>viri sanguinum, declinate a me : <l eID="gen9964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4370"/><l level="1" sID="gen9965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4370"/>quia dicitis in cogitatione : <l eID="gen9965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9966"/>Accipient in vanitate civitates tuas. <l eID="gen9966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4371"/><l level="1" sID="gen9967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4371"/>Nonne qui oderunt te, Domine, oderam, <l eID="gen9967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9968"/>et super inimicos tuos tabescebam ? <l eID="gen9968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4372"/><l level="1" sID="gen9969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4372"/>Perfecto odio oderam illos, <l eID="gen9969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9970"/>et inimici facti sunt mihi. <l eID="gen9970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4373"/><l level="1" sID="gen9971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4373"/>Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum ; <l eID="gen9971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9972"/>interroga me, et cognosce semitas meas. <l eID="gen9972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 138:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4374"/><l level="1" sID="gen9973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4374"/>Et vide si via iniquitatis in me est, <l eID="gen9973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9974"/>et deduc me in via æterna. <l eID="gen9974" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9925"/> <chapter eID="Ps.138"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:1
verses.text: In finem. Psalmus David.  <div eID="gen9975" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4375"/><lg sID="gen9976"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4375"/>Eripe me, Domine, ab homine malo ; <l eID="gen9977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9978"/>a viro iniquo eripe me. <l eID="gen9978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4376"/><l level="1" sID="gen9979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4376"/>Qui cogitaverunt iniquitates in corde, <l eID="gen9979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9980"/>tota die constituebant prælia. <l eID="gen9980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4377"/><l level="1" sID="gen9981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4377"/>Acuerunt linguas suas sicut serpentis ; <l eID="gen9981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9982"/>venenum aspidum sub labiis eorum. <l eID="gen9982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4378"/><l level="1" sID="gen9983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4378"/>Custodi me, Domine, de manu peccatoris, <l eID="gen9983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9984"/>et ab hominibus iniquis eripe me. <l eID="gen9984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9985"/>Qui cogitaverunt supplantare gressus meos : <l eID="gen9985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4379"/><l level="1" sID="gen9986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4379"/>absconderunt superbi laqueum mihi. <l eID="gen9986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9987"/>Et funes extenderunt in laqueum ; <l eID="gen9987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9988"/>juxta iter, scandalum posuerunt mihi. <l eID="gen9988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4380"/><l level="1" sID="gen9989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4380"/>Dixi Domino : Deus meus es tu ; <l eID="gen9989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9990"/>exaudi, Domine, vocem deprecationis meæ. <l eID="gen9990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4381"/><l level="1" sID="gen9991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4381"/>Domine, Domine, virtus salutis meæ, <l eID="gen9991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9992"/>obumbrasti super caput meum in die belli. <l eID="gen9992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4382"/><l level="1" sID="gen9993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4382"/>Ne tradas me, Domine, a desiderio meo peccatori : <l eID="gen9993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9994"/>cogitaverunt contra me ; <l eID="gen9994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9995"/>ne derelinquas me, ne forte exaltentur. <l eID="gen9995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4383"/><l level="1" sID="gen9996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4383"/>Caput circuitus eorum : <l eID="gen9996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9997"/>labor labiorum ipsorum operiet eos. <l eID="gen9997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4384"/><l level="1" sID="gen9998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4384"/>Cadent super eos carbones ; <l eID="gen9998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen9999"/>in ignem dejicies eos : <l eID="gen9999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10000"/>in miseriis non subsistent. <l eID="gen10000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4385"/><l level="1" sID="gen10001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4385"/>Vir linguosus non dirigetur in terra ; <l eID="gen10001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10002"/>virum injustum mala capient in interitu. <l eID="gen10002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4386"/><l level="1" sID="gen10003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4386"/>Cognovi quia faciet Dominus judicium inopis, <l eID="gen10003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10004"/>et vindictam pauperum. <l eID="gen10004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 139:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4387"/><l level="1" sID="gen10005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4387"/>Verumtamen justi confitebuntur nomini tuo, <l eID="gen10005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10006"/>et habitabunt recti cum vultu tuo. <l eID="gen10006" level="1"/><lg eID="gen9976"/> <chapter eID="Ps.139"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:1
verses.text: Psalmus David. <div eID="gen10007" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10008"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10009"/>Domine, clamavi ad te : exaudi me ; <l eID="gen10009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10010"/>intende voci meæ, cum clamavero ad te. <l eID="gen10010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4388"/><l level="1" sID="gen10011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4388"/>Dirigatur oratio mea sicut incensum in conspectu tuo ; <l eID="gen10011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10012"/>elevatio manuum mearum sacrificium vespertinum. <l eID="gen10012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4389"/><l level="1" sID="gen10013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4389"/>Pone, Domine, custodiam ori meo, <l eID="gen10013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10014"/>et ostium circumstantiæ labiis meis. <l eID="gen10014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4390"/><l level="1" sID="gen10015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4390"/>Non declines cor meum in verba malitiæ, <l eID="gen10015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10016"/>ad excusandas excusationes in peccatis ; <l eID="gen10016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10017"/>cum hominibus operantibus iniquitatem, <l eID="gen10017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10018"/>et non communicabo cum electis eorum. <l eID="gen10018" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4391"/><l level="1" sID="gen10019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4391"/>Corripiet me justus in misericordia, et increpabit me : <l eID="gen10019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10020"/>oleum autem peccatoris non impinguet caput meum. <l eID="gen10020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10021"/>Quoniam adhuc et oratio mea in beneplacitis eorum : <l eID="gen10021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4392"/><l level="1" sID="gen10022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4392"/>absorpti sunt juncti petræ judices eorum. <l eID="gen10022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10023"/>Audient verba mea, quoniam potuerunt. <l eID="gen10023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4393"/><l level="1" sID="gen10024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4393"/>Sicut crassitudo terræ erupta est super terram, <l eID="gen10024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10025"/>dissipata sunt ossa nostra secus infernum. <l eID="gen10025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4394"/><l level="1" sID="gen10026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4394"/>Quia ad te, Domine, Domine, oculi mei ; <l eID="gen10026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10027"/>in te speravi, non auferas animam meam. <l eID="gen10027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4395"/><l level="1" sID="gen10028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4395"/>Custodi me a laqueo quem statuerunt mihi, <l eID="gen10028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10029"/>et a scandalis operantium iniquitatem. <l eID="gen10029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 140:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4396"/><l level="1" sID="gen10030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4396"/>Cadent in retiaculo ejus peccatores : <l eID="gen10030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10031"/>singulariter sum ego, donec transeam. <l eID="gen10031" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10008"/> <chapter eID="Ps.140"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:1
verses.text: Intellectus David, cum esset in spelunca, oratio.  <div eID="gen10032" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4397"/><lg sID="gen10033"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4397"/>Voce mea ad Dominum clamavi, <l eID="gen10034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10035"/>voce mea ad Dominum deprecatus sum. <l eID="gen10035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4398"/><l level="1" sID="gen10036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4398"/>Effundo in conspectu ejus orationem meam, <l eID="gen10036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10037"/>et tribulationem meam ante ipsum pronuntio : <l eID="gen10037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4399"/><l level="1" sID="gen10038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4399"/>in deficiendo ex me spiritum meum, <l eID="gen10038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10039"/>et tu cognovisti semitas meas. <l eID="gen10039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10040"/>In via hac qua ambulabam <l eID="gen10040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10041"/>absconderunt laqueum mihi. <l eID="gen10041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4400"/><l level="1" sID="gen10042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4400"/>Considerabam ad dexteram, et videbam, <l eID="gen10042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10043"/>et non erat qui cognosceret me : <l eID="gen10043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10044"/>periit fuga a me, <l eID="gen10044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10045"/>et non est qui requirat animam meam. <l eID="gen10045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4401"/><l level="1" sID="gen10046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4401"/>Clamavi ad te, Domine ; <l eID="gen10046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10047"/>dixi : Tu es spes mea, <l eID="gen10047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10048"/>portio mea in terra viventium. <l eID="gen10048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4402"/><l level="1" sID="gen10049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4402"/>Intende ad deprecationem meam, <l eID="gen10049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10050"/>quia humiliatus sum nimis. <l eID="gen10050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10051"/>Libera me a persequentibus me, <l eID="gen10051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10052"/>quia confortati sunt super me. <l eID="gen10052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 141:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4403"/><l level="1" sID="gen10053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4403"/>Educ de custodia animam meam <l eID="gen10053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10054"/>ad confitendum nomini tuo ; <l eID="gen10054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10055"/>me exspectant justi donec retribuas mihi. <l eID="gen10055" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10033"/> <chapter eID="Ps.141"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:1
verses.text: Psalmus David, quando persequebatur eum Absalom filius ejus. <div eID="gen10056" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10057"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10058"/>Domine, exaudi orationem meam ; <l eID="gen10058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10059"/>auribus percipe obsecrationem meam in veritate tua ; <l eID="gen10059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10060"/>exaudi me in tua justitia. <l eID="gen10060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4404"/><l level="1" sID="gen10061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4404"/>Et non intres in judicium cum servo tuo, <l eID="gen10061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10062"/>quia non justificabitur in conspectu tuo omnis vivens. <l eID="gen10062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4405"/><l level="1" sID="gen10063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4405"/>Quia persecutus est inimicus animam meam ; <l eID="gen10063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10064"/>humiliavit in terra vitam meam ; <l eID="gen10064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10065"/>collocavit me in obscuris, sicut mortuos sæculi. <l eID="gen10065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4406"/><l level="1" sID="gen10066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4406"/>Et anxiatus est super me spiritus meus ; <l eID="gen10066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10067"/>in me turbatum est cor meum. <l eID="gen10067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4407"/><l level="1" sID="gen10068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4407"/>Memor fui dierum antiquorum ; <l eID="gen10068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10069"/>meditatus sum in omnibus operibus tuis : <l eID="gen10069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10070"/>in factis manuum tuarum meditabar. <l eID="gen10070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4408"/><l level="1" sID="gen10071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4408"/>Expandi manus meas ad te ; <l eID="gen10071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10072"/>anima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi. <l eID="gen10072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4409"/><l level="1" sID="gen10073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4409"/>Velociter exaudi me, Domine ; <l eID="gen10073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10074"/>defecit spiritus meus. <l eID="gen10074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10075"/>Non avertas faciem tuam a me, <l eID="gen10075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10076"/>et similis ero descendentibus in lacum. <l eID="gen10076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4410"/><l level="1" sID="gen10077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4410"/>Auditam fac mihi mane misericordiam tuam, <l eID="gen10077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10078"/>quia in te speravi. <l eID="gen10078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10079"/>Notam fac mihi viam in qua ambulem, <l eID="gen10079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10080"/>quia ad te levavi animam meam. <l eID="gen10080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4411"/><l level="1" sID="gen10081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4411"/>Eripe me de inimicis meis, Domine : <l eID="gen10081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10082"/>ad te confugi. <l eID="gen10082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4412"/><l level="1" sID="gen10083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4412"/>Doce me facere voluntatem tuam, <l eID="gen10083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10084"/>quia Deus meus es tu. <l eID="gen10084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10085"/>Spiritus tuus bonus deducet me in terram rectam. <l eID="gen10085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4413"/><l level="1" sID="gen10086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4413"/>Propter nomen tuum, Domine, vivificabis me : <l eID="gen10086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10087"/>in æquitate tua, educes de tribulatione animam meam, <l eID="gen10087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 142:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4414"/><l level="1" sID="gen10088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4414"/>et in misericordia tua disperdes inimicos meos, <l eID="gen10088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10089"/>et perdes omnes qui tribulant animam meam, <l eID="gen10089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10090"/>quoniam ego servus tuus sum. <l eID="gen10090" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10057"/> <chapter eID="Ps.142"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:1
verses.text: Psalmus David. Adversus Goliath. <div eID="gen10091" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10092"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10093"/>Benedictus Dominus Deus meus, <l eID="gen10093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10094"/>qui docet manus meas ad prælium, <l eID="gen10094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10095"/>et digitos meos ad bellum. <l eID="gen10095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4415"/><l level="1" sID="gen10096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4415"/>Misericordia mea et refugium meum ; <l eID="gen10096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10097"/>susceptor meus et liberator meus ; <l eID="gen10097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10098"/>protector meus, et in ipso speravi, <l eID="gen10098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10099"/>qui subdit populum meum sub me. <l eID="gen10099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4416"/><l level="1" sID="gen10100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4416"/>Domine, quid est homo, quia innotuisti ei ? <l eID="gen10100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10101"/>aut filius hominis, quia reputas eum ? <l eID="gen10101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4417"/><l level="1" sID="gen10102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4417"/>Homo vanitati similis factus est ; <l eID="gen10102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10103"/>dies ejus sicut umbra prætereunt. <l eID="gen10103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4418"/><l level="1" sID="gen10104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4418"/>Domine, inclina cælos tuos, et descende ; <l eID="gen10104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10105"/>tange montes, et fumigabunt. <l eID="gen10105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4419"/><l level="1" sID="gen10106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4419"/>Fulgura coruscationem, et dissipabis eos ; <l eID="gen10106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10107"/>emitte sagittas tuas, et conturbabis eos. <l eID="gen10107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4420"/><l level="1" sID="gen10108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4420"/>Emitte manum tuam de alto : eripe me, <l eID="gen10108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10109"/>et libera me de aquis multis, <l eID="gen10109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10110"/>de manu filiorum alienorum : <l eID="gen10110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4421"/><l level="1" sID="gen10111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4421"/>quorum os locutum est vanitatem, <l eID="gen10111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10112"/>et dextera eorum dextera iniquitatis. <l eID="gen10112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4422"/><l level="1" sID="gen10113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4422"/>Deus, canticum novum cantabo tibi ; <l eID="gen10113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10114"/>in psalterio decachordo psallam tibi. <l eID="gen10114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4423"/><l level="1" sID="gen10115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4423"/>Qui das salutem regibus, <l eID="gen10115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10116"/>qui redemisti David servum tuum de gladio maligno, <l eID="gen10116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4424"/><l level="1" sID="gen10117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4424"/>eripe me, et erue me de manu filiorum alienorum, <l eID="gen10117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10118"/>quorum os locutum est vanitatem, <l eID="gen10118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10119"/>et dextera eorum dextera iniquitatis. <l eID="gen10119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4425"/><l level="1" sID="gen10120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4425"/>Quorum filii sicut novellæ plantationes in juventute sua ; <l eID="gen10120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10121"/>filiæ eorum compositæ, <l eID="gen10121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10122"/>circumornatæ ut similitudo templi. <l eID="gen10122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4426"/><l level="1" sID="gen10123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4426"/>Promptuaria eorum plena, eructantia ex hoc in illud ; <l eID="gen10123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10124"/>oves eorum fœtosæ, abundantes in egressibus suis ; <l eID="gen10124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4427"/><l level="1" sID="gen10125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4427"/>boves eorum crassæ. <l eID="gen10125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10126"/>Non est ruina maceriæ, neque transitus, <l eID="gen10126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10127"/>neque clamor in plateis eorum. <l eID="gen10127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 143:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4428"/><l level="1" sID="gen10128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4428"/>Beatum dixerunt populum cui hæc sunt ; <l eID="gen10128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10129"/>beatus populus cujus Dominus Deus ejus. <l eID="gen10129" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10092"/> <chapter eID="Ps.143"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:1
verses.text: Laudatio ipsi David. <div eID="gen10130" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10131"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10132"/>Exaltabo te, Deus meus rex, <l eID="gen10132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10133"/>et benedicam nomini tuo in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen10133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4429"/><l level="1" sID="gen10134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4429"/>Per singulos dies benedicam tibi, <l eID="gen10134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10135"/>et laudabo nomen tuum in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen10135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4430"/><l level="1" sID="gen10136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4430"/>Magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis, <l eID="gen10136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10137"/>et magnitudinis ejus non est finis. <l eID="gen10137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4431"/><l level="1" sID="gen10138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4431"/>Generatio et generatio laudabit opera tua, <l eID="gen10138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10139"/>et potentiam tuam pronuntiabunt. <l eID="gen10139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4432"/><l level="1" sID="gen10140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4432"/>Magnificentiam gloriæ sanctitatis tuæ loquentur, <l eID="gen10140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10141"/>et mirabilia tua narrabunt. <l eID="gen10141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4433"/><l level="1" sID="gen10142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4433"/>Et virtutem terribilium tuorum dicent, <l eID="gen10142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10143"/>et magnitudinem tuam narrabunt. <l eID="gen10143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4434"/><l level="1" sID="gen10144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4434"/>Memoriam abundantiæ suavitatis tuæ eructabunt, <l eID="gen10144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10145"/>et justitia tua exsultabunt. <l eID="gen10145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4435"/><l level="1" sID="gen10146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4435"/>Miserator et misericors Dominus : <l eID="gen10146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10147"/>patiens, et multum misericors. <l eID="gen10147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4436"/><l level="1" sID="gen10148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4436"/>Suavis Dominus universis, <l eID="gen10148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10149"/>et miserationes ejus super omnia opera ejus. <l eID="gen10149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4437"/><l level="1" sID="gen10150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4437"/>Confiteantur tibi, Domine, omnia opera tua, <l eID="gen10150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10151"/>et sancti tui benedicant tibi. <l eID="gen10151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4438"/><l level="1" sID="gen10152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4438"/>Gloriam regni tui dicent, <l eID="gen10152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10153"/>et potentiam tuam loquentur : <l eID="gen10153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4439"/><l level="1" sID="gen10154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4439"/>ut notam faciant filiis hominum potentiam tuam, <l eID="gen10154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10155"/>et gloriam magnificentiæ regni tui. <l eID="gen10155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:13
