verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4440"/><l level="1" sID="gen10156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4440"/>Regnum tuum regnum omnium sæculorum ; <l eID="gen10156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10157"/>et dominatio tua in omni generatione et generationem. <l eID="gen10157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10158"/>Fidelis Dominus in omnibus verbis suis, <l eID="gen10158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10159"/>et sanctus in omnibus operibus suis. <l eID="gen10159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4441"/><l level="1" sID="gen10160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4441"/>Allevat Dominus omnes qui corruunt, <l eID="gen10160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10161"/>et erigit omnes elisos. <l eID="gen10161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4442"/><l level="1" sID="gen10162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4442"/>Oculi omnium in te sperant, Domine, <l eID="gen10162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10163"/>et tu das escam illorum in tempore opportuno. <l eID="gen10163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4443"/><l level="1" sID="gen10164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4443"/>Aperis tu manum tuam, <l eID="gen10164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10165"/>et imples omne animal benedictione. <l eID="gen10165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4444"/><l level="1" sID="gen10166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4444"/>Justus Dominus in omnibus viis suis, <l eID="gen10166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10167"/>et sanctus in omnibus operibus suis. <l eID="gen10167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4445"/><l level="1" sID="gen10168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4445"/>Prope est Dominus omnibus invocantibus eum, <l eID="gen10168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10169"/>omnibus invocantibus eum in veritate. <l eID="gen10169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4446"/><l level="1" sID="gen10170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4446"/>Voluntatem timentium se faciet, <l eID="gen10170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10171"/>et deprecationem eorum exaudiet, et salvos faciet eos. <l eID="gen10171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4447"/><l level="1" sID="gen10172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4447"/>Custodit Dominus omnes diligentes se, <l eID="gen10172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10173"/>et omnes peccatores disperdet. <l eID="gen10173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 144:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4448"/><l level="1" sID="gen10174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4448"/>Laudationem Domini loquetur os meum ; <l eID="gen10174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10175"/>et benedicat omnis caro nomini sancto ejus in sæculum, et in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen10175" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10131"/> <chapter eID="Ps.144"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:1
verses.text: Alleluja, Aggæi et Zachariæ.  <div eID="gen10176" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4449"/><lg sID="gen10177"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4449"/>Lauda, anima mea, Dominum. <l eID="gen10178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10179"/>Laudabo Dominum in vita mea ; <l eID="gen10179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10180"/>psallam Deo meo quamdiu fuero. <l eID="gen10180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10181"/>Nolite confidere in principibus, <l eID="gen10181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4450"/><l level="1" sID="gen10182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4450"/>in filiis hominum, in quibus non est salus. <l eID="gen10182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4451"/><l level="1" sID="gen10183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4451"/>Exibit spiritus ejus, et revertetur in terram suam ; <l eID="gen10183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10184"/>in illa die peribunt omnes cogitationes eorum. <l eID="gen10184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4452"/><l level="1" sID="gen10185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4452"/>Beatus cujus Deus Jacob adjutor ejus, <l eID="gen10185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10186"/>spes ejus in Domino Deo ipsius : <l eID="gen10186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4453"/><l level="1" sID="gen10187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4453"/>qui fecit cælum et terram, <l eID="gen10187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10188"/>mare, et omnia quæ in eis sunt. <l eID="gen10188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4454"/><l level="1" sID="gen10189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4454"/>Qui custodit veritatem in sæculum ; <l eID="gen10189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10190"/>facit judicium injuriam patientibus ; <l eID="gen10190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10191"/>dat escam esurientibus. <l eID="gen10191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10192"/>Dominus solvit compeditos ; <l eID="gen10192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4455"/><l level="1" sID="gen10193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4455"/>Dominus illuminat cæcos. <l eID="gen10193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10194"/>Dominus erigit elisos ; <l eID="gen10194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10195"/>Dominus diligit justos. <l eID="gen10195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4456"/><l level="1" sID="gen10196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4456"/>Dominus custodit advenas, <l eID="gen10196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10197"/>pupillum et viduam suscipiet, <l eID="gen10197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10198"/>et vias peccatorum disperdet. <l eID="gen10198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 145:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4457"/><l level="1" sID="gen10199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4457"/>Regnabit Dominus in sæcula ; <l eID="gen10199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10200"/>Deus tuus, Sion, in generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen10200" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10177"/> <chapter eID="Ps.145"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen10201" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10202"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10203"/>Laudate Dominum, quoniam bonus est psalmus ; <l eID="gen10203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10204"/>Deo nostro sit jucunda, decoraque laudatio. <l eID="gen10204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4458"/><l level="1" sID="gen10205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4458"/>Ædificans Jerusalem Dominus, <l eID="gen10205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10206"/>dispersiones Israëlis congregabit : <l eID="gen10206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4459"/><l level="1" sID="gen10207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4459"/>qui sanat contritos corde, <l eID="gen10207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10208"/>et alligat contritiones eorum ; <l eID="gen10208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4460"/><l level="1" sID="gen10209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4460"/>qui numerat multitudinem stellarum, <l eID="gen10209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10210"/>et omnibus eis nomina vocat. <l eID="gen10210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4461"/><l level="1" sID="gen10211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4461"/>Magnus Dominus noster, et magna virtus ejus, <l eID="gen10211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10212"/>et sapientiæ ejus non est numerus. <l eID="gen10212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4462"/><l level="1" sID="gen10213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4462"/>Suscipiens mansuetos Dominus ; <l eID="gen10213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10214"/>humilians autem peccatores usque ad terram. <l eID="gen10214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4463"/><l level="1" sID="gen10215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4463"/>Præcinite Domino in confessione ; <l eID="gen10215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10216"/>psallite Deo nostro in cithara. <l eID="gen10216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4464"/><l level="1" sID="gen10217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4464"/>Qui operit cælum nubibus, <l eID="gen10217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10218"/>et parat terræ pluviam ; <l eID="gen10218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10219"/>qui producit in montibus fœnum, <l eID="gen10219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10220"/>et herbam servituti hominum ; <l eID="gen10220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4465"/><l level="1" sID="gen10221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4465"/>qui dat jumentis escam ipsorum, <l eID="gen10221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10222"/>et pullis corvorum invocantibus eum. <l eID="gen10222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4466"/><l level="1" sID="gen10223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4466"/>Non in fortitudine equi voluntatem habebit, <l eID="gen10223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10224"/>nec in tibiis viri beneplacitum erit ei. <l eID="gen10224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 146:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4467"/><l level="1" sID="gen10225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4467"/>Beneplacitum est Domino super timentes eum, <l eID="gen10225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10226"/>et in eis qui sperant super misericordia ejus. <l eID="gen10226" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10202"/> <chapter eID="Ps.146"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen10227" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10228"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10229"/>Lauda, Jerusalem, Dominum ; <l eID="gen10229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10230"/>lauda Deum tuum, Sion. <l eID="gen10230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4468"/><l level="1" sID="gen10231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4468"/>Quoniam confortavit seras portarum tuarum ; <l eID="gen10231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10232"/>benedixit filiis tuis in te. <l eID="gen10232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4469"/><l level="1" sID="gen10233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4469"/>Qui posuit fines tuos pacem, <l eID="gen10233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10234"/>et adipe frumenti satiat te. <l eID="gen10234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4470"/><l level="1" sID="gen10235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4470"/>Qui emittit eloquium suum terræ : <l eID="gen10235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10236"/>velociter currit sermo ejus. <l eID="gen10236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4471"/><l level="1" sID="gen10237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4471"/>Qui dat nivem sicut lanam ; <l eID="gen10237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10238"/>nebulam sicut cinerem spargit. <l eID="gen10238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4472"/><l level="1" sID="gen10239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4472"/>Mittit crystallum suam sicut buccellas : <l eID="gen10239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10240"/>ante faciem frigoris ejus quis sustinebit ? <l eID="gen10240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4473"/><l level="1" sID="gen10241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4473"/>Emittet verbum suum, et liquefaciet ea ; <l eID="gen10241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10242"/>flabit spiritus ejus, et fluent aquæ. <l eID="gen10242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4474"/><l level="1" sID="gen10243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4474"/>Qui annuntiat verbum suum Jacob, <l eID="gen10243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10244"/>justitias et judicia sua Israël. <l eID="gen10244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 147:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4475"/><l level="1" sID="gen10245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4475"/>Non fecit taliter omni nationi, <l eID="gen10245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10246"/>et judicia sua non manifestavit eis. <l eID="gen10246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10247"/>Alleluja. <l eID="gen10247" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10228"/> <chapter eID="Ps.147"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen10248" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10249"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10250"/>Laudate Dominum de cælis ; <l eID="gen10250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10251"/>laudate eum in excelsis. <l eID="gen10251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4476"/><l level="1" sID="gen10252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4476"/>Laudate eum, omnes angeli ejus ; <l eID="gen10252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10253"/>laudate eum, omnes virtutes ejus. <l eID="gen10253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4477"/><l level="1" sID="gen10254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4477"/>Laudate eum, sol et luna ; <l eID="gen10254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10255"/>laudate eum, omnes stellæ et lumen. <l eID="gen10255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4478"/><l level="1" sID="gen10256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4478"/>Laudate eum, cæli cælorum ; <l eID="gen10256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10257"/>et aquæ omnes quæ super cælos sunt, <l eID="gen10257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4479"/><l level="1" sID="gen10258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4479"/>laudent nomen Domini. <l eID="gen10258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10259"/>Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt ; <l eID="gen10259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10260"/>ipse mandavit, et creata sunt. <l eID="gen10260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4480"/><l level="1" sID="gen10261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4480"/>Statuit ea in æternum, et in sæculum sæculi ; <l eID="gen10261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10262"/>præceptum posuit, et non præteribit. <l eID="gen10262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4481"/><l level="1" sID="gen10263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4481"/>Laudate Dominum de terra, <l eID="gen10263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10264"/>dracones et omnes abyssi ; <l eID="gen10264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4482"/><l level="1" sID="gen10265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4482"/>ignis, grando, nix, glacies, spiritus procellarum, <l eID="gen10265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10266"/>quæ faciunt verbum ejus ; <l eID="gen10266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4483"/><l level="1" sID="gen10267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4483"/>montes, et omnes colles ; <l eID="gen10267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10268"/>ligna fructifera, et omnes cedri ; <l eID="gen10268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4484"/><l level="1" sID="gen10269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4484"/>bestiæ, et universa pecora ; <l eID="gen10269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10270"/>serpentes, et volucres pennatæ ; <l eID="gen10270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4485"/><l level="1" sID="gen10271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4485"/>reges terræ et omnes populi ; <l eID="gen10271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10272"/>principes et omnes judices terræ ; <l eID="gen10272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4486"/><l level="1" sID="gen10273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4486"/>juvenes et virgines ; senes cum junioribus, <l eID="gen10273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10274"/>laudent nomen Domini : <l eID="gen10274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4487"/><l level="1" sID="gen10275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4487"/>quia exaltatum est nomen ejus solius. <l eID="gen10275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 148:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4488"/><l level="1" sID="gen10276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4488"/>Confessio ejus super cælum et terram ; <l eID="gen10276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10277"/>et exaltavit cornu populi sui. <l eID="gen10277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10278"/>Hymnus omnibus sanctis ejus ; <l eID="gen10278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10279"/>filiis Israël, populo appropinquanti sibi. <l eID="gen10279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10280"/>Alleluja. <l eID="gen10280" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10249"/> <chapter eID="Ps.148"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen10281" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10282"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10283"/>Cantate Domino canticum novum ; <l eID="gen10283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10284"/>laus ejus in ecclesia sanctorum. <l eID="gen10284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4489"/><l level="1" sID="gen10285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4489"/>Lætetur Israël in eo qui fecit eum, <l eID="gen10285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10286"/>et filii Sion exsultent in rege suo. <l eID="gen10286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4490"/><l level="1" sID="gen10287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4490"/>Laudent nomen ejus in choro ; <l eID="gen10287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10288"/>in tympano et psalterio psallant ei. <l eID="gen10288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4491"/><l level="1" sID="gen10289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4491"/>Quia beneplacitum est Domino in populo suo, <l eID="gen10289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10290"/>et exaltabit mansuetos in salutem. <l eID="gen10290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4492"/><l level="1" sID="gen10291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4492"/>Exsultabunt sancti in gloria ; <l eID="gen10291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10292"/>lætabuntur in cubilibus suis. <l eID="gen10292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4493"/><l level="1" sID="gen10293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4493"/>Exaltationes Dei in gutture eorum, <l eID="gen10293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10294"/>et gladii ancipites in manibus eorum : <l eID="gen10294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4494"/><l level="1" sID="gen10295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4494"/>ad faciendam vindictam in nationibus, <l eID="gen10295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10296"/>increpationes in populis ; <l eID="gen10296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4495"/><l level="1" sID="gen10297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4495"/>ad alligandos reges eorum in compedibus, <l eID="gen10297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10298"/>et nobiles eorum in manicis ferreis ; <l eID="gen10298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 149:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4496"/><l level="1" sID="gen10299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4496"/>ut faciant in eis judicium conscriptum : <l eID="gen10299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10300"/>gloria hæc est omnibus sanctis ejus. <l eID="gen10300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10301"/>Alleluja. <l eID="gen10301" level="1"/><lg eID="gen10282"/> <chapter eID="Ps.149"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:1
verses.text: Alleluja. <div eID="gen10302" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen10303"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10304"/>Laudate Dominum in sanctis ejus ; <l eID="gen10304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10305"/>laudate eum in firmamento virtutis ejus. <l eID="gen10305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4497"/><l level="1" sID="gen10306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4497"/>Laudate eum in virtutibus ejus ; <l eID="gen10306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10307"/>laudate eum secundum multitudinem magnitudinis ejus. <l eID="gen10307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4498"/><l level="1" sID="gen10308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4498"/>Laudate eum in sono tubæ ; <l eID="gen10308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10309"/>laudate eum in psalterio et cithara. <l eID="gen10309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4499"/><l level="1" sID="gen10310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4499"/>Laudate eum in tympano et choro ; <l eID="gen10310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10311"/>laudate eum in chordis et organo. <l eID="gen10311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4500"/><l level="1" sID="gen10312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4500"/>Laudate eum in cymbalis benesonantibus ; <l eID="gen10312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10313"/>laudate eum in cymbalis jubilationis. <l eID="gen10313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Psalms 150:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4501"/><l level="1" sID="gen10314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4501"/>Omnis spiritus laudet Dominum ! <l eID="gen10314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10315"/>Alleluja. <l eID="gen10315" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10303"/> <chapter eID="Ps.150"/> <div eID="gen4555" osisID="Ps" type="book"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:1
verses.text: Parabolæ Salomonis, filii David, regis Israël, <l eID="gen10318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4502"/><l level="1" sID="gen10319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4502"/>ad sciendam sapientiam et disciplinam ; <l eID="gen10319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4503"/><l level="1" sID="gen10320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4503"/>ad intelligenda verba prudentiæ, <l eID="gen10320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10321"/>et suscipiendam eruditionem doctrinæ, <l eID="gen10321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10322"/>justitiam, et judicium, et æquitatem : <l eID="gen10322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4504"/><l level="1" sID="gen10323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4504"/>ut detur parvulis astutia, <l eID="gen10323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10324"/>adolescenti scientia et intellectus. <l eID="gen10324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4505"/><l level="1" sID="gen10325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4505"/>Audiens sapiens, sapientior erit, <l eID="gen10325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10326"/>et intelligens gubernacula possidebit. <l eID="gen10326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4506"/><l level="1" sID="gen10327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4506"/>Animadvertet parabolam et interpretationem, <l eID="gen10327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10328"/>verba sapientum et ænigmata eorum. <l eID="gen10328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4507"/><l level="1" sID="gen10329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4507"/>Timor Domini principium sapientiæ ; <l eID="gen10329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10330"/>sapientiam atque doctrinam stulti despiciunt. <l eID="gen10330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4508"/><l level="1" sID="gen10331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4508"/>Audi, fili mi, disciplinam patris tui, <l eID="gen10331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10332"/>et ne dimittas legem matris tuæ : <l eID="gen10332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4509"/><l level="1" sID="gen10333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4509"/>ut addatur gratia capiti tuo, <l eID="gen10333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10334"/>et torques collo tuo. <l eID="gen10334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4510"/><l level="1" sID="gen10335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4510"/>Fili mi, si te lactaverint peccatores, <l eID="gen10335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10336"/>ne acquiescas eis. <l eID="gen10336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4511"/><l level="1" sID="gen10337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4511"/>Si dixerint : Veni nobiscum, insidiemur sanguini ; <l eID="gen10337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10338"/>abscondamus tendiculas contra insontem frustra ; <l eID="gen10338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4512"/><l level="1" sID="gen10339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4512"/>deglutiamus eum sicut infernus viventem, <l eID="gen10339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10340"/>et integrum quasi descendentem in lacum ; <l eID="gen10340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4513"/><l level="1" sID="gen10341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4513"/>omnem pretiosam substantiam reperiemus ; <l eID="gen10341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10342"/>implebimus domos nostras spoliis : <l eID="gen10342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4514"/><l level="1" sID="gen10343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4514"/>sortem mitte nobiscum, <l eID="gen10343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10344"/>marsupium unum sit omnium nostrum : <l eID="gen10344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4515"/><l level="1" sID="gen10345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4515"/>fili mi, ne ambules cum eis ; <l eID="gen10345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10346"/>prohibe pedem tuum a semitis eorum : <l eID="gen10346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4516"/><l level="1" sID="gen10347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4516"/>pedes enim illorum ad malum currunt, <l eID="gen10347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10348"/>et festinant ut effundant sanguinem. <l eID="gen10348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4517"/><l level="1" sID="gen10349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4517"/>Frustra autem jacitur rete <l eID="gen10349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10350"/>ante oculos pennatorum. <l eID="gen10350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4518"/><l level="1" sID="gen10351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4518"/>Ipsi quoque contra sanguinem suum insidiantur, <l eID="gen10351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10352"/>et moliuntur fraudes contra animas suas. <l eID="gen10352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4519"/><l level="1" sID="gen10353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4519"/>Sic semitæ omnis avari : <l eID="gen10353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10354"/>animas possidentium rapiunt. <l eID="gen10354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4520"/><l level="1" sID="gen10355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4520"/>Sapientia foris prædicat ; <l eID="gen10355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10356"/>in plateis dat vocem suam : <l eID="gen10356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4521"/><l level="1" sID="gen10357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4521"/>in capite turbarum clamitat ; <l eID="gen10357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10358"/>in foribus portarum urbis profert verba sua, dicens : <l eID="gen10358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4522"/><l level="1" sID="gen10359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4522"/>Usquequo, parvuli, diligitis infantiam, <l eID="gen10359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10360"/>et stulti ea quæ sibi sunt noxia cupient, <l eID="gen10360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10361"/>et imprudentes odibunt scientiam ? <l eID="gen10361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4523"/><l level="1" sID="gen10362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4523"/>convertimini ad correptionem meam. <l eID="gen10362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10363"/>En proferam vobis spiritum meum, <l eID="gen10363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10364"/>et ostendam vobis verba mea. <l eID="gen10364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4524"/><l level="1" sID="gen10365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4524"/>Quia vocavi, et renuistis ; <l eID="gen10365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10366"/>extendi manum meam, et non fuit qui aspiceret : <l eID="gen10366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4525"/><l level="1" sID="gen10367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4525"/>despexistis omne consilium meum, <l eID="gen10367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10368"/>et increpationes meas neglexistis. <l eID="gen10368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4526"/><l level="1" sID="gen10369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4526"/>Ego quoque in interitu vestro ridebo, <l eID="gen10369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10370"/>et subsannabo cum vobis id quod timebatis advenerit. <l eID="gen10370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4527"/><l level="1" sID="gen10371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4527"/>Cum irruerit repentina calamitas, <l eID="gen10371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10372"/>et interitus quasi tempestas ingruerit ; <l eID="gen10372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10373"/>quando venerit super vos tribulatio et angustia : <l eID="gen10373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4528"/><l level="1" sID="gen10374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4528"/>tunc invocabunt me, et non exaudiam ; <l eID="gen10374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10375"/>mane consurgent, et non invenient me : <l eID="gen10375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4529"/><l level="1" sID="gen10376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4529"/>eo quod exosam habuerint disciplinam, <l eID="gen10376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10377"/>et timorem Domini non susceperint, <l eID="gen10377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4530"/><l level="1" sID="gen10378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4530"/>nec acquieverint consilio meo, <l eID="gen10378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10379"/>et detraxerint universæ correptioni meæ. <l eID="gen10379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4531"/><l level="1" sID="gen10380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4531"/>Comedent igitur fructus viæ suæ, <l eID="gen10380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10381"/>suisque consiliis saturabuntur. <l eID="gen10381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4532"/><l level="1" sID="gen10382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4532"/>Aversio parvulorum interficiet eos, <l eID="gen10382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10383"/>et prosperitas stultorum perdet illos. <l eID="gen10383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 1:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4533"/><l level="1" sID="gen10384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4533"/>Qui autem me audierit, absque terrore requiescet, <l eID="gen10384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10385"/>et abundantia perfruetur, timore malorum sublato.  <chapter eID="Prov.1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:1
verses.text: Fili mi, si susceperis sermones meos, <l eID="gen10386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10387"/>et mandata mea absconderis penes te : <l eID="gen10387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4534"/><l level="1" sID="gen10388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4534"/>ut audiat sapientiam auris tua, <l eID="gen10388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10389"/>inclina cor tuum ad cognoscendam prudentiam. <l eID="gen10389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4535"/><l level="1" sID="gen10390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4535"/>Si enim sapientiam invocaveris, <l eID="gen10390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10391"/>et inclinaveris cor tuum prudentiæ ; <l eID="gen10391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4536"/><l level="1" sID="gen10392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4536"/>si quæsieris eam quasi pecuniam, <l eID="gen10392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10393"/>et sicut thesauros effoderis illam : <l eID="gen10393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4537"/><l level="1" sID="gen10394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4537"/>tunc intelliges timorem Domini, <l eID="gen10394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10395"/>et scientiam Dei invenies, <l eID="gen10395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4538"/><l level="1" sID="gen10396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4538"/>quia Dominus dat sapientiam, <l eID="gen10396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10397"/>et ex ore ejus prudentia et scientia. <l eID="gen10397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4539"/><l level="1" sID="gen10398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4539"/>Custodiet rectorum salutem, <l eID="gen10398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10399"/>et proteget gradientes simpliciter, <l eID="gen10399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4540"/><l level="1" sID="gen10400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4540"/>servans semitas justitiæ, <l eID="gen10400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10401"/>et vias sanctorum custodiens. <l eID="gen10401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4541"/><l level="1" sID="gen10402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4541"/>Tunc intelliges justitiam, et judicium, <l eID="gen10402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10403"/>et æquitatem, et omnem semitam bonam. <l eID="gen10403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4542"/><l level="1" sID="gen10404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4542"/>Si intraverit sapientia cor tuum, <l eID="gen10404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10405"/>et scientia animæ tuæ placuerit, <l eID="gen10405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4543"/><l level="1" sID="gen10406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4543"/>consilium custodiet te, <l eID="gen10406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10407"/>et prudentia servabit te : <l eID="gen10407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4544"/><l level="1" sID="gen10408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4544"/>ut eruaris a via mala, <l eID="gen10408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10409"/>et ab homine qui perversa loquitur ; <l eID="gen10409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4545"/><l level="1" sID="gen10410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4545"/>qui relinquunt iter rectum, <l eID="gen10410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10411"/>et ambulant per vias tenebrosas ; <l eID="gen10411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4546"/><l level="1" sID="gen10412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4546"/>qui lætantur cum malefecerint, <l eID="gen10412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10413"/>et exsultant in rebus pessimis ; <l eID="gen10413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4547"/><l level="1" sID="gen10414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4547"/>quorum viæ perversæ sunt, <l eID="gen10414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10415"/>et infames gressus eorum. <l eID="gen10415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4548"/><l level="1" sID="gen10416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4548"/>Ut eruaris a muliere aliena, <l eID="gen10416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10417"/>et ab extranea quæ mollit sermones suos, <l eID="gen10417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4549"/><l level="1" sID="gen10418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4549"/>et relinquit ducem pubertatis suæ, <l eID="gen10418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4550"/><l level="1" sID="gen10419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4550"/>et pacti Dei sui oblita est. <l eID="gen10419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10420"/>Inclinata est enim ad mortem domus ejus, <l eID="gen10420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10421"/>et ad inferos semitæ ipsius. <l eID="gen10421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4551"/><l level="1" sID="gen10422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4551"/>Omnes qui ingrediuntur ad eam non revertentur, <l eID="gen10422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10423"/>nec apprehendent semitas vitæ. <l eID="gen10423" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4552"/><l level="1" sID="gen10424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4552"/>Ut ambules in via bona, <l eID="gen10424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10425"/>et calles justorum custodias : <l eID="gen10425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4553"/><l level="1" sID="gen10426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4553"/>qui enim recti sunt habitabunt in terra, <l eID="gen10426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10427"/>et simplices permanebunt in ea ; <l eID="gen10427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4554"/><l level="1" sID="gen10428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4554"/>impii vero de terra perdentur, <l eID="gen10428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10429"/>et qui inique agunt auferentur ex ea.  <chapter eID="Prov.2"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:1
verses.text: Fili mi, ne obliviscaris legis meæ, <l eID="gen10430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10431"/>et præcepta mea cor tuum custodiat : <l eID="gen10431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4555"/><l level="1" sID="gen10432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4555"/>longitudinem enim dierum, et annos vitæ, et pacem, <l eID="gen10432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10433"/>apponent tibi. <l eID="gen10433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4556"/><l level="1" sID="gen10434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4556"/>Misericordia et veritas te non deserant ; <l eID="gen10434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10435"/>circumda eas gutturi tuo, <l eID="gen10435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10436"/>et describe in tabulis cordis tui : <l eID="gen10436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4557"/><l level="1" sID="gen10437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4557"/>et invenies gratiam, et disciplinam bonam, <l eID="gen10437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10438"/>coram Deo et hominibus. <l eID="gen10438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4558"/><l level="1" sID="gen10439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4558"/>Habe fiduciam in Domino ex toto corde tuo, <l eID="gen10439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10440"/>et ne innitaris prudentiæ tuæ. <l eID="gen10440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4559"/><l level="1" sID="gen10441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4559"/>In omnibus viis tuis cogita illum, <l eID="gen10441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10442"/>et ipse diriget gressus tuos. <l eID="gen10442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4560"/><l level="1" sID="gen10443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4560"/>Ne sis sapiens apud temetipsum ; <l eID="gen10443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10444"/>time Deum, et recede a malo : <l eID="gen10444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4561"/><l level="1" sID="gen10445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4561"/>sanitas quippe erit umbilico tuo, <l eID="gen10445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10446"/>et irrigatio ossium tuorum. <l eID="gen10446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4562"/><l level="1" sID="gen10447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4562"/>Honora Dominum de tua substantia, <l eID="gen10447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10448"/>et de primitiis omnium frugum tuarum da ei : <l eID="gen10448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4563"/><l level="1" sID="gen10449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4563"/>et implebuntur horrea tua saturitate, <l eID="gen10449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10450"/>et vino torcularia tua redundabunt. <l eID="gen10450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4564"/><l level="1" sID="gen10451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4564"/>Disciplinam Domini, fili mi, ne abjicias, <l eID="gen10451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10452"/>nec deficias cum ab eo corriperis : <l eID="gen10452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4565"/><l level="1" sID="gen10453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4565"/>quem enim diligit Dominus, corripit, <l eID="gen10453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10454"/>et quasi pater in filio complacet sibi. <l eID="gen10454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4566"/><l level="1" sID="gen10455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4566"/>Beatus homo qui invenit sapientiam, <l eID="gen10455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10456"/>et qui affluit prudentia. <l eID="gen10456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4567"/><l level="1" sID="gen10457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4567"/>Melior est acquisitio ejus negotiatione argenti, <l eID="gen10457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10458"/>et auri primi et purissimi fructus ejus. <l eID="gen10458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4568"/><l level="1" sID="gen10459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4568"/>Pretiosior est cunctis opibus, <l eID="gen10459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10460"/>et omnia quæ desiderantur huic non valent comparari. <l eID="gen10460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4569"/><l level="1" sID="gen10461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4569"/>Longitudo dierum in dextera ejus, <l eID="gen10461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10462"/>et in sinistra illius divitiæ et gloria. <l eID="gen10462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4570"/><l level="1" sID="gen10463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4570"/>Viæ ejus viæ pulchræ, <l eID="gen10463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10464"/>et omnes semitæ illius pacificæ. <l eID="gen10464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4571"/><l level="1" sID="gen10465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4571"/>Lignum vitæ est his qui apprehenderint eam, <l eID="gen10465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10466"/>et qui tenuerit eam beatus. <l eID="gen10466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4572"/><l level="1" sID="gen10467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4572"/>Dominus sapientia fundavit terram ; <l eID="gen10467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10468"/>stabilivit cælos prudentia. <l eID="gen10468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4573"/><l level="1" sID="gen10469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4573"/>Sapientia illius eruperunt abyssi, <l eID="gen10469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10470"/>et nubes rore concrescunt. <l eID="gen10470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4574"/><l level="1" sID="gen10471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4574"/>Fili mi, ne effluant hæc ab oculis tuis. <l eID="gen10471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10472"/>Custodi legem atque consilium, <l eID="gen10472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4575"/><l level="1" sID="gen10473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4575"/>et erit vita animæ tuæ, <l eID="gen10473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10474"/>et gratia faucibus tuis. <l eID="gen10474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4576"/><l level="1" sID="gen10475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4576"/>Tunc ambulabis fiducialiter in via tua, <l eID="gen10475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10476"/>et pes tuus non impinget. <l eID="gen10476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4577"/><l level="1" sID="gen10477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4577"/>Si dormieris, non timebis ; <l eID="gen10477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10478"/>quiesces, et suavis erit somnus tuus. <l eID="gen10478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4578"/><l level="1" sID="gen10479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4578"/>Ne paveas repentino terrore, <l eID="gen10479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10480"/>et irruentes tibi potentias impiorum. <l eID="gen10480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4579"/><l level="1" sID="gen10481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4579"/>Dominus enim erit in latere tuo, <l eID="gen10481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10482"/>et custodiet pedem tuum, ne capiaris. <l eID="gen10482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4580"/><l level="1" sID="gen10483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4580"/>Noli prohibere benefacere eum qui potest : <l eID="gen10483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10484"/>si vales, et ipse benefac. <l eID="gen10484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4581"/><l level="1" sID="gen10485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4581"/>Ne dicas amico tuo : Vade, et revertere : cras dabo tibi : <l eID="gen10485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10486"/>cum statim possis dare. <l eID="gen10486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4582"/><l level="1" sID="gen10487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4582"/>Ne moliaris amico tuo malum, <l eID="gen10487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10488"/>cum ille in te habeat fiduciam. <l eID="gen10488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4583"/><l level="1" sID="gen10489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4583"/>Ne contendas adversus hominem frustra, <l eID="gen10489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10490"/>cum ipse tibi nihil mali fecerit. <l eID="gen10490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4584"/><l level="1" sID="gen10491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4584"/>Ne æmuleris hominem injustum, <l eID="gen10491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10492"/>nec imiteris vias ejus : <l eID="gen10492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4585"/><l level="1" sID="gen10493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4585"/>quia abominatio Domini est omnis illusor, <l eID="gen10493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10494"/>et cum simplicibus sermocinatio ejus. <l eID="gen10494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4586"/><l level="1" sID="gen10495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4586"/>Egestas a Domino in domo impii ; <l eID="gen10495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10496"/>habitacula autem justorum benedicentur. <l eID="gen10496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4587"/><l level="1" sID="gen10497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4587"/>Ipse deludet illusores, <l eID="gen10497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10498"/>et mansuetis dabit gratiam. <l eID="gen10498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 3:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4588"/><l level="1" sID="gen10499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4588"/>Gloriam sapientes possidebunt ; <l eID="gen10499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10500"/>stultorum exaltatio ignominia. <l eID="gen10500" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4589"/><div sID="gen10501" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="Prov.3"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:1
verses.text: Audite, filii, disciplinam patris, <l eID="gen10503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10504"/>et attendite ut sciatis prudentiam. <l eID="gen10504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4589"/><l level="1" sID="gen10505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4589"/>Donum bonum tribuam vobis : <l eID="gen10505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10506"/>legem meam ne derelinquatis. <l eID="gen10506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4590"/><l level="1" sID="gen10507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4590"/>Nam et ego filius fui patris mei, <l eID="gen10507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10508"/>tenellus et unigenitus coram matre mea. <l eID="gen10508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4591"/><l level="1" sID="gen10509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4591"/>Et docebat me, atque dicebat : <l eID="gen10509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10510"/>Suscipiat verba mea cor tuum ; <l eID="gen10510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10511"/>custodi præcepta mea, et vives. <l eID="gen10511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4592"/><l level="1" sID="gen10512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4592"/>Posside sapientiam, posside prudentiam : <l eID="gen10512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10513"/>ne obliviscaris, neque declines a verbis oris mei. <l eID="gen10513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4593"/><l level="1" sID="gen10514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4593"/>Ne dimittas eam, et custodiet te : <l eID="gen10514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10515"/>dilige eam, et conservabit te. <l eID="gen10515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4594"/><l level="1" sID="gen10516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4594"/>Principium sapientiæ : posside sapientiam, <l eID="gen10516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10517"/>et in omni possessione tua acquire prudentiam. <l eID="gen10517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4595"/><l level="1" sID="gen10518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4595"/>Arripe illam, et exaltabit te ; <l eID="gen10518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10519"/>glorificaberis ab ea cum eam fueris amplexatus. <l eID="gen10519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4596"/><l level="1" sID="gen10520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4596"/>Dabit capiti tuo augmenta gratiarum, <l eID="gen10520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10521"/>et corona inclyta proteget te. <l eID="gen10521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4597"/><l level="1" sID="gen10522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4597"/>Audi, fili mi, et suscipe verba mea, <l eID="gen10522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10523"/>ut multiplicentur tibi anni vitæ. <l eID="gen10523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4598"/><l level="1" sID="gen10524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4598"/>Viam sapientiæ monstrabo tibi ; <l eID="gen10524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10525"/>ducam te per semitas æquitatis : <l eID="gen10525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4599"/><l level="1" sID="gen10526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4599"/>quas cum ingressus fueris, non arctabuntur gressus tui, <l eID="gen10526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10527"/>et currens non habebis offendiculum. <l eID="gen10527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4600"/><l level="1" sID="gen10528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4600"/>Tene disciplinam, ne dimittas eam ; <l eID="gen10528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10529"/>custodi illam, quia ipsa est vita tua. <l eID="gen10529" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4601"/><l level="1" sID="gen10530"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4601"/>Ne delecteris in semitis impiorum, <l eID="gen10530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10531"/>nec tibi placeat malorum via. <l eID="gen10531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4602"/><l level="1" sID="gen10532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4602"/>Fuge ab ea, nec transeas per illam ; <l eID="gen10532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10533"/>declina, et desere eam. <l eID="gen10533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4603"/><l level="1" sID="gen10534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4603"/>Non enim dormiunt nisi malefecerint, <l eID="gen10534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10535"/>et rapitur somnus ab eis nisi supplantaverint. <l eID="gen10535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4604"/><l level="1" sID="gen10536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4604"/>Comedunt panem impietatis, <l eID="gen10536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10537"/>et vinum iniquitatis bibunt. <l eID="gen10537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4605"/><l level="1" sID="gen10538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4605"/>Justorum autem semita quasi lux splendens procedit, <l eID="gen10538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10539"/>et crescit usque ad perfectam diem. <l eID="gen10539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4606"/><l level="1" sID="gen10540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4606"/>Via impiorum tenebrosa ; <l eID="gen10540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10541"/>nesciunt ubi corruant. <l eID="gen10541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4607"/><l level="1" sID="gen10542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4607"/>Fili mi, ausculta sermones meos, <l eID="gen10542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10543"/>et ad eloquia mea inclina aurem tuam. <l eID="gen10543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4608"/><l level="1" sID="gen10544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4608"/>Ne recedant ab oculis tuis : <l eID="gen10544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10545"/>custodi ea in medio cordis tui : <l eID="gen10545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4609"/><l level="1" sID="gen10546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4609"/>vita enim sunt invenientibus ea, <l eID="gen10546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10547"/>et universæ carni sanitas. <l eID="gen10547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4610"/><l level="1" sID="gen10548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4610"/>Omni custodia serva cor tuum, <l eID="gen10548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10549"/>quia ex ipso vita procedit. <l eID="gen10549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4611"/><l level="1" sID="gen10550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4611"/>Remove a te os pravum, <l eID="gen10550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10551"/>et detrahentia labia sint procul a te. <l eID="gen10551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4612"/><l level="1" sID="gen10552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4612"/>Oculi tui recta videant, <l eID="gen10552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10553"/>et palpebræ tuæ præcedant gressus tuos. <l eID="gen10553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4613"/><l level="1" sID="gen10554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4613"/>Dirige semitam pedibus tuis, <l eID="gen10554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10555"/>et omnes viæ tuæ stabilientur. <l eID="gen10555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4614"/><l level="1" sID="gen10556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4614"/>Ne declines ad dexteram neque ad sinistram ; <l eID="gen10556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10557"/>averte pedem tuum a malo : <l eID="gen10557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10558"/>vias enim quæ a dextris sunt novit Dominus : <l eID="gen10558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10559"/>perversæ vero sunt quæ a sinistris sunt. <l eID="gen10559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10560"/>Ipse autem rectos faciet cursus tuos, <l eID="gen10560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10561"/>itinera autem tua in pace producet.  <chapter eID="Prov.4"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:1
verses.text: Fili mi, attende ad sapientiam meam, <l eID="gen10562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10563"/>et prudentiæ meæ inclina aurem tuam : <l eID="gen10563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4615"/><l level="1" sID="gen10564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4615"/>ut custodias cogitationes, et disciplinam labia tua conservent. <l eID="gen10564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10565"/>Ne attendas fallaciæ mulieris ; <l eID="gen10565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4616"/><l level="1" sID="gen10566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4616"/>favus enim distillans labia meretricis, <l eID="gen10566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10567"/>et nitidius oleo guttur ejus : <l eID="gen10567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4617"/><l level="1" sID="gen10568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4617"/>novissima autem illius amara quasi absinthium, <l eID="gen10568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10569"/>et acuta quasi gladius biceps. <l eID="gen10569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4618"/><l level="1" sID="gen10570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4618"/>Pedes ejus descendunt in mortem, <l eID="gen10570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10571"/>et ad inferos gressus illius penetrant. <l eID="gen10571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4619"/><l level="1" sID="gen10572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4619"/>Per semitam vitæ non ambulant ; <l eID="gen10572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10573"/>vagi sunt gressus ejus et investigabiles. <l eID="gen10573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4620"/><l level="1" sID="gen10574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4620"/>Nunc ergo fili mi, audi me, <l eID="gen10574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10575"/>et ne recedas a verbis oris mei. <l eID="gen10575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4621"/><l level="1" sID="gen10576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4621"/>Longe fac ab ea viam tuam, <l eID="gen10576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10577"/>et ne appropinques foribus domus ejus. <l eID="gen10577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4622"/><l level="1" sID="gen10578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4622"/>Ne des alienis honorem tuum, <l eID="gen10578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10579"/>et annos tuos crudeli : <l eID="gen10579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4623"/><l level="1" sID="gen10580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4623"/>ne forte impleantur extranei viribus tuis, <l eID="gen10580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10581"/>et labores tui sint in domo aliena, <l eID="gen10581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4624"/><l level="1" sID="gen10582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4624"/>et gemas in novissimis, <l eID="gen10582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10583"/>quando consumpseris carnes tuas et corpus tuum, <l eID="gen10583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10584"/>et dicas :

verses.name: Proverbs 5:12
verses.text: Cur detestatus sum disciplinam, <l eID="gen10584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10585"/>et increpationibus non acquievit cor meum, <l eID="gen10585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4625"/><l level="1" sID="gen10586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4625"/>nec audivi vocem docentium me, <l eID="gen10586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10587"/>et magistris non inclinavi aurem meam ? <l eID="gen10587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4626"/><l level="1" sID="gen10588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4626"/>pene fui in omni malo, <l eID="gen10588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10589"/>in medio ecclesiæ et synagogæ. <l eID="gen10589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4627"/><l level="1" sID="gen10590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4627"/>Bibe aquam de cisterna tua, <l eID="gen10590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10591"/>et fluenta putei tui ; <l eID="gen10591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4628"/><l level="1" sID="gen10592"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4628"/>deriventur fontes tui foras, <l eID="gen10592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10593"/>et in plateis aquas tuas divide. <l eID="gen10593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4629"/><l level="1" sID="gen10594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4629"/>Habeto eas solus, <l eID="gen10594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10595"/>nec sint alieni participes tui. <l eID="gen10595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4630"/><l level="1" sID="gen10596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4630"/>Sit vena tua benedicta, <l eID="gen10596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10597"/>et lætare cum muliere adolescentiæ tuæ. <l eID="gen10597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4631"/><l level="1" sID="gen10598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4631"/>Cerva carissima, et gratissimus hinnulus : <l eID="gen10598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10599"/>ubera ejus inebrient te in omni tempore ; <l eID="gen10599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10600"/>in amore ejus delectare jugiter. <l eID="gen10600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4632"/><l level="1" sID="gen10601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4632"/>Quare seduceris, fili mi, ab aliena, <l eID="gen10601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10602"/>et foveris in sinu alterius ? <l eID="gen10602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4633"/><l level="1" sID="gen10603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4633"/>Respicit Dominus vias hominis, <l eID="gen10603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10604"/>et omnes gressus ejus considerat. <l eID="gen10604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4634"/><l level="1" sID="gen10605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4634"/>Iniquitates suas capiunt impium, <l eID="gen10605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10606"/>et funibus peccatorum suorum constringitur. <l eID="gen10606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4635"/><l level="1" sID="gen10607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4635"/>Ipse morietur, quia non habuit disciplinam, <l eID="gen10607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10608"/>et in multitudine stultitiæ suæ decipietur.  <chapter eID="Prov.5"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:1
verses.text: Fili mi, si spoponderis pro amico tuo, <l eID="gen10609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10610"/>defixisti apud extraneum manum tuam : <l eID="gen10610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4636"/><l level="1" sID="gen10611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4636"/>illaqueatus es verbis oris tui, <l eID="gen10611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10612"/>et captus propriis sermonibus. <l eID="gen10612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4637"/><l level="1" sID="gen10613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4637"/>Fac ergo quod dico, fili mi, et temetipsum libera, <l eID="gen10613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10614"/>quia incidisti in manum proximi tui. <l eID="gen10614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10615"/>Discurre, festina, suscita amicum tuum. <l eID="gen10615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4638"/><l level="1" sID="gen10616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4638"/>Ne dederis somnum oculis tuis, <l eID="gen10616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10617"/>nec dormitent palpebræ tuæ. <l eID="gen10617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4639"/><l level="1" sID="gen10618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4639"/>Eruere quasi damula de manu, <l eID="gen10618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10619"/>et quasi avis de manu aucupis. <l eID="gen10619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4640"/><l level="1" sID="gen10620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4640"/>Vade ad formicam, o piger, <l eID="gen10620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10621"/>et considera vias ejus, et disce sapientiam. <l eID="gen10621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4641"/><l level="1" sID="gen10622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4641"/>Quæ cum non habeat ducem, <l eID="gen10622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10623"/>nec præceptorem, nec principem, <l eID="gen10623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4642"/><l level="1" sID="gen10624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4642"/>parat in æstate cibum sibi, <l eID="gen10624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10625"/>et congregat in messe quod comedat. <l eID="gen10625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4643"/><l level="1" sID="gen10626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4643"/>Usquequo, piger, dormies ? <l eID="gen10626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10627"/>quando consurges e somno tuo ? <l eID="gen10627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4644"/><l level="1" sID="gen10628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4644"/>Paululum dormies, paululum dormitabis, <l eID="gen10628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10629"/>paululum conseres manus ut dormias ; <l eID="gen10629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4645"/><l level="1" sID="gen10630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4645"/>et veniet tibi quasi viator egestas, <l eID="gen10630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10631"/>et pauperies quasi vir armatus. <l eID="gen10631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10632"/>Si vero impiger fueris, veniet ut fons messis tua, <l eID="gen10632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10633"/>et egestas longe fugiet a te. <l eID="gen10633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4646"/><l level="1" sID="gen10634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4646"/>Homo apostata, vir inutilis, graditur ore perverso ; <l eID="gen10634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4647"/><l level="1" sID="gen10635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4647"/>annuit oculis, terit pede, digito loquitur, <l eID="gen10635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4648"/><l level="1" sID="gen10636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4648"/>pravo corde machinatur malum, <l eID="gen10636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10637"/>et omni tempore jurgia seminat. <l eID="gen10637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4649"/><l level="1" sID="gen10638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4649"/>Huic extemplo veniet perditio sua, <l eID="gen10638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10639"/>et subito conteretur, nec habebit ultra medicinam. <l eID="gen10639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4650"/><l level="1" sID="gen10640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4650"/>Sex sunt quæ odit Dominus, <l eID="gen10640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10641"/>et septimum detestatur anima ejus : <l eID="gen10641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4651"/><l level="1" sID="gen10642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4651"/>oculos sublimes, linguam mendacem, <l eID="gen10642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10643"/>manus effundentes innoxium sanguinem, <l eID="gen10643" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4652"/><l level="1" sID="gen10644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4652"/>cor machinans cogitationes pessimas, <l eID="gen10644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10645"/>pedes veloces ad currendum in malum, <l eID="gen10645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:19
