verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4653"/><l level="1" sID="gen10646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4653"/>proferentem mendacia testem fallacem, <l eID="gen10646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10647"/>et eum qui seminat inter fratres discordias. <l eID="gen10647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4654"/><l level="1" sID="gen10648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4654"/>Conserva, fili mi, præcepta patris tui, <l eID="gen10648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10649"/>et ne dimittas legem matris tuæ. <l eID="gen10649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4655"/><l level="1" sID="gen10650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4655"/>Liga ea in corde tuo jugiter, <l eID="gen10650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10651"/>et circumda gutturi tuo. <l eID="gen10651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4656"/><l level="1" sID="gen10652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4656"/>Cum ambulaveris, gradiantur tecum ; <l eID="gen10652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10653"/>cum dormieris, custodiant te : <l eID="gen10653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10654"/>et evigilans loquere cum eis. <l eID="gen10654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4657"/><l level="1" sID="gen10655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4657"/>Quia mandatum lucerna est, et lex lux, <l eID="gen10655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10656"/>et via vitæ increpatio disciplinæ : <l eID="gen10656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4658"/><l level="1" sID="gen10657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4658"/>ut custodiant te a muliere mala, <l eID="gen10657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10658"/>et a blanda lingua extraneæ. <l eID="gen10658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4659"/><l level="1" sID="gen10659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4659"/>Non concupiscat pulchritudinem ejus cor tuum, <l eID="gen10659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10660"/>nec capiaris nutibus illius : <l eID="gen10660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4660"/><l level="1" sID="gen10661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4660"/>pretium enim scorti vix est unius panis, <l eID="gen10661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10662"/>mulier autem viri pretiosam animam capit. <l eID="gen10662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4661"/><l level="1" sID="gen10663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4661"/>Numquid potest homo abscondere ignem in sinu suo, <l eID="gen10663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10664"/>ut vestimenta illius non ardeant ? <l eID="gen10664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4662"/><l level="1" sID="gen10665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4662"/>aut ambulare super prunas, <l eID="gen10665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10666"/>ut non comburantur plantæ ejus ? <l eID="gen10666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4663"/><l level="1" sID="gen10667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4663"/>sic qui ingreditur ad mulierem proximi sui, <l eID="gen10667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10668"/>non erit mundus cum tetigerit eam. <l eID="gen10668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4664"/><l level="1" sID="gen10669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4664"/>Non grandis est culpa cum quis furatus fuerit : <l eID="gen10669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10670"/>furatur enim ut esurientem impleat animam ; <l eID="gen10670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4665"/><l level="1" sID="gen10671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4665"/>deprehensus quoque reddet septuplum, <l eID="gen10671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10672"/>et omnem substantiam domus suæ tradet. <l eID="gen10672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4666"/><l level="1" sID="gen10673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4666"/>Qui autem adulter est, <l eID="gen10673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10674"/>propter cordis inopiam perdet animam suam ; <l eID="gen10674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4667"/><l level="1" sID="gen10675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4667"/>turpitudinem et ignominiam congregat sibi, <l eID="gen10675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10676"/>et opprobrium illius non delebitur : <l eID="gen10676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4668"/><l level="1" sID="gen10677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4668"/>quia zelus et furor viri <l eID="gen10677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10678"/>non parcet in die vindictæ, <l eID="gen10678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 6:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4669"/><l level="1" sID="gen10679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4669"/>nec acquiescet cujusquam precibus, <l eID="gen10679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10680"/>nec suscipiet pro redemptione dona plurima.  <chapter eID="Prov.6"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:1
verses.text: Fili mi, custodi sermones meos, <l eID="gen10681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10682"/>et præcepta mea reconde tibi. <l eID="gen10682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10683"/>Fili,

verses.name: Proverbs 7:2
verses.text: serva mandata mea, et vives ; <l eID="gen10683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10684"/>et legem meam quasi pupillam oculi tui : <l eID="gen10684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4670"/><l level="1" sID="gen10685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4670"/>liga eam in digitis tuis, <l eID="gen10685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10686"/>scribe illam in tabulis cordis tui. <l eID="gen10686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4671"/><l level="1" sID="gen10687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4671"/>Dic sapientiæ : Soror mea es, <l eID="gen10687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10688"/>et prudentiam voca amicam tuam : <l eID="gen10688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4672"/><l level="1" sID="gen10689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4672"/>ut custodiant te a muliere extranea, <l eID="gen10689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10690"/>et ab aliena quæ verba sua dulcia facit. <l eID="gen10690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4673"/><l level="1" sID="gen10691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4673"/>De fenestra enim domus meæ <l eID="gen10691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10692"/>per cancellos prospexi, <l eID="gen10692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4674"/><l level="1" sID="gen10693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4674"/>et video parvulos ; <l eID="gen10693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10694"/>considero vecordem juvenem, <l eID="gen10694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4675"/><l level="1" sID="gen10695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4675"/>qui transit per plateam juxta angulum <l eID="gen10695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10696"/>et prope viam domus illius graditur : <l eID="gen10696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4676"/><l level="1" sID="gen10697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4676"/>in obscuro, advesperascente die, <l eID="gen10697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10698"/>in noctis tenebris et caligine. <l eID="gen10698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4677"/><l level="1" sID="gen10699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4677"/>Et ecce occurrit illi mulier ornatu meretricio, <l eID="gen10699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10700"/>præparata ad capiendas animas : <l eID="gen10700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10701"/>garrula et vaga, <l eID="gen10701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4678"/><l level="1" sID="gen10702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4678"/>quietis impatiens, <l eID="gen10702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10703"/>nec valens in domo consistere pedibus suis ; <l eID="gen10703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4679"/><l level="1" sID="gen10704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4679"/>nunc foris, nunc in plateis, <l eID="gen10704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10705"/>nunc juxta angulos insidians. <l eID="gen10705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4680"/><l level="1" sID="gen10706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4680"/>Apprehensumque deosculatur juvenem, <l eID="gen10706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10707"/>et procaci vultu blanditur, dicens : <l eID="gen10707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4681"/><l level="1" sID="gen10708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4681"/>Victimas pro salute vovi ; <l eID="gen10708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10709"/>hodie reddidi vota mea : <l eID="gen10709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4682"/><l level="1" sID="gen10710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4682"/>idcirco egressa sum in occursum tuum, <l eID="gen10710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10711"/>desiderans te videre, et reperi. <l eID="gen10711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4683"/><l level="1" sID="gen10712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4683"/>Intexui funibus lectulum meum ; <l eID="gen10712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10713"/>stravi tapetibus pictis ex Ægypto : <l eID="gen10713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4684"/><l level="1" sID="gen10714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4684"/>aspersi cubile meum myrrha, <l eID="gen10714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10715"/>et aloë, et cinnamomo. <l eID="gen10715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4685"/><l level="1" sID="gen10716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4685"/>Veni, inebriemur uberibus, <l eID="gen10716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10717"/>et fruamur cupitis amplexibus donec illucescat dies. <l eID="gen10717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4686"/><l level="1" sID="gen10718"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4686"/>Non est enim vir in domo sua : <l eID="gen10718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10719"/>abiit via longissima : <l eID="gen10719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4687"/><l level="1" sID="gen10720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4687"/>sacculum pecuniæ secum tulit ; <l eID="gen10720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10721"/>in die plenæ lunæ reversurus est in domum suam. <l eID="gen10721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4688"/><l level="1" sID="gen10722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4688"/>Irretivit eum multis sermonibus, <l eID="gen10722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10723"/>et blanditiis labiorum protraxit illum. <l eID="gen10723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4689"/><l level="1" sID="gen10724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4689"/>Statim eam sequitur quasi bos ductus ad victimam, <l eID="gen10724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10725"/>et quasi agnus lasciviens, <l eID="gen10725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10726"/>et ignorans quod ad vincula stultus trahatur : <l eID="gen10726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4690"/><l level="1" sID="gen10727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4690"/>donec transfigat sagitta jecur ejus, <l eID="gen10727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10728"/>velut si avis festinet ad laqueum, <l eID="gen10728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10729"/>et nescit quod de periculo animæ illius agitur. <l eID="gen10729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4691"/><l level="1" sID="gen10730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4691"/>Nunc ergo, fili mi, audi me, <l eID="gen10730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10731"/>et attende verbis oris mei. <l eID="gen10731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4692"/><l level="1" sID="gen10732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4692"/>Ne abstrahatur in viis illius mens tua, <l eID="gen10732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10733"/>neque decipiaris semitis ejus ; <l eID="gen10733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4693"/><l level="1" sID="gen10734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4693"/>multos enim vulneratos dejecit, <l eID="gen10734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10735"/>et fortissimi quique interfecti sunt ab ea. <l eID="gen10735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 7:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4694"/><l level="1" sID="gen10736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4694"/>Viæ inferi domus ejus, <l eID="gen10736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10737"/>penetrantes in interiora mortis.  <chapter eID="Prov.7"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:1
verses.text: Numquid non sapientia clamitat, <l eID="gen10738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10739"/>et prudentia dat vocem suam ? <l eID="gen10739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4695"/><l level="1" sID="gen10740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4695"/>In summis excelsisque verticibus supra viam, <l eID="gen10740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10741"/>in mediis semitis stans, <l eID="gen10741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4696"/><l level="1" sID="gen10742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4696"/>juxta portas civitatis, <l eID="gen10742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10743"/>in ipsis foribus loquitur, dicens : <l eID="gen10743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4697"/><l level="1" sID="gen10744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4697"/>O viri, ad vos clamito, <l eID="gen10744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10745"/>et vox mea ad filios hominum. <l eID="gen10745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4698"/><l level="1" sID="gen10746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4698"/>Intelligite, parvuli, astutiam, <l eID="gen10746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10747"/>et insipientes, animadvertite. <l eID="gen10747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4699"/><l level="1" sID="gen10748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4699"/>Audite, quoniam de rebus magnis locutura sum, <l eID="gen10748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10749"/>et aperientur labia mea ut recta prædicent. <l eID="gen10749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4700"/><l level="1" sID="gen10750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4700"/>Veritatem meditabitur guttur meum, <l eID="gen10750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10751"/>et labia mea detestabuntur impium. <l eID="gen10751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4701"/><l level="1" sID="gen10752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4701"/>Justi sunt omnes sermones mei : <l eID="gen10752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10753"/>non est in eis pravum quid, neque perversum ; <l eID="gen10753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4702"/><l level="1" sID="gen10754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4702"/>recti sunt intelligentibus, <l eID="gen10754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10755"/>et æqui invenientibus scientiam. <l eID="gen10755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4703"/><l level="1" sID="gen10756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4703"/>Accipite disciplinam meam, et non pecuniam ; <l eID="gen10756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10757"/>doctrinam magis quam aurum eligite : <l eID="gen10757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4704"/><l level="1" sID="gen10758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4704"/>melior est enim sapientia cunctis pretiosissimis, <l eID="gen10758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10759"/>et omne desiderabile ei non potest comparari. <l eID="gen10759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4705"/><l level="1" sID="gen10760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4705"/>Ego sapientia, habito in consilio, <l eID="gen10760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10761"/>et eruditis intersum cogitationibus. <l eID="gen10761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4706"/><l level="1" sID="gen10762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4706"/>Timor Domini odit malum : <l eID="gen10762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10763"/>arrogantiam, et superbiam, <l eID="gen10763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10764"/>et viam pravam, et os bilingue, detestor. <l eID="gen10764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4707"/><l level="1" sID="gen10765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4707"/>Meum est consilium et æquitas ; <l eID="gen10765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10766"/>mea est prudentia, mea est fortitudo. <l eID="gen10766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4708"/><l level="1" sID="gen10767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4708"/>Per me reges regnant, <l eID="gen10767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10768"/>et legum conditores justa decernunt ; <l eID="gen10768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4709"/><l level="1" sID="gen10769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4709"/>per me principes imperant, <l eID="gen10769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10770"/>et potentes decernunt justitiam. <l eID="gen10770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4710"/><l level="1" sID="gen10771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4710"/>Ego diligentes me diligo, <l eID="gen10771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10772"/>et qui mane vigilant ad me, invenient me. <l eID="gen10772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4711"/><l level="1" sID="gen10773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4711"/>Mecum sunt divitiæ et gloria, <l eID="gen10773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10774"/>opes superbæ et justitia. <l eID="gen10774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4712"/><l level="1" sID="gen10775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4712"/>Melior est enim fructus meus auro et lapide pretioso, <l eID="gen10775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10776"/>et genimina mea argento electo. <l eID="gen10776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4713"/><l level="1" sID="gen10777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4713"/>In viis justitiæ ambulo, <l eID="gen10777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10778"/>in medio semitarum judicii : <l eID="gen10778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4714"/><l level="1" sID="gen10779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4714"/>ut ditem diligentes me, <l eID="gen10779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10780"/>et thesauros eorum repleam. <l eID="gen10780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4715"/><l level="1" sID="gen10781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4715"/>Dominus possedit me in initio viarum suarum <l eID="gen10781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10782"/>antequam quidquam faceret a principio. <l eID="gen10782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4716"/><l level="1" sID="gen10783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4716"/>Ab æterno ordinata sum, <l eID="gen10783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10784"/>et ex antiquis antequam terra fieret. <l eID="gen10784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4717"/><l level="1" sID="gen10785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4717"/>Nondum erant abyssi, et ego jam concepta eram : <l eID="gen10785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10786"/>necdum fontes aquarum eruperant, <l eID="gen10786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4718"/><l level="1" sID="gen10787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4718"/>necdum montes gravi mole constiterant : <l eID="gen10787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10788"/>ante colles ego parturiebar. <l eID="gen10788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4719"/><l level="1" sID="gen10789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4719"/>Adhuc terram non fecerat, et flumina, <l eID="gen10789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10790"/>et cardines orbis terræ. <l eID="gen10790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4720"/><l level="1" sID="gen10791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4720"/>Quando præparabat cælos, aderam ; <l eID="gen10791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10792"/>quando certa lege et gyro vallabat abyssos ; <l eID="gen10792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4721"/><l level="1" sID="gen10793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4721"/>quando æthera firmabat sursum, <l eID="gen10793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10794"/>et librabat fontes aquarum ; <l eID="gen10794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4722"/><l level="1" sID="gen10795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4722"/>quando circumdabat mari terminum suum, <l eID="gen10795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10796"/>et legem ponebat aquis, ne transirent fines suos ; <l eID="gen10796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10797"/>quando appendebat fundamenta terræ : <l eID="gen10797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4723"/><l level="1" sID="gen10798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4723"/>cum eo eram, cuncta componens. <l eID="gen10798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10799"/>Et delectabar per singulos dies, <l eID="gen10799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10800"/>ludens coram eo omni tempore, <l eID="gen10800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4724"/><l level="1" sID="gen10801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4724"/>ludens in orbe terrarum ; <l eID="gen10801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10802"/>et deliciæ meæ esse cum filiis hominum. <l eID="gen10802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4725"/><l level="1" sID="gen10803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4725"/>Nunc ergo, filii, audite me : <l eID="gen10803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10804"/>beati qui custodiunt vias meas. <l eID="gen10804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4726"/><l level="1" sID="gen10805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4726"/>Audite disciplinam, et estote sapientes, <l eID="gen10805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10806"/>et nolite abjicere eam. <l eID="gen10806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4727"/><l level="1" sID="gen10807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4727"/>Beatus homo qui audit me, <l eID="gen10807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10808"/>et qui vigilat ad fores meas quotidie, <l eID="gen10808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10809"/>et observat ad postes ostii mei. <l eID="gen10809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4728"/><l level="1" sID="gen10810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4728"/>Qui me invenerit, inveniet vitam, <l eID="gen10810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10811"/>et hauriet salutem a Domino. <l eID="gen10811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 8:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4729"/><l level="1" sID="gen10812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4729"/>Qui autem in me peccaverit, lædet animam suam ; <l eID="gen10812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10813"/>omnes qui me oderunt diligunt mortem.  <chapter eID="Prov.8"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:1
verses.text: Sapientia ædificavit sibi domum : <l eID="gen10814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10815"/>excidit columnas septem. <l eID="gen10815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4730"/><l level="1" sID="gen10816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4730"/>Immolavit victimas suas, miscuit vinum, <l eID="gen10816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10817"/>et proposuit mensam suam. <l eID="gen10817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4731"/><l level="1" sID="gen10818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4731"/>Misit ancillas suas ut vocarent <l eID="gen10818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10819"/>ad arcem et ad mœnia civitatis. <l eID="gen10819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4732"/><l level="1" sID="gen10820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4732"/>Si quis est parvulus, veniat ad me. <l eID="gen10820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10821"/>Et insipientibus locuta est : <l eID="gen10821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4733"/><l level="1" sID="gen10822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4733"/>Venite, comedite panem meum, <l eID="gen10822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10823"/>et bibite vinum quod miscui vobis. <l eID="gen10823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4734"/><l level="1" sID="gen10824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4734"/>Relinquite infantiam, et vivite, <l eID="gen10824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10825"/>et ambulate per vias prudentiæ. <l eID="gen10825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4735"/><l level="1" sID="gen10826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4735"/>Qui erudit derisorem, ipse injuriam sibi facit, <l eID="gen10826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10827"/>et qui arguit impium, sibi maculam generat. <l eID="gen10827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4736"/><l level="1" sID="gen10828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4736"/>Noli arguere derisorem, ne oderit te : <l eID="gen10828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10829"/>argue sapientem, et diliget te. <l eID="gen10829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4737"/><l level="1" sID="gen10830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4737"/>Da sapienti occasionem, et addetur ei sapientia ; <l eID="gen10830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10831"/>doce justum, et festinabit accipere. <l eID="gen10831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4738"/><l level="1" sID="gen10832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4738"/>Principium sapientiæ timor Domini, <l eID="gen10832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10833"/>et scientia sanctorum prudentia. <l eID="gen10833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4739"/><l level="1" sID="gen10834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4739"/>Per me enim multiplicabuntur dies tui, <l eID="gen10834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10835"/>et addentur tibi anni vitæ. <l eID="gen10835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4740"/><l level="1" sID="gen10836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4740"/>Si sapiens fueris, tibimetipsi eris ; <l eID="gen10836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10837"/>si autem illusor, solus portabis malum. <l eID="gen10837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4741"/><l level="1" sID="gen10838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4741"/>Mulier stulta et clamosa, <l eID="gen10838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10839"/>plenaque illecebris, et nihil omnino sciens, <l eID="gen10839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4742"/><l level="1" sID="gen10840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4742"/>sedit in foribus domus suæ, <l eID="gen10840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10841"/>super sellam in excelso urbis loco, <l eID="gen10841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4743"/><l level="1" sID="gen10842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4743"/>ut vocaret transeuntes per viam, <l eID="gen10842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10843"/>et pergentes itinere suo : <l eID="gen10843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4744"/><l level="1" sID="gen10844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4744"/>Qui est parvulus declinet ad me. <l eID="gen10844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10845"/>Et vecordi locuta est : <l eID="gen10845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4745"/><l level="1" sID="gen10846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4745"/>Aquæ furtivæ dulciores sunt, <l eID="gen10846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10847"/>et panis absconditus suavior. <l eID="gen10847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4746"/><l level="1" sID="gen10848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4746"/>Et ignoravit quod ibi sint gigantes, <l eID="gen10848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10849"/>et in profundis inferni convivæ ejus.  <chapter eID="Prov.9"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:1
verses.text: Filius sapiens lætificat patrem, <l eID="gen10850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10851"/>filius vero stultus mœstitia est matris suæ. <l eID="gen10851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4747"/><l level="1" sID="gen10852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4747"/>Nil proderunt thesauri impietatis, <l eID="gen10852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10853"/>justitia vero liberabit a morte. <l eID="gen10853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4748"/><l level="1" sID="gen10854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4748"/>Non affliget Dominus fame animam justi, <l eID="gen10854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10855"/>et insidias impiorum subvertet. <l eID="gen10855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4749"/><l level="1" sID="gen10856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4749"/>Egestatem operata est manus remissa ; <l eID="gen10856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10857"/>manus autem fortium divitias parat. <l eID="gen10857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10858"/>Qui nititur mendaciis, hic pascit ventos ; <l eID="gen10858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10859"/>idem autem ipse sequitur aves volantes. <l eID="gen10859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4750"/><l level="1" sID="gen10860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4750"/>Qui congregat in messe, filius sapiens est ; <l eID="gen10860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10861"/>qui autem stertit æstate, filius confusionis. <l eID="gen10861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4751"/><l level="1" sID="gen10862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4751"/>Benedictio Domini super caput justi ; <l eID="gen10862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10863"/>os autem impiorum operit iniquitas. <l eID="gen10863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4752"/><l level="1" sID="gen10864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4752"/>Memoria justi cum laudibus, <l eID="gen10864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10865"/>et nomen impiorum putrescet. <l eID="gen10865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4753"/><l level="1" sID="gen10866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4753"/>Sapiens corde præcepta suscipit ; <l eID="gen10866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10867"/>stultus cæditur labiis. <l eID="gen10867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4754"/><l level="1" sID="gen10868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4754"/>Qui ambulat simpliciter ambulat confidenter ; <l eID="gen10868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10869"/>qui autem depravat vias suas manifestus erit. <l eID="gen10869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4755"/><l level="1" sID="gen10870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4755"/>Qui annuit oculo dabit dolorem ; <l eID="gen10870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10871"/>et stultus labiis verberabitur. <l eID="gen10871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4756"/><l level="1" sID="gen10872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4756"/>Vena vitæ os justi, <l eID="gen10872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10873"/>et os impiorum operit iniquitatem. <l eID="gen10873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4757"/><l level="1" sID="gen10874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4757"/>Odium suscitat rixas, <l eID="gen10874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10875"/>et universa delicta operit caritas. <l eID="gen10875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4758"/><l level="1" sID="gen10876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4758"/>In labiis sapientis invenitur sapientia, <l eID="gen10876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10877"/>et virga in dorso ejus qui indiget corde. <l eID="gen10877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4759"/><l level="1" sID="gen10878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4759"/>Sapientes abscondunt scientiam ; <l eID="gen10878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10879"/>os autem stulti confusioni proximum est. <l eID="gen10879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4760"/><l level="1" sID="gen10880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4760"/>Substantia divitis, urbs fortitudinis ejus ; <l eID="gen10880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10881"/>pavor pauperum egestas eorum. <l eID="gen10881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4761"/><l level="1" sID="gen10882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4761"/>Opus justi ad vitam, <l eID="gen10882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10883"/>fructus autem impii ad peccatum. <l eID="gen10883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4762"/><l level="1" sID="gen10884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4762"/>Via vitæ custodienti disciplinam ; <l eID="gen10884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10885"/>qui autem increpationes relinquit, errat. <l eID="gen10885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4763"/><l level="1" sID="gen10886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4763"/>Abscondunt odium labia mendacia ; <l eID="gen10886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10887"/>qui profert contumeliam, insipiens est. <l eID="gen10887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4764"/><l level="1" sID="gen10888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4764"/>In multiloquio non deerit peccatum, <l eID="gen10888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10889"/>qui autem moderatur labia sua prudentissimus est. <l eID="gen10889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4765"/><l level="1" sID="gen10890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4765"/>Argentum electum lingua justi ; <l eID="gen10890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10891"/>cor autem impiorum pro nihilo. <l eID="gen10891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4766"/><l level="1" sID="gen10892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4766"/>Labia justi erudiunt plurimos ; <l eID="gen10892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10893"/>qui autem indocti sunt in cordis egestate morientur. <l eID="gen10893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4767"/><l level="1" sID="gen10894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4767"/>Benedictio Domini divites facit, <l eID="gen10894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10895"/>nec sociabitur eis afflictio. <l eID="gen10895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4768"/><l level="1" sID="gen10896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4768"/>Quasi per risum stultus operatur scelus, <l eID="gen10896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10897"/>sapientia autem est viro prudentia. <l eID="gen10897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4769"/><l level="1" sID="gen10898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4769"/>Quod timet impius veniet super eum ; <l eID="gen10898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10899"/>desiderium suum justus dabitur. <l eID="gen10899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4770"/><l level="1" sID="gen10900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4770"/>Quasi tempestas transiens non erit impius ; <l eID="gen10900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10901"/>justus autem quasi fundamentum sempiternum. <l eID="gen10901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4771"/><l level="1" sID="gen10902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4771"/>Sicut acetum dentibus, et fumus oculis, <l eID="gen10902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10903"/>sic piger his qui miserunt eum. <l eID="gen10903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4772"/><l level="1" sID="gen10904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4772"/>Timor Domini apponet dies, <l eID="gen10904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10905"/>et anni impiorum breviabuntur. <l eID="gen10905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4773"/><l level="1" sID="gen10906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4773"/>Exspectatio justorum lætitia, <l eID="gen10906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10907"/>spes autem impiorum peribit. <l eID="gen10907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4774"/><l level="1" sID="gen10908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4774"/>Fortitudo simplicis via Domini, <l eID="gen10908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10909"/>et pavor his qui operantur malum. <l eID="gen10909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4775"/><l level="1" sID="gen10910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4775"/>Justus in æternum non commovebitur, <l eID="gen10910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10911"/>impii autem non habitabunt super terram. <l eID="gen10911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4776"/><l level="1" sID="gen10912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4776"/>Os justi parturiet sapientiam ; <l eID="gen10912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10913"/>lingua pravorum peribit. <l eID="gen10913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4777"/><l level="1" sID="gen10914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4777"/>Labia justi considerant placita, <l eID="gen10914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10915"/>et os impiorum perversa.  <chapter eID="Prov.10"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:1
verses.text: Statera dolosa abominatio est apud Dominum, <l eID="gen10916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10917"/>et pondus æquum voluntas ejus. <l eID="gen10917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4778"/><l level="1" sID="gen10918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4778"/>Ubi fuerit superbia, ibi erit et contumelia ; <l eID="gen10918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10919"/>ubi autem est humilitas, ibi et sapientia. <l eID="gen10919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4779"/><l level="1" sID="gen10920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4779"/>Simplicitas justorum diriget eos, <l eID="gen10920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10921"/>et supplantatio perversorum vastabit illos. <l eID="gen10921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4780"/><l level="1" sID="gen10922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4780"/>Non proderunt divitiæ in die ultionis ; <l eID="gen10922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10923"/>justitia autem liberabit a morte. <l eID="gen10923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4781"/><l level="1" sID="gen10924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4781"/>Justitia simplicis diriget viam ejus, <l eID="gen10924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10925"/>et in impietate sua corruet impius. <l eID="gen10925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4782"/><l level="1" sID="gen10926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4782"/>Justitia rectorum liberabit eos, <l eID="gen10926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10927"/>et in insidiis suis capientur iniqui. <l eID="gen10927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4783"/><l level="1" sID="gen10928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4783"/>Mortuo homine impio, nulla erit ultra spes, <l eID="gen10928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10929"/>et exspectatio sollicitorum peribit. <l eID="gen10929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4784"/><l level="1" sID="gen10930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4784"/>Justus de angustia liberatus est, <l eID="gen10930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10931"/>et tradetur impius pro eo. <l eID="gen10931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4785"/><l level="1" sID="gen10932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4785"/>Simulator ore decipit amicum suum ; <l eID="gen10932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10933"/>justi autem liberabuntur scientia. <l eID="gen10933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4786"/><l level="1" sID="gen10934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4786"/>In bonis justorum exsultabit civitas, <l eID="gen10934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10935"/>et in perditione impiorum erit laudatio. <l eID="gen10935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4787"/><l level="1" sID="gen10936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4787"/>Benedictione justorum exaltabitur civitas, <l eID="gen10936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10937"/>et ore impiorum subvertetur. <l eID="gen10937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4788"/><l level="1" sID="gen10938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4788"/>Qui despicit amicum suum indigens corde est ; <l eID="gen10938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10939"/>vir autem prudens tacebit. <l eID="gen10939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4789"/><l level="1" sID="gen10940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4789"/>Qui ambulat fraudulenter, revelat arcana ; <l eID="gen10940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10941"/>qui autem fidelis est animi, celat amici commissum. <l eID="gen10941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4790"/><l level="1" sID="gen10942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4790"/>Ubi non est gubernator, populus corruet ; <l eID="gen10942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10943"/>salus autem, ubi multa consilia. <l eID="gen10943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4791"/><l level="1" sID="gen10944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4791"/>Affligetur malo qui fidem facit pro extraneo ; <l eID="gen10944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10945"/>qui autem cavet laqueos securus erit. <l eID="gen10945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4792"/><l level="1" sID="gen10946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4792"/>Mulier gratiosa inveniet gloriam, <l eID="gen10946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10947"/>et robusti habebunt divitias. <l eID="gen10947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4793"/><l level="1" sID="gen10948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4793"/>Benefacit animæ suæ vir misericors ; <l eID="gen10948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10949"/>qui autem crudelis est, etiam propinquos abjicit. <l eID="gen10949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4794"/><l level="1" sID="gen10950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4794"/>Impius facit opus instabile, <l eID="gen10950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10951"/>seminanti autem justitiam merces fidelis. <l eID="gen10951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4795"/><l level="1" sID="gen10952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4795"/>Clementia præparat vitam, <l eID="gen10952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10953"/>et sectatio malorum mortem. <l eID="gen10953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4796"/><l level="1" sID="gen10954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4796"/>Abominabile Domino cor pravum, <l eID="gen10954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10955"/>et voluntas ejus in iis qui simpliciter ambulant. <l eID="gen10955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4797"/><l level="1" sID="gen10956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4797"/>Manus in manu non erit innocens malus ; <l eID="gen10956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10957"/>semen autem justorum salvabitur. <l eID="gen10957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4798"/><l level="1" sID="gen10958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4798"/>Circulus aureus in naribus suis, <l eID="gen10958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10959"/>mulier pulchra et fatua. <l eID="gen10959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4799"/><l level="1" sID="gen10960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4799"/>Desiderium justorum omne bonum est ; <l eID="gen10960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10961"/>præstolatio impiorum furor. <l eID="gen10961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4800"/><l level="1" sID="gen10962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4800"/>Alii dividunt propria, et ditiores fiunt ; <l eID="gen10962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10963"/>alii rapiunt non sua, et semper in egestate sunt. <l eID="gen10963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4801"/><l level="1" sID="gen10964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4801"/>Anima quæ benedicit impinguabitur, <l eID="gen10964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10965"/>et qui inebriat, ipse quoque inebriabitur. <l eID="gen10965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4802"/><l level="1" sID="gen10966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4802"/>Qui abscondit frumenta maledicetur in populis ; <l eID="gen10966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10967"/>benedictio autem super caput vendentium. <l eID="gen10967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4803"/><l level="1" sID="gen10968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4803"/>Bene consurgit diluculo qui quærit bona ; <l eID="gen10968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10969"/>qui autem investigator malorum est, opprimetur ab eis. <l eID="gen10969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4804"/><l level="1" sID="gen10970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4804"/>Qui confidit in divitiis suis corruet : <l eID="gen10970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10971"/>justi autem quasi virens folium germinabunt. <l eID="gen10971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4805"/><l level="1" sID="gen10972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4805"/>Qui conturbat domum suam possidebit ventos, <l eID="gen10972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10973"/>et qui stultus est serviet sapienti. <l eID="gen10973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4806"/><l level="1" sID="gen10974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4806"/>Fructus justi lignum vitæ, <l eID="gen10974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10975"/>et qui suscipit animas sapiens est. <l eID="gen10975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 11:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4807"/><l level="1" sID="gen10976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4807"/>Si justus in terra recipit, <l eID="gen10976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10977"/>quanto magis impius et peccator !  <chapter eID="Prov.11"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:1
verses.text: Qui diligit disciplinam diligit scientiam ; <l eID="gen10978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10979"/>qui autem odit increpationes insipiens est. <l eID="gen10979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4808"/><l level="1" sID="gen10980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4808"/>Qui bonus est hauriet gratiam a Domino ; <l eID="gen10980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10981"/>qui autem confidit in cogitationibus suis impie agit. <l eID="gen10981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4809"/><l level="1" sID="gen10982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4809"/>Non roborabitur homo ex impietate, <l eID="gen10982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10983"/>et radix justorum non commovebitur. <l eID="gen10983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4810"/><l level="1" sID="gen10984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4810"/>Mulier diligens corona est viro suo ; <l eID="gen10984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10985"/>et putredo in ossibus ejus, quæ confusione res dignas gerit. <l eID="gen10985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4811"/><l level="1" sID="gen10986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4811"/>Cogitationes justorum judicia, <l eID="gen10986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10987"/>et consilia impiorum fraudulenta. <l eID="gen10987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4812"/><l level="1" sID="gen10988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4812"/>Verba impiorum insidiantur sanguini ; <l eID="gen10988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10989"/>os justorum liberabit eos. <l eID="gen10989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4813"/><l level="1" sID="gen10990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4813"/>Verte impios, et non erunt ; <l eID="gen10990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10991"/>domus autem justorum permanebit. <l eID="gen10991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4814"/><l level="1" sID="gen10992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4814"/>Doctrina sua noscetur vir ; <l eID="gen10992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10993"/>qui autem vanus et excors est patebit contemptui. <l eID="gen10993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4815"/><l level="1" sID="gen10994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4815"/>Melior est pauper et sufficiens sibi <l eID="gen10994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10995"/>quam gloriosus et indigens pane. <l eID="gen10995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4816"/><l level="1" sID="gen10996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4816"/>Novit justus jumentorum suorum animas ; <l eID="gen10996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10997"/>viscera autem impiorum crudelia. <l eID="gen10997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4817"/><l level="1" sID="gen10998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4817"/>Qui operatur terram suam satiabitur panibus ; <l eID="gen10998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen10999"/>qui autem sectatur otium stultissimus est. <l eID="gen10999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11000"/>Qui suavis est in vini demorationibus, <l eID="gen11000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11001"/>in suis munitionibus relinquit contumeliam. <l eID="gen11001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4818"/><l level="1" sID="gen11002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4818"/>Desiderium impii munimentum est pessimorum ; <l eID="gen11002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11003"/>radix autem justorum proficiet. <l eID="gen11003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4819"/><l level="1" sID="gen11004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4819"/>Propter peccata labiorum ruina proximat malo ; <l eID="gen11004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11005"/>effugiet autem justus de angustia. <l eID="gen11005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4820"/><l level="1" sID="gen11006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4820"/>De fructu oris sui unusquisque replebitur bonis, <l eID="gen11006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11007"/>et juxta opera manuum suarum retribuetur ei. <l eID="gen11007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4821"/><l level="1" sID="gen11008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4821"/>Via stulti recta in oculis ejus ; <l eID="gen11008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11009"/>qui autem sapiens est audit consilia. <l eID="gen11009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4822"/><l level="1" sID="gen11010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4822"/>Fatuus statim indicat iram suam ; <l eID="gen11010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11011"/>qui autem dissimulat injuriam callidus est. <l eID="gen11011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4823"/><l level="1" sID="gen11012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4823"/>Qui quod novit loquitur, index justitiæ est ; <l eID="gen11012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11013"/>qui autem mentitur, testis est fraudulentus. <l eID="gen11013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4824"/><l level="1" sID="gen11014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4824"/>Est qui promittit, et quasi gladio pungitur conscientiæ : <l eID="gen11014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11015"/>lingua autem sapientium sanitas est. <l eID="gen11015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4825"/><l level="1" sID="gen11016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4825"/>Labium veritatis firmum erit in perpetuum ; <l eID="gen11016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11017"/>qui autem testis est repentinus, concinnat linguam mendacii. <l eID="gen11017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4826"/><l level="1" sID="gen11018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4826"/>Dolus in corde cogitantium mala ; <l eID="gen11018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11019"/>qui autem pacis ineunt consilia, sequitur eos gaudium. <l eID="gen11019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4827"/><l level="1" sID="gen11020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4827"/>Non contristabit justum quidquid ei acciderit : <l eID="gen11020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11021"/>impii autem replebuntur malo. <l eID="gen11021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4828"/><l level="1" sID="gen11022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4828"/>Abominatio est Domino labia mendacia ; <l eID="gen11022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11023"/>qui autem fideliter agunt placent ei. <l eID="gen11023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4829"/><l level="1" sID="gen11024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4829"/>Homo versatus celat scientiam, <l eID="gen11024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11025"/>et cor insipientium provocat stultitiam. <l eID="gen11025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4830"/><l level="1" sID="gen11026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4830"/>Manus fortium dominabitur ; <l eID="gen11026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11027"/>quæ autem remissa est, tributis serviet. <l eID="gen11027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4831"/><l level="1" sID="gen11028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4831"/>Mœror in corde viri humiliabit illum, <l eID="gen11028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11029"/>et sermone bono lætificabitur. <l eID="gen11029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4832"/><l level="1" sID="gen11030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4832"/>Qui negligit damnum propter amicum, justus est ; <l eID="gen11030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11031"/>iter autem impiorum decipiet eos. <l eID="gen11031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4833"/><l level="1" sID="gen11032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4833"/>Non inveniet fraudulentus lucrum, <l eID="gen11032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11033"/>et substantia hominis erit auri pretium. <l eID="gen11033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 12:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4834"/><l level="1" sID="gen11034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4834"/>In semita justitiæ vita ; <l eID="gen11034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11035"/>iter autem devium ducit ad mortem.  <chapter eID="Prov.12"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:1
verses.text: Filius sapiens doctrina patris ; <l eID="gen11036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11037"/>qui autem illusor est non audit cum arguitur. <l eID="gen11037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4835"/><l level="1" sID="gen11038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4835"/>De fructu oris sui homo satiabitur bonis : <l eID="gen11038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11039"/>anima autem prævaricatorum iniqua. <l eID="gen11039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4836"/><l level="1" sID="gen11040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4836"/>Qui custodit os suum custodit animam suam ; <l eID="gen11040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11041"/>qui autem inconsideratus est ad loquendum, sentiet mala. <l eID="gen11041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4837"/><l level="1" sID="gen11042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4837"/>Vult et non vult piger ; <l eID="gen11042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11043"/>anima autem operantium impinguabitur. <l eID="gen11043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4838"/><l level="1" sID="gen11044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4838"/>Verbum mendax justus detestabitur ; <l eID="gen11044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11045"/>impius autem confundit, et confundetur. <l eID="gen11045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4839"/><l level="1" sID="gen11046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4839"/>Justitia custodit innocentis viam, <l eID="gen11046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11047"/>impietas autem peccatorem supplantat. <l eID="gen11047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4840"/><l level="1" sID="gen11048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4840"/>Est quasi dives, cum nihil habeat, <l eID="gen11048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11049"/>et est quasi pauper, cum in multis divitiis sit. <l eID="gen11049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4841"/><l level="1" sID="gen11050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4841"/>Redemptio animæ viri divitiæ suæ ; <l eID="gen11050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11051"/>qui autem pauper est, increpationem non sustinet. <l eID="gen11051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4842"/><l level="1" sID="gen11052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4842"/>Lux justorum lætificat : <l eID="gen11052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11053"/>lucerna autem impiorum extinguetur. <l eID="gen11053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4843"/><l level="1" sID="gen11054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4843"/>Inter superbos semper jurgia sunt ; <l eID="gen11054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11055"/>qui autem agunt omnia cum consilio, reguntur sapientia. <l eID="gen11055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4844"/><l level="1" sID="gen11056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4844"/>Substantia festinata minuetur ; <l eID="gen11056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11057"/>quæ autem paulatim colligitur manu, multiplicabitur. <l eID="gen11057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4845"/><l level="1" sID="gen11058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4845"/>Spes quæ differtur affligit animam ; <l eID="gen11058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11059"/>lignum vitæ desiderium veniens. <l eID="gen11059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4846"/><l level="1" sID="gen11060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4846"/>Qui detrahit alicui rei, ipse se in futurum obligat ; <l eID="gen11060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11061"/>qui autem timet præceptum, in pace versabitur. <l eID="gen11061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11062"/>Animæ dolosæ errant in peccatis : <l eID="gen11062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11063"/>justi autem misericordes sunt, et miserantur. <l eID="gen11063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4847"/><l level="1" sID="gen11064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4847"/>Lex sapientis fons vitæ, <l eID="gen11064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11065"/>ut declinet a ruina mortis. <l eID="gen11065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4848"/><l level="1" sID="gen11066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4848"/>Doctrina bona dabit gratiam ; <l eID="gen11066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11067"/>in itinere contemptorum vorago. <l eID="gen11067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4849"/><l level="1" sID="gen11068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4849"/>Astutus omnia agit cum consilio ; <l eID="gen11068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11069"/>qui autem fatuus est aperit stultitiam. <l eID="gen11069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4850"/><l level="1" sID="gen11070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4850"/>Nuntius impii cadet in malum ; <l eID="gen11070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11071"/>legatus autem fidelis, sanitas. <l eID="gen11071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4851"/><l level="1" sID="gen11072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4851"/>Egestas et ignominia ei qui deserit disciplinam ; <l eID="gen11072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11073"/>qui autem acquiescit arguenti glorificabitur. <l eID="gen11073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4852"/><l level="1" sID="gen11074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4852"/>Desiderium si compleatur delectat animam ; <l eID="gen11074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11075"/>detestantur stulti eos qui fugiunt mala. <l eID="gen11075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4853"/><l level="1" sID="gen11076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4853"/>Qui cum sapientibus graditur sapiens erit ; <l eID="gen11076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11077"/>amicus stultorum similis efficietur. <l eID="gen11077" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4854"/><l level="1" sID="gen11078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4854"/>Peccatores persequitur malum, <l eID="gen11078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11079"/>et justis retribuentur bona. <l eID="gen11079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4855"/><l level="1" sID="gen11080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4855"/>Bonus reliquit hæredes filios et nepotes, <l eID="gen11080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11081"/>et custoditur justo substantia peccatoris. <l eID="gen11081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4856"/><l level="1" sID="gen11082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4856"/>Multi cibi in novalibus patrum, <l eID="gen11082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11083"/>et aliis congregantur absque judicio. <l eID="gen11083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4857"/><l level="1" sID="gen11084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4857"/>Qui parcit virgæ odit filium suum ; <l eID="gen11084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11085"/>qui autem diligit illum instanter erudit. <l eID="gen11085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4858"/><l level="1" sID="gen11086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4858"/>Justus comedit et replet animam suam ; <l eID="gen11086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11087"/>venter autem impiorum insaturabilis.  <chapter eID="Prov.13"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:1
verses.text: Sapiens mulier ædificat domum suam ; <l eID="gen11088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11089"/>insipiens exstructam quoque manibus destruet. <l eID="gen11089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4859"/><l level="1" sID="gen11090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4859"/>Ambulans recto itinere, et timens Deum, <l eID="gen11090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11091"/>despicitur ab eo qui infami graditur via. <l eID="gen11091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4860"/><l level="1" sID="gen11092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4860"/>In ore stulti virga superbiæ ; <l eID="gen11092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11093"/>labia autem sapientium custodiunt eos. <l eID="gen11093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4861"/><l level="1" sID="gen11094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4861"/>Ubi non sunt boves, præsepe vacuum est ; <l eID="gen11094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11095"/>ubi autem plurimæ segetes, ibi manifesta est fortitudo bovis. <l eID="gen11095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4862"/><l level="1" sID="gen11096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4862"/>Testis fidelis non mentitur ; <l eID="gen11096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11097"/>profert autem mendacium dolosus testis. <l eID="gen11097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4863"/><l level="1" sID="gen11098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4863"/>Quærit derisor sapientiam, et non invenit ; <l eID="gen11098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11099"/>doctrina prudentium facilis. <l eID="gen11099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4864"/><l level="1" sID="gen11100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4864"/>Vade contra virum stultum, <l eID="gen11100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11101"/>et nescit labia prudentiæ. <l eID="gen11101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4865"/><l level="1" sID="gen11102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4865"/>Sapientia callidi est intelligere viam suam, <l eID="gen11102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11103"/>et imprudentia stultorum errans. <l eID="gen11103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4866"/><l level="1" sID="gen11104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4866"/>Stultus illudet peccatum, <l eID="gen11104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11105"/>et inter justos morabitur gratia. <l eID="gen11105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4867"/><l level="1" sID="gen11106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4867"/>Cor quod novit amaritudinem animæ suæ, <l eID="gen11106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11107"/>in gaudio ejus non miscebitur extraneus. <l eID="gen11107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4868"/><l level="1" sID="gen11108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4868"/>Domus impiorum delebitur : <l eID="gen11108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11109"/>tabernacula vero justorum germinabunt. <l eID="gen11109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4869"/><l level="1" sID="gen11110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4869"/>Est via quæ videtur homini justa, <l eID="gen11110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11111"/>novissima autem ejus deducunt ad mortem. <l eID="gen11111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4870"/><l level="1" sID="gen11112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4870"/>Risus dolore miscebitur, <l eID="gen11112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11113"/>et extrema gaudii luctus occupat. <l eID="gen11113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4871"/><l level="1" sID="gen11114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4871"/>Viis suis replebitur stultus, <l eID="gen11114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11115"/>et super eum erit vir bonus. <l eID="gen11115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:15
