verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4872"/><l level="1" sID="gen11116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4872"/>Innocens credit omni verbo ; <l eID="gen11116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11117"/>astutus considerat gressus suos. <l eID="gen11117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11118"/>Filio doloso nihil erit boni ; <l eID="gen11118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11119"/>servo autem sapienti prosperi erunt actus, <l eID="gen11119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11120"/>et dirigetur via ejus. <l eID="gen11120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4873"/><l level="1" sID="gen11121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4873"/>Sapiens timet, et declinat a malo ; <l eID="gen11121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11122"/>stultus transilit, et confidit. <l eID="gen11122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4874"/><l level="1" sID="gen11123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4874"/>Impatiens operabitur stultitiam, <l eID="gen11123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11124"/>et vir versutus odiosus est. <l eID="gen11124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4875"/><l level="1" sID="gen11125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4875"/>Possidebunt parvuli stultitiam, <l eID="gen11125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11126"/>et exspectabunt astuti scientiam. <l eID="gen11126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4876"/><l level="1" sID="gen11127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4876"/>Jacebunt mali ante bonos, <l eID="gen11127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11128"/>et impii ante portas justorum. <l eID="gen11128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4877"/><l level="1" sID="gen11129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4877"/>Etiam proximo suo pauper odiosus erit : <l eID="gen11129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11130"/>amici vero divitum multi. <l eID="gen11130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4878"/><l level="1" sID="gen11131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4878"/>Qui despicit proximum suum peccat ; <l eID="gen11131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11132"/>qui autem miseretur pauperis beatus erit. <l eID="gen11132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11133"/>Qui credit in Domino misericordiam diligit. <l eID="gen11133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4879"/><l level="1" sID="gen11134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4879"/>Errant qui operantur malum ; <l eID="gen11134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11135"/>misericordia et veritas præparant bona. <l eID="gen11135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4880"/><l level="1" sID="gen11136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4880"/>In omni opere erit abundantia ; <l eID="gen11136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11137"/>ubi autem verba sunt plurima, ibi frequenter egestas. <l eID="gen11137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4881"/><l level="1" sID="gen11138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4881"/>Corona sapientium divitiæ eorum ; <l eID="gen11138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11139"/>fatuitas stultorum imprudentia. <l eID="gen11139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4882"/><l level="1" sID="gen11140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4882"/>Liberat animas testis fidelis, <l eID="gen11140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11141"/>et profert mendacia versipellis. <l eID="gen11141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4883"/><l level="1" sID="gen11142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4883"/>In timore Domini fiducia fortitudinis, <l eID="gen11142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11143"/>et filiis ejus erit spes. <l eID="gen11143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4884"/><l level="1" sID="gen11144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4884"/>Timor Domini fons vitæ, <l eID="gen11144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11145"/>ut declinent a ruina mortis. <l eID="gen11145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4885"/><l level="1" sID="gen11146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4885"/>In multitudine populi dignitas regis, <l eID="gen11146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11147"/>et in paucitate plebis ignominia principis. <l eID="gen11147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4886"/><l level="1" sID="gen11148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4886"/>Qui patiens est multa gubernatur prudentia ; <l eID="gen11148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11149"/>qui autem impatiens est exaltat stultitiam suam. <l eID="gen11149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4887"/><l level="1" sID="gen11150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4887"/>Vita carnium sanitas cordis ; <l eID="gen11150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11151"/>putredo ossium invidia. <l eID="gen11151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4888"/><l level="1" sID="gen11152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4888"/>Qui calumniatur egentem exprobrat factori ejus ; <l eID="gen11152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11153"/>honorat autem eum qui miseretur pauperis. <l eID="gen11153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4889"/><l level="1" sID="gen11154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4889"/>In malitia sua expelletur impius : <l eID="gen11154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11155"/>sperat autem justus in morte sua. <l eID="gen11155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4890"/><l level="1" sID="gen11156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4890"/>In corde prudentis requiescit sapientia, <l eID="gen11156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11157"/>et indoctos quosque erudiet. <l eID="gen11157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4891"/><l level="1" sID="gen11158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4891"/>Justitia elevat gentem ; <l eID="gen11158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11159"/>miseros autem facit populos peccatum. <l eID="gen11159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 14:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4892"/><l level="1" sID="gen11160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4892"/>Acceptus est regi minister intelligens ; <l eID="gen11160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11161"/>iracundiam ejus inutilis sustinebit.  <chapter eID="Prov.14"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:1
verses.text: Responsio mollis frangit iram ; <l eID="gen11162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11163"/>sermo durus suscitat furorem. <l eID="gen11163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4893"/><l level="1" sID="gen11164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4893"/>Lingua sapientium ornat scientiam ; <l eID="gen11164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11165"/>os fatuorum ebullit stultitiam. <l eID="gen11165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4894"/><l level="1" sID="gen11166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4894"/>In omni loco, oculi Domini <l eID="gen11166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11167"/>contemplantur bonos et malos. <l eID="gen11167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4895"/><l level="1" sID="gen11168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4895"/>Lingua placabilis lignum vitæ ; <l eID="gen11168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11169"/>quæ autem immoderata est conteret spiritum. <l eID="gen11169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4896"/><l level="1" sID="gen11170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4896"/>Stultus irridet disciplinam patris sui ; <l eID="gen11170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11171"/>qui autem custodit increpationes astutior fiet. <l eID="gen11171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11172"/>In abundanti justitia virtus maxima est : <l eID="gen11172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11173"/>cogitationes autem impiorum eradicabuntur. <l eID="gen11173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4897"/><l level="1" sID="gen11174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4897"/>Domus justi plurima fortitudo, <l eID="gen11174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11175"/>et in fructibus impii conturbatio. <l eID="gen11175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4898"/><l level="1" sID="gen11176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4898"/>Labia sapientium disseminabunt scientiam ; <l eID="gen11176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11177"/>cor stultorum dissimile erit. <l eID="gen11177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4899"/><l level="1" sID="gen11178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4899"/>Victimæ impiorum abominabiles Domino ; <l eID="gen11178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11179"/>vota justorum placabilia. <l eID="gen11179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4900"/><l level="1" sID="gen11180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4900"/>Abominatio est Domino via impii ; <l eID="gen11180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11181"/>qui sequitur justitiam diligitur ab eo. <l eID="gen11181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4901"/><l level="1" sID="gen11182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4901"/>Doctrina mala deserenti viam vitæ ; <l eID="gen11182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11183"/>qui increpationes odit, morietur. <l eID="gen11183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4902"/><l level="1" sID="gen11184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4902"/>Infernus et perditio coram Domino ; <l eID="gen11184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11185"/>quanto magis corda filiorum hominum ! <l eID="gen11185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4903"/><l level="1" sID="gen11186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4903"/>Non amat pestilens eum qui se corripit, <l eID="gen11186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11187"/>nec ad sapientes graditur. <l eID="gen11187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4904"/><l level="1" sID="gen11188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4904"/>Cor gaudens exhilarat faciem ; <l eID="gen11188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11189"/>in mœrore animi dejicitur spiritus. <l eID="gen11189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4905"/><l level="1" sID="gen11190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4905"/>Cor sapientis quærit doctrinam, <l eID="gen11190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11191"/>et os stultorum pascitur imperitia. <l eID="gen11191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4906"/><l level="1" sID="gen11192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4906"/>Omnes dies pauperis, mali ; <l eID="gen11192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11193"/>secura mens quasi juge convivium. <l eID="gen11193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4907"/><l level="1" sID="gen11194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4907"/>Melius est parum cum timore Domini, <l eID="gen11194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11195"/>quam thesauri magni et insatiabiles. <l eID="gen11195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4908"/><l level="1" sID="gen11196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4908"/>Melius est vocari ad olera cum caritate, <l eID="gen11196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11197"/>quam ad vitulum saginatum cum odio. <l eID="gen11197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4909"/><l level="1" sID="gen11198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4909"/>Vir iracundus provocat rixas ; <l eID="gen11198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11199"/>qui patiens est mitigat suscitatas. <l eID="gen11199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4910"/><l level="1" sID="gen11200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4910"/>Iter pigrorum quasi sepes spinarum ; <l eID="gen11200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11201"/>via justorum absque offendiculo. <l eID="gen11201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4911"/><l level="1" sID="gen11202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4911"/>Filius sapiens lætificat patrem, <l eID="gen11202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11203"/>et stultus homo despicit matrem suam. <l eID="gen11203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4912"/><l level="1" sID="gen11204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4912"/>Stultitia gaudium stulto, <l eID="gen11204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11205"/>et vir prudens dirigit gressus suos. <l eID="gen11205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4913"/><l level="1" sID="gen11206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4913"/>Dissipantur cogitationes ubi non est consilium ; <l eID="gen11206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11207"/>ubi vero sunt plures consiliarii, confirmantur. <l eID="gen11207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4914"/><l level="1" sID="gen11208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4914"/>Lætatur homo in sententia oris sui, <l eID="gen11208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11209"/>et sermo opportunus est optimus. <l eID="gen11209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4915"/><l level="1" sID="gen11210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4915"/>Semita vitæ super eruditum, <l eID="gen11210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11211"/>ut declinet de inferno novissimo. <l eID="gen11211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4916"/><l level="1" sID="gen11212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4916"/>Domum superborum demolietur Dominus, <l eID="gen11212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11213"/>et firmos faciet terminos viduæ. <l eID="gen11213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4917"/><l level="1" sID="gen11214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4917"/>Abominatio Domini cogitationes malæ, <l eID="gen11214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11215"/>et purus sermo pulcherrimus firmabitur ab eo. <l eID="gen11215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4918"/><l level="1" sID="gen11216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4918"/>Conturbat domum suam qui sectatur avaritiam ; <l eID="gen11216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11217"/>qui autem odit munera, vivet. <l eID="gen11217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11218"/>Per misericordiam et fidem purgantur peccata : <l eID="gen11218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11219"/>per timorem autem Domini declinat omnis a malo. <l eID="gen11219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4919"/><l level="1" sID="gen11220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4919"/>Mens justi meditatur obedientiam ; <l eID="gen11220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11221"/>os impiorum redundat malis. <l eID="gen11221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4920"/><l level="1" sID="gen11222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4920"/>Longe est Dominus ab impiis, <l eID="gen11222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11223"/>et orationes justorum exaudiet. <l eID="gen11223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4921"/><l level="1" sID="gen11224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4921"/>Lux oculorum lætificat animam ; <l eID="gen11224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11225"/>fama bona impinguat ossa. <l eID="gen11225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4922"/><l level="1" sID="gen11226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4922"/>Auris quæ audit increpationes vitæ <l eID="gen11226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11227"/>in medio sapientium commorabitur. <l eID="gen11227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4923"/><l level="1" sID="gen11228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4923"/>Qui abjicit disciplinam despicit animam suam ; <l eID="gen11228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11229"/>qui autem acquiescit increpationibus possessor est cordis. <l eID="gen11229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 15:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4924"/><l level="1" sID="gen11230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4924"/>Timor Domini disciplina sapientiæ, <l eID="gen11230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11231"/>et gloriam præcedit humilitas.  <chapter eID="Prov.15"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:1
verses.text: Hominis est animam præparare, <l eID="gen11232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11233"/>et Domini gubernare linguam. <l eID="gen11233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4925"/><l level="1" sID="gen11234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4925"/>Omnes viæ hominis patent oculis ejus ; <l eID="gen11234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11235"/>spirituum ponderator est Dominus. <l eID="gen11235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4926"/><l level="1" sID="gen11236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4926"/>Revela Domino opera tua, <l eID="gen11236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11237"/>et dirigentur cogitationes tuæ. <l eID="gen11237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4927"/><l level="1" sID="gen11238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4927"/>Universa propter semetipsum operatus est Dominus ; <l eID="gen11238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11239"/>impium quoque ad diem malum. <l eID="gen11239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4928"/><l level="1" sID="gen11240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4928"/>Abominatio Domini est omnis arrogans ; <l eID="gen11240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11241"/>etiamsi manus ad manum fuerit, non est innocens. <l eID="gen11241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11242"/>Initium viæ bonæ facere justitiam ; <l eID="gen11242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11243"/>accepta est autem apud Deum magis quam immolare hostias. <l eID="gen11243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4929"/><l level="1" sID="gen11244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4929"/>Misericordia et veritate redimitur iniquitas, <l eID="gen11244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11245"/>et in timore Domini declinatur a malo. <l eID="gen11245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4930"/><l level="1" sID="gen11246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4930"/>Cum placuerint Domino viæ hominis, <l eID="gen11246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11247"/>inimicos quoque ejus convertet ad pacem. <l eID="gen11247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4931"/><l level="1" sID="gen11248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4931"/>Melius est parum cum justitia <l eID="gen11248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11249"/>quam multi fructus cum iniquitate. <l eID="gen11249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4932"/><l level="1" sID="gen11250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4932"/>Cor hominis disponit viam suam, <l eID="gen11250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11251"/>sed Domini est dirigere gressus ejus. <l eID="gen11251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4933"/><l level="1" sID="gen11252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4933"/>Divinatio in labiis regis ; <l eID="gen11252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11253"/>in judicio non errabit os ejus. <l eID="gen11253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4934"/><l level="1" sID="gen11254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4934"/>Pondus et statera judicia Domini sunt, <l eID="gen11254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11255"/>et opera ejus omnes lapides sacculi. <l eID="gen11255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4935"/><l level="1" sID="gen11256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4935"/>Abominabiles regi qui agunt impie, <l eID="gen11256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11257"/>quoniam justitia firmatur solium. <l eID="gen11257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4936"/><l level="1" sID="gen11258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4936"/>Voluntas regum labia justa ; <l eID="gen11258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11259"/>qui recta loquitur diligetur. <l eID="gen11259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4937"/><l level="1" sID="gen11260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4937"/>Indignatio regis nuntii mortis, <l eID="gen11260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11261"/>et vir sapiens placabit eam. <l eID="gen11261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4938"/><l level="1" sID="gen11262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4938"/>In hilaritate vultus regis vita, <l eID="gen11262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11263"/>et clementia ejus quasi imber serotinus. <l eID="gen11263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4939"/><l level="1" sID="gen11264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4939"/>Posside sapientiam, quia auro melior est, <l eID="gen11264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11265"/>et acquire prudentiam, quia pretiosior est argento. <l eID="gen11265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4940"/><l level="1" sID="gen11266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4940"/>Semita justorum declinat mala ; <l eID="gen11266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11267"/>custos animæ suæ servat viam suam. <l eID="gen11267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4941"/><l level="1" sID="gen11268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4941"/>Contritionem præcedit superbia, <l eID="gen11268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11269"/>et ante ruinam exaltatur spiritus. <l eID="gen11269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4942"/><l level="1" sID="gen11270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4942"/>Melius est humiliari cum mitibus <l eID="gen11270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11271"/>quam dividere spolia cum superbis. <l eID="gen11271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4943"/><l level="1" sID="gen11272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4943"/>Eruditus in verbo reperiet bona, <l eID="gen11272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11273"/>et qui sperat in Domino beatus est. <l eID="gen11273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4944"/><l level="1" sID="gen11274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4944"/>Qui sapiens est corde appellabitur prudens, <l eID="gen11274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11275"/>et qui dulcis eloquio majora percipiet. <l eID="gen11275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4945"/><l level="1" sID="gen11276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4945"/>Fons vitæ eruditio possidentis ; <l eID="gen11276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11277"/>doctrina stultorum fatuitas. <l eID="gen11277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4946"/><l level="1" sID="gen11278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4946"/>Cor sapientis erudiet os ejus, <l eID="gen11278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11279"/>et labiis ejus addet gratiam. <l eID="gen11279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4947"/><l level="1" sID="gen11280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4947"/>Favus mellis composita verba ; <l eID="gen11280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11281"/>dulcedo animæ sanitas ossium. <l eID="gen11281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4948"/><l level="1" sID="gen11282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4948"/>Est via quæ videtur homini recta, <l eID="gen11282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11283"/>et novissima ejus ducunt ad mortem. <l eID="gen11283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4949"/><l level="1" sID="gen11284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4949"/>Anima laborantis laborat sibi, <l eID="gen11284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11285"/>quia compulit eum os suum. <l eID="gen11285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4950"/><l level="1" sID="gen11286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4950"/>Vir impius fodit malum, <l eID="gen11286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11287"/>et in labiis ejus ignis ardescit. <l eID="gen11287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4951"/><l level="1" sID="gen11288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4951"/>Homo perversus suscitat lites, <l eID="gen11288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11289"/>et verbosus separat principes. <l eID="gen11289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4952"/><l level="1" sID="gen11290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4952"/>Vir iniquus lactat amicum suum, <l eID="gen11290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11291"/>et ducit eum per viam non bonam. <l eID="gen11291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4953"/><l level="1" sID="gen11292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4953"/>Qui attonitis oculis cogitat prava, <l eID="gen11292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11293"/>mordens labia sua perficit malum. <l eID="gen11293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4954"/><l level="1" sID="gen11294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4954"/>Corona dignitatis senectus, <l eID="gen11294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11295"/>quæ in viis justitiæ reperietur. <l eID="gen11295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4955"/><l level="1" sID="gen11296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4955"/>Melior est patiens viro forti, <l eID="gen11296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11297"/>et qui dominatur animo suo expugnatore urbium. <l eID="gen11297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 16:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4956"/><l level="1" sID="gen11298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4956"/>Sortes mittuntur in sinum, <l eID="gen11298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11299"/>sed a Domino temperantur.  <chapter eID="Prov.16"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:1
verses.text: Melior est buccella sicca cum gaudio <l eID="gen11300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11301"/>quam domus plena victimis cum jurgio. <l eID="gen11301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4957"/><l level="1" sID="gen11302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4957"/>Servus sapiens dominabitur filiis stultis, <l eID="gen11302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11303"/>et inter fratres hæreditatem dividet. <l eID="gen11303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4958"/><l level="1" sID="gen11304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4958"/>Sicut igne probatur argentum et aurum camino, <l eID="gen11304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11305"/>ita corda probat Dominus. <l eID="gen11305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4959"/><l level="1" sID="gen11306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4959"/>Malus obedit linguæ iniquæ, <l eID="gen11306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11307"/>et fallax obtemperat labiis mendacibus. <l eID="gen11307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4960"/><l level="1" sID="gen11308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4960"/>Qui despicit pauperem exprobrat factori ejus, <l eID="gen11308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11309"/>et qui ruina lætatur alterius non erit impunitus. <l eID="gen11309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4961"/><l level="1" sID="gen11310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4961"/>Corona senum filii filiorum, <l eID="gen11310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11311"/>et gloria filiorum patres eorum. <l eID="gen11311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4962"/><l level="1" sID="gen11312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4962"/>Non decent stultum verba composita, <l eID="gen11312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11313"/>nec principem labium mentiens. <l eID="gen11313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4963"/><l level="1" sID="gen11314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4963"/>Gemma gratissima exspectatio præstolantis ; <l eID="gen11314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11315"/>quocumque se vertit, prudenter intelligit. <l eID="gen11315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4964"/><l level="1" sID="gen11316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4964"/>Qui celat delictum quærit amicitias ; <l eID="gen11316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11317"/>qui altero sermone repetit, separat fœderatos. <l eID="gen11317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4965"/><l level="1" sID="gen11318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4965"/>Plus proficit correptio apud prudentem, <l eID="gen11318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11319"/>quam centum plagæ apud stultum. <l eID="gen11319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4966"/><l level="1" sID="gen11320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4966"/>Semper jurgia quærit malus : <l eID="gen11320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11321"/>angelus autem crudelis mittetur contra eum. <l eID="gen11321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4967"/><l level="1" sID="gen11322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4967"/>Expedit magis ursæ occurrere raptis fœtibus, <l eID="gen11322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11323"/>quam fatuo confidenti in stultitia sua. <l eID="gen11323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4968"/><l level="1" sID="gen11324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4968"/>Qui reddit mala pro bonis, <l eID="gen11324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11325"/>non recedet malum de domo ejus. <l eID="gen11325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4969"/><l level="1" sID="gen11326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4969"/>Qui dimittit aquam caput est jurgiorum, <l eID="gen11326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11327"/>et antequam patiatur contumeliam judicium deserit. <l eID="gen11327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4970"/><l level="1" sID="gen11328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4970"/>Qui justificat impium, et qui condemnat justum, <l eID="gen11328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11329"/>abominabilis est uterque apud Deum. <l eID="gen11329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4971"/><l level="1" sID="gen11330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4971"/>Quid prodest stulto habere divitias, <l eID="gen11330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11331"/>cum sapientiam emere non possit ? <l eID="gen11331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11332"/>Qui altum facit domum suam quærit ruinam, <l eID="gen11332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11333"/>et qui evitat discere incidet in mala. <l eID="gen11333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4972"/><l level="1" sID="gen11334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4972"/>Omni tempore diligit qui amicus est, <l eID="gen11334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11335"/>et frater in angustiis comprobatur. <l eID="gen11335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4973"/><l level="1" sID="gen11336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4973"/>Stultus homo plaudet manibus, <l eID="gen11336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11337"/>cum spoponderit pro amico suo. <l eID="gen11337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4974"/><l level="1" sID="gen11338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4974"/>Qui meditatur discordias diligit rixas, <l eID="gen11338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11339"/>et qui exaltat ostium quærit ruinam. <l eID="gen11339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4975"/><l level="1" sID="gen11340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4975"/>Qui perversi cordis est non inveniet bonum, <l eID="gen11340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11341"/>et qui vertit linguam incidet in malum. <l eID="gen11341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4976"/><l level="1" sID="gen11342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4976"/>Natus est stultus in ignominiam suam ; <l eID="gen11342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11343"/>sed nec pater in fatuo lætabitur. <l eID="gen11343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4977"/><l level="1" sID="gen11344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4977"/>Animus gaudens ætatem floridam facit ; <l eID="gen11344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11345"/>spiritus tristis exsiccat ossa. <l eID="gen11345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4978"/><l level="1" sID="gen11346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4978"/>Munera de sinu impius accipit, <l eID="gen11346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11347"/>ut pervertat semitas judicii. <l eID="gen11347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4979"/><l level="1" sID="gen11348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4979"/>In facie prudentis lucet sapientia ; <l eID="gen11348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11349"/>oculi stultorum in finibus terræ. <l eID="gen11349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4980"/><l level="1" sID="gen11350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4980"/>Ira patris filius stultus, <l eID="gen11350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11351"/>et dolor matris quæ genuit eum. <l eID="gen11351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4981"/><l level="1" sID="gen11352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4981"/>Non est bonum damnum inferre justo, <l eID="gen11352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11353"/>nec percutere principem qui recta judicat. <l eID="gen11353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4982"/><l level="1" sID="gen11354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4982"/>Qui moderatur sermones suos doctus et prudens est, <l eID="gen11354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11355"/>et pretiosi spiritus vir eruditus. <l eID="gen11355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 17:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4983"/><l level="1" sID="gen11356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4983"/>Stultus quoque, si tacuerit, sapiens reputabitur, <l eID="gen11356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11357"/>et si compresserit labia sua, intelligens.  <chapter eID="Prov.17"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:1
verses.text: Occasiones quærit qui vult recedere ab amico : <l eID="gen11358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11359"/>omni tempore erit exprobrabilis. <l eID="gen11359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4984"/><l level="1" sID="gen11360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4984"/>Non recipit stultus verba prudentiæ, <l eID="gen11360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11361"/>nisi ea dixeris quæ versantur in corde ejus. <l eID="gen11361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4985"/><l level="1" sID="gen11362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4985"/>Impius, cum in profundum venerit peccatorum, contemnit ; <l eID="gen11362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11363"/>sed sequitur eum ignominia et opprobrium. <l eID="gen11363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4986"/><l level="1" sID="gen11364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4986"/>Aqua profunda verba ex ore viri, <l eID="gen11364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11365"/>et torrens redundans fons sapientiæ. <l eID="gen11365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4987"/><l level="1" sID="gen11366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4987"/>Accipere personam impii non est bonum, <l eID="gen11366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11367"/>ut declines a veritate judicii. <l eID="gen11367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4988"/><l level="1" sID="gen11368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4988"/>Labia stulti miscent se rixis, <l eID="gen11368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11369"/>et os ejus jurgia provocat. <l eID="gen11369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4989"/><l level="1" sID="gen11370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4989"/>Os stulti contritio ejus, <l eID="gen11370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11371"/>et labia ipsius ruina animæ ejus. <l eID="gen11371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4990"/><l level="1" sID="gen11372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4990"/>Verba bilinguis quasi simplicia, <l eID="gen11372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11373"/>et ipsa perveniunt usque ad interiora ventris. <l eID="gen11373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11374"/>Pigrum dejicit timor ; <l eID="gen11374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11375"/>animæ autem effeminatorum esurient. <l eID="gen11375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4991"/><l level="1" sID="gen11376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4991"/>Qui mollis et dissolutus est in opere suo <l eID="gen11376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11377"/>frater est sua opera dissipantis. <l eID="gen11377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4992"/><l level="1" sID="gen11378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4992"/>Turris fortissima nomen Domini ; <l eID="gen11378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11379"/>ad ipsum currit justus, et exaltabitur. <l eID="gen11379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4993"/><l level="1" sID="gen11380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4993"/>Substantia divitis urbs roboris ejus, <l eID="gen11380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11381"/>et quasi murus validus circumdans eum. <l eID="gen11381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4994"/><l level="1" sID="gen11382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4994"/>Antequam conteratur, exaltatur cor hominis, <l eID="gen11382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11383"/>et antequam glorificetur, humiliatur. <l eID="gen11383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4995"/><l level="1" sID="gen11384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4995"/>Qui prius respondet quam audiat, <l eID="gen11384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11385"/>stultum se esse demonstrat, et confusione dignum. <l eID="gen11385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4996"/><l level="1" sID="gen11386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4996"/>Spiritus viri sustentat imbecillitatem suam ; <l eID="gen11386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11387"/>spiritum vero ad irascendum facilem quis poterit sustinere ? <l eID="gen11387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4997"/><l level="1" sID="gen11388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4997"/>Cor prudens possidebit scientiam, <l eID="gen11388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11389"/>et auris sapientium quærit doctrinam. <l eID="gen11389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4998"/><l level="1" sID="gen11390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4998"/>Donum hominis dilatat viam ejus, <l eID="gen11390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11391"/>et ante principes spatium ei facit. <l eID="gen11391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4999"/><l level="1" sID="gen11392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4999"/>Justus prior est accusator sui : <l eID="gen11392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11393"/>venit amicus ejus, et investigabit eum. <l eID="gen11393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5000"/><l level="1" sID="gen11394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5000"/>Contradictiones comprimit sors, <l eID="gen11394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11395"/>et inter potentes quoque dijudicat. <l eID="gen11395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5001"/><l level="1" sID="gen11396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5001"/>Frater qui adjuvatur a fratre quasi civitas firma, <l eID="gen11396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11397"/>et judicia quasi vectes urbium. <l eID="gen11397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5002"/><l level="1" sID="gen11398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5002"/>De fructu oris viri replebitur venter ejus, <l eID="gen11398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11399"/>et genimina labiorum ipsius saturabunt eum. <l eID="gen11399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5003"/><l level="1" sID="gen11400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5003"/>Mors et vita in manu linguæ ; <l eID="gen11400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11401"/>qui diligunt eam comedent fructus ejus. <l eID="gen11401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5004"/><l level="1" sID="gen11402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5004"/>Qui invenit mulierem bonam invenit bonum, <l eID="gen11402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11403"/>et hauriet jucunditatem a Domino. <l eID="gen11403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11404"/>Qui expellit mulierem bonam expellit bonum ; <l eID="gen11404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11405"/>qui autem tenet adulteram stultus est et impius. <l eID="gen11405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5005"/><l level="1" sID="gen11406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5005"/>Cum obsecrationibus loquetur pauper, <l eID="gen11406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11407"/>et dives effabitur rigide. <l eID="gen11407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5006"/><l level="1" sID="gen11408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5006"/>Vir amabilis ad societatem <l eID="gen11408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11409"/>magis amicus erit quam frater.  <chapter eID="Prov.18"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:1
verses.text: Melior est pauper qui ambulat in simplicitate sua <l eID="gen11410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11411"/>quam dives torquens labia sua, et insipiens. <l eID="gen11411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5007"/><l level="1" sID="gen11412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5007"/>Ubi non est scientia animæ, non est bonum, <l eID="gen11412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11413"/>et qui festinus est pedibus offendet. <l eID="gen11413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5008"/><l level="1" sID="gen11414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5008"/>Stultitia hominis supplantat gressus ejus, <l eID="gen11414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11415"/>et contra Deum fervet animo suo. <l eID="gen11415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5009"/><l level="1" sID="gen11416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5009"/>Divitiæ addunt amicos plurimos ; <l eID="gen11416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11417"/>a paupere autem et hi quos habuit separantur. <l eID="gen11417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5010"/><l level="1" sID="gen11418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5010"/>Testis falsus non erit impunitus, <l eID="gen11418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11419"/>et qui mendacia loquitur non effugiet. <l eID="gen11419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5011"/><l level="1" sID="gen11420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5011"/>Multi colunt personam potentis, <l eID="gen11420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11421"/>et amici sunt dona tribuentis. <l eID="gen11421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5012"/><l level="1" sID="gen11422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5012"/>Fratres hominis pauperis oderunt eum ; <l eID="gen11422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11423"/>insuper et amici procul recesserunt ab eo. <l eID="gen11423" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen10502"/> <div sID="gen11424" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen11424" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11425"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11426"/>Qui tantum verba sectatur nihil habebit ; <l eID="gen11426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5013"/><l level="1" sID="gen11427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5013"/>qui autem possessor est mentis diligit animam suam, <l eID="gen11427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11428"/>et custos prudentiæ inveniet bona. <l eID="gen11428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5014"/><l level="1" sID="gen11429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5014"/>Falsus testis non erit impunitus, <l eID="gen11429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11430"/>et qui loquitur mendacia peribit. <l eID="gen11430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5015"/><l level="1" sID="gen11431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5015"/>Non decent stultum deliciæ, <l eID="gen11431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11432"/>nec servum dominari principibus. <l eID="gen11432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5016"/><l level="1" sID="gen11433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5016"/>Doctrina viri per patientiam noscitur, <l eID="gen11433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11434"/>et gloria ejus est iniqua prætergredi. <l eID="gen11434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5017"/><l level="1" sID="gen11435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5017"/>Sicut fremitus leonis, ita et regis ira, <l eID="gen11435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11436"/>et sicut ros super herbam, ita et hilaritas ejus. <l eID="gen11436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5018"/><l level="1" sID="gen11437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5018"/>Dolor patris filius stultus, <l eID="gen11437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11438"/>et tecta jugiter perstillantia litigiosa mulier. <l eID="gen11438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5019"/><l level="1" sID="gen11439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5019"/>Domus et divitiæ dantur a parentibus ; <l eID="gen11439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11440"/>a Domino autem proprie uxor prudens. <l eID="gen11440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5020"/><l level="1" sID="gen11441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5020"/>Pigredo immittit soporem, <l eID="gen11441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11442"/>et anima dissoluta esuriet. <l eID="gen11442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5021"/><l level="1" sID="gen11443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5021"/>Qui custodit mandatum custodit animam suam ; <l eID="gen11443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11444"/>qui autem negligit viam suam mortificabitur. <l eID="gen11444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5022"/><l level="1" sID="gen11445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5022"/>Fœneratur Domino qui miseretur pauperis, <l eID="gen11445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11446"/>et vicissitudinem suam reddet ei. <l eID="gen11446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5023"/><l level="1" sID="gen11447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5023"/>Erudi filium tuum ; ne desperes : <l eID="gen11447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11448"/>ad interfectionem autem ejus ne ponas animam tuam. <l eID="gen11448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5024"/><l level="1" sID="gen11449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5024"/>Qui impatiens est sustinebit damnum, <l eID="gen11449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11450"/>et cum rapuerit, aliud apponet. <l eID="gen11450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5025"/><l level="1" sID="gen11451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5025"/>Audi consilium, et suscipe disciplinam, <l eID="gen11451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11452"/>ut sis sapiens in novissimis tuis. <l eID="gen11452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5026"/><l level="1" sID="gen11453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5026"/>Multæ cogitationes in corde viri ; <l eID="gen11453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11454"/>voluntas autem Domini permanebit. <l eID="gen11454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5027"/><l level="1" sID="gen11455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5027"/>Homo indigens misericors est, <l eID="gen11455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11456"/>et melior est pauper quam vir mendax. <l eID="gen11456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5028"/><l level="1" sID="gen11457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5028"/>Timor Domini ad vitam, <l eID="gen11457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11458"/>et in plenitudine commorabitur absque visitatione pessima. <l eID="gen11458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5029"/><l level="1" sID="gen11459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5029"/>Abscondit piger manum suam sub ascella, <l eID="gen11459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11460"/>nec ad os suum applicat eam. <l eID="gen11460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5030"/><l level="1" sID="gen11461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5030"/>Pestilente flagellato stultus sapientior erit ; <l eID="gen11461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11462"/>si autem corripueris sapientem, intelliget disciplinam. <l eID="gen11462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5031"/><l level="1" sID="gen11463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5031"/>Qui affligit patrem, et fugat matrem, <l eID="gen11463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11464"/>ignominiosus est et infelix. <l eID="gen11464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5032"/><l level="1" sID="gen11465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5032"/>Non cesses, fili, audire doctrinam, <l eID="gen11465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11466"/>nec ignores sermones scientiæ. <l eID="gen11466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5033"/><l level="1" sID="gen11467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5033"/>Testis iniquus deridet judicium, <l eID="gen11467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11468"/>et os impiorum devorat iniquitatem. <l eID="gen11468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 19:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5034"/><l level="1" sID="gen11469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5034"/>Parata sunt derisoribus judicia, <l eID="gen11469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11470"/>et mallei percutientes stultorum corporibus.  <chapter eID="Prov.19"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:1
verses.text: Luxuriosa res vinum, et tumultuosa ebrietas : <l eID="gen11471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11472"/>quicumque his delectatur non erit sapiens. <l eID="gen11472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5035"/><l level="1" sID="gen11473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5035"/>Sicut rugitus leonis, ita et terror regis : <l eID="gen11473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11474"/>qui provocat eum peccat in animam suam. <l eID="gen11474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5036"/><l level="1" sID="gen11475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5036"/>Honor est homini qui separat se a contentionibus ; <l eID="gen11475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11476"/>omnes autem stulti miscentur contumeliis. <l eID="gen11476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5037"/><l level="1" sID="gen11477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5037"/>Propter frigus piger arare noluit ; <l eID="gen11477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11478"/>mendicabit ergo æstate, et non dabitur illi. <l eID="gen11478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5038"/><l level="1" sID="gen11479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5038"/>Sicut aqua profunda, sic consilium in corde viri ; <l eID="gen11479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11480"/>sed homo sapiens exhauriet illud. <l eID="gen11480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5039"/><l level="1" sID="gen11481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5039"/>Multi homines misericordes vocantur ; <l eID="gen11481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11482"/>virum autem fidelem quis inveniet ? <l eID="gen11482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5040"/><l level="1" sID="gen11483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5040"/>Justus qui ambulat in simplicitate sua <l eID="gen11483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11484"/>beatos post se filios derelinquet. <l eID="gen11484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5041"/><l level="1" sID="gen11485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5041"/>Rex qui sedet in solio judicii <l eID="gen11485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11486"/>dissipat omne malum intuitu suo. <l eID="gen11486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5042"/><l level="1" sID="gen11487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5042"/>Quis potest dicere : Mundum est cor meum ; <l eID="gen11487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11488"/>purus sum a peccato ? <l eID="gen11488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5043"/><l level="1" sID="gen11489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5043"/>Pondus et pondus, mensura et mensura : <l eID="gen11489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11490"/>utrumque abominabile est apud Deum. <l eID="gen11490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5044"/><l level="1" sID="gen11491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5044"/>Ex studiis suis intelligitur puer, <l eID="gen11491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11492"/>si munda et recta sint opera ejus. <l eID="gen11492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5045"/><l level="1" sID="gen11493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5045"/>Aurem audientem, et oculum videntem : <l eID="gen11493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11494"/>Dominus fecit utrumque. <l eID="gen11494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5046"/><l level="1" sID="gen11495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5046"/>Noli diligere somnum, ne te egestas opprimat : <l eID="gen11495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11496"/>aperi oculos tuos, et saturare panibus. <l eID="gen11496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5047"/><l level="1" sID="gen11497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5047"/>Malum est, malum est, dicit omnis emptor ; <l eID="gen11497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11498"/>et cum recesserit, tunc gloriabitur. <l eID="gen11498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5048"/><l level="1" sID="gen11499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5048"/>Est aurum et multitudo gemmarum, <l eID="gen11499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11500"/>et vas pretiosum labia scientiæ. <l eID="gen11500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5049"/><l level="1" sID="gen11501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5049"/>Tolle vestimentum ejus qui fidejussor extitit alieni, <l eID="gen11501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11502"/>et pro extraneis aufer pignus ab eo. <l eID="gen11502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5050"/><l level="1" sID="gen11503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5050"/>Suavis est homini panis mendacii, <l eID="gen11503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11504"/>et postea implebitur os ejus calculo. <l eID="gen11504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5051"/><l level="1" sID="gen11505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5051"/>Cogitationes consiliis roborantur, <l eID="gen11505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11506"/>et gubernaculis tractanda sunt bella. <l eID="gen11506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5052"/><l level="1" sID="gen11507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5052"/>Ei qui revelat mysteria, et ambulat fraudulenter, <l eID="gen11507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11508"/>et dilatat labia sua, ne commiscearis. <l eID="gen11508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5053"/><l level="1" sID="gen11509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5053"/>Qui maledicit patri suo et matri, <l eID="gen11509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11510"/>extinguetur lucerna ejus in mediis tenebris : <l eID="gen11510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5054"/><l level="1" sID="gen11511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5054"/>hæreditas ad quam festinatur in principio, <l eID="gen11511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11512"/>in novissimo benedictione carebit. <l eID="gen11512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5055"/><l level="1" sID="gen11513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5055"/>Ne dicas : Reddam malum : <l eID="gen11513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11514"/>exspecta Dominum, et liberabit te. <l eID="gen11514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5056"/><l level="1" sID="gen11515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5056"/>Abominatio est apud Dominum pondus et pondus ; <l eID="gen11515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11516"/>statera dolosa non est bona. <l eID="gen11516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5057"/><l level="1" sID="gen11517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5057"/>A Domino diriguntur gressus viri : <l eID="gen11517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11518"/>quis autem hominum intelligere potest viam suam ? <l eID="gen11518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5058"/><l level="1" sID="gen11519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5058"/>Ruina est homini devorare sanctos, <l eID="gen11519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11520"/>et post vota retractare. <l eID="gen11520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5059"/><l level="1" sID="gen11521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5059"/>Dissipat impios rex sapiens, <l eID="gen11521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11522"/>et incurvat super eos fornicem. <l eID="gen11522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5060"/><l level="1" sID="gen11523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5060"/>Lucerna Domini spiraculum hominis, <l eID="gen11523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11524"/>quæ investigat omnia secreta ventris. <l eID="gen11524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5061"/><l level="1" sID="gen11525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5061"/>Misericordia et veritas custodiunt regem, <l eID="gen11525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11526"/>et roboratur clementia thronus ejus. <l eID="gen11526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5062"/><l level="1" sID="gen11527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5062"/>Exsultatio juvenum fortitudo eorum, <l eID="gen11527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11528"/>et dignitas senum canities. <l eID="gen11528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 20:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5063"/><l level="1" sID="gen11529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5063"/>Livor vulneris absterget mala, <l eID="gen11529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11530"/>et plagæ in secretioribus ventris.  <chapter eID="Prov.20"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:1
verses.text: Sicut divisiones aquarum, ita cor regis in manu Domini : <l eID="gen11531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11532"/>quocumque voluerit, inclinabit illud. <l eID="gen11532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5064"/><l level="1" sID="gen11533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5064"/>Omnis via viri recta sibi videtur : <l eID="gen11533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11534"/>appendit autem corda Dominus. <l eID="gen11534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5065"/><l level="1" sID="gen11535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5065"/>Facere misericordiam et judicium <l eID="gen11535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11536"/>magis placet Domino quam victimæ. <l eID="gen11536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5066"/><l level="1" sID="gen11537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5066"/>Exaltatio oculorum est dilatatio cordis ; <l eID="gen11537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11538"/>lucerna impiorum peccatum. <l eID="gen11538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5067"/><l level="1" sID="gen11539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5067"/>Cogitationes robusti semper in abundantia ; <l eID="gen11539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11540"/>omnis autem piger semper in egestate est. <l eID="gen11540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5068"/><l level="1" sID="gen11541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5068"/>Qui congregat thesauros lingua mendacii vanus et excors est, <l eID="gen11541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11542"/>et impingetur ad laqueos mortis. <l eID="gen11542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5069"/><l level="1" sID="gen11543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5069"/>Rapinæ impiorum detrahent eos, <l eID="gen11543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11544"/>quia noluerunt facere judicium. <l eID="gen11544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5070"/><l level="1" sID="gen11545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5070"/>Perversa via viri aliena est ; <l eID="gen11545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11546"/>qui autem mundus est, rectum opus ejus. <l eID="gen11546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5071"/><l level="1" sID="gen11547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5071"/>Melius est sedere in angulo domatis, <l eID="gen11547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11548"/>quam cum muliere litigiosa, et in domo communi. <l eID="gen11548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5072"/><l level="1" sID="gen11549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5072"/>Anima impii desiderat malum : <l eID="gen11549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11550"/>non miserebitur proximo suo. <l eID="gen11550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5073"/><l level="1" sID="gen11551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5073"/>Mulctato pestilente, sapientior erit parvulus, <l eID="gen11551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11552"/>et si sectetur sapientem, sumet scientiam. <l eID="gen11552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5074"/><l level="1" sID="gen11553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5074"/>Excogitat justus de domo impii, <l eID="gen11553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11554"/>ut detrahat impios a malo. <l eID="gen11554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5075"/><l level="1" sID="gen11555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5075"/>Qui obturat aurem suam ad clamorem pauperis, <l eID="gen11555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11556"/>et ipse clamabit, et non exaudietur. <l eID="gen11556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5076"/><l level="1" sID="gen11557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5076"/>Munus absconditum extinguit iras, <l eID="gen11557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11558"/>et donum in sinu indignationem maximam. <l eID="gen11558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5077"/><l level="1" sID="gen11559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5077"/>Gaudium justo est facere judicium, <l eID="gen11559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11560"/>et pavor operantibus iniquitatem. <l eID="gen11560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5078"/><l level="1" sID="gen11561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5078"/>Vir qui erraverit a via doctrinæ <l eID="gen11561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11562"/>in cœtu gigantum commorabitur. <l eID="gen11562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5079"/><l level="1" sID="gen11563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5079"/>Qui diligit epulas in egestate erit ; <l eID="gen11563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11564"/>qui amat vinum et pinguia non ditabitur. <l eID="gen11564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5080"/><l level="1" sID="gen11565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5080"/>Pro justo datur impius, <l eID="gen11565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11566"/>et pro rectis iniquus. <l eID="gen11566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5081"/><l level="1" sID="gen11567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5081"/>Melius est habitare in terra deserta <l eID="gen11567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11568"/>quam cum muliere rixosa et iracunda. <l eID="gen11568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5082"/><l level="1" sID="gen11569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5082"/>Thesaurus desiderabilis, et oleum in habitaculo justi : <l eID="gen11569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11570"/>et imprudens homo dissipabit illud. <l eID="gen11570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5083"/><l level="1" sID="gen11571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5083"/>Qui sequitur justitiam et misericordiam <l eID="gen11571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11572"/>inveniet vitam, justitiam, et gloriam. <l eID="gen11572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5084"/><l level="1" sID="gen11573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5084"/>Civitatem fortium ascendit sapiens, <l eID="gen11573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11574"/>et destruxit robur fiduciæ ejus. <l eID="gen11574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5085"/><l level="1" sID="gen11575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5085"/>Qui custodit os suum et linguam suam <l eID="gen11575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11576"/>custodit ab angustiis animam suam. <l eID="gen11576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5086"/><l level="1" sID="gen11577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5086"/>Superbus et arrogans vocatur indoctus, <l eID="gen11577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11578"/>qui in ira operatur superbiam. <l eID="gen11578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5087"/><l level="1" sID="gen11579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5087"/>Desideria occidunt pigrum : <l eID="gen11579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11580"/>noluerunt enim quidquam manus ejus operari. <l eID="gen11580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5088"/><l level="1" sID="gen11581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5088"/>Tota die concupiscit et desiderat ; <l eID="gen11581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11582"/>qui autem justus est, tribuet, et non cessabit. <l eID="gen11582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5089"/><l level="1" sID="gen11583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5089"/>Hostiæ impiorum abominabiles, <l eID="gen11583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11584"/>quia offeruntur ex scelere. <l eID="gen11584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:28
