verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5090"/><l level="1" sID="gen11585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5090"/>Testis mendax peribit ; <l eID="gen11585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11586"/>vir obediens loquetur victoriam. <l eID="gen11586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5091"/><l level="1" sID="gen11587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5091"/>Vir impius procaciter obfirmat vultum suum ; <l eID="gen11587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11588"/>qui autem rectus est corrigit viam suam. <l eID="gen11588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5092"/><l level="1" sID="gen11589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5092"/>Non est sapientia, non est prudentia, <l eID="gen11589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11590"/>non est consilium contra Dominum. <l eID="gen11590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 21:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5093"/><l level="1" sID="gen11591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5093"/>Equus paratur ad diem belli ; <l eID="gen11591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11592"/>Dominus autem salutem tribuit.  <chapter eID="Prov.21"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:1
verses.text: Melius est nomen bonum quam divitiæ multæ ; <l eID="gen11593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11594"/>super argentum et aurum gratia bona. <l eID="gen11594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5094"/><l level="1" sID="gen11595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5094"/>Dives et pauper obviaverunt sibi : <l eID="gen11595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11596"/>utriusque operator est Dominus. <l eID="gen11596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5095"/><l level="1" sID="gen11597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5095"/>Callidus vidit malum, et abscondit se ; <l eID="gen11597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11598"/>innocens pertransiit, et afflictus est damno. <l eID="gen11598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5096"/><l level="1" sID="gen11599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5096"/>Finis modestiæ timor Domini, <l eID="gen11599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11600"/>divitiæ, et gloria, et vita. <l eID="gen11600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5097"/><l level="1" sID="gen11601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5097"/>Arma et gladii in via perversi ; <l eID="gen11601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11602"/>custos autem animæ suæ longe recedit ab eis. <l eID="gen11602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5098"/><l level="1" sID="gen11603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5098"/>Proverbium est : adolescens juxta viam suam ; <l eID="gen11603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11604"/>etiam cum senuerit, non recedet ab ea. <l eID="gen11604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5099"/><l level="1" sID="gen11605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5099"/>Dives pauperibus imperat, <l eID="gen11605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11606"/>et qui accipit mutuum servus est fœnerantis. <l eID="gen11606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5100"/><l level="1" sID="gen11607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5100"/>Qui seminat iniquitatem metet mala, <l eID="gen11607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11608"/>et virga iræ suæ consummabitur. <l eID="gen11608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5101"/><l level="1" sID="gen11609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5101"/>Qui pronus est ad misericordiam benedicetur : <l eID="gen11609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11610"/>de panibus enim suis dedit pauperi. <l eID="gen11610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11611"/>Victoriam et honorem acquiret qui dat munera ; <l eID="gen11611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11612"/>animam autem aufert accipientium. <l eID="gen11612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5102"/><l level="1" sID="gen11613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5102"/>Ejice derisorem, et exibit cum eo jurgium, <l eID="gen11613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11614"/>cessabuntque causæ et contumeliæ. <l eID="gen11614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5103"/><l level="1" sID="gen11615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5103"/>Qui diligit cordis munditiam, <l eID="gen11615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11616"/>propter gratiam labiorum suorum habebit amicum regem. <l eID="gen11616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5104"/><l level="1" sID="gen11617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5104"/>Oculi Domini custodiunt scientiam, <l eID="gen11617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11618"/>et supplantantur verba iniqui. <l eID="gen11618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5105"/><l level="1" sID="gen11619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5105"/>Dicit piger : Leo est foris ; <l eID="gen11619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11620"/>in medio platearum occidendus sum. <l eID="gen11620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5106"/><l level="1" sID="gen11621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5106"/>Fovea profunda os alienæ : <l eID="gen11621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11622"/>cui iratus est Dominus, incidet in eam. <l eID="gen11622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5107"/><l level="1" sID="gen11623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5107"/>Stultitia colligata est in corde pueri, <l eID="gen11623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11624"/>et virga disciplinæ fugabit eam. <l eID="gen11624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5108"/><l level="1" sID="gen11625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5108"/>Qui calumniatur pauperem ut augeat divitias suas, <l eID="gen11625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11626"/>dabit ipse ditiori, et egebit. <l eID="gen11626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5109"/><l level="1" sID="gen11627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5109"/>Inclina aurem tuam, et audi verba sapientium : <l eID="gen11627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11628"/>appone autem cor ad doctrinam meam, <l eID="gen11628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5110"/><l level="1" sID="gen11629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5110"/>quæ pulchra erit tibi cum servaveris eam in ventre tuo, <l eID="gen11629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11630"/>et redundabit in labiis tuis : <l eID="gen11630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5111"/><l level="1" sID="gen11631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5111"/>ut sit in Domino fiducia tua, <l eID="gen11631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11632"/>unde et ostendi eam tibi hodie. <l eID="gen11632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5112"/><l level="1" sID="gen11633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5112"/>Ecce descripsi eam tibi tripliciter, <l eID="gen11633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11634"/>in cogitationibus et scientia : <l eID="gen11634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5113"/><l level="1" sID="gen11635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5113"/>ut ostenderem tibi firmitatem et eloquia veritatis, <l eID="gen11635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11636"/>respondere ex his illis qui miserunt te. <l eID="gen11636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5114"/><l level="1" sID="gen11637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5114"/>Non facias violentiam pauperi quia pauper est, <l eID="gen11637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11638"/>neque conteras egenum in porta : <l eID="gen11638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5115"/><l level="1" sID="gen11639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5115"/>quia judicabit Dominus causam ejus, <l eID="gen11639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11640"/>et configet eos qui confixerunt animam ejus. <l eID="gen11640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5116"/><l level="1" sID="gen11641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5116"/>Noli esse amicus homini iracundo, <l eID="gen11641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11642"/>neque ambules cum viro furioso : <l eID="gen11642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5117"/><l level="1" sID="gen11643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5117"/>ne forte discas semitas ejus, <l eID="gen11643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11644"/>et sumas scandalum animæ tuæ. <l eID="gen11644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5118"/><l level="1" sID="gen11645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5118"/>Noli esse cum his qui defigunt manus suas, <l eID="gen11645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11646"/>et qui vades se offerunt pro debitis : <l eID="gen11646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5119"/><l level="1" sID="gen11647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5119"/>si enim non habes unde restituas, <l eID="gen11647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11648"/>quid causæ est ut tollat operimentum de cubili tuo ? <l eID="gen11648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5120"/><l level="1" sID="gen11649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5120"/>Ne transgrediaris terminos antiquos, <l eID="gen11649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11650"/>quos posuerunt patres tui. <l eID="gen11650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5121"/><l level="1" sID="gen11651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5121"/>Vidisti virum velocem in opere suo ? <l eID="gen11651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11652"/>coram regibus stabit, nec erit ante ignobiles.  <chapter eID="Prov.22"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:1
verses.text: Quando sederis ut comedas cum principe, <l eID="gen11653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11654"/>diligenter attende quæ apposita sunt ante faciem tuam. <l eID="gen11654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5122"/><l level="1" sID="gen11655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5122"/>Et statue cultrum in gutture tuo : <l eID="gen11655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11656"/>si tamen habes in potestate animam tuam. <l eID="gen11656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5123"/><l level="1" sID="gen11657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5123"/>Ne desideres de cibis ejus, <l eID="gen11657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11658"/>in quo est panis mendacii. <l eID="gen11658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5124"/><l level="1" sID="gen11659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5124"/>Noli laborare ut diteris, <l eID="gen11659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11660"/>sed prudentiæ tuæ pone modum. <l eID="gen11660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5125"/><l level="1" sID="gen11661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5125"/>Ne erigas oculos tuos ad opes quas non potes habere, <l eID="gen11661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11662"/>quia facient sibi pennas quasi aquilæ, et volabunt in cælum. <l eID="gen11662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5126"/><l level="1" sID="gen11663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5126"/>Ne comedas cum homine invido, <l eID="gen11663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11664"/>et ne desideres cibos ejus : <l eID="gen11664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5127"/><l level="1" sID="gen11665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5127"/>quoniam in similitudinem arioli et conjectoris <l eID="gen11665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11666"/>æstimat quod ignorat. <l eID="gen11666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11667"/>Comede et bibe, dicet tibi ; <l eID="gen11667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11668"/>et mens ejus non est tecum. <l eID="gen11668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5128"/><l level="1" sID="gen11669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5128"/>Cibos quos comederas evomes, <l eID="gen11669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11670"/>et perdes pulchros sermones tuos. <l eID="gen11670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5129"/><l level="1" sID="gen11671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5129"/>In auribus insipientium ne loquaris, <l eID="gen11671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11672"/>qui despicient doctrinam eloquii tui. <l eID="gen11672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5130"/><l level="1" sID="gen11673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5130"/>Ne attingas parvulorum terminos, <l eID="gen11673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11674"/>et agrum pupillorum ne introëas : <l eID="gen11674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5131"/><l level="1" sID="gen11675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5131"/>propinquus enim illorum fortis est, <l eID="gen11675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11676"/>et ipse judicabit contra te causam illorum. <l eID="gen11676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5132"/><l level="1" sID="gen11677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5132"/>Ingrediatur ad doctrinam cor tuum, <l eID="gen11677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11678"/>et aures tuæ ad verba scientiæ. <l eID="gen11678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5133"/><l level="1" sID="gen11679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5133"/>Noli subtrahere a puero disciplinam : <l eID="gen11679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11680"/>si enim percusseris eum virga, non morietur. <l eID="gen11680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5134"/><l level="1" sID="gen11681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5134"/>Tu virga percuties eum, <l eID="gen11681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11682"/>et animam ejus de inferno liberabis. <l eID="gen11682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5135"/><l level="1" sID="gen11683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5135"/>Fili mi, si sapiens fuerit animus tuus, <l eID="gen11683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11684"/>gaudebit tecum cor meum : <l eID="gen11684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5136"/><l level="1" sID="gen11685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5136"/>et exsultabunt renes mei, <l eID="gen11685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11686"/>cum locuta fuerint rectum labia tua. <l eID="gen11686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5137"/><l level="1" sID="gen11687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5137"/>Non æmuletur cor tuum peccatores, <l eID="gen11687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11688"/>sed in timore Domini esto tota die : <l eID="gen11688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5138"/><l level="1" sID="gen11689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5138"/>quia habebis spem in novissimo, <l eID="gen11689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11690"/>et præstolatio tua non auferetur. <l eID="gen11690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5139"/><l level="1" sID="gen11691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5139"/>Audi, fili mi, et esto sapiens, <l eID="gen11691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11692"/>et dirige in via animum tuum. <l eID="gen11692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5140"/><l level="1" sID="gen11693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5140"/>Noli esse in conviviis potatorum, <l eID="gen11693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11694"/>nec in comessationibus eorum qui carnes ad vescendum conferunt : <l eID="gen11694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5141"/><l level="1" sID="gen11695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5141"/>quia vacantes potibus et dantes symbola consumentur, <l eID="gen11695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11696"/>et vestietur pannis dormitatio. <l eID="gen11696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5142"/><l level="1" sID="gen11697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5142"/>Audi patrem tuum, qui genuit te, <l eID="gen11697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11698"/>et ne contemnas cum senuerit mater tua. <l eID="gen11698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5143"/><l level="1" sID="gen11699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5143"/>Veritatem eme, et noli vendere sapientiam, <l eID="gen11699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11700"/>et doctrinam, et intelligentiam. <l eID="gen11700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5144"/><l level="1" sID="gen11701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5144"/>Exsultat gaudio pater justi ; <l eID="gen11701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11702"/>qui sapientem genuit, lætabitur in eo. <l eID="gen11702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5145"/><l level="1" sID="gen11703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5145"/>Gaudeat pater tuus et mater tua, <l eID="gen11703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11704"/>et exsultet quæ genuit te. <l eID="gen11704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5146"/><l level="1" sID="gen11705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5146"/>Præbe, fili mi, cor tuum mihi, <l eID="gen11705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11706"/>et oculi tui vias meas custodiant. <l eID="gen11706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5147"/><l level="1" sID="gen11707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5147"/>Fovea enim profunda est meretrix, <l eID="gen11707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11708"/>et puteus angustus aliena. <l eID="gen11708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5148"/><l level="1" sID="gen11709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5148"/>Insidiatur in via quasi latro, <l eID="gen11709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11710"/>et quos incautos viderit, interficiet. <l eID="gen11710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5149"/><l level="1" sID="gen11711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5149"/>Cui væ ? cujus patri væ ? <l eID="gen11711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11712"/>cui rixæ ? cui foveæ ? <l eID="gen11712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11713"/>cui sine causa vulnera ? cui suffusio oculorum ? <l eID="gen11713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5150"/><l level="1" sID="gen11714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5150"/>nonne his qui commorantur in vino, <l eID="gen11714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11715"/>et student calicibus epotandis ? <l eID="gen11715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5151"/><l level="1" sID="gen11716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5151"/>Ne intuearis vinum quando flavescit, <l eID="gen11716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11717"/>cum splenduerit in vitro color ejus : <l eID="gen11717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11718"/>ingreditur blande, <l eID="gen11718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5152"/><l level="1" sID="gen11719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5152"/>sed in novissimo mordebit ut coluber, <l eID="gen11719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11720"/>et sicut regulus venena diffundet. <l eID="gen11720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5153"/><l level="1" sID="gen11721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5153"/>Oculi tui videbunt extraneas, <l eID="gen11721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11722"/>et cor tuum loquetur perversa. <l eID="gen11722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5154"/><l level="1" sID="gen11723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5154"/>Et eris sicut dormiens in medio mari, <l eID="gen11723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11724"/>et quasi sopitus gubernator, amisso clavo. <l eID="gen11724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 23:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5155"/><l level="1" sID="gen11725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5155"/>Et dices : Verberaverunt me, sed non dolui ; <l eID="gen11725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11726"/>traxerunt me, et ego non sensi. <l eID="gen11726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11727"/>Quando evigilabo, et rursus vina reperiam ?  <chapter eID="Prov.23"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:1
verses.text: Ne æmuleris viros malos, <l eID="gen11728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11729"/>nec desideres esse cum eis : <l eID="gen11729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5156"/><l level="1" sID="gen11730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5156"/>quia rapinas meditatur mens eorum, <l eID="gen11730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11731"/>et fraudes labia eorum loquuntur. <l eID="gen11731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5157"/><l level="1" sID="gen11732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5157"/>Sapientia ædificabitur domus, <l eID="gen11732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11733"/>et prudentia roborabitur. <l eID="gen11733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5158"/><l level="1" sID="gen11734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5158"/>In doctrina replebuntur cellaria, <l eID="gen11734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11735"/>universa substantia pretiosa et pulcherrima. <l eID="gen11735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5159"/><l level="1" sID="gen11736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5159"/>Vir sapiens fortis est, <l eID="gen11736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11737"/>et vir doctus robustus et validus : <l eID="gen11737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5160"/><l level="1" sID="gen11738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5160"/>quia cum dispositione initur bellum, <l eID="gen11738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11739"/>et erit salus ubi multa consilia sunt. <l eID="gen11739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5161"/><l level="1" sID="gen11740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5161"/>Excelsa stulto sapientia ; <l eID="gen11740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11741"/>in porta non aperiet os suum. <l eID="gen11741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5162"/><l level="1" sID="gen11742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5162"/>Qui cogitat mala facere stultus vocabitur : <l eID="gen11742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5163"/><l level="1" sID="gen11743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5163"/>cogitatio stulti peccatum est, <l eID="gen11743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11744"/>et abominatio hominum detractor. <l eID="gen11744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5164"/><l level="1" sID="gen11745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5164"/>Si desperaveris lassus in die angustiæ, <l eID="gen11745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11746"/>imminuetur fortitudo tua. <l eID="gen11746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5165"/><l level="1" sID="gen11747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5165"/>Erue eos qui ducuntur ad mortem, <l eID="gen11747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11748"/>et qui trahuntur ad interitum, liberare ne cesses. <l eID="gen11748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5166"/><l level="1" sID="gen11749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5166"/>Si dixeris : Vires non suppetunt ; <l eID="gen11749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11750"/>qui inspector est cordis ipse intelligit : <l eID="gen11750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11751"/>et servatorem animæ tuæ nihil fallit, <l eID="gen11751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11752"/>reddetque homini juxta opera sua. <l eID="gen11752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5167"/><l level="1" sID="gen11753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5167"/>Comede, fili mi, mel, quia bonum est, <l eID="gen11753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11754"/>et favum dulcissimum gutturi tuo. <l eID="gen11754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5168"/><l level="1" sID="gen11755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5168"/>Sic et doctrina sapientiæ animæ tuæ : <l eID="gen11755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11756"/>quam cum inveneris, habebis in novissimis spem, <l eID="gen11756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11757"/>et spes tua non peribit. <l eID="gen11757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5169"/><l level="1" sID="gen11758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5169"/>Ne insidieris, et quæras impietatem in domo justi, <l eID="gen11758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11759"/>neque vastes requiem ejus. <l eID="gen11759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5170"/><l level="1" sID="gen11760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5170"/>Septies enim cadet justus, et resurget : <l eID="gen11760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11761"/>impii autem corruent in malum. <l eID="gen11761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5171"/><l level="1" sID="gen11762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5171"/>Cum ceciderit inimicus tuus ne gaudeas, <l eID="gen11762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11763"/>et in ruina ejus ne exsultet cor tuum : <l eID="gen11763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5172"/><l level="1" sID="gen11764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5172"/>ne forte videat Dominus, et displiceat ei, <l eID="gen11764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11765"/>et auferat ab eo iram suam. <l eID="gen11765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5173"/><l level="1" sID="gen11766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5173"/>Ne contendas cum pessimis, <l eID="gen11766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11767"/>nec æmuleris impios : <l eID="gen11767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5174"/><l level="1" sID="gen11768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5174"/>quoniam non habent futurorum spem mali, <l eID="gen11768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11769"/>et lucerna impiorum extinguetur. <l eID="gen11769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5175"/><l level="1" sID="gen11770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5175"/>Time Dominum, fili mi, et regem, <l eID="gen11770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11771"/>et cum detractoribus non commiscearis : <l eID="gen11771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5176"/><l level="1" sID="gen11772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5176"/>quoniam repente consurget perditio eorum, <l eID="gen11772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11773"/>et ruinam utriusque quis novit ? <l eID="gen11773" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen11425"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5177"/><div sID="gen11774" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5177"/>Hæc quoque sapientibus. <div eID="gen11774" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen11775"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11776"/>Cognoscere personam in judicio non est bonum. <l eID="gen11776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5178"/><l level="1" sID="gen11777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5178"/>Qui dicunt impio : Justus es : maledicent eis populi, <l eID="gen11777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11778"/>et detestabuntur eos tribus. <l eID="gen11778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5179"/><l level="1" sID="gen11779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5179"/>Qui arguunt eum laudabuntur, <l eID="gen11779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11780"/>et super ipsos veniet benedictio. <l eID="gen11780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5180"/><l level="1" sID="gen11781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5180"/>Labia deosculabitur <l eID="gen11781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11782"/>qui recta verba respondet. <l eID="gen11782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5181"/><l level="1" sID="gen11783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5181"/>Præpara foris opus tuum, <l eID="gen11783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11784"/>et diligenter exerce agrum tuum, <l eID="gen11784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11785"/>ut postea ædifices domum tuam. <l eID="gen11785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5182"/><l level="1" sID="gen11786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5182"/>Ne sis testis frustra contra proximum tuum, <l eID="gen11786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11787"/>nec lactes quemquam labiis tuis. <l eID="gen11787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5183"/><l level="1" sID="gen11788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5183"/>Ne dicas : Quomodo fecit mihi, sic faciam ei ; <l eID="gen11788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11789"/>reddam unicuique secundum opus suum. <l eID="gen11789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5184"/><l level="1" sID="gen11790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5184"/>Per agrum hominis pigri transivi, <l eID="gen11790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11791"/>et per vineam viri stulti : <l eID="gen11791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5185"/><l level="1" sID="gen11792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5185"/>et ecce totum repleverant urticæ, <l eID="gen11792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11793"/>et operuerant superficiem ejus spinæ, <l eID="gen11793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11794"/>et maceria lapidum destructa erat. <l eID="gen11794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5186"/><l level="1" sID="gen11795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5186"/>Quod cum vidissem, posui in corde meo, <l eID="gen11795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11796"/>et exemplo didici disciplinam. <l eID="gen11796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5187"/><l level="1" sID="gen11797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5187"/>Parum, inquam, dormies, modicum dormitabis ; <l eID="gen11797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11798"/>pauxillum manus conseres ut quiescas : <l eID="gen11798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 24:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5188"/><l level="1" sID="gen11799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5188"/>et veniet tibi quasi cursor egestas, <l eID="gen11799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11800"/>et mendicitas quasi vir armatus. <l eID="gen11800" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11775"/> <chapter eID="Prov.24"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:1
verses.text: Hæ quoque parabolæ Salomonis, quas transtulerunt viri Ezechiæ regis Juda.  <div eID="gen11801" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5189"/><lg sID="gen11802"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5189"/>Gloria Dei est celare verbum, <l eID="gen11803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11804"/>et gloria regum investigare sermonem. <l eID="gen11804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5190"/><l level="1" sID="gen11805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5190"/>Cælum sursum, et terra deorsum, <l eID="gen11805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11806"/>et cor regum inscrutabile. <l eID="gen11806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5191"/><l level="1" sID="gen11807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5191"/>Aufer rubiginem de argento, <l eID="gen11807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11808"/>et egredietur vas purissimum. <l eID="gen11808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5192"/><l level="1" sID="gen11809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5192"/>Aufer impietatem de vultu regis, <l eID="gen11809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11810"/>et firmabitur justitia thronus ejus. <l eID="gen11810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5193"/><l level="1" sID="gen11811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5193"/>Ne gloriosus appareas coram rege, <l eID="gen11811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11812"/>et in loco magnorum ne steteris. <l eID="gen11812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5194"/><l level="1" sID="gen11813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5194"/>Melius est enim ut dicatur tibi : Ascende huc, <l eID="gen11813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11814"/>quam ut humilieris coram principe. <l eID="gen11814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5195"/><l level="1" sID="gen11815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5195"/>Quæ viderunt oculi tui ne proferas in jurgio cito, <l eID="gen11815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11816"/>ne postea emendare non possis, <l eID="gen11816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11817"/>cum dehonestaveris amicum tuum. <l eID="gen11817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5196"/><l level="1" sID="gen11818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5196"/>Causam tuam tracta cum amico tuo, <l eID="gen11818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11819"/>et secretum extraneo ne reveles : <l eID="gen11819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5197"/><l level="1" sID="gen11820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5197"/>ne forte insultet tibi cum audierit, <l eID="gen11820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11821"/>et exprobrare non cesset. <l eID="gen11821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11822"/>Gratia et amicitia liberant : <l eID="gen11822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11823"/>quas tibi serva, ne exprobrabilis fias. <l eID="gen11823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5198"/><l level="1" sID="gen11824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5198"/>Mala aurea in lectis argenteis, <l eID="gen11824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11825"/>qui loquitur verbum in tempore suo. <l eID="gen11825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5199"/><l level="1" sID="gen11826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5199"/>Inauris aurea, et margaritum fulgens, <l eID="gen11826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11827"/>qui arguit sapientem et aurem obedientem. <l eID="gen11827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5200"/><l level="1" sID="gen11828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5200"/>Sicut frigus nivis in die messis, <l eID="gen11828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11829"/>ita legatus fidelis ei qui misit eum : <l eID="gen11829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11830"/>animam ipsius requiescere facit. <l eID="gen11830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5201"/><l level="1" sID="gen11831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5201"/>Nubes, et ventus, et pluviæ non sequentes, <l eID="gen11831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11832"/>vir gloriosus et promissa non complens. <l eID="gen11832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5202"/><l level="1" sID="gen11833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5202"/>Patientia lenietur princeps, <l eID="gen11833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11834"/>et lingua mollis confringet duritiam. <l eID="gen11834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5203"/><l level="1" sID="gen11835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5203"/>Mel invenisti : comede quod sufficit tibi, <l eID="gen11835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11836"/>ne forte satiatus evomas illud. <l eID="gen11836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5204"/><l level="1" sID="gen11837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5204"/>Subtrahe pedem tuum de domo proximi tui, <l eID="gen11837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11838"/>nequando satiatus oderit te. <l eID="gen11838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5205"/><l level="1" sID="gen11839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5205"/>Jaculum, et gladius, et sagitta acuta, <l eID="gen11839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11840"/>homo qui loquitur contra proximum suum falsum testimonium. <l eID="gen11840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5206"/><l level="1" sID="gen11841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5206"/>Dens putridus, et pes lassus, <l eID="gen11841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11842"/>qui sperat super infideli in die angustiæ, <l eID="gen11842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5207"/><l level="1" sID="gen11843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5207"/>et amittit pallium in die frigoris. <l eID="gen11843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11844"/>Acetum in nitro, <l eID="gen11844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11845"/>qui cantat carmina cordi pessimo. <l eID="gen11845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11846"/>Sicut tinea vestimento, et vermis ligno, <l eID="gen11846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11847"/>ita tristitia viri nocet cordi. <l eID="gen11847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5208"/><l level="1" sID="gen11848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5208"/>Si esurierit inimicus tuus, ciba illum ; <l eID="gen11848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11849"/>si sitierit, da ei aquam bibere : <l eID="gen11849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5209"/><l level="1" sID="gen11850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5209"/>prunas enim congregabis super caput ejus, <l eID="gen11850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11851"/>et Dominus reddet tibi. <l eID="gen11851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5210"/><l level="1" sID="gen11852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5210"/>Ventus aquilo dissipat pluvias, <l eID="gen11852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11853"/>et facies tristis linguam detrahentem. <l eID="gen11853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5211"/><l level="1" sID="gen11854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5211"/>Melius est sedere in angulo domatis <l eID="gen11854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11855"/>quam cum muliere litigiosa et in domo communi. <l eID="gen11855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5212"/><l level="1" sID="gen11856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5212"/>Aqua frigida animæ sitienti, <l eID="gen11856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11857"/>et nuntius bonus de terra longinqua. <l eID="gen11857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5213"/><l level="1" sID="gen11858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5213"/>Fons turbatus pede et vena corrupta, <l eID="gen11858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11859"/>justus cadens coram impio. <l eID="gen11859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5214"/><l level="1" sID="gen11860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5214"/>Sicut qui mel multum comedit non est ei bonum, <l eID="gen11860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11861"/>sic qui scrutator est majestatis opprimetur a gloria. <l eID="gen11861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 25:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5215"/><l level="1" sID="gen11862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5215"/>Sicut urbs patens et absque murorum ambitu, <l eID="gen11862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11863"/>ita vir qui non potest in loquendo cohibere spiritum suum.  <chapter eID="Prov.25"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:1
verses.text: Quomodo nix in æstate, et pluviæ in messe, <l eID="gen11864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11865"/>sic indecens est stulto gloria. <l eID="gen11865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5216"/><l level="1" sID="gen11866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5216"/>Sicut avis ad alia transvolans, et passer quolibet vadens, <l eID="gen11866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11867"/>sic maledictum frustra prolatum in quempiam superveniet. <l eID="gen11867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5217"/><l level="1" sID="gen11868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5217"/>Flagellum equo, et camus asino, <l eID="gen11868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11869"/>et virga in dorso imprudentium. <l eID="gen11869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5218"/><l level="1" sID="gen11870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5218"/>Ne respondeas stulto juxta stultitiam suam, <l eID="gen11870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11871"/>ne efficiaris ei similis. <l eID="gen11871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5219"/><l level="1" sID="gen11872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5219"/>Responde stulto juxta stultitiam suam, <l eID="gen11872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11873"/>ne sibi sapiens esse videatur. <l eID="gen11873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5220"/><l level="1" sID="gen11874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5220"/>Claudus pedibus, et iniquitatem bibens, <l eID="gen11874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11875"/>qui mittit verba per nuntium stultum. <l eID="gen11875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5221"/><l level="1" sID="gen11876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5221"/>Quomodo pulchras frustra habet claudus tibias, <l eID="gen11876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11877"/>sic indecens est in ore stultorum parabola. <l eID="gen11877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5222"/><l level="1" sID="gen11878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5222"/>Sicut qui mittit lapidem in acervum Mercurii, <l eID="gen11878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11879"/>ita qui tribuit insipienti honorem. <l eID="gen11879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5223"/><l level="1" sID="gen11880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5223"/>Quomodo si spina nascatur in manu temulenti, <l eID="gen11880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11881"/>sic parabola in ore stultorum. <l eID="gen11881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5224"/><l level="1" sID="gen11882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5224"/>Judicium determinat causas, <l eID="gen11882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11883"/>et qui imponit stulto silentium iras mitigat. <l eID="gen11883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5225"/><l level="1" sID="gen11884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5225"/>Sicut canis qui revertitur ad vomitum suum, <l eID="gen11884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11885"/>sic imprudens qui iterat stultitiam suam. <l eID="gen11885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5226"/><l level="1" sID="gen11886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5226"/>Vidisti hominem sapientem sibi videri ? <l eID="gen11886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11887"/>magis illo spem habebit insipiens. <l eID="gen11887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5227"/><l level="1" sID="gen11888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5227"/>Dicit piger : Leo est in via, <l eID="gen11888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11889"/>et leæna in itineribus. <l eID="gen11889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5228"/><l level="1" sID="gen11890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5228"/>Sicut ostium vertitur in cardine suo, <l eID="gen11890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11891"/>ita piger in lectulo suo. <l eID="gen11891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5229"/><l level="1" sID="gen11892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5229"/>Abscondit piger manum sub ascella sua, <l eID="gen11892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11893"/>et laborat si ad os suum eam converterit. <l eID="gen11893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5230"/><l level="1" sID="gen11894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5230"/>Sapientior sibi piger videtur <l eID="gen11894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11895"/>septem viris loquentibus sententias. <l eID="gen11895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5231"/><l level="1" sID="gen11896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5231"/>Sicut qui apprehendit auribus canem, <l eID="gen11896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11897"/>sic qui transit impatiens et commiscetur rixæ alterius. <l eID="gen11897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5232"/><l level="1" sID="gen11898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5232"/>Sicut noxius est qui mittit sagittas et lanceas in mortem, <l eID="gen11898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5233"/><l level="1" sID="gen11899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5233"/>ita vir fraudulenter nocet amico suo, <l eID="gen11899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11900"/>et cum fuerit deprehensus dicit : Ludens feci. <l eID="gen11900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5234"/><l level="1" sID="gen11901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5234"/>Cum defecerint ligna extinguetur ignis, <l eID="gen11901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11902"/>et susurrone subtracto, jurgia conquiescent. <l eID="gen11902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5235"/><l level="1" sID="gen11903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5235"/>Sicut carbones ad prunas, et ligna ad ignem, <l eID="gen11903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11904"/>sic homo iracundus suscitat rixas. <l eID="gen11904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5236"/><l level="1" sID="gen11905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5236"/>Verba susurronis quasi simplicia, <l eID="gen11905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11906"/>et ipsa perveniunt ad intima ventris. <l eID="gen11906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5237"/><l level="1" sID="gen11907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5237"/>Quomodo si argento sordido ornare velis vas fictile, <l eID="gen11907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11908"/>sic labia tumentia cum pessimo corde sociata. <l eID="gen11908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5238"/><l level="1" sID="gen11909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5238"/>Labiis suis intelligitur inimicus, <l eID="gen11909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11910"/>cum in corde tractaverit dolos. <l eID="gen11910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5239"/><l level="1" sID="gen11911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5239"/>Quando submiserit vocem suam, ne credideris ei, <l eID="gen11911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11912"/>quoniam septem nequitiæ sunt in corde illius. <l eID="gen11912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5240"/><l level="1" sID="gen11913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5240"/>Qui operit odium fraudulenter, <l eID="gen11913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11914"/>revelabitur malitia ejus in consilio. <l eID="gen11914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5241"/><l level="1" sID="gen11915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5241"/>Qui fodit foveam incidet in eam, <l eID="gen11915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11916"/>et qui volvit lapidem revertetur ad eum. <l eID="gen11916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 26:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5242"/><l level="1" sID="gen11917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5242"/>Lingua fallax non amat veritatem, <l eID="gen11917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11918"/>et os lubricum operatur ruinas.  <chapter eID="Prov.26"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:1
verses.text: Ne glorieris in crastinum, <l eID="gen11919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11920"/>ignorans quid superventura pariat dies. <l eID="gen11920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5243"/><l level="1" sID="gen11921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5243"/>Laudet te alienus, et non os tuum ; <l eID="gen11921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11922"/>extraneus, et non labia tua. <l eID="gen11922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5244"/><l level="1" sID="gen11923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5244"/>Grave est saxum, et onerosa arena, <l eID="gen11923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11924"/>sed ira stulti utroque gravior. <l eID="gen11924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5245"/><l level="1" sID="gen11925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5245"/>Ira non habet misericordiam nec erumpens furor, <l eID="gen11925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11926"/>et impetum concitati ferre quis poterit ? <l eID="gen11926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5246"/><l level="1" sID="gen11927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5246"/>Melior est manifesta correptio <l eID="gen11927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11928"/>quam amor absconditus. <l eID="gen11928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5247"/><l level="1" sID="gen11929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5247"/>Meliora sunt vulnera diligentis <l eID="gen11929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11930"/>quam fraudulenta oscula odientis. <l eID="gen11930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5248"/><l level="1" sID="gen11931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5248"/>Anima saturata calcabit favum, <l eID="gen11931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11932"/>et anima esuriens etiam amarum pro dulci sumet. <l eID="gen11932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5249"/><l level="1" sID="gen11933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5249"/>Sicut avis transmigrans de nido suo, <l eID="gen11933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11934"/>sic vir qui derelinquit locum suum. <l eID="gen11934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5250"/><l level="1" sID="gen11935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5250"/>Unguento et variis odoribus delectatur cor, <l eID="gen11935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11936"/>et bonis amici consiliis anima dulcoratur. <l eID="gen11936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5251"/><l level="1" sID="gen11937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5251"/>Amicum tuum et amicum patris tui ne dimiseris, <l eID="gen11937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11938"/>et domum fratris tui ne ingrediaris in die afflictionis tuæ. <l eID="gen11938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11939"/>Melior est vicinus juxta <l eID="gen11939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11940"/>quam frater procul. <l eID="gen11940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5252"/><l level="1" sID="gen11941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5252"/>Stude sapientiæ, fili mi, et lætifica cor meum, <l eID="gen11941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11942"/>ut possis exprobranti respondere sermonem. <l eID="gen11942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5253"/><l level="1" sID="gen11943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5253"/>Astutus videns malum, absconditus est : <l eID="gen11943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11944"/>parvuli transeuntes sustinuerunt dispendia. <l eID="gen11944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5254"/><l level="1" sID="gen11945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5254"/>Tolle vestimentum ejus qui spopondit pro extraneo, <l eID="gen11945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11946"/>et pro alienis aufer ei pignus. <l eID="gen11946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5255"/><l level="1" sID="gen11947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5255"/>Qui benedicit proximo suo voce grandi, <l eID="gen11947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11948"/>de nocte consurgens maledicenti similis erit. <l eID="gen11948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5256"/><l level="1" sID="gen11949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5256"/>Tecta perstillantia in die frigoris <l eID="gen11949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11950"/>et litigiosa mulier comparantur. <l eID="gen11950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5257"/><l level="1" sID="gen11951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5257"/>Qui retinet eam quasi qui ventum teneat, <l eID="gen11951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11952"/>et oleum dexteræ suæ vocabit. <l eID="gen11952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5258"/><l level="1" sID="gen11953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5258"/>Ferrum ferro exacuitur, <l eID="gen11953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11954"/>et homo exacuit faciem amici sui. <l eID="gen11954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5259"/><l level="1" sID="gen11955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5259"/>Qui servat ficum comedet fructus ejus, <l eID="gen11955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11956"/>et qui custos est domini sui glorificabitur. <l eID="gen11956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5260"/><l level="1" sID="gen11957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5260"/>Quomodo in aquis resplendent vultus prospicientium, <l eID="gen11957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11958"/>sic corda hominum manifesta sunt prudentibus. <l eID="gen11958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5261"/><l level="1" sID="gen11959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5261"/>Infernus et perditio numquam implentur : <l eID="gen11959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11960"/>similiter et oculi hominum insatiabiles. <l eID="gen11960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5262"/><l level="1" sID="gen11961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5262"/>Quomodo probatur in conflatorio argentum et in fornace aurum, <l eID="gen11961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11962"/>sic probatur homo ore laudantis. <l eID="gen11962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11963"/>Cor iniqui inquirit mala, <l eID="gen11963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11964"/>cor autem rectum inquirit scientiam. <l eID="gen11964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5263"/><l level="1" sID="gen11965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5263"/>Si contuderis stultum in pila <l eID="gen11965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11966"/>quasi ptisanas feriente desuper pilo, <l eID="gen11966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11967"/>non auferetur ab eo stultitia ejus. <l eID="gen11967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5264"/><l level="1" sID="gen11968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5264"/>Diligenter agnosce vultum pecoris tui, <l eID="gen11968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11969"/>tuosque greges considera : <l eID="gen11969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5265"/><l level="1" sID="gen11970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5265"/>non enim habebis jugiter potestatem, <l eID="gen11970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11971"/>sed corona tribuetur in generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen11971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5266"/><l level="1" sID="gen11972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5266"/>Aperta sunt prata, et apparuerunt herbæ virentes, <l eID="gen11972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11973"/>et collecta sunt fœna de montibus. <l eID="gen11973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5267"/><l level="1" sID="gen11974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5267"/>Agni ad vestimentum tuum, <l eID="gen11974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11975"/>et hædi ad agri pretium. <l eID="gen11975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 27:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5268"/><l level="1" sID="gen11976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5268"/>Sufficiat tibi lac caprarum in cibos tuos, <l eID="gen11976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11977"/>et in necessaria domus tuæ, et ad victum ancillis tuis.  <chapter eID="Prov.27"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:1
verses.text: Fugit impius nemine persequente ; <l eID="gen11978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11979"/>justus autem, quasi leo confidens, absque terrore erit. <l eID="gen11979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5269"/><l level="1" sID="gen11980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5269"/>Propter peccata terræ multi principes ejus ; <l eID="gen11980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11981"/>et propter hominis sapientiam, et horum scientiam quæ dicuntur, <l eID="gen11981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11982"/>vita ducis longior erit. <l eID="gen11982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5270"/><l level="1" sID="gen11983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5270"/>Vir pauper calumnians pauperes <l eID="gen11983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11984"/>similis est imbri vehementi in quo paratur fames. <l eID="gen11984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5271"/><l level="1" sID="gen11985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5271"/>Qui derelinquunt legem laudant impium ; <l eID="gen11985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11986"/>qui custodiunt, succenduntur contra eum. <l eID="gen11986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5272"/><l level="1" sID="gen11987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5272"/>Viri mali non cogitant judicium ; <l eID="gen11987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11988"/>qui autem inquirunt Dominum animadvertunt omnia. <l eID="gen11988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5273"/><l level="1" sID="gen11989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5273"/>Melior est pauper ambulans in simplicitate sua <l eID="gen11989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11990"/>quam dives in pravis itineribus. <l eID="gen11990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5274"/><l level="1" sID="gen11991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5274"/>Qui custodit legem filius sapiens est ; <l eID="gen11991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11992"/>qui autem comessatores pascit confundit patrem suum. <l eID="gen11992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5275"/><l level="1" sID="gen11993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5275"/>Qui coacervat divitias usuris et fœnore, <l eID="gen11993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11994"/>liberali in pauperes congregat eas. <l eID="gen11994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5276"/><l level="1" sID="gen11995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5276"/>Qui declinat aures suas ne audiat legem, <l eID="gen11995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11996"/>oratio ejus erit execrabilis. <l eID="gen11996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5277"/><l level="1" sID="gen11997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5277"/>Qui decipit justos in via mala, in interitu suo corruet, <l eID="gen11997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen11998"/>et simplices possidebunt bona ejus. <l eID="gen11998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5278"/><l level="1" sID="gen11999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5278"/>Sapiens sibi videtur vir dives ; <l eID="gen11999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12000"/>pauper autem prudens scrutabitur eum. <l eID="gen12000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5279"/><l level="1" sID="gen12001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5279"/>In exsultatione justorum multa gloria est ; <l eID="gen12001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12002"/>regnantibus impiis, ruinæ hominum. <l eID="gen12002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5280"/><l level="1" sID="gen12003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5280"/>Qui abscondit scelera sua non dirigetur ; <l eID="gen12003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12004"/>qui autem confessus fuerit et reliquerit ea, misericordiam consequetur. <l eID="gen12004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5281"/><l level="1" sID="gen12005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5281"/>Beatus homo qui semper est pavidus ; <l eID="gen12005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12006"/>qui vero mentis est duræ corruet in malum. <l eID="gen12006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5282"/><l level="1" sID="gen12007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5282"/>Leo rugiens et ursus esuriens, <l eID="gen12007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12008"/>princeps impius super populum pauperem. <l eID="gen12008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5283"/><l level="1" sID="gen12009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5283"/>Dux indigens prudentia multos opprimet per calumniam ; <l eID="gen12009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12010"/>qui autem odit avaritiam, longi fient dies ejus. <l eID="gen12010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5284"/><l level="1" sID="gen12011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5284"/>Hominem qui calumniatur animæ sanguinem, <l eID="gen12011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12012"/>si usque ad lacum fugerit, nemo sustinet. <l eID="gen12012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5285"/><l level="1" sID="gen12013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5285"/>Qui ambulat simpliciter salvus erit ; <l eID="gen12013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12014"/>qui perversis graditur viis concidet semel. <l eID="gen12014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5286"/><l level="1" sID="gen12015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5286"/>Qui operatur terram suam satiabitur panibus ; <l eID="gen12015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12016"/>qui autem sectatur otium replebitur egestate. <l eID="gen12016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5287"/><l level="1" sID="gen12017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5287"/>Vir fidelis multum laudabitur ; <l eID="gen12017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12018"/>qui autem festinat ditari non erit innocens. <l eID="gen12018" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5288"/><l level="1" sID="gen12019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5288"/>Qui cognoscit in judicio faciem non bene facit ; <l eID="gen12019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12020"/>iste et pro buccella panis deserit veritatem. <l eID="gen12020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5289"/><l level="1" sID="gen12021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5289"/>Vir qui festinat ditari, et aliis invidet, <l eID="gen12021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12022"/>ignorat quod egestas superveniet ei. <l eID="gen12022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5290"/><l level="1" sID="gen12023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5290"/>Qui corripit hominem gratiam postea inveniet apud eum, <l eID="gen12023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12024"/>magis quam ille qui per linguæ blandimenta decipit. <l eID="gen12024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5291"/><l level="1" sID="gen12025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5291"/>Qui subtrahit aliquid a patre suo et a matre, <l eID="gen12025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12026"/>et dicit hoc non esse peccatum, <l eID="gen12026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12027"/>particeps homicidæ est. <l eID="gen12027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5292"/><l level="1" sID="gen12028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5292"/>Qui se jactat et dilatat, jurgia concitat ; <l eID="gen12028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12029"/>qui vero sperat in Domino sanabitur. <l eID="gen12029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5293"/><l level="1" sID="gen12030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5293"/>Qui confidit in corde suo stultus est ; <l eID="gen12030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12031"/>qui autem graditur sapienter, ipse salvabitur. <l eID="gen12031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5294"/><l level="1" sID="gen12032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5294"/>Qui dat pauperi non indigebit ; <l eID="gen12032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12033"/>qui despicit deprecantem sustinebit penuriam. <l eID="gen12033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 28:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5295"/><l level="1" sID="gen12034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5295"/>Cum surrexerint impii, abscondentur homines ; <l eID="gen12034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12035"/>cum illi perierint, multiplicabuntur justi.  <chapter eID="Prov.28"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:1
verses.text: Viro qui corripientem dura cervice contemnit, <l eID="gen12036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12037"/>repentinus ei superveniet interitus, <l eID="gen12037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12038"/>et eum sanitas non sequetur. <l eID="gen12038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5296"/><l level="1" sID="gen12039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5296"/>In multiplicatione justorum lætabitur vulgus ; <l eID="gen12039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12040"/>cum impii sumpserint principatum, gemet populus. <l eID="gen12040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5297"/><l level="1" sID="gen12041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5297"/>Vir qui amat sapientiam lætificat patrem suum ; <l eID="gen12041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12042"/>qui autem nutrit scorta perdet substantiam. <l eID="gen12042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5298"/><l level="1" sID="gen12043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5298"/>Rex justus erigit terram ; <l eID="gen12043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12044"/>vir avarus destruet eam. <l eID="gen12044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5299"/><l level="1" sID="gen12045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5299"/>Homo qui blandis fictisque sermonibus loquitur amico suo <l eID="gen12045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12046"/>rete expandit gressibus ejus. <l eID="gen12046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5300"/><l level="1" sID="gen12047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5300"/>Peccantem virum iniquum involvet laqueus, <l eID="gen12047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12048"/>et justus laudabit atque gaudebit. <l eID="gen12048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5301"/><l level="1" sID="gen12049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5301"/>Novit justus causam pauperum ; <l eID="gen12049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12050"/>impius ignorat scientiam. <l eID="gen12050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5302"/><l level="1" sID="gen12051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5302"/>Homines pestilentes dissipant civitatem ; <l eID="gen12051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12052"/>sapientes vero avertunt furorem. <l eID="gen12052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5303"/><l level="1" sID="gen12053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5303"/>Vir sapiens si cum stulto contenderit, <l eID="gen12053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12054"/>sive irascatur, sive rideat, non inveniet requiem. <l eID="gen12054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:10
