verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5304"/><l level="1" sID="gen12055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5304"/>Viri sanguinum oderunt simplicem ; <l eID="gen12055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12056"/>justi autem quærunt animam ejus. <l eID="gen12056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5305"/><l level="1" sID="gen12057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5305"/>Totum spiritum suum profert stultus ; <l eID="gen12057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12058"/>sapiens differt, et reservat in posterum. <l eID="gen12058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5306"/><l level="1" sID="gen12059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5306"/>Princeps qui libenter audit verba mendacii, <l eID="gen12059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12060"/>omnes ministros habet impios. <l eID="gen12060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5307"/><l level="1" sID="gen12061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5307"/>Pauper et creditor obviaverunt sibi : <l eID="gen12061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12062"/>utriusque illuminator est Dominus. <l eID="gen12062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5308"/><l level="1" sID="gen12063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5308"/>Rex qui judicat in veritate pauperes, <l eID="gen12063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12064"/>thronus ejus in æternum firmabitur. <l eID="gen12064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5309"/><l level="1" sID="gen12065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5309"/>Virga atque correptio tribuit sapientiam ; <l eID="gen12065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12066"/>puer autem qui dimittitur voluntati suæ confundit matrem suam. <l eID="gen12066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5310"/><l level="1" sID="gen12067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5310"/>In multiplicatione impiorum multiplicabuntur scelera, <l eID="gen12067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12068"/>et justi ruinas eorum videbunt. <l eID="gen12068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5311"/><l level="1" sID="gen12069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5311"/>Erudi filium tuum, et refrigerabit te, <l eID="gen12069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12070"/>et dabit delicias animæ tuæ. <l eID="gen12070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5312"/><l level="1" sID="gen12071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5312"/>Cum prophetia defecerit, dissipabitur populus ; <l eID="gen12071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12072"/>qui vero custodit legem beatus est. <l eID="gen12072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5313"/><l level="1" sID="gen12073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5313"/>Servus verbis non potest erudiri, <l eID="gen12073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12074"/>quia quod dicis intelligit, et respondere contemnit. <l eID="gen12074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5314"/><l level="1" sID="gen12075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5314"/>Vidisti hominem velocem ad loquendum ? <l eID="gen12075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12076"/>stultitia magis speranda est quam illius correptio. <l eID="gen12076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5315"/><l level="1" sID="gen12077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5315"/>Qui delicate a pueritia nutrit servum suum <l eID="gen12077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12078"/>postea sentiet eum contumacem. <l eID="gen12078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5316"/><l level="1" sID="gen12079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5316"/>Vir iracundus provocat rixas, <l eID="gen12079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12080"/>et qui ad indignandum facilis est erit ad peccandum proclivior. <l eID="gen12080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5317"/><l level="1" sID="gen12081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5317"/>Superbum sequitur humilitas, <l eID="gen12081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12082"/>et humilem spiritu suscipiet gloria. <l eID="gen12082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5318"/><l level="1" sID="gen12083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5318"/>Qui cum fure participat odit animam suam ; <l eID="gen12083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12084"/>adjurantem audit, et non indicat. <l eID="gen12084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5319"/><l level="1" sID="gen12085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5319"/>Qui timet hominem cito corruet ; <l eID="gen12085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12086"/>qui sperat in Domino sublevabitur. <l eID="gen12086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5320"/><l level="1" sID="gen12087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5320"/>Multi requirunt faciem principis, <l eID="gen12087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12088"/>et judicium a Domino egreditur singulorum. <l eID="gen12088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 29:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5321"/><l level="1" sID="gen12089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5321"/>Abominantur justi virum impium, <l eID="gen12089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12090"/>et abominantur impii eos qui in recta sunt via. <l eID="gen12090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12091"/>Verbum custodiens filius <l eID="gen12091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12092"/>extra perditionem erit. <l eID="gen12092" level="1"/><lg eID="gen11802"/> <chapter eID="Prov.29"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:1
verses.text: Verba Congregantis, filii Vomentis. Visio quam locutus est vir cum quo est Deus, et qui Deo secum morante confortatus, ait :  <div eID="gen12093" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5322"/><lg sID="gen12094"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5322"/>Stultissimus sum virorum, <l eID="gen12095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12096"/>et sapientia hominum non est mecum. <l eID="gen12096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5323"/><l level="1" sID="gen12097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5323"/>Non didici sapientiam, <l eID="gen12097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12098"/>et non novi scientiam sanctorum. <l eID="gen12098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5324"/><l level="1" sID="gen12099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5324"/>Quis ascendit in cælum, atque descendit ? <l eID="gen12099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12100"/>quis continuit spiritum in manibus suis ? <l eID="gen12100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12101"/>quis colligavit aquas quasi in vestimento ? <l eID="gen12101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12102"/>quis suscitavit omnes terminos terræ ? <l eID="gen12102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12103"/>quod nomen est ejus, et quod nomen filii ejus, si nosti ? <l eID="gen12103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5325"/><l level="1" sID="gen12104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5325"/>Omnis sermo Dei ignitus : <l eID="gen12104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12105"/>clypeus est sperantibus in se. <l eID="gen12105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5326"/><l level="1" sID="gen12106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5326"/>Ne addas quidquam verbis illius, <l eID="gen12106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12107"/>et arguaris, inveniarisque mendax. <l eID="gen12107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5327"/><l level="1" sID="gen12108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5327"/>Duo rogavi te : <l eID="gen12108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12109"/>ne deneges mihi antequam moriar : <l eID="gen12109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5328"/><l level="1" sID="gen12110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5328"/>vanitatem et verba mendacia longe fac a me ; <l eID="gen12110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12111"/>mendicitatem et divitias ne dederis mihi : <l eID="gen12111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12112"/>tribue tantum victui meo necessaria, <l eID="gen12112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5329"/><l level="1" sID="gen12113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5329"/>ne forte satiatus illiciar ad negandum, <l eID="gen12113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12114"/>et dicam : Quis est Dominus ? <l eID="gen12114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12115"/>aut egestate compulsus, furer, <l eID="gen12115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12116"/>et perjurem nomen Dei mei. <l eID="gen12116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5330"/><l level="1" sID="gen12117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5330"/>Ne accuses servum ad dominum suum, <l eID="gen12117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12118"/>ne forte maledicat tibi, et corruas. <l eID="gen12118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5331"/><l level="1" sID="gen12119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5331"/>Generatio quæ patri suo maledicit, <l eID="gen12119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12120"/>et quæ matri suæ non benedicit ; <l eID="gen12120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5332"/><l level="1" sID="gen12121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5332"/>generatio quæ sibi munda videtur, <l eID="gen12121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12122"/>et tamen non est lota a sordibus suis ; <l eID="gen12122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5333"/><l level="1" sID="gen12123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5333"/>generatio cujus excelsi sunt oculi, <l eID="gen12123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12124"/>et palpebræ ejus in alta surrectæ ; <l eID="gen12124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5334"/><l level="1" sID="gen12125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5334"/>generatio quæ pro dentibus gladios habet, <l eID="gen12125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12126"/>et commandit molaribus suis, <l eID="gen12126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12127"/>ut comedat inopes de terra, <l eID="gen12127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12128"/>et pauperes ex hominibus. <l eID="gen12128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5335"/><l level="1" sID="gen12129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5335"/>Sanguisugæ duæ sunt filiæ, <l eID="gen12129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12130"/>dicentes : Affer, affer. <l eID="gen12130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12131"/>Tria sunt insaturabilia, <l eID="gen12131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12132"/>et quartum quod numquam dicit : Sufficit. <l eID="gen12132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5336"/><l level="1" sID="gen12133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5336"/>Infernus, et os vulvæ, <l eID="gen12133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12134"/>et terra quæ non satiatur aqua : <l eID="gen12134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12135"/>ignis vero numquam dicit : Sufficit. <l eID="gen12135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5337"/><l level="1" sID="gen12136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5337"/>Oculum qui subsannat patrem, <l eID="gen12136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12137"/>et qui despicit partum matris suæ, <l eID="gen12137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12138"/>effodiant eum corvi de torrentibus, <l eID="gen12138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12139"/>et comedant eum filii aquilæ ! <l eID="gen12139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5338"/><l level="1" sID="gen12140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5338"/>Tria sunt difficilia mihi, <l eID="gen12140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12141"/>et quartum penitus ignoro : <l eID="gen12141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5339"/><l level="1" sID="gen12142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5339"/>viam aquilæ in cælo, <l eID="gen12142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12143"/>viam colubri super petram, <l eID="gen12143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12144"/>viam navis in medio mari, <l eID="gen12144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12145"/>et viam viri in adolescentia. <l eID="gen12145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5340"/><l level="1" sID="gen12146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5340"/>Talis est et via mulieris adulteræ, <l eID="gen12146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12147"/>quæ comedit, et tergens os suum <l eID="gen12147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12148"/>dicit : Non sum operata malum. <l eID="gen12148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5341"/><l level="1" sID="gen12149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5341"/>Per tria movetur terra, <l eID="gen12149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12150"/>et quartum non potest sustinere : <l eID="gen12150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5342"/><l level="1" sID="gen12151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5342"/>per servum, cum regnaverit ; <l eID="gen12151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12152"/>per stultum, cum saturatus fuerit cibo ; <l eID="gen12152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5343"/><l level="1" sID="gen12153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5343"/>per odiosam mulierem, cum in matrimonio fuerit assumpta ; <l eID="gen12153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12154"/>et per ancillam, cum fuerit hæres dominæ suæ. <l eID="gen12154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5344"/><l level="1" sID="gen12155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5344"/>Quatuor sunt minima terræ, <l eID="gen12155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12156"/>et ipsa sunt sapientiora sapientibus : <l eID="gen12156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5345"/><l level="1" sID="gen12157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5345"/>formicæ, populus infirmus, <l eID="gen12157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12158"/>qui præparat in messe cibum sibi ; <l eID="gen12158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5346"/><l level="1" sID="gen12159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5346"/>lepusculus, plebs invalida, <l eID="gen12159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12160"/>qui collocat in petra cubile suum ; <l eID="gen12160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5347"/><l level="1" sID="gen12161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5347"/>regem locusta non habet, <l eID="gen12161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12162"/>et egreditur universa per turmas suas ; <l eID="gen12162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5348"/><l level="1" sID="gen12163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5348"/>stellio manibus nititur, <l eID="gen12163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12164"/>et moratur in ædibus regis. <l eID="gen12164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5349"/><l level="1" sID="gen12165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5349"/>Tria sunt quæ bene gradiuntur, <l eID="gen12165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12166"/>et quartum quod incedit feliciter : <l eID="gen12166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5350"/><l level="1" sID="gen12167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5350"/>leo, fortissimus bestiarum, <l eID="gen12167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12168"/>ad nullius pavebit occursum ; <l eID="gen12168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5351"/><l level="1" sID="gen12169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5351"/>gallus succinctus lumbos ; <l eID="gen12169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12170"/>et aries ; nec est rex, qui resistat ei. <l eID="gen12170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5352"/><l level="1" sID="gen12171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5352"/>Est qui stultus apparuit postquam elevatus est in sublime ; <l eID="gen12171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12172"/>si enim intellexisset, ori suo imposuisset manum. <l eID="gen12172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 30:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5353"/><l level="1" sID="gen12173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5353"/>Qui autem fortiter premit ubera ad eliciendum lac exprimit butyrum ; <l eID="gen12173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12174"/>et qui vehementer emungit elicit sanguinem ; <l eID="gen12174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12175"/>et qui provocat iras producit discordias. <l eID="gen12175" level="1"/><lg eID="gen12094"/> <chapter eID="Prov.30"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:1
verses.text: Verba Lamuelis regis. Visio qua erudivit eum mater sua.  <div eID="gen12176" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5354"/><lg sID="gen12177"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5354"/>Quid, dilecte mi ? quid, dilecte uteri mei ? <l eID="gen12178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12179"/>quid, dilecte votorum meorum ? <l eID="gen12179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5355"/><l level="1" sID="gen12180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5355"/>Ne dederis mulieribus substantiam tuam, <l eID="gen12180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12181"/>et divitias tuas ad delendos reges. <l eID="gen12181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5356"/><l level="1" sID="gen12182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5356"/>Noli regibus, o Lamuel, noli regibus dare vinum, <l eID="gen12182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12183"/>quia nullum secretum est ubi regnat ebrietas ; <l eID="gen12183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5357"/><l level="1" sID="gen12184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5357"/>et ne forte bibant, et obliviscantur judiciorum, <l eID="gen12184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12185"/>et mutent causam filiorum pauperis. <l eID="gen12185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5358"/><l level="1" sID="gen12186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5358"/>Date siceram mœrentibus, <l eID="gen12186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12187"/>et vinum his qui amaro sunt animo. <l eID="gen12187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5359"/><l level="1" sID="gen12188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5359"/>Bibant, et obliviscantur egestatis suæ, <l eID="gen12188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12189"/>et doloris sui non recordentur amplius. <l eID="gen12189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5360"/><l level="1" sID="gen12190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5360"/>Aperi os tuum muto, <l eID="gen12190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12191"/>et causis omnium filiorum qui pertranseunt. <l eID="gen12191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5361"/><l level="1" sID="gen12192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5361"/>Aperi os tuum, decerne quod justum est, <l eID="gen12192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12193"/>et judica inopem et pauperem. <l eID="gen12193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5362"/><l level="1" sID="gen12194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5362"/>Mulierem fortem quis inveniet ? <l eID="gen12194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12195"/>procul et de ultimis finibus pretium ejus. <l eID="gen12195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5363"/><l level="1" sID="gen12196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5363"/>Confidit in ea cor viri sui, <l eID="gen12196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12197"/>et spoliis non indigebit. <l eID="gen12197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5364"/><l level="1" sID="gen12198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5364"/>Reddet ei bonum, et non malum, <l eID="gen12198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12199"/>omnibus diebus vitæ suæ. <l eID="gen12199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5365"/><l level="1" sID="gen12200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5365"/>Quæsivit lanam et linum, <l eID="gen12200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12201"/>et operata est consilia manuum suarum. <l eID="gen12201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5366"/><l level="1" sID="gen12202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5366"/>Facta est quasi navis institoris, <l eID="gen12202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12203"/>de longe portans panem suum. <l eID="gen12203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5367"/><l level="1" sID="gen12204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5367"/>Et de nocte surrexit, <l eID="gen12204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12205"/>deditque prædam domesticis suis, <l eID="gen12205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12206"/>et cibaria ancillis suis. <l eID="gen12206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5368"/><l level="1" sID="gen12207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5368"/>Consideravit agrum, et emit eum ; <l eID="gen12207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12208"/>de fructu manuum suarum plantavit vineam. <l eID="gen12208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5369"/><l level="1" sID="gen12209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5369"/>Accinxit fortitudine lumbos suos, <l eID="gen12209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12210"/>et roboravit brachium suum. <l eID="gen12210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5370"/><l level="1" sID="gen12211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5370"/>Gustavit, et vidit quia bona est negotiatio ejus ; <l eID="gen12211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12212"/>non extinguetur in nocte lucerna ejus. <l eID="gen12212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5371"/><l level="1" sID="gen12213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5371"/>Manum suam misit ad fortia, <l eID="gen12213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12214"/>et digiti ejus apprehenderunt fusum. <l eID="gen12214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5372"/><l level="1" sID="gen12215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5372"/>Manum suam aperuit inopi, <l eID="gen12215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12216"/>et palmas suas extendit ad pauperem. <l eID="gen12216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5373"/><l level="1" sID="gen12217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5373"/>Non timebit domui suæ a frigoribus nivis ; <l eID="gen12217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12218"/>omnes enim domestici ejus vestiti sunt duplicibus. <l eID="gen12218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5374"/><l level="1" sID="gen12219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5374"/>Stragulatam vestem fecit sibi ; <l eID="gen12219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12220"/>byssus et purpura indumentum ejus. <l eID="gen12220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5375"/><l level="1" sID="gen12221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5375"/>Nobilis in portis vir ejus, <l eID="gen12221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12222"/>quando sederit cum senatoribus terræ. <l eID="gen12222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5376"/><l level="1" sID="gen12223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5376"/>Sindonem fecit, et vendidit, <l eID="gen12223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12224"/>et cingulum tradidit Chananæo. <l eID="gen12224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5377"/><l level="1" sID="gen12225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5377"/>Fortitudo et decor indumentum ejus, <l eID="gen12225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12226"/>et ridebit in die novissimo. <l eID="gen12226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5378"/><l level="1" sID="gen12227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5378"/>Os suum aperuit sapientiæ, <l eID="gen12227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12228"/>et lex clementiæ in lingua ejus. <l eID="gen12228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5379"/><l level="1" sID="gen12229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5379"/>Consideravit semitas domus suæ, <l eID="gen12229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12230"/>et panem otiosa non comedit. <l eID="gen12230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5380"/><l level="1" sID="gen12231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5380"/>Surrexerunt filii ejus, et beatissimam prædicaverunt ; <l eID="gen12231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12232"/>vir ejus, et laudavit eam. <l eID="gen12232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5381"/><l level="1" sID="gen12233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5381"/>Multæ filiæ congregaverunt divitias ; <l eID="gen12233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12234"/>tu supergressa es universas. <l eID="gen12234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5382"/><l level="1" sID="gen12235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5382"/>Fallax gratia, et vana est pulchritudo : <l eID="gen12235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12236"/>mulier timens Dominum, ipsa laudabitur. <l eID="gen12236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Proverbs 31:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5383"/><l level="1" sID="gen12237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5383"/>Date ei de fructu manuum suarum, <l eID="gen12237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12238"/>et laudent eam in portis opera ejus. <l eID="gen12238" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12177"/> <chapter eID="Prov.31"/> <div eID="gen10316" osisID="Prov" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:1
verses.text: Verba Ecclesiastæ, filii David, regis Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen12240" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5384"/><lg sID="gen12241"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5384"/>Vanitas vanitatum, dixit Ecclesiastes ; <l eID="gen12242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12243"/>vanitas vanitatum, et omnia vanitas. <l eID="gen12243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5385"/><l level="1" sID="gen12244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5385"/>Quid habet amplius homo <l eID="gen12244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12245"/>de universo labore suo quo laborat sub sole ? <l eID="gen12245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5386"/><l level="1" sID="gen12246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5386"/>Generatio præterit, et generatio advenit ; <l eID="gen12246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12247"/>terra autem in æternum stat. <l eID="gen12247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5387"/><l level="1" sID="gen12248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5387"/>Oritur sol et occidit, <l eID="gen12248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12249"/>et ad locum suum revertitur ; <l eID="gen12249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12250"/>ibique renascens,

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:6
verses.text: gyrat per meridiem, et flectitur ad aquilonem. <l eID="gen12250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12251"/>Lustrans universa in circuitu pergit spiritus, <l eID="gen12251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12252"/>et in circulos suos revertitur. <l eID="gen12252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5388"/><l level="1" sID="gen12253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5388"/>Omnia flumina intrant in mare, <l eID="gen12253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12254"/>et mare non redundat ; <l eID="gen12254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12255"/>ad locum unde exeunt flumina <l eID="gen12255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12256"/>revertuntur ut iterum fluant. <l eID="gen12256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5389"/><l level="1" sID="gen12257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5389"/>Cunctæ res difficiles ; <l eID="gen12257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12258"/>non potest eas homo explicare sermone. <l eID="gen12258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12259"/>Non saturatur oculus visu, <l eID="gen12259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12260"/>nec auris auditu impletur. <l eID="gen12260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5390"/><l level="1" sID="gen12261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5390"/>Quid est quod fuit ? Ipsum quod futurum est. <l eID="gen12261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12262"/>Quid est quod factum est ? Ipsum quod faciendum est. <l eID="gen12262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5391"/><l level="1" sID="gen12263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5391"/>Nihil sub sole novum, <l eID="gen12263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12264"/>nec valet quisquam dicere : Ecce hoc recens est : <l eID="gen12264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12265"/>jam enim præcessit in sæculis quæ fuerunt ante nos. <l eID="gen12265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5392"/><l level="1" sID="gen12266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5392"/>Non est priorum memoria ; <l eID="gen12266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12267"/>sed nec eorum quidem quæ postea futura sunt <l eID="gen12267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12268"/>erit recordatio apud eos qui futuri sunt in novissimo. <l eID="gen12268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5393"/><l level="1" sID="gen12269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5393"/>Ego Ecclesiastes fui rex Israël in Jerusalem ; <l eID="gen12269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5394"/><l level="1" sID="gen12270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5394"/>et proposui in animo meo quærere et investigare sapienter <l eID="gen12270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12271"/>de omnibus quæ fiunt sub sole. <l eID="gen12271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12272"/>Hanc occupationem pessimam <l eID="gen12272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12273"/>dedit Deus filiis hominum, ut occuparentur in ea. <l eID="gen12273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5395"/><l level="1" sID="gen12274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5395"/>Vidi cuncta quæ fiunt sub sole, <l eID="gen12274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12275"/>et ecce universa vanitas et afflictio spiritus. <l eID="gen12275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5396"/><l level="1" sID="gen12276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5396"/>Perversi difficile corriguntur, <l eID="gen12276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12277"/>et stultorum infinitus est numerus. <l eID="gen12277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5397"/><l level="1" sID="gen12278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5397"/>Locutus sum in corde meo, dicens : <l eID="gen12278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12279"/>Ecce magnus effectus sum, et præcessi omnes sapientia <l eID="gen12279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12280"/>qui fuerunt ante me in Jerusalem ; <l eID="gen12280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12281"/>et mens mea contemplata est multa sapienter, et didici. <l eID="gen12281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5398"/><l level="1" sID="gen12282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5398"/>Dedique cor meum ut scirem prudentiam atque doctrinam, <l eID="gen12282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12283"/>erroresque et stultitiam ; <l eID="gen12283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12284"/>et agnovi quod in his quoque esset labor et afflictio spiritus : <l eID="gen12284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5399"/><l level="1" sID="gen12285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5399"/>eo quod in multa sapientia multa sit indignatio ; <l eID="gen12285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12286"/>et qui addit scientiam, addit et laborem.  <chapter eID="Eccl.1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:1
verses.text: Dixi ego in corde meo : Vadam, <l eID="gen12287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12288"/>et affluam deliciis, et fruar bonis ; <l eID="gen12288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12289"/>et vidi quod hoc quoque esset vanitas. <l eID="gen12289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5400"/><l level="1" sID="gen12290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5400"/>Risum reputavi errorem, <l eID="gen12290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12291"/>et gaudio dixi : Quid frustra deciperis ? <l eID="gen12291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5401"/><l level="1" sID="gen12292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5401"/>Cogitavi in corde meo abstrahere a vino carnem meam, <l eID="gen12292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12293"/>ut animam meam transferrem ad sapientiam, <l eID="gen12293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12294"/>devitaremque stultitiam, <l eID="gen12294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12295"/>donec viderem quid esset utile filiis hominum, <l eID="gen12295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12296"/>quo facto opus est sub sole numero dierum vitæ suæ. <l eID="gen12296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5402"/><l level="1" sID="gen12297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5402"/>Magnificavi opera mea, <l eID="gen12297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12298"/>ædificavi mihi domos, <l eID="gen12298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12299"/>et plantavi vineas ; <l eID="gen12299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5403"/><l level="1" sID="gen12300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5403"/>feci hortos et pomaria, <l eID="gen12300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12301"/>et consevi ea cuncti generis arboribus ; <l eID="gen12301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5404"/><l level="1" sID="gen12302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5404"/>et exstruxi mihi piscinas aquarum, <l eID="gen12302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12303"/>ut irrigarem silvam lignorum germinantium. <l eID="gen12303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5405"/><l level="1" sID="gen12304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5405"/>Possedi servos et ancillas, <l eID="gen12304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12305"/>multamque familiam habui : <l eID="gen12305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12306"/>armenta quoque, et magnos ovium greges, <l eID="gen12306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12307"/>ultra omnes qui fuerunt ante me in Jerusalem ; <l eID="gen12307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5406"/><l level="1" sID="gen12308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5406"/>coacervavi mihi argentum et aurum, <l eID="gen12308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12309"/>et substantias regum ac provinciarum ; <l eID="gen12309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12310"/>feci mihi cantores et cantatrices, <l eID="gen12310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12311"/>et delicias filiorum hominum, <l eID="gen12311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12312"/>scyphos, et urceos in ministerio ad vina fundenda ; <l eID="gen12312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5407"/><l level="1" sID="gen12313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5407"/>et supergressus sum opibus <l eID="gen12313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12314"/>omnes qui ante me fuerunt in Jerusalem : <l eID="gen12314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12315"/>sapientia quoque perseveravit mecum. <l eID="gen12315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5408"/><l level="1" sID="gen12316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5408"/>Et omnia quæ desideraverunt oculi mei <l eID="gen12316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12317"/>non negavi eis, <l eID="gen12317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12318"/>nec prohibui cor meum quin omni voluptate frueretur, <l eID="gen12318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12319"/>et oblectaret se in his quæ præparaveram ; <l eID="gen12319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12320"/>et hanc ratus sum partem meam si uterer labore meo. <l eID="gen12320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5409"/><l level="1" sID="gen12321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5409"/>Cumque me convertissem ad universa opera quæ fecerant manus meæ, <l eID="gen12321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12322"/>et ad labores in quibus frustra sudaveram, <l eID="gen12322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12323"/>vidi in omnibus vanitatem et afflictionem animi, <l eID="gen12323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12324"/>et nihil permanere sub sole. <l eID="gen12324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5410"/><l level="1" sID="gen12325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5410"/>Transivi ad contemplandam sapientiam, <l eID="gen12325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12326"/>erroresque, et stultitiam. <l eID="gen12326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12327"/>(Quid est, inquam, homo, <l eID="gen12327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12328"/>ut sequi possit regem, factorem suum ?) <l eID="gen12328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5411"/><l level="1" sID="gen12329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5411"/>Et vidi quod tantum præcederet sapientia stultitiam, <l eID="gen12329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12330"/>quantum differt lux a tenebris. <l eID="gen12330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5412"/><l level="1" sID="gen12331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5412"/>Sapientis oculi in capite ejus ; <l eID="gen12331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12332"/>stultus in tenebris ambulat : <l eID="gen12332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12333"/>et didici quod unus utriusque esset interitus. <l eID="gen12333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5413"/><l level="1" sID="gen12334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5413"/>Et dixi in corde meo : <l eID="gen12334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12335"/>Si unus et stulti et meus occasus erit, <l eID="gen12335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12336"/>quid mihi prodest quod majorem sapientiæ dedi operam ? <l eID="gen12336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12337"/>Locutusque cum mente mea, <l eID="gen12337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12338"/>animadverti quod hoc quoque esset vanitas. <l eID="gen12338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5414"/><l level="1" sID="gen12339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5414"/>Non enim erit memoria sapientis similiter ut stulti in perpetuum, <l eID="gen12339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12340"/>et futura tempora oblivione cuncta pariter operient : <l eID="gen12340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12341"/>moritur doctus similiter ut indoctus. <l eID="gen12341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5415"/><l level="1" sID="gen12342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5415"/>Et idcirco tæduit me vitæ meæ, <l eID="gen12342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12343"/>videntem mala universa esse sub sole, <l eID="gen12343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12344"/>et cuncta vanitatem et afflictionem spiritus. <l eID="gen12344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5416"/><l level="1" sID="gen12345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5416"/>Rursus detestatus sum omnem industriam meam, <l eID="gen12345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12346"/>qua sub sole studiosissime laboravi, <l eID="gen12346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12347"/>habiturus hæredem post me, <l eID="gen12347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5417"/><l level="1" sID="gen12348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5417"/>quem ignoro utrum sapiens an stultus futurus sit, <l eID="gen12348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12349"/>et dominabitur in laboribus meis, <l eID="gen12349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12350"/>quibus desudavi et sollicitus fui : <l eID="gen12350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12351"/>et est quidquam tam vanum ? <l eID="gen12351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5418"/><l level="1" sID="gen12352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5418"/>Unde cessavi, <l eID="gen12352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12353"/>renuntiavitque cor meum ultra laborare sub sole. <l eID="gen12353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5419"/><l level="1" sID="gen12354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5419"/>Nam cum alius laboret in sapientia, <l eID="gen12354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12355"/>et doctrina, et sollicitudine, <l eID="gen12355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12356"/>homini otioso quæsita dimittit ; <l eID="gen12356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12357"/>et hoc ergo vanitas et magnum malum. <l eID="gen12357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5420"/><l level="1" sID="gen12358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5420"/>Quid enim proderit homini de universo labore suo, <l eID="gen12358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12359"/>et afflictione spiritus, <l eID="gen12359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12360"/>qua sub sole cruciatus est ? <l eID="gen12360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5421"/><l level="1" sID="gen12361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5421"/>Cuncti dies ejus doloribus et ærumnis pleni sunt, <l eID="gen12361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12362"/>nec per noctem mente requiescit. <l eID="gen12362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12363"/>Et hoc nonne vanitas est ? <l eID="gen12363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5422"/><l level="1" sID="gen12364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5422"/>Nonne melius est comedere et bibere, <l eID="gen12364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12365"/>et ostendere animæ suæ bona de laboribus suis ? <l eID="gen12365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12366"/>et hoc de manu Dei est. <l eID="gen12366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5423"/><l level="1" sID="gen12367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5423"/>Quis ita devorabit et deliciis affluet ut ego ? <l eID="gen12367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5424"/><l level="1" sID="gen12368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5424"/>Homini bono in conspectu suo <l eID="gen12368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12369"/>dedit Deus sapientiam, et scientiam, et lætitiam ; <l eID="gen12369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12370"/>peccatori autem dedit afflictionem et curam superfluam, <l eID="gen12370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12371"/>ut addat, et congreget, <l eID="gen12371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12372"/>et tradat ei qui placuit Deo ; <l eID="gen12372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12373"/>sed et hoc vanitas est, et cassa sollicitudo mentis.  <chapter eID="Eccl.2"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:1
verses.text: Omnia tempus habent, <l eID="gen12374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12375"/>et suis spatiis transeunt universa sub cælo. <l eID="gen12375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5425"/><l level="1" sID="gen12376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5425"/>Tempus nascendi, et tempus moriendi ; <l eID="gen12376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12377"/>tempus plantandi, et tempus evellendi quod plantatum est. <l eID="gen12377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5426"/><l level="1" sID="gen12378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5426"/>Tempus occidendi, et tempus sanandi ; <l eID="gen12378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12379"/>tempus destruendi, et tempus ædificandi. <l eID="gen12379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5427"/><l level="1" sID="gen12380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5427"/>Tempus flendi, et tempus ridendi ; <l eID="gen12380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12381"/>tempus plangendi, et tempus saltandi. <l eID="gen12381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5428"/><l level="1" sID="gen12382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5428"/>Tempus spargendi lapides, et tempus colligendi, <l eID="gen12382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12383"/>tempus amplexandi, et tempus longe fieri ab amplexibus. <l eID="gen12383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5429"/><l level="1" sID="gen12384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5429"/>Tempus acquirendi, et tempus perdendi ; <l eID="gen12384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12385"/>tempus custodiendi, et tempus abjiciendi. <l eID="gen12385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5430"/><l level="1" sID="gen12386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5430"/>Tempus scindendi, et tempus consuendi ; <l eID="gen12386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12387"/>tempus tacendi, et tempus loquendi. <l eID="gen12387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5431"/><l level="1" sID="gen12388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5431"/>Tempus dilectionis, et tempus odii ; <l eID="gen12388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12389"/>tempus belli, et tempus pacis. <l eID="gen12389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5432"/><l level="1" sID="gen12390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5432"/>Quid habet amplius homo de labore suo ? <l eID="gen12390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5433"/><l level="1" sID="gen12391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5433"/>Vidi afflictionem quam dedit Deus filiis hominum, <l eID="gen12391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12392"/>ut distendantur in ea. <l eID="gen12392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5434"/><l level="1" sID="gen12393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5434"/>Cuncta fecit bona in tempore suo, <l eID="gen12393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12394"/>et mundum tradidit disputationi eorum, <l eID="gen12394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12395"/>ut non inveniat homo opus <l eID="gen12395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12396"/>quod operatus est Deus ab initio usque ad finem. <l eID="gen12396" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5435"/><l level="1" sID="gen12397"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5435"/>Et cognovi quod non esset melius nisi lætari, <l eID="gen12397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12398"/>et facere bene in vita sua ; <l eID="gen12398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5436"/><l level="1" sID="gen12399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5436"/>omnis enim homo qui comedit et bibit, <l eID="gen12399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12400"/>et videt bonum de labore suo, <l eID="gen12400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12401"/>hoc donum Dei est. <l eID="gen12401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5437"/><l level="1" sID="gen12402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5437"/>Didici quod omnia opera quæ fecit Deus perseverent in perpetuum ; <l eID="gen12402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12403"/>non possumus eis quidquam addere, nec auferre, <l eID="gen12403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12404"/>quæ fecit Deus ut timeatur. <l eID="gen12404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5438"/><l level="1" sID="gen12405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5438"/>Quod factum est, ipsum permanet ; <l eID="gen12405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12406"/>quæ futura sunt jam fuerunt, <l eID="gen12406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12407"/>et Deus instaurat quod abiit. <l eID="gen12407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5439"/><l level="1" sID="gen12408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5439"/>Vidi sub sole in loco judicii impietatem, <l eID="gen12408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12409"/>et in loco justitiæ iniquitatem : <l eID="gen12409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5440"/><l level="1" sID="gen12410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5440"/>et dixi in corde meo : <l eID="gen12410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12411"/>Justum et impium judicabit Deus, <l eID="gen12411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12412"/>et tempus omnis rei tunc erit. <l eID="gen12412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5441"/><l level="1" sID="gen12413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5441"/>Dixi in corde meo de filiis hominum, <l eID="gen12413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12414"/>ut probaret eos Deus, <l eID="gen12414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12415"/>et ostenderet similes esse bestiis. <l eID="gen12415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5442"/><l level="1" sID="gen12416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5442"/>Idcirco unus interitus est hominis et jumentorum, <l eID="gen12416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12417"/>et æqua utriusque conditio. <l eID="gen12417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12418"/>Sicut moritur homo, <l eID="gen12418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12419"/>sic et illa moriuntur. <l eID="gen12419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12420"/>Similiter spirant omnia, <l eID="gen12420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12421"/>et nihil habet homo jumento amplius : <l eID="gen12421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12422"/>cuncta subjacent vanitati, <l eID="gen12422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5443"/><l level="1" sID="gen12423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5443"/>et omnia pergunt ad unum locum. <l eID="gen12423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12424"/>De terra facta sunt, <l eID="gen12424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12425"/>et in terram pariter revertuntur. <l eID="gen12425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5444"/><l level="1" sID="gen12426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5444"/>Quis novit si spiritus filiorum Adam ascendat sursum, <l eID="gen12426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12427"/>et si spiritus jumentorum descendat deorsum ? <l eID="gen12427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5445"/><l level="1" sID="gen12428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5445"/>Et deprehendi nihil esse melius <l eID="gen12428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12429"/>quam lætari hominem in opere suo, <l eID="gen12429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12430"/>et hanc esse partem illius. <l eID="gen12430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12431"/>Quis enim eum adducet ut post se futura cognoscat ?  <chapter eID="Eccl.3"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:1
verses.text: Verti me ad alia, et vidi calumnias <l eID="gen12432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12433"/>quæ sub sole geruntur, <l eID="gen12433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12434"/>et lacrimas innocentium, <l eID="gen12434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12435"/>et neminem consolatorem, <l eID="gen12435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12436"/>nec posse resistere eorum violentiæ, <l eID="gen12436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12437"/>cunctorum auxilio destitutos, <l eID="gen12437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5446"/><l level="1" sID="gen12438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5446"/>et laudavi magis mortuos quam viventes ; <l eID="gen12438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5447"/><l level="1" sID="gen12439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5447"/>et feliciorem utroque judicavi <l eID="gen12439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12440"/>qui necdum natus est, <l eID="gen12440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12441"/>nec vidit mala quæ sub sole fiunt. <l eID="gen12441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5448"/><l level="1" sID="gen12442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5448"/>Rursum contemplatus sum omnes labores hominum, <l eID="gen12442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12443"/>et industrias animadverti patere invidiæ proximi ; <l eID="gen12443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12444"/>et in hoc ergo vanitas et cura superflua est. <l eID="gen12444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5449"/><l level="1" sID="gen12445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5449"/>Stultus complicat manus suas, <l eID="gen12445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12446"/>et comedit carnes suas, dicens : <l eID="gen12446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5450"/><l level="1" sID="gen12447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5450"/>Melior est pugillus cum requie, <l eID="gen12447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12448"/>quam plena utraque manus cum labore et afflictione animi. <l eID="gen12448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5451"/><l level="1" sID="gen12449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5451"/>Considerans, reperi et aliam vanitatem sub sole. <l eID="gen12449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5452"/><l level="1" sID="gen12450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5452"/>Unus est, et secundum non habet, <l eID="gen12450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12451"/>non filium, non fratrem, <l eID="gen12451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12452"/>et tamen laborare non cessat, <l eID="gen12452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12453"/>nec satiantur oculi ejus divitiis ; <l eID="gen12453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12454"/>nec recogitat, dicens : <l eID="gen12454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12455"/>Cui laboro, et fraudo animam meam bonis ? <l eID="gen12455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12456"/>In hoc quoque vanitas est et afflictio pessima. <l eID="gen12456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5453"/><l level="1" sID="gen12457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5453"/>Melius est ergo duos esse simul quam unum ; <l eID="gen12457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12458"/>habent enim emolumentum societatis suæ. <l eID="gen12458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5454"/><l level="1" sID="gen12459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5454"/>Si unus ceciderit, ab altero fulcietur. <l eID="gen12459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12460"/>Væ soli, quia cum ceciderit, non habet sublevantem se. <l eID="gen12460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5455"/><l level="1" sID="gen12461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5455"/>Et si dormierint duo, fovebuntur mutuo ; <l eID="gen12461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12462"/>unus quomodo calefiet ? <l eID="gen12462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5456"/><l level="1" sID="gen12463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5456"/>Et si quispiam prævaluerit contra unum, <l eID="gen12463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12464"/>duo resistunt ei ; <l eID="gen12464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12465"/>funiculus triplex difficile rumpitur. <l eID="gen12465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5457"/><l level="1" sID="gen12466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5457"/>Melior est puer pauper et sapiens, <l eID="gen12466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12467"/>rege sene et stulto, <l eID="gen12467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12468"/>qui nescit prævidere in posterum. <l eID="gen12468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5458"/><l level="1" sID="gen12469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5458"/>Quod de carcere catenisque interdum quis egrediatur ad regnum ; <l eID="gen12469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12470"/>et alius, natus in regno, inopia consumatur. <l eID="gen12470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5459"/><l level="1" sID="gen12471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5459"/>Vidi cunctos viventes qui ambulant sub sole <l eID="gen12471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12472"/>cum adolescente secundo, qui consurget pro eo. <l eID="gen12472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5460"/><l level="1" sID="gen12473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5460"/>Infinitus numerus est populi <l eID="gen12473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12474"/>omnium qui fuerunt ante eum, <l eID="gen12474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12475"/>et qui postea futuri sunt non lætabuntur in eo ; <l eID="gen12475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12476"/>sed et hoc vanitas et afflictio spiritus. <l eID="gen12476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5461"/><l level="1" sID="gen12477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5461"/>Custodi pedem tuum ingrediens domum Dei, <l eID="gen12477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12478"/>et appropinqua ut audias. <l eID="gen12478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12479"/>Multo enim melior est obedientia quam stultorum victimæ, <l eID="gen12479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12480"/>qui nesciunt quid faciunt mali.  <chapter eID="Eccl.4"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:1
verses.text: Ne temere quid loquaris, <l eID="gen12481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12482"/>neque cor tuum sit velox ad proferendum sermonem coram Deo. <l eID="gen12482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12483"/>Deus enim in cælo, et tu super terram ; <l eID="gen12483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12484"/>idcirco sint pauci sermones tui. <l eID="gen12484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5462"/><l level="1" sID="gen12485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5462"/>Multas curas sequuntur somnia, <l eID="gen12485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12486"/>et in multis sermonibus invenietur stultitia. <l eID="gen12486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5463"/><l level="1" sID="gen12487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5463"/>Si quid vovisti Deo, <l eID="gen12487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12488"/>ne moreris reddere : <l eID="gen12488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12489"/>displicet enim ei infidelis et stulta promissio, <l eID="gen12489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12490"/>sed quodcumque voveris redde : <l eID="gen12490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5464"/><l level="1" sID="gen12491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5464"/>multoque melius est non vovere, <l eID="gen12491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12492"/>quam post votum promissa non reddere. <l eID="gen12492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5465"/><l level="1" sID="gen12493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5465"/>Ne dederis os tuum ut peccare facias carnem tuam, <l eID="gen12493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12494"/>neque dicas coram angelo : <l eID="gen12494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12495"/>Non est providentia : <l eID="gen12495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12496"/>ne forte iratus Deus contra sermones tuos <l eID="gen12496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12497"/>dissipet cuncta opera manuum tuarum. <l eID="gen12497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5466"/><l level="1" sID="gen12498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5466"/>Ubi multa sunt somnia, <l eID="gen12498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12499"/>plurimæ sunt vanitates, et sermones innumeri ; <l eID="gen12499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12500"/>tu vero Deum time. <l eID="gen12500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5467"/><l level="1" sID="gen12501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5467"/>Si videris calumnias egenorum, et violenta judicia, <l eID="gen12501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12502"/>et subverti justitiam in provincia, <l eID="gen12502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12503"/>non mireris super hoc negotio : <l eID="gen12503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12504"/>quia excelso excelsior est alius, <l eID="gen12504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12505"/>et super hos quoque eminentiores sunt alii ; <l eID="gen12505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5468"/><l level="1" sID="gen12506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5468"/>et insuper universæ terræ rex imperat servienti. <l eID="gen12506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5469"/><l level="1" sID="gen12507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5469"/>Avarus non implebitur pecunia, <l eID="gen12507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12508"/>et qui amat divitias fructum non capiet ex eis ; <l eID="gen12508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12509"/>et hoc ergo vanitas. <l eID="gen12509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5470"/><l level="1" sID="gen12510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5470"/>Ubi multæ sunt opes, <l eID="gen12510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12511"/>multi et qui comedunt eas. <l eID="gen12511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12512"/>Et quid prodest possessori, <l eID="gen12512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12513"/>nisi quod cernit divitias oculis suis ? <l eID="gen12513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5471"/><l level="1" sID="gen12514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5471"/>Dulcis est somnus operanti, <l eID="gen12514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12515"/>sive parum sive multum comedat ; <l eID="gen12515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12516"/>saturitas autem divitis non sinit eum dormire. <l eID="gen12516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5472"/><l level="1" sID="gen12517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5472"/>Est et alia infirmitas pessima quam vidi sub sole : <l eID="gen12517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12518"/>divitiæ conservatæ in malum domini sui. <l eID="gen12518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5473"/><l level="1" sID="gen12519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5473"/>Pereunt enim in afflictione pessima : <l eID="gen12519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12520"/>generavit filium qui in summa egestate erit. <l eID="gen12520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5474"/><l level="1" sID="gen12521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5474"/>Sicut egressus est nudus de utero matris suæ, sic revertetur, <l eID="gen12521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12522"/>et nihil auferet secum de labore suo. <l eID="gen12522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5475"/><l level="1" sID="gen12523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5475"/>Miserabilis prorsus infirmitas : <l eID="gen12523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12524"/>quomodo venit, sic revertetur. <l eID="gen12524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12525"/>Quid ergo prodest ei quod laboravit in ventum ? <l eID="gen12525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5476"/><l level="1" sID="gen12526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5476"/>cunctis diebus vitæ suæ comedit in tenebris, <l eID="gen12526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12527"/>et in curis multis, et in ærumna atque tristitia. <l eID="gen12527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5477"/><l level="1" sID="gen12528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5477"/>Hoc itaque visum est mihi bonum, <l eID="gen12528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12529"/>ut comedat quis et bibat, <l eID="gen12529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12530"/>et fruatur lætitia ex labore suo <l eID="gen12530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12531"/>quo laboravit ipse sub sole, <l eID="gen12531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12532"/>numero dierum vitæ suæ <l eID="gen12532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12533"/>quos dedit ei Deus ; <l eID="gen12533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12534"/>et hæc est pars illius. <l eID="gen12534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5478"/><l level="1" sID="gen12535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5478"/>Et omni homini cui dedit Deus divitias atque substantiam, <l eID="gen12535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12536"/>potestatemque ei tribuit ut comedat ex eis, <l eID="gen12536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12537"/>et fruatur parte sua, et lætetur de labore suo : <l eID="gen12537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12538"/>hoc est donum Dei. <l eID="gen12538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5479"/><l level="1" sID="gen12539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5479"/>Non enim satis recordabitur dierum vitæ suæ, <l eID="gen12539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12540"/>eo quod Deus occupet deliciis cor ejus.  <chapter eID="Eccl.5"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:1
verses.text: Est et aliud malum quod vidi sub sole, <l eID="gen12541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12542"/>et quidem frequens apud homines : <l eID="gen12542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5480"/><l level="1" sID="gen12543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5480"/>vir cui dedit Deus divitias, <l eID="gen12543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12544"/>et substantiam, et honorem, <l eID="gen12544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12545"/>et nihil deest animæ suæ ex omnibus quæ desiderat ; <l eID="gen12545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12546"/>nec tribuit ei potestatem Deus ut comedat ex eo, <l eID="gen12546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12547"/>sed homo extraneus vorabit illud : <l eID="gen12547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12548"/>hoc vanitas et miseria magna est. <l eID="gen12548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5481"/><l level="1" sID="gen12549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5481"/>Si genuerit quispiam centum liberos, <l eID="gen12549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12550"/>et vixerit multos annos, <l eID="gen12550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12551"/>et plures dies ætatis habuerit, <l eID="gen12551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12552"/>et anima illius non utatur bonis substantiæ suæ, <l eID="gen12552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12553"/>sepulturaque careat : <l eID="gen12553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12554"/>de hoc ergo pronuntio quod melior illo sit abortivus. <l eID="gen12554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5482"/><l level="1" sID="gen12555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5482"/>Frustra enim venit, <l eID="gen12555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12556"/>et pergit ad tenebras, <l eID="gen12556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12557"/>et oblivione delebitur nomen ejus. <l eID="gen12557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5483"/><l level="1" sID="gen12558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5483"/>Non vidit solem, <l eID="gen12558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12559"/>neque cognovit distantiam boni et mali. <l eID="gen12559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5484"/><l level="1" sID="gen12560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5484"/>Etiam si duobus millibus annis vixerit, <l eID="gen12560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12561"/>et non fuerit perfruitus bonis, <l eID="gen12561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12562"/>nonne ad unum locum properant omnia ? <l eID="gen12562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5485"/><l level="1" sID="gen12563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5485"/>Omnis labor hominis in ore ejus ; <l eID="gen12563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12564"/>sed anima ejus non implebitur. <l eID="gen12564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5486"/><l level="1" sID="gen12565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5486"/>Quid habet amplius sapiens a stulto ? <l eID="gen12565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12566"/>et quid pauper, nisi ut pergat illuc ubi est vita ? <l eID="gen12566" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5487"/><l level="1" sID="gen12567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5487"/>Melius est videre quod cupias, <l eID="gen12567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12568"/>quam desiderare quod nescias. <l eID="gen12568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12569"/>Sed et hoc vanitas est, et præsumptio spiritus. <l eID="gen12569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5488"/><l level="1" sID="gen12570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5488"/>Qui futurus est, jam vocatum est nomen ejus ; <l eID="gen12570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12571"/>et scitur quod homo sit, <l eID="gen12571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12572"/>et non possit contra fortiorem se in judicio contendere. <l eID="gen12572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 6:11
