verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5489"/><l level="1" sID="gen12573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5489"/>Verba sunt plurima, <l eID="gen12573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12574"/>multamque in disputando habentia vanitatem.  <chapter eID="Eccl.6"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:1
verses.text: Quid necesse est homini majora se quærere, <l eID="gen12575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12576"/>cum ignoret quid conducat sibi in vita sua, <l eID="gen12576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12577"/>numero dierum peregrinationis suæ, <l eID="gen12577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12578"/>et tempore quod velut umbra præterit ? <l eID="gen12578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12579"/>aut quis ei poterit indicare <l eID="gen12579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12580"/>quod post eum futurum sub sole sit ? <l eID="gen12580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5490"/><l level="1" sID="gen12581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5490"/>Melius est nomen bonum quam unguenta pretiosa, <l eID="gen12581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12582"/>et dies mortis die nativitatis. <l eID="gen12582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5491"/><l level="1" sID="gen12583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5491"/>Melius est ire ad domum luctus <l eID="gen12583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12584"/>quam ad domum convivii ; <l eID="gen12584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12585"/>in illa enim finis cunctorum admonetur hominum, <l eID="gen12585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12586"/>et vivens cogitat quid futurum sit. <l eID="gen12586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5492"/><l level="1" sID="gen12587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5492"/>Melior est ira risu, <l eID="gen12587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12588"/>quia per tristitiam vultus corrigitur animus delinquentis. <l eID="gen12588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5493"/><l level="1" sID="gen12589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5493"/>Cor sapientium ubi tristitia est, <l eID="gen12589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12590"/>et cor stultorum ubi lætitia. <l eID="gen12590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5494"/><l level="1" sID="gen12591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5494"/>Melius est a sapiente corripi, <l eID="gen12591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12592"/>quam stultorum adulatione decipi ; <l eID="gen12592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5495"/><l level="1" sID="gen12593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5495"/>quia sicut sonitus spinarum ardentium sub olla, <l eID="gen12593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12594"/>sic risus stulti. <l eID="gen12594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12595"/>Sed et hoc vanitas. <l eID="gen12595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5496"/><l level="1" sID="gen12596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5496"/>Calumnia conturbat sapientem, <l eID="gen12596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12597"/>et perdet robur cordis illius. <l eID="gen12597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5497"/><l level="1" sID="gen12598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5497"/>Melior est finis orationis quam principium. <l eID="gen12598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12599"/>Melior est patiens arrogante. <l eID="gen12599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5498"/><l level="1" sID="gen12600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5498"/>Ne sis velox ad irascendum, <l eID="gen12600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12601"/>quia ira in sinu stulti requiescit. <l eID="gen12601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5499"/><l level="1" sID="gen12602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5499"/>Ne dicas : Quid putas causæ est <l eID="gen12602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12603"/>quod priora tempora meliora fuere quam nunc sunt ? <l eID="gen12603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12604"/>stulta enim est hujuscemodi interrogatio. <l eID="gen12604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5500"/><l level="1" sID="gen12605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5500"/>Utilior est sapientia cum divitiis, <l eID="gen12605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12606"/>et magis prodest videntibus solem. <l eID="gen12606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5501"/><l level="1" sID="gen12607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5501"/>Sicut enim protegit sapientia, sic protegit pecunia ; <l eID="gen12607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12608"/>hoc autem plus habet eruditio et sapientia, <l eID="gen12608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12609"/>quod vitam tribuunt possessori suo. <l eID="gen12609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5502"/><l level="1" sID="gen12610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5502"/>Considera opera Dei, <l eID="gen12610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12611"/>quod nemo possit corrigere quem ille despexerit. <l eID="gen12611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5503"/><l level="1" sID="gen12612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5503"/>In die bona fruere bonis, <l eID="gen12612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12613"/>et malam diem præcave ; <l eID="gen12613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12614"/>sicut enim hanc, sic et illam fecit Deus, <l eID="gen12614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12615"/>ut non inveniat homo contra eum justas querimonias. <l eID="gen12615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5504"/><l level="1" sID="gen12616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5504"/>Hæc quoque vidi in diebus vanitatis meæ : <l eID="gen12616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12617"/>justus perit in justitia sua, <l eID="gen12617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12618"/>et impius multo vivit tempore in malitia sua. <l eID="gen12618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5505"/><l level="1" sID="gen12619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5505"/>Noli esse justus multum, <l eID="gen12619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12620"/>neque plus sapias quam necesse est, <l eID="gen12620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12621"/>ne obstupescas. <l eID="gen12621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5506"/><l level="1" sID="gen12622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5506"/>Ne impie agas multum, <l eID="gen12622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12623"/>et noli esse stultus, <l eID="gen12623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12624"/>ne moriaris in tempore non tuo. <l eID="gen12624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5507"/><l level="1" sID="gen12625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5507"/>Bonum est te sustentare justum : <l eID="gen12625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12626"/>sed et ab illo ne subtrahas manum tuam ; <l eID="gen12626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12627"/>quia qui timet Deum nihil negligit. <l eID="gen12627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5508"/><l level="1" sID="gen12628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5508"/>Sapientia confortavit sapientem <l eID="gen12628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12629"/>super decem principes civitatis ; <l eID="gen12629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5509"/><l level="1" sID="gen12630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5509"/>non est enim homo justus in terra <l eID="gen12630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12631"/>qui faciat bonum et non peccet. <l eID="gen12631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5510"/><l level="1" sID="gen12632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5510"/>Sed et cunctis sermonibus qui dicuntur <l eID="gen12632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12633"/>ne accomodes cor tuum, <l eID="gen12633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12634"/>ne forte audias servum tuum maledicentem tibi ; <l eID="gen12634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5511"/><l level="1" sID="gen12635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5511"/>scit enim conscientia tua <l eID="gen12635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12636"/>quia et tu crebro maledixisti aliis. <l eID="gen12636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5512"/><l level="1" sID="gen12637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5512"/>Cuncta tentavi in sapientia. <l eID="gen12637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12638"/>Dixi : Sapiens efficiar : <l eID="gen12638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12639"/>et ipsa longius recessit a me, <l eID="gen12639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5513"/><l level="1" sID="gen12640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5513"/>multo magis quam erat. <l eID="gen12640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12641"/>Et alta profunditas, quis inveniet eam ? <l eID="gen12641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5514"/><l level="1" sID="gen12642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5514"/>Lustravi universa animo meo, <l eID="gen12642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12643"/>ut scirem et considerarem, <l eID="gen12643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12644"/>et quærerem sapientiam, et rationem, <l eID="gen12644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12645"/>et ut cognoscerem impietatem stulti, <l eID="gen12645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12646"/>et errorem imprudentium : <l eID="gen12646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5515"/><l level="1" sID="gen12647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5515"/>et inveni amariorem morte mulierem, <l eID="gen12647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12648"/>quæ laqueus venatorum est, <l eID="gen12648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12649"/>et sagena cor ejus ; <l eID="gen12649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12650"/>vincula sunt manus illius. <l eID="gen12650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12651"/>Qui placet Deo effugiet illam ; <l eID="gen12651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12652"/>qui autem peccator est capietur ab illa. <l eID="gen12652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5516"/><l level="1" sID="gen12653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5516"/>Ecce hoc inveni, dixit Ecclesiastes, <l eID="gen12653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12654"/>unum et alterum ut invenirem rationem, <l eID="gen12654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5517"/><l level="1" sID="gen12655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5517"/>quam adhuc quærit anima mea, <l eID="gen12655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12656"/>et non inveni. <l eID="gen12656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12657"/>Virum de mille unum reperi ; <l eID="gen12657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12658"/>mulierem ex omnibus non inveni. <l eID="gen12658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5518"/><l level="1" sID="gen12659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5518"/>Solummodo hoc inveni, <l eID="gen12659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12660"/>quod fecerit Deus hominem rectum, <l eID="gen12660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12661"/>et ipse se infinitis miscuerit quæstionibus. <l eID="gen12661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12662"/>Quis talis ut sapiens est ? <l eID="gen12662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12663"/>et quis cognovit solutionem verbi ?  <chapter eID="Eccl.7"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:1
verses.text: Sapientia hominis lucet in vultu ejus, <l eID="gen12664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12665"/>et potentissimus faciem illius commutabit. <l eID="gen12665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5519"/><l level="1" sID="gen12666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5519"/>Ego os regis observo, <l eID="gen12666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12667"/>et præcepta juramenti Dei. <l eID="gen12667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5520"/><l level="1" sID="gen12668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5520"/>Ne festines recedere a facie ejus, <l eID="gen12668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12669"/>neque permaneas in opere malo : <l eID="gen12669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12670"/>quia omne quod voluerit faciet. <l eID="gen12670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5521"/><l level="1" sID="gen12671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5521"/>Et sermo illius potestate plenus est, <l eID="gen12671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12672"/>nec dicere ei quisquam potest : Quare ita facis ? <l eID="gen12672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5522"/><l level="1" sID="gen12673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5522"/>Qui custodit præceptum non experietur quidquam mali. <l eID="gen12673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12674"/>Tempus et responsionem cor sapientis intelligit. <l eID="gen12674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5523"/><l level="1" sID="gen12675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5523"/>Omni negotio tempus est, et opportunitas : <l eID="gen12675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12676"/>et multa hominis afflictio, <l eID="gen12676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5524"/><l level="1" sID="gen12677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5524"/>quia ignorat præterita, <l eID="gen12677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12678"/>et futura nullo scire potest nuntio. <l eID="gen12678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5525"/><l level="1" sID="gen12679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5525"/>Non est in hominis potestate prohibere spiritum, <l eID="gen12679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12680"/>nec habet potestatem in die mortis : <l eID="gen12680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12681"/>nec sinitur quiescere ingruente bello, <l eID="gen12681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12682"/>neque salvabit impietas impium. <l eID="gen12682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5526"/><l level="1" sID="gen12683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5526"/>Omnia hæc consideravi, <l eID="gen12683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12684"/>et dedi cor meum in cunctis operibus quæ fiunt sub sole. <l eID="gen12684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12685"/>Interdum dominatur homo homini in malum suum. <l eID="gen12685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5527"/><l level="1" sID="gen12686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5527"/>Vidi impios sepultos, <l eID="gen12686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12687"/>qui etiam cum adhuc viverent <l eID="gen12687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12688"/>in loco sancto erant, <l eID="gen12688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12689"/>et laudabantur in civitate <l eID="gen12689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12690"/>quasi justorum operum. <l eID="gen12690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12691"/>Sed et hoc vanitas est. <l eID="gen12691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5528"/><l level="1" sID="gen12692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5528"/>Etenim quia non profertur cito contra malos sententia, <l eID="gen12692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12693"/>absque timore ullo <l eID="gen12693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12694"/>filii hominum perpetrant mala. <l eID="gen12694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5529"/><l level="1" sID="gen12695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5529"/>Attamen peccator ex eo quod centies facit malum, <l eID="gen12695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12696"/>et per patientiam sustentatur ; <l eID="gen12696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12697"/>ego cognovi quod erit bonum timentibus Deum, <l eID="gen12697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12698"/>qui verentur faciem ejus. <l eID="gen12698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5530"/><l level="1" sID="gen12699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5530"/>Non sit bonum impio, <l eID="gen12699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12700"/>nec prolongentur dies ejus, <l eID="gen12700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12701"/>sed quasi umbra transeant qui non timent faciem Domini. <l eID="gen12701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5531"/><l level="1" sID="gen12702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5531"/>Est et alia vanitas quæ fit super terram : <l eID="gen12702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12703"/>sunt justi quibus mala proveniunt <l eID="gen12703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12704"/>quasi opera egerint impiorum : <l eID="gen12704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12705"/>et sunt impii qui ita securi sunt <l eID="gen12705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12706"/>quasi justorum facta habeant. <l eID="gen12706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12707"/>Sed et hoc vanissimum judico. <l eID="gen12707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5532"/><l level="1" sID="gen12708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5532"/>Laudavi igitur lætitiam ; <l eID="gen12708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12709"/>quod non esset homini bonum sub sole, <l eID="gen12709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12710"/>nisi quod comederet, et biberet, atque gauderet, <l eID="gen12710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12711"/>et hoc solum secum auferret de labore suo, <l eID="gen12711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12712"/>in diebus vitæ suæ quos dedit ei Deus sub sole. <l eID="gen12712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5533"/><l level="1" sID="gen12713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5533"/>Et apposui cor meum ut scirem sapientiam, <l eID="gen12713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12714"/>et intelligerem distentionem quæ versatur in terra. <l eID="gen12714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12715"/>Est homo qui diebus et noctibus somnum non capit oculis. <l eID="gen12715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5534"/><l level="1" sID="gen12716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5534"/>Et intellexi quod omnium operum Dei <l eID="gen12716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12717"/>nullam possit homo invenire rationem <l eID="gen12717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12718"/>eorum quæ fiunt sub sole ; <l eID="gen12718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12719"/>et quanto plus laboraverit ad quærendum, <l eID="gen12719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12720"/>tanto minus inveniat : <l eID="gen12720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12721"/>etiam si dixerit sapiens se nosse, non poterit reperire.  <chapter eID="Eccl.8"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:1
verses.text: Omnia hæc tractavi in corde meo, <l eID="gen12722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12723"/>ut curiose intelligerem. <l eID="gen12723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12724"/>Sunt justi atque sapientes, <l eID="gen12724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12725"/>et opera eorum in manu Dei ; <l eID="gen12725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12726"/>et tamen nescit homo utrum amore an odio dignus sit. <l eID="gen12726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5535"/><l level="1" sID="gen12727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5535"/>Sed omnia in futurum servantur incerta, <l eID="gen12727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12728"/>eo quod universa æque eveniant justo et impio, <l eID="gen12728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12729"/>bono et malo, mundo et immundo, <l eID="gen12729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12730"/>immolanti victimas et sacrificia contemnenti. <l eID="gen12730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12731"/>Sicut bonus, sic et peccator ; <l eID="gen12731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12732"/>ut perjurus, ita et ille qui verum dejerat. <l eID="gen12732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5536"/><l level="1" sID="gen12733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5536"/>Hoc est pessimum inter omnia quæ sub sole fiunt : <l eID="gen12733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12734"/>quia eadem cunctis eveniunt. <l eID="gen12734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12735"/>Unde et corda filiorum hominum implentur malitia <l eID="gen12735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12736"/>et contemptu in vita sua, <l eID="gen12736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12737"/>et post hæc ad inferos deducentur. <l eID="gen12737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5537"/><l level="1" sID="gen12738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5537"/>Nemo est qui semper vivat, et qui hujus rei habeat fiduciam ; <l eID="gen12738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12739"/>melior est canis vivus leone mortuo. <l eID="gen12739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5538"/><l level="1" sID="gen12740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5538"/>Viventes enim sciunt se esse morituros ; <l eID="gen12740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12741"/>mortui vero nihil noverunt amplius, <l eID="gen12741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12742"/>nec habent ultra mercedem, <l eID="gen12742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12743"/>quia oblivioni tradita est memoria eorum. <l eID="gen12743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5539"/><l level="1" sID="gen12744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5539"/>Amor quoque, et odium, et invidiæ simul perierunt ; <l eID="gen12744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12745"/>nec habent partem in hoc sæculo, <l eID="gen12745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12746"/>et in opere quod sub sole geritur. <l eID="gen12746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5540"/><l level="1" sID="gen12747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5540"/>Vade ergo, et comede in lætitia panem tuum, <l eID="gen12747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12748"/>et bibe cum gaudio vinum tuum, <l eID="gen12748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12749"/>quia Deo placent opera tua. <l eID="gen12749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5541"/><l level="1" sID="gen12750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5541"/>Omni tempore sint vestimenta tua candida, <l eID="gen12750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12751"/>et oleum de capite tuo non deficiat. <l eID="gen12751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5542"/><l level="1" sID="gen12752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5542"/>Perfruere vita cum uxore quam diligis, <l eID="gen12752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12753"/>cunctis diebus vitæ instabilitatis tuæ, <l eID="gen12753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12754"/>qui dati sunt tibi sub sole omni tempore vanitatis tuæ : <l eID="gen12754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12755"/>hæc est enim pars in vita <l eID="gen12755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12756"/>et in labore tuo quo laboras sub sole. <l eID="gen12756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5543"/><l level="1" sID="gen12757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5543"/>Quodcumque facere potest manus tua, <l eID="gen12757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12758"/>instanter operare, <l eID="gen12758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12759"/>quia nec opus, nec ratio, nec sapientia, nec scientia <l eID="gen12759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12760"/>erunt apud inferos, quo tu properas. <l eID="gen12760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5544"/><l level="1" sID="gen12761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5544"/>Verti me ad aliud, et vidi sub sole <l eID="gen12761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12762"/>nec velocium esse cursum, <l eID="gen12762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12763"/>nec fortium bellum, <l eID="gen12763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12764"/>nec sapientium panem, <l eID="gen12764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12765"/>nec doctorum divitias, <l eID="gen12765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12766"/>nec artificum gratiam ; <l eID="gen12766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12767"/>sed tempus casumque in omnibus. <l eID="gen12767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5545"/><l level="1" sID="gen12768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5545"/>Nescit homo finem suum ; <l eID="gen12768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12769"/>sed sicut pisces capiuntur hamo, <l eID="gen12769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12770"/>et sicut aves laqueo comprehenduntur, <l eID="gen12770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12771"/>sic capiuntur homines in tempore malo, <l eID="gen12771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12772"/>cum eis extemplo supervenerit. <l eID="gen12772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5546"/><l level="1" sID="gen12773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5546"/>Hanc quoque sub sole vidi sapientiam, <l eID="gen12773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12774"/>et probavi maximam : <l eID="gen12774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5547"/><l level="1" sID="gen12775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5547"/>civitas parva, et pauci in ea viri ; <l eID="gen12775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12776"/>venit contra eam rex magnus, et vallavit eam, <l eID="gen12776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12777"/>exstruxitque munitiones per gyrum, et perfecta est obsidio. <l eID="gen12777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5548"/><l level="1" sID="gen12778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5548"/>Inventusque est in ea vir pauper et sapiens, <l eID="gen12778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12779"/>et liberavit urbem per sapientiam suam ; <l eID="gen12779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12780"/>et nullus deinceps recordatus est hominis illius pauperis. <l eID="gen12780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5549"/><l level="1" sID="gen12781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5549"/>Et dicebam ego meliorem esse sapientiam fortitudine. <l eID="gen12781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12782"/>Quomodo ergo sapientia pauperis contempta est, <l eID="gen12782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12783"/>et verba ejus non sunt audita ? <l eID="gen12783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5550"/><l level="1" sID="gen12784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5550"/>Verba sapientium audiuntur in silentio, <l eID="gen12784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12785"/>plus quam clamor principis inter stultos. <l eID="gen12785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5551"/><l level="1" sID="gen12786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5551"/>Melior est sapientia quam arma bellica ; <l eID="gen12786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12787"/>et qui in uno peccaverit, multa bona perdet.  <chapter eID="Eccl.9"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:1
verses.text: Muscæ morientes perdunt suavitatem unguenti. <l eID="gen12788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12789"/>Pretiosior est sapientia et gloria, <l eID="gen12789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12790"/>parva et ad tempus stultitia. <l eID="gen12790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5552"/><l level="1" sID="gen12791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5552"/>Cor sapientis in dextera ejus, <l eID="gen12791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12792"/>et cor stulti in sinistra illius. <l eID="gen12792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5553"/><l level="1" sID="gen12793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5553"/>Sed et in via stultus ambulans, <l eID="gen12793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12794"/>cum ipse insipiens sit, <l eID="gen12794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12795"/>omnes stultos æstimat. <l eID="gen12795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5554"/><l level="1" sID="gen12796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5554"/>Si spiritus potestatem habentis ascenderit super te, <l eID="gen12796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12797"/>locum tuum ne demiseris, <l eID="gen12797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12798"/>quia curatio faciet cessare peccata maxima. <l eID="gen12798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5555"/><l level="1" sID="gen12799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5555"/>Est malum quod vidi sub sole, <l eID="gen12799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12800"/>quasi per errorem egrediens a facie principis : <l eID="gen12800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5556"/><l level="1" sID="gen12801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5556"/>positum stultum in dignitate sublimi, <l eID="gen12801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12802"/>et divites sedere deorsum. <l eID="gen12802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5557"/><l level="1" sID="gen12803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5557"/>Vidi servos in equis, <l eID="gen12803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12804"/>et principes ambulantes super terram quasi servos. <l eID="gen12804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5558"/><l level="1" sID="gen12805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5558"/>Qui fodit foveam incidet in eam, <l eID="gen12805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12806"/>et qui dissipat sepem mordebit eum coluber. <l eID="gen12806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5559"/><l level="1" sID="gen12807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5559"/>Qui transfert lapides affligetur in eis, <l eID="gen12807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12808"/>et qui scindit ligna vulnerabitur ab eis. <l eID="gen12808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5560"/><l level="1" sID="gen12809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5560"/>Si retusum fuerit ferrum, <l eID="gen12809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12810"/>et hoc non ut prius, sed hebetatum fuerit, <l eID="gen12810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12811"/>multo labore exacuetur, <l eID="gen12811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12812"/>et post industriam sequetur sapientia. <l eID="gen12812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5561"/><l level="1" sID="gen12813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5561"/>Si mordeat serpens in silentio, <l eID="gen12813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12814"/>nihil eo minus habet qui occulte detrahit. <l eID="gen12814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5562"/><l level="1" sID="gen12815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5562"/>Verba oris sapientis gratia, <l eID="gen12815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12816"/>et labia insipientis præcipitabunt eum ; <l eID="gen12816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5563"/><l level="1" sID="gen12817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5563"/>initium verborum ejus stultitia, <l eID="gen12817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12818"/>et novissimum oris illius error pessimus. <l eID="gen12818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5564"/><l level="1" sID="gen12819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5564"/>Stultus verba multiplicat. <l eID="gen12819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12820"/>Ignorat homo quid ante se fuerit ; <l eID="gen12820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12821"/>et quid post se futurum sit, quis ei poterit indicare ? <l eID="gen12821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5565"/><l level="1" sID="gen12822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5565"/>Labor stultorum affliget eos, <l eID="gen12822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12823"/>qui nesciunt in urbem pergere. <l eID="gen12823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5566"/><l level="1" sID="gen12824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5566"/>Væ tibi, terra, cujus rex puer est, <l eID="gen12824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12825"/>et cujus principes mane comedunt. <l eID="gen12825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5567"/><l level="1" sID="gen12826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5567"/>Beata terra cujus rex nobilis est, <l eID="gen12826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12827"/>et cujus principes vescuntur in tempore suo, <l eID="gen12827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12828"/>ad reficiendum, et non ad luxuriam. <l eID="gen12828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5568"/><l level="1" sID="gen12829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5568"/>In pigritiis humiliabitur contignatio, <l eID="gen12829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12830"/>et in infirmitate manuum perstillabit domus. <l eID="gen12830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5569"/><l level="1" sID="gen12831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5569"/>In risum faciunt panem et vinum <l eID="gen12831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12832"/>ut epulentur viventes ; <l eID="gen12832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12833"/>et pecuniæ obediunt omnia. <l eID="gen12833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5570"/><l level="1" sID="gen12834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5570"/>In cogitatione tua regi ne detrahas, <l eID="gen12834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12835"/>et in secreto cubiculi tui ne maledixeris diviti : <l eID="gen12835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12836"/>quia et aves cæli portabunt vocem tuam, <l eID="gen12836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12837"/>et qui habet pennas annuntiabit sententiam.  <chapter eID="Eccl.10"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:1
verses.text: Mitte panem tuum super transeuntes aquas, <l eID="gen12838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12839"/>quia post tempora multa invenies illum. <l eID="gen12839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5571"/><l level="1" sID="gen12840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5571"/>Da partem septem necnon et octo, <l eID="gen12840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12841"/>quia ignoras quid futurum sit mali super terram. <l eID="gen12841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5572"/><l level="1" sID="gen12842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5572"/>Si repletæ fuerint nubes, <l eID="gen12842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12843"/>imbrem super terram effundent. <l eID="gen12843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12844"/>Si ceciderit lignum ad austrum aut ad aquilonem, <l eID="gen12844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12845"/>in quocumque loco ceciderit, ibi erit. <l eID="gen12845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5573"/><l level="1" sID="gen12846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5573"/>Qui observat ventum non seminat ; <l eID="gen12846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12847"/>et qui considerat nubes numquam metet. <l eID="gen12847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5574"/><l level="1" sID="gen12848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5574"/>Quomodo ignoras quæ sit via spiritus, <l eID="gen12848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12849"/>et qua ratione compingantur ossa in ventre prægnantis, <l eID="gen12849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12850"/>sic nescis opera Dei, <l eID="gen12850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12851"/>qui fabricator est omnium. <l eID="gen12851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5575"/><l level="1" sID="gen12852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5575"/>Mane semina semen tuum, <l eID="gen12852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12853"/>et vespere ne cesset manus tua : <l eID="gen12853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12854"/>quia nescis quid magis oriatur, hoc aut illud ; <l eID="gen12854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12855"/>et si utrumque simul, melius erit. <l eID="gen12855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5576"/><l level="1" sID="gen12856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5576"/>Dulce lumen, <l eID="gen12856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12857"/>et delectabile est oculis videre solem. <l eID="gen12857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5577"/><l level="1" sID="gen12858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5577"/>Si annis multis vixerit homo, <l eID="gen12858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12859"/>et in his omnibus lætatus fuerit, <l eID="gen12859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12860"/>meminisse debet tenebrosi temporis, et dierum multorum, <l eID="gen12860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12861"/>qui cum venerint, vanitatis arguentur præterita. <l eID="gen12861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5578"/><l level="1" sID="gen12862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5578"/>Lætare ergo, juvenis, in adolescentia tua, <l eID="gen12862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12863"/>et in bono sit cor tuum in diebus juventutis tuæ : <l eID="gen12863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12864"/>et ambula in viis cordis tui, <l eID="gen12864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12865"/>et in intuitu oculorum tuorum, <l eID="gen12865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12866"/>et scito quod pro omnibus his adducet te Deus in judicium. <l eID="gen12866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5579"/><l level="1" sID="gen12867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5579"/>Aufer iram a corde tuo, <l eID="gen12867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12868"/>et amove malitiam a carne tua : <l eID="gen12868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12869"/>adolescentia enim et voluptas vana sunt.  <chapter eID="Eccl.11"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:1
verses.text: Memento Creatoris tui in diebus juventutis tuæ, <l eID="gen12870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12871"/>antequam veniat tempus afflictionis, <l eID="gen12871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12872"/>et appropinquent anni de quibus dicas : <l eID="gen12872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12873"/>Non mihi placent ; <l eID="gen12873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5580"/><l level="1" sID="gen12874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5580"/>antequam tenebrescat sol, et lumen, et luna, et stellæ, <l eID="gen12874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12875"/>et revertantur nubes post pluviam ; <l eID="gen12875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5581"/><l level="1" sID="gen12876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5581"/>quando commovebuntur custodes domus, <l eID="gen12876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12877"/>et nutabunt viri fortissimi, <l eID="gen12877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12878"/>et otiosæ erunt molentes in minuto numero, <l eID="gen12878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12879"/>et tenebrescent videntes per foramina ; <l eID="gen12879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5582"/><l level="1" sID="gen12880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5582"/>et claudent ostia in platea, <l eID="gen12880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12881"/>in humilitate vocis molentis, <l eID="gen12881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12882"/>et consurgent ad vocem volucris, <l eID="gen12882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12883"/>et obsurdescent omnes filiæ carminis : <l eID="gen12883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5583"/><l level="1" sID="gen12884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5583"/>excelsa quoque timebunt, et formidabunt in via. <l eID="gen12884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12885"/>Florebit amygdalus, impinguabitur locusta, <l eID="gen12885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12886"/>et dissipabitur capparis, <l eID="gen12886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12887"/>quoniam ibit homo in domum æternitatis suæ, <l eID="gen12887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12888"/>et circuibunt in platea plangentes. <l eID="gen12888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5584"/><l level="1" sID="gen12889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5584"/>Antequam rumpatur funiculus argenteus, <l eID="gen12889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12890"/>et recurrat vitta aurea, <l eID="gen12890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12891"/>et conteratur hydria super fontem, <l eID="gen12891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12892"/>et confringatur rota super cisternam, <l eID="gen12892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5585"/><l level="1" sID="gen12893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5585"/>et revertatur pulvis in terram suam unde erat, <l eID="gen12893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12894"/>et spiritus redeat ad Deum, qui dedit illum. <l eID="gen12894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5586"/><l level="1" sID="gen12895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5586"/>Vanitas vanitatum, dixit Ecclesiastes, <l eID="gen12895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12896"/>et omnia vanitas. <l eID="gen12896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5587"/><l level="1" sID="gen12897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5587"/>Cumque esset sapientissimus Ecclesiastes, <l eID="gen12897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12898"/>docuit populum, et enarravit quæ fecerat ; <l eID="gen12898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12899"/>et investigans composuit parabolas multas. <l eID="gen12899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5588"/><l level="1" sID="gen12900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5588"/>Quæsivit verba utilia, <l eID="gen12900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12901"/>et conscripsit sermones rectissimos ac veritate plenos. <l eID="gen12901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5589"/><l level="1" sID="gen12902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5589"/>Verba sapientium sicut stimuli, <l eID="gen12902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12903"/>et quasi clavi in altum defixi, <l eID="gen12903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12904"/>quæ per magistrorum consilium data sunt a pastore uno. <l eID="gen12904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5590"/><l level="1" sID="gen12905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5590"/>His amplius, fili mi, ne requiras. <l eID="gen12905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12906"/>Faciendi plures libros nullus est finis ; <l eID="gen12906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12907"/>frequensque meditatio, carnis afflictio est. <l eID="gen12907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5591"/><l level="1" sID="gen12908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5591"/>Finem loquendi pariter omnes audiamus. <l eID="gen12908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12909"/>Deum time, et mandata ejus observa : <l eID="gen12909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12910"/>hoc est enim omnis homo, <l eID="gen12910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ecclesiastes 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5592"/><l level="1" sID="gen12911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5592"/>et cuncta quæ fiunt adducet Deus in judicium <l eID="gen12911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12912"/>pro omni errato, sive bonum, sive malum illud sit. <l eID="gen12912" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12241"/> <chapter eID="Eccl.12"/> <div eID="gen12239" osisID="Eccl" type="book"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:1
verses.text: Osculetur me osculo oris sui ; <l eID="gen12915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12916"/>quia meliora sunt ubera tua vino, <l eID="gen12916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5593"/><l level="1" sID="gen12917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5593"/>fragrantia unguentis optimis. <l eID="gen12917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12918"/>Oleum effusum nomen tuum ; <l eID="gen12918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12919"/>ideo adolescentulæ dilexerunt te. <l eID="gen12919" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12914"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5594"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus Adolescentularum</title> <lg sID="gen12920"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5594"/>Trahe me, post te curremus <l eID="gen12921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12922"/>in odorem unguentorum tuorum. <l eID="gen12922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12923"/>Introduxit me rex in cellaria sua ; <l eID="gen12923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12924"/>exsultabimus et lætabimur in te, <l eID="gen12924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12925"/>memores uberum tuorum super vinum. <l eID="gen12925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12926"/>Recti diligunt te. <l eID="gen12926" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12920"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5595"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen12927"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5595"/>Nigra sum, sed formosa, filiæ Jerusalem, <l eID="gen12928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12929"/>sicut tabernacula Cedar, sicut pelles Salomonis. <l eID="gen12929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5596"/><l level="1" sID="gen12930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5596"/>Nolite me considerare quod fusca sim, <l eID="gen12930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12931"/>quia decoloravit me sol. <l eID="gen12931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12932"/>Filii matris meæ pugnaverunt contra me ; <l eID="gen12932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12933"/>posuerunt me custodem in vineis : <l eID="gen12933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12934"/>vineam meam non custodivi. <l eID="gen12934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5597"/><l level="1" sID="gen12935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5597"/>Indica mihi, quem diligit anima mea, ubi pascas, <l eID="gen12935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12936"/>ubi cubes in meridie, <l eID="gen12936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12937"/>ne vagari incipiam post greges sodalium tuorum. <l eID="gen12937" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12927"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5598"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen12938"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5598"/>Si ignoras te, o pulcherrima inter mulieres, <l eID="gen12939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12940"/>egredere, et abi post vestigia gregum, <l eID="gen12940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12941"/>et pasce hædos tuos juxta tabernacula pastorum. <l eID="gen12941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5599"/><l level="1" sID="gen12942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5599"/>Equitatui meo in curribus Pharaonis <l eID="gen12942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12943"/>assimilavi te, amica mea. <l eID="gen12943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5600"/><l level="1" sID="gen12944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5600"/>Pulchræ sunt genæ tuæ sicut turturis ; <l eID="gen12944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12945"/>collum tuum sicut monilia. <l eID="gen12945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5601"/><l level="1" sID="gen12946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5601"/>Murenulas aureas faciemus tibi, <l eID="gen12946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12947"/>vermiculatas argento. <l eID="gen12947" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12938"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5602"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen12948"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5602"/>Dum esset rex in accubitu suo, <l eID="gen12949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12950"/>nardus mea dedit odorem suum. <l eID="gen12950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5603"/><l level="1" sID="gen12951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5603"/>Fasciculus myrrhæ dilectus meus mihi ; <l eID="gen12951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12952"/>inter ubera mea commorabitur. <l eID="gen12952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5604"/><l level="1" sID="gen12953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5604"/>Botrus cypri dilectus meus mihi <l eID="gen12953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12954"/>in vineis Engaddi. <l eID="gen12954" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12948"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5605"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen12955"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5605"/>Ecce tu pulchra es, amica mea ! ecce tu pulchra es ! <l eID="gen12956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12957"/>Oculi tui columbarum. <l eID="gen12957" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12955"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5606"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen12958"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5606"/>Ecce tu pulcher es, dilecte mi, et decorus ! <l eID="gen12959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12960"/>Lectulus noster floridus. <l eID="gen12960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5607"/><l level="1" sID="gen12961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5607"/>Tigna domorum nostrarum cedrina, <l eID="gen12961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12962"/>laquearia nostra cypressina.  <chapter eID="Song.1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:1
verses.text: Ego flos campi, <l eID="gen12963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12964"/>et lilium convallium. <l eID="gen12964" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12958"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5608"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen12965"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5608"/>Sicut lilium inter spinas, <l eID="gen12966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12967"/>sic amica mea inter filias. <l eID="gen12967" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12965"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5609"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen12968"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5609"/>Sicut malus inter ligna silvarum, <l eID="gen12969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12970"/>sic dilectus meus inter filios. <l eID="gen12970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12971"/>Sub umbra illius quem desideraveram sedi, <l eID="gen12971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12972"/>et fructus ejus dulcis gutturi meo. <l eID="gen12972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5610"/><l level="1" sID="gen12973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5610"/>Introduxit me in cellam vinariam ; <l eID="gen12973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12974"/>ordinavit in me caritatem. <l eID="gen12974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5611"/><l level="1" sID="gen12975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5611"/>Fulcite me floribus, <l eID="gen12975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12976"/>stipate me malis, <l eID="gen12976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12977"/>quia amore langueo. <l eID="gen12977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5612"/><l level="1" sID="gen12978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5612"/>Læva ejus sub capite meo, <l eID="gen12978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12979"/>et dextera illius amplexabitur me. <l eID="gen12979" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12968"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5613"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen12980"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5613"/>Adjuro vos, filiæ Jerusalem, <l eID="gen12981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12982"/>per capreas cervosque camporum, <l eID="gen12982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12983"/>ne suscitetis, neque evigilare faciatis dilectam, <l eID="gen12983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12984"/>quoadusque ipsa velit. <l eID="gen12984" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12980"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5614"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen12985"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5614"/>Vox dilecti mei ; ecce iste venit, <l eID="gen12986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12987"/>saliens in montibus, transiliens colles. <l eID="gen12987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5615"/><l level="1" sID="gen12988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5615"/>Similis est dilectus meus capreæ, <l eID="gen12988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12989"/>hinnuloque cervorum. <l eID="gen12989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12990"/>En ipse stat post parietem nostrum, <l eID="gen12990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12991"/>respiciens per fenestras, <l eID="gen12991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12992"/>prospiciens per cancellos. <l eID="gen12992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5616"/><l level="1" sID="gen12993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5616"/>En dilectus meus loquitur mihi. <l eID="gen12993" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12985"/> <title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen12994"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12995"/>Surge, propera, amica mea, <l eID="gen12995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12996"/>columba mea, formosa mea, et veni : <l eID="gen12996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5617"/><l level="1" sID="gen12997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5617"/>jam enim hiems transiit ; <l eID="gen12997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen12998"/>imber abiit, et recessit. <l eID="gen12998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5618"/><l level="1" sID="gen12999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5618"/>Flores apparuerunt in terra nostra ; <l eID="gen12999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13000"/>tempus putationis advenit : <l eID="gen13000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13001"/>vox turturis audita est in terra nostra ; <l eID="gen13001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5619"/><l level="1" sID="gen13002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5619"/>ficus protulit grossos suos ; <l eID="gen13002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13003"/>vineæ florentes dederunt odorem suum. <l eID="gen13003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13004"/>Surge, amica mea, speciosa mea, et veni : <l eID="gen13004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5620"/><l level="1" sID="gen13005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5620"/>columba mea, in foraminibus petræ, in caverna maceriæ, <l eID="gen13005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13006"/>ostende mihi faciem tuam, <l eID="gen13006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13007"/>sonet vox tua in auribus meis : <l eID="gen13007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13008"/>vox enim tua dulcis, et facies tua decora. <l eID="gen13008" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen12994"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5621"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13009"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5621"/>Capite nobis vulpes parvulas <l eID="gen13010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13011"/>quæ demoliuntur vineas : <l eID="gen13011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13012"/>nam vinea nostra floruit. <l eID="gen13012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5622"/><l level="1" sID="gen13013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5622"/>Dilectus meus mihi, et ego illi, <l eID="gen13013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13014"/>qui pascitur inter lilia, <l eID="gen13014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5623"/><l level="1" sID="gen13015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5623"/>donec aspiret dies, et inclinentur umbræ. <l eID="gen13015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13016"/>Revertere ; similis esto, dilecte mi, capreæ, <l eID="gen13016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13017"/>hinnuloque cervorum super montes Bether.  <chapter eID="Song.2"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:1
verses.text: In lectulo meo, per noctes, <l eID="gen13018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13019"/>quæsivi quem diligit anima mea : <l eID="gen13019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13020"/>quæsivi illum, et non inveni. <l eID="gen13020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5624"/><l level="1" sID="gen13021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5624"/>Surgam, et circuibo civitatem : <l eID="gen13021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13022"/>per vicos et plateas <l eID="gen13022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13023"/>quæram quem diligit anima mea : <l eID="gen13023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13024"/>quæsivi illum, et non inveni. <l eID="gen13024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5625"/><l level="1" sID="gen13025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5625"/>Invenerunt me vigiles qui custodiunt civitatem : <l eID="gen13025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13026"/>Num quem diligit anima mea vidistis ? <l eID="gen13026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5626"/><l level="1" sID="gen13027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5626"/>Paululum cum pertransissem eos, <l eID="gen13027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13028"/>inveni quem diligit anima mea : <l eID="gen13028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13029"/>tenui eum, nec dimittam, <l eID="gen13029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13030"/>donec introducam illum in domum matris meæ, <l eID="gen13030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13031"/>et in cubiculum genetricis meæ. <l eID="gen13031" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13009"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5627"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen13032"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5627"/>Adjuro vos, filiæ Jerusalem, <l eID="gen13033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13034"/>per capreas cervosque camporum, <l eID="gen13034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13035"/>ne suscitetis, neque evigilare faciatis dilectam, <l eID="gen13035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13036"/>donec ipsa velit. <l eID="gen13036" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13032"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5628"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus</title> <lg sID="gen13037"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5628"/>Quæ est ista quæ ascendit per desertum <l eID="gen13038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13039"/>sicut virgula fumi ex aromatibus myrrhæ, <l eID="gen13039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13040"/>et thuris, et universi pulveris pigmentarii ? <l eID="gen13040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5629"/><l level="1" sID="gen13041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5629"/>En lectulum Salomonis sexaginta fortes ambiunt <l eID="gen13041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13042"/>ex fortissimis Israël, <l eID="gen13042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5630"/><l level="1" sID="gen13043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5630"/>omnes tenentes gladios, et ad bella doctissimi : <l eID="gen13043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13044"/>uniuscujusque ensis super femur suum <l eID="gen13044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13045"/>propter timores nocturnos. <l eID="gen13045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5631"/><l level="1" sID="gen13046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5631"/>Ferculum fecit sibi rex Salomon <l eID="gen13046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13047"/>de lignis Libani ; <l eID="gen13047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5632"/><l level="1" sID="gen13048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5632"/>columnas ejus fecit argenteas, <l eID="gen13048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13049"/>reclinatorium aureum, ascensum purpureum ; <l eID="gen13049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13050"/>media caritate constravit, <l eID="gen13050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13051"/>propter filias Jerusalem. <l eID="gen13051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5633"/><l level="1" sID="gen13052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5633"/>Egredimini et videte, filiæ Sion, <l eID="gen13052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13053"/>regem Salomonem in diademate quo coronavit illum mater sua <l eID="gen13053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13054"/>in die desponsationis illius, <l eID="gen13054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13055"/>et in die lætitiæ cordis ejus. <l eID="gen13055" level="1"/><lg eID="gen13037"/> <chapter eID="Song.3"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:1
verses.text: Quam pulchra es, amica mea ! quam pulchra es ! <l eID="gen13057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13058"/>Oculi tui columbarum, <l eID="gen13058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13059"/>absque eo quod intrinsecus latet. <l eID="gen13059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13060"/>Capilli tui sicut greges caprarum <l eID="gen13060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13061"/>quæ ascenderunt de monte Galaad. <l eID="gen13061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5634"/><l level="1" sID="gen13062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5634"/>Dentes tui sicut greges tonsarum <l eID="gen13062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13063"/>quæ ascenderunt de lavacro ; <l eID="gen13063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13064"/>omnes gemellis fœtibus, <l eID="gen13064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13065"/>et sterilis non est inter eas. <l eID="gen13065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5635"/><l level="1" sID="gen13066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5635"/>Sicut vitta coccinea labia tua, <l eID="gen13066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13067"/>et eloquium tuum dulce. <l eID="gen13067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13068"/>Sicut fragmen mali punici, ita genæ tuæ, <l eID="gen13068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13069"/>absque eo quod intrinsecus latet. <l eID="gen13069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5636"/><l level="1" sID="gen13070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5636"/>Sicut turris David collum tuum, <l eID="gen13070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13071"/>quæ ædificata est cum propugnaculis ; <l eID="gen13071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13072"/>mille clypei pendent ex ea, <l eID="gen13072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13073"/>omnis armatura fortium. <l eID="gen13073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5637"/><l level="1" sID="gen13074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5637"/>Duo ubera tua sicut duo hinnuli, <l eID="gen13074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13075"/>capreæ gemelli, qui pascuntur in liliis. <l eID="gen13075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5638"/><l level="1" sID="gen13076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5638"/>Donec aspiret dies, et inclinentur umbræ, <l eID="gen13076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13077"/>vadam ad montem myrrhæ, et ad collem thuris. <l eID="gen13077" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5639"/><l level="1" sID="gen13078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5639"/>Tota pulchra es, amica mea, <l eID="gen13078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13079"/>et macula non est in te. <l eID="gen13079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5640"/><l level="1" sID="gen13080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5640"/>Veni de Libano, sponsa mea : <l eID="gen13080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13081"/>veni de Libano, veni, coronaberis : <l eID="gen13081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13082"/>de capite Amana, de vertice Sanir et Hermon, <l eID="gen13082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13083"/>de cubilibus leonum, de montibus pardorum. <l eID="gen13083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5641"/><l level="1" sID="gen13084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5641"/>Vulnerasti cor meum, soror mea, sponsa ; <l eID="gen13084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13085"/>vulnerasti cor meum in uno oculorum tuorum, <l eID="gen13085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13086"/>et in uno crine colli tui. <l eID="gen13086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5642"/><l level="1" sID="gen13087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5642"/>Quam pulchræ sunt mammæ tuæ, soror mea sponsa ! <l eID="gen13087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13088"/>pulchriora sunt ubera tua vino, <l eID="gen13088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13089"/>et odor unguentorum tuorum super omnia aromata. <l eID="gen13089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5643"/><l level="1" sID="gen13090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5643"/>Favus distillans labia tua, sponsa ; <l eID="gen13090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13091"/>mel et lac sub lingua tua : <l eID="gen13091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13092"/>et odor vestimentorum tuorum sicut odor thuris. <l eID="gen13092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5644"/><l level="1" sID="gen13093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5644"/>Hortus conclusus soror mea, sponsa, <l eID="gen13093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13094"/>hortus conclusus, fons signatus. <l eID="gen13094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5645"/><l level="1" sID="gen13095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5645"/>Emissiones tuæ paradisus malorum punicorum, <l eID="gen13095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13096"/>cum pomorum fructibus, cypri cum nardo. <l eID="gen13096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5646"/><l level="1" sID="gen13097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5646"/>Nardus et crocus, fistula et cinnamomum, <l eID="gen13097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13098"/>cum universis lignis Libani ; <l eID="gen13098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13099"/>myrrha et aloë, cum omnibus primis unguentis. <l eID="gen13099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5647"/><l level="1" sID="gen13100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5647"/>Fons hortorum, puteus aquarum viventium, <l eID="gen13100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13101"/>quæ fluunt impetu de Libano. <l eID="gen13101" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13056"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5648"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13102"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5648"/>Surge, aquilo, et veni, auster : <l eID="gen13103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13104"/>perfla hortum meum, et fluant aromata illius.  <chapter eID="Song.4"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:1
verses.text: Veniat dilectus meus in hortum suum, <l eID="gen13105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13106"/>et comedat fructum pomorum suorum. <l eID="gen13106" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13102"/> <title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen13107"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13108"/>Veni in hortum meum, soror mea, sponsa ; <l eID="gen13108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13109"/>messui myrrham meam cum aromatibus meis ; <l eID="gen13109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13110"/>comedi favum cum melle meo ; <l eID="gen13110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13111"/>bibi vinum meum cum lacte meo ; <l eID="gen13111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13112"/>comedite, amici, et bibite, <l eID="gen13112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13113"/>et inebriamini, carissimi. <l eID="gen13113" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13107"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5649"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13114"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5649"/>Ego dormio, et cor meum vigilat. <l eID="gen13115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13116"/>Vox dilecti mei pulsantis : <l eID="gen13116" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13114"/> <title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen13117"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13118"/>Aperi mihi, soror mea, amica mea, <l eID="gen13118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13119"/>columba mea, immaculata mea, <l eID="gen13119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13120"/>quia caput meum plenum est rore, <l eID="gen13120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13121"/>et cincinni mei guttis noctium. <l eID="gen13121" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13117"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5650"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13122"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5650"/>Expoliavi me tunica mea : quomodo induar illa ? <l eID="gen13123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13124"/>lavi pedes meos : quomodo inquinabo illos ? <l eID="gen13124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5651"/><l level="1" sID="gen13125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5651"/>Dilectus meus misit manum suam per foramen, <l eID="gen13125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13126"/>et venter meus intremuit ad tactum ejus. <l eID="gen13126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5652"/><l level="1" sID="gen13127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5652"/>Surrexi ut aperirem dilecto meo ; <l eID="gen13127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13128"/>manus meæ stillaverunt myrrham, <l eID="gen13128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13129"/>et digiti mei pleni myrrha probatissima. <l eID="gen13129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:6
