verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5653"/><l level="1" sID="gen13130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5653"/>Pessulum ostii mei aperui dilecto meo, <l eID="gen13130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13131"/>at ille declinaverat, atque transierat. <l eID="gen13131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13132"/>Anima mea liquefacta est, ut locutus est ; <l eID="gen13132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13133"/>quæsivi, et non inveni illum ; <l eID="gen13133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13134"/>vocavi, et non respondit mihi. <l eID="gen13134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5654"/><l level="1" sID="gen13135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5654"/>Invenerunt me custodes qui circumeunt civitatem ; <l eID="gen13135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13136"/>percusserunt me, et vulneraverunt me. <l eID="gen13136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13137"/>Tulerunt pallium meum mihi custodes murorum. <l eID="gen13137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5655"/><l level="1" sID="gen13138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5655"/>Adjuro vos, filiæ Jerusalem, <l eID="gen13138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13139"/>si inveneritis dilectum meum, <l eID="gen13139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13140"/>ut nuntietis ei quia amore langueo. <l eID="gen13140" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13122"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5656"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus</title> <lg sID="gen13141"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5656"/>Qualis est dilectus tuus ex dilecto, o pulcherrima mulierum ? <l eID="gen13142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13143"/>qualis est dilectus tuus ex dilecto, quia sic adjurasti nos ? <l eID="gen13143" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13141"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5657"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13144"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5657"/>Dilectus meus candidus et rubicundus ; <l eID="gen13145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13146"/>electus ex millibus. <l eID="gen13146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5658"/><l level="1" sID="gen13147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5658"/>Caput ejus aurum optimum ; <l eID="gen13147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13148"/>comæ ejus sicut elatæ palmarum, nigræ quasi corvus. <l eID="gen13148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5659"/><l level="1" sID="gen13149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5659"/>Oculi ejus sicut columbæ super rivulos aquarum, <l eID="gen13149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13150"/>quæ lacte sunt lotæ, et resident juxta fluenta plenissima. <l eID="gen13150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5660"/><l level="1" sID="gen13151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5660"/>Genæ illius sicut areolæ aromatum, <l eID="gen13151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13152"/>consitæ a pigmentariis. <l eID="gen13152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13153"/>Labia ejus lilia, <l eID="gen13153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13154"/>distillantia myrrham primam. <l eID="gen13154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5661"/><l level="1" sID="gen13155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5661"/>Manus illius tornatiles, aureæ, <l eID="gen13155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13156"/>plenæ hyacinthis. <l eID="gen13156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13157"/>Venter ejus eburneus, <l eID="gen13157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13158"/>distinctus sapphiris. <l eID="gen13158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5662"/><l level="1" sID="gen13159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5662"/>Crura illius columnæ marmoreæ <l eID="gen13159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13160"/>quæ fundatæ sunt super bases aureas. <l eID="gen13160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13161"/>Species ejus ut Libani, <l eID="gen13161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13162"/>electus ut cedri. <l eID="gen13162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5663"/><l level="1" sID="gen13163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5663"/>Guttur illius suavissimum, <l eID="gen13163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13164"/>et totus desiderabilis. <l eID="gen13164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13165"/>Talis est dilectus meus, <l eID="gen13165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13166"/>et ipse est amicus meus, filiæ Jerusalem. <l eID="gen13166" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13144"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5664"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus</title> <lg sID="gen13167"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5664"/>Quo abiit dilectus tuus, o pulcherrima mulierum ? <l eID="gen13168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13169"/>quo declinavit dilectus tuus ? <l eID="gen13169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13170"/>et quæremus eum tecum. <l eID="gen13170" level="1"/><lg eID="gen13167"/> <chapter eID="Song.5"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:1
verses.text: Dilectus meus descendit in hortum suum ad areolam aromatum, <l eID="gen13172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13173"/>ut pascatur in hortis, et lilia colligat. <l eID="gen13173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5665"/><l level="1" sID="gen13174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5665"/>Ego dilecto meo, et dilectus meus mihi, <l eID="gen13174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13175"/>qui pascitur inter lilia. <l eID="gen13175" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13171"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5666"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen13176"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5666"/>Pulchra es, amica mea ; <l eID="gen13177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13178"/>suavis, et decora sicut Jerusalem ; <l eID="gen13178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13179"/>terribilis ut castrorum acies ordinata. <l eID="gen13179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5667"/><l level="1" sID="gen13180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5667"/>Averte oculos tuos a me, <l eID="gen13180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13181"/>quia ipsi me avolare fecerunt. <l eID="gen13181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13182"/>Capilli tui sicut grex caprarum <l eID="gen13182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13183"/>quæ apparuerunt de Galaad. <l eID="gen13183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5668"/><l level="1" sID="gen13184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5668"/>Dentes tui sicut grex ovium <l eID="gen13184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13185"/>quæ ascenderunt de lavacro : <l eID="gen13185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13186"/>omnes gemellis fœtibus, <l eID="gen13186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13187"/>et sterilis non est in eis. <l eID="gen13187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5669"/><l level="1" sID="gen13188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5669"/>Sicut cortex mali punici, sic genæ tuæ, <l eID="gen13188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13189"/>absque occultis tuis. <l eID="gen13189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5670"/><l level="1" sID="gen13190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5670"/>Sexaginta sunt reginæ, et octoginta concubinæ, <l eID="gen13190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13191"/>et adolescentularum non est numerus. <l eID="gen13191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5671"/><l level="1" sID="gen13192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5671"/>Una est columba mea, perfecta mea, <l eID="gen13192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13193"/>una est matris suæ, electa genetrici suæ. <l eID="gen13193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13194"/>Viderunt eam filiæ, et beatissimam prædicaverunt ; <l eID="gen13194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13195"/>reginæ et concubinæ, et laudaverunt eam. <l eID="gen13195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5672"/><l level="1" sID="gen13196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5672"/>Quæ est ista quæ progreditur quasi aurora consurgens, <l eID="gen13196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13197"/>pulchra ut luna, electa ut sol, <l eID="gen13197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13198"/>terribilis ut castrorum acies ordinata ? <l eID="gen13198" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13176"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5673"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13199"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5673"/>Descendi in hortum nucum, <l eID="gen13200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13201"/>ut viderem poma convallium, <l eID="gen13201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13202"/>et inspicerem si floruisset vinea, <l eID="gen13202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13203"/>et germinassent mala punica. <l eID="gen13203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5674"/><l level="1" sID="gen13204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5674"/>Nescivi : anima mea conturbavit me, <l eID="gen13204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13205"/>propter quadrigas Aminadab. <l eID="gen13205" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13199"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5675"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus</title> <lg sID="gen13206"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5675"/>Revertere, revertere, Sulamitis ! <l eID="gen13207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13208"/>revertere, revertere ut intueamur te. <l eID="gen13208" level="1"/><lg eID="gen13206"/> <chapter eID="Song.6"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:1
verses.text: Quid videbis in Sulamite, nisi choros castrorum ? <l eID="gen13210" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13209"/> <title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus</title> <lg sID="gen13211"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13212"/>Quam pulchri sunt gressus tui in calceamentis, filia principis ! <l eID="gen13212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13213"/>Juncturæ femorum tuorum sicut monilia <l eID="gen13213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13214"/>quæ fabricata sunt manu artificis. <l eID="gen13214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5676"/><l level="1" sID="gen13215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5676"/>Umbilicus tuus crater tornatilis, <l eID="gen13215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13216"/>numquam indigens poculis. <l eID="gen13216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13217"/>Venter tuus sicut acervus tritici vallatus liliis. <l eID="gen13217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5677"/><l level="1" sID="gen13218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5677"/>Duo ubera tua sicut duo hinnuli, <l eID="gen13218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13219"/>gemelli capreæ. <l eID="gen13219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5678"/><l level="1" sID="gen13220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5678"/>Collum tuum sicut turris eburnea ; <l eID="gen13220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13221"/>oculi tui sicut piscinæ in Hesebon <l eID="gen13221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13222"/>quæ sunt in porta filiæ multitudinis. <l eID="gen13222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13223"/>Nasus tuus sicut turris Libani, <l eID="gen13223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13224"/>quæ respicit contra Damascum. <l eID="gen13224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5679"/><l level="1" sID="gen13225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5679"/>Caput tuum ut Carmelus ; <l eID="gen13225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13226"/>et comæ capitis tui sicut purpura regis <l eID="gen13226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13227"/>vincta canalibus. <l eID="gen13227" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13211"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5680"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen13228"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5680"/>Quam pulchra es, et quam decora, <l eID="gen13229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13230"/>carissima, in deliciis ! <l eID="gen13230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5681"/><l level="1" sID="gen13231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5681"/>Statura tua assimilata est palmæ, <l eID="gen13231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13232"/>et ubera tua botris. <l eID="gen13232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5682"/><l level="1" sID="gen13233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5682"/>Dixi : Ascendam in palmam, <l eID="gen13233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13234"/>et apprehendam fructus ejus ; <l eID="gen13234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13235"/>et erunt ubera tua sicut botri vineæ, <l eID="gen13235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13236"/>et odor oris tui sicut malorum. <l eID="gen13236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5683"/><l level="1" sID="gen13237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5683"/>Guttur tuum sicut vinum optimum, <l eID="gen13237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13238"/>dignum dilecto meo ad potandum, <l eID="gen13238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13239"/>labiisque et dentibus illius ad ruminandum. <l eID="gen13239" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13228"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5684"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13240"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5684"/>Ego dilecto meo, <l eID="gen13241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13242"/>et ad me conversio ejus. <l eID="gen13242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5685"/><l level="1" sID="gen13243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5685"/>Veni, dilecte mi, egrediamur in agrum, <l eID="gen13243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13244"/>commoremur in villis. <l eID="gen13244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5686"/><l level="1" sID="gen13245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5686"/>Mane surgamus ad vineas : <l eID="gen13245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13246"/>videamus si floruit vinea, <l eID="gen13246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13247"/>si flores fructus parturiunt, <l eID="gen13247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13248"/>si floruerunt mala punica ; <l eID="gen13248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13249"/>ibi dabo tibi ubera mea. <l eID="gen13249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5687"/><l level="1" sID="gen13250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5687"/>Mandragoræ dederunt odorem <l eID="gen13250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13251"/>in portis nostris omnia poma : <l eID="gen13251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13252"/>nova et vetera, dilecte mi, servavi tibi.  <chapter eID="Song.7"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:1
verses.text: Quis mihi det te fratrem meum, <l eID="gen13253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13254"/>sugentem ubera matris meæ, <l eID="gen13254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13255"/>ut inveniam te foris, et deosculer te, <l eID="gen13255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13256"/>et jam me nemo despiciat ? <l eID="gen13256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5688"/><l level="1" sID="gen13257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5688"/>Apprehendam te, et ducam in domum matris meæ : <l eID="gen13257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13258"/>ibi me docebis, <l eID="gen13258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13259"/>et dabo tibi poculum ex vino condito, <l eID="gen13259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13260"/>et mustum malorum granatorum meorum. <l eID="gen13260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5689"/><l level="1" sID="gen13261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5689"/>Læva ejus sub capite meo, <l eID="gen13261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13262"/>et dextera illius amplexabitur me. <l eID="gen13262" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13240"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5690"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen13263"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5690"/>Adjuro vos, filiæ Jerusalem, <l eID="gen13264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13265"/>ne suscitetis, neque evigilare faciatis dilectam, <l eID="gen13265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13266"/>donec ipsa velit. <l eID="gen13266" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13263"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5691"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus</title> <lg sID="gen13267"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5691"/>Quæ est ista quæ ascendit de deserto, deliciis affluens, <l eID="gen13268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13269"/>innixa super dilectum suum ? <l eID="gen13269" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13267"/> <title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen13270"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13271"/>Sub arbore malo suscitavi te ; <l eID="gen13271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13272"/>ibi corrupta est mater tua, <l eID="gen13272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13273"/>ibi violata est genitrix tua. <l eID="gen13273" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13270"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5692"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13274"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5692"/>Pone me ut signaculum super cor tuum, <l eID="gen13275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13276"/>ut signaculum super brachium tuum, <l eID="gen13276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13277"/>quia fortis est ut mors dilectio, <l eID="gen13277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13278"/>dura sicut infernus æmulatio : <l eID="gen13278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13279"/>lampades ejus lampades ignis atque flammarum. <l eID="gen13279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5693"/><l level="1" sID="gen13280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5693"/>Aquæ multæ non potuerunt extinguere caritatem, <l eID="gen13280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13281"/>nec flumina obruent illam. <l eID="gen13281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13282"/>Si dederit homo omnem substantiam domus suæ pro dilectione, <l eID="gen13282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13283"/>quasi nihil despiciet eam. <l eID="gen13283" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13274"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5694"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus Fratrum</title> <lg sID="gen13284"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5694"/>Soror nostra parva, <l eID="gen13285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13286"/>et ubera non habet ; <l eID="gen13286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13287"/>quid faciemus sorori nostræ <l eID="gen13287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13288"/>in die quando alloquenda est ? <l eID="gen13288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5695"/><l level="1" sID="gen13289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5695"/>Si murus est, <l eID="gen13289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13290"/>ædificemus super eum propugnacula argentea ; <l eID="gen13290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13291"/>si ostium est, compingamus illud tabulis cedrinis. <l eID="gen13291" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13284"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5696"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13292"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5696"/>Ego murus, et ubera mea sicut turris, <l eID="gen13293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13294"/>ex quo facta sum coram eo, quasi pacem reperiens. <l eID="gen13294" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13292"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5697"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Chorus Fratrum</title> <lg sID="gen13295"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5697"/>Vinea fuit pacifico in ea quæ habet populos : <l eID="gen13296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13297"/>tradidit eam custodibus ; <l eID="gen13297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13298"/>vir affert pro fructu ejus mille argenteos. <l eID="gen13298" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13295"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5698"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13299"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5698"/>Vinea mea coram me est. <l eID="gen13300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13301"/>Mille tui pacifici, <l eID="gen13301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13302"/>et ducenti his qui custodiunt fructus ejus. <l eID="gen13302" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13299"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5699"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsus</title> <lg sID="gen13303"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5699"/>Quæ habitas in hortis, amici auscultant ; <l eID="gen13304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13305"/>fac me audire vocem tuam. <l eID="gen13305" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13303"/>

verses.name: Song of Solomon 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5700"/><title level="2" subType="x-speaker">Sponsa</title> <lg sID="gen13306"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5700"/>Fuge, dilecte mi, et assimilare capreæ, <l eID="gen13307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13308"/>hinnuloque cervorum super montes aromatum. <l eID="gen13308" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13306"/> <chapter eID="Song.8"/> <div eID="gen12913" osisID="Song" type="book"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:1
verses.text: Diligite justitiam, qui judicatis terram. <l eID="gen13311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13312"/>Sentite de Domino in bonitate, <l eID="gen13312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13313"/>et in simplicitate cordis quærite illum : <l eID="gen13313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5701"/><l level="1" sID="gen13314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5701"/>quoniam invenitur ab his qui non tentant illum, <l eID="gen13314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13315"/>apparet autem eis qui fidem habent in illum. <l eID="gen13315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5702"/><l level="1" sID="gen13316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5702"/>Perversæ enim cogitationes separant a Deo ; <l eID="gen13316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13317"/>probata autem virtus corripit insipientes. <l eID="gen13317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5703"/><l level="1" sID="gen13318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5703"/>Quoniam in malevolam animam non introibit sapientia, <l eID="gen13318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13319"/>nec habitabit in corpore subdito peccatis. <l eID="gen13319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5704"/><l level="1" sID="gen13320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5704"/>Spiritus enim sanctus disciplinæ effugiet fictum, <l eID="gen13320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13321"/>et auferet se a cogitationibus quæ sunt sine intellectu, <l eID="gen13321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13322"/>et corripietur a superveniente iniquitate. <l eID="gen13322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5705"/><l level="1" sID="gen13323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5705"/>Benignus est enim spiritus sapientiæ, <l eID="gen13323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13324"/>et non liberabit maledicum a labiis suis : <l eID="gen13324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13325"/>quoniam renum illius testis est Deus, <l eID="gen13325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13326"/>et cordis illius scrutator est verus, <l eID="gen13326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13327"/>et linguæ ejus auditor. <l eID="gen13327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5706"/><l level="1" sID="gen13328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5706"/>Quoniam spiritus Domini replevit orbem terrarum, <l eID="gen13328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13329"/>et hoc quod continet omnia, scientiam habet vocis. <l eID="gen13329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5707"/><l level="1" sID="gen13330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5707"/>Propter hoc qui loquitur iniqua non potest latere, <l eID="gen13330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13331"/>nec præteriet illum corripiens judicium. <l eID="gen13331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5708"/><l level="1" sID="gen13332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5708"/>In cogitationibus enim impii interrogatio erit ; <l eID="gen13332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13333"/>sermonum autem illius auditio ad Deum veniet, <l eID="gen13333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13334"/>ad correptionem iniquitatum illius. <l eID="gen13334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5709"/><l level="1" sID="gen13335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5709"/>Quoniam auris zeli audit omnia, <l eID="gen13335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13336"/>et tumultus murmurationum non abscondetur. <l eID="gen13336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5710"/><l level="1" sID="gen13337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5710"/>Custodite ergo vos a murmuratione quæ nihil prodest, <l eID="gen13337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13338"/>et a detractione parcite linguæ : <l eID="gen13338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13339"/>quoniam sermo obscurus in vacuum non ibit, <l eID="gen13339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13340"/>os autem quod mentitur occidit animam. <l eID="gen13340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5711"/><l level="1" sID="gen13341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5711"/>Nolite zelare mortem in errore vitæ vestræ, <l eID="gen13341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13342"/>neque acquiratis perditionem in operibus manuum vestrarum. <l eID="gen13342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5712"/><l level="1" sID="gen13343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5712"/>Quoniam Deus mortem non fecit, <l eID="gen13343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13344"/>nec lætatur in perditione vivorum. <l eID="gen13344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5713"/><l level="1" sID="gen13345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5713"/>Creavit enim ut essent omnia, <l eID="gen13345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13346"/>et sanabiles fecit nationes orbis terrarum : <l eID="gen13346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13347"/>et non est in illis medicamentum exterminii, <l eID="gen13347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13348"/>nec inferorum regnum in terra. <l eID="gen13348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5714"/><l level="1" sID="gen13349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5714"/>Justitia enim perpetua est, et immortalis. <l eID="gen13349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5715"/><l level="1" sID="gen13350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5715"/>Impii autem manibus et verbis accersierunt illam, <l eID="gen13350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13351"/>et æstimantes illam amicam, defluxerunt ; <l eID="gen13351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13352"/>et sponsiones posuerunt ad illam, <l eID="gen13352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13353"/>quoniam digni sunt qui sint ex parte illius.  <chapter eID="Wis.1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:1
verses.text: Dixerunt enim cogitantes apud se non recte : <l eID="gen13354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13355"/>Exiguum et cum tædio est tempus vitæ nostræ, <l eID="gen13355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13356"/>et non est refrigerium in fine hominis, <l eID="gen13356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13357"/>et non est qui agnitus sit reversus ab inferis. <l eID="gen13357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5716"/><l level="1" sID="gen13358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5716"/>Quia ex nihilo nati sumus, <l eID="gen13358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13359"/>et post hoc erimus tamquam non fuerimus. <l eID="gen13359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13360"/>Quoniam fumus flatus est in naribus nostris, <l eID="gen13360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13361"/>et sermo scintilla ad commovendum cor nostrum : <l eID="gen13361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5717"/><l level="1" sID="gen13362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5717"/>qua extincta, cinis erit corpus nostrum, <l eID="gen13362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13363"/>et spiritus diffundetur tamquam mollis aër ; <l eID="gen13363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13364"/>et transibit vita nostra tamquam vestigium nubis, <l eID="gen13364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13365"/>et sicut nebula dissolvetur quæ fugata est a radiis solis, <l eID="gen13365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13366"/>et a calore illius aggravata. <l eID="gen13366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5718"/><l level="1" sID="gen13367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5718"/>Et nomen nostrum oblivionem accipiet per tempus, <l eID="gen13367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13368"/>et nemo memoriam habebit operum nostrorum. <l eID="gen13368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5719"/><l level="1" sID="gen13369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5719"/>Umbræ enim transitus est tempus nostrum, <l eID="gen13369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13370"/>et non est reversio finis nostri : <l eID="gen13370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13371"/>quoniam consignata est, et nemo revertitur. <l eID="gen13371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5720"/><l level="1" sID="gen13372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5720"/>Venite ergo, et fruamur bonis quæ sunt, <l eID="gen13372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13373"/>et utamur creatura tamquam in juventute celeriter. <l eID="gen13373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5721"/><l level="1" sID="gen13374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5721"/>Vino pretioso et unguentis nos impleamus, <l eID="gen13374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13375"/>et non prætereat nos flos temporis. <l eID="gen13375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5722"/><l level="1" sID="gen13376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5722"/>Coronemus nos rosis antequam marcescant ; <l eID="gen13376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13377"/>nullum pratum sit quod non pertranseat luxuria nostra : <l eID="gen13377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5723"/><l level="1" sID="gen13378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5723"/>nemo nostrum exsors sit luxuriæ nostræ. <l eID="gen13378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13379"/>Ubique relinquamus signa lætitiæ, <l eID="gen13379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13380"/>quoniam hæc est pars nostra, et hæc est sors. <l eID="gen13380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5724"/><l level="1" sID="gen13381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5724"/>Opprimamus pauperem justum, et non parcamus viduæ, <l eID="gen13381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13382"/>nec veterani revereamur canos multi temporis : <l eID="gen13382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5725"/><l level="1" sID="gen13383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5725"/>sit autem fortitudo nostra lex justitiæ ; <l eID="gen13383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13384"/>quod enim infirmum est, inutile invenitur. <l eID="gen13384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5726"/><l level="1" sID="gen13385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5726"/>Circumveniamus ergo justum, quoniam inutilis est nobis, <l eID="gen13385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13386"/>et contrarius est operibus nostris, <l eID="gen13386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13387"/>et improperat nobis peccata legis, <l eID="gen13387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13388"/>et diffamat in nos peccata disciplinæ nostræ. <l eID="gen13388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5727"/><l level="1" sID="gen13389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5727"/>Promittit se scientiam Dei habere, <l eID="gen13389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13390"/>et filium Dei se nominat. <l eID="gen13390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5728"/><l level="1" sID="gen13391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5728"/>Factus est nobis in traductionem cogitationum nostrarum. <l eID="gen13391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5729"/><l level="1" sID="gen13392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5729"/>Gravis est nobis etiam ad videndum, <l eID="gen13392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13393"/>quoniam dissimilis est aliis vita illius, <l eID="gen13393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13394"/>et immutatæ sunt viæ ejus. <l eID="gen13394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5730"/><l level="1" sID="gen13395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5730"/>Tamquam nugaces æstimati sumus ab illo, <l eID="gen13395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13396"/>et abstinet se a viis nostris tamquam ab immunditiis, <l eID="gen13396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13397"/>et præfert novissima justorum, <l eID="gen13397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13398"/>et gloriatur patrem se habere Deum. <l eID="gen13398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5731"/><l level="1" sID="gen13399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5731"/>Videamus ergo si sermones illius veri sint, <l eID="gen13399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13400"/>et tentemus quæ ventura sunt illi, <l eID="gen13400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13401"/>et sciemus quæ erunt novissima illius. <l eID="gen13401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5732"/><l level="1" sID="gen13402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5732"/>Si enim est verus filius Dei, suscipiet illum, <l eID="gen13402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13403"/>et liberabit eum de manibus contrariorum. <l eID="gen13403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5733"/><l level="1" sID="gen13404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5733"/>Contumelia et tormento interrogemus eum, <l eID="gen13404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13405"/>ut sciamus reverentiam ejus, <l eID="gen13405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13406"/>et probemus patientiam illius. <l eID="gen13406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5734"/><l level="1" sID="gen13407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5734"/>Morte turpissima condemnemus eum ; <l eID="gen13407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13408"/>erit enim ei respectus ex sermonibus illius. <l eID="gen13408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5735"/><l level="1" sID="gen13409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5735"/>Hæc cogitaverunt, et erraverunt : <l eID="gen13409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13410"/>excæcavit enim illos malitia eorum. <l eID="gen13410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5736"/><l level="1" sID="gen13411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5736"/>Et nescierunt sacramenta Dei : <l eID="gen13411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13412"/>neque mercedem speraverunt justitiæ, <l eID="gen13412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13413"/>nec judicaverunt honorem animarum sanctarum. <l eID="gen13413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5737"/><l level="1" sID="gen13414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5737"/>Quoniam Deus creavit hominem inexterminabilem, <l eID="gen13414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13415"/>et ad imaginem similitudinis suæ fecit illum. <l eID="gen13415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5738"/><l level="1" sID="gen13416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5738"/>Invidia autem diaboli mors introivit in orbem terrarum : <l eID="gen13416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5739"/><l level="1" sID="gen13417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5739"/>imitantur autem illum qui sunt ex parte illius.  <chapter eID="Wis.2"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:1
verses.text: Justorum autem animæ in manu Dei sunt, <l eID="gen13418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13419"/>et non tanget illos tormentum mortis. <l eID="gen13419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5740"/><l level="1" sID="gen13420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5740"/>Visi sunt oculis insipientium mori, <l eID="gen13420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13421"/>et æstimata est afflictio exitus illorum, <l eID="gen13421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5741"/><l level="1" sID="gen13422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5741"/>et quod a nobis est iter exterminium ; <l eID="gen13422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13423"/>illi autem sunt in pace : <l eID="gen13423" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5742"/><l level="1" sID="gen13424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5742"/>etsi coram hominibus tormenta passi sunt, <l eID="gen13424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13425"/>spes illorum immortalitate plena est. <l eID="gen13425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5743"/><l level="1" sID="gen13426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5743"/>In paucis vexati sunt, in multis bene disponentur, <l eID="gen13426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13427"/>quoniam Deus tentavit eos, <l eID="gen13427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13428"/>et invenit illos dignos se. <l eID="gen13428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5744"/><l level="1" sID="gen13429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5744"/>Tamquam aurum in fornace probavit illos, <l eID="gen13429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13430"/>et quasi holocausti hostiam accepit illos, <l eID="gen13430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13431"/>et in tempore erit respectus illorum. <l eID="gen13431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5745"/><l level="1" sID="gen13432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5745"/>Fulgebunt justi <l eID="gen13432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13433"/>et tamquam scintillæ in arundineto discurrent. <l eID="gen13433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5746"/><l level="1" sID="gen13434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5746"/>Judicabunt nationes, et dominabuntur populis, <l eID="gen13434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13435"/>et regnabit Dominus illorum in perpetuum. <l eID="gen13435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5747"/><l level="1" sID="gen13436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5747"/>Qui confidunt in illo intelligent veritatem, <l eID="gen13436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13437"/>et fideles in dilectione acquiescent illi, <l eID="gen13437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13438"/>quoniam donum et pax est electis ejus. <l eID="gen13438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5748"/><l level="1" sID="gen13439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5748"/>Impii autem secundum quæ cogitaverunt <l eID="gen13439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13440"/>correptionem habebunt : <l eID="gen13440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13441"/>qui neglexerunt justum, <l eID="gen13441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13442"/>et a Domino recesserunt. <l eID="gen13442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5749"/><l level="1" sID="gen13443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5749"/>Sapientiam enim et disciplinam qui abjicit infelix est : <l eID="gen13443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13444"/>et vacua est spes illorum, <l eID="gen13444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13445"/>et labores sine fructu, <l eID="gen13445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13446"/>et inutilia opera eorum. <l eID="gen13446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5750"/><l level="1" sID="gen13447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5750"/>Mulieres eorum insensatæ sunt, <l eID="gen13447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13448"/>et nequissimi filii eorum. <l eID="gen13448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5751"/><l level="1" sID="gen13449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5751"/>Maledicta creatura eorum, quoniam felix est sterilis ; <l eID="gen13449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13450"/>et incoinquinata, quæ nescivit thorum in delicto, <l eID="gen13450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13451"/>habebit fructum in respectione animarum sanctarum ; <l eID="gen13451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5752"/><l level="1" sID="gen13452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5752"/>et spado qui non operatus est per manus suas iniquitatem, <l eID="gen13452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13453"/>nec cogitavit adversus Deum nequissima : <l eID="gen13453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13454"/>dabitur enim illi fidei donum electum, <l eID="gen13454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13455"/>et sors in templo Dei acceptissima. <l eID="gen13455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5753"/><l level="1" sID="gen13456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5753"/>Bonorum enim laborum gloriosus est fructus, <l eID="gen13456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13457"/>et quæ non concidat radix sapientiæ. <l eID="gen13457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5754"/><l level="1" sID="gen13458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5754"/>Filii autem adulterorum in inconsummatione erunt, <l eID="gen13458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13459"/>et ab iniquo thoro semen exterminabitur. <l eID="gen13459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5755"/><l level="1" sID="gen13460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5755"/>Et si quidem longæ vitæ erunt, in nihilum computabuntur, <l eID="gen13460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13461"/>et sine honore erit novissima senectus illorum : <l eID="gen13461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5756"/><l level="1" sID="gen13462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5756"/>et si celerius defuncti fuerint, non habebunt spem, <l eID="gen13462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13463"/>nec in die agnitionis allocutionem. <l eID="gen13463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5757"/><l level="1" sID="gen13464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5757"/>Nationis enim iniquæ diræ sunt consummationes.  <chapter eID="Wis.3"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:1
verses.text: O quam pulchra est casta generatio, cum claritate ! <l eID="gen13465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13466"/>immortalis est enim memoria illius, <l eID="gen13466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13467"/>quoniam et apud Deum nota est, et apud homines. <l eID="gen13467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5758"/><l level="1" sID="gen13468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5758"/>Cum præsens est, imitantur illam, <l eID="gen13468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13469"/>et desiderant eam cum se eduxerit ; <l eID="gen13469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13470"/>et in perpetuum coronata triumphat, <l eID="gen13470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13471"/>incoinquinatorum certaminum præmium vincens. <l eID="gen13471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5759"/><l level="1" sID="gen13472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5759"/>Multigena autem impiorum multitudo non erit utilis, <l eID="gen13472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13473"/>et spuria vitulamina non dabunt radices altas, <l eID="gen13473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13474"/>nec stabile firmamentum collocabunt. <l eID="gen13474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5760"/><l level="1" sID="gen13475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5760"/>Etsi in ramis in tempore germinaverint, <l eID="gen13475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13476"/>infirmiter posita, a vento commovebuntur, <l eID="gen13476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13477"/>et a nimietate ventorum eradicabuntur. <l eID="gen13477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5761"/><l level="1" sID="gen13478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5761"/>Confringentur enim rami inconsummati ; <l eID="gen13478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13479"/>et fructus illorum inutiles et acerbi ad manducandum, <l eID="gen13479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13480"/>et ad nihilum apti. <l eID="gen13480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5762"/><l level="1" sID="gen13481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5762"/>Ex iniquis enim somnis filii qui nascuntur, <l eID="gen13481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13482"/>testes sunt nequitiæ adversus parentes in interrogatione sua. <l eID="gen13482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5763"/><l level="1" sID="gen13483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5763"/>Justus autem si morte præoccupatus fuerit, <l eID="gen13483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13484"/>in refrigerio erit ; <l eID="gen13484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5764"/><l level="1" sID="gen13485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5764"/>senectus enim venerabilis est non diuturna, <l eID="gen13485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13486"/>neque annorum numero computata : <l eID="gen13486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13487"/>cani autem sunt sensus hominis, <l eID="gen13487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5765"/><l level="1" sID="gen13488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5765"/>et ætas senectutis vita immaculata. <l eID="gen13488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5766"/><l level="1" sID="gen13489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5766"/>Placens Deo factus est dilectus, <l eID="gen13489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13490"/>et vivens inter peccatores translatus est. <l eID="gen13490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5767"/><l level="1" sID="gen13491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5767"/>Raptus est, ne malitia mutaret intellectum ejus, <l eID="gen13491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13492"/>aut ne fictio deciperet animam illius. <l eID="gen13492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5768"/><l level="1" sID="gen13493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5768"/>Fascinatio enim nugacitatis obscurat bona, <l eID="gen13493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13494"/>et inconstantia concupiscentiæ transvertit sensum sine malitia. <l eID="gen13494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5769"/><l level="1" sID="gen13495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5769"/>Consummatus in brevi, <l eID="gen13495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13496"/>explevit tempora multa ; <l eID="gen13496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5770"/><l level="1" sID="gen13497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5770"/>placita enim erat Deo anima illius : <l eID="gen13497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13498"/>propter hoc properavit educere illum de medio iniquitatum. <l eID="gen13498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13499"/>Populi autem videntes, et non intelligentes, <l eID="gen13499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13500"/>nec ponentes in præcordiis talia, <l eID="gen13500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5771"/><l level="1" sID="gen13501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5771"/>quoniam gratia Dei et misericordia est in sanctos ejus, <l eID="gen13501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13502"/>et respectus in electos illius. <l eID="gen13502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5772"/><l level="1" sID="gen13503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5772"/>Condemnat autem justus mortuus vivos impios, <l eID="gen13503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13504"/>et juventus celerius consummata longam vitam injusti. <l eID="gen13504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5773"/><l level="1" sID="gen13505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5773"/>Videbunt enim finem sapientis, <l eID="gen13505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13506"/>et non intelligent quid cogitaverit de illo Deus, <l eID="gen13506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13507"/>et quare munierit illum Dominus. <l eID="gen13507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5774"/><l level="1" sID="gen13508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5774"/>Videbunt, et contemnent eum ; <l eID="gen13508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13509"/>illos autem Dominus irridebit. <l eID="gen13509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5775"/><l level="1" sID="gen13510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5775"/>Et erunt post hæc decidentes sine honore, <l eID="gen13510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13511"/>et in contumelia inter mortuos in perpetuum : <l eID="gen13511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13512"/>quoniam disrumpet illos inflatos sine voce, <l eID="gen13512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13513"/>et commovebit illos a fundamentis, <l eID="gen13513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13514"/>et usque ad supremum desolabuntur, <l eID="gen13514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13515"/>et erunt gementes, et memoria illorum peribit. <l eID="gen13515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5776"/><l level="1" sID="gen13516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5776"/>Venient in cogitatione peccatorum suorum timidi, <l eID="gen13516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13517"/>et traducent illos ex adverso iniquitates ipsorum.  <chapter eID="Wis.4"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:1
verses.text: Tunc stabunt justi in magna constantia <l eID="gen13518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13519"/>adversus eos qui se angustiaverunt, <l eID="gen13519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13520"/>et qui abstulerunt labores eorum. <l eID="gen13520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5777"/><l level="1" sID="gen13521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5777"/>Videntes turbabuntur timore horribili, <l eID="gen13521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13522"/>et mirabuntur in subitatione insperatæ salutis ; <l eID="gen13522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5778"/><l level="1" sID="gen13523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5778"/>dicentes intra se, pœnitentiam agentes, <l eID="gen13523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13524"/>et præ angustia spiritus gementes : <l eID="gen13524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13525"/>Hi sunt quos habuimus aliquando in derisum, <l eID="gen13525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13526"/>et in similitudinem improperii. <l eID="gen13526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5779"/><l level="1" sID="gen13527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5779"/>Nos insensati, vitam illorum æstimabamus insaniam, <l eID="gen13527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13528"/>et finem illorum sine honore ; <l eID="gen13528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5780"/><l level="1" sID="gen13529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5780"/>ecce quomodo computati sunt inter filios Dei, <l eID="gen13529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13530"/>et inter sanctos sors illorum est. <l eID="gen13530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5781"/><l level="1" sID="gen13531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5781"/>Ergo erravimus a via veritatis, <l eID="gen13531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13532"/>et justitiæ lumen non luxit nobis, <l eID="gen13532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13533"/>et sol intelligentiæ non est ortus nobis. <l eID="gen13533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5782"/><l level="1" sID="gen13534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5782"/>Lassati sumus in via iniquitatis et perditionis, <l eID="gen13534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13535"/>et ambulavimus vias difficiles : <l eID="gen13535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13536"/>viam autem Domini ignoravimus. <l eID="gen13536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5783"/><l level="1" sID="gen13537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5783"/>Quid nobis profuit superbia ? <l eID="gen13537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13538"/>aut divitiarum jactantia quid contulit nobis ? <l eID="gen13538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5784"/><l level="1" sID="gen13539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5784"/>Transierunt omnia illa tamquam umbra, <l eID="gen13539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13540"/>et tamquam nuntius percurrens, <l eID="gen13540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5785"/><l level="1" sID="gen13541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5785"/>et tamquam navis quæ pertransit fluctuantem aquam, <l eID="gen13541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13542"/>cujus cum præterierit non est vestigium invenire, <l eID="gen13542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13543"/>neque semitam carinæ illius in fluctibus ; <l eID="gen13543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5786"/><l level="1" sID="gen13544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5786"/>aut tamquam avis quæ transvolat in aëre, <l eID="gen13544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13545"/>cujus nullum invenitur argumentum itineris, <l eID="gen13545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13546"/>sed tantum sonitus alarum verberans levem ventum, <l eID="gen13546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13547"/>et scindens per vim itineris aërem : <l eID="gen13547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13548"/>commotis alis transvolavit, <l eID="gen13548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13549"/>et post hoc nullum signum invenitur itineris illius ; <l eID="gen13549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5787"/><l level="1" sID="gen13550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5787"/>aut tamquam sagitta emissa in locum destinatum, <l eID="gen13550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13551"/>divisus aër continuo in se reclusus est, <l eID="gen13551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13552"/>ut ignoretur transitus illius : <l eID="gen13552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5788"/><l level="1" sID="gen13553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5788"/>sic et nos nati continuo desivimus esse ; <l eID="gen13553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13554"/>et virtutis quidem nullum signum valuimus ostendere, <l eID="gen13554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13555"/>in malignitate autem nostra consumpti sumus. <l eID="gen13555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5789"/><l level="1" sID="gen13556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5789"/>Talia dixerunt in inferno hi qui peccaverunt : <l eID="gen13556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5790"/><l level="1" sID="gen13557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5790"/>quoniam spes impii tamquam lanugo est quæ a vento tollitur, <l eID="gen13557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13558"/>et tamquam spuma gracilis quæ a procella dispergitur, <l eID="gen13558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13559"/>et tamquam fumus qui a vento diffusus est, <l eID="gen13559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13560"/>et tamquam memoria hospitis unius diei prætereuntis. <l eID="gen13560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5791"/><l level="1" sID="gen13561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5791"/>Justi autem in perpetuum vivent, <l eID="gen13561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13562"/>et apud Dominum est merces eorum, <l eID="gen13562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13563"/>et cogitatio illorum apud Altissimum. <l eID="gen13563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5792"/><l level="1" sID="gen13564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5792"/>Ideo accipient regnum decoris, <l eID="gen13564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13565"/>et diadema speciei de manu Domini : <l eID="gen13565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13566"/>quoniam dextera sua teget eos, <l eID="gen13566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13567"/>et brachio sancto suo defendet illos. <l eID="gen13567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5793"/><l level="1" sID="gen13568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5793"/>Accipiet armaturam zelus illius, <l eID="gen13568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13569"/>et armabit creaturam ad ultionem inimicorum. <l eID="gen13569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5794"/><l level="1" sID="gen13570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5794"/>Induet pro thorace justitiam, <l eID="gen13570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13571"/>et accipiet pro galea judicium certum ; <l eID="gen13571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5795"/><l level="1" sID="gen13572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5795"/>sumet scutum inexpugnabile æquitatem. <l eID="gen13572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5796"/><l level="1" sID="gen13573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5796"/>Acuet autem duram iram in lanceam, <l eID="gen13573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13574"/>et pugnabit cum illo orbis terrarum contra insensatos. <l eID="gen13574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5797"/><l level="1" sID="gen13575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5797"/>Ibunt directe emissiones fulgurum, <l eID="gen13575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13576"/>et tamquam a bene curvato arcu nubium exterminabuntur, <l eID="gen13576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13577"/>et ad certum locum insilient. <l eID="gen13577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5798"/><l level="1" sID="gen13578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5798"/>Et a petrosa ira plenæ mittentur grandines ; <l eID="gen13578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13579"/>excandescet in illos aqua maris, <l eID="gen13579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13580"/>et flumina concurrent duriter. <l eID="gen13580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5799"/><l level="1" sID="gen13581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5799"/>Contra illos stabit spiritus virtutis, <l eID="gen13581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13582"/>et tamquam turbo venti dividet illos ; <l eID="gen13582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13583"/>et ad eremum perducet omnem terram iniquitas illorum, <l eID="gen13583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13584"/>et malignitas evertet sedes potentium.  <chapter eID="Wis.5"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:1
verses.text: Melior est sapientia quam vires, <l eID="gen13585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13586"/>et vir prudens quam fortis. <l eID="gen13586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5800"/><l level="1" sID="gen13587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5800"/>Audite ergo, reges, et intelligite ; <l eID="gen13587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13588"/>discite, judices finium terræ. <l eID="gen13588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5801"/><l level="1" sID="gen13589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5801"/>Præbete aures, vos qui continetis multitudines, <l eID="gen13589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13590"/>et placetis vobis in turbis nationum. <l eID="gen13590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5802"/><l level="1" sID="gen13591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5802"/>Quoniam data est a Domino potestas vobis, <l eID="gen13591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13592"/>et virtus ab Altissimo : <l eID="gen13592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13593"/>qui interrogabit opera vestra, et cogitationes scrutabitur. <l eID="gen13593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5803"/><l level="1" sID="gen13594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5803"/>Quoniam cum essetis ministri regni illius, <l eID="gen13594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13595"/>non recte judicastis, nec custodistis legem justitiæ, <l eID="gen13595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13596"/>neque secundum voluntatem Dei ambulastis. <l eID="gen13596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5804"/><l level="1" sID="gen13597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5804"/>Horrende et cito apparebit vobis, <l eID="gen13597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13598"/>quoniam judicium durissimum his qui præsunt fiet. <l eID="gen13598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5805"/><l level="1" sID="gen13599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5805"/>Exiguo enim conceditur misericordia ; <l eID="gen13599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13600"/>potentes autem potenter tormenta patientur. <l eID="gen13600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5806"/><l level="1" sID="gen13601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5806"/>Non enim subtrahet personam cujusquam Deus, <l eID="gen13601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13602"/>nec verebitur magnitudinem ejus cujusquam, <l eID="gen13602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13603"/>quoniam pusillum et magnum ipse fecit, <l eID="gen13603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13604"/>et æqualiter cura est illi de omnibus. <l eID="gen13604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5807"/><l level="1" sID="gen13605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5807"/>Fortioribus autem fortior instat cruciatio. <l eID="gen13605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5808"/><l level="1" sID="gen13606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5808"/>Ad vos ergo, reges, sunt hi sermones mei : <l eID="gen13606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13607"/>ut discatis sapientiam, et non excidatis. <l eID="gen13607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5809"/><l level="1" sID="gen13608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5809"/>Qui enim custodierint justa juste, justificabuntur ; <l eID="gen13608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13609"/>et qui didicerint ista, invenient quid respondeant. <l eID="gen13609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5810"/><l level="1" sID="gen13610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5810"/>Concupiscite ergo sermones meos ; <l eID="gen13610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13611"/>diligite illos, et habebitis disciplinam. <l eID="gen13611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5811"/><l level="1" sID="gen13612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5811"/>Clara est, et quæ numquam marcescit, sapientia : <l eID="gen13612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13613"/>et facile videtur ab his qui diligunt eam, <l eID="gen13613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13614"/>et invenitur ab his qui quærunt illam. <l eID="gen13614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5812"/><l level="1" sID="gen13615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5812"/>Præoccupat qui se concupiscunt, <l eID="gen13615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13616"/>ut illis se prior ostendat. <l eID="gen13616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5813"/><l level="1" sID="gen13617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5813"/>Qui de luce vigilaverit ad illam non laborabit ; <l eID="gen13617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13618"/>assidentem enim illam foribus suis inveniet. <l eID="gen13618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5814"/><l level="1" sID="gen13619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5814"/>Cogitare ergo de illa sensus est consummatus, <l eID="gen13619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13620"/>et qui vigilaverit propter illam cito securus erit. <l eID="gen13620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5815"/><l level="1" sID="gen13621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5815"/>Quoniam dignos se ipsa circuit quærens, <l eID="gen13621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13622"/>et in viis ostendit se hilariter, <l eID="gen13622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13623"/>et in omni providentia occurrit illis. <l eID="gen13623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5816"/><l level="1" sID="gen13624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5816"/>Initium enim illius verissima est disciplinæ concupiscentia. <l eID="gen13624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5817"/><l level="1" sID="gen13625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5817"/>Cura ergo disciplinæ dilectio est, <l eID="gen13625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13626"/>et dilectio custodia legum illius est ; <l eID="gen13626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13627"/>custoditio autem legum consummatio incorruptionis est ; <l eID="gen13627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5818"/><l level="1" sID="gen13628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5818"/>incorruptio autem facit esse proximum Deo. <l eID="gen13628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5819"/><l level="1" sID="gen13629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5819"/>Concupiscentia itaque sapientiæ deducit ad regnum perpetuum. <l eID="gen13629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5820"/><l level="1" sID="gen13630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5820"/>Si ergo delectamini sedibus et sceptris, o reges populi, <l eID="gen13630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13631"/>diligite sapientiam, ut in perpetuum regnetis : <l eID="gen13631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5821"/><l level="1" sID="gen13632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5821"/>diligite lumen sapientiæ, omnes qui præestis populis. <l eID="gen13632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5822"/><l level="1" sID="gen13633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5822"/>Quid est autem sapientia, et quemadmodum facta sit, referam, <l eID="gen13633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13634"/>et non abscondam a vobis sacramenta Dei : <l eID="gen13634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13635"/>sed ab initio nativitatis investigabo, <l eID="gen13635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13636"/>et ponam in lucem scientiam illius, <l eID="gen13636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13637"/>et non præteribo veritatem. <l eID="gen13637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5823"/><l level="1" sID="gen13638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5823"/>Neque cum invidia tabescente iter habebo, <l eID="gen13638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13639"/>quoniam talis homo non erit particeps sapientiæ. <l eID="gen13639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5824"/><l level="1" sID="gen13640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5824"/>Multitudo autem sapientium sanitas est orbis terrarum, <l eID="gen13640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13641"/>et rex sapiens stabilimentum populi est. <l eID="gen13641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5825"/><l level="1" sID="gen13642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5825"/>Ergo accipite disciplinam per sermones meos, <l eID="gen13642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13643"/>et proderit vobis.  <chapter eID="Wis.6"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:1
verses.text: Sum quidem et ego mortalis homo, similis omnibus, <l eID="gen13644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13645"/>et ex genere terreni illius qui prior factus est : <l eID="gen13645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13646"/>et in ventre matris figuratus sum caro ; <l eID="gen13646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5826"/><l level="1" sID="gen13647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5826"/>decem mensium tempore coagulatus sum in sanguine : <l eID="gen13647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13648"/>ex semine hominis, et delectamento somni conveniente. <l eID="gen13648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5827"/><l level="1" sID="gen13649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5827"/>Et ego natus accepi communem aërem, <l eID="gen13649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13650"/>et in similiter factam decidi terram, <l eID="gen13650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13651"/>et primam vocem similem omnibus emisi plorans. <l eID="gen13651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5828"/><l level="1" sID="gen13652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5828"/>In involumentis nutritus sum, et curis magnis : <l eID="gen13652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5829"/><l level="1" sID="gen13653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5829"/>nemo enim ex regibus aliud habuit nativitatis initium. <l eID="gen13653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5830"/><l level="1" sID="gen13654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5830"/>Unus ergo introitus est omnibus ad vitam, <l eID="gen13654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13655"/>et similis exitus. <l eID="gen13655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:7
