verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5831"/><l level="1" sID="gen13656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5831"/>Propter hoc optavi, et datus est mihi sensus ; <l eID="gen13656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13657"/>et invocavi, et venit in me spiritus sapientiæ : <l eID="gen13657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5832"/><l level="1" sID="gen13658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5832"/>et præposui illam regnis et sedibus, <l eID="gen13658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13659"/>et divitias nihil esse duxi in comparatione illius. <l eID="gen13659" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5833"/><l level="1" sID="gen13660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5833"/>Nec comparavi illi lapidem pretiosum, <l eID="gen13660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13661"/>quoniam omne aurum in comparatione illius arena est exigua, <l eID="gen13661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13662"/>et tamquam lutum æstimabitur argentum in conspectu illius. <l eID="gen13662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5834"/><l level="1" sID="gen13663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5834"/>Super salutem et speciem dilexi illam, <l eID="gen13663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13664"/>et proposui pro luce habere illam, <l eID="gen13664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13665"/>quoniam inextinguibile est lumen illius. <l eID="gen13665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5835"/><l level="1" sID="gen13666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5835"/>Venerunt autem mihi omnia bona pariter cum illa, <l eID="gen13666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13667"/>et innumerabilis honestas per manus illius ; <l eID="gen13667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5836"/><l level="1" sID="gen13668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5836"/>et lætatus sum in omnibus, <l eID="gen13668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13669"/>quoniam antecedebat me ista sapientia, <l eID="gen13669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13670"/>et ignorabam quoniam horum omnium mater est. <l eID="gen13670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5837"/><l level="1" sID="gen13671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5837"/>Quam sine fictione didici, <l eID="gen13671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13672"/>et sine invidia communico, <l eID="gen13672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13673"/>et honestatem illius non abscondo. <l eID="gen13673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5838"/><l level="1" sID="gen13674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5838"/>Infinitus enim thesaurus est hominibus ; <l eID="gen13674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13675"/>quo qui usi sunt, participes facti sunt amicitiæ Dei, <l eID="gen13675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13676"/>propter disciplinæ dona commendati. <l eID="gen13676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5839"/><l level="1" sID="gen13677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5839"/>Mihi autem dedit Deus dicere ex sententia, <l eID="gen13677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13678"/>et præsumere digna horum quæ mihi dantur : <l eID="gen13678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13679"/>quoniam ipse sapientiæ dux est, <l eID="gen13679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13680"/>et sapientium emendator. <l eID="gen13680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5840"/><l level="1" sID="gen13681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5840"/>In manu enim illius et nos et sermones nostri, <l eID="gen13681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13682"/>et omnis sapientia, et operum scientia, et disciplina. <l eID="gen13682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5841"/><l level="1" sID="gen13683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5841"/>Ipse enim dedit mihi horum quæ sunt scientiam veram, <l eID="gen13683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13684"/>ut sciam dispositionem orbis terrarum, et virtutes elementorum, <l eID="gen13684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5842"/><l level="1" sID="gen13685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5842"/>initium, et consummationem, et medietatem temporum, <l eID="gen13685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13686"/>vicissitudinum permutationes, et commutationes temporum, <l eID="gen13686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5843"/><l level="1" sID="gen13687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5843"/>anni cursus, et stellarum dispositiones, <l eID="gen13687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5844"/><l level="1" sID="gen13688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5844"/>naturas animalium, et iras bestiarum, <l eID="gen13688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13689"/>vim ventorum, et cogitationes hominum, <l eID="gen13689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13690"/>differentias virgultorum, et virtutes radicum. <l eID="gen13690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5845"/><l level="1" sID="gen13691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5845"/>Et quæcumque sunt absconsa et improvisa didici : <l eID="gen13691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13692"/>omnium enim artifex docuit me sapientia. <l eID="gen13692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5846"/><l level="1" sID="gen13693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5846"/>Est enim in illa spiritus intelligentiæ, <l eID="gen13693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13694"/>sanctus, unicus, multiplex, subtilis, <l eID="gen13694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13695"/>disertus, mobilis, incoinquinatus, certus, <l eID="gen13695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13696"/>suavis, amans bonum, acutus, <l eID="gen13696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13697"/>quem nihil vetat, benefaciens, <l eID="gen13697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5847"/><l level="1" sID="gen13698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5847"/>humanus, benignus, stabilis, certus, securus, <l eID="gen13698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13699"/>omnem habens virtutem, omnia prospiciens, <l eID="gen13699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13700"/>et qui capiat omnes spiritus, <l eID="gen13700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13701"/>intelligibilis, mundus, subtilis. <l eID="gen13701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5848"/><l level="1" sID="gen13702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5848"/>Omnibus enim mobilibus mobilior est sapientia : <l eID="gen13702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13703"/>attingit autem ubique propter suam munditiam. <l eID="gen13703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5849"/><l level="1" sID="gen13704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5849"/>Vapor est enim virtutis Dei, <l eID="gen13704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13705"/>et emanatio quædam est claritatis omnipotentis Dei sincera, <l eID="gen13705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13706"/>et ideo nihil inquinatum in eam incurrit : <l eID="gen13706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5850"/><l level="1" sID="gen13707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5850"/>candor est enim lucis æternæ, <l eID="gen13707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13708"/>et speculum sine macula Dei majestatis, <l eID="gen13708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13709"/>et imago bonitatis illius. <l eID="gen13709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5851"/><l level="1" sID="gen13710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5851"/>Et cum sit una, omnia potest ; <l eID="gen13710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13711"/>et in se permanens omnia innovat : <l eID="gen13711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13712"/>et per nationes in animas sanctas se transfert ; <l eID="gen13712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13713"/>amicos Dei et prophetas constituit. <l eID="gen13713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5852"/><l level="1" sID="gen13714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5852"/>Neminem enim diligit Deus, <l eID="gen13714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13715"/>nisi eum qui cum sapientia inhabitat. <l eID="gen13715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5853"/><l level="1" sID="gen13716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5853"/>Est enim hæc speciosior sole, <l eID="gen13716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13717"/>et super omnem dispositionem stellarum : <l eID="gen13717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13718"/>luci comparata, invenitur prior. <l eID="gen13718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5854"/><l level="1" sID="gen13719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5854"/>Illi enim succedit nox ; <l eID="gen13719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13720"/>sapientiam autem non vincit malitia.  <chapter eID="Wis.7"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:1
verses.text: Attingit ergo a fine usque ad finem fortiter, <l eID="gen13721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13722"/>et disponit omnia suaviter. <l eID="gen13722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5855"/><l level="1" sID="gen13723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5855"/>Hanc amavi, et exquisivi a juventute mea, <l eID="gen13723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13724"/>et quæsivi sponsam mihi eam assumere, <l eID="gen13724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13725"/>et amator factus sum formæ illius. <l eID="gen13725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5856"/><l level="1" sID="gen13726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5856"/>Generositatem illius glorificat, <l eID="gen13726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13727"/>contubernium habens Dei ; <l eID="gen13727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13728"/>sed et omnium Dominus dilexit illam. <l eID="gen13728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5857"/><l level="1" sID="gen13729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5857"/>Doctrix enim est disciplinæ Dei, <l eID="gen13729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13730"/>et electrix operum illius. <l eID="gen13730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5858"/><l level="1" sID="gen13731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5858"/>Et si divitiæ appetuntur in vita, <l eID="gen13731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13732"/>quid sapientia locupletius quæ operatur omnia ? <l eID="gen13732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5859"/><l level="1" sID="gen13733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5859"/>Si autem sensus operatur, <l eID="gen13733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13734"/>quis horum quæ sunt magis quam illa est artifex ? <l eID="gen13734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5860"/><l level="1" sID="gen13735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5860"/>Et si justitiam quis diligit, <l eID="gen13735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13736"/>labores hujus magnas habent virtutes : <l eID="gen13736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13737"/>sobrietatem enim et prudentiam docet, <l eID="gen13737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13738"/>et justitiam, et virtutem, <l eID="gen13738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13739"/>quibus utilius nihil est in vita hominibus. <l eID="gen13739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5861"/><l level="1" sID="gen13740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5861"/>Et si multitudinem scientiæ desiderat quis, <l eID="gen13740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13741"/>scit præterita, et de futuris æstimat ; <l eID="gen13741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13742"/>scit versutias sermonum, et dissolutiones argumentorum ; <l eID="gen13742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13743"/>signa et monstra scit antequam fiant, <l eID="gen13743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13744"/>et eventus temporum et sæculorum. <l eID="gen13744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5862"/><l level="1" sID="gen13745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5862"/>Proposui ergo hanc adducere mihi ad convivendum, <l eID="gen13745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13746"/>sciens quoniam mecum communicabit de bonis, <l eID="gen13746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13747"/>et erit allocutio cogitationis et tædii mei. <l eID="gen13747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5863"/><l level="1" sID="gen13748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5863"/>Habebo propter hanc claritatem ad turbas, <l eID="gen13748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13749"/>et honorem apud seniores juvenis ; <l eID="gen13749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5864"/><l level="1" sID="gen13750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5864"/>et acutus inveniar in judicio, <l eID="gen13750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13751"/>et in conspectu potentium admirabilis ero, <l eID="gen13751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13752"/>et facies principum mirabuntur me : <l eID="gen13752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5865"/><l level="1" sID="gen13753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5865"/>tacentem me sustinebunt, <l eID="gen13753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13754"/>et loquentem me respicient, <l eID="gen13754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13755"/>et sermocinante me plura, manus ori suo imponent. <l eID="gen13755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5866"/><l level="1" sID="gen13756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5866"/>Præterea habebo per hanc immortalitatem, <l eID="gen13756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13757"/>et memoriam æternam his qui post me futuri sunt relinquam. <l eID="gen13757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5867"/><l level="1" sID="gen13758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5867"/>Disponam populos, <l eID="gen13758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13759"/>et nationes mihi erunt subditæ : <l eID="gen13759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5868"/><l level="1" sID="gen13760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5868"/>timebunt me audientes reges horrendi. <l eID="gen13760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13761"/>In multitudine videbor bonus, <l eID="gen13761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13762"/>et in bello fortis. <l eID="gen13762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5869"/><l level="1" sID="gen13763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5869"/>Intrans in domum meam, conquiescam cum illa : <l eID="gen13763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13764"/>non enim habet amaritudinem conversatio illius, <l eID="gen13764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13765"/>nec tædium convictus illius, <l eID="gen13765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13766"/>sed lætitiam et gaudium. <l eID="gen13766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5870"/><l level="1" sID="gen13767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5870"/>Hæc cogitans apud me <l eID="gen13767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13768"/>et commemorans in corde meo, <l eID="gen13768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13769"/>quoniam immortalitas est in cognatione sapientiæ, <l eID="gen13769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5871"/><l level="1" sID="gen13770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5871"/>et in amicitia illius delectatio bona, <l eID="gen13770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13771"/>et in operibus manuum illius honestas sine defectione, <l eID="gen13771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13772"/>et in certamine loquelæ illius sapientia, <l eID="gen13772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13773"/>et præclaritas in communicatione sermonum ipsius : <l eID="gen13773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13774"/>circuibam quærens, ut mihi illam assumerem. <l eID="gen13774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5872"/><l level="1" sID="gen13775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5872"/>Puer autem eram ingeniosus, <l eID="gen13775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13776"/>et sortitus sum animam bonam. <l eID="gen13776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5873"/><l level="1" sID="gen13777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5873"/>Et cum essem magis bonus, <l eID="gen13777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13778"/>veni ad corpus incoinquinatum. <l eID="gen13778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5874"/><l level="1" sID="gen13779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5874"/>Et ut scivi quoniam aliter non possem esse continens, nisi Deus det ; <l eID="gen13779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13780"/>et hoc ipsum erat sapientiæ, scire cujus esset hoc donum : <l eID="gen13780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13781"/>adii Dominum, et deprecatus sum illum, <l eID="gen13781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13782"/>et dixi ex totis præcordiis meis :  <chapter eID="Wis.8"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:1
verses.text: Deus patrum meorum, et Domine misericordiæ, <l eID="gen13783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13784"/>qui fecisti omnia verbo tuo, <l eID="gen13784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5875"/><l level="1" sID="gen13785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5875"/>et sapientia tua constituisti hominem, <l eID="gen13785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13786"/>ut dominaretur creaturæ quæ a te facta est, <l eID="gen13786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5876"/><l level="1" sID="gen13787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5876"/>ut disponat orbem terrarum in æquitate et justitia, <l eID="gen13787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13788"/>et in directione cordis judicium judicet : <l eID="gen13788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5877"/><l level="1" sID="gen13789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5877"/>da mihi sedium tuarum assistricem sapientiam, <l eID="gen13789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13790"/>et noli me reprobare a pueris tuis : <l eID="gen13790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5878"/><l level="1" sID="gen13791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5878"/>quoniam servus tuus sum ego, et filius ancillæ tuæ ; <l eID="gen13791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13792"/>homo infirmus, et exigui temporis, <l eID="gen13792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13793"/>et minor ad intellectum judicii et legum. <l eID="gen13793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5879"/><l level="1" sID="gen13794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5879"/>Nam etsi quis erit consummatus inter filios hominum, <l eID="gen13794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13795"/>si ab illo abfuerit sapientia tua, in nihilum computabitur. <l eID="gen13795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5880"/><l level="1" sID="gen13796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5880"/>Tu elegisti me regem populo tuo, <l eID="gen13796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13797"/>et judicem filiorum tuorum et filiarum : <l eID="gen13797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5881"/><l level="1" sID="gen13798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5881"/>et dixisti me ædificare templum in monte sancto tuo, <l eID="gen13798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13799"/>et in civitate habitationis tuæ altare : <l eID="gen13799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13800"/>similitudinem tabernaculi sancti tui quod præparasti ab initio. <l eID="gen13800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5882"/><l level="1" sID="gen13801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5882"/>Et tecum sapientia tua, quæ novit opera tua, <l eID="gen13801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13802"/>quæ et affuit tunc cum orbem terrarum faceres, <l eID="gen13802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13803"/>et sciebat quid esset placitum oculis tuis, <l eID="gen13803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13804"/>et quid directum in præceptis tuis. <l eID="gen13804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5883"/><l level="1" sID="gen13805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5883"/>Mitte illam de cælis sanctis tuis, <l eID="gen13805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13806"/>et a sede magnitudinis tuæ, <l eID="gen13806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13807"/>ut mecum sit et mecum laboret, <l eID="gen13807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13808"/>ut sciam quid acceptum sit apud te : <l eID="gen13808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5884"/><l level="1" sID="gen13809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5884"/>scit enim illa omnia, et intelligit, <l eID="gen13809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13810"/>et deducet me in operibus meis sobrie, <l eID="gen13810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13811"/>et custodiet me in sua potentia. <l eID="gen13811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5885"/><l level="1" sID="gen13812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5885"/>Et erunt accepta opera mea, <l eID="gen13812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13813"/>et disponam populum tuum juste, <l eID="gen13813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13814"/>et ero dignus sedium patris mei. <l eID="gen13814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5886"/><l level="1" sID="gen13815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5886"/>Quis enim hominum poterit scire consilium Dei ? <l eID="gen13815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13816"/>aut quis poterit cogitare quid velit Deus ? <l eID="gen13816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5887"/><l level="1" sID="gen13817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5887"/>Cogitationes enim mortalium timidæ, <l eID="gen13817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13818"/>et incertæ providentiæ nostræ ; <l eID="gen13818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5888"/><l level="1" sID="gen13819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5888"/>corpus enim quod corrumpitur aggravat animam, <l eID="gen13819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13820"/>et terrena inhabitatio deprimit sensum multa cogitantem. <l eID="gen13820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5889"/><l level="1" sID="gen13821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5889"/>Et difficile æstimamus quæ in terra sunt, <l eID="gen13821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13822"/>et quæ in prospectu sunt invenimus cum labore : <l eID="gen13822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13823"/>quæ autem in cælis sunt, quis investigabit ? <l eID="gen13823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5890"/><l level="1" sID="gen13824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5890"/>Sensum autem tuum, quis sciet, nisi tu dederis sapientiam, <l eID="gen13824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13825"/>et miseris spiritum sanctum tuum de altissimis, <l eID="gen13825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5891"/><l level="1" sID="gen13826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5891"/>et sic correctæ sint semitæ eorum qui sunt in terris, <l eID="gen13826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13827"/>et quæ tibi placent didicerint homines ? <l eID="gen13827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5892"/><l level="1" sID="gen13828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5892"/>Nam per sapientiam sanati sunt <l eID="gen13828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13829"/>quicumque placuerunt tibi, Domine, a principio.  <chapter eID="Wis.9"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:1
verses.text: Hæc illum qui primus formatus est a Deo patre orbis terrarum, <l eID="gen13830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13831"/>cum solus esset creatus, custodivit, <l eID="gen13831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5893"/><l level="1" sID="gen13832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5893"/>et eduxit illum a delicto suo, <l eID="gen13832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13833"/>et dedit illi virtutem continendi omnia. <l eID="gen13833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5894"/><l level="1" sID="gen13834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5894"/>Ab hac ut recessit injustus in ira sua, <l eID="gen13834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13835"/>per iram homicidii fraterni deperiit. <l eID="gen13835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5895"/><l level="1" sID="gen13836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5895"/>Propter quem cum aqua deleret terram, sanavit iterum sapientia, <l eID="gen13836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13837"/>per contemptibile lignum justum gubernans. <l eID="gen13837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5896"/><l level="1" sID="gen13838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5896"/>Hæc et in consensu nequitiæ, cum se nationes contulissent, <l eID="gen13838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13839"/>scivit justum, et conservavit sine querela Deo, <l eID="gen13839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13840"/>et in filii misericordia fortem custodivit. <l eID="gen13840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5897"/><l level="1" sID="gen13841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5897"/>Hæc justum a pereuntibus impiis liberavit fugientem, <l eID="gen13841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13842"/>descendente igne in Pentapolim : <l eID="gen13842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5898"/><l level="1" sID="gen13843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5898"/>quibus in testimonium nequitiæ <l eID="gen13843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13844"/>fumigabunda constat deserta terra, <l eID="gen13844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13845"/>et incerto tempore fructus habentes arbores : <l eID="gen13845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13846"/>et incredibilis animæ memoria stans figmentum salis. <l eID="gen13846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5899"/><l level="1" sID="gen13847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5899"/>Sapientiam enim prætereuntes, <l eID="gen13847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13848"/>non tantum in hoc lapsi sunt ut ignorarent bona, <l eID="gen13848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13849"/>sed et insipientiæ suæ reliquerunt hominibus memoriam, <l eID="gen13849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13850"/>ut in his quæ peccaverunt nec latere potuissent. <l eID="gen13850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5900"/><l level="1" sID="gen13851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5900"/>Sapientia autem hos qui se observant <l eID="gen13851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13852"/>a doloribus liberavit. <l eID="gen13852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5901"/><l level="1" sID="gen13853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5901"/>Hæc profugum iræ fratris justum deduxit per vias rectas, <l eID="gen13853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13854"/>et ostendit illi regnum Dei, <l eID="gen13854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13855"/>et dedit illi scientiam sanctorum ; <l eID="gen13855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13856"/>honestavit illum in laboribus, <l eID="gen13856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13857"/>et complevit labores illius. <l eID="gen13857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5902"/><l level="1" sID="gen13858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5902"/>In fraude circumvenientium illum affuit illi, <l eID="gen13858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13859"/>et honestum fecit illum. <l eID="gen13859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5903"/><l level="1" sID="gen13860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5903"/>Custodivit illum ab inimicis, <l eID="gen13860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13861"/>et a seductoribus tutavit illum : <l eID="gen13861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13862"/>et certamen forte dedit illi ut vinceret, <l eID="gen13862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13863"/>et sciret quoniam omnium potentior est sapientia. <l eID="gen13863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5904"/><l level="1" sID="gen13864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5904"/>Hæc venditum justum non dereliquit, <l eID="gen13864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13865"/>sed a peccatoribus liberavit eum ; <l eID="gen13865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13866"/>descenditque cum illo in foveam, <l eID="gen13866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5905"/><l level="1" sID="gen13867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5905"/>et in vinculis non dereliquit illum, <l eID="gen13867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13868"/>donec afferret illi sceptrum regni, <l eID="gen13868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13869"/>et potentiam adversus eos qui eum deprimebant : <l eID="gen13869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13870"/>et mendaces ostendit qui maculaverunt illum, <l eID="gen13870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13871"/>et dedit illi claritatem æternam. <l eID="gen13871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5906"/><l level="1" sID="gen13872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5906"/>Hæc populum justum et semen sine querela liberavit <l eID="gen13872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13873"/>a nationibus quæ illum deprimebant. <l eID="gen13873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5907"/><l level="1" sID="gen13874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5907"/>Intravit in animam servi Dei, <l eID="gen13874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13875"/>et stetit contra reges horrendos in portentis et signis. <l eID="gen13875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5908"/><l level="1" sID="gen13876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5908"/>Et reddidit justis mercedem laborum suorum, <l eID="gen13876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13877"/>et deduxit illos in via mirabili : <l eID="gen13877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13878"/>et fuit illis in velamento diei, <l eID="gen13878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13879"/>et in luce stellarum per noctem ; <l eID="gen13879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5909"/><l level="1" sID="gen13880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5909"/>transtulit illos per mare Rubrum, <l eID="gen13880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13881"/>et transvexit illos per aquam nimiam. <l eID="gen13881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5910"/><l level="1" sID="gen13882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5910"/>Inimicos autem illorum demersit in mare, <l eID="gen13882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13883"/>et ab altitudine inferorum eduxit illos. <l eID="gen13883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13884"/>Ideo justi tulerunt spolia impiorum, <l eID="gen13884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5911"/><l level="1" sID="gen13885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5911"/>et decantaverunt, Domine, nomen sanctum tuum, <l eID="gen13885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13886"/>et victricem manum tuam laudaverunt pariter : <l eID="gen13886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5912"/><l level="1" sID="gen13887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5912"/>quoniam sapientia aperuit os mutorum, <l eID="gen13887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13888"/>et linguas infantium fecit disertas.  <chapter eID="Wis.10"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:1
verses.text: Direxit opera eorum in manibus prophetæ sancti. <l eID="gen13889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5913"/><l level="1" sID="gen13890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5913"/>Iter fecerunt per deserta quæ non habitabantur, <l eID="gen13890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13891"/>et in locis desertis fixerunt casas. <l eID="gen13891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5914"/><l level="1" sID="gen13892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5914"/>Steterunt contra hostes, <l eID="gen13892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13893"/>et de inimicis se vindicaverunt. <l eID="gen13893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5915"/><l level="1" sID="gen13894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5915"/>Sitierunt, et invocaverunt te, <l eID="gen13894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13895"/>et data est illis aqua de petra altissima, <l eID="gen13895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13896"/>et requies sitis de lapide duro. <l eID="gen13896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5916"/><l level="1" sID="gen13897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5916"/>Per quæ enim pœnas passi sunt inimici illorum <l eID="gen13897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13898"/>a defectione potus sui, <l eID="gen13898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13899"/>et in eis cum abundarent filii Israël lætati sunt : <l eID="gen13899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5917"/><l level="1" sID="gen13900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5917"/>per hæc, cum illis deessent, bene cum illis actum est. <l eID="gen13900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5918"/><l level="1" sID="gen13901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5918"/>Nam pro fonte quidem sempiterni fluminis, <l eID="gen13901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13902"/>humanum sanguinem dedisti injustis. <l eID="gen13902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5919"/><l level="1" sID="gen13903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5919"/>Qui cum minuerentur in traductione infantium occisorum, <l eID="gen13903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13904"/>dedisti illis abundantem aquam insperate, <l eID="gen13904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5920"/><l level="1" sID="gen13905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5920"/>ostendens per sitim quæ tunc fuit, <l eID="gen13905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13906"/>quemadmodum tuos exaltares, <l eID="gen13906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13907"/>et adversarios illorum necares. <l eID="gen13907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5921"/><l level="1" sID="gen13908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5921"/>Cum enim tentati sunt, <l eID="gen13908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13909"/>et quidem cum misericordia disciplinam accipientes, <l eID="gen13909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13910"/>scierunt quemadmodum cum ira judicati impii tormenta paterentur. <l eID="gen13910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5922"/><l level="1" sID="gen13911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5922"/>Hos quidem tamquam pater monens probasti ; <l eID="gen13911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13912"/>illos autem tamquam durus rex interrogans condemnasti. <l eID="gen13912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5923"/><l level="1" sID="gen13913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5923"/>Absentes enim, et præsentes, similiter torquebantur. <l eID="gen13913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5924"/><l level="1" sID="gen13914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5924"/>Duplex enim illos acceperat tædium et gemitus, <l eID="gen13914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13915"/>cum memoria præteritorum. <l eID="gen13915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5925"/><l level="1" sID="gen13916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5925"/>Cum enim audirent per sua tormenta bene secum agi, <l eID="gen13916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13917"/>commemorati sunt Dominum, admirantes in finem exitus. <l eID="gen13917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5926"/><l level="1" sID="gen13918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5926"/>Quem enim in expositione prava projectum deriserunt, <l eID="gen13918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13919"/>in finem eventus mirati sunt, <l eID="gen13919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13920"/>non similiter justis sitientes. <l eID="gen13920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5927"/><l level="1" sID="gen13921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5927"/>Pro cogitationibus autem insensatis iniquitatis illorum, <l eID="gen13921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13922"/>quod quidam errantes colebant mutos serpentes <l eID="gen13922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13923"/>et bestias supervacuas, <l eID="gen13923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13924"/>immisisti illis multitudinem mutorum animalium in vindictam ; <l eID="gen13924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5928"/><l level="1" sID="gen13925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5928"/>ut scirent quia per quæ peccat quis, per hæc et torquetur. <l eID="gen13925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5929"/><l level="1" sID="gen13926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5929"/>Non enim impossibilis erat omnipotens manus tua, <l eID="gen13926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13927"/>quæ creavit orbem terrarum ex materia invisa, <l eID="gen13927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13928"/>immittere illis multitudinem ursorum, aut audaces leones, <l eID="gen13928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5930"/><l level="1" sID="gen13929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5930"/>aut novi generis ira plenas ignotas bestias, <l eID="gen13929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13930"/>aut vaporem ignium spirantes, <l eID="gen13930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13931"/>aut fumi odorem proferentes, <l eID="gen13931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13932"/>aut horrendas ab oculis scintillas emittentes ; <l eID="gen13932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5931"/><l level="1" sID="gen13933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5931"/>quarum non solum læsura poterat illos exterminare, <l eID="gen13933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13934"/>sed et aspectus per timorem occidere. <l eID="gen13934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5932"/><l level="1" sID="gen13935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5932"/>Sed et sine his uno spiritu poterant occidi, <l eID="gen13935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13936"/>persecutionem passi ab ipsis factis suis, <l eID="gen13936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13937"/>et dispersi per spiritum virtutis tuæ : <l eID="gen13937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13938"/>sed omnia in mensura, et numero et pondere disposuisti. <l eID="gen13938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5933"/><l level="1" sID="gen13939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5933"/>Multum enim valere, tibi soli supererat semper : <l eID="gen13939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13940"/>et virtuti brachii tui quis resistet ? <l eID="gen13940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5934"/><l level="1" sID="gen13941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5934"/>Quoniam tamquam momentum stateræ, <l eID="gen13941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13942"/>sic est ante te orbis terrarum, <l eID="gen13942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13943"/>et tamquam gutta roris antelucani quæ descendit in terram. <l eID="gen13943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5935"/><l level="1" sID="gen13944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5935"/>Sed misereris omnium, quia omnia potes ; <l eID="gen13944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13945"/>et dissimulas peccata hominum, propter pœnitentiam. <l eID="gen13945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5936"/><l level="1" sID="gen13946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5936"/>Diligis enim omnia quæ sunt, <l eID="gen13946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13947"/>et nihil odisti eorum quæ fecisti ; <l eID="gen13947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13948"/>nec enim odiens aliquid constituisti aut fecisti. <l eID="gen13948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5937"/><l level="1" sID="gen13949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5937"/>Quomodo autem posset aliquid permanere, nisi tu voluisses ? <l eID="gen13949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13950"/>aut quod a te vocatum non esset conservaretur ? <l eID="gen13950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5938"/><l level="1" sID="gen13951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5938"/>Parcis autem omnibus, quoniam tua sunt, Domine, <l eID="gen13951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13952"/>qui amas animas.  <chapter eID="Wis.11"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:1
verses.text: O quam bonus et suavis est, Domine, spiritus tuus in omnibus ! <l eID="gen13953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5939"/><l level="1" sID="gen13954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5939"/>Ideoque eos qui exerrant partibus corripis, <l eID="gen13954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13955"/>et de quibus peccant admones et alloqueris, <l eID="gen13955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13956"/>ut relicta malitia credant in te, Domine. <l eID="gen13956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5940"/><l level="1" sID="gen13957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5940"/>Illos enim antiquos inhabitatores terræ sanctæ tuæ, <l eID="gen13957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13958"/>quos exhorruisti, <l eID="gen13958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5941"/><l level="1" sID="gen13959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5941"/>quoniam odibilia opera tibi faciebant <l eID="gen13959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13960"/>per medicamina et sacrificia injusta, <l eID="gen13960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5942"/><l level="1" sID="gen13961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5942"/>et filiorum suorum necatores sine misericordia, <l eID="gen13961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13962"/>et comestores viscerum hominum, <l eID="gen13962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13963"/>et devoratores sanguinis a medio sacramento tuo, <l eID="gen13963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5943"/><l level="1" sID="gen13964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5943"/>et auctores parentes animarum inauxiliatarum, <l eID="gen13964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13965"/>perdere voluisti per manus parentum nostrorum : <l eID="gen13965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5944"/><l level="1" sID="gen13966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5944"/>ut dignam perciperent peregrinationem puerorum Dei, <l eID="gen13966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13967"/>quæ tibi omnium carior est terra. <l eID="gen13967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5945"/><l level="1" sID="gen13968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5945"/>Sed et his tamquam hominibus pepercisti, <l eID="gen13968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13969"/>et misisti antecessores exercitus tui vespas, <l eID="gen13969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13970"/>ut illos paulatim exterminarent. <l eID="gen13970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5946"/><l level="1" sID="gen13971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5946"/>Non quia impotens eras in bello subjicere impios justis, <l eID="gen13971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13972"/>aut bestiis sævis, aut verbo duro simul exterminare : <l eID="gen13972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5947"/><l level="1" sID="gen13973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5947"/>sed partibus judicans, <l eID="gen13973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13974"/>dabas locum pœnitentiæ, <l eID="gen13974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13975"/>non ignorans quoniam nequam est natio eorum, <l eID="gen13975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13976"/>et naturalis malitia ipsorum, <l eID="gen13976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13977"/>et quoniam non poterat mutari cogitatio illorum in perpetuum. <l eID="gen13977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5948"/><l level="1" sID="gen13978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5948"/>Semen enim erat maledictum ab initio ; <l eID="gen13978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13979"/>nec timens aliquem, veniam dabas peccatis illorum. <l eID="gen13979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5949"/><l level="1" sID="gen13980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5949"/>Quis enim dicet tibi : Quid fecisti ? <l eID="gen13980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13981"/>aut quis stabit contra judicium tuum ? <l eID="gen13981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13982"/>aut quis in conspectu tuo veniet vindex iniquorum hominum ? <l eID="gen13982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13983"/>aut quis tibi imputabit, si perierint nationes quas tu fecisti ? <l eID="gen13983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5950"/><l level="1" sID="gen13984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5950"/>Non enim est alius deus quam tu, <l eID="gen13984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13985"/>cui cura est de omnibus, <l eID="gen13985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13986"/>ut ostendas quoniam non injuste judicas judicium. <l eID="gen13986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5951"/><l level="1" sID="gen13987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5951"/>Neque rex, neque tyrannus in conspectu tuo inquirent <l eID="gen13987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13988"/>de his quos perdidisti. <l eID="gen13988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5952"/><l level="1" sID="gen13989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5952"/>Cum ergo sis justus, juste omnia disponis ; <l eID="gen13989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13990"/>ipsum quoque qui non debet puniri, condemnare, <l eID="gen13990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13991"/>exterum æstimas a tua virtute. <l eID="gen13991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5953"/><l level="1" sID="gen13992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5953"/>Virtus enim tua justitiæ initium est, <l eID="gen13992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13993"/>et ob hoc quod Dominus es, <l eID="gen13993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13994"/>omnibus te parcere facis. <l eID="gen13994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5954"/><l level="1" sID="gen13995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5954"/>Virtutem enim ostendis tu, <l eID="gen13995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13996"/>qui non crederis esse in virtute consummatus, <l eID="gen13996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13997"/>et horum qui te nesciunt audaciam traducis. <l eID="gen13997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5955"/><l level="1" sID="gen13998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5955"/>Tu autem dominator virtutis, cum tranquillitate judicas, <l eID="gen13998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen13999"/>et cum magna reverentia disponis nos : <l eID="gen13999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14000"/>subest enim tibi, cum volueris posse. <l eID="gen14000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5956"/><l level="1" sID="gen14001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5956"/>Docuisti autem populum tuum per talia opera, <l eID="gen14001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14002"/>quoniam oportet justum esse et humanum ; <l eID="gen14002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14003"/>et bonæ spei fecisti filios tuos, <l eID="gen14003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14004"/>quoniam judicans das locum in peccatis pœnitentiæ. <l eID="gen14004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5957"/><l level="1" sID="gen14005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5957"/>Si enim inimicos servorum tuorum, et debitos morti, <l eID="gen14005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14006"/>cum tanta cruciasti attentione, <l eID="gen14006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14007"/>dans tempus et locum per quæ possent mutari a malitia : <l eID="gen14007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5958"/><l level="1" sID="gen14008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5958"/>cum quanta diligentia judicasti filios tuos, <l eID="gen14008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14009"/>quorum parentibus juramenta et conventiones dedisti bonarum promissionum ! <l eID="gen14009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5959"/><l level="1" sID="gen14010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5959"/>Cum ergo das nobis disciplinam, <l eID="gen14010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14011"/>inimicos nostros multipliciter flagellas, <l eID="gen14011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14012"/>ut bonitatem tuam cogitemus judicantes, <l eID="gen14012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14013"/>et cum de nobis judicatur, speremus misericordiam tuam. <l eID="gen14013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5960"/><l level="1" sID="gen14014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5960"/>Unde et illis qui in vita sua insensate et injuste vixerunt, <l eID="gen14014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14015"/>per hæc quæ coluerunt dedisti summa tormenta. <l eID="gen14015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5961"/><l level="1" sID="gen14016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5961"/>Etenim in erroris via diutius erraverunt, <l eID="gen14016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14017"/>deos æstimantes hæc quæ in animalibus sunt supervacua, <l eID="gen14017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14018"/>infantium insensatorum more viventes. <l eID="gen14018" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5962"/><l level="1" sID="gen14019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5962"/>Propter hoc tamquam pueris insensatis judicium in derisum dedisti. <l eID="gen14019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5963"/><l level="1" sID="gen14020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5963"/>Qui autem ludibriis et increpationibus non sunt correcti, <l eID="gen14020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14021"/>dignum Dei judicium experti sunt. <l eID="gen14021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 12:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5964"/><l level="1" sID="gen14022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5964"/>In quibus enim patientes indignabantur <l eID="gen14022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14023"/>per hæc quos putabant deos, <l eID="gen14023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14024"/>in ipsis cum exterminarentur videntes, <l eID="gen14024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14025"/>illum quem olim negabant se nosse, verum Deum agnoverunt ; <l eID="gen14025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14026"/>propter quod et finis condemnationis eorum venit super illos.  <chapter eID="Wis.12"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:1
verses.text: Vani autem sunt omnes homines <l eID="gen14027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14028"/>in quibus non subest scientia Dei ; <l eID="gen14028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14029"/>et de his quæ videntur bona, <l eID="gen14029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14030"/>non potuerunt intelligere eum qui est, <l eID="gen14030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14031"/>neque operibus attendentes agnoverunt quis esset artifex : <l eID="gen14031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5965"/><l level="1" sID="gen14032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5965"/>sed aut ignem, aut spiritum, aut citatum aërem, <l eID="gen14032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14033"/>aut gyrum stellarum, aut nimiam aquam, aut solem et lunam, <l eID="gen14033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14034"/>rectores orbis terrarum deos putaverunt. <l eID="gen14034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5966"/><l level="1" sID="gen14035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5966"/>Quorum si specie delectati, deos putaverunt, <l eID="gen14035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14036"/>sciant quanto his dominator eorum speciosior est : <l eID="gen14036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14037"/>speciei enim generator hæc omnia constituit. <l eID="gen14037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5967"/><l level="1" sID="gen14038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5967"/>Aut si virtutem et opera eorum mirati sunt, <l eID="gen14038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14039"/>intelligant ab illis quoniam qui hæc fecit fortior est illis : <l eID="gen14039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5968"/><l level="1" sID="gen14040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5968"/>a magnitudine enim speciei et creaturæ <l eID="gen14040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14041"/>cognoscibiliter poterit creator horum videri. <l eID="gen14041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5969"/><l level="1" sID="gen14042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5969"/>Sed tamen adhuc in his minor est querela ; <l eID="gen14042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14043"/>et hi enim fortasse errant, <l eID="gen14043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14044"/>Deum quærentes, et volentes invenire. <l eID="gen14044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5970"/><l level="1" sID="gen14045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5970"/>Etenim cum in operibus illius conversentur inquirunt, <l eID="gen14045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14046"/>et persuasum habent quoniam bona sunt quæ videntur. <l eID="gen14046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5971"/><l level="1" sID="gen14047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5971"/>Iterum autem nec his debet ignosci. <l eID="gen14047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5972"/><l level="1" sID="gen14048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5972"/>Si enim tantum potuerunt scire <l eID="gen14048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14049"/>ut possent æstimare sæculum, <l eID="gen14049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14050"/>quomodo hujus Dominum non facilius invenerunt ? <l eID="gen14050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5973"/><l level="1" sID="gen14051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5973"/>Infelices autem sunt, <l eID="gen14051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14052"/>et inter mortuos spes illorum est, <l eID="gen14052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14053"/>qui appellaverunt deos opera manuum hominum : <l eID="gen14053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14054"/>aurum et argentum, artis inventionem, <l eID="gen14054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14055"/>et similitudines animalium, aut lapidem inutilem, <l eID="gen14055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14056"/>opus manus antiquæ. <l eID="gen14056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5974"/><l level="1" sID="gen14057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5974"/>Aut si quis artifex faber de silva lignum rectum secuerit, <l eID="gen14057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14058"/>et hujus docte eradat omnem corticem, <l eID="gen14058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14059"/>et arte sua usus <l eID="gen14059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14060"/>diligenter fabricet vas utile in conversationem vitæ ; <l eID="gen14060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5975"/><l level="1" sID="gen14061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5975"/>reliquiis autem ejus operis <l eID="gen14061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14062"/>ad præparationem escæ abutatur, <l eID="gen14062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5976"/><l level="1" sID="gen14063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5976"/>et reliquum horum quod ad nullos usus facit, <l eID="gen14063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14064"/>lignum curvum et vorticibus plenum <l eID="gen14064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14065"/>sculpat diligenter per vacuitatem suam, <l eID="gen14065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14066"/>et per scientiam suæ artis figuret illud, <l eID="gen14066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14067"/>et assimilet illud imagini hominis, <l eID="gen14067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5977"/><l level="1" sID="gen14068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5977"/>aut alicui ex animalibus illud comparet : <l eID="gen14068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14069"/>perliniens rubrica, et rubicundum faciens fuco colorem illius, <l eID="gen14069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14070"/>et omnem maculam quæ in illo est perliniens ; <l eID="gen14070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5978"/><l level="1" sID="gen14071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5978"/>et faciat ei dignam habitationem, <l eID="gen14071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14072"/>et in pariete ponens illud, <l eID="gen14072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14073"/>et confirmans ferro

verses.name: Wisdom 13:16
verses.text: ne forte cadat, <l eID="gen14073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14074"/>prospiciens illi : <l eID="gen14074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14075"/>sciens quoniam non potest adjuvare se : <l eID="gen14075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14076"/>imago enim est, et opus est illi adjutorium. <l eID="gen14076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5979"/><l level="1" sID="gen14077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5979"/>Et de substantia sua, et de filiis suis, <l eID="gen14077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14078"/>et de nuptiis votum faciens inquirit : <l eID="gen14078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14079"/>non erubescit loqui cum illo qui sine anima est. <l eID="gen14079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5980"/><l level="1" sID="gen14080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5980"/>Et pro sanitate quidem infirmum deprecatur, <l eID="gen14080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14081"/>et pro vita rogat mortuum, <l eID="gen14081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14082"/>et in adjutorium inutilem invocat. <l eID="gen14082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5981"/><l level="1" sID="gen14083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5981"/>Et pro itinere petit ab eo qui ambulare non potest ; <l eID="gen14083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14084"/>et de acquirendo, et de operando, <l eID="gen14084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14085"/>et de omnium rerum eventu, <l eID="gen14085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14086"/>petit ab eo qui in omnibus est inutilis.  <chapter eID="Wis.13"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:1
verses.text: Iterum alius navigare cogitans, <l eID="gen14087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14088"/>et per feros fluctus iter facere incipiens, <l eID="gen14088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14089"/>ligno portante se, fragilius lignum invocat. <l eID="gen14089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5982"/><l level="1" sID="gen14090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5982"/>Illud enim cupiditas acquirendi excogitavit, <l eID="gen14090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14091"/>et artifex sapientia fabricavit sua. <l eID="gen14091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5983"/><l level="1" sID="gen14092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5983"/>Tua autem, Pater, providentia gubernat : <l eID="gen14092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14093"/>quoniam dedisti et in mari viam, <l eID="gen14093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14094"/>et inter fluctus semitam firmissimam, <l eID="gen14094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5984"/><l level="1" sID="gen14095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5984"/>ostendens quoniam potens es ex omnibus salvare, <l eID="gen14095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14096"/>etiam si sine arte aliquis adeat mare. <l eID="gen14096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5985"/><l level="1" sID="gen14097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5985"/>Sed ut non essent vacua sapientiæ tuæ opera, <l eID="gen14097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14098"/>propter hoc etiam et exiguo ligno credunt homines animas suas, <l eID="gen14098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14099"/>et transeuntes mare per ratem liberati sunt. <l eID="gen14099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5986"/><l level="1" sID="gen14100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5986"/>Sed et ab initio cum perirent superbi gigantes, <l eID="gen14100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14101"/>spes orbis terrarum ad ratem confugiens, <l eID="gen14101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14102"/>remisit sæculo semen nativitatis quæ manu tua erat gubernata. <l eID="gen14102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5987"/><l level="1" sID="gen14103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5987"/>Benedictum est enim lignum per quod fit justitia ; <l eID="gen14103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5988"/><l level="1" sID="gen14104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5988"/>per manus autem quod fit idolum, <l eID="gen14104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14105"/>maledictum est et ipsum, et qui fecit illud : <l eID="gen14105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14106"/>quia ille quidem operatus est, <l eID="gen14106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14107"/>illud autem cum esset fragile, deus cognominatus est. <l eID="gen14107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5989"/><l level="1" sID="gen14108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5989"/>Similiter autem odio sunt Deo impius et impietas ejus ; <l eID="gen14108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5990"/><l level="1" sID="gen14109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5990"/>etenim quod factum est, cum illo qui fecit tormenta patietur. <l eID="gen14109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5991"/><l level="1" sID="gen14110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5991"/>Propter hoc et in idolis nationum non erit respectus, <l eID="gen14110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14111"/>quoniam creaturæ Dei in odium factæ sunt, <l eID="gen14111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14112"/>et in tentationem animabus hominum, <l eID="gen14112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14113"/>et in muscipulam pedibus insipientium. <l eID="gen14113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5992"/><l level="1" sID="gen14114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5992"/>Initium enim fornicationis est exquisitio idolorum, <l eID="gen14114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14115"/>et adinventio illorum corruptio vitæ est : <l eID="gen14115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5993"/><l level="1" sID="gen14116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5993"/>neque enim erant ab initio, <l eID="gen14116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14117"/>neque erunt in perpetuum. <l eID="gen14117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5994"/><l level="1" sID="gen14118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5994"/>Supervacuitas enim hominum hæc advenit in orbem terrarum, <l eID="gen14118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14119"/>et ideo brevis illorum finis est inventus. <l eID="gen14119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5995"/><l level="1" sID="gen14120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5995"/>Acerbo enim luctu dolens pater, <l eID="gen14120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14121"/>cito sibi rapti filii fecit imaginem ; <l eID="gen14121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14122"/>et illum qui tunc quasi homo mortuus fuerat, <l eID="gen14122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14123"/>nunc tamquam deum colere cœpit, <l eID="gen14123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14124"/>et constituit inter servos suos sacra et sacrificia. <l eID="gen14124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5996"/><l level="1" sID="gen14125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5996"/>Deinde interveniente tempore, convalescente iniqua consuetudine, <l eID="gen14125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14126"/>hic error tamquam lex custoditus est, <l eID="gen14126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14127"/>et tyrannorum imperio colebantur figmenta. <l eID="gen14127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5997"/><l level="1" sID="gen14128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5997"/>Et hos quos in palam homines honorare non poterant <l eID="gen14128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14129"/>propter hoc quod longe essent, <l eID="gen14129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14130"/>e longinquo figura eorum allata, <l eID="gen14130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14131"/>evidentem imaginem regis quem honorare volebant fecerunt, <l eID="gen14131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14132"/>ut illum qui aberat, tamquam præsentem colerent sua sollicitudine. <l eID="gen14132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5998"/><l level="1" sID="gen14133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5998"/>Provexit autem ad horum culturam <l eID="gen14133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14134"/>et hos qui ignorabant artificis eximia diligentia. <l eID="gen14134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5999"/><l level="1" sID="gen14135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5999"/>Ille enim, volens placere illi qui se assumpsit, <l eID="gen14135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14136"/>elaboravit arte sua ut similitudinem in melius figuraret. <l eID="gen14136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6000"/><l level="1" sID="gen14137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6000"/>Multitudo autem hominum, abducta per speciem operis, <l eID="gen14137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14138"/>eum qui ante tempus tamquam homo honoratus fuerat, <l eID="gen14138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14139"/>nunc deum æstimaverunt. <l eID="gen14139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6001"/><l level="1" sID="gen14140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6001"/>Et hæc fuit vitæ humanæ deceptio, <l eID="gen14140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14141"/>quoniam aut affectui aut regibus deservientes homines, <l eID="gen14141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14142"/>incommunicabile nomen lapidibus et lignis imposuerunt. <l eID="gen14142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6002"/><l level="1" sID="gen14143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6002"/>Et non suffecerat errasse eos circa Dei scientiam, <l eID="gen14143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14144"/>sed et in magno viventes inscientiæ bello, <l eID="gen14144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14145"/>tot et tam magna mala pacem appellant. <l eID="gen14145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6003"/><l level="1" sID="gen14146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6003"/>Aut enim filios suos sacrificantes, <l eID="gen14146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14147"/>aut obscura sacrificia facientes, <l eID="gen14147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14148"/>aut insaniæ plenas vigilias habentes, <l eID="gen14148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6004"/><l level="1" sID="gen14149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6004"/>neque vitam, neque nuptias mundas jam custodiunt : <l eID="gen14149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14150"/>sed alius alium per invidiam occidit, <l eID="gen14150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14151"/>aut adulterans contristat, <l eID="gen14151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6005"/><l level="1" sID="gen14152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6005"/>et omnia commista sunt : sanguis, homicidium, <l eID="gen14152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14153"/>furtum et fictio, corruptio et infidelitas, <l eID="gen14153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14154"/>turbatio et perjurium, tumultus bonorum, <l eID="gen14154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6006"/><l level="1" sID="gen14155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6006"/>Dei immemoratio, animarum inquinatio, <l eID="gen14155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14156"/>nativitatis immutatio, nuptiarum inconstantia, <l eID="gen14156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14157"/>inordinatio mœchiæ et impudicitiæ. <l eID="gen14157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6007"/><l level="1" sID="gen14158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6007"/>Infandorum enim idolorum cultura <l eID="gen14158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14159"/>omnis mali causa est, et initium et finis. <l eID="gen14159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6008"/><l level="1" sID="gen14160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6008"/>Aut enim dum lætantur insaniunt, <l eID="gen14160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14161"/>aut certe vaticinantur falsa, <l eID="gen14161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14162"/>aut vivunt injuste, aut pejerant cito. <l eID="gen14162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6009"/><l level="1" sID="gen14163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6009"/>Dum enim confidunt in idolis quæ sine anima sunt, <l eID="gen14163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14164"/>male jurantes noceri se non sperant. <l eID="gen14164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:30
