verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6010"/><l level="1" sID="gen14165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6010"/>Utraque ergo illis evenient digne, <l eID="gen14165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14166"/>quoniam male senserunt de Deo, attendentes idolis, <l eID="gen14166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14167"/>et juraverunt injuste, <l eID="gen14167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14168"/>in dolo contemnentes justitiam. <l eID="gen14168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6011"/><l level="1" sID="gen14169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6011"/>Non enim juratorum virtus, <l eID="gen14169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14170"/>sed peccantium pœna, <l eID="gen14170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14171"/>perambulat semper injustorum prævaricationem.  <chapter eID="Wis.14"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:1
verses.text: Tu autem, Deus noster, suavis et verus es, <l eID="gen14172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14173"/>patiens, et in misericordia disponens omnia. <l eID="gen14173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6012"/><l level="1" sID="gen14174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6012"/>Etenim si peccaverimus, tui sumus, <l eID="gen14174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14175"/>scientes magnitudinem tuam ; <l eID="gen14175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14176"/>et si non peccaverimus, <l eID="gen14176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14177"/>scimus quoniam apud te sumus computati. <l eID="gen14177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6013"/><l level="1" sID="gen14178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6013"/>Nosse enim te, consummata justitia est ; <l eID="gen14178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14179"/>et scire justitiam et virtutem tuam, radix est immortalitatis. <l eID="gen14179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6014"/><l level="1" sID="gen14180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6014"/>Non enim in errorem induxit nos <l eID="gen14180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14181"/>hominum malæ artis excogitatio, <l eID="gen14181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14182"/>nec umbra picturæ labor sine fructu, <l eID="gen14182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14183"/>effigies sculpta per varios colores : <l eID="gen14183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6015"/><l level="1" sID="gen14184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6015"/>cujus aspectus insensato dat concupiscentiam, <l eID="gen14184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14185"/>et diligit mortuæ imaginis effigiem sine anima. <l eID="gen14185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6016"/><l level="1" sID="gen14186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6016"/>Malorum amatores digni sunt qui spem habeant in talibus, <l eID="gen14186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14187"/>et qui faciunt illos, et qui diligunt, et qui colunt. <l eID="gen14187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6017"/><l level="1" sID="gen14188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6017"/>Sed et figulus mollem terram premens, <l eID="gen14188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14189"/>laboriose fingit ad usus nostros unumquodque vas ; <l eID="gen14189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14190"/>et de eodem luto fingit quæ munda sunt in usum vasa, <l eID="gen14190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14191"/>et similiter quæ his sunt contraria : <l eID="gen14191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14192"/>horum autem vasorum quis sit usus, <l eID="gen14192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14193"/>judex est figulus. <l eID="gen14193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6018"/><l level="1" sID="gen14194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6018"/>Et cum labore vano deum fingit de eodem luto <l eID="gen14194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14195"/>ille qui paulo ante de terra factus fuerat, <l eID="gen14195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14196"/>et post pusillum reducit se unde acceptus est, <l eID="gen14196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14197"/>repetitus animæ debitum quam habebat. <l eID="gen14197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6019"/><l level="1" sID="gen14198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6019"/>Sed cura est illi non quia laboraturus est, <l eID="gen14198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14199"/>nec quoniam brevis illi vita est : <l eID="gen14199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14200"/>sed concertatur aurificibus et argentariis ; <l eID="gen14200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14201"/>sed et ærarios imitatur, <l eID="gen14201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14202"/>et gloriam præfert, quoniam res supervacuas fingit. <l eID="gen14202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6020"/><l level="1" sID="gen14203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6020"/>Cinis est enim cor ejus, <l eID="gen14203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14204"/>et terra supervacua spes illius, <l eID="gen14204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14205"/>et luto vilior vita ejus : <l eID="gen14205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6021"/><l level="1" sID="gen14206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6021"/>quoniam ignoravit qui se finxit, <l eID="gen14206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14207"/>et qui inspiravit illi animam quæ operatur, <l eID="gen14207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14208"/>et qui insufflavit ei spiritum vitalem. <l eID="gen14208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6022"/><l level="1" sID="gen14209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6022"/>Sed et æstimaverunt ludum esse vitam nostram, <l eID="gen14209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14210"/>et conversationem vitæ compositam ad lucrum, <l eID="gen14210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14211"/>et oportere undecumque etiam ex malo acquirere. <l eID="gen14211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6023"/><l level="1" sID="gen14212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6023"/>Hic enim scit se super omnes delinquere, <l eID="gen14212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14213"/>qui ex terræ materia fragilia vasa et sculptilia fingit. <l eID="gen14213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6024"/><l level="1" sID="gen14214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6024"/>Omnes enim insipientes, <l eID="gen14214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14215"/>et infelices supra modum animæ superbi, <l eID="gen14215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14216"/>sunt inimici populi tui, et imperantes illi : <l eID="gen14216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6025"/><l level="1" sID="gen14217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6025"/>quoniam omnia idola nationum deos æstimaverunt, <l eID="gen14217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14218"/>quibus neque oculorum usus est ad videndum, <l eID="gen14218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14219"/>neque nares ad percipiendum spiritum, <l eID="gen14219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14220"/>neque aures ad audiendum, <l eID="gen14220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14221"/>neque digiti manuum ad tractandum, <l eID="gen14221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14222"/>sed et pedes eorum pigri ad ambulandum. <l eID="gen14222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6026"/><l level="1" sID="gen14223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6026"/>Homo enim fecit illos ; <l eID="gen14223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14224"/>et qui spiritum mutuatus est, is finxit illos. <l eID="gen14224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14225"/>Nemo enim sibi similem homo poterit deum fingere. <l eID="gen14225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6027"/><l level="1" sID="gen14226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6027"/>Cum enim sit mortalis, mortuum fingit manibus iniquis. <l eID="gen14226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14227"/>Melior enim est ipse his quos colit, <l eID="gen14227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14228"/>quia ipse quidem vixit, cum esset mortalis, illi autem numquam. <l eID="gen14228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6028"/><l level="1" sID="gen14229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6028"/>Sed et animalia miserrima colunt ; <l eID="gen14229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14230"/>insensata enim comparata his, illis sunt deteriora. <l eID="gen14230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6029"/><l level="1" sID="gen14231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6029"/>Sed nec aspectu aliquis ex his animalibus bona potest conspicere : <l eID="gen14231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14232"/>effugerunt autem Dei laudem et benedictionem ejus.  <chapter eID="Wis.15"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:1
verses.text: Propter hæc et per his similia passi sunt digne tormenta, <l eID="gen14233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14234"/>et per multitudinem bestiarum exterminati sunt. <l eID="gen14234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6030"/><l level="1" sID="gen14235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6030"/>Pro quibus tormentis bene disposuisti populum tuum, <l eID="gen14235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14236"/>quibus dedisti concupiscentiam delectamenti sui novum saporem, <l eID="gen14236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14237"/>escam parans eis ortygometram : <l eID="gen14237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6031"/><l level="1" sID="gen14238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6031"/>ut illi quidem, concupiscentes escam <l eID="gen14238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14239"/>propter ea quæ illis ostensa et missa sunt, <l eID="gen14239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14240"/>etiam a necessaria concupiscentia averterentur. <l eID="gen14240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14241"/>Hi autem in brevi inopes facti, novam gustaverunt escam. <l eID="gen14241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6032"/><l level="1" sID="gen14242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6032"/>Oportebat enim illis sine excusatione quidem <l eID="gen14242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14243"/>supervenire interitum exercentibus tyrannidem ; <l eID="gen14243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14244"/>his autem tantum ostendere <l eID="gen14244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14245"/>quemadmodum inimici eorum exterminabantur. <l eID="gen14245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6033"/><l level="1" sID="gen14246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6033"/>Etenim cum illis supervenit sæva bestiarum ira, <l eID="gen14246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14247"/>morsibus perversorum colubrorum exterminabantur. <l eID="gen14247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6034"/><l level="1" sID="gen14248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6034"/>Sed non in perpetuum ira tua permansit, <l eID="gen14248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14249"/>sed ad correptionem in brevi turbati sunt, <l eID="gen14249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14250"/>signum habentes salutis ad commemorationem mandati legis tuæ. <l eID="gen14250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6035"/><l level="1" sID="gen14251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6035"/>Qui enim conversus est, <l eID="gen14251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14252"/>non per hoc quod videbat sanabatur, <l eID="gen14252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14253"/>sed per te, omnium salvatorem. <l eID="gen14253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6036"/><l level="1" sID="gen14254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6036"/>In hoc autem ostendisti inimicis nostris <l eID="gen14254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14255"/>quia tu es qui liberas ab omni malo. <l eID="gen14255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6037"/><l level="1" sID="gen14256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6037"/>Illos enim locustarum et muscarum occiderunt morsus, <l eID="gen14256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14257"/>et non est inventa sanitas animæ illorum, <l eID="gen14257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14258"/>quia digni erant ab hujuscemodi exterminari. <l eID="gen14258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6038"/><l level="1" sID="gen14259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6038"/>Filios autem tuos nec draconum venenatorum vicerunt dentes : <l eID="gen14259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14260"/>misericordia enim tua adveniens sanabat illos. <l eID="gen14260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6039"/><l level="1" sID="gen14261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6039"/>In memoria enim sermonum tuorum examinabantur, <l eID="gen14261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14262"/>et velociter salvabantur : <l eID="gen14262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14263"/>ne in altam incidentes oblivionem <l eID="gen14263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14264"/>non possent tuo uti adjutorio. <l eID="gen14264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6040"/><l level="1" sID="gen14265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6040"/>Etenim neque herba, neque malagma sanavit eos : <l eID="gen14265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14266"/>sed tuus, Domine, sermo, qui sanat omnia. <l eID="gen14266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6041"/><l level="1" sID="gen14267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6041"/>Tu es enim, Domine, qui vitæ et mortis habes potestatem, <l eID="gen14267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14268"/>et deducis ad portas mortis, et reducis. <l eID="gen14268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6042"/><l level="1" sID="gen14269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6042"/>Homo autem occidit quidem per malitiam ; <l eID="gen14269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14270"/>et cum exierit spiritus, non revertetur, <l eID="gen14270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14271"/>nec revocabit animam quæ recepta est. <l eID="gen14271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6043"/><l level="1" sID="gen14272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6043"/>Sed tuam manum effugere impossibile est. <l eID="gen14272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6044"/><l level="1" sID="gen14273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6044"/>Negantes enim te nosse impii, <l eID="gen14273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14274"/>per fortitudinem brachii tui flagellati sunt : <l eID="gen14274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14275"/>novis aquis, et grandinibus, <l eID="gen14275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14276"/>et pluviis persecutionem passi, <l eID="gen14276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14277"/>et per ignem consumpti. <l eID="gen14277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6045"/><l level="1" sID="gen14278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6045"/>Quod enim mirabile erat, in aqua, quæ omnia extinguit, <l eID="gen14278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14279"/>plus ignis valebat : <l eID="gen14279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14280"/>vindex est enim orbis justorum. <l eID="gen14280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6046"/><l level="1" sID="gen14281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6046"/>Quodam enim tempore mansuetabatur ignis, <l eID="gen14281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14282"/>ne comburerentur quæ ad impios missa erant animalia, <l eID="gen14282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14283"/>sed ut ipsi videntes scirent <l eID="gen14283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14284"/>quoniam Dei judicio patiuntur persecutionem. <l eID="gen14284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6047"/><l level="1" sID="gen14285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6047"/>Et quodam tempore in aqua <l eID="gen14285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14286"/>supra virtutem ignis exardescebat undique, <l eID="gen14286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14287"/>ut iniquæ terræ nationem exterminaret. <l eID="gen14287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6048"/><l level="1" sID="gen14288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6048"/>Pro quibus angelorum esca nutrivisti populum tuum, <l eID="gen14288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14289"/>et paratum panem de cælo præstitisti illis sine labore, <l eID="gen14289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14290"/>omne delectamentum in se habentem, <l eID="gen14290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14291"/>et omnis saporis suavitatem. <l eID="gen14291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6049"/><l level="1" sID="gen14292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6049"/>Substantia enim tua dulcedinem tuam, <l eID="gen14292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14293"/>quam in filios habes, ostendebat ; <l eID="gen14293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14294"/>et deserviens uniuscujusque voluntati, <l eID="gen14294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14295"/>ad quod quisque volebat convertebatur. <l eID="gen14295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6050"/><l level="1" sID="gen14296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6050"/>Nix autem et glacies sustinebant vim ignis, et non tabescebant : <l eID="gen14296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14297"/>ut scirent quoniam fructus inimicorum exterminabat <l eID="gen14297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14298"/>ignis ardens in grandine et pluvia coruscans ; <l eID="gen14298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6051"/><l level="1" sID="gen14299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6051"/>hic autem iterum ut nutrirentur justi, <l eID="gen14299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14300"/>etiam suæ virtutis oblitus est. <l eID="gen14300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6052"/><l level="1" sID="gen14301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6052"/>Creatura enim tibi factori deserviens, <l eID="gen14301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14302"/>exardescit in tormentum adversus injustos, <l eID="gen14302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14303"/>et lenior fit ad benefaciendum pro his qui in te confidunt. <l eID="gen14303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6053"/><l level="1" sID="gen14304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6053"/>Propter hoc et tunc in omnia transfigurata, <l eID="gen14304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14305"/>omnium nutrici gratiæ tuæ deserviebat, <l eID="gen14305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14306"/>ad voluntatem eorum qui a te desiderabant : <l eID="gen14306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6054"/><l level="1" sID="gen14307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6054"/>ut scirent filii tui quos dilexisti, Domine, <l eID="gen14307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14308"/>quoniam non nativitatis fructus pascunt homines, <l eID="gen14308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14309"/>sed sermo tuus hos qui in te crediderint conservat. <l eID="gen14309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6055"/><l level="1" sID="gen14310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6055"/>Quod enim ab igne non poterat exterminari, <l eID="gen14310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14311"/>statim ab exiguo radio solis calefactum tabescebat : <l eID="gen14311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6056"/><l level="1" sID="gen14312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6056"/>ut notum omnibus esset <l eID="gen14312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14313"/>quoniam oportet prævenire solem ad benedictionem tuam, <l eID="gen14313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14314"/>et ad ortum lucis te adorare. <l eID="gen14314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6057"/><l level="1" sID="gen14315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6057"/>Ingrati enim spes tamquam hibernalis glacies tabescet, <l eID="gen14315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14316"/>et disperiet tamquam aqua supervacua.  <chapter eID="Wis.16"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:1
verses.text: Magna sunt enim judicia tua, Domine, <l eID="gen14317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14318"/>et inenarrabilia verba tua : <l eID="gen14318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14319"/>propter hoc indisciplinatæ animæ erraverunt. <l eID="gen14319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6058"/><l level="1" sID="gen14320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6058"/>Dum enim persuasum habent iniqui <l eID="gen14320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14321"/>posse dominari nationi sanctæ, <l eID="gen14321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14322"/>vinculis tenebrarum et longæ noctis compediti, <l eID="gen14322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14323"/>inclusi sub tectis, <l eID="gen14323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14324"/>fugitivi perpetuæ providentiæ jacuerunt. <l eID="gen14324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6059"/><l level="1" sID="gen14325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6059"/>Et dum putant se latere in obscuris peccatis, <l eID="gen14325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14326"/>tenebroso oblivionis velamento dispersi sunt, <l eID="gen14326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14327"/>paventes horrende, <l eID="gen14327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14328"/>et cum admiratione nimia perturbati. <l eID="gen14328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6060"/><l level="1" sID="gen14329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6060"/>Neque enim quæ continebat illos spelunca sine timore custodiebat, <l eID="gen14329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14330"/>quoniam sonitus descendens perturbabat illos, <l eID="gen14330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14331"/>et personæ tristes illis apparentes pavorem illis præstabant. <l eID="gen14331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6061"/><l level="1" sID="gen14332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6061"/>Et ignis quidem nulla vis poterat illis lumen præbere, <l eID="gen14332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14333"/>nec siderum limpidæ flammæ <l eID="gen14333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14334"/>illuminare poterant illam noctem horrendam. <l eID="gen14334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6062"/><l level="1" sID="gen14335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6062"/>Apparebat autem illis subitaneus ignis, timore plenus ; <l eID="gen14335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14336"/>et timore perculsi illius quæ non videbatur faciei, <l eID="gen14336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14337"/>æstimabant deteriora esse quæ videbantur. <l eID="gen14337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6063"/><l level="1" sID="gen14338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6063"/>Et magicæ artis appositi erant derisus, <l eID="gen14338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14339"/>et sapientiæ gloriæ correptio cum contumelia. <l eID="gen14339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6064"/><l level="1" sID="gen14340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6064"/>Illi enim qui promittebant <l eID="gen14340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14341"/>timores et perturbationes expellere se ab anima languente, <l eID="gen14341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14342"/>hi cum derisu pleni timore languebant. <l eID="gen14342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6065"/><l level="1" sID="gen14343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6065"/>Nam etsi nihil illos ex monstris perturbabat, <l eID="gen14343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14344"/>transitu animalium et serpentium sibilatione commoti, <l eID="gen14344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14345"/>tremebundi peribant, <l eID="gen14345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14346"/>et aërem quem nulla ratione quis effugere posset, negantes se videre. <l eID="gen14346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6066"/><l level="1" sID="gen14347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6066"/>Cum sit enim timida nequitia, <l eID="gen14347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14348"/>dat testimonium condemnationis : <l eID="gen14348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14349"/>semper enim præsumit sæva, <l eID="gen14349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14350"/>perturbata conscientia : <l eID="gen14350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6067"/><l level="1" sID="gen14351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6067"/>nihil enim est timor nisi proditio cogitationis auxiliorum. <l eID="gen14351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6068"/><l level="1" sID="gen14352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6068"/>Et dum ab intus minor est exspectatio, <l eID="gen14352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14353"/>majorem computat inscientiam ejus causæ, <l eID="gen14353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14354"/>de qua tormentum præstat. <l eID="gen14354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6069"/><l level="1" sID="gen14355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6069"/>Illi autem qui impotentem vere noctem, <l eID="gen14355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14356"/>et ab infimis et ab altissimis inferis supervenientem, <l eID="gen14356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14357"/>eumdem somnum dormientes, <l eID="gen14357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6070"/><l level="1" sID="gen14358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6070"/>aliquando monstrorum exagitabantur timore, <l eID="gen14358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14359"/>aliquando animæ deficiebant traductione : <l eID="gen14359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14360"/>subitaneus enim illis et insperatus timor supervenerat. <l eID="gen14360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6071"/><l level="1" sID="gen14361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6071"/>Deinde si quisquam ex illis decidisset, <l eID="gen14361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14362"/>custodiebatur in carcere sine ferro reclusus. <l eID="gen14362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6072"/><l level="1" sID="gen14363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6072"/>Si enim rusticus quis erat, aut pastor, <l eID="gen14363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14364"/>aut agri laborum operarius præoccupatus esset, <l eID="gen14364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14365"/>ineffugibilem sustinebat necessitatem ; <l eID="gen14365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6073"/><l level="1" sID="gen14366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6073"/>una enim catena tenebrarum omnes erant colligati. <l eID="gen14366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14367"/>Sive spiritus sibilans, <l eID="gen14367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14368"/>aut inter spissos arborum ramos avium sonus suavis, <l eID="gen14368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14369"/>aut vis aquæ decurrentis nimium, <l eID="gen14369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6074"/><l level="1" sID="gen14370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6074"/>aut sonus validus præcipitatarum petrarum, <l eID="gen14370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14371"/>aut ludentium animalium cursus invisus, <l eID="gen14371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14372"/>aut mugientium valida bestiarum vox, <l eID="gen14372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14373"/>aut resonans de altissimis montibus echo : <l eID="gen14373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14374"/>deficientes faciebant illos præ timore. <l eID="gen14374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6075"/><l level="1" sID="gen14375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6075"/>Omnis enim orbis terrarum limpido illuminabatur lumine, <l eID="gen14375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14376"/>et non impeditis operibus continebatur. <l eID="gen14376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6076"/><l level="1" sID="gen14377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6076"/>Solis autem illis superposita erat gravis nox, <l eID="gen14377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14378"/>imago tenebrarum quæ superventura illis erat : <l eID="gen14378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14379"/>ipsi ergo sibi erant graviores tenebris.  <chapter eID="Wis.17"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:1
verses.text: Sanctis autem tuis maxima erat lux, <l eID="gen14380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14381"/>et horum quidem vocem audiebant, sed figuram non videbant. <l eID="gen14381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14382"/>Et quia non et ipsi eadem passi erant, magnificabant te ; <l eID="gen14382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6077"/><l level="1" sID="gen14383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6077"/>et qui ante læsi erant, quia non lædebantur, gratias agebant, <l eID="gen14383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14384"/>et ut esset differentia, donum petebant. <l eID="gen14384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6078"/><l level="1" sID="gen14385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6078"/>Propter quod ignis ardentem columnam <l eID="gen14385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14386"/>ducem habuerunt ignotæ viæ, <l eID="gen14386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14387"/>et solem sine læsura boni hospitii præstitisti. <l eID="gen14387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6079"/><l level="1" sID="gen14388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6079"/>Digni quidem illi carere luce, <l eID="gen14388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14389"/>et pati carcerem tenebrarum, <l eID="gen14389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14390"/>qui inclusos custodiebant filios tuos, <l eID="gen14390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14391"/>per quos incipiebat incorruptum legis lumen sæculo dari. <l eID="gen14391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6080"/><l level="1" sID="gen14392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6080"/>Cum cogitarent justorum occidere infantes, <l eID="gen14392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14393"/>et uno exposito filio et liberato, <l eID="gen14393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14394"/>in traductionem illorum, multitudinem filiorum abstulisti, <l eID="gen14394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14395"/>et pariter illos perdidisti in aqua valida. <l eID="gen14395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6081"/><l level="1" sID="gen14396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6081"/>Illa enim nox ante cognita est a patribus nostris, <l eID="gen14396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14397"/>ut vere scientes quibus juramentis crediderunt, <l eID="gen14397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14398"/>animæquiores essent. <l eID="gen14398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6082"/><l level="1" sID="gen14399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6082"/>Suscepta est autem a populo tuo sanitas quidem justorum, <l eID="gen14399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14400"/>injustorum autem exterminatio. <l eID="gen14400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6083"/><l level="1" sID="gen14401"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6083"/>Sicut enim læsisti adversarios, <l eID="gen14401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14402"/>sic et nos provocans magnificasti. <l eID="gen14402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6084"/><l level="1" sID="gen14403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6084"/>Absconse enim sacrificabant justi pueri bonorum, <l eID="gen14403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14404"/>et justitiæ legem in concordia disposuerunt ; <l eID="gen14404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14405"/>similiter et bona et mala recepturos justos, <l eID="gen14405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14406"/>patrum jam decantantes laudes. <l eID="gen14406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6085"/><l level="1" sID="gen14407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6085"/>Resonabat autem inconveniens inimicorum vox, <l eID="gen14407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14408"/>et flebilis audiebatur planctus ploratorum infantium. <l eID="gen14408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6086"/><l level="1" sID="gen14409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6086"/>Simili autem pœna servus cum domino afflictus est, <l eID="gen14409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14410"/>et popularis homo regi similia passus. <l eID="gen14410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6087"/><l level="1" sID="gen14411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6087"/>Similiter ergo omnes, uno nomine mortis, <l eID="gen14411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14412"/>mortuos habebant innumerabiles : <l eID="gen14412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14413"/>nec enim ad sepeliendum vivi sufficiebant, <l eID="gen14413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14414"/>quoniam uno momento quæ erat præclarior <l eID="gen14414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14415"/>natio illorum exterminata est. <l eID="gen14415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6088"/><l level="1" sID="gen14416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6088"/>De omnibus enim non credentes, propter veneficia ; <l eID="gen14416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14417"/>tunc vero primum cum fuit exterminium primogenitorum, <l eID="gen14417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14418"/>spoponderunt populum Dei esse. <l eID="gen14418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6089"/><l level="1" sID="gen14419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6089"/>Cum enim quietum silentium contineret omnia, <l eID="gen14419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14420"/>et nox in suo cursu medium iter haberet, <l eID="gen14420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6090"/><l level="1" sID="gen14421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6090"/>omnipotens sermo tuus de cælo, a regalibus sedibus, <l eID="gen14421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14422"/>durus debellator in mediam exterminii terram prosilivit, <l eID="gen14422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6091"/><l level="1" sID="gen14423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6091"/>gladius acutus insimulatum imperium tuum portans : <l eID="gen14423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14424"/>et stans, replevit omnia morte, <l eID="gen14424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14425"/>et usque ad cælum attingebat stans in terra. <l eID="gen14425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6092"/><l level="1" sID="gen14426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6092"/>Tunc continuo visus somniorum malorum turbaverunt illos, <l eID="gen14426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14427"/>et timores supervenerunt insperati. <l eID="gen14427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6093"/><l level="1" sID="gen14428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6093"/>Et alius alibi projectus semivivus, <l eID="gen14428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14429"/>propter quam moriebatur causam demonstrabat mortis. <l eID="gen14429" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6094"/><l level="1" sID="gen14430"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6094"/>Visiones enim quæ illos turbaverunt hæc præmonebant, <l eID="gen14430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14431"/>ne inscii quare mala patiebantur perirent. <l eID="gen14431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6095"/><l level="1" sID="gen14432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6095"/>Tetigit autem tunc et justos tentatio mortis, <l eID="gen14432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14433"/>et commotio in eremo facta est multitudinis : <l eID="gen14433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14434"/>sed non diu permansit ira tua. <l eID="gen14434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6096"/><l level="1" sID="gen14435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6096"/>Prosperans enim homo sine querela deprecari pro populis, <l eID="gen14435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14436"/>proferens servitutis suæ scutum, <l eID="gen14436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14437"/>orationem et per incensum deprecationem allegans, <l eID="gen14437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14438"/>restitit iræ, et finem imposuit necessitati, <l eID="gen14438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14439"/>ostendens quoniam tuus est famulus. <l eID="gen14439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6097"/><l level="1" sID="gen14440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6097"/>Vicit autem turbas non in virtute corporis, <l eID="gen14440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14441"/>nec armaturæ potentia : <l eID="gen14441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14442"/>sed verbo illum qui se vexabat subjecit, <l eID="gen14442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14443"/>juramenta parentum et testamentum commemorans. <l eID="gen14443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6098"/><l level="1" sID="gen14444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6098"/>Cum enim jam acervatim cecidissent super alterutrum mortui, <l eID="gen14444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14445"/>interstitit, et amputavit impetum, <l eID="gen14445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14446"/>et divisit illam quæ ad vivos ducebat viam. <l eID="gen14446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6099"/><l level="1" sID="gen14447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6099"/>In veste enim poderis quam habebat, totus erat orbis terrarum ; <l eID="gen14447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14448"/>et parentum magnalia in quatuor ordinibus lapidum erant sculpta, <l eID="gen14448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14449"/>et magnificentia tua in diademate capitis illius sculpta erat. <l eID="gen14449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 18:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6100"/><l level="1" sID="gen14450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6100"/>His autem cessit qui exterminabat, et hæc extimuit : <l eID="gen14450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14451"/>erat enim sola tentatio iræ sufficiens.  <chapter eID="Wis.18"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:1
verses.text: Impiis autem usque in novissimum <l eID="gen14452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14453"/>sine misericordia ira supervenit. <l eID="gen14453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14454"/>Præsciebat enim et futura illorum : <l eID="gen14454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6101"/><l level="1" sID="gen14455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6101"/>quoniam cum ipsi permisissent ut se educerent, <l eID="gen14455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14456"/>et cum magna sollicitudine præmisissent illos, <l eID="gen14456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14457"/>consequebantur illos, pœnitentia acti. <l eID="gen14457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6102"/><l level="1" sID="gen14458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6102"/>Adhuc enim inter manus habentes luctum, <l eID="gen14458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14459"/>et deplorantes ad monumenta mortuorum, <l eID="gen14459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14460"/>aliam sibi assumpserunt cogitationem inscientiæ, <l eID="gen14460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14461"/>et quos rogantes projecerant, <l eID="gen14461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14462"/>hos tamquam fugitivos persequebantur. <l eID="gen14462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6103"/><l level="1" sID="gen14463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6103"/>Ducebat enim illos ad hunc finem digna necessitas ; <l eID="gen14463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14464"/>et horum quæ acciderant commemorationem amittebant, <l eID="gen14464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14465"/>ut quæ deerant tormentis repleret punitio : <l eID="gen14465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6104"/><l level="1" sID="gen14466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6104"/>et populus quidem tuus mirabiliter transiret, <l eID="gen14466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14467"/>illi autem novam mortem invenirent. <l eID="gen14467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6105"/><l level="1" sID="gen14468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6105"/>Omnis enim creatura ad suum genus ab initio refigurabatur, <l eID="gen14468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14469"/>deserviens tuis præceptis, <l eID="gen14469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14470"/>ut pueri tui custodirentur illæsi. <l eID="gen14470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6106"/><l level="1" sID="gen14471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6106"/>Nam nubes castra eorum obumbrabat, <l eID="gen14471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14472"/>et ex aqua quæ ante erat, terra arida apparuit, <l eID="gen14472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14473"/>et in mari Rubro via sine impedimento, <l eID="gen14473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14474"/>et campus germinans de profundo nimio : <l eID="gen14474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6107"/><l level="1" sID="gen14475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6107"/>per quem omnis natio transivit quæ tegebatur tua manu, <l eID="gen14475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14476"/>videntes tua mirabilia et monstra. <l eID="gen14476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6108"/><l level="1" sID="gen14477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6108"/>Tamquam enim equi depaverunt escam, <l eID="gen14477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14478"/>et tamquam agni exsultaverunt, <l eID="gen14478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14479"/>magnificantes te, Domine, qui liberasti illos. <l eID="gen14479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6109"/><l level="1" sID="gen14480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6109"/>Memores enim erant adhuc eorum <l eID="gen14480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14481"/>quæ in incolatu illorum facta fuerant : <l eID="gen14481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14482"/>quemadmodum pro natione animalium eduxit terra muscas, <l eID="gen14482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14483"/>et pro piscibus eructavit fluvius multitudinem ranarum. <l eID="gen14483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6110"/><l level="1" sID="gen14484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6110"/>Novissime autem viderunt novam creaturam avium, <l eID="gen14484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14485"/>cum, adducti concupiscentia, postulaverunt escas epulationis. <l eID="gen14485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6111"/><l level="1" sID="gen14486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6111"/>In allocutione enim desiderii ascendit illis de mari ortygometra : <l eID="gen14486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14487"/>et vexationes peccatoribus supervenerunt, <l eID="gen14487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14488"/>non sine illis quæ ante facta erant argumentis per vim fulminum : <l eID="gen14488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14489"/>juste enim patiebantur secundum suas nequitias. <l eID="gen14489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6112"/><l level="1" sID="gen14490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6112"/>Etenim detestabiliorem inhospitalitatem instituerunt : <l eID="gen14490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14491"/>alii quidem ignotos non recipiebant advenas ; <l eID="gen14491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14492"/>alii autem bonos hospites in servitutem redigebant. <l eID="gen14492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6113"/><l level="1" sID="gen14493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6113"/>Et non solum hæc, sed et alius quidam respectus illorum erat, <l eID="gen14493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14494"/>quoniam inviti recipiebant extraneos. <l eID="gen14494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6114"/><l level="1" sID="gen14495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6114"/>Qui autem cum lætitia receperunt hos <l eID="gen14495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14496"/>qui eisdem usi erant justitiis, <l eID="gen14496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14497"/>sævissimis afflixerunt doloribus. <l eID="gen14497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6115"/><l level="1" sID="gen14498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6115"/>Percussi sunt autem cæcitate : <l eID="gen14498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14499"/>sicut illi in foribus justi, <l eID="gen14499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14500"/>cum subitaneis cooperti essent tenebris, <l eID="gen14500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14501"/>unusquisque transitum ostii sui quærebat. <l eID="gen14501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6116"/><l level="1" sID="gen14502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6116"/>In se enim elementa dum convertuntur, <l eID="gen14502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14503"/>sicut in organo qualitatis sonus immutatur, <l eID="gen14503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14504"/>et omnia suum sonum custodiunt : <l eID="gen14504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14505"/>unde æstimari ex ipso visu certo potest. <l eID="gen14505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6117"/><l level="1" sID="gen14506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6117"/>Agrestia enim in aquatica convertebantur, <l eID="gen14506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14507"/>et quæcumque erant natantia, in terram transibant. <l eID="gen14507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6118"/><l level="1" sID="gen14508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6118"/>Ignis in aqua valebat supra suam virtutem, <l eID="gen14508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14509"/>et aqua extinguentis naturæ obliviscebatur. <l eID="gen14509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Wisdom 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6119"/><l level="1" sID="gen14510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6119"/>Flammæ e contrario corruptibilium animalium <l eID="gen14510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14511"/>non vexaverunt carnes coambulantium, <l eID="gen14511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14512"/>nec dissolvebant illam, quæ facile dissolvebatur sicut glacies, bonam escam. <l eID="gen14512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14513"/>In omnibus enim magnificasti populum tuum, Domine, <l eID="gen14513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14514"/>et honorasti, et non despexisti, <l eID="gen14514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14515"/>in omni tempore et in omni loco assistens eis. <l eID="gen14515" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen13310"/> <chapter eID="Wis.19"/> <div eID="gen13309" osisID="Wis" type="book"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:1
verses.text: Omnis sapientia a Domino Deo est : <l eID="gen14519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14520"/>et cum illo fuit semper, et est ante ævum. <l eID="gen14520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6120"/><l level="1" sID="gen14521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6120"/>Arenam maris, et pluviæ guttas, <l eID="gen14521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14522"/>et dies sæculi, quis dinumeravit ? <l eID="gen14522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14523"/>altitudinem cæli, et latitudinem terræ, <l eID="gen14523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14524"/>et profundum abyssi, quis dimensus est ? <l eID="gen14524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6121"/><l level="1" sID="gen14525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6121"/>sapientiam Dei præcedentem omnia, quis investigavit ? <l eID="gen14525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6122"/><l level="1" sID="gen14526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6122"/>Prior omnium creata est sapientia, <l eID="gen14526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14527"/>et intellectus prudentiæ ab ævo. <l eID="gen14527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6123"/><l level="1" sID="gen14528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6123"/>Fons sapientiæ verbum Dei in excelsis, <l eID="gen14528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14529"/>et ingressus illius mandata æterna. <l eID="gen14529" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6124"/><l level="1" sID="gen14530"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6124"/>Radix sapientiæ cui revelata est ? <l eID="gen14530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14531"/>et astutias illius quis agnovit ? <l eID="gen14531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6125"/><l level="1" sID="gen14532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6125"/>disciplina sapientiæ cui revelata est et manifestata ? <l eID="gen14532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14533"/>et multiplicationem ingressus illius quis intellexit ? <l eID="gen14533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6126"/><l level="1" sID="gen14534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6126"/>Unus est altissimus, Creator omnipotens, <l eID="gen14534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14535"/>et rex potens et metuendus nimis, <l eID="gen14535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14536"/>sedens super thronum illius, et dominans Deus. <l eID="gen14536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6127"/><l level="1" sID="gen14537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6127"/>Ipse creavit illam in Spiritu Sancto, <l eID="gen14537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14538"/>et vidit, et dinumeravit, et mensus est : <l eID="gen14538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6128"/><l level="1" sID="gen14539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6128"/>et effudit illam super omnia opera sua, <l eID="gen14539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14540"/>et super omnem carnem, secundum datum suum, <l eID="gen14540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14541"/>et præbuit illam diligentibus se. <l eID="gen14541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6129"/><l level="1" sID="gen14542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6129"/>Timor Domini gloria, et gloriatio, <l eID="gen14542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14543"/>et lætitia, et corona exsultationis. <l eID="gen14543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6130"/><l level="1" sID="gen14544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6130"/>Timor Domini delectabit cor, <l eID="gen14544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14545"/>et dabit lætitiam, et gaudium, et longitudinem dierum. <l eID="gen14545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6131"/><l level="1" sID="gen14546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6131"/>Timenti Dominum bene erit in extremis, <l eID="gen14546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14547"/>et in die defunctionis suæ benedicetur. <l eID="gen14547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6132"/><l level="1" sID="gen14548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6132"/>Dilectio Dei honorabilis sapientia : <l eID="gen14548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6133"/><l level="1" sID="gen14549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6133"/>quibus autem apparuerit in visu diligunt eam in visione, <l eID="gen14549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14550"/>et in agnitione magnalium suorum. <l eID="gen14550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6134"/><l level="1" sID="gen14551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6134"/>Initium sapientiæ timor Domini : <l eID="gen14551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14552"/>et cum fidelibus in vulva concreatus est : <l eID="gen14552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14553"/>cum electis feminis graditur, <l eID="gen14553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14554"/>et cum justis et fidelibus agnoscitur. <l eID="gen14554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6135"/><l level="1" sID="gen14555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6135"/>Timor Domini scientiæ religiositas : <l eID="gen14555" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6136"/><l level="1" sID="gen14556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6136"/>religiositas custodiet et justificabit cor ; <l eID="gen14556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14557"/>jucunditatem atque gaudium dabit. <l eID="gen14557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6137"/><l level="1" sID="gen14558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6137"/>Timenti Dominum bene erit, <l eID="gen14558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14559"/>et in diebus consummationis illius benedicetur. <l eID="gen14559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6138"/><l level="1" sID="gen14560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6138"/>Plenitudo sapientiæ est timere Deum, <l eID="gen14560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14561"/>et plenitudo a fructibus illius. <l eID="gen14561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6139"/><l level="1" sID="gen14562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6139"/>Omnem domum illius implebit a generationibus, <l eID="gen14562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14563"/>et receptacula a thesauris illius. <l eID="gen14563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6140"/><l level="1" sID="gen14564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6140"/>Corona sapientiæ timor Domini, <l eID="gen14564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14565"/>replens pacem et salutis fructum : <l eID="gen14565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6141"/><l level="1" sID="gen14566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6141"/>et vidit, et dinumeravit eam : <l eID="gen14566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14567"/>utraque autem sunt dona Dei. <l eID="gen14567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6142"/><l level="1" sID="gen14568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6142"/>Scientiam et intellectum prudentiæ sapientia compartietur, <l eID="gen14568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14569"/>et gloriam tenentium se exaltat. <l eID="gen14569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6143"/><l level="1" sID="gen14570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6143"/>Radix sapientiæ est timere Dominum, <l eID="gen14570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14571"/>et rami illius longævi. <l eID="gen14571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6144"/><l level="1" sID="gen14572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6144"/>In thesauris sapientiæ intellectus et scientiæ religiositas : <l eID="gen14572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14573"/>execratio autem peccatoribus sapientia. <l eID="gen14573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6145"/><l level="1" sID="gen14574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6145"/>Timor Domini expellit peccatum : <l eID="gen14574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6146"/><l level="1" sID="gen14575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6146"/>nam qui sine timore est non poterit justificari : <l eID="gen14575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14576"/>iracundia enim animositatis illius subversio illius est. <l eID="gen14576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6147"/><l level="1" sID="gen14577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6147"/>Usque in tempus sustinebit patiens, <l eID="gen14577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14578"/>et postea redditio jucunditatis. <l eID="gen14578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6148"/><l level="1" sID="gen14579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6148"/>Bonus sensus usque in tempus abscondet verba illius, <l eID="gen14579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14580"/>et labia multorum enarrabunt sensum illius. <l eID="gen14580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6149"/><l level="1" sID="gen14581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6149"/>In thesauris sapientiæ significatio disciplinæ : <l eID="gen14581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6150"/><l level="1" sID="gen14582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6150"/>execratio autem peccatori cultura Dei. <l eID="gen14582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6151"/><l level="1" sID="gen14583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6151"/>Fili, concupiscens sapientiam, conserva justitiam, <l eID="gen14583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14584"/>et Deus præbebit illam tibi. <l eID="gen14584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6152"/><l level="1" sID="gen14585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6152"/>Sapientia enim et disciplina timor Domini : <l eID="gen14585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14586"/>et quod beneplacitum est illi, <l eID="gen14586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6153"/><l level="1" sID="gen14587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6153"/>fides et mansuetudo, <l eID="gen14587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14588"/>et adimplebit thesauros illius. <l eID="gen14588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6154"/><l level="1" sID="gen14589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6154"/>Ne sis incredibilis timori Domini, <l eID="gen14589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14590"/>et ne accesseris ad illum duplici corde. <l eID="gen14590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6155"/><l level="1" sID="gen14591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6155"/>Ne fueris hypocrita in conspectu hominum, <l eID="gen14591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14592"/>et non scandalizeris in labiis tuis. <l eID="gen14592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6156"/><l level="1" sID="gen14593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6156"/>Attende in illis, ne forte cadas, <l eID="gen14593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14594"/>et adducas animæ tuæ inhonorationem : <l eID="gen14594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6157"/><l level="1" sID="gen14595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6157"/>et revelet Deus absconsa tua, <l eID="gen14595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14596"/>et in medio synagogæ elidat te : <l eID="gen14596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 1:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6158"/><l level="1" sID="gen14597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6158"/>quoniam accessisti maligne ad Dominum, <l eID="gen14597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14598"/>et cor tuum plenum est dolo et fallacia.  <chapter eID="Sir.1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:1
verses.text: Fili, accedens ad servitutem Dei <l eID="gen14599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14600"/>sta in justitia et timore, <l eID="gen14600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14601"/>et præpara animam tuam ad tentationem. <l eID="gen14601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6159"/><l level="1" sID="gen14602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6159"/>Deprime cor tuum, et sustine : <l eID="gen14602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14603"/>inclina aurem tuam, et suscipe verba intellectus : <l eID="gen14603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14604"/>et ne festines in tempore obductionis. <l eID="gen14604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6160"/><l level="1" sID="gen14605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6160"/>Sustine sustentationes Dei : <l eID="gen14605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14606"/>conjungere Deo, et sustine, <l eID="gen14606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14607"/>ut crescat in novissimo vita tua. <l eID="gen14607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6161"/><l level="1" sID="gen14608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6161"/>Omne quod tibi applicitum fuerit accipe : <l eID="gen14608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14609"/>et in dolore sustine, <l eID="gen14609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14610"/>et in humilitate tua patientiam habe : <l eID="gen14610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6162"/><l level="1" sID="gen14611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6162"/>quoniam in igne probatur aurum et argentum, <l eID="gen14611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14612"/>homines vero receptibiles in camino humiliationis. <l eID="gen14612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6163"/><l level="1" sID="gen14613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6163"/>Crede Deo, et recuperabit te : <l eID="gen14613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14614"/>et dirige viam tuam, et spera in illum : <l eID="gen14614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14615"/>serva timorem illius, et in illo veterasce. <l eID="gen14615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6164"/><l level="1" sID="gen14616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6164"/>Metuentes Dominum, sustinete misericordiam ejus : <l eID="gen14616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14617"/>et non deflectatis ab illo, ne cadatis. <l eID="gen14617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6165"/><l level="1" sID="gen14618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6165"/>Qui timetis Dominum, credite illi, <l eID="gen14618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14619"/>et non evacuabitur merces vestra. <l eID="gen14619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6166"/><l level="1" sID="gen14620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6166"/>Qui timetis Dominum, sperate in illum, <l eID="gen14620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14621"/>et in oblectationem veniet vobis misericordia. <l eID="gen14621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6167"/><l level="1" sID="gen14622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6167"/>Qui timetis Dominum, diligite illum, <l eID="gen14622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14623"/>et illuminabuntur corda vestra. <l eID="gen14623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6168"/><l level="1" sID="gen14624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6168"/>Respicite, filii, nationes hominum : <l eID="gen14624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14625"/>et scitote quia nullus speravit in Domino et confusus est. <l eID="gen14625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6169"/><l level="1" sID="gen14626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6169"/>Quis enim permansit in mandatis ejus, et derelictus est ? <l eID="gen14626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14627"/>aut quis invocavit eum, et despexit illum ? <l eID="gen14627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6170"/><l level="1" sID="gen14628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6170"/>Quoniam pius et misericors est Deus, <l eID="gen14628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14629"/>et remittet in die tribulationis peccata, <l eID="gen14629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14630"/>et protector est omnibus exquirentibus se in veritate. <l eID="gen14630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6171"/><l level="1" sID="gen14631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6171"/>Væ duplici corde, et labiis scelestis, <l eID="gen14631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14632"/>et manibus malefacientibus, <l eID="gen14632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14633"/>et peccatori terram ingredienti duabus viis ! <l eID="gen14633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6172"/><l level="1" sID="gen14634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6172"/>Væ dissolutis corde, qui non credunt Deo, <l eID="gen14634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14635"/>et ideo non protegentur ab eo ! <l eID="gen14635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6173"/><l level="1" sID="gen14636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6173"/>Væ his qui perdiderunt sustinentiam, <l eID="gen14636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14637"/>et qui dereliquerunt vias rectas, <l eID="gen14637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14638"/>et diverterunt in vias pravas ! <l eID="gen14638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6174"/><l level="1" sID="gen14639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6174"/>Et quid facient cum inspicere cœperit Dominus ? <l eID="gen14639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6175"/><l level="1" sID="gen14640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6175"/>Qui timent Dominum non erunt incredibiles verbo illius : <l eID="gen14640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14641"/>et qui diligunt illum conservabunt viam illius. <l eID="gen14641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6176"/><l level="1" sID="gen14642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6176"/>Qui timent Dominum inquirent quæ beneplacita sunt ei, <l eID="gen14642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14643"/>et qui diligunt eum replebuntur lege ipsius. <l eID="gen14643" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6177"/><l level="1" sID="gen14644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6177"/>Qui timent Dominum præparabunt corda sua, <l eID="gen14644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14645"/>et in conspectu illius sanctificabunt animas suas. <l eID="gen14645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6178"/><l level="1" sID="gen14646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6178"/>Qui timent Dominum custodiunt mandata illius, <l eID="gen14646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14647"/>et patientiam habebunt usque ad inspectionem illius, <l eID="gen14647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6179"/><l level="1" sID="gen14648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6179"/>dicentes : Si pœnitentiam non egerimus, <l eID="gen14648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14649"/>incidemus in manus Domini, et non in manus hominum. <l eID="gen14649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6180"/><l level="1" sID="gen14650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6180"/>Secundum enim magnitudinem ipsius, <l eID="gen14650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14651"/>sic et misericordia illius cum ipso est.  <chapter eID="Sir.2"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:1
verses.text: Filii sapientiæ ecclesia justorum, <l eID="gen14652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14653"/>et natio illorum obedientia et dilectio. <l eID="gen14653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6181"/><l level="1" sID="gen14654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6181"/>Judicium patris audite, filii, <l eID="gen14654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14655"/>et sic facite, ut salvi sitis. <l eID="gen14655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6182"/><l level="1" sID="gen14656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6182"/>Deus enim honoravit patrem in filiis : <l eID="gen14656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14657"/>et judicium matris exquirens, firmavit in filios. <l eID="gen14657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6183"/><l level="1" sID="gen14658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6183"/>Qui diligit Deum exorabit pro peccatis, <l eID="gen14658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14659"/>et continebit se ab illis, <l eID="gen14659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14660"/>et in oratione dierum exaudietur. <l eID="gen14660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6184"/><l level="1" sID="gen14661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6184"/>Et sicut qui thesaurizat, <l eID="gen14661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14662"/>ita et qui honorificat matrem suam. <l eID="gen14662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6185"/><l level="1" sID="gen14663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6185"/>Qui honorat patrem suum jucundabitur in filiis, <l eID="gen14663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14664"/>et in die orationis suæ exaudietur. <l eID="gen14664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6186"/><l level="1" sID="gen14665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6186"/>Qui honorat patrem suum vita vivet longiore, <l eID="gen14665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14666"/>et qui obedit patri refrigerabit matrem. <l eID="gen14666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6187"/><l level="1" sID="gen14667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6187"/>Qui timet Dominum honorat parentes, <l eID="gen14667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14668"/>et quasi dominis serviet his qui se genuerunt. <l eID="gen14668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6188"/><l level="1" sID="gen14669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6188"/>In opere, et sermone, et omni patientia, honora patrem tuum, <l eID="gen14669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6189"/><l level="1" sID="gen14670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6189"/>ut superveniat tibi benedictio ab eo, <l eID="gen14670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14671"/>et benedictio illius in novissimo maneat. <l eID="gen14671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6190"/><l level="1" sID="gen14672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6190"/>Benedictio patris firmat domos filiorum : <l eID="gen14672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14673"/>maledictio autem matris eradicat fundamenta. <l eID="gen14673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:12
