verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6191"/><l level="1" sID="gen14674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6191"/>Ne glorieris in contumelia patris tui : <l eID="gen14674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14675"/>non enim est tibi gloria ejus confusio. <l eID="gen14675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6192"/><l level="1" sID="gen14676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6192"/>Gloria enim hominis ex honore patris sui, <l eID="gen14676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14677"/>et dedecus filii pater sine honore. <l eID="gen14677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6193"/><l level="1" sID="gen14678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6193"/>Fili, suscipe senectam patris tui, <l eID="gen14678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14679"/>et non contristes eum in vita illius : <l eID="gen14679" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6194"/><l level="1" sID="gen14680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6194"/>et si defecerit sensu, veniam da, <l eID="gen14680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14681"/>et ne spernas eum in virtute tua : <l eID="gen14681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14682"/>eleemosyna enim patris non erit in oblivione. <l eID="gen14682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6195"/><l level="1" sID="gen14683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6195"/>Nam pro peccato matris restituetur tibi bonum : <l eID="gen14683" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6196"/><l level="1" sID="gen14684"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6196"/>et in justitia ædificabitur tibi, <l eID="gen14684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14685"/>et in die tribulationis commemorabitur tui, <l eID="gen14685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14686"/>et sicut in sereno glacies, solventur peccata tua. <l eID="gen14686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6197"/><l level="1" sID="gen14687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6197"/>Quam malæ famæ est qui derelinquit patrem, <l eID="gen14687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14688"/>et est maledictus a Deo qui exasperat matrem ! <l eID="gen14688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6198"/><l level="1" sID="gen14689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6198"/>Fili, in mansuetudine opera tua perfice, <l eID="gen14689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14690"/>et super hominum gloriam diligeris. <l eID="gen14690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6199"/><l level="1" sID="gen14691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6199"/>Quanto magnus es, humilia te in omnibus, <l eID="gen14691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14692"/>et coram Deo invenies gratiam : <l eID="gen14692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6200"/><l level="1" sID="gen14693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6200"/>quoniam magna potentia Dei solius, <l eID="gen14693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14694"/>et ab humilibus honoratur. <l eID="gen14694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6201"/><l level="1" sID="gen14695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6201"/>Altiora te ne quæsieris, <l eID="gen14695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14696"/>et fortiora te ne scrutatus fueris : <l eID="gen14696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14697"/>sed quæ præcepit tibi Deus, illa cogita semper, <l eID="gen14697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14698"/>et in pluribus operibus ejus ne fueris curiosus. <l eID="gen14698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6202"/><l level="1" sID="gen14699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6202"/>Non est enim tibi necessarium <l eID="gen14699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14700"/>ea, quæ abscondita sunt, videre oculis tuis. <l eID="gen14700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6203"/><l level="1" sID="gen14701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6203"/>In supervacuis rebus noli scrutari multipliciter, <l eID="gen14701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14702"/>et in pluribus operibus ejus non eris curiosus. <l eID="gen14702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6204"/><l level="1" sID="gen14703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6204"/>Plurima enim super sensum hominum ostensa sunt tibi : <l eID="gen14703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6205"/><l level="1" sID="gen14704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6205"/>multos quoque supplantavit suspicio illorum, <l eID="gen14704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14705"/>et in vanitate detinuit sensus illorum. <l eID="gen14705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6206"/><l level="1" sID="gen14706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6206"/>Cor durum habebit male in novissimo, <l eID="gen14706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14707"/>et qui amat periculum in illo peribit. <l eID="gen14707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6207"/><l level="1" sID="gen14708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6207"/>Cor ingrediens duas vias non habebit successus, <l eID="gen14708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14709"/>et pravus corde in illis scandalizabitur. <l eID="gen14709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6208"/><l level="1" sID="gen14710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6208"/>Cor nequam gravabitur in doloribus, <l eID="gen14710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14711"/>et peccator adjiciet ad peccandum. <l eID="gen14711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6209"/><l level="1" sID="gen14712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6209"/>Synagogæ superborum non erit sanitas, <l eID="gen14712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14713"/>frutex enim peccati radicabitur in illis, et non intelligetur. <l eID="gen14713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6210"/><l level="1" sID="gen14714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6210"/>Cor sapientis intelligitur in sapientia, <l eID="gen14714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14715"/>et auris bona audiet cum omni concupiscentia sapientiam. <l eID="gen14715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6211"/><l level="1" sID="gen14716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6211"/>Sapiens cor et intelligibile abstinebit se a peccatis, <l eID="gen14716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14717"/>et in operibus justitiæ successus habebit. <l eID="gen14717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6212"/><l level="1" sID="gen14718"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6212"/>Ignem ardentem exstinguit aqua, <l eID="gen14718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14719"/>et eleemosyna resistit peccatis : <l eID="gen14719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 3:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6213"/><l level="1" sID="gen14720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6213"/>et Deus prospector est ejus qui reddit gratiam : <l eID="gen14720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14721"/>meminit ejus in posterum, <l eID="gen14721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14722"/>et in tempore casus sui inveniet firmamentum.  <chapter eID="Sir.3"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:1
verses.text: Fili, eleemosynam pauperis ne defraudes, <l eID="gen14723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14724"/>et oculos tuos ne transvertas a paupere. <l eID="gen14724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6214"/><l level="1" sID="gen14725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6214"/>Animam esurientem ne despexeris, <l eID="gen14725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14726"/>et non exasperes pauperem in inopia sua. <l eID="gen14726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6215"/><l level="1" sID="gen14727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6215"/>Cor inopis ne afflixeris, <l eID="gen14727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14728"/>et non protrahas datum angustianti. <l eID="gen14728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6216"/><l level="1" sID="gen14729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6216"/>Rogationem contribulati ne abjicias, <l eID="gen14729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14730"/>et non avertas faciem tuam ab egeno. <l eID="gen14730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6217"/><l level="1" sID="gen14731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6217"/>Ab inope ne avertas oculos tuos propter iram : <l eID="gen14731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14732"/>et non relinquas quærentibus tibi retro maledicere. <l eID="gen14732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6218"/><l level="1" sID="gen14733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6218"/>Maledicentis enim tibi in amaritudine animæ, <l eID="gen14733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14734"/>exaudietur deprecatio illius : <l eID="gen14734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14735"/>exaudiet autem eum qui fecit illum. <l eID="gen14735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6219"/><l level="1" sID="gen14736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6219"/>Congregationi pauperum affabilem te facito : <l eID="gen14736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14737"/>et presbytero humilia animam tuam, <l eID="gen14737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14738"/>et magnato humilia caput tuum. <l eID="gen14738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6220"/><l level="1" sID="gen14739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6220"/>Declina pauperi sine tristitia aurem tuam, <l eID="gen14739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14740"/>et redde debitum tuum, <l eID="gen14740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14741"/>et responde illi pacifica in mansuetudine. <l eID="gen14741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6221"/><l level="1" sID="gen14742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6221"/>Libera eum qui injuriam patitur de manu superbi, <l eID="gen14742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14743"/>et non acide feras in anima tua. <l eID="gen14743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6222"/><l level="1" sID="gen14744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6222"/>In judicando esto pupillis misericors ut pater, <l eID="gen14744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14745"/>et pro viro matri illorum : <l eID="gen14745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6223"/><l level="1" sID="gen14746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6223"/>et eris tu velut filius Altissimi obediens, <l eID="gen14746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14747"/>et miserebitur tui magis quam mater. <l eID="gen14747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6224"/><l level="1" sID="gen14748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6224"/>Sapientia filiis suis vitam inspirat : <l eID="gen14748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14749"/>et suscipit inquirentes se, <l eID="gen14749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14750"/>et præibit in via justitiæ. <l eID="gen14750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6225"/><l level="1" sID="gen14751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6225"/>Et qui illam diligit, diligit vitam, <l eID="gen14751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14752"/>et qui vigilaverint ad illam complectentur placorem ejus. <l eID="gen14752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6226"/><l level="1" sID="gen14753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6226"/>Qui tenuerint illam, vitam hæreditabunt : <l eID="gen14753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14754"/>et quo introibit benedicet Deus. <l eID="gen14754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6227"/><l level="1" sID="gen14755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6227"/>Qui serviunt ei obsequentes erunt sancto : <l eID="gen14755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14756"/>et eos qui diligunt illam, diligit Deus. <l eID="gen14756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6228"/><l level="1" sID="gen14757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6228"/>Qui audit illam judicabit gentes : <l eID="gen14757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14758"/>et qui intuetur illam permanebit confidens. <l eID="gen14758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6229"/><l level="1" sID="gen14759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6229"/>Si crediderit ei, hæreditabit illam, <l eID="gen14759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14760"/>et erunt in confirmatione creaturæ illius : <l eID="gen14760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6230"/><l level="1" sID="gen14761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6230"/>quoniam in tentatione ambulat cum eo, <l eID="gen14761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14762"/>et in primis eligit eum. <l eID="gen14762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6231"/><l level="1" sID="gen14763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6231"/>Timorem, et metum, et probationem inducet super illum : <l eID="gen14763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14764"/>et cruciabit illum in tribulatione doctrinæ suæ, <l eID="gen14764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14765"/>donec tentet eum in cogitationibus suis, <l eID="gen14765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14766"/>et credat animæ illius. <l eID="gen14766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6232"/><l level="1" sID="gen14767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6232"/>Et firmabit illum, et iter adducet directum ad illum, <l eID="gen14767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14768"/>et lætificabit illum : <l eID="gen14768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6233"/><l level="1" sID="gen14769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6233"/>et denudabit absconsa sua illi, <l eID="gen14769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14770"/>et thesaurizabit super illum scientiam et intellectum justitiæ. <l eID="gen14770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6234"/><l level="1" sID="gen14771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6234"/>Si autem oberraverit, derelinquet eum, <l eID="gen14771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14772"/>et tradet eum in manus inimici sui. <l eID="gen14772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6235"/><l level="1" sID="gen14773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6235"/>Fili, conserva tempus, <l eID="gen14773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14774"/>et devita a malo. <l eID="gen14774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6236"/><l level="1" sID="gen14775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6236"/>Pro anima tua ne confundaris dicere verum : <l eID="gen14775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6237"/><l level="1" sID="gen14776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6237"/>est enim confusio adducens peccatum, <l eID="gen14776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14777"/>et est confusio adducens gloriam et gratiam. <l eID="gen14777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6238"/><l level="1" sID="gen14778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6238"/>Ne accipias faciem adversus faciem tuam, <l eID="gen14778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14779"/>nec adversus animam tuam mendacium. <l eID="gen14779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6239"/><l level="1" sID="gen14780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6239"/>Ne reverearis proximum tuum in casu suo, <l eID="gen14780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6240"/><l level="1" sID="gen14781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6240"/>nec retineas verbum in tempore salutis. <l eID="gen14781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14782"/>Non abscondas sapientiam tuam in decore suo : <l eID="gen14782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6241"/><l level="1" sID="gen14783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6241"/>in lingua enim sapientia dignoscitur : <l eID="gen14783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14784"/>et sensus, et scientia, et doctrina in verbo sensati, <l eID="gen14784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14785"/>et firmamentum in operibus justitiæ. <l eID="gen14785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6242"/><l level="1" sID="gen14786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6242"/>Non contradicas verbo veritatis ullo modo, <l eID="gen14786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14787"/>et de mendacio ineruditionis tuæ confundere. <l eID="gen14787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6243"/><l level="1" sID="gen14788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6243"/>Non confundaris confiteri peccata tua, <l eID="gen14788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14789"/>et ne subjicias te omni homini pro peccato. <l eID="gen14789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6244"/><l level="1" sID="gen14790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6244"/>Noli resistere contra faciem potentis, <l eID="gen14790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14791"/>nec coneris contra ictum fluvii. <l eID="gen14791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6245"/><l level="1" sID="gen14792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6245"/>Pro justitia agonizare pro anima tua, <l eID="gen14792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14793"/>et usque ad mortem certa pro justitia : <l eID="gen14793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14794"/>et Deus expugnabit pro te inimicos tuos. <l eID="gen14794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6246"/><l level="1" sID="gen14795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6246"/>Noli citatus esse in lingua tua, <l eID="gen14795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14796"/>et inutilis, et remissus in operibus tuis. <l eID="gen14796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6247"/><l level="1" sID="gen14797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6247"/>Noli esse sicut leo in domo tua, <l eID="gen14797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14798"/>evertens domesticos tuos, et opprimens subjectos tibi. <l eID="gen14798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 4:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6248"/><l level="1" sID="gen14799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6248"/>Non sit porrecta manus tua ad accipiendum, <l eID="gen14799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14800"/>et ad dandum collecta.  <chapter eID="Sir.4"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:1
verses.text: Noli attendere ad possessiones iniquas, <l eID="gen14801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14802"/>et ne dixeris : Est mihi sufficiens vita : <l eID="gen14802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14803"/>nihil enim proderit in tempore vindictæ et obductionis. <l eID="gen14803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6249"/><l level="1" sID="gen14804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6249"/>Ne sequaris in fortitudine tua concupiscentiam cordis tui, <l eID="gen14804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6250"/><l level="1" sID="gen14805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6250"/>et ne dixeris : Quomodo potui ? <l eID="gen14805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14806"/>aut, Quis me subjiciet propter facta mea ? <l eID="gen14806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14807"/>Deus enim vindicans vindicabit. <l eID="gen14807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6251"/><l level="1" sID="gen14808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6251"/>Ne dixeris : Peccavi : et quid mihi accidit triste ? <l eID="gen14808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14809"/>Altissimus enim est patiens redditor. <l eID="gen14809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6252"/><l level="1" sID="gen14810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6252"/>De propitiatio peccato noli esse sine metu, <l eID="gen14810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14811"/>neque adjicias peccatum super peccatum. <l eID="gen14811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6253"/><l level="1" sID="gen14812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6253"/>Et ne dicas : Miseratio Domini magna est, <l eID="gen14812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14813"/>multitudinis peccatorum meorum miserebitur : <l eID="gen14813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6254"/><l level="1" sID="gen14814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6254"/>misericordia enim et ira ab illo cito proximant, <l eID="gen14814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14815"/>et in peccatores respicit ira illius. <l eID="gen14815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6255"/><l level="1" sID="gen14816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6255"/>Non tardes converti ad Dominum, <l eID="gen14816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14817"/>et ne differas de die in diem : <l eID="gen14817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6256"/><l level="1" sID="gen14818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6256"/>subito enim veniet ira illius, <l eID="gen14818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14819"/>et in tempore vindictæ disperdet te. <l eID="gen14819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6257"/><l level="1" sID="gen14820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6257"/>Noli anxius esse in divitiis injustis : <l eID="gen14820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14821"/>non enim proderunt tibi in die obductionis et vindictæ. <l eID="gen14821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6258"/><l level="1" sID="gen14822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6258"/>Non ventiles te in omnem ventum, <l eID="gen14822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14823"/>et non eas in omnem viam : <l eID="gen14823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14824"/>sic enim omnis peccator probatur in duplici lingua. <l eID="gen14824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6259"/><l level="1" sID="gen14825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6259"/>Esto firmus in via Domini, <l eID="gen14825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14826"/>et in veritate sensus tui et scientia : <l eID="gen14826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14827"/>et prosequatur te verbum pacis et justitiæ. <l eID="gen14827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6260"/><l level="1" sID="gen14828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6260"/>Esto mansuetus ad audiendum verbum, ut intelligas, <l eID="gen14828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14829"/>et cum sapientia proferas responsum verum. <l eID="gen14829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6261"/><l level="1" sID="gen14830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6261"/>Si est tibi intellectus, responde proximo : <l eID="gen14830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14831"/>sin autem, sit manus tua super os tuum, <l eID="gen14831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14832"/>ne capiaris in verbo indisciplinato, et confundaris. <l eID="gen14832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6262"/><l level="1" sID="gen14833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6262"/>Honor et gloria in sermone sensati : <l eID="gen14833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14834"/>lingua vero imprudentis subversio est ipsius. <l eID="gen14834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6263"/><l level="1" sID="gen14835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6263"/>Non appelleris susurro, <l eID="gen14835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14836"/>et lingua tua ne capiaris et confundaris : <l eID="gen14836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6264"/><l level="1" sID="gen14837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6264"/>super furem enim est confusio et pœnitentia, <l eID="gen14837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14838"/>et denotatio pessima super bilinguem : <l eID="gen14838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14839"/>susurratori autem odium, et inimicitia, et contumelia. <l eID="gen14839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6265"/><l level="1" sID="gen14840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6265"/>Justifica pusillum <l eID="gen14840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14841"/>et magnum similiter.  <chapter eID="Sir.5"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:1
verses.text: Noli fieri pro amico inimicus proximo : <l eID="gen14842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14843"/>improperium enim et contumeliam malus hæreditabit : <l eID="gen14843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14844"/>et omnis peccator invidus et bilinguis. <l eID="gen14844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6266"/><l level="1" sID="gen14845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6266"/>Non te extollas in cogitatione animæ tuæ velut taurus, <l eID="gen14845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14846"/>ne forte elidatur virtus tua per stultitiam : <l eID="gen14846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6267"/><l level="1" sID="gen14847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6267"/>et folia tua comedat, et fructus tuos perdat, <l eID="gen14847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14848"/>et relinquaris velut lignum aridum in eremo. <l eID="gen14848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6268"/><l level="1" sID="gen14849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6268"/>Anima enim nequam disperdet qui se habet, <l eID="gen14849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14850"/>et in gaudium inimicis dat illum, <l eID="gen14850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14851"/>et deducet in sortem impiorum. <l eID="gen14851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6269"/><l level="1" sID="gen14852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6269"/>Verbum dulce multiplicat amicos et mitigat inimicos, <l eID="gen14852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14853"/>et lingua eucharis in bono homine abundat. <l eID="gen14853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6270"/><l level="1" sID="gen14854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6270"/>Multi pacifici sint tibi : <l eID="gen14854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14855"/>et consiliarius sit tibi unus de mille. <l eID="gen14855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6271"/><l level="1" sID="gen14856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6271"/>Si possides amicum, in tentatione posside eum, <l eID="gen14856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14857"/>et ne facile credas ei. <l eID="gen14857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6272"/><l level="1" sID="gen14858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6272"/>Est enim amicus secundum tempus suum, <l eID="gen14858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14859"/>et non permanebit in die tribulationis. <l eID="gen14859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6273"/><l level="1" sID="gen14860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6273"/>Et est amicus qui convertitur ad inimicitiam, <l eID="gen14860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14861"/>et est amicus qui odium et rixam et convitia denudabit. <l eID="gen14861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6274"/><l level="1" sID="gen14862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6274"/>Est autem amicus socius mensæ, <l eID="gen14862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14863"/>et non permanebit in die necessitatis. <l eID="gen14863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6275"/><l level="1" sID="gen14864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6275"/>Amicus si permanserit fixus, erit tibi quasi coæqualis, <l eID="gen14864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14865"/>et in domesticis tuis fiducialiter aget. <l eID="gen14865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6276"/><l level="1" sID="gen14866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6276"/>Si humiliaverit se contra te, <l eID="gen14866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14867"/>et a facie tua absconderit se, <l eID="gen14867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14868"/>unanimem habebis amicitiam bonam. <l eID="gen14868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6277"/><l level="1" sID="gen14869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6277"/>Ab inimicis tuis separare, <l eID="gen14869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14870"/>et ab amicis tuis attende. <l eID="gen14870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6278"/><l level="1" sID="gen14871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6278"/>Amicus fidelis protectio fortis : <l eID="gen14871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14872"/>qui autem invenit illum, invenit thesaurum. <l eID="gen14872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6279"/><l level="1" sID="gen14873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6279"/>Amico fideli nulla est comparatio, <l eID="gen14873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14874"/>et non est digna ponderatio auri et argenti contra bonitatem fidei illius. <l eID="gen14874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6280"/><l level="1" sID="gen14875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6280"/>Amicus fidelis medicamentum vitæ et immortalitatis : <l eID="gen14875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14876"/>et qui metuunt Dominum, invenient illum. <l eID="gen14876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6281"/><l level="1" sID="gen14877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6281"/>Qui timet Deum æque habebit amicitiam bonam, <l eID="gen14877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14878"/>quoniam secundum illum erit amicus illius. <l eID="gen14878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6282"/><l level="1" sID="gen14879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6282"/>Fili, a juventute tua excipe doctrinam, <l eID="gen14879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14880"/>et usque ad canos invenies sapientiam. <l eID="gen14880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6283"/><l level="1" sID="gen14881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6283"/>Quasi is qui arat et seminat accede ad eam, <l eID="gen14881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14882"/>et sustine bonos fructus illius. <l eID="gen14882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6284"/><l level="1" sID="gen14883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6284"/>In opere enim ipsius exiguum laborabis, <l eID="gen14883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14884"/>et cito edes de generationibus illius. <l eID="gen14884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6285"/><l level="1" sID="gen14885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6285"/>Quam aspera est nimium sapientia indoctis hominibus ! <l eID="gen14885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14886"/>et non permanebit in illa excors. <l eID="gen14886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6286"/><l level="1" sID="gen14887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6286"/>Quasi lapidis virtus probatio erit in illis : <l eID="gen14887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14888"/>et non demorabuntur projicere illam. <l eID="gen14888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6287"/><l level="1" sID="gen14889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6287"/>Sapientia enim doctrinæ secundum nomen est ejus, <l eID="gen14889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14890"/>et non est multis manifestata : <l eID="gen14890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14891"/>quibus autem cognita est, <l eID="gen14891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14892"/>permanet usque ad conspectum Dei. <l eID="gen14892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6288"/><l level="1" sID="gen14893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6288"/>Audi, fili, et accipe consilium intellectus, <l eID="gen14893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14894"/>et ne abjicias consilium meum. <l eID="gen14894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6289"/><l level="1" sID="gen14895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6289"/>Injice pedem tuum in compedes illius, <l eID="gen14895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14896"/>et in torques illius collum tuum. <l eID="gen14896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6290"/><l level="1" sID="gen14897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6290"/>Subjice humerum tuum, et porta illam, <l eID="gen14897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14898"/>et ne acedieris vinculis ejus. <l eID="gen14898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6291"/><l level="1" sID="gen14899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6291"/>In omni animo tuo accede ad illam, <l eID="gen14899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14900"/>et in omni virtute tua conserva vias ejus. <l eID="gen14900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6292"/><l level="1" sID="gen14901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6292"/>Investiga illam, et manifestabitur tibi : <l eID="gen14901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14902"/>et continens factus, ne derelinquas eam : <l eID="gen14902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6293"/><l level="1" sID="gen14903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6293"/>in novissimis enim invenies requiem in ea, <l eID="gen14903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14904"/>et convertetur tibi in oblectationem. <l eID="gen14904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6294"/><l level="1" sID="gen14905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6294"/>Et erunt tibi compedes ejus in protectionem fortitudinis et bases virtutis, <l eID="gen14905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14906"/>et torques illius in stolam gloriæ : <l eID="gen14906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6295"/><l level="1" sID="gen14907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6295"/>decor enim vitæ est in illa, <l eID="gen14907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14908"/>et vincula illius alligatura salutaris. <l eID="gen14908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6296"/><l level="1" sID="gen14909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6296"/>Stolam gloriæ indues eam, <l eID="gen14909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14910"/>et coronam gratulationis superpones tibi. <l eID="gen14910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6297"/><l level="1" sID="gen14911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6297"/>Fili, si attenderis mihi, disces : <l eID="gen14911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14912"/>et si accommodaveris animum tuum, sapiens eris. <l eID="gen14912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6298"/><l level="1" sID="gen14913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6298"/>Si inclinaveris aurem tuam, excipies doctrinam : <l eID="gen14913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14914"/>et si dilexeris audire, sapiens eris. <l eID="gen14914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6299"/><l level="1" sID="gen14915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6299"/>In multitudine presbyterorum prudentium sta, <l eID="gen14915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14916"/>et sapientiæ illorum ex corde conjungere, <l eID="gen14916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14917"/>ut omnem narrationem Dei possis audire, <l eID="gen14917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14918"/>et proverbia laudis non effugiant a te. <l eID="gen14918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6300"/><l level="1" sID="gen14919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6300"/>Et si videris sensatum, evigila ad eum, <l eID="gen14919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14920"/>et gradus ostiorum illius exterat pes tuus. <l eID="gen14920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 6:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6301"/><l level="1" sID="gen14921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6301"/>Cogitatum tuum habe in præceptis Dei, <l eID="gen14921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14922"/>et in mandatis illius maxime assiduus esto : <l eID="gen14922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14923"/>et ipse dabit tibi cor, <l eID="gen14923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14924"/>et concupiscentia sapientiæ dabitur tibi.  <chapter eID="Sir.6"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:1
verses.text: Noli facere mala, et non te apprehendent : <l eID="gen14925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6302"/><l level="1" sID="gen14926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6302"/>discede ab iniquo, et deficient mala abs te. <l eID="gen14926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6303"/><l level="1" sID="gen14927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6303"/>Fili, non semines mala in sulcis injustitiæ, <l eID="gen14927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14928"/>et non metes ea in septuplum. <l eID="gen14928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6304"/><l level="1" sID="gen14929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6304"/>Noli quærere a Domino ducatum, <l eID="gen14929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14930"/>neque a rege cathedram honoris. <l eID="gen14930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6305"/><l level="1" sID="gen14931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6305"/>Non te justifices ante Deum, <l eID="gen14931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14932"/>quoniam agnitor cordis ipse est : <l eID="gen14932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14933"/>et penes regem noli velle videri sapiens. <l eID="gen14933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6306"/><l level="1" sID="gen14934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6306"/>Noli quærere fieri judex, <l eID="gen14934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14935"/>nisi valeas virtute irrumpere iniquitates : <l eID="gen14935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14936"/>ne forte extimescas faciem potentis, <l eID="gen14936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14937"/>et ponas scandalum in æquitate tua. <l eID="gen14937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6307"/><l level="1" sID="gen14938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6307"/>Non pecces in multitudinem civitatis, <l eID="gen14938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14939"/>nec te immittas in populum : <l eID="gen14939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6308"/><l level="1" sID="gen14940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6308"/>neque alliges duplicia peccata, <l eID="gen14940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14941"/>nec enim in uno eris immunis. <l eID="gen14941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6309"/><l level="1" sID="gen14942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6309"/>Noli esse pusillanimis in animo tuo : <l eID="gen14942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6310"/><l level="1" sID="gen14943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6310"/>exorare et facere eleemosynam ne despicias. <l eID="gen14943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6311"/><l level="1" sID="gen14944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6311"/>Ne dicas : In multitudine munerum meorum respiciet Deus, <l eID="gen14944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14945"/>et offerente me Deo altissimo, munera mea suscipiet. <l eID="gen14945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6312"/><l level="1" sID="gen14946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6312"/>Non irrideas hominem in amaritudine animæ : <l eID="gen14946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14947"/>est enim qui humiliat et exaltat circumspector Deus. <l eID="gen14947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6313"/><l level="1" sID="gen14948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6313"/>Noli amare mendacium adversus fratrem tuum, <l eID="gen14948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14949"/>neque in amicum similiter facias. <l eID="gen14949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6314"/><l level="1" sID="gen14950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6314"/>Noli velle mentiri omne mendacium : <l eID="gen14950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14951"/>assiduitas enim illius non est bona. <l eID="gen14951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6315"/><l level="1" sID="gen14952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6315"/>Noli verbosus esse in multitudine presbyterorum, <l eID="gen14952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14953"/>et non iteres verbum in oratione tua. <l eID="gen14953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6316"/><l level="1" sID="gen14954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6316"/>Non oderis laboriosa opera, <l eID="gen14954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14955"/>et rusticationem creatam ab Altissimo. <l eID="gen14955" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6317"/><l level="1" sID="gen14956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6317"/>Non te reputes in multitudine indisciplinatorum. <l eID="gen14956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6318"/><l level="1" sID="gen14957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6318"/>Memento iræ, quoniam non tardabit. <l eID="gen14957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6319"/><l level="1" sID="gen14958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6319"/>Humilia valde spiritum tuum, <l eID="gen14958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14959"/>quoniam vindicta carnis impii ignis et vermis. <l eID="gen14959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6320"/><l level="1" sID="gen14960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6320"/>Noli prævaricari in amicum pecuniam differentem, <l eID="gen14960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14961"/>neque fratrem carissimum auro spreveris. <l eID="gen14961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6321"/><l level="1" sID="gen14962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6321"/>Noli discedere a muliere sensata et bona, <l eID="gen14962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14963"/>quam sortitus es in timore Domini : <l eID="gen14963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14964"/>gratia enim verecundiæ illius super aurum. <l eID="gen14964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6322"/><l level="1" sID="gen14965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6322"/>Non lædas servum in veritate operantem, <l eID="gen14965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14966"/>neque mercenarium dantem animam suam. <l eID="gen14966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6323"/><l level="1" sID="gen14967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6323"/>Servus sensatus sit tibi dilectus quasi anima tua : <l eID="gen14967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14968"/>non defraudes illum libertate, <l eID="gen14968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14969"/>neque inopem derelinquas illum. <l eID="gen14969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6324"/><l level="1" sID="gen14970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6324"/>Pecora tibi sunt, attende illis : <l eID="gen14970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14971"/>et si sunt utilia, perseverent apud te. <l eID="gen14971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6325"/><l level="1" sID="gen14972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6325"/>Filii tibi sunt ? erudi illos, <l eID="gen14972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14973"/>et curva illos a pueritia illorum. <l eID="gen14973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6326"/><l level="1" sID="gen14974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6326"/>Filiæ tibi sunt ? serva corpus illarum, <l eID="gen14974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14975"/>et non ostendas hilarem faciem tuam ad illas. <l eID="gen14975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6327"/><l level="1" sID="gen14976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6327"/>Trade filiam, et grande opus feceris : <l eID="gen14976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14977"/>et homini sensato da illam. <l eID="gen14977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6328"/><l level="1" sID="gen14978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6328"/>Mulier si est tibi secundum animam tuam, non projicias illam : <l eID="gen14978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14979"/>et odibili non credas te. <l eID="gen14979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14980"/>In toto corde tuo <l eID="gen14980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6329"/><l level="1" sID="gen14981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6329"/>honora patrem tuum, <l eID="gen14981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14982"/>et gemitus matris tuæ ne obliviscaris : <l eID="gen14982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6330"/><l level="1" sID="gen14983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6330"/>memento quoniam nisi per illos natus non fuisses : <l eID="gen14983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14984"/>et retribue illis, quomodo et illi tibi. <l eID="gen14984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6331"/><l level="1" sID="gen14985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6331"/>In tota anima tua time Dominum, <l eID="gen14985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14986"/>et sacerdotes illius sanctifica. <l eID="gen14986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6332"/><l level="1" sID="gen14987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6332"/>In omni virtute tua dilige eum qui te fecit, <l eID="gen14987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14988"/>et ministros ejus ne derelinquas. <l eID="gen14988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6333"/><l level="1" sID="gen14989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6333"/>Honora Deum ex tota anima tua, <l eID="gen14989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14990"/>et honorifica sacerdotes, <l eID="gen14990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14991"/>et propurga te cum brachiis. <l eID="gen14991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6334"/><l level="1" sID="gen14992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6334"/>Da illis partem, sicut mandatum est tibi, primitiarum et purgationis, <l eID="gen14992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14993"/>et de negligentia tua purga te cum paucis. <l eID="gen14993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6335"/><l level="1" sID="gen14994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6335"/>Datum brachiorum tuorum, <l eID="gen14994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14995"/>et sacrificium sanctificationis offeres Domino, <l eID="gen14995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14996"/>et initia sanctorum. <l eID="gen14996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6336"/><l level="1" sID="gen14997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6336"/>Et pauperi porrige manum tuam, <l eID="gen14997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen14998"/>ut perficiatur propitiatio et benedictio tua. <l eID="gen14998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6337"/><l level="1" sID="gen14999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6337"/>Gratia dati in conspectu omnis viventis, <l eID="gen14999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15000"/>et mortuo non prohibeas gratiam. <l eID="gen15000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6338"/><l level="1" sID="gen15001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6338"/>Non desis plorantibus in consolatione, <l eID="gen15001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15002"/>et cum lugentibus ambula. <l eID="gen15002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6339"/><l level="1" sID="gen15003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6339"/>Non te pigeat visitare infirmum : <l eID="gen15003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15004"/>ex his enim in dilectione firmaberis. <l eID="gen15004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 7:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6340"/><l level="1" sID="gen15005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6340"/>In omnibus operibus tuis memorare novissima tua, <l eID="gen15005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15006"/>et in æternum non peccabis.  <chapter eID="Sir.7"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:1
verses.text: Non litiges cum homine potente, <l eID="gen15007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15008"/>ne forte incidas in manus illius. <l eID="gen15008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6341"/><l level="1" sID="gen15009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6341"/>Non contendas cum viro locuplete, <l eID="gen15009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15010"/>ne forte contra te constituat litem tibi : <l eID="gen15010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6342"/><l level="1" sID="gen15011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6342"/>multos enim perdidit aurum et argentum, <l eID="gen15011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15012"/>et usque ad cor regum extendit et convertit. <l eID="gen15012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6343"/><l level="1" sID="gen15013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6343"/>Non litiges cum homine linguato, <l eID="gen15013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15014"/>et non strues in ignem illius ligna. <l eID="gen15014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6344"/><l level="1" sID="gen15015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6344"/>Non communices homini indocto, <l eID="gen15015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15016"/>ne male de progenie tua loquatur. <l eID="gen15016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6345"/><l level="1" sID="gen15017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6345"/>Ne despicias hominem avertentem se a peccato, <l eID="gen15017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15018"/>neque improperes ei : <l eID="gen15018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15019"/>memento quoniam omnes in correptione sumus. <l eID="gen15019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6346"/><l level="1" sID="gen15020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6346"/>Ne spernas hominem in sua senectute, <l eID="gen15020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15021"/>etenim ex nobis senescunt. <l eID="gen15021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6347"/><l level="1" sID="gen15022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6347"/>Noli de mortuo inimico tuo gaudere : <l eID="gen15022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15023"/>sciens quoniam omnes morimur, <l eID="gen15023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15024"/>et in gaudium nolumus venire. <l eID="gen15024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6348"/><l level="1" sID="gen15025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6348"/>Ne despicias narrationem presbyterorum sapientium, <l eID="gen15025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15026"/>et in proverbiis eorum conversare : <l eID="gen15026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6349"/><l level="1" sID="gen15027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6349"/>ab ipsis enim disces sapientiam et doctrinam intellectus, <l eID="gen15027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15028"/>et servire magnatis sine querela. <l eID="gen15028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6350"/><l level="1" sID="gen15029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6350"/>Non te prætereat narratio seniorum, <l eID="gen15029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15030"/>ipsi enim didicerunt a patribus suis : <l eID="gen15030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6351"/><l level="1" sID="gen15031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6351"/>quoniam ab ipsis disces intellectum, <l eID="gen15031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15032"/>et in tempore necessitatis dare responsum. <l eID="gen15032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6352"/><l level="1" sID="gen15033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6352"/>Non incendas carbones peccatorum arguens eos, <l eID="gen15033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15034"/>et ne incendaris flamma ignis peccatorum illorum. <l eID="gen15034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6353"/><l level="1" sID="gen15035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6353"/>Ne contra faciem stes contumeliosi, <l eID="gen15035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15036"/>ne sedeat quasi insidiator ori tuo. <l eID="gen15036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6354"/><l level="1" sID="gen15037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6354"/>Noli fœnerari homini fortiori te : <l eID="gen15037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15038"/>quod si fœneraveris, quasi perditum habe. <l eID="gen15038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6355"/><l level="1" sID="gen15039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6355"/>Non spondeas super virtutem tuam : <l eID="gen15039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15040"/>quod si spoponderis, quasi restituens cogita. <l eID="gen15040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6356"/><l level="1" sID="gen15041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6356"/>Non judices contra judicem, <l eID="gen15041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15042"/>quoniam secundum quod justum est judicat. <l eID="gen15042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6357"/><l level="1" sID="gen15043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6357"/>Cum audace non eas in via, <l eID="gen15043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15044"/>ne forte gravet mala sua in te : <l eID="gen15044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15045"/>ipse enim secundum voluntatem suam vadit, <l eID="gen15045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15046"/>et simul cum stultitia illius peries. <l eID="gen15046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6358"/><l level="1" sID="gen15047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6358"/>Cum iracundo non facias rixam, <l eID="gen15047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15048"/>et cum audace non eas in desertum : <l eID="gen15048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15049"/>quoniam quasi nihil est ante illum sanguis, <l eID="gen15049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15050"/>et ubi non est adjutorium, elidet te. <l eID="gen15050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6359"/><l level="1" sID="gen15051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6359"/>Cum fatuis consilium non habeas : <l eID="gen15051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15052"/>non enim poterunt diligere nisi quæ eis placent. <l eID="gen15052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6360"/><l level="1" sID="gen15053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6360"/>Coram extraneo ne facias consilium : <l eID="gen15053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15054"/>nescis enim quid pariet. <l eID="gen15054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6361"/><l level="1" sID="gen15055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6361"/>Non omni homini cor tuum manifestes, <l eID="gen15055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15056"/>ne forte inferat tibi gratiam falsam, et convicietur tibi.  <chapter eID="Sir.8"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:1
verses.text: Non zeles mulierem sinus tui, <l eID="gen15057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15058"/>ne ostendat super te malitiam doctrinæ nequam. <l eID="gen15058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6362"/><l level="1" sID="gen15059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6362"/>Non des mulieri potestatem animæ tuæ, <l eID="gen15059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15060"/>ne ingrediatur in virtutem tuam, et confundaris. <l eID="gen15060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6363"/><l level="1" sID="gen15061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6363"/>Ne respicias mulierem multivolam, <l eID="gen15061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15062"/>ne forte incidas in laqueos illius. <l eID="gen15062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6364"/><l level="1" sID="gen15063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6364"/>Cum saltatrice ne assiduus sis, <l eID="gen15063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15064"/>nec audias illam, ne forte pereas in efficacia illius. <l eID="gen15064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6365"/><l level="1" sID="gen15065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6365"/>Virginem ne conspicias, <l eID="gen15065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15066"/>ne forte scandalizeris in decore illius. <l eID="gen15066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6366"/><l level="1" sID="gen15067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6366"/>Ne des fornicariis animam tuam in ullo, <l eID="gen15067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15068"/>ne perdas te et hæreditatem tuam. <l eID="gen15068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6367"/><l level="1" sID="gen15069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6367"/>Noli circumspicere in vicis civitatis, <l eID="gen15069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15070"/>nec oberraveris in plateis illius. <l eID="gen15070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6368"/><l level="1" sID="gen15071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6368"/>Averte faciem tuam a muliere compta, <l eID="gen15071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15072"/>et ne circumspicias speciem alienam. <l eID="gen15072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6369"/><l level="1" sID="gen15073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6369"/>Propter speciem mulieris multi perierunt : <l eID="gen15073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15074"/>et ex hoc concupiscentia quasi ignis exardescit. <l eID="gen15074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6370"/><l level="1" sID="gen15075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6370"/>Omnis mulier quæ est fornicaria, <l eID="gen15075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15076"/>quasi stercus in via conculcabitur. <l eID="gen15076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6371"/><l level="1" sID="gen15077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6371"/>Speciem mulieris alienæ multi admirati, reprobi facti sunt : <l eID="gen15077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15078"/>colloquium enim illius quasi ignis exardescit. <l eID="gen15078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6372"/><l level="1" sID="gen15079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6372"/>Cum aliena muliere ne sedeas omnino, <l eID="gen15079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15080"/>nec accumbas cum ea super cubitum : <l eID="gen15080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6373"/><l level="1" sID="gen15081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6373"/>et non alterceris cum illa in vino, <l eID="gen15081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15082"/>ne forte declinet cor tuum in illam, <l eID="gen15082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15083"/>et sanguine tuo labaris in perditionem. <l eID="gen15083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6374"/><l level="1" sID="gen15084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6374"/>Ne derelinquas amicum antiquum : <l eID="gen15084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15085"/>novus enim non erit similis illi. <l eID="gen15085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6375"/><l level="1" sID="gen15086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6375"/>Vinum novum amicus novus : <l eID="gen15086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15087"/>veterascet, et cum suavitate bibes illud. <l eID="gen15087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6376"/><l level="1" sID="gen15088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6376"/>Non zeles gloriam et opes peccatoris : <l eID="gen15088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15089"/>non enim scis quæ futura sit illius subversio. <l eID="gen15089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6377"/><l level="1" sID="gen15090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6377"/>Non placeat tibi injuria injustorum, <l eID="gen15090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15091"/>sciens quoniam usque ad inferos non placebit impius. <l eID="gen15091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6378"/><l level="1" sID="gen15092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6378"/>Longe abesto ab homine potestatem habente occidendi, <l eID="gen15092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15093"/>et non suspicaberis timorem mortis. <l eID="gen15093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6379"/><l level="1" sID="gen15094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6379"/>Et si accesseris ad illum, noli aliquid committere, <l eID="gen15094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15095"/>ne forte auferat vitam tuam. <l eID="gen15095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6380"/><l level="1" sID="gen15096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6380"/>Communionem mortis scito, <l eID="gen15096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15097"/>quoniam in medio laqueorum ingredieris, <l eID="gen15097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15098"/>et super dolentium arma ambulabis. <l eID="gen15098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6381"/><l level="1" sID="gen15099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6381"/>Secundum virtutem tuam cave te a proximo tuo, <l eID="gen15099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15100"/>et cum sapientibus et prudentibus tracta. <l eID="gen15100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6382"/><l level="1" sID="gen15101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6382"/>Viri justi sint tibi convivæ, <l eID="gen15101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15102"/>et in timore Dei sit tibi gloriatio : <l eID="gen15102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6383"/><l level="1" sID="gen15103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6383"/>et in sensu sit tibi cogitatus Dei, <l eID="gen15103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15104"/>et omnis enarratio tua in præceptis Altissimi. <l eID="gen15104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6384"/><l level="1" sID="gen15105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6384"/>In manu artificum opera laudabuntur, <l eID="gen15105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15106"/>et princeps populi in sapientia sermonis sui, <l eID="gen15106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15107"/>in sensu vero seniorum verbum. <l eID="gen15107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6385"/><l level="1" sID="gen15108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6385"/>Terribilis est in civitate sua homo linguosus : <l eID="gen15108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15109"/>et temerarius in verbo suo odibilis erit.  <chapter eID="Sir.9"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:1
verses.text: Judex sapiens judicabit populum suum, <l eID="gen15110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15111"/>et principatus sensati stabilis erit. <l eID="gen15111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6386"/><l level="1" sID="gen15112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6386"/>Secundum judicem populi, sic et ministri ejus : <l eID="gen15112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15113"/>et qualis rector est civitatis, tales et inhabitantes in ea. <l eID="gen15113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6387"/><l level="1" sID="gen15114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6387"/>Rex insipiens perdet populum suum : <l eID="gen15114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15115"/>et civitates inhabitabuntur per sensum potentium. <l eID="gen15115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6388"/><l level="1" sID="gen15116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6388"/>In manu Dei potestas terræ : <l eID="gen15116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15117"/>et utilem rectorem suscitabit in tempus super illam. <l eID="gen15117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6389"/><l level="1" sID="gen15118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6389"/>In manu Dei prosperitas hominis, <l eID="gen15118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15119"/>et super faciem scribæ imponet honorem suum. <l eID="gen15119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6390"/><l level="1" sID="gen15120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6390"/>Omnis injuriæ proximi ne memineris, <l eID="gen15120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15121"/>et nihil agas in operibus injuriæ. <l eID="gen15121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6391"/><l level="1" sID="gen15122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6391"/>Odibilis coram Deo est et hominibus superbia, <l eID="gen15122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15123"/>et execrabilis omnis iniquitas gentium. <l eID="gen15123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6392"/><l level="1" sID="gen15124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6392"/>Regnum a gente in gentem transfertur propter injustitias, <l eID="gen15124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15125"/>et injurias, et contumelias, et diversos dolos. <l eID="gen15125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6393"/><l level="1" sID="gen15126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6393"/>Avaro autem nihil est scelestius. <l eID="gen15126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15127"/>Quid superbit terra et cinis ? <l eID="gen15127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6394"/><l level="1" sID="gen15128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6394"/>Nihil est iniquius quam amare pecuniam : <l eID="gen15128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15129"/>hic enim et animam suam venalem habet, <l eID="gen15129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15130"/>quoniam in vita sua projecit intima sua. <l eID="gen15130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6395"/><l level="1" sID="gen15131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6395"/>Omnis potentatus brevis vita ; <l eID="gen15131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15132"/>languor prolixior gravat medicum. <l eID="gen15132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6396"/><l level="1" sID="gen15133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6396"/>Brevem languorem præcidit medicus : <l eID="gen15133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15134"/>sic et rex hodie est, et cras morietur. <l eID="gen15134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6397"/><l level="1" sID="gen15135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6397"/>Cum enim morietur homo, <l eID="gen15135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15136"/>hæreditabit serpentes, et bestias, et vermes. <l eID="gen15136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6398"/><l level="1" sID="gen15137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6398"/>Initium superbiæ hominis apostatare a Deo : <l eID="gen15137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6399"/><l level="1" sID="gen15138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6399"/>quoniam ab eo qui fecit illum recessit cor ejus, <l eID="gen15138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15139"/>quoniam initium omnis peccati est superbia. <l eID="gen15139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15140"/>Qui tenuerit illam adimplebitur maledictis, <l eID="gen15140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15141"/>et subvertet eum in finem. <l eID="gen15141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6400"/><l level="1" sID="gen15142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6400"/>Propterea exhonoravit Dominus conventus malorum, <l eID="gen15142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15143"/>et destruxit eos usque in finem. <l eID="gen15143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6401"/><l level="1" sID="gen15144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6401"/>Sedes ducum superborum destruxit Deus, <l eID="gen15144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15145"/>et sedere fecit mites pro eis. <l eID="gen15145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:18
