verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6402"/><l level="1" sID="gen15146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6402"/>Radices gentium superbarum arefecit Deus, <l eID="gen15146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15147"/>et plantavit humiles ex ipsis gentibus. <l eID="gen15147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6403"/><l level="1" sID="gen15148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6403"/>Terras gentium evertit Dominus, <l eID="gen15148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15149"/>et perdidit eas usque ad fundamentum. <l eID="gen15149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6404"/><l level="1" sID="gen15150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6404"/>Arefecit ex ipsis, et disperdidit eos, <l eID="gen15150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15151"/>et cessare fecit memoriam eorum a terra. <l eID="gen15151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6405"/><l level="1" sID="gen15152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6405"/>Memoria superborum perdidit Deus, <l eID="gen15152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15153"/>et reliquit memoriam humilium sensu. <l eID="gen15153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6406"/><l level="1" sID="gen15154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6406"/>Non est creata hominibus superbia, <l eID="gen15154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15155"/>neque iracundia nationi mulierum. <l eID="gen15155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6407"/><l level="1" sID="gen15156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6407"/>Semen hominum honorabitur hoc, quod timet Deum : <l eID="gen15156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15157"/>semen autem hoc exhonorabitur, quod præterit mandata Domini. <l eID="gen15157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6408"/><l level="1" sID="gen15158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6408"/>In medio fratrum rector illorum in honore : <l eID="gen15158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15159"/>et qui timent Dominum erunt in oculis illius. <l eID="gen15159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6409"/><l level="1" sID="gen15160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6409"/>Gloria divitum, honoratorum, et pauperum, <l eID="gen15160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15161"/>timor Dei est. <l eID="gen15161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6410"/><l level="1" sID="gen15162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6410"/>Noli despicere hominem justum pauperem, <l eID="gen15162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15163"/>et noli magnificare virum peccatorem divitem. <l eID="gen15163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6411"/><l level="1" sID="gen15164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6411"/>Magnus, et judex, et potens est in honore : <l eID="gen15164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15165"/>et non est major illo qui timet Deum. <l eID="gen15165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6412"/><l level="1" sID="gen15166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6412"/>Servo sensato liberi servient : <l eID="gen15166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15167"/>et vir prudens et disciplinatus non murmurabit correptus, <l eID="gen15167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15168"/>et inscius non honorabitur. <l eID="gen15168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6413"/><l level="1" sID="gen15169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6413"/>Noli extollere te in faciendo opere tuo, <l eID="gen15169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15170"/>et noli cunctari in tempore angustiæ. <l eID="gen15170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6414"/><l level="1" sID="gen15171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6414"/>Melior est qui operatur et abundat in omnibus, <l eID="gen15171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15172"/>quam qui gloriatur et eget pane. <l eID="gen15172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6415"/><l level="1" sID="gen15173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6415"/>Fili, in mansuetudine serva animam tuam, <l eID="gen15173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15174"/>et da illi honorem secundum meritum suum. <l eID="gen15174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6416"/><l level="1" sID="gen15175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6416"/>Peccantem in animam suam quis justificabit ? <l eID="gen15175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15176"/>et quis honorificabit exhonorantem animam suam ? <l eID="gen15176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6417"/><l level="1" sID="gen15177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6417"/>Pauper gloriatur per disciplinam et timorem suum : <l eID="gen15177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15178"/>et est homo qui honorificatur propter substantiam suam. <l eID="gen15178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6418"/><l level="1" sID="gen15179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6418"/>Qui autem gloriatur in paupertate, quanto magis in substantia ! <l eID="gen15179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15180"/>et qui gloriatur in substantia, paupertatem vereatur.  <chapter eID="Sir.10"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:1
verses.text: Sapientia humiliati exaltabit caput illius, <l eID="gen15181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15182"/>et in medio magnatorum consedere illum faciet. <l eID="gen15182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6419"/><l level="1" sID="gen15183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6419"/>Non laudes virum in specie sua, <l eID="gen15183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15184"/>neque spernas hominem in visu suo. <l eID="gen15184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6420"/><l level="1" sID="gen15185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6420"/>Brevis in volatilibus est apis, <l eID="gen15185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15186"/>et initium dulcoris habet fructus illius. <l eID="gen15186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6421"/><l level="1" sID="gen15187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6421"/>In vestitu ne glorieris umquam, <l eID="gen15187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15188"/>nec in die honoris tui extollaris : <l eID="gen15188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15189"/>quoniam mirabilia opera Altissimi solius, <l eID="gen15189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15190"/>et gloriosa, et absconsa, et invisa opera illius. <l eID="gen15190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6422"/><l level="1" sID="gen15191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6422"/>Multi tyranni sederunt in throno : <l eID="gen15191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15192"/>et insuspicabilis portavit diadema. <l eID="gen15192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6423"/><l level="1" sID="gen15193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6423"/>Multi potentes oppressi sunt valide, <l eID="gen15193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15194"/>et gloriosi traditi sunt in manus alterorum. <l eID="gen15194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6424"/><l level="1" sID="gen15195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6424"/>Priusquam interroges, ne vituperes quemquam : <l eID="gen15195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15196"/>et cum interrogaveris, corripe juste. <l eID="gen15196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6425"/><l level="1" sID="gen15197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6425"/>Priusquam audias, ne respondeas verbum : <l eID="gen15197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15198"/>et in medio sermonum ne adjicias loqui. <l eID="gen15198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6426"/><l level="1" sID="gen15199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6426"/>De ea re quæ te non molestat, ne certeris : <l eID="gen15199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15200"/>et in judicio peccantium ne consistas. <l eID="gen15200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6427"/><l level="1" sID="gen15201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6427"/>Fili, ne in multis sint actus tui : <l eID="gen15201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15202"/>et si dives fueris, non eris immunis a delicto. <l eID="gen15202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15203"/>Si enim secutus fueris, non apprehendes : <l eID="gen15203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15204"/>et non effugies, si præcucurreris. <l eID="gen15204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6428"/><l level="1" sID="gen15205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6428"/>Est homo laborans et festinans, et dolens : <l eID="gen15205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15206"/>impius, et tanto magis non abundabit. <l eID="gen15206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6429"/><l level="1" sID="gen15207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6429"/>Est homo marcidus egens recuperatione, <l eID="gen15207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15208"/>plus deficiens virtute, et abundans paupertate : <l eID="gen15208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6430"/><l level="1" sID="gen15209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6430"/>et oculus Dei respexit illum in bono, <l eID="gen15209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15210"/>et erexit eum ab humilitate ipsius, et exaltavit caput ejus : <l eID="gen15210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15211"/>et mirati sunt in illo multi, et honoraverunt Deum. <l eID="gen15211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6431"/><l level="1" sID="gen15212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6431"/>Bona et mala, vita et mors, <l eID="gen15212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15213"/>paupertas et honestas, a Deo sunt : <l eID="gen15213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6432"/><l level="1" sID="gen15214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6432"/>sapientia, et disciplina, et scientia legis, apud Deum : <l eID="gen15214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15215"/>dilectio, et viæ bonorum, apud ipsum. <l eID="gen15215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6433"/><l level="1" sID="gen15216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6433"/>Error et tenebræ peccatoribus concreata sunt : <l eID="gen15216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15217"/>qui autem exsultant in malis consenescunt in malo. <l eID="gen15217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6434"/><l level="1" sID="gen15218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6434"/>Datio Dei permanet justis, <l eID="gen15218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15219"/>et profectus illius successus habebit in æternum. <l eID="gen15219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6435"/><l level="1" sID="gen15220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6435"/>Est qui locupletatur parce agendo, <l eID="gen15220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15221"/>et hæc est pars mercedis illius. <l eID="gen15221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6436"/><l level="1" sID="gen15222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6436"/>In eo quod dicit : Inveni requiem mihi, <l eID="gen15222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15223"/>et nunc manducabo de bonis meis solus : <l eID="gen15223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6437"/><l level="1" sID="gen15224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6437"/>et nescit quod tempus præteriet, et mors appropinquet, <l eID="gen15224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15225"/>et relinquat omnia aliis, et morietur. <l eID="gen15225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6438"/><l level="1" sID="gen15226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6438"/>Sta in testamento tuo, et in illo colloquere, <l eID="gen15226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15227"/>et in opere mandatorum tuorum veterasce. <l eID="gen15227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6439"/><l level="1" sID="gen15228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6439"/>Ne manseris in operibus peccatorum : <l eID="gen15228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15229"/>confide autem in Deo, et mane in loco tuo. <l eID="gen15229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6440"/><l level="1" sID="gen15230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6440"/>Facile est enim in oculis Dei <l eID="gen15230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15231"/>subito honestare pauperem. <l eID="gen15231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6441"/><l level="1" sID="gen15232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6441"/>Benedictio Dei in mercedem justi festinat, <l eID="gen15232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15233"/>et in hora veloci processus illius fructificat. <l eID="gen15233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6442"/><l level="1" sID="gen15234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6442"/>Ne dicas : Quid est mihi opus ? <l eID="gen15234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15235"/>et quæ erunt mihi ex hoc bona ? <l eID="gen15235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6443"/><l level="1" sID="gen15236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6443"/>Ne dicas : Sufficiens mihi sum : <l eID="gen15236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15237"/>et quid ex hoc pessimabor ? <l eID="gen15237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6444"/><l level="1" sID="gen15238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6444"/>In die bonorum ne immemor sis malorum, <l eID="gen15238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15239"/>et in die malorum ne immemor sis bonorum : <l eID="gen15239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6445"/><l level="1" sID="gen15240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6445"/>quoniam facile est coram Deo in die obitus <l eID="gen15240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15241"/>retribuere unicuique secundum vias suas. <l eID="gen15241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6446"/><l level="1" sID="gen15242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6446"/>Malitia horæ oblivionem facit luxuriæ magnæ, <l eID="gen15242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15243"/>et in fine hominis denudatio operum illius. <l eID="gen15243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6447"/><l level="1" sID="gen15244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6447"/>Ante mortem ne laudes hominem quemquam : <l eID="gen15244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15245"/>quoniam in filiis suis agnoscitur vir. <l eID="gen15245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6448"/><l level="1" sID="gen15246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6448"/>Non omnem hominem inducas in domum tuam : <l eID="gen15246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15247"/>multæ enim sunt insidiæ dolosi. <l eID="gen15247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6449"/><l level="1" sID="gen15248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6449"/>Sicut enim eructant præcordia fœtentium, <l eID="gen15248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15249"/>et sicut perdix inducitur in caveam, et ut caprea in laqueum : <l eID="gen15249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15250"/>sic et cor superborum, <l eID="gen15250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15251"/>et sicut prospector videns casum proximi sui. <l eID="gen15251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6450"/><l level="1" sID="gen15252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6450"/>Bona enim in mala convertens insidiatur, <l eID="gen15252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15253"/>et in electis imponet maculam. <l eID="gen15253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6451"/><l level="1" sID="gen15254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6451"/>A scintilla una augetur ignis, <l eID="gen15254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15255"/>et ab uno doloso augetur sanguis : <l eID="gen15255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15256"/>homo vero peccator sanguini insidiatur. <l eID="gen15256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6452"/><l level="1" sID="gen15257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6452"/>Attende tibi a pestifero, fabricat enim mala, <l eID="gen15257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15258"/>ne inducat super te subsannationem in perpetuum. <l eID="gen15258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 11:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6453"/><l level="1" sID="gen15259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6453"/>Admitte ad te alienigenam : <l eID="gen15259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15260"/>et subvertet te in turbine, <l eID="gen15260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15261"/>et abalienabit te a tuis propriis.  <chapter eID="Sir.11"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:1
verses.text: Si benefeceris, scito cui feceris, <l eID="gen15262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15263"/>et erit gratia in bonis tuis multa. <l eID="gen15263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6454"/><l level="1" sID="gen15264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6454"/>Benefac justo, et invenies retributionem magnam : <l eID="gen15264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15265"/>et si non ab ipso, certe a Domino. <l eID="gen15265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6455"/><l level="1" sID="gen15266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6455"/>Non est enim ei bene qui assiduus est in malis, <l eID="gen15266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15267"/>et eleemosynas non danti : <l eID="gen15267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15268"/>quoniam et Altissimus odio habet peccatores, <l eID="gen15268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15269"/>et misertus est pœnitentibus. <l eID="gen15269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6456"/><l level="1" sID="gen15270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6456"/>Da misericordi, et ne suscipias peccatorem : <l eID="gen15270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15271"/>et impiis et peccatoribus reddet vindictam, <l eID="gen15271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15272"/>custodiens eos in diem vindictæ. <l eID="gen15272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6457"/><l level="1" sID="gen15273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6457"/>Da bono, et non receperis peccatorem. <l eID="gen15273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6458"/><l level="1" sID="gen15274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6458"/>Benefac humili, et non dederis impio : <l eID="gen15274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15275"/>prohibe panes illi dari, ne in ipsis potentior te sit : <l eID="gen15275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6459"/><l level="1" sID="gen15276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6459"/>nam duplicia mala invenies in omnibus bonis quæcumque feceris illi, <l eID="gen15276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15277"/>quoniam et Altissimus odio habet peccatores, <l eID="gen15277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15278"/>et impiis reddet vindictam. <l eID="gen15278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6460"/><l level="1" sID="gen15279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6460"/>Non agnoscetur in bonis amicus, <l eID="gen15279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15280"/>et non abscondetur in malis inimicus. <l eID="gen15280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6461"/><l level="1" sID="gen15281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6461"/>In bonis viri, inimici illius in tristitia : <l eID="gen15281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15282"/>et in malitia illius, amicus agnitus est. <l eID="gen15282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6462"/><l level="1" sID="gen15283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6462"/>Non credas inimico tuo in æternum : <l eID="gen15283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15284"/>sicut enim æramentum æruginat nequitia illius : <l eID="gen15284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6463"/><l level="1" sID="gen15285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6463"/>et si humiliatus vadat curvus, <l eID="gen15285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15286"/>adjice animum tuum, et custodi te ab illo. <l eID="gen15286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6464"/><l level="1" sID="gen15287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6464"/>Non statuas illum penes te, <l eID="gen15287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15288"/>nec sedeat ad dexteram tuam, <l eID="gen15288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15289"/>ne forte conversus in locum tuum, inquirat cathedram tuam, <l eID="gen15289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15290"/>et in novissimo agnosces verba mea, <l eID="gen15290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15291"/>et in sermonibus meis stimuleris. <l eID="gen15291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6465"/><l level="1" sID="gen15292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6465"/>Quis miserebitur incantatori a serpente percusso, <l eID="gen15292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15293"/>et omnibus qui appropiant bestiis ? <l eID="gen15293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15294"/>et sic qui comitatur cum viro iniquo, <l eID="gen15294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15295"/>et obvolutus est in peccatis ejus. <l eID="gen15295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6466"/><l level="1" sID="gen15296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6466"/>Una hora tecum permanebit : <l eID="gen15296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15297"/>si autem declinaveris, non supportabit. <l eID="gen15297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6467"/><l level="1" sID="gen15298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6467"/>In labiis suis indulcat inimicus, <l eID="gen15298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15299"/>et in corde suo insidiatur ut subvertat te in foveam. <l eID="gen15299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6468"/><l level="1" sID="gen15300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6468"/>In oculis suis lacrimatur inimicus, <l eID="gen15300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15301"/>et si invenerit tempus, non satiabitur sanguine. <l eID="gen15301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6469"/><l level="1" sID="gen15302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6469"/>Et si incurrerint tibi mala, <l eID="gen15302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15303"/>invenies eum illic priorem. <l eID="gen15303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6470"/><l level="1" sID="gen15304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6470"/>In oculis suis lacrimatur inimicus, <l eID="gen15304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15305"/>et quasi adjuvans suffodiet plantas tuas. <l eID="gen15305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6471"/><l level="1" sID="gen15306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6471"/>Caput suum movebit, et plaudet manu, <l eID="gen15306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15307"/>et multa susurrans commutabit vultum suum.  <chapter eID="Sir.12"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:1
verses.text: Qui tetigerit picem inquinabitur ab ea : <l eID="gen15308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15309"/>et qui communicaverit superbo induet superbiam. <l eID="gen15309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6472"/><l level="1" sID="gen15310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6472"/>Pondus super se tollat qui honestiori se communicat, <l eID="gen15310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15311"/>et ditiori te ne socius fueris. <l eID="gen15311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6473"/><l level="1" sID="gen15312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6473"/>Quid communicabit cacabus ad ollam ? <l eID="gen15312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15313"/>quando enim se colliserint, confringetur. <l eID="gen15313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6474"/><l level="1" sID="gen15314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6474"/>Dives injuste egit, et fremet : <l eID="gen15314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15315"/>pauper autem læsus tacebit. <l eID="gen15315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6475"/><l level="1" sID="gen15316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6475"/>Si largitus fueris, assumet te : <l eID="gen15316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15317"/>et si non habueris, derelinquet te. <l eID="gen15317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6476"/><l level="1" sID="gen15318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6476"/>Si habes, convivet tecum, et evacuabit te : <l eID="gen15318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15319"/>et ipse non dolebit super te. <l eID="gen15319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6477"/><l level="1" sID="gen15320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6477"/>Si necessarius illi fueris, supplantabit te, <l eID="gen15320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15321"/>et subridens spem dabit, narrans tibi bona, <l eID="gen15321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15322"/>et dicet : Quid opus est tibi ? <l eID="gen15322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6478"/><l level="1" sID="gen15323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6478"/>Et confundet te in cibis suis, <l eID="gen15323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15324"/>donec te exinaniat bis et ter : <l eID="gen15324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15325"/>et in novissimo deridebit te, <l eID="gen15325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15326"/>et postea videns derelinquet te, <l eID="gen15326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15327"/>et caput suum movebit ad te. <l eID="gen15327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6479"/><l level="1" sID="gen15328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6479"/>Humiliare Deo, et exspecta manus ejus. <l eID="gen15328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6480"/><l level="1" sID="gen15329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6480"/>Attende ne seductus in stultitiam humilieris. <l eID="gen15329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6481"/><l level="1" sID="gen15330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6481"/>Noli esse humilis in sapientia tua, <l eID="gen15330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15331"/>ne humiliatus in stultitiam seducaris. <l eID="gen15331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6482"/><l level="1" sID="gen15332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6482"/>Advocatus a potentiore, discede : <l eID="gen15332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15333"/>ex hoc enim magis te advocabit. <l eID="gen15333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6483"/><l level="1" sID="gen15334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6483"/>Ne improbus sis, ne impingaris : <l eID="gen15334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15335"/>et ne longe sis ab eo, ne eas in oblivionem. <l eID="gen15335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6484"/><l level="1" sID="gen15336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6484"/>Ne retineas ex æquo loqui cum illo, <l eID="gen15336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15337"/>nec credas multis verbis illius : <l eID="gen15337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15338"/>ex multa enim loquela tentabit te, <l eID="gen15338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15339"/>et subridens interrogabit te de absconditis tuis. <l eID="gen15339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6485"/><l level="1" sID="gen15340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6485"/>Immitis animus illius conservabit verba tua : <l eID="gen15340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15341"/>et non parcet de malitia, et de vinculis. <l eID="gen15341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6486"/><l level="1" sID="gen15342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6486"/>Cave tibi, et attende diligenter auditui tuo, <l eID="gen15342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15343"/>quoniam cum subversione tua ambulas : <l eID="gen15343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6487"/><l level="1" sID="gen15344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6487"/>audiens vero illa, <l eID="gen15344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15345"/>quasi in somnis vide, et vigilabis. <l eID="gen15345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6488"/><l level="1" sID="gen15346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6488"/>Omni vita tua dilige Deum, <l eID="gen15346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15347"/>et invoca illum in salute tua. <l eID="gen15347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6489"/><l level="1" sID="gen15348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6489"/>Omne animal diligit simile sibi, <l eID="gen15348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15349"/>sic et omnis homo proximum sibi. <l eID="gen15349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6490"/><l level="1" sID="gen15350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6490"/>Omnis caro ad similem sibi conjungetur, <l eID="gen15350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15351"/>et omnis homo simili sui sociabitur. <l eID="gen15351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6491"/><l level="1" sID="gen15352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6491"/>Si communicabit lupus agno aliquando, <l eID="gen15352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15353"/>sic peccator justo. <l eID="gen15353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6492"/><l level="1" sID="gen15354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6492"/>Quæ communicatio sancto homini ad canem ? <l eID="gen15354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15355"/>aut quæ pars diviti ad pauperem ? <l eID="gen15355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6493"/><l level="1" sID="gen15356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6493"/>Venatio leonis onager in eremo : <l eID="gen15356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15357"/>sic et pascua divitum sunt pauperes. <l eID="gen15357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6494"/><l level="1" sID="gen15358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6494"/>Et sicut abominatio est superbo humilitas, <l eID="gen15358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15359"/>sic et execratio divitis pauper. <l eID="gen15359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6495"/><l level="1" sID="gen15360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6495"/>Dives commotus confirmatur ab amicis suis : <l eID="gen15360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15361"/>humilis autem cum ceciderit, expelletur et a notis. <l eID="gen15361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6496"/><l level="1" sID="gen15362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6496"/>Diviti decepto multi recuperatores : <l eID="gen15362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15363"/>locutus est superbia, et justificaverunt illum. <l eID="gen15363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6497"/><l level="1" sID="gen15364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6497"/>Humilis deceptus est, insuper et arguitur : <l eID="gen15364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15365"/>locutus est sensate, et non est datus ei locus. <l eID="gen15365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6498"/><l level="1" sID="gen15366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6498"/>Dives locutus est, et omnes tacuerunt, <l eID="gen15366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15367"/>et verbum illius usque ad nubes perducent. <l eID="gen15367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6499"/><l level="1" sID="gen15368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6499"/>Pauper locutus est, et dicunt : Quis est hic ? <l eID="gen15368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15369"/>et si offenderit, subvertent illum. <l eID="gen15369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6500"/><l level="1" sID="gen15370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6500"/>Bona est substantia cui non est peccatum in conscientia : <l eID="gen15370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15371"/>et nequissima paupertas in ore impii. <l eID="gen15371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6501"/><l level="1" sID="gen15372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6501"/>Cor hominis immutat faciem illius, <l eID="gen15372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15373"/>sive in bona, sive in mala. <l eID="gen15373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 13:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6502"/><l level="1" sID="gen15374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6502"/>Vestigium cordis boni et faciem bonam <l eID="gen15374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15375"/>difficile invenies, et cum labore.  <chapter eID="Sir.13"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:1
verses.text: Beatus vir qui non est lapsus verbo ex ore suo, <l eID="gen15376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15377"/>et non est stimulatus in tristitia delicti. <l eID="gen15377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6503"/><l level="1" sID="gen15378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6503"/>Felix qui non habuit animi sui tristitiam, <l eID="gen15378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15379"/>et non excidit a spe sua. <l eID="gen15379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6504"/><l level="1" sID="gen15380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6504"/>Viro cupido et tenaci sine ratione est substantia : <l eID="gen15380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15381"/>et homini livido ad quid aurum ? <l eID="gen15381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6505"/><l level="1" sID="gen15382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6505"/>Qui acervat ex animo suo injuste, aliis congregat, <l eID="gen15382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15383"/>et in bonis illius alius luxuriabitur. <l eID="gen15383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6506"/><l level="1" sID="gen15384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6506"/>Qui sibi nequam est, cui alii bonus erit ? <l eID="gen15384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15385"/>et non jucundabitur in bonis suis. <l eID="gen15385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6507"/><l level="1" sID="gen15386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6507"/>Qui sibi invidet, nihil est illo nequius : <l eID="gen15386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15387"/>et hæc redditio est malitiæ illius. <l eID="gen15387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6508"/><l level="1" sID="gen15388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6508"/>Et si bene fecerit, ignoranter et non volens facit : <l eID="gen15388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15389"/>et in novissimo manifestat malitiam suam. <l eID="gen15389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6509"/><l level="1" sID="gen15390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6509"/>Nequam est oculus lividi : <l eID="gen15390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15391"/>et avertens faciem suam, et despiciens animam suam. <l eID="gen15391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6510"/><l level="1" sID="gen15392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6510"/>Insatiabilis oculus cupidi in parte iniquitatis : <l eID="gen15392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15393"/>non satiabitur donec consumat arefaciens animam suam. <l eID="gen15393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6511"/><l level="1" sID="gen15394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6511"/>Oculus malus ad mala, et non saturabitur pane, <l eID="gen15394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15395"/>sed indigens et in tristitia erit super mensam suam. <l eID="gen15395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6512"/><l level="1" sID="gen15396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6512"/>Fili, si habes, benefac tecum, <l eID="gen15396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15397"/>et Deo dignas oblationes offer. <l eID="gen15397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6513"/><l level="1" sID="gen15398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6513"/>Memor esto quoniam mors non tardat, <l eID="gen15398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15399"/>et testamentum inferorum, quia demonstratum est tibi : <l eID="gen15399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15400"/>testamentum enim hujus mundi morte morietur. <l eID="gen15400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6514"/><l level="1" sID="gen15401"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6514"/>Ante mortem benefac amico tuo, <l eID="gen15401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15402"/>et secundum vires tuas exporrigens da pauperi. <l eID="gen15402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6515"/><l level="1" sID="gen15403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6515"/>Non defrauderis a die bono, <l eID="gen15403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15404"/>et particula boni doni non te prætereat. <l eID="gen15404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6516"/><l level="1" sID="gen15405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6516"/>Nonne aliis relinques dolores et labores tuos <l eID="gen15405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15406"/>in divisione sortis ? <l eID="gen15406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6517"/><l level="1" sID="gen15407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6517"/>Da et accipe, <l eID="gen15407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15408"/>et justifica animam tuam. <l eID="gen15408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6518"/><l level="1" sID="gen15409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6518"/>Ante obitum tuum operare justitiam, <l eID="gen15409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15410"/>quoniam non est apud inferos invenire cibum. <l eID="gen15410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6519"/><l level="1" sID="gen15411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6519"/>Omnis caro sicut fœnum veterascet, <l eID="gen15411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15412"/>et sicut folium fructificans in arbore viridi. <l eID="gen15412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6520"/><l level="1" sID="gen15413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6520"/>Alia generantur, et alia dejiciuntur : <l eID="gen15413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15414"/>sic generatio carnis et sanguinis, alia finitur, et alia nascitur. <l eID="gen15414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6521"/><l level="1" sID="gen15415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6521"/>Omne opus corruptibile in fine deficiet, <l eID="gen15415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15416"/>et qui illud operatur ibit cum illo. <l eID="gen15416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6522"/><l level="1" sID="gen15417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6522"/>Et omne opus electum justificabitur, <l eID="gen15417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15418"/>et qui operatur illud honorabitur in illo. <l eID="gen15418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6523"/><l level="1" sID="gen15419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6523"/>Beatus vir qui in sapientia morabitur, <l eID="gen15419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15420"/>et qui in justitia sua meditabitur, <l eID="gen15420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15421"/>et in sensu cogitabit circumspectionem Dei : <l eID="gen15421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6524"/><l level="1" sID="gen15422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6524"/>qui excogitat vias illius in corde suo, <l eID="gen15422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15423"/>et in absconditis suis intelligens, <l eID="gen15423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15424"/>vadens post illam quasi investigator, <l eID="gen15424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15425"/>et in viis illius consistens : <l eID="gen15425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6525"/><l level="1" sID="gen15426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6525"/>qui respicit per fenestras illius, <l eID="gen15426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15427"/>et in januis illius audiens : <l eID="gen15427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6526"/><l level="1" sID="gen15428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6526"/>qui requiescit juxta domum illius, <l eID="gen15428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15429"/>et in parietibus illius figens palum, <l eID="gen15429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15430"/>statuet casulam suam ad manus illius, <l eID="gen15430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15431"/>et requiescent in casula illius bona per ævum. <l eID="gen15431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6527"/><l level="1" sID="gen15432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6527"/>Statuet filios suos sub tegmine illius, <l eID="gen15432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15433"/>et sub ramis ejus morabitur. <l eID="gen15433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6528"/><l level="1" sID="gen15434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6528"/>Protegetur sub tegmine illius a fervore, <l eID="gen15434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15435"/>et in gloria ejus requiescet.  <chapter eID="Sir.14"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:1
verses.text: Qui timet Deum faciet bona, <l eID="gen15436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15437"/>et qui continens est justitiæ apprehendet illam : <l eID="gen15437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6529"/><l level="1" sID="gen15438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6529"/>et obviabit illi quasi mater honorificata, <l eID="gen15438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15439"/>et quasi mulier a virginitate suscipiet illum. <l eID="gen15439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6530"/><l level="1" sID="gen15440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6530"/>Cibabit illum pane vitæ et intellectus, <l eID="gen15440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15441"/>et aqua sapientiæ salutaris potabit illum : <l eID="gen15441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15442"/>et firmabitur in illo, et non flectetur : <l eID="gen15442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6531"/><l level="1" sID="gen15443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6531"/>et continebit illum, et non confundetur : <l eID="gen15443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15444"/>et exaltabit illum apud proximos suos, <l eID="gen15444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6532"/><l level="1" sID="gen15445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6532"/>et in medio ecclesiæ aperiet os ejus, <l eID="gen15445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15446"/>et adimplebit illum spiritu sapientiæ et intellectus, <l eID="gen15446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15447"/>et stola gloriæ vestiet illum. <l eID="gen15447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6533"/><l level="1" sID="gen15448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6533"/>Jucunditatem et exsultationem thesaurizabit super illum, <l eID="gen15448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15449"/>et nomine æterno hæreditabit illum. <l eID="gen15449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6534"/><l level="1" sID="gen15450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6534"/>Homines stulti non apprehendent illam, <l eID="gen15450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15451"/>et homines sensati obviabunt illi. <l eID="gen15451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15452"/>Homines stulti non videbunt eam : <l eID="gen15452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15453"/>longe enim abest a superbia et dolo. <l eID="gen15453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6535"/><l level="1" sID="gen15454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6535"/>Viri mendaces non erunt illius memores : <l eID="gen15454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15455"/>et viri veraces invenientur in illa, <l eID="gen15455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15456"/>et successum habebunt usque ad inspectionem Dei. <l eID="gen15456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6536"/><l level="1" sID="gen15457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6536"/>Non est speciosa laus in ore peccatoris, <l eID="gen15457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6537"/><l level="1" sID="gen15458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6537"/>quoniam a Deo profecta est sapientia. <l eID="gen15458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15459"/>Sapientiæ enim Dei astabit laus, <l eID="gen15459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15460"/>et in ore fideli abundabit, <l eID="gen15460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15461"/>et Dominator dabit eam illi. <l eID="gen15461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6538"/><l level="1" sID="gen15462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6538"/>Non dixeris : Per Deum abest : <l eID="gen15462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15463"/>quæ enim odit ne feceris. <l eID="gen15463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6539"/><l level="1" sID="gen15464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6539"/>Non dicas : Ille me implanavit : <l eID="gen15464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15465"/>non enim necessarii sunt ei homines impii. <l eID="gen15465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6540"/><l level="1" sID="gen15466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6540"/>Omne execramentum erroris odit Dominus, <l eID="gen15466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15467"/>et non erit amabile timentibus eum. <l eID="gen15467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6541"/><l level="1" sID="gen15468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6541"/>Deus ab initio constituit hominem, <l eID="gen15468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15469"/>et reliquit illum in manu consilii sui : <l eID="gen15469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6542"/><l level="1" sID="gen15470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6542"/>adjecit mandata et præcepta sua. <l eID="gen15470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6543"/><l level="1" sID="gen15471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6543"/>Si volueris mandata servare, conservabunt te, <l eID="gen15471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15472"/>et in perpetuum fidem placitam facere. <l eID="gen15472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6544"/><l level="1" sID="gen15473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6544"/>Apposuit tibi aquam et ignem, <l eID="gen15473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15474"/>ad quod volueris porrige manum tuam. <l eID="gen15474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6545"/><l level="1" sID="gen15475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6545"/>Ante hominem vita et mors, bonum et malum : <l eID="gen15475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15476"/>quod placuerit ei dabitur illi : <l eID="gen15476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6546"/><l level="1" sID="gen15477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6546"/>quoniam multa sapientia Dei, et fortis in potentia, <l eID="gen15477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15478"/>videns omnes sine intermissione. <l eID="gen15478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6547"/><l level="1" sID="gen15479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6547"/>Oculi Domini ad timentes eum, <l eID="gen15479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15480"/>et ipse agnoscit omnem operam hominis. <l eID="gen15480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6548"/><l level="1" sID="gen15481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6548"/>Nemini mandavit impie agere, <l eID="gen15481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15482"/>et nemini dedit spatium peccandi : <l eID="gen15482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 15:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6549"/><l level="1" sID="gen15483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6549"/>non enim concupiscit multitudinem <l eID="gen15483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15484"/>filiorum infidelium et inutilium.  <chapter eID="Sir.15"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:1
verses.text: Ne jucunderis in filiis impiis, si multiplicentur : <l eID="gen15485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15486"/>nec oblecteris super ipsos, si non est timor Dei in illis. <l eID="gen15486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6550"/><l level="1" sID="gen15487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6550"/>Non credas vitæ illorum, <l eID="gen15487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15488"/>et ne respexeris in labores eorum. <l eID="gen15488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6551"/><l level="1" sID="gen15489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6551"/>Melior est enim unus timens Deum, <l eID="gen15489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15490"/>quam mille filii impii : <l eID="gen15490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6552"/><l level="1" sID="gen15491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6552"/>et utile est mori sine filiis, <l eID="gen15491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15492"/>quam relinquere filios impios. <l eID="gen15492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6553"/><l level="1" sID="gen15493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6553"/>Ab uno sensato inhabitabitur patria : <l eID="gen15493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15494"/>tribus impiorum deseretur. <l eID="gen15494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6554"/><l level="1" sID="gen15495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6554"/>Multa talia vidit oculis meus, <l eID="gen15495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15496"/>et fortiora horum audivit auris mea. <l eID="gen15496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6555"/><l level="1" sID="gen15497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6555"/>In synagoga peccantium exardebit ignis, <l eID="gen15497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15498"/>et in gente incredibili exardescet ira. <l eID="gen15498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6556"/><l level="1" sID="gen15499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6556"/>Non exoraverunt pro peccatis suis antiqui gigantes, <l eID="gen15499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15500"/>qui destructi sunt confidentes suæ virtuti. <l eID="gen15500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6557"/><l level="1" sID="gen15501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6557"/>Et non pepercit peregrinationi Lot, <l eID="gen15501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15502"/>et execratus est eos præ superbia verbi illorum. <l eID="gen15502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6558"/><l level="1" sID="gen15503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6558"/>Non misertus est illis, gentem totam perdens, <l eID="gen15503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15504"/>et extollentem se in peccatis suis. <l eID="gen15504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6559"/><l level="1" sID="gen15505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6559"/>Et sicut sexcenta millia peditum, <l eID="gen15505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15506"/>qui congregati sunt in duritia cordis sui : <l eID="gen15506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15507"/>et si unus fuisset cervicatus, <l eID="gen15507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15508"/>mirum si fuisset immunis. <l eID="gen15508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6560"/><l level="1" sID="gen15509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6560"/>Misericordia enim et ira est cum illo : <l eID="gen15509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15510"/>potens exoratio, et effundens iram. <l eID="gen15510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6561"/><l level="1" sID="gen15511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6561"/>Secundum misericordiam suam, <l eID="gen15511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15512"/>sic correptio illius homines secundum opera sua judicat. <l eID="gen15512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6562"/><l level="1" sID="gen15513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6562"/>Non effugiet in rapina peccator, <l eID="gen15513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15514"/>et non retardabit sufferentia misericordiam facientis. <l eID="gen15514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6563"/><l level="1" sID="gen15515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6563"/>Omnis misericordia faciet locum unicuique, <l eID="gen15515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15516"/>secundum meritum operum suorum, <l eID="gen15516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15517"/>et secundum intellectum peregrinationis ipsius. <l eID="gen15517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6564"/><l level="1" sID="gen15518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6564"/>Non dicas : A Deo abscondar : <l eID="gen15518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15519"/>et ex summo, quis mei memorabitur ? <l eID="gen15519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6565"/><l level="1" sID="gen15520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6565"/>in populo magno non agnoscar : <l eID="gen15520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15521"/>quæ est enim anima mea in tam immensa creatura ? <l eID="gen15521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6566"/><l level="1" sID="gen15522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6566"/>Ecce cælum et cæli cælorum, <l eID="gen15522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15523"/>abyssus, et universa terra, et quæ in eis sunt, <l eID="gen15523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15524"/>in conspectu illius commovebuntur. <l eID="gen15524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6567"/><l level="1" sID="gen15525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6567"/>Montes simul, et colles, et fundamenta terræ, <l eID="gen15525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15526"/>cum conspexerit illa Deus, tremore concutientur. <l eID="gen15526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6568"/><l level="1" sID="gen15527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6568"/>Et in omnibus his insensatum est cor, <l eID="gen15527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15528"/>et omne cor intelligitur ab illo. <l eID="gen15528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6569"/><l level="1" sID="gen15529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6569"/>Et vias illius quis intelligit, <l eID="gen15529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15530"/>et procellam quam nec oculus videbit hominis ? <l eID="gen15530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6570"/><l level="1" sID="gen15531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6570"/>Nam plurima illius opera sunt in absconsis : <l eID="gen15531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15532"/>sed opera justitiæ ejus quis enuntiabit, aut quis sustinebit ? <l eID="gen15532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15533"/>longe enim est testamentum a quibusdam, <l eID="gen15533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15534"/>et interrogatio omnium in consummatione est. <l eID="gen15534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6571"/><l level="1" sID="gen15535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6571"/>Qui minoratur corde cogitat inania, <l eID="gen15535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15536"/>et vir imprudens et errans cogitat stulta. <l eID="gen15536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6572"/><l level="1" sID="gen15537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6572"/>Audi me, fili, et disce disciplinam sensus, <l eID="gen15537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15538"/>et in verbis meis attende in corde tuo : <l eID="gen15538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6573"/><l level="1" sID="gen15539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6573"/>et dicam in æquitate disciplinam, <l eID="gen15539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15540"/>et scrutabor enarrare sapientiam : <l eID="gen15540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15541"/>et in verbis meis attende in corde tuo, <l eID="gen15541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15542"/>et dico in æquitate spiritus virtutes <l eID="gen15542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15543"/>quas posuit Deus in opera sua ab initio, <l eID="gen15543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15544"/>et in veritate enuntio scientiam ejus. <l eID="gen15544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6574"/><l level="1" sID="gen15545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6574"/>In judicio Dei opera ejus ab initio, <l eID="gen15545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15546"/>et ab institutione ipsorum distinxit partes illorum, <l eID="gen15546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15547"/>et initia eorum in gentibus suis. <l eID="gen15547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6575"/><l level="1" sID="gen15548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6575"/>Ornavit in æternum opera illorum : <l eID="gen15548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15549"/>nec esurierunt, nec laboraverunt, <l eID="gen15549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15550"/>et non destiterunt ab operibus suis. <l eID="gen15550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6576"/><l level="1" sID="gen15551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6576"/>Unusquisque proximum sibi non angustiabit in æternum : <l eID="gen15551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6577"/><l level="1" sID="gen15552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6577"/>non sis incredibilis verbo illius. <l eID="gen15552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6578"/><l level="1" sID="gen15553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6578"/>Post hæc Deus in terram respexit, <l eID="gen15553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15554"/>et implevit illam bonis suis : <l eID="gen15554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 16:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6579"/><l level="1" sID="gen15555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6579"/>anima omnis vitalis denuntiavit ante faciem ipsius, <l eID="gen15555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15556"/>et in ipsam iterum reversio illorum.  <chapter eID="Sir.16"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:1
verses.text: Deus creavit de terra hominem, <l eID="gen15557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15558"/>et secundum imaginem suam fecit illum : <l eID="gen15558" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6580"/><l level="1" sID="gen15559"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6580"/>et iterum convertit illum in ipsam, <l eID="gen15559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15560"/>et secundum se vestivit illum virtute. <l eID="gen15560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6581"/><l level="1" sID="gen15561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6581"/>Numerum dierum et tempus dedit illi, <l eID="gen15561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15562"/>et dedit illi potestatem eorum quæ sunt super terram. <l eID="gen15562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6582"/><l level="1" sID="gen15563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6582"/>Posuit timorem illius super omnem carnem, <l eID="gen15563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15564"/>et dominatus est bestiarum et volatilium. <l eID="gen15564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6583"/><l level="1" sID="gen15565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6583"/>Creavit ex ipso adjutorium simile sibi : <l eID="gen15565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15566"/>consilium, et linguam, et oculos, et aures, <l eID="gen15566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15567"/>et cor dedit illis excogitandi, <l eID="gen15567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15568"/>et disciplina intellectus replevit illos. <l eID="gen15568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6584"/><l level="1" sID="gen15569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6584"/>Creavit illis scientiam spiritus, <l eID="gen15569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15570"/>sensu implevit cor illorum, <l eID="gen15570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15571"/>et mala et bona ostendit illis. <l eID="gen15571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6585"/><l level="1" sID="gen15572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6585"/>Posuit oculum suum super corda illorum, <l eID="gen15572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15573"/>ostendere illis magnalia operum suorum : <l eID="gen15573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6586"/><l level="1" sID="gen15574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6586"/>ut nomen sanctificationis collaudent, <l eID="gen15574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15575"/>et gloriari in mirabilibus illius ; <l eID="gen15575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15576"/>ut magnalia enarrent operum ejus. <l eID="gen15576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6587"/><l level="1" sID="gen15577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6587"/>Addidit illis disciplinam, <l eID="gen15577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15578"/>et legem vitæ hæreditavit illos. <l eID="gen15578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6588"/><l level="1" sID="gen15579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6588"/>Testamentum æternum constituit cum illis, <l eID="gen15579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15580"/>et justitiam et judicia sua ostendit illis. <l eID="gen15580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6589"/><l level="1" sID="gen15581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6589"/>Et magnalia honoris ejus vidit oculus illorum, <l eID="gen15581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15582"/>et honorem vocis audierunt aures illorum. <l eID="gen15582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15583"/>Et dixit illis : Attendite ab omni iniquo. <l eID="gen15583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6590"/><l level="1" sID="gen15584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6590"/>Et mandavit illis unicuique de proximo suo. <l eID="gen15584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6591"/><l level="1" sID="gen15585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6591"/>Viæ illorum coram ipso sunt semper : <l eID="gen15585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15586"/>non sunt absconsæ ab oculis ipsius. <l eID="gen15586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6592"/><l level="1" sID="gen15587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6592"/>In unamquamque gentem præposuit rectorem : <l eID="gen15587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6593"/><l level="1" sID="gen15588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6593"/>et pars Dei Israël facta est manifesta. <l eID="gen15588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6594"/><l level="1" sID="gen15589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6594"/>Et omnia opera illorum velut sol in conspectu Dei : <l eID="gen15589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15590"/>et oculi ejus sine intermissione inspicientes in viis eorum. <l eID="gen15590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6595"/><l level="1" sID="gen15591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6595"/>Non sunt absconsa testamenta per iniquitatem illorum, <l eID="gen15591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15592"/>et omnes iniquitates eorum in conspectu Dei. <l eID="gen15592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6596"/><l level="1" sID="gen15593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6596"/>Eleemosyna viri quasi signaculum cum ipso, <l eID="gen15593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15594"/>et gratiam hominis quasi pupillam conservabit. <l eID="gen15594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6597"/><l level="1" sID="gen15595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6597"/>Et postea resurget, <l eID="gen15595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15596"/>et retribuet illis retributionem, unicuique in caput ipsorum, <l eID="gen15596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15597"/>et convertet in interiores partes terræ. <l eID="gen15597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6598"/><l level="1" sID="gen15598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6598"/>Pœnitentibus autem dedit viam justitiæ, <l eID="gen15598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15599"/>et confirmavit deficientes sustinere, <l eID="gen15599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15600"/>et destinavit illis sortem veritatis. <l eID="gen15600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6599"/><l level="1" sID="gen15601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6599"/>Convertere ad Dominum, et relinque peccata tua : <l eID="gen15601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6600"/><l level="1" sID="gen15602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6600"/>precare ante faciem Domini, et minue offendicula. <l eID="gen15602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6601"/><l level="1" sID="gen15603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6601"/>Revertere ad Dominum, et avertere ab injustitia tua, <l eID="gen15603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15604"/>et nimis odito execrationem : <l eID="gen15604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6602"/><l level="1" sID="gen15605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6602"/>et cognosce justitias et judicia Dei, <l eID="gen15605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15606"/>et sta in sorte propositionis, et orationis altissimi Dei. <l eID="gen15606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6603"/><l level="1" sID="gen15607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6603"/>In partes vade sæculi sancti, <l eID="gen15607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15608"/>cum vivis et dantibus confessionem Deo. <l eID="gen15608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6604"/><l level="1" sID="gen15609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6604"/>Non demoreris in errore impiorum : <l eID="gen15609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15610"/>ante mortem confitere : <l eID="gen15610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15611"/>a mortuo, quasi nihil, perit confessio. <l eID="gen15611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6605"/><l level="1" sID="gen15612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6605"/>Confiteberis vivens, <l eID="gen15612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15613"/>vivus et sanus confiteberis : <l eID="gen15613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15614"/>et laudabis Deum, <l eID="gen15614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15615"/>et gloriaberis in miserationibus illius. <l eID="gen15615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6606"/><l level="1" sID="gen15616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6606"/>Quam magna misericordia Domini, <l eID="gen15616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15617"/>et propitiatio illius convertentibus ad se ! <l eID="gen15617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6607"/><l level="1" sID="gen15618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6607"/>Nec enim omnia possunt esse in hominibus, <l eID="gen15618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15619"/>quoniam non est immortalis filius hominis, <l eID="gen15619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15620"/>et in vanitate malitiæ placuerunt. <l eID="gen15620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6608"/><l level="1" sID="gen15621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6608"/>Quid lucidius sole ? <l eID="gen15621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15622"/>et hic deficiet ; <l eID="gen15622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15623"/>aut quid nequius quam quod excogitavit caro et sanguis ? <l eID="gen15623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15624"/>et hoc arguetur. <l eID="gen15624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 17:31
