verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6609"/><l level="1" sID="gen15625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6609"/>Virtutem altitudinis cæli ipse conspicit : <l eID="gen15625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15626"/>et omnes homines terra et cinis.  <chapter eID="Sir.17"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:1
verses.text: Qui vivet in æternum creavit omnia simul. <l eID="gen15627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15628"/>Deus solus justificabitur, <l eID="gen15628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15629"/>et manet invictus rex in æternum. <l eID="gen15629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6610"/><l level="1" sID="gen15630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6610"/>Quis sufficit enarrare opera illius ? <l eID="gen15630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6611"/><l level="1" sID="gen15631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6611"/>quis enim investigabit magnalia ejus ? <l eID="gen15631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6612"/><l level="1" sID="gen15632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6612"/>virtutem autem magnitudinis ejus quis enuntiabit ? <l eID="gen15632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15633"/>aut quis adjiciet enarrare misericordiam ejus ? <l eID="gen15633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6613"/><l level="1" sID="gen15634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6613"/>Non est minuere neque adjicere, <l eID="gen15634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15635"/>nec est invenire magnalia Dei. <l eID="gen15635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6614"/><l level="1" sID="gen15636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6614"/>Cum consummaverit homo, tunc incipiet : <l eID="gen15636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15637"/>et cum quieverit, aporiabitur. <l eID="gen15637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6615"/><l level="1" sID="gen15638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6615"/>Quid est homo ? et quæ est gratia illius ? <l eID="gen15638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15639"/>et quid bonum aut quid nequam illius ? <l eID="gen15639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6616"/><l level="1" sID="gen15640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6616"/>Numerus dierum hominum, ut multum centum anni, <l eID="gen15640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15641"/>quasi gutta aquæ maris deputati sunt : <l eID="gen15641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15642"/>et sicut calculus arenæ, sic exigui anni in die ævi. <l eID="gen15642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6617"/><l level="1" sID="gen15643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6617"/>Propter hoc patiens est Deus in illis, <l eID="gen15643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15644"/>et effundit super eos misericordiam suam. <l eID="gen15644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6618"/><l level="1" sID="gen15645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6618"/>Vidit præsumptionem cordis eorum, quoniam mala est : <l eID="gen15645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15646"/>et cognovit subversionem illorum, quoniam nequam est. <l eID="gen15646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6619"/><l level="1" sID="gen15647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6619"/>Ideo adimplevit propitiationem suam in illis, <l eID="gen15647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15648"/>et ostendit eis viam æquitatis. <l eID="gen15648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6620"/><l level="1" sID="gen15649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6620"/>Miseratio hominis circa proximum suum : <l eID="gen15649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15650"/>misericordia autem Dei super omnem carnem. <l eID="gen15650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6621"/><l level="1" sID="gen15651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6621"/>Qui misericordiam habet, docet et erudit <l eID="gen15651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15652"/>quasi pastor gregem suum. <l eID="gen15652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6622"/><l level="1" sID="gen15653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6622"/>Miseretur excipientis doctrinam miserationis, <l eID="gen15653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15654"/>et qui festinat in judiciis ejus. <l eID="gen15654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6623"/><l level="1" sID="gen15655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6623"/>Fili, in bonis non des querelam, <l eID="gen15655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15656"/>et in omni dato non des tristitiam verbi mali. <l eID="gen15656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6624"/><l level="1" sID="gen15657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6624"/>Nonne ardorem refrigerabit ros ? <l eID="gen15657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15658"/>sic et verbum melius quam datum. <l eID="gen15658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6625"/><l level="1" sID="gen15659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6625"/>Nonne ecce verbum super datum bonum ? <l eID="gen15659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15660"/>sed utraque cum homine justificato. <l eID="gen15660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6626"/><l level="1" sID="gen15661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6626"/>Stultus acriter improperabit : <l eID="gen15661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15662"/>et datus indisciplinati tabescere facit oculos. <l eID="gen15662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6627"/><l level="1" sID="gen15663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6627"/>Ante judicium para justitiam tibi, <l eID="gen15663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15664"/>et antequam loquaris, disce. <l eID="gen15664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6628"/><l level="1" sID="gen15665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6628"/>Ante languorem adhibe medicinam : <l eID="gen15665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15666"/>et ante judicium interroga teipsum, <l eID="gen15666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15667"/>et in conspectu Dei invenies propitiationem. <l eID="gen15667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6629"/><l level="1" sID="gen15668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6629"/>Ante languorem humilia te, <l eID="gen15668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15669"/>et in tempore infirmitatis ostende conversationem tuam. <l eID="gen15669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6630"/><l level="1" sID="gen15670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6630"/>Non impediaris orare semper, <l eID="gen15670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15671"/>et ne verearis usque ad mortem justificari, <l eID="gen15671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15672"/>quoniam merces Dei manet in æternum. <l eID="gen15672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6631"/><l level="1" sID="gen15673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6631"/>Ante orationem præpara animam tuam, <l eID="gen15673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15674"/>et noli esse quasi homo qui tentat Deum. <l eID="gen15674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6632"/><l level="1" sID="gen15675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6632"/>Memento iræ in die consummationis, <l eID="gen15675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15676"/>et tempus retributionis in conversatione faciei. <l eID="gen15676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6633"/><l level="1" sID="gen15677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6633"/>Memento paupertatis in tempore abundantiæ, <l eID="gen15677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15678"/>et necessitatum paupertatis in die divitiarum. <l eID="gen15678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6634"/><l level="1" sID="gen15679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6634"/>A mane usque ad vesperam immutabitur tempus, <l eID="gen15679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15680"/>et hæc omnia citata in oculis Dei. <l eID="gen15680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6635"/><l level="1" sID="gen15681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6635"/>Homo sapiens in omnibus metuet, <l eID="gen15681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15682"/>et in diebus delictorum attendet ab inertia. <l eID="gen15682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6636"/><l level="1" sID="gen15683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6636"/>Omnis astutus agnoscit sapientiam, <l eID="gen15683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15684"/>et invenienti eam dabit confessionem. <l eID="gen15684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6637"/><l level="1" sID="gen15685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6637"/>Sensati in verbis et ipsi sapienter egerunt, <l eID="gen15685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15686"/>et intellexerunt veritatem et justitiam, <l eID="gen15686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15687"/>et impluerunt proverbia et judicia. <l eID="gen15687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6638"/><l level="1" sID="gen15688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6638"/>Post concupiscentias tuas non eas, <l eID="gen15688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15689"/>et a voluntate tua avertere. <l eID="gen15689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6639"/><l level="1" sID="gen15690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6639"/>Si præstes animæ tuæ concupiscentias ejus, <l eID="gen15690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15691"/>faciat te in gaudium inimicis tuis. <l eID="gen15691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6640"/><l level="1" sID="gen15692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6640"/>Ne oblecteris in turbis nec in modicis : <l eID="gen15692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15693"/>assidua enim est commissio illorum. <l eID="gen15693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 18:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6641"/><l level="1" sID="gen15694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6641"/>Ne fueris mediocris in contentione ex fœnore, <l eID="gen15694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15695"/>et est tibi nihil in sacculo : <l eID="gen15695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15696"/>eris enim invidus vitæ tuæ.  <chapter eID="Sir.18"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:1
verses.text: Operarius ebriosus non locupletabitur : <l eID="gen15697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15698"/>et qui spernit modica paulatim decidet. <l eID="gen15698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6642"/><l level="1" sID="gen15699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6642"/>Vinum et mulieres apostatare faciunt sapientes, <l eID="gen15699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15700"/>et arguent sensatos. <l eID="gen15700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6643"/><l level="1" sID="gen15701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6643"/>Et qui se jungit fornicariis erit nequam : <l eID="gen15701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15702"/>putredo et vermes hæreditabunt illum : <l eID="gen15702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15703"/>et extolletur in exemplum majus, <l eID="gen15703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15704"/>et tolletur de numero anima ejus. <l eID="gen15704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6644"/><l level="1" sID="gen15705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6644"/>Qui credit cito levis corde est, et minorabitur : <l eID="gen15705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15706"/>et qui delinquit in animam suam, insuper habebitur. <l eID="gen15706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6645"/><l level="1" sID="gen15707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6645"/>Qui gaudet iniquitate, denotabitur : <l eID="gen15707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15708"/>et qui odit correptionem, minuetur vita : <l eID="gen15708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15709"/>et qui odit loquacitatem, extinguit malitiam. <l eID="gen15709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6646"/><l level="1" sID="gen15710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6646"/>Qui peccat in animam suam, pœnitebit : <l eID="gen15710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15711"/>et qui jucundatur in malitia, denotabitur. <l eID="gen15711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6647"/><l level="1" sID="gen15712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6647"/>Ne iteres verbum nequam et durum, <l eID="gen15712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15713"/>et non minoraberis. <l eID="gen15713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6648"/><l level="1" sID="gen15714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6648"/>Amico et inimico noli narrare sensum tuum : <l eID="gen15714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15715"/>et si est tibi delictum, noli denudare : <l eID="gen15715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6649"/><l level="1" sID="gen15716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6649"/>audiet enim te, et custodiet te, <l eID="gen15716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15717"/>et quasi defendens peccatum, odiet te, <l eID="gen15717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15718"/>et sic aderit tibi semper. <l eID="gen15718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6650"/><l level="1" sID="gen15719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6650"/>Audisti verbum adversus proximum tuum ? <l eID="gen15719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15720"/>commoriatur in te, fidens quoniam non te dirumpet. <l eID="gen15720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6651"/><l level="1" sID="gen15721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6651"/>A facie verbi parturit fatuus, <l eID="gen15721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15722"/>tamquam gemitus partus infantis. <l eID="gen15722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6652"/><l level="1" sID="gen15723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6652"/>Sagitta infixa femori carnis, <l eID="gen15723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15724"/>sic verbum in corde stulti. <l eID="gen15724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6653"/><l level="1" sID="gen15725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6653"/>Corripe amicum, <l eID="gen15725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15726"/>ne forte non intellexerit, et dicat : Non feci : <l eID="gen15726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15727"/>aut, si fecerit, ne iterum addat facere. <l eID="gen15727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6654"/><l level="1" sID="gen15728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6654"/>Corripe proximum, ne forte non dixerit : <l eID="gen15728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15729"/>et si dixerit, ne forte iteret. <l eID="gen15729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6655"/><l level="1" sID="gen15730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6655"/>Corripe amicum, sæpe enim fit commissio : <l eID="gen15730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6656"/><l level="1" sID="gen15731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6656"/>et non omni verbo credas. <l eID="gen15731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15732"/>Est qui labitur lingua, sed non ex animo : <l eID="gen15732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6657"/><l level="1" sID="gen15733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6657"/>quis est enim qui non deliquerit in lingua sua ? <l eID="gen15733" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen14518"/> <div sID="gen15734" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen15734" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen15735"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15736"/>Corripe proximum antequam commineris, <l eID="gen15736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6658"/><l level="1" sID="gen15737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6658"/>et da locum timori Altissimi : <l eID="gen15737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15738"/>quia omnis sapientia timor Dei, et in illa timere Deum, <l eID="gen15738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15739"/>et in omni sapientia dispositio legis. <l eID="gen15739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6659"/><l level="1" sID="gen15740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6659"/>Et non est sapientia nequitiæ disciplina, <l eID="gen15740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15741"/>et non est cogitatus peccatorum prudentia. <l eID="gen15741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6660"/><l level="1" sID="gen15742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6660"/>Est nequitia, et in ipsa execratio, <l eID="gen15742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15743"/>et est insipiens qui minuitur sapientia. <l eID="gen15743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6661"/><l level="1" sID="gen15744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6661"/>Melior est homo qui minuitur sapientia, <l eID="gen15744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15745"/>et deficiens sensu, in timore, <l eID="gen15745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15746"/>quam qui abundat sensu, <l eID="gen15746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15747"/>et transgreditur legem Altissimi. <l eID="gen15747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6662"/><l level="1" sID="gen15748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6662"/>Est solertia certa, et ipsa iniqua : <l eID="gen15748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6663"/><l level="1" sID="gen15749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6663"/>et est qui emittit verbum certum enarrans veritatem. <l eID="gen15749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15750"/>Est qui nequiter humiliat se, <l eID="gen15750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15751"/>et interiora ejus plena sunt dolo : <l eID="gen15751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6664"/><l level="1" sID="gen15752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6664"/>et est qui se nimium submittit a multa humilitate : <l eID="gen15752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15753"/>et est qui inclinat faciem suam, <l eID="gen15753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15754"/>et fingit se non videre quod ignoratum est : <l eID="gen15754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6665"/><l level="1" sID="gen15755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6665"/>et si ab imbecillitate virium vetetur peccare, <l eID="gen15755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15756"/>si invenerit tempus malefaciendi, malefaciet. <l eID="gen15756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6666"/><l level="1" sID="gen15757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6666"/>Ex visu cognoscitur vir, <l eID="gen15757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15758"/>et ab occursu faciei cognoscitur sensatus. <l eID="gen15758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6667"/><l level="1" sID="gen15759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6667"/>Amictus corporis, et risus dentium, <l eID="gen15759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15760"/>et ingressus hominis, enuntiant de illo. <l eID="gen15760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 19:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6668"/><l level="1" sID="gen15761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6668"/>Est correptio mendax in ira contumeliosi, <l eID="gen15761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15762"/>et est judicium quod non probatur esse bonum : <l eID="gen15762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15763"/>et est tacens, et ipse est prudens.  <chapter eID="Sir.19"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:1
verses.text: Quam bonum est arguere, quam irasci, <l eID="gen15764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15765"/>et confitentem in oratione non prohibere ! <l eID="gen15765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6669"/><l level="1" sID="gen15766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6669"/>Concupiscentia spadonis devirginabit juvenculam : <l eID="gen15766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6670"/><l level="1" sID="gen15767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6670"/>sic qui facit per vim judicium iniquum. <l eID="gen15767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6671"/><l level="1" sID="gen15768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6671"/>Quam bonum est correptum manifestare pœnitentiam ! <l eID="gen15768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15769"/>sic enim effugies voluntarium peccatum. <l eID="gen15769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6672"/><l level="1" sID="gen15770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6672"/>Est tacens qui invenitur sapiens : <l eID="gen15770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15771"/>et est odibilis qui procax est ad loquendum. <l eID="gen15771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6673"/><l level="1" sID="gen15772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6673"/>Est tacens non habens sensum loquelæ : <l eID="gen15772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15773"/>et est tacens sciens tempus aptum. <l eID="gen15773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6674"/><l level="1" sID="gen15774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6674"/>Homo sapiens tacebit usque ad tempus : <l eID="gen15774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15775"/>lascivus autem et imprudens non servabunt tempus. <l eID="gen15775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6675"/><l level="1" sID="gen15776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6675"/>Qui multis utitur verbis lædet animam suam : <l eID="gen15776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15777"/>et qui potestatem sibi sumit injuste, odietur. <l eID="gen15777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6676"/><l level="1" sID="gen15778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6676"/>Est processio in malis viro indisciplinato, <l eID="gen15778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15779"/>et est inventio in detrimentum. <l eID="gen15779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6677"/><l level="1" sID="gen15780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6677"/>Est datum quod non est utile, <l eID="gen15780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15781"/>et est datum cujus retributio duplex. <l eID="gen15781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6678"/><l level="1" sID="gen15782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6678"/>Est propter gloriam minoratio, <l eID="gen15782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15783"/>et est qui ab humilitate levabit caput. <l eID="gen15783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6679"/><l level="1" sID="gen15784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6679"/>Est qui multa redimat modico pretio, <l eID="gen15784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15785"/>et restituens ea in septuplum. <l eID="gen15785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6680"/><l level="1" sID="gen15786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6680"/>Sapiens in verbis seipsum amabilem facit : <l eID="gen15786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15787"/>gratiæ autem fatuorum effundentur. <l eID="gen15787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6681"/><l level="1" sID="gen15788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6681"/>Datus insipientis non erit utilis tibi : <l eID="gen15788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15789"/>oculi enim illius septemplices sunt. <l eID="gen15789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6682"/><l level="1" sID="gen15790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6682"/>Exigua dabit, et multa improperabit : <l eID="gen15790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15791"/>et apertio oris illius inflammatio est. <l eID="gen15791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6683"/><l level="1" sID="gen15792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6683"/>Hodie fœneratur quis, et cras expetit : <l eID="gen15792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15793"/>odibilis est homo hujusmodi. <l eID="gen15793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6684"/><l level="1" sID="gen15794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6684"/>Fatuo non erit amicus, <l eID="gen15794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15795"/>et non erit gratia bonis illius : <l eID="gen15795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6685"/><l level="1" sID="gen15796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6685"/>qui enim edunt panem illius, falsæ linguæ sunt. <l eID="gen15796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15797"/>Quoties et quanti irridebunt eum ! <l eID="gen15797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6686"/><l level="1" sID="gen15798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6686"/>neque enim quod habendum erat directo sensu distribuit ; <l eID="gen15798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15799"/>similiter et quod non erat habendum. <l eID="gen15799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6687"/><l level="1" sID="gen15800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6687"/>Lapsus falsæ linguæ quasi qui in pavimento cadens : <l eID="gen15800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15801"/>sic casus malorum festinanter veniet. <l eID="gen15801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6688"/><l level="1" sID="gen15802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6688"/>Homo acharis quasi fabula vana, <l eID="gen15802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15803"/>in ore indisciplinatorum assidua erit. <l eID="gen15803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6689"/><l level="1" sID="gen15804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6689"/>Ex ore fatui reprobabitur parabola : <l eID="gen15804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15805"/>non enim dicit illam in tempore suo. <l eID="gen15805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6690"/><l level="1" sID="gen15806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6690"/>Est qui vetatur peccare præ inopia, <l eID="gen15806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15807"/>et in requie sua stimulabitur. <l eID="gen15807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6691"/><l level="1" sID="gen15808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6691"/>Est qui perdet animam suam præ confusione, <l eID="gen15808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15809"/>et ab imprudenti persona perdet eam : <l eID="gen15809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15810"/>personæ autem acceptione perdet se. <l eID="gen15810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6692"/><l level="1" sID="gen15811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6692"/>Est qui præ confusione promittit amico, <l eID="gen15811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15812"/>et lucratus est eum inimicum gratis. <l eID="gen15812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6693"/><l level="1" sID="gen15813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6693"/>Opprobrium nequam in homine mendacium : <l eID="gen15813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15814"/>et in ore indisciplinatorum assidue erit. <l eID="gen15814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6694"/><l level="1" sID="gen15815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6694"/>Potior fur quam assiduitas viri mendacis : <l eID="gen15815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15816"/>perditionem autem ambo hæreditabunt. <l eID="gen15816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6695"/><l level="1" sID="gen15817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6695"/>Mores hominum mendacium sine honore, <l eID="gen15817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15818"/>et confusio illorum cum ipsis sine intermissione. <l eID="gen15818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6696"/><l level="1" sID="gen15819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6696"/>Sapiens in verbis producet seipsum, <l eID="gen15819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15820"/>et homo prudens placebit magnatis. <l eID="gen15820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6697"/><l level="1" sID="gen15821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6697"/>Qui operatur terram suam inaltabit acervum frugum, <l eID="gen15821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15822"/>et qui operatur justitiam, ipse exaltabitur : <l eID="gen15822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15823"/>qui vero placet magnatis effugiet iniquitatem. <l eID="gen15823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6698"/><l level="1" sID="gen15824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6698"/>Xenia et dona excæcant oculos judicum, <l eID="gen15824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15825"/>et quasi mutus, in ore avertit correptiones eorum. <l eID="gen15825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6699"/><l level="1" sID="gen15826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6699"/>Sapientia absconsa, et thesaurus invisus, <l eID="gen15826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15827"/>quæ utilitas in utrisque ? <l eID="gen15827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 20:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6700"/><l level="1" sID="gen15828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6700"/>Melior est qui celat insipientiam suam, <l eID="gen15828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15829"/>quam homo qui abscondit sapientiam suam.  <chapter eID="Sir.20"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:1
verses.text: Fili, peccasti, non adjicias iterum : <l eID="gen15830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15831"/>sed et de pristinis deprecare, ut tibi dimittantur. <l eID="gen15831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6701"/><l level="1" sID="gen15832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6701"/>Quasi a facie colubri fuge peccata : <l eID="gen15832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15833"/>et si accesseris ad illa, suscipient te. <l eID="gen15833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6702"/><l level="1" sID="gen15834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6702"/>Dentes leonis dentes ejus, <l eID="gen15834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15835"/>interficientes animas hominum. <l eID="gen15835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6703"/><l level="1" sID="gen15836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6703"/>Quasi rhomphæa bis acuta omnis iniquitas : <l eID="gen15836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15837"/>plagæ illius non est sanitas. <l eID="gen15837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6704"/><l level="1" sID="gen15838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6704"/>Objurgatio et injuriæ annullabunt substantiam, <l eID="gen15838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15839"/>et domus quæ nimis locuples est annullabitur superbia : <l eID="gen15839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15840"/>sic substantia superbi eradicabitur. <l eID="gen15840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6705"/><l level="1" sID="gen15841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6705"/>Deprecatio pauperis ex ore usque ad aures ejus perveniet, <l eID="gen15841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15842"/>et judicium festinato adveniet illi. <l eID="gen15842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6706"/><l level="1" sID="gen15843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6706"/>Qui odit correptionem vestigium est peccatoris, <l eID="gen15843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15844"/>et qui timet Deum convertetur ad cor suum. <l eID="gen15844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6707"/><l level="1" sID="gen15845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6707"/>Notus a longe potens lingua audaci, <l eID="gen15845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15846"/>et sensatus scit labi se ab ipso. <l eID="gen15846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6708"/><l level="1" sID="gen15847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6708"/>Qui ædificat domum suam impendiis alienis, <l eID="gen15847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15848"/>quasi qui colligit lapides suos in hieme. <l eID="gen15848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6709"/><l level="1" sID="gen15849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6709"/>Stupa collecta synagoga peccantium, <l eID="gen15849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15850"/>et consummatio illorum flamma ignis. <l eID="gen15850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6710"/><l level="1" sID="gen15851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6710"/>Via peccatorum complanata lapidibus : <l eID="gen15851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15852"/>et in fine illorum inferi, et tenebræ, et pœnæ. <l eID="gen15852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6711"/><l level="1" sID="gen15853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6711"/>Qui custodit justitiam, continebit sensum ejus. <l eID="gen15853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6712"/><l level="1" sID="gen15854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6712"/>Consummatio timoris Dei, sapientia et sensus. <l eID="gen15854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6713"/><l level="1" sID="gen15855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6713"/>Non erudietur <l eID="gen15855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15856"/>qui non est sapiens in bono. <l eID="gen15856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6714"/><l level="1" sID="gen15857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6714"/>Est autem sapientia quæ abundat in malo, <l eID="gen15857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15858"/>et non est sensus ubi est amaritudo. <l eID="gen15858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6715"/><l level="1" sID="gen15859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6715"/>Scientia sapientis tamquam inundatio abundabit, <l eID="gen15859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15860"/>et consilium illius sicut fons vitæ permanet. <l eID="gen15860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6716"/><l level="1" sID="gen15861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6716"/>Cor fatui quasi vas confractum, <l eID="gen15861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15862"/>et omnem sapientiam non tenebit. <l eID="gen15862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6717"/><l level="1" sID="gen15863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6717"/>Verbum sapiens quodcumque audierit scius, <l eID="gen15863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15864"/>laudabit, et ad se adjiciet : <l eID="gen15864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15865"/>audivit luxuriosus, et displicebit illi, <l eID="gen15865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15866"/>et projiciet illud post dorsum suum. <l eID="gen15866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6718"/><l level="1" sID="gen15867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6718"/>Narratio fatui quasi sarcina in via : <l eID="gen15867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15868"/>nam in labiis sensati invenietur gratia. <l eID="gen15868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6719"/><l level="1" sID="gen15869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6719"/>Os prudentis quæritur in ecclesia, <l eID="gen15869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15870"/>et verba illius cogitabunt in cordibus suis. <l eID="gen15870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6720"/><l level="1" sID="gen15871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6720"/>Tamquam domus exterminata, sic fatuo sapientia : <l eID="gen15871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15872"/>et scientia insensati inenarrabilia verba. <l eID="gen15872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6721"/><l level="1" sID="gen15873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6721"/>Compedes in pedibus, stulto doctrina : <l eID="gen15873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15874"/>et quasi vincula manuum super manum dextram. <l eID="gen15874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6722"/><l level="1" sID="gen15875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6722"/>Fatuus in risu exaltat vocem suam : <l eID="gen15875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15876"/>vir autem sapiens vix tacite ridebit. <l eID="gen15876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6723"/><l level="1" sID="gen15877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6723"/>Ornamentum aureum prudenti doctrina, <l eID="gen15877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15878"/>et quasi brachiale in brachio dextro. <l eID="gen15878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6724"/><l level="1" sID="gen15879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6724"/>Pes fatui facilis in domum proximi : <l eID="gen15879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15880"/>et homo peritus confundetur a persona potentis. <l eID="gen15880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6725"/><l level="1" sID="gen15881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6725"/>Stultus a fenestra respiciet in domum : <l eID="gen15881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15882"/>vir autem eruditus foris stabit. <l eID="gen15882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6726"/><l level="1" sID="gen15883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6726"/>Stultitia hominis auscultare per ostium : <l eID="gen15883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15884"/>et prudens gravabitur contumelia. <l eID="gen15884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6727"/><l level="1" sID="gen15885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6727"/>Labia imprudentium stulta narrabunt ; <l eID="gen15885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15886"/>verba autem prudentium statera ponderabuntur. <l eID="gen15886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6728"/><l level="1" sID="gen15887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6728"/>In ore fatuorum cor illorum, <l eID="gen15887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15888"/>et in corde sapientium os illorum. <l eID="gen15888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6729"/><l level="1" sID="gen15889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6729"/>Dum maledicit impius diabolum, <l eID="gen15889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15890"/>maledicit ipse animam suam. <l eID="gen15890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 21:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6730"/><l level="1" sID="gen15891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6730"/>Susurro coinquinabit animam suam, et in omnibus odietur, <l eID="gen15891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15892"/>et qui cum eo manserit odiosus erit : <l eID="gen15892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15893"/>tacitus et sensatus honorabitur.  <chapter eID="Sir.21"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:1
verses.text: In lapide luteo lapidatus est piger : <l eID="gen15894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15895"/>et omnes loquentur super aspernationem illius. <l eID="gen15895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6731"/><l level="1" sID="gen15896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6731"/>De stercore boum lapidatus est piger : <l eID="gen15896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15897"/>et omnis qui tetigerit eum excutiet manus. <l eID="gen15897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6732"/><l level="1" sID="gen15898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6732"/>Confusio patris est de filio indisciplinato : <l eID="gen15898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15899"/>filia autem in deminoratione fiet. <l eID="gen15899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6733"/><l level="1" sID="gen15900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6733"/>Filia prudens hæreditas viro suo : <l eID="gen15900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15901"/>nam quæ confundit, in contumeliam fit genitoris. <l eID="gen15901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6734"/><l level="1" sID="gen15902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6734"/>Patrem et virum confundit audax, <l eID="gen15902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15903"/>et ab impiis non minorabitur : <l eID="gen15903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15904"/>ab utrisque autem inhonorabitur. <l eID="gen15904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6735"/><l level="1" sID="gen15905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6735"/>Musica in luctu importuna narratio : <l eID="gen15905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15906"/>flagella et doctrina in omni tempore sapientia. <l eID="gen15906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6736"/><l level="1" sID="gen15907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6736"/>Qui docet fatuum, <l eID="gen15907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15908"/>quasi qui conglutinat testam. <l eID="gen15908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6737"/><l level="1" sID="gen15909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6737"/>Qui narrat verbum non audienti, <l eID="gen15909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15910"/>quasi qui excitat dormientem de gravi somno. <l eID="gen15910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6738"/><l level="1" sID="gen15911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6738"/>Cum dormiente loquitur qui enarrat stulto sapientiam : <l eID="gen15911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15912"/>et in fine narrationis dicit : Quis est hic ? <l eID="gen15912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6739"/><l level="1" sID="gen15913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6739"/>Supra mortuum plora, defecit enim lux ejus : <l eID="gen15913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15914"/>et supra fatuum plora, defecit enim sensus. <l eID="gen15914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6740"/><l level="1" sID="gen15915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6740"/>Modicum plora super mortuum, quoniam requievit : <l eID="gen15915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6741"/><l level="1" sID="gen15916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6741"/>nequissimi enim nequissima vita super mortem fatui. <l eID="gen15916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6742"/><l level="1" sID="gen15917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6742"/>Luctus mortui septem dies : <l eID="gen15917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15918"/>fatui autem et impii omnes dies vitæ illorum. <l eID="gen15918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6743"/><l level="1" sID="gen15919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6743"/>Cum stulto ne multum loquaris, <l eID="gen15919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15920"/>et cum insensato ne abieris. <l eID="gen15920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6744"/><l level="1" sID="gen15921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6744"/>Serva te ab illo, ut non molestiam habeas, <l eID="gen15921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15922"/>et non coinquinaberis peccato illius. <l eID="gen15922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6745"/><l level="1" sID="gen15923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6745"/>Deflecte ab illo, et invenies requiem, <l eID="gen15923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15924"/>et non acediaberis in stultitia illius. <l eID="gen15924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6746"/><l level="1" sID="gen15925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6746"/>Super plumbum quid gravabitur ? <l eID="gen15925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15926"/>et quod illi aliud nomen quam fatuus ? <l eID="gen15926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6747"/><l level="1" sID="gen15927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6747"/>Arenam, et salem, et massam ferri facilius est ferre <l eID="gen15927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15928"/>quam hominem imprudentem, et fatuum, et impium. <l eID="gen15928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6748"/><l level="1" sID="gen15929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6748"/>Loramentum ligneum colligatum in fundamento ædificii non dissolvetur, <l eID="gen15929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15930"/>sic et cor confirmatum in cogitatione consilii. <l eID="gen15930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6749"/><l level="1" sID="gen15931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6749"/>Cogitatus sensati in omni tempore metu non depravabitur. <l eID="gen15931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6750"/><l level="1" sID="gen15932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6750"/>Sicut pali in excelsis, et cæmenta sine impensa posita, <l eID="gen15932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15933"/>contra faciem venti non permanebunt : <l eID="gen15933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6751"/><l level="1" sID="gen15934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6751"/>sic et cor timidum in cogitatione stulti <l eID="gen15934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15935"/>contra impetum timoris non resistet. <l eID="gen15935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6752"/><l level="1" sID="gen15936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6752"/>Sicut cor trepidum in cogitatione fatui omni tempore non metuet, <l eID="gen15936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15937"/>sic et qui in præceptis Dei permanet semper. <l eID="gen15937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6753"/><l level="1" sID="gen15938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6753"/>Pungens oculum deducit lacrimas, <l eID="gen15938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15939"/>et qui pungit cor profert sensum. <l eID="gen15939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6754"/><l level="1" sID="gen15940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6754"/>Mittens lapidem in volatilia, dejiciet illa : <l eID="gen15940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15941"/>sic et qui conviciatur amico, dissolvit amicitiam. <l eID="gen15941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6755"/><l level="1" sID="gen15942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6755"/>Ad amicum etsi produxeris gladium, non desperes : <l eID="gen15942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15943"/>est enim regressus. <l eID="gen15943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15944"/>Ad amicum

verses.name: Sirach 22:27
verses.text: si aperueris os triste, non timeas : <l eID="gen15944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15945"/>est enim concordatio : <l eID="gen15945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15946"/>excepto convitio, et improperio, et superbia, <l eID="gen15946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15947"/>et mysterii revelatione, et plaga dolosa : <l eID="gen15947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15948"/>in his omnibus effugiet amicus. <l eID="gen15948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6756"/><l level="1" sID="gen15949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6756"/>Fidem posside cum amico in paupertate illius, <l eID="gen15949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15950"/>ut et in bonis illius læteris. <l eID="gen15950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6757"/><l level="1" sID="gen15951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6757"/>In tempore tribulationis illius permane illi fidelis, <l eID="gen15951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15952"/>ut et in hæreditate illius cohæres sis. <l eID="gen15952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6758"/><l level="1" sID="gen15953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6758"/>Ante ignem camini vapor et fumus ignis inaltatur : <l eID="gen15953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15954"/>sic et ante sanguinem maledicta, et contumeliæ, et minæ. <l eID="gen15954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6759"/><l level="1" sID="gen15955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6759"/>Amicum salutare non confundar, <l eID="gen15955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15956"/>a facie illius non me abscondam : <l eID="gen15956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15957"/>et si mala mihi evenerint per illum, sustinebo. <l eID="gen15957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6760"/><l level="1" sID="gen15958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6760"/>Omnis qui audiet cavebit se ab eo. <l eID="gen15958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 22:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6761"/><l level="1" sID="gen15959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6761"/>Quis dabit ori meo custodiam, <l eID="gen15959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15960"/>et super labia mea signaculum certum, <l eID="gen15960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15961"/>ut non cadam ab ipsis, <l eID="gen15961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15962"/>et lingua mea perdat me ?  <chapter eID="Sir.22"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:1
verses.text: Domine, pater et dominator vitæ meæ, <l eID="gen15963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15964"/>ne derelinquas me in consilio eorum, <l eID="gen15964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15965"/>nec sinas me cadere in illis. <l eID="gen15965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6762"/><l level="1" sID="gen15966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6762"/>Quis superponet in cogitatu meo flagella, <l eID="gen15966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15967"/>et in corde meo doctrinam sapientiæ, <l eID="gen15967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15968"/>ut ignorationibus eorum non parcant mihi, <l eID="gen15968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15969"/>et non appareant delicta eorum, <l eID="gen15969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6763"/><l level="1" sID="gen15970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6763"/>et ne adincrescant ignorantiæ meæ, <l eID="gen15970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15971"/>et multiplicentur delicta mea, <l eID="gen15971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15972"/>et peccata mea abundent, <l eID="gen15972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15973"/>et incidam in conspectu adversariorum meorum, <l eID="gen15973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15974"/>et gaudeat super me inimicus meus ? <l eID="gen15974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6764"/><l level="1" sID="gen15975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6764"/>Domine, pater et Deus vitæ meæ, <l eID="gen15975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15976"/>ne derelinquas me in cogitatu illorum. <l eID="gen15976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6765"/><l level="1" sID="gen15977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6765"/>Extollentiam oculorum meorum ne dederis mihi, <l eID="gen15977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15978"/>et omne desiderium averte a me. <l eID="gen15978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6766"/><l level="1" sID="gen15979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6766"/>Aufer a me ventris concupiscentias, <l eID="gen15979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15980"/>et concubitus concupiscentiæ ne apprehendant me, <l eID="gen15980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15981"/>et animæ irreverenti et infrunitæ ne tradas me. <l eID="gen15981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6767"/><l level="1" sID="gen15982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6767"/>Doctrinam oris audite, filii : <l eID="gen15982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15983"/>et qui custodierit illam non periet labiis, <l eID="gen15983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15984"/>nec scandalizabitur in operibus nequissimis. <l eID="gen15984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6768"/><l level="1" sID="gen15985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6768"/>In vanitate sua apprehenditur peccator : <l eID="gen15985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15986"/>et superbus et maledicus scandalizabitur in illis. <l eID="gen15986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6769"/><l level="1" sID="gen15987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6769"/>Jurationi non assuescat os tuum : <l eID="gen15987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15988"/>multi enim casus in illa. <l eID="gen15988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6770"/><l level="1" sID="gen15989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6770"/>Nominatio vero Dei non sit assidua in ore tuo, <l eID="gen15989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15990"/>et nominibus sanctorum non admiscearis, <l eID="gen15990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15991"/>quoniam non erit immunis ab eis. <l eID="gen15991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6771"/><l level="1" sID="gen15992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6771"/>Sicut enim servus interrogatus assidue a livore non minuitur, <l eID="gen15992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15993"/>sic omnis jurans et nominans in toto a peccato non purgabitur. <l eID="gen15993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6772"/><l level="1" sID="gen15994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6772"/>Vir multum jurans implebitur iniquitate, <l eID="gen15994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15995"/>et non discedet a domo illius plaga. <l eID="gen15995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6773"/><l level="1" sID="gen15996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6773"/>Et si frustraverit, delictum illius super ipsum erit : <l eID="gen15996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15997"/>et si dissimulaverit, delinquit dupliciter : <l eID="gen15997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6774"/><l level="1" sID="gen15998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6774"/>et si in vacuum juraverit, non justificabitur : <l eID="gen15998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen15999"/>replebitur enim retributione domus illius. <l eID="gen15999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6775"/><l level="1" sID="gen16000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6775"/>Est et alia loquela contraria morti : <l eID="gen16000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16001"/>non inveniatur in hæreditate Jacob. <l eID="gen16001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6776"/><l level="1" sID="gen16002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6776"/>Etenim a misericordibus omnia hæc auferentur, <l eID="gen16002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16003"/>et in delictis non volutabuntur. <l eID="gen16003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6777"/><l level="1" sID="gen16004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6777"/>Indisciplinatæ loquelæ non assuescat os tuum : <l eID="gen16004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16005"/>est enim in illa verbum peccati. <l eID="gen16005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6778"/><l level="1" sID="gen16006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6778"/>Memento patris et matris tuæ : <l eID="gen16006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16007"/>in medio enim magnatorum consistis : <l eID="gen16007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6779"/><l level="1" sID="gen16008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6779"/>ne forte obliviscatur te Deus in conspectu illorum, <l eID="gen16008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16009"/>et assiduitate tua infatuatus, improperium patiaris, <l eID="gen16009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16010"/>et maluisses non nasci, <l eID="gen16010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16011"/>et diem nativitatis tuæ maledicas. <l eID="gen16011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6780"/><l level="1" sID="gen16012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6780"/>Homo assuetus in verbis improperii <l eID="gen16012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16013"/>in omnibus diebus suis non erudietur. <l eID="gen16013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6781"/><l level="1" sID="gen16014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6781"/>Duo genera abundant in peccatis, <l eID="gen16014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16015"/>et tertium adducit iram et perditionem. <l eID="gen16015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6782"/><l level="1" sID="gen16016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6782"/>Anima calida quasi ignis ardens, <l eID="gen16016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16017"/>non extinguetur donec aliquid glutiat : <l eID="gen16017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6783"/><l level="1" sID="gen16018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6783"/>et homo nequam in ore carnis suæ <l eID="gen16018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16019"/>non desinet donec incendat ignem. <l eID="gen16019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6784"/><l level="1" sID="gen16020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6784"/>Homini fornicario omnis panis dulcis : <l eID="gen16020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16021"/>non fatigabitur transgrediens usque ad finem. <l eID="gen16021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6785"/><l level="1" sID="gen16022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6785"/>Omnis homo qui transgreditur lectum suum, <l eID="gen16022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16023"/>contemnens in animam suam, et dicens : Quis me videt ? <l eID="gen16023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6786"/><l level="1" sID="gen16024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6786"/>Tenebræ circumdant me, et parietes cooperiunt me, <l eID="gen16024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16025"/>et nemo circumspicit me : quem vereor ? <l eID="gen16025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16026"/>delictorum meorum non memorabitur Altissimus. <l eID="gen16026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6787"/><l level="1" sID="gen16027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6787"/>Et non intelligit quoniam omnia videt oculus illius, <l eID="gen16027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16028"/>quoniam expellit a se timorem Dei hujusmodi hominis timor, <l eID="gen16028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16029"/>et oculi hominum timentes illum : <l eID="gen16029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6788"/><l level="1" sID="gen16030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6788"/>et non cognovit quoniam oculi Domini <l eID="gen16030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16031"/>multo plus lucidiores sunt super solem, <l eID="gen16031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16032"/>circumspicientes omnes vias hominum, <l eID="gen16032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16033"/>et profundum abyssi, et hominum corda, <l eID="gen16033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16034"/>intuentes in absconditas partes. <l eID="gen16034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6789"/><l level="1" sID="gen16035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6789"/>Domino enim Deo antequam crearentur omnia sunt agnita : <l eID="gen16035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16036"/>sic et post perfectum respicit omnia. <l eID="gen16036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6790"/><l level="1" sID="gen16037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6790"/>Hic in plateis civitatis vindicabitur, <l eID="gen16037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16038"/>et quasi pullus equinus fugabitur, <l eID="gen16038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16039"/>et ubi non speravit apprehendetur. <l eID="gen16039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6791"/><l level="1" sID="gen16040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6791"/>Et erit dedecus omnibus, <l eID="gen16040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16041"/>eo quod non intellexerit timorem Domini. <l eID="gen16041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6792"/><l level="1" sID="gen16042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6792"/>Sic et mulier omnis relinquens virum suum, <l eID="gen16042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16043"/>et statuens hæreditatem ex alieno matrimonio : <l eID="gen16043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6793"/><l level="1" sID="gen16044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6793"/>primo enim in lege Altissimi incredibilis fuit : <l eID="gen16044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16045"/>secundo in virum suum deliquit : <l eID="gen16045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16046"/>tertio in adulterio fornicata est, <l eID="gen16046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16047"/>et ex alio viro filios statuit sibi. <l eID="gen16047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6794"/><l level="1" sID="gen16048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6794"/>Hæc in ecclesiam adducetur, <l eID="gen16048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16049"/>et in filios ejus respicietur : <l eID="gen16049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6795"/><l level="1" sID="gen16050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6795"/>non tradent filii ejus radices, <l eID="gen16050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16051"/>et rami ejus non dabunt fructum : <l eID="gen16051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6796"/><l level="1" sID="gen16052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6796"/>derelinquet in maledictum memoriam ejus, <l eID="gen16052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16053"/>et dedecus illius non delebitur. <l eID="gen16053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6797"/><l level="1" sID="gen16054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6797"/>Et agnoscent qui derelicti sunt, <l eID="gen16054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16055"/>quoniam nihil melius est quam timor Dei, <l eID="gen16055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16056"/>et nihil dulcius quam respicere in mandatis Domini. <l eID="gen16056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 23:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6798"/><l level="1" sID="gen16057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6798"/>Gloria magna est sequi Dominum : <l eID="gen16057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16058"/>longitudo enim dierum assumetur ab eo.  <chapter eID="Sir.23"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:1
verses.text: Sapientia laudabit animam suam, <l eID="gen16059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16060"/>et in Deo honorabitur, <l eID="gen16060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16061"/>et in medio populi sui gloriabitur, <l eID="gen16061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6799"/><l level="1" sID="gen16062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6799"/>et in ecclesiis Altissimi aperiet os suum, <l eID="gen16062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16063"/>et in conspectu virtutis illius gloriabitur, <l eID="gen16063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6800"/><l level="1" sID="gen16064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6800"/>et in medio populi sui exaltabitur, <l eID="gen16064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16065"/>et in plenitudine sancta admirabitur, <l eID="gen16065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6801"/><l level="1" sID="gen16066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6801"/>et in multitudine electorum habebit laudem, <l eID="gen16066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16067"/>et inter benedictos benedicetur, dicens : <l eID="gen16067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6802"/><l level="1" sID="gen16068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6802"/>Ego ex ore Altissimi prodivi, <l eID="gen16068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16069"/>primogenita ante omnem creaturam. <l eID="gen16069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6803"/><l level="1" sID="gen16070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6803"/>Ego feci in cælis ut oriretur lumen indeficiens, <l eID="gen16070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16071"/>et sicut nebula texi omnem terram. <l eID="gen16071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6804"/><l level="1" sID="gen16072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6804"/>Ego in altissimis habitavi, <l eID="gen16072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16073"/>et thronus meus in columna nubis. <l eID="gen16073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6805"/><l level="1" sID="gen16074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6805"/>Gyrum cæli circuivi sola, <l eID="gen16074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16075"/>et profundum abyssi penetravi : <l eID="gen16075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16076"/>in fluctibus maris ambulavi. <l eID="gen16076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6806"/><l level="1" sID="gen16077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6806"/>Et in omni terra steti : <l eID="gen16077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16078"/>et in omni populo, <l eID="gen16078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6807"/><l level="1" sID="gen16079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6807"/>et in omni gente primatum habui : <l eID="gen16079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6808"/><l level="1" sID="gen16080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6808"/>et omnium excellentium et humilium corda virtute calcavi. <l eID="gen16080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16081"/>Et in his omnibus requiem quæsivi, <l eID="gen16081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16082"/>et in hæreditate Domini morabor. <l eID="gen16082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6809"/><l level="1" sID="gen16083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6809"/>Tunc præcepit, et dixit mihi Creator omnium : <l eID="gen16083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16084"/>et qui creavit me, requievit in tabernaculo meo. <l eID="gen16084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6810"/><l level="1" sID="gen16085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6810"/>Et dixit mihi : In Jacob inhabita, <l eID="gen16085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16086"/>et in Israël hæreditare, <l eID="gen16086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16087"/>et in electis meis mitte radices. <l eID="gen16087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6811"/><l level="1" sID="gen16088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6811"/>Ab initio et ante sæcula creata sum, <l eID="gen16088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16089"/>et usque ad futurum sæculum non desinam : <l eID="gen16089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16090"/>et in habitatione sancta coram ipso ministravi. <l eID="gen16090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6812"/><l level="1" sID="gen16091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6812"/>Et sic in Sion firmata sum, <l eID="gen16091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16092"/>et in civitate sanctificata similiter requievi, <l eID="gen16092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16093"/>et in Jerusalem potestas mea. <l eID="gen16093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6813"/><l level="1" sID="gen16094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6813"/>Et radicavi in populo honorificato, <l eID="gen16094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16095"/>et in parte Dei mei hæreditas illius, <l eID="gen16095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16096"/>et in plenitudine sanctorum detentio mea. <l eID="gen16096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6814"/><l level="1" sID="gen16097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6814"/>Quasi cedrus exaltata sum in Libano, <l eID="gen16097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16098"/>et quasi cypressus in monte Sion : <l eID="gen16098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6815"/><l level="1" sID="gen16099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6815"/>quasi palma exaltata sum in Cades, <l eID="gen16099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16100"/>et quasi plantatio rosæ in Jericho : <l eID="gen16100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6816"/><l level="1" sID="gen16101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6816"/>quasi oliva speciosa in campis, <l eID="gen16101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16102"/>et quasi platanus exaltata sum juxta aquam in plateis. <l eID="gen16102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:20
