verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6817"/><l level="1" sID="gen16103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6817"/>Sicut cinnamomum et balsamum aromatizans odorem dedi ; <l eID="gen16103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16104"/>quasi myrrha electa dedi suavitatem odoris : <l eID="gen16104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6818"/><l level="1" sID="gen16105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6818"/>et quasi storax, et galbanus, et ungula, et gutta, <l eID="gen16105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16106"/>et quasi Libanus non incisus vaporavi habitationem meam, <l eID="gen16106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16107"/>et quasi balsamum non mistum odor meus. <l eID="gen16107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6819"/><l level="1" sID="gen16108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6819"/>Ego quasi terebinthus extendi ramos meos, <l eID="gen16108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16109"/>et rami mei honoris et gratiæ. <l eID="gen16109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6820"/><l level="1" sID="gen16110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6820"/>Ego quasi vitis fructificavi suavitatem odoris : <l eID="gen16110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16111"/>et flores mei fructus honoris et honestatis. <l eID="gen16111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6821"/><l level="1" sID="gen16112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6821"/>Ego mater pulchræ dilectionis, et timoris, <l eID="gen16112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16113"/>et agnitionis, et sanctæ spei. <l eID="gen16113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6822"/><l level="1" sID="gen16114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6822"/>In me gratia omnis viæ et veritatis : <l eID="gen16114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16115"/>in me omnis spes vitæ et virtutis. <l eID="gen16115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6823"/><l level="1" sID="gen16116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6823"/>Transite ad me, omnes qui concupiscitis me, <l eID="gen16116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16117"/>et a generationibus meis implemini : <l eID="gen16117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6824"/><l level="1" sID="gen16118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6824"/>spiritus enim meus super mel dulcis, <l eID="gen16118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16119"/>et hæreditas mea super mel et favum. <l eID="gen16119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6825"/><l level="1" sID="gen16120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6825"/>Memoria mea in generationes sæculorum. <l eID="gen16120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6826"/><l level="1" sID="gen16121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6826"/>Qui edunt me, adhuc esurient, <l eID="gen16121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16122"/>et qui bibunt me, adhuc sitient. <l eID="gen16122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6827"/><l level="1" sID="gen16123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6827"/>Qui audit me non confundetur, <l eID="gen16123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16124"/>et qui operantur in me non peccabunt : <l eID="gen16124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6828"/><l level="1" sID="gen16125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6828"/>qui elucidant me, vitam æternam habebunt. <l eID="gen16125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6829"/><l level="1" sID="gen16126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6829"/>Hæc omnia liber vitæ, <l eID="gen16126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16127"/>et testamentum Altissimi, et agnitio veritatis. <l eID="gen16127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6830"/><l level="1" sID="gen16128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6830"/>Legem mandavit Moyses in præceptis justitiarum, <l eID="gen16128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16129"/>et hæreditatem domui Jacob, <l eID="gen16129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16130"/>et Israël promissiones. <l eID="gen16130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6831"/><l level="1" sID="gen16131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6831"/>Posuit David, puero suo, <l eID="gen16131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16132"/>excitare regem ex ipso fortissimum, <l eID="gen16132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16133"/>et in throno honoris sedentem in sempiternum. <l eID="gen16133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6832"/><l level="1" sID="gen16134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6832"/>Qui implet quasi Phison sapientiam, <l eID="gen16134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16135"/>et sicut Tigris in diebus novorum : <l eID="gen16135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6833"/><l level="1" sID="gen16136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6833"/>qui adimplet quasi Euphrates sensum, <l eID="gen16136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16137"/>qui multiplicat quasi Jordanis in tempore messis : <l eID="gen16137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6834"/><l level="1" sID="gen16138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6834"/>qui mittit disciplinam sicut lucem, <l eID="gen16138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16139"/>et assistens quasi Gehon in die vindemiæ. <l eID="gen16139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6835"/><l level="1" sID="gen16140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6835"/>Qui perficit primus scire ipsam, <l eID="gen16140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16141"/>et infirmior non investigabit eam. <l eID="gen16141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6836"/><l level="1" sID="gen16142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6836"/>A mari enim abundavit cogitatio ejus, <l eID="gen16142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16143"/>et consilium illius ab abysso magna. <l eID="gen16143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6837"/><l level="1" sID="gen16144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6837"/>Ego sapientia effudi flumina : <l eID="gen16144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6838"/><l level="1" sID="gen16145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6838"/>ego quasi trames aquæ immensæ de fluvio : <l eID="gen16145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16146"/>ego quasi fluvii dioryx, <l eID="gen16146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16147"/>et sicut aquæductus exivi de paradiso. <l eID="gen16147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6839"/><l level="1" sID="gen16148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6839"/>Dixi : Rigabo hortum meum plantationum, <l eID="gen16148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16149"/>et inebriabo prati mei fructum. <l eID="gen16149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6840"/><l level="1" sID="gen16150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6840"/>Et ecce factus est mihi trames abundans, <l eID="gen16150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16151"/>et fluvius meus appropinquavit ad mare : <l eID="gen16151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6841"/><l level="1" sID="gen16152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6841"/>quoniam doctrinam quasi antelucanum illumino omnibus, <l eID="gen16152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16153"/>et enarrabo illam usque ad longinquum. <l eID="gen16153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6842"/><l level="1" sID="gen16154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6842"/>Penetrabo omnes inferiores partes terræ, <l eID="gen16154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16155"/>et inspiciam omnes dormientes, <l eID="gen16155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16156"/>et illuminabo omnes sperantes in Domino. <l eID="gen16156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6843"/><l level="1" sID="gen16157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6843"/>Adhuc doctrinam quasi prophetiam effundam, <l eID="gen16157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16158"/>et relinquam illam quærentibus sapientiam, <l eID="gen16158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16159"/>et non desinam in progenies illorum usque in ævum sanctum. <l eID="gen16159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 24:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6844"/><l level="1" sID="gen16160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6844"/>Videte quoniam non soli mihi laboravi, <l eID="gen16160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16161"/>sed omnibus exquirentibus veritatem.  <chapter eID="Sir.24"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:1
verses.text: In tribus placitum est spiritui meo, <l eID="gen16162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16163"/>quæ sunt probata coram Deo et hominibus : <l eID="gen16163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6845"/><l level="1" sID="gen16164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6845"/>concordia fratrum, <l eID="gen16164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16165"/>et amor proximorum, <l eID="gen16165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16166"/>et vir et mulier bene sibi consentientes. <l eID="gen16166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6846"/><l level="1" sID="gen16167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6846"/>Tres species odivit anima mea, <l eID="gen16167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16168"/>et aggravor valde animæ illorum : <l eID="gen16168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6847"/><l level="1" sID="gen16169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6847"/>pauperem superbum, divitem mendacem, <l eID="gen16169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16170"/>senem fatuum et insensatum. <l eID="gen16170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6848"/><l level="1" sID="gen16171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6848"/>Quæ in juventute tua non congregasti, <l eID="gen16171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16172"/>quomodo in senectute tua invenies ? <l eID="gen16172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6849"/><l level="1" sID="gen16173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6849"/>Quam speciosum canitiei judicium, <l eID="gen16173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16174"/>et presbyteris cognoscere consilium ! <l eID="gen16174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6850"/><l level="1" sID="gen16175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6850"/>Quam speciosa veteranis sapientia, <l eID="gen16175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16176"/>et gloriosus intellectus et consilium ! <l eID="gen16176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6851"/><l level="1" sID="gen16177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6851"/>Corona senum multa peritia, <l eID="gen16177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16178"/>et gloria illorum timor Dei. <l eID="gen16178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6852"/><l level="1" sID="gen16179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6852"/>Novem insuspicabilia cordis magnificavi : <l eID="gen16179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16180"/>et decimum dicam in lingua hominibus : <l eID="gen16180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6853"/><l level="1" sID="gen16181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6853"/>homo qui jucundatur in filiis, <l eID="gen16181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16182"/>vivens et videns subversionem inimicorum suorum. <l eID="gen16182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6854"/><l level="1" sID="gen16183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6854"/>Beatus qui habitat cum muliere sensata, <l eID="gen16183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16184"/>et qui lingua sua non est lapsus, <l eID="gen16184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16185"/>et qui non servivit indignis se. <l eID="gen16185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6855"/><l level="1" sID="gen16186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6855"/>Beatus qui invenit amicum verum, <l eID="gen16186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16187"/>et qui enarrat justitiam auri audienti. <l eID="gen16187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6856"/><l level="1" sID="gen16188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6856"/>Quam magnus qui invenit sapientiam et scientiam ! <l eID="gen16188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16189"/>sed non est super timentem Dominum. <l eID="gen16189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6857"/><l level="1" sID="gen16190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6857"/>Timor Dei super omnia se superposuit. <l eID="gen16190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6858"/><l level="1" sID="gen16191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6858"/>Beatus homo cui donatum est habere timorem Dei : <l eID="gen16191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16192"/>qui tenet illum, cui assimilabitur ? <l eID="gen16192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6859"/><l level="1" sID="gen16193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6859"/>Timor Dei initium dilectionis ejus : <l eID="gen16193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16194"/>fidei autem initium agglutinandum est ei. <l eID="gen16194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6860"/><l level="1" sID="gen16195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6860"/>Omnis plaga tristitia cordis est, <l eID="gen16195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16196"/>et omnis malitia nequitia mulieris. <l eID="gen16196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6861"/><l level="1" sID="gen16197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6861"/>Et omnem plagam, et non plagam videbit cordis : <l eID="gen16197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6862"/><l level="1" sID="gen16198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6862"/>et omnem nequitiam, et non nequitiam mulieris : <l eID="gen16198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6863"/><l level="1" sID="gen16199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6863"/>et omnem obductum, et non obductum odientium : <l eID="gen16199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6864"/><l level="1" sID="gen16200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6864"/>et omnem vindictam, et non vindictam inimicorum. <l eID="gen16200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6865"/><l level="1" sID="gen16201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6865"/>Non est caput nequius super caput colubri, <l eID="gen16201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6866"/><l level="1" sID="gen16202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6866"/>et non est ira super iram mulieris. <l eID="gen16202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16203"/>Commorari leoni et draconi placebit, <l eID="gen16203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16204"/>quam habitare cum muliere nequam. <l eID="gen16204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6867"/><l level="1" sID="gen16205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6867"/>Nequitia mulieris immutat faciem ejus : <l eID="gen16205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16206"/>et obcæcat vultum suum tamquam ursus, <l eID="gen16206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16207"/>et quasi saccum ostendit. <l eID="gen16207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16208"/>In medio proximorum ejus <l eID="gen16208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6868"/><l level="1" sID="gen16209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6868"/>ingemuit vir ejus, <l eID="gen16209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16210"/>et audiens suspiravit modicum. <l eID="gen16210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6869"/><l level="1" sID="gen16211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6869"/>Brevis omnis malitia super malitiam mulieris : <l eID="gen16211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16212"/>sors peccatorum cadat super illam. <l eID="gen16212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6870"/><l level="1" sID="gen16213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6870"/>Sicut ascensus arenosus in pedibus veterani, <l eID="gen16213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16214"/>sic mulier linguata homini quieto. <l eID="gen16214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6871"/><l level="1" sID="gen16215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6871"/>Ne respicias in mulieris speciem, <l eID="gen16215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16216"/>et non concupiscas mulierem in specie. <l eID="gen16216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6872"/><l level="1" sID="gen16217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6872"/>Mulieris ira, et irreverentia, <l eID="gen16217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16218"/>et confusio magna. <l eID="gen16218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6873"/><l level="1" sID="gen16219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6873"/>Mulier si primatum habeat, <l eID="gen16219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16220"/>contraria est viro suo. <l eID="gen16220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6874"/><l level="1" sID="gen16221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6874"/>Cor humile, et facies tristis, <l eID="gen16221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16222"/>et plaga cordis, mulier nequam. <l eID="gen16222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6875"/><l level="1" sID="gen16223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6875"/>Manus debiles et genua dissoluta, <l eID="gen16223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16224"/>mulier quæ non beatificat virum suum. <l eID="gen16224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6876"/><l level="1" sID="gen16225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6876"/>A muliere initium factum est peccati, <l eID="gen16225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16226"/>et per illam omnes morimur. <l eID="gen16226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6877"/><l level="1" sID="gen16227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6877"/>Non des aquæ tuæ exitum, nec modicum : <l eID="gen16227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16228"/>nec mulieri nequam veniam prodeundi. <l eID="gen16228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6878"/><l level="1" sID="gen16229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6878"/>Si non ambulaverit ad manum tuam, <l eID="gen16229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16230"/>confundet te in conspectu inimicorum. <l eID="gen16230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 25:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6879"/><l level="1" sID="gen16231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6879"/>A carnibus tuis abscinde illam, <l eID="gen16231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16232"/>ne semper te abutatur.  <chapter eID="Sir.25"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:1
verses.text: Mulieris bonæ beatus vir : <l eID="gen16233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16234"/>numerus enim annorum illius duplex. <l eID="gen16234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6880"/><l level="1" sID="gen16235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6880"/>Mulier fortis oblectat virum suum, <l eID="gen16235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16236"/>et annos vitæ illius in pace implebit. <l eID="gen16236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6881"/><l level="1" sID="gen16237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6881"/>Pars bona mulier bona, <l eID="gen16237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16238"/>in parte timentium Deum dabitur viro pro factis bonis : <l eID="gen16238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6882"/><l level="1" sID="gen16239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6882"/>divitis autem et pauperis cor bonum, <l eID="gen16239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16240"/>in omni tempore vultus illorum hilaris. <l eID="gen16240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6883"/><l level="1" sID="gen16241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6883"/>A tribus timuit cor meum, <l eID="gen16241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16242"/>et in quarto facies mea metuit : <l eID="gen16242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6884"/><l level="1" sID="gen16243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6884"/>delaturam civitatis, et collectionem populi : <l eID="gen16243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6885"/><l level="1" sID="gen16244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6885"/>calumniam mendacem super mortem omnia gravia : <l eID="gen16244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6886"/><l level="1" sID="gen16245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6886"/>dolor cordis et luctus, mulier zelotypa. <l eID="gen16245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6887"/><l level="1" sID="gen16246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6887"/>In muliere zelotypa flagellum linguæ, <l eID="gen16246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16247"/>omnibus communicans. <l eID="gen16247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6888"/><l level="1" sID="gen16248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6888"/>Sicut boum jugum quod movetur, ita et mulier nequam : <l eID="gen16248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16249"/>qui tenet illam quasi qui apprehendit scorpionem. <l eID="gen16249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6889"/><l level="1" sID="gen16250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6889"/>Mulier ebriosa ira magna, et contumelia : <l eID="gen16250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16251"/>et turpitudo illius non tegetur. <l eID="gen16251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6890"/><l level="1" sID="gen16252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6890"/>Fornicatio mulieris in extollentia oculorum, <l eID="gen16252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16253"/>et in palpebris illius agnoscetur. <l eID="gen16253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6891"/><l level="1" sID="gen16254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6891"/>In filia non avertente se, firma custodiam, <l eID="gen16254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16255"/>ne inventa occasione utatur se. <l eID="gen16255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6892"/><l level="1" sID="gen16256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6892"/>Ab omni irreverentia oculorum ejus cave, <l eID="gen16256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16257"/>et ne mireris si te neglexerit. <l eID="gen16257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6893"/><l level="1" sID="gen16258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6893"/>Sicut viator sitiens ad fontem os aperiet, <l eID="gen16258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16259"/>et ab omni aqua proxima bibet, <l eID="gen16259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16260"/>et contra omnem palum sedebit, <l eID="gen16260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16261"/>et contra omnem sagittam aperiet pharetram donec deficiat. <l eID="gen16261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6894"/><l level="1" sID="gen16262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6894"/>Gratia mulieris sedulæ delectabit virum suum, <l eID="gen16262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16263"/>et ossa illius impinguabit. <l eID="gen16263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6895"/><l level="1" sID="gen16264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6895"/>Disciplina illius datum Dei est. <l eID="gen16264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6896"/><l level="1" sID="gen16265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6896"/>Mulier sensata et tacita, <l eID="gen16265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16266"/>non est immutatio eruditæ animæ. <l eID="gen16266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6897"/><l level="1" sID="gen16267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6897"/>Gratia super gratiam <l eID="gen16267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16268"/>mulier sancta et pudorata. <l eID="gen16268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6898"/><l level="1" sID="gen16269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6898"/>Omnis autem ponderatio non est digna <l eID="gen16269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16270"/>continentis animæ. <l eID="gen16270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6899"/><l level="1" sID="gen16271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6899"/>Sicut sol oriens mundo in altissimis Dei, <l eID="gen16271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16272"/>sic mulieris bonæ species in ornamentum domus ejus. <l eID="gen16272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6900"/><l level="1" sID="gen16273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6900"/>Lucerna splendens super candelabrum sanctum, <l eID="gen16273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16274"/>et species faciei super ætatem stabilem. <l eID="gen16274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6901"/><l level="1" sID="gen16275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6901"/>Columnæ aureæ super bases argenteas, <l eID="gen16275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16276"/>et pedes firmi super plantas stabilis mulieris. <l eID="gen16276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6902"/><l level="1" sID="gen16277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6902"/>Fundamenta æterna supra petram solidam, <l eID="gen16277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16278"/>et mandata Dei in corde mulieris sanctæ. <l eID="gen16278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6903"/><l level="1" sID="gen16279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6903"/>In duobus contristatum est cor meum, <l eID="gen16279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16280"/>et in tertio iracundia mihi advenit : <l eID="gen16280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6904"/><l level="1" sID="gen16281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6904"/>vir bellator deficiens per inopiam ; <l eID="gen16281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16282"/>et vir sensatus contemptus ; <l eID="gen16282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6905"/><l level="1" sID="gen16283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6905"/>et qui transgreditur a justitia ad peccatum : <l eID="gen16283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16284"/>Deus paravit eum ad rhomphæam. <l eID="gen16284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 26:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6906"/><l level="1" sID="gen16285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6906"/>Duæ species difficiles et periculosæ mihi apparuerunt : <l eID="gen16285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16286"/>difficile exuitur negotians a negligentia, <l eID="gen16286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16287"/>et non justificabitur caupo a peccatis labiorum.  <chapter eID="Sir.26"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:1
verses.text: Propter inopiam multi deliquerunt : <l eID="gen16288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16289"/>et qui quærit locupletari avertit oculum suum. <l eID="gen16289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6907"/><l level="1" sID="gen16290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6907"/>Sicut in medio compaginis lapidum palus figitur, <l eID="gen16290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16291"/>sic et inter medium venditionis et emptionis angustiabitur peccatum : <l eID="gen16291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6908"/><l level="1" sID="gen16292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6908"/>conteretur cum delinquente delictum. <l eID="gen16292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6909"/><l level="1" sID="gen16293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6909"/>Si non in timore Domini tenueris te instanter, <l eID="gen16293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16294"/>cito subvertetur domus tua. <l eID="gen16294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6910"/><l level="1" sID="gen16295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6910"/>Sicut in percussura cribri remanebit pulvis, <l eID="gen16295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16296"/>sic aporia hominis in cogitatu illius. <l eID="gen16296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6911"/><l level="1" sID="gen16297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6911"/>Vasa figuli probat fornax, <l eID="gen16297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16298"/>et homines justos tentatio tribulationis. <l eID="gen16298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6912"/><l level="1" sID="gen16299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6912"/>Sicut rusticatio de ligno ostendit fructum illius, <l eID="gen16299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16300"/>sic verbum ex cogitatu cordis hominis. <l eID="gen16300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6913"/><l level="1" sID="gen16301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6913"/>Ante sermonem non laudes virum : <l eID="gen16301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16302"/>hæc enim tentatio est hominum. <l eID="gen16302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6914"/><l level="1" sID="gen16303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6914"/>Si sequaris justitiam, apprehendes illam, <l eID="gen16303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16304"/>et indues quasi poderem honoris : <l eID="gen16304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16305"/>et inhabitabis cum ea, et proteget te in sempiternum, <l eID="gen16305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16306"/>et in die agnitionis invenies firmamentum. <l eID="gen16306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6915"/><l level="1" sID="gen16307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6915"/>Volatilia ad sibi similia conveniunt : <l eID="gen16307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16308"/>et veritas ad eos qui operantur illam revertetur. <l eID="gen16308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6916"/><l level="1" sID="gen16309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6916"/>Leo venationi insidiatur semper : <l eID="gen16309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16310"/>sic peccata operantibus iniquitates. <l eID="gen16310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6917"/><l level="1" sID="gen16311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6917"/>Homo sanctus in sapientia manet sicut sol : <l eID="gen16311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16312"/>nam stultus sicut luna mutatur. <l eID="gen16312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6918"/><l level="1" sID="gen16313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6918"/>In medio insensatorum serva verbum tempori : <l eID="gen16313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16314"/>in medio autem cogitantium assiduus esto. <l eID="gen16314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6919"/><l level="1" sID="gen16315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6919"/>Narratio peccantium odiosa, <l eID="gen16315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16316"/>et risus illorum in deliciis peccati. <l eID="gen16316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6920"/><l level="1" sID="gen16317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6920"/>Loquela multum jurans horripilationem capiti statuet, <l eID="gen16317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16318"/>et irreverentia ipsius obturatio aurium. <l eID="gen16318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6921"/><l level="1" sID="gen16319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6921"/>Effusio sanguinis in rixa superborum, <l eID="gen16319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16320"/>et maledictio illorum auditus gravis. <l eID="gen16320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6922"/><l level="1" sID="gen16321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6922"/>Qui denudat arcana amici fidem perdit, <l eID="gen16321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16322"/>et non inveniet amicum ad animum suum. <l eID="gen16322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6923"/><l level="1" sID="gen16323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6923"/>Dilige proximum, <l eID="gen16323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16324"/>et conjungere fide cum illo. <l eID="gen16324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6924"/><l level="1" sID="gen16325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6924"/>Quod si denudaveris absconsa illius, <l eID="gen16325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16326"/>non persequeris post eum. <l eID="gen16326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6925"/><l level="1" sID="gen16327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6925"/>Sicut enim homo qui perdit amicum suum, <l eID="gen16327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16328"/>sic et qui perdit amicitiam proximi sui. <l eID="gen16328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6926"/><l level="1" sID="gen16329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6926"/>Et sicut qui dimittit avem de manu sua, <l eID="gen16329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16330"/>sic dereliquisti proximum tuum, et non eum capies. <l eID="gen16330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6927"/><l level="1" sID="gen16331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6927"/>Non illum sequaris, quoniam longe abest : <l eID="gen16331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16332"/>effugit enim quasi caprea de laqueo, quoniam vulnerata est anima ejus : <l eID="gen16332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6928"/><l level="1" sID="gen16333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6928"/>ultra eum non poteris colligare. <l eID="gen16333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16334"/>Et maledicti est concordatio : <l eID="gen16334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6929"/><l level="1" sID="gen16335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6929"/>denudare autem amici mysteria, desperatio est animæ infelicis. <l eID="gen16335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6930"/><l level="1" sID="gen16336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6930"/>Annuens oculo fabricat iniqua, <l eID="gen16336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16337"/>et nemo eum abjiciet. <l eID="gen16337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6931"/><l level="1" sID="gen16338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6931"/>In conspectu oculorum tuorum condulcabit os suum, <l eID="gen16338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16339"/>et super sermones tuos admirabitur : <l eID="gen16339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16340"/>novissime autem pervertet os suum, <l eID="gen16340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16341"/>et in verbis tuis dabit scandalum. <l eID="gen16341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6932"/><l level="1" sID="gen16342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6932"/>Multa odivi, et non coæquavi ei, <l eID="gen16342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16343"/>et Dominus odiet illum. <l eID="gen16343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6933"/><l level="1" sID="gen16344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6933"/>Qui in altum mittit lapidem, super caput ejus cadet : <l eID="gen16344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16345"/>et plaga dolosa dolosi dividet vulnera. <l eID="gen16345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6934"/><l level="1" sID="gen16346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6934"/>Et qui foveam fodit incidet in eam : <l eID="gen16346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16347"/>et qui statuit lapidem proximo offendet in eo : <l eID="gen16347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16348"/>et qui laqueum alii ponit, peribit in illo. <l eID="gen16348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6935"/><l level="1" sID="gen16349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6935"/>Facienti nequissimum consilium, super ipsum devolvetur, <l eID="gen16349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16350"/>et non agnoscet unde adveniat illi. <l eID="gen16350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6936"/><l level="1" sID="gen16351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6936"/>Illusio et improperium superborum, <l eID="gen16351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16352"/>et vindicta sicut leo insidiabitur illi. <l eID="gen16352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6937"/><l level="1" sID="gen16353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6937"/>Laqueo peribunt qui oblectantur casu justorum, <l eID="gen16353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16354"/>dolor autem consumet illos antequam moriantur. <l eID="gen16354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 27:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6938"/><l level="1" sID="gen16355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6938"/>Ira et furor utraque execrabilia sunt, <l eID="gen16355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16356"/>et vir peccator continens erit illorum.  <chapter eID="Sir.27"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:1
verses.text: Qui vindicari vult, a Domino inveniet vindictam, <l eID="gen16357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16358"/>et peccata illius servans servabit. <l eID="gen16358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6939"/><l level="1" sID="gen16359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6939"/>Relinque proximo tuo nocenti te, <l eID="gen16359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16360"/>et tunc deprecanti tibi peccata solventur. <l eID="gen16360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6940"/><l level="1" sID="gen16361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6940"/>Homo homini reservat iram, <l eID="gen16361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16362"/>et a Deo quærit medelam : <l eID="gen16362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6941"/><l level="1" sID="gen16363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6941"/>in hominem similem sibi non habet misericordiam, <l eID="gen16363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16364"/>et de peccatis suis deprecatur. <l eID="gen16364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6942"/><l level="1" sID="gen16365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6942"/>Ipse cum caro sit reservat iram, <l eID="gen16365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16366"/>et propitiationem petit a Deo : <l eID="gen16366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16367"/>quis exorabit pro delictis illius ? <l eID="gen16367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6943"/><l level="1" sID="gen16368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6943"/>Memento novissimorum, et desine inimicari : <l eID="gen16368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6944"/><l level="1" sID="gen16369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6944"/>tabitudo enim et mors imminent in mandatis ejus. <l eID="gen16369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6945"/><l level="1" sID="gen16370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6945"/>Memorare timorem Dei, <l eID="gen16370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16371"/>et non irascaris proximo. <l eID="gen16371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6946"/><l level="1" sID="gen16372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6946"/>Memorare testamentum Altissimi, <l eID="gen16372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16373"/>et despice ignorantiam proximi. <l eID="gen16373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6947"/><l level="1" sID="gen16374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6947"/>Abstine te a lite, <l eID="gen16374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16375"/>et minues peccata. <l eID="gen16375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6948"/><l level="1" sID="gen16376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6948"/>Homo enim iracundus incendit litem, <l eID="gen16376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16377"/>et vir peccator turbabit amicos, <l eID="gen16377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16378"/>et in medio pacem habentium immittet inimicitiam. <l eID="gen16378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6949"/><l level="1" sID="gen16379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6949"/>Secundum enim ligna silvæ sic ignis exardescit : <l eID="gen16379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16380"/>et secundum virtutem hominis sic iracundia illius erit, <l eID="gen16380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16381"/>et secundum substantiam suam exaltabit iram suam. <l eID="gen16381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6950"/><l level="1" sID="gen16382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6950"/>Certamen festinatum incendit ignem, <l eID="gen16382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16383"/>et lis festinans effundit sanguinem : <l eID="gen16383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16384"/>et lingua testificans adducit mortem. <l eID="gen16384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6951"/><l level="1" sID="gen16385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6951"/>Si sufflaveris in scintillam, quasi ignis exardebit : <l eID="gen16385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16386"/>et si exspueris super illam, extinguetur : <l eID="gen16386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16387"/>utraque ex ore proficiscuntur. <l eID="gen16387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6952"/><l level="1" sID="gen16388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6952"/>Susurro et bilinguis maledictus, <l eID="gen16388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16389"/>multos enim turbabit pacem habentes. <l eID="gen16389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6953"/><l level="1" sID="gen16390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6953"/>Lingua tertia multos commovit, <l eID="gen16390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16391"/>et dispersit illos de gente in gentem. <l eID="gen16391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6954"/><l level="1" sID="gen16392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6954"/>Civitates muratas divitum destruxit, <l eID="gen16392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16393"/>et domus magnatorum effodit. <l eID="gen16393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6955"/><l level="1" sID="gen16394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6955"/>Virtutes populorum concidit, <l eID="gen16394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16395"/>et gentes fortes dissolvit. <l eID="gen16395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6956"/><l level="1" sID="gen16396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6956"/>Lingua tertia mulieres viratas ejecit, <l eID="gen16396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16397"/>et privavit illas laboribus suis. <l eID="gen16397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6957"/><l level="1" sID="gen16398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6957"/>Qui respicit illam non habebit requiem, <l eID="gen16398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16399"/>nec habebit amicum in quo requiescat. <l eID="gen16399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6958"/><l level="1" sID="gen16400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6958"/>Flagelli plaga livorem facit : <l eID="gen16400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16401"/>plaga autem linguæ comminuet ossa. <l eID="gen16401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6959"/><l level="1" sID="gen16402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6959"/>Multi ceciderunt in ore gladii : <l eID="gen16402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16403"/>sed non sic quasi qui interierunt per linguam suam. <l eID="gen16403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6960"/><l level="1" sID="gen16404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6960"/>Beatus qui tectus est a lingua nequam, <l eID="gen16404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16405"/>qui in iracundiam illius non transivit, <l eID="gen16405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16406"/>et qui non attraxit jugum illius, <l eID="gen16406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16407"/>et in vinculis ejus non est ligatus : <l eID="gen16407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6961"/><l level="1" sID="gen16408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6961"/>jugum enim illius jugum ferreum est, <l eID="gen16408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16409"/>et vinculum illius vinculum æreum est ; <l eID="gen16409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6962"/><l level="1" sID="gen16410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6962"/>mors illius mors nequissima : <l eID="gen16410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16411"/>et utilis potius infernus quam illa. <l eID="gen16411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6963"/><l level="1" sID="gen16412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6963"/>Perseverantia illius non permanebit, <l eID="gen16412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16413"/>sed obtinebit vias injustorum, <l eID="gen16413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16414"/>et in flamma sua non comburet justos. <l eID="gen16414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6964"/><l level="1" sID="gen16415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6964"/>Qui relinquunt Deum incident in illam, <l eID="gen16415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16416"/>et exardebit in illis, et non extinguetur, <l eID="gen16416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16417"/>et immittetur in illos quasi leo, <l eID="gen16417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16418"/>et quasi pardus lædet illos. <l eID="gen16418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6965"/><l level="1" sID="gen16419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6965"/>Sepi aures tuas spinis : <l eID="gen16419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16420"/>linguam nequam noli audire : <l eID="gen16420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16421"/>et ori tuo facito ostia et seras. <l eID="gen16421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6966"/><l level="1" sID="gen16422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6966"/>Aurum tuum et argentum tuum confla, <l eID="gen16422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16423"/>et verbis tuis facito stateram, <l eID="gen16423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16424"/>et frenos ori tuo rectos : <l eID="gen16424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 28:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6967"/><l level="1" sID="gen16425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6967"/>et attende ne forte labaris in lingua, <l eID="gen16425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16426"/>et cadas in conspectu inimicorum insidiantium tibi, <l eID="gen16426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16427"/>et sit casus tuus insanabilis in mortem.  <chapter eID="Sir.28"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:1
verses.text: Qui facit misericordiam fœneratur proximo suo : <l eID="gen16428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16429"/>et qui prævalet manu mandata servat. <l eID="gen16429" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6968"/><l level="1" sID="gen16430"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6968"/>Fœnerare proximo tuo in tempore necessitatis illius : <l eID="gen16430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16431"/>et iterum redde proximo in tempore suo. <l eID="gen16431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6969"/><l level="1" sID="gen16432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6969"/>Confirma verbum, et fideliter age cum illo : <l eID="gen16432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16433"/>et in omni tempore invenies quod tibi necessarium est. <l eID="gen16433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6970"/><l level="1" sID="gen16434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6970"/>Multi quasi inventionem æstimaverunt fœnus, <l eID="gen16434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16435"/>et præstiterunt molestiam his qui se adjuverunt. <l eID="gen16435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6971"/><l level="1" sID="gen16436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6971"/>Donec accipiant, osculantur manus dantis, <l eID="gen16436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16437"/>et in promissionibus humiliant vocem suam : <l eID="gen16437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6972"/><l level="1" sID="gen16438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6972"/>et in tempore redditionis postulabit tempus, <l eID="gen16438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16439"/>et loquetur verba tædii et murmurationum, <l eID="gen16439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16440"/>et tempus causabitur. <l eID="gen16440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6973"/><l level="1" sID="gen16441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6973"/>Si autem potuerit reddere, adversabitur : <l eID="gen16441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16442"/>solidi vix reddet dimidium, <l eID="gen16442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16443"/>et computabit illud quasi inventionem : <l eID="gen16443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6974"/><l level="1" sID="gen16444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6974"/>sin autem, fraudabit illum pecunia sua, <l eID="gen16444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16445"/>et possidebit illum inimicum gratis : <l eID="gen16445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6975"/><l level="1" sID="gen16446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6975"/>et convitia et maledicta reddet illi, <l eID="gen16446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16447"/>et pro honore et beneficio reddet illi contumeliam. <l eID="gen16447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6976"/><l level="1" sID="gen16448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6976"/>Multi non causa nequitiæ non fœnerati sunt, <l eID="gen16448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16449"/>sed fraudari gratis timuerunt. <l eID="gen16449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6977"/><l level="1" sID="gen16450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6977"/>Verumtamen super humilem animo fortior esto, <l eID="gen16450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16451"/>et pro eleemosyna non trahas illum. <l eID="gen16451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6978"/><l level="1" sID="gen16452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6978"/>Propter mandatum assume pauperem, <l eID="gen16452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16453"/>et propter inopiam ejus ne dimittas eum vacuum. <l eID="gen16453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6979"/><l level="1" sID="gen16454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6979"/>Perde pecuniam propter fratrem et amicum tuum, <l eID="gen16454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16455"/>et non abscondas illam sub lapide in perditionem. <l eID="gen16455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6980"/><l level="1" sID="gen16456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6980"/>Pone thesaurum tuum in præceptis Altissimi, <l eID="gen16456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16457"/>et proderit tibi magis quam aurum. <l eID="gen16457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6981"/><l level="1" sID="gen16458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6981"/>Conclude eleemosynam in corde pauperis, <l eID="gen16458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16459"/>et hæc pro te exorabit ab omni malo. <l eID="gen16459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6982"/><l level="1" sID="gen16460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6982"/>Super scutum potentis

verses.name: Sirach 29:17
verses.text: et super lanceam <l eID="gen16460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6983"/><l level="1" sID="gen16461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6983"/>adversus inimicum tuum pugnabit. <l eID="gen16461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6984"/><l level="1" sID="gen16462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6984"/>Vir bonus fidem facit pro proximo suo : <l eID="gen16462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16463"/>et qui perdiderit confusionem derelinquet sibi. <l eID="gen16463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6985"/><l level="1" sID="gen16464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6985"/>Gratiam fidejussoris ne obliviscaris : <l eID="gen16464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16465"/>dedit enim pro te animam suam. <l eID="gen16465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6986"/><l level="1" sID="gen16466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6986"/>Repromissorem fugit peccator et immundus. <l eID="gen16466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6987"/><l level="1" sID="gen16467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6987"/>Bona repromissoris sibi ascribit peccator : <l eID="gen16467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16468"/>et ingratus sensu derelinquet liberantem se. <l eID="gen16468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6988"/><l level="1" sID="gen16469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6988"/>Vir repromittit de proximo suo : <l eID="gen16469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16470"/>et cum perdiderit reverentiam, derelinquetur ab eo. <l eID="gen16470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6989"/><l level="1" sID="gen16471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6989"/>Repromissio nequissima multos perdidit dirigentes, <l eID="gen16471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16472"/>et commovit illos quasi fluctus maris. <l eID="gen16472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6990"/><l level="1" sID="gen16473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6990"/>Viros potentes gyrans migrare fecit, <l eID="gen16473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16474"/>et vagati sunt in gentibus alienis. <l eID="gen16474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6991"/><l level="1" sID="gen16475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6991"/>Peccator transgrediens mandatum Domini incidet in promissionem nequam : <l eID="gen16475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16476"/>et qui conatur multa agere incidet in judicium. <l eID="gen16476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6992"/><l level="1" sID="gen16477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6992"/>Recupera proximum secundum virtutem tuam, <l eID="gen16477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16478"/>et attende tibi ne incidas. <l eID="gen16478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6993"/><l level="1" sID="gen16479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6993"/>Initium vitæ hominis, aqua et panis, <l eID="gen16479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16480"/>et vestimentum, et domus protegens turpitudinem. <l eID="gen16480" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6994"/><l level="1" sID="gen16481"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6994"/>Melior est victus pauperis sub tegmine asserum <l eID="gen16481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16482"/>quam epulæ splendidæ in peregre sine domicilio. <l eID="gen16482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6995"/><l level="1" sID="gen16483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6995"/>Minimum pro magno placeat tibi, <l eID="gen16483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16484"/>et improperium peregrinationis non audies. <l eID="gen16484" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6996"/><l level="1" sID="gen16485"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6996"/>Vita nequam hospitandi de domo in domum : <l eID="gen16485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16486"/>et ubi hospitabitur non fiducialiter aget, nec aperiet os. <l eID="gen16486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6997"/><l level="1" sID="gen16487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6997"/>Hospitabitur, et pascet, et potabit ingratos, <l eID="gen16487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16488"/>et ad hæc amara audiet : <l eID="gen16488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6998"/><l level="1" sID="gen16489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6998"/>transi, hospes, et orna mensam, <l eID="gen16489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16490"/>et quæ in manu habes ciba ceteros. <l eID="gen16490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6999"/><l level="1" sID="gen16491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6999"/>Exi a facie honoris amicorum meorum : <l eID="gen16491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16492"/>necessitudine domus meæ hospitio mihi factus est frater. <l eID="gen16492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 29:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7000"/><l level="1" sID="gen16493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7000"/>Gravia hæc homini habenti sensum : <l eID="gen16493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16494"/>correptio domus, et improperium fœneratoris.  <chapter eID="Sir.29"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:1
verses.text: Qui diligit filium suum assiduat illi flagella, <l eID="gen16495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16496"/>ut lætetur in novissimo suo, <l eID="gen16496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16497"/>et non palpet proximorum ostia. <l eID="gen16497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7001"/><l level="1" sID="gen16498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7001"/>Qui docet filium suum laudabitur in illo, <l eID="gen16498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16499"/>et in medio domesticorum in illo gloriabitur. <l eID="gen16499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7002"/><l level="1" sID="gen16500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7002"/>Qui docet filium suum in zelum mittit inimicum, <l eID="gen16500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16501"/>et in medio amicorum gloriabitur in illo. <l eID="gen16501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7003"/><l level="1" sID="gen16502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7003"/>Mortuus est pater ejus, et quasi non est mortuus : <l eID="gen16502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16503"/>similem enim reliquit sibi post se. <l eID="gen16503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7004"/><l level="1" sID="gen16504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7004"/>In vita sua vidit, et lætatus est in illo : <l eID="gen16504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16505"/>in obitu suo non est contristatus, <l eID="gen16505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16506"/>nec confusus est coram inimicis : <l eID="gen16506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7005"/><l level="1" sID="gen16507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7005"/>reliquit enim defensorem domus contra inimicos, <l eID="gen16507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16508"/>et amicis reddentem gratiam. <l eID="gen16508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7006"/><l level="1" sID="gen16509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7006"/>Pro animabus filiorum colligabit vulnera sua, <l eID="gen16509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16510"/>et super omnem vocem turbabuntur viscera ejus. <l eID="gen16510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7007"/><l level="1" sID="gen16511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7007"/>Equus indomitus evadit durus, <l eID="gen16511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16512"/>et filius remissus evadet præceps. <l eID="gen16512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7008"/><l level="1" sID="gen16513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7008"/>Lacta filium, et paventem te faciet : <l eID="gen16513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16514"/>lude cum eo, et contristabit te. <l eID="gen16514" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7009"/><l level="1" sID="gen16515"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7009"/>Non corrideas illi, ne doleas, <l eID="gen16515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16516"/>et in novissimo obstupescent dentes tui. <l eID="gen16516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7010"/><l level="1" sID="gen16517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7010"/>Non des illi potestatem in juventute, <l eID="gen16517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16518"/>et ne despicias cogitatus illius. <l eID="gen16518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7011"/><l level="1" sID="gen16519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7011"/>Curva cervicem ejus in juventute, <l eID="gen16519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16520"/>et tunde latera ejus dum infans est, <l eID="gen16520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16521"/>ne forte induret, et non credat tibi, <l eID="gen16521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16522"/>et erit tibi dolor animæ. <l eID="gen16522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7012"/><l level="1" sID="gen16523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7012"/>Doce filium tuum, et operare in illo, <l eID="gen16523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16524"/>ne in turpitudinem illius offendas. <l eID="gen16524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7013"/><l level="1" sID="gen16525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7013"/>Melior est pauper sanus, et fortis viribus, <l eID="gen16525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16526"/>quam dives imbecillis et flagellatus malitia. <l eID="gen16526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7014"/><l level="1" sID="gen16527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7014"/>Salus animæ in sanctitate justitiæ <l eID="gen16527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16528"/>melior est omni auro et argento : <l eID="gen16528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16529"/>et corpus validum quam census immensus. <l eID="gen16529" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7015"/><l level="1" sID="gen16530"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7015"/>Non est census super censum salutis corporis, <l eID="gen16530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16531"/>et non est oblectamentum super cordis gaudium. <l eID="gen16531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7016"/><l level="1" sID="gen16532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7016"/>Melior est mors quam vita amara, <l eID="gen16532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16533"/>et requies æterna quam languor perseverans. <l eID="gen16533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7017"/><l level="1" sID="gen16534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7017"/>Bona abscondita in ore clauso, <l eID="gen16534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16535"/>quasi appositiones epularum circumpositæ sepulchro. <l eID="gen16535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7018"/><l level="1" sID="gen16536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7018"/>Quid proderit libatio idolo ? <l eID="gen16536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16537"/>nec enim manducabit, nec odorabit. <l eID="gen16537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7019"/><l level="1" sID="gen16538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7019"/>Sic qui effugatur a Domino, <l eID="gen16538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16539"/>portans mercedes iniquitatis : <l eID="gen16539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7020"/><l level="1" sID="gen16540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7020"/>videns oculis et ingemiscens, <l eID="gen16540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16541"/>sicut spado complectens virginem, et suspirans. <l eID="gen16541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7021"/><l level="1" sID="gen16542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7021"/>Tristitiam non des animæ tuæ, <l eID="gen16542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16543"/>et non affligas temetipsum in consilio tuo. <l eID="gen16543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7022"/><l level="1" sID="gen16544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7022"/>Jucunditas cordis, hæc est vita hominis, <l eID="gen16544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16545"/>et thesaurus sine defectione sanctitatis : <l eID="gen16545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16546"/>et exsultatio viri est longævitas. <l eID="gen16546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7023"/><l level="1" sID="gen16547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7023"/>Miserere animæ tuæ placens Deo, et contine : <l eID="gen16547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16548"/>congrega cor tuum in sanctitate ejus, <l eID="gen16548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16549"/>et tristitiam longe repelle a te. <l eID="gen16549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7024"/><l level="1" sID="gen16550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7024"/>Multos enim occidit tristitia, <l eID="gen16550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16551"/>et non est utilitas in illa. <l eID="gen16551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7025"/><l level="1" sID="gen16552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7025"/>Zelus et iracundia minuunt dies, <l eID="gen16552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16553"/>et ante tempus senectam adducet cogitatus. <l eID="gen16553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 30:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7026"/><l level="1" sID="gen16554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7026"/>Splendidum cor et bonum in epulis est : <l eID="gen16554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16555"/>epulæ enim illius diligenter fiunt.  <chapter eID="Sir.30"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:1
verses.text: Vigilia honestatis tabefaciet carnes, <l eID="gen16556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16557"/>et cogitatus illius auferet somnum. <l eID="gen16557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7027"/><l level="1" sID="gen16558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7027"/>Cogitatus præscientiæ avertit sensum, <l eID="gen16558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16559"/>et infirmitas gravis sobriam facit animam. <l eID="gen16559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7028"/><l level="1" sID="gen16560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7028"/>Laboravit dives in congregatione substantiæ, <l eID="gen16560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16561"/>et in requie sua replebitur bonis suis. <l eID="gen16561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7029"/><l level="1" sID="gen16562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7029"/>Laboravit pauper in diminutione victus, <l eID="gen16562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16563"/>et in fine inops fit. <l eID="gen16563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7030"/><l level="1" sID="gen16564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7030"/>Qui aurum diligit non justificabitur, <l eID="gen16564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16565"/>et qui insequitur consumptionem replebitur ex ea. <l eID="gen16565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7031"/><l level="1" sID="gen16566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7031"/>Multi dati sunt in auri casus, <l eID="gen16566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16567"/>et facta est in specie ipsius perditio illorum. <l eID="gen16567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7032"/><l level="1" sID="gen16568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7032"/>Lignum offensionis est aurum sacrificantium : <l eID="gen16568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16569"/>væ illis qui sectantur illud ! <l eID="gen16569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16570"/>et omnis imprudens deperiet in illo. <l eID="gen16570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:8
