verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7033"/><l level="1" sID="gen16571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7033"/>Beatus dives qui inventus est sine macula, <l eID="gen16571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16572"/>et qui post aurum non abiit, <l eID="gen16572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16573"/>nec speravit in pecunia et thesauris. <l eID="gen16573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7034"/><l level="1" sID="gen16574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7034"/>Quis est hic ? et laudabimus eum : <l eID="gen16574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16575"/>fecit enim mirabilia in vita sua. <l eID="gen16575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7035"/><l level="1" sID="gen16576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7035"/>Qui probatus est in illo, et perfectus est, erit illi gloria æterna : <l eID="gen16576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16577"/>qui potuit transgredi, et non est transgressus ; <l eID="gen16577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16578"/>facere mala, et non fecit. <l eID="gen16578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7036"/><l level="1" sID="gen16579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7036"/>Ideo stabilita sunt bona illius in Domino, <l eID="gen16579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16580"/>et eleemosynas illius enarrabit omnis ecclesia sanctorum. <l eID="gen16580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7037"/><l level="1" sID="gen16581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7037"/>Supra mensam magnam sedisti ? <l eID="gen16581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16582"/>non aperias super illam faucem tuam prior. <l eID="gen16582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7038"/><l level="1" sID="gen16583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7038"/>Non dicas sic : Multa sunt, quæ super illam sunt. <l eID="gen16583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7039"/><l level="1" sID="gen16584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7039"/>Memento quoniam malus est oculus nequam. <l eID="gen16584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7040"/><l level="1" sID="gen16585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7040"/>Nequius oculo quid creatum est ? <l eID="gen16585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16586"/>ideo ab omni facie sua lacrimabitur, cum viderit. <l eID="gen16586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7041"/><l level="1" sID="gen16587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7041"/>Ne extendas manum tuam prior, <l eID="gen16587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16588"/>et invidia contaminatus erubescas. <l eID="gen16588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7042"/><l level="1" sID="gen16589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7042"/>Ne comprimaris in convivio. <l eID="gen16589" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7043"/><l level="1" sID="gen16590"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7043"/>Intellige quæ sunt proximi tui ex teipso. <l eID="gen16590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7044"/><l level="1" sID="gen16591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7044"/>Utere quasi homo frugi his quæ tibi apponuntur : <l eID="gen16591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16592"/>ne, cum manducas multum, odio habearis. <l eID="gen16592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7045"/><l level="1" sID="gen16593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7045"/>Cessa prior causa disciplinæ : <l eID="gen16593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16594"/>et noli nimius esse, ne forte offendas. <l eID="gen16594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7046"/><l level="1" sID="gen16595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7046"/>Et si in medio multorum sedisti, <l eID="gen16595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16596"/>prior illis ne extendas manum tuam, <l eID="gen16596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16597"/>nec prior poscas bibere. <l eID="gen16597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7047"/><l level="1" sID="gen16598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7047"/>Quam sufficiens est homini erudito vinum exiguum ! <l eID="gen16598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16599"/>et in dormiendo non laborabis ab illo, <l eID="gen16599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16600"/>et non senties dolorem. <l eID="gen16600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7048"/><l level="1" sID="gen16601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7048"/>Vigilia, cholera et tortura viro infrunito, <l eID="gen16601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7049"/><l level="1" sID="gen16602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7049"/>somnus sanitatis in homine parco : <l eID="gen16602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16603"/>dormiet usque mane, <l eID="gen16603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16604"/>et anima illius cum ipso delectabitur. <l eID="gen16604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7050"/><l level="1" sID="gen16605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7050"/>Et si coactus fueris in edendo multum, <l eID="gen16605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16606"/>surge e medio, evome, et refrigerabit te, <l eID="gen16606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16607"/>et non adduces corpori tuo infirmitatem. <l eID="gen16607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7051"/><l level="1" sID="gen16608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7051"/>Audi me, fili, et ne spernas me, <l eID="gen16608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16609"/>et in novissimo invenies verba mea. <l eID="gen16609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7052"/><l level="1" sID="gen16610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7052"/>In omnibus operibus tuis esto velox, <l eID="gen16610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16611"/>et omnis infirmitas non occurret tibi. <l eID="gen16611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7053"/><l level="1" sID="gen16612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7053"/>Splendidum in panibus benedicent labia multorum, <l eID="gen16612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16613"/>et testimonium veritatis illius fidele. <l eID="gen16613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7054"/><l level="1" sID="gen16614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7054"/>Nequissimo in pane murmurabit civitas, <l eID="gen16614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16615"/>et testimonium nequitiæ illius verum est. <l eID="gen16615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7055"/><l level="1" sID="gen16616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7055"/>Diligentes in vino noli provocare : <l eID="gen16616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16617"/>multos enim exterminavit vinum. <l eID="gen16617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7056"/><l level="1" sID="gen16618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7056"/>Ignis probat ferrum durum : <l eID="gen16618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16619"/>sic vinum corda superborum arguet in ebrietate potatum. <l eID="gen16619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7057"/><l level="1" sID="gen16620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7057"/>Æqua vita hominibus vinum in sobrietate : <l eID="gen16620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16621"/>si bibas illud moderate, eris sobrius. <l eID="gen16621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7058"/><l level="1" sID="gen16622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7058"/>Quæ vita est ei qui minuitur vino ? <l eID="gen16622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7059"/><l level="1" sID="gen16623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7059"/>Quid defraudat vitam ? mors. <l eID="gen16623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7060"/><l level="1" sID="gen16624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7060"/>Vinum in jucunditatem creatum est, <l eID="gen16624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16625"/>et non in ebrietatem ab initio. <l eID="gen16625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7061"/><l level="1" sID="gen16626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7061"/>Exsultatio animæ et cordis vinum moderate potatum. <l eID="gen16626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7062"/><l level="1" sID="gen16627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7062"/>Sanitas est animæ et corpori sobrius potus. <l eID="gen16627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7063"/><l level="1" sID="gen16628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7063"/>Vinum multum potatum irritationem, <l eID="gen16628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16629"/>et iram, et ruinas multas facit. <l eID="gen16629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7064"/><l level="1" sID="gen16630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7064"/>Amaritudo animæ <l eID="gen16630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16631"/>vinum multum potatum. <l eID="gen16631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7065"/><l level="1" sID="gen16632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7065"/>Ebrietatis animositas, imprudentis offensio, <l eID="gen16632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16633"/>minorans virtutem, et faciens vulnera. <l eID="gen16633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7066"/><l level="1" sID="gen16634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7066"/>In convivio vini non arguas proximum, <l eID="gen16634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16635"/>et non despicias eum in jucunditate illius. <l eID="gen16635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 31:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7067"/><l level="1" sID="gen16636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7067"/>Verba improperii non dicas illi, <l eID="gen16636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16637"/>et non premas illum repetendo.  <chapter eID="Sir.31"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:1
verses.text: Rectorem te posuerunt ? noli extolli : <l eID="gen16638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16639"/>esto in illis quasi unus ex ipsis. <l eID="gen16639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7068"/><l level="1" sID="gen16640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7068"/>Curam illorum habe, et sic conside, <l eID="gen16640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16641"/>et omni cura tua explicita recumbe : <l eID="gen16641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7069"/><l level="1" sID="gen16642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7069"/>ut læteris propter illos, <l eID="gen16642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16643"/>et ornamentum gratiæ accipias coronam, <l eID="gen16643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16644"/>et dignationem consequaris corrogationis. <l eID="gen16644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7070"/><l level="1" sID="gen16645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7070"/>Loquere major natu : <l eID="gen16645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16646"/>decet enim te <l eID="gen16646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7071"/><l level="1" sID="gen16647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7071"/>primum verbum diligenti scientia, <l eID="gen16647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16648"/>et non impedias musicam. <l eID="gen16648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7072"/><l level="1" sID="gen16649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7072"/>Ubi auditus non est, non effundas sermonem, <l eID="gen16649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16650"/>et importune noli extolli in sapientia tua. <l eID="gen16650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7073"/><l level="1" sID="gen16651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7073"/>Gemmula carbunculi in ornamento auri, <l eID="gen16651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16652"/>et comparatio musicorum in convivio vini. <l eID="gen16652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7074"/><l level="1" sID="gen16653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7074"/>Sicut in fabricatione auri signum est smaragdi, <l eID="gen16653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16654"/>sic numerus musicorum in jucundo et moderato vino. <l eID="gen16654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7075"/><l level="1" sID="gen16655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7075"/>Audi tacens, <l eID="gen16655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16656"/>et pro reverentia accedet tibi bona gratia. <l eID="gen16656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7076"/><l level="1" sID="gen16657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7076"/>Adolescens, loquere in tua causa vix. <l eID="gen16657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7077"/><l level="1" sID="gen16658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7077"/>Si bis interrogatus fueris, <l eID="gen16658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16659"/>habeat caput responsum tuum. <l eID="gen16659" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7078"/><l level="1" sID="gen16660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7078"/>In multis esto quasi inscius, <l eID="gen16660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16661"/>et audi tacens simul et quærens. <l eID="gen16661" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7079"/><l level="1" sID="gen16662"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7079"/>In medio magnatorum non præsumas : <l eID="gen16662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16663"/>et ubi sunt senes non multum loquaris. <l eID="gen16663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7080"/><l level="1" sID="gen16664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7080"/>Ante grandinem præibit coruscatio : <l eID="gen16664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16665"/>et ante verecundiam præibit gratia, <l eID="gen16665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16666"/>et pro reverentia accedet tibi bona gratia. <l eID="gen16666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7081"/><l level="1" sID="gen16667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7081"/>Et hora surgendi non te trices : <l eID="gen16667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16668"/>præcurre autem prior in domum tuam, <l eID="gen16668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16669"/>et illic avocare, et illic lude, <l eID="gen16669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7082"/><l level="1" sID="gen16670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7082"/>et age conceptiones tuas, <l eID="gen16670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16671"/>et non in delictis et verbo superbo : <l eID="gen16671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7083"/><l level="1" sID="gen16672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7083"/>et super his omnibus benedicito Dominum, qui fecit, <l eID="gen16672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16673"/>et inebriantem te ab omnibus bonis suis. <l eID="gen16673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7084"/><l level="1" sID="gen16674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7084"/>Qui timet Dominum excipiet doctrinam ejus : <l eID="gen16674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16675"/>et qui vigilaverint ad illum invenient benedictionem. <l eID="gen16675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7085"/><l level="1" sID="gen16676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7085"/>Qui quærit legem replebitur ab ea, <l eID="gen16676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16677"/>et qui insidiose agit scandalizabitur in ea. <l eID="gen16677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7086"/><l level="1" sID="gen16678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7086"/>Qui timent Dominum invenient judicium justum, <l eID="gen16678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16679"/>et justitias quasi lumen accendent. <l eID="gen16679" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7087"/><l level="1" sID="gen16680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7087"/>Peccator homo vitabit correptionem, <l eID="gen16680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16681"/>et secundum voluntatem suam inveniet comparationem. <l eID="gen16681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7088"/><l level="1" sID="gen16682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7088"/>Vir consilii non disperdet intelligentiam : <l eID="gen16682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16683"/>alienus et superbus non pertimescet timorem : <l eID="gen16683" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7089"/><l level="1" sID="gen16684"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7089"/>etiam postquam fecit cum eo sine consilio, <l eID="gen16684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16685"/>et suis insectationibus arguetur. <l eID="gen16685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7090"/><l level="1" sID="gen16686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7090"/>Fili, sine consilio nihil facias, <l eID="gen16686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16687"/>et post factum non pœnitebis. <l eID="gen16687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7091"/><l level="1" sID="gen16688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7091"/>In via ruinæ non eas, et non offendes in lapides : <l eID="gen16688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16689"/>nec credas te viæ laboriosæ, ne ponas animæ tuæ scandalum. <l eID="gen16689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7092"/><l level="1" sID="gen16690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7092"/>Et a filiis tuis cave, <l eID="gen16690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16691"/>et a domesticis tuis attende. <l eID="gen16691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7093"/><l level="1" sID="gen16692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7093"/>In omni opere tuo crede ex fide animæ tuæ, <l eID="gen16692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16693"/>hoc est enim conservatio mandatorum. <l eID="gen16693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 32:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7094"/><l level="1" sID="gen16694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7094"/>Qui credit Deo attendit mandatis : <l eID="gen16694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16695"/>et qui confidit in illo non minorabitur.  <chapter eID="Sir.32"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:1
verses.text: Timenti Dominum non occurrent mala : <l eID="gen16696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16697"/>sed in tentatione Deus illum conservabit, et liberabit a malis. <l eID="gen16697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16698"/>Sapiens non odit mandata et justitias, <l eID="gen16698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7095"/><l level="1" sID="gen16699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7095"/>et non illidetur quasi in procella navis. <l eID="gen16699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7096"/><l level="1" sID="gen16700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7096"/>Homo sensatus credit legi Dei, <l eID="gen16700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16701"/>et lex illi fidelis. <l eID="gen16701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7097"/><l level="1" sID="gen16702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7097"/>Qui interrogationem manifestat parabit verbum, <l eID="gen16702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16703"/>et sic deprecatus exaudietur : <l eID="gen16703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16704"/>et conservabit disciplinam, et tunc respondebit. <l eID="gen16704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7098"/><l level="1" sID="gen16705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7098"/>Præcordia fatui quasi rota carri, <l eID="gen16705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16706"/>et quasi axis versatilis cogitatus illius. <l eID="gen16706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7099"/><l level="1" sID="gen16707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7099"/>Equus emissarius, sic et amicus subsannator : <l eID="gen16707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16708"/>sub omni supra sedente hinnit. <l eID="gen16708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7100"/><l level="1" sID="gen16709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7100"/>Quare dies diem superat, et iterum lux lucem, <l eID="gen16709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16710"/>et annus annum a sole ? <l eID="gen16710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7101"/><l level="1" sID="gen16711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7101"/>A Domini scientia separati sunt, <l eID="gen16711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16712"/>facto sole, et præceptum custodiente. <l eID="gen16712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7102"/><l level="1" sID="gen16713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7102"/>Et immutavit tempora, et dies festos ipsorum, <l eID="gen16713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16714"/>et in illis dies festos celebraverunt ad horam. <l eID="gen16714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7103"/><l level="1" sID="gen16715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7103"/>Ex ipsis exaltavit et magnificavit Deus, <l eID="gen16715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16716"/>et ex ipsis posuit in numerum dierum : <l eID="gen16716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16717"/>et omnes homines de solo et ex terra unde creatus est Adam. <l eID="gen16717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7104"/><l level="1" sID="gen16718"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7104"/>In multitudine disciplinæ Dominus separavit eos, <l eID="gen16718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16719"/>et immutavit vias eorum. <l eID="gen16719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7105"/><l level="1" sID="gen16720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7105"/>Ex ipsis benedixit et exaltavit, <l eID="gen16720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16721"/>et ex ipsis sanctificavit, et ad se applicavit, <l eID="gen16721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16722"/>et ex ipsis maledixit, et humiliavit, <l eID="gen16722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16723"/>et convertit illos a separatione ipsorum. <l eID="gen16723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7106"/><l level="1" sID="gen16724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7106"/>Quasi lutum figuli in manu ipsius, <l eID="gen16724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16725"/>plasmare illud et disponere. <l eID="gen16725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7107"/><l level="1" sID="gen16726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7107"/>Omnes viæ ejus secundum dispositionem ejus : <l eID="gen16726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16727"/>sic homo in manu illius qui se fecit, <l eID="gen16727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16728"/>et reddet illi secundum judicium suum. <l eID="gen16728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7108"/><l level="1" sID="gen16729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7108"/>Contra malum bonum est, et contra mortem vita : <l eID="gen16729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16730"/>sic et contra virum justum peccator, <l eID="gen16730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16731"/>et sic intuere in omnia opera Altissimi, <l eID="gen16731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16732"/>duo et duo, et unum contra unum. <l eID="gen16732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7109"/><l level="1" sID="gen16733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7109"/>Et ego novissimus evigilavi, <l eID="gen16733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16734"/>et quasi qui colligit acinos post vindemiatores. <l eID="gen16734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7110"/><l level="1" sID="gen16735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7110"/>In benedictione Dei et ipse speravi, <l eID="gen16735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16736"/>et quasi qui vindemiat replevi torcular. <l eID="gen16736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7111"/><l level="1" sID="gen16737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7111"/>Respicite quoniam non mihi soli laboravi, <l eID="gen16737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16738"/>sed omnibus exquirentibus disciplinam. <l eID="gen16738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7112"/><l level="1" sID="gen16739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7112"/>Audite me, magnates et omnes populi : <l eID="gen16739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16740"/>et rectores ecclesiæ, auribus percipite. <l eID="gen16740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7113"/><l level="1" sID="gen16741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7113"/>Filio et mulieri, fratri et amico, <l eID="gen16741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16742"/>non des potestatem super te in vita tua : <l eID="gen16742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16743"/>et non dederis alii possessionem tuam, <l eID="gen16743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16744"/>ne forte pœniteat te, et depreceris pro illis. <l eID="gen16744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7114"/><l level="1" sID="gen16745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7114"/>Dum adhuc superes et aspiras, <l eID="gen16745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16746"/>non immutabit te omnis caro. <l eID="gen16746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7115"/><l level="1" sID="gen16747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7115"/>Melius est enim ut filii tui te rogent, <l eID="gen16747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16748"/>quam te respicere in manus filiorum tuorum. <l eID="gen16748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7116"/><l level="1" sID="gen16749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7116"/>In omnibus operibus tuis præcellens esto. <l eID="gen16749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7117"/><l level="1" sID="gen16750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7117"/>Ne dederis maculam in gloria tua. <l eID="gen16750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16751"/>In die consummationis dierum vitæ tuæ, et in tempore exitus tui, <l eID="gen16751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16752"/>distribue hæreditatem tuam. <l eID="gen16752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7118"/><l level="1" sID="gen16753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7118"/>Cibaria, et virga, et onus asino : <l eID="gen16753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16754"/>panis, et disciplina, et opus servo. <l eID="gen16754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7119"/><l level="1" sID="gen16755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7119"/>Operatur in disciplina, et quærit requiescere : <l eID="gen16755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16756"/>laxa manus illi, et quærit libertatem. <l eID="gen16756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7120"/><l level="1" sID="gen16757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7120"/>Jugum et lorum curvant collum durum, <l eID="gen16757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16758"/>et servum inclinant operationes assiduæ. <l eID="gen16758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7121"/><l level="1" sID="gen16759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7121"/>Servo malevolo tortura et compedes : <l eID="gen16759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16760"/>mitte illum in operationem, ne vacet : <l eID="gen16760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7122"/><l level="1" sID="gen16761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7122"/>multam enim malitiam docuit otiositas. <l eID="gen16761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7123"/><l level="1" sID="gen16762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7123"/>In opera constitue eum : <l eID="gen16762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16763"/>sic enim condecet illum. <l eID="gen16763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16764"/>Quod si non obaudierit, curva illum compedibus, <l eID="gen16764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16765"/>et non amplifices super omnem carnem : <l eID="gen16765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16766"/>verum sine judicio nihil facias grave. <l eID="gen16766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7124"/><l level="1" sID="gen16767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7124"/>Si est tibi servus fidelis, sit tibi quasi anima tua : <l eID="gen16767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16768"/>quasi fratrem sic eum tracta, <l eID="gen16768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16769"/>quoniam in sanguine animæ comparasti illum. <l eID="gen16769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7125"/><l level="1" sID="gen16770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7125"/>Si læseris eum injuste, <l eID="gen16770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16771"/>in fugam convertetur : <l eID="gen16771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 33:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7126"/><l level="1" sID="gen16772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7126"/>et si extollens discesserit, <l eID="gen16772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16773"/>quem quæras et in qua via quæras illum nescis.  <chapter eID="Sir.33"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:1
verses.text: Vana spes et mendacium viro insensato : <l eID="gen16774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16775"/>et somnia extollunt imprudentes. <l eID="gen16775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7127"/><l level="1" sID="gen16776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7127"/>Quasi qui apprehendit umbram et persequitur ventum, <l eID="gen16776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16777"/>sic et qui attendit ad visa mendacia. <l eID="gen16777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7128"/><l level="1" sID="gen16778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7128"/>Hoc secundum hoc visio somniorum, <l eID="gen16778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16779"/>ante faciem hominis similitudo hominis. <l eID="gen16779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7129"/><l level="1" sID="gen16780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7129"/>Ab immundo, quid mundabitur ? <l eID="gen16780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16781"/>et a mendace, quid verum dicetur ? <l eID="gen16781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7130"/><l level="1" sID="gen16782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7130"/>Divinatio erroris, et auguria mendacia, <l eID="gen16782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16783"/>et somnia malefacientium, vanitas est : <l eID="gen16783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7131"/><l level="1" sID="gen16784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7131"/>et sicut parturientis, cor tuum phantasias patitur. <l eID="gen16784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16785"/>Nisi ab Altissimo fuerit emissa visitatio, <l eID="gen16785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16786"/>ne dederis in illis cor tuum : <l eID="gen16786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7132"/><l level="1" sID="gen16787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7132"/>multos enim errare fecerunt somnia, <l eID="gen16787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16788"/>et exciderunt sperantes in illis. <l eID="gen16788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7133"/><l level="1" sID="gen16789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7133"/>Sine mendacio consummabitur verbum legis, <l eID="gen16789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16790"/>et sapientia in ore fidelis complanabitur. <l eID="gen16790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7134"/><l level="1" sID="gen16791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7134"/>Qui non est tentatus quid scit ? <l eID="gen16791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16792"/>vir in multis expertus cogitabit multa : <l eID="gen16792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16793"/>et qui multa didicit enarrabit intellectum. <l eID="gen16793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7135"/><l level="1" sID="gen16794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7135"/>Qui non est expertus pauca recognoscit : <l eID="gen16794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16795"/>qui autem in multis factus est, multiplicat malitiam. <l eID="gen16795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7136"/><l level="1" sID="gen16796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7136"/>Qui tentatus non est qualia scit ? <l eID="gen16796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16797"/>qui implanatus est abundabit nequitia. <l eID="gen16797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7137"/><l level="1" sID="gen16798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7137"/>Multa vidi errando, <l eID="gen16798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16799"/>et plurimas verborum consuetudines. <l eID="gen16799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7138"/><l level="1" sID="gen16800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7138"/>Aliquoties usque ad mortem periclitatus sum horum causa, <l eID="gen16800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16801"/>et liberatus sum gratia Dei. <l eID="gen16801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7139"/><l level="1" sID="gen16802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7139"/>Spiritus timentium Deum quæritur, <l eID="gen16802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16803"/>et in respectu illius benedicetur. <l eID="gen16803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7140"/><l level="1" sID="gen16804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7140"/>Spes enim illorum in salvantem illos, <l eID="gen16804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16805"/>et oculi Dei in diligentes se. <l eID="gen16805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7141"/><l level="1" sID="gen16806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7141"/>Qui timet Dominum nihil trepidabit : <l eID="gen16806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16807"/>et non pavebit, quoniam ipse est spes ejus. <l eID="gen16807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7142"/><l level="1" sID="gen16808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7142"/>Timentis Dominum, beata est anima ejus. <l eID="gen16808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7143"/><l level="1" sID="gen16809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7143"/>Ad quem respicit, et quis est fortitudo ejus ? <l eID="gen16809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7144"/><l level="1" sID="gen16810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7144"/>Oculi Domini super timentes eum : <l eID="gen16810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16811"/>protector potentiæ, firmamentum virtutis, <l eID="gen16811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16812"/>tegimen ardoris, et umbraculum meridiani : <l eID="gen16812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7145"/><l level="1" sID="gen16813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7145"/>deprecatio offensionis, et adjutorium casus : <l eID="gen16813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16814"/>exaltans animam, et illuminans oculos, <l eID="gen16814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16815"/>dans sanitatem, et vitam, et benedictionem. <l eID="gen16815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7146"/><l level="1" sID="gen16816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7146"/>Immolantis ex iniquo oblatio est maculata, <l eID="gen16816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16817"/>et non sunt beneplacitæ subsannationes injustorum. <l eID="gen16817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7147"/><l level="1" sID="gen16818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7147"/>Dominus solus sustinentibus se <l eID="gen16818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16819"/>in via veritatis et justitiæ. <l eID="gen16819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7148"/><l level="1" sID="gen16820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7148"/>Dona iniquorum non probat Altissimus, <l eID="gen16820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16821"/>nec respicit in oblationes iniquorum, <l eID="gen16821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16822"/>nec in multitudine sacrificiorum eorum propitiabitur peccatis. <l eID="gen16822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7149"/><l level="1" sID="gen16823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7149"/>Qui offert sacrificium ex substantia pauperum, <l eID="gen16823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16824"/>quasi qui victimat filium in conspectu patris sui. <l eID="gen16824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7150"/><l level="1" sID="gen16825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7150"/>Panis egentium vita pauperum est : <l eID="gen16825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16826"/>qui defraudat illum homo sanguinis est. <l eID="gen16826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7151"/><l level="1" sID="gen16827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7151"/>Qui aufert in sudore panem, <l eID="gen16827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16828"/>quasi qui occidit proximum suum. <l eID="gen16828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7152"/><l level="1" sID="gen16829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7152"/>Qui effundit sanguinem, <l eID="gen16829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16830"/>et qui fraudem facit mercenario, fratres sunt. <l eID="gen16830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7153"/><l level="1" sID="gen16831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7153"/>Unus ædificans, et unus destruens : <l eID="gen16831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16832"/>quid prodest illis, nisi labor ? <l eID="gen16832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7154"/><l level="1" sID="gen16833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7154"/>Unus orans, et unus maledicens : <l eID="gen16833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16834"/>cujus vocem exaudiet Deus ? <l eID="gen16834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7155"/><l level="1" sID="gen16835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7155"/>Qui baptizatur a mortuo, et iterum tangit eum, <l eID="gen16835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16836"/>quid proficit lavatio illius ? <l eID="gen16836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 34:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7156"/><l level="1" sID="gen16837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7156"/>Sic homo qui jejunat in peccatis suis, <l eID="gen16837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16838"/>et iterum eadem faciens : <l eID="gen16838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16839"/>quid proficit humiliando se ? <l eID="gen16839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16840"/>orationem illius quis exaudiet ?  <chapter eID="Sir.34"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:1
verses.text: Qui conservat legem <l eID="gen16841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16842"/>multiplicat oblationem. <l eID="gen16842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7157"/><l level="1" sID="gen16843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7157"/>Sacrificium salutare est attendere mandatis, <l eID="gen16843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16844"/>et discedere ab omni iniquitate. <l eID="gen16844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7158"/><l level="1" sID="gen16845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7158"/>Et propitiationem litare sacrificii super injustitias : <l eID="gen16845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16846"/>et deprecatio pro peccatis, recedere ab injustitia. <l eID="gen16846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7159"/><l level="1" sID="gen16847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7159"/>Retribuet gratiam qui offert similaginem : <l eID="gen16847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16848"/>et qui facit misericordiam offert sacrificium. <l eID="gen16848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7160"/><l level="1" sID="gen16849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7160"/>Beneplacitum est Domino recedere ab iniquitate : <l eID="gen16849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16850"/>et deprecatio pro peccatis recedere ab injustitia. <l eID="gen16850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7161"/><l level="1" sID="gen16851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7161"/>Non apparebis ante conspectum Domini vacuus : <l eID="gen16851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7162"/><l level="1" sID="gen16852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7162"/>hæc enim omnia propter mandatum Dei fiunt. <l eID="gen16852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7163"/><l level="1" sID="gen16853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7163"/>Oblatio justi impinguat altare, <l eID="gen16853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16854"/>et odor suavitatis est in conspectu Altissimi. <l eID="gen16854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7164"/><l level="1" sID="gen16855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7164"/>Sacrificium justi acceptum est, <l eID="gen16855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16856"/>et memoriam ejus non obliviscetur Dominus. <l eID="gen16856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7165"/><l level="1" sID="gen16857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7165"/>Bono animo gloriam redde Deo, <l eID="gen16857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16858"/>et non minuas primitias manuum tuarum. <l eID="gen16858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7166"/><l level="1" sID="gen16859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7166"/>In omni dato hilarem fac vultum tuum, <l eID="gen16859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16860"/>et in exsultatione sanctifica decimas tuas. <l eID="gen16860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7167"/><l level="1" sID="gen16861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7167"/>Da Altissimo secundum datum ejus, <l eID="gen16861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16862"/>et in bono oculo adinventionem facito manuum tuarum, <l eID="gen16862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7168"/><l level="1" sID="gen16863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7168"/>quoniam Dominus retribuens est, <l eID="gen16863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16864"/>et septies tantum reddet tibi. <l eID="gen16864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7169"/><l level="1" sID="gen16865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7169"/>Noli offerre munera prava, <l eID="gen16865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16866"/>non enim suscipiet illa. <l eID="gen16866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7170"/><l level="1" sID="gen16867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7170"/>Et noli inspicere sacrificum injustum, <l eID="gen16867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16868"/>quoniam Dominus judex est, <l eID="gen16868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16869"/>et non est apud illum gloria personæ. <l eID="gen16869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7171"/><l level="1" sID="gen16870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7171"/>Non accipiet Dominus personam in pauperem, <l eID="gen16870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16871"/>et deprecationem læsi exaudiet. <l eID="gen16871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7172"/><l level="1" sID="gen16872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7172"/>Non despiciet preces pupilli, <l eID="gen16872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16873"/>nec viduam, si effundat loquelam gemitus. <l eID="gen16873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7173"/><l level="1" sID="gen16874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7173"/>Nonne lacrimæ viduæ ad maxillam descendunt, <l eID="gen16874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16875"/>et exclamatio ejus super deducentem eas ? <l eID="gen16875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7174"/><l level="1" sID="gen16876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7174"/>A maxilla enim ascendunt usque ad cælum, <l eID="gen16876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16877"/>et Dominus exauditor non delectabitur in illis. <l eID="gen16877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7175"/><l level="1" sID="gen16878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7175"/>Qui adorat Deum in oblectatione suscipietur, <l eID="gen16878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16879"/>et deprecatio illius usque ad nubes propinquabit. <l eID="gen16879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7176"/><l level="1" sID="gen16880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7176"/>Oratio humiliantis se nubes penetrabit, <l eID="gen16880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16881"/>et donec propinquet non consolabitur, <l eID="gen16881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16882"/>et non discedet donec Altissimus aspiciat. <l eID="gen16882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7177"/><l level="1" sID="gen16883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7177"/>Et Dominus non elongabit : <l eID="gen16883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16884"/>et judicabit justos, et faciet judicium : <l eID="gen16884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16885"/>et Fortissimus non habebit in illis patientiam, <l eID="gen16885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16886"/>ut contribulet dorsum ipsorum : <l eID="gen16886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7178"/><l level="1" sID="gen16887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7178"/>et gentibus reddet vindictam, <l eID="gen16887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16888"/>donec tollat plenitudinem superborum, <l eID="gen16888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16889"/>et sceptra iniquorum contribulet : <l eID="gen16889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7179"/><l level="1" sID="gen16890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7179"/>donec reddat hominibus secundum actus suos, <l eID="gen16890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16891"/>et secundum opera Adæ, et secundum præsumptionem illius : <l eID="gen16891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7180"/><l level="1" sID="gen16892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7180"/>donec judicet judicium plebis suæ, <l eID="gen16892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16893"/>et oblectabit justos misericordia sua. <l eID="gen16893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 35:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7181"/><l level="1" sID="gen16894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7181"/>Speciosa misericordia Dei in tempore tribulationis, <l eID="gen16894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16895"/>quasi nubes pluviæ in tempore siccitatis.  <chapter eID="Sir.35"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:1
verses.text: Miserere nostri, Deus omnium, et respice nos, <l eID="gen16896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16897"/>et ostende nobis lucem miserationum tuarum : <l eID="gen16897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7182"/><l level="1" sID="gen16898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7182"/>et immitte timorem tuum super gentes quæ non exquisierunt te, <l eID="gen16898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16899"/>ut cognoscant quia non est deus nisi tu, <l eID="gen16899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16900"/>et enarrent magnalia tua. <l eID="gen16900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7183"/><l level="1" sID="gen16901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7183"/>Alleva manum tuam super gentes alienas, <l eID="gen16901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16902"/>ut videant potentiam tuam. <l eID="gen16902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7184"/><l level="1" sID="gen16903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7184"/>Sicut enim in conspectu eorum sanctificatus es in nobis, <l eID="gen16903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16904"/>sic in conspectu nostro magnificaberis in eis : <l eID="gen16904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7185"/><l level="1" sID="gen16905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7185"/>ut cognoscant te, sicut et nos cognovimus <l eID="gen16905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16906"/>quoniam non est deus præter te, Domine. <l eID="gen16906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7186"/><l level="1" sID="gen16907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7186"/>Innova signa, et immuta mirabilia. <l eID="gen16907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7187"/><l level="1" sID="gen16908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7187"/>Glorifica manum et brachium dextrum. <l eID="gen16908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7188"/><l level="1" sID="gen16909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7188"/>Excita furorem, et effunde iram. <l eID="gen16909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7189"/><l level="1" sID="gen16910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7189"/>Tolle adversarium, et afflige inimicum. <l eID="gen16910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7190"/><l level="1" sID="gen16911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7190"/>Festina tempus, et memento finis, <l eID="gen16911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16912"/>ut enarrent mirabilia tua. <l eID="gen16912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7191"/><l level="1" sID="gen16913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7191"/>In ira flammæ devoretur qui salvatur : <l eID="gen16913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16914"/>et qui pessimant plebem tuam inveniant perditionem. <l eID="gen16914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7192"/><l level="1" sID="gen16915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7192"/>Contere caput principum inimicorum, <l eID="gen16915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16916"/>dicentium : Non est alius præter nos. <l eID="gen16916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7193"/><l level="1" sID="gen16917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7193"/>Congrega omnes tribus Jacob, <l eID="gen16917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16918"/>ut cognoscant quia non est deus nisi tu, <l eID="gen16918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16919"/>et enarrent magnalia tua, <l eID="gen16919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16920"/>et hæreditabis eos sicut ab initio. <l eID="gen16920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7194"/><l level="1" sID="gen16921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7194"/>Miserere plebi tuæ, super quam invocatum est nomen tuum, <l eID="gen16921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16922"/>et Israël quem coæquasti primogenito tuo. <l eID="gen16922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7195"/><l level="1" sID="gen16923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7195"/>Miserere civitati sanctificationis tuæ, <l eID="gen16923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16924"/>Jerusalem, civitati requiei tuæ. <l eID="gen16924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7196"/><l level="1" sID="gen16925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7196"/>Reple Sion inenarrabilibus verbis tuis, <l eID="gen16925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16926"/>et gloria tua populum tuum. <l eID="gen16926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7197"/><l level="1" sID="gen16927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7197"/>Da testimonium his qui ab initio creaturæ tuæ sunt, <l eID="gen16927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16928"/>et suscita prædicationes quas locuti sunt in nomine tuo prophetæ priores. <l eID="gen16928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7198"/><l level="1" sID="gen16929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7198"/>Da mercedem sustinentibus te, <l eID="gen16929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16930"/>ut prophetæ tui fideles inveniantur : <l eID="gen16930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16931"/>et exaudi orationes servorum tuorum, <l eID="gen16931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7199"/><l level="1" sID="gen16932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7199"/>secundum benedictionem Aaron de populo tuo : <l eID="gen16932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16933"/>et dirige nos in viam justitiæ, <l eID="gen16933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16934"/>et sciant omnes qui habitant terram <l eID="gen16934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16935"/>quia tu es Deus conspector sæculorum. <l eID="gen16935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7200"/><l level="1" sID="gen16936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7200"/>Omnem escam manducabit venter : <l eID="gen16936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16937"/>et est cibus cibo melior. <l eID="gen16937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7201"/><l level="1" sID="gen16938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7201"/>Fauces contingunt cibum feræ, <l eID="gen16938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16939"/>et cor sensatum verba mendacia. <l eID="gen16939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7202"/><l level="1" sID="gen16940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7202"/>Cor pravum dabit tristitiam, <l eID="gen16940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16941"/>et homo peritus resistet illi. <l eID="gen16941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7203"/><l level="1" sID="gen16942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7203"/>Omnem masculum excipiet mulier : <l eID="gen16942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16943"/>et est filia melior filia. <l eID="gen16943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7204"/><l level="1" sID="gen16944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7204"/>Species mulieris exhilarat faciem viri sui, <l eID="gen16944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16945"/>et super omnem concupiscentiam hominis superducit desiderium. <l eID="gen16945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7205"/><l level="1" sID="gen16946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7205"/>Si est lingua curationis, <l eID="gen16946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16947"/>est et mitigationis et misericordiæ : <l eID="gen16947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16948"/>non est vir illius secundum filios hominum. <l eID="gen16948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7206"/><l level="1" sID="gen16949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7206"/>Qui possidet mulierem bonam inchoat possessionem : <l eID="gen16949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16950"/>adjutorium secundum illum est, et columna ut requies. <l eID="gen16950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7207"/><l level="1" sID="gen16951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7207"/>Ubi non est sepes, diripietur possessio : <l eID="gen16951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16952"/>et ubi non est mulier, ingemiscit egens. <l eID="gen16952" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 36:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7208"/><l level="1" sID="gen16953"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7208"/>Quis credit ei qui non habet nidum, <l eID="gen16953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16954"/>et deflectens ubicumque obscuraverit, <l eID="gen16954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16955"/>quasi succinctus latro exiliens de civitate in civitatem ?  <chapter eID="Sir.36"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:1
verses.text: Omnis amicus dicet : Et ego amicitiam copulavi : <l eID="gen16956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16957"/>sed est amicus solo nomine amicus. <l eID="gen16957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16958"/>Nonne tristitia inest usque ad mortem ? <l eID="gen16958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7209"/><l level="1" sID="gen16959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7209"/>sodalis autem et amicus ad inimicitiam convertentur. <l eID="gen16959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7210"/><l level="1" sID="gen16960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7210"/>O præsumptio nequissima, unde creata es <l eID="gen16960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16961"/>cooperire aridam malitia et dolositate illius ? <l eID="gen16961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7211"/><l level="1" sID="gen16962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7211"/>Sodalis amico conjucundatur in oblectationibus, <l eID="gen16962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16963"/>et in tempore tribulationis adversarius erit. <l eID="gen16963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7212"/><l level="1" sID="gen16964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7212"/>Sodalis amico condolet causa ventris, <l eID="gen16964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16965"/>et contra hostem accipiet scutum. <l eID="gen16965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7213"/><l level="1" sID="gen16966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7213"/>Non obliviscaris amici tui in animo tuo, <l eID="gen16966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16967"/>et non immemor sis illius in opibus tuis. <l eID="gen16967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7214"/><l level="1" sID="gen16968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7214"/>Noli consiliari cum eo qui tibi insidiatur, <l eID="gen16968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16969"/>et a zelantibus te absconde consilium. <l eID="gen16969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7215"/><l level="1" sID="gen16970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7215"/>Omnis consiliarius prodit consilium, <l eID="gen16970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16971"/>sed est consiliarius in semetipso. <l eID="gen16971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7216"/><l level="1" sID="gen16972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7216"/>A consiliario serva animam tuam : <l eID="gen16972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16973"/>prius scito quæ sit illius necessitas : <l eID="gen16973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16974"/>et ipse enim animo suo cogitabit : <l eID="gen16974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7217"/><l level="1" sID="gen16975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7217"/>ne forte mittat sudem in terram, <l eID="gen16975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16976"/>et dicat tibi : <l eID="gen16976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7218"/><l level="1" sID="gen16977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7218"/>Bona est via tua : <l eID="gen16977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16978"/>et stet e contrario videre quid tibi eveniat. <l eID="gen16978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7219"/><l level="1" sID="gen16979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7219"/>Cum viro irreligioso tracta de sanctitate, <l eID="gen16979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16980"/>et cum injusto de justitia, <l eID="gen16980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16981"/>et cum muliere de ea quæ æmulatur, <l eID="gen16981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16982"/>cum timido de bello, <l eID="gen16982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16983"/>cum negotiatore de trajectione, <l eID="gen16983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16984"/>cum emptore de venditione, <l eID="gen16984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16985"/>cum viro livido de gratiis agendis, <l eID="gen16985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7220"/><l level="1" sID="gen16986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7220"/>cum impio de pietate, <l eID="gen16986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16987"/>cum inhonesto de honestate, <l eID="gen16987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16988"/>cum operario agrario de omni opere, <l eID="gen16988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7221"/><l level="1" sID="gen16989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7221"/>cum operario annuali de consummatione anni, <l eID="gen16989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16990"/>cum servo pigro de multa operatione. <l eID="gen16990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16991"/>Non attendas his in omni consilio : <l eID="gen16991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7222"/><l level="1" sID="gen16992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7222"/>sed cum viro sancto assiduus esto, <l eID="gen16992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16993"/>quemcumque cognoveris observantem timorem Dei : <l eID="gen16993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7223"/><l level="1" sID="gen16994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7223"/>cujus anima est secundum animam tuam, <l eID="gen16994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16995"/>et qui, cum titubaveris in tenebris, condolebit tibi. <l eID="gen16995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7224"/><l level="1" sID="gen16996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7224"/>Cor boni consilii statue tecum : <l eID="gen16996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16997"/>non est enim tibi aliud pluris illo. <l eID="gen16997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7225"/><l level="1" sID="gen16998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7225"/>Anima viri sancti enuntiat aliquando vera, <l eID="gen16998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen16999"/>quam septem circumspectores sedentes in excelso ad speculandum. <l eID="gen16999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7226"/><l level="1" sID="gen17000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7226"/>Et in his omnibus deprecare Altissimum, <l eID="gen17000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17001"/>ut dirigat in veritate viam tuam. <l eID="gen17001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7227"/><l level="1" sID="gen17002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7227"/>Ante omnia opera verbum verax præcedat te, <l eID="gen17002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17003"/>et ante omnem actum consilium stabile. <l eID="gen17003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7228"/><l level="1" sID="gen17004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7228"/>Verbum nequam immutabit cor : <l eID="gen17004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17005"/>ex quo partes quatuor oriuntur : <l eID="gen17005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17006"/>bonum et malum, vita et mors : <l eID="gen17006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17007"/>et dominatrix illorum est assidua lingua. <l eID="gen17007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17008"/>Est vir astutus multorum eruditor, <l eID="gen17008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17009"/>et animæ suæ inutilis est. <l eID="gen17009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7229"/><l level="1" sID="gen17010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7229"/>Vir peritus multos erudivit, <l eID="gen17010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17011"/>et animæ suæ suavis est. <l eID="gen17011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7230"/><l level="1" sID="gen17012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7230"/>Qui sophistice loquitur odibilis est : <l eID="gen17012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17013"/>in omni re defraudabitur. <l eID="gen17013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7231"/><l level="1" sID="gen17014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7231"/>Non est illi data a Domino gratia, <l eID="gen17014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17015"/>omni enim sapientia defraudatus est. <l eID="gen17015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7232"/><l level="1" sID="gen17016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7232"/>Est sapiens animæ suæ sapiens, <l eID="gen17016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17017"/>et fructus sensus illius laudabilis. <l eID="gen17017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7233"/><l level="1" sID="gen17018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7233"/>Vir sapiens plebem suam erudit, <l eID="gen17018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17019"/>et fructus sensus illius fideles sunt. <l eID="gen17019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7234"/><l level="1" sID="gen17020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7234"/>Vir sapiens implebitur benedictionibus, <l eID="gen17020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17021"/>et videntes illum laudabunt. <l eID="gen17021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7235"/><l level="1" sID="gen17022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7235"/>Vita viri in numero dierum : <l eID="gen17022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17023"/>dies autem Israël innumerabiles sunt. <l eID="gen17023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7236"/><l level="1" sID="gen17024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7236"/>Sapiens in populo hæreditabit honorem, <l eID="gen17024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17025"/>et nomen illius erit vivens in æternum. <l eID="gen17025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7237"/><l level="1" sID="gen17026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7237"/>Fili, in vita tua tenta animam tuam, <l eID="gen17026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17027"/>et si fuerit nequam non des illi potestatem : <l eID="gen17027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7238"/><l level="1" sID="gen17028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7238"/>non enim omnia omnibus expediunt, <l eID="gen17028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17029"/>et non omni animæ omne genus placet. <l eID="gen17029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7239"/><l level="1" sID="gen17030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7239"/>Noli avidus esse in omni epulatione, <l eID="gen17030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17031"/>et non te effundas super omnem escam : <l eID="gen17031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7240"/><l level="1" sID="gen17032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7240"/>in multis enim escis erit infirmitas, <l eID="gen17032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17033"/>et aviditas appropinquabit usque ad choleram. <l eID="gen17033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 37:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7241"/><l level="1" sID="gen17034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7241"/>Propter crapulam multi obierunt : <l eID="gen17034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17035"/>qui autem abstinens est adjiciet vitam.  <chapter eID="Sir.37"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:1
verses.text: Honora medicum propter necessitatem : <l eID="gen17036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17037"/>etenim illum creavit Altissimus. <l eID="gen17037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7242"/><l level="1" sID="gen17038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7242"/>A Deo est enim omnis medela, <l eID="gen17038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17039"/>et a rege accipiet donationem. <l eID="gen17039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7243"/><l level="1" sID="gen17040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7243"/>Disciplina medici exaltabit caput illius, <l eID="gen17040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17041"/>et in conspectu magnatorum collaudabitur. <l eID="gen17041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7244"/><l level="1" sID="gen17042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7244"/>Altissimus creavit de terra medicamenta, <l eID="gen17042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17043"/>et vir prudens non abhorrebit illa. <l eID="gen17043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7245"/><l level="1" sID="gen17044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7245"/>Nonne a ligno indulcata est aqua amara ? <l eID="gen17044" level="1"/>
