verses.name: Sirach 38:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7246"/><l level="1" sID="gen17045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7246"/>Ad agnitionem hominum virtus illorum : <l eID="gen17045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17046"/>et dedit hominibus scientiam Altissimus, <l eID="gen17046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17047"/>honorari in mirabilibus suis. <l eID="gen17047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7247"/><l level="1" sID="gen17048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7247"/>In his curans mitigabit dolorem : <l eID="gen17048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17049"/>et unguentarius faciet pigmenta suavitatis, <l eID="gen17049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17050"/>et unctiones conficiet sanitatis : <l eID="gen17050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17051"/>et non consummabuntur opera ejus. <l eID="gen17051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7248"/><l level="1" sID="gen17052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7248"/>Pax enim Dei super faciem terræ. <l eID="gen17052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7249"/><l level="1" sID="gen17053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7249"/>Fili, in tua infirmitate ne despicias teipsum : <l eID="gen17053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17054"/>sed ora Dominum, et ipse curabit te. <l eID="gen17054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7250"/><l level="1" sID="gen17055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7250"/>Averte a delicto, et dirige manus, <l eID="gen17055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17056"/>et ab omni delicto munda cor tuum. <l eID="gen17056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7251"/><l level="1" sID="gen17057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7251"/>Da suavitatem et memoriam similaginis, <l eID="gen17057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17058"/>et impingua oblationem, et da locum medico : <l eID="gen17058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7252"/><l level="1" sID="gen17059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7252"/>etenim illum Dominus creavit, et non discedat a te, <l eID="gen17059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17060"/>quia opera ejus sunt necessaria. <l eID="gen17060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7253"/><l level="1" sID="gen17061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7253"/>Est enim tempus quando in manus illorum incurras : <l eID="gen17061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7254"/><l level="1" sID="gen17062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7254"/>ipsi vero Dominum deprecabuntur, ut dirigat requiem eorum, <l eID="gen17062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17063"/>et sanitatem, propter conversationem illorum. <l eID="gen17063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7255"/><l level="1" sID="gen17064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7255"/>Qui delinquit in conspectu ejus qui fecit eum, <l eID="gen17064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17065"/>incidet in manus medici. <l eID="gen17065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7256"/><l level="1" sID="gen17066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7256"/>Fili, in mortuum produc lacrimas, <l eID="gen17066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17067"/>et quasi dira passus incipe plorare : <l eID="gen17067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17068"/>et secundum judicium contege corpus illius, <l eID="gen17068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17069"/>et non despicias sepulturam illius. <l eID="gen17069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7257"/><l level="1" sID="gen17070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7257"/>Propter delaturam autem amare fer luctum illius uno die, <l eID="gen17070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17071"/>et consolare propter tristitiam : <l eID="gen17071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7258"/><l level="1" sID="gen17072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7258"/>et fac luctum secundum meritum ejus <l eID="gen17072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17073"/>uno die, vel duobus, propter detractionem : <l eID="gen17073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7259"/><l level="1" sID="gen17074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7259"/>a tristitia enim festinat mors, et cooperit virtutem, <l eID="gen17074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17075"/>et tristitia cordis flectit cervicem. <l eID="gen17075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7260"/><l level="1" sID="gen17076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7260"/>In abductione permanet tristitia, <l eID="gen17076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17077"/>et substantia inopis secundum cor ejus. <l eID="gen17077" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7261"/><l level="1" sID="gen17078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7261"/>Ne dederis in tristitia cor tuum, <l eID="gen17078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17079"/>sed repelle eam a te, et memento novissimorum. <l eID="gen17079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7262"/><l level="1" sID="gen17080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7262"/>Noli oblivisci, neque enim est conversio : <l eID="gen17080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17081"/>et huic nihil proderis, et teipsum pessimabis. <l eID="gen17081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7263"/><l level="1" sID="gen17082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7263"/>Memor esto judicii mei : sic enim erit et tuum : <l eID="gen17082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17083"/>mihi heri, et tibi hodie. <l eID="gen17083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7264"/><l level="1" sID="gen17084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7264"/>In requie mortui requiescere fac memoriam ejus, <l eID="gen17084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17085"/>et consolare illum in exitu spiritus sui. <l eID="gen17085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7265"/><l level="1" sID="gen17086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7265"/>Sapientia scribæ in tempore vacuitatis, <l eID="gen17086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17087"/>et qui minoratur actu sapientiam percipiet, <l eID="gen17087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17088"/>qua sapientia replebitur. <l eID="gen17088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7266"/><l level="1" sID="gen17089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7266"/>Qui tenet aratrum, <l eID="gen17089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17090"/>et qui gloriatur in jaculo, stimulo boves agitat, <l eID="gen17090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17091"/>et conversatur in operibus eorum, <l eID="gen17091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17092"/>et enarratio ejus in filiis taurorum. <l eID="gen17092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7267"/><l level="1" sID="gen17093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7267"/>Cor suum dabit ad versandos sulcos, <l eID="gen17093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17094"/>et vigilia ejus in sagina vaccarum. <l eID="gen17094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7268"/><l level="1" sID="gen17095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7268"/>Sic omnis faber et architectus, <l eID="gen17095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17096"/>qui noctem tamquam diem transigit : <l eID="gen17096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17097"/>qui sculpit signacula sculptilia, <l eID="gen17097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17098"/>et assiduitas ejus variat picturam : <l eID="gen17098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17099"/>cor suum dabit in similitudinem picturæ, <l eID="gen17099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17100"/>et vigilia sua perficiet opus. <l eID="gen17100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7269"/><l level="1" sID="gen17101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7269"/>Sic faber ferrarius sedens juxta incudem, <l eID="gen17101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17102"/>et considerans opus ferri : <l eID="gen17102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17103"/>vapor ignis uret carnes ejus, <l eID="gen17103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17104"/>et in calore fornacis concertatur. <l eID="gen17104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7270"/><l level="1" sID="gen17105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7270"/>Vox mallei innovat aurem ejus, <l eID="gen17105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17106"/>et contra similitudinem vasis oculus ejus. <l eID="gen17106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7271"/><l level="1" sID="gen17107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7271"/>Cor suum dabit in consummationem operum, <l eID="gen17107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17108"/>et vigilia sua ornabit in perfectionem. <l eID="gen17108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7272"/><l level="1" sID="gen17109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7272"/>Sic figulus sedens ad opus suum, <l eID="gen17109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17110"/>convertens pedibus suis rotam, <l eID="gen17110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17111"/>qui in sollicitudine positus est semper propter opus suum, <l eID="gen17111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17112"/>et in numero est omnis operatio ejus. <l eID="gen17112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7273"/><l level="1" sID="gen17113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7273"/>In brachio suo formabit lutum, <l eID="gen17113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17114"/>et ante pedes suos curvabit virtutem suam. <l eID="gen17114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7274"/><l level="1" sID="gen17115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7274"/>Cor suum dabit ut consummet linitionem, <l eID="gen17115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17116"/>et vigilia sua mundabit fornacem. <l eID="gen17116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7275"/><l level="1" sID="gen17117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7275"/>Omnes hi in manibus suis speraverunt, <l eID="gen17117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17118"/>et unusquisque in arte sua sapiens est. <l eID="gen17118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7276"/><l level="1" sID="gen17119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7276"/>Sine his omnibus non ædificatur civitas, <l eID="gen17119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7277"/><l level="1" sID="gen17120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7277"/>et non inhabitabunt, nec inambulabunt, <l eID="gen17120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17121"/>et in ecclesiam non transilient. <l eID="gen17121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7278"/><l level="1" sID="gen17122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7278"/>Super sellam judicis non sedebunt, <l eID="gen17122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17123"/>et testamentum judicii non intelligent, <l eID="gen17123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17124"/>neque palam facient disciplinam et judicium, <l eID="gen17124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17125"/>et in parabolis non invenientur : <l eID="gen17125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 38:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7279"/><l level="1" sID="gen17126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7279"/>sed creaturam ævi confirmabunt : <l eID="gen17126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17127"/>et deprecatio illorum in operatione artis, <l eID="gen17127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17128"/>accomodantes animam suam, <l eID="gen17128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17129"/>et conquirentes in lege Altissimi.  <chapter eID="Sir.38"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:1
verses.text: Sapientiam omnium antiquorum exquiret sapiens, <l eID="gen17130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17131"/>et in prophetis vacabit. <l eID="gen17131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7280"/><l level="1" sID="gen17132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7280"/>Narrationem virorum nominatorum conservabit, <l eID="gen17132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17133"/>et in versutias parabolarum simul introibit. <l eID="gen17133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7281"/><l level="1" sID="gen17134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7281"/>Occulta proverbiorum exquiret, <l eID="gen17134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17135"/>et in absconditis parabolarum conversabitur. <l eID="gen17135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7282"/><l level="1" sID="gen17136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7282"/>In medio magnatorum ministrabit, <l eID="gen17136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17137"/>et in conspectu præsidis apparebit. <l eID="gen17137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7283"/><l level="1" sID="gen17138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7283"/>In terram alienigenarum gentium pertransiet : <l eID="gen17138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17139"/>bona enim et mala in hominibus tentabit. <l eID="gen17139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7284"/><l level="1" sID="gen17140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7284"/>Cor suum tradet ad vigilandum diluculo ad Dominum, qui fecit illum, <l eID="gen17140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17141"/>et in conspectu Altissimi deprecabitur. <l eID="gen17141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7285"/><l level="1" sID="gen17142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7285"/>Aperiet os suum in oratione, <l eID="gen17142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17143"/>et pro delictis suis deprecabitur. <l eID="gen17143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7286"/><l level="1" sID="gen17144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7286"/>Si enim Dominus magnus voluerit, <l eID="gen17144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17145"/>spiritu intelligentiæ replebit illum : <l eID="gen17145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7287"/><l level="1" sID="gen17146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7287"/>et ipse tamquam imbres mittet eloquia sapientiæ suæ, <l eID="gen17146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17147"/>et in oratione confitebitur Domino : <l eID="gen17147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7288"/><l level="1" sID="gen17148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7288"/>et ipse diriget consilium ejus, et disciplinam, <l eID="gen17148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17149"/>et in absconditis suis consiliabitur. <l eID="gen17149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7289"/><l level="1" sID="gen17150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7289"/>Ipse palam faciet disciplinam doctrinæ suæ, <l eID="gen17150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17151"/>et in lege testamenti Domini gloriabitur. <l eID="gen17151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7290"/><l level="1" sID="gen17152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7290"/>Collaudabunt multi sapientiam ejus, <l eID="gen17152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17153"/>et usque in sæculum non delebitur. <l eID="gen17153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7291"/><l level="1" sID="gen17154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7291"/>Non recedet memoria ejus, <l eID="gen17154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17155"/>et nomen ejus requiretur a generatione in generationem. <l eID="gen17155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7292"/><l level="1" sID="gen17156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7292"/>Sapientiam ejus enarrabunt gentes, <l eID="gen17156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17157"/>et laudem ejus enuntiabit ecclesia. <l eID="gen17157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7293"/><l level="1" sID="gen17158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7293"/>Si permanserit, nomen derelinquet plus quam mille : <l eID="gen17158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17159"/>et si requieverit, proderit illi. <l eID="gen17159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7294"/><l level="1" sID="gen17160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7294"/>Adhuc consiliabor ut enarrem : <l eID="gen17160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17161"/>ut furore enim repletus sum. <l eID="gen17161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7295"/><l level="1" sID="gen17162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7295"/>In voce dicit : Obaudite me, divini fructus, <l eID="gen17162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17163"/>et quasi rosa plantata super rivos aquarum fructificate. <l eID="gen17163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7296"/><l level="1" sID="gen17164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7296"/>Quasi Libanus odorem suavitatis habete. <l eID="gen17164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7297"/><l level="1" sID="gen17165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7297"/>Florete flores quasi lilium : <l eID="gen17165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17166"/>et date odorem, et frondete in gratiam : <l eID="gen17166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17167"/>et collaudate canticum, et benedicite Dominum in operibus suis. <l eID="gen17167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7298"/><l level="1" sID="gen17168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7298"/>Date nomini ejus magnificentiam, <l eID="gen17168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17169"/>et confitemini illi in voce labiorum vestrorum, <l eID="gen17169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17170"/>et in canticis labiorum, et citharis : <l eID="gen17170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17171"/>et sic dicetis in confessione : <l eID="gen17171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7299"/><l level="1" sID="gen17172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7299"/>Opera Domini universa bona valde. <l eID="gen17172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7300"/><l level="1" sID="gen17173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7300"/>In verbo ejus stetit aqua sicut congeries : <l eID="gen17173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17174"/>et in sermone oris illius sicut exceptoria aquarum : <l eID="gen17174" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7301"/><l level="1" sID="gen17175"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7301"/>quoniam in præcepto ipsius placor fit, <l eID="gen17175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17176"/>et non est minoratio in salute ipsius. <l eID="gen17176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7302"/><l level="1" sID="gen17177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7302"/>Opera omnis carnis coram illo, <l eID="gen17177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17178"/>et non est quidquam absconditum ab oculis ejus. <l eID="gen17178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7303"/><l level="1" sID="gen17179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7303"/>A sæculo usque in sæculum respicit, <l eID="gen17179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17180"/>et nihil est mirabile in conspectu ejus. <l eID="gen17180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7304"/><l level="1" sID="gen17181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7304"/>Non est dicere : Quid est hoc, aut quid est istud ? <l eID="gen17181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17182"/>omnia enim in tempore suo quærentur. <l eID="gen17182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7305"/><l level="1" sID="gen17183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7305"/>Benedictio illius quasi fluvius inundavit. <l eID="gen17183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7306"/><l level="1" sID="gen17184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7306"/>Quomodo cataclysmus aridam inebriavit, <l eID="gen17184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17185"/>sic ira ipsius gentes quæ non exquisierunt eum hæreditabit. <l eID="gen17185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7307"/><l level="1" sID="gen17186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7307"/>Quomodo convertit aquas in siccitatem, et siccata est terra, <l eID="gen17186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17187"/>et viæ illius viis illorum directæ sunt, <l eID="gen17187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17188"/>sic peccatoribus offensiones in ira ejus. <l eID="gen17188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7308"/><l level="1" sID="gen17189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7308"/>Bona bonis creata sunt ab initio : <l eID="gen17189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17190"/>sic nequissimis bona et mala. <l eID="gen17190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7309"/><l level="1" sID="gen17191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7309"/>Initium necessariæ rei vitæ hominum, aqua, ignis, et ferrum, <l eID="gen17191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17192"/>sal, lac, et panis similagineus, et mel, <l eID="gen17192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17193"/>et botrus uvæ, et oleum, et vestimentum. <l eID="gen17193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7310"/><l level="1" sID="gen17194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7310"/>Hæc omnia sanctis in bona, <l eID="gen17194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17195"/>sic et impiis et peccatoribus in mala convertentur. <l eID="gen17195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7311"/><l level="1" sID="gen17196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7311"/>Sunt spiritus qui ad vindictam creati sunt, <l eID="gen17196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17197"/>et in furore suo confirmaverunt tormenta sua. <l eID="gen17197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7312"/><l level="1" sID="gen17198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7312"/>In tempore consummationis effundent virtutem, <l eID="gen17198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17199"/>et furorem ejus qui fecit illos placabunt. <l eID="gen17199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7313"/><l level="1" sID="gen17200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7313"/>Ignis, grando, fames, et mors, <l eID="gen17200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17201"/>omnia hæc ad vindictam creata sunt : <l eID="gen17201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7314"/><l level="1" sID="gen17202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7314"/>bestiarum dentes, et scorpii, et serpentes, <l eID="gen17202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17203"/>et rhomphæa vindicans in exterminium impios. <l eID="gen17203" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7315"/><l level="1" sID="gen17204"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7315"/>In mandatis ejus epulabuntur : <l eID="gen17204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17205"/>et super terram in necessitatem præparabuntur, <l eID="gen17205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17206"/>et in temporibus suis non præterient verbum. <l eID="gen17206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7316"/><l level="1" sID="gen17207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7316"/>Propterea ab initio confirmatus sum, et consiliatus sum, <l eID="gen17207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17208"/>et cogitavi, et scripta dimisi. <l eID="gen17208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7317"/><l level="1" sID="gen17209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7317"/>Omnia opera Domini bona, <l eID="gen17209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17210"/>et omne opus hora sua subministrabit. <l eID="gen17210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7318"/><l level="1" sID="gen17211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7318"/>Non est dicere : Hoc illo nequius est : <l eID="gen17211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17212"/>omnia enim in tempore suo comprobabuntur. <l eID="gen17212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 39:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7319"/><l level="1" sID="gen17213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7319"/>Et nunc in omni corde et ore collaudate, <l eID="gen17213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17214"/>et benedicite nomen Domini.  <chapter eID="Sir.39"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:1
verses.text: Occupatio magna creata est omnibus hominibus, <l eID="gen17215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17216"/>et jugum grave super filios Adam, <l eID="gen17216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17217"/>a die exitus de ventre matris eorum <l eID="gen17217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17218"/>usque in diem sepulturæ in matrem omnium. <l eID="gen17218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7320"/><l level="1" sID="gen17219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7320"/>Cogitationes eorum, et timores cordis, <l eID="gen17219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17220"/>adinventio exspectationis, et dies finitionis, <l eID="gen17220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7321"/><l level="1" sID="gen17221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7321"/>a residente super sedem gloriosam, <l eID="gen17221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17222"/>usque ad humiliatum in terra et cinere : <l eID="gen17222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7322"/><l level="1" sID="gen17223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7322"/>ab eo qui utitur hyacintho et portat coronam, <l eID="gen17223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17224"/>usque ad eum qui operitur lino crudo : <l eID="gen17224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17225"/>furor, zelus, tumultus, fluctuatio, et timor mortis, <l eID="gen17225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17226"/>iracundia perseverans, et contentio : <l eID="gen17226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7323"/><l level="1" sID="gen17227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7323"/>et in tempore refectionis in cubili, <l eID="gen17227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17228"/>somnus noctis immutat scientiam ejus. <l eID="gen17228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7324"/><l level="1" sID="gen17229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7324"/>Modicum tamquam nihil in requie, <l eID="gen17229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17230"/>et ab eo in somnis, quasi in die respectus. <l eID="gen17230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7325"/><l level="1" sID="gen17231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7325"/>Conturbatus est in visu cordis sui, <l eID="gen17231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17232"/>tamquam qui evaserit in die belli : <l eID="gen17232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17233"/>in tempore salutis suæ exsurrexit, <l eID="gen17233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17234"/>et admirans ad nullum timorem : <l eID="gen17234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7326"/><l level="1" sID="gen17235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7326"/>cum omni carne, ab homine usque ad pecus, <l eID="gen17235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17236"/>et super peccatores septuplum. <l eID="gen17236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7327"/><l level="1" sID="gen17237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7327"/>Ad hæc mors, sanguis, contentio, et rhomphæa, <l eID="gen17237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17238"/>oppressiones, fames, et contritio, et flagella : <l eID="gen17238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7328"/><l level="1" sID="gen17239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7328"/>super iniquos creata sunt hæc omnia : <l eID="gen17239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17240"/>et propter illos factus est cataclysmus. <l eID="gen17240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7329"/><l level="1" sID="gen17241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7329"/>Omnia quæ de terra sunt in terram convertentur, <l eID="gen17241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17242"/>et omnes aquæ in mare revertentur. <l eID="gen17242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7330"/><l level="1" sID="gen17243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7330"/>Omne munus et iniquitas delebitur, <l eID="gen17243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17244"/>et fides in sæculum stabit. <l eID="gen17244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7331"/><l level="1" sID="gen17245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7331"/>Substantiæ injustorum sicut fluvius siccabuntur, <l eID="gen17245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17246"/>et sicut tonitruum magnum in pluvia personabunt. <l eID="gen17246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7332"/><l level="1" sID="gen17247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7332"/>In aperiendo manus suas lætabitur : <l eID="gen17247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17248"/>sic prævaricatores in consummatione tabescent. <l eID="gen17248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7333"/><l level="1" sID="gen17249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7333"/>Nepotes impiorum non multiplicabunt ramos : <l eID="gen17249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17250"/>et radices immundæ super cacumen petræ sonant. <l eID="gen17250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7334"/><l level="1" sID="gen17251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7334"/>Super omnem aquam viriditas, <l eID="gen17251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17252"/>et ad oram fluminis ante omne fœnum evelletur. <l eID="gen17252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7335"/><l level="1" sID="gen17253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7335"/>Gratia sicut paradisus in benedictionibus, <l eID="gen17253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17254"/>et misericordia in sæculum permanet. <l eID="gen17254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7336"/><l level="1" sID="gen17255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7336"/>Vita sibi sufficientis operarii condulcabitur, <l eID="gen17255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17256"/>et in ea invenies thesaurum. <l eID="gen17256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7337"/><l level="1" sID="gen17257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7337"/>Filii et ædificatio civitatis confirmabit nomen : <l eID="gen17257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17258"/>et super hæc mulier immaculata computabitur. <l eID="gen17258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7338"/><l level="1" sID="gen17259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7338"/>Vinum et musica lætificant cor : <l eID="gen17259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17260"/>et super utraque dilectio sapientiæ. <l eID="gen17260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7339"/><l level="1" sID="gen17261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7339"/>Tibiæ et psalterium suavem faciunt melodiam : <l eID="gen17261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17262"/>et super utraque lingua suavis. <l eID="gen17262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7340"/><l level="1" sID="gen17263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7340"/>Gratiam et speciem desiderabit oculus tuus : <l eID="gen17263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17264"/>et super hæc virides sationes. <l eID="gen17264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7341"/><l level="1" sID="gen17265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7341"/>Amicus et sodalis in tempore convenientes, <l eID="gen17265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17266"/>et super utrosque mulier cum viro. <l eID="gen17266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7342"/><l level="1" sID="gen17267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7342"/>Fratres in adjutorium in tempore tribulationis : <l eID="gen17267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17268"/>et super eos misericordia liberabit. <l eID="gen17268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7343"/><l level="1" sID="gen17269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7343"/>Aurum et argentum est constitutio pedum : <l eID="gen17269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17270"/>et super utrumque consilium beneplacitum. <l eID="gen17270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7344"/><l level="1" sID="gen17271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7344"/>Facultates et virtutes exaltant cor, <l eID="gen17271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17272"/>et super hæc timor Domini. <l eID="gen17272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7345"/><l level="1" sID="gen17273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7345"/>Non est in timore Domini minoratio : <l eID="gen17273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17274"/>et non est in eo inquirere adjutorium. <l eID="gen17274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7346"/><l level="1" sID="gen17275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7346"/>Timor Domini sicut paradisus benedictionis, <l eID="gen17275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17276"/>et super omnem gloriam operuerunt illum. <l eID="gen17276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7347"/><l level="1" sID="gen17277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7347"/>Fili, in tempore vitæ tuæ ne indigeas : <l eID="gen17277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17278"/>melius est enim mori quam indigere. <l eID="gen17278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7348"/><l level="1" sID="gen17279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7348"/>Vir respiciens in mensam alienam, <l eID="gen17279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17280"/>non est vita ejus in cogitatione victus : <l eID="gen17280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17281"/>alit enim animam suam cibis alienis : <l eID="gen17281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7349"/><l level="1" sID="gen17282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7349"/>vir autem disciplinatus et eruditus custodiet se. <l eID="gen17282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 40:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7350"/><l level="1" sID="gen17283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7350"/>In ore imprudentis condulcabitur inopia, <l eID="gen17283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17284"/>et in ventre ejus ignis ardebit.  <chapter eID="Sir.40"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:1
verses.text: O mors, quam amara est memoria tua <l eID="gen17285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17286"/>homini pacem habenti in substantiis suis : <l eID="gen17286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7351"/><l level="1" sID="gen17287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7351"/>viro quieto, et cujus viæ directæ sunt in omnibus, <l eID="gen17287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17288"/>et adhuc valenti accipere cibum ! <l eID="gen17288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7352"/><l level="1" sID="gen17289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7352"/>O mors, bonum est judicium tuum homini indigenti, <l eID="gen17289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17290"/>et qui minoratur viribus, <l eID="gen17290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7353"/><l level="1" sID="gen17291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7353"/>defecto ætate, et cui de omnibus cura est, <l eID="gen17291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17292"/>et incredibili, qui perdit patientiam ! <l eID="gen17292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7354"/><l level="1" sID="gen17293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7354"/>Noli metuere judicium mortis : <l eID="gen17293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17294"/>memento quæ ante te fuerunt, <l eID="gen17294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17295"/>et quæ superventura sunt tibi : <l eID="gen17295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17296"/>hoc judicium a Domino omni carni. <l eID="gen17296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7355"/><l level="1" sID="gen17297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7355"/>Et quid superveniet tibi in beneplacito Altissimi ? <l eID="gen17297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17298"/>sive decem, sive centum, sive mille anni : <l eID="gen17298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7356"/><l level="1" sID="gen17299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7356"/>non est enim in inferno accusatio vitæ. <l eID="gen17299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7357"/><l level="1" sID="gen17300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7357"/>Filii abominationum fiunt filii peccatorum, <l eID="gen17300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17301"/>et qui conversantur secus domos impiorum. <l eID="gen17301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7358"/><l level="1" sID="gen17302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7358"/>Filiorum peccatorum periet hæreditas, <l eID="gen17302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17303"/>et cum semine illorum assiduitas opprobrii. <l eID="gen17303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7359"/><l level="1" sID="gen17304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7359"/>De patre impio queruntur filii, <l eID="gen17304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17305"/>quoniam propter illum sunt in opprobrio. <l eID="gen17305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7360"/><l level="1" sID="gen17306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7360"/>Væ vobis, viri impii, <l eID="gen17306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17307"/>qui dereliquistis legem Domini Altissimi ! <l eID="gen17307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7361"/><l level="1" sID="gen17308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7361"/>Et si nati fueritis, in maledictione nascemini : <l eID="gen17308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17309"/>et si mortui fueritis, in maledictione erit pars vestra. <l eID="gen17309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7362"/><l level="1" sID="gen17310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7362"/>Omnia quæ de terra sunt in terram convertentur : <l eID="gen17310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17311"/>sic impii a maledicto in perditionem. <l eID="gen17311" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7363"/><l level="1" sID="gen17312"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7363"/>Luctus hominum in corpore ipsorum : <l eID="gen17312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17313"/>nomen autem impiorum delebitur. <l eID="gen17313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7364"/><l level="1" sID="gen17314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7364"/>Curam habe de bono nomine : <l eID="gen17314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17315"/>hoc enim magis permanebit tibi <l eID="gen17315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17316"/>quam mille thesauri pretiosi et magni. <l eID="gen17316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7365"/><l level="1" sID="gen17317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7365"/>Bonæ vitæ numerus dierum : <l eID="gen17317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17318"/>bonum autem nomen permanebit in ævum. <l eID="gen17318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7366"/><l level="1" sID="gen17319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7366"/>Disciplinam in pace conservate, filii : <l eID="gen17319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17320"/>sapientia enim abscondita, et thesaurus invisus, <l eID="gen17320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17321"/>quæ utilitas in utrisque ? <l eID="gen17321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7367"/><l level="1" sID="gen17322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7367"/>Melior est homo qui abscondit stultitiam suam, <l eID="gen17322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17323"/>quam homo qui abscondit sapientiam suam. <l eID="gen17323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7368"/><l level="1" sID="gen17324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7368"/>Verumtamen reveremini in his quæ procedunt de ore meo : <l eID="gen17324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7369"/><l level="1" sID="gen17325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7369"/>non est enim bonum omnem reverentiam observare, <l eID="gen17325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17326"/>et non omnia omnibus bene placent in fide. <l eID="gen17326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7370"/><l level="1" sID="gen17327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7370"/>Erubescite a patre et a matre de fornicatione : <l eID="gen17327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17328"/>et a præsidente et a potente de mendacio : <l eID="gen17328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7371"/><l level="1" sID="gen17329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7371"/>a principe et a judice de delicto : <l eID="gen17329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17330"/>a synagoga et plebe de iniquitate : <l eID="gen17330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7372"/><l level="1" sID="gen17331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7372"/>a socio et amico de injustitia, <l eID="gen17331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17332"/>et de loco in quo habitas : <l eID="gen17332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7373"/><l level="1" sID="gen17333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7373"/>de furto, de veritate Dei, et testamento : <l eID="gen17333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17334"/>de discubitu in panibus, et ab obfuscatione dati et accepti : <l eID="gen17334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7374"/><l level="1" sID="gen17335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7374"/>a salutantibus de silentio, <l eID="gen17335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17336"/>a respectu mulieris fornicariæ, <l eID="gen17336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17337"/>et ab aversione vultus cognati. <l eID="gen17337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7375"/><l level="1" sID="gen17338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7375"/>Ne avertas faciem a proximo tuo, <l eID="gen17338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17339"/>et ab auferendo partem et non restituendo. <l eID="gen17339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7376"/><l level="1" sID="gen17340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7376"/>Ne respicias mulierem alieni viri, <l eID="gen17340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17341"/>et ne scruteris ancillam ejus, <l eID="gen17341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17342"/>neque steteris ad lectum ejus. <l eID="gen17342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 41:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7377"/><l level="1" sID="gen17343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7377"/>Ab amicis de sermonibus improperii : <l eID="gen17343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17344"/>et cum dederis, ne improperes.  <chapter eID="Sir.41"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:1
verses.text: Non duplices sermonem auditus de revelatione sermonis absconditi : <l eID="gen17345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17346"/>et eris vere sine confusione, <l eID="gen17346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17347"/>et invenies gratiam in conspectu omnium hominum. <l eID="gen17347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17348"/>Ne pro his omnibus confundaris, <l eID="gen17348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17349"/>et ne accipias personam ut delinquas : <l eID="gen17349" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7378"/><l level="1" sID="gen17350"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7378"/>de lege Altissimi, et testamento, <l eID="gen17350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17351"/>et de judicio justificare impium, <l eID="gen17351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7379"/><l level="1" sID="gen17352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7379"/>de verbo sociorum et viatorum, <l eID="gen17352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17353"/>et de datione hæreditatis amicorum, <l eID="gen17353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7380"/><l level="1" sID="gen17354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7380"/>de æqualitate stateræ et ponderum, <l eID="gen17354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17355"/>de acquisitione multorum et paucorum, <l eID="gen17355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7381"/><l level="1" sID="gen17356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7381"/>de corruptione emptionis et negotiatorum, <l eID="gen17356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17357"/>et de multa disciplina filiorum, <l eID="gen17357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17358"/>et servo pessimo latus sanguinare. <l eID="gen17358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7382"/><l level="1" sID="gen17359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7382"/>Super mulierem nequam bonum est signum. <l eID="gen17359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7383"/><l level="1" sID="gen17360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7383"/>Ubi manus multæ sunt, claude : <l eID="gen17360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17361"/>et quodcumque trades, numera et appende : <l eID="gen17361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17362"/>datum vero et acceptum omne describe. <l eID="gen17362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7384"/><l level="1" sID="gen17363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7384"/>De disciplina insensati et fatui, <l eID="gen17363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17364"/>et de senioribus qui judicantur ab adolescentibus : <l eID="gen17364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17365"/>et eris eruditus in omnibus, <l eID="gen17365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17366"/>et probabilis in conspectu omnium vivorum. <l eID="gen17366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7385"/><l level="1" sID="gen17367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7385"/>Filia patris abscondita est vigilia, <l eID="gen17367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17368"/>et sollicitudo ejus aufert somnum : <l eID="gen17368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17369"/>ne forte in adolescentia sua adulta efficiatur, <l eID="gen17369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17370"/>et cum viro commorata odibilis fiat : <l eID="gen17370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7386"/><l level="1" sID="gen17371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7386"/>nequando polluatur in virginitate sua, <l eID="gen17371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17372"/>et in paternis suis gravida inveniatur : <l eID="gen17372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17373"/>ne forte cum viro commorata transgrediatur, <l eID="gen17373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17374"/>aut certe sterilis efficiatur. <l eID="gen17374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7387"/><l level="1" sID="gen17375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7387"/>Super filiam luxuriosam confirma custodiam, <l eID="gen17375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17376"/>nequando faciat te in opprobrium venire inimicis, <l eID="gen17376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17377"/>a detractione in civitate, et objectione plebis, <l eID="gen17377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17378"/>et confundat te in multitudine populi. <l eID="gen17378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7388"/><l level="1" sID="gen17379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7388"/>Omni homini noli intendere in specie, <l eID="gen17379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17380"/>et in medio mulierum noli commorari : <l eID="gen17380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7389"/><l level="1" sID="gen17381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7389"/>de vestimentis enim procedit tinea, <l eID="gen17381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17382"/>et a muliere iniquitas viri. <l eID="gen17382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7390"/><l level="1" sID="gen17383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7390"/>Melior est enim iniquitas viri quam mulier benefaciens, <l eID="gen17383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17384"/>et mulier confundens in opprobrium. <l eID="gen17384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7391"/><l level="1" sID="gen17385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7391"/>Memor ero igitur operum Domini, <l eID="gen17385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17386"/>et quæ vidi annuntiabo. <l eID="gen17386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17387"/>In sermonibus Domini opera ejus. <l eID="gen17387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7392"/><l level="1" sID="gen17388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7392"/>Sol illuminans per omnia respexit, <l eID="gen17388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17389"/>et gloria Domini plenum est opus ejus. <l eID="gen17389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7393"/><l level="1" sID="gen17390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7393"/>Nonne Dominus fecit sanctos enarrare omnia mirabilia sua, <l eID="gen17390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17391"/>quæ confirmavit Dominus omnipotens stabiliri in gloria sua ? <l eID="gen17391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7394"/><l level="1" sID="gen17392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7394"/>Abyssum et cor hominum investigavit, <l eID="gen17392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17393"/>et in astutia eorum excogitavit. <l eID="gen17393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7395"/><l level="1" sID="gen17394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7395"/>Cognovit enim Dominus omnem scientiam, <l eID="gen17394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17395"/>et inspexit in signum ævi, <l eID="gen17395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17396"/>annuntians quæ præterierunt et quæ superventura sunt, <l eID="gen17396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17397"/>revelans vestigia occultorum. <l eID="gen17397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7396"/><l level="1" sID="gen17398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7396"/>Non præterit illum omnis cogitatus, <l eID="gen17398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17399"/>et non abscondit se ab eo ullus sermo. <l eID="gen17399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7397"/><l level="1" sID="gen17400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7397"/>Magnalia sapientiæ suæ decoravit, <l eID="gen17400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17401"/>qui est ante sæculum et usque in sæculum : <l eID="gen17401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17402"/>neque adjectum est, <l eID="gen17402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7398"/><l level="1" sID="gen17403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7398"/>neque minuitur, <l eID="gen17403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17404"/>et non eget alicujus consilio. <l eID="gen17404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7399"/><l level="1" sID="gen17405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7399"/>Quam desiderabilia omnia opera ejus ! <l eID="gen17405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17406"/>et tamquam scintilla quæ est considerare ! <l eID="gen17406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7400"/><l level="1" sID="gen17407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7400"/>Omnia hæc vivunt, et manent in sæculum, <l eID="gen17407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17408"/>et in omni necessitate omnia obaudiunt ei. <l eID="gen17408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7401"/><l level="1" sID="gen17409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7401"/>Omnia duplicia, unum contra unum, <l eID="gen17409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17410"/>et non fecit quidquam deesse. <l eID="gen17410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 42:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7402"/><l level="1" sID="gen17411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7402"/>Uniuscujusque confirmavit bona : <l eID="gen17411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17412"/>et quis satiabitur videns gloriam ejus ?  <chapter eID="Sir.42"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:1
verses.text: Altitudinis firmamentum pulchritudo ejus est, <l eID="gen17413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17414"/>species cæli in visione gloriæ. <l eID="gen17414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7403"/><l level="1" sID="gen17415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7403"/>Sol in aspectu annuntians in exitu, <l eID="gen17415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17416"/>vas admirabile, opus Excelsi. <l eID="gen17416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7404"/><l level="1" sID="gen17417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7404"/>In meridiano exurit terram, <l eID="gen17417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17418"/>et in conspectu ardoris ejus quis poterit sustinere ? <l eID="gen17418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17419"/>fornacem custodiens in operibus ardoris : <l eID="gen17419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7405"/><l level="1" sID="gen17420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7405"/>tripliciter sol exurens montes, <l eID="gen17420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17421"/>radios igneos exsufflans, <l eID="gen17421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17422"/>et refulgens radiis suis obcæcat oculos. <l eID="gen17422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7406"/><l level="1" sID="gen17423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7406"/>Magnus Dominus qui fecit illum, <l eID="gen17423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17424"/>et in sermonibus ejus festinavit iter. <l eID="gen17424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7407"/><l level="1" sID="gen17425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7407"/>Et luna in omnibus in tempore suo, <l eID="gen17425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17426"/>ostensio temporis, et signum ævi. <l eID="gen17426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7408"/><l level="1" sID="gen17427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7408"/>A luna signum diei festi : <l eID="gen17427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17428"/>luminare quod minuitur in consummatione. <l eID="gen17428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7409"/><l level="1" sID="gen17429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7409"/>Mensis secundum nomen ejus est, <l eID="gen17429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17430"/>crescens mirabiliter in consummatione. <l eID="gen17430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7410"/><l level="1" sID="gen17431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7410"/>Vas castrorum in excelsis, <l eID="gen17431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17432"/>in firmamento cæli resplendens gloriose. <l eID="gen17432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7411"/><l level="1" sID="gen17433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7411"/>Species cæli gloria stellarum : <l eID="gen17433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17434"/>mundum illuminans in excelsis Dominus. <l eID="gen17434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7412"/><l level="1" sID="gen17435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7412"/>In verbis Sancti stabunt ad judicium, <l eID="gen17435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17436"/>et non deficient in vigiliis suis. <l eID="gen17436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7413"/><l level="1" sID="gen17437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7413"/>Vide arcum, et benedic eum qui fecit illum : <l eID="gen17437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17438"/>valde speciosus est in splendore suo. <l eID="gen17438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7414"/><l level="1" sID="gen17439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7414"/>Gyravit cælum in circuitu gloriæ suæ : <l eID="gen17439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17440"/>manus Excelsi aperuerunt illum. <l eID="gen17440" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7415"/><l level="1" sID="gen17441"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7415"/>Imperio suo acceleravit nivem, <l eID="gen17441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17442"/>et accelerat coruscationes emittere judicii sui. <l eID="gen17442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7416"/><l level="1" sID="gen17443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7416"/>Propterea aperti sunt thesauri, <l eID="gen17443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17444"/>et evolaverunt nebulæ sicut aves. <l eID="gen17444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7417"/><l level="1" sID="gen17445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7417"/>In magnitudine sua posuit nubes, <l eID="gen17445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17446"/>et confracti sunt lapides grandinis. <l eID="gen17446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7418"/><l level="1" sID="gen17447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7418"/>In conspectu ejus commovebuntur montes, <l eID="gen17447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17448"/>et in voluntate ejus aspirabit notus. <l eID="gen17448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7419"/><l level="1" sID="gen17449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7419"/>Vox tonitrui ejus verberavit terram, <l eID="gen17449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17450"/>tempestas aquilonis, et congregatio spiritus : <l eID="gen17450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7420"/><l level="1" sID="gen17451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7420"/>et sicut avis deponens ad sedendum, aspergit nivem, <l eID="gen17451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17452"/>et sicut locusta demergens descensus ejus. <l eID="gen17452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7421"/><l level="1" sID="gen17453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7421"/>Pulchritudinem candoris ejus admirabitur oculus, <l eID="gen17453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17454"/>et super imbrem ejus expavescet cor. <l eID="gen17454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7422"/><l level="1" sID="gen17455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7422"/>Gelu sicut salem effundet super terram : <l eID="gen17455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17456"/>et dum gelaverit, fiet tamquam cacumina tribuli. <l eID="gen17456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7423"/><l level="1" sID="gen17457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7423"/>Frigidus ventus aquilo flavit, <l eID="gen17457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17458"/>et gelavit crystallus ab aqua : <l eID="gen17458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17459"/>super omnem congregationem aquarum requiescet, <l eID="gen17459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17460"/>et sicut lorica induet se aquis : <l eID="gen17460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7424"/><l level="1" sID="gen17461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7424"/>et devorabit montes, et exuret desertum, <l eID="gen17461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17462"/>et extinguet viride, sicut igne. <l eID="gen17462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7425"/><l level="1" sID="gen17463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7425"/>Medicina omnium in festinatione nebulæ : <l eID="gen17463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17464"/>et ros obvians ab ardore venienti humilem efficiet eum. <l eID="gen17464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7426"/><l level="1" sID="gen17465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7426"/>In sermone ejus siluit ventus, <l eID="gen17465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17466"/>et cogitatione sua placavit abyssum : <l eID="gen17466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17467"/>et plantavit in illa Dominus insulas. <l eID="gen17467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7427"/><l level="1" sID="gen17468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7427"/>Qui navigant mare enarrent pericula ejus, <l eID="gen17468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17469"/>et audientes auribus nostris admirabimur. <l eID="gen17469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7428"/><l level="1" sID="gen17470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7428"/>Illic præclara opera et mirabilia, <l eID="gen17470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17471"/>varia bestiarum genera, et omnium pecorum, et creatura belluarum. <l eID="gen17471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7429"/><l level="1" sID="gen17472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7429"/>Propter ipsum confirmatus est itineris finis, <l eID="gen17472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17473"/>et in sermone ejus composita sunt omnia. <l eID="gen17473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7430"/><l level="1" sID="gen17474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7430"/>Multa dicemus, et deficiemus in verbis : <l eID="gen17474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17475"/>consummatio autem sermonum ipse est in omnibus. <l eID="gen17475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7431"/><l level="1" sID="gen17476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7431"/>Gloriantes ad quid valebimus ? <l eID="gen17476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17477"/>ipse enim omnipotens super omnia opera sua. <l eID="gen17477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7432"/><l level="1" sID="gen17478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7432"/>Terribilis Dominus, et magnus vehementer, <l eID="gen17478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17479"/>et mirabilis potentia ipsius. <l eID="gen17479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7433"/><l level="1" sID="gen17480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7433"/>Glorificantes Dominum quantumcumque potueritis, <l eID="gen17480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17481"/>supervalebit enim adhuc : et admirabilis magnificentia ejus. <l eID="gen17481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7434"/><l level="1" sID="gen17482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7434"/>Benedicentes Dominum, exaltate illum quantum potestis : <l eID="gen17482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17483"/>major enim est omni laude. <l eID="gen17483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7435"/><l level="1" sID="gen17484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7435"/>Exaltantes eum, replemini virtute, ne laboretis, <l eID="gen17484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17485"/>non enim comprehendetis. <l eID="gen17485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7436"/><l level="1" sID="gen17486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7436"/>Quis videbit eum et enarrabit ? <l eID="gen17486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17487"/>et quis magnificabit eum sicut est ab initio ? <l eID="gen17487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7437"/><l level="1" sID="gen17488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7437"/>Multa abscondita sunt majora his : <l eID="gen17488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17489"/>pauca enim vidimus operum ejus. <l eID="gen17489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 43:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7438"/><l level="1" sID="gen17490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7438"/>Omnia autem Dominus fecit, <l eID="gen17490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17491"/>et pie agentibus dedit sapientiam.  <chapter eID="Sir.43"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:1
verses.text: Laudemus viros gloriosos, <l eID="gen17492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17493"/>et parentes nostros in generatione sua. <l eID="gen17493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7439"/><l level="1" sID="gen17494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7439"/>Multam gloriam fecit Dominus : <l eID="gen17494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17495"/>magnificentia sua a sæculo. <l eID="gen17495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7440"/><l level="1" sID="gen17496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7440"/>Dominantes in potestatibus suis, <l eID="gen17496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17497"/>homines magni virtute et prudentia sua præditi, <l eID="gen17497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17498"/>nuntiantes in prophetis dignitatem prophetarum : <l eID="gen17498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7441"/><l level="1" sID="gen17499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7441"/>et imperantes in præsenti populo, <l eID="gen17499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17500"/>et virtute prudentiæ populis sanctissima verba : <l eID="gen17500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7442"/><l level="1" sID="gen17501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7442"/>in peritia sua requirentes modos musicos, <l eID="gen17501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17502"/>et narrantes carmina Scripturarum : <l eID="gen17502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7443"/><l level="1" sID="gen17503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7443"/>homines divites in virtute, <l eID="gen17503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17504"/>pulchritudinis studium habentes, <l eID="gen17504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17505"/>pacificantes in domibus suis. <l eID="gen17505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7444"/><l level="1" sID="gen17506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7444"/>Omnes isti in generationibus gentis suæ gloriam adepti sunt, <l eID="gen17506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17507"/>et in diebus suis habentur in laudibus. <l eID="gen17507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7445"/><l level="1" sID="gen17508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7445"/>Qui de illis nati sunt reliquerunt nomen <l eID="gen17508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17509"/>narrandi laudes eorum. <l eID="gen17509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7446"/><l level="1" sID="gen17510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7446"/>Et sunt quorum non est memoria : <l eID="gen17510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17511"/>perierunt quasi qui non fuerint : <l eID="gen17511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17512"/>et nati sunt quasi non nati, <l eID="gen17512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17513"/>et filii ipsorum cum ipsis. <l eID="gen17513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7447"/><l level="1" sID="gen17514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7447"/>Sed illi viri misericordiæ sunt, <l eID="gen17514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17515"/>quorum pietates non defuerunt. <l eID="gen17515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7448"/><l level="1" sID="gen17516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7448"/>Cum semine eorum permanent bona : <l eID="gen17516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7449"/><l level="1" sID="gen17517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7449"/>hæreditas sancta nepotes eorum, <l eID="gen17517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17518"/>et in testamentis stetit semen eorum : <l eID="gen17518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7450"/><l level="1" sID="gen17519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7450"/>et filii eorum propter illos usque in æternum manent : <l eID="gen17519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17520"/>semen eorum et gloria eorum non derelinquetur. <l eID="gen17520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7451"/><l level="1" sID="gen17521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7451"/>Corpora ipsorum in pace sepulta sunt, <l eID="gen17521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17522"/>et nomen eorum vivit in generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen17522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7452"/><l level="1" sID="gen17523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7452"/>Sapientiam ipsorum narrent populi, <l eID="gen17523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17524"/>et laudem eorum nuntiet ecclesia. <l eID="gen17524" level="1"/>
