verses.name: Sirach 44:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7453"/><l level="1" sID="gen17525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7453"/>Enoch placuit Deo, et translatus est in paradisum, <l eID="gen17525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17526"/>ut det gentibus pœnitentiam. <l eID="gen17526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7454"/><l level="1" sID="gen17527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7454"/>Noë inventus est perfectus, justus, <l eID="gen17527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17528"/>et in tempore iracundiæ factus est reconciliatio. <l eID="gen17528" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7455"/><l level="1" sID="gen17529"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7455"/>Ideo dimissum est reliquum terræ, <l eID="gen17529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17530"/>cum factum est diluvium. <l eID="gen17530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7456"/><l level="1" sID="gen17531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7456"/>Testamenta sæculi posita sunt apud illum, <l eID="gen17531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17532"/>ne deleri possit diluvio omnis caro. <l eID="gen17532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7457"/><l level="1" sID="gen17533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7457"/>Abraham magnus pater multitudinis gentium, <l eID="gen17533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17534"/>et non est inventus similis illi in gloria : <l eID="gen17534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17535"/>qui conservavit legem Excelsi, <l eID="gen17535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17536"/>et fuit in testamento cum illo. <l eID="gen17536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7458"/><l level="1" sID="gen17537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7458"/>In carne ejus stare fecit testamentum, <l eID="gen17537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17538"/>et in tentatione inventus est fidelis. <l eID="gen17538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7459"/><l level="1" sID="gen17539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7459"/>Ideo jurejurando dedit illi gloriam in gente sua, <l eID="gen17539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17540"/>crescere illum quasi terræ cumulum, <l eID="gen17540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7460"/><l level="1" sID="gen17541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7460"/>et ut stellas exaltare semen ejus, <l eID="gen17541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17542"/>et hæreditare illos a mari usque ad mare, <l eID="gen17542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17543"/>et a flumine usque ad terminos terræ. <l eID="gen17543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7461"/><l level="1" sID="gen17544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7461"/>Et in Isaac eodem modo fecit, <l eID="gen17544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17545"/>propter Abraham patrem ejus. <l eID="gen17545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7462"/><l level="1" sID="gen17546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7462"/>Benedictionem omnium gentium dedit illi Dominus, <l eID="gen17546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17547"/>et testamentum confirmavit super caput Jacob. <l eID="gen17547" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7463"/><l level="1" sID="gen17548"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7463"/>Agnovit eum in benedictionibus suis, <l eID="gen17548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17549"/>et dedit illi hæreditatem, <l eID="gen17549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17550"/>et divisit illi partem in tribubus duodecim. <l eID="gen17550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 44:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7464"/><l level="1" sID="gen17551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7464"/>Et conservavit illi homines misericordiæ, <l eID="gen17551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17552"/>invenientes gratiam in oculis omnis carnis.  <chapter eID="Sir.44"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:1
verses.text: Dilectus Deo et hominibus Moyses, <l eID="gen17553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17554"/>cujus memoria in benedictione est. <l eID="gen17554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7465"/><l level="1" sID="gen17555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7465"/>Similem illum fecit in gloria sanctorum, <l eID="gen17555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17556"/>et magnificavit eum in timore inimicorum, <l eID="gen17556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17557"/>et in verbis suis monstra placavit. <l eID="gen17557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7466"/><l level="1" sID="gen17558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7466"/>Glorificavit illum in conspectu regum, <l eID="gen17558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17559"/>et jussit illi coram populo suo, <l eID="gen17559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17560"/>et ostendit illi gloriam suam. <l eID="gen17560" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7467"/><l level="1" sID="gen17561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7467"/>In fide et lenitate ipsius sanctum fecit illum, <l eID="gen17561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17562"/>et elegit eum ex omni carne. <l eID="gen17562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7468"/><l level="1" sID="gen17563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7468"/>Audivit enim eum, et vocem ipsius, <l eID="gen17563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17564"/>et induxit illum in nubem. <l eID="gen17564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7469"/><l level="1" sID="gen17565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7469"/>Et dedit illi coram præcepta, <l eID="gen17565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17566"/>et legem vitæ et disciplinæ, <l eID="gen17566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17567"/>docere Jacob testamentum suum, <l eID="gen17567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17568"/>et judicia sua Israël. <l eID="gen17568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7470"/><l level="1" sID="gen17569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7470"/>Excelsum fecit Aaron fratrem ejus, <l eID="gen17569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17570"/>et similem sibi, de tribu Levi. <l eID="gen17570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7471"/><l level="1" sID="gen17571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7471"/>Statuit ei testamentum æternum, <l eID="gen17571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17572"/>et dedit illi sacerdotium gentis, <l eID="gen17572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17573"/>et beatificavit illum in gloria : <l eID="gen17573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7472"/><l level="1" sID="gen17574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7472"/>et circumcinxit eum zona gloriæ, <l eID="gen17574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17575"/>et induit eum stolam gloriæ, <l eID="gen17575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17576"/>et coronavit eum in vasis virtutis. <l eID="gen17576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7473"/><l level="1" sID="gen17577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7473"/>Circumpedes, et femoralia, et humerale posuit ei : <l eID="gen17577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17578"/>et cinxit illum tintinnabulis aureis plurimis in gyro : <l eID="gen17578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7474"/><l level="1" sID="gen17579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7474"/>dare sonitum in incessu suo, <l eID="gen17579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17580"/>auditum facere sonitum in templo <l eID="gen17580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17581"/>in memoriam filiis gentis suæ. <l eID="gen17581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7475"/><l level="1" sID="gen17582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7475"/>Stolam sanctam auro, et hyacintho, et purpura, <l eID="gen17582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17583"/>opus textile viri sapientis, judicio et veritate præditi : <l eID="gen17583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7476"/><l level="1" sID="gen17584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7476"/>torto cocco opus artificis <l eID="gen17584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17585"/>gemmis pretiosis figuratis in ligatura auri, <l eID="gen17585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17586"/>et opere lapidarii sculptis, <l eID="gen17586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17587"/>in memoriam secundum numerum tribuum Israël. <l eID="gen17587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7477"/><l level="1" sID="gen17588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7477"/>Corona aurea super mitram ejus <l eID="gen17588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17589"/>expressa signo sanctitatis, et gloria honoris : <l eID="gen17589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17590"/>opus virtutis, et desideria oculorum ornata. <l eID="gen17590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7478"/><l level="1" sID="gen17591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7478"/>Sic pulchra ante ipsum non fuerunt talia <l eID="gen17591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17592"/>usque ad originem. <l eID="gen17592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7479"/><l level="1" sID="gen17593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7479"/>Non est indutus illa alienigena aliquis, <l eID="gen17593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17594"/>sed tantum filii ipsius soli, <l eID="gen17594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17595"/>et nepotes ejus per omne tempus. <l eID="gen17595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7480"/><l level="1" sID="gen17596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7480"/>Sacrificia ipsius <l eID="gen17596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17597"/>consumpta sunt igne quotidie. <l eID="gen17597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7481"/><l level="1" sID="gen17598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7481"/>Complevit Moyses manus ejus, <l eID="gen17598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17599"/>et unxit illum oleo sancto. <l eID="gen17599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7482"/><l level="1" sID="gen17600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7482"/>Factum est illi in testamentum æternum, <l eID="gen17600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17601"/>et semini ejus, sicut dies cæli, <l eID="gen17601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17602"/>fungi sacerdotio, et habere laudem, <l eID="gen17602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17603"/>et glorificare populum suum in nomine ejus. <l eID="gen17603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7483"/><l level="1" sID="gen17604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7483"/>Ipsum elegit ab omni vivente, <l eID="gen17604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17605"/>offerre sacrificium Deo, incensum, et bonum odorem, <l eID="gen17605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17606"/>in memoriam placare pro populo suo : <l eID="gen17606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7484"/><l level="1" sID="gen17607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7484"/>et dedit illi in præceptis suis potestatem, <l eID="gen17607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17608"/>in testamentis judiciorum : <l eID="gen17608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17609"/>docere Jacob testimonia, <l eID="gen17609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17610"/>et in lege sua lucem dare Israël. <l eID="gen17610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7485"/><l level="1" sID="gen17611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7485"/>Quia contra illum steterunt alieni, <l eID="gen17611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17612"/>et propter invidiam circumdederunt illum homines in deserto, <l eID="gen17612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17613"/>qui erant cum Dathan et Abiron, <l eID="gen17613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17614"/>et congregatio Core in iracundia. <l eID="gen17614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7486"/><l level="1" sID="gen17615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7486"/>Vidit Dominus Deus, et non placuit illi, <l eID="gen17615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17616"/>et consumpti sunt in impetu iracundiæ. <l eID="gen17616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7487"/><l level="1" sID="gen17617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7487"/>Fecit illis monstra, <l eID="gen17617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17618"/>et consumpsit illos in flamma ignis. <l eID="gen17618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7488"/><l level="1" sID="gen17619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7488"/>Et addidit Aaron gloriam, <l eID="gen17619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17620"/>et dedit illi hæreditatem, <l eID="gen17620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17621"/>et primitias frugum terræ divisit illi. <l eID="gen17621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7489"/><l level="1" sID="gen17622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7489"/>Panem ipsis in primis paravit in satietatem : <l eID="gen17622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17623"/>nam et sacrificia Domini edent, <l eID="gen17623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17624"/>quæ dedit illi et semini ejus. <l eID="gen17624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7490"/><l level="1" sID="gen17625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7490"/>Ceterum in terra gentes non hæreditabit, <l eID="gen17625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17626"/>et pars non est illi in gente : <l eID="gen17626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17627"/>ipse est enim pars ejus, et hæreditas. <l eID="gen17627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7491"/><l level="1" sID="gen17628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7491"/>Phinees, filius Eleazari, tertius in gloria est, <l eID="gen17628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17629"/>imitando eum in timore Domini, <l eID="gen17629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7492"/><l level="1" sID="gen17630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7492"/>et stare in reverentia gentis : <l eID="gen17630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17631"/>in bonitate et alacritate animæ suæ placuit Deo pro Israël. <l eID="gen17631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7493"/><l level="1" sID="gen17632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7493"/>Ideo statuit illi testamentum pacis, <l eID="gen17632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17633"/>principem sanctorum et gentis suæ, <l eID="gen17633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17634"/>ut sit illi et semini ejus sacerdotii dignitas in æternum. <l eID="gen17634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 45:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7494"/><l level="1" sID="gen17635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7494"/>Et testamentum David regi filio Jesse de tribu Juda, <l eID="gen17635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17636"/>hæreditas ipsi et semini ejus : <l eID="gen17636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17637"/>ut daret sapientiam in cor nostrum, <l eID="gen17637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17638"/>judicare gentem suam in justitia, <l eID="gen17638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17639"/>ne abolerentur bona ipsorum : <l eID="gen17639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17640"/>et gloriam ipsorum in gentem eorum æternam fecit.  <chapter eID="Sir.45"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:1
verses.text: Fortis in bello Jesus Nave, successor Moysi in prophetis, <l eID="gen17641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17642"/>qui fuit magnus secundum nomen suum, <l eID="gen17642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7495"/><l level="1" sID="gen17643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7495"/>maximus in salutem electorum Dei, <l eID="gen17643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17644"/>expugnare insurgentes hostes, <l eID="gen17644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17645"/>ut consequeretur hæreditatem Israël. <l eID="gen17645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7496"/><l level="1" sID="gen17646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7496"/>Quam gloriam adeptus est in tollendo manus suas, <l eID="gen17646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17647"/>et jactando contra civitates rhomphæas ! <l eID="gen17647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7497"/><l level="1" sID="gen17648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7497"/>Quis ante illum sic restitit ? <l eID="gen17648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17649"/>nam hostes ipse Dominus perduxit. <l eID="gen17649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7498"/><l level="1" sID="gen17650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7498"/>An non in iracundia ejus impeditus est sol, <l eID="gen17650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17651"/>et una dies facta est quasi duo ? <l eID="gen17651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7499"/><l level="1" sID="gen17652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7499"/>Invocavit Altissimum potentem, <l eID="gen17652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17653"/>in oppugnando inimicos undique : <l eID="gen17653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17654"/>et audivit illum magnus et sanctus Deus, <l eID="gen17654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17655"/>in saxis grandinis virtutis valde fortis. <l eID="gen17655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7500"/><l level="1" sID="gen17656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7500"/>Impetum fecit contra gentem hostilem, <l eID="gen17656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17657"/>et in descensu perdidit contrarios : <l eID="gen17657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7501"/><l level="1" sID="gen17658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7501"/>ut cognoscant gentes potentiam ejus, <l eID="gen17658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17659"/>quia contra Deum pugnare non est facile. <l eID="gen17659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17660"/>Et secutus est a tergo potentis : <l eID="gen17660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7502"/><l level="1" sID="gen17661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7502"/>et in diebus Moysi misericordiam fecit, <l eID="gen17661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17662"/>ipse, et Caleb filius Jephone, <l eID="gen17662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17663"/>stare contra hostem, et prohibere gentem a peccatis, <l eID="gen17663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17664"/>et perfringere murmur malitiæ. <l eID="gen17664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7503"/><l level="1" sID="gen17665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7503"/>Et ipsi duo constituti a periculo liberati sunt <l eID="gen17665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17666"/>a numero sexcentorum millium peditum, <l eID="gen17666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17667"/>inducere illos in hæreditatem, <l eID="gen17667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17668"/>in terram quæ manat lac et mel. <l eID="gen17668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7504"/><l level="1" sID="gen17669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7504"/>Et dedit Dominus ipsi Caleb fortitudinem, <l eID="gen17669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17670"/>et usque in senectutem permansit illi virtus, <l eID="gen17670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17671"/>ut ascenderet in excelsum terræ locum, <l eID="gen17671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17672"/>et semen ipsius obtinuit hæreditatem, <l eID="gen17672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7505"/><l level="1" sID="gen17673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7505"/>ut viderent omnes filii Israël <l eID="gen17673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17674"/>quia bonum est obsequi sancto Deo. <l eID="gen17674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7506"/><l level="1" sID="gen17675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7506"/>Et judices singuli suo nomine, quorum non est corruptum cor, <l eID="gen17675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17676"/>qui non aversi sunt a Domino, <l eID="gen17676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7507"/><l level="1" sID="gen17677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7507"/>ut sit memoria illorum in benedictione, <l eID="gen17677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17678"/>et ossa eorum pullulent de loco suo : <l eID="gen17678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7508"/><l level="1" sID="gen17679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7508"/>et nomen eorum permaneat in æternum, <l eID="gen17679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17680"/>permanens ad filios illorum, sanctorum virorum gloria. <l eID="gen17680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7509"/><l level="1" sID="gen17681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7509"/>Dilectus a Domino Deo suo Samuel, propheta Domini, <l eID="gen17681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17682"/>renovavit imperium, <l eID="gen17682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17683"/>et unxit principes in gente sua. <l eID="gen17683" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7510"/><l level="1" sID="gen17684"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7510"/>In lege Domini congregationem judicavit, <l eID="gen17684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17685"/>et vidit Deus Jacob : <l eID="gen17685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17686"/>et in fide sua probatus est propheta, <l eID="gen17686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7511"/><l level="1" sID="gen17687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7511"/>et cognitus est in verbis suis fidelis, <l eID="gen17687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17688"/>quia vidit Deum lucis. <l eID="gen17688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7512"/><l level="1" sID="gen17689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7512"/>Et invocavit Dominum omnipotentem, <l eID="gen17689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17690"/>in oppugnando hostes circumstantes undique, <l eID="gen17690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17691"/>in oblatione agni inviolati. <l eID="gen17691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7513"/><l level="1" sID="gen17692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7513"/>Et intonuit de cælo Dominus, <l eID="gen17692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17693"/>et in sonitu magno auditam fecit vocem suam : <l eID="gen17693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7514"/><l level="1" sID="gen17694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7514"/>et contrivit principes Tyriorum, <l eID="gen17694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17695"/>et omnes duces Philisthiim : <l eID="gen17695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7515"/><l level="1" sID="gen17696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7515"/>et ante tempus finis vitæ suæ et sæculi, <l eID="gen17696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17697"/>testimonium præbuit in conspectu Domini et christi : <l eID="gen17697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17698"/>pecunias et usque ad calceamenta ab omni carne non accepit, <l eID="gen17698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17699"/>et non accusavit illum homo. <l eID="gen17699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 46:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7516"/><l level="1" sID="gen17700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7516"/>Et post hoc dormivit : et notum fecit regi, <l eID="gen17700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17701"/>et ostendit illi finem vitæ suæ : <l eID="gen17701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17702"/>et exaltavit vocem suam de terra in prophetia, <l eID="gen17702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17703"/>delere impietatem gentis.  <chapter eID="Sir.46"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:1
verses.text: Post hæc surrexit Nathan, <l eID="gen17704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17705"/>propheta in diebus David. <l eID="gen17705" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7517"/><l level="1" sID="gen17706"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7517"/>Et quasi adeps separatus a carne, <l eID="gen17706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17707"/>sic David a filiis Israël. <l eID="gen17707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7518"/><l level="1" sID="gen17708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7518"/>Cum leonibus lusit quasi cum agnis, <l eID="gen17708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17709"/>et in ursis similiter fecit sicut in agnis ovium, in juventute sua. <l eID="gen17709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7519"/><l level="1" sID="gen17710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7519"/>Numquid non occidit gigantem, <l eID="gen17710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17711"/>et abstulit opprobrium de gente ? <l eID="gen17711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7520"/><l level="1" sID="gen17712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7520"/>In tollendo manum, <l eID="gen17712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17713"/>saxo fundæ dejecit exsultationem Goliæ : <l eID="gen17713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7521"/><l level="1" sID="gen17714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7521"/>nam invocavit Dominum omnipotentem, <l eID="gen17714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17715"/>et dedit in dextera ejus tollere hominem fortem in bello, <l eID="gen17715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17716"/>et exaltare cornu gentis suæ. <l eID="gen17716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7522"/><l level="1" sID="gen17717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7522"/>Sic in decem millibus glorificavit eum : <l eID="gen17717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17718"/>et laudavit eum in benedictionibus Domini, <l eID="gen17718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17719"/>in offerendo illi coronam gloriæ : <l eID="gen17719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7523"/><l level="1" sID="gen17720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7523"/>contrivit enim inimicos undique, <l eID="gen17720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17721"/>et extirpavit Philisthiim contrarios usque in hodiernum diem : <l eID="gen17721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17722"/>contrivit cornu ipsorum usque in æternum. <l eID="gen17722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7524"/><l level="1" sID="gen17723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7524"/>In omni opere dedit confessionem Sancto, <l eID="gen17723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17724"/>et Excelso in verbo gloriæ. <l eID="gen17724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7525"/><l level="1" sID="gen17725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7525"/>De omni corde suo laudavit Dominum : <l eID="gen17725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17726"/>et dilexit Deum, qui fecit illum, <l eID="gen17726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17727"/>et dedit illi contra inimicos potentiam : <l eID="gen17727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7526"/><l level="1" sID="gen17728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7526"/>et stare fecit cantores contra altare, <l eID="gen17728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17729"/>et in sono eorum dulces fecit modos. <l eID="gen17729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7527"/><l level="1" sID="gen17730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7527"/>Et dedit in celebrationibus decus, <l eID="gen17730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17731"/>et ornavit tempora usque ad consummationem vitæ, <l eID="gen17731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17732"/>ut laudarent nomen sanctum Domini, <l eID="gen17732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17733"/>et amplificarent mane Dei sanctitatem. <l eID="gen17733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7528"/><l level="1" sID="gen17734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7528"/>Dominus purgavit peccata ipsius, <l eID="gen17734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17735"/>et exaltavit in æternum cornu ejus : <l eID="gen17735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17736"/>et dedit illi testamentum regni, <l eID="gen17736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17737"/>et sedem gloriæ in Israël. <l eID="gen17737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7529"/><l level="1" sID="gen17738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7529"/>Post ipsum surrexit filius sensatus, <l eID="gen17738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17739"/>et propter illum dejecit omnem potentiam inimicorum. <l eID="gen17739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7530"/><l level="1" sID="gen17740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7530"/>Salomon imperavit in diebus pacis, <l eID="gen17740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17741"/>cui subjecit Deus omnes hostes, <l eID="gen17741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17742"/>ut conderet domum in nomine suo, <l eID="gen17742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17743"/>et pararet sanctitatem in sempiternum. <l eID="gen17743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17744"/>Quemadmodum eruditus es in juventute tua, <l eID="gen17744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7531"/><l level="1" sID="gen17745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7531"/>et impletus es, quasi flumen, sapientia, <l eID="gen17745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17746"/>et terram retexit anima tua. <l eID="gen17746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7532"/><l level="1" sID="gen17747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7532"/>Et replesti in comparationibus ænigmata : <l eID="gen17747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17748"/>ad insulas longe divulgatum est nomen tuum, <l eID="gen17748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17749"/>et dilectus es in pace tua. <l eID="gen17749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7533"/><l level="1" sID="gen17750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7533"/>In cantilenis, et proverbiis, <l eID="gen17750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17751"/>et comparationibus, et interpretationibus, miratæ sunt terræ : <l eID="gen17751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7534"/><l level="1" sID="gen17752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7534"/>et in nomine Domini Dei, <l eID="gen17752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17753"/>cui est cognomen Deus Israël. <l eID="gen17753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7535"/><l level="1" sID="gen17754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7535"/>Collegisti quasi auricalcum aurum, <l eID="gen17754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17755"/>et ut plumbum complesti argentum : <l eID="gen17755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7536"/><l level="1" sID="gen17756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7536"/>et inclinasti femora tua mulieribus : <l eID="gen17756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17757"/>potestatem habuisti in corpore tuo. <l eID="gen17757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7537"/><l level="1" sID="gen17758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7537"/>Dedisti maculam in gloria tua, <l eID="gen17758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17759"/>et profanasti semen tuum, <l eID="gen17759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17760"/>inducere iracundiam ad liberos tuos, <l eID="gen17760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17761"/>et incitari stultitiam tuam : <l eID="gen17761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7538"/><l level="1" sID="gen17762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7538"/>ut faceres imperium bipartitum, <l eID="gen17762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17763"/>et ex Ephraim imperare imperium durum. <l eID="gen17763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7539"/><l level="1" sID="gen17764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7539"/>Deus autem non derelinquet misericordiam suam : <l eID="gen17764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17765"/>et non corrumpet, nec delebit opera sua, <l eID="gen17765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17766"/>neque perdet a stirpe nepotes electi sui, <l eID="gen17766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17767"/>et semen ejus qui diligit Dominum non corrumpet. <l eID="gen17767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7540"/><l level="1" sID="gen17768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7540"/>Dedit autem reliquum Jacob, <l eID="gen17768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17769"/>et David de ipsa stirpe. <l eID="gen17769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7541"/><l level="1" sID="gen17770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7541"/>Et finem habuit Salomon cum patribus suis. <l eID="gen17770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7542"/><l level="1" sID="gen17771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7542"/>Et dereliquit post se de semine suo, gentis stultitiam, <l eID="gen17771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7543"/><l level="1" sID="gen17772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7543"/>et imminutum a prudentia, Roboam, <l eID="gen17772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17773"/>qui avertit gentem consilio suo : <l eID="gen17773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7544"/><l level="1" sID="gen17774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7544"/>et Jeroboam filium Nabat, qui peccare fecit Israël, <l eID="gen17774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17775"/>et dedit viam peccandi Ephraim : <l eID="gen17775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17776"/>et plurima redundaverunt peccata ipsorum. <l eID="gen17776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7545"/><l level="1" sID="gen17777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7545"/>Valde averterunt illos a terra sua. <l eID="gen17777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 47:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7546"/><l level="1" sID="gen17778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7546"/>Et quæsivit omnes nequitias, <l eID="gen17778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17779"/>usque dum perveniret ad illos defensio, <l eID="gen17779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17780"/>et ab omnibus peccatis liberavit eos.  <chapter eID="Sir.47"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:1
verses.text: Et surrexit Elias propheta quasi ignis, <l eID="gen17781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17782"/>et verbum ipsius quasi facula ardebat. <l eID="gen17782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7547"/><l level="1" sID="gen17783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7547"/>Qui induxit in illos famem : <l eID="gen17783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17784"/>et irritantes illum invidia sua pauci facti sunt : <l eID="gen17784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17785"/>non enim poterant sustinere præcepta Domini. <l eID="gen17785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7548"/><l level="1" sID="gen17786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7548"/>Verbo Domini continuit cælum, <l eID="gen17786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17787"/>et dejecit de cælo ignem ter. <l eID="gen17787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7549"/><l level="1" sID="gen17788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7549"/>Sic amplificatus est Elias in mirabilibus suis. <l eID="gen17788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17789"/>Et quis potest similiter sic gloriari tibi ? <l eID="gen17789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7550"/><l level="1" sID="gen17790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7550"/>qui sustulisti mortuum ab inferis de sorte mortis, <l eID="gen17790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17791"/>in verbo Domini Dei : <l eID="gen17791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7551"/><l level="1" sID="gen17792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7551"/>qui dejecisti reges ad pernicem, <l eID="gen17792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17793"/>et confregisti facile potentiam ipsorum, <l eID="gen17793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17794"/>et gloriosos de lecto suo : <l eID="gen17794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7552"/><l level="1" sID="gen17795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7552"/>qui audis in Sina judicium, <l eID="gen17795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17796"/>et in Horeb judicia defensionis : <l eID="gen17796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7553"/><l level="1" sID="gen17797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7553"/>qui ungis reges ad pœnitentiam, <l eID="gen17797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17798"/>et prophetas facis successores post te : <l eID="gen17798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7554"/><l level="1" sID="gen17799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7554"/>qui receptus es in turbine ignis, <l eID="gen17799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17800"/>in curru equorum igneorum : <l eID="gen17800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7555"/><l level="1" sID="gen17801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7555"/>qui scriptus es in judiciis temporum, <l eID="gen17801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17802"/>lenire iracundiam Domini, <l eID="gen17802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17803"/>conciliare cor patris ad filium, <l eID="gen17803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17804"/>et restituere tribus Jacob. <l eID="gen17804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7556"/><l level="1" sID="gen17805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7556"/>Beati sunt qui te viderunt, <l eID="gen17805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17806"/>et in amicitia tua decorati sunt. <l eID="gen17806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7557"/><l level="1" sID="gen17807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7557"/>Nam nos vita vivimus tantum : <l eID="gen17807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17808"/>post mortem autem non erit tale nomen nostrum. <l eID="gen17808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7558"/><l level="1" sID="gen17809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7558"/>Elias quidem in turbine tectus est, <l eID="gen17809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17810"/>et in Eliseo completus est spiritus ejus : <l eID="gen17810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17811"/>in diebus suis non pertimuit principem, <l eID="gen17811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17812"/>et potentia nemo vicit illum : <l eID="gen17812" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7559"/><l level="1" sID="gen17813"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7559"/>nec superavit illum verbum aliquod, <l eID="gen17813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17814"/>et mortuum prophetavit corpus ejus. <l eID="gen17814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7560"/><l level="1" sID="gen17815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7560"/>In vita sua fecit monstra, <l eID="gen17815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17816"/>et in morte mirabilia operatus est. <l eID="gen17816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7561"/><l level="1" sID="gen17817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7561"/>In omnibus istis non pœnituit populus, <l eID="gen17817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17818"/>et non recesserunt a peccatis suis, <l eID="gen17818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17819"/>usque dum ejecti sunt de terra sua, <l eID="gen17819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17820"/>et dispersi sunt in omnem terram : <l eID="gen17820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7562"/><l level="1" sID="gen17821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7562"/>et relicta est gens perpauca, <l eID="gen17821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17822"/>et princeps in domo David. <l eID="gen17822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7563"/><l level="1" sID="gen17823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7563"/>Quidam ipsorum fecerunt quod placeret Deo : <l eID="gen17823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17824"/>alii autem multa commiserunt peccata. <l eID="gen17824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7564"/><l level="1" sID="gen17825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7564"/>Ezechias munivit civitatem suam, <l eID="gen17825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17826"/>et induxit in medium ipsius aquam : <l eID="gen17826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17827"/>et fodit ferro rupem, <l eID="gen17827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17828"/>et ædificavit ad aquam puteum. <l eID="gen17828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7565"/><l level="1" sID="gen17829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7565"/>In diebus ipsius ascendit Sennacherib, <l eID="gen17829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17830"/>et misit Rabsacen, et sustulit manum suam contra illos : <l eID="gen17830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17831"/>et extulit manum suam in Sion, <l eID="gen17831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17832"/>et superbus factus est potentia sua. <l eID="gen17832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7566"/><l level="1" sID="gen17833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7566"/>Tunc mota sunt corda et manus ipsorum : <l eID="gen17833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17834"/>et doluerunt quasi parturientes mulieres. <l eID="gen17834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7567"/><l level="1" sID="gen17835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7567"/>Et invocaverunt Dominum misericordem, <l eID="gen17835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17836"/>et expandentes manus suas extulerunt ad cælum : <l eID="gen17836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17837"/>et Sanctus, Dominus Deus, audivit cito vocem ipsorum. <l eID="gen17837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7568"/><l level="1" sID="gen17838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7568"/>Non est commemoratus peccatorum illorum, <l eID="gen17838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17839"/>neque dedit illos inimicis suis : <l eID="gen17839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17840"/>sed purgavit eos in manu Isaiæ sancti prophetæ. <l eID="gen17840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7569"/><l level="1" sID="gen17841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7569"/>Dejecit castra Assyriorum, <l eID="gen17841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17842"/>et contrivit illos angelus Domini : <l eID="gen17842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7570"/><l level="1" sID="gen17843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7570"/>nam fecit Ezechias quod placuit Deo, <l eID="gen17843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17844"/>et fortiter ivit in via David patris sui, <l eID="gen17844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17845"/>quam mandavit illi Isaias, propheta magnus, <l eID="gen17845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17846"/>et fidelis in conspectu Dei. <l eID="gen17846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7571"/><l level="1" sID="gen17847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7571"/>In diebus ipsius retro rediit sol, <l eID="gen17847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17848"/>et addidit regi vitam. <l eID="gen17848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7572"/><l level="1" sID="gen17849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7572"/>Spiritu magno vidit ultima, <l eID="gen17849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17850"/>et consolatus est lugentes in Sion <l eID="gen17850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17851"/>usque in sempiternum. <l eID="gen17851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 48:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7573"/><l level="1" sID="gen17852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7573"/>Ostendit futura, <l eID="gen17852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17853"/>et abscondita antequam evenirent.  <chapter eID="Sir.48"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:1
verses.text: Memoria Josiæ in compositionem odoris facta <l eID="gen17854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17855"/>opus pigmentarii. <l eID="gen17855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7574"/><l level="1" sID="gen17856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7574"/>In omni ore quasi mel indulcabitur ejus memoria, <l eID="gen17856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17857"/>et ut musica in convivio vini. <l eID="gen17857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7575"/><l level="1" sID="gen17858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7575"/>Ipse est directus divinitus in pœnitentiam gentis, <l eID="gen17858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17859"/>et tulit abominationes impietatis. <l eID="gen17859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7576"/><l level="1" sID="gen17860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7576"/>Et gubernavit ad Dominum cor ipsius, <l eID="gen17860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17861"/>et in diebus peccatorum corroboravit pietatem. <l eID="gen17861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7577"/><l level="1" sID="gen17862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7577"/>Præter David et Ezechiam et Josiam, <l eID="gen17862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17863"/>omnes peccatum commiserunt : <l eID="gen17863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7578"/><l level="1" sID="gen17864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7578"/>nam reliquerunt legem Altissimi reges Juda, <l eID="gen17864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17865"/>et contempserunt timorem Dei. <l eID="gen17865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7579"/><l level="1" sID="gen17866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7579"/>Dederunt enim regnum suum aliis, <l eID="gen17866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17867"/>et gloriam suam alienigenæ genti. <l eID="gen17867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7580"/><l level="1" sID="gen17868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7580"/>Incenderunt electam sanctitatis civitatem, <l eID="gen17868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17869"/>et desertas fecerunt vias ipsius in manu Jeremiæ. <l eID="gen17869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7581"/><l level="1" sID="gen17870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7581"/>Nam male tractaverunt illum <l eID="gen17870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17871"/>qui a ventre matris consecratus est propheta, <l eID="gen17871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17872"/>evertere, et eruere, et perdere, <l eID="gen17872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17873"/>et iterum ædificare, et renovare : <l eID="gen17873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7582"/><l level="1" sID="gen17874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7582"/>Ezechiel, qui vidit conspectum gloriæ <l eID="gen17874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17875"/>quam ostendit illi in curru cherubim. <l eID="gen17875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7583"/><l level="1" sID="gen17876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7583"/>Nam commemoratus est inimicorum in imbre, <l eID="gen17876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17877"/>benefacere illis qui ostenderunt rectas vias. <l eID="gen17877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7584"/><l level="1" sID="gen17878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7584"/>Et duodecim prophetarum ossa pullulent de loco suo : <l eID="gen17878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17879"/>nam corroboraverunt Jacob, <l eID="gen17879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17880"/>et redemerunt se in fide virtutis. <l eID="gen17880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7585"/><l level="1" sID="gen17881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7585"/>Quomodo amplificemus Zorobabel ? <l eID="gen17881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17882"/>nam et ipse quasi signum in dextera manu : <l eID="gen17882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7586"/><l level="1" sID="gen17883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7586"/>sic et Jesum filium Josedec, <l eID="gen17883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17884"/>qui in diebus suis ædificaverunt domum, <l eID="gen17884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17885"/>et exaltaverunt templum sanctum Domino, <l eID="gen17885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17886"/>paratum in gloriam sempiternam. <l eID="gen17886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7587"/><l level="1" sID="gen17887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7587"/>Et Nehemias in memoriam multi temporis, <l eID="gen17887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17888"/>qui erexit nobis muros eversos, <l eID="gen17888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17889"/>et stare fecit portas et seras, <l eID="gen17889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17890"/>qui erexit domos nostras. <l eID="gen17890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7588"/><l level="1" sID="gen17891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7588"/>Nemo natus est in terra qualis Henoch, <l eID="gen17891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17892"/>nam et ipse receptus est a terra : <l eID="gen17892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7589"/><l level="1" sID="gen17893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7589"/>neque ut Joseph, qui natus est homo princeps fratrum, <l eID="gen17893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17894"/>firmamentum gentis, rector fratrum, stabilimentum populi : <l eID="gen17894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7590"/><l level="1" sID="gen17895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7590"/>et ossa ipsius visitata sunt, <l eID="gen17895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17896"/>et post mortem prophetaverunt. <l eID="gen17896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 49:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7591"/><l level="1" sID="gen17897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7591"/>Seth et Sem apud homines gloriam adepti sunt, <l eID="gen17897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17898"/>et super omnem animam in origine Adam.  <chapter eID="Sir.49"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:1
verses.text: Simon, Oniæ filius, sacerdos magnus, <l eID="gen17899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17900"/>qui in vita sua suffulsit domum, <l eID="gen17900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17901"/>et in diebus suis corroboravit templum. <l eID="gen17901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7592"/><l level="1" sID="gen17902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7592"/>Templi etiam altitudo ab ipso fundata est, <l eID="gen17902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17903"/>duplex ædificatio, et excelsi parietes templi. <l eID="gen17903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7593"/><l level="1" sID="gen17904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7593"/>In diebus ipsius emanaverunt putei aquarum, <l eID="gen17904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17905"/>et quasi mare adimpleti sunt supra modum. <l eID="gen17905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7594"/><l level="1" sID="gen17906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7594"/>Qui curavit gentem suam, <l eID="gen17906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17907"/>et liberavit eam a perditione : <l eID="gen17907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7595"/><l level="1" sID="gen17908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7595"/>qui prævaluit amplificare civitatem, <l eID="gen17908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17909"/>qui adeptus est gloriam in conversatione gentis, <l eID="gen17909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17910"/>et ingressum domus et atrii amplificavit. <l eID="gen17910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7596"/><l level="1" sID="gen17911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7596"/>Quasi stella matutina in medio nebulæ, <l eID="gen17911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17912"/>et quasi luna plena, in diebus suis lucet : <l eID="gen17912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7597"/><l level="1" sID="gen17913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7597"/>et quasi sol refulgens, <l eID="gen17913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17914"/>sic ille effulsit in templo Dei. <l eID="gen17914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7598"/><l level="1" sID="gen17915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7598"/>Quasi arcus refulgens inter nebulas gloriæ, <l eID="gen17915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17916"/>et quasi flos rosarum in diebus vernis, <l eID="gen17916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17917"/>et quasi lilia quæ sunt in transitu aquæ, <l eID="gen17917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17918"/>et quasi thus redolens in diebus æstatis : <l eID="gen17918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7599"/><l level="1" sID="gen17919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7599"/>quasi ignis effulgens, <l eID="gen17919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17920"/>et thus ardens in igne : <l eID="gen17920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7600"/><l level="1" sID="gen17921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7600"/>quasi vas auri solidum, <l eID="gen17921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17922"/>ornatum omni lapide pretioso : <l eID="gen17922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7601"/><l level="1" sID="gen17923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7601"/>quasi oliva pullulans, et cypressus in altitudinem se extollens, <l eID="gen17923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17924"/>in accipiendo ipsum stolam gloriæ, <l eID="gen17924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17925"/>et vestiri eum in consummationem virtutis. <l eID="gen17925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7602"/><l level="1" sID="gen17926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7602"/>In ascensu altaris sancti <l eID="gen17926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17927"/>gloriam dedit sanctitatis amictum. <l eID="gen17927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7603"/><l level="1" sID="gen17928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7603"/>In accipiendo autem partes de manu sacerdotum, <l eID="gen17928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17929"/>et ipse stans juxta aram : <l eID="gen17929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17930"/>et circa illum corona fratrum : <l eID="gen17930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17931"/>quasi plantatio cedri in monte Libano, <l eID="gen17931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7604"/><l level="1" sID="gen17932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7604"/>sic circa illum steterunt quasi rami palmæ : <l eID="gen17932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17933"/>et omnes filii Aaron in gloria sua. <l eID="gen17933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7605"/><l level="1" sID="gen17934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7605"/>Oblatio autem Domini in manibus ipsorum <l eID="gen17934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17935"/>coram omni synagoga Israël : <l eID="gen17935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17936"/>et consummatione fungens in ara, <l eID="gen17936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17937"/>amplificare oblationem excelsi Regis, <l eID="gen17937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7606"/><l level="1" sID="gen17938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7606"/>porrexit manum suam in libatione, <l eID="gen17938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17939"/>et libavit de sanguine uvæ. <l eID="gen17939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7607"/><l level="1" sID="gen17940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7607"/>Effudit in fundamento altaris <l eID="gen17940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17941"/>odorem divinum excelso Principi. <l eID="gen17941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7608"/><l level="1" sID="gen17942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7608"/>Tunc exclamaverunt filii Aaron, <l eID="gen17942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17943"/>in tubis productilibus sonuerunt : <l eID="gen17943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17944"/>et auditam fecerunt vocem magnam in memoriam coram Deo. <l eID="gen17944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7609"/><l level="1" sID="gen17945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7609"/>Tunc omnis populus simul properaverunt, <l eID="gen17945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17946"/>et ceciderunt in faciem super terram, <l eID="gen17946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17947"/>adorare Dominum Deum suum, <l eID="gen17947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17948"/>et dare preces omnipotenti Deo excelso. <l eID="gen17948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7610"/><l level="1" sID="gen17949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7610"/>Et amplificaverunt psallentes in vocibus suis, <l eID="gen17949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17950"/>et in magna domo auctus est sonus suavitatis plenus. <l eID="gen17950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7611"/><l level="1" sID="gen17951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7611"/>Et rogavit populus Dominum excelsum in prece, <l eID="gen17951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17952"/>usque dum perfectus est honor Domini, <l eID="gen17952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17953"/>et munus suum perfecerunt. <l eID="gen17953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7612"/><l level="1" sID="gen17954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7612"/>Tunc descendens, manus suas extulit <l eID="gen17954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17955"/>in omne congregationem filiorum Israël, <l eID="gen17955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17956"/>dare gloriam Deo a labiis suis, <l eID="gen17956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17957"/>et in nomine ipsius gloriari : <l eID="gen17957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7613"/><l level="1" sID="gen17958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7613"/>et iteravit orationem suam, <l eID="gen17958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17959"/>volens ostendere virtutem Dei. <l eID="gen17959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7614"/><l level="1" sID="gen17960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7614"/>Et nunc orate Deum omnium, qui magna fecit in omni terra, <l eID="gen17960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17961"/>qui auxit dies nostros a ventre matris nostræ, <l eID="gen17961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17962"/>et fecit nobiscum secundum suam misericordiam : <l eID="gen17962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7615"/><l level="1" sID="gen17963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7615"/>det nobis jucunditatem cordis, <l eID="gen17963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17964"/>et fieri pacem in diebus nostris in Israël per dies sempiternos : <l eID="gen17964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7616"/><l level="1" sID="gen17965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7616"/>credere Israël nobiscum esse Dei misericordiam, <l eID="gen17965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17966"/>ut liberet nos in diebus suis. <l eID="gen17966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7617"/><l level="1" sID="gen17967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7617"/>Duas gentes odit anima mea : <l eID="gen17967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17968"/>tertia autem non est gens quam oderim : <l eID="gen17968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7618"/><l level="1" sID="gen17969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7618"/>qui sedent in monte Seir, et Philisthiim, <l eID="gen17969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17970"/>et stultus populus qui habitat in Sichimis. <l eID="gen17970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7619"/><l level="1" sID="gen17971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7619"/>Doctrinam sapientiæ et disciplinæ scripsit in codice isto <l eID="gen17971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17972"/>Jesus, filius Sirach, Jerosolymita, <l eID="gen17972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17973"/>qui renovavit sapientiam de corde suo. <l eID="gen17973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7620"/><l level="1" sID="gen17974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7620"/>Beatus qui in istis versatur bonis : <l eID="gen17974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17975"/>qui ponit illa in corde suo, sapiens erit semper. <l eID="gen17975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 50:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7621"/><l level="1" sID="gen17976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7621"/>Si enim hæc fecerit, ad omnia valebit, quia lux Dei vestigium ejus est. <l eID="gen17976" level="1"/><lg eID="gen15735"/> <chapter eID="Sir.50"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:1
verses.text: Oratio Jesu filii Sirach. <div eID="gen17977" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen17978"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17979"/>Confitebor tibi, Domine rex, <l eID="gen17979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17980"/>et collaudabo te Deum salvatorem meum. <l eID="gen17980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7622"/><l level="1" sID="gen17981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7622"/>Confitebor nomini tuo, <l eID="gen17981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17982"/>quoniam adjutor et protector factus es mihi, <l eID="gen17982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7623"/><l level="1" sID="gen17983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7623"/>et liberasti corpus meum a perditione : <l eID="gen17983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17984"/>a laqueo linguæ iniquæ, et a labiis operantium mendacium : <l eID="gen17984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17985"/>et in conspectu astantium factus es mihi adjutor. <l eID="gen17985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7624"/><l level="1" sID="gen17986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7624"/>Et liberasti me, secundum multitudinem misericordiæ nominis tui, <l eID="gen17986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17987"/>a rugientibus præparatis ad escam : <l eID="gen17987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7625"/><l level="1" sID="gen17988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7625"/>de manibus quærentium animam meam, <l eID="gen17988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17989"/>et de portis tribulationum quæ circumdederunt me ; <l eID="gen17989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7626"/><l level="1" sID="gen17990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7626"/>a pressura flammæ quæ circumdedit me, <l eID="gen17990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17991"/>et in medio ignis non sum æstuatus ; <l eID="gen17991" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7627"/><l level="1" sID="gen17992"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7627"/>de altitudine ventris inferi, <l eID="gen17992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17993"/>et a lingua coinquinata, et a verbo mendacii, <l eID="gen17993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17994"/>a rege iniquo, et a lingua injusta. <l eID="gen17994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7628"/><l level="1" sID="gen17995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7628"/>Laudabit usque ad mortem anima mea Dominum, <l eID="gen17995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7629"/><l level="1" sID="gen17996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7629"/>et vita mea appropinquans erat in inferno deorsum. <l eID="gen17996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7630"/><l level="1" sID="gen17997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7630"/>Circumdederunt me undique, et non erat qui adjuvaret : <l eID="gen17997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen17998"/>respiciens eram ad adjutorium hominum, et non erat. <l eID="gen17998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7631"/><l level="1" sID="gen17999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7631"/>Memoratus sum misericordiæ tuæ Domine, <l eID="gen17999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18000"/>et operationis tuæ, quæ a sæculo sunt : <l eID="gen18000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7632"/><l level="1" sID="gen18001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7632"/>quoniam eruis sustinentes te, Domine, <l eID="gen18001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18002"/>et liberas eos de manibus gentium. <l eID="gen18002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7633"/><l level="1" sID="gen18003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7633"/>Exaltasti super terram habitationem meam, <l eID="gen18003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18004"/>et pro morte defluente deprecatus sum. <l eID="gen18004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7634"/><l level="1" sID="gen18005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7634"/>Invocavi Dominum patrem Domini mei, <l eID="gen18005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18006"/>ut non derelinquat me in die tribulationis meæ, <l eID="gen18006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18007"/>et in tempore superborum, sine adjutorio. <l eID="gen18007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7635"/><l level="1" sID="gen18008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7635"/>Laudabo nomen tuum assidue, <l eID="gen18008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18009"/>et collaudabo illud in confessione : <l eID="gen18009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18010"/>et exaudita est oratio mea, <l eID="gen18010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7636"/><l level="1" sID="gen18011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7636"/>et liberasti me de perditione, <l eID="gen18011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18012"/>et eripuisti me de tempore iniquo. <l eID="gen18012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7637"/><l level="1" sID="gen18013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7637"/>Propterea confitebor, et laudem dicam tibi, <l eID="gen18013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18014"/>et benedicam nomini Domini. <l eID="gen18014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7638"/><l level="1" sID="gen18015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7638"/>Cum adhuc junior essem, priusquam oberrarem, <l eID="gen18015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18016"/>quæsivi sapientiam palam in oratione mea. <l eID="gen18016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7639"/><l level="1" sID="gen18017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7639"/>Ante templum postulabam pro illis, <l eID="gen18017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18018"/>et usque in novissimis inquiram eam : <l eID="gen18018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18019"/>et effloruit tamquam præcox uva. <l eID="gen18019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7640"/><l level="1" sID="gen18020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7640"/>Lætatum est cor meum in ea : <l eID="gen18020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18021"/>ambulavit pes meus iter rectum : <l eID="gen18021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18022"/>a juventute mea investigabam eam. <l eID="gen18022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7641"/><l level="1" sID="gen18023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7641"/>Inclinavi modico aurem meam, <l eID="gen18023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18024"/>et excepi illam. <l eID="gen18024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7642"/><l level="1" sID="gen18025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7642"/>Multam inveni in meipso sapientiam, <l eID="gen18025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18026"/>et multum profeci in ea. <l eID="gen18026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7643"/><l level="1" sID="gen18027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7643"/>Danti mihi sapientiam dabo gloriam : <l eID="gen18027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7644"/><l level="1" sID="gen18028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7644"/>consiliatus sum enim ut facerem illam. <l eID="gen18028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18029"/>Zelatus sum bonum, et non confundar. <l eID="gen18029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7645"/><l level="1" sID="gen18030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7645"/>Colluctata est anima mea in illa, <l eID="gen18030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18031"/>et in faciendo eam confirmatus sum. <l eID="gen18031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7646"/><l level="1" sID="gen18032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7646"/>Manus meas extendi in altum, <l eID="gen18032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18033"/>et insipientiam ejus luxi ; <l eID="gen18033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:27
