verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7647"/><l level="1" sID="gen18034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7647"/>animam meam direxi ad illam, <l eID="gen18034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18035"/>et in agnitione inveni eam. <l eID="gen18035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7648"/><l level="1" sID="gen18036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7648"/>Possedi cum ipsa cor ab initio : <l eID="gen18036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18037"/>propter hoc, non derelinquar. <l eID="gen18037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7649"/><l level="1" sID="gen18038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7649"/>Venter meus conturbatus est quærendo illam : <l eID="gen18038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18039"/>propterea bonam possidebo possessionem. <l eID="gen18039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7650"/><l level="1" sID="gen18040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7650"/>Dedit mihi Dominus linguam mercedem meam, <l eID="gen18040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18041"/>et in ipsa laudabo eum. <l eID="gen18041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7651"/><l level="1" sID="gen18042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7651"/>Appropiate ad me, indocti, <l eID="gen18042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18043"/>et congregate vos in domum disciplinæ. <l eID="gen18043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7652"/><l level="1" sID="gen18044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7652"/>Quid adhuc retardatis ? et quid dicitis in his ? <l eID="gen18044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18045"/>animæ vestræ sitiunt vehementer. <l eID="gen18045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7653"/><l level="1" sID="gen18046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7653"/>Aperui os meum, et locutus sum : <l eID="gen18046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18047"/>Comparate vobis sine argento, <l eID="gen18047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7654"/><l level="1" sID="gen18048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7654"/>et collum vestrum subjicite jugo : <l eID="gen18048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18049"/>et suscipiat anima vestra disciplinam : <l eID="gen18049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18050"/>in proximo est enim invenire eam. <l eID="gen18050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7655"/><l level="1" sID="gen18051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7655"/>Videte oculis vestris, quia modicum laboravi, <l eID="gen18051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18052"/>et inveni mihi multam requiem. <l eID="gen18052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7656"/><l level="1" sID="gen18053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7656"/>Assumite disciplinam in multo numero argenti, <l eID="gen18053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18054"/>et copiosum aurum possidete in ea. <l eID="gen18054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7657"/><l level="1" sID="gen18055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7657"/>Lætetur anima vestra in misericordia ejus, <l eID="gen18055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18056"/>et non confundemini in laude ipsius. <l eID="gen18056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Sirach 51:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7658"/><l level="1" sID="gen18057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7658"/>Operamini opus vestrum ante tempus, <l eID="gen18057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18058"/>et dabit vobis mercedem vestram in tempore suo. <l eID="gen18058" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen17978"/> <chapter eID="Sir.51"/> <div eID="gen14516" osisID="Sir" type="book"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:1
verses.text: Visio Isaiæ, filii Amos, quam vidit super Judam et Jerusalem, in diebus Oziæ, Joathan, Achaz, et Ezechiæ, regum Juda.  <div eID="gen18060" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7659"/><lg sID="gen18061"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7659"/>Audite, cæli, et auribus percipe, terra, <l eID="gen18062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18063"/>quoniam Dominus locutus est. <l eID="gen18063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18064"/>Filios enutrivi, et exaltavi ; <l eID="gen18064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18065"/>ipsi autem spreverunt me. <l eID="gen18065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7660"/><l level="1" sID="gen18066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7660"/>Cognovit bos possessorem suum, <l eID="gen18066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18067"/>et asinus præsepe domini sui ; <l eID="gen18067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18068"/>Israël autem me non cognovit, <l eID="gen18068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18069"/>et populus meus non intellexit. <l eID="gen18069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7661"/><l level="1" sID="gen18070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7661"/>Væ genti peccatrici, <l eID="gen18070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18071"/>populo gravi iniquitate, <l eID="gen18071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18072"/>semini nequam, filiis sceleratis ! <l eID="gen18072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18073"/>dereliquerunt Dominum ; <l eID="gen18073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18074"/>blasphemaverunt Sanctum Israël ; <l eID="gen18074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18075"/>abalienati sunt retrorsum. <l eID="gen18075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7662"/><l level="1" sID="gen18076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7662"/>Super quo percutiam vos ultra, addentes prævaricationem ? <l eID="gen18076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18077"/>omne caput languidum, <l eID="gen18077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18078"/>et omne cor mœrens. <l eID="gen18078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7663"/><l level="1" sID="gen18079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7663"/>A planta pedis usque ad verticem, <l eID="gen18079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18080"/>non est in eo sanitas ; <l eID="gen18080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18081"/>vulnus, et livor, et plaga tumens, <l eID="gen18081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18082"/>non est circumligata, nec curata medicamine, <l eID="gen18082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18083"/>neque fota oleo. <l eID="gen18083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7664"/><l level="1" sID="gen18084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7664"/>Terra vestra deserta ; <l eID="gen18084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18085"/>civitates vestræ succensæ igni : <l eID="gen18085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18086"/>regionem vestram coram vobis alieni devorant, <l eID="gen18086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18087"/>et desolabitur sicut in vastitate hostili. <l eID="gen18087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7665"/><l level="1" sID="gen18088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7665"/>Et derelinquetur filia Sion <l eID="gen18088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18089"/>ut umbraculum in vinea, <l eID="gen18089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18090"/>et sicut tugurium in cucumerario, <l eID="gen18090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18091"/>et sicut civitas quæ vastatur. <l eID="gen18091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7666"/><l level="1" sID="gen18092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7666"/>Nisi Dominus exercituum <l eID="gen18092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18093"/>reliquisset nobis semen, <l eID="gen18093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18094"/>quasi Sodoma fuissemus, <l eID="gen18094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18095"/>et quasi Gomorrha similes essemus. <l eID="gen18095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7667"/><l level="1" sID="gen18096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7667"/>Audite verbum Domini, <l eID="gen18096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18097"/>principes Sodomorum ; <l eID="gen18097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18098"/>percipite auribus legem Dei nostri, <l eID="gen18098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18099"/>populus Gomorrhæ. <l eID="gen18099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7668"/><l level="1" sID="gen18100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7668"/>Quo mihi multitudinem victimarum vestrarum ? <l eID="gen18100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18101"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen18101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18102"/>Plenus sum : <l eID="gen18102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18103"/>holocausta arietum, <l eID="gen18103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18104"/>et adipem pinguium, <l eID="gen18104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18105"/>et sanguinem vitulorum et agnorum et hircorum, <l eID="gen18105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18106"/>nolui. <l eID="gen18106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7669"/><l level="1" sID="gen18107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7669"/>Cum veniretis ante conspectum meum, <l eID="gen18107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18108"/>quis quæsivit hæc de manibus vestris, <l eID="gen18108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18109"/>ut ambularetis in atriis meis ? <l eID="gen18109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7670"/><l level="1" sID="gen18110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7670"/>Ne offeratis ultra sacrificium frustra : <l eID="gen18110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18111"/>incensum abominatio est mihi. <l eID="gen18111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18112"/>Neomeniam et sabbatum, et festivitates alias, non feram ; <l eID="gen18112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18113"/>iniqui sunt cœtus vestri. <l eID="gen18113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7671"/><l level="1" sID="gen18114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7671"/>Calendas vestras, et solemnitates vestras odivit anima mea : <l eID="gen18114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18115"/>facta sunt mihi molesta ; laboravi sustinens. <l eID="gen18115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7672"/><l level="1" sID="gen18116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7672"/>Et cum extenderitis manus vestras, avertam oculos meos a vobis, <l eID="gen18116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18117"/>et cum multiplicaveritis orationem, non exaudiam : <l eID="gen18117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18118"/>manus enim vestræ sanguine plenæ sunt. <l eID="gen18118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7673"/><l level="1" sID="gen18119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7673"/>Lavamini, mundi estote ; <l eID="gen18119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18120"/>auferte malum cogitationum vestrarum <l eID="gen18120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18121"/>ab oculis meis : <l eID="gen18121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18122"/>quiescite agere perverse, <l eID="gen18122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7674"/><l level="1" sID="gen18123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7674"/>discite benefacere ; <l eID="gen18123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18124"/>quærite judicium, subvenite oppresso, <l eID="gen18124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18125"/>judicate pupillo, defendite viduam. <l eID="gen18125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7675"/><l level="1" sID="gen18126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7675"/>Et venite, et arguite me, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen18126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18127"/>Si fuerint peccata vestra ut coccinum, <l eID="gen18127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18128"/>quasi nix dealbabuntur ; <l eID="gen18128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18129"/>et si fuerint rubra quasi vermiculus, <l eID="gen18129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18130"/>velut lana alba erunt. <l eID="gen18130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7676"/><l level="1" sID="gen18131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7676"/>Si volueritis, et audieritis me, <l eID="gen18131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18132"/>bona terræ comeditis. <l eID="gen18132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7677"/><l level="1" sID="gen18133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7677"/>Quod si nolueritis, et me ad iracundiam provocaveritis, <l eID="gen18133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18134"/>gladius devorabit vos, <l eID="gen18134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18135"/>quia os Domini locutum est. <l eID="gen18135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7678"/><l level="1" sID="gen18136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7678"/>Quomodo facta est meretrix <l eID="gen18136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18137"/>civitas fidelis, plena judicii ? <l eID="gen18137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18138"/>justitia habitavit in ea, <l eID="gen18138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18139"/>nunc autem homicidæ. <l eID="gen18139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7679"/><l level="1" sID="gen18140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7679"/>Argentum tuum versum est in scoriam ; <l eID="gen18140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18141"/>vinum tuum mistum est aqua. <l eID="gen18141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7680"/><l level="1" sID="gen18142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7680"/>Principes tui infideles, <l eID="gen18142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18143"/>socii furum. <l eID="gen18143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18144"/>Omnes diligunt munera, <l eID="gen18144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18145"/>sequuntur retributiones. <l eID="gen18145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18146"/>Pupillo non judicant, <l eID="gen18146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18147"/>et causa viduæ non ingreditur ad illos. <l eID="gen18147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7681"/><l level="1" sID="gen18148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7681"/>Propter hoc ait Dominus, <l eID="gen18148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18149"/>Deus exercituum, Fortis Israël : <l eID="gen18149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18150"/>Heu ! consolabor super hostibus meis, <l eID="gen18150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18151"/>et vindicabor de inimicis meis. <l eID="gen18151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7682"/><l level="1" sID="gen18152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7682"/>Et convertam manum meam ad te, <l eID="gen18152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18153"/>et excoquam ad puram scoriam tuam, <l eID="gen18153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18154"/>et auferam omne stannum tuum. <l eID="gen18154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7683"/><l level="1" sID="gen18155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7683"/>Et restituam judices tuos ut fuerunt prius, <l eID="gen18155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18156"/>et consiliarios tuos sicut antiquitus ; <l eID="gen18156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18157"/>post hæc vocaberis civitas justi, <l eID="gen18157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18158"/>urbs fidelis. <l eID="gen18158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7684"/><l level="1" sID="gen18159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7684"/>Sion in judicio redimetur, <l eID="gen18159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18160"/>et reducent eam in justitia. <l eID="gen18160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7685"/><l level="1" sID="gen18161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7685"/>Et conteret scelestos, et peccatores simul ; <l eID="gen18161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18162"/>et qui dereliquerunt Dominum consumentur. <l eID="gen18162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7686"/><l level="1" sID="gen18163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7686"/>Confundentur enim ab idolis quibus sacrificaverunt, <l eID="gen18163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18164"/>et erubescetis super hortis quos elegeratis, <l eID="gen18164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7687"/><l level="1" sID="gen18165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7687"/>cum fueritis velut quercus defluentibus foliis, <l eID="gen18165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18166"/>et velut hortus absque aqua. <l eID="gen18166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 1:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7688"/><l level="1" sID="gen18167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7688"/>Et erit fortitudo vestra ut favilla stuppæ, <l eID="gen18167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18168"/>et opus vestrum quasi scintilla, <l eID="gen18168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18169"/>et succendetur utrumque simul, <l eID="gen18169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18170"/>et non erit qui extinguat. <l eID="gen18170" level="1"/><lg eID="gen18061"/> <chapter eID="Isa.1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:1
verses.text: Verbum quod vidit Isaias, filius Amos, super Juda et Jerusalem.  <div eID="gen18171" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7689"/><lg sID="gen18172"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7689"/>Et erit in novissimis diebus : <l eID="gen18173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18174"/>præparatus mons domus Domini <l eID="gen18174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18175"/>in vertice montium, <l eID="gen18175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18176"/>et elevabitur super colles ; <l eID="gen18176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18177"/>et fluent ad eum omnes gentes, <l eID="gen18177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7690"/><l level="1" sID="gen18178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7690"/>et ibunt populi multi, et dicent : <l eID="gen18178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18179"/>Venite, et ascendamus ad montem Domini, <l eID="gen18179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18180"/>et ad domum Dei Jacob ; <l eID="gen18180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18181"/>et docebit nos vias suas, <l eID="gen18181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18182"/>et ambulabimus in semitis ejus, <l eID="gen18182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18183"/>quia de Sion exibit lex, <l eID="gen18183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18184"/>et verbum Domini de Jerusalem. <l eID="gen18184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7691"/><l level="1" sID="gen18185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7691"/>Et judicabit gentes, <l eID="gen18185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18186"/>et arguet populos multos ; <l eID="gen18186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18187"/>et conflabunt gladios suos in vomeres, <l eID="gen18187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18188"/>et lanceas suas in falces. <l eID="gen18188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18189"/>Non levabit gens contra gentem gladium, <l eID="gen18189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18190"/>nec exercebuntur ultra ad prælium. <l eID="gen18190" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7692"/><l level="1" sID="gen18191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7692"/>Domus Jacob, venite, <l eID="gen18191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18192"/>et ambulemus in lumine Domini. <l eID="gen18192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7693"/><l level="1" sID="gen18193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7693"/>Projecisti enim populum tuum, <l eID="gen18193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18194"/>domum Jacob, <l eID="gen18194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18195"/>quia repleti sunt ut olim, <l eID="gen18195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18196"/>et augeres habuerunt ut Philisthiim, <l eID="gen18196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18197"/>et pueris alienis adhæserunt. <l eID="gen18197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7694"/><l level="1" sID="gen18198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7694"/>Repleta est terra argento et auro, <l eID="gen18198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18199"/>et non est finis thesaurorum ejus. <l eID="gen18199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7695"/><l level="1" sID="gen18200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7695"/>Et repleta est terra ejus equis, <l eID="gen18200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18201"/>et innumerabiles quadrigæ ejus. <l eID="gen18201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18202"/>Et repleta est terra ejus idolis ; <l eID="gen18202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18203"/>opus manuum suarum adoraverunt, <l eID="gen18203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18204"/>quod fecerunt digiti eorum. <l eID="gen18204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7696"/><l level="1" sID="gen18205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7696"/>Et incurvavit se homo, <l eID="gen18205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18206"/>et humiliatus est vir ; <l eID="gen18206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18207"/>ne ergo dimittas eis. <l eID="gen18207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7697"/><l level="1" sID="gen18208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7697"/>Ingredere in petram, et abscondere in fossa humo <l eID="gen18208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18209"/>a facie timoris Domini, et a gloria majestatis ejus. <l eID="gen18209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7698"/><l level="1" sID="gen18210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7698"/>Oculi sublimes hominis humiliati sunt, <l eID="gen18210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18211"/>et incurvabitur altitudo virorum ; <l eID="gen18211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18212"/>exaltabitur autem Dominus solus <l eID="gen18212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18213"/>in die illa. <l eID="gen18213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7699"/><l level="1" sID="gen18214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7699"/>Quia dies Domini exercituum <l eID="gen18214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18215"/>super omnem superbum, et excelsum, <l eID="gen18215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18216"/>et super omnem arrogantem, <l eID="gen18216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18217"/>et humiliabitur ; <l eID="gen18217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7700"/><l level="1" sID="gen18218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7700"/>et super omnes cedros Libani sublimes et erectas, <l eID="gen18218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18219"/>et super omnes quercus Basan, <l eID="gen18219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7701"/><l level="1" sID="gen18220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7701"/>et super omnes montes excelsos, <l eID="gen18220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18221"/>et super omnes colles elevatos, <l eID="gen18221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7702"/><l level="1" sID="gen18222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7702"/>et super omnem turrim excelsam, <l eID="gen18222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18223"/>et super omnem murum munitum, <l eID="gen18223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7703"/><l level="1" sID="gen18224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7703"/>et super omnes naves Tharsis, <l eID="gen18224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18225"/>et super omne quod visu pulchrum est, <l eID="gen18225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7704"/><l level="1" sID="gen18226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7704"/>et incurvabitur sublimitas hominum, <l eID="gen18226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18227"/>et humiliabitur altitudo virorum, <l eID="gen18227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18228"/>et elevabitur Dominus solus <l eID="gen18228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18229"/>in die illa ; <l eID="gen18229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7705"/><l level="1" sID="gen18230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7705"/>et idola penitus conterentur ; <l eID="gen18230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7706"/><l level="1" sID="gen18231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7706"/>et introibunt in speluncas petrarum, <l eID="gen18231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18232"/>et in voragines terræ, <l eID="gen18232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18233"/>a facie formidinis Domini <l eID="gen18233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18234"/>et a gloria majestatis ejus, <l eID="gen18234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18235"/>cum surrexerit percutere terram. <l eID="gen18235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7707"/><l level="1" sID="gen18236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7707"/>In die illa projiciet homo <l eID="gen18236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18237"/>idola argenti sui, et simulacra auri sui, <l eID="gen18237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18238"/>quæ fecerat sibi ut adoraret, <l eID="gen18238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18239"/>talpas et vespertiliones. <l eID="gen18239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7708"/><l level="1" sID="gen18240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7708"/>Et ingreditur scissuras petrarum <l eID="gen18240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18241"/>et in cavernas saxorum, <l eID="gen18241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18242"/>a facie formidinis Domini, <l eID="gen18242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18243"/>et a gloria majestatis ejus, <l eID="gen18243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18244"/>cum surrexerit percutere terram. <l eID="gen18244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7709"/><l level="1" sID="gen18245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7709"/>Quiescite ergo ab homine, <l eID="gen18245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18246"/>cujus spiritus in naribus ejus est, <l eID="gen18246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18247"/>quia excelsus reputatus est ipse.  <chapter eID="Isa.2"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:1
verses.text: Ecce enim Dominator, Dominus exercituum, <l eID="gen18248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18249"/>auferet a Jerusalem et a Juda <l eID="gen18249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18250"/>validum et fortem, <l eID="gen18250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18251"/>omne robur panis, et omne robor aquæ ; <l eID="gen18251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7710"/><l level="1" sID="gen18252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7710"/>fortem, et virum bellatorem, <l eID="gen18252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18253"/>judicem, et prophetam, et ariolum, et senem ; <l eID="gen18253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7711"/><l level="1" sID="gen18254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7711"/>principem super quinquaginta, et honorabilem vultu et consiliarium, <l eID="gen18254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18255"/>et sapientem de architectis, et prudentem eloquii mystici. <l eID="gen18255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7712"/><l level="1" sID="gen18256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7712"/>Et dabo pueros principes eorum, <l eID="gen18256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18257"/>et effeminati dominabuntur eis ; <l eID="gen18257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7713"/><l level="1" sID="gen18258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7713"/>et irruet populus, vir ad virum, <l eID="gen18258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18259"/>et unusquisque ad proximum suum ; <l eID="gen18259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18260"/>tumultuabitur puer contra senem, <l eID="gen18260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18261"/>et ignobilis contra nobilem. <l eID="gen18261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7714"/><l level="1" sID="gen18262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7714"/>Apprehendet enim vir fratrem suum, <l eID="gen18262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18263"/>domesticum patris sui : <l eID="gen18263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18264"/>Vestimentum tibi est, princeps esto noster, <l eID="gen18264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18265"/>ruina autem hæc sub manu tua. <l eID="gen18265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7715"/><l level="1" sID="gen18266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7715"/>Respondebit in die illa, dicens : <l eID="gen18266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18267"/>Non sum medicus, <l eID="gen18267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18268"/>et in domo mea non est panis neque vestimentum : <l eID="gen18268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18269"/>nolite constituere me principem populi. <l eID="gen18269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7716"/><l level="1" sID="gen18270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7716"/>Ruit enim Jerusalem, et Judas concidit, <l eID="gen18270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18271"/>quia lingua eorum et adinventiones eorum contra Dominum, <l eID="gen18271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18272"/>ut provocarent oculos majestatis ejus. <l eID="gen18272" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7717"/><l level="1" sID="gen18273"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7717"/>Agnitio vultus eorum respondit eis ; <l eID="gen18273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18274"/>et peccatum suum quasi Sodoma prædicaverunt, nec absconderunt. <l eID="gen18274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18275"/>Væ animæ eorum, quoniam reddita sunt eis mala ! <l eID="gen18275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7718"/><l level="1" sID="gen18276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7718"/>Dicite justo quoniam bene, <l eID="gen18276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18277"/>quoniam fructum adinventionum suarum comedet. <l eID="gen18277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7719"/><l level="1" sID="gen18278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7719"/>Væ impio in malum ! <l eID="gen18278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18279"/>retributio enim manuum ejus fiet ei. <l eID="gen18279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7720"/><l level="1" sID="gen18280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7720"/>Populum meum exactores sui spoliaverunt, <l eID="gen18280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18281"/>et mulieres dominatæ sunt eis. <l eID="gen18281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18282"/>Popule meus, qui te beatum dicunt, ipsi te decipiunt, <l eID="gen18282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18283"/>et viam gressuum tuorum dissipant. <l eID="gen18283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7721"/><l level="1" sID="gen18284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7721"/>Stat ad judicandum Dominus, <l eID="gen18284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18285"/>et stat ad judicandos populos. <l eID="gen18285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7722"/><l level="1" sID="gen18286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7722"/>Dominus ad judicium veniet <l eID="gen18286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18287"/>cum senibus populi sui, et principibus ejus ; <l eID="gen18287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18288"/>vos enim depasti estis vineam, <l eID="gen18288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18289"/>et rapina pauperis in domo vestra. <l eID="gen18289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7723"/><l level="1" sID="gen18290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7723"/>Quare atteritis populum meum, <l eID="gen18290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18291"/>et facies pauperum commolitis ? <l eID="gen18291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18292"/>dicit Dominus Deus exercituum. <l eID="gen18292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7724"/><l level="1" sID="gen18293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7724"/>Et dixit Dominus : <l eID="gen18293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18294"/>Pro eo quod elevatæ sunt filiæ Sion, <l eID="gen18294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18295"/>et ambulaverunt extento collo, <l eID="gen18295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18296"/>et nutibus oculorum ibant, <l eID="gen18296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18297"/>et plaudebant, ambulabant pedibus suis, <l eID="gen18297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18298"/>et composito gradu incedebant ; <l eID="gen18298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7725"/><l level="1" sID="gen18299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7725"/>decalvabit Dominus verticem filiarum Sion, <l eID="gen18299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18300"/>et Dominus crinem earum nudabit. <l eID="gen18300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7726"/><l level="1" sID="gen18301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7726"/>In die illa auferet Dominus ornamentum calceamentum, <l eID="gen18301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7727"/><l level="1" sID="gen18302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7727"/>et lunulas, et torques, <l eID="gen18302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18303"/>et monilia, et armillas, et mitras, <l eID="gen18303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7728"/><l level="1" sID="gen18304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7728"/>et discriminalia, et periscelidas, et murenulas, <l eID="gen18304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18305"/>et olfactoriola, et inaures, <l eID="gen18305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7729"/><l level="1" sID="gen18306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7729"/>et annulos, et gemmas in fronte pendentes, <l eID="gen18306" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7730"/><l level="1" sID="gen18307"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7730"/>et mutatoria, et palliola, <l eID="gen18307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18308"/>et linteamina, et acus, <l eID="gen18308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7731"/><l level="1" sID="gen18309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7731"/>et specula, et sindones, <l eID="gen18309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18310"/>et vittas, et theristra. <l eID="gen18310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7732"/><l level="1" sID="gen18311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7732"/>Et erit pro suavi odore fœtor, <l eID="gen18311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18312"/>et pro zona funiculus, <l eID="gen18312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18313"/>et pro crispanti crine calvitium, <l eID="gen18313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18314"/>et pro fascia pectorali cilicium. <l eID="gen18314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7733"/><l level="1" sID="gen18315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7733"/>Pulcherrimi quoque viri tui gladio cadent, <l eID="gen18315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18316"/>et fortes tui in prælio. <l eID="gen18316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7734"/><l level="1" sID="gen18317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7734"/>Et mœrebunt atque lugebunt portæ ejus, <l eID="gen18317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18318"/>et desolata in terra sedebit.  <chapter eID="Isa.3"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:1
verses.text: Et apprehendent septem mulieres virum unum in die illa, dicentes : <l eID="gen18319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18320"/>Panem nostrum comedemus, <l eID="gen18320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18321"/>et vestimentis nostris operiemur : <l eID="gen18321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18322"/>tantummodo invocetur nomen tuum super nos ; <l eID="gen18322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18323"/>aufer opprobrium nostrum. <l eID="gen18323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7735"/><l level="1" sID="gen18324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7735"/>In die illa, <l eID="gen18324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18325"/>erit germen Domini in magnificentia et gloria, <l eID="gen18325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18326"/>et fructus terræ sublimis, et exsultatio <l eID="gen18326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18327"/>his qui salvati fuerint de Israël. <l eID="gen18327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7736"/><l level="1" sID="gen18328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7736"/>Et erit : omnis qui relictus fuerit in Sion, <l eID="gen18328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18329"/>et residuus in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen18329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18330"/>Sanctus vocabitur, <l eID="gen18330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18331"/>omnis qui scriptus est in vita in Jerusalem. <l eID="gen18331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7737"/><l level="1" sID="gen18332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7737"/>Si abluerit Dominus sordes filiarum Sion, <l eID="gen18332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18333"/>et sanguinem Jerusalem laverit de medio ejus, <l eID="gen18333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18334"/>in spiritu judicii, et spiritu ardoris. <l eID="gen18334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7738"/><l level="1" sID="gen18335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7738"/>Et creabit Dominus super omnem locum montis Sion, <l eID="gen18335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18336"/>et ubi invocatus est, <l eID="gen18336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18337"/>nubem per diem et fumum, <l eID="gen18337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18338"/>et splendorem ignis flammantis in nocte : <l eID="gen18338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18339"/>super omnem enim gloriam protectio. <l eID="gen18339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7739"/><l level="1" sID="gen18340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7739"/>Et tabernaculum erit in umbraculum, <l eID="gen18340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18341"/>diei ab æstu, <l eID="gen18341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18342"/>et in securitatem et absconsionem <l eID="gen18342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18343"/>a turbine et a pluvia.  <chapter eID="Isa.4"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:1
verses.text: Cantabo dilecto meo <l eID="gen18344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18345"/>canticum patruelis mei vineæ suæ. <l eID="gen18345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18346"/>Vinea facta est dilecto meo <l eID="gen18346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18347"/>in cornu filio olei. <l eID="gen18347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7740"/><l level="1" sID="gen18348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7740"/>Et sepivit eam, et lapides elegit ex illa, <l eID="gen18348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18349"/>et plantavit eam electam ; <l eID="gen18349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18350"/>et ædificavit turrim in medio ejus, <l eID="gen18350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18351"/>et torcular exstruxit in ea ; <l eID="gen18351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18352"/>et exspectavit ut faceret uvas, <l eID="gen18352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18353"/>et fecit labruscas. <l eID="gen18353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7741"/><l level="1" sID="gen18354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7741"/>Nunc ergo, habitatores Jerusalem <l eID="gen18354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18355"/>et viri Juda, <l eID="gen18355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18356"/>judicate inter me <l eID="gen18356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18357"/>et vineam meam. <l eID="gen18357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7742"/><l level="1" sID="gen18358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7742"/>Quid est quod debui ultra facere vineæ meæ, <l eID="gen18358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18359"/>et non feci ei ? <l eID="gen18359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18360"/>an quod exspectavi ut faceret uvas, <l eID="gen18360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18361"/>et fecit labruscas ? <l eID="gen18361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7743"/><l level="1" sID="gen18362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7743"/>Et nunc ostendam vobis <l eID="gen18362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18363"/>quid ego faciam vineæ meæ : <l eID="gen18363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18364"/>auferam sepem ejus, <l eID="gen18364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18365"/>et erit in direptionem ; <l eID="gen18365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18366"/>diruam maceriam ejus, <l eID="gen18366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18367"/>et erit in conculcationem. <l eID="gen18367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7744"/><l level="1" sID="gen18368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7744"/>Et ponam eam desertam ; <l eID="gen18368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18369"/>non putabitur et non fodietur : <l eID="gen18369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18370"/>et ascendent vepres et spinæ, <l eID="gen18370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18371"/>et nubibus mandabo <l eID="gen18371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18372"/>ne pluant super eam imbrem. <l eID="gen18372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7745"/><l level="1" sID="gen18373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7745"/>Vinea enim Domini exercituum <l eID="gen18373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18374"/>domus Israël est ; <l eID="gen18374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18375"/>et vir Juda <l eID="gen18375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18376"/>germen ejus delectabile : <l eID="gen18376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18377"/>et exspectavi ut faceret judicium, <l eID="gen18377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18378"/>et ecce iniquitas ; <l eID="gen18378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18379"/>et justitiam, et ecce clamor. <l eID="gen18379" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7746"/><l level="1" sID="gen18380"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7746"/>Væ qui conjungitis domum ad domum, <l eID="gen18380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18381"/>et agrum agro copulatis <l eID="gen18381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18382"/>usque ad terminum loci ! <l eID="gen18382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18383"/>Numquid habitabitis vos soli <l eID="gen18383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18384"/>in medio terræ ? <l eID="gen18384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7747"/><l level="1" sID="gen18385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7747"/>In auribus meis sunt hæc, <l eID="gen18385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18386"/>dicit Dominus exercituum ; <l eID="gen18386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18387"/>nisi domus multæ desertæ fuerint, <l eID="gen18387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18388"/>grandes et pulchræ, absque habitatore. <l eID="gen18388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7748"/><l level="1" sID="gen18389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7748"/>Decem enim jugera vinearum facient lagunculam unam, <l eID="gen18389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18390"/>et triginta modii sementis facient modios tres. <l eID="gen18390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7749"/><l level="1" sID="gen18391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7749"/>Væ qui consurgitis mane <l eID="gen18391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18392"/>ad ebrietatem sectandam, <l eID="gen18392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18393"/>et potandum usque ad vesperam, <l eID="gen18393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18394"/>ut vino æstuetis ! <l eID="gen18394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7750"/><l level="1" sID="gen18395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7750"/>Cithara, et lyra, et tympanum, <l eID="gen18395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18396"/>et tibia, et vinum in conviviis vestris ; <l eID="gen18396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18397"/>et opus Domini non respicitis, <l eID="gen18397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18398"/>nec opera manuum ejus consideratis. <l eID="gen18398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7751"/><l level="1" sID="gen18399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7751"/>Propterea captivus ductus est populus meus, <l eID="gen18399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18400"/>quia non habuit scientiam, <l eID="gen18400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18401"/>et nobiles ejus interierunt fame, <l eID="gen18401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18402"/>et multitudo ejus siti exaruit. <l eID="gen18402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7752"/><l level="1" sID="gen18403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7752"/>Propterea dilatavit infernus animam suam, <l eID="gen18403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18404"/>et aperuit os suum absque ullo termino ; <l eID="gen18404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18405"/>et descendent fortes ejus, <l eID="gen18405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18406"/>et populus ejus, et sublimes gloriosique ejus, ad eum. <l eID="gen18406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7753"/><l level="1" sID="gen18407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7753"/>Et incurvabitur homo, et humiliabitur vir, <l eID="gen18407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18408"/>et oculi sublimium deprimentur. <l eID="gen18408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7754"/><l level="1" sID="gen18409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7754"/>Et exaltabitur Dominus exercituum in judicio ; <l eID="gen18409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18410"/>et Deus sanctus sanctificabitur in justitia. <l eID="gen18410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7755"/><l level="1" sID="gen18411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7755"/>Et pascentur agni juxta ordinem suum, <l eID="gen18411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18412"/>et deserta in ubertatem versa advenæ comedent. <l eID="gen18412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7756"/><l level="1" sID="gen18413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7756"/>Væ qui trahitis iniquitatem <l eID="gen18413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18414"/>in funiculis vanitatis, <l eID="gen18414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18415"/>et quasi vinculum plaustri peccatum ! <l eID="gen18415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7757"/><l level="1" sID="gen18416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7757"/>qui dicitis : Festinet, <l eID="gen18416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18417"/>et cito veniat opus ejus, ut videamus ; <l eID="gen18417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18418"/>et appropiet, et veniat <l eID="gen18418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18419"/>consilium sancti Israël, <l eID="gen18419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18420"/>et sciemus illud ! <l eID="gen18420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7758"/><l level="1" sID="gen18421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7758"/>Væ qui dicitis malum bonum, <l eID="gen18421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18422"/>et bonum malum ; <l eID="gen18422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18423"/>ponentes tenebras lucem, <l eID="gen18423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18424"/>et lucem tenebras ; <l eID="gen18424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18425"/>ponentes amarum in dulce, <l eID="gen18425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18426"/>et dulce in amarum ! <l eID="gen18426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7759"/><l level="1" sID="gen18427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7759"/>Væ qui sapientes estis in oculis vestris, <l eID="gen18427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18428"/>et coram vobismetipsis prudentes. <l eID="gen18428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7760"/><l level="1" sID="gen18429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7760"/>Væ qui potentes estis ad bibendum vinum, <l eID="gen18429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18430"/>et viri fortes ad miscendam ebrietatem ! <l eID="gen18430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7761"/><l level="1" sID="gen18431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7761"/>qui justificatis impium pro muneribus, <l eID="gen18431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18432"/>et justitiam justi aufertis ab eo ! <l eID="gen18432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7762"/><l level="1" sID="gen18433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7762"/>Propter hoc, sicut devorat stipulam lingua ignis, <l eID="gen18433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18434"/>et calor flammæ exurit, <l eID="gen18434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18435"/>sic radix eorum quasi favilla erit, <l eID="gen18435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18436"/>et germen eorum ut pulvis ascendet ; <l eID="gen18436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18437"/>abjecerunt enim legem Domini exercituum, <l eID="gen18437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18438"/>et eloquium sancti Israël blasphemaverunt. <l eID="gen18438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7763"/><l level="1" sID="gen18439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7763"/>Ideo iratus est furor Domini in populum suum, <l eID="gen18439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18440"/>et extendit manum suam super eum, et percussit eum : <l eID="gen18440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18441"/>et conturbati sunt montes, <l eID="gen18441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18442"/>et facta sunt morticina eorum quasi stercus in medio platearum. <l eID="gen18442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18443"/>In his omnibus non est adversus furor ejus, <l eID="gen18443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18444"/>sed adhuc manus ejus extenta. <l eID="gen18444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7764"/><l level="1" sID="gen18445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7764"/>Et elevabit signum in nationibus procul, <l eID="gen18445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18446"/>et sibilabit ad eum de finibus terræ : <l eID="gen18446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18447"/>et ecce festinus velociter veniet. <l eID="gen18447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7765"/><l level="1" sID="gen18448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7765"/>Non est deficiens neque laborans in eo ; <l eID="gen18448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18449"/>non dormitabit, neque dormiet ; <l eID="gen18449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18450"/>neque solvetur cingulum renum ejus, <l eID="gen18450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18451"/>nec rumpetur corrigia calceamenti ejus. <l eID="gen18451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7766"/><l level="1" sID="gen18452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7766"/>Sagittæ ejus acutæ, et omnes arcus ejus extenti. <l eID="gen18452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18453"/>Ungulæ equorum ejus ut silex, <l eID="gen18453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18454"/>et rotæ ejus quasi impetus tempestatis. <l eID="gen18454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7767"/><l level="1" sID="gen18455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7767"/>Rugitus ejus ut leonis ; <l eID="gen18455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18456"/>rugiet ut catuli leonum : <l eID="gen18456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18457"/>et frendet, et tenebit prædam, <l eID="gen18457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18458"/>et amplexabitur, et non erit qui eruat. <l eID="gen18458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 5:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7768"/><l level="1" sID="gen18459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7768"/>Et sonabit super eum in die illa sicut sonitus maris : <l eID="gen18459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18460"/>aspiciemus in terram, <l eID="gen18460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18461"/>et ecce tenebræ tribulationis, <l eID="gen18461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18462"/>et lux obtenebrata est in caligine ejus. <l eID="gen18462" level="1"/><lg eID="gen18172"/> <chapter eID="Isa.5"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:1
verses.text: In anno quo mortuus est rex Ozias, vidi Dominum sedentem super solium excelsum et elevatum ; et ea quæ sub ipso erant replebant templum.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:2
verses.text: Seraphim stabant super illud : sex alæ uni, et sex alæ alteri ; duabus velabant faciem ejus, et duabus velabant pedes ejus, et duabus volabant.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:3
verses.text: Et clamabant alter ad alterum, et dicebant : <div eID="gen18463" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18464"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18465"/>Sanctus, sanctus, sanctus Dominus, Deus exercituum ; <l eID="gen18465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18466"/>plena est omnis terra gloria ejus.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:4
verses.text: Et commota sunt superliminaria cardinum a voce clamantis, et domus repleta est fumo.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:5
verses.text: Et dixi : <l eID="gen18466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18467"/>Væ mihi, quia tacui, <l eID="gen18467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18468"/>quia vir pollutus labiis ego sum, <l eID="gen18468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18469"/>et in medio populi polluta labia habentis ego habito, <l eID="gen18469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18470"/>et regem Dominum exercituum vidi oculis meis.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:6
verses.text: Et volavit ad me unus de seraphim, et in manu ejus calculus, quem forcipe tulerat de altari,

verses.name: Isaiah 6:7
verses.text: et tetigit os meum, et dixit : <l eID="gen18470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18471"/>Ecce tetigit hoc labia tua, <l eID="gen18471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18472"/>et auferetur iniquitas tua, et peccatum tuum mundabitur.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:8
verses.text: Et audivi vocem Domini dicentis : <l eID="gen18472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18473"/>Quem mittam ? <l eID="gen18473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18474"/>et quis ibit nobis ? Et dixi : <l eID="gen18474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18475"/>Ecce ego, mitte me.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:9
verses.text: Et dixit : <l eID="gen18475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18476"/>Vade, et dices populo huic : <l eID="gen18476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18477"/>Audite audientes, et nolite intelligere ; <l eID="gen18477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18478"/>et videte visionem, et nolite cognoscere. <l eID="gen18478" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7769"/><l level="1" sID="gen18479"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7769"/>Excæca cor populi hujus, <l eID="gen18479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18480"/>et aures ejus aggrava, <l eID="gen18480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18481"/>et oculos ejus claude : <l eID="gen18481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18482"/>ne forte videat oculis suis, <l eID="gen18482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18483"/>et auribus suis audiat, <l eID="gen18483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18484"/>et corde suo intelligat, <l eID="gen18484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18485"/>et convertatur, et sanem eum.

verses.name: Isaiah 6:11
verses.text: Et dixi : <l eID="gen18485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18486"/>Usquequo, Domine ? Et dixit : <l eID="gen18486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18487"/>Donec desolentur civitates absque habitatore, <l eID="gen18487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18488"/>et domus sine homine, <l eID="gen18488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18489"/>et terra relinquetur deserta. <l eID="gen18489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7770"/><l level="1" sID="gen18490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7770"/>Et longe faciet Dominus homines, <l eID="gen18490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18491"/>et multiplicabitur quæ derelicta fuerat in medio terræ. <l eID="gen18491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7771"/><l level="1" sID="gen18492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7771"/>Et adhuc in ea decimatio, <l eID="gen18492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18493"/>et convertetur, et erit in ostensionem <l eID="gen18493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18494"/>sicut terebinthus, et sicut quercus quæ expandit ramos suos ; <l eID="gen18494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18495"/>semen sanctum erit id quod steterit in ea. <l eID="gen18495" level="1"/><lg eID="gen18464"/> <chapter eID="Isa.6"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:1
verses.text: Et factum est in diebus Achaz, filii Joathan, filii Oziæ, regis Juda, ascendit Rasin, rex Syriæ, et Phacee, filius Romeliæ, rex Israël, in Jerusalem, ad præliandum contra eam : et non potuerunt

verses.name: Isaiah 7:2
verses.text: debellare eam. Et nuntiaverunt domui David, dicentes : Requievit Syria super Ephraim. Et commotum est cor ejus, et cor populi ejus, sicut moventur ligna silvarum a facie venti.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:3
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad Isaiam : Egredere in occursum Achaz, tu et qui derelictus est Jasub, filius tuus, ad extremum aquæductus piscinæ superioris in via agri Fullonis ;

verses.name: Isaiah 7:4
verses.text: et dices ad eum : <div eID="gen18496" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen18497"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18498"/>Vide ut sileas ; noli timere, <l eID="gen18498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18499"/>et cor tuum ne formidet <l eID="gen18499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18500"/>a duabus caudis titionum fumigantium istorum, <l eID="gen18500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18501"/>in ira furoris Rasin, regis Syriæ, et filii Romeliæ ; <l eID="gen18501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7772"/><l level="1" sID="gen18502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7772"/>eo quod consilium inierit contra te Syria in malum, <l eID="gen18502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18503"/>Ephraim, et filius Romeliæ, dicentes : <l eID="gen18503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7773"/><l level="1" sID="gen18504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7773"/>Ascendamus ad Judam, <l eID="gen18504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18505"/>et suscitemus eum, et avellamus eum ad nos, <l eID="gen18505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18506"/>et ponamus regem in medio ejus filium Tabeel. <l eID="gen18506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7774"/><l level="1" sID="gen18507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7774"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen18507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18508"/>Non stabit, et non erit istud ; <l eID="gen18508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7775"/><l level="1" sID="gen18509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7775"/>sed caput Syriæ Damascus, <l eID="gen18509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18510"/>et caput Damasci Rasin ; <l eID="gen18510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18511"/>et adhuc sexaginta et quinque anni, <l eID="gen18511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18512"/>et desinet Ephraim esse populus ; <l eID="gen18512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7776"/><l level="1" sID="gen18513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7776"/>et caput Ephraim Samaria, <l eID="gen18513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18514"/>et caput Samariæ filius Romeliæ. <l eID="gen18514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18515"/>Si non credideritis, non permanebitis.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:10
verses.text: Et adjecit Dominus loqui ad Achaz, dicens :

verses.name: Isaiah 7:11
verses.text: Pete tibi signum a Domino Deo tuo, in profundum inferni, sive in excelsum supra.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:12
verses.text: Et dixit Achaz : Non petam, et non tentabo Dominum.

verses.name: Isaiah 7:13
verses.text: Et dixit : <l eID="gen18515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18516"/>Audite ergo, domus David. <l eID="gen18516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18517"/>Numquid parum vobis est molestos esse hominibus, <l eID="gen18517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18518"/>quia molesti estis et Deo meo ? <l eID="gen18518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7777"/><l level="1" sID="gen18519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7777"/>Propter hoc dabit Dominus ipse vobis signum : <l eID="gen18519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18520"/>ecce virgo concipiet, et pariet filium, <l eID="gen18520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18521"/>et vocabitur nomen ejus Emmanuel. <l eID="gen18521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7778"/><l level="1" sID="gen18522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7778"/>Butyrum et mel comedet, <l eID="gen18522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18523"/>ut sciat reprobare malum, et eligere bonum. <l eID="gen18523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7779"/><l level="1" sID="gen18524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7779"/>Quia antequam sciat puer reprobare malum et eligere bonum, <l eID="gen18524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18525"/>derelinquetur terra quam tu detestaris a facie duorum regum suorum. <l eID="gen18525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7780"/><l level="1" sID="gen18526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7780"/>Adducet Dominus super te, et super populum tuum, <l eID="gen18526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18527"/>et super domum patris tui, <l eID="gen18527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18528"/>dies qui non venerunt <l eID="gen18528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18529"/>a diebus separationis Ephraim a Juda, <l eID="gen18529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18530"/>cum rege Assyriorum. <l eID="gen18530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7781"/><l level="1" sID="gen18531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7781"/>Et erit in die illa : sibilabit Dominus <l eID="gen18531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18532"/>muscæ quæ est in extremo fluminum Ægypti, <l eID="gen18532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18533"/>et api quæ est in terra Assur ; <l eID="gen18533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7782"/><l level="1" sID="gen18534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7782"/>et venient, et requiescent omnes <l eID="gen18534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18535"/>in torrentibus vallium, <l eID="gen18535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18536"/>et in cavernis petrarum, <l eID="gen18536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18537"/>et in omnibus frutetis, et in universis foraminibus. <l eID="gen18537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7783"/><l level="1" sID="gen18538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7783"/>In die illa radet Dominus <l eID="gen18538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18539"/>in novacula conducta in his qui trans flumen sunt, <l eID="gen18539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18540"/>in rege Assyriorum, <l eID="gen18540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18541"/>caput et pilos pedum, <l eID="gen18541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18542"/>et barbam universam. <l eID="gen18542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7784"/><l level="1" sID="gen18543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7784"/>Et erit in die illa : <l eID="gen18543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18544"/>nutriet homo vaccam boum, et duas oves, <l eID="gen18544" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7785"/><l level="1" sID="gen18545"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7785"/>et præ ubertate lactis <l eID="gen18545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18546"/>comedet butyrum ; <l eID="gen18546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18547"/>butyrum enim et mel manducabit <l eID="gen18547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18548"/>omnis qui relictus fuerit in medio terræ. <l eID="gen18548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7786"/><l level="1" sID="gen18549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7786"/>Et erit in die illa : omnis locus ubi fuerint <l eID="gen18549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18550"/>mille vites, mille argenteis, <l eID="gen18550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18551"/>in spinas et in vepres erunt. <l eID="gen18551" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7787"/><l level="1" sID="gen18552"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7787"/>Cum sagittis et arcu ingredientur illuc : <l eID="gen18552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18553"/>vepres enim et spinæ erunt in universa terra. <l eID="gen18553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7788"/><l level="1" sID="gen18554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7788"/>Et omnes montes qui in sarculo sarrientur, <l eID="gen18554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18555"/>non veniet illuc terror spinarum et veprium : <l eID="gen18555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18556"/>et erit in pascua bovis, et in conculcationem pecoris. <l eID="gen18556" level="1"/><lg eID="gen18497"/> <chapter eID="Isa.7"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:1
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Sume tibi librum grandem, et scribe in eo stylo hominis : Velociter spolia detrahe, cito prædare.

verses.name: Isaiah 8:2
verses.text: Et adhibui mihi testes fideles, Uriam sacerdotem, et Zachariam, filium Barachiæ :

verses.name: Isaiah 8:3
verses.text: et accessi ad prophetissam, et concepit, et peperit filium. Et dixit Dominus ad me : Voca nomen ejus : Accelera spolia detrahere ; Festina prædari :

verses.name: Isaiah 8:4
verses.text: quia antequam sciat puer vocare patrem suum et matrem suam, auferetur fortitudo Damasci, et spolia Samariæ, coram rege Assyriorum.  <div eID="gen18557" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7789"/><div sID="gen18558" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7789"/>Et adjecit Dominus loqui ad me adhuc, dicens :  <div eID="gen18558" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7790"/><lg sID="gen18559"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7790"/>Pro eo quod abjecit populus iste <l eID="gen18560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18561"/>aquas Siloë, quæ vadunt cum silentio, <l eID="gen18561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18562"/>et assumpsit magis Rasin, <l eID="gen18562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18563"/>et filium Romeliæ : <l eID="gen18563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7791"/><l level="1" sID="gen18564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7791"/>propter hoc ecce Dominus adducet super eos <l eID="gen18564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18565"/>aquas fluminis fortes et multas, <l eID="gen18565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18566"/>regem Assyriorum, et omnem gloriam ejus, <l eID="gen18566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18567"/>et ascendet super omnes rivos ejus, <l eID="gen18567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18568"/>et fluet super universas ripas ejus ; <l eID="gen18568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7792"/><l level="1" sID="gen18569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7792"/>et ibit per Judam, inundans, et transiens : <l eID="gen18569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18570"/>usque ad collum veniet. <l eID="gen18570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18571"/>Et erit extensio alarum ejus <l eID="gen18571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18572"/>implens latitudinem terræ tuæ, o Emmanuel ! <l eID="gen18572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7793"/><l level="1" sID="gen18573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7793"/>Congregamini, populi, et vincimini ; <l eID="gen18573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18574"/>et audite, universæ procul terræ : <l eID="gen18574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18575"/>confortamini, et vincimini ; <l eID="gen18575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18576"/>accingite vos, et vincimini. <l eID="gen18576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7794"/><l level="1" sID="gen18577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7794"/>Inite consilium, et dissipabitur ; <l eID="gen18577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18578"/>loquimini verbum, et non fiet : <l eID="gen18578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18579"/>quia nobiscum Deus. <l eID="gen18579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7795"/><l level="1" sID="gen18580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7795"/>Hæc enim ait Dominus ad me : Sicut in manu forti erudivit me, <l eID="gen18580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18581"/>ne irem in via populi hujus, dicens : <l eID="gen18581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7796"/><l level="1" sID="gen18582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7796"/>Non dicatis : Conjuratio ; <l eID="gen18582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18583"/>omnia enim quæ loquitur populus iste, conjuratio est : <l eID="gen18583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18584"/>et timorem ejus ne timeatis, neque paveatis. <l eID="gen18584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7797"/><l level="1" sID="gen18585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7797"/>Dominum exercituum ipsum sanctificate ; <l eID="gen18585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18586"/>ipse pavor vester, et ipse terror vester : <l eID="gen18586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7798"/><l level="1" sID="gen18587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7798"/>et erit vobis in sanctificationem ; <l eID="gen18587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18588"/>in lapidem autem offensionis, et in petram scandali, <l eID="gen18588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18589"/>duabus domibus Israël ; <l eID="gen18589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18590"/>in laqueum et in ruinam habitantibus Jerusalem. <l eID="gen18590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7799"/><l level="1" sID="gen18591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7799"/>Et offendent ex eis plurimi, <l eID="gen18591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18592"/>et cadent, et conterentur, <l eID="gen18592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18593"/>et irretientur, et capientur. <l eID="gen18593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7800"/><l level="1" sID="gen18594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7800"/>Liga testimonium, <l eID="gen18594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18595"/>signa legem in discipulis meis. <l eID="gen18595" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7801"/><l level="1" sID="gen18596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7801"/>Et exspectabo Dominum qui abscondit faciem suam <l eID="gen18596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18597"/>a domo Jacob, et præstolabor eum. <l eID="gen18597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7802"/><l level="1" sID="gen18598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7802"/>Ecce ego et pueri mei quos dedit mihi Dominus <l eID="gen18598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18599"/>in signum, et in portentum Israël <l eID="gen18599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18600"/>a Domino exercituum, <l eID="gen18600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18601"/>qui habitat in monte Sion : <l eID="gen18601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:19
