verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7803"/><l level="1" sID="gen18602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7803"/>et cum dixerint ad vos : <l eID="gen18602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18603"/>Quærite a pythonibus <l eID="gen18603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18604"/>et a divinis qui strident in incantationibus suis : <l eID="gen18604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18605"/>numquid non populus a Deo suo requiret, <l eID="gen18605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18606"/>pro vivis a mortuis ? <l eID="gen18606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7804"/><l level="1" sID="gen18607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7804"/>ad legem magis et ad testimonium. <l eID="gen18607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18608"/>Quod si non dixerint juxta verbum hoc, <l eID="gen18608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18609"/>non erit eis matutina lux. <l eID="gen18609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7805"/><l level="1" sID="gen18610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7805"/>Et transibit per eam, corruet, et esuriet ; <l eID="gen18610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18611"/>et cum esurierit, irascetur. <l eID="gen18611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18612"/>Et maledicet regi suo, et Deo suo, <l eID="gen18612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18613"/>et suscipiet sursum, <l eID="gen18613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7806"/><l level="1" sID="gen18614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7806"/>et ad terram intuebitur ; <l eID="gen18614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18615"/>et ecce tribulatio et tenebræ, <l eID="gen18615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18616"/>dissolutio et angustia, <l eID="gen18616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18617"/>et caligo persequens, <l eID="gen18617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18618"/>et non poterit avolare de angustia sua.  <chapter eID="Isa.8"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:1
verses.text: Primo tempore alleviata est <l eID="gen18619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18620"/>terra Zabulon et terra Nephthali : <l eID="gen18620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18621"/>et novissimo aggravata est via maris <l eID="gen18621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18622"/>trans Jordanem Galilææ gentium. <l eID="gen18622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7807"/><l level="1" sID="gen18623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7807"/>Populus qui ambulabat in tenebris, <l eID="gen18623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18624"/>vidit lucem magnam ; <l eID="gen18624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18625"/>habitantibus in regione umbræ mortis, <l eID="gen18625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18626"/>lux orta est eis. <l eID="gen18626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7808"/><l level="1" sID="gen18627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7808"/>Multiplicasti gentem, <l eID="gen18627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18628"/>et non magnificasti lætitiam. <l eID="gen18628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18629"/>Lætabuntur coram te, sicut qui lætantur in messe ; <l eID="gen18629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18630"/>sicut exsultant victores capta præda, quando dividunt spolia. <l eID="gen18630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7809"/><l level="1" sID="gen18631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7809"/>Jugum enim oneris ejus, <l eID="gen18631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18632"/>et virgam humeri ejus, <l eID="gen18632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18633"/>et sceptrum exactoris ejus <l eID="gen18633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18634"/>superasti, sicut in die Madian. <l eID="gen18634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7810"/><l level="1" sID="gen18635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7810"/>Quia omnis violentia prædatio cum tumultu, <l eID="gen18635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18636"/>et vestimentum mistum sanguine, <l eID="gen18636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18637"/>erit in combustionem, <l eID="gen18637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18638"/>et cibus ignis. <l eID="gen18638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7811"/><l level="1" sID="gen18639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7811"/>Parvulus enim natus est nobis, <l eID="gen18639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18640"/>et filius datus est nobis, <l eID="gen18640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18641"/>et factus est principatus super humerum ejus : <l eID="gen18641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18642"/>et vocabitur nomen ejus, <l eID="gen18642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18643"/>Admirabilis, Consiliarius, Deus, Fortis, <l eID="gen18643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18644"/>Pater futuri sæculi, Princeps pacis. <l eID="gen18644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7812"/><l level="1" sID="gen18645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7812"/>Multiplicabitur ejus imperium, <l eID="gen18645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18646"/>et pacis non erit finis ; <l eID="gen18646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18647"/>super solium David, et super regnum ejus sedebit, <l eID="gen18647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18648"/>ut confirmet illud et corroboret <l eID="gen18648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18649"/>in judicio et justitia, <l eID="gen18649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18650"/>amodo et usque in sempiternum : <l eID="gen18650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18651"/>zelus Domini exercituum faciet hoc. <l eID="gen18651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7813"/><l level="1" sID="gen18652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7813"/>Verbum misit Dominus in Jacob, <l eID="gen18652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18653"/>et cecidit in Israël. <l eID="gen18653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7814"/><l level="1" sID="gen18654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7814"/>Et sciet omnis populus Ephraim, <l eID="gen18654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18655"/>et habitantes Samariam, <l eID="gen18655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18656"/>in superbia et magnitudine cordis dicentes : <l eID="gen18656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7815"/><l level="1" sID="gen18657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7815"/>Lateres ceciderunt, sed quadris lapidibus ædificabimus ; <l eID="gen18657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18658"/>sycomoros succiderunt, sed cedros immutabimus. <l eID="gen18658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7816"/><l level="1" sID="gen18659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7816"/>Et elevabit Dominus hostes Rasin super eum, <l eID="gen18659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18660"/>et inimicos ejus in tumultum vertet. <l eID="gen18660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7817"/><l level="1" sID="gen18661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7817"/>Syriam ab oriente, et Philisthiim ab occidente ; <l eID="gen18661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18662"/>et devorabunt Israël toto ore. <l eID="gen18662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18663"/>In omnibus his non est aversus furor ejus, <l eID="gen18663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18664"/>sed adhuc manus ejus extenta. <l eID="gen18664" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7818"/><l level="1" sID="gen18665"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7818"/>Et populus non est reversus ad percutientem se, <l eID="gen18665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18666"/>et Dominum exercituum non inquisierunt. <l eID="gen18666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7819"/><l level="1" sID="gen18667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7819"/>Et disperdet Dominus ab Israël caput et caudam, <l eID="gen18667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18668"/>incurvantem et refrenantem, die una. <l eID="gen18668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7820"/><l level="1" sID="gen18669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7820"/>Longævus et honorabilis, ipse est caput ; <l eID="gen18669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18670"/>et propheta docens mendacium, ipse est cauda. <l eID="gen18670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7821"/><l level="1" sID="gen18671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7821"/>Et erunt qui beatificant populum istum, seducentes ; <l eID="gen18671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18672"/>et qui beatificantur, præcipitati. <l eID="gen18672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7822"/><l level="1" sID="gen18673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7822"/>Propter hoc super adolescentulis ejus non lætabitur Dominus, <l eID="gen18673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18674"/>et pupillorum ejus et viduarum non miserebitur : <l eID="gen18674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18675"/>quia omnis hypocrita est et nequam, <l eID="gen18675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18676"/>et universum os locutum est stultitiam ; <l eID="gen18676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18677"/>in omnibus his non est aversus furor ejus, <l eID="gen18677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18678"/>sed adhuc manus ejus extenta. <l eID="gen18678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7823"/><l level="1" sID="gen18679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7823"/>Succensa est enim quasi ignis impietas : <l eID="gen18679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18680"/>veprem et spinam vorabit, <l eID="gen18680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18681"/>et succendetur in densitate saltus, <l eID="gen18681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18682"/>et convolvetur superbia fumi. <l eID="gen18682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7824"/><l level="1" sID="gen18683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7824"/>In ira Domini exercituum conturbata est terra, <l eID="gen18683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18684"/>et erit populus quasi esca ignis ; <l eID="gen18684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18685"/>vir fratri suo non parcet. <l eID="gen18685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7825"/><l level="1" sID="gen18686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7825"/>Et declinabit ad dexteram, et esuriet ; <l eID="gen18686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18687"/>et comedet ad sinistram, et non saturabitur ; <l eID="gen18687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18688"/>unusquisque carnem brachii sui vorabit : <l eID="gen18688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18689"/>Manasses Ephraim, et Ephraim Manassen ; <l eID="gen18689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18690"/>simul ipsi contra Judam. <l eID="gen18690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7826"/><l level="1" sID="gen18691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7826"/>In omnibus his non est aversus furor ejus, <l eID="gen18691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18692"/>sed adhuc manus ejus extenta.  <chapter eID="Isa.9"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:1
verses.text: Væ qui condunt leges iniquas, <l eID="gen18693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18694"/>et scribentes injustitiam scripserunt, <l eID="gen18694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7827"/><l level="1" sID="gen18695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7827"/>ut opprimerent in judicio pauperes, <l eID="gen18695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18696"/>et vim facerent causæ humilium populi mei ; <l eID="gen18696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18697"/>ut essent viduæ præda eorum, <l eID="gen18697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18698"/>et pupillos diriperent. <l eID="gen18698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7828"/><l level="1" sID="gen18699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7828"/>Quid facietis in die visitationis, <l eID="gen18699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18700"/>et calamitatis de longe venientis ? <l eID="gen18700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18701"/>ad cujus confugietis auxilium ? <l eID="gen18701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18702"/>et ubi derelinquetis gloriam vestram, <l eID="gen18702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7829"/><l level="1" sID="gen18703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7829"/>ne incurvemini sub vinculo, <l eID="gen18703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18704"/>et cum interfectis cadatis ? <l eID="gen18704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18705"/>Super omnibus his non est aversus furor ejus, <l eID="gen18705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18706"/>sed adhuc manus ejus extenta. <l eID="gen18706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7830"/><l level="1" sID="gen18707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7830"/>Væ Assur ! virga furoris mei et baculus ipse est ; <l eID="gen18707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18708"/>in manu eorum indignatio mea. <l eID="gen18708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7831"/><l level="1" sID="gen18709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7831"/>Ad gentem fallacem mittam eum, <l eID="gen18709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18710"/>et contra populum furoris mei mandabo illi, <l eID="gen18710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18711"/>ut auferat spolia, et diripiat prædam, <l eID="gen18711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18712"/>et ponat illum in conculcationem quasi lutum platearum. <l eID="gen18712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7832"/><l level="1" sID="gen18713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7832"/>Ipse autem non sic arbitrabitur, <l eID="gen18713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18714"/>et cor ejus non ita existimabit ; <l eID="gen18714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18715"/>sed ad conterendum erit cor ejus, <l eID="gen18715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18716"/>et ad internecionem gentium non paucarum. <l eID="gen18716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7833"/><l level="1" sID="gen18717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7833"/>Dicet enim :

verses.name: Isaiah 10:9
verses.text: Numquid non principes mei simul reges sunt ? <l eID="gen18717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18718"/>numquid non ut Charcamis, sic Calano ? <l eID="gen18718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18719"/>et ut Arphad, sic Emath ? <l eID="gen18719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18720"/>numquid non ut Damascus, sic Samaria ? <l eID="gen18720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7834"/><l level="1" sID="gen18721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7834"/>Quomodo invenit manus mea regna idoli, <l eID="gen18721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18722"/>sic et simulacra eorum de Jerusalem et de Samaria. <l eID="gen18722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7835"/><l level="1" sID="gen18723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7835"/>Numquid non sicut feci Samariæ et idolis ejus, <l eID="gen18723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18724"/>sic faciam Jerusalem et simulacris ejus ? <l eID="gen18724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7836"/><l level="1" sID="gen18725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7836"/>Et erit, cum impleverit Dominus <l eID="gen18725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18726"/>cuncta opera sua <l eID="gen18726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18727"/>in monte Sion et in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen18727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18728"/>visitabo super fructum magnifici cordis regis Assur, <l eID="gen18728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18729"/>et super gloriam altitudinis oculorum ejus. <l eID="gen18729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7837"/><l level="1" sID="gen18730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7837"/>Dixit enim : In fortitudine manus meæ feci, <l eID="gen18730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18731"/>et in sapientia mea intellexi ; <l eID="gen18731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18732"/>et abstuli terminos populorum, <l eID="gen18732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18733"/>et principes eorum deprædatus sum, <l eID="gen18733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18734"/>et detraxi quasi potens in sublimi residentes. <l eID="gen18734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7838"/><l level="1" sID="gen18735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7838"/>Et invenit quasi nidum manus mea <l eID="gen18735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18736"/>fortitudinem populorum ; <l eID="gen18736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18737"/>et sicut colliguntur ova quæ derelicta sunt, <l eID="gen18737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18738"/>sic universam terram ego congregavi ; <l eID="gen18738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18739"/>et non fuit qui moveret pennam, <l eID="gen18739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18740"/>et aperiret os, et ganniret. <l eID="gen18740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7839"/><l level="1" sID="gen18741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7839"/>Numquid gloriabitur securis contra eum qui secat in ea ? <l eID="gen18741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18742"/>aut exaltabitur serra contra eum a quo trahitur ? <l eID="gen18742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18743"/>Quomodo si elevetur virga contra elevantem se, <l eID="gen18743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18744"/>et exaltetur baculus, qui utique lignum est. <l eID="gen18744" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7840"/><l level="1" sID="gen18745"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7840"/>Propter hoc mittet Dominator, Dominus exercituum, <l eID="gen18745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18746"/>in pinguibus ejus tenuitatem ; <l eID="gen18746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18747"/>et subtus gloriam ejus succensa ardebit <l eID="gen18747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18748"/>quasi combustio ignis. <l eID="gen18748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7841"/><l level="1" sID="gen18749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7841"/>Et erit lumen Israël in igne, <l eID="gen18749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18750"/>et Sanctus ejus in flamma ; <l eID="gen18750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18751"/>et succendetur, et devorabitur <l eID="gen18751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18752"/>spina ejus et vepres in die una. <l eID="gen18752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7842"/><l level="1" sID="gen18753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7842"/>Et gloria saltus ejus, et carmeli ejus, <l eID="gen18753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18754"/>ab anima usque ad carnem consumetur ; <l eID="gen18754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18755"/>et erit terrore profugus. <l eID="gen18755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7843"/><l level="1" sID="gen18756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7843"/>Et reliquiæ ligni saltus ejus præ paucitate numerabuntur, <l eID="gen18756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18757"/>et puer scribet eos. <l eID="gen18757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7844"/><l level="1" sID="gen18758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7844"/>Et erit in die illa : <l eID="gen18758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18759"/>non adjiciet residuum Israël, <l eID="gen18759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18760"/>et hi qui fugerint de domo Jacob, <l eID="gen18760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18761"/>inniti super eo qui percutit eos ; <l eID="gen18761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18762"/>sed innitetur super Dominum, <l eID="gen18762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18763"/>Sanctum Israël, in veritate. <l eID="gen18763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7845"/><l level="1" sID="gen18764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7845"/>Reliquiæ convertentur ; reliquiæ, inquam, Jacob <l eID="gen18764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18765"/>ad Deum fortem. <l eID="gen18765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7846"/><l level="1" sID="gen18766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7846"/>Si enim fuerit populus tuus, Israël, quasi arena maris, <l eID="gen18766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18767"/>reliquiæ convertentur ex eo ; <l eID="gen18767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18768"/>consummatio abbreviata <l eID="gen18768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18769"/>inundabit justitiam. <l eID="gen18769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7847"/><l level="1" sID="gen18770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7847"/>Consummationem enim et abbreviationem <l eID="gen18770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18771"/>Dominus Deus exercituum faciet in medio omnis terræ. <l eID="gen18771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7848"/><l level="1" sID="gen18772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7848"/>Propter hoc, hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : <l eID="gen18772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18773"/>Noli timere, populus meus, <l eID="gen18773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18774"/>habitator Sion, ab Assur : <l eID="gen18774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18775"/>in virga percutiet te, <l eID="gen18775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18776"/>et baculum suum levabit super te, <l eID="gen18776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18777"/>in via Ægypti. <l eID="gen18777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7849"/><l level="1" sID="gen18778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7849"/>Adhuc enim paululum modicumque, <l eID="gen18778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18779"/>et consummabitur indignatio <l eID="gen18779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18780"/>et furor meus super scelus eorum. <l eID="gen18780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7850"/><l level="1" sID="gen18781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7850"/>Et suscitabit super eum Dominus exercituum flagellum, <l eID="gen18781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18782"/>juxta plagam Madian in petra Oreb : <l eID="gen18782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18783"/>et virgam suam super mare, <l eID="gen18783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18784"/>et levabit eam in via Ægypti. <l eID="gen18784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7851"/><l level="1" sID="gen18785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7851"/>Et erit in die illa : <l eID="gen18785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18786"/>auferetur onus ejus de humero tuo <l eID="gen18786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18787"/>et jugum ejus de collo tuo, <l eID="gen18787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18788"/>et computrescet jugum a facie olei. <l eID="gen18788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7852"/><l level="1" sID="gen18789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7852"/>Veniet in Ajath, transibit in Magron, <l eID="gen18789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18790"/>apud Machmas commendabit vasa sua. <l eID="gen18790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7853"/><l level="1" sID="gen18791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7853"/>Transierunt cursim, <l eID="gen18791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18792"/>Gaba sedes nostra ; <l eID="gen18792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18793"/>obstupuit Rama, <l eID="gen18793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18794"/>Gabaath Saulis fugit. <l eID="gen18794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7854"/><l level="1" sID="gen18795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7854"/>Hinni voce tua, filia Gallim, <l eID="gen18795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18796"/>attende Laisa, paupercula Anathoth. <l eID="gen18796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7855"/><l level="1" sID="gen18797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7855"/>Migravit Medemena ; <l eID="gen18797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18798"/>habitatores Gabim, confortamini. <l eID="gen18798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7856"/><l level="1" sID="gen18799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7856"/>Adhuc dies est ut in Nobe stetur ; <l eID="gen18799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18800"/>agitabit manum suam super montem filiæ Sion, <l eID="gen18800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18801"/>collem Jerusalem. <l eID="gen18801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7857"/><l level="1" sID="gen18802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7857"/>Ecce Dominator, Dominus exercituum, <l eID="gen18802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18803"/>confringet lagunculam in terrore ; <l eID="gen18803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18804"/>et excelsi statura succidentur, <l eID="gen18804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18805"/>et sublimes humiliabuntur. <l eID="gen18805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 10:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7858"/><l level="1" sID="gen18806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7858"/>Et subvertentur condensa saltus ferro ; <l eID="gen18806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18807"/>et Libanus cum excelsis cadet.  <chapter eID="Isa.10"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:1
verses.text: Et egredietur virga de radice Jesse, <l eID="gen18808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18809"/>et flos de radice ejus ascendet. <l eID="gen18809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7859"/><l level="1" sID="gen18810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7859"/>Et requiescet super eum spiritus Domini : <l eID="gen18810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18811"/>spiritus sapientiæ et intellectus, <l eID="gen18811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18812"/>spiritus consilii et fortitudinis, <l eID="gen18812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18813"/>spiritus scientiæ et pietatis ; <l eID="gen18813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7860"/><l level="1" sID="gen18814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7860"/>et replebit eum spiritus timoris Domini. <l eID="gen18814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18815"/>Non secundum visionem oculorum judicabit, <l eID="gen18815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18816"/>neque secundum auditum aurium arguet ; <l eID="gen18816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7861"/><l level="1" sID="gen18817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7861"/>sed judicabit in justitia pauperes, <l eID="gen18817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18818"/>et arguet in æquitate pro mansuetis terræ ; <l eID="gen18818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18819"/>et percutiet terram virga oris sui, <l eID="gen18819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18820"/>et spiritu labiorum suorum interficiet impium. <l eID="gen18820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7862"/><l level="1" sID="gen18821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7862"/>Et erit justitia cingulum lumborum ejus, <l eID="gen18821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18822"/>et fides cinctorium renum ejus. <l eID="gen18822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7863"/><l level="1" sID="gen18823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7863"/>Habitabit lupus cum agno, <l eID="gen18823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18824"/>et pardus cum hædo accubabit ; <l eID="gen18824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18825"/>vitulus, et leo, et ovis, simul morabuntur, <l eID="gen18825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18826"/>et puer parvulus minabit eos. <l eID="gen18826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7864"/><l level="1" sID="gen18827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7864"/>Vitulus et ursus pascentur, <l eID="gen18827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18828"/>simul requiescent catuli eorum ; <l eID="gen18828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18829"/>et leo quasi bos comedet paleas. <l eID="gen18829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7865"/><l level="1" sID="gen18830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7865"/>Et delectabitur infans ab ubere super foramine aspidis ; <l eID="gen18830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18831"/>et in caverna reguli <l eID="gen18831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18832"/>qui ablactatus fuerit manum suam mittet. <l eID="gen18832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7866"/><l level="1" sID="gen18833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7866"/>Non nocebunt, et non occident <l eID="gen18833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18834"/>in universo monte sancto meo, <l eID="gen18834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18835"/>quia repleta est terra scientia Domini, sicut aquæ maris operientes. <l eID="gen18835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7867"/><l level="1" sID="gen18836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7867"/>In die illa radix Jesse, <l eID="gen18836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18837"/>qui stat in signum populorum, <l eID="gen18837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18838"/>ipsum gentes deprecabuntur, <l eID="gen18838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18839"/>et erit sepulchrum ejus gloriosum. <l eID="gen18839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7868"/><l level="1" sID="gen18840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7868"/>Et erit in die illa : adjiciet Dominus secundo manum suam <l eID="gen18840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18841"/>ad possidendum residuum populi sui, <l eID="gen18841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18842"/>quod relinquetur ab Assyriis, et ab Ægypto, <l eID="gen18842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18843"/>et a Phetros, et ab Æthiopia, et ab Ælam, et a Sennaar, <l eID="gen18843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18844"/>et ab Emath, et ab insulis maris. <l eID="gen18844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7869"/><l level="1" sID="gen18845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7869"/>Et levabit signum in nationes, <l eID="gen18845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18846"/>et congregabit profugos Israël, <l eID="gen18846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18847"/>et dispersos Juda colliget <l eID="gen18847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18848"/>a quatuor plagis terræ. <l eID="gen18848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7870"/><l level="1" sID="gen18849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7870"/>Et auferetur zelus Ephraim, <l eID="gen18849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18850"/>et hostes Juda peribunt ; <l eID="gen18850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18851"/>Ephraim non æmulabitur Judam, <l eID="gen18851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18852"/>et Judas non pugnabit contra Ephraim. <l eID="gen18852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7871"/><l level="1" sID="gen18853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7871"/>Et volabunt in humeros Philisthiim per mare, <l eID="gen18853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18854"/>simul prædabuntur filios orientis ; <l eID="gen18854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18855"/>Idumæa et Moab præceptum manus eorum, <l eID="gen18855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18856"/>et filii Ammon obedientes erunt. <l eID="gen18856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7872"/><l level="1" sID="gen18857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7872"/>Et desolabit Dominus linguam maris Ægypti, <l eID="gen18857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18858"/>et levabit manum suam super flumen in fortitudine spiritus sui ; <l eID="gen18858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18859"/>et percutiet eum in septem rivis, <l eID="gen18859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18860"/>ita ut transeant per eum calceati. <l eID="gen18860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7873"/><l level="1" sID="gen18861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7873"/>Et erit via residuo populo meo <l eID="gen18861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18862"/>qui relinquetur ab Assyriis, <l eID="gen18862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18863"/>sicut fuit Israëli <l eID="gen18863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18864"/>in die illa qua ascendit de terra Ægypti.  <chapter eID="Isa.11"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:1
verses.text: Et dices in die illa : <l eID="gen18865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18866"/>Confitebor tibi, Domine, quoniam iratus es mihi ; <l eID="gen18866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18867"/>conversus est furor tuus, et consolatus es me. <l eID="gen18867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7874"/><l level="1" sID="gen18868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7874"/>Ecce Deus salvator meus ; <l eID="gen18868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18869"/>fiducialiter agam, et non timebo : <l eID="gen18869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18870"/>quia fortitudo mea et laus mea Dominus, <l eID="gen18870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18871"/>et factus est mihi in salutem. <l eID="gen18871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7875"/><l level="1" sID="gen18872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7875"/>Haurietis aquas in gaudio de fontibus salvatoris. <l eID="gen18872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7876"/><l level="1" sID="gen18873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7876"/>Et dicetis in die illa : <l eID="gen18873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18874"/>Confitemini Domino et invocate nomen ejus ; <l eID="gen18874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18875"/>notas facite in populis adinventiones ejus ; <l eID="gen18875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18876"/>mementote quoniam excelsum est nomen ejus. <l eID="gen18876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7877"/><l level="1" sID="gen18877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7877"/>Cantate Domino, quoniam magnifice fecit ; <l eID="gen18877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18878"/>annuntiate hoc in universa terra. <l eID="gen18878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7878"/><l level="1" sID="gen18879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7878"/>Exsulta et lauda, habitatio Sion, <l eID="gen18879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18880"/>quia magnus in medio tui Sanctus Israël. <l eID="gen18880" level="1"/><lg eID="gen18559"/> <chapter eID="Isa.12"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:1
verses.text: Onus Babylonis, quod vidit Isaias, filius Amos.  <div eID="gen18881" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7879"/><lg sID="gen18882"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7879"/>Super montem caliginosum levate signum : <l eID="gen18883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18884"/>exaltate vocem, <l eID="gen18884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18885"/>levate manum, <l eID="gen18885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18886"/>et ingrediantur portas duces. <l eID="gen18886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7880"/><l level="1" sID="gen18887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7880"/>Ego mandavi sanctificatis meis, <l eID="gen18887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18888"/>et vocavi fortes meos in ira mea, <l eID="gen18888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18889"/>exsultantes in gloria mea. <l eID="gen18889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7881"/><l level="1" sID="gen18890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7881"/>Vox multitudinis in montibus, <l eID="gen18890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18891"/>quasi populorum frequentium ; <l eID="gen18891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18892"/>vox sonitus regum, <l eID="gen18892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18893"/>gentium congregatarum. <l eID="gen18893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18894"/>Dominus exercituum præcepit <l eID="gen18894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18895"/>militiæ belli, <l eID="gen18895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7882"/><l level="1" sID="gen18896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7882"/>venientibus de terra procul, <l eID="gen18896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18897"/>a summitate cæli ; <l eID="gen18897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18898"/>Dominus, et vasa furoris ejus, <l eID="gen18898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18899"/>ut disperdat omnem terram. <l eID="gen18899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7883"/><l level="1" sID="gen18900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7883"/>Ululate, quia prope est dies Domini ; <l eID="gen18900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18901"/>quasi vastitas a Domino veniet. <l eID="gen18901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7884"/><l level="1" sID="gen18902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7884"/>Propter hoc omnes manus dissolventur, <l eID="gen18902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18903"/>et omne cor hominis contabescet, <l eID="gen18903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7885"/><l level="1" sID="gen18904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7885"/>et conteretur. <l eID="gen18904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18905"/>Torsiones et dolores tenebunt ; <l eID="gen18905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18906"/>quasi parturiens dolebunt : <l eID="gen18906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18907"/>unusquisque ad proximum suum stupebit, <l eID="gen18907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18908"/>facies combustæ vultus eorum. <l eID="gen18908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7886"/><l level="1" sID="gen18909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7886"/>Ecce dies Domini veniet, <l eID="gen18909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18910"/>crudelis, et indignationis plenus, et iræ, furorisque, <l eID="gen18910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18911"/>ad ponendam terram in solitudinem, <l eID="gen18911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18912"/>et peccatores ejus conterendos de ea. <l eID="gen18912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7887"/><l level="1" sID="gen18913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7887"/>Quoniam stellæ cæli, et splendor earum, <l eID="gen18913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18914"/>non expandent lumen suum ; <l eID="gen18914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18915"/>obtenebratus est sol in ortu suo, <l eID="gen18915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18916"/>et luna non splendebit in lumine suo. <l eID="gen18916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7888"/><l level="1" sID="gen18917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7888"/>Et visitabo super orbis mala, <l eID="gen18917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18918"/>et contra impios iniquitatem eorum ; <l eID="gen18918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18919"/>et quiescere faciam superbiam infidelium, <l eID="gen18919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18920"/>et arrogantiam fortium humiliabo. <l eID="gen18920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7889"/><l level="1" sID="gen18921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7889"/>Pretiosior erit vir auro, <l eID="gen18921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18922"/>et homo mundo obrizo. <l eID="gen18922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7890"/><l level="1" sID="gen18923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7890"/>Super hoc cælum turbabo ; <l eID="gen18923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18924"/>et movebitur terra de loco suo, <l eID="gen18924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18925"/>propter indignationem Domini exercituum, <l eID="gen18925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18926"/>et propter diem iræ furoris ejus. <l eID="gen18926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7891"/><l level="1" sID="gen18927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7891"/>Et erit quasi damula fugiens, <l eID="gen18927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18928"/>et quasi ovis, et non erit qui congreget. <l eID="gen18928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18929"/>Unusquisque ad populum suum convertetur, <l eID="gen18929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18930"/>et singuli ad terram suam fugient. <l eID="gen18930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7892"/><l level="1" sID="gen18931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7892"/>Omnis qui inventus fuerit occidetur, <l eID="gen18931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18932"/>et omnis qui supervenerit cadet in gladio ; <l eID="gen18932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7893"/><l level="1" sID="gen18933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7893"/>infantes eorum allidentur in oculis eorum, <l eID="gen18933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18934"/>diripientur domus eorum, et uxores eorum violabuntur. <l eID="gen18934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7894"/><l level="1" sID="gen18935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7894"/>Ecce ego suscitabo super eos Medos, <l eID="gen18935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18936"/>qui argentum non quærant, <l eID="gen18936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18937"/>nec aurum velint ; <l eID="gen18937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7895"/><l level="1" sID="gen18938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7895"/>sed sagittis parvulos interficient, <l eID="gen18938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18939"/>et lactantibus uteris non miserebuntur, <l eID="gen18939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18940"/>et super filios non parcet oculus eorum. <l eID="gen18940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7896"/><l level="1" sID="gen18941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7896"/>Et erit Babylon illa gloriosa in regnis, <l eID="gen18941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18942"/>inclyta superbia Chaldæorum, <l eID="gen18942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18943"/>sicut subvertit Dominus Sodomam et Gomorrham. <l eID="gen18943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7897"/><l level="1" sID="gen18944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7897"/>Non habitabitur usque in finem, <l eID="gen18944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18945"/>et non fundabitur usque ad generationem et generationem ; <l eID="gen18945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18946"/>nec ponet ibi tentoria Arabs, <l eID="gen18946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18947"/>nec pastores requiescent ibi. <l eID="gen18947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7898"/><l level="1" sID="gen18948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7898"/>Sed requiescent ibi bestiæ, <l eID="gen18948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18949"/>et replebuntur domus eorum draconibus, <l eID="gen18949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18950"/>et habitabunt ibi struthiones, <l eID="gen18950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18951"/>et pilosi saltabunt ibi ; <l eID="gen18951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7899"/><l level="1" sID="gen18952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7899"/>et respondebunt ibi ululæ in ædibus ejus, <l eID="gen18952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18953"/>et sirenes in delubris voluptatis.  <chapter eID="Isa.13"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:1
verses.text: Prope est ut veniat tempus ejus, <l eID="gen18954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18955"/>et dies ejus non elongabuntur. <l eID="gen18955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18956"/>Miserebitur enim Dominus Jacob, <l eID="gen18956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18957"/>et eliget adhuc de Israël, <l eID="gen18957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18958"/>et requiescere eos faciet super humum suam ; <l eID="gen18958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18959"/>adjungetur advena ad eos, <l eID="gen18959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18960"/>et adhærebit domui Jacob. <l eID="gen18960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7900"/><l level="1" sID="gen18961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7900"/>Et tenebunt eos populi, <l eID="gen18961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18962"/>et adducent eos in locum suum ; <l eID="gen18962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18963"/>et possidebit eos domus Israël <l eID="gen18963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18964"/>super terram Domini <l eID="gen18964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18965"/>in servos et ancillas : <l eID="gen18965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18966"/>et erunt capientes eos qui se ceperant, <l eID="gen18966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18967"/>et subjicient exactores suos. <l eID="gen18967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7901"/><l level="1" sID="gen18968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7901"/>Et erit in die illa : cum requiem dederit tibi Deus <l eID="gen18968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18969"/>a labore tuo, et a concussione tua, <l eID="gen18969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18970"/>et a servitute dura qua ante servisti, <l eID="gen18970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7902"/><l level="1" sID="gen18971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7902"/>sumes parabolam istam <l eID="gen18971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18972"/>contra regem Babylonis, et dices : <l eID="gen18972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18973"/>Quomodo cessavit exactor ; <l eID="gen18973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18974"/>quievit tributum ? <l eID="gen18974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7903"/><l level="1" sID="gen18975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7903"/>Contrivit Dominus baculum impiorum, <l eID="gen18975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18976"/>virgam dominantium, <l eID="gen18976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7904"/><l level="1" sID="gen18977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7904"/>cædentem populos in indignatione <l eID="gen18977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18978"/>plaga insanabili, <l eID="gen18978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18979"/>subjicientem in furore gentes, <l eID="gen18979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18980"/>persequentem crudeliter. <l eID="gen18980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7905"/><l level="1" sID="gen18981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7905"/>Conquievit et siluit omnis terra, <l eID="gen18981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18982"/>gavisa est et exsultavit ; <l eID="gen18982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7906"/><l level="1" sID="gen18983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7906"/>abietes quoque lætatæ sunt super te, <l eID="gen18983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18984"/>et cedri Libani : <l eID="gen18984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18985"/>ex quo dormisti, non ascendet <l eID="gen18985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18986"/>qui succidat nos. <l eID="gen18986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7907"/><l level="1" sID="gen18987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7907"/>Infernus subter conturbatus est <l eID="gen18987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18988"/>in occursum adventus tui ; <l eID="gen18988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18989"/>suscitavit tibi gigantes. <l eID="gen18989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18990"/>Omnes principes terræ <l eID="gen18990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18991"/>surrexerunt de soliis suis, <l eID="gen18991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18992"/>omnes principes nationum. <l eID="gen18992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7908"/><l level="1" sID="gen18993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7908"/>Universi respondebunt, et dicent tibi : <l eID="gen18993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18994"/>Et tu vulneratus es sicut et nos ; <l eID="gen18994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18995"/>nostri similis effectus es. <l eID="gen18995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7909"/><l level="1" sID="gen18996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7909"/>Detracta est ad inferos superbia tua, <l eID="gen18996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18997"/>concidit cadaver tuum ; <l eID="gen18997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18998"/>subter te sternetur tinea, <l eID="gen18998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen18999"/>et operimentum tuum erunt vermes. <l eID="gen18999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7910"/><l level="1" sID="gen19000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7910"/>Quomodo cecidisti de cælo, <l eID="gen19000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19001"/>Lucifer, qui mane oriebaris ? <l eID="gen19001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19002"/>corruisti in terram, <l eID="gen19002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19003"/>qui vulnerabas gentes ? <l eID="gen19003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7911"/><l level="1" sID="gen19004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7911"/>Qui dicebas in corde tuo : <l eID="gen19004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19005"/>In cælum conscendam, <l eID="gen19005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19006"/>super astra Dei <l eID="gen19006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19007"/>exaltabo solium meum ; <l eID="gen19007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19008"/>sedebo in monte testamenti, <l eID="gen19008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19009"/>in lateribus aquilonis ; <l eID="gen19009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7912"/><l level="1" sID="gen19010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7912"/>ascendam super altitudinem nubium, <l eID="gen19010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19011"/>similis ero Altissimo ? <l eID="gen19011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7913"/><l level="1" sID="gen19012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7913"/>Verumtamen ad infernum detraheris, <l eID="gen19012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19013"/>in profundum laci. <l eID="gen19013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7914"/><l level="1" sID="gen19014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7914"/>Qui te viderint, ad te inclinabuntur, <l eID="gen19014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19015"/>teque prospicient : <l eID="gen19015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19016"/>Numquid iste est vir qui conturbavit terram, <l eID="gen19016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19017"/>qui concussit regna, <l eID="gen19017" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7915"/><l level="1" sID="gen19018"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7915"/>qui posuit orbem desertum, <l eID="gen19018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19019"/>et urbes ejus destruxit, <l eID="gen19019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19020"/>vinctis ejus non aperuit carcerem ? <l eID="gen19020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7916"/><l level="1" sID="gen19021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7916"/>Omnes reges gentium <l eID="gen19021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19022"/>universi dormierunt in gloria, <l eID="gen19022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19023"/>vir in domo sua ; <l eID="gen19023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7917"/><l level="1" sID="gen19024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7917"/>tu autem projectus es de sepulchro tuo, <l eID="gen19024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19025"/>quasi stirps inutilis pollutus, <l eID="gen19025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19026"/>et obvolutus cum his qui interfecti sunt gladio, <l eID="gen19026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19027"/>et descenderunt ad fundamenta laci, <l eID="gen19027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19028"/>quasi cadaver putridum. <l eID="gen19028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7918"/><l level="1" sID="gen19029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7918"/>Non habebis consortium, neque cum eis in sepultura ; <l eID="gen19029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19030"/>tu enim terram tuam disperdidisti, <l eID="gen19030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19031"/>tu populum tuum occidisti : <l eID="gen19031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19032"/>non vocabitur in æternum <l eID="gen19032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19033"/>semen pessimorum. <l eID="gen19033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7919"/><l level="1" sID="gen19034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7919"/>Præparate filios ejus occisioni, <l eID="gen19034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19035"/>in iniquitate patrum suorum : <l eID="gen19035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19036"/>non consurgent, nec hæreditabunt terram, <l eID="gen19036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19037"/>neque implebunt faciem orbis civitatum. <l eID="gen19037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7920"/><l level="1" sID="gen19038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7920"/>Et consurgam super eos, <l eID="gen19038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19039"/>dicit Dominus exercituum ; <l eID="gen19039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19040"/>et perdam Babylonis nomen, et reliquias, <l eID="gen19040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19041"/>et germen, et progeniem, dicit Dominus ; <l eID="gen19041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7921"/><l level="1" sID="gen19042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7921"/>et ponam eam in possessionem ericii, <l eID="gen19042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19043"/>et in paludes aquarum, <l eID="gen19043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19044"/>et scopabo eam in scopa terens, <l eID="gen19044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19045"/>dicit Dominus exercituum. <l eID="gen19045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7922"/><l level="1" sID="gen19046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7922"/>Juravit Dominus exercituum, dicens : <l eID="gen19046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19047"/>Si non, ut putavi, ita erit ; <l eID="gen19047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19048"/>et quomodo mente tractavi, <l eID="gen19048" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7923"/><l level="1" sID="gen19049"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7923"/>sic eveniet : <l eID="gen19049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19050"/>ut conteram Assyrium in terra mea, <l eID="gen19050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19051"/>et in montibus meis conculcem eum ; <l eID="gen19051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19052"/>et auferetur ab eis jugum ejus, <l eID="gen19052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19053"/>et onus illius ab humero eorum tolletur. <l eID="gen19053" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7924"/><l level="1" sID="gen19054"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7924"/>Hoc consilium quod cogitavi super omnem terram ; <l eID="gen19054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19055"/>et hæc est manus extenta super universas gentes. <l eID="gen19055" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7925"/><l level="1" sID="gen19056"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7925"/>Dominus enim exercituum decrevit ; et quis poterit infirmare ? <l eID="gen19056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19057"/>et manus ejus extenta ; et quis avertet eam ? <l eID="gen19057" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen18882"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7926"/><div sID="gen19058" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7926"/>In anno quo mortuus est rex Achaz, factum est onus istud :  <div eID="gen19058" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7927"/><lg sID="gen19059"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7927"/>Ne lætaris, Philisthæa omnis tu, <l eID="gen19060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19061"/>quoniam comminuta est virga percussoris tui ; <l eID="gen19061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19062"/>de radice enim colubri egredietur regulus, <l eID="gen19062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19063"/>et semen ejus absorbens volucrem. <l eID="gen19063" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7928"/><l level="1" sID="gen19064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7928"/>Et pascentur primogeniti pauperum, <l eID="gen19064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19065"/>et pauperes fiducialiter requiescent ; <l eID="gen19065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19066"/>et interire faciam in fame radicem tuam, <l eID="gen19066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19067"/>et reliquias tuas interficiam. <l eID="gen19067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7929"/><l level="1" sID="gen19068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7929"/>Ulula, porta ; clama civitas ; <l eID="gen19068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19069"/>prostrata est Philisthæa omnis ; <l eID="gen19069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19070"/>ab aquilone enim fumus veniet, <l eID="gen19070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19071"/>et non est qui effugiet agmen ejus. <l eID="gen19071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 14:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7930"/><l level="1" sID="gen19072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7930"/>Et quid respondebitur nuntiis gentis ? <l eID="gen19072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19073"/>Quia Dominus fundavit Sion, <l eID="gen19073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19074"/>et in ipso sperabunt pauperes populi ejus. <l eID="gen19074" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19059"/> <chapter eID="Isa.14"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:1
verses.text: Onus Moab. <div eID="gen19075" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19076"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19077"/>Quia nocte vastata est <l eID="gen19077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19078"/>Ar Moab, conticuit ; <l eID="gen19078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19079"/>quia nocte vastatus est <l eID="gen19079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19080"/>murus Moab, conticuit. <l eID="gen19080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7931"/><l level="1" sID="gen19081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7931"/>Ascendit domus, <l eID="gen19081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19082"/>et Dibon ad excelsa, <l eID="gen19082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19083"/>in planctum super Nabo ; <l eID="gen19083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19084"/>et super Medaba, Moab ululavit ; <l eID="gen19084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19085"/>in cunctis capitibus ejus calvitium, <l eID="gen19085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19086"/>et omnis barba radetur. <l eID="gen19086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7932"/><l level="1" sID="gen19087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7932"/>In triviis ejus accincti sunt sacco ; <l eID="gen19087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19088"/>super tecta ejus et in plateis ejus <l eID="gen19088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19089"/>omnis ululatus descendit in fletum. <l eID="gen19089" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7933"/><l level="1" sID="gen19090"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7933"/>Clamabit Hesebon et Eleale, <l eID="gen19090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19091"/>usque Jasa audita est vox eorum ; <l eID="gen19091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19092"/>super hoc expediti Moab ululabunt, <l eID="gen19092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19093"/>anima ejus ululabit sibi. <l eID="gen19093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7934"/><l level="1" sID="gen19094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7934"/>Cor meum ad Moab clamabit ; <l eID="gen19094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19095"/>vectes ejus usque ad Segor, <l eID="gen19095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19096"/>vitulam conternantem ; <l eID="gen19096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19097"/>per ascensum enim Luith <l eID="gen19097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19098"/>flens ascendet, <l eID="gen19098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19099"/>et in via Oronaim <l eID="gen19099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19100"/>clamorem contritionis levabunt. <l eID="gen19100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7935"/><l level="1" sID="gen19101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7935"/>Aquæ enim Nemrim desertæ erunt, <l eID="gen19101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19102"/>quia aruit herba, defecit germen, <l eID="gen19102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19103"/>viror omnis interiit. <l eID="gen19103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7936"/><l level="1" sID="gen19104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7936"/>Secundum magnitudinem operis, et visitatio eorum : <l eID="gen19104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19105"/>ad torrentem Salicum ducent eos. <l eID="gen19105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7937"/><l level="1" sID="gen19106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7937"/>Quoniam circuivit clamor terminum Moab ; <l eID="gen19106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19107"/>usque ad Gallim ululatus ejus, <l eID="gen19107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19108"/>et usque ad puteum Elim clamor ejus. <l eID="gen19108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7938"/><l level="1" sID="gen19109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7938"/>Quia aquæ Dibon repletæ sunt sanguine ; <l eID="gen19109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19110"/>ponam enim super Dibon additamenta ; <l eID="gen19110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19111"/>his qui fugerint de Moab leonem, <l eID="gen19111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19112"/>et reliquiis terræ.  <chapter eID="Isa.15"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:1
verses.text: Emitte agnum, Domine, dominatorem terræ, <l eID="gen19113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19114"/>de petra deserti <l eID="gen19114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19115"/>ad montem filiæ Sion. <l eID="gen19115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7939"/><l level="1" sID="gen19116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7939"/>Et erit : sicut avis fugiens, <l eID="gen19116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19117"/>et pulli de nido avolantes, <l eID="gen19117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19118"/>sic erunt filiæ Moab <l eID="gen19118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19119"/>in transcensu Arnon. <l eID="gen19119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7940"/><l level="1" sID="gen19120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7940"/>Ini consilium, <l eID="gen19120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19121"/>coge concilium ; <l eID="gen19121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19122"/>pone quasi noctem umbram tuam <l eID="gen19122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19123"/>in meridie ; <l eID="gen19123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19124"/>absconde fugientes, et vagos ne prodas. <l eID="gen19124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7941"/><l level="1" sID="gen19125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7941"/>Habitabunt apud te profugi mei ; <l eID="gen19125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19126"/>Moab, esto latibulum eorum a facie vastatoris : <l eID="gen19126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19127"/>finitus est enim pulvis, consummatus est miser, <l eID="gen19127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19128"/>defecit qui conculcabat terram. <l eID="gen19128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7942"/><l level="1" sID="gen19129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7942"/>Et præparabitur in misericordia solium, <l eID="gen19129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19130"/>et sedebit super illud in veritate <l eID="gen19130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19131"/>in tabernaculo David, <l eID="gen19131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19132"/>judicans et quærens judicium, <l eID="gen19132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19133"/>et velociter reddens quod justum est. <l eID="gen19133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7943"/><l level="1" sID="gen19134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7943"/>Audivimus superbiam Moab : <l eID="gen19134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19135"/>superbus est valde ; <l eID="gen19135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19136"/>superbia ejus, et arrogantia ejus, et indignatio ejus <l eID="gen19136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19137"/>plus quam fortitudo ejus. <l eID="gen19137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7944"/><l level="1" sID="gen19138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7944"/>Idcirco ululabit Moab ad Moab ; <l eID="gen19138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19139"/>universus ululabit : <l eID="gen19139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19140"/>his qui lætantur super muros cocti lateris, <l eID="gen19140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19141"/>loquimini plagas suas. <l eID="gen19141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7945"/><l level="1" sID="gen19142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7945"/>Quoniam suburbana Hesebon deserta sunt, <l eID="gen19142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19143"/>et vineam Sabama <l eID="gen19143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19144"/>domini gentium exciderunt : <l eID="gen19144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19145"/>flagella ejus usque ad Jazer pervenerunt, <l eID="gen19145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19146"/>erraverunt in deserto ; <l eID="gen19146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19147"/>propagines ejus relictæ sunt, <l eID="gen19147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19148"/>transierunt mare. <l eID="gen19148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7946"/><l level="1" sID="gen19149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7946"/>Super hoc plorabo in fletu Jazer <l eID="gen19149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19150"/>vineam Sabama ; <l eID="gen19150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19151"/>inebriabo de lacrima mea, <l eID="gen19151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19152"/>Hesebon et Eleale, <l eID="gen19152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19153"/>quoniam super vindemiam tuam et super messem tuam <l eID="gen19153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19154"/>vox calcantium irruit. <l eID="gen19154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7947"/><l level="1" sID="gen19155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7947"/>Et auferetur lætitia et exsultatio de Carmelo, <l eID="gen19155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19156"/>et in vineis non exsultabit neque jubilabit. <l eID="gen19156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19157"/>Vinum in torculari non calcabit qui calcare consueverat ; <l eID="gen19157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19158"/>vocem calcantium abstuli. <l eID="gen19158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7948"/><l level="1" sID="gen19159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7948"/>Super hoc venter meus ad Moab <l eID="gen19159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19160"/>quasi cithara sonabit, <l eID="gen19160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19161"/>et viscera mea ad murum cocti lateris. <l eID="gen19161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7949"/><l level="1" sID="gen19162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7949"/>Et erit : cum apparuerit quod laboravit Moab <l eID="gen19162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19163"/>super excelsis suis, <l eID="gen19163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19164"/>ingredietur ad sancta sua ut obsecret, <l eID="gen19164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19165"/>et non valebit.

verses.name: Isaiah 16:13
verses.text: Hoc verbum quod locutus est Dominus ad Moab ex tunc.

verses.name: Isaiah 16:14
verses.text: Et nunc locutus est Dominus, dicens : In tribus annis, quasi anni mercenarii, auferetur gloria Moab super omni populo multo, et relinquetur parvus et modicus, nequaquam multus. <l eID="gen19165" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19076"/> <chapter eID="Isa.16"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:1
verses.text: Onus Damasci. <div eID="gen19166" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19167"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19168"/>Ecce Damascus desinet esse civitas, <l eID="gen19168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19169"/>et erit sicut acervus lapidum in ruina. <l eID="gen19169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7950"/><l level="1" sID="gen19170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7950"/>Derelictæ civitates Aroër <l eID="gen19170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19171"/>gregibus erunt, <l eID="gen19171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19172"/>et requiescent ibi, et non erit qui exterreat. <l eID="gen19172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7951"/><l level="1" sID="gen19173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7951"/>Et cessabit adjutorium ab Ephraim, <l eID="gen19173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19174"/>et regnum a Damasco ; <l eID="gen19174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19175"/>et reliquiæ Syriæ <l eID="gen19175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19176"/>sicut gloria filiorum Israël erunt, <l eID="gen19176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19177"/>dicit Dominus exercituum. <l eID="gen19177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7952"/><l level="1" sID="gen19178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7952"/>Et erit in die illa : <l eID="gen19178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19179"/>attenuabitur gloria Jacob, <l eID="gen19179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19180"/>et pinguedo carnis ejus marcescet. <l eID="gen19180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7953"/><l level="1" sID="gen19181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7953"/>Et erit sicut congregans in messe quod restiterit, <l eID="gen19181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19182"/>et brachium ejus spicas leget ; <l eID="gen19182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19183"/>et erit sicut quærens spicas <l eID="gen19183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19184"/>in valle Raphaim. <l eID="gen19184" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7954"/><l level="1" sID="gen19185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7954"/>Et relinquetur in eo sicut racemus et sicut excussio oleæ <l eID="gen19185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19186"/>duarum vel trium olivarum in summitate rami, <l eID="gen19186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19187"/>sive quatuor aut quinque in cacuminibus ejus fructus ejus, <l eID="gen19187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19188"/>dicit Dominus Deus Israël. <l eID="gen19188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7955"/><l level="1" sID="gen19189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7955"/>In die illa inclinabitur homo ad <l eID="gen19189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19190"/>factorem suum, <l eID="gen19190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19191"/>et oculi ejus ad Sanctum Israël respicient ; <l eID="gen19191" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7956"/><l level="1" sID="gen19192"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7956"/>et non inclinabitur ad altaria quæ fecerunt manus ejus ; <l eID="gen19192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19193"/>et quæ operati sunt digiti ejus non respiciet <l eID="gen19193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19194"/>lucos et delubra. <l eID="gen19194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:9
