verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7957"/><l level="1" sID="gen19195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7957"/>In die illa erunt civitates fortitudinis ejus <l eID="gen19195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19196"/>derelictæ sicut aratra, et segetes <l eID="gen19196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19197"/>quæ derelictæ sunt a facie filiorum Israël ; <l eID="gen19197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19198"/>et eris deserta. <l eID="gen19198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7958"/><l level="1" sID="gen19199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7958"/>Quia oblitus es Dei salvatoris tui, <l eID="gen19199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19200"/>et fortis adjutoris tui non es recordata : <l eID="gen19200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19201"/>propterea plantabis plantationem fidelem, <l eID="gen19201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19202"/>et germen alienum seminabis ; <l eID="gen19202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7959"/><l level="1" sID="gen19203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7959"/>in die plantationis tuæ labrusca, <l eID="gen19203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19204"/>et mane semen tuum florebit ; <l eID="gen19204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19205"/>ablata est messis in die hæreditatis, <l eID="gen19205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19206"/>et dolebit graviter. <l eID="gen19206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7960"/><l level="1" sID="gen19207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7960"/>Væ multitudini populorum multorum, <l eID="gen19207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19208"/>ut multitudo maris sonantis ; <l eID="gen19208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19209"/>et tumultus turbarum, <l eID="gen19209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19210"/>sicut sonitus aquarum multarum. <l eID="gen19210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7961"/><l level="1" sID="gen19211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7961"/>Sonabunt populi sicut sonitus aquarum inundantium, <l eID="gen19211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19212"/>et increpabit eum, et fugiet procul ; <l eID="gen19212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19213"/>et rapietur sicut pulvis montium a facie venti, <l eID="gen19213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19214"/>et sicut turbo coram tempestate. <l eID="gen19214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7962"/><l level="1" sID="gen19215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7962"/>In tempore vespere, et ecce turbatio ; <l eID="gen19215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19216"/>in matutino, et non subsistet. <l eID="gen19216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19217"/>Hæc est pars eorum qui vastaverunt nos, <l eID="gen19217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19218"/>et sors diripientium nos.  <chapter eID="Isa.17"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:1
verses.text: Væ terræ cymbalo alarum, <l eID="gen19219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19220"/>quæ est trans flumina Æthiopiæ, <l eID="gen19220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7963"/><l level="1" sID="gen19221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7963"/>qui mittit in mare legatos, <l eID="gen19221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19222"/>et in vasis papyri super aquas. <l eID="gen19222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19223"/>Ite, angeli veloces, <l eID="gen19223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19224"/>ad gentem convulsam et dilaceratam ; <l eID="gen19224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19225"/>ad populum terribilem, post quem non est alius ; <l eID="gen19225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19226"/>ad gentem exspectantem et conculcatam, <l eID="gen19226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19227"/>cujus diripuerunt flumina terram ejus. <l eID="gen19227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7964"/><l level="1" sID="gen19228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7964"/>Omnes habitatores orbis, qui moramini in terra, cum elevatum fuerit signum in montibus, videbitis, <l eID="gen19228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19229"/>et clangorem tubæ audietis. <l eID="gen19229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7965"/><l level="1" sID="gen19230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7965"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen19230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19231"/>Quiescam et considerabo in loco meo, <l eID="gen19231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19232"/>sicut meridiana lux clara est, <l eID="gen19232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19233"/>et sicut nubes roris in die messis. <l eID="gen19233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7966"/><l level="1" sID="gen19234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7966"/>Ante messem enim totus effloruit, <l eID="gen19234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19235"/>et immatura perfectio germinabit ; <l eID="gen19235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19236"/>et præcidentur ramusculi ejus falcibus, <l eID="gen19236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19237"/>et quæ derelicta fuerint abscindentur et excutientur. <l eID="gen19237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7967"/><l level="1" sID="gen19238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7967"/>Et relinquentur simul avibus montium <l eID="gen19238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19239"/>et bestiis terræ ; <l eID="gen19239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19240"/>et æstate perpetua erunt super eum volucres, <l eID="gen19240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19241"/>et omnes bestiæ terræ super illum hiemabunt. <l eID="gen19241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7968"/><l level="1" sID="gen19242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7968"/>In tempore illo deferetur munus Domino exercituum <l eID="gen19242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19243"/>a populo divulso et dilacerato, <l eID="gen19243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19244"/>a populo terribili, post quem non fuit alius ; <l eID="gen19244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19245"/>a gente exspectante, exspectante et conculcata, <l eID="gen19245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19246"/>cujus diripuerunt flumina terram ejus ; <l eID="gen19246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19247"/>ad locum nominis Domini exercituum, montem Sion. <l eID="gen19247" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19167"/> <chapter eID="Isa.18"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:1
verses.text: Onus Ægypti. <div eID="gen19248" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19249"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19250"/>Ecce Dominus ascendet super nubem levem, <l eID="gen19250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19251"/>et ingredietur Ægyptum, <l eID="gen19251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19252"/>et commovebuntur simulacra Ægypti a facie ejus, <l eID="gen19252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19253"/>et cor Ægypti tabescet in medio ejus, <l eID="gen19253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7969"/><l level="1" sID="gen19254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7969"/>et concurrere faciam Ægyptios adversus Ægyptios ; <l eID="gen19254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19255"/>et pugnabit vir contra fratrem suum, et vir contra amicum suum, <l eID="gen19255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19256"/>civitas adversus civitatem, regnum adversus regnum. <l eID="gen19256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7970"/><l level="1" sID="gen19257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7970"/>Et dirumpetur spiritus Ægypti in visceribus ejus, <l eID="gen19257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19258"/>et consilium ejus præcipitabo ; <l eID="gen19258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19259"/>et interrogabunt simulacra sua, et divinos suos, <l eID="gen19259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19260"/>et pythones, et ariolos. <l eID="gen19260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7971"/><l level="1" sID="gen19261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7971"/>Et tradam Ægyptum in manu dominorum crudelium, <l eID="gen19261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19262"/>et rex fortis dominabitur eorum, <l eID="gen19262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19263"/>ait Dominus Deus exercituum. <l eID="gen19263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7972"/><l level="1" sID="gen19264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7972"/>Et arescet aqua de mari, <l eID="gen19264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19265"/>et fluvius desolabitur atque siccabitur. <l eID="gen19265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7973"/><l level="1" sID="gen19266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7973"/>Et deficient flumina, <l eID="gen19266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19267"/>attenuabuntur et siccabuntur rivi aggerum, <l eID="gen19267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19268"/>calamus et juncus marcescet. <l eID="gen19268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7974"/><l level="1" sID="gen19269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7974"/>Nudabitur alveus rivi a fonte suo, <l eID="gen19269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19270"/>et omnis sementis irrigua <l eID="gen19270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19271"/>siccabitur, arescet, et non erit. <l eID="gen19271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7975"/><l level="1" sID="gen19272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7975"/>Et mœrebunt piscatores, <l eID="gen19272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19273"/>et lugebunt omnes mittentes in flumen hamum ; <l eID="gen19273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19274"/>et expandentes rete super faciem aquarum emarcescent. <l eID="gen19274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7976"/><l level="1" sID="gen19275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7976"/>Confundentur qui operabantur linum, <l eID="gen19275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19276"/>pectentes et texentes subtilia. <l eID="gen19276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7977"/><l level="1" sID="gen19277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7977"/>Et erunt irrigua ejus flaccentia : <l eID="gen19277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19278"/>omnes qui faciebant lacunas ad capiendos pisces. <l eID="gen19278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7978"/><l level="1" sID="gen19279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7978"/>Stulti principes Taneos, <l eID="gen19279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19280"/>sapientes consiliarii Pharaonis <l eID="gen19280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19281"/>dederunt consilium insipiens. <l eID="gen19281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19282"/>Quomodo dicetis Pharaoni : <l eID="gen19282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19283"/>Filius sapientium ego, <l eID="gen19283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19284"/>filius regum antiquorum ? <l eID="gen19284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7979"/><l level="1" sID="gen19285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7979"/>Ubi nunc sunt sapientes tui ? <l eID="gen19285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19286"/>annuntient tibi, et indicent <l eID="gen19286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19287"/>quid cogitaverit Dominus exercituum super Ægyptum. <l eID="gen19287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7980"/><l level="1" sID="gen19288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7980"/>Stulti facti sunt principes Taneos, <l eID="gen19288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19289"/>emarcuerunt principes Mempheos ; <l eID="gen19289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19290"/>deceperunt Ægyptum, angulum populorum ejus. <l eID="gen19290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7981"/><l level="1" sID="gen19291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7981"/>Dominus miscuit in medio ejus spiritum vertiginis ; <l eID="gen19291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19292"/>et errare fecerunt Ægyptum in omni opere suo, <l eID="gen19292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19293"/>sicut errat ebrius et vomens. <l eID="gen19293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7982"/><l level="1" sID="gen19294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7982"/>Et non erit Ægypto opus <l eID="gen19294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19295"/>quod faciat caput et caudam, <l eID="gen19295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19296"/>incurvantem et refrenantem. <l eID="gen19296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7983"/><l level="1" sID="gen19297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7983"/>In die illa erit Ægyptus quasi mulieres ; <l eID="gen19297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19298"/>et stupebunt, et timebunt <l eID="gen19298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19299"/>a facie commotionis manus Domini exercituum, <l eID="gen19299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19300"/>quam ipse movebit super eam. <l eID="gen19300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7984"/><l level="1" sID="gen19301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7984"/>Et erit terra Juda <l eID="gen19301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19302"/>Ægypto in pavorem ; <l eID="gen19302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19303"/>omnis qui illius fuerit recordatus pavebit <l eID="gen19303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19304"/>a facie consilii Domini exercituum, <l eID="gen19304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19305"/>quod ipse cogitavit super eam. <l eID="gen19305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7985"/><l level="1" sID="gen19306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7985"/>In die illa erunt quinque civitates <l eID="gen19306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19307"/>in terra Ægypti <l eID="gen19307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19308"/>loquentes lingua Chanaan, <l eID="gen19308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19309"/>et jurantes per Dominum exercituum : <l eID="gen19309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19310"/>Civitas solis vocabitur una. <l eID="gen19310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7986"/><l level="1" sID="gen19311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7986"/>In die illa erit altare Domini <l eID="gen19311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19312"/>in medio terræ Ægypti, <l eID="gen19312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19313"/>et titulus Domini juxta terminum ejus. <l eID="gen19313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7987"/><l level="1" sID="gen19314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7987"/>Erit in signum et in testimonium Domino exercituum <l eID="gen19314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19315"/>in terra Ægypti ; <l eID="gen19315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19316"/>clamabunt enim ad Dominum a facie tribulationis, <l eID="gen19316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19317"/>et mittet eis salvatorem <l eID="gen19317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19318"/>et propugnatorem qui liberet eos. <l eID="gen19318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7988"/><l level="1" sID="gen19319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7988"/>Et cognoscetur Dominus ab Ægypto, <l eID="gen19319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19320"/>et cognoscent Ægyptii Dominum <l eID="gen19320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19321"/>in die illa ; <l eID="gen19321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19322"/>et colent eum in hostiis et in muneribus ; <l eID="gen19322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19323"/>et vota vovebunt Domino, et solvent. <l eID="gen19323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7989"/><l level="1" sID="gen19324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7989"/>Et percutiet Dominus Ægyptum plaga, <l eID="gen19324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19325"/>et sanabit eam ; <l eID="gen19325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19326"/>et revertentur ad Dominum, <l eID="gen19326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19327"/>et placabitur eis, et sanabit eos. <l eID="gen19327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7990"/><l level="1" sID="gen19328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7990"/>In die illa erit via <l eID="gen19328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19329"/>de Ægypto in Assyrios ; <l eID="gen19329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19330"/>et intrabit Assyrius Ægyptum, <l eID="gen19330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19331"/>et Ægyptius in Assyrios, <l eID="gen19331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19332"/>et servient Ægyptii Assur. <l eID="gen19332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7991"/><l level="1" sID="gen19333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7991"/>In die illa erit Israël tertius <l eID="gen19333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19334"/>Ægyptio et Assyrio ; <l eID="gen19334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19335"/>benedictio in medio terræ <l eID="gen19335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 19:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7992"/><l level="1" sID="gen19336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7992"/>cui benedixit Dominus exercituum, dicens : <l eID="gen19336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19337"/>Benedictus populus meus Ægypti, <l eID="gen19337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19338"/>et opus manuum mearum Assyrio ; <l eID="gen19338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19339"/>hæreditas autem mea Israël. <l eID="gen19339" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19249"/> <chapter eID="Isa.19"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:1
verses.text: In anno quo ingressus est Thathan in Azotum, cum misisset eum Sargon, rex Assyriorum, et pugnasset contra Azotum, et cepisset eam :

verses.name: Isaiah 20:2
verses.text: in tempore illo locutus est Dominus in manu Isaiæ, filii Amos, dicens : Vade, et solve saccum de lumbis tuis, et calceamenta tua tolle de pedibus tuis. Et fecit sic, vadens nudus et discalceatus.

verses.name: Isaiah 20:3
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus : <div eID="gen19340" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19341"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19342"/>Sicut ambulavit servus meus Isaias nudus et discalceatus, <l eID="gen19342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19343"/>trium annorum signum et portentum erit <l eID="gen19343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19344"/>super Ægyptum et super Æthiopiam ; <l eID="gen19344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7993"/><l level="1" sID="gen19345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7993"/>sic minabit rex Assyriorum captivitatem Ægypti, <l eID="gen19345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19346"/>et transmigrationem Æthiopiæ, <l eID="gen19346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19347"/>juvenum et senum, nudam et discalceatam, discoopertis natibus, ad ignominiam Ægypti. <l eID="gen19347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7994"/><l level="1" sID="gen19348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7994"/>Et timebunt, et confundentur <l eID="gen19348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19349"/>ab Æthiopia spe sua, <l eID="gen19349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19350"/>et ab Ægypto gloria sua. <l eID="gen19350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7995"/><l level="1" sID="gen19351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7995"/>Et dicet habitator insulæ hujus in die illa : <l eID="gen19351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19352"/>Ecce hæc erat spes nostra, <l eID="gen19352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19353"/>ad quos confugimus in auxilium, ut liberarent nos <l eID="gen19353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19354"/>a facie regis Assyriorum : <l eID="gen19354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19355"/>et quomodo effugere poterimus nos ? <l eID="gen19355" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19341"/> <chapter eID="Isa.20"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:1
verses.text: Onus deserti maris. <div eID="gen19356" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19357"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19358"/>Sicut turbines ab africo veniunt, <l eID="gen19358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19359"/>de deserto venit, <l eID="gen19359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19360"/>de terra horribili. <l eID="gen19360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7996"/><l level="1" sID="gen19361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7996"/>Visio dura nuntiata est mihi : <l eID="gen19361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19362"/>qui incredulus est infideliter agit ; <l eID="gen19362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19363"/>et qui depopulator est vastat. <l eID="gen19363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19364"/>Ascende, Ælam ; obside, Mede ; <l eID="gen19364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19365"/>omnem gemitum ejus cessare feci. <l eID="gen19365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7997"/><l level="1" sID="gen19366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7997"/>Propterea repleti sunt lumbi mei dolore ; <l eID="gen19366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19367"/>angustia possedit me <l eID="gen19367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19368"/>sicut angustia parturientis ; <l eID="gen19368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19369"/>corrui cum audirem, conturbatus sum cum viderem. <l eID="gen19369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7998"/><l level="1" sID="gen19370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7998"/>Emarcuit cor meum ; <l eID="gen19370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19371"/>tenebræ stupefecerunt me : <l eID="gen19371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19372"/>Babylon dilecta mea <l eID="gen19372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19373"/>posita est mihi in miraculum. <l eID="gen19373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7999"/><l level="1" sID="gen19374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7999"/>Pone mensam, contemplare in specula <l eID="gen19374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19375"/>comedentes et bibentes : <l eID="gen19375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19376"/>surgite, principes, <l eID="gen19376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19377"/>arripite clypeum. <l eID="gen19377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8000"/><l level="1" sID="gen19378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8000"/>Hæc enim dixit mihi Dominus : <l eID="gen19378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19379"/>Vade, et pone speculatorem, <l eID="gen19379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19380"/>et quodcumque viderit annuntiet. <l eID="gen19380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8001"/><l level="1" sID="gen19381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8001"/>Et vidit currum duorum equitum, <l eID="gen19381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19382"/>ascensorem asini, <l eID="gen19382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19383"/>et ascensorem cameli ; <l eID="gen19383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19384"/>et contemplatus est diligenter multo intuitu. <l eID="gen19384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8002"/><l level="1" sID="gen19385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8002"/>Et clamavit leo : <l eID="gen19385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19386"/>Super speculam Domini ego sum, <l eID="gen19386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19387"/>stans jugiter per diem ; <l eID="gen19387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19388"/>et super custodiam meam ego sum, <l eID="gen19388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19389"/>stans totis noctibus. <l eID="gen19389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8003"/><l level="1" sID="gen19390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8003"/>Ecce iste venit ascensor <l eID="gen19390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19391"/>vir bigæ equitum ; <l eID="gen19391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19392"/>et respondit, et dixit : <l eID="gen19392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19393"/>Cecidit, cecidit Babylon, <l eID="gen19393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19394"/>et omnia sculptilia deorum ejus <l eID="gen19394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19395"/>contrita sunt in terram. <l eID="gen19395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8004"/><l level="1" sID="gen19396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8004"/>Tritura mea et filii areæ meæ, <l eID="gen19396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19397"/>quæ audivi a Domino exercituum, <l eID="gen19397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19398"/>Deo Israël, <l eID="gen19398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19399"/>annuntiavi vobis. <l eID="gen19399" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen19357"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8005"/><div sID="gen19400" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8005"/>Onus Duma. <div eID="gen19400" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19401"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19402"/>Ad me clamat ex Seir : <l eID="gen19402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19403"/>Custos, quid de nocte ? <l eID="gen19403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19404"/>custos, quid de nocte ? <l eID="gen19404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8006"/><l level="1" sID="gen19405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8006"/>Dixit custos : <l eID="gen19405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19406"/>Venit mane et nox ; <l eID="gen19406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19407"/>si quæritis, quærite ; <l eID="gen19407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19408"/>convertimini, venite. <l eID="gen19408" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen19401"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8007"/><div sID="gen19409" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8007"/>Onus in Arabia. <div eID="gen19409" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19410"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19411"/>In saltu ad vesperam dormietis, <l eID="gen19411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19412"/>in semitis Dedanim. <l eID="gen19412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8008"/><l level="1" sID="gen19413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8008"/>Occurrentes sitienti ferte aquam, <l eID="gen19413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19414"/>qui habitatis terram austri ; <l eID="gen19414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19415"/>cum panibus occurrite fugienti. <l eID="gen19415" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8009"/><l level="1" sID="gen19416"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8009"/>A facie enim gladiorum fugerunt, <l eID="gen19416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19417"/>a facie gladii imminentis, <l eID="gen19417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19418"/>a facie arcus extenti, <l eID="gen19418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19419"/>a facie gravis prælii. <l eID="gen19419" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8010"/><l level="1" sID="gen19420"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8010"/>Quoniam hæc dicit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen19420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19421"/>Adhuc in uno anno, quasi in anno mercenarii, <l eID="gen19421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19422"/>et auferetur omnis gloria Cedar. <l eID="gen19422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8011"/><l level="1" sID="gen19423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8011"/>Et reliquiæ numeri sagittariorum fortium <l eID="gen19423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19424"/>de filiis Cedar imminuentur ; <l eID="gen19424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19425"/>Dominus enim Deus Israël locutus est. <l eID="gen19425" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19410"/> <chapter eID="Isa.21"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:1
verses.text: Onus vallis Visionis. <div eID="gen19426" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19427"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19428"/>Quidnam quoque tibi est, quia ascendisti <l eID="gen19428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19429"/>et tu omnis in tecta ? <l eID="gen19429" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8012"/><l level="1" sID="gen19430"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8012"/>Clamoris plena, urbs frequens, <l eID="gen19430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19431"/>civitas exsultans ; <l eID="gen19431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19432"/>interfecti tui, non interfecti gladio, <l eID="gen19432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19433"/>nec mortui in bello. <l eID="gen19433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8013"/><l level="1" sID="gen19434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8013"/>Cuncti principes tui fugerunt simul <l eID="gen19434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19435"/>dureque ligati sunt ; <l eID="gen19435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19436"/>omnes qui inventi sunt vincti sunt pariter ; <l eID="gen19436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19437"/>procul fugerunt. <l eID="gen19437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8014"/><l level="1" sID="gen19438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8014"/>Propterea dixi : Recedite a me : <l eID="gen19438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19439"/>amare flebo ; <l eID="gen19439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19440"/>nolite incumbere ut consolemini me <l eID="gen19440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19441"/>super vastitate filiæ populi mei ; <l eID="gen19441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8015"/><l level="1" sID="gen19442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8015"/>dies enim interfectionis, <l eID="gen19442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19443"/>et conculcationis, et fletuum, <l eID="gen19443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19444"/>Domino Deo exercituum, <l eID="gen19444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19445"/>in valle Visionis, <l eID="gen19445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19446"/>scrutans murum, <l eID="gen19446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19447"/>et magnificus super montem. <l eID="gen19447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8016"/><l level="1" sID="gen19448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8016"/>Et Ælam sumpsit pharetram, <l eID="gen19448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19449"/>currum hominis equitis, <l eID="gen19449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19450"/>et parietem nudavit clypeus. <l eID="gen19450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8017"/><l level="1" sID="gen19451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8017"/>Et erunt electæ valles tuæ plenæ quadrigarum, <l eID="gen19451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19452"/>et equites ponent sedes suas in porta. <l eID="gen19452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8018"/><l level="1" sID="gen19453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8018"/>Et revelabitur operimentum Judæ, <l eID="gen19453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19454"/>et videbis in die illa <l eID="gen19454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19455"/>armamentarium domus saltus. <l eID="gen19455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8019"/><l level="1" sID="gen19456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8019"/>Et scissuras civitatis David videbitis, <l eID="gen19456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19457"/>quia multiplicatæ sunt ; <l eID="gen19457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19458"/>et congregastis aquas piscinæ inferioris, <l eID="gen19458" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8020"/><l level="1" sID="gen19459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8020"/>et domos Jerusalem numerastis, <l eID="gen19459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19460"/>et destruxistis domos ad muniendum murum. <l eID="gen19460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8021"/><l level="1" sID="gen19461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8021"/>Et lacum fecistis inter duos muros <l eID="gen19461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19462"/>ad aquam piscinæ veteris ; <l eID="gen19462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19463"/>et non suspexistis ad eum qui fecerat eam, <l eID="gen19463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19464"/>et operatorem ejus de longe non vidistis. <l eID="gen19464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8022"/><l level="1" sID="gen19465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8022"/>Et vocabit Dominus Deus exercituum <l eID="gen19465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19466"/>in die illa <l eID="gen19466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19467"/>ad fletum, et ad planctum, <l eID="gen19467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19468"/>ad calvitium, et ad cingulum sacci ; <l eID="gen19468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8023"/><l level="1" sID="gen19469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8023"/>et ecce gaudium et lætitia, <l eID="gen19469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19470"/>occidere vitulos et jugulare arietes, <l eID="gen19470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19471"/>comedere carnes, et bibere vinum : <l eID="gen19471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19472"/>comedamus et bibamus, <l eID="gen19472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19473"/>cras enim moriemur. <l eID="gen19473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8024"/><l level="1" sID="gen19474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8024"/>Et revelata est in auribus meis vox Domini exercituum : <l eID="gen19474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19475"/>Si dimittetur iniquitas hæc vobis donec moriamini, <l eID="gen19475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19476"/>dicit Dominus Deus exercituum. <l eID="gen19476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8025"/><l level="1" sID="gen19477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8025"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : <l eID="gen19477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19478"/>Vade, ingredere ad eum qui habitat in tabernaculo, <l eID="gen19478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19479"/>ad Sobnam, præpositum templi, et dices ad eum : <l eID="gen19479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8026"/><l level="1" sID="gen19480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8026"/>Quid tu hic, aut quasi quis hic ? <l eID="gen19480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19481"/>quia excidisti tibi hic sepulchrum, <l eID="gen19481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19482"/>excidisti in excelso memoriale diligenter, <l eID="gen19482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19483"/>in petra tabernaculum tibi. <l eID="gen19483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8027"/><l level="1" sID="gen19484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8027"/>Ecce Dominus asportari te faciet, <l eID="gen19484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19485"/>sicut asportatur gallus gallinaceus ; <l eID="gen19485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19486"/>et quasi amictum, sic sublevabit te. <l eID="gen19486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8028"/><l level="1" sID="gen19487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8028"/>Coronas coronabit te tribulatione ; <l eID="gen19487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19488"/>quasi pilam mittet te in terram latam et spatiosam ; <l eID="gen19488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19489"/>ibi morieris, et ibi erit currus gloriæ tuæ, <l eID="gen19489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19490"/>ignominia domus domini tui. <l eID="gen19490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8029"/><l level="1" sID="gen19491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8029"/>Et expellam te de statione tua, <l eID="gen19491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19492"/>et de ministerio tuo deponam te. <l eID="gen19492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8030"/><l level="1" sID="gen19493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8030"/>Et erit in die illa : <l eID="gen19493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19494"/>vocabo servum meum Eliacim, filium Helciæ, <l eID="gen19494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8031"/><l level="1" sID="gen19495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8031"/>et induam illum tunica tua, <l eID="gen19495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19496"/>et cingulo tuo confortabo eum, <l eID="gen19496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19497"/>et potestatem tuam dabo in manu ejus ; <l eID="gen19497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19498"/>et erit quasi pater habitantibus Jerusalem <l eID="gen19498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19499"/>et domui Juda. <l eID="gen19499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8032"/><l level="1" sID="gen19500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8032"/>Et dabo clavem domus David <l eID="gen19500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19501"/>super humerum ejus ; <l eID="gen19501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19502"/>et aperiet, et non erit qui claudat ; <l eID="gen19502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19503"/>et claudet, et non erit qui aperiat. <l eID="gen19503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8033"/><l level="1" sID="gen19504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8033"/>Et figam illum paxillum in loco fideli, <l eID="gen19504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19505"/>et erit in solium gloriæ domui patris ejus. <l eID="gen19505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8034"/><l level="1" sID="gen19506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8034"/>Et suspendent super eum omnem gloriam domus patris ejus ; <l eID="gen19506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19507"/>vasorum diversa genera, <l eID="gen19507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19508"/>omne vas parvulum, <l eID="gen19508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19509"/>a vasis craterarum usque ad omne vas musicorum. <l eID="gen19509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8035"/><l level="1" sID="gen19510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8035"/>In die illa, dicit Dominus exercituum, <l eID="gen19510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19511"/>auferetur paxillus qui fixus fuerat in loco fideli, <l eID="gen19511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19512"/>et frangetur, et cadet, <l eID="gen19512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19513"/>et peribit quod pependerat in eo, <l eID="gen19513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19514"/>quia Dominus locutus est. <l eID="gen19514" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19427"/> <chapter eID="Isa.22"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:1
verses.text: Onus Tyri. <div eID="gen19515" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen19516"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19517"/>Ululate, naves maris, <l eID="gen19517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19518"/>quia vastata est domus <l eID="gen19518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19519"/>unde venire consueverant : <l eID="gen19519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19520"/>de terra Cethim <l eID="gen19520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19521"/>revelatum est eis. <l eID="gen19521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8036"/><l level="1" sID="gen19522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8036"/>Tacete, qui habitatis in insula ; <l eID="gen19522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19523"/>negotiatores Sidonis, transfretantes mare, repleverunt te. <l eID="gen19523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8037"/><l level="1" sID="gen19524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8037"/>In aquis multis semen Nili ; <l eID="gen19524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19525"/>messis fluminis fruges ejus : <l eID="gen19525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19526"/>et facta est negotiatio gentium. <l eID="gen19526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8038"/><l level="1" sID="gen19527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8038"/>Erubesce, Sidon ; ait enim mare, <l eID="gen19527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19528"/>fortitudo maris, dicens : <l eID="gen19528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19529"/>Non parturivi, et non peperi, <l eID="gen19529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19530"/>et non enutrivi juvenes, <l eID="gen19530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19531"/>nec ad incrementum perduxi virgines. <l eID="gen19531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8039"/><l level="1" sID="gen19532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8039"/>Cum auditum fuerit in Ægypto, <l eID="gen19532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19533"/>dolebunt cum audierint de Tiro. <l eID="gen19533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8040"/><l level="1" sID="gen19534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8040"/>Transite maria, ululate, <l eID="gen19534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19535"/>qui habitatis in insula ! <l eID="gen19535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8041"/><l level="1" sID="gen19536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8041"/>Numquid non vestra hæc est, quæ gloriabatur <l eID="gen19536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19537"/>a diebus pristinis in antiquitate sua ? <l eID="gen19537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19538"/>Ducent eam pedes sui <l eID="gen19538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19539"/>longe ad peregrinandum. <l eID="gen19539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8042"/><l level="1" sID="gen19540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8042"/>Quis cogitavit hoc <l eID="gen19540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19541"/>super Tyrum quondam coronatam, <l eID="gen19541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19542"/>cujus negotiatores principes, <l eID="gen19542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19543"/>institores ejus inclyti terræ ? <l eID="gen19543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8043"/><l level="1" sID="gen19544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8043"/>Dominus exercituum cogitavit hoc, <l eID="gen19544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19545"/>ut detraheret superbiam omnis gloriæ, <l eID="gen19545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19546"/>et ad ignominiam deduceret universos inclytos terræ. <l eID="gen19546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8044"/><l level="1" sID="gen19547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8044"/>Transi terram tuam quasi flumen, filia maris ! <l eID="gen19547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19548"/>non est cingulum ultra tibi. <l eID="gen19548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8045"/><l level="1" sID="gen19549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8045"/>Manum suam extendit super mare ; <l eID="gen19549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19550"/>conturbavit regna. <l eID="gen19550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19551"/>Dominus mandavit adversus Chanaan, <l eID="gen19551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19552"/>ut contereret fortes ejus ; <l eID="gen19552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8046"/><l level="1" sID="gen19553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8046"/>et dixit : Non adjicies ultra ut glorieris, <l eID="gen19553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19554"/>calumniam sustinens virgo filia Sidonis : <l eID="gen19554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19555"/>in Cethim consurgens transfreta : <l eID="gen19555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19556"/>ibi quoque non erit requies tibi. <l eID="gen19556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8047"/><l level="1" sID="gen19557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8047"/>Ecce terra Chaldæorum, talis populus non fuit : <l eID="gen19557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19558"/>Assur fundavit eam ; <l eID="gen19558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19559"/>in captivitatem traduxerunt robustos ejus, <l eID="gen19559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19560"/>suffoderunt domos ejus, <l eID="gen19560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19561"/>posuerunt eam in ruinam. <l eID="gen19561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8048"/><l level="1" sID="gen19562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8048"/>Ululate, naves maris, <l eID="gen19562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19563"/>quia devastata est fortitudo vestra.

verses.name: Isaiah 23:15
verses.text: Et erit in die illa : in oblivione eris, o Tyre ! septuaginta annis, sicut dies regis unius ; post septuaginta autem annos erit Tyro quasi canticum meretricis : <l eID="gen19563" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8049"/><l level="1" sID="gen19564"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8049"/>Sume citharam, circui civitatem, <l eID="gen19564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19565"/>meretrix oblivioni tradita : <l eID="gen19565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19566"/>bene cane, frequenta canticum, <l eID="gen19566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19567"/>ut memoria tui sit. <l eID="gen19567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8050"/><l level="1" sID="gen19568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8050"/>Et erit post septuaginta annos : <l eID="gen19568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19569"/>visitabit Dominus Tyrum, <l eID="gen19569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19570"/>et reducet eam ad mercedes suas, <l eID="gen19570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19571"/>et rursum fornicabitur cum universis regnis terræ <l eID="gen19571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19572"/>super faciem terræ ; <l eID="gen19572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8051"/><l level="1" sID="gen19573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8051"/>et erunt negotiationes ejus et mercedes ejus sanctificatæ Domino : <l eID="gen19573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19574"/>non condentur neque reponentur, <l eID="gen19574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19575"/>quia his qui habitaverint coram Domino erit negotiatio ejus, <l eID="gen19575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19576"/>ut manducent in saturitatem, et vestiantur usque ad vetustatem.  <chapter eID="Isa.23"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:1
verses.text: Ecce Dominus dissipabit terram : <l eID="gen19577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19578"/>et nudabit eam, et affliget faciem ejus, <l eID="gen19578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19579"/>et disperget habitatores ejus. <l eID="gen19579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8052"/><l level="1" sID="gen19580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8052"/>Et erit sicut populus, sic sacerdos ; <l eID="gen19580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19581"/>et sicut servus, sic dominus ejus ; <l eID="gen19581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19582"/>sicut ancilla, sic domina ejus ; <l eID="gen19582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19583"/>sicut emens, sic ille qui vendit ; <l eID="gen19583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19584"/>sicut fœnerator, sic is qui mutuum accipit ; <l eID="gen19584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19585"/>sicut qui repetit, sic qui debet. <l eID="gen19585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8053"/><l level="1" sID="gen19586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8053"/>Dissipatione dissipabitur terra, et direptione prædabitur ; <l eID="gen19586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19587"/>Dominus enim locutus est verbum hoc. <l eID="gen19587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8054"/><l level="1" sID="gen19588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8054"/>Luxit, et defluxit terra, et infirmata est ; <l eID="gen19588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19589"/>defluxit orbis, <l eID="gen19589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19590"/>infirmata est altitudo populi terræ. <l eID="gen19590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8055"/><l level="1" sID="gen19591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8055"/>Et terra infecta est ab habitatoribus suis, <l eID="gen19591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19592"/>quia transgressi sunt leges, <l eID="gen19592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19593"/>mutaverunt jus, <l eID="gen19593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19594"/>dissipaverunt fœdus sempiternum. <l eID="gen19594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8056"/><l level="1" sID="gen19595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8056"/>Propter hoc maledictio vorabit terram, <l eID="gen19595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19596"/>et peccabunt habitatores ejus ; <l eID="gen19596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19597"/>ideoque insanient cultores ejus, <l eID="gen19597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19598"/>et relinquentur homines pauci. <l eID="gen19598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8057"/><l level="1" sID="gen19599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8057"/>Luxit vindemia, infirmata est vitis, <l eID="gen19599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19600"/>ingemuerunt omnes qui lætabantur corde ; <l eID="gen19600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8058"/><l level="1" sID="gen19601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8058"/>cessavit gaudium tympanorum, <l eID="gen19601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19602"/>quievit sonitus lætantium, <l eID="gen19602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19603"/>conticuit dulcedo citharæ. <l eID="gen19603" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8059"/><l level="1" sID="gen19604"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8059"/>Cum cantico non bibent vinum ; <l eID="gen19604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19605"/>amara erit potio bibentibus illam. <l eID="gen19605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8060"/><l level="1" sID="gen19606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8060"/>Attrita est civitas vanitatis, <l eID="gen19606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19607"/>clausa est omnis domus, nullo introëunte. <l eID="gen19607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8061"/><l level="1" sID="gen19608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8061"/>Clamor erit super vino in plateis, <l eID="gen19608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19609"/>deserta est omnia lætitia, <l eID="gen19609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19610"/>translatum est gaudium terræ. <l eID="gen19610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8062"/><l level="1" sID="gen19611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8062"/>Relicta est in urbe solitudo, <l eID="gen19611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19612"/>et calamitas opprimet portas. <l eID="gen19612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8063"/><l level="1" sID="gen19613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8063"/>Quia hæc erunt in medio terræ <l eID="gen19613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19614"/>in medio populorum, <l eID="gen19614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19615"/>quomodo si paucæ olivæ quæ remanserunt <l eID="gen19615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19616"/>excutiantur ex olea et racemi, <l eID="gen19616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19617"/>cum fuerit finita vindemia. <l eID="gen19617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8064"/><l level="1" sID="gen19618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8064"/>Hi levabunt vocem suam, atque laudabunt : <l eID="gen19618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19619"/>cum glorificatus fuerit Dominus, hinnient de mari. <l eID="gen19619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8065"/><l level="1" sID="gen19620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8065"/>Propter hoc in doctrinis glorificate Dominum ; <l eID="gen19620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19621"/>in insulis maris <l eID="gen19621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19622"/>nomen Domini Dei Israël. <l eID="gen19622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8066"/><l level="1" sID="gen19623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8066"/>A finibus terræ laudes audivimus, <l eID="gen19623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19624"/>gloriam Justi. <l eID="gen19624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19625"/>Et dixi : Secretum meum mihi, <l eID="gen19625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19626"/>secretum meum mihi. <l eID="gen19626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19627"/>Væ mihi ! <l eID="gen19627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19628"/>prævaricantes prævaricati sunt, <l eID="gen19628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19629"/>et prævaricatione transgressorum prævaricati sunt. <l eID="gen19629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8067"/><l level="1" sID="gen19630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8067"/>Formido, et fovea, et laqueus <l eID="gen19630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19631"/>super te, qui habitator es terræ. <l eID="gen19631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8068"/><l level="1" sID="gen19632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8068"/>Et erit : qui fugerit a voce formidinis cadet in foveam ; <l eID="gen19632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19633"/>et qui se explicaverit de fovea tenebitur laqueo ; <l eID="gen19633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19634"/>quia cataractæ de excelsis apertæ sunt <l eID="gen19634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19635"/>et concutientur fundamenta terræ. <l eID="gen19635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8069"/><l level="1" sID="gen19636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8069"/>Confractione confringetur terra, <l eID="gen19636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19637"/>contritione conteretur terra, <l eID="gen19637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19638"/>commotione commovebitur terra ; <l eID="gen19638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8070"/><l level="1" sID="gen19639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8070"/>agitatione agitabitur terra sicut ebrius, <l eID="gen19639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19640"/>et auferetur quasi tabernaculum unius noctis ; <l eID="gen19640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19641"/>et gravabit eam iniquitas sua, <l eID="gen19641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19642"/>et corruet, et non adjiciet ut resurgat. <l eID="gen19642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8071"/><l level="1" sID="gen19643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8071"/>Et erit : in die illa visitabit Dominus <l eID="gen19643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19644"/>super militiam cæli in excelso, <l eID="gen19644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19645"/>et super reges terræ qui sunt super terram ; <l eID="gen19645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8072"/><l level="1" sID="gen19646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8072"/>et congregabuntur in congregatione unius fascis in lacum, <l eID="gen19646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19647"/>et claudentur ibi in carcere, <l eID="gen19647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19648"/>et post multos dies visitabuntur. <l eID="gen19648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 24:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8073"/><l level="1" sID="gen19649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8073"/>Et erubescet luna, et confundetur sol, <l eID="gen19649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19650"/>cum regnaverit Dominus exercituum <l eID="gen19650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19651"/>in monte Sion et in Jerusalem <l eID="gen19651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19652"/>et in conspectu senum suorum fuerit glorificatus.  <chapter eID="Isa.24"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:1
verses.text: Domine, Deus meus es tu ; <l eID="gen19653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19654"/>exaltabo te, et confitebor nomini tuo : <l eID="gen19654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19655"/>quoniam fecisti mirabilia, <l eID="gen19655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19656"/>cogitationes antiquas fideles. Amen. <l eID="gen19656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8074"/><l level="1" sID="gen19657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8074"/>Quia posuisti civitatem in tumulum, <l eID="gen19657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19658"/>urbem fortem in ruinam, domum alienorum : <l eID="gen19658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19659"/>ut non sit civitas, <l eID="gen19659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19660"/>et in sempiternum non ædificetur. <l eID="gen19660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8075"/><l level="1" sID="gen19661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8075"/>Super hoc laudabit te populus fortis ; <l eID="gen19661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19662"/>civitas gentium robustarum timebit te : <l eID="gen19662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8076"/><l level="1" sID="gen19663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8076"/>quia factus es fortitudo pauperi, <l eID="gen19663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19664"/>fortitudo egeno in tribulatione sua, <l eID="gen19664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19665"/>spes a turbine, <l eID="gen19665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19666"/>umbraculum ab æstu ; <l eID="gen19666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19667"/>spiritus enim robustorum <l eID="gen19667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19668"/>quasi turbo impellens parietem. <l eID="gen19668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8077"/><l level="1" sID="gen19669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8077"/>Sicut æstus in siti, <l eID="gen19669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19670"/>tumultum alienorum humiliabis ; <l eID="gen19670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19671"/>et quasi calore sub nube torrente, <l eID="gen19671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19672"/>propaginem fortium marcescere facies. <l eID="gen19672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8078"/><l level="1" sID="gen19673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8078"/>Et faciet Dominus exercituum <l eID="gen19673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19674"/>omnibus populis in monte hoc <l eID="gen19674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19675"/>convivium pinguium, <l eID="gen19675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19676"/>convivium vindemiæ, <l eID="gen19676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19677"/>pinguium medullatorum, <l eID="gen19677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19678"/>vindemiæ defæcatæ. <l eID="gen19678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8079"/><l level="1" sID="gen19679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8079"/>Et præcipitabit in monte isto <l eID="gen19679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19680"/>faciem vinculi colligati super omnes populos, <l eID="gen19680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19681"/>et telam quam orditus est super omnes nationes. <l eID="gen19681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8080"/><l level="1" sID="gen19682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8080"/>Præcipitabit mortem in sempiternum ; <l eID="gen19682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19683"/>et auferet Dominus Deus <l eID="gen19683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19684"/>lacrimam ab omni facie, <l eID="gen19684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19685"/>et opprobrium populi sui auferet <l eID="gen19685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19686"/>de universa terra : <l eID="gen19686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19687"/>quia Dominus locutus est. <l eID="gen19687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8081"/><l level="1" sID="gen19688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8081"/>Et dicet in die illa : <l eID="gen19688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19689"/>Ecce Deus noster iste ; <l eID="gen19689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19690"/>exspectavimus eum, et salvabit nos ; <l eID="gen19690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19691"/>iste Dominus, sustinuimus eum : <l eID="gen19691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19692"/>exsultabimus, et lætabimur in salutari ejus. <l eID="gen19692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8082"/><l level="1" sID="gen19693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8082"/>Quia requiescet manus Domini <l eID="gen19693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19694"/>in monte isto ; <l eID="gen19694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19695"/>et triturabitur Moab sub eo, <l eID="gen19695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19696"/>sicuti teruntur paleæ in plaustro. <l eID="gen19696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8083"/><l level="1" sID="gen19697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8083"/>Et extendet manus suas sub eo <l eID="gen19697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19698"/>sicut extendit natans ad natandum ; <l eID="gen19698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19699"/>et humiliabit gloriam ejus <l eID="gen19699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19700"/>cum allisione manuum ejus. <l eID="gen19700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8084"/><l level="1" sID="gen19701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8084"/>Et munimenta sublimium murorum tuorum <l eID="gen19701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19702"/>concident, et humiliabuntur, <l eID="gen19702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19703"/>et detrahentur in terram usque ad pulverem.  <chapter eID="Isa.25"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:1
verses.text: In die illa cantabitur canticum istud in terra Juda : <l eID="gen19704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19705"/>Urbs fortitudinis nostræ Sion ; salvator ponetur in ea <l eID="gen19705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19706"/>murus et antemurale. <l eID="gen19706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8085"/><l level="1" sID="gen19707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8085"/>Aperite portas, et ingrediatur gens justa, <l eID="gen19707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19708"/>custodiens veritatem. <l eID="gen19708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8086"/><l level="1" sID="gen19709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8086"/>Vetus error abiit : servabis pacem ; <l eID="gen19709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19710"/>pacem, quia in te speravimus. <l eID="gen19710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8087"/><l level="1" sID="gen19711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8087"/>Sperastis in Domino in sæculis æternis ; <l eID="gen19711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19712"/>in Domino Deo forti in perpetuum. <l eID="gen19712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8088"/><l level="1" sID="gen19713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8088"/>Quia incurvabit habitantes in excelso ; <l eID="gen19713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19714"/>civitatem sublimem humiliabit : <l eID="gen19714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19715"/>humiliabit eam usque ad terram, <l eID="gen19715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19716"/>detrahet eam usque ad pulverem. <l eID="gen19716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8089"/><l level="1" sID="gen19717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8089"/>Conculcabit eam pes, <l eID="gen19717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19718"/>pedes pauperis, gressus egenorum. <l eID="gen19718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8090"/><l level="1" sID="gen19719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8090"/>Semita justi recta est, <l eID="gen19719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19720"/>rectus callis justi ad ambulandum. <l eID="gen19720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8091"/><l level="1" sID="gen19721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8091"/>Et in semita judiciorum tuorum, Domine, sustinuimus te : <l eID="gen19721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19722"/>nomen tuum et memoriale tuum in desiderio animæ. <l eID="gen19722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8092"/><l level="1" sID="gen19723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8092"/>Anima mea desideravit te in nocte, <l eID="gen19723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19724"/>sed et spiritu meo in præcordiis meis de mane vigilabo ad te. <l eID="gen19724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19725"/>Cum feceris judicia tua in terra, <l eID="gen19725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19726"/>justitiam discent habitatores orbis. <l eID="gen19726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8093"/><l level="1" sID="gen19727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8093"/>Misereamur impio, et non discet justitiam ; <l eID="gen19727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19728"/>in terra sanctorum iniqua gessit, <l eID="gen19728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19729"/>et non videbit gloriam Domini. <l eID="gen19729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8094"/><l level="1" sID="gen19730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8094"/>Domine, exaltetur manus tua, et non videant ; <l eID="gen19730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19731"/>videant, et confundantur zelantes populi ; <l eID="gen19731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19732"/>et ignis hostes tuos devoret. <l eID="gen19732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8095"/><l level="1" sID="gen19733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8095"/>Domine, dabis pacem nobis : <l eID="gen19733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19734"/>omnia enim opera nostra <l eID="gen19734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19735"/>operatus es nobis. <l eID="gen19735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8096"/><l level="1" sID="gen19736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8096"/>Domine Deus noster, possederunt nos <l eID="gen19736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19737"/>domini absque te ; <l eID="gen19737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19738"/>tantum in te recordemur nominis tui. <l eID="gen19738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8097"/><l level="1" sID="gen19739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8097"/>Morientes non vivant, <l eID="gen19739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19740"/>gigantes non resurgant : <l eID="gen19740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19741"/>propterea visitasti et contrivisti eos, <l eID="gen19741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19742"/>et perdidisti omnem memoriam eorum. <l eID="gen19742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8098"/><l level="1" sID="gen19743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8098"/>Indulsisti genti, Domine, <l eID="gen19743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19744"/>indulsisti genti, numquid glorificatus es ? <l eID="gen19744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19745"/>elongasti omnes terminos terræ. <l eID="gen19745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8099"/><l level="1" sID="gen19746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8099"/>Domine, in angustia requisierunt te, <l eID="gen19746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19747"/>in tribulatione murmuris doctrina tua eis. <l eID="gen19747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8100"/><l level="1" sID="gen19748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8100"/>Sicut quæ concipit, cum appropinquaverit ad partum, <l eID="gen19748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19749"/>dolens clamat in doloribus suis, <l eID="gen19749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19750"/>sic facti sumus a facie tua, Domine. <l eID="gen19750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8101"/><l level="1" sID="gen19751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8101"/>Concepimus, et quasi parturivimus, <l eID="gen19751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19752"/>et peperimus spiritum. <l eID="gen19752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19753"/>Salutes non fecimus in terra ; <l eID="gen19753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19754"/>ideo non ceciderunt habitatores terræ. <l eID="gen19754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8102"/><l level="1" sID="gen19755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8102"/>Vivent mortui tui, <l eID="gen19755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19756"/>interfecti mei resurgent. <l eID="gen19756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19757"/>Expergiscimini, et laudate, <l eID="gen19757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19758"/>qui habitatis in pulvere, <l eID="gen19758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19759"/>quia ros lucis ros tuus, <l eID="gen19759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19760"/>et terram gigantum detrahes in ruinam. <l eID="gen19760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8103"/><l level="1" sID="gen19761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8103"/>Vade, populus meus, intra in cubicula tua ; <l eID="gen19761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19762"/>claude ostia tua super te, <l eID="gen19762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19763"/>abscondere modicum ad momentum, <l eID="gen19763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19764"/>donec pertranseat indignatio. <l eID="gen19764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 26:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8104"/><l level="1" sID="gen19765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8104"/>Ecce enim Dominus egredietur de loco suo, <l eID="gen19765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19766"/>ut visitet iniquitatem habitatoris terræ contra eum ; <l eID="gen19766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19767"/>et revelabit terra sanguinem suum, et non operiet ultra interfectos suos.  <chapter eID="Isa.26"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:1
verses.text: In die illa visitabit Dominus <l eID="gen19768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19769"/>in gladio suo duro, et grandi, et forti, <l eID="gen19769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19770"/>super Leviathan, serpentem vectem, <l eID="gen19770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19771"/>et super Leviathan, serpentem tortuosum, <l eID="gen19771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19772"/>et occidet cetum qui in mari est. <l eID="gen19772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8105"/><l level="1" sID="gen19773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8105"/>In die illa vinea meri cantabit ei. <l eID="gen19773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8106"/><l level="1" sID="gen19774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8106"/>Ego Dominus qui servo eam ; <l eID="gen19774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19775"/>repente propinabo ei. <l eID="gen19775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19776"/>Ne forte visitetur contra eam, <l eID="gen19776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19777"/>nocte et die servo eam. <l eID="gen19777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8107"/><l level="1" sID="gen19778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8107"/>Indignatio non est mihi. <l eID="gen19778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19779"/>Quis dabit me spinam et veprem in prælio ? <l eID="gen19779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19780"/>gradiar super eam, <l eID="gen19780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19781"/>succendam eam pariter. <l eID="gen19781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8108"/><l level="1" sID="gen19782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8108"/>An potius tenebit fortitudinem meam ? <l eID="gen19782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19783"/>faciet pacem mihi, <l eID="gen19783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19784"/>pacem faciet mihi. <l eID="gen19784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8109"/><l level="1" sID="gen19785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8109"/>Qui ingrediuntur impetu ad Jacob, <l eID="gen19785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19786"/>florebit et germinabit Israël, <l eID="gen19786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19787"/>et implebunt faciem orbis semine. <l eID="gen19787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8110"/><l level="1" sID="gen19788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8110"/>Numquid juxta plagam percutientis se percussit eum ? <l eID="gen19788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19789"/>aut sicut occidit interfectos ejus, sic occisus est ? <l eID="gen19789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:8
