verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8111"/><l level="1" sID="gen19790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8111"/>In mensura contra mensuram, <l eID="gen19790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19791"/>cum abjecta fuerit, judicabis eam ; <l eID="gen19791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19792"/>meditatus est in spiritu suo duro <l eID="gen19792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19793"/>per diem æstus. <l eID="gen19793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8112"/><l level="1" sID="gen19794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8112"/>Idcirco super hoc dimittetur iniquitas domui Jacob ; <l eID="gen19794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19795"/>et iste omnis fructus : ut auferatur peccatum ejus, <l eID="gen19795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19796"/>cum posuerit omnes lapides altaris <l eID="gen19796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19797"/>sicut lapides cineris allisos : <l eID="gen19797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19798"/>non stabunt luci et delubra. <l eID="gen19798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8113"/><l level="1" sID="gen19799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8113"/>Civitas enim munita desolata erit ; <l eID="gen19799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19800"/>speciosa relinquetur, et dimittetur quasi desertum ; <l eID="gen19800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19801"/>ibi pascetur vitulus, <l eID="gen19801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19802"/>et ibi accubabit, et consumet summitates ejus. <l eID="gen19802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8114"/><l level="1" sID="gen19803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8114"/>In siccitate messes illius conterentur. <l eID="gen19803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19804"/>Mulieres venientes, et docentes eam ; <l eID="gen19804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19805"/>non est enim populus sapiens : <l eID="gen19805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19806"/>propterea non miserebitur ejus qui fecit eum, <l eID="gen19806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19807"/>et qui formavit eum non parcet ei. <l eID="gen19807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8115"/><l level="1" sID="gen19808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8115"/>Et erit : in die illa <l eID="gen19808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19809"/>percutiet Dominus <l eID="gen19809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19810"/>ab alveo fluminis usque ad torrentem Ægypti ; <l eID="gen19810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19811"/>et vos congregabimini unus et unus, filii Israël. <l eID="gen19811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8116"/><l level="1" sID="gen19812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8116"/>Et erit : in die illa clangetur in tuba magna ; <l eID="gen19812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19813"/>et venient qui perditi fuerant de terra Assyriorum, <l eID="gen19813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19814"/>et qui ejecti erant in terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen19814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19815"/>et adorabunt Dominum <l eID="gen19815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19816"/>in monte sancto in Jerusalem.  <chapter eID="Isa.27"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:1
verses.text: Væ coronæ superbiæ, ebriis Ephraim, <l eID="gen19817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19818"/>et flori decidenti, gloriæ exsultationis ejus, <l eID="gen19818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19819"/>qui erant in vertice vallis pinguissimæ, <l eID="gen19819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19820"/>errantes a vino. <l eID="gen19820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8117"/><l level="1" sID="gen19821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8117"/>Ecce validus et fortis Dominus <l eID="gen19821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19822"/>sicut impetus grandinis ; turbo confringens, <l eID="gen19822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19823"/>sicut impetus aquarum multarum inundantium <l eID="gen19823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19824"/>et emissarum super terram spatiosam. <l eID="gen19824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8118"/><l level="1" sID="gen19825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8118"/>Pedibus conculcabitur <l eID="gen19825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19826"/>corona superbiæ ebriorum Ephraim. <l eID="gen19826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8119"/><l level="1" sID="gen19827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8119"/>Et erit flos decidens gloriæ exsultationis ejus, <l eID="gen19827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19828"/>qui est super verticem vallis pinguium, <l eID="gen19828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19829"/>quasi temporaneum ante maturitatem autumni, <l eID="gen19829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19830"/>quod, cum aspexerit videns, <l eID="gen19830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19831"/>statim ut manu tenuerit, devorabit illud. <l eID="gen19831" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8120"/><l level="1" sID="gen19832"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8120"/>In die illa erit Dominus exercituum corona gloriæ, <l eID="gen19832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19833"/>et sertum exsultationis residuo populi sui ; <l eID="gen19833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8121"/><l level="1" sID="gen19834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8121"/>et spiritus judicii sedenti super judicium, <l eID="gen19834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19835"/>et fortitudo revertentibus de bello ad portam. <l eID="gen19835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8122"/><l level="1" sID="gen19836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8122"/>Verum hi quoque præ vino nescierunt, et præ ebrietate erraverunt ; <l eID="gen19836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19837"/>sacerdos et propheta nescierunt præ ebrietate ; <l eID="gen19837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19838"/>absorpti sunt a vino, erraverunt in ebrietate, <l eID="gen19838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19839"/>nescierunt videntem, ignoraverunt judicium. <l eID="gen19839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8123"/><l level="1" sID="gen19840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8123"/>Omnes enim mensæ repletæ sunt vomitu sordiumque, <l eID="gen19840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19841"/>ita ut non esset ultra locus. <l eID="gen19841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8124"/><l level="1" sID="gen19842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8124"/>Quem docebit scientiam ? <l eID="gen19842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19843"/>et quem intelligere faciet auditum ? <l eID="gen19843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19844"/>Ablactatos a lacte, <l eID="gen19844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19845"/>avulsos ab uberibus. <l eID="gen19845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8125"/><l level="1" sID="gen19846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8125"/>Quia manda, remanda ; manda, remanda ; <l eID="gen19846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19847"/>exspecta, reexspecta ; exspecta, reexspecta ; <l eID="gen19847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19848"/>modicum ibi, modicum ibi. <l eID="gen19848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8126"/><l level="1" sID="gen19849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8126"/>In loquela enim labii, <l eID="gen19849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19850"/>et lingua altera <l eID="gen19850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19851"/>loquetur ad populum istum. <l eID="gen19851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8127"/><l level="1" sID="gen19852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8127"/>Cui dixit : Hæc est requies mea, <l eID="gen19852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19853"/>reficite lassum ; <l eID="gen19853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19854"/>et hoc est meum refrigerium : <l eID="gen19854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19855"/>et noluerunt audire. <l eID="gen19855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8128"/><l level="1" sID="gen19856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8128"/>Et erit eis verbum Domini : <l eID="gen19856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19857"/>Manda, remanda ; manda, remanda ; <l eID="gen19857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19858"/>exspecta, reexspecta ; exspecta, reexspecta ; <l eID="gen19858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19859"/>modicum ibi, modicum ibi ; <l eID="gen19859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19860"/>ut vadant, et cadant retrorsum, <l eID="gen19860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19861"/>et conterantur, et illaqueentur, et capiantur. <l eID="gen19861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8129"/><l level="1" sID="gen19862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8129"/>Propter hoc audite verbum Domini, viri illusores, <l eID="gen19862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19863"/>qui dominamini super populum meum, qui est in Jerusalem. <l eID="gen19863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8130"/><l level="1" sID="gen19864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8130"/>Dixistis enim : Percussimus fœdus cum morte, <l eID="gen19864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19865"/>et cum inferno fecimus pactum : <l eID="gen19865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19866"/>flagellum inundans cum transierit, non veniet super nos <l eID="gen19866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19867"/>quia posuimus mendacium spem nostram, <l eID="gen19867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19868"/>et mendacio protecti sumus. <l eID="gen19868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8131"/><l level="1" sID="gen19869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8131"/>Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen19869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19870"/>Ecce ego mittam in fundamentis Sion lapidem, <l eID="gen19870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19871"/>lapidem probatum, <l eID="gen19871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19872"/>angularem, pretiosum, in fundamento fundatum ; <l eID="gen19872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19873"/>qui crediderit, non festinet. <l eID="gen19873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8132"/><l level="1" sID="gen19874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8132"/>Et ponam in pondere judicium, <l eID="gen19874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19875"/>et justitiam in mensura ; <l eID="gen19875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19876"/>et subvertet grando spem mendacii, <l eID="gen19876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19877"/>et protectionem aquæ inundabunt. <l eID="gen19877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8133"/><l level="1" sID="gen19878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8133"/>Et delebitur fœdus vestrum cum morte, <l eID="gen19878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19879"/>et pactum vestrum cum inferno non stabit : <l eID="gen19879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19880"/>flagellum inundans cum transierit, eritis ei in conculcationem. <l eID="gen19880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8134"/><l level="1" sID="gen19881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8134"/>Quandocumque pertransierit, tollet vos, <l eID="gen19881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19882"/>quoniam in mane diluculo pertransibit in die et in nocte ; <l eID="gen19882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19883"/>et tantummodo sola vexatio intellectum dabit auditui. <l eID="gen19883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8135"/><l level="1" sID="gen19884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8135"/>Coangustatum est enim stratum, ita ut alter decidat ; <l eID="gen19884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19885"/>et pallium breve utrumque operire non potest. <l eID="gen19885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8136"/><l level="1" sID="gen19886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8136"/>Sicut enim in monte divisionum stabit Dominus ; <l eID="gen19886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19887"/>sicut in valle quæ est in Gabaon irascetur, <l eID="gen19887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19888"/>ut faciat opus suum, alienum opus ejus : <l eID="gen19888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19889"/>ut operetur opus suum, peregrinum est opus ejus ab eo. <l eID="gen19889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8137"/><l level="1" sID="gen19890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8137"/>Et nunc nolite illudere, <l eID="gen19890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19891"/>ne forte constringantur vincula vestra ; <l eID="gen19891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19892"/>consummationem enim et abbreviationem audivi <l eID="gen19892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19893"/>a Domino Deo exercituum, super universam terram. <l eID="gen19893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8138"/><l level="1" sID="gen19894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8138"/>Auribus percipite, et audite vocem meam : <l eID="gen19894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19895"/>attendite, et audite eloquium meum. <l eID="gen19895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8139"/><l level="1" sID="gen19896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8139"/>Numquid tota die arabit arans ut serat ? <l eID="gen19896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19897"/>proscindet et sarriet humum suam ? <l eID="gen19897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8140"/><l level="1" sID="gen19898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8140"/>Nonne cum adæquaverit faciem ejus, <l eID="gen19898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19899"/>seret gith et cyminum sparget ? <l eID="gen19899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19900"/>et ponet triticum per ordinem, et hordeum, <l eID="gen19900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19901"/>et milium, et viciam in finibus suis ? <l eID="gen19901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8141"/><l level="1" sID="gen19902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8141"/>Et erudiet illum in judicio ; <l eID="gen19902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19903"/>Deus suus docebit illum. <l eID="gen19903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8142"/><l level="1" sID="gen19904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8142"/>Non enim in serris triturabitur gith, <l eID="gen19904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19905"/>nec rota plaustri super cyminum circuibit ; <l eID="gen19905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19906"/>sed in virga excutietur gith, <l eID="gen19906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19907"/>et cyminum in baculo. <l eID="gen19907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8143"/><l level="1" sID="gen19908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8143"/>Panis autem comminuetur ; <l eID="gen19908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19909"/>verum non in perpetuum triturans triturabit illum, <l eID="gen19909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19910"/>neque vexabit eum rota plaustri, <l eID="gen19910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19911"/>neque ungulis suis comminuet eum. <l eID="gen19911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 28:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8144"/><l level="1" sID="gen19912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8144"/>Et hoc a Domino Deo exercituum exivit, <l eID="gen19912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19913"/>ut mirabile faceret consilium, et magnificaret justitiam.  <chapter eID="Isa.28"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:1
verses.text: Væ Ariel, Ariel <l eID="gen19914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19915"/>civitas, quam expugnavit David ! <l eID="gen19915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19916"/>additus est annus ad annum : <l eID="gen19916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19917"/>solemnitates evolutæ sunt. <l eID="gen19917" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8145"/><l level="1" sID="gen19918"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8145"/>Et circumvallabo Ariel, <l eID="gen19918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19919"/>et erit tristis et mœrens, <l eID="gen19919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19920"/>et erit mihi quasi Ariel. <l eID="gen19920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8146"/><l level="1" sID="gen19921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8146"/>Et circumdabo quasi sphæram in circuitu tuo, <l eID="gen19921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19922"/>et jaciam contra te aggerem, <l eID="gen19922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19923"/>et munimenta ponam in obsidionem tuam. <l eID="gen19923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8147"/><l level="1" sID="gen19924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8147"/>Humiliaberis, de terra loqueris, <l eID="gen19924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19925"/>et de humo audietur eloquium tuum ; <l eID="gen19925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19926"/>et erit quasi pythonis de terra vox tua, <l eID="gen19926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19927"/>et de humo eloquium tuum mussitabit. <l eID="gen19927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8148"/><l level="1" sID="gen19928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8148"/>Et erit sicut pulvis tenuis multitudo ventilantium te, <l eID="gen19928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19929"/>et sicut favilla pertransiens multitudo eorum qui contra te prævaluerunt ; <l eID="gen19929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8149"/><l level="1" sID="gen19930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8149"/>eritque repente confestim. <l eID="gen19930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19931"/>A Domino exercituum visitabitur <l eID="gen19931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19932"/>in tonitruo, et commotione terræ, et voce magna <l eID="gen19932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19933"/>turbinis et tempestatis, et flammæ ignis devorantis. <l eID="gen19933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8150"/><l level="1" sID="gen19934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8150"/>Et erit sicut somnium visionis nocturnæ <l eID="gen19934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19935"/>multitudo omnium gentium quæ dimicaverunt contra Ariel, <l eID="gen19935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19936"/>et omnes qui militaverunt, et obsederunt, <l eID="gen19936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19937"/>et prævaluerunt adversus eam. <l eID="gen19937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8151"/><l level="1" sID="gen19938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8151"/>Et sicut somniat esuriens, et comedit, <l eID="gen19938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19939"/>cum autem fuerit expergefactus, vacua est anima ejus ; <l eID="gen19939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19940"/>et sicut somniat sitiens et bibit, <l eID="gen19940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19941"/>et postquam fuerit expergefactus, lassus adhuc sitit, <l eID="gen19941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19942"/>et anima ejus vacua est : <l eID="gen19942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19943"/>sic erit multitudo omnium gentium <l eID="gen19943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19944"/>quæ dimicaverunt contra montem Sion. <l eID="gen19944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8152"/><l level="1" sID="gen19945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8152"/>Obstupescite et admiramini ; <l eID="gen19945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19946"/>fluctuate et vacillate ; <l eID="gen19946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19947"/>inebriamini, et non a vino ; <l eID="gen19947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19948"/>movemini, et non ab ebrietate. <l eID="gen19948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8153"/><l level="1" sID="gen19949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8153"/>Quoniam miscuit vobis Dominus <l eID="gen19949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19950"/>spiritum soporis ; claudet oculos vestros : <l eID="gen19950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19951"/>prophetas et principes vestros, qui vident visiones, operiet. <l eID="gen19951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8154"/><l level="1" sID="gen19952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8154"/>Et erit vobis visio omnium <l eID="gen19952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19953"/>sicut verba libri signati, <l eID="gen19953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19954"/>quem cum dederint scienti litteras, <l eID="gen19954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19955"/>dicent : Lege istum : <l eID="gen19955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19956"/>et respondebit : Non possum, signatus est enim. <l eID="gen19956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8155"/><l level="1" sID="gen19957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8155"/>Et dabitur liber nescienti litteras, <l eID="gen19957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19958"/>diceturque ei : Lege ; <l eID="gen19958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19959"/>et respondebit : Nescio litteras. <l eID="gen19959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8156"/><l level="1" sID="gen19960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8156"/>Et dixit Dominus : Eo quod appropinquat populus iste ore suo, <l eID="gen19960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19961"/>et labiis suis glorificat me, <l eID="gen19961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19962"/>cor autem ejus longe est a me, <l eID="gen19962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19963"/>et timuerunt me mandato hominum et doctrinis, <l eID="gen19963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8157"/><l level="1" sID="gen19964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8157"/>ideo ecce ego addam ut admirationem faciam <l eID="gen19964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19965"/>populo huic miraculo grandi et stupendo ; <l eID="gen19965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19966"/>peribit enim sapientia a sapientibus ejus, <l eID="gen19966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19967"/>et intellectus prudentium ejus abscondetur. <l eID="gen19967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8158"/><l level="1" sID="gen19968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8158"/>Væ qui profundi estis corde, <l eID="gen19968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19969"/>ut a Domino abscondatis consilium ; <l eID="gen19969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19970"/>quorum sunt in tenebris opera, <l eID="gen19970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19971"/>et dicunt : Quis videt nos ? <l eID="gen19971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19972"/>et quis novit nos ? <l eID="gen19972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8159"/><l level="1" sID="gen19973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8159"/>Perversa est hæc vestra cogitatio ; <l eID="gen19973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19974"/>quasi si lutum contra figulum cogitet, <l eID="gen19974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19975"/>et dicat opus factori suo : Non fecisti me ; <l eID="gen19975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19976"/>et figmentum dicat fictori suo : Non intelligis. <l eID="gen19976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8160"/><l level="1" sID="gen19977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8160"/>Nonne adhuc in modico et in brevi <l eID="gen19977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19978"/>convertetur Libanus in carmel, <l eID="gen19978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19979"/>et carmel in saltum reputabitur ? <l eID="gen19979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8161"/><l level="1" sID="gen19980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8161"/>Et audient in die illa surdi verba libri, <l eID="gen19980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19981"/>et de tenebris et caligine oculi cæcorum videbunt. <l eID="gen19981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8162"/><l level="1" sID="gen19982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8162"/>Et addent mites in Domino lætitiam, <l eID="gen19982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19983"/>et pauperes homines in Sancto Israël exsultabunt ; <l eID="gen19983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8163"/><l level="1" sID="gen19984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8163"/>quoniam defecit qui prævalebat, consummatus est illusor, <l eID="gen19984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19985"/>et succisi sunt omnes qui vigilabant super iniquitatem, <l eID="gen19985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8164"/><l level="1" sID="gen19986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8164"/>qui peccare faciebant homines in verbo, <l eID="gen19986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19987"/>et arguentem in porta supplantabant, <l eID="gen19987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19988"/>et declinaverunt frustra a justo. <l eID="gen19988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8165"/><l level="1" sID="gen19989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8165"/>Propter hoc, hæc dicit Dominus ad domum Jacob, <l eID="gen19989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19990"/>qui redemit Abraham : <l eID="gen19990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19991"/>Non modo confundetur Jacob, <l eID="gen19991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19992"/>nec modo vultus ejus erubescet ; <l eID="gen19992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8166"/><l level="1" sID="gen19993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8166"/>sed cum viderit filios suos, <l eID="gen19993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19994"/>opera manuum mearum in medio sui <l eID="gen19994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19995"/>sanctificantes nomen meum, <l eID="gen19995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19996"/>et sanctificabunt Sanctum Jacob, <l eID="gen19996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19997"/>et Deum Israël prædicabunt ; <l eID="gen19997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 29:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8167"/><l level="1" sID="gen19998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8167"/>et scient errantes spiritu intellectum, <l eID="gen19998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen19999"/>et mussitatores discent legem.  <chapter eID="Isa.29"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:1
verses.text: Væ filii desertores, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen20000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20001"/>ut faceretis consilium, et non ex me, <l eID="gen20001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20002"/>et ordiremini telam, et non per spiritum meum, <l eID="gen20002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20003"/>ut adderetis peccatum super peccatum ; <l eID="gen20003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8168"/><l level="1" sID="gen20004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8168"/>qui ambulatis ut descendatis in Ægyptum, <l eID="gen20004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20005"/>et os meum non interrogastis, <l eID="gen20005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20006"/>sperantes auxilium in fortitudine Pharaonis, <l eID="gen20006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20007"/>et habentes fiduciam in umbra Ægypti ! <l eID="gen20007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8169"/><l level="1" sID="gen20008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8169"/>Et erit vobis fortitudo Pharaonis in confusionem, <l eID="gen20008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20009"/>et fiducia umbræ Ægypti in ignominiam. <l eID="gen20009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8170"/><l level="1" sID="gen20010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8170"/>Erant enim in Tani principes tui, <l eID="gen20010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20011"/>et nuntii tui usque ad Hanes pervenerunt. <l eID="gen20011" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8171"/><l level="1" sID="gen20012"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8171"/>Omnes confusi sunt super populo qui eis prodesse non potuit : <l eID="gen20012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20013"/>non fuerunt in auxilium et in aliquam utilitatem, <l eID="gen20013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20014"/>sed in confusionem et in opprobrium.

verses.name: Isaiah 30:6
verses.text: Onus jumentorum austri. <l eID="gen20014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20015"/>In terra tribulationis et angustiæ <l eID="gen20015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20016"/>leæna, et leo ex eis, <l eID="gen20016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20017"/>vipera et regulus volans ; <l eID="gen20017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20018"/>portantes super humeros jumentorum divitias suas, <l eID="gen20018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20019"/>et super gibbum camelorum thesauros suos, <l eID="gen20019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20020"/>ad populum qui eis prodesse non poterit. <l eID="gen20020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8172"/><l level="1" sID="gen20021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8172"/>Ægyptus enim frustra et vane auxiliabitur. <l eID="gen20021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20022"/>Ideo clamavi super hoc : Superbia tantum est, quiesce. <l eID="gen20022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8173"/><l level="1" sID="gen20023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8173"/>Nunc ergo ingressus, scribe ei super buxum, <l eID="gen20023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20024"/>et in libro diligenter exara illud, <l eID="gen20024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20025"/>et erit in die novissimo <l eID="gen20025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20026"/>in testimonium usque in æternum. <l eID="gen20026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8174"/><l level="1" sID="gen20027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8174"/>Populus enim ad iracundiam provocans est : <l eID="gen20027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20028"/>et filii mendaces, <l eID="gen20028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20029"/>filii nolentes <l eID="gen20029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20030"/>audire legem Dei ; <l eID="gen20030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8175"/><l level="1" sID="gen20031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8175"/>qui dicunt videntibus : Nolite videre, <l eID="gen20031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20032"/>et aspicientibus : Nolite aspicere nobis ea quæ recta sunt ; <l eID="gen20032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20033"/>loquimini nobis placentia : <l eID="gen20033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20034"/>videte nobis errores. <l eID="gen20034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8176"/><l level="1" sID="gen20035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8176"/>Auferte a me viam ; <l eID="gen20035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20036"/>declinate a me semitam ; <l eID="gen20036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20037"/>cesset a facie nostra <l eID="gen20037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20038"/>Sanctus Israël. <l eID="gen20038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8177"/><l level="1" sID="gen20039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8177"/>Propterea hæc dicit Sanctus Israël : Pro eo quod reprobastis verbum hoc, <l eID="gen20039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20040"/>et sperastis in calumnia et in tumultu, <l eID="gen20040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20041"/>et innixi estis super eo ; <l eID="gen20041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8178"/><l level="1" sID="gen20042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8178"/>propterea erit vobis iniquitas hæc <l eID="gen20042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20043"/>sicut interruptio cadens, <l eID="gen20043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20044"/>et requisita in muro excelso, <l eID="gen20044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20045"/>quoniam subito, dum non speratur, veniet contritio ejus. <l eID="gen20045" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8179"/><l level="1" sID="gen20046"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8179"/>Et comminuetur sicut conteritur lagena figuli <l eID="gen20046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20047"/>contritione pervalida, <l eID="gen20047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20048"/>et non invenietur de fragmentis ejus testa <l eID="gen20048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20049"/>in qua portetur igniculus de incendio, <l eID="gen20049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20050"/>aut hauriatur parum aquæ de fovea. <l eID="gen20050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8180"/><l level="1" sID="gen20051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8180"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus, Sanctus Israël : <l eID="gen20051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20052"/>Si revertamini et quiescatis, salvi eritis ; <l eID="gen20052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20053"/>in silentio et in spe erit fortitudo vestra. <l eID="gen20053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20054"/>Et noluistis, <l eID="gen20054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8181"/><l level="1" sID="gen20055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8181"/>et dixistis : Nequaquam, <l eID="gen20055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20056"/>sed ad equos fugiemus : <l eID="gen20056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20057"/>ideo fugietis ; <l eID="gen20057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20058"/>et : Super veloces ascendemus : <l eID="gen20058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20059"/>ideo velociores erunt qui persequentur vos. <l eID="gen20059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8182"/><l level="1" sID="gen20060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8182"/>Mille homines a facie terroris unius ; <l eID="gen20060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20061"/>et a facie terroris quinque fugietis, <l eID="gen20061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20062"/>donec relinquamini <l eID="gen20062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20063"/>quasi malus navis in vertice montis, <l eID="gen20063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20064"/>et quasi signum super collem. <l eID="gen20064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8183"/><l level="1" sID="gen20065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8183"/>Propterea exspectat Dominus ut misereatur vestri ; <l eID="gen20065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20066"/>et ideo exaltabitur parcens vobis, <l eID="gen20066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20067"/>quia Deus judicii Dominus : <l eID="gen20067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20068"/>beati omnes qui exspectant eum ! <l eID="gen20068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8184"/><l level="1" sID="gen20069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8184"/>Populus enim Sion habitabit in Jerusalem : <l eID="gen20069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20070"/>plorans nequaquam plorabis : <l eID="gen20070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20071"/>miserans miserebitur tui, ad vocem clamoris tui : <l eID="gen20071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20072"/>statim ut audierit, respondebit tibi. <l eID="gen20072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8185"/><l level="1" sID="gen20073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8185"/>Et dabit vobis Dominus <l eID="gen20073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20074"/>panem arctum, et aquam brevem ; <l eID="gen20074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20075"/>et non faciet avolare a te ultra doctorem tuum ; <l eID="gen20075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20076"/>et erunt oculi tui videntes præceptorem tuum. <l eID="gen20076" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8186"/><l level="1" sID="gen20077"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8186"/>Et aures tuæ audient verbum post tergum monentis : <l eID="gen20077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20078"/>Hæc est via ; ambulate in ea, <l eID="gen20078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20079"/>et non declinetis neque ad dexteram, neque ad sinistram. <l eID="gen20079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8187"/><l level="1" sID="gen20080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8187"/>Et contaminabis laminas sculptilium argenti tui, <l eID="gen20080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20081"/>et vestimentum conflatilis auri tui, <l eID="gen20081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20082"/>et disperges ea sicut immunditiam menstruatæ. <l eID="gen20082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20083"/>Egredere, dices ei. <l eID="gen20083" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8188"/><l level="1" sID="gen20084"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8188"/>Et dabitur pluvia semini tuo, <l eID="gen20084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20085"/>ubicumque seminaveris in terra, <l eID="gen20085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20086"/>et panis frugum terræ <l eID="gen20086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20087"/>erit uberrimus et pinguis ; <l eID="gen20087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20088"/>pascetur in possessione tua in die illo agnus spatiose, <l eID="gen20088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8189"/><l level="1" sID="gen20089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8189"/>et tauri tui, et pulli asinorum, <l eID="gen20089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20090"/>qui operantur terram, <l eID="gen20090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20091"/>commistum migma comedent <l eID="gen20091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20092"/>sicut in area ventilatum est. <l eID="gen20092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8190"/><l level="1" sID="gen20093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8190"/>Et erunt super omnem montem excelsum, <l eID="gen20093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20094"/>et super omnem collem elevatum, <l eID="gen20094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20095"/>rivi currentium aquarum, <l eID="gen20095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20096"/>in die interfectionis multorum, <l eID="gen20096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20097"/>cum ceciderint turres : <l eID="gen20097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8191"/><l level="1" sID="gen20098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8191"/>et erit lux lunæ sicut lux solis, <l eID="gen20098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20099"/>et lux solis erit septempliciter <l eID="gen20099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20100"/>sicut lux septem dierum, <l eID="gen20100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20101"/>in die qua alligaverit Dominus vulnus populi sui, <l eID="gen20101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20102"/>et percussuram plagæ ejus sanaverit. <l eID="gen20102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8192"/><l level="1" sID="gen20103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8192"/>Ecce nomen Domini venit de longinquo, <l eID="gen20103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20104"/>ardens furor ejus, et gravis ad portandum ; <l eID="gen20104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20105"/>labia ejus repleta sunt indignatione, <l eID="gen20105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20106"/>et lingua ejus quasi ignis devorans. <l eID="gen20106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8193"/><l level="1" sID="gen20107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8193"/>Spiritus ejus velut torrens <l eID="gen20107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20108"/>inundans usque ad medium colli, <l eID="gen20108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20109"/>ad perdendas gentes in nihilum, <l eID="gen20109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20110"/>et frenum erroris quod erat in maxillis populorum. <l eID="gen20110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8194"/><l level="1" sID="gen20111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8194"/>Canticum erit vobis <l eID="gen20111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20112"/>sicut nox sanctificatæ solemnitatis, <l eID="gen20112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20113"/>et lætitia cordis <l eID="gen20113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20114"/>sicut qui pergit cum tibia, <l eID="gen20114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20115"/>ut intret in montem Domini <l eID="gen20115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20116"/>ad Fortem Israël. <l eID="gen20116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8195"/><l level="1" sID="gen20117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8195"/>Et auditam faciet Dominus gloriam vocis suæ, <l eID="gen20117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20118"/>et terrorem brachii sui ostendet <l eID="gen20118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20119"/>in comminatione furoris, et flamma ignis devorantis : <l eID="gen20119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20120"/>allidet in turbine, et in lapide grandinis. <l eID="gen20120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8196"/><l level="1" sID="gen20121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8196"/>A voce enim Domini pavebit Assur <l eID="gen20121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20122"/>virga percussus. <l eID="gen20122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8197"/><l level="1" sID="gen20123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8197"/>Et erit transitus virgæ fundatus, <l eID="gen20123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20124"/>quam requiescere faciet Dominus super eum <l eID="gen20124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20125"/>in tympanis et citharis ; <l eID="gen20125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20126"/>et in bellis præcipuis expugnabit eos. <l eID="gen20126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 30:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8198"/><l level="1" sID="gen20127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8198"/>Præparata est enim ab heri Topheth, <l eID="gen20127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20128"/>a rege præparata, <l eID="gen20128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20129"/>profunda, et dilatata. <l eID="gen20129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20130"/>Nutrimenta ejus, ignis et ligna multa ; <l eID="gen20130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20131"/>flatus Domini sicut torrens sulphuris succendens eam.  <chapter eID="Isa.30"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:1
verses.text: Væ qui descendunt in Ægyptum ad auxilium, <l eID="gen20132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20133"/>in equis sperantes, <l eID="gen20133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20134"/>et habentes fiduciam super quadrigis, quia multæ sunt ; <l eID="gen20134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20135"/>et super equitibus, quia prævalidi nimis ; <l eID="gen20135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20136"/>et non sunt confisi super Sanctum Israël, <l eID="gen20136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20137"/>et Dominum non requisierunt ! <l eID="gen20137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8199"/><l level="1" sID="gen20138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8199"/>Ipse autem sapiens adduxit malum, <l eID="gen20138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20139"/>et verba sua non abstulit ; <l eID="gen20139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20140"/>et consurget contra domum pessimorum, <l eID="gen20140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20141"/>et contra auxilium operantium iniquitatem. <l eID="gen20141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8200"/><l level="1" sID="gen20142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8200"/>Ægyptus homo, et non deus ; <l eID="gen20142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20143"/>et equi eorum caro, et non spiritus ; <l eID="gen20143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20144"/>et Dominus inclinabit manum suam, <l eID="gen20144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20145"/>et corruet auxiliator, et cadet cui præstatur auxilium, <l eID="gen20145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20146"/>simulque omnes consumentur. <l eID="gen20146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8201"/><l level="1" sID="gen20147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8201"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen20147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20148"/>Quomodo si rugiat leo <l eID="gen20148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20149"/>et catulus leonis super prædam suam ; <l eID="gen20149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20150"/>et cum occurrerit ei multitudo pastorum, <l eID="gen20150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20151"/>a voce eorum non formidabit, <l eID="gen20151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20152"/>et a multitudine eorum non pavebit : <l eID="gen20152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20153"/>sic descendet Dominus exercituum ut prælietur <l eID="gen20153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20154"/>super montem Sion et super collem ejus. <l eID="gen20154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8202"/><l level="1" sID="gen20155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8202"/>Sicut aves volantes, <l eID="gen20155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20156"/>sic proteget Dominus exercituum Jerusalem, <l eID="gen20156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20157"/>protegens et liberans, transiens et salvans. <l eID="gen20157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8203"/><l level="1" sID="gen20158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8203"/>Convertimini, sicut in profundum recesseratis, <l eID="gen20158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20159"/>filii Israël. <l eID="gen20159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8204"/><l level="1" sID="gen20160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8204"/>In die enim illa abjiciet vir <l eID="gen20160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20161"/>idola argenti sui, et idola auri sui, <l eID="gen20161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20162"/>quæ fecerunt vobis manus vestræ in peccatum. <l eID="gen20162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8205"/><l level="1" sID="gen20163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8205"/>Et cadet Assur in gladio non viri, <l eID="gen20163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20164"/>et gladius non hominis vorabit eum : <l eID="gen20164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20165"/>et fugiet non a facie gladii, <l eID="gen20165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20166"/>et juvenes ejus vectigales erunt. <l eID="gen20166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8206"/><l level="1" sID="gen20167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8206"/>Et fortitudo ejus a terrore transibit, <l eID="gen20167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20168"/>et pavebunt fugientes principes ejus, <l eID="gen20168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20169"/>dixit Dominus : cujus ignis est in Sion <l eID="gen20169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20170"/>et caminus ejus in Jerusalem.  <chapter eID="Isa.31"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:1
verses.text: Ecce in justitia regnabit rex, <l eID="gen20171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20172"/>et principes in judicio præerunt. <l eID="gen20172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8207"/><l level="1" sID="gen20173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8207"/>Et erit vir sicut qui absconditur a vento, <l eID="gen20173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20174"/>et celat se a tempestate ; <l eID="gen20174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20175"/>sicut rivi aquarum in siti, <l eID="gen20175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20176"/>et umbra petræ prominentis in terra deserta. <l eID="gen20176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8208"/><l level="1" sID="gen20177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8208"/>Non caligabunt oculi videntium, <l eID="gen20177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20178"/>et aures audientium diligenter auscultabunt. <l eID="gen20178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8209"/><l level="1" sID="gen20179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8209"/>Et cor stultorum intelliget scientiam, <l eID="gen20179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20180"/>et lingua balborum velociter loquetur et plane. <l eID="gen20180" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8210"/><l level="1" sID="gen20181"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8210"/>Non vocabitur ultra is qui insipiens est, princeps, <l eID="gen20181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20182"/>neque fraudulentus appellabitur major ; <l eID="gen20182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8211"/><l level="1" sID="gen20183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8211"/>stultus enim fatua loquetur, <l eID="gen20183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20184"/>et cor ejus faciet iniquitatem, <l eID="gen20184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20185"/>ut perficiat simulationem, <l eID="gen20185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20186"/>et loquatur ad Dominum fraudulenter, <l eID="gen20186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20187"/>et vacuam faciat animam esurientis, <l eID="gen20187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20188"/>et potum sitienti auferat. <l eID="gen20188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8212"/><l level="1" sID="gen20189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8212"/>Fraudulenti vasa pessima sunt ; <l eID="gen20189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20190"/>ipse enim cogitationes concinnavit <l eID="gen20190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20191"/>ad perdendos mites in sermone mendacii, <l eID="gen20191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20192"/>cum loqueretur pauper judicium. <l eID="gen20192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8213"/><l level="1" sID="gen20193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8213"/>Princeps vero ea quæ digna sunt principe cogitabit, <l eID="gen20193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20194"/>et ipse super duces stabit. <l eID="gen20194" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8214"/><l level="1" sID="gen20195"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8214"/>Mulieres opulentæ, surgite, <l eID="gen20195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20196"/>et audite vocem meam ; <l eID="gen20196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20197"/>filiæ confidentes, <l eID="gen20197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20198"/>percipite auribus eloquium meum. <l eID="gen20198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8215"/><l level="1" sID="gen20199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8215"/>Post dies enim et annum, <l eID="gen20199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20200"/>vos conturbabimini confidentes ; <l eID="gen20200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20201"/>consummata est enim vindemia, <l eID="gen20201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20202"/>collectio ultra non veniet. <l eID="gen20202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8216"/><l level="1" sID="gen20203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8216"/>Obstupescite, opulentæ ; <l eID="gen20203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20204"/>conturbamini, confidentes : <l eID="gen20204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20205"/>exuite vos et confundimini ; <l eID="gen20205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20206"/>accingite lumbos vestros. <l eID="gen20206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8217"/><l level="1" sID="gen20207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8217"/>Super ubera plangite, <l eID="gen20207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20208"/>super regione desiderabili, <l eID="gen20208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20209"/>super vinea fertili. <l eID="gen20209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8218"/><l level="1" sID="gen20210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8218"/>Super humum populi mei <l eID="gen20210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20211"/>spinæ et vepres ascendent : <l eID="gen20211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20212"/>quanto magis super omnes domos gaudii <l eID="gen20212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20213"/>civitatis exultantis ! <l eID="gen20213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8219"/><l level="1" sID="gen20214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8219"/>Domus enim dimissa est, <l eID="gen20214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20215"/>multitudo urbis relicta est, <l eID="gen20215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20216"/>tenebræ et palpatio <l eID="gen20216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20217"/>factæ sunt super speluncas usque in æternum ; <l eID="gen20217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20218"/>gaudium onagrorum, <l eID="gen20218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20219"/>pascua gregum. <l eID="gen20219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8220"/><l level="1" sID="gen20220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8220"/>Donec effundatur super nos <l eID="gen20220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20221"/>spiritus de excelso, <l eID="gen20221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20222"/>et erit desertum in carmel, <l eID="gen20222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20223"/>et carmel in saltum reputabitur. <l eID="gen20223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8221"/><l level="1" sID="gen20224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8221"/>Et habitabit in solitudine judicium, <l eID="gen20224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20225"/>et justitia in carmel sedebit. <l eID="gen20225" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8222"/><l level="1" sID="gen20226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8222"/>Et erit opus justitiæ pax, <l eID="gen20226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20227"/>et cultus justitiæ silentium, <l eID="gen20227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20228"/>et securitas usque in sempiternum. <l eID="gen20228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8223"/><l level="1" sID="gen20229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8223"/>Et sedebit populus meus in pulchritudine pacis, <l eID="gen20229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20230"/>et in tabernaculis fiduciæ, <l eID="gen20230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20231"/>et in requie opulenta. <l eID="gen20231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8224"/><l level="1" sID="gen20232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8224"/>Grando autem in descensione saltus, <l eID="gen20232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20233"/>et humilitate humiliabitur civitas. <l eID="gen20233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8225"/><l level="1" sID="gen20234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8225"/>Beati qui seminatis super omnes aquas, <l eID="gen20234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20235"/>immittentes pedem bovis et asini.  <chapter eID="Isa.32"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:1
verses.text: Væ qui prædaris ! nonne et ipse prædaberis ? <l eID="gen20236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20237"/>et qui spernis, nonne et ipse sperneris ? <l eID="gen20237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20238"/>Cum consummaveris deprædationem, deprædaberis ; <l eID="gen20238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20239"/>cum fatigatus desieris contemnere, contemneris. <l eID="gen20239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8226"/><l level="1" sID="gen20240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8226"/>Domine, miserere nostri, <l eID="gen20240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20241"/>te enim exspectavimus ; <l eID="gen20241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20242"/>esto brachium nostrum in mane, <l eID="gen20242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20243"/>et salus nostra in tempore tribulationis. <l eID="gen20243" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8227"/><l level="1" sID="gen20244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8227"/>A voce angeli fugerunt populi, <l eID="gen20244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20245"/>et ab exaltatione tua dispersæ sunt gentes. <l eID="gen20245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8228"/><l level="1" sID="gen20246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8228"/>Et congregabuntur spolia vestra sicut colligitur bruchus, <l eID="gen20246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20247"/>velut cum fossæ plenæ fuerint de eo. <l eID="gen20247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8229"/><l level="1" sID="gen20248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8229"/>Magnificatus est Dominus, quoniam habitavit in excelso ; <l eID="gen20248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20249"/>implevit Sion judicio et justitia. <l eID="gen20249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8230"/><l level="1" sID="gen20250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8230"/>Et erit fides in temporibus tuis : <l eID="gen20250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20251"/>divitiæ salutis sapientia et scientia ; <l eID="gen20251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20252"/>timor Domini ipse est thesaurus ejus. <l eID="gen20252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8231"/><l level="1" sID="gen20253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8231"/>Ecce videntes clamabunt foris ; <l eID="gen20253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20254"/>angeli pacis amare flebunt. <l eID="gen20254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8232"/><l level="1" sID="gen20255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8232"/>Dissipatæ sunt viæ, <l eID="gen20255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20256"/>cessavit transiens per semitam : <l eID="gen20256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20257"/>irritum factum est pactum, projecit civitates, <l eID="gen20257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20258"/>non reputavit homines. <l eID="gen20258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8233"/><l level="1" sID="gen20259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8233"/>Luxit et elanguit terra ; <l eID="gen20259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20260"/>confusus est Libanus, et obsorduit : <l eID="gen20260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20261"/>et factus est Saron sicut desertum, <l eID="gen20261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20262"/>et concussa est Basan, et Carmelus. <l eID="gen20262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8234"/><l level="1" sID="gen20263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8234"/>Nunc consurgam, dicit Dominus ; <l eID="gen20263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20264"/>nunc exaltabor, nunc sublevabor. <l eID="gen20264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8235"/><l level="1" sID="gen20265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8235"/>Concipietis ardorem, parietis stipulam ; <l eID="gen20265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20266"/>spiritus vester ut ignis vorabit vos. <l eID="gen20266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8236"/><l level="1" sID="gen20267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8236"/>Et erunt populi quasi de incendio cinis ; <l eID="gen20267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20268"/>spinæ congregatæ igni comburentur. <l eID="gen20268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8237"/><l level="1" sID="gen20269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8237"/>Audite, qui longe estis, quæ fecerim ; <l eID="gen20269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20270"/>et cognoscite, vicini, fortitudinem meam. <l eID="gen20270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8238"/><l level="1" sID="gen20271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8238"/>Conterriti sunt in Sion peccatores ; <l eID="gen20271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20272"/>possedit tremor hypocritas. <l eID="gen20272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20273"/>Quis poterit habitare de vobis cum igne devorante ? <l eID="gen20273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20274"/>quis habitabit ex vobis cum ardoribus sempiternis ? <l eID="gen20274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8239"/><l level="1" sID="gen20275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8239"/>Qui ambulat in justitiis et loquitur veritatem, <l eID="gen20275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20276"/>qui projicit avaritiam ex calumnia, <l eID="gen20276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20277"/>et excutit manus suas ab omni munere, <l eID="gen20277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20278"/>qui obturat aures suas ne audiat sanguinem, <l eID="gen20278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20279"/>et claudit oculos suos ne videat malum. <l eID="gen20279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8240"/><l level="1" sID="gen20280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8240"/>Iste in excelsis habitabit ; <l eID="gen20280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20281"/>munimenta saxorum sublimitas ejus : <l eID="gen20281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20282"/>panis ei datus est, aquæ ejus fideles sunt. <l eID="gen20282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8241"/><l level="1" sID="gen20283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8241"/>Regem in decore suo videbunt oculi ejus, <l eID="gen20283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20284"/>cernent terram de longe. <l eID="gen20284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8242"/><l level="1" sID="gen20285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8242"/>Cor tuum meditabitur timorem : <l eID="gen20285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20286"/>ubi est litteratus ? ubi legis verba ponderans ? <l eID="gen20286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20287"/>ubi doctor parvulorum ? <l eID="gen20287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8243"/><l level="1" sID="gen20288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8243"/>Populum impudentem non videbis, <l eID="gen20288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20289"/>populum alti sermonis, ita ut non possis intelligere <l eID="gen20289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20290"/>disertitudinem linguæ ejus, in quo nulla est sapientia. <l eID="gen20290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8244"/><l level="1" sID="gen20291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8244"/>Respice, Sion, civitatem solemnitatis nostræ : <l eID="gen20291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20292"/>oculi tui videbunt Jerusalem, <l eID="gen20292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20293"/>habitationem opulentam, <l eID="gen20293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20294"/>tabernaculum quod nequaquam transferri poterit ; <l eID="gen20294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20295"/>nec auferentur clavi ejus in sempiternum, <l eID="gen20295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20296"/>et omnes funiculi ejus non rumpentur : <l eID="gen20296" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8245"/><l level="1" sID="gen20297"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8245"/>quia solummodo ibi magnificus est Dominus noster : <l eID="gen20297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20298"/>locus fluviorum rivi latissimi et patentes : <l eID="gen20298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20299"/>non transibit per eum navis remigum, <l eID="gen20299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20300"/>neque trieris magna transgredietur eum. <l eID="gen20300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8246"/><l level="1" sID="gen20301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8246"/>Dominus enim judex noster, <l eID="gen20301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20302"/>Dominus legifer noster, <l eID="gen20302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20303"/>Dominus rex noster, <l eID="gen20303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20304"/>ipse salvabit nos. <l eID="gen20304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8247"/><l level="1" sID="gen20305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8247"/>Laxati sunt funiculi tui, <l eID="gen20305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20306"/>et non prævalebunt ; <l eID="gen20306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20307"/>sic erit malus tuus <l eID="gen20307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20308"/>ut dilatare signum non queas. <l eID="gen20308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20309"/>Tunc dividentur spolia prædarum multarum ; <l eID="gen20309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20310"/>claudi diripient rapinam. <l eID="gen20310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 33:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8248"/><l level="1" sID="gen20311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8248"/>Nec dicet vicinus : Elangui ; <l eID="gen20311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20312"/>populus qui habitat in ea, auferetur ab eo iniquitas.  <chapter eID="Isa.33"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:1
verses.text: Accedite, gentes, et audite ; <l eID="gen20313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20314"/>et populi, attendite : <l eID="gen20314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20315"/>audiat terra, et plenitudo ejus ; <l eID="gen20315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20316"/>orbis, et omne germen ejus. <l eID="gen20316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8249"/><l level="1" sID="gen20317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8249"/>Quia indignatio Domini super omnes gentes, <l eID="gen20317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20318"/>et furor super universam militiam eorum : <l eID="gen20318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20319"/>interfecit eos, et dedit eos in occisionem. <l eID="gen20319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8250"/><l level="1" sID="gen20320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8250"/>Interfecti eorum projicientur, <l eID="gen20320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20321"/>et de cadaveribus eorum ascendet fœtor ; <l eID="gen20321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20322"/>tabescent montes a sanguine eorum. <l eID="gen20322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8251"/><l level="1" sID="gen20323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8251"/>Et tabescet omnis militia cælorum, <l eID="gen20323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20324"/>et complicabuntur sicut liber cæli : <l eID="gen20324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20325"/>et omnis militia eorum defluet, <l eID="gen20325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20326"/>sicut defluit folium de vinea et de ficu. <l eID="gen20326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8252"/><l level="1" sID="gen20327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8252"/>Quoniam inebriatus est in cælo gladius meus ; <l eID="gen20327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20328"/>ecce super Idumæam descendet, <l eID="gen20328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20329"/>et super populum interfectionis meæ, ad judicium. <l eID="gen20329" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8253"/><l level="1" sID="gen20330"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8253"/>Gladius Domini repletus est sanguine, <l eID="gen20330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20331"/>incrassatus est adipe, <l eID="gen20331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20332"/>de sanguine agnorum et hircorum, <l eID="gen20332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20333"/>de sanguine medullatorum arietum : <l eID="gen20333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20334"/>victima enim Domini in Bosra, <l eID="gen20334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20335"/>et interfectio magna in terra Edom. <l eID="gen20335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8254"/><l level="1" sID="gen20336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8254"/>Et descendent unicornes cum eis, <l eID="gen20336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20337"/>et tauri cum potentibus ; <l eID="gen20337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20338"/>inebriabitur terra eorum sanguine, <l eID="gen20338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20339"/>et humus eorum adipe pinguium. <l eID="gen20339" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8255"/><l level="1" sID="gen20340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8255"/>Quia dies ultionis Domini, <l eID="gen20340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20341"/>annus retributionum judicii Sion. <l eID="gen20341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8256"/><l level="1" sID="gen20342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8256"/>Et convertentur torrentes ejus in picem, <l eID="gen20342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20343"/>et humus ejus in sulphur ; <l eID="gen20343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20344"/>et erit terra ejus in picem ardentem. <l eID="gen20344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8257"/><l level="1" sID="gen20345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8257"/>Nocte et die non extinguetur, <l eID="gen20345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20346"/>in sempiternum ascendet fumus ejus, <l eID="gen20346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20347"/>a generatione in generationem desolabitur, <l eID="gen20347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20348"/>in sæcula sæculorum non erit transiens per eam. <l eID="gen20348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8258"/><l level="1" sID="gen20349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8258"/>Et possidebunt illam onocrotalus et ericius ; <l eID="gen20349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20350"/>ibis et corvus habitabunt in ea : <l eID="gen20350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20351"/>et extendetur super eam mensura, ut redigatur ad nihilum, <l eID="gen20351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20352"/>et perpendiculum in desolationem. <l eID="gen20352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8259"/><l level="1" sID="gen20353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8259"/>Nobiles ejus non erunt ibi ; regem potius invocabunt, <l eID="gen20353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20354"/>et omnes principes ejus erunt in nihilum. <l eID="gen20354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8260"/><l level="1" sID="gen20355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8260"/>Et orientur in domibus ejus spinæ et urticæ, <l eID="gen20355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20356"/>et paliurus in munitionibus ejus ; <l eID="gen20356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20357"/>et erit cubile draconum, <l eID="gen20357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20358"/>et pascua struthionum. <l eID="gen20358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8261"/><l level="1" sID="gen20359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8261"/>Et occurrent dæmonia onocentauris, <l eID="gen20359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20360"/>et pilosus clamabit alter ad alterum ; <l eID="gen20360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20361"/>ibi cubavit lamia, <l eID="gen20361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20362"/>et invenit sibi requiem. <l eID="gen20362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8262"/><l level="1" sID="gen20363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8262"/>Ibi habuit foveam ericius, et enutrivit catulos, <l eID="gen20363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20364"/>et circumfodit, et fovit in umbra ejus ; <l eID="gen20364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20365"/>illuc congregati sunt milvi, alter ad alterum. <l eID="gen20365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8263"/><l level="1" sID="gen20366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8263"/>Requirite diligenter in libro Domini, et legite : <l eID="gen20366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20367"/>Unum ex eis non defuit, <l eID="gen20367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20368"/>alter alterum non quæsivit ; <l eID="gen20368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20369"/>quia quod ex ore meo procedit, ille mandavit, <l eID="gen20369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20370"/>et spiritus ejus ipse congregavit ea. <l eID="gen20370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 34:17
