verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8264"/><l level="1" sID="gen20371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8264"/>Et ipse misit eis sortem, <l eID="gen20371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20372"/>et manus ejus divisit eam illis in mensuram : <l eID="gen20372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20373"/>usque in æternum possidebunt eam ; <l eID="gen20373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20374"/>in generationem et generationem habitabunt in ea.  <chapter eID="Isa.34"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:1
verses.text: Lætabitur deserta et invia, <l eID="gen20375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20376"/>et exsultabit solitudo, <l eID="gen20376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20377"/>et florebit quasi lilium. <l eID="gen20377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8265"/><l level="1" sID="gen20378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8265"/>Germinans germinabit, et exsultabit <l eID="gen20378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20379"/>lætabunda et laudans : <l eID="gen20379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20380"/>gloria Libani data est ei, <l eID="gen20380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20381"/>decor Carmeli et Saron ; <l eID="gen20381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20382"/>ipsi videbunt gloriam Domini, <l eID="gen20382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20383"/>et decorem Dei nostri. <l eID="gen20383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8266"/><l level="1" sID="gen20384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8266"/>Confortate manus dissolutas, <l eID="gen20384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20385"/>et genua debilia roborate. <l eID="gen20385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8267"/><l level="1" sID="gen20386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8267"/>Dicite pusillanimis : <l eID="gen20386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20387"/>Confortamini, et nolite timere : <l eID="gen20387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20388"/>ecce Deus vester ultionem adducet retributionis ; <l eID="gen20388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20389"/>Deus ipse veniet, et salvabit vos. <l eID="gen20389" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8268"/><l level="1" sID="gen20390"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8268"/>Tunc aperientur oculi cæcorum, <l eID="gen20390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20391"/>et aures surdorum patebunt ; <l eID="gen20391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8269"/><l level="1" sID="gen20392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8269"/>tunc saliet sicut cervus claudus, <l eID="gen20392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20393"/>et aperta erit lingua mutorum : <l eID="gen20393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20394"/>quia scissæ sunt in deserto aquæ, <l eID="gen20394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20395"/>et torrentes in solitudine ; <l eID="gen20395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8270"/><l level="1" sID="gen20396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8270"/>et quæ erat arida, erit in stagnum, <l eID="gen20396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20397"/>et sitiens in fontes aquarum. <l eID="gen20397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20398"/>In cubilibus, in quibus prius dracones habitabant, <l eID="gen20398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20399"/>orietur viror calami et junci. <l eID="gen20399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8271"/><l level="1" sID="gen20400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8271"/>Et erit ibi semita et via, <l eID="gen20400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20401"/>et via sancta vocabitur : <l eID="gen20401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20402"/>non transibit per eam pollutus, <l eID="gen20402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20403"/>et hæc erit vobis directa via, <l eID="gen20403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20404"/>ita ut stulti non errent per eam. <l eID="gen20404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8272"/><l level="1" sID="gen20405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8272"/>Non erit ibi leo, <l eID="gen20405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20406"/>et mala bestia non ascendet per eam, <l eID="gen20406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20407"/>nec invenietur ibi ; <l eID="gen20407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20408"/>et ambulabunt qui liberati fuerint. <l eID="gen20408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8273"/><l level="1" sID="gen20409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8273"/>Et redempti a Domino convertentur, <l eID="gen20409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20410"/>et venient in Sion cum laude, <l eID="gen20410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20411"/>et lætitia sempiterna super caput eorum : <l eID="gen20411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20412"/>gaudium et lætitiam obtinebunt, <l eID="gen20412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20413"/>et fugiet dolor et gemitus. <l eID="gen20413" level="1"/><lg eID="gen19516"/> <chapter eID="Isa.35"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:1
verses.text: Et factum est in quartodecimo anno regis Ezechiæ, ascendit Sennacherib, rex Assyriorum, super omnes civitates Juda munitas, et cepit eas.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:2
verses.text: Et misit rex Assyriorum Rabsacen de Lachis in Jerusalem, ad regem Ezechiam in manu gravi : et stetit in aquæductu piscinæ superioris in via Agri fullonis.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:3
verses.text: Et egressus est ad eum Eliacim, filius Helciæ, qui erat super domum, et Sobna scriba, et Joahe filius Asaph, a commentariis.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:4
verses.text: Et dixit ad eos Rabsaces : Dicite Ezechiæ : Hæc dicit rex magnus, rex Assyriorum : Quæ est ista fiducia qua confidis ?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:5
verses.text: aut quo consilio vel fortitudine rebellare disponis ? super quem habes fiduciam, quia recessisti a me ?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:6
verses.text: Ecce confidis super baculum arundineum confractum istum, super Ægyptum ; cui si innixus fuerit homo, intrabit in manum ejus, et perforabit eam : sic Pharao, rex Ægypti, omnibus qui confidunt in eo.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:7
verses.text: Quod si responderis mihi : In Domino Deo nostro confidimus ; nonne ipse est cujus abstulit Ezechias excelsa et altaria, et dixit Judæ et Jerusalem : Coram altari isto adorabitis ?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:8
verses.text: Et nunc trade te domino meo, regi Assyriorum, et dabo tibi duo millia equorum, nec poteris ex te præbere ascensores eorum :

verses.name: Isaiah 36:9
verses.text: et quomodo sustinebis faciem judicis unius loci ex servis domini mei minoribus ? Quod si confidis in Ægypto, in quadrigis et in equitibus,

verses.name: Isaiah 36:10
verses.text: et nunc numquid sine Domino ascendi ad terram istam, ut disperderem eam ? Dominus dixit ad me : Ascende super terram istam, et disperde eam.  <div eID="gen20414" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 36:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8274"/><div sID="gen20415" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8274"/>Et dixit Eliacim, et Sobna, et Joahe, ad Rabsacen : Loquere ad servos tuos syra lingua ; intelligimus enim ; ne loquaris ad nos judaice in auribus populi qui est super murum.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:12
verses.text: Et dixit ad eos Rabsaces : Numquid ad dominum tuum et ad te misit me dominus meus, ut loquerer omnia verba ista ? et non potius ad viros qui sedent in muro, ut comedant stercora sua, et bibant urinam pedum suorum vobiscum ?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:13
verses.text: Et stetit Rabsaces, et clamavit voce magna judaice, et dixit : Audite verba regis magni, regis Assyriorum !

verses.name: Isaiah 36:14
verses.text: Hæc dicit rex : Non seducat vos Ezechias, quia non poterit eruere vos.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:15
verses.text: Et non vobis tribuat fiduciam Ezechias super Domino, dicens : Eruens liberabit nos Dominus : non dabitur civitas ista in manu regis Assyriorum.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:16
verses.text: Nolite audire Ezechiam ; hæc enim dicit rex Assyriorum : Facite mecum benedictionem, et egredimini ad me, et comedite unusquisque vineam suam, et unusquisque ficum suam, et bibite unusquisque aquam cisternæ suæ,

verses.name: Isaiah 36:17
verses.text: donec veniam, et tollam vos ad terram quæ est ut terra vestra, terram frumenti et vini, terram panum et vinearum.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:18
verses.text: Nec conturbet vos Ezechias, dicens : Dominus liberabit nos. Numquid liberaverunt dii gentium unusquisque terram suam de manu regis Assyriorum ?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:19
verses.text: Ubi est deus Emath et Arphad ? ubi est deus Sepharvaim ? numquid liberaverunt Samariam de manu mea ?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:20
verses.text: Quis est ex omnibus diis terrarum istarum qui eruerit terram suam de manu mea, ut eruat Dominus Jerusalem de manu mea ?

verses.name: Isaiah 36:21
verses.text: Et siluerunt, et non responderunt ei verbum. Mandaverat enim rex, dicens : Ne respondeatis ei.

verses.name: Isaiah 36:22
verses.text: Et ingressus est Eliacim, filius Helciæ, qui erat super domum, et Sobna scriba, et Joahe filius Asaph, a commentariis, ad Ezechiam, scissis vestibus, et nuntiaverunt ei verba Rabsacis.  <chapter eID="Isa.36"/> <div eID="gen20415" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:1
verses.text: Et factum est, cum audisset rex Ezechias, scidit vestimenta sua, et obvolutus est sacco, et intravit in domum Domini.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:2
verses.text: Et misit Eliacim, qui erat super domum, et Sobnam scribam, et seniores de sacerdotibus, opertos saccis, ad Isaiam, filium Amos, prophetam,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:3
verses.text: et dixerunt ad eum : Hæc dicit Ezechias : Dies tribulationis, et correptionis, et blasphemiæ, dies hæc ; quia venerunt filii usque ad partum, et virtus non est pariendi.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:4
verses.text: Si quomodo audiat Dominus Deus tuus verba Rabsacis, quem misit rex Assyriorum dominus suus ad blasphemandum Deum viventem et exprobrandum sermonibus quos audivit Dominus Deus tuus : leva ergo orationem pro reliquiis quæ repertæ sunt.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:5
verses.text: Et venerunt servi regis Ezechiæ ad Isaiam.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:6
verses.text: Et dixit ad eos Isaias : Hæc dicetis domino vestro : Hæc dicit Dominus : Ne timeas a facie verborum quæ audisti, quibus blasphemaverunt pueri regis Assyriorum me.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:7
verses.text: Ecce ego dabo ei spiritum, et audiet nuntium, et revertetur ad terram suam, et corruere eum faciam gladio in terra sua.  <div eID="gen20416" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8275"/><div sID="gen20417" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8275"/>Reversus est autem Rabsaces, et invenit regem Assyriorum præliantem adversus Lobnam : audierat enim quia profectus esset de Lachis.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:9
verses.text: Et audivit de Tharaca rege Æthiopiæ, dicentes : Egressus est ut pugnet contra te. Quod cum audisset, misit nuntios ad Ezechiam, dicens :

verses.name: Isaiah 37:10
verses.text: Hæc dicetis Ezechiæ regi Judæ, loquentes : Non te decipiat Deus tuus in quo tu confidis, dicens : Non dabitur Jerusalem in manu regis Assyriorum.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:11
verses.text: Ecce tu audisti omnia quæ fecerunt reges Assyriorum omnibus terris, quas subverterunt : et tu poteris liberari ?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:12
verses.text: Numquid eruerunt eos dii gentium quos subverterunt patres mei, Gozam, et Haram, et Reseph, et filios Eden qui erant in Thalassar ?

verses.name: Isaiah 37:13
verses.text: Ubi est rex Emath, et rex Arphad, et rex urbis Sepharvaim, Ana, et Ava ?  <div eID="gen20417" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8276"/><div sID="gen20418" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8276"/>Et tulit Ezechias libros de manu nuntiorum, et legit eos, et ascendit in domum Domini, et expandit eos Ezechias coram Domino :

verses.name: Isaiah 37:15
verses.text: et oravit Ezechias ad Dominum, dicens :

verses.name: Isaiah 37:16
verses.text: Domine exercituum, Deus Israël, qui sedes super cherubim, tu es Deus solus omnium regnorum terræ : tu fecisti cælum et terram.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:17
verses.text: Inclina, Domine, aurem tuam, et audi ; aperi, Domine, oculos tuos, et vide : et audi omnia verba Sennacherib, quæ misit ad blasphemandum Deum viventem.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:18
verses.text: Vere enim, Domine, desertas fecerunt reges Assyriorum terras, et regiones earum,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:19
verses.text: et dederunt deos earum igni : non enim erant dii, sed opera manuum hominum, lignum et lapis, et comminuerunt eos.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:20
verses.text: Et nunc, Domine Deus noster, salva nos de manu ejus, et cognoscant omnia regna terræ quia tu es Dominus solus.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:21
verses.text: Et misit Isaias, filius Amos, ad Ezechiam, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Pro quibus rogasti me de Sennacherib, rege Assyriorum,

verses.name: Isaiah 37:22
verses.text: hoc est verbum quod locutus est Dominus super eum : <div eID="gen20418" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20419"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20420"/>Despexit te et subsannavit te, <l eID="gen20420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20421"/>virgo filia Sion ; <l eID="gen20421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20422"/>post te caput movit, <l eID="gen20422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20423"/>filia Jerusalem. <l eID="gen20423" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8277"/><l level="1" sID="gen20424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8277"/>Cui exprobrasti ? et quem blasphemasti ? <l eID="gen20424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20425"/>et super quem exaltasti vocem, <l eID="gen20425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20426"/>et levasti altitudinem oculorum tuorum ? <l eID="gen20426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20427"/>ad Sanctum Israël. <l eID="gen20427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8278"/><l level="1" sID="gen20428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8278"/>In manu servorum tuorum exprobrasti Domino, <l eID="gen20428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20429"/>et dixisti : In multitudine quadrigarum mearum <l eID="gen20429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20430"/>ego ascendi altitudinem montium juga Libani ; <l eID="gen20430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20431"/>et succidam excelsa cedrorum ejus, <l eID="gen20431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20432"/>et electas abietes illius, <l eID="gen20432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20433"/>et introibo altitudinem summitatis ejus, <l eID="gen20433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20434"/>saltum Carmeli ejus. <l eID="gen20434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8279"/><l level="1" sID="gen20435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8279"/>Ego fodi, et bibi aquam, <l eID="gen20435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20436"/>et exsiccavi vestigio pedis mei <l eID="gen20436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20437"/>omnes rivos aggerum. <l eID="gen20437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8280"/><l level="1" sID="gen20438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8280"/>Numquid non audisti quæ olim fecerim ei ? <l eID="gen20438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20439"/>Ex diebus antiquis ego plasmavi illud ; <l eID="gen20439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20440"/>et nunc adduxi, <l eID="gen20440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20441"/>et factum est in eradicationem collium compugnantium, <l eID="gen20441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20442"/>et civitatum munitarum. <l eID="gen20442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8281"/><l level="1" sID="gen20443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8281"/>Habitatores earum breviata manu <l eID="gen20443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20444"/>contremuerunt, et confusi sunt. <l eID="gen20444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20445"/>Facti sunt sicut fœnum agri, <l eID="gen20445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20446"/>et gramen pascuæ, <l eID="gen20446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20447"/>et herba tectorum, <l eID="gen20447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20448"/>quæ exaruit antequam maturesceret. <l eID="gen20448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8282"/><l level="1" sID="gen20449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8282"/>Habitationem tuam, et egressum tuum, <l eID="gen20449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20450"/>et introitum tuum cognovi, <l eID="gen20450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20451"/>et insaniam tuam contra me. <l eID="gen20451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8283"/><l level="1" sID="gen20452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8283"/>Cum fureres adversum me, <l eID="gen20452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20453"/>superbia tua ascendit in aures meas. <l eID="gen20453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20454"/>Ponam ergo circulum in naribus tuis, <l eID="gen20454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20455"/>et frenum in labiis tuis, <l eID="gen20455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20456"/>et reducam te in viam <l eID="gen20456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20457"/>per quem venisti. <l eID="gen20457" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen20419"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8284"/><div sID="gen20458" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8284"/>Tibi autem hoc erit signum : comede hoc anno quæ sponte nascuntur, et in anno secundo pomis vescere ; in anno autem tertio seminate et metite, et plantate vineas, et comedite fructum earum.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:31
verses.text: Et mittet id quod salvatum fuerit de domo Juda, et quod reliquum est, radicem deorsum, et faciet fructum sursum :

verses.name: Isaiah 37:32
verses.text: quia de Jerusalem exibunt reliquiæ, et salvatio de monte Sion : zelus Domini exercituum faciet istud.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:33
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus de rege Assyriorum : <div eID="gen20458" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen20459"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20460"/>Non intrabit civitatem hanc, <l eID="gen20460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20461"/>et non jaciet ibi sagittam, <l eID="gen20461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20462"/>et non occupabit eam clypeus, <l eID="gen20462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20463"/>et non mittet in circuitu ejus aggerem. <l eID="gen20463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8285"/><l level="1" sID="gen20464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8285"/>In via qua venit, per eam revertetur, <l eID="gen20464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20465"/>et civitatem hanc non ingredietur, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen20465" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 37:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8286"/><l level="1" sID="gen20466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8286"/>Et protegam civitatem istam, ut salvem eam <l eID="gen20466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20467"/>propter me, et propter David, servum meum.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:36
verses.text: Egressus est autem angelus Domini, et percussit in castris Assyriorum centum octoginta quinque millia. Et surrexerunt mane, et ecce omnes cadavera mortuorum.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:37
verses.text: Et egressus est, et abiit, et reversus est Sennacherib, rex Assyriorum, et habitavit in Ninive.

verses.name: Isaiah 37:38
verses.text: Et factum est, cum adoraret in templo Nesroch deum suum, Adramelech et Sarasar, filii ejus, percusserunt eum gladio, fugeruntque in terram Ararat ; et regnavit Asarhaddon, filius ejus, pro eo. <l eID="gen20467" level="1"/><lg eID="gen20459"/> <chapter eID="Isa.37"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:1
verses.text: In diebus illis ægrotavit Ezechias usque ad mortem ; et introivit ad eum Isaias, filius Amos, propheta, et dixit ei : Hæc dicit Dominus : Dispone domui tuæ, quia morieris tu, et non vives.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:2
verses.text: Et convertit Ezechias faciem suam ad parietem, et oravit ad Dominum,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:3
verses.text: et dixit : Obsecro, Domine, memento, quæso, quomodo ambulaverim coram te in veritate et in corde perfecto, et quod bonum est in oculis tuis fecerim. Et flevit Ezechias fletu magno.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:4
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Isaiam, dicens :

verses.name: Isaiah 38:5
verses.text: Vade, et dic Ezechiæ : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus David patris tui : Audivi orationem tuam, et vidi lacrimas tuas ; ecce ego adjiciam super dies tuos quindecim annos,

verses.name: Isaiah 38:6
verses.text: et de manu regis Assyriorum eruam te, et civitatem istam, et protegam eam.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:7
verses.text: Hoc autem tibi erit signum a Domino, quia faciet Dominus verbum hoc quod locutus est :

verses.name: Isaiah 38:8
verses.text: ecce ego reverti faciam umbram linearum per quas descenderat in horologio Achaz in sole, retrorsum decem lineis. Et reversus est sol decem lineis per gradus quos descenderat.  <div eID="gen20468" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8287"/><div sID="gen20469" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8287"/>Scriptura Ezechiæ, regis Juda, cum ægrotasset et convaluisset de infirmitate sua.  <div eID="gen20469" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8288"/><lg sID="gen20470"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8288"/>Ego dixi in dimidio dierum meorum : <l eID="gen20471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20472"/>Vadam ad portas inferi ; <l eID="gen20472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20473"/>quæsivi residuum annorum meorum. <l eID="gen20473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8289"/><l level="1" sID="gen20474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8289"/>Dixi : Non videbo Dominum Deum <l eID="gen20474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20475"/>in terra viventium ; <l eID="gen20475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20476"/>non aspiciam hominem ultra, <l eID="gen20476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20477"/>et habitatorem quietis. <l eID="gen20477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8290"/><l level="1" sID="gen20478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8290"/>Generatio mea ablata est, et convoluta est a me, <l eID="gen20478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20479"/>quasi tabernaculum pastorum. <l eID="gen20479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20480"/>Præcisa est velut a texente vita mea ; <l eID="gen20480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20481"/>dum adhuc ordirer, succidit me : <l eID="gen20481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20482"/>de mane usque ad vesperam finies me. <l eID="gen20482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8291"/><l level="1" sID="gen20483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8291"/>Sperabam usque ad mane ; <l eID="gen20483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20484"/>quasi leo, sic contrivit omnia ossa mea : <l eID="gen20484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20485"/>de mane usque ad vesperam finies me. <l eID="gen20485" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8292"/><l level="1" sID="gen20486"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8292"/>Sicut pullus hirundinis, sic clamabo ; <l eID="gen20486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20487"/>meditabor ut columba. <l eID="gen20487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20488"/>Attenuati sunt oculi mei, suspicientes in excelsum. <l eID="gen20488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20489"/>Domine, vim patior : responde pro me. <l eID="gen20489" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8293"/><l level="1" sID="gen20490"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8293"/>Quid dicam, aut quid respondebit mihi, <l eID="gen20490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20491"/>cum ipse fecerit ? <l eID="gen20491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20492"/>Recogitabo tibi omnes annos meos <l eID="gen20492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20493"/>in amaritudine animæ meæ. <l eID="gen20493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8294"/><l level="1" sID="gen20494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8294"/>Domine, si sic vivitur, <l eID="gen20494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20495"/>et in talibus vita spiritus mei, <l eID="gen20495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20496"/>corripies me, et vivificabis me. <l eID="gen20496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8295"/><l level="1" sID="gen20497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8295"/>Ecce in pace amaritudo mea amarissima. <l eID="gen20497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20498"/>Tu autem eruisti animam meam <l eID="gen20498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20499"/>ut non periret ; <l eID="gen20499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20500"/>projecisti post tergum tuum <l eID="gen20500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20501"/>omnia peccata mea. <l eID="gen20501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8296"/><l level="1" sID="gen20502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8296"/>Quia non infernus confitebitur tibi, <l eID="gen20502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20503"/>neque mors laudabit te : <l eID="gen20503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20504"/>non exspectabunt qui descendunt in lacum <l eID="gen20504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20505"/>veritatem tuam. <l eID="gen20505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8297"/><l level="1" sID="gen20506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8297"/>Vivens, vivens ipse confitebitur tibi, <l eID="gen20506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20507"/>sicut et ego hodie ; <l eID="gen20507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20508"/>pater filiis notam faciet <l eID="gen20508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20509"/>veritatem tuam. <l eID="gen20509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 38:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8298"/><l level="1" sID="gen20510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8298"/>Domine, salvum me fac ! <l eID="gen20510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20511"/>et psalmos nostros cantabimus <l eID="gen20511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20512"/>cunctis diebus vitæ nostræ <l eID="gen20512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20513"/>in domo Domini.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:21
verses.text: Et jussit Isaias ut tollerent massam de ficis, et cataplasmarent super vulnus, et sanaretur.

verses.name: Isaiah 38:22
verses.text: Et dixit Ezechias : Quod erit signum quia ascendam in domum Domini ? <l eID="gen20513" level="1"/><lg eID="gen20470"/> <chapter eID="Isa.38"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 39:1
verses.text: In tempore illo misit Merodach Baladan, filius Baladan, rex Babylonis, libros et munera ad Ezechiam : audierat enim quod ægrotasset et convaluisset.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:2
verses.text: Lætatus est autem super eis Ezechias, et ostendit eis cellam aromatum, et argenti, et auri, et odoramentorum, et unguenti optimi, et omnes apothecas supellectilis suæ, et universa quæ inventa sunt in thesauris ejus. Non fuit verbum quod non ostenderet eis Ezechias in domo sua, et in omni potestate sua.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:3
verses.text: Introivit autem Isaias propheta ad Ezechiam regem, et dixit ei : Quid dixerunt viri isti, et unde venerunt ad te ? Et dixit Ezechias : De terra longinqua venerunt ad me, de Babylone.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:4
verses.text: Et dixit : Quid viderunt in domo tua ? Et dixit Ezechias : Omnia quæ in domo mea sunt viderunt ; non fuit res quam non ostenderim eis in thesauris meis.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:5
verses.text: Et dixit Isaias ad Ezechiam : Audi verbum Domini exercituum.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:6
verses.text: Ecce dies venient, et auferentur omnia quæ in domo tua sunt, et quæ thesaurizaverunt patres tui usque ad diem hanc, in Babylonem ; non relinquetur quidquam, dicit Dominus.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:7
verses.text: Et de filiis tuis, qui exibunt de te, quos genueris, tollent, et erunt eunuchi in palatio regis Babylonis.

verses.name: Isaiah 39:8
verses.text: Et dixit Ezechias ad Isaiam : Bonum verbum Domini, quod locutus est. Et dixit : Fiat tantum pax et veritas in diebus meis !  <chapter eID="Isa.39"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:1
verses.text: Consolamini, consolamini, popule meus, <l eID="gen20516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20517"/>dicit Deus vester. <l eID="gen20517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8299"/><l level="1" sID="gen20518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8299"/>Loquimini ad cor Jerusalem, <l eID="gen20518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20519"/>et advocate eam, <l eID="gen20519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20520"/>quoniam completa est malitia ejus, <l eID="gen20520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20521"/>dimissa est iniquitas illius : <l eID="gen20521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20522"/>suscepit de manu Domini duplicia <l eID="gen20522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20523"/>pro omnibus peccatis suis. <l eID="gen20523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8300"/><l level="1" sID="gen20524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8300"/>Vox clamantis in deserto : <l eID="gen20524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20525"/>Parate viam Domini, <l eID="gen20525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20526"/>rectas facite in solitudine semitas Dei nostri. <l eID="gen20526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8301"/><l level="1" sID="gen20527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8301"/>Omnis vallis exaltabitur, <l eID="gen20527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20528"/>et omnis mons et collis humiliabitur, <l eID="gen20528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20529"/>et erunt prava in directa, <l eID="gen20529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20530"/>et aspera in vias planas : <l eID="gen20530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8302"/><l level="1" sID="gen20531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8302"/>et revelabitur gloria Domini, <l eID="gen20531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20532"/>et videbit omnis caro pariter <l eID="gen20532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20533"/>quod os Domini locutum est. <l eID="gen20533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8303"/><l level="1" sID="gen20534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8303"/>Vox dicentis : Clama. <l eID="gen20534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20535"/>Et dixi : Quid clamabo ? <l eID="gen20535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20536"/>Omnis caro fœnum, <l eID="gen20536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20537"/>et omnis gloria ejus quasi flos agri. <l eID="gen20537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8304"/><l level="1" sID="gen20538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8304"/>Exsiccatum est fœnum, et cecidit flos, <l eID="gen20538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20539"/>quia spiritus Domini sufflavit in eo. <l eID="gen20539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20540"/>Vere fœnum est populus : <l eID="gen20540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8305"/><l level="1" sID="gen20541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8305"/>exsiccatum est fœnum, et cecidit flos ; <l eID="gen20541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20542"/>verbum autem Domini nostri manet in æternum. <l eID="gen20542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8306"/><l level="1" sID="gen20543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8306"/>Super montem excelsum ascende, <l eID="gen20543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20544"/>tu qui evangelizas Sion ; <l eID="gen20544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20545"/>exalta in fortitudine vocem tuam, <l eID="gen20545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20546"/>qui evangelizas Jerusalem : <l eID="gen20546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20547"/>exalta, noli timere. <l eID="gen20547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20548"/>Dic civitatibus Juda : <l eID="gen20548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20549"/>Ecce Deus vester : <l eID="gen20549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8307"/><l level="1" sID="gen20550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8307"/>ecce Dominus Deus in fortitudine veniet, <l eID="gen20550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20551"/>et brachium ejus dominabitur : <l eID="gen20551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20552"/>ecce merces ejus cum eo, <l eID="gen20552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20553"/>et opus illius coram illo. <l eID="gen20553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8308"/><l level="1" sID="gen20554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8308"/>Sicut pastor gregem suum pascet, <l eID="gen20554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20555"/>in brachio suo congregabit agnos, <l eID="gen20555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20556"/>et in sinu suo levabit ; <l eID="gen20556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20557"/>fœtas ipse portabit. <l eID="gen20557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8309"/><l level="1" sID="gen20558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8309"/>Quis mensus est pugillo aquas, <l eID="gen20558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20559"/>et cælos palmo ponderavit ? <l eID="gen20559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20560"/>quis appendit tribus digitis molem terræ, <l eID="gen20560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20561"/>et libravit in pondere montes, <l eID="gen20561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20562"/>et colles in statera ? <l eID="gen20562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8310"/><l level="1" sID="gen20563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8310"/>Quis adjuvit spiritum Domini ? <l eID="gen20563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20564"/>aut quis consiliarius ejus fuit, et ostendit illi ? <l eID="gen20564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8311"/><l level="1" sID="gen20565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8311"/>cum quo iniit consilium, et instruxit eum, <l eID="gen20565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20566"/>et docuit eum semitam justitiæ, <l eID="gen20566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20567"/>et erudivit eum scientiam, <l eID="gen20567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20568"/>et viam prudentiæ ostendit illi ? <l eID="gen20568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8312"/><l level="1" sID="gen20569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8312"/>Ecce gentes quasi stilla situlæ, <l eID="gen20569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20570"/>et quasi momentum stateræ reputatæ sunt ; <l eID="gen20570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20571"/>ecce insulæ quasi pulvis exiguus. <l eID="gen20571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8313"/><l level="1" sID="gen20572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8313"/>Et Libanus non sufficiet ad succendendum, <l eID="gen20572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20573"/>et animalia ejus non sufficient ad holocaustum. <l eID="gen20573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8314"/><l level="1" sID="gen20574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8314"/>Omnes gentes quasi non sint, sic sunt coram eo, <l eID="gen20574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20575"/>et quasi nihilum et inane reputatæ sunt ei. <l eID="gen20575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8315"/><l level="1" sID="gen20576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8315"/>Cui ergo similem fecisti Deum ? <l eID="gen20576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20577"/>aut quam imaginem ponetis ei ? <l eID="gen20577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8316"/><l level="1" sID="gen20578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8316"/>Numquid sculptile conflavit faber ? <l eID="gen20578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20579"/>aut aurifex auro figuravit illud, <l eID="gen20579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20580"/>et laminis argenteis argentarius ? <l eID="gen20580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8317"/><l level="1" sID="gen20581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8317"/>Forte lignum et imputribile elegit ; <l eID="gen20581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20582"/>artifex sapiens quærit <l eID="gen20582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20583"/>quomodo statuat simulacrum, quod non moveatur. <l eID="gen20583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8318"/><l level="1" sID="gen20584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8318"/>Numquid non scitis ? numquid non audistis ? <l eID="gen20584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20585"/>numquid non annuntiatum est vobis ab initio ? <l eID="gen20585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20586"/>numquid non intellexistis fundamenta terræ ? <l eID="gen20586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8319"/><l level="1" sID="gen20587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8319"/>Qui sedet super gyrum terræ, <l eID="gen20587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20588"/>et habitatores ejus sunt quasi locustæ ; <l eID="gen20588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20589"/>qui extendit velut nihilum cælos, <l eID="gen20589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20590"/>et expandit eos sicut tabernaculum ad inhabitandum ; <l eID="gen20590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8320"/><l level="1" sID="gen20591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8320"/>qui dat secretorum scrutatores quasi non sint, <l eID="gen20591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20592"/>judices terræ velut inane fecit. <l eID="gen20592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8321"/><l level="1" sID="gen20593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8321"/>Et quidem neque plantatus, neque satus, <l eID="gen20593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20594"/>neque radicatus in terra truncus eorum ; <l eID="gen20594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20595"/>repente flavit in eos, et aruerunt, <l eID="gen20595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20596"/>et turbo quasi stipulam auferet eos. <l eID="gen20596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8322"/><l level="1" sID="gen20597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8322"/>Et cui assimilastis me, et adæquastis ? <l eID="gen20597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20598"/>dicit Sanctus. <l eID="gen20598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8323"/><l level="1" sID="gen20599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8323"/>Levate in excelsum oculos vestros, et videte <l eID="gen20599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20600"/>quis creavit hæc : <l eID="gen20600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20601"/>qui educit in numero militiam eorum, <l eID="gen20601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20602"/>et omnes ex nomine vocat ; <l eID="gen20602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20603"/>præ multitudine fortitudinis et roboris, virtutisque ejus, <l eID="gen20603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20604"/>neque unum reliquum fuit. <l eID="gen20604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8324"/><l level="1" sID="gen20605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8324"/>Quare dicis, Jacob, <l eID="gen20605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20606"/>et loqueris, Israël : <l eID="gen20606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20607"/>Abscondita est via mea a Domino, <l eID="gen20607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20608"/>et a Deo meo judicium meum transivit ? <l eID="gen20608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8325"/><l level="1" sID="gen20609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8325"/>Numquid nescis, aut non audisti ? <l eID="gen20609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20610"/>Deus sempiternus Dominus, <l eID="gen20610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20611"/>qui creavit terminos terræ : <l eID="gen20611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20612"/>non deficiet, neque laborabit, <l eID="gen20612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20613"/>nec est investigatio sapientiæ ejus. <l eID="gen20613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8326"/><l level="1" sID="gen20614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8326"/>Qui dat lasso virtutem, <l eID="gen20614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20615"/>et his qui non sunt, fortitudinem et robur multiplicat. <l eID="gen20615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8327"/><l level="1" sID="gen20616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8327"/>Deficient pueri, et laborabunt, <l eID="gen20616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20617"/>et juvenes in infirmitate cadent ; <l eID="gen20617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 40:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8328"/><l level="1" sID="gen20618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8328"/>qui autem sperant in Domino mutabunt fortitudinem, <l eID="gen20618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20619"/>assument pennas sicut aquilæ : <l eID="gen20619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20620"/>current et non laborabunt, <l eID="gen20620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20621"/>ambulabunt et non deficient.  <chapter eID="Isa.40"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:1
verses.text: Taceant ad me insulæ, <l eID="gen20622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20623"/>et gentes mutent fortitudinem : <l eID="gen20623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20624"/>accedant, et tunc loquantur ; <l eID="gen20624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20625"/>simul ad judicium propinquemus. <l eID="gen20625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8329"/><l level="1" sID="gen20626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8329"/>Quis suscitavit ab oriente Justum, <l eID="gen20626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20627"/>vocavit eum ut sequeretur se ? <l eID="gen20627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20628"/>Dabit in conspectu ejus gentes, <l eID="gen20628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20629"/>et reges obtinebit : <l eID="gen20629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20630"/>dabit quasi pulverem gladio ejus, <l eID="gen20630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20631"/>sicut stipulam vento raptam arcui ejus. <l eID="gen20631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8330"/><l level="1" sID="gen20632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8330"/>Persequetur eos, transibit in pace : <l eID="gen20632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20633"/>semita in pedibus ejus non apparebit. <l eID="gen20633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8331"/><l level="1" sID="gen20634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8331"/>Quis hæc operatus est, et fecit, <l eID="gen20634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20635"/>vocans generationes ab exordio ? <l eID="gen20635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20636"/>Ego Dominus : <l eID="gen20636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20637"/>primus et novissimus ego sum. <l eID="gen20637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8332"/><l level="1" sID="gen20638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8332"/>Viderunt insulæ, et timuerunt ; <l eID="gen20638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20639"/>extrema terræ obstupuerunt : <l eID="gen20639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20640"/>appropinquaverunt, et accesserunt. <l eID="gen20640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8333"/><l level="1" sID="gen20641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8333"/>Unusquisque proximo suo auxiliabitur, <l eID="gen20641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20642"/>et fratri suo dicet : Confortare. <l eID="gen20642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8334"/><l level="1" sID="gen20643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8334"/>Confortavit faber ærarius <l eID="gen20643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20644"/>percutiens malleo <l eID="gen20644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20645"/>eum, qui cudebat tunc temporis, <l eID="gen20645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20646"/>dicens : Glutino bonum est ; <l eID="gen20646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20647"/>et confortavit eum clavis, ut non moveretur. <l eID="gen20647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8335"/><l level="1" sID="gen20648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8335"/>Et tu, Israël, serve meus, <l eID="gen20648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20649"/>Jacob quem elegi, <l eID="gen20649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20650"/>semen Abraham amici mei : <l eID="gen20650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8336"/><l level="1" sID="gen20651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8336"/>in quo apprehendi te ab extremis terræ, <l eID="gen20651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20652"/>et a longinquis ejus vocavi te, <l eID="gen20652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20653"/>et dixi tibi : Servus meus es tu : <l eID="gen20653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20654"/>elegi te, et non abjeci te. <l eID="gen20654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8337"/><l level="1" sID="gen20655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8337"/>Ne timeas, quia ego tecum sum ; <l eID="gen20655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20656"/>ne declines, quia ego Deus tuus : <l eID="gen20656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20657"/>confortavi te, et auxiliatus sum tibi, <l eID="gen20657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20658"/>et suscepit te dextera Justi mei. <l eID="gen20658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8338"/><l level="1" sID="gen20659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8338"/>Ecce confundentur et erubescent <l eID="gen20659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20660"/>omnes qui pugnant adversum te ; <l eID="gen20660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20661"/>erunt quasi non sint, et peribunt <l eID="gen20661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20662"/>viri qui contradicunt tibi. <l eID="gen20662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8339"/><l level="1" sID="gen20663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8339"/>Quæres eos, et non invenies, <l eID="gen20663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20664"/>viros rebelles tuos ; <l eID="gen20664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20665"/>erunt quasi non sint, et veluti consumptio <l eID="gen20665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20666"/>homines bellantes adversum te. <l eID="gen20666" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8340"/><l level="1" sID="gen20667"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8340"/>Quia ego Dominus Deus tuus, <l eID="gen20667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20668"/>apprehendens manum tuam, <l eID="gen20668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20669"/>dicensque tibi : Ne timeas : <l eID="gen20669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20670"/>ego adjuvi te. <l eID="gen20670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8341"/><l level="1" sID="gen20671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8341"/>Noli timere, vermis Jacob, <l eID="gen20671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20672"/>qui mortui estis ex Israël : <l eID="gen20672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20673"/>ego auxiliatus sum tibi, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen20673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20674"/>et redemptor tuus Sanctus Israël. <l eID="gen20674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8342"/><l level="1" sID="gen20675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8342"/>Ego posui te quasi plaustrum triturans novum, <l eID="gen20675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20676"/>habens rostra serrantia ; <l eID="gen20676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20677"/>triturabis montes, et comminues, <l eID="gen20677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20678"/>et colles quasi pulverem pones. <l eID="gen20678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8343"/><l level="1" sID="gen20679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8343"/>Ventilabis eos, et ventus tollet, <l eID="gen20679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20680"/>et turbo disperget eos ; <l eID="gen20680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20681"/>et tu exsultabis in Domino, <l eID="gen20681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20682"/>in Sancto Israël lætaberis. <l eID="gen20682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8344"/><l level="1" sID="gen20683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8344"/>Egeni et pauperes <l eID="gen20683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20684"/>quærunt aquas, et non sunt ; <l eID="gen20684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20685"/>lingua eorum siti aruit. <l eID="gen20685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20686"/>Ego Dominus exaudiam eos, <l eID="gen20686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20687"/>Deus Israël, non derelinquam eos. <l eID="gen20687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8345"/><l level="1" sID="gen20688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8345"/>Aperiam in supinis collibus flumina, <l eID="gen20688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20689"/>et in medio camporum fontes : <l eID="gen20689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20690"/>ponam desertum in stagna aquarum, <l eID="gen20690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20691"/>et terram inviam in rivos aquarum. <l eID="gen20691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8346"/><l level="1" sID="gen20692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8346"/>Dabo in solitudinem cedrum, <l eID="gen20692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20693"/>et spinam, et myrtum, et lignum olivæ ; <l eID="gen20693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20694"/>ponam in deserto abietem, <l eID="gen20694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20695"/>ulmum, et buxum simul : <l eID="gen20695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8347"/><l level="1" sID="gen20696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8347"/>ut videant, et sciant, <l eID="gen20696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20697"/>et recogitent, et intelligant pariter, <l eID="gen20697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20698"/>quia manus Domini fecit hoc, <l eID="gen20698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20699"/>et Sanctus Israël creavit illud. <l eID="gen20699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8348"/><l level="1" sID="gen20700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8348"/>Prope facite judicium vestrum, <l eID="gen20700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20701"/>dicit Dominus ; <l eID="gen20701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20702"/>Afferte, si quid forte habetis, <l eID="gen20702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20703"/>dicit rex Jacob. <l eID="gen20703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8349"/><l level="1" sID="gen20704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8349"/>Accedant, et nuntient nobis <l eID="gen20704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20705"/>quæcumque ventura sunt ; <l eID="gen20705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20706"/>priora quæ fuerunt, nuntiate, <l eID="gen20706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20707"/>et ponemus cor nostrum, <l eID="gen20707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20708"/>et sciemus novissima eorum ; <l eID="gen20708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20709"/>et quæ ventura sunt, indicate nobis. <l eID="gen20709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8350"/><l level="1" sID="gen20710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8350"/>Annuntiate quæ ventura sunt in futurum, <l eID="gen20710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20711"/>et sciemus quia dii estis vos ; <l eID="gen20711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20712"/>bene quoque aut male, si potestis, facite, <l eID="gen20712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20713"/>et loquamur et videamus simul. <l eID="gen20713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8351"/><l level="1" sID="gen20714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8351"/>Ecce vos estis ex nihilo, <l eID="gen20714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20715"/>et opus vestrum ex eo quod non est : <l eID="gen20715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20716"/>abominatio est qui elegit vos. <l eID="gen20716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8352"/><l level="1" sID="gen20717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8352"/>Suscitavi ab aquilone, et veniet ab ortu solis : <l eID="gen20717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20718"/>vocabit nomen meum, <l eID="gen20718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20719"/>et adducet magistratus quasi lutum, <l eID="gen20719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20720"/>et velut plastes conculcans humum. <l eID="gen20720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8353"/><l level="1" sID="gen20721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8353"/>Quis annuntiavit ab exordio ut sciamus, <l eID="gen20721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20722"/>et a principio ut dicamus : Justus es ? <l eID="gen20722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20723"/>Non est neque annuntians, neque prædicens, <l eID="gen20723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20724"/>neque audiens sermones vestros. <l eID="gen20724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8354"/><l level="1" sID="gen20725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8354"/>Primus ad Sion dicet : Ecce adsunt, <l eID="gen20725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20726"/>et Jerusalem evangelistam dabo. <l eID="gen20726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8355"/><l level="1" sID="gen20727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8355"/>Et vidi, <l eID="gen20727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20728"/>et non erat neque ex istis quisquam <l eID="gen20728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20729"/>qui iniret consilium, <l eID="gen20729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20730"/>et interrogatus responderet verbum. <l eID="gen20730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 41:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8356"/><l level="1" sID="gen20731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8356"/>Ecce omnes injusti, <l eID="gen20731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20732"/>et vana opera eorum ; <l eID="gen20732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20733"/>ventus et inane simulacra eorum.  <chapter eID="Isa.41"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:1
verses.text: Ecce servus meus, suscipiam eum ; <l eID="gen20734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20735"/>electus meus, complacuit sibi in illo anima mea : <l eID="gen20735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20736"/>dedi spiritum meum super eum : <l eID="gen20736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20737"/>judicium gentibus proferet. <l eID="gen20737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8357"/><l level="1" sID="gen20738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8357"/>Non clamabit, neque accipiet personam, <l eID="gen20738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20739"/>nec audietur vox ejus foris. <l eID="gen20739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8358"/><l level="1" sID="gen20740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8358"/>Calamum quassatum non conteret, <l eID="gen20740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20741"/>et linum fumigans non extinguet : <l eID="gen20741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20742"/>in veritate educet judicium. <l eID="gen20742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8359"/><l level="1" sID="gen20743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8359"/>Non erit tristis, neque turbulentus, <l eID="gen20743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20744"/>donec ponat in terra judicium ; <l eID="gen20744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20745"/>et legem ejus insulæ exspectabunt. <l eID="gen20745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8360"/><l level="1" sID="gen20746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8360"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen20746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20747"/>creans cælos, et extendens eos ; <l eID="gen20747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20748"/>firmans terram, et quæ germinant ex ea ; <l eID="gen20748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20749"/>dans flatum populo qui est super eam, <l eID="gen20749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20750"/>et spiritum calcantibus eam : <l eID="gen20750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8361"/><l level="1" sID="gen20751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8361"/>Ego Dominus vocavi te in justitia, <l eID="gen20751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20752"/>et apprehendi manum tuam, <l eID="gen20752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20753"/>et servavi te : <l eID="gen20753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20754"/>et dedi te in fœdus populi, <l eID="gen20754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20755"/>in lucem gentium, <l eID="gen20755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8362"/><l level="1" sID="gen20756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8362"/>ut aperires oculos cæcorum, <l eID="gen20756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20757"/>et educeres de conclusione vinctum, <l eID="gen20757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20758"/>de domo carceris sedentes in tenebris. <l eID="gen20758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8363"/><l level="1" sID="gen20759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8363"/>Ego Dominus, <l eID="gen20759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20760"/>hoc est nomen meum ; <l eID="gen20760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20761"/>gloriam meam alteri non dabo, <l eID="gen20761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20762"/>et laudem meam sculptilibus. <l eID="gen20762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8364"/><l level="1" sID="gen20763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8364"/>Quæ prima fuerunt, ecce venerunt ; <l eID="gen20763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20764"/>nova quoque ego annuntio : <l eID="gen20764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20765"/>antequam oriantur, <l eID="gen20765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20766"/>audita vobis faciam. <l eID="gen20766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8365"/><l level="1" sID="gen20767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8365"/>Cantate Domino canticum novum, <l eID="gen20767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20768"/>laus ejus ab extremis terræ, <l eID="gen20768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20769"/>qui descenditis in mare, et plenitudo ejus ; <l eID="gen20769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20770"/>insulæ, et habitatores earum. <l eID="gen20770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8366"/><l level="1" sID="gen20771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8366"/>Sublevetur desertum et civitates ejus. <l eID="gen20771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20772"/>In domibus habitabit Cedar : <l eID="gen20772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20773"/>laudate, habitatores petræ ; <l eID="gen20773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20774"/>de vertice montium clamabunt. <l eID="gen20774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8367"/><l level="1" sID="gen20775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8367"/>Ponent Domino gloriam, <l eID="gen20775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20776"/>et laudem ejus in insulis nuntiabunt. <l eID="gen20776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8368"/><l level="1" sID="gen20777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8368"/>Dominus sicut fortis egredietur, <l eID="gen20777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20778"/>sicut vir præliator suscitabit zelum ; <l eID="gen20778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20779"/>vociferabitur, et clamabit : <l eID="gen20779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20780"/>super inimicos suos confortabitur. <l eID="gen20780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8369"/><l level="1" sID="gen20781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8369"/>Tacui semper, <l eID="gen20781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20782"/>silui, patiens fui : <l eID="gen20782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20783"/>sicut parturiens loquar ; <l eID="gen20783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20784"/>dissipabo, et absorbebo simul. <l eID="gen20784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8370"/><l level="1" sID="gen20785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8370"/>Desertos faciam montes et colles, <l eID="gen20785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20786"/>et omne gramen eorum exsiccabo ; <l eID="gen20786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20787"/>et ponam flumina in insulas, <l eID="gen20787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20788"/>et stagna arefaciam. <l eID="gen20788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8371"/><l level="1" sID="gen20789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8371"/>Et ducam cæcos in viam quam nesciunt, <l eID="gen20789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20790"/>et in semitis quas ignoraverunt ambulare eos faciam ; <l eID="gen20790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20791"/>ponam tenebras coram eis in lucem, <l eID="gen20791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20792"/>et prava in recta ; <l eID="gen20792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20793"/>hæc verba feci eis, <l eID="gen20793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20794"/>et non dereliqui eos. <l eID="gen20794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8372"/><l level="1" sID="gen20795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8372"/>Conversi sunt retrorsum, confundantur confusione, <l eID="gen20795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20796"/>qui confidunt in sculptili ; <l eID="gen20796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20797"/>qui dicunt conflatili : <l eID="gen20797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20798"/>Vos dii nostri. <l eID="gen20798" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8373"/><l level="1" sID="gen20799"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8373"/>Surdi, audite, <l eID="gen20799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20800"/>et cæci, intuemini ad videndum. <l eID="gen20800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8374"/><l level="1" sID="gen20801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8374"/>Quis cæcus, nisi servus meus ; <l eID="gen20801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20802"/>et surdus, nisi ad quem nuntios meos misi ? <l eID="gen20802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20803"/>quis cæcus, nisi qui venundatus est ? <l eID="gen20803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20804"/>et quis cæcus, nisi servus Domini ? <l eID="gen20804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8375"/><l level="1" sID="gen20805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8375"/>Qui vides multa, nonne custodies ? <l eID="gen20805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20806"/>qui apertas habes aures, nonne audies ? <l eID="gen20806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8376"/><l level="1" sID="gen20807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8376"/>Et Dominus voluit ut sanctificaret eum, <l eID="gen20807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20808"/>et magnificaret legem, et extolleret. <l eID="gen20808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8377"/><l level="1" sID="gen20809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8377"/>Ipse autem populus direptus, et vastatus ; <l eID="gen20809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20810"/>laqueus juvenum omnes, <l eID="gen20810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20811"/>et in domibus carcerum absconditi sunt ; <l eID="gen20811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20812"/>facti sunt in rapinam, nec est qui eruat ; <l eID="gen20812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20813"/>in direptionem, nec est qui dicat : Redde. <l eID="gen20813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8378"/><l level="1" sID="gen20814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8378"/>Quis est in vobis qui audiat hoc, <l eID="gen20814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20815"/>attendat, et auscultet futura ? <l eID="gen20815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8379"/><l level="1" sID="gen20816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8379"/>Quis dedit in direptionem Jacob, <l eID="gen20816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20817"/>et Israël vastantibus ? <l eID="gen20817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20818"/>nonne Dominus ipse, cui peccavimus ? <l eID="gen20818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20819"/>Et noluerunt in viis ejus ambulare, <l eID="gen20819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20820"/>et non audierunt legem ejus. <l eID="gen20820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 42:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8380"/><l level="1" sID="gen20821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8380"/>Et effudit super eum indignationem furoris sui, <l eID="gen20821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20822"/>et forte bellum ; <l eID="gen20822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20823"/>et combussit eum in circuitu, et non cognovit ; <l eID="gen20823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20824"/>et succendit eum, et non intellexit.  <chapter eID="Isa.42"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:1
verses.text: Et nunc hæc dicit Dominus <l eID="gen20825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20826"/>creans te, Jacob, <l eID="gen20826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20827"/>et formans te, Israël : <l eID="gen20827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20828"/>Noli timere, quia redemi te, <l eID="gen20828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20829"/>et vocavi te nomine tuo : meus es tu. <l eID="gen20829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8381"/><l level="1" sID="gen20830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8381"/>Cum transieris per aquas, tecum ero, <l eID="gen20830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20831"/>et flumina non operient te ; <l eID="gen20831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20832"/>cum ambulaveris in igne, non combureris, et flamma non ardebit in te. <l eID="gen20832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8382"/><l level="1" sID="gen20833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8382"/>Quia ego Dominus Deus tuus, <l eID="gen20833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20834"/>Sanctus Israël, salvator tuus, <l eID="gen20834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20835"/>dedi propitiationem tuam Ægyptum, <l eID="gen20835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20836"/>Æthopiam, et Saba, pro te. <l eID="gen20836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8383"/><l level="1" sID="gen20837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8383"/>Ex quo honorabilis factus es in oculis meis, <l eID="gen20837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20838"/>et gloriosus, ego dilexi te, <l eID="gen20838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20839"/>et dabo homines pro te, <l eID="gen20839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20840"/>et populos pro anima tua. <l eID="gen20840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8384"/><l level="1" sID="gen20841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8384"/>Noli timere, quia ego tecum sum ; <l eID="gen20841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20842"/>ab oriente adducam semen tuum, <l eID="gen20842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20843"/>et ab occidente congregabo te. <l eID="gen20843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8385"/><l level="1" sID="gen20844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8385"/>Dicam aquiloni : Da ; <l eID="gen20844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20845"/>et austro : Noli prohibere : <l eID="gen20845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20846"/>affer filios meos de longinquo, <l eID="gen20846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20847"/>et filias meas ab extremis terræ. <l eID="gen20847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8386"/><l level="1" sID="gen20848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8386"/>Et omnem qui invocat nomen meum, <l eID="gen20848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20849"/>in gloriam meam creavi eum, formavi eum, et feci eum. <l eID="gen20849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8387"/><l level="1" sID="gen20850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8387"/>Educ foras populum cæcum, et oculos habentem ; <l eID="gen20850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20851"/>surdum, et aures ei sunt. <l eID="gen20851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8388"/><l level="1" sID="gen20852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8388"/>Omnes gentes congregatæ sunt simul, <l eID="gen20852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20853"/>et collectæ sunt tribus. <l eID="gen20853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20854"/>Quis in vobis annuntiet istud, <l eID="gen20854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20855"/>et quæ prima sunt audire nos faciet ? <l eID="gen20855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20856"/>Dent testes eorum, justificentur, <l eID="gen20856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20857"/>et audiant, et dicant : Vere. <l eID="gen20857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8389"/><l level="1" sID="gen20858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8389"/>Vos testes mei, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen20858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20859"/>et servus meus quem elegi : <l eID="gen20859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20860"/>ut sciatis, et credatis mihi, <l eID="gen20860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20861"/>et intelligatis quia ego ipse sum ; <l eID="gen20861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20862"/>ante me non est formatus Deus, <l eID="gen20862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20863"/>et post me non erit. <l eID="gen20863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8390"/><l level="1" sID="gen20864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8390"/>Ego sum, ego sum Dominus, <l eID="gen20864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20865"/>et non est absque me salvator. <l eID="gen20865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8391"/><l level="1" sID="gen20866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8391"/>Ego annuntiavi, et salvavi ; auditum feci, <l eID="gen20866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20867"/>et non fuit in vobis alienus : <l eID="gen20867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20868"/>vos testes mei, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen20868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20869"/>et ego Deus. <l eID="gen20869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8392"/><l level="1" sID="gen20870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8392"/>Et ab initio ego ipse, <l eID="gen20870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20871"/>et non est qui de manu mea eruat. <l eID="gen20871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20872"/>Operabor, et quis avertet illud ? <l eID="gen20872" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8393"/><l level="1" sID="gen20873"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8393"/>Hæc dicit Dominus, redemptor vester, <l eID="gen20873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20874"/>Sanctus Israël : <l eID="gen20874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20875"/>Propter vos misi in Babylonem, <l eID="gen20875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20876"/>et detraxi vectes universos, <l eID="gen20876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20877"/>et Chaldæos in navibus suis gloriantes. <l eID="gen20877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8394"/><l level="1" sID="gen20878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8394"/>Ego Dominus, Sanctus vester, <l eID="gen20878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20879"/>creans Israël, rex vester. <l eID="gen20879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8395"/><l level="1" sID="gen20880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8395"/>Hæc dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen20880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20881"/>qui dedit in mari viam, <l eID="gen20881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20882"/>et in aquis torrentibus semitam ; <l eID="gen20882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8396"/><l level="1" sID="gen20883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8396"/>qui eduxit quadrigam et equum, <l eID="gen20883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20884"/>agmen et robustum : <l eID="gen20884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20885"/>simul obdormierunt, nec resurgent ; <l eID="gen20885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20886"/>contriti sunt quasi linum, et extincti sunt. <l eID="gen20886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8397"/><l level="1" sID="gen20887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8397"/>Ne memineritis priorum, <l eID="gen20887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20888"/>et antiqua ne intueamini. <l eID="gen20888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8398"/><l level="1" sID="gen20889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8398"/>Ecce ego facio nova, <l eID="gen20889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20890"/>et nunc orientur, utique cognoscetis ea : <l eID="gen20890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20891"/>ponam in deserto viam, <l eID="gen20891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20892"/>et in invio flumina. <l eID="gen20892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:20
