verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8399"/><l level="1" sID="gen20893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8399"/>Glorificabit me bestia agri, <l eID="gen20893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20894"/>dracones, et struthiones : <l eID="gen20894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20895"/>quia dedi in deserto aquas, <l eID="gen20895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20896"/>flumina in invio, <l eID="gen20896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20897"/>ut darem potum populo meo, electo meo. <l eID="gen20897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8400"/><l level="1" sID="gen20898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8400"/>Populum istum formavi mihi : <l eID="gen20898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20899"/>laudem meam narrabit. <l eID="gen20899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8401"/><l level="1" sID="gen20900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8401"/>Non me invocasti, Jacob, <l eID="gen20900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20901"/>nec laborasti in me, Israël. <l eID="gen20901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8402"/><l level="1" sID="gen20902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8402"/>Non obtulisti mihi arietem holocausti tui, <l eID="gen20902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20903"/>et victimis tuis non glorificasti me ; <l eID="gen20903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20904"/>non te servire feci in oblatione, <l eID="gen20904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20905"/>nec laborem tibi præbui in thure. <l eID="gen20905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8403"/><l level="1" sID="gen20906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8403"/>Non emisti mihi argento calamum, <l eID="gen20906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20907"/>et adipe victimarum tuarum non inebriasti me : <l eID="gen20907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20908"/>verumtamen servire me fecisti in peccatis tuis ; <l eID="gen20908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20909"/>præbuisti mihi laborem in iniquitatibus tuis. <l eID="gen20909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8404"/><l level="1" sID="gen20910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8404"/>Ego sum, ego sum ipse qui deleo iniquitates tuas propter me, <l eID="gen20910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20911"/>et peccatorum tuorum non recordabor. <l eID="gen20911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8405"/><l level="1" sID="gen20912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8405"/>Reduc me in memoriam, et judicemur simul : <l eID="gen20912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20913"/>narra si quid habes ut justificeris. <l eID="gen20913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8406"/><l level="1" sID="gen20914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8406"/>Pater tuus primus peccavit, <l eID="gen20914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20915"/>et interpretes tui prævaricati sunt in me : <l eID="gen20915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 43:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8407"/><l level="1" sID="gen20916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8407"/>et contaminavi principes sanctos ; <l eID="gen20916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20917"/>dedi ad internecionem Jacob, <l eID="gen20917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20918"/>et Israël in blasphemiam.  <chapter eID="Isa.43"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:1
verses.text: Et nunc audi, Jacob, serve meus, <l eID="gen20919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20920"/>et Israël, quem elegi. <l eID="gen20920" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8408"/><l level="1" sID="gen20921"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8408"/>Hæc dicit Dominus faciens et formans te, <l eID="gen20921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20922"/>ab utero auxiliator tuus : <l eID="gen20922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20923"/>Noli timere, serve meus Jacob, <l eID="gen20923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20924"/>et rectissime, quem elegi. <l eID="gen20924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8409"/><l level="1" sID="gen20925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8409"/>Effundam enim aquas super sitientem, <l eID="gen20925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20926"/>et fluenta super aridam ; <l eID="gen20926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20927"/>effundam spiritum meum super semen tuum, <l eID="gen20927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20928"/>et benedictionem meam super stirpem tuam : <l eID="gen20928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8410"/><l level="1" sID="gen20929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8410"/>et germinabunt inter herbas, <l eID="gen20929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20930"/>quasi salices juxta præterfluentes aquas. <l eID="gen20930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8411"/><l level="1" sID="gen20931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8411"/>Iste dicet : Domini ego sum ; <l eID="gen20931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20932"/>et ille vocabit in nomine Jacob ; <l eID="gen20932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20933"/>et hic scribet manu sua : Domino, <l eID="gen20933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20934"/>et in nomine Israël assimilabitur. <l eID="gen20934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8412"/><l level="1" sID="gen20935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8412"/>Hæc dicit Dominus, rex Israël, <l eID="gen20935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20936"/>et redemptor ejus, Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen20936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20937"/>Ego primus, et ego novissimus, <l eID="gen20937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20938"/>et absque me non est deus. <l eID="gen20938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8413"/><l level="1" sID="gen20939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8413"/>Quis similis mei ? vocet, <l eID="gen20939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20940"/>et annuntiet : et ordinem exponat mihi, <l eID="gen20940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20941"/>ex quo constitui populum antiquum ; <l eID="gen20941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20942"/>ventura et quæ futura sunt annuntient eis. <l eID="gen20942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8414"/><l level="1" sID="gen20943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8414"/>Nolite timere, neque conturbemini : <l eID="gen20943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20944"/>ex tunc audire te feci, <l eID="gen20944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20945"/>et annuntiavi ; vos estis testes mei. <l eID="gen20945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20946"/>Numquid est Deus absque me, <l eID="gen20946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20947"/>et formator quem ego non noverim ? <l eID="gen20947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8415"/><l level="1" sID="gen20948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8415"/>Plastæ idoli omnes nihil sunt, <l eID="gen20948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20949"/>et amantissima eorum non proderunt eis. <l eID="gen20949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20950"/>Ipsi sunt testes eorum, quia non vident, <l eID="gen20950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20951"/>neque intelligunt, ut confundantur. <l eID="gen20951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8416"/><l level="1" sID="gen20952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8416"/>Quis formavit deum, <l eID="gen20952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20953"/>et sculptile conflavit ad nihil utile ? <l eID="gen20953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8417"/><l level="1" sID="gen20954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8417"/>Ecce omnes participes ejus confundentur, <l eID="gen20954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20955"/>fabri enim sunt ex hominibus ; <l eID="gen20955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20956"/>convenient omnes, stabunt <l eID="gen20956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20957"/>et pavebunt, et confundentur simul. <l eID="gen20957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8418"/><l level="1" sID="gen20958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8418"/>Faber ferrarius lima operatus est, <l eID="gen20958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20959"/>in prunis et in malleis formavit illud, <l eID="gen20959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20960"/>et operatus est in brachio fortitudinis suæ ; <l eID="gen20960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20961"/>esuriet et deficiet, <l eID="gen20961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20962"/>non bibet aquam et lassescet. <l eID="gen20962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8419"/><l level="1" sID="gen20963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8419"/>Artifex lignarius extendit normam, <l eID="gen20963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20964"/>formavit illud in runcina, <l eID="gen20964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20965"/>fecit illud in angularibus, <l eID="gen20965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20966"/>et in circino tornavit illud, <l eID="gen20966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20967"/>et fecit imaginem viri <l eID="gen20967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20968"/>quasi speciosum hominem <l eID="gen20968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20969"/>habitantem in domo ; <l eID="gen20969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8420"/><l level="1" sID="gen20970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8420"/>succidit cedros, <l eID="gen20970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20971"/>tulit ilicem, et quercum, <l eID="gen20971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20972"/>quæ steterat inter ligna saltus ; <l eID="gen20972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20973"/>plantavit pinum, quam pluvia nutrivit : <l eID="gen20973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8421"/><l level="1" sID="gen20974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8421"/>et facta est hominibus in focum ; <l eID="gen20974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20975"/>sumpsit ex eis, et calefactus est ; <l eID="gen20975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20976"/>et succendit et coxit panes ; <l eID="gen20976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20977"/>de reliquo autem operatus est deum et adoravit ; <l eID="gen20977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20978"/>fecit sculptile, et curvatus est ante illud. <l eID="gen20978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8422"/><l level="1" sID="gen20979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8422"/>Medium ejus combussit igni, <l eID="gen20979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20980"/>et de medio ejus carnes comedit ; <l eID="gen20980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20981"/>coxit pulmentum, et saturatus est, <l eID="gen20981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20982"/>et calefactus est, et dixit : Vah ! <l eID="gen20982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20983"/>calefactus sum, vidi focum ; <l eID="gen20983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8423"/><l level="1" sID="gen20984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8423"/>reliquum autem ejus deum fecit et sculptile sibi ; <l eID="gen20984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20985"/>curvatur ante illud, et adorat illud, <l eID="gen20985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20986"/>et obsecrat, dicens : <l eID="gen20986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20987"/>Libera me, quia deus meus es tu ! <l eID="gen20987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8424"/><l level="1" sID="gen20988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8424"/>Nescierunt, neque intellexerunt ; <l eID="gen20988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20989"/>obliti enim sunt ne videant oculi eorum, <l eID="gen20989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20990"/>et ne intelligant corde suo. <l eID="gen20990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8425"/><l level="1" sID="gen20991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8425"/>Non recogitant in mente sua, <l eID="gen20991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20992"/>neque cognoscunt, neque sentiunt, ut dicant : <l eID="gen20992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20993"/>Medietatem ejus combussi igni, <l eID="gen20993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20994"/>et coxi super carbones ejus panes ; <l eID="gen20994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20995"/>coxi carnes et comedi, <l eID="gen20995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20996"/>et de reliquo ejus idolum faciam ? <l eID="gen20996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20997"/>ante truncum ligni procidam ? <l eID="gen20997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8426"/><l level="1" sID="gen20998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8426"/>Pars ejus cinis est ; <l eID="gen20998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen20999"/>cor insipiens adoravit illud, <l eID="gen20999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21000"/>et non liberabit animam suam : <l eID="gen21000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21001"/>neque dicet : Forte mendacium est in dextera mea. <l eID="gen21001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8427"/><l level="1" sID="gen21002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8427"/>Memento horum Jacob, <l eID="gen21002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21003"/>et Israël, quoniam servus meus es tu. <l eID="gen21003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21004"/>Formavi te ; servus meus es tu, <l eID="gen21004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21005"/>Israël, ne obliviscaris mei. <l eID="gen21005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8428"/><l level="1" sID="gen21006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8428"/>Delevi ut nubem iniquitates tuas, <l eID="gen21006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21007"/>et quasi nebulam peccata tua : <l eID="gen21007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21008"/>revertere ad me, quoniam redemi te. <l eID="gen21008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8429"/><l level="1" sID="gen21009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8429"/>Laudate, cæli, quoniam misericordiam fecit Dominus ; <l eID="gen21009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21010"/>jubilate, extrema terræ ; <l eID="gen21010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21011"/>resonate, montes, laudationem, <l eID="gen21011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21012"/>saltus et omne lignum ejus, <l eID="gen21012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21013"/>quoniam redemit Dominus Jacob, <l eID="gen21013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21014"/>et Israël gloriabitur. <l eID="gen21014" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8430"/><l level="1" sID="gen21015"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8430"/>Hæc dicit Dominus, redemptor tuus, <l eID="gen21015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21016"/>et formator tuus ex utero : <l eID="gen21016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21017"/>Ego sum Dominus, faciens omnia, <l eID="gen21017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21018"/>extendens cælos solus, <l eID="gen21018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21019"/>stabiliens terram, et nullus mecum ; <l eID="gen21019" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8431"/><l level="1" sID="gen21020"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8431"/>irrita faciens signa divinorum, <l eID="gen21020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21021"/>et ariolos in furorem vertens ; <l eID="gen21021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21022"/>convertens sapientes retrorsum, <l eID="gen21022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21023"/>et scientiam eorum stultam faciens ; <l eID="gen21023" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8432"/><l level="1" sID="gen21024"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8432"/>suscitans verbum servi sui, <l eID="gen21024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21025"/>et consilium nuntiorum suorum complens ; <l eID="gen21025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21026"/>qui dico Jerusalem : Habitaberis, <l eID="gen21026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21027"/>et civitatibus Juda : Ædificabimini, <l eID="gen21027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21028"/>et deserta ejus suscitabo ; <l eID="gen21028" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8433"/><l level="1" sID="gen21029"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8433"/>qui dico profundo : Desolare, <l eID="gen21029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21030"/>et flumina tua arefaciam ; <l eID="gen21030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 44:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8434"/><l level="1" sID="gen21031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8434"/>qui dico Cyro : Pastor meus es, <l eID="gen21031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21032"/>et omnem voluntatem meam complebis ; <l eID="gen21032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21033"/>qui dico Jerusalem : Ædificaberis, <l eID="gen21033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21034"/>et templo : Fundaberis.  <chapter eID="Isa.44"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus christo meo Cyro, <l eID="gen21035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21036"/>cujus apprehendi dexteram, <l eID="gen21036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21037"/>ut subjiciam ante faciem ejus gentes, <l eID="gen21037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21038"/>et dorsa regum vertam, <l eID="gen21038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21039"/>et aperiam coram eo januas, <l eID="gen21039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21040"/>et portæ non claudentur : <l eID="gen21040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8435"/><l level="1" sID="gen21041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8435"/>Ego ante te ibo, et gloriosos terræ humiliabo ; <l eID="gen21041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21042"/>portas æreas conteram, <l eID="gen21042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21043"/>et vectes ferreos confringam : <l eID="gen21043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8436"/><l level="1" sID="gen21044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8436"/>et dabo tibi thesauros absconditos, <l eID="gen21044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21045"/>et arcana secretorum, <l eID="gen21045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21046"/>ut scias quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen21046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21047"/>qui voco nomen tuum, Deus Israël, <l eID="gen21047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8437"/><l level="1" sID="gen21048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8437"/>propter servum meum Jacob, <l eID="gen21048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21049"/>et Israël, electum meum ; <l eID="gen21049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21050"/>et vocavi te nomine tuo : <l eID="gen21050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21051"/>assimilavi te, et non cognovisti me. <l eID="gen21051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8438"/><l level="1" sID="gen21052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8438"/>Ego Dominus, et non est amplius ; <l eID="gen21052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21053"/>extra me non est deus ; <l eID="gen21053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21054"/>accinxi te, et non cognovisti me : <l eID="gen21054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8439"/><l level="1" sID="gen21055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8439"/>ut sciant hi qui ab ortu solis et qui ab occidente, <l eID="gen21055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21056"/>quoniam absque me non est : <l eID="gen21056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21057"/>ego Dominus, et non est alter : <l eID="gen21057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8440"/><l level="1" sID="gen21058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8440"/>formans lucem et creans tenebras, <l eID="gen21058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21059"/>faciens pacem et creans malum : <l eID="gen21059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21060"/>ego Dominus faciens omnia hæc. <l eID="gen21060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8441"/><l level="1" sID="gen21061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8441"/>Rorate, cæli, desuper, <l eID="gen21061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21062"/>et nubes pluant justum ; <l eID="gen21062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21063"/>aperiatur terra, et germinet Salvatorem, <l eID="gen21063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21064"/>et justitia oriatur simul : <l eID="gen21064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21065"/>ego Dominus creavi eum. <l eID="gen21065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8442"/><l level="1" sID="gen21066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8442"/>Væ qui contradicit fictori suo, <l eID="gen21066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21067"/>testa de samiis terræ ! <l eID="gen21067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21068"/>Numquid dicet lutum figulo suo : Quid facis, <l eID="gen21068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21069"/>et opus tuum absque manibus est ? <l eID="gen21069" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8443"/><l level="1" sID="gen21070"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8443"/>Væ qui dicit patri : Quid generas ? <l eID="gen21070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21071"/>et mulieri : Quid parturis ? <l eID="gen21071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8444"/><l level="1" sID="gen21072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8444"/>Hæc dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen21072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21073"/>Sanctus Israël, plastes ejus : <l eID="gen21073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21074"/>Ventura interrogate me ; <l eID="gen21074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21075"/>super filios meos et super opus manuum mearum mandate mihi. <l eID="gen21075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8445"/><l level="1" sID="gen21076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8445"/>Ego feci terram, <l eID="gen21076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21077"/>et hominem super eam creavi ego : <l eID="gen21077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21078"/>manus meæ tetenderunt cælos, <l eID="gen21078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21079"/>et omni militiæ eorum mandavi. <l eID="gen21079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8446"/><l level="1" sID="gen21080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8446"/>Ego suscitavi eum ad justitiam, <l eID="gen21080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21081"/>et omnes vias ejus dirigam ; <l eID="gen21081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21082"/>ipse ædificabit civitatem meam, <l eID="gen21082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21083"/>et captivitatem meam dimittet, <l eID="gen21083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21084"/>non in pretio neque in muneribus, <l eID="gen21084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21085"/>dicit Dominus Deus exercituum. <l eID="gen21085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8447"/><l level="1" sID="gen21086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8447"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen21086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21087"/>Labor Ægypti, et negotiatio Æthiopiæ, <l eID="gen21087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21088"/>et Sabaim viri sublimes <l eID="gen21088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21089"/>ad te transibunt, et tui erunt ; <l eID="gen21089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21090"/>post te ambulabunt, <l eID="gen21090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21091"/>vincti manicis pergent, et te adorabunt, <l eID="gen21091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21092"/>teque deprecabuntur. <l eID="gen21092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21093"/>Tantum in te est Deus, <l eID="gen21093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21094"/>et non est absque te deus. <l eID="gen21094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8448"/><l level="1" sID="gen21095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8448"/>Vere tu es Deus absconditus, <l eID="gen21095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21096"/>Deus Israël, salvator. <l eID="gen21096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8449"/><l level="1" sID="gen21097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8449"/>Confusi sunt, et erubuerunt omnes : <l eID="gen21097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21098"/>simul abierunt in confusionem fabricatores errorum. <l eID="gen21098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8450"/><l level="1" sID="gen21099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8450"/>Israël salvatus est in Domino salute æterna ; <l eID="gen21099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21100"/>non confundemini, et non erubescetis usque in sæculum sæculi. <l eID="gen21100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8451"/><l level="1" sID="gen21101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8451"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus <l eID="gen21101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21102"/>creans cælos, <l eID="gen21102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21103"/>ipse Deus formans terram <l eID="gen21103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21104"/>et faciens eam, ipse plastes ejus ; <l eID="gen21104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21105"/>non in vanum creavit eam : <l eID="gen21105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21106"/>ut habitaretur formavit eam : <l eID="gen21106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21107"/>Ego Dominus, et non est alius. <l eID="gen21107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8452"/><l level="1" sID="gen21108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8452"/>Non in abscondito locutus sum, <l eID="gen21108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21109"/>in loco terræ tenebroso ; <l eID="gen21109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21110"/>non dixi semini Jacob frustra : <l eID="gen21110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21111"/>Quærite me : <l eID="gen21111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21112"/>ego Dominus loquens justitiam, <l eID="gen21112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21113"/>annuntians recta. <l eID="gen21113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8453"/><l level="1" sID="gen21114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8453"/>Congregamini, et venite, et accedite simul <l eID="gen21114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21115"/>qui salvati estis ex gentibus : <l eID="gen21115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21116"/>nescierunt qui levant lignum sculpturæ suæ, <l eID="gen21116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21117"/>et rogant deum non salvantem. <l eID="gen21117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8454"/><l level="1" sID="gen21118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8454"/>Annuntiate, et venite, <l eID="gen21118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21119"/>et consiliamini simul. <l eID="gen21119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21120"/>Quis auditum fecit hoc ab initio, <l eID="gen21120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21121"/>ex tunc prædixit illud ? <l eID="gen21121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21122"/>numquid non ego Dominus, <l eID="gen21122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21123"/>et non est ultra deus absque me ? <l eID="gen21123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21124"/>Deus justus, et salvans non est præter me. <l eID="gen21124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8455"/><l level="1" sID="gen21125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8455"/>Convertimini ad me, et salvi eritis, <l eID="gen21125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21126"/>omnes fines terræ, <l eID="gen21126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21127"/>quia ego Deus, et non est alius. <l eID="gen21127" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8456"/><l level="1" sID="gen21128"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8456"/>In memetipso juravi ; <l eID="gen21128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21129"/>egredietur de ore meo justitiæ verbum, <l eID="gen21129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21130"/>et non revertetur : <l eID="gen21130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21131"/>quia mihi curvabitur omne genu, <l eID="gen21131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21132"/>et jurabit omnis lingua. <l eID="gen21132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8457"/><l level="1" sID="gen21133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8457"/>Ergo in Domino, dicet, <l eID="gen21133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21134"/>meæ sunt justitiæ et imperium ; <l eID="gen21134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21135"/>ad eum venient, et confundentur <l eID="gen21135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21136"/>omnes qui repugnant ei. <l eID="gen21136" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 45:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8458"/><l level="1" sID="gen21137"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8458"/>In Domino justificabitur, et laudabitur <l eID="gen21137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21138"/>omne semen Israël.  <chapter eID="Isa.45"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:1
verses.text: Confractus est Bel, contritus est Nabo ; <l eID="gen21139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21140"/>facta sunt simulacra eorum bestiis et jumentis, <l eID="gen21140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21141"/>onera vestra gravi pondere <l eID="gen21141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21142"/>usque ad lassitudinem. <l eID="gen21142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8459"/><l level="1" sID="gen21143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8459"/>Contabuerunt, et contrita sunt simul ; <l eID="gen21143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21144"/>non potuerunt salvare portantem, <l eID="gen21144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21145"/>et anima eorum in captivitatem ibit. <l eID="gen21145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8460"/><l level="1" sID="gen21146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8460"/>Audite me, domus Jacob, <l eID="gen21146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21147"/>et omne residuum domus Israël ; <l eID="gen21147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21148"/>qui portamini a meo utero, <l eID="gen21148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21149"/>qui gestamini a mea vulva. <l eID="gen21149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8461"/><l level="1" sID="gen21150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8461"/>Usque ad senectam ego ipse, <l eID="gen21150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21151"/>et usque ad canos ego portabo ; <l eID="gen21151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21152"/>ego feci, et ego feram ; <l eID="gen21152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21153"/>ego portabo, et salvabo. <l eID="gen21153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8462"/><l level="1" sID="gen21154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8462"/>Cui assimilastis me, et adæquastis, <l eID="gen21154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21155"/>et comparastis me, et fecistis similem ? <l eID="gen21155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8463"/><l level="1" sID="gen21156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8463"/>Qui confertis aurum de sacculo, <l eID="gen21156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21157"/>et argentum statera ponderatis, <l eID="gen21157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21158"/>conducentes aurificem ut faciat deum, <l eID="gen21158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21159"/>et procidunt, et adorant. <l eID="gen21159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8464"/><l level="1" sID="gen21160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8464"/>Portant illum in humeris gestantes, <l eID="gen21160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21161"/>et ponentes in loco suo, <l eID="gen21161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21162"/>et stabit, ac de loco suo non movebitur : <l eID="gen21162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21163"/>sed et cum clamaverint ad eum, non audiet ; <l eID="gen21163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21164"/>de tribulatione non salvabit eos. <l eID="gen21164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8465"/><l level="1" sID="gen21165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8465"/>Mementote istud, et confundamini ; <l eID="gen21165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21166"/>redite, prævaricatores, ad cor. <l eID="gen21166" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8466"/><l level="1" sID="gen21167"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8466"/>Recordamini prioris sæculi, <l eID="gen21167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21168"/>quoniam ego sum Deus, et non est ultra deus, <l eID="gen21168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21169"/>nec est similis mei. <l eID="gen21169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8467"/><l level="1" sID="gen21170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8467"/>Annuntians ab exordio novissimum, <l eID="gen21170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21171"/>et ab initio quæ necdum facta sunt, <l eID="gen21171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21172"/>dicens : Consilium meum stabit, <l eID="gen21172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21173"/>et omnis voluntas mea fiet. <l eID="gen21173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8468"/><l level="1" sID="gen21174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8468"/>Vocans ab oriente avem, <l eID="gen21174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21175"/>et de terra longinqua virum voluntatis meæ : <l eID="gen21175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21176"/>et locutus sum, et adducam illud ; <l eID="gen21176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21177"/>creavi et faciam illud. <l eID="gen21177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8469"/><l level="1" sID="gen21178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8469"/>Audite me, duro corde, <l eID="gen21178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21179"/>qui longe estis a justitia. <l eID="gen21179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 46:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8470"/><l level="1" sID="gen21180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8470"/>Prope feci justitiam meam, non elongabitur, <l eID="gen21180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21181"/>et salus mea non morabitur. <l eID="gen21181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21182"/>Dabo in Sion salutem, <l eID="gen21182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21183"/>et in Israël gloriam meam.  <chapter eID="Isa.46"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:1
verses.text: Descende, sede in pulvere, <l eID="gen21184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21185"/>virgo filia Babylon : <l eID="gen21185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21186"/>sede in terra ; non est solium <l eID="gen21186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21187"/>filiæ Chaldæorum, <l eID="gen21187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21188"/>quia ultra non vocaberis <l eID="gen21188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21189"/>mollis et tenera. <l eID="gen21189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8471"/><l level="1" sID="gen21190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8471"/>Tolle molam, et mole farinam ; <l eID="gen21190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21191"/>denuda turpitudinem tuam ; <l eID="gen21191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21192"/>discooperi humerum, revela crura, <l eID="gen21192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21193"/>transi flumina. <l eID="gen21193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8472"/><l level="1" sID="gen21194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8472"/>Revelabitur ignominia tua, <l eID="gen21194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21195"/>et videbitur opprobrium tuum ; <l eID="gen21195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21196"/>ultionem capiam, et non resistet mihi homo. <l eID="gen21196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8473"/><l level="1" sID="gen21197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8473"/>Redemptor noster, Dominus exercituum nomen illius, <l eID="gen21197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21198"/>Sanctus Israël. <l eID="gen21198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8474"/><l level="1" sID="gen21199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8474"/>Sede tacens, et intra in tenebras, <l eID="gen21199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21200"/>filia Chaldæorum, <l eID="gen21200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21201"/>quia non vocaberis ultra <l eID="gen21201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21202"/>domina regnorum. <l eID="gen21202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8475"/><l level="1" sID="gen21203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8475"/>Iratus sum super populum meum : <l eID="gen21203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21204"/>contaminavi hæreditatem meam, <l eID="gen21204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21205"/>et dedi eos in manu tua : <l eID="gen21205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21206"/>non posuisti eis misericordias ; <l eID="gen21206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21207"/>super senem aggravasti jugum tuum valde. <l eID="gen21207" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8476"/><l level="1" sID="gen21208"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8476"/>Et dixisti : In sempiternum ero domina. <l eID="gen21208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21209"/>Non posuisti hæc super cor tuum, <l eID="gen21209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21210"/>neque recordata es novissimi tui. <l eID="gen21210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8477"/><l level="1" sID="gen21211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8477"/>Et nunc audi hæc delicata, <l eID="gen21211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21212"/>et habitans confidenter, <l eID="gen21212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21213"/>quæ dicis in corde tuo : <l eID="gen21213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21214"/>Ego sum, et non est præter me amplius ; <l eID="gen21214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21215"/>non sedebo vidua, <l eID="gen21215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21216"/>et ignorabo sterilitatem. <l eID="gen21216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8478"/><l level="1" sID="gen21217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8478"/>Venient tibi duo hæc <l eID="gen21217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21218"/>subito in die una, <l eID="gen21218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21219"/>sterilitas et viduitas : <l eID="gen21219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21220"/>universa venerunt super te, <l eID="gen21220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21221"/>propter multitudinem maleficiorum tuorum, <l eID="gen21221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21222"/>et propter duritiam incantatorum tuorum vehementem. <l eID="gen21222" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8479"/><l level="1" sID="gen21223"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8479"/>Et fiduciam habuisti in malitia tua, <l eID="gen21223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21224"/>et dixisti : Non est qui videat me. <l eID="gen21224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21225"/>Sapientia tua et scientia tua, <l eID="gen21225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21226"/>hæc decepit te. <l eID="gen21226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21227"/>Et dixisti in corde tuo : <l eID="gen21227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21228"/>Ego sum, et præter me non est altera. <l eID="gen21228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8480"/><l level="1" sID="gen21229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8480"/>Veniet super te malum, <l eID="gen21229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21230"/>et nescies ortum ejus ; <l eID="gen21230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21231"/>et irruet super te calamitas <l eID="gen21231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21232"/>quam non poteris expiare ; <l eID="gen21232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21233"/>veniet super te repente miseria <l eID="gen21233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21234"/>quam nescies. <l eID="gen21234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8481"/><l level="1" sID="gen21235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8481"/>Sta cum incantatoribus tuis <l eID="gen21235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21236"/>et cum multitudine maleficiorum tuorum, <l eID="gen21236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21237"/>in quibus laborasti ab adolescentia tua, <l eID="gen21237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21238"/>si forte quod prosit tibi, <l eID="gen21238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21239"/>aut si possis fieri fortior. <l eID="gen21239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8482"/><l level="1" sID="gen21240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8482"/>Defecisti in multitudine consiliorum tuorum. <l eID="gen21240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21241"/>Stent, et salvent te <l eID="gen21241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21242"/>augures cæli, <l eID="gen21242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21243"/>qui contemplabantur sidera, <l eID="gen21243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21244"/>et supputabant menses, <l eID="gen21244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21245"/>ut ex eis annuntiarent ventura tibi. <l eID="gen21245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8483"/><l level="1" sID="gen21246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8483"/>Ecce facti sunt quasi stipula, <l eID="gen21246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21247"/>ignis combussit eos ; <l eID="gen21247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21248"/>non liberabunt animam suam <l eID="gen21248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21249"/>de manu flammæ ; <l eID="gen21249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21250"/>non sunt prunæ quibus calefiant, <l eID="gen21250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21251"/>nec focus ut sedeant ad eum. <l eID="gen21251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 47:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8484"/><l level="1" sID="gen21252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8484"/>Sic facta sunt tibi in quibuscumque laboraveras : <l eID="gen21252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21253"/>negotiatores tui ab adolescentia tua, <l eID="gen21253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21254"/>unusquisque in via sua erraverunt ; <l eID="gen21254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21255"/>non est qui salvet te.  <chapter eID="Isa.47"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:1
verses.text: Audite hæc, domus Jacob, <l eID="gen21256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21257"/>qui vocamini nomine Israël, <l eID="gen21257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21258"/>et de aquis Juda existis ; <l eID="gen21258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21259"/>qui juratis in nomine Domini, <l eID="gen21259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21260"/>et Dei Israël recordamini <l eID="gen21260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21261"/>non in veritate neque in justitia. <l eID="gen21261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8485"/><l level="1" sID="gen21262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8485"/>De civitate enim sancta vocati sunt, <l eID="gen21262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21263"/>et super Deum Israël constabiliti sunt : <l eID="gen21263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21264"/>Dominus exercituum nomen ejus. <l eID="gen21264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8486"/><l level="1" sID="gen21265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8486"/>Priora ex tunc annuntiavi, <l eID="gen21265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21266"/>et ex ore meo exierunt, et audita feci ea : <l eID="gen21266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21267"/>repente operatus sum, et venerunt. <l eID="gen21267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8487"/><l level="1" sID="gen21268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8487"/>Scivi enim quia durus es tu, <l eID="gen21268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21269"/>et nervus ferreus cervix tua, <l eID="gen21269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21270"/>et frons tua ærea. <l eID="gen21270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8488"/><l level="1" sID="gen21271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8488"/>Prædixi tibi ex tunc ; <l eID="gen21271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21272"/>antequam venirent, indicavi tibi, <l eID="gen21272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21273"/>ne forte diceres : Idola mea fecerunt hæc, <l eID="gen21273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21274"/>et sculptilia mea et conflatilia mandaverunt ista. <l eID="gen21274" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8489"/><l level="1" sID="gen21275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8489"/>Quæ audisti, vide omnia ; <l eID="gen21275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21276"/>vos autem, num annuntiastis ? <l eID="gen21276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21277"/>Audita feci tibi nova ex tunc, <l eID="gen21277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21278"/>et conservata sunt quæ nescis. <l eID="gen21278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8490"/><l level="1" sID="gen21279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8490"/>Nunc creata sunt et non ex tunc ; <l eID="gen21279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21280"/>et ante diem, et non audisti ea, <l eID="gen21280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21281"/>ne forte dicas : Ecce ego cognovi ea. <l eID="gen21281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8491"/><l level="1" sID="gen21282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8491"/>Neque audisti, neque cognovisti, <l eID="gen21282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21283"/>neque ex tunc aperta est auris tua : <l eID="gen21283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21284"/>scio enim quia prævaricans prævaricaberis, <l eID="gen21284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21285"/>et transgressorem ex utero vocavi te. <l eID="gen21285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8492"/><l level="1" sID="gen21286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8492"/>Propter nomen meum longe faciam furorem meum, <l eID="gen21286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21287"/>et laude mea infrenabo te, <l eID="gen21287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21288"/>ne intereas. <l eID="gen21288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8493"/><l level="1" sID="gen21289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8493"/>Ecce excoxi te, sed non quasi argentum ; <l eID="gen21289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21290"/>elegi te in camino paupertatis. <l eID="gen21290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8494"/><l level="1" sID="gen21291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8494"/>Propter me, propter me faciam, <l eID="gen21291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21292"/>ut non blasphemer ; <l eID="gen21292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21293"/>et gloriam meam alteri non dabo. <l eID="gen21293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8495"/><l level="1" sID="gen21294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8495"/>Audi me, Jacob, <l eID="gen21294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21295"/>et Israël, quem ego voco : <l eID="gen21295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21296"/>ego ipse, ego primus, <l eID="gen21296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21297"/>et ego novissimus. <l eID="gen21297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8496"/><l level="1" sID="gen21298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8496"/>Manus quoque mea fundavit terram, <l eID="gen21298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21299"/>et dextera mea mensa est cælos ; <l eID="gen21299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21300"/>ego vocabo eos, <l eID="gen21300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21301"/>et stabunt simul. <l eID="gen21301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8497"/><l level="1" sID="gen21302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8497"/>Congregamini, omnes vos, et audite : <l eID="gen21302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21303"/>quis de eis annuntiavit hæc ? <l eID="gen21303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21304"/>Dominus dilexit eum, faciet voluntatem suam in Babylone, <l eID="gen21304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21305"/>et brachium suum in Chaldæis. <l eID="gen21305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8498"/><l level="1" sID="gen21306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8498"/>Ego, ego locutus sum, et vocavi eum ; <l eID="gen21306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21307"/>adduxi eum, et directa est via ejus. <l eID="gen21307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8499"/><l level="1" sID="gen21308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8499"/>Accedite ad me et audite hoc : <l eID="gen21308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21309"/>non a principio in abscondito locutus sum : <l eID="gen21309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21310"/>ex tempore antequam fieret, ibi eram : <l eID="gen21310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21311"/>et nunc Dominus Deus misit me, <l eID="gen21311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21312"/>et spiritus ejus. <l eID="gen21312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8500"/><l level="1" sID="gen21313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8500"/>Hæc dicit Dominus, redemptor tuus, <l eID="gen21313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21314"/>Sanctus Israël : <l eID="gen21314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21315"/>Ego Dominus Deus tuus, <l eID="gen21315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21316"/>docens te utilia, <l eID="gen21316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21317"/>gubernans te in via qua ambulas. <l eID="gen21317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8501"/><l level="1" sID="gen21318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8501"/>Utinam attendisses mandata mea : <l eID="gen21318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21319"/>facta fuisset sicut flumen pax tua, <l eID="gen21319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21320"/>et justitia tua sicut gurgites maris : <l eID="gen21320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8502"/><l level="1" sID="gen21321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8502"/>et fuisset quasi arena semen tuum, <l eID="gen21321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21322"/>et stirps uteri tui ut lapilli ejus ; <l eID="gen21322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21323"/>non interisset et non fuisset attritum <l eID="gen21323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21324"/>nomen ejus a facie mea. <l eID="gen21324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8503"/><l level="1" sID="gen21325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8503"/>Egredimini de Babylone, fugite a Chaldæis, <l eID="gen21325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21326"/>in voce exsultationis annuntiate : <l eID="gen21326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21327"/>auditum facite hoc, <l eID="gen21327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21328"/>et efferte illud usque ad extrema terræ. <l eID="gen21328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21329"/>Dicite : Redemit Dominus <l eID="gen21329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21330"/>servum suum Jacob. <l eID="gen21330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8504"/><l level="1" sID="gen21331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8504"/>Non sitierunt in deserto, cum educeret eos : <l eID="gen21331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21332"/>aquam de petra produxit eis, <l eID="gen21332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21333"/>et scidit petram, et fluxerunt aquæ. <l eID="gen21333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 48:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8505"/><l level="1" sID="gen21334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8505"/>Non est pax impiis, dicit Dominus.  <chapter eID="Isa.48"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:1
verses.text: Audite, insulæ, <l eID="gen21335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21336"/>et attendite, populi de longe : <l eID="gen21336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21337"/>Dominus ab utero vocavit me ; <l eID="gen21337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21338"/>de ventre matris meæ recordatus est nominis mei. <l eID="gen21338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8506"/><l level="1" sID="gen21339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8506"/>Et posuit os meum quasi gladium acutum, <l eID="gen21339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21340"/>in umbra manus suæ protexit me, <l eID="gen21340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21341"/>et posuit me sicut sagittam electam : <l eID="gen21341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21342"/>in pharetra sua abscondit me. <l eID="gen21342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8507"/><l level="1" sID="gen21343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8507"/>Et dixit mihi : Servus meus es tu Israël, <l eID="gen21343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21344"/>quia in te gloriabor. <l eID="gen21344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8508"/><l level="1" sID="gen21345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8508"/>Et ego dixi : In vacuum laboravi ; <l eID="gen21345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21346"/>sine causa et vane fortitudinem meam consumpsi : <l eID="gen21346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21347"/>ergo judicium meum cum Domino, <l eID="gen21347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21348"/>et opus meum cum Deo meo. <l eID="gen21348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8509"/><l level="1" sID="gen21349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8509"/>Et nunc dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen21349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21350"/>formans me ex utero servum sibi, <l eID="gen21350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21351"/>ut reducam Jacob ad eum, <l eID="gen21351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21352"/>et Israël non congregabitur ; <l eID="gen21352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21353"/>et glorificatus sum in oculis Domini, <l eID="gen21353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21354"/>et Deus meus factus est fortitudo mea. <l eID="gen21354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8510"/><l level="1" sID="gen21355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8510"/>Et dixit : Parum est ut sis mihi servus <l eID="gen21355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21356"/>ad suscitandas tribus Jacob, <l eID="gen21356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21357"/>et fæces Israël convertendas : <l eID="gen21357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21358"/>ecce dedi te in lucem gentium, <l eID="gen21358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21359"/>ut sis salus mea <l eID="gen21359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21360"/>usque ad extremum terræ. <l eID="gen21360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8511"/><l level="1" sID="gen21361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8511"/>Hæc dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen21361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21362"/>redemptor Israël, Sanctus ejus, <l eID="gen21362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21363"/>ad contemptibilem animam, ad abominatam gentem, <l eID="gen21363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21364"/>ad servum dominorum : <l eID="gen21364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21365"/>Reges videbunt, <l eID="gen21365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21366"/>et consurgent principes, et adorabunt <l eID="gen21366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21367"/>propter Dominum, quia fidelis est, <l eID="gen21367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21368"/>et Sanctum Israël qui elegit te. <l eID="gen21368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8512"/><l level="1" sID="gen21369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8512"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen21369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21370"/>In tempore placito exaudivi te, <l eID="gen21370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21371"/>et in die salutis auxiliatus sum tui : <l eID="gen21371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21372"/>et servavi te, et dedi te in fœdus populi, <l eID="gen21372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21373"/>ut suscitares terram, <l eID="gen21373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21374"/>et possideres hæreditates dissipatas ; <l eID="gen21374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8513"/><l level="1" sID="gen21375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8513"/>ut diceres his qui vincti sunt : Exite, <l eID="gen21375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21376"/>et his qui in tenebris : Revelamini. <l eID="gen21376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21377"/>Super vias pascentur, <l eID="gen21377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21378"/>et in omnibus planis pascua eorum. <l eID="gen21378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8514"/><l level="1" sID="gen21379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8514"/>Non esurient neque sitient, <l eID="gen21379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21380"/>et non percutiet eos æstus et sol, <l eID="gen21380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21381"/>quia miserator eorum reget eos, <l eID="gen21381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21382"/>et ad fontes aquarum potabit eos. <l eID="gen21382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8515"/><l level="1" sID="gen21383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8515"/>Et ponam omnes montes meos in viam, <l eID="gen21383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21384"/>et semitæ meæ exaltabuntur. <l eID="gen21384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8516"/><l level="1" sID="gen21385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8516"/>Ecce isti de longe venient, <l eID="gen21385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21386"/>et ecce illi ab aquilone et mari, <l eID="gen21386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21387"/>et isti de terra australi. <l eID="gen21387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8517"/><l level="1" sID="gen21388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8517"/>Laudate, cæli, et exsulta, terra ; <l eID="gen21388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21389"/>jubilate, montes, laudem, <l eID="gen21389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21390"/>quia consolatus est Dominus populum suum, <l eID="gen21390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21391"/>et pauperum suorum miserebitur. <l eID="gen21391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8518"/><l level="1" sID="gen21392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8518"/>Et dixit Sion : Dereliquit me Dominus, <l eID="gen21392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21393"/>et Dominus oblitus est mei. <l eID="gen21393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8519"/><l level="1" sID="gen21394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8519"/>Numquid oblivisci potest mulier infantem suum, <l eID="gen21394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21395"/>ut non misereatur filio uteri sui ? <l eID="gen21395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21396"/>Etsi illa oblita fuerit, <l eID="gen21396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21397"/>ego tamen non obliviscar tui. <l eID="gen21397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8520"/><l level="1" sID="gen21398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8520"/>Ecce in manibus meis descripsi te ; <l eID="gen21398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21399"/>muri tui coram oculis meis semper. <l eID="gen21399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8521"/><l level="1" sID="gen21400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8521"/>Venerunt structores tui ; <l eID="gen21400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21401"/>destruentes te et dissipantes a te exibunt. <l eID="gen21401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8522"/><l level="1" sID="gen21402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8522"/>Leva in circuitu oculos tuos, et vide : <l eID="gen21402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21403"/>omnes isti congregati sunt, venerunt tibi. <l eID="gen21403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21404"/>Vivo ego, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen21404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21405"/>quia omnibus his velut ornamento vestieris, <l eID="gen21405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21406"/>et circumdabis tibi eos quasi sponsa ; <l eID="gen21406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8523"/><l level="1" sID="gen21407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8523"/>quia deserta tua, et solitudines tuæ, <l eID="gen21407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21408"/>et terra ruinæ tuæ, <l eID="gen21408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21409"/>nunc angusta erunt præ habitatoribus ; <l eID="gen21409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21410"/>et longe fugabuntur qui absorbebant te. <l eID="gen21410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8524"/><l level="1" sID="gen21411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8524"/>Adhuc dicent in auribus tuis <l eID="gen21411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21412"/>filii sterilitatis tuæ : <l eID="gen21412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21413"/>Angustus est mihi locus ; <l eID="gen21413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21414"/>fac spatium mihi ut habitem. <l eID="gen21414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8525"/><l level="1" sID="gen21415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8525"/>Et dices in corde tuo : <l eID="gen21415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21416"/>Quis genuit mihi istos ? <l eID="gen21416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21417"/>ego sterilis et non pariens, <l eID="gen21417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21418"/>transmigrata, et captiva ; <l eID="gen21418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21419"/>et istos quis enutrivit ? <l eID="gen21419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21420"/>ego destituta et sola ; <l eID="gen21420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21421"/>et isti ubi erant ? <l eID="gen21421" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8526"/><l level="1" sID="gen21422"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8526"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen21422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21423"/>Ecce levabo ad gentes manum meam, <l eID="gen21423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21424"/>et ad populos exaltabo signum meum : <l eID="gen21424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21425"/>et afferent filios tuos in ulnis, <l eID="gen21425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21426"/>et filias tuas super humeros portabunt. <l eID="gen21426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8527"/><l level="1" sID="gen21427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8527"/>Et erunt reges nutritii tui, <l eID="gen21427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21428"/>et reginæ nutrices tuæ ; <l eID="gen21428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21429"/>vultu in terram demisso adorabunt te, <l eID="gen21429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21430"/>et pulverem pedum tuorum lingent. <l eID="gen21430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21431"/>Et scies quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen21431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21432"/>super quo non confundentur qui exspectant eum. <l eID="gen21432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8528"/><l level="1" sID="gen21433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8528"/>Numquid tolletur a forti præda ? <l eID="gen21433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21434"/>aut quod captum fuerit a robusto, salvum esse poterit ? <l eID="gen21434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8529"/><l level="1" sID="gen21435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8529"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen21435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21436"/>Equidem, et captivitas a forti tolletur, <l eID="gen21436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21437"/>et quod ablatum fuerit a robusto, salvabitur. <l eID="gen21437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21438"/>Eos vero qui judicaverunt te, ego judicabo, <l eID="gen21438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21439"/>et filios tuos ego salvabo. <l eID="gen21439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 49:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8530"/><l level="1" sID="gen21440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8530"/>Et cibabo hostes tuos carnibus suis, <l eID="gen21440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21441"/>et quasi musto, sanguine suo inebriabuntur, <l eID="gen21441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21442"/>et sciet omnis caro <l eID="gen21442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21443"/>quia ego Dominus salvans te, <l eID="gen21443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21444"/>et redemptor tuus fortis Jacob.  <chapter eID="Isa.49"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen21445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21446"/>Quis est hic liber repudii matris vestræ, <l eID="gen21446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21447"/>quo dimisi eam ? <l eID="gen21447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21448"/>aut quis est creditor meus, <l eID="gen21448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21449"/>cui vendidi vos ? <l eID="gen21449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21450"/>Ecce in iniquitatibus vestris venditi estis, <l eID="gen21450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21451"/>et in sceleribus vestris dimisi matrem vestram. <l eID="gen21451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8531"/><l level="1" sID="gen21452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8531"/>Quia veni, et non erat vir ; <l eID="gen21452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21453"/>vocavi, et non erat qui audiret. <l eID="gen21453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21454"/>Numquid abbreviata et parvula facta est manus mea, <l eID="gen21454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21455"/>ut non possim redimere ? <l eID="gen21455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21456"/>aut non est in me virtus ad liberandum ? <l eID="gen21456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21457"/>Ecce in increpatione mea desertum faciam mare, <l eID="gen21457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21458"/>ponam flumina in siccum ; <l eID="gen21458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21459"/>computrescent pisces sine aqua, <l eID="gen21459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21460"/>et morientur in siti. <l eID="gen21460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8532"/><l level="1" sID="gen21461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8532"/>Induam cælos tenebris, <l eID="gen21461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21462"/>et saccum ponam operimentum eorum. <l eID="gen21462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8533"/><l level="1" sID="gen21463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8533"/>Dominus dedit mihi <l eID="gen21463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21464"/>linguam eruditam, <l eID="gen21464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21465"/>ut sciam sustentare eum qui lassus est verbo. <l eID="gen21465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21466"/>Erigit mane, <l eID="gen21466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21467"/>mane erigit mihi aurem, <l eID="gen21467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21468"/>ut audiam quasi magistrum. <l eID="gen21468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8534"/><l level="1" sID="gen21469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8534"/>Dominus Deus aperuit mihi aurem, <l eID="gen21469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21470"/>ego autem non contradico : <l eID="gen21470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21471"/>retrorsum non abii. <l eID="gen21471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8535"/><l level="1" sID="gen21472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8535"/>Corpus meum dedi percutientibus, <l eID="gen21472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21473"/>et genas meas vellentibus ; <l eID="gen21473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21474"/>faciem meam non averti ab increpantibus <l eID="gen21474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21475"/>et conspuentibus in me. <l eID="gen21475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8536"/><l level="1" sID="gen21476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8536"/>Dominus Deus auxiliator meus, <l eID="gen21476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21477"/>ideo non sum confusus ; <l eID="gen21477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21478"/>ideo posui faciem meam ut petram durissimam, <l eID="gen21478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21479"/>et scio quoniam non confundar. <l eID="gen21479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8537"/><l level="1" sID="gen21480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8537"/>Juxta est qui justificat me ; quis contradicet mihi ? <l eID="gen21480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21481"/>Stemus simul ; <l eID="gen21481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21482"/>quis est adversarius meus ? accedat ad me. <l eID="gen21482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8538"/><l level="1" sID="gen21483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8538"/>Ecce Dominus Deus auxiliator meus ; <l eID="gen21483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21484"/>quis est qui condemnet me ? <l eID="gen21484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21485"/>Ecce omnes quasi vestimentum conterentur ; <l eID="gen21485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21486"/>tinea comedet eos. <l eID="gen21486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8539"/><l level="1" sID="gen21487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8539"/>Quis ex vobis timens Dominum, <l eID="gen21487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21488"/>audiens vocem servi sui ? <l eID="gen21488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21489"/>Qui ambulavit in tenebris, <l eID="gen21489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21490"/>et non est lumen ei, <l eID="gen21490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21491"/>speret in nomine Domini, <l eID="gen21491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21492"/>et innitatur super Deum suum. <l eID="gen21492" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 50:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8540"/><l level="1" sID="gen21493"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8540"/>Ecce vos omnes accendentes ignem, <l eID="gen21493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21494"/>accincti flammis : <l eID="gen21494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21495"/>ambulate in lumine ignis vestri, <l eID="gen21495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21496"/>et in flammis quas succendistis ; <l eID="gen21496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21497"/>de manu mea factum est hoc vobis : <l eID="gen21497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21498"/>in doloribus dormietis.  <chapter eID="Isa.50"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:1
verses.text: Audite me, qui sequimini quod justum est, <l eID="gen21499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21500"/>et quæritis Dominum ; <l eID="gen21500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21501"/>attendite ad petram unde excisi estis, <l eID="gen21501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21502"/>et ad cavernam laci de qua præcisi estis. <l eID="gen21502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8541"/><l level="1" sID="gen21503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8541"/>Attendite ad Abraham, patrem vestrum, <l eID="gen21503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21504"/>et ad Saram, quæ peperit vos : <l eID="gen21504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21505"/>quia unum vocavi eum, <l eID="gen21505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21506"/>et benedixi ei, et multiplicavi eum. <l eID="gen21506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8542"/><l level="1" sID="gen21507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8542"/>Consolabitur ergo Dominus Sion, <l eID="gen21507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21508"/>et consolabitur omnes ruinas ejus : <l eID="gen21508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21509"/>et ponet desertum ejus quasi delicias, <l eID="gen21509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21510"/>et solitudinem ejus quasi hortum Domini. <l eID="gen21510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21511"/>Gaudium et lætitia invenietur in ea, <l eID="gen21511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21512"/>gratiarum actio et vox laudis. <l eID="gen21512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8543"/><l level="1" sID="gen21513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8543"/>Attendite ad me, popule meus, <l eID="gen21513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21514"/>et tribus mea, me audite : <l eID="gen21514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21515"/>quia lex a me exiet, <l eID="gen21515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21516"/>et judicium meum in lucem populorum requiescet. <l eID="gen21516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:5
