verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8544"/><l level="1" sID="gen21517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8544"/>Prope est justus meus, egressus est salvator meus, <l eID="gen21517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21518"/>et brachia mea populos judicabunt ; <l eID="gen21518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21519"/>me insulæ exspectabunt, <l eID="gen21519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21520"/>et brachium meum sustinebunt. <l eID="gen21520" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8545"/><l level="1" sID="gen21521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8545"/>Levate in cælum oculos vestros, <l eID="gen21521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21522"/>et videte sub terra deorsum : <l eID="gen21522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21523"/>quia cæli sicut fumus liquescent, <l eID="gen21523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21524"/>et terra sicut vestimentum atteretur, <l eID="gen21524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21525"/>et habitatores ejus sicut hæc interibunt : <l eID="gen21525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21526"/>salus autem mea in sempiternum erit, <l eID="gen21526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21527"/>et justitia mea non deficiet. <l eID="gen21527" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8546"/><l level="1" sID="gen21528"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8546"/>Audite me, qui scitis justum, <l eID="gen21528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21529"/>populus meus, lex mea in corde eorum : <l eID="gen21529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21530"/>nolite timere opprobrium hominum, <l eID="gen21530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21531"/>et blasphemias eorum ne metuatis : <l eID="gen21531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8547"/><l level="1" sID="gen21532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8547"/>sicut enim vestimentum, sic comedet eos vermis, <l eID="gen21532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21533"/>et sicut lanam, sic devorabit eos tinea : <l eID="gen21533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21534"/>salus autem mea in sempiternum erit, <l eID="gen21534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21535"/>et justitia mea in generationes generationum. <l eID="gen21535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8548"/><l level="1" sID="gen21536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8548"/>Consurge, consurge, induere fortitudinem, <l eID="gen21536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21537"/>brachium Domini ! <l eID="gen21537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21538"/>consurge sicut in diebus antiquis, <l eID="gen21538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21539"/>in generationibus sæculorum. <l eID="gen21539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21540"/>Numquid non tu percussisti superbum, <l eID="gen21540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21541"/>vulnerasti draconem ? <l eID="gen21541" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8549"/><l level="1" sID="gen21542"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8549"/>numquid non tu siccasti mare, <l eID="gen21542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21543"/>aquam abyssi vehementis ; <l eID="gen21543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21544"/>qui posuisti profundum maris viam, <l eID="gen21544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21545"/>ut transirent liberati ? <l eID="gen21545" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8550"/><l level="1" sID="gen21546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8550"/>Et nunc qui redempti sunt a Domino, revertentur, <l eID="gen21546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21547"/>et venient in Sion laudantes, <l eID="gen21547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21548"/>et lætitia sempiterna super capita eorum : <l eID="gen21548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21549"/>gaudium et lætitiam tenebunt ; <l eID="gen21549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21550"/>fugiet dolor et gemitus. <l eID="gen21550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8551"/><l level="1" sID="gen21551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8551"/>Ego, ego ipse consolabor vos. <l eID="gen21551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21552"/>Quis tu, ut timeres ab homine mortali, <l eID="gen21552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21553"/>et a filio hominis qui quasi fœnum ita arescet ? <l eID="gen21553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8552"/><l level="1" sID="gen21554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8552"/>Et oblitus es Domini, factoris tui, <l eID="gen21554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21555"/>qui tetendit cælos et fundavit terram ; <l eID="gen21555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21556"/>et formidasti jugiter tota die <l eID="gen21556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21557"/>a facie furoris ejus qui te tribulabat, <l eID="gen21557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21558"/>et paraverat ad perdendum. <l eID="gen21558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21559"/>Ubi nunc est furor tribulantis ? <l eID="gen21559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8553"/><l level="1" sID="gen21560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8553"/>Cito veniet gradiens ad aperiendum ; <l eID="gen21560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21561"/>et non interficiet usque ad internecionem, <l eID="gen21561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21562"/>nec deficiet panis ejus. <l eID="gen21562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8554"/><l level="1" sID="gen21563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8554"/>Ego autem sum Dominus Deus tuus, <l eID="gen21563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21564"/>qui conturbo mare, et intumescunt fluctus ejus : <l eID="gen21564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21565"/>Dominus exercituum nomen meum. <l eID="gen21565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8555"/><l level="1" sID="gen21566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8555"/>Posui verba mea in ore tuo, <l eID="gen21566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21567"/>et in umbra manus meæ protexi te, <l eID="gen21567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21568"/>ut plantes cælos, et fundes terram, <l eID="gen21568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21569"/>et dicas ad Sion : Populus meus es tu. <l eID="gen21569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8556"/><l level="1" sID="gen21570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8556"/>Elevare, elevare, <l eID="gen21570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21571"/>consurge, Jerusalem, <l eID="gen21571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21572"/>quæ bibisti de manu Domini <l eID="gen21572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21573"/>calicem iræ ejus ; <l eID="gen21573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21574"/>usque ad fundum calicis soporis bibisti, <l eID="gen21574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21575"/>et potasti usque ad fæces. <l eID="gen21575" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8557"/><l level="1" sID="gen21576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8557"/>Non est qui sustentet eam, <l eID="gen21576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21577"/>ex omnibus filiis quos genuit ; <l eID="gen21577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21578"/>et non est qui apprehendat manum ejus, <l eID="gen21578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21579"/>ex omnibus filiis quos enutrivit. <l eID="gen21579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8558"/><l level="1" sID="gen21580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8558"/>Duo sunt quæ occurrerunt tibi ; <l eID="gen21580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21581"/>quis contristabitur super te ? <l eID="gen21581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21582"/>Vastitas, et contritio, et fames, et gladius ; <l eID="gen21582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21583"/>quis consolabitur te ? <l eID="gen21583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8559"/><l level="1" sID="gen21584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8559"/>Filii tui projecti sunt, dormierunt <l eID="gen21584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21585"/>in capite omnium viarum <l eID="gen21585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21586"/>sicut oryx illaqueatus, <l eID="gen21586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21587"/>pleni indignatione Domini, <l eID="gen21587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21588"/>increpatione Dei tui. <l eID="gen21588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8560"/><l level="1" sID="gen21589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8560"/>Idcirco audi hoc, paupercula, <l eID="gen21589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21590"/>et ebria non a vino. <l eID="gen21590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8561"/><l level="1" sID="gen21591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8561"/>Hæc dicit dominator tuus Dominus, <l eID="gen21591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21592"/>et Deus tuus, qui pugnabit pro populo suo : <l eID="gen21592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21593"/>Ecce tuli de manu tua <l eID="gen21593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21594"/>calicem soporis, <l eID="gen21594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21595"/>fundum calicis indignationis meæ : <l eID="gen21595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21596"/>non adjicies ut bibas illum ultra. <l eID="gen21596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 51:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8562"/><l level="1" sID="gen21597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8562"/>Et ponam illum in manu eorum qui te humiliaverunt, <l eID="gen21597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21598"/>et dixerunt animæ tuæ : <l eID="gen21598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21599"/>Incurvare, ut transeamus ; <l eID="gen21599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21600"/>et posuisti ut terram corpus tuum, <l eID="gen21600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21601"/>et quasi viam transeuntibus.  <chapter eID="Isa.51"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:1
verses.text: Consurge, consurge, induere fortitudine tua, Sion ! <l eID="gen21602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21603"/>induere vestimentis gloriæ tuæ, <l eID="gen21603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21604"/>Jerusalem, civitas Sancti, <l eID="gen21604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21605"/>quia non adjiciet ultra ut pertranseat per te <l eID="gen21605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21606"/>incircumcisus et immundus. <l eID="gen21606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8563"/><l level="1" sID="gen21607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8563"/>Excutere de pulvere, consurge ; <l eID="gen21607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21608"/>sede, Jerusalem ! <l eID="gen21608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21609"/>solve vincula colli tui, <l eID="gen21609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21610"/>captiva filia Sion. <l eID="gen21610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8564"/><l level="1" sID="gen21611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8564"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen21611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21612"/>Gratis venundati estis, <l eID="gen21612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21613"/>et sine argento redimemini. <l eID="gen21613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8565"/><l level="1" sID="gen21614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8565"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen21614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21615"/>In Ægyptum descendit populus meus in principio, ut colonus esset ibi, <l eID="gen21615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21616"/>et Assur absque ulla causa calumniatus est eum. <l eID="gen21616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8566"/><l level="1" sID="gen21617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8566"/>Et nunc quid mihi est hic, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen21617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21618"/>quoniam ablatus est populus meus gratis ? <l eID="gen21618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21619"/>Dominatores ejus inique agunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen21619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21620"/>et jugiter tota die nomen meum blasphematur. <l eID="gen21620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8567"/><l level="1" sID="gen21621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8567"/>Propter hoc sciet populus meus nomen meum <l eID="gen21621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21622"/>in die illa : <l eID="gen21622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21623"/>quia ego ipse qui loquebar, ecce adsum. <l eID="gen21623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8568"/><l level="1" sID="gen21624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8568"/>Quam pulchri super montes pedes annuntiantis <l eID="gen21624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21625"/>et prædicantis pacem ; <l eID="gen21625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21626"/>annuntiantis bonum, <l eID="gen21626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21627"/>prædicantis salutem, <l eID="gen21627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21628"/>dicentis Sion : <l eID="gen21628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21629"/>Regnabit Deus tuus ! <l eID="gen21629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8569"/><l level="1" sID="gen21630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8569"/>Vox speculatorum tuorum : levaverunt vocem, <l eID="gen21630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21631"/>simul laudabunt, <l eID="gen21631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21632"/>quia oculo ad oculum videbunt <l eID="gen21632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21633"/>cum converterit Dominus Sion. <l eID="gen21633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8570"/><l level="1" sID="gen21634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8570"/>Gaudete, et laudate simul, <l eID="gen21634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21635"/>deserta Jerusalem, <l eID="gen21635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21636"/>quia consolatus est Dominus populum suum ; <l eID="gen21636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21637"/>redemit Jerusalem. <l eID="gen21637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8571"/><l level="1" sID="gen21638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8571"/>Paravit Dominus brachium sanctum suum <l eID="gen21638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21639"/>in oculis omnium gentium ; <l eID="gen21639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21640"/>et videbunt omnes fines terræ <l eID="gen21640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21641"/>salutare Dei nostri. <l eID="gen21641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8572"/><l level="1" sID="gen21642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8572"/>Recedite, recedite ; exite inde, <l eID="gen21642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21643"/>pollutum nolite tangere ; <l eID="gen21643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21644"/>exite de medio ejus ; mundamini, <l eID="gen21644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21645"/>qui fertis vasa Domini. <l eID="gen21645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8573"/><l level="1" sID="gen21646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8573"/>Quoniam non in tumultu exibitis, <l eID="gen21646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21647"/>nec in fuga properabitis ; <l eID="gen21647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21648"/>præcedet enim vos Dominus, <l eID="gen21648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21649"/>et congregabit vos Deus Israël. <l eID="gen21649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8574"/><l level="1" sID="gen21650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8574"/>Ecce intelliget servus meus, <l eID="gen21650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21651"/>exaltabitur et elevabitur, et sublimis erit valde. <l eID="gen21651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8575"/><l level="1" sID="gen21652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8575"/>Sicut obstupuerunt super te multi, <l eID="gen21652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21653"/>sic inglorius erit inter viros aspectus ejus, <l eID="gen21653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21654"/>et forma ejus inter filios hominum. <l eID="gen21654" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 52:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8576"/><l level="1" sID="gen21655"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8576"/>Iste asperget gentes multas ; <l eID="gen21655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21656"/>super ipsum continebunt reges os suum : <l eID="gen21656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21657"/>quia quibus non est narratum de eo viderunt, <l eID="gen21657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21658"/>et qui non audierunt contemplati sunt.  <chapter eID="Isa.52"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:1
verses.text: Quis credidit auditui nostro ? <l eID="gen21659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21660"/>et brachium Domini cui revelatum est ? <l eID="gen21660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8577"/><l level="1" sID="gen21661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8577"/>Et ascendet sicut virgultum coram eo, <l eID="gen21661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21662"/>et sicut radix de terra sitienti. <l eID="gen21662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21663"/>Non est species ei, neque decor, <l eID="gen21663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21664"/>et vidimus eum, <l eID="gen21664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21665"/>et non erat aspectus, et desideravimus eum : <l eID="gen21665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8578"/><l level="1" sID="gen21666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8578"/>despectum, et novissimum virorum, <l eID="gen21666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21667"/>virum dolorum, et scientem infirmitatem, <l eID="gen21667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21668"/>et quasi absconditus vultus ejus et despectus, <l eID="gen21668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21669"/>unde nec reputavimus eum. <l eID="gen21669" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8579"/><l level="1" sID="gen21670"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8579"/>Vere languores nostros ipse tulit, <l eID="gen21670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21671"/>et dolores nostros ipse portavit ; <l eID="gen21671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21672"/>et nos putavimus eum quasi leprosum, <l eID="gen21672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21673"/>et percussum a Deo, et humiliatum. <l eID="gen21673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8580"/><l level="1" sID="gen21674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8580"/>Ipse autem vulneratus est propter iniquitates nostras ; <l eID="gen21674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21675"/>attritus est propter scelera nostra : <l eID="gen21675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21676"/>disciplina pacis nostræ super eum, <l eID="gen21676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21677"/>et livore ejus sanati sumus. <l eID="gen21677" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8581"/><l level="1" sID="gen21678"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8581"/>Omnes nos quasi oves erravimus, <l eID="gen21678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21679"/>unusquisque in viam suam declinavit : <l eID="gen21679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21680"/>et posuit Dominus in eo <l eID="gen21680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21681"/>iniquitatem omnium nostrum. <l eID="gen21681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8582"/><l level="1" sID="gen21682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8582"/>Oblatus est quia ipse voluit, <l eID="gen21682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21683"/>et non aperuit os suum ; <l eID="gen21683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21684"/>sicut ovis ad occisionem ducetur, <l eID="gen21684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21685"/>et quasi agnus coram tondente se obmutescet, <l eID="gen21685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21686"/>et non aperiet os suum. <l eID="gen21686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8583"/><l level="1" sID="gen21687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8583"/>De angustia, et de judicio sublatus est. <l eID="gen21687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21688"/>Generationem ejus quis enarrabit ? <l eID="gen21688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21689"/>quia abscissus est de terra viventium : <l eID="gen21689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21690"/>propter scelus populi mei percussi eum. <l eID="gen21690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8584"/><l level="1" sID="gen21691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8584"/>Et dabit impios pro sepultura, <l eID="gen21691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21692"/>et divitem pro morte sua, <l eID="gen21692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21693"/>eo quod iniquitatem non fecerit, <l eID="gen21693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21694"/>neque dolus fuerit in ore ejus. <l eID="gen21694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8585"/><l level="1" sID="gen21695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8585"/>Et Dominus voluit conterere eum in infirmitate. <l eID="gen21695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21696"/>Si posuerit pro peccato animam suam, <l eID="gen21696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21697"/>videbit semen longævum, <l eID="gen21697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21698"/>et voluntas Domini in manu ejus dirigetur. <l eID="gen21698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8586"/><l level="1" sID="gen21699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8586"/>Pro eo quod laboravit anima ejus, <l eID="gen21699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21700"/>videbit et saturabitur. <l eID="gen21700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21701"/>In scientia sua justificabit <l eID="gen21701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21702"/>ipse justus servus meus multos, <l eID="gen21702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21703"/>et iniquitates eorum ipse portabit. <l eID="gen21703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 53:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8587"/><l level="1" sID="gen21704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8587"/>Ideo dispertiam ei plurimos, <l eID="gen21704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21705"/>et fortium dividet spolia, <l eID="gen21705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21706"/>pro eo quod tradidit in mortem animam suam, <l eID="gen21706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21707"/>et cum sceleratis reputatus est, <l eID="gen21707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21708"/>et ipse peccata multorum tulit, <l eID="gen21708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21709"/>et pro transgressoribus rogavit.  <chapter eID="Isa.53"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:1
verses.text: Lauda, sterilis, quæ non paris ; <l eID="gen21710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21711"/>decanta laudem, et hinni, quæ non pariebas : <l eID="gen21711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21712"/>quoniam multi filii desertæ <l eID="gen21712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21713"/>magis quam ejus quæ habet virum, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen21713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8588"/><l level="1" sID="gen21714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8588"/>Dilata locum tentorii tui, <l eID="gen21714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21715"/>et pelles tabernaculorum tuorum extende : <l eID="gen21715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21716"/>ne parcas : <l eID="gen21716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21717"/>longos fac funiculos tuos, <l eID="gen21717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21718"/>et clavos tuos consolida. <l eID="gen21718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8589"/><l level="1" sID="gen21719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8589"/>Ad dexteram enim et ad lævam penetrabis, <l eID="gen21719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21720"/>et semen tuum gentes hæreditabit, <l eID="gen21720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21721"/>et civitates desertas inhabitabit. <l eID="gen21721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8590"/><l level="1" sID="gen21722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8590"/>Noli timere, quia non confunderis, <l eID="gen21722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21723"/>neque erubesces ; non enim te pudebit, <l eID="gen21723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21724"/>quia confusionis adolescentiæ tuæ oblivisceris, <l eID="gen21724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21725"/>et opprobrii viduitatis tuæ non recordaberis amplius. <l eID="gen21725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8591"/><l level="1" sID="gen21726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8591"/>Quia dominabitur tui qui fecit te, <l eID="gen21726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21727"/>Dominus exercituum nomen ejus, <l eID="gen21727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21728"/>et redemptor tuus, Sanctus Israël : <l eID="gen21728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21729"/>Deus omnis terræ vocabitur. <l eID="gen21729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8592"/><l level="1" sID="gen21730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8592"/>Quia ut mulierem derelictam et mœrentem spiritu <l eID="gen21730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21731"/>vocavit te Dominus, <l eID="gen21731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21732"/>et uxorem ab adolescentia abjectam, <l eID="gen21732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21733"/>dixit Deus tuus. <l eID="gen21733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8593"/><l level="1" sID="gen21734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8593"/>Ad punctum in modico dereliqui te, <l eID="gen21734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21735"/>et in miserationibus magnis congregabo te. <l eID="gen21735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8594"/><l level="1" sID="gen21736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8594"/>In momento indignationis abscondi <l eID="gen21736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21737"/>faciem meam parumper a te ; <l eID="gen21737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21738"/>et in misericordia sempiterna misertus sum tui, <l eID="gen21738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21739"/>dixit redemptor tuus, Dominus. <l eID="gen21739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8595"/><l level="1" sID="gen21740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8595"/>Sicut in diebus Noë istud mihi est, <l eID="gen21740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21741"/>cui juravi ne inducerem aquas Noë ultra super terram ; <l eID="gen21741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21742"/>sic juravi ut non irascar tibi, <l eID="gen21742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21743"/>et non increpem te. <l eID="gen21743" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8596"/><l level="1" sID="gen21744"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8596"/>Montes enim commovebuntur, <l eID="gen21744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21745"/>et colles contremiscent ; <l eID="gen21745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21746"/>misericordia autem mea non recedet a te, <l eID="gen21746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21747"/>et fœdus pacis meæ non movebitur, <l eID="gen21747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21748"/>dixit miserator tuus Dominus. <l eID="gen21748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8597"/><l level="1" sID="gen21749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8597"/>Paupercula, tempestate convulsa absque ulla consolatione, <l eID="gen21749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21750"/>ecce ego sternam per ordinem lapides tuos, <l eID="gen21750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21751"/>et fundabo te in sapphiris : <l eID="gen21751" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8598"/><l level="1" sID="gen21752"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8598"/>et ponam jaspidem propugnacula tua, <l eID="gen21752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21753"/>et portas tuas in lapides sculptos, <l eID="gen21753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21754"/>et omnes terminos tuos in lapides desiderabiles ; <l eID="gen21754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8599"/><l level="1" sID="gen21755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8599"/>universos filios tuos doctos a Domino, <l eID="gen21755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21756"/>et multitudinem pacis filiis tuis. <l eID="gen21756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8600"/><l level="1" sID="gen21757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8600"/>Et in justitia fundaberis : <l eID="gen21757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21758"/>recede procul a calumnia, quia non timebis, <l eID="gen21758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21759"/>et a pavore, quia non appropinquabit tibi. <l eID="gen21759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8601"/><l level="1" sID="gen21760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8601"/>Ecce accola veniet qui non erat mecum, <l eID="gen21760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21761"/>advena quondam tuus adjungetur tibi. <l eID="gen21761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8602"/><l level="1" sID="gen21762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8602"/>Ecce ego creavi fabrum <l eID="gen21762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21763"/>sufflantem in igne prunas, <l eID="gen21763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21764"/>et proferentem vas in opus suum ; <l eID="gen21764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21765"/>et ego creavi interfectorem ad disperdendum. <l eID="gen21765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 54:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8603"/><l level="1" sID="gen21766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8603"/>Omne vas quod fictum est contra te, non dirigetur, <l eID="gen21766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21767"/>et omnem linguam resistentem tibi in judicio, judicabis. <l eID="gen21767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21768"/>Hæc est hæreditas servorum Domini, <l eID="gen21768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21769"/>et justitia eorum apud me, dicit Dominus.  <chapter eID="Isa.54"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:1
verses.text: Omnes sitientes, venite ad aquas, <l eID="gen21770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21771"/>et qui non habetis argentum, <l eID="gen21771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21772"/>properate, emite, et comedite : <l eID="gen21772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21773"/>venite, emite absque argento <l eID="gen21773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21774"/>et absque ulla commutatione <l eID="gen21774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21775"/>vinum et lac. <l eID="gen21775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8604"/><l level="1" sID="gen21776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8604"/>Quare appenditis argentum non in panibus, <l eID="gen21776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21777"/>et laborem vestrum non in saturitate ? <l eID="gen21777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21778"/>Audite, audientes me, et comedite bonum, <l eID="gen21778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21779"/>et delectabitur in crassitudine anima vestra. <l eID="gen21779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8605"/><l level="1" sID="gen21780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8605"/>Inclinate aurem vestram, et venite ad me ; <l eID="gen21780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21781"/>audite, et vivet anima vestra, <l eID="gen21781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21782"/>et feriam vobiscum pactum sempiternum, <l eID="gen21782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21783"/>misericordias David fideles. <l eID="gen21783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8606"/><l level="1" sID="gen21784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8606"/>Ecce testem populis dedi eum, <l eID="gen21784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21785"/>ducem ac præceptorem gentibus. <l eID="gen21785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8607"/><l level="1" sID="gen21786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8607"/>Ecce gentem quam nesciebas vocabis, <l eID="gen21786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21787"/>et gentes quæ te non cognoverunt ad te current, <l eID="gen21787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21788"/>propter Dominum Deum tuum, <l eID="gen21788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21789"/>et Sanctum Israël, quia glorificavit te. <l eID="gen21789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8608"/><l level="1" sID="gen21790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8608"/>Quærite Dominum dum inveniri potest ; <l eID="gen21790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21791"/>invocate eum dum prope est. <l eID="gen21791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8609"/><l level="1" sID="gen21792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8609"/>Derelinquat impius viam suam, <l eID="gen21792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21793"/>et vir iniquus cogitationes suas, <l eID="gen21793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21794"/>et revertatur ad Dominum, et miserebitur ejus ; <l eID="gen21794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21795"/>et ad Deum nostrum, quoniam multus est ad ignoscendum. <l eID="gen21795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8610"/><l level="1" sID="gen21796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8610"/>Non enim cogitationes meæ cogitationes vestræ, <l eID="gen21796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21797"/>neque viæ vestræ viæ meæ, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen21797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8611"/><l level="1" sID="gen21798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8611"/>Quia sicut exaltantur cæli a terra, <l eID="gen21798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21799"/>sic exaltatæ sunt viæ meæ a viis vestris, <l eID="gen21799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21800"/>et cogitationes meæ a cogitationibus vestris. <l eID="gen21800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8612"/><l level="1" sID="gen21801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8612"/>Et quomodo descendit imber et nix de cælo, <l eID="gen21801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21802"/>et illuc ultra non revertitur, <l eID="gen21802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21803"/>sed inebriat terram, et infundit eam, <l eID="gen21803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21804"/>et germinare eam facit, <l eID="gen21804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21805"/>et dat semen serenti, <l eID="gen21805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21806"/>et panem comedenti : <l eID="gen21806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8613"/><l level="1" sID="gen21807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8613"/>sic erit verbum meum quod egredietur de ore meo ; <l eID="gen21807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21808"/>non revertetur ad me vacuum, <l eID="gen21808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21809"/>sed faciet quæcumque volui, <l eID="gen21809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21810"/>et prosperabitur in his ad quæ misi illud. <l eID="gen21810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8614"/><l level="1" sID="gen21811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8614"/>Quia in lætitia egrediemini, <l eID="gen21811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21812"/>et in pace deducemini ; <l eID="gen21812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21813"/>montes et colles cantabunt coram vobis laudem, <l eID="gen21813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21814"/>et omnia ligna regionis plaudent manu. <l eID="gen21814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 55:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8615"/><l level="1" sID="gen21815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8615"/>Pro saliunca ascendet abies, <l eID="gen21815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21816"/>et pro urtica crescet myrtus ; <l eID="gen21816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21817"/>et erit Dominus nominatus <l eID="gen21817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21818"/>in signum æternum quod non auferetur.  <chapter eID="Isa.55"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen21819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21820"/>Custodite judicium, et facite justitiam, <l eID="gen21820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21821"/>quia juxta est salus mea ut veniat, <l eID="gen21821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21822"/>et justitia mea ut reveletur. <l eID="gen21822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8616"/><l level="1" sID="gen21823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8616"/>Beatus vir qui facit hoc, <l eID="gen21823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21824"/>et filius hominis qui apprehendet istud, <l eID="gen21824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21825"/>custodiens sabbatum ne polluat illud, <l eID="gen21825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21826"/>custodiens manus suas ne faciat omne malum. <l eID="gen21826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8617"/><l level="1" sID="gen21827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8617"/>Et non dicat filius advenæ qui adhæret Domino, dicens : <l eID="gen21827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21828"/>Separatione dividet me Dominus a populo suo ; <l eID="gen21828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21829"/>et non dicat eunuchus : <l eID="gen21829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21830"/>Ecce ego lignum aridum. <l eID="gen21830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8618"/><l level="1" sID="gen21831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8618"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus eunuchis : <l eID="gen21831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21832"/>Qui custodierint sabbata mea, <l eID="gen21832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21833"/>et elegerint quæ ego volui, <l eID="gen21833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21834"/>et tenuerint fœdus meum, <l eID="gen21834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8619"/><l level="1" sID="gen21835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8619"/>dabo eis in domo mea et in muris meis <l eID="gen21835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21836"/>locum, et nomen <l eID="gen21836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21837"/>melius a filiis et filiabus : <l eID="gen21837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21838"/>nomen sempiternum dabo eis, <l eID="gen21838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21839"/>quod non peribit. <l eID="gen21839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8620"/><l level="1" sID="gen21840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8620"/>Et filios advenæ, qui adhærent Domino, <l eID="gen21840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21841"/>ut colant eum, et diligant nomen ejus, <l eID="gen21841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21842"/>ut sint ei in servos ; <l eID="gen21842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21843"/>omnem custodientem sabbatum ne polluat illud, <l eID="gen21843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21844"/>et tenentem fœdus meum ; <l eID="gen21844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8621"/><l level="1" sID="gen21845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8621"/>adducam eos in montem sanctum meum, <l eID="gen21845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21846"/>et lætificabo eos in domo orationis meæ ; <l eID="gen21846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21847"/>holocausta eorum et victimæ eorum placebunt mihi super altari meo, <l eID="gen21847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21848"/>quia domus mea domus orationis vocabitur <l eID="gen21848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21849"/>cunctis populis. <l eID="gen21849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8622"/><l level="1" sID="gen21850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8622"/>Ait Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen21850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21851"/>qui congregat dispersos Israël : <l eID="gen21851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21852"/>Adhuc congregabo ad eum <l eID="gen21852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21853"/>congregatos ejus. <l eID="gen21853" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8623"/><l level="1" sID="gen21854"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8623"/>Omnes bestiæ agri, <l eID="gen21854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21855"/>venite ad devorandum, <l eID="gen21855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21856"/>universæ bestiæ saltus. <l eID="gen21856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8624"/><l level="1" sID="gen21857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8624"/>Speculatores ejus cæci omnes ; <l eID="gen21857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21858"/>nescierunt universi : <l eID="gen21858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21859"/>canes muti non valentes latrare, <l eID="gen21859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21860"/>videntes vana, dormientes, <l eID="gen21860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21861"/>et amantes somnia. <l eID="gen21861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8625"/><l level="1" sID="gen21862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8625"/>Et canes imprudentissimi <l eID="gen21862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21863"/>nescierunt saturitatem ; <l eID="gen21863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21864"/>ipsi pastores <l eID="gen21864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21865"/>ignoraverunt intelligentiam : <l eID="gen21865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21866"/>omnes in viam suam declinaverunt ; <l eID="gen21866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21867"/>unusquisque ad avaritiam suam, a summo usque ad novissimum. <l eID="gen21867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 56:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8626"/><l level="1" sID="gen21868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8626"/>Venite, sumamus vinum, <l eID="gen21868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21869"/>et impleamur ebrietate ; <l eID="gen21869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21870"/>et erit sicut hodie, sic et cras, <l eID="gen21870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21871"/>et multo amplius.  <chapter eID="Isa.56"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:1
verses.text: Justus perit, <l eID="gen21872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21873"/>et non est qui recogitet in corde suo ; <l eID="gen21873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21874"/>et viri misericordiæ colliguntur, <l eID="gen21874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21875"/>quia non est qui intelligat : <l eID="gen21875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21876"/>a facie enim malitiæ collectus est justus. <l eID="gen21876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8627"/><l level="1" sID="gen21877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8627"/>Veniat pax ; <l eID="gen21877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21878"/>requiescat in cubili suo <l eID="gen21878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21879"/>qui ambulavit in directione sua. <l eID="gen21879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8628"/><l level="1" sID="gen21880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8628"/>Vos autem accedite huc, <l eID="gen21880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21881"/>filii auguratricis, <l eID="gen21881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21882"/>semen adulteri et fornicariæ. <l eID="gen21882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8629"/><l level="1" sID="gen21883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8629"/>Super quem lusistis ? <l eID="gen21883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21884"/>super quem dilatastis os, <l eID="gen21884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21885"/>et ejecistis linguam ? <l eID="gen21885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21886"/>Numquid non vos filii scelesti, <l eID="gen21886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21887"/>semen mendax, <l eID="gen21887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8630"/><l level="1" sID="gen21888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8630"/>qui consolamini in diis <l eID="gen21888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21889"/>subter omne lignum frondosum, <l eID="gen21889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21890"/>immolantes parvulos in torrentibus, <l eID="gen21890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21891"/>subter eminentes petras ? <l eID="gen21891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8631"/><l level="1" sID="gen21892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8631"/>In partibus torrentis pars tua ; <l eID="gen21892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21893"/>hæc est sors tua : <l eID="gen21893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21894"/>et ipsis effudisti libamen, <l eID="gen21894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21895"/>obtulisti sacrificium. <l eID="gen21895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21896"/>Numquid super his non indignabor ? <l eID="gen21896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8632"/><l level="1" sID="gen21897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8632"/>Super montem excelsum et sublimem <l eID="gen21897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21898"/>posuisti cubile tuum, <l eID="gen21898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21899"/>et illuc ascendisti <l eID="gen21899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21900"/>ut immolares hostias. <l eID="gen21900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8633"/><l level="1" sID="gen21901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8633"/>Et post ostium, et retro postem, <l eID="gen21901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21902"/>posuisti memoriale tuum. <l eID="gen21902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21903"/>Quia juxta me discooperuisti, <l eID="gen21903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21904"/>et suscepisti adulterum, dilatasti cubile tuum, <l eID="gen21904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21905"/>et pepigisti cum eis fœdus ; <l eID="gen21905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21906"/>dilexisti stratum eorum <l eID="gen21906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21907"/>manu aperta. <l eID="gen21907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8634"/><l level="1" sID="gen21908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8634"/>Et ornasti te regi unguento, <l eID="gen21908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21909"/>et multiplicasti pigmenta tua. <l eID="gen21909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21910"/>Misisti legatos tuos procul, <l eID="gen21910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21911"/>et humiliata es usque ad inferos. <l eID="gen21911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8635"/><l level="1" sID="gen21912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8635"/>In multitudine viæ tuæ laborasti ; <l eID="gen21912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21913"/>non dixisti : Quiescam. <l eID="gen21913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21914"/>Vitam manus tuæ invenisti ; <l eID="gen21914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21915"/>propterea non rogasti. <l eID="gen21915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8636"/><l level="1" sID="gen21916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8636"/>Pro quo sollicita timuisti, <l eID="gen21916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21917"/>quia mentita es, <l eID="gen21917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21918"/>et mei non es recordata, <l eID="gen21918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21919"/>neque cogitasti in corde tuo ? <l eID="gen21919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21920"/>Quia ego tacens et quasi non videns, <l eID="gen21920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21921"/>et mei oblita es. <l eID="gen21921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8637"/><l level="1" sID="gen21922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8637"/>Ego annuntiabo justitiam tuam, <l eID="gen21922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21923"/>et opera tua non proderunt tibi. <l eID="gen21923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8638"/><l level="1" sID="gen21924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8638"/>Cum clamaveris, liberent te congregati tui, <l eID="gen21924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21925"/>et omnes eos auferet ventus, <l eID="gen21925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21926"/>tollet aura. <l eID="gen21926" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen20515"/> <div sID="gen21927" type="x-p"/> <div eID="gen21927" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen21928"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21929"/>Qui autem fiduciam habet mei, hæreditabit terram, <l eID="gen21929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21930"/>et possidebit montem sanctum meum. <l eID="gen21930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8639"/><l level="1" sID="gen21931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8639"/>Et dicam : Viam facite, præbete iter ; declinate de semita, <l eID="gen21931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21932"/>auferte offendicula de via populi mei. <l eID="gen21932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8640"/><l level="1" sID="gen21933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8640"/>Quia hæc dicit Excelsus, <l eID="gen21933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21934"/>et Sublimis, habitans æternitatem, et sanctum nomen ejus : <l eID="gen21934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21935"/>in excelso et in sancto habitans, <l eID="gen21935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21936"/>et cum contrito et humili spiritu : <l eID="gen21936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21937"/>ut vivificet spiritum humilium, <l eID="gen21937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21938"/>et vivificet cor contritorum. <l eID="gen21938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8641"/><l level="1" sID="gen21939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8641"/>Non enim in sempiternum litigabo, <l eID="gen21939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21940"/>neque usque ad finem irascar, <l eID="gen21940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21941"/>quia spiritus a facie mea egredietur, <l eID="gen21941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21942"/>et flatus ego faciam. <l eID="gen21942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8642"/><l level="1" sID="gen21943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8642"/>Propter iniquitatem avaritiæ ejus iratus sum, et percussi eum. <l eID="gen21943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21944"/>Abscondi a te faciem meam, et indignatus sum ; <l eID="gen21944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21945"/>et abiit vagus in via cordis sui. <l eID="gen21945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8643"/><l level="1" sID="gen21946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8643"/>Vias ejus vidi, et sanavi eum ; <l eID="gen21946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21947"/>et reduxi eum, et reddidi consolationes <l eID="gen21947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21948"/>ipsi, et lugentibus ejus. <l eID="gen21948" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8644"/><l level="1" sID="gen21949"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8644"/>Creavi fructum labiorum pacem ; <l eID="gen21949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21950"/>pacem ei qui longe est et qui prope, <l eID="gen21950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21951"/>dixit Dominus, et sanavi eum. <l eID="gen21951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8645"/><l level="1" sID="gen21952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8645"/>Impii autem quasi mare fervens, <l eID="gen21952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21953"/>quod quiescere non potest, <l eID="gen21953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21954"/>et redundant fluctus ejus in conculcationem et lutum. <l eID="gen21954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 57:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8646"/><l level="1" sID="gen21955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8646"/>Non est pax impiis, dicit Dominus Deus.  <chapter eID="Isa.57"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:1
verses.text: Clama, ne cesses, <l eID="gen21956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21957"/>quasi tuba exalta vocem tuam, <l eID="gen21957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21958"/>et annuntia populo meo scelera eorum, <l eID="gen21958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21959"/>et domui Jacob peccata eorum. <l eID="gen21959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8647"/><l level="1" sID="gen21960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8647"/>Me etenim de die in diem quærunt, <l eID="gen21960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21961"/>et scire vias meas volunt, <l eID="gen21961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21962"/>quasi gens quæ justitiam fecerit, <l eID="gen21962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21963"/>et judicium Dei sui non dereliquerit. <l eID="gen21963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21964"/>Rogant me judicia justitiæ ; <l eID="gen21964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21965"/>appropinquare Deo volunt. <l eID="gen21965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8648"/><l level="1" sID="gen21966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8648"/>Quare jejunavimus, et non aspexisti ; <l eID="gen21966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21967"/>humiliavimus animas nostras, et nescisti ? <l eID="gen21967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21968"/>Ecce in die jejunii vestri invenitur voluntas vestra, <l eID="gen21968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21969"/>et omnes debitores vestros repetitis. <l eID="gen21969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8649"/><l level="1" sID="gen21970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8649"/>Ecce ad lites et contentiones jejunatis, <l eID="gen21970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21971"/>et percutitis pugno impie. <l eID="gen21971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21972"/>Nolite jejunare sicut usque ad hanc diem, <l eID="gen21972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21973"/>ut audiatur in excelso clamor vester. <l eID="gen21973" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8650"/><l level="1" sID="gen21974"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8650"/>Numquid tale est jejunium quod elegi, <l eID="gen21974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21975"/>per diem affligere hominem animam suam ? <l eID="gen21975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21976"/>numquid contorquere quasi circulum caput suum, <l eID="gen21976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21977"/>et saccum et cinerem sternere ? <l eID="gen21977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21978"/>numquid istud vocabis jejunium, <l eID="gen21978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21979"/>et diem acceptabilem Domino ? <l eID="gen21979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8651"/><l level="1" sID="gen21980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8651"/>Nonne hoc est magis jejunium quod elegi ? <l eID="gen21980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21981"/>Dissolve colligationes impietatis, <l eID="gen21981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21982"/>solve fasciculos deprimentes, <l eID="gen21982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21983"/>dimitte eos qui confracti sunt liberos, <l eID="gen21983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21984"/>et omne onus dirumpe ; <l eID="gen21984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8652"/><l level="1" sID="gen21985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8652"/>frange esurienti panem tuum, <l eID="gen21985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21986"/>et egenos vagosque induc in domum tuam ; <l eID="gen21986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21987"/>cum videris nudum, operi eum, <l eID="gen21987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21988"/>et carnem tuam ne despexeris. <l eID="gen21988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8653"/><l level="1" sID="gen21989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8653"/>Tunc erumpet quasi mane lumen tuum ; <l eID="gen21989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21990"/>et sanitas tua citius orietur, <l eID="gen21990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21991"/>et anteibit faciem tuam justitia tua, <l eID="gen21991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21992"/>et gloria Domini colliget te. <l eID="gen21992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8654"/><l level="1" sID="gen21993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8654"/>Tunc invocabis, et Dominus exaudiet ; <l eID="gen21993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21994"/>clamabis, et dicet : Ecce adsum. <l eID="gen21994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21995"/>Si abstuleris de medio tui catenam, <l eID="gen21995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21996"/>et desieris extendere digitum et loqui quod non prodest ; <l eID="gen21996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8655"/><l level="1" sID="gen21997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8655"/>cum effuderis esurienti animam tuam, <l eID="gen21997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21998"/>et animam afflictam repleveris, <l eID="gen21998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen21999"/>orietur in tenebris lux tua, <l eID="gen21999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22000"/>et tenebræ tuæ erunt sicut meridies. <l eID="gen22000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8656"/><l level="1" sID="gen22001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8656"/>Et requiem tibi dabit Dominus semper, <l eID="gen22001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22002"/>et implebit splendoribus animam tuam, <l eID="gen22002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22003"/>et ossa tua liberabit ; <l eID="gen22003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22004"/>et eris quasi hortus irriguus, <l eID="gen22004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22005"/>et sicut fons aquarum <l eID="gen22005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22006"/>cujus non deficient aquæ. <l eID="gen22006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8657"/><l level="1" sID="gen22007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8657"/>Et ædificabuntur in te deserta sæculorum, <l eID="gen22007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22008"/>fundamenta generationis et generationis suscitabis ; <l eID="gen22008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22009"/>et vocaberis ædificator sepium, <l eID="gen22009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22010"/>avertens semitas in quietem. <l eID="gen22010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8658"/><l level="1" sID="gen22011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8658"/>Si averteris a sabbato pedem tuum <l eID="gen22011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22012"/>facere voluntatem tuam in die sancto meo, <l eID="gen22012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22013"/>et vocaveris sabbatum delicatum, <l eID="gen22013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22014"/>et sanctum Domini gloriosum, <l eID="gen22014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22015"/>et glorificaveris eum dum non facis vias tuas, <l eID="gen22015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22016"/>et non invenitur voluntas tua, ut loquaris sermonem : <l eID="gen22016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 58:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8659"/><l level="1" sID="gen22017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8659"/>tunc delectaberis super Domino, <l eID="gen22017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22018"/>et sustollam te super altitudines terræ, <l eID="gen22018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22019"/>et cibabo te hæreditate Jacob patris tui : <l eID="gen22019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22020"/>os enim Domini locutum est.  <chapter eID="Isa.58"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:1
verses.text: Ecce non est abbreviata manus Domini, ut salvare nequeat, <l eID="gen22021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22022"/>neque aggravata est auris ejus, ut non exaudiat. <l eID="gen22022" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8660"/><l level="1" sID="gen22023"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8660"/>Sed iniquitates vestræ diviserunt <l eID="gen22023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22024"/>inter vos et Deum vestrum ; <l eID="gen22024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22025"/>et peccata vestra absconderunt faciem ejus a vobis, <l eID="gen22025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22026"/>ne exaudiret. <l eID="gen22026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8661"/><l level="1" sID="gen22027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8661"/>Manus enim vestræ pollutæ sunt sanguine, <l eID="gen22027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22028"/>et digiti vestri iniquitate ; <l eID="gen22028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22029"/>labia vestra locuta sunt mendacium, <l eID="gen22029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22030"/>et lingua vestra iniquitatem fatur. <l eID="gen22030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8662"/><l level="1" sID="gen22031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8662"/>Non est qui invocet justitiam, <l eID="gen22031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22032"/>neque est qui judicet vere : <l eID="gen22032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22033"/>sed confidunt in nihilo, et loquuntur vanitates ; <l eID="gen22033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22034"/>conceperunt laborem, et pepererunt iniquitatem. <l eID="gen22034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8663"/><l level="1" sID="gen22035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8663"/>Ova aspidum ruperunt, <l eID="gen22035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22036"/>et telas araneæ texuerunt. <l eID="gen22036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22037"/>Qui comederit de ovis eorum, morietur ; <l eID="gen22037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22038"/>et quod confotum est, erumpet in regulum. <l eID="gen22038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8664"/><l level="1" sID="gen22039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8664"/>Telæ eorum non erunt in vestimentum, <l eID="gen22039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22040"/>neque operientur operibus suis ; <l eID="gen22040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22041"/>opera eorum opera inutilia, <l eID="gen22041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22042"/>et opus iniquitatis in manibus eorum. <l eID="gen22042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8665"/><l level="1" sID="gen22043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8665"/>Pedes eorum ad malum currunt, <l eID="gen22043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22044"/>et festinant ut effundant sanguinem innocentem ; <l eID="gen22044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22045"/>cogitationes eorum cogitationes inutiles : <l eID="gen22045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22046"/>vastitas et contritio in viis eorum. <l eID="gen22046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8666"/><l level="1" sID="gen22047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8666"/>Viam pacis nescierunt, <l eID="gen22047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22048"/>et non est judicium in gressibus eorum ; <l eID="gen22048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22049"/>semitæ eorum incurvatæ sunt eis : <l eID="gen22049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22050"/>omnis qui calcat in eis, ignorat pacem. <l eID="gen22050" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8667"/><l level="1" sID="gen22051"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8667"/>Propter hoc elongatum est judicium a nobis, <l eID="gen22051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22052"/>et non apprehendet nos justitia. <l eID="gen22052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22053"/>Exspectavimus lucem, et ecce tenebræ ; <l eID="gen22053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22054"/>splendorem, et in tenebris ambulavimus. <l eID="gen22054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8668"/><l level="1" sID="gen22055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8668"/>Palpavimus sicut cæci parietem, <l eID="gen22055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22056"/>et quasi absque oculis attrectavimus : <l eID="gen22056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22057"/>impegimus meridie quasi in tenebris ; <l eID="gen22057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22058"/>in caliginosis quasi mortui. <l eID="gen22058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8669"/><l level="1" sID="gen22059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8669"/>Rugiemus quasi ursi omnes, <l eID="gen22059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22060"/>et quasi columbæ meditantes gememus : <l eID="gen22060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22061"/>exspectavimus judicium, et non est ; <l eID="gen22061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22062"/>salutem, et elongata est a nobis. <l eID="gen22062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8670"/><l level="1" sID="gen22063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8670"/>Multiplicatæ sunt enim iniquitates nostræ coram te, <l eID="gen22063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22064"/>et peccata nostra responderunt nobis, <l eID="gen22064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22065"/>quia scelera nostra nobiscum <l eID="gen22065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22066"/>et iniquitates nostras cognovimus. <l eID="gen22066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8671"/><l level="1" sID="gen22067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8671"/>Peccare et mentiri contra Dominum, <l eID="gen22067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22068"/>et aversi sumus ne iremus post tergum Dei nostri, <l eID="gen22068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22069"/>ut loqueremur calumniam et transgressionem ; <l eID="gen22069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22070"/>concepimus et locuti sumus de corde verba mendacii. <l eID="gen22070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8672"/><l level="1" sID="gen22071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8672"/>Et conversum est retrorsum judicium, <l eID="gen22071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22072"/>et justitia longe stetit, <l eID="gen22072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22073"/>quia corruit in platea veritas, <l eID="gen22073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22074"/>et æquitas non potuit ingredi. <l eID="gen22074" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8673"/><l level="1" sID="gen22075"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8673"/>Et facta est veritas in oblivionem, <l eID="gen22075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22076"/>et qui recessit a malo, prædæ patuit. <l eID="gen22076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22077"/>Et vidit Dominus, et malum apparuit in oculis ejus, <l eID="gen22077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22078"/>quia non est judicium. <l eID="gen22078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8674"/><l level="1" sID="gen22079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8674"/>Et vidit quia non est vir, <l eID="gen22079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22080"/>et aporiatus est, quia non est qui occurrat ; <l eID="gen22080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22081"/>et salvavit sibi brachium suum, <l eID="gen22081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22082"/>et justitia ejus ipsa confirmavit eum. <l eID="gen22082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8675"/><l level="1" sID="gen22083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8675"/>Indutus est justitia ut lorica, <l eID="gen22083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22084"/>et galea salutis in capite ejus ; <l eID="gen22084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22085"/>indutus est vestimentis ultionis, <l eID="gen22085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22086"/>et opertus est quasi pallio zeli : <l eID="gen22086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8676"/><l level="1" sID="gen22087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8676"/>sicut ad vindictam quasi ad retributionem <l eID="gen22087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22088"/>indignationis hostibus suis, <l eID="gen22088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22089"/>et vicissitudinem inimicis suis ; <l eID="gen22089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22090"/>insulis vicem reddet. <l eID="gen22090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8677"/><l level="1" sID="gen22091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8677"/>Et timebunt qui ab occidente nomen Domini, <l eID="gen22091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22092"/>et qui ab ortu solis gloriam ejus, <l eID="gen22092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22093"/>cum venerit quasi fluvius violentus <l eID="gen22093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22094"/>quem spiritus Domini cogit ; <l eID="gen22094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8678"/><l level="1" sID="gen22095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8678"/>et venerit Sion redemptor, <l eID="gen22095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22096"/>et eis qui redeunt ab iniquitate in Jacob, <l eID="gen22096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22097"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 59:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8679"/><l level="1" sID="gen22098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8679"/>Hoc fœdus meum cum eis, <l eID="gen22098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22099"/>dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen22099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22100"/>spiritus meus qui est in te, <l eID="gen22100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22101"/>et verba mea quæ posui in ore tuo, <l eID="gen22101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22102"/>non recedent de ore tuo, <l eID="gen22102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22103"/>et de ore seminis tui, <l eID="gen22103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22104"/>et de ore seminis seminis tui, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen22104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22105"/>amodo et usque in sempiternum.  <chapter eID="Isa.59"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:1
verses.text: Surge, illuminare, Jerusalem, quia venit lumen tuum, <l eID="gen22106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22107"/>et gloria Domini super te orta est. <l eID="gen22107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8680"/><l level="1" sID="gen22108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8680"/>Quia ecce tenebræ operient terram, <l eID="gen22108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22109"/>et caligo populos ; <l eID="gen22109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22110"/>super te autem orietur Dominus, <l eID="gen22110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22111"/>et gloria ejus in te videbitur. <l eID="gen22111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8681"/><l level="1" sID="gen22112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8681"/>Et ambulabunt gentes in lumine tuo, <l eID="gen22112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22113"/>et reges in splendore ortus tui. <l eID="gen22113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8682"/><l level="1" sID="gen22114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8682"/>Leva in circuitu oculos tuos, et vide : <l eID="gen22114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22115"/>omnes isti congregati sunt, venerunt tibi ; <l eID="gen22115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22116"/>filii tui de longe venient <l eID="gen22116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22117"/>et filiæ tuæ de latere surgent. <l eID="gen22117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8683"/><l level="1" sID="gen22118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8683"/>Tunc videbis, et afflues ; <l eID="gen22118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22119"/>mirabitur et dilatabitur cor tuum : <l eID="gen22119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22120"/>quando conversa fuerit ad te multitudo maris ; <l eID="gen22120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22121"/>fortitudo gentium venerit tibi. <l eID="gen22121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8684"/><l level="1" sID="gen22122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8684"/>Inundatio camelorum operiet te, <l eID="gen22122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22123"/>dromedarii Madian et Epha ; <l eID="gen22123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22124"/>omnes de Saba venient, <l eID="gen22124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22125"/>aurum et thus deferentes, <l eID="gen22125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22126"/>et laudem Domino annuntiantes. <l eID="gen22126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8685"/><l level="1" sID="gen22127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8685"/>Omne pecus Cedar congregabitur tibi ; <l eID="gen22127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22128"/>arietes Nabaioth ministrabunt tibi : <l eID="gen22128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22129"/>offerentur super placabili altari meo, <l eID="gen22129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22130"/>et domum majestatis meæ glorificabo. <l eID="gen22130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8686"/><l level="1" sID="gen22131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8686"/>Qui sunt isti qui ut nubes volant, <l eID="gen22131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22132"/>et quasi columbæ ad fenestras suas ? <l eID="gen22132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:9
