verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8687"/><l level="1" sID="gen22133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8687"/>Me enim insulæ exspectant, <l eID="gen22133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22134"/>et naves maris in principio, <l eID="gen22134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22135"/>ut adducam filios tuos de longe ; <l eID="gen22135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22136"/>argentum eorum, et aurum eorum cum eis, <l eID="gen22136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22137"/>nomini Domini Dei tui, <l eID="gen22137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22138"/>et Sancto Israël, quia glorificavit te. <l eID="gen22138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8688"/><l level="1" sID="gen22139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8688"/>Et ædificabunt filii peregrinorum muros tuos, <l eID="gen22139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22140"/>et reges eorum ministrabunt tibi ; <l eID="gen22140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22141"/>in indignatione enim mea percussi te, <l eID="gen22141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22142"/>et in reconciliatione mea misertus sum tui. <l eID="gen22142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8689"/><l level="1" sID="gen22143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8689"/>Et aperientur portæ tuæ jugiter ; <l eID="gen22143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22144"/>die ac nocte non claudentur, <l eID="gen22144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22145"/>ut afferatur ad te fortitudo gentium, <l eID="gen22145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22146"/>et reges earum adducantur. <l eID="gen22146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8690"/><l level="1" sID="gen22147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8690"/>Gens enim et regnum quod non servierit tibi peribit, <l eID="gen22147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22148"/>et gentes solitudine vastabuntur. <l eID="gen22148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8691"/><l level="1" sID="gen22149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8691"/>Gloria Libani ad te veniet, <l eID="gen22149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22150"/>abies, et buxus, et pinus simul <l eID="gen22150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22151"/>ad ornandum locum sanctificationis meæ ; <l eID="gen22151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22152"/>et locum pedum meorum glorificabo. <l eID="gen22152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8692"/><l level="1" sID="gen22153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8692"/>Et venient ad te curvi filii eorum qui humiliaverunt te, <l eID="gen22153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22154"/>et adorabunt vestigia pedum tuorum omnes qui detrahebant tibi : <l eID="gen22154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22155"/>et vocabunt te civitatem Domini, <l eID="gen22155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22156"/>Sion Sancti Israël. <l eID="gen22156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8693"/><l level="1" sID="gen22157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8693"/>Pro eo quod fuisti derelicta <l eID="gen22157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22158"/>et odio habita, <l eID="gen22158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22159"/>et non erat qui per te transiret : <l eID="gen22159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22160"/>ponam te in superbiam sæculorum, <l eID="gen22160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22161"/>gaudium in generationem et generationem : <l eID="gen22161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8694"/><l level="1" sID="gen22162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8694"/>et suges lac gentium, <l eID="gen22162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22163"/>et mamilla regum lactaberis ; <l eID="gen22163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22164"/>et scies quia ego Dominus salvans te, <l eID="gen22164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22165"/>et redemptor tuus, Fortis Jacob. <l eID="gen22165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8695"/><l level="1" sID="gen22166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8695"/>Pro ære afferam aurum, <l eID="gen22166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22167"/>et pro ferro afferam argentum, <l eID="gen22167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22168"/>et pro lignis æs, <l eID="gen22168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22169"/>et pro lapidibus ferrum : <l eID="gen22169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22170"/>et ponam visitationem tuam pacem, <l eID="gen22170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22171"/>et præpositos tuos justitiam. <l eID="gen22171" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8696"/><l level="1" sID="gen22172"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8696"/>Non audietur ultra iniquitas in terra tua ; <l eID="gen22172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22173"/>vastitas et contritio in terminis tuis : <l eID="gen22173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22174"/>et occupabit salus muros tuos, <l eID="gen22174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22175"/>et portas tuas laudatio. <l eID="gen22175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8697"/><l level="1" sID="gen22176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8697"/>Non erit tibi amplius sol ad lucendum per diem, <l eID="gen22176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22177"/>nec splendor lunæ illuminabit te : <l eID="gen22177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22178"/>sed erit tibi Dominus in lucem sempiternam, <l eID="gen22178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22179"/>et Deus tuus in gloriam tuam. <l eID="gen22179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8698"/><l level="1" sID="gen22180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8698"/>Non occidet ultra sol tuus, <l eID="gen22180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22181"/>et luna tua non minuetur, <l eID="gen22181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22182"/>quia erit tibi Dominus in lucem sempiternam, <l eID="gen22182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22183"/>et complebuntur dies luctus tui. <l eID="gen22183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8699"/><l level="1" sID="gen22184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8699"/>Populus autem tuus omnes justi ; <l eID="gen22184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22185"/>in perpetuum hæreditabunt terram : <l eID="gen22185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22186"/>germen plantationis meæ, <l eID="gen22186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22187"/>opus manus meæ ad glorificandum. <l eID="gen22187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 60:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8700"/><l level="1" sID="gen22188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8700"/>Minimus erit in mille, <l eID="gen22188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22189"/>et parvulus in gentem fortissimam. <l eID="gen22189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22190"/>Ego Dominus in tempore ejus <l eID="gen22190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22191"/>subito faciam istud.  <chapter eID="Isa.60"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:1
verses.text: Spiritus Domini super me, <l eID="gen22192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22193"/>eo quod unxerit Dominus me ; <l eID="gen22193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22194"/>ad annuntiandum mansuetis misit me, <l eID="gen22194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22195"/>ut mederer contritis corde, <l eID="gen22195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22196"/>et prædicarem captivis indulgentiam, <l eID="gen22196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22197"/>et clausis apertionem ; <l eID="gen22197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8701"/><l level="1" sID="gen22198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8701"/>ut prædicarem annum placabilem Domino, <l eID="gen22198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22199"/>et diem ultionis Deo nostro ; <l eID="gen22199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22200"/>ut consolarer omnes lugentes, <l eID="gen22200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8702"/><l level="1" sID="gen22201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8702"/>ut ponerem lugentibus Sion, <l eID="gen22201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22202"/>et darem eis coronam pro cinere, <l eID="gen22202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22203"/>oleum gaudii pro luctu, <l eID="gen22203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22204"/>pallium laudis pro spiritu mœroris ; <l eID="gen22204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22205"/>et vocabuntur in ea fortes justitiæ, <l eID="gen22205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22206"/>plantatio Domini ad glorificandum. <l eID="gen22206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8703"/><l level="1" sID="gen22207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8703"/>Et ædificabunt deserta a sæculo, <l eID="gen22207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22208"/>et ruinas antiquas erigent, <l eID="gen22208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22209"/>et instaurabunt civitates desertas, <l eID="gen22209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22210"/>dissipatas in generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen22210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8704"/><l level="1" sID="gen22211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8704"/>Et stabunt alieni, et pascent pecora vestra, <l eID="gen22211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22212"/>et filii peregrinorum agricolæ et vinitores vestri erunt. <l eID="gen22212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8705"/><l level="1" sID="gen22213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8705"/>Vos autem sacerdotes Domini vocabimini : <l eID="gen22213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22214"/>Ministri Dei nostri, dicetur vobis, <l eID="gen22214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22215"/>fortitudinem gentium comedetis, <l eID="gen22215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22216"/>et in gloria earum superbietis. <l eID="gen22216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8706"/><l level="1" sID="gen22217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8706"/>Pro confusione vestra duplici et rubore, <l eID="gen22217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22218"/>laudabunt partem suam ; <l eID="gen22218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22219"/>propter hoc in terra sua duplicia possidebunt, <l eID="gen22219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22220"/>lætitia sempiterna erit eis. <l eID="gen22220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8707"/><l level="1" sID="gen22221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8707"/>Quia ego Dominus diligens judicium, <l eID="gen22221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22222"/>et odio habens rapinam in holocausto ; <l eID="gen22222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22223"/>et dabo opus eorum in veritate, <l eID="gen22223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22224"/>et fœdus perpetuum feriam eis. <l eID="gen22224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8708"/><l level="1" sID="gen22225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8708"/>Et scient in gentibus semen eorum, <l eID="gen22225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22226"/>et germen eorum in medio populorum ; <l eID="gen22226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22227"/>omnes qui viderint eos cognoscent illos, <l eID="gen22227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22228"/>quia isti sunt semen cui benedixit Dominus. <l eID="gen22228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8709"/><l level="1" sID="gen22229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8709"/>Gaudens gaudebo in Domino, <l eID="gen22229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22230"/>et exsultabit anima mea in Deo meo, <l eID="gen22230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22231"/>quia induit me vestimentis salutis, <l eID="gen22231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22232"/>et indumento justitiæ circumdedit me, <l eID="gen22232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22233"/>quasi sponsum decoratum corona, <l eID="gen22233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22234"/>et quasi sponsam ornatam monilibus suis. <l eID="gen22234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 61:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8710"/><l level="1" sID="gen22235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8710"/>Sicut enim terra profert germen suum, <l eID="gen22235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22236"/>et sicut hortus semen suum germinat, <l eID="gen22236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22237"/>sic Dominus Deus germinabit justitiam <l eID="gen22237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22238"/>et laudem coram universis gentibus.  <chapter eID="Isa.61"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:1
verses.text: Propter Sion non tacebo, <l eID="gen22239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22240"/>et propter Jerusalem non quiescam, <l eID="gen22240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22241"/>donec egrediatur ut splendor justus ejus, <l eID="gen22241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22242"/>et salvator ejus ut lampas accendatur. <l eID="gen22242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8711"/><l level="1" sID="gen22243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8711"/>Et videbunt gentes justum tuum, <l eID="gen22243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22244"/>et cuncti reges inclytum tuum ; <l eID="gen22244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22245"/>et vocabitur tibi nomen novum, <l eID="gen22245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22246"/>quod os Domini nominabit. <l eID="gen22246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8712"/><l level="1" sID="gen22247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8712"/>Et eris corona gloriæ in manu Domini, <l eID="gen22247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22248"/>et diadema regni in manu Dei tui. <l eID="gen22248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8713"/><l level="1" sID="gen22249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8713"/>Non vocaberis ultra Derelicta, <l eID="gen22249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22250"/>et terra tua non vocabitur amplius Desolata ; <l eID="gen22250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22251"/>sed vocaberis, Voluntas mea in ea, <l eID="gen22251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22252"/>et terra tua Inhabitata, <l eID="gen22252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22253"/>quia complacuit Domino in te, <l eID="gen22253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22254"/>et terra tua inhabitabitur. <l eID="gen22254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8714"/><l level="1" sID="gen22255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8714"/>Habitabit enim juvenis cum virgine, <l eID="gen22255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22256"/>et habitabunt in te filii tui ; <l eID="gen22256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22257"/>et gaudebit sponsus super sponsam, <l eID="gen22257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22258"/>et gaudebit super te Deus tuus. <l eID="gen22258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8715"/><l level="1" sID="gen22259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8715"/>Super muros tuos, Jerusalem, constitui custodes ; <l eID="gen22259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22260"/>tota die et tota nocte <l eID="gen22260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22261"/>in perpetuum non tacebunt. <l eID="gen22261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22262"/>Qui reminiscimini Domini, ne taceatis, <l eID="gen22262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8716"/><l level="1" sID="gen22263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8716"/>et ne detis silentium ei, <l eID="gen22263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22264"/>donec stabiliat et donec ponat Jerusalem <l eID="gen22264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22265"/>laudem in terra. <l eID="gen22265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8717"/><l level="1" sID="gen22266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8717"/>Juravit Dominus in dextera sua, <l eID="gen22266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22267"/>et in brachio fortitudinis suæ : <l eID="gen22267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22268"/>Si dedero triticum tuum ultra <l eID="gen22268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22269"/>cibum inimicis tuis ; <l eID="gen22269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22270"/>et si biberint filii alieni vinum tuum <l eID="gen22270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22271"/>in quo laborasti. <l eID="gen22271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8718"/><l level="1" sID="gen22272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8718"/>Quia qui congregant illud, comedent, <l eID="gen22272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22273"/>et laudabunt Dominum ; <l eID="gen22273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22274"/>et qui comportant illud, bibent <l eID="gen22274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22275"/>in atriis sanctis meis. <l eID="gen22275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8719"/><l level="1" sID="gen22276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8719"/>Transite, transite per portas, <l eID="gen22276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22277"/>præparate viam populo : <l eID="gen22277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22278"/>planum facite iter, eligite lapides, <l eID="gen22278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22279"/>et elevate signum ad populos. <l eID="gen22279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8720"/><l level="1" sID="gen22280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8720"/>Ecce Dominus auditum fecit <l eID="gen22280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22281"/>in extremis terræ : <l eID="gen22281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22282"/>Dicite filiæ Sion : <l eID="gen22282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22283"/>Ecce Salvator tuus venit ; <l eID="gen22283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22284"/>ecce merces ejus cum eo, <l eID="gen22284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22285"/>et opus ejus coram illo. <l eID="gen22285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 62:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8721"/><l level="1" sID="gen22286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8721"/>Et vocabunt eos, Populus sanctus, <l eID="gen22286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22287"/>redempti a Domino ; <l eID="gen22287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22288"/>tu autem vocaberis, Quæsita civitas, <l eID="gen22288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22289"/>et non Derelicta.  <chapter eID="Isa.62"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:1
verses.text: Quis est iste, qui venit de Edom, <l eID="gen22290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22291"/>tinctis vestibus de Bosra ? <l eID="gen22291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22292"/>iste formosus in stola sua, <l eID="gen22292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22293"/>gradiens in multitudine fortitudinis suæ ? <l eID="gen22293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22294"/>Ego qui loquor justitiam, <l eID="gen22294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22295"/>et propugnator sum ad salvandum. <l eID="gen22295" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8722"/><l level="1" sID="gen22296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8722"/>Quare ergo rubrum est indumentum tuum, <l eID="gen22296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22297"/>et vestimenta tua sicut calcantium in torculari ? <l eID="gen22297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8723"/><l level="1" sID="gen22298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8723"/>Torcular calcavi solus, <l eID="gen22298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22299"/>et de gentibus non est vir mecum ; <l eID="gen22299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22300"/>calcavi eos in furore meo, <l eID="gen22300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22301"/>et conculcavi eos in ira mea : <l eID="gen22301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22302"/>et aspersus est sanguis eorum super vestimenta mea, <l eID="gen22302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22303"/>et omnia indumenta mea inquinavi. <l eID="gen22303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8724"/><l level="1" sID="gen22304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8724"/>Dies enim ultionis in corde meo ; <l eID="gen22304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22305"/>annus redemptionis meæ venit. <l eID="gen22305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8725"/><l level="1" sID="gen22306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8725"/>Circumspexi, et non erat auxiliator ; <l eID="gen22306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22307"/>quæsivi, et non fuit qui adjuvaret : <l eID="gen22307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22308"/>et salvavit mihi brachium meum, <l eID="gen22308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22309"/>et indignatio mea ipsa auxiliata est mihi. <l eID="gen22309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8726"/><l level="1" sID="gen22310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8726"/>Et conculcavi populos in furore meo, <l eID="gen22310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22311"/>et inebriavi eos in indignatione mea, <l eID="gen22311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22312"/>et detraxi in terram virtutem eorum. <l eID="gen22312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8727"/><l level="1" sID="gen22313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8727"/>Miserationum Domini recordabor ; <l eID="gen22313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22314"/>laudem Domini <l eID="gen22314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22315"/>super omnibus quæ reddidit nobis Dominus, <l eID="gen22315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22316"/>et super multitudinem bonorum domui Israël, <l eID="gen22316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22317"/>quæ largitus est eis secundum indulgentiam suam, <l eID="gen22317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22318"/>et secundum multitudinem misericordiarum suarum. <l eID="gen22318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8728"/><l level="1" sID="gen22319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8728"/>Et dixit : Verumtamen populus meus est, <l eID="gen22319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22320"/>filii non negantes ; <l eID="gen22320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22321"/>et factus est eis salvator. <l eID="gen22321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8729"/><l level="1" sID="gen22322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8729"/>In omni tribulatione eorum non est tribulatus, <l eID="gen22322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22323"/>et angelus faciei ejus salvavit eos : <l eID="gen22323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22324"/>in dilectione sua et in indulgentia sua <l eID="gen22324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22325"/>ipse redemit eos, <l eID="gen22325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22326"/>et portavit eos, et elevavit eos <l eID="gen22326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22327"/>cunctis diebus sæculi. <l eID="gen22327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8730"/><l level="1" sID="gen22328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8730"/>Ipsi autem ad iracundiam provocaverunt, <l eID="gen22328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22329"/>et afflixerunt spiritum Sancti ejus : <l eID="gen22329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22330"/>et conversus est eis in inimicum, <l eID="gen22330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22331"/>et ipse debellavit eos. <l eID="gen22331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8731"/><l level="1" sID="gen22332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8731"/>Et recordatus est dierum sæculi Moysi, et populi sui. <l eID="gen22332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22333"/>Ubi est qui eduxit eos de mari <l eID="gen22333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22334"/>cum pastoribus gregis sui ? <l eID="gen22334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22335"/>Ubi est qui posuit in medio ejus <l eID="gen22335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22336"/>spiritum Sancti sui ; <l eID="gen22336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8732"/><l level="1" sID="gen22337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8732"/>qui eduxit ad dexteram Moysen, <l eID="gen22337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22338"/>brachio majestatis suæ ; <l eID="gen22338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22339"/>qui scidit aquas ante eos, <l eID="gen22339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22340"/>ut faceret sibi nomen sempiternum ; <l eID="gen22340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8733"/><l level="1" sID="gen22341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8733"/>qui eduxit eos per abyssos, <l eID="gen22341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22342"/>quasi equum in deserto <l eID="gen22342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22343"/>non impingentem ? <l eID="gen22343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8734"/><l level="1" sID="gen22344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8734"/>Quasi animal in campo descendens, <l eID="gen22344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22345"/>spiritus Domini ductor ejus fuit. <l eID="gen22345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22346"/>Sic adduxisti populum tuum, <l eID="gen22346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22347"/>ut faceres tibi nomen gloriæ. <l eID="gen22347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8735"/><l level="1" sID="gen22348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8735"/>Attende de cælo, et vide <l eID="gen22348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22349"/>de habitaculo sancto tuo, et gloriæ tuæ. <l eID="gen22349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22350"/>Ubi est zelus tuus, et fortitudo tua, <l eID="gen22350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22351"/>multitudo viscerum tuorum et miserationum tuarum ? <l eID="gen22351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22352"/>Super me continuerunt se. <l eID="gen22352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8736"/><l level="1" sID="gen22353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8736"/>Tu enim pater noster : <l eID="gen22353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22354"/>et Abraham nescivit nos, <l eID="gen22354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22355"/>et Israël ignoravit nos : <l eID="gen22355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22356"/>tu, Domine, pater noster, <l eID="gen22356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22357"/>redemptor noster, a sæculo nomen tuum. <l eID="gen22357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8737"/><l level="1" sID="gen22358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8737"/>Quare errare nos fecisti, Domine, de viis tuis ; <l eID="gen22358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22359"/>indurasti cor nostrum ne timeremus te ? <l eID="gen22359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22360"/>Convertere propter servos tuos, <l eID="gen22360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22361"/>tribus hæreditatis tuæ. <l eID="gen22361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8738"/><l level="1" sID="gen22362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8738"/>Quasi nihilum possederunt populum sanctum tuum : <l eID="gen22362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22363"/>hostes nostri conculcaverunt sanctificationem tuam. <l eID="gen22363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 63:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8739"/><l level="1" sID="gen22364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8739"/>Facti sumus quasi in principio, cum non dominareris nostri, <l eID="gen22364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22365"/>neque invocaretur nomen tuum super nos.  <chapter eID="Isa.63"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:1
verses.text: Utinam dirumperes cælos, et descenderes ; <l eID="gen22366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22367"/>a facie tua montes defluerent ; <l eID="gen22367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8740"/><l level="1" sID="gen22368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8740"/>sicut exustio ignis tabescerent, <l eID="gen22368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22369"/>aquæ arderent igni : <l eID="gen22369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22370"/>ut notum fieret nomen tuum inimicis tuis ; <l eID="gen22370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22371"/>a facie tua gentes turbarentur. <l eID="gen22371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8741"/><l level="1" sID="gen22372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8741"/>Cum feceris mirabilia, non sustinebimus ; <l eID="gen22372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22373"/>descendisti, et a facie tua montes defluxerunt. <l eID="gen22373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8742"/><l level="1" sID="gen22374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8742"/>A sæculo non audierunt, neque auribus perceperunt ; <l eID="gen22374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22375"/>oculus non vidit, Deus, absque te, <l eID="gen22375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22376"/>quæ præparasti exspectantibus te. <l eID="gen22376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8743"/><l level="1" sID="gen22377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8743"/>Occurristi lætanti, et facienti justitiam ; <l eID="gen22377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22378"/>in viis tuis recordabuntur tui. <l eID="gen22378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22379"/>Ecce tu iratus es, et peccavimus ; <l eID="gen22379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22380"/>in ipsis fuimus semper, et salvabimur. <l eID="gen22380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8744"/><l level="1" sID="gen22381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8744"/>Et facti sumus ut immundus omnes nos, <l eID="gen22381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22382"/>et quasi pannus menstruatæ universæ justitiæ nostræ ; <l eID="gen22382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22383"/>et cecidimus quasi folium universi, <l eID="gen22383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22384"/>et iniquitates nostræ quasi ventus abstulerunt nos. <l eID="gen22384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8745"/><l level="1" sID="gen22385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8745"/>Non est qui invocet nomen tuum ; <l eID="gen22385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22386"/>qui consurgat, et teneat te. <l eID="gen22386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22387"/>Abscondisti faciem tuam a nobis, <l eID="gen22387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22388"/>et allisisti nos in manu iniquitatis nostræ. <l eID="gen22388" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8746"/><l level="1" sID="gen22389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8746"/>Et nunc, Domine, pater noster es tu, <l eID="gen22389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22390"/>nos vero lutum ; <l eID="gen22390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22391"/>et fictor noster tu, <l eID="gen22391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22392"/>et opera manuum tuarum omnes nos. <l eID="gen22392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8747"/><l level="1" sID="gen22393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8747"/>Ne irascaris, Domine, satis, <l eID="gen22393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22394"/>et ne ultra memineris iniquitatis nostræ ; <l eID="gen22394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22395"/>ecce, respice, populus tuus omnes nos. <l eID="gen22395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8748"/><l level="1" sID="gen22396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8748"/>Civitas Sancti tui facta est deserta, <l eID="gen22396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22397"/>Sion deserta facta est, <l eID="gen22397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22398"/>Jerusalem desolata est. <l eID="gen22398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8749"/><l level="1" sID="gen22399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8749"/>Domus sanctificationis nostræ et gloriæ nostræ, <l eID="gen22399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22400"/>ubi laudaverunt te patres nostri, <l eID="gen22400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22401"/>facta est in exustionem ignis, <l eID="gen22401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22402"/>et omnia desiderabilia nostra versa sunt in ruinas. <l eID="gen22402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 64:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8750"/><l level="1" sID="gen22403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8750"/>Numquid super his continebis te, Domine ; <l eID="gen22403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22404"/>tacebis, et affliges nos vehementer ?  <chapter eID="Isa.64"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:1
verses.text: Quæsierunt me qui ante non interrogabant ; <l eID="gen22405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22406"/>invenerunt qui non quæsierunt me. <l eID="gen22406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22407"/>Dixi : Ecce ego, ecce ego, <l eID="gen22407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22408"/>ad gentem quæ non invocabat nomen meum. <l eID="gen22408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8751"/><l level="1" sID="gen22409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8751"/>Expandi manus meas tota die <l eID="gen22409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22410"/>ad populum incredulum, <l eID="gen22410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22411"/>qui graditur in via non bona <l eID="gen22411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22412"/>post cogitationes suas. <l eID="gen22412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8752"/><l level="1" sID="gen22413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8752"/>Populus qui ad iracundiam provocat me <l eID="gen22413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22414"/>ante faciem meam semper ; <l eID="gen22414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22415"/>qui immolant in hortis, <l eID="gen22415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22416"/>et sacrificant super lateres ; <l eID="gen22416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8753"/><l level="1" sID="gen22417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8753"/>qui habitant in sepulchris, <l eID="gen22417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22418"/>et in delubris idolorum dormiunt ; <l eID="gen22418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22419"/>qui comedunt carnem suillam, <l eID="gen22419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22420"/>et jus profanum in vasis eorum ; <l eID="gen22420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8754"/><l level="1" sID="gen22421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8754"/>qui dicunt : Recede a me, <l eID="gen22421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22422"/>non appropinques mihi, quia immundus es. <l eID="gen22422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22423"/>Isti fumus erunt in furore meo, <l eID="gen22423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22424"/>ignis ardens tota die. <l eID="gen22424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8755"/><l level="1" sID="gen22425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8755"/>Ecce scriptum est coram me : <l eID="gen22425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22426"/>Non tacebo, sed reddam, <l eID="gen22426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22427"/>et retribuam in sinum eorum. <l eID="gen22427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8756"/><l level="1" sID="gen22428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8756"/>Iniquitates vestras, et iniquitates patrum vestrorum simul, <l eID="gen22428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22429"/>dicit Dominus ; <l eID="gen22429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22430"/>qui sacrificaverunt super montes, <l eID="gen22430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22431"/>et super colles exprobraverunt mihi ; <l eID="gen22431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22432"/>et remetiar opus eorum primum <l eID="gen22432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22433"/>in sinu eorum. <l eID="gen22433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8757"/><l level="1" sID="gen22434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8757"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen22434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22435"/>Quomodo si inveniatur granum in botro, <l eID="gen22435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22436"/>et dicatur : Ne dissipes illud, <l eID="gen22436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22437"/>quoniam benedictio est : <l eID="gen22437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22438"/>sic faciam propter servos meos, <l eID="gen22438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22439"/>ut non disperdam totum. <l eID="gen22439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8758"/><l level="1" sID="gen22440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8758"/>Et educam de Jacob semen, <l eID="gen22440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22441"/>et de Juda possidentem montes meos ; <l eID="gen22441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22442"/>et hæreditabunt eam electi mei, <l eID="gen22442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22443"/>et servi mei habitabunt ibi. <l eID="gen22443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8759"/><l level="1" sID="gen22444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8759"/>Et erunt campestria in caulas gregum, <l eID="gen22444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22445"/>et vallis Achor in cubile armentorum, <l eID="gen22445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22446"/>populo meo qui requisierunt me. <l eID="gen22446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8760"/><l level="1" sID="gen22447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8760"/>Et vos qui dereliquistis Dominum, <l eID="gen22447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22448"/>qui obliti estis montem sanctum meum, <l eID="gen22448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22449"/>qui ponitis fortunæ mensam, <l eID="gen22449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22450"/>et libatis super eam : <l eID="gen22450" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8761"/><l level="1" sID="gen22451"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8761"/>numerabo vos in gladio, <l eID="gen22451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22452"/>et omnes in cæde corruetis : <l eID="gen22452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22453"/>pro eo quod vocavi, et non respondistis ; <l eID="gen22453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22454"/>locutus sum, et non audistis ; <l eID="gen22454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22455"/>et faciebatis malum in oculis meis, <l eID="gen22455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22456"/>et quæ nolui elegistis. <l eID="gen22456" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8762"/><l level="1" sID="gen22457"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8762"/>Propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen22457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22458"/>Ecce servi mei comedent, <l eID="gen22458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22459"/>et vos esurietis ; <l eID="gen22459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22460"/>ecce servi mei bibent, <l eID="gen22460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22461"/>et vos sitietis ; <l eID="gen22461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8763"/><l level="1" sID="gen22462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8763"/>ecce servi mei lætabuntur, <l eID="gen22462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22463"/>et vos confundemini ; <l eID="gen22463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22464"/>ecce servi mei laudabunt præ exsultatione cordis, <l eID="gen22464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22465"/>et vos clamabitis præ dolore cordis, <l eID="gen22465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22466"/>et præ contritione spiritus ululabitis, <l eID="gen22466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8764"/><l level="1" sID="gen22467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8764"/>et dimittetis nomen vestrum in juramentum electis meis ; <l eID="gen22467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22468"/>et interficiet te Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen22468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22469"/>et servos suos vocabit nomine alio : <l eID="gen22469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8765"/><l level="1" sID="gen22470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8765"/>in quo qui benedictus est super terram <l eID="gen22470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22471"/>benedicetur in Deo, amen, <l eID="gen22471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22472"/>et qui jurat in terra <l eID="gen22472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22473"/>jurabit in Deo, amen : <l eID="gen22473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22474"/>quia oblivioni traditæ sunt angustiæ priores, <l eID="gen22474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22475"/>et quia absconditæ sunt ab oculis meis. <l eID="gen22475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8766"/><l level="1" sID="gen22476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8766"/>Ecce enim ego creo cælos novos, <l eID="gen22476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22477"/>et terram novam ; <l eID="gen22477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22478"/>et non erunt in memoria priora, <l eID="gen22478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22479"/>et non ascendent super cor. <l eID="gen22479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8767"/><l level="1" sID="gen22480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8767"/>Sed gaudebitis et exsultabitis usque in sempiternum <l eID="gen22480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22481"/>in his quæ ego creo : <l eID="gen22481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22482"/>quia ecce ego creo Jerusalem exsultationem, <l eID="gen22482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22483"/>et populum ejus gaudium. <l eID="gen22483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8768"/><l level="1" sID="gen22484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8768"/>Et exsultabo in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen22484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22485"/>et gaudebo in populo meo, <l eID="gen22485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22486"/>et non audietur in eo ultra <l eID="gen22486" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22487"/>vox fletus et vox clamoris. <l eID="gen22487" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8769"/><l level="1" sID="gen22488"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8769"/>Non erit ibi amplius infans dierum, <l eID="gen22488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22489"/>et senex qui non impleat dies suos, <l eID="gen22489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22490"/>quoniam puer centum annorum morietur, <l eID="gen22490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22491"/>et peccator centum annorum maledictus erit. <l eID="gen22491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8770"/><l level="1" sID="gen22492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8770"/>Et ædificabunt domos, et habitabunt ; <l eID="gen22492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22493"/>et plantabunt vineas, et comedent fructus earum. <l eID="gen22493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8771"/><l level="1" sID="gen22494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8771"/>Non ædificabunt, et alius habitabit ; <l eID="gen22494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22495"/>non plantabunt, et alius comedet : <l eID="gen22495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22496"/>secundum enim dies ligni erunt dies populi mei, <l eID="gen22496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22497"/>et opera manuum eorum inveterabunt. <l eID="gen22497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8772"/><l level="1" sID="gen22498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8772"/>Electi mei non laborabunt frustra, <l eID="gen22498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22499"/>neque generabunt in conturbatione, <l eID="gen22499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22500"/>quia semen benedictorum Domini est, <l eID="gen22500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22501"/>et nepotes eorum cum eis. <l eID="gen22501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8773"/><l level="1" sID="gen22502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8773"/>Eritque antequam clament, ego exaudiam ; <l eID="gen22502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22503"/>adhuc illis loquentibus, ego audiam. <l eID="gen22503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 65:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8774"/><l level="1" sID="gen22504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8774"/>Lupus et agnus pascentur simul, <l eID="gen22504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22505"/>leo et bos comedent paleas, <l eID="gen22505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22506"/>et serpenti pulvis panis ejus. <l eID="gen22506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22507"/>Non nocebunt, neque occident <l eID="gen22507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22508"/>in omni monte sancto meo, dicit Dominus.  <chapter eID="Isa.65"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : Cælum sedes mea, <l eID="gen22509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22510"/>terra autem scabellum pedum meorum. <l eID="gen22510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22511"/>Quæ est ista domus quam ædificabitis mihi ? <l eID="gen22511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22512"/>et quis est iste locus quietis meæ ? <l eID="gen22512" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8775"/><l level="1" sID="gen22513"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8775"/>Omnia hæc manus mea fecit, <l eID="gen22513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22514"/>et facta sunt universa ista, <l eID="gen22514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22515"/>dicit Dominus ; <l eID="gen22515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22516"/>ad quem autem respiciam, nisi ad pauperculum, <l eID="gen22516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22517"/>et contritum spiritu, et trementem sermones meos ? <l eID="gen22517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8776"/><l level="1" sID="gen22518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8776"/>Qui immolat bovem, quasi qui interficiat virum ; <l eID="gen22518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22519"/>qui mactat pecus, quasi qui excerebret canem ; <l eID="gen22519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22520"/>qui offert oblationem, quasi qui sanguinem suillum offerat ; <l eID="gen22520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22521"/>qui recordatur thuris, quasi qui benedicat idolo. <l eID="gen22521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22522"/>Hæc omnia elegerunt in viis suis, <l eID="gen22522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22523"/>et in abominationibus suis anima eorum delectata est. <l eID="gen22523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8777"/><l level="1" sID="gen22524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8777"/>Unde et ego eligam illusiones eorum, <l eID="gen22524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22525"/>et quæ timebant adducam eis ; <l eID="gen22525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22526"/>quia vocavi, et non erat qui responderet ; <l eID="gen22526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22527"/>locutus sum, et non audierunt ; <l eID="gen22527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22528"/>feceruntque malum in oculis meis, <l eID="gen22528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22529"/>et quæ nolui elegerunt. <l eID="gen22529" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8778"/><l level="1" sID="gen22530"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8778"/>Audite verbum Domini, <l eID="gen22530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22531"/>qui tremitis ad verbum ejus. <l eID="gen22531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22532"/>Dixerunt fratres vestri odientes vos, <l eID="gen22532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22533"/>et abjicientes propter nomen meum : <l eID="gen22533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22534"/>Glorificetur Dominus, <l eID="gen22534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22535"/>et videbimus in lætitia vestra ; <l eID="gen22535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22536"/>ipsi autem confundentur. <l eID="gen22536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8779"/><l level="1" sID="gen22537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8779"/>Vox populi de civitate, <l eID="gen22537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22538"/>vox de templo, <l eID="gen22538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22539"/>vox Domini <l eID="gen22539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22540"/>reddentis retributionem inimicis suis. <l eID="gen22540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8780"/><l level="1" sID="gen22541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8780"/>Antequam parturiret, peperit ; <l eID="gen22541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22542"/>antequam veniret partus ejus, <l eID="gen22542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22543"/>peperit masculum. <l eID="gen22543" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8781"/><l level="1" sID="gen22544"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8781"/>Quis audivit umquam tale ? <l eID="gen22544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22545"/>et quis vidit huic simile ? <l eID="gen22545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22546"/>numquid parturiet terra in die una, <l eID="gen22546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22547"/>aut parietur gens simul, <l eID="gen22547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22548"/>quia parturivit et peperit <l eID="gen22548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22549"/>Sion filios suos ? <l eID="gen22549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8782"/><l level="1" sID="gen22550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8782"/>Numquid ego qui alios parere facio, ipse non pariam ? <l eID="gen22550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22551"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22552"/>Si ego, qui generationem ceteris tribuo, sterilis ero ? <l eID="gen22552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22553"/>ait Dominus Deus tuus. <l eID="gen22553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8783"/><l level="1" sID="gen22554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8783"/>Lætamini cum Jerusalem et exsultate in ea, <l eID="gen22554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22555"/>omnes qui diligitis eam ; <l eID="gen22555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22556"/>gaudete cum ea gaudio, <l eID="gen22556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22557"/>universi qui lugetis super eam : <l eID="gen22557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8784"/><l level="1" sID="gen22558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8784"/>ut sugatis et repleamini <l eID="gen22558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22559"/>ab ubere consolationis ejus ; <l eID="gen22559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22560"/>ut mulgeatis et deliciis affluatis <l eID="gen22560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22561"/>ab omnimoda gloria ejus. <l eID="gen22561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8785"/><l level="1" sID="gen22562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8785"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen22562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22563"/>Ecce ego declinabo super eam quasi fluvium pacis, <l eID="gen22563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22564"/>et quasi torrentem inundantem gloriam gentium, <l eID="gen22564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22565"/>quam sugetis : <l eID="gen22565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22566"/>ad ubera portabimini, <l eID="gen22566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22567"/>et super genua blandientur vobis. <l eID="gen22567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8786"/><l level="1" sID="gen22568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8786"/>Quomodo si cui mater blandiatur, <l eID="gen22568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22569"/>ita ego consolabor vos, <l eID="gen22569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22570"/>et in Jerusalem consolabimini. <l eID="gen22570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8787"/><l level="1" sID="gen22571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8787"/>Videbitis, et gaudebit cor vestrum, <l eID="gen22571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22572"/>et ossa vestra quasi herba germinabunt : <l eID="gen22572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22573"/>et cognoscetur manus Domini servis ejus, <l eID="gen22573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22574"/>et indignabitur inimicis suis. <l eID="gen22574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8788"/><l level="1" sID="gen22575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8788"/>Quia ecce Dominus in igne veniet, <l eID="gen22575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22576"/>et quasi turbo quadrigæ ejus, <l eID="gen22576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22577"/>reddere in indignatione furorem suum <l eID="gen22577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22578"/>et increpationem suam in flamma ignis : <l eID="gen22578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8789"/><l level="1" sID="gen22579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8789"/>quia in igne Dominus dijudicabit, <l eID="gen22579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22580"/>et in gladio suo ad omnem carnem ; <l eID="gen22580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22581"/>et multiplicabuntur interfecti a Domino, <l eID="gen22581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8790"/><l level="1" sID="gen22582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8790"/>qui sanctificabantur et mundos se putabant in hortis <l eID="gen22582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22583"/>post januam intrinsecus, <l eID="gen22583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22584"/>qui comedebant carnem suillam, <l eID="gen22584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22585"/>et abominationem et murem : <l eID="gen22585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22586"/>simul consumentur, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8791"/><l level="1" sID="gen22587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8791"/>Ego autem opera eorum et cogitationes eorum <l eID="gen22587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22588"/>venio ut congregem, <l eID="gen22588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22589"/>cum omnibus gentibus et linguis : <l eID="gen22589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22590"/>et venient, et videbunt gloriam meam. <l eID="gen22590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8792"/><l level="1" sID="gen22591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8792"/>Et ponam in eis signum, <l eID="gen22591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22592"/>et mittam ex eis qui salvati fuerint, ad gentes <l eID="gen22592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22593"/>in mare, in Africam, et Lydiam, tendentes sagittam ; <l eID="gen22593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22594"/>in Italiam et Græciam, <l eID="gen22594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22595"/>ad insulas longe, <l eID="gen22595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22596"/>ad eos qui non audierunt de me, <l eID="gen22596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22597"/>et non viderunt gloriam meam. <l eID="gen22597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22598"/>Et annuntiabunt gloriam meam gentibus ; <l eID="gen22598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8793"/><l level="1" sID="gen22599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8793"/>et adducent omnes fratres vestros <l eID="gen22599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22600"/>de cunctis gentibus <l eID="gen22600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22601"/>donum Domino, <l eID="gen22601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22602"/>in equis, et in quadrigis, et in lecticis, <l eID="gen22602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22603"/>et in mulis, et in carrucis, <l eID="gen22603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22604"/>ad montem sanctum meum <l eID="gen22604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22605"/>Jerusalem, dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen22605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22606"/>quomodo si inferant filii Israël munus <l eID="gen22606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22607"/>in vase mundo in domum Domini. <l eID="gen22607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8794"/><l level="1" sID="gen22608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8794"/>Et assumam ex eis <l eID="gen22608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22609"/>in sacerdotes et Levitas, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22609" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8795"/><l level="1" sID="gen22610"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8795"/>Quia sicut cæli novi et terra nova, <l eID="gen22610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22611"/>quæ ego facio stare coram me, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen22611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22612"/>sic stabit semen vestrum et nomen vestrum. <l eID="gen22612" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8796"/><l level="1" sID="gen22613"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8796"/>Et erit mensis ex mense, <l eID="gen22613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22614"/>et sabbatum ex sabbato : <l eID="gen22614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22615"/>veniet omnis caro ut adoret coram facie mea, <l eID="gen22615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22616"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Isaiah 66:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8797"/><l level="1" sID="gen22617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8797"/>Et egredientur, et videbunt cadavera <l eID="gen22617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22618"/>virorum qui prævaricati sunt in me ; <l eID="gen22618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22619"/>vermis eorum non morietur, <l eID="gen22619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22620"/>et ignis eorum non extinguetur : <l eID="gen22620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22621"/>et erunt usque ad satietatem visionis omni carni. <l eID="gen22621" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen21928"/> <chapter eID="Isa.66"/> <div eID="gen18059" osisID="Isa" type="book"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:1
verses.text: Verba Jeremiæ filii Helciæ, de sacerdotibus qui fuerunt in Anathoth, in terra Benjamin.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:2
verses.text: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad eum in diebus Josiæ filii Amon, regis Juda, in tertiodecimo anno regni ejus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:3
verses.text: Et factum est in diebus Joakim filii Josiæ, regis Juda, usque ad consummationem undecimi anni Sedeciæ, filii Josiæ, regis Juda, usque ad transmigrationem Jerusalem, in mense quinto.  <div eID="gen22623" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8798"/><div sID="gen22624" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8798"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen22624" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8799"/><lg sID="gen22625"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8799"/>Priusquam te formarem in utero, novi te, <l eID="gen22626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22627"/>et antequam exires de vulva, sanctificavi te, <l eID="gen22627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22628"/>et prophetam in gentibus dedi te.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:6
verses.text: Et dixi : <l eID="gen22628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22629"/>A, a, a, Domine Deus, ecce nescio loqui, <l eID="gen22629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22630"/>quia puer ego sum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:7
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen22630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22631"/>Noli dicere : Puer sum : <l eID="gen22631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22632"/>quoniam ad omnia quæ mittam te ibis, <l eID="gen22632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22633"/>et universa quæcumque mandavero tibi loqueris. <l eID="gen22633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8800"/><l level="1" sID="gen22634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8800"/>Ne timeas a facie eorum, <l eID="gen22634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22635"/>quia tecum ego sum ut eruam te, <l eID="gen22635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22636"/>dicit Dominus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:9
verses.text: Et misit Dominus manum suam, et tetigit os meum, et dixit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen22636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22637"/>Ecce dedi verba mea in ore tuo : <l eID="gen22637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8801"/><l level="1" sID="gen22638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8801"/>ecce constitui te hodie <l eID="gen22638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22639"/>super gentes et super regna, <l eID="gen22639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22640"/>ut evellas, et destruas, <l eID="gen22640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22641"/>et disperdas, et dissipes, <l eID="gen22641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22642"/>et ædifices, et plantes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:11
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens : <l eID="gen22642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22643"/>Quid tu vides, Jeremia ? Et dixi : <l eID="gen22643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22644"/>Virgam vigilantem ego video.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:12
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen22644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22645"/>Bene vidisti : <l eID="gen22645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22646"/>quia vigilabo ego super verbo meo, <l eID="gen22646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22647"/>ut faciam illud.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:13
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini secundo ad me, dicens : <l eID="gen22647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22648"/>Quid tu vides ? Et dixi : <l eID="gen22648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22649"/>Ollam succensam ego video, <l eID="gen22649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22650"/>et faciem ejus a facie aquilonis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:14
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen22650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22651"/>Ab aquilone pandetur malum <l eID="gen22651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22652"/>super omnes habitatores terræ : <l eID="gen22652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8802"/><l level="1" sID="gen22653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8802"/>quia ecce ego convocabo omnes cognationes regnorum aquilonis, <l eID="gen22653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22654"/>ait Dominus : <l eID="gen22654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22655"/>et venient, et ponent unusquisque solium suum <l eID="gen22655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22656"/>in introitu portarum Jerusalem, <l eID="gen22656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22657"/>et super omnes muros ejus in circuitu, <l eID="gen22657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22658"/>et super universas urbes Juda : <l eID="gen22658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8803"/><l level="1" sID="gen22659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8803"/>et loquar judicia mea cum eis <l eID="gen22659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22660"/>super omnem malitiam eorum qui dereliquerunt me, <l eID="gen22660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22661"/>et libaverunt diis alienis, <l eID="gen22661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22662"/>et adoraverunt opus manuum suarum. <l eID="gen22662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8804"/><l level="1" sID="gen22663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8804"/>Tu ergo, accinge lumbos tuos, <l eID="gen22663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22664"/>et surge, et loquere ad eos <l eID="gen22664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22665"/>omnia quæ ego præcipio tibi. <l eID="gen22665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22666"/>Ne formides a facie eorum, <l eID="gen22666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22667"/>nec enim timere te faciam vultum eorum. <l eID="gen22667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8805"/><l level="1" sID="gen22668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8805"/>Ego quippe dedi te hodie in civitatem munitam, <l eID="gen22668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22669"/>et in columnam ferream, <l eID="gen22669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22670"/>et in murum æreum, <l eID="gen22670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22671"/>super omnem terram, <l eID="gen22671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22672"/>regibus Juda, principibus ejus, <l eID="gen22672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22673"/>et sacerdotibus, et populo terræ. <l eID="gen22673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8806"/><l level="1" sID="gen22674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8806"/>Et bellabunt adversum te, <l eID="gen22674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22675"/>et non prævalebunt, <l eID="gen22675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22676"/>quia ego tecum sum, ait Dominus, ut liberem te. <l eID="gen22676" level="1"/><lg eID="gen22625"/> <chapter eID="Jer.1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen22677" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8807"/><lg sID="gen22678"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8807"/>Vade, et clama in auribus Jerusalem, dicens : <l eID="gen22679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22680"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen22680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22681"/>Recordatus sum tui, miserans adolescentiam tuam, <l eID="gen22681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22682"/>et caritatem desponsationis tuæ, <l eID="gen22682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22683"/>quando secuta es me in deserto, <l eID="gen22683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22684"/>in terra quæ non seminatur. <l eID="gen22684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8808"/><l level="1" sID="gen22685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8808"/>Sanctus Israël Domino, <l eID="gen22685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22686"/>primitiæ frugum ejus : <l eID="gen22686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22687"/>omnes qui devorant eum delinquunt : <l eID="gen22687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22688"/>mala venient super eos, <l eID="gen22688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22689"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8809"/><l level="1" sID="gen22690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8809"/>Audite verbum Domini, domus Jacob, <l eID="gen22690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22691"/>et omnes cognationes domus Israël. <l eID="gen22691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8810"/><l level="1" sID="gen22692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8810"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen22692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22693"/>Quid invenerunt patres vestri in me iniquitatis, <l eID="gen22693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22694"/>quia elongaverunt a me, <l eID="gen22694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22695"/>et ambulaverunt post vanitatem, <l eID="gen22695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22696"/>et vani facti sunt ? <l eID="gen22696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8811"/><l level="1" sID="gen22697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8811"/>Et non dixerunt : Ubi est Dominus <l eID="gen22697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22698"/>qui ascendere nos fecit de terra Ægypti ; <l eID="gen22698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22699"/>qui traduxit nos per desertum, <l eID="gen22699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22700"/>per terram inhabitabilem et inviam, <l eID="gen22700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22701"/>per terram sitis, et imaginem mortis, <l eID="gen22701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22702"/>per terram in qua non ambulavit vir, <l eID="gen22702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22703"/>neque habitavit homo ? <l eID="gen22703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8812"/><l level="1" sID="gen22704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8812"/>Et induxi vos in terram Carmeli, <l eID="gen22704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22705"/>ut comederetis fructum ejus et optima illius : <l eID="gen22705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22706"/>et ingressi contaminastis terram meam, <l eID="gen22706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22707"/>et hæreditatem meam posuistis in abominationem. <l eID="gen22707" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8813"/><l level="1" sID="gen22708"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8813"/>Sacerdotes non dixerunt : Ubi est Dominus ? <l eID="gen22708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22709"/>et tenentes legem nescierunt me, <l eID="gen22709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22710"/>et pastores prævaricati sunt in me, <l eID="gen22710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22711"/>et prophetæ prophetaverunt in Baal, <l eID="gen22711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22712"/>et idola secuti sunt. <l eID="gen22712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8814"/><l level="1" sID="gen22713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8814"/>Propterea adhuc judicio contendam vobiscum, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen22713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22714"/>et cum filiis vestris disceptabo. <l eID="gen22714" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8815"/><l level="1" sID="gen22715"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8815"/>Transite ad insulas Cethim, et videte : <l eID="gen22715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22716"/>et in Cedar mittite, et considerate vehementer : <l eID="gen22716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22717"/>et videte si factum est hujuscemodi : <l eID="gen22717" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8816"/><l level="1" sID="gen22718"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8816"/>si mutavit gens deos suos, <l eID="gen22718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22719"/>et certe ipsi non sunt dii : <l eID="gen22719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22720"/>populus vero meus mutavit gloriam suam in idolum. <l eID="gen22720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8817"/><l level="1" sID="gen22721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8817"/>Obstupescite, cæli, super hoc, <l eID="gen22721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22722"/>et portæ ejus, desolamini vehementer, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22722" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8818"/><l level="1" sID="gen22723"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8818"/>Duo enim mala fecit populus meus : <l eID="gen22723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22724"/>me dereliquerunt fontem aquæ vivæ, <l eID="gen22724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22725"/>et foderunt sibi cisternas, cisternas dissipatas, <l eID="gen22725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22726"/>quia continere non valent aquas. <l eID="gen22726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8819"/><l level="1" sID="gen22727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8819"/>Numquid servus est Israël, aut vernaculus ? <l eID="gen22727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22728"/>quare ergo factus est in prædam ? <l eID="gen22728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8820"/><l level="1" sID="gen22729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8820"/>Super eum rugierunt leones, <l eID="gen22729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22730"/>et dederunt vocem suam : <l eID="gen22730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22731"/>posuerunt terram ejus in solitudinem. <l eID="gen22731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22732"/>Civitates ejus exustæ sunt, <l eID="gen22732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22733"/>et non est qui habitet in eis. <l eID="gen22733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8821"/><l level="1" sID="gen22734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8821"/>Filii quoque Mempheos et Taphnes <l eID="gen22734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22735"/>constupraverunt te usque ad verticem. <l eID="gen22735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8822"/><l level="1" sID="gen22736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8822"/>Numquid non istud factum est tibi, <l eID="gen22736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22737"/>quia dereliquisti Dominum Deum tuum <l eID="gen22737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22738"/>eo tempore quo ducebat te per viam ? <l eID="gen22738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8823"/><l level="1" sID="gen22739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8823"/>Et nunc quid tibi vis in via Ægypti, <l eID="gen22739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22740"/>ut bibas aquam turbidam ? <l eID="gen22740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22741"/>et quid tibi cum via Assyriorum, <l eID="gen22741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22742"/>ut bibas aquam fluminis ? <l eID="gen22742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8824"/><l level="1" sID="gen22743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8824"/>Arguet te malitia tua, <l eID="gen22743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22744"/>et aversio tua increpabit te. <l eID="gen22744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22745"/>Scito et vide quia malum et amarum est <l eID="gen22745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22746"/>reliquisse te Dominum Deum tuum, <l eID="gen22746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22747"/>et non esse timorem mei apud te, <l eID="gen22747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22748"/>dicit Dominus Deus exercituum. <l eID="gen22748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:20
