verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8825"/><l level="1" sID="gen22749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8825"/>A sæculo confregisti jugum meum : <l eID="gen22749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22750"/>rupisti vincula mea, <l eID="gen22750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22751"/>et dixisti : Non serviam. <l eID="gen22751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22752"/>In omni enim colle sublimi, <l eID="gen22752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22753"/>et sub omni ligno frondoso, <l eID="gen22753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22754"/>tu prosternebaris meretrix. <l eID="gen22754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8826"/><l level="1" sID="gen22755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8826"/>Ego autem plantavi te vineam electam, <l eID="gen22755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22756"/>omne semen verum : <l eID="gen22756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22757"/>quomodo ergo conversa es mihi in pravum, <l eID="gen22757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22758"/>vinea aliena ? <l eID="gen22758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8827"/><l level="1" sID="gen22759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8827"/>Si laveris te nitro, <l eID="gen22759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22760"/>et multiplicaveris tibi herbam borith, <l eID="gen22760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22761"/>maculata es in iniquitate tua coram me, <l eID="gen22761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22762"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen22762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8828"/><l level="1" sID="gen22763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8828"/>Quomodo dicis : Non sum polluta ; <l eID="gen22763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22764"/>post Baalim non ambulavi ? <l eID="gen22764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22765"/>Vide vias tuas in convalle ; <l eID="gen22765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22766"/>scito quid feceris : <l eID="gen22766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22767"/>cursor levis explicans vias suas. <l eID="gen22767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8829"/><l level="1" sID="gen22768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8829"/>Onager assuetus in solitudine, <l eID="gen22768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22769"/>in desiderio animæ suæ attraxit ventum amoris sui : <l eID="gen22769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22770"/>nullus avertet eam : <l eID="gen22770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22771"/>omnes qui quærunt eam non deficient : <l eID="gen22771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22772"/>in menstruis ejus invenient eam. <l eID="gen22772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8830"/><l level="1" sID="gen22773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8830"/>Prohibe pedem tuum a nuditate, <l eID="gen22773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22774"/>et guttur tuum a siti. <l eID="gen22774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22775"/>Et dixisti : Desperavi : nequaquam faciam : <l eID="gen22775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22776"/>adamavi quippe alienos, <l eID="gen22776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22777"/>et post eos ambulabo. <l eID="gen22777" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8831"/><l level="1" sID="gen22778"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8831"/>Quomodo confunditur fur quando deprehenditur, <l eID="gen22778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22779"/>sic confusi sunt domus Israël, <l eID="gen22779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22780"/>ipsi et reges eorum, <l eID="gen22780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22781"/>principes, et sacerdotes, et prophetæ eorum, <l eID="gen22781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8832"/><l level="1" sID="gen22782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8832"/>dicentes ligno : Pater meus es tu : <l eID="gen22782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22783"/>et lapidi : Tu me genuisti. <l eID="gen22783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22784"/>Verterunt ad me tergum et non faciem, <l eID="gen22784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22785"/>et in tempore afflictionis suæ dicent : <l eID="gen22785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22786"/>Surge, et libera nos. <l eID="gen22786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8833"/><l level="1" sID="gen22787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8833"/>Ubi sunt dii tui quos fecisti tibi ? <l eID="gen22787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22788"/>surgant, et liberent te in tempore afflictionis tuæ : <l eID="gen22788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22789"/>secundum numerum quippe civitatum tuarum erant dii tui, Juda. <l eID="gen22789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8834"/><l level="1" sID="gen22790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8834"/>Quid vultis mecum judicio contendere ? <l eID="gen22790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22791"/>omnes dereliquistis me, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8835"/><l level="1" sID="gen22792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8835"/>Frustra percussi filios vestros : <l eID="gen22792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22793"/>disciplinam non receperunt. <l eID="gen22793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22794"/>Devoravit gladius vester prophetas vestros : <l eID="gen22794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22795"/>quasi leo vastator

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:31
verses.text: generatio vestra. <l eID="gen22795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22796"/>Videte verbum Domini : <l eID="gen22796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22797"/>numquid solitudo factus sum Israëli, <l eID="gen22797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22798"/>aut terra serotina ? <l eID="gen22798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22799"/>quare ergo dixit populus meus : Recessimus ; <l eID="gen22799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22800"/>non veniemus ultra ad te ? <l eID="gen22800" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8836"/><l level="1" sID="gen22801"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8836"/>Numquid obliviscetur virgo ornamenti sui, <l eID="gen22801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22802"/>aut sponsa fasciæ pectoralis suæ ? <l eID="gen22802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22803"/>populus vero meus oblitus est mei diebus innumeris. <l eID="gen22803" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8837"/><l level="1" sID="gen22804"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8837"/>Quid niteris bonam ostendere viam tuam <l eID="gen22804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22805"/>ad quærendam dilectionem, <l eID="gen22805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22806"/>quæ insuper et malitias tuas docuisti vias tuas, <l eID="gen22806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8838"/><l level="1" sID="gen22807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8838"/>et in alis tuis inventus est sanguis animarum pauperum et innocentum ? <l eID="gen22807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22808"/>non in fossis inveni eos, <l eID="gen22808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22809"/>sed in omnibus quæ supra memoravi. <l eID="gen22809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8839"/><l level="1" sID="gen22810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8839"/>Et dixisti : Absque peccato et innocens ego sum, <l eID="gen22810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22811"/>et propterea avertatur furor tuus a me. <l eID="gen22811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22812"/>Ecce ego judicio contendam tecum, <l eID="gen22812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22813"/>eo quod dixeris : Non peccavi. <l eID="gen22813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8840"/><l level="1" sID="gen22814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8840"/>Quam vilis facta es nimis, iterans vias tuas ! <l eID="gen22814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22815"/>et ab Ægypto confunderis, <l eID="gen22815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22816"/>sicut confusa es ab Assur. <l eID="gen22816" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 2:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8841"/><l level="1" sID="gen22817"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8841"/>Nam et ab ista egredieris, <l eID="gen22817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22818"/>et manus tuæ erunt super caput tuum : <l eID="gen22818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22819"/>quoniam obtrivit Dominus confidentiam tuam, <l eID="gen22819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22820"/>et nihil habebis prosperum in ea.  <chapter eID="Jer.2"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:1
verses.text: Vulgo dicitur : Si dimiserit vir uxorem suam, <l eID="gen22821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22822"/>et recedens ab eo duxerit virum alterum, <l eID="gen22822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22823"/>numquid revertetur ad eam ultra ? <l eID="gen22823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22824"/>numquid non polluta et contaminata erit mulier illa ? <l eID="gen22824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22825"/>Tu autem fornicata es cum amatoribus multis : <l eID="gen22825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22826"/>tamen revertere ad me, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen22826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22827"/>et ego suscipiam te. <l eID="gen22827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8842"/><l level="1" sID="gen22828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8842"/>Leva oculos tuos in directum, <l eID="gen22828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22829"/>et vide ubi non prostrata sis. <l eID="gen22829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22830"/>In viis sedebas, <l eID="gen22830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22831"/>exspectans eos quasi latro in solitudine : <l eID="gen22831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22832"/>et polluisti terram in fornicationibus tuis, et in malitiis tuis. <l eID="gen22832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8843"/><l level="1" sID="gen22833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8843"/>Quam ob rem prohibitæ sunt stillæ pluviarum, <l eID="gen22833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22834"/>et serotinus imber non fuit. <l eID="gen22834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22835"/>Frons mulieris meretricis facta est tibi ; <l eID="gen22835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22836"/>noluisti erubescere. <l eID="gen22836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8844"/><l level="1" sID="gen22837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8844"/>Ergo saltem amodo voca me : <l eID="gen22837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22838"/>Pater meus, dux virginitatis meæ tu es : <l eID="gen22838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8845"/><l level="1" sID="gen22839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8845"/>numquid irasceris in perpetuum, <l eID="gen22839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22840"/>aut perseverabis in finem ? <l eID="gen22840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22841"/>ecce locuta es, et fecisti mala, et potuisti. <l eID="gen22841" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen22678"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8846"/><div sID="gen22842" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8846"/>Et dixit Dominus ad me in diebus Josiæ regis : <div eID="gen22842" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen22843"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22844"/>Numquid vidisti quæ fecerit aversatrix Israël ? <l eID="gen22844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22845"/>Abiit sibimet super omnem montem excelsum, <l eID="gen22845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22846"/>et sub omni ligno frondoso, <l eID="gen22846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22847"/>et fornicata est ibi. <l eID="gen22847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8847"/><l level="1" sID="gen22848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8847"/>Et dixi, cum fecisset hæc omnia : <l eID="gen22848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22849"/>Ad me revertere : <l eID="gen22849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22850"/>et non est reversa. <l eID="gen22850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22851"/>Et vidit prævaricatrix soror ejus Juda <l eID="gen22851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8848"/><l level="1" sID="gen22852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8848"/>quia pro eo quod mœchata esset aversatrix Israël, <l eID="gen22852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22853"/>dimisissem eam, <l eID="gen22853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22854"/>et dedissem ei libellum repudii : <l eID="gen22854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22855"/>et non timuit prævaricatrix Juda soror ejus, <l eID="gen22855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22856"/>sed abiit, et fornicata est etiam ipsa : <l eID="gen22856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8849"/><l level="1" sID="gen22857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8849"/>et facilitate fornicationis suæ contaminavit terram, <l eID="gen22857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22858"/>et mœchata est cum lapide et ligno : <l eID="gen22858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8850"/><l level="1" sID="gen22859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8850"/>et in omnibus his non est reversa ad me <l eID="gen22859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22860"/>prævaricatrix soror ejus Juda <l eID="gen22860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22861"/>in toto corde suo, <l eID="gen22861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22862"/>sed in mendacio, ait Dominus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:11
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Justificavit animam suam aversatrix Israël, comparatione prævaricatricis Judæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:12
verses.text: Vade, et clama sermones istos contra aquilonem, et dices : <l eID="gen22862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22863"/>Revertere, aversatrix Israël, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen22863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22864"/>et non avertam faciem meam a vobis, <l eID="gen22864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22865"/>quia sanctus ego sum, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen22865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22866"/>et non irascar in perpetuum. <l eID="gen22866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8851"/><l level="1" sID="gen22867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8851"/>Verumtamen scito iniquitatem tuam, <l eID="gen22867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22868"/>quia in Dominum Deum tuum prævaricata es, <l eID="gen22868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22869"/>et dispersisti vias tuas alienis sub omni ligno frondoso, <l eID="gen22869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22870"/>et vocem meam non audisti, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen22870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8852"/><l level="1" sID="gen22871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8852"/>Convertimini, filii revertentes, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen22871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22872"/>quia ego vir vester : <l eID="gen22872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22873"/>et assumam vos unum de civitate, <l eID="gen22873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22874"/>et duos de cognatione, <l eID="gen22874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22875"/>et introducam vos in Sion. <l eID="gen22875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8853"/><l level="1" sID="gen22876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8853"/>Et dabo vobis pastores juxta cor meum, <l eID="gen22876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22877"/>et pascent vos scientia et doctrina. <l eID="gen22877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8854"/><l level="1" sID="gen22878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8854"/>Cumque multiplicati fueritis, <l eID="gen22878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22879"/>et creveritis in terra in diebus illis, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen22879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22880"/>non dicent ultra : <l eID="gen22880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22881"/>Arca testamenti Domini : <l eID="gen22881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22882"/>neque ascendet super cor, neque recordabuntur illius, <l eID="gen22882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22883"/>nec visitabitur, nec fiet ultra. <l eID="gen22883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8855"/><l level="1" sID="gen22884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8855"/>In tempore illo vocabunt Jerusalem solium Domini : <l eID="gen22884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22885"/>et congregabuntur ad eam omnes gentes <l eID="gen22885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22886"/>in nomine Domini in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen22886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22887"/>et non ambulabunt post pravitatem cordis sui pessimi. <l eID="gen22887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8856"/><l level="1" sID="gen22888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8856"/>In diebus illis ibit domus Juda ad domum Israël, <l eID="gen22888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22889"/>et venient simul de terra aquilonis <l eID="gen22889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22890"/>ad terram quam dedi patribus vestris. <l eID="gen22890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8857"/><l level="1" sID="gen22891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8857"/>Ego autem dixi : <l eID="gen22891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22892"/>Quomodo ponam te in filios, <l eID="gen22892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22893"/>et tribuam tibi terram desiderabilem, <l eID="gen22893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22894"/>hæreditatem præclaram exercituum gentium ? <l eID="gen22894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22895"/>Et dixi : Patrem vocabis me, <l eID="gen22895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22896"/>et post me ingredi non cessabis. <l eID="gen22896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8858"/><l level="1" sID="gen22897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8858"/>Sed quomodo si contemnat mulier amatorem suum, <l eID="gen22897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22898"/>sic contempsit me domus Israël, <l eID="gen22898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22899"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8859"/><l level="1" sID="gen22900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8859"/>Vox in viis audita est, <l eID="gen22900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22901"/>ploratus et ululatus filiorum Israël : <l eID="gen22901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22902"/>quoniam iniquam fecerunt viam suam ; <l eID="gen22902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22903"/>obliti sunt Domini Dei sui. <l eID="gen22903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8860"/><l level="1" sID="gen22904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8860"/>Convertimini, filii revertentes, <l eID="gen22904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22905"/>et sanabo aversiones vestras. <l eID="gen22905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22906"/>Ecce nos venimus ad te : <l eID="gen22906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22907"/>tu enim es Dominus Deus noster. <l eID="gen22907" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8861"/><l level="1" sID="gen22908"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8861"/>Vere mendaces erant colles, <l eID="gen22908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22909"/>et multitudo montium : <l eID="gen22909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22910"/>vere in Domino Deo nostro salus Israël. <l eID="gen22910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8862"/><l level="1" sID="gen22911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8862"/>Confusio comedit laborem patrum nostrorum ab adolescentia nostra : <l eID="gen22911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22912"/>greges eorum, et armenta eorum, <l eID="gen22912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22913"/>filios eorum, et filias eorum. <l eID="gen22913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8863"/><l level="1" sID="gen22914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8863"/>Dormiemus in confusione nostra, <l eID="gen22914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22915"/>et operiet nos ignominia nostra : <l eID="gen22915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22916"/>quoniam Domino Deo nostro peccavimus nos, et patres nostri, <l eID="gen22916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22917"/>ab adolescentia nostra usque ad diem hanc : <l eID="gen22917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22918"/>et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri.  <chapter eID="Jer.3"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:1
verses.text: Si reverteris, Israël, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen22919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22920"/>ad me convertere : <l eID="gen22920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22921"/>si abstuleris offendicula tua a facie mea, <l eID="gen22921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22922"/>non commoveberis. <l eID="gen22922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8864"/><l level="1" sID="gen22923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8864"/>Et jurabis : Vivit Dominus in veritate, et in judicio, et in justitia : <l eID="gen22923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22924"/>et benedicent eum gentes, <l eID="gen22924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22925"/>ipsumque laudabunt. <l eID="gen22925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8865"/><l level="1" sID="gen22926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8865"/>Hæc enim dicit Dominus viro Juda et Jerusalem : <l eID="gen22926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22927"/>Novate vobis novale, <l eID="gen22927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22928"/>et nolite serere super spinas. <l eID="gen22928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8866"/><l level="1" sID="gen22929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8866"/>Circumcidimini Domino, <l eID="gen22929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22930"/>et auferte præputia cordium vestrorum, <l eID="gen22930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22931"/>viri Juda, et habitatores Jerusalem : <l eID="gen22931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22932"/>ne forte egrediatur ut ignis indignatio mea, <l eID="gen22932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22933"/>et succendatur, et non sit qui extinguat, <l eID="gen22933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22934"/>propter malitiam cogitationum vestrarum. <l eID="gen22934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8867"/><l level="1" sID="gen22935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8867"/>Annuntiate in Juda, et in Jerusalem auditum facite : <l eID="gen22935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22936"/>loquimini, et canite tuba in terra, <l eID="gen22936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22937"/>clamate fortiter, et dicite : <l eID="gen22937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22938"/>Congregamini, et ingrediamur civitates munitas. <l eID="gen22938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8868"/><l level="1" sID="gen22939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8868"/>Levate signum in Sion ; <l eID="gen22939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22940"/>confortamini, nolite stare : <l eID="gen22940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22941"/>quia malum ego adduco ab aquilone, <l eID="gen22941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22942"/>et contritionem magnam. <l eID="gen22942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8869"/><l level="1" sID="gen22943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8869"/>Ascendit leo de cubili suo, <l eID="gen22943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22944"/>et prædo gentium se levavit : <l eID="gen22944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22945"/>egressus est de loco suo ut ponat terram tuam in solitudinem : <l eID="gen22945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22946"/>civitates tuæ vastabuntur, <l eID="gen22946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22947"/>remanentes absque habitatore. <l eID="gen22947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8870"/><l level="1" sID="gen22948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8870"/>Super hoc accingite vos ciliciis ; <l eID="gen22948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22949"/>plangite, et ululate : <l eID="gen22949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22950"/>quia non est aversa ira furoris Domini a nobis. <l eID="gen22950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8871"/><l level="1" sID="gen22951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8871"/>Et erit in die illa, dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen22951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22952"/>peribit cor regis, et cor principum, <l eID="gen22952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22953"/>et obstupescent sacerdotes, <l eID="gen22953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22954"/>et prophetæ consternabuntur.

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:10
verses.text: Et dixi : <l eID="gen22954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22955"/>Heu ! heu ! heu ! Domine Deus, <l eID="gen22955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22956"/>ergone decepisti populum istum et Jerusalem, <l eID="gen22956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22957"/>dicens : Pax erit vobis : <l eID="gen22957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22958"/>et ecce pervenit gladius usque ad animam ? <l eID="gen22958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8872"/><l level="1" sID="gen22959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8872"/>In tempore illo dicetur populo huic et Jerusalem : <l eID="gen22959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22960"/>Ventus urens in viis quæ sunt in deserto viæ filiæ populi mei, <l eID="gen22960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22961"/>non ad ventilandum et ad purgandum. <l eID="gen22961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8873"/><l level="1" sID="gen22962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8873"/>Spiritus plenus ex his veniet mihi, <l eID="gen22962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22963"/>et nunc ego loquar judicia mea cum eis. <l eID="gen22963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8874"/><l level="1" sID="gen22964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8874"/>Ecce quasi nubes ascendet, <l eID="gen22964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22965"/>et quasi tempestas currus ejus : <l eID="gen22965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22966"/>velociores aquilis equi illius. <l eID="gen22966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22967"/>Væ nobis, quoniam vastati sumus. <l eID="gen22967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8875"/><l level="1" sID="gen22968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8875"/>Lava a malitia cor tuum, Jerusalem, ut salva fias : <l eID="gen22968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22969"/>usquequo morabuntur in te cogitationes noxiæ ? <l eID="gen22969" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8876"/><l level="1" sID="gen22970"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8876"/>Vox enim annuntiantis a Dan, <l eID="gen22970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22971"/>et notum facientis idolum de monte Ephraim. <l eID="gen22971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8877"/><l level="1" sID="gen22972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8877"/>Dicite gentibus : Ecce auditum est in Jerusalem <l eID="gen22972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22973"/>custodes venire de terra longinqua, <l eID="gen22973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22974"/>et dare super civitates Juda vocem suam : <l eID="gen22974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8878"/><l level="1" sID="gen22975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8878"/>quasi custodes agrorum facti sunt super eam in gyro, <l eID="gen22975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22976"/>quia me ad iracundiam provocavit, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen22976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8879"/><l level="1" sID="gen22977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8879"/>Viæ tuæ et cogitationes tuæ fecerunt hæc tibi : <l eID="gen22977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22978"/>ista malitia tua, quia amara, <l eID="gen22978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22979"/>quia tetigit cor tuum. <l eID="gen22979" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8880"/><l level="1" sID="gen22980"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8880"/>Ventrem meum, ventrem meum doleo ; <l eID="gen22980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22981"/>sensus cordis mei turbati sunt in me. <l eID="gen22981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22982"/>Non tacebo, quoniam vocem buccinæ audivit anima mea, <l eID="gen22982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22983"/>clamorem prælii. <l eID="gen22983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8881"/><l level="1" sID="gen22984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8881"/>Contritio super contritionem vocata est, <l eID="gen22984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22985"/>et vastata est omnis terra : <l eID="gen22985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22986"/>repente vastata sunt tabernacula mea ; <l eID="gen22986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22987"/>subito pelles meæ. <l eID="gen22987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8882"/><l level="1" sID="gen22988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8882"/>Usquequo videbo fugientem ; <l eID="gen22988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22989"/>audiam vocem buccinæ ? <l eID="gen22989" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8883"/><l level="1" sID="gen22990"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8883"/>Quia stultus populus meus me non cognovit : <l eID="gen22990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22991"/>filii insipientes sunt et vecordes : <l eID="gen22991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22992"/>sapientes sunt ut faciant mala, <l eID="gen22992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22993"/>bene autem facere nescierunt. <l eID="gen22993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8884"/><l level="1" sID="gen22994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8884"/>Aspexi terram, et ecce vacua erat et nihili ; <l eID="gen22994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22995"/>et cælos, et non erat lux in eis. <l eID="gen22995" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8885"/><l level="1" sID="gen22996"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8885"/>Vidi montes, et ecce movebantur : <l eID="gen22996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22997"/>et omnes colles conturbati sunt. <l eID="gen22997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8886"/><l level="1" sID="gen22998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8886"/>Intuitus sum, et non erat homo : <l eID="gen22998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen22999"/>et omne volatile cæli recessit. <l eID="gen22999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8887"/><l level="1" sID="gen23000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8887"/>Aspexi, et ecce Carmelus desertus, <l eID="gen23000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23001"/>et omnes urbes ejus destructæ sunt a facie Domini, <l eID="gen23001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23002"/>et a facie iræ furoris ejus. <l eID="gen23002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8888"/><l level="1" sID="gen23003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8888"/>Hæc enim dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23004"/>Deserta erit omnis terra, <l eID="gen23004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23005"/>sed tamen consummationem non faciam. <l eID="gen23005" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8889"/><l level="1" sID="gen23006"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8889"/>Lugebit terra, et mœrebunt cæli desuper, <l eID="gen23006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23007"/>eo quod locutus sum. <l eID="gen23007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23008"/>Cogitavi, et non pœnituit me, <l eID="gen23008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23009"/>nec aversus sum ab eo. <l eID="gen23009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8890"/><l level="1" sID="gen23010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8890"/>A voce equitis et mittentis sagittam fugit omnis civitas : <l eID="gen23010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23011"/>ingressi sunt ardua, et ascenderunt rupes : <l eID="gen23011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23012"/>universæ urbes derelictæ sunt, <l eID="gen23012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23013"/>et non habitat in eis homo. <l eID="gen23013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8891"/><l level="1" sID="gen23014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8891"/>Tu autem vastata, quid facies ? <l eID="gen23014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23015"/>cum vestieris te coccino, <l eID="gen23015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23016"/>cum ornata fueris monili aureo, <l eID="gen23016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23017"/>et pinxeris stibio oculos tuos, <l eID="gen23017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23018"/>frustra componeris : <l eID="gen23018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23019"/>contempserunt te amatores tui ; <l eID="gen23019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23020"/>animam tuam quærent. <l eID="gen23020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 4:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8892"/><l level="1" sID="gen23021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8892"/>Vocem enim quasi parturientis audivi, <l eID="gen23021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23022"/>angustias ut puerperæ : <l eID="gen23022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23023"/>vox filiæ Sion intermorientis, <l eID="gen23023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23024"/>expandentisque manus suas : <l eID="gen23024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23025"/>Væ mihi, quia defecit anima mea propter interfectos !  <chapter eID="Jer.4"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:1
verses.text: Circuite vias Jerusalem, <l eID="gen23026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23027"/>et aspicite, et considerate, <l eID="gen23027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23028"/>et quærite in plateis ejus, <l eID="gen23028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23029"/>an inveniatis virum facientem judicium, <l eID="gen23029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23030"/>et quærentem fidem : <l eID="gen23030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23031"/>et propitius ero ei. <l eID="gen23031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8893"/><l level="1" sID="gen23032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8893"/>Quod si etiam : Vivit Dominus, dixerint, <l eID="gen23032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23033"/>et hoc falso jurabunt. <l eID="gen23033" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8894"/><l level="1" sID="gen23034"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8894"/>Domine, oculi tui respiciunt fidem : <l eID="gen23034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23035"/>percussisti eos, et non doluerunt ; <l eID="gen23035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23036"/>attrivisti eos, et renuerunt accipere disciplinam : <l eID="gen23036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23037"/>induraverunt facies suas supra petram, <l eID="gen23037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23038"/>et noluerunt reverti. <l eID="gen23038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8895"/><l level="1" sID="gen23039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8895"/>Ego autem dixi : Forsitan pauperes sunt et stulti, <l eID="gen23039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23040"/>ignorantes viam Domini, <l eID="gen23040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23041"/>judicium Dei sui. <l eID="gen23041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8896"/><l level="1" sID="gen23042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8896"/>Ibo igitur ad optimates, et loquar eis : <l eID="gen23042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23043"/>ipsi enim cognoverunt viam Domini, <l eID="gen23043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23044"/>judicium Dei sui : <l eID="gen23044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23045"/>et ecce magis hi simul confregerunt jugum ; <l eID="gen23045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23046"/>ruperunt vincula. <l eID="gen23046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8897"/><l level="1" sID="gen23047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8897"/>Idcirco percussit eos leo de silva ; <l eID="gen23047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23048"/>lupus ad vesperam vastavit eos : <l eID="gen23048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23049"/>pardus vigilans super civitates eorum : <l eID="gen23049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23050"/>omnis qui egressus fuerit ex eis capietur : <l eID="gen23050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23051"/>quia multiplicatæ sunt prævaricationes eorum ; <l eID="gen23051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23052"/>confortatæ sunt aversiones eorum. <l eID="gen23052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8898"/><l level="1" sID="gen23053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8898"/>Super quo propitius tibi esse potero ? <l eID="gen23053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23054"/>filii tui dereliquerunt me, <l eID="gen23054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23055"/>et jurant in his qui non sunt dii. <l eID="gen23055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23056"/>Saturavi eos, et mœchati sunt, <l eID="gen23056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23057"/>et in domo meretricis luxuriabantur. <l eID="gen23057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8899"/><l level="1" sID="gen23058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8899"/>Equi amatores et emissarii facti sunt : <l eID="gen23058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23059"/>unusquisque ad uxorem proximi sui hinniebat. <l eID="gen23059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8900"/><l level="1" sID="gen23060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8900"/>Numquid super his non visitabo, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen23060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23061"/>et in gente tali non ulciscetur anima mea ? <l eID="gen23061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8901"/><l level="1" sID="gen23062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8901"/>Ascendite muros ejus, et dissipate : <l eID="gen23062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23063"/>consummationem autem nolite facere : <l eID="gen23063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23064"/>auferte propagines ejus, <l eID="gen23064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23065"/>quia non sunt Domini. <l eID="gen23065" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8902"/><l level="1" sID="gen23066"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8902"/>Prævaricatione enim prævaricata est in me <l eID="gen23066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23067"/>domus Israël, et domus Juda, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen23067" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8903"/><l level="1" sID="gen23068"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8903"/>Negaverunt Dominum, et dixerunt : <l eID="gen23068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23069"/>Non est ipse : neque veniet super nos malum : <l eID="gen23069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23070"/>gladium et famem non videbimus. <l eID="gen23070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8904"/><l level="1" sID="gen23071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8904"/>Prophetæ fuerunt in ventum locuti, <l eID="gen23071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23072"/>et responsum non fuit in eis : <l eID="gen23072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23073"/>hæc ergo evenient illis. <l eID="gen23073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8905"/><l level="1" sID="gen23074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8905"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : <l eID="gen23074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23075"/>Quia locuti estis verbum istud, <l eID="gen23075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23076"/>ecce ego do verba mea in ore tuo in ignem, <l eID="gen23076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23077"/>et populum istum in ligna, <l eID="gen23077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23078"/>et vorabit eos. <l eID="gen23078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8906"/><l level="1" sID="gen23079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8906"/>Ecce ego adducam super vos gentem de longinquo, <l eID="gen23079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23080"/>domus Israël, ait Dominus : <l eID="gen23080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23081"/>gentem robustam, <l eID="gen23081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23082"/>gentem antiquam, <l eID="gen23082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23083"/>gentem cujus ignorabis linguam, <l eID="gen23083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23084"/>nec intelliges quid loquatur. <l eID="gen23084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8907"/><l level="1" sID="gen23085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8907"/>Pharetra ejus quasi sepulchrum patens ; <l eID="gen23085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23086"/>universi fortes. <l eID="gen23086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8908"/><l level="1" sID="gen23087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8908"/>Et comedet segetes tuas et panem tuum ; <l eID="gen23087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23088"/>devorabit filios tuos et filias tuas ; <l eID="gen23088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23089"/>comedet gregem tuum et armenta tua ; <l eID="gen23089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23090"/>comedet vineam tuam et ficum tuam : <l eID="gen23090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23091"/>et conteret urbes munitas tuas, <l eID="gen23091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23092"/>in quibus tu habes fiduciam, gladio. <l eID="gen23092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8909"/><l level="1" sID="gen23093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8909"/>Verumtamen in diebus illis, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen23093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23094"/>non faciam vos in consummationem. <l eID="gen23094" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8910"/><l level="1" sID="gen23095"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8910"/>Quod si dixeritis : <l eID="gen23095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23096"/>Quare fecit nobis Dominus Deus noster hæc omnia ? <l eID="gen23096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23097"/>dices ad eos : <l eID="gen23097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23098"/>Sicut dereliquistis me, <l eID="gen23098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23099"/>et servistis deo alieno in terra vestra, <l eID="gen23099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23100"/>sic servietis alienis in terra non vestra. <l eID="gen23100" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8911"/><l level="1" sID="gen23101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8911"/>Annuntiate hoc domui Jacob, <l eID="gen23101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23102"/>et auditum facite in Juda, dicentes : <l eID="gen23102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8912"/><l level="1" sID="gen23103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8912"/>Audi, popule stulte, qui non habes cor : <l eID="gen23103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23104"/>qui habentes oculos, non videtis ; <l eID="gen23104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23105"/>et aures, et non auditis. <l eID="gen23105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8913"/><l level="1" sID="gen23106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8913"/>Me ergo non timebitis, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen23106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23107"/>et a facie mea non dolebitis ? <l eID="gen23107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23108"/>qui posui arenam terminum mari, <l eID="gen23108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23109"/>præceptum sempiternum quod non præteribit : <l eID="gen23109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23110"/>et commovebuntur, et non poterunt ; <l eID="gen23110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23111"/>et intumescent fluctus ejus, et non transibunt illud. <l eID="gen23111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8914"/><l level="1" sID="gen23112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8914"/>Populo autem huic factum est cor incredulum et exasperans : <l eID="gen23112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23113"/>recesserunt, et abierunt. <l eID="gen23113" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8915"/><l level="1" sID="gen23114"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8915"/>Et non dixerunt in corde suo : <l eID="gen23114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23115"/>Metuamus Dominum Deum nostrum, <l eID="gen23115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23116"/>qui dat nobis pluviam temporaneam et serotinam in tempore suo, <l eID="gen23116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23117"/>plenitudinem annuæ messis custodientem nobis. <l eID="gen23117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8916"/><l level="1" sID="gen23118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8916"/>Iniquitates vestræ declinaverunt hæc, <l eID="gen23118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23119"/>et peccata vestra prohibuerunt bonum a vobis : <l eID="gen23119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8917"/><l level="1" sID="gen23120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8917"/>quia inventi sunt in populo meo impii insidiantes quasi aucupes, <l eID="gen23120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23121"/>laqueos ponentes et pedicas ad capiendos viros. <l eID="gen23121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8918"/><l level="1" sID="gen23122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8918"/>Sicut decipula plena avibus, <l eID="gen23122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23123"/>sic domus eorum plenæ dolo : <l eID="gen23123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23124"/>ideo magnificati sunt et ditati. <l eID="gen23124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8919"/><l level="1" sID="gen23125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8919"/>Incrassati sunt et impinguati, <l eID="gen23125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23126"/>et præterierunt sermones meos pessime. <l eID="gen23126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23127"/>Causam viduæ non judicaverunt, <l eID="gen23127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23128"/>causam pupilli non direxerunt, <l eID="gen23128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23129"/>et judicium pauperum non judicaverunt. <l eID="gen23129" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8920"/><l level="1" sID="gen23130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8920"/>Numquid super his non visitabo, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen23130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23131"/>aut super gentem hujuscemodi non ulciscetur anima mea ? <l eID="gen23131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8921"/><l level="1" sID="gen23132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8921"/>Stupor et mirabilia facta sunt in terra : <l eID="gen23132" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 5:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8922"/><l level="1" sID="gen23133"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8922"/>prophetæ prophetabant mendacium, <l eID="gen23133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23134"/>et sacerdotes applaudebant manibus suis, <l eID="gen23134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23135"/>et populus meus dilexit talia. <l eID="gen23135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23136"/>Quid igitur fiet in novissimo ejus ?  <chapter eID="Jer.5"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:1
verses.text: Confortamini, filii Benjamin, in medio Jerusalem : <l eID="gen23137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23138"/>et in Thecua clangite buccina, <l eID="gen23138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23139"/>et super Bethacarem levate vexillum, <l eID="gen23139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23140"/>quia malum visum est ab aquilone, <l eID="gen23140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23141"/>et contritio magna. <l eID="gen23141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8923"/><l level="1" sID="gen23142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8923"/>Speciosæ et delicatæ assimilavi filiam Sion. <l eID="gen23142" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8924"/><l level="1" sID="gen23143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8924"/>Ad eam venient pastores et greges eorum ; <l eID="gen23143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23144"/>fixerunt in ea tentoria in circuitu : <l eID="gen23144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23145"/>pascet unusquisque eos qui sub manu sua sunt. <l eID="gen23145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8925"/><l level="1" sID="gen23146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8925"/>Sanctificate super eam bellum : <l eID="gen23146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23147"/>consurgite, et ascendamus in meridie : <l eID="gen23147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23148"/>væ nobis, quia declinavit dies ; <l eID="gen23148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23149"/>quia longiores factæ sunt umbræ vesperi ! <l eID="gen23149" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8926"/><l level="1" sID="gen23150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8926"/>Surgite, et ascendamus in nocte, <l eID="gen23150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23151"/>et dissipemus domus ejus. <l eID="gen23151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8927"/><l level="1" sID="gen23152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8927"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen23152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23153"/>Cædite lignum ejus, <l eID="gen23153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23154"/>et fundite circa Jerusalem aggerem. <l eID="gen23154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23155"/>Hæc est civitas visitationis : <l eID="gen23155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23156"/>omnis calumnia in medio ejus. <l eID="gen23156" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8928"/><l level="1" sID="gen23157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8928"/>Sicut frigidam fecit cisterna aquam suam, <l eID="gen23157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23158"/>sic frigidam fecit malitiam suam. <l eID="gen23158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23159"/>Iniquitas et vastitas audietur in ea, <l eID="gen23159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23160"/>coram me semper infirmitas et plaga. <l eID="gen23160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8929"/><l level="1" sID="gen23161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8929"/>Erudire, Jerusalem, <l eID="gen23161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23162"/>ne forte recedat anima mea a te ; <l eID="gen23162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23163"/>ne forte ponam te desertam, <l eID="gen23163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23164"/>terram inhabitabilem. <l eID="gen23164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8930"/><l level="1" sID="gen23165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8930"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen23165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23166"/>Usque ad racemum colligent quasi in vinea reliquias Israël. <l eID="gen23166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23167"/>Converte manum tuam quasi vindemiator ad cartallum. <l eID="gen23167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8931"/><l level="1" sID="gen23168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8931"/>Cui loquar, et quem contestabor ut audiat ? <l eID="gen23168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23169"/>ecce incircumcisæ aures eorum, <l eID="gen23169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23170"/>et audire non possunt : <l eID="gen23170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23171"/>ecce verbum Domini factum est eis in opprobrium, <l eID="gen23171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23172"/>et non suscipient illud. <l eID="gen23172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8932"/><l level="1" sID="gen23173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8932"/>Idcirco furore Domini plenus sum ; <l eID="gen23173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23174"/>laboravi sustinens. <l eID="gen23174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23175"/>Effunde super parvulum foris, <l eID="gen23175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23176"/>et super consilium juvenum simul : <l eID="gen23176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23177"/>vir enim cum muliere capietur ; <l eID="gen23177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23178"/>senex cum pleno dierum. <l eID="gen23178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8933"/><l level="1" sID="gen23179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8933"/>Et transibunt domus eorum ad alteros, <l eID="gen23179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23180"/>agri et uxores pariter, <l eID="gen23180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23181"/>quia extendam manum meam super habitantes terram, dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23181" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8934"/><l level="1" sID="gen23182"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8934"/>a minore quippe usque ad majorem <l eID="gen23182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23183"/>omnes avaritiæ student, <l eID="gen23183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23184"/>et a propheta usque ad sacerdotem <l eID="gen23184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23185"/>cuncti faciunt dolum. <l eID="gen23185" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8935"/><l level="1" sID="gen23186"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8935"/>Et curabant contritionem filiæ populi mei cum ignominia, <l eID="gen23186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23187"/>dicentes : Pax, pax ! <l eID="gen23187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23188"/>et non erat pax. <l eID="gen23188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8936"/><l level="1" sID="gen23189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8936"/>Confusi sunt, quia abominationem fecerunt : <l eID="gen23189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23190"/>quin potius confusione non sunt confusi, <l eID="gen23190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23191"/>et erubescere nescierunt. <l eID="gen23191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23192"/>Quam ob rem cadent inter ruentes : <l eID="gen23192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23193"/>in tempore visitationis suæ corruent, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen23193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8937"/><l level="1" sID="gen23194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8937"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23195"/>State super vias, et videte, <l eID="gen23195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23196"/>et interrogate de semitis antiquis quæ sit via bona, <l eID="gen23196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23197"/>et ambulate in ea : <l eID="gen23197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23198"/>et invenietis refrigerium animabus vestris. <l eID="gen23198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23199"/>Et dixerunt : Non ambulabimus. <l eID="gen23199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8938"/><l level="1" sID="gen23200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8938"/>Et constitui super vos speculatores : <l eID="gen23200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23201"/>Audite vocem tubæ. <l eID="gen23201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23202"/>Et dixerunt : Non audiemus. <l eID="gen23202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8939"/><l level="1" sID="gen23203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8939"/>Ideo audite, gentes, <l eID="gen23203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23204"/>et cognosce, congregatio, <l eID="gen23204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23205"/>quanta ego faciam eis. <l eID="gen23205" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8940"/><l level="1" sID="gen23206"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8940"/>Audi, terra : <l eID="gen23206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23207"/>ecce ego adducam mala super populum istum, <l eID="gen23207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23208"/>fructum cogitationum ejus : <l eID="gen23208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23209"/>quia verba mea non audierunt, <l eID="gen23209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23210"/>et legem meam projecerunt. <l eID="gen23210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8941"/><l level="1" sID="gen23211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8941"/>Ut quid mihi thus de Saba affertis, <l eID="gen23211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23212"/>et calamum suave olentem de terra longinqua ? <l eID="gen23212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23213"/>Holocautomata vestra non sunt accepta, <l eID="gen23213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23214"/>et victimæ vestræ non placuerunt mihi. <l eID="gen23214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8942"/><l level="1" sID="gen23215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8942"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23216"/>Ecce ego dabo in populum istum ruinas : <l eID="gen23216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23217"/>et ruent in eis patres et filii simul ; <l eID="gen23217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23218"/>vicinus et proximus peribunt. <l eID="gen23218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8943"/><l level="1" sID="gen23219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8943"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23220"/>Ecce populus venit de terra aquilonis, <l eID="gen23220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23221"/>et gens magna consurget a finibus terræ. <l eID="gen23221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8944"/><l level="1" sID="gen23222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8944"/>Sagittam et scutum arripiet : <l eID="gen23222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23223"/>crudelis est et non miserebitur. <l eID="gen23223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23224"/>Vox ejus quasi mare sonabit : <l eID="gen23224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23225"/>et super equos ascendent, <l eID="gen23225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23226"/>præparati quasi vir ad prælium <l eID="gen23226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23227"/>adversum te, filia Sion. <l eID="gen23227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8945"/><l level="1" sID="gen23228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8945"/>Audivimus famam ejus ; <l eID="gen23228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23229"/>dissolutæ sunt manus nostræ : <l eID="gen23229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23230"/>tribulatio apprehendit nos, <l eID="gen23230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23231"/>dolores ut parturientem. <l eID="gen23231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8946"/><l level="1" sID="gen23232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8946"/>Nolite exire ad agros, <l eID="gen23232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23233"/>et in via ne ambuletis, <l eID="gen23233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23234"/>quoniam gladius inimici, <l eID="gen23234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23235"/>pavor in circuitu. <l eID="gen23235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8947"/><l level="1" sID="gen23236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8947"/>Filia populi mei, accingere cilicio, <l eID="gen23236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23237"/>et conspergere cinere : <l eID="gen23237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23238"/>luctum unigeniti fac tibi, <l eID="gen23238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23239"/>planctum amarum, <l eID="gen23239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23240"/>quia repente veniet vastator super nos. <l eID="gen23240" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8948"/><l level="1" sID="gen23241"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8948"/>Probatorem dedi te in populo meo robustum : <l eID="gen23241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23242"/>et scies, et probabis viam eorum. <l eID="gen23242" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8949"/><l level="1" sID="gen23243"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8949"/>Omnes isti principes declinantes, <l eID="gen23243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23244"/>ambulantes fraudulenter, <l eID="gen23244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23245"/>æs et ferrum : <l eID="gen23245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23246"/>universi corrupti sunt. <l eID="gen23246" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8950"/><l level="1" sID="gen23247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8950"/>Defecit sufflatorium ; <l eID="gen23247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23248"/>in igne consumptum est plumbum : <l eID="gen23248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23249"/>frustra conflavit conflator, <l eID="gen23249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23250"/>malitiæ enim eorum non sunt consumptæ. <l eID="gen23250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 6:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8951"/><l level="1" sID="gen23251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8951"/>Argentum reprobum vocate eos, <l eID="gen23251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23252"/>quia Dominus projecit illos. <l eID="gen23252" level="1"/><lg eID="gen22843"/> <chapter eID="Jer.6"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:2
verses.text: Sta in porta domus Domini, et prædica ibi verbum istud, et dic : <div eID="gen23253" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23254"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23255"/>Audite verbum Domini, omnis Juda, <l eID="gen23255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23256"/>qui ingredimini per portas has ut adoretis Dominum. <l eID="gen23256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8952"/><l level="1" sID="gen23257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8952"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen23257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23258"/>Bonas facite vias vestras, et studia vestra, <l eID="gen23258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23259"/>et habitabo vobiscum in loco isto. <l eID="gen23259" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8953"/><l level="1" sID="gen23260"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8953"/>Nolite confidere in verbis mendacii, dicentes : <l eID="gen23260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23261"/>Templum Domini, templum Domini, templum Domini est ! <l eID="gen23261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8954"/><l level="1" sID="gen23262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8954"/>Quoniam si bene direxeritis vias vestras, et studia vestra ; <l eID="gen23262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23263"/>si feceritis judicium inter virum et proximum ejus ; <l eID="gen23263" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8955"/><l level="1" sID="gen23264"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8955"/>advenæ, et pupillo, et viduæ non feceritis calumniam, <l eID="gen23264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23265"/>nec sanguinem innocentem effuderitis in loco hoc, <l eID="gen23265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23266"/>et post deos alienos non ambulaveritis in malum vobismetipsis : <l eID="gen23266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8956"/><l level="1" sID="gen23267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8956"/>habitabo vobiscum in loco isto, <l eID="gen23267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23268"/>in terra quam dedi patribus vestris a sæculo et usque in sæculum. <l eID="gen23268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8957"/><l level="1" sID="gen23269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8957"/>Ecce vos confiditis vobis in sermonibus mendacii, <l eID="gen23269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23270"/>qui non proderunt vobis : <l eID="gen23270" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8958"/><l level="1" sID="gen23271"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8958"/>furari, occidere, adulterari, <l eID="gen23271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23272"/>jurare mendaciter, libare Baalim, <l eID="gen23272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23273"/>et ire post deos alienos quos ignoratis : <l eID="gen23273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8959"/><l level="1" sID="gen23274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8959"/>et venistis, et stetistis coram me <l eID="gen23274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23275"/>in domo hac, in qua invocatum est nomen meum, <l eID="gen23275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23276"/>et dixistis : Liberati sumus, <l eID="gen23276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23277"/>eo quod fecerimus omnes abominationes istas. <l eID="gen23277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8960"/><l level="1" sID="gen23278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8960"/>Numquid ergo spelunca latronum facta est domus ista, <l eID="gen23278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23279"/>in qua invocatum est nomen meum in oculis vestris ? <l eID="gen23279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23280"/>Ego, ego sum : ego vidi, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen23280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8961"/><l level="1" sID="gen23281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8961"/>Ite ad locum meum in Silo, <l eID="gen23281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23282"/>ubi habitavit nomen meum a principio, <l eID="gen23282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23283"/>et videte quæ fecerim ei propter malitiam populi mei Israël. <l eID="gen23283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8962"/><l level="1" sID="gen23284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8962"/>Et nunc, quia fecistis omnia opera hæc, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen23284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23285"/>et locutus sum ad vos mane consurgens, et loquens, et non audistis : <l eID="gen23285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23286"/>et vocavi vos, et non respondistis : <l eID="gen23286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8963"/><l level="1" sID="gen23287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8963"/>faciam domui huic, in qua invocatum est nomen meum, <l eID="gen23287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23288"/>et in qua vos habetis fiduciam, <l eID="gen23288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23289"/>et loco quem dedi vobis et patribus vestris, <l eID="gen23289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23290"/>sicut feci Silo : <l eID="gen23290" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8964"/><l level="1" sID="gen23291"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8964"/>et projiciam vos a facie mea <l eID="gen23291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23292"/>sicut projeci omnes fratres vestros, <l eID="gen23292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23293"/>universum semen Ephraim. <l eID="gen23293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8965"/><l level="1" sID="gen23294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8965"/>Tu ergo, noli orare pro populo hoc, <l eID="gen23294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23295"/>nec assumas pro eis laudem et orationem : <l eID="gen23295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23296"/>et non obsistas mihi, <l eID="gen23296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23297"/>quia non exaudiam te. <l eID="gen23297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8966"/><l level="1" sID="gen23298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8966"/>Nonne vides quid isti faciunt in civitatibus Juda, <l eID="gen23298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23299"/>et in plateis Jerusalem ? <l eID="gen23299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8967"/><l level="1" sID="gen23300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8967"/>Filii colligunt ligna, <l eID="gen23300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23301"/>et patres succendunt ignem, <l eID="gen23301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23302"/>et mulieres conspergunt adipem, <l eID="gen23302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23303"/>ut faciant placentas reginæ cæli, <l eID="gen23303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23304"/>et libent diis alienis, <l eID="gen23304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23305"/>et me ad iracundiam provocent. <l eID="gen23305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8968"/><l level="1" sID="gen23306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8968"/>Numquid me ad iracundiam provocant ? <l eID="gen23306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23307"/>dicit Dominus ; <l eID="gen23307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23308"/>nonne semetipsos in confusionem vultus sui ? <l eID="gen23308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8969"/><l level="1" sID="gen23309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8969"/>Ideo hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen23309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23310"/>Ecce furor meus et indignatio mea conflatur super locum istum, <l eID="gen23310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23311"/>super viros, et super jumenta, <l eID="gen23311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23312"/>et super lignum regionis, et super fruges terræ : <l eID="gen23312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23313"/>et succendetur, et non extinguetur. <l eID="gen23313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8970"/><l level="1" sID="gen23314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8970"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen23314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23315"/>Holocautomata vestra addite victimis vestris, <l eID="gen23315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23316"/>et comedite carnes : <l eID="gen23316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8971"/><l level="1" sID="gen23317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8971"/>quia non sum locutus cum patribus vestris, et non præcepi eis, <l eID="gen23317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23318"/>in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen23318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23319"/>de verbo holocautomatum et victimarum : <l eID="gen23319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8972"/><l level="1" sID="gen23320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8972"/>sed hoc verbum præcepi eis, dicens : <l eID="gen23320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23321"/>Audite vocem meam, <l eID="gen23321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23322"/>et ero vobis Deus, <l eID="gen23322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23323"/>et vos eritis mihi populus : <l eID="gen23323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23324"/>et ambulate in omni via quam mandavi vobis, <l eID="gen23324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23325"/>ut bene sit vobis. <l eID="gen23325" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8973"/><l level="1" sID="gen23326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8973"/>Et non audierunt, nec inclinaverunt aurem suam : <l eID="gen23326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23327"/>sed abierunt in voluntatibus et in pravitate cordis sui mali : <l eID="gen23327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23328"/>factique sunt retrorsum, et non in ante, <l eID="gen23328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8974"/><l level="1" sID="gen23329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8974"/>a die qua egressi sunt patres eorum de terra Ægypti <l eID="gen23329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23330"/>usque ad diem hanc. <l eID="gen23330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23331"/>Et misi ad vos omnes servos meos prophetas per diem, <l eID="gen23331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23332"/>consurgens diluculo, et mittens : <l eID="gen23332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8975"/><l level="1" sID="gen23333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8975"/>et non audierunt me, <l eID="gen23333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23334"/>nec inclinaverunt aurem suam : <l eID="gen23334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23335"/>sed induraverunt cervicem suam, <l eID="gen23335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23336"/>et pejus operati sunt quam patres eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:27
