verses.text: Et loqueris ad eos omnia verba hæc, et non audient te : et vocabis eos, et non respondebunt tibi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:28
verses.text: Et dices ad eos : <l eID="gen23336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23337"/>Hæc est gens quæ non audivit vocem Domini Dei sui, <l eID="gen23337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23338"/>nec recepit disciplinam ; <l eID="gen23338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23339"/>periit fides, <l eID="gen23339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23340"/>et ablata est de ore eorum. <l eID="gen23340" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8976"/><l level="1" sID="gen23341"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8976"/>Tonde capillum tuum, et projice, <l eID="gen23341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23342"/>et sume in directum planctum : <l eID="gen23342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23343"/>quia projecit Dominus et reliquit generationem furoris sui ; <l eID="gen23343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8977"/><l level="1" sID="gen23344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8977"/>quia fecerunt filii Juda malum in oculis meis, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen23344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23345"/>Posuerunt offendicula sua in domo <l eID="gen23345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23346"/>in qua invocatum est nomen meum, ut polluerent eam : <l eID="gen23346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8978"/><l level="1" sID="gen23347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8978"/>et ædificaverunt excelsa Topheth, <l eID="gen23347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23348"/>quæ est in valle filii Ennom, <l eID="gen23348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23349"/>ut incenderent filios suos et filias suas igni, <l eID="gen23349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23350"/>quæ non præcepi, nec cogitavi in corde meo. <l eID="gen23350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8979"/><l level="1" sID="gen23351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8979"/>Ideo ecce dies venient, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen23351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23352"/>et non dicetur amplius Topheth, et vallis filii Ennom, <l eID="gen23352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23353"/>sed vallis interfectionis : <l eID="gen23353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23354"/>et sepelient in Topheth, eo quod non sit locus. <l eID="gen23354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8980"/><l level="1" sID="gen23355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8980"/>Et erit morticinum populi hujus in cibos volucribus cæli et bestiis terræ, <l eID="gen23355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23356"/>et non erit qui abigat. <l eID="gen23356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 7:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8981"/><l level="1" sID="gen23357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8981"/>Et quiescere faciam de urbibus Juda, <l eID="gen23357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23358"/>et de plateis Jerusalem, <l eID="gen23358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23359"/>vocem gaudii et vocem lætitiæ, <l eID="gen23359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23360"/>vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ : <l eID="gen23360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23361"/>in desolationem enim erit terra.  <chapter eID="Jer.7"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:1
verses.text: In illo tempore, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen23362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23363"/>ejicient ossa regum Juda, et ossa principum ejus, <l eID="gen23363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23364"/>et ossa sacerdotum, et ossa prophetarum, <l eID="gen23364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23365"/>et ossa eorum qui habitaverunt Jerusalem, <l eID="gen23365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23366"/>de sepulchris suis : <l eID="gen23366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8982"/><l level="1" sID="gen23367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8982"/>et expandent ea ad solem, et lunam, <l eID="gen23367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23368"/>et omnem militiam cæli, <l eID="gen23368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23369"/>quæ dilexerunt, et quibus servierunt, <l eID="gen23369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23370"/>et post quæ ambulaverunt, <l eID="gen23370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23371"/>et quæ quæsierunt, et adoraverunt. <l eID="gen23371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23372"/>Non colligentur, et non sepelientur : <l eID="gen23372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23373"/>in sterquilinium super faciem terræ erunt. <l eID="gen23373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8983"/><l level="1" sID="gen23374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8983"/>Et eligent magis mortem quam vitam, <l eID="gen23374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23375"/>omnes qui residui fuerint de cognatione hac pessima, <l eID="gen23375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23376"/>in universis locis quæ derelicta sunt, <l eID="gen23376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23377"/>ad quæ ejeci eos, dicit Dominus exercituum. <l eID="gen23377" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen23254"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8984"/><div sID="gen23378" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8984"/>Et dices ad eos : <div eID="gen23378" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23379"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23380"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23381"/>Numquid qui cadit non resurget ? <l eID="gen23381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23382"/>et qui aversus est non revertetur ? <l eID="gen23382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8985"/><l level="1" sID="gen23383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8985"/>Quare ergo aversus est populus iste in Jerusalem <l eID="gen23383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23384"/>aversione contentiosa ? <l eID="gen23384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23385"/>Apprehenderunt mendacium, <l eID="gen23385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23386"/>et noluerunt reverti. <l eID="gen23386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8986"/><l level="1" sID="gen23387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8986"/>Attendi, et auscultavi : <l eID="gen23387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23388"/>nemo quod bonum est loquitur ; <l eID="gen23388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23389"/>nullus est qui agat pœnitentiam super peccato suo, <l eID="gen23389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23390"/>dicens : Quid feci ? <l eID="gen23390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23391"/>Omnes conversi sunt ad cursum suum, <l eID="gen23391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23392"/>quasi equus impetu vadens ad prælium. <l eID="gen23392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8987"/><l level="1" sID="gen23393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8987"/>Milvus in cælo cognovit tempus suum : <l eID="gen23393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23394"/>turtur, et hirundo, et ciconia custodierunt tempus adventus sui : <l eID="gen23394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23395"/>populus autem meus non cognovit judicium Domini. <l eID="gen23395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8988"/><l level="1" sID="gen23396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8988"/>Quomodo dicitis : Sapientes nos sumus, <l eID="gen23396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23397"/>et lex Domini nobiscum est ? <l eID="gen23397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23398"/>vere mendacium operatus est stylus mendax scribarum ! <l eID="gen23398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8989"/><l level="1" sID="gen23399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8989"/>Confusi sunt sapientes ; <l eID="gen23399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23400"/>perterriti et capti sunt : <l eID="gen23400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23401"/>verbum enim Domini projecerunt, <l eID="gen23401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23402"/>et sapientia nulla est in eis. <l eID="gen23402" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8990"/><l level="1" sID="gen23403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8990"/>Propterea dabo mulieres eorum exteris, <l eID="gen23403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23404"/>agros eorum hæredibus, <l eID="gen23404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23405"/>quia a minimo usque ad maximum <l eID="gen23405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23406"/>omnes avaritiam sequuntur : <l eID="gen23406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23407"/>a propheta usque ad sacerdotem <l eID="gen23407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23408"/>cuncti faciunt mendacium. <l eID="gen23408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8991"/><l level="1" sID="gen23409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8991"/>Et sanabant contritionem filiæ populi mei ad ignominiam, <l eID="gen23409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23410"/>dicentes : Pax, pax ! <l eID="gen23410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23411"/>cum non esset pax. <l eID="gen23411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8992"/><l level="1" sID="gen23412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8992"/>Confusi sunt, quia abominationem fecerunt : <l eID="gen23412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23413"/>quinimmo confusione non sunt confusi, <l eID="gen23413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23414"/>et erubescere nescierunt. <l eID="gen23414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23415"/>Idcirco cadent inter corruentes : <l eID="gen23415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23416"/>in tempore visitationis suæ corruent, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen23416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8993"/><l level="1" sID="gen23417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8993"/>Congregans congregabo eos, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen23417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23418"/>Non est uva in vitibus, et non sunt ficus in ficulnea : <l eID="gen23418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23419"/>folium defluxit, <l eID="gen23419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23420"/>et dedi eis quæ prætergressa sunt. <l eID="gen23420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8994"/><l level="1" sID="gen23421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8994"/>Quare sedemus ? <l eID="gen23421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23422"/>convenite, et ingrediamur civitatem munitam, <l eID="gen23422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23423"/>et sileamus ibi : <l eID="gen23423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23424"/>quia Dominus Deus noster silere nos fecit, <l eID="gen23424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23425"/>et potum dedit nobis aquam fellis : <l eID="gen23425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23426"/>peccavimus enim Domino. <l eID="gen23426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8995"/><l level="1" sID="gen23427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8995"/>Exspectavimus pacem, et non erat bonum : <l eID="gen23427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23428"/>tempus medelæ, et ecce formido. <l eID="gen23428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8996"/><l level="1" sID="gen23429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8996"/>A Dan auditus est fremitus equorum ejus ; <l eID="gen23429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23430"/>a voce hinnituum pugnatorum ejus commota est omnis terra : <l eID="gen23430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23431"/>et venerunt, et devoraverunt terram et plenitudinem ejus ; <l eID="gen23431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23432"/>urbem et habitatores ejus. <l eID="gen23432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8997"/><l level="1" sID="gen23433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8997"/>Quia ecce ego mittam vobis serpentes regulos, <l eID="gen23433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23434"/>quibus non est incantatio : <l eID="gen23434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23435"/>et mordebunt vos, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen23435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8998"/><l level="1" sID="gen23436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8998"/>Dolor meus super dolorem, <l eID="gen23436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23437"/>in me cor meum mœrens. <l eID="gen23437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv8999"/><l level="1" sID="gen23438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv8999"/>Ecce vox clamoris filiæ populi mei de terra longinqua : <l eID="gen23438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23439"/>Numquid Dominus non est in Sion ? <l eID="gen23439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23440"/>aut rex ejus non est in ea ? <l eID="gen23440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23441"/>Quare ergo me ad iracundiam concitaverunt in sculptilibus suis, <l eID="gen23441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23442"/>et in vanitatibus alienis ? <l eID="gen23442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9000"/><l level="1" sID="gen23443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9000"/>Transiit messis, finita est æstas, <l eID="gen23443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23444"/>et nos salvati non sumus. <l eID="gen23444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9001"/><l level="1" sID="gen23445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9001"/>Super contritione filiæ populi mei contritus sum, et contristatus : <l eID="gen23445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23446"/>stupor obtinuit me. <l eID="gen23446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 8:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9002"/><l level="1" sID="gen23447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9002"/>Numquid resina non est in Galaad ? <l eID="gen23447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23448"/>aut medicus non est ibi ? <l eID="gen23448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23449"/>quare igitur non est obducta cicatrix filiæ populi mei ?  <chapter eID="Jer.8"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:1
verses.text: Quis dabit capiti meo aquam, <l eID="gen23450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23451"/>et oculis meis fontem lacrimarum, <l eID="gen23451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23452"/>et plorabo die ac nocte interfectos filiæ populi mei ? <l eID="gen23452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9003"/><l level="1" sID="gen23453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9003"/>Quis dabit me in solitudine diversorium viatorum, <l eID="gen23453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23454"/>et derelinquam populum meum, <l eID="gen23454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23455"/>et recedam ab eis ? <l eID="gen23455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23456"/>quia omnes adulteri sunt, <l eID="gen23456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23457"/>cœtus prævaricatorum. <l eID="gen23457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9004"/><l level="1" sID="gen23458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9004"/>Et extenderunt linguam suam <l eID="gen23458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23459"/>quasi arcum mendacii et non veritatis : <l eID="gen23459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23460"/>confortati sunt in terra, <l eID="gen23460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23461"/>quia de malo ad malum egressi sunt, <l eID="gen23461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23462"/>et me non cognoverunt, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen23462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9005"/><l level="1" sID="gen23463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9005"/>Unusquisque se a proximo suo custodiat, <l eID="gen23463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23464"/>et in omni fratre suo non habeat fiduciam : <l eID="gen23464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23465"/>quia omnis frater supplantans supplantabit, <l eID="gen23465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23466"/>et omnis amicus fraudulenter incedet. <l eID="gen23466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9006"/><l level="1" sID="gen23467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9006"/>Et vir fratrem suum deridebit, <l eID="gen23467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23468"/>et veritatem non loquentur : <l eID="gen23468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23469"/>docuerunt enim linguam suam loqui mendacium ; <l eID="gen23469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23470"/>ut inique agerent laboraverunt. <l eID="gen23470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9007"/><l level="1" sID="gen23471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9007"/>Habitatio tua in medio doli : <l eID="gen23471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23472"/>in dolo renuerunt scire me, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen23472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9008"/><l level="1" sID="gen23473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9008"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen23473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23474"/>Ecce ego conflabo, et probabo eos : <l eID="gen23474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23475"/>quid enim aliud faciam a facie filiæ populi mei ? <l eID="gen23475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9009"/><l level="1" sID="gen23476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9009"/>Sagitta vulnerans lingua eorum, <l eID="gen23476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23477"/>dolum locuta est. <l eID="gen23477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23478"/>In ore suo pacem cum amico suo loquitur, <l eID="gen23478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23479"/>et occulte ponit ei insidias. <l eID="gen23479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9010"/><l level="1" sID="gen23480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9010"/>Numquid super his non visitabo, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen23480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23481"/>aut in gente hujusmodi non ulciscetur anima mea ? <l eID="gen23481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9011"/><l level="1" sID="gen23482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9011"/>Super montes assumam fletum ac lamentum, <l eID="gen23482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23483"/>et super speciosa deserti planctum, <l eID="gen23483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23484"/>quoniam incensa sunt, eo quod non sit vir pertransiens, <l eID="gen23484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23485"/>et non audierunt vocem possidentis : <l eID="gen23485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23486"/>a volucre cæli usque ad pecora transmigraverunt et recesserunt. <l eID="gen23486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9012"/><l level="1" sID="gen23487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9012"/>Et dabo Jerusalem in acervos arenæ, <l eID="gen23487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23488"/>et cubilia draconum : <l eID="gen23488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23489"/>et civitates Juda dabo in desolationem, <l eID="gen23489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23490"/>eo quod non sit habitator. <l eID="gen23490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9013"/><l level="1" sID="gen23491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9013"/>Quis est vir sapiens qui intelligat hoc, <l eID="gen23491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23492"/>et ad quem verbum oris Domini fiat, ut annuntiet istud, <l eID="gen23492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23493"/>quare perierit terra, et exusta sit quasi desertum, <l eID="gen23493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23494"/>eo quod non sit qui pertranseat ? <l eID="gen23494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9014"/><l level="1" sID="gen23495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9014"/>Et dixit Dominus : <l eID="gen23495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23496"/>Quia dereliquerunt legem meam quam dedi eis, <l eID="gen23496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23497"/>et non audierunt vocem meam, <l eID="gen23497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23498"/>et non ambulaverunt in ea, <l eID="gen23498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9015"/><l level="1" sID="gen23499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9015"/>et abierunt post pravitatem cordis sui, <l eID="gen23499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23500"/>et post Baalim, quod didicerunt a patribus suis : <l eID="gen23500" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9016"/><l level="1" sID="gen23501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9016"/>idcirco hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen23501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23502"/>Ecce ego cibabo populum istum absinthio, <l eID="gen23502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23503"/>et potum dabo eis aquam fellis. <l eID="gen23503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9017"/><l level="1" sID="gen23504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9017"/>Et dispergam eos in gentibus <l eID="gen23504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23505"/>quas non noverunt ipsi et patres eorum, <l eID="gen23505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23506"/>et mittam post eos gladium, <l eID="gen23506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23507"/>donec consumantur. <l eID="gen23507" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9018"/><l level="1" sID="gen23508"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9018"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen23508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23509"/>Contemplamini, et vocate lamentatrices, et veniant : <l eID="gen23509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23510"/>et ad eas quæ sapientes sunt mittite, et properent : <l eID="gen23510" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9019"/><l level="1" sID="gen23511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9019"/>festinent, et assumant super nos lamentum : <l eID="gen23511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23512"/>deducant oculi nostri lacrimas, <l eID="gen23512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23513"/>et palpebræ nostræ defluant aquis. <l eID="gen23513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9020"/><l level="1" sID="gen23514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9020"/>Quia vox lamentationis audita est de Sion : <l eID="gen23514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23515"/>Quomodo vastati sumus, <l eID="gen23515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23516"/>et confusi vehementer ? <l eID="gen23516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23517"/>quia dereliquimus terram ; <l eID="gen23517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23518"/>quoniam dejecta sunt tabernacula nostra. <l eID="gen23518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9021"/><l level="1" sID="gen23519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9021"/>Audite ergo, mulieres, verbum Domini, <l eID="gen23519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23520"/>et assumant aures vestræ sermonem oris ejus, <l eID="gen23520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23521"/>et docete filias vestras lamentum, <l eID="gen23521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23522"/>et unaquæque proximam suam planctum : <l eID="gen23522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9022"/><l level="1" sID="gen23523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9022"/>quia ascendit mors per fenestras nostras ; <l eID="gen23523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23524"/>ingressa est domos nostras, <l eID="gen23524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23525"/>disperdere parvulos deforis, <l eID="gen23525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23526"/>juvenes de plateis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:22
verses.text: Loquere : <l eID="gen23526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23527"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23528"/>Et cadet morticinum hominis <l eID="gen23528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23529"/>quasi stercus super faciem regionis, <l eID="gen23529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23530"/>et quasi fœnum post tergum metentis, <l eID="gen23530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23531"/>et non est qui colligat. <l eID="gen23531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9023"/><l level="1" sID="gen23532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9023"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23533"/>Non glorietur sapiens in sapientia sua, <l eID="gen23533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23534"/>et non glorietur fortis in fortitudine sua, <l eID="gen23534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23535"/>et non glorietur dives in divitiis suis : <l eID="gen23535" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9024"/><l level="1" sID="gen23536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9024"/>sed in hoc glorietur, qui gloriatur, <l eID="gen23536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23537"/>scire et nosse me, <l eID="gen23537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23538"/>quia ego sum Dominus qui facio misericordiam, <l eID="gen23538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23539"/>et judicium, et justitiam in terra : <l eID="gen23539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23540"/>hæc enim placent mihi, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen23540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9025"/><l level="1" sID="gen23541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9025"/>Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen23541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23542"/>et visitabo super omnem qui circumcisum habet præputium, <l eID="gen23542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 9:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9026"/><l level="1" sID="gen23543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9026"/>super Ægyptum, et super Juda, et super Edom, <l eID="gen23543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23544"/>et super filios Ammon, et super Moab ; <l eID="gen23544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23545"/>et super omnes qui attonsi sunt in comam, <l eID="gen23545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23546"/>habitantes in deserto : <l eID="gen23546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23547"/>quia omnes gentes habent præputium, <l eID="gen23547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23548"/>omnis autem domus Israël incircumcisi sunt corde.  <chapter eID="Jer.9"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:1
verses.text: Audite verbum quod locutus est Dominus super vos, domus Israël. <l eID="gen23549" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9027"/><l level="1" sID="gen23550"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9027"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23551"/>Juxta vias gentium nolite discere, <l eID="gen23551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23552"/>et a signis cæli nolite metuere, quæ timent gentes, <l eID="gen23552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9028"/><l level="1" sID="gen23553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9028"/>quia leges populorum vanæ sunt. <l eID="gen23553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23554"/>Quia lignum de saltu præcidit opus manus artificis in ascia : <l eID="gen23554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9029"/><l level="1" sID="gen23555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9029"/>argento et auro decoravit illud : <l eID="gen23555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23556"/>clavis et malleis compegit, ut non dissolvatur : <l eID="gen23556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9030"/><l level="1" sID="gen23557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9030"/>in similitudinem palmæ fabricata sunt, <l eID="gen23557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23558"/>et non loquentur : <l eID="gen23558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23559"/>portata tollentur, <l eID="gen23559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23560"/>quia incedere non valent. <l eID="gen23560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23561"/>Nolite ergo timere ea, <l eID="gen23561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23562"/>quia nec male possunt facere, nec bene. <l eID="gen23562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9031"/><l level="1" sID="gen23563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9031"/>Non est similis tui, Domine : <l eID="gen23563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23564"/>magnus es tu, <l eID="gen23564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23565"/>et magnum nomen tuum in fortitudine. <l eID="gen23565" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9032"/><l level="1" sID="gen23566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9032"/>Quis non timebit te, o Rex gentium ? <l eID="gen23566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23567"/>tuum est enim decus : <l eID="gen23567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23568"/>inter cunctos sapientes gentium, <l eID="gen23568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23569"/>et in universis regnis eorum, <l eID="gen23569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23570"/>nullus est similis tui. <l eID="gen23570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9033"/><l level="1" sID="gen23571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9033"/>Pariter insipientes et fatui probabuntur : <l eID="gen23571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23572"/>doctrina vanitatis eorum lignum est. <l eID="gen23572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9034"/><l level="1" sID="gen23573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9034"/>Argentum involutum de Tharsis affertur, <l eID="gen23573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23574"/>et aurum de Ophaz : <l eID="gen23574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23575"/>opus artificis et manus ærarii. <l eID="gen23575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23576"/>Hyacinthus et purpura indumentum eorum : <l eID="gen23576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23577"/>opus artificum universa hæc. <l eID="gen23577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9035"/><l level="1" sID="gen23578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9035"/>Dominus autem Deus verus est, <l eID="gen23578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23579"/>ipse Deus vivens, <l eID="gen23579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23580"/>et rex sempiternus. <l eID="gen23580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23581"/>Ab indignatione ejus commovebitur terra, <l eID="gen23581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23582"/>et non sustinebunt gentes comminationem ejus. <l eID="gen23582" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9036"/><l level="1" sID="gen23583"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9036"/>Sic ergo dicetis eis : <l eID="gen23583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23584"/>Dii qui cælos et terram non fecerunt, <l eID="gen23584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23585"/>pereant de terra et de his quæ sub cælo sunt ! <l eID="gen23585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9037"/><l level="1" sID="gen23586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9037"/>Qui facit terram in fortitudine sua, <l eID="gen23586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23587"/>præparat orbem in sapientia sua, <l eID="gen23587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23588"/>et prudentia sua extendit cælos : <l eID="gen23588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9038"/><l level="1" sID="gen23589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9038"/>ad vocem suam dat multitudinem aquarum in cælo, <l eID="gen23589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23590"/>et elevat nebulas ab extremitatibus terræ : <l eID="gen23590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23591"/>fulgura in pluviam facit, <l eID="gen23591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23592"/>et educit ventum de thesauris suis. <l eID="gen23592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9039"/><l level="1" sID="gen23593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9039"/>Stultus factus est omnis homo a scientia : <l eID="gen23593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23594"/>confusus est artifex omnis in sculptili, <l eID="gen23594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23595"/>quoniam falsum est quod conflavit, <l eID="gen23595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23596"/>et non est spiritus in eis. <l eID="gen23596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9040"/><l level="1" sID="gen23597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9040"/>Vana sunt, et opus risu dignum : <l eID="gen23597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23598"/>in tempore visitationis suæ peribunt. <l eID="gen23598" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9041"/><l level="1" sID="gen23599"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9041"/>Non est his similis pars Jacob : <l eID="gen23599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23600"/>qui enim formavit omnia, ipse est, <l eID="gen23600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23601"/>et Israël virga hæreditatis ejus : <l eID="gen23601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23602"/>Dominus exercituum nomen illi. <l eID="gen23602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9042"/><l level="1" sID="gen23603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9042"/>Congrega de terra confusionem tuam, <l eID="gen23603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23604"/>quæ habitas in obsidione : <l eID="gen23604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9043"/><l level="1" sID="gen23605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9043"/>quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23606"/>Ecce ego longe projiciam habitatores terræ in hac vice, <l eID="gen23606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23607"/>et tribulabo eos ita ut inveniantur. <l eID="gen23607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9044"/><l level="1" sID="gen23608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9044"/>Væ mihi super contritione mea : <l eID="gen23608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23609"/>pessima plaga mea. <l eID="gen23609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23610"/>Ego autem dixi : <l eID="gen23610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23611"/>Plane hæc infirmitas mea est, et portabo illam. <l eID="gen23611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9045"/><l level="1" sID="gen23612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9045"/>Tabernaculum meum vastatum est ; <l eID="gen23612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23613"/>omnes funiculi mei dirupti sunt : <l eID="gen23613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23614"/>filii mei exierunt a me, et non subsistunt. <l eID="gen23614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23615"/>Non est qui extendat ultra tentorium meum, <l eID="gen23615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23616"/>et erigat pelles meas. <l eID="gen23616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9046"/><l level="1" sID="gen23617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9046"/>Quia stulte egerunt pastores, <l eID="gen23617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23618"/>et Dominum non quæsierunt : <l eID="gen23618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23619"/>propterea non intellexerunt, <l eID="gen23619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23620"/>et omnis grex eorum dispersus est. <l eID="gen23620" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9047"/><l level="1" sID="gen23621"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9047"/>Vox auditionis ecce venit, <l eID="gen23621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23622"/>et commotio magna de terra aquilonis : <l eID="gen23622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23623"/>ut ponat civitates Juda solitudinem, <l eID="gen23623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23624"/>et habitaculum draconum. <l eID="gen23624" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9048"/><l level="1" sID="gen23625"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9048"/>Scio, Domine, <l eID="gen23625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23626"/>quia non est hominis via ejus, <l eID="gen23626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23627"/>nec viri est ut ambulet, <l eID="gen23627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23628"/>et dirigat gressus suos. <l eID="gen23628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9049"/><l level="1" sID="gen23629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9049"/>Corripe me, Domine, verumtamen in judicio, <l eID="gen23629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23630"/>et non in furore tuo, ne forte ad nihilum redigas me. <l eID="gen23630" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 10:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9050"/><l level="1" sID="gen23631"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9050"/>Effunde indignationem tuam super gentes quæ non cognoverunt te, <l eID="gen23631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23632"/>et super provincias quæ nomen tuum non invocaverunt : <l eID="gen23632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23633"/>quia comederunt Jacob, et devoraverunt eum, <l eID="gen23633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23634"/>et consumpserunt illum, et decus ejus dissipaverunt. <l eID="gen23634" level="1"/><lg eID="gen23379"/> <chapter eID="Jer.10"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est a Domino ad Jeremiam, dicens :  <div eID="gen23635" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9051"/><lg sID="gen23636"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9051"/>Audite verba pacti hujus, <l eID="gen23637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23638"/>et loquimini ad viros Juda, <l eID="gen23638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23639"/>et ad habitatores Jerusalem, <l eID="gen23639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9052"/><l level="1" sID="gen23640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9052"/>et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : <l eID="gen23640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23641"/>Maledictus vir qui non audierit verba pacti hujus <l eID="gen23641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9053"/><l level="1" sID="gen23642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9053"/>quod præcepi patribus vestris, <l eID="gen23642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23643"/>in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen23643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23644"/>de fornace ferrea, dicens : <l eID="gen23644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23645"/>Audite vocem meam, et facite omnia quæ præcipio vobis, <l eID="gen23645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23646"/>et eritis mihi in populum, <l eID="gen23646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23647"/>et ego ero vobis in Deum : <l eID="gen23647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9054"/><l level="1" sID="gen23648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9054"/>ut suscitem juramentum quod juravi patribus vestris, <l eID="gen23648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23649"/>daturum me eis terram fluentem lacte et melle, <l eID="gen23649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23650"/>sicut est dies hæc. Et respondi, et dixi : Amen, Domine.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:6
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen23650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23651"/>Vociferare omnia verba hæc in civitatibus Juda, <l eID="gen23651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23652"/>et foris Jerusalem, dicens : <l eID="gen23652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23653"/>Audite verba pacti hujus, et facite illa, <l eID="gen23653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9055"/><l level="1" sID="gen23654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9055"/>quia contestans contestatus sum patres vestros, <l eID="gen23654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23655"/>in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti, usque ad diem hanc : <l eID="gen23655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23656"/>mane consurgens contestatus sum, <l eID="gen23656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23657"/>et dixi : Audite vocem meam. <l eID="gen23657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9056"/><l level="1" sID="gen23658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9056"/>Et non audierunt, nec inclinaverunt aurem suam, <l eID="gen23658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23659"/>sed abierunt, unusquisque in pravitate cordis sui mali : <l eID="gen23659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23660"/>et induxi super eos omnia verba pacti hujus <l eID="gen23660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23661"/>quod præcepi ut facerent, <l eID="gen23661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23662"/>et non fecerunt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:9
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen23662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23663"/>Inventa est conjuratio in viris Juda et in habitatoribus Jerusalem. <l eID="gen23663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9057"/><l level="1" sID="gen23664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9057"/>Reversi sunt ad iniquitates patrum suorum priores, <l eID="gen23664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23665"/>qui noluerunt audire verba mea : <l eID="gen23665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23666"/>et hi ergo abierunt post deos alienos, ut servirent eis : <l eID="gen23666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23667"/>irritum fecerunt domus Israël et domus Juda pactum meum <l eID="gen23667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23668"/>quod pepigi cum patribus eorum. <l eID="gen23668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9058"/><l level="1" sID="gen23669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9058"/>Quam ob rem hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23670"/>Ecce ego inducam super eos mala <l eID="gen23670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23671"/>de quibus exire non poterunt : <l eID="gen23671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23672"/>et clamabunt ad me, et non exaudiam eos. <l eID="gen23672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9059"/><l level="1" sID="gen23673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9059"/>Et ibunt civitates Juda et habitatores Jerusalem, <l eID="gen23673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23674"/>et clamabunt ad deos quibus libant, <l eID="gen23674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23675"/>et non salvabunt eos in tempore afflictionis eorum. <l eID="gen23675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9060"/><l level="1" sID="gen23676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9060"/>Secundum numerum enim civitatum tuarum <l eID="gen23676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23677"/>erant dii tui, Juda : <l eID="gen23677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23678"/>et secundum numerum viarum Jerusalem, <l eID="gen23678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23679"/>posuisti aras confusionis, <l eID="gen23679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23680"/>aras ad libandum Baalim. <l eID="gen23680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9061"/><l level="1" sID="gen23681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9061"/>Tu ergo noli orare pro populo hoc, <l eID="gen23681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23682"/>et ne assumas pro eis laudem et orationem, <l eID="gen23682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23683"/>quia non exaudiam in tempore clamoris eorum ad me, <l eID="gen23683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23684"/>in tempore afflictionis eorum. <l eID="gen23684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9062"/><l level="1" sID="gen23685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9062"/>Quid est, quod dilectus meus in domo mea fecit scelera multa ? <l eID="gen23685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23686"/>numquid carnes sanctæ auferent a te malitias tuas, <l eID="gen23686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23687"/>in quibus gloriata es ? <l eID="gen23687" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9063"/><l level="1" sID="gen23688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9063"/>Olivam uberem, pulchram, fructiferam, speciosam, <l eID="gen23688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23689"/>vocavit Dominus nomen tuum : <l eID="gen23689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23690"/>ad vocem loquelæ, grandis exarsit ignis in ea, <l eID="gen23690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23691"/>et combusta sunt fruteta ejus. <l eID="gen23691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9064"/><l level="1" sID="gen23692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9064"/>Et Dominus exercituum, qui plantavit te, <l eID="gen23692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23693"/>locutus est super te malum, <l eID="gen23693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23694"/>pro malis domus Israël, et domus Juda, <l eID="gen23694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23695"/>quæ fecerunt sibi ad irritandum me, <l eID="gen23695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23696"/>libantes Baalim. <l eID="gen23696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9065"/><l level="1" sID="gen23697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9065"/>Tu autem, Domine, demonstrasti mihi, et cognovi : <l eID="gen23697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23698"/>tunc ostendisti mihi studia eorum. <l eID="gen23698" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9066"/><l level="1" sID="gen23699"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9066"/>Et ego quasi agnus mansuetus, <l eID="gen23699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23700"/>qui portatur ad victimam : <l eID="gen23700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23701"/>et non cognovi quia cogitaverunt super me consilia, dicentes : <l eID="gen23701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23702"/>Mittamus lignum in panem ejus, <l eID="gen23702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23703"/>et eradamus eum de terra viventium, <l eID="gen23703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23704"/>et nomen ejus non memoretur amplius. <l eID="gen23704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9067"/><l level="1" sID="gen23705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9067"/>Tu autem, Domine Sabaoth, qui judicas juste, <l eID="gen23705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23706"/>et probas renes et corda, <l eID="gen23706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23707"/>videam ultionem tuam ex eis : <l eID="gen23707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23708"/>tibi enim revelavi causam meam. <l eID="gen23708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9068"/><l level="1" sID="gen23709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9068"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus ad viros Anathoth, <l eID="gen23709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23710"/>qui quærunt animam tuam, et dicunt : <l eID="gen23710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23711"/>Non prophetabis in nomine Domini, <l eID="gen23711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23712"/>et non morieris in manibus nostris : <l eID="gen23712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9069"/><l level="1" sID="gen23713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9069"/>propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen23713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23714"/>Ecce ego visitabo super eos : <l eID="gen23714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23715"/>juvenes morientur in gladio ; <l eID="gen23715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23716"/>filii eorum et filiæ eorum morientur in fame. <l eID="gen23716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 11:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9070"/><l level="1" sID="gen23717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9070"/>Et reliquiæ non erunt ex eis : <l eID="gen23717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23718"/>inducam enim malum super viros Anathoth, <l eID="gen23718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23719"/>annum visitationis eorum.  <chapter eID="Jer.11"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:1
verses.text: Justus quidem tu es, Domine, si disputem tecum : <l eID="gen23720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23721"/>verumtamen justa loquar ad te : <l eID="gen23721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23722"/>Quare via impiorum prosperatur ; <l eID="gen23722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23723"/>bene est omnibus qui prævaricantur et inique agunt ? <l eID="gen23723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9071"/><l level="1" sID="gen23724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9071"/>Plantasti eos, et radicem miserunt : <l eID="gen23724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23725"/>proficiunt, et faciunt fructum : <l eID="gen23725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23726"/>prope es tu ori eorum, <l eID="gen23726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23727"/>et longe a renibus eorum. <l eID="gen23727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9072"/><l level="1" sID="gen23728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9072"/>Et tu, Domine, nosti me, vidisti me, <l eID="gen23728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23729"/>et probasti cor meum tecum. <l eID="gen23729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23730"/>Congrega eos quasi gregem ad victimam, <l eID="gen23730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23731"/>et sanctifica eos in die occisionis. <l eID="gen23731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9073"/><l level="1" sID="gen23732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9073"/>Usquequo lugebit terra, <l eID="gen23732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23733"/>et herba omnis regionis siccabitur, <l eID="gen23733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23734"/>propter malitiam habitantium in ea ? <l eID="gen23734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23735"/>Consumptum est animal, et volucre, <l eID="gen23735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23736"/>quoniam dixerunt : Non videbit novissima nostra. <l eID="gen23736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9074"/><l level="1" sID="gen23737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9074"/>Si cum peditibus currens laborasti, <l eID="gen23737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23738"/>quomodo contendere poteris cum equis ? <l eID="gen23738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23739"/>cum autem in terra pacis securus fueris, <l eID="gen23739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23740"/>quid facies in superbia Jordanis ? <l eID="gen23740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9075"/><l level="1" sID="gen23741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9075"/>Nam et fratres tui, et domus patris tui, <l eID="gen23741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23742"/>etiam ipsi pugnaverunt adversum te, <l eID="gen23742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23743"/>et clamaverunt post te plena voce : <l eID="gen23743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23744"/>ne credas eis, <l eID="gen23744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23745"/>cum locuti fuerint tibi bona. <l eID="gen23745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9076"/><l level="1" sID="gen23746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9076"/>Reliqui domum meam ; <l eID="gen23746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23747"/>dimisi hæreditatem meam : <l eID="gen23747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23748"/>dedi dilectam animam meam in manu inimicorum ejus. <l eID="gen23748" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9077"/><l level="1" sID="gen23749"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9077"/>Facta est mihi hæreditas mea quasi leo in silva : <l eID="gen23749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23750"/>dedit contra me vocem, ideo odivi eam. <l eID="gen23750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9078"/><l level="1" sID="gen23751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9078"/>Numquid avis discolor hæreditas mea mihi ? <l eID="gen23751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23752"/>numquid avis tincta per totum ? <l eID="gen23752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23753"/>Venite, congregamini, omnes bestiæ terræ : <l eID="gen23753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23754"/>properate ad devorandum. <l eID="gen23754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9079"/><l level="1" sID="gen23755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9079"/>Pastores multi demoliti sunt vineam meam, <l eID="gen23755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23756"/>conculcaverunt partem meam, <l eID="gen23756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23757"/>dederunt portionem meam desiderabilem in desertum solitudinis. <l eID="gen23757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9080"/><l level="1" sID="gen23758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9080"/>Posuerunt eam in dissipationem, <l eID="gen23758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23759"/>luxitque super me : <l eID="gen23759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23760"/>desolatione desolata est omnis terra, <l eID="gen23760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23761"/>quia nullus est qui recogitet corde. <l eID="gen23761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9081"/><l level="1" sID="gen23762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9081"/>Super omnes vias deserti venerunt vastatores, <l eID="gen23762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23763"/>quia gladius Domini devorabit : <l eID="gen23763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23764"/>ab extremo terræ usque ad extremum ejus, <l eID="gen23764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23765"/>non est pax universæ carni. <l eID="gen23765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9082"/><l level="1" sID="gen23766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9082"/>Seminaverunt triticum, <l eID="gen23766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23767"/>et spinas messuerunt : <l eID="gen23767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23768"/>hæreditatem acceperunt, <l eID="gen23768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23769"/>et non eis proderit. <l eID="gen23769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23770"/>Confundemini a fructibus vestris <l eID="gen23770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23771"/>propter iram furoris Domini. <l eID="gen23771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9083"/><l level="1" sID="gen23772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9083"/>Hæc dicit Dominus adversum omnes vicinos meos pessimos, <l eID="gen23772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23773"/>qui tangunt hæreditatem quam distribui populo meo Israël : <l eID="gen23773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23774"/>Ecce ego evellam eos de terra sua, <l eID="gen23774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23775"/>et domum Juda evellam de medio eorum. <l eID="gen23775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9084"/><l level="1" sID="gen23776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9084"/>Et cum evulsero eos, convertar, <l eID="gen23776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23777"/>et miserebor eorum, et reducam eos : <l eID="gen23777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23778"/>virum ad hæreditatem suam, <l eID="gen23778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23779"/>et virum in terram suam. <l eID="gen23779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9085"/><l level="1" sID="gen23780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9085"/>Et erit : si eruditi didicerint vias populi mei, <l eID="gen23780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23781"/>ut jurent in nomine meo : Vivit Dominus ! <l eID="gen23781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23782"/>sicut docuerunt populum meum jurare in Baal, <l eID="gen23782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23783"/>ædificabuntur in medio populi mei. <l eID="gen23783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 12:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9086"/><l level="1" sID="gen23784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9086"/>Quod si non audierint, <l eID="gen23784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23785"/>evellam gentem illam evulsione et perditione, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen23785" level="1"/><lg eID="gen23636"/> <chapter eID="Jer.12"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus ad me : Vade, et posside tibi lumbare lineum, et pones illud super lumbos tuos, et in aquam non inferes illud.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:2
verses.text: Et possedi lumbare juxta verbum Domini, et posui circa lumbos meos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:3
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me secundo, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:4
verses.text: Tolle lumbare quod possedisti, quod est circa lumbos tuos : et surgens vade ad Euphraten, et absconde ibi illud in foramine petræ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:5
verses.text: Et abii, et abscondi illud in Euphrate, sicut præceperat mihi Dominus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:6
verses.text: Et factum est post dies plurimos, dixit Dominus ad me : Surge, vade ad Euphraten, et tolle inde lumbare quod præcepi tibi ut absconderes illud ibi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:7
verses.text: Et abii ad Euphraten, et fodi, et tuli lumbare de loco ubi absconderam illud : et ecce computruerat lumbare, ita ut nulli usui aptum esset.

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:8
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen23786" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9087"/><lg sID="gen23787"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9087"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23789"/>Sic putrescere faciam superbiam Juda, <l eID="gen23789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23790"/>et superbiam Jerusalem multam : <l eID="gen23790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9088"/><l level="1" sID="gen23791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9088"/>populum istum pessimum qui nolunt audire verba mea, <l eID="gen23791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23792"/>et ambulant in pravitate cordis sui, <l eID="gen23792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23793"/>abieruntque post deos alienos ut servirent eis et adorarent eos : <l eID="gen23793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23794"/>et erunt sicut lumbare istud, <l eID="gen23794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23795"/>quod nulli usui aptum est. <l eID="gen23795" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9089"/><l level="1" sID="gen23796"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9089"/>Sicut enim adhæret lumbare ad lumbos viri, <l eID="gen23796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23797"/>sic agglutinavi mihi omnem domum Israël, <l eID="gen23797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23798"/>et omnem domum Juda, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen23798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23799"/>ut essent mihi in populum, <l eID="gen23799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23800"/>et in nomen, et in laudem, et in gloriam : <l eID="gen23800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23801"/>et non audierunt. <l eID="gen23801" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen23787"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9090"/><div sID="gen23802" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9090"/>Dices ergo ad eos sermonem istum : <div eID="gen23802" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23803"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23804"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : <l eID="gen23804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23805"/>Omnis laguncula implebitur vino. Et dicent ad te : <l eID="gen23805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23806"/>Numquid ignoramus quia omnis laguncula implebitur vino ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:13
verses.text: Et dices ad eos : <l eID="gen23806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23807"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23808"/>Ecce ego implebo omnes habitatores terræ hujus, <l eID="gen23808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23809"/>et reges qui sedent de stirpe David super thronum ejus, <l eID="gen23809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23810"/>et sacerdotes, et prophetas, <l eID="gen23810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23811"/>et omnes habitatores Jerusalem, ebrietate. <l eID="gen23811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9091"/><l level="1" sID="gen23812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9091"/>Et dispergam eos virum a fratre suo, <l eID="gen23812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23813"/>et patres et filios pariter, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen23813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23814"/>Non parcam, et non concedam : <l eID="gen23814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23815"/>neque miserebor, ut non disperdam eos. <l eID="gen23815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9092"/><l level="1" sID="gen23816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9092"/>Audite, et auribus percipite : <l eID="gen23816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23817"/>nolite elevari, quia Dominus locutus est. <l eID="gen23817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9093"/><l level="1" sID="gen23818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9093"/>Date Domino Deo vestro gloriam <l eID="gen23818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23819"/>antequam contenebrescat, <l eID="gen23819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23820"/>et antequam offendant pedes vestri ad montes caliginosos : <l eID="gen23820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23821"/>exspectabitis lucem, <l eID="gen23821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23822"/>et ponet eam in umbram mortis, et in caliginem. <l eID="gen23822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9094"/><l level="1" sID="gen23823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9094"/>Quod si hoc non audieritis, <l eID="gen23823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23824"/>in abscondito plorabit anima mea a facie superbiæ : <l eID="gen23824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23825"/>plorans plorabit, <l eID="gen23825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23826"/>et deducet oculus meus lacrimam, <l eID="gen23826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23827"/>quia captus est grex Domini. <l eID="gen23827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9095"/><l level="1" sID="gen23828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9095"/>Dic regi et dominatrici : <l eID="gen23828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23829"/>Humiliamini, sedete, <l eID="gen23829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23830"/>quoniam descendit de capite vestro corona gloriæ vestræ. <l eID="gen23830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9096"/><l level="1" sID="gen23831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9096"/>Civitates austri clausæ sunt, <l eID="gen23831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23832"/>et non est qui aperiat : <l eID="gen23832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23833"/>translata est omnis Juda transmigratione perfecta. <l eID="gen23833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9097"/><l level="1" sID="gen23834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9097"/>Levate oculos vestros et videte, <l eID="gen23834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23835"/>qui venitis ab aquilone : <l eID="gen23835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23836"/>ubi est grex qui datus est tibi, <l eID="gen23836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23837"/>pecus inclytum tuum ? <l eID="gen23837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9098"/><l level="1" sID="gen23838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9098"/>Quid dices cum visitaverit te ? <l eID="gen23838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23839"/>tu enim docuisti eos adversum te, <l eID="gen23839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23840"/>et erudisti in caput tuum. <l eID="gen23840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23841"/>Numquid non dolores apprehendent te, <l eID="gen23841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23842"/>quasi mulierem parturientem ? <l eID="gen23842" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9099"/><l level="1" sID="gen23843"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9099"/>Quod si dixeris in corde tuo : Quare venerunt mihi hæc ? <l eID="gen23843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23844"/>propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ <l eID="gen23844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23845"/>revelata sunt verecundiora tua, <l eID="gen23845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23846"/>pollutæ sunt plantæ tuæ. <l eID="gen23846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9100"/><l level="1" sID="gen23847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9100"/>Si mutare potest Æthiops pellem suam, <l eID="gen23847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23848"/>aut pardus varietates suas, <l eID="gen23848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23849"/>et vos poteritis benefacere, <l eID="gen23849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23850"/>cum didiceritis malum. <l eID="gen23850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9101"/><l level="1" sID="gen23851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9101"/>Et disseminabo eos quasi stipulam <l eID="gen23851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23852"/>quæ vento raptatur in deserto. <l eID="gen23852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9102"/><l level="1" sID="gen23853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9102"/>Hæc sors tua, <l eID="gen23853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23854"/>parsque mensuræ tuæ a me, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen23854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23855"/>quia oblita es mei, <l eID="gen23855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23856"/>et confisa es in mendacio. <l eID="gen23856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9103"/><l level="1" sID="gen23857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9103"/>Unde et ego nudavi femora tua contra faciem tuam, <l eID="gen23857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23858"/>et apparuit ignominia tua : <l eID="gen23858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 13:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9104"/><l level="1" sID="gen23859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9104"/>adulteria tua, et hinnitus tuus, <l eID="gen23859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23860"/>scelus fornicationis tuæ : <l eID="gen23860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23861"/>super colles in agro vidi abominationes tuas. <l eID="gen23861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23862"/>Væ tibi, Jerusalem ! <l eID="gen23862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23863"/>non mundaberis post me : usquequo adhuc ? <l eID="gen23863" level="1"/><lg eID="gen23803"/> <chapter eID="Jer.13"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:1
verses.text: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, de sermonibus siccitatis.  <div eID="gen23864" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9105"/><lg sID="gen23865"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9105"/>Luxit Judæa, et portæ ejus corruerunt, <l eID="gen23866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23867"/>et obscuratæ sunt in terra, <l eID="gen23867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23868"/>et clamor Jerusalem ascendit. <l eID="gen23868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9106"/><l level="1" sID="gen23869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9106"/>Majores miserunt minores suos ad aquam : <l eID="gen23869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23870"/>venerunt ad hauriendum. <l eID="gen23870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23871"/>Non invenerunt aquam : <l eID="gen23871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23872"/>reportaverunt vasa sua vacua. <l eID="gen23872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23873"/>Confusi sunt, et afflicti, <l eID="gen23873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23874"/>et operuerunt capita sua. <l eID="gen23874" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9107"/><l level="1" sID="gen23875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9107"/>Propter terræ vastitatem, <l eID="gen23875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23876"/>quia non venit pluvia in terram, <l eID="gen23876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23877"/>confusi sunt agricolæ : <l eID="gen23877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23878"/>operuerunt capita sua. <l eID="gen23878" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9108"/><l level="1" sID="gen23879"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9108"/>Nam et cerva in agro peperit, et reliquit, <l eID="gen23879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23880"/>quia non erat herba. <l eID="gen23880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9109"/><l level="1" sID="gen23881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9109"/>Et onagri steterunt in rupibus ; <l eID="gen23881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23882"/>traxerunt ventum quasi dracones : <l eID="gen23882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23883"/>defecerunt oculi eorum, <l eID="gen23883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23884"/>quia non erat herba. <l eID="gen23884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9110"/><l level="1" sID="gen23885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9110"/>Si iniquitates nostræ responderint nobis, Domine, <l eID="gen23885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23886"/>fac propter nomen tuum : <l eID="gen23886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23887"/>quoniam multæ sunt aversiones nostræ : <l eID="gen23887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23888"/>tibi peccavimus. <l eID="gen23888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9111"/><l level="1" sID="gen23889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9111"/>Exspectatio Israël, <l eID="gen23889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23890"/>salvator ejus in tempore tribulationis, <l eID="gen23890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23891"/>quare quasi colonus futurus es in terra, <l eID="gen23891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23892"/>et quasi viator declinans ad manendum ? <l eID="gen23892" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9112"/><l level="1" sID="gen23893"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9112"/>quare futurus es velut vir vagus, <l eID="gen23893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23894"/>ut fortis qui non potest salvare ? <l eID="gen23894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23895"/>Tu autem in nobis es, Domine, <l eID="gen23895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23896"/>et nomen tuum invocatum est super nos : <l eID="gen23896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23897"/>ne derelinquas nos. <l eID="gen23897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9113"/><l level="1" sID="gen23898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9113"/>Hæc dicit Dominus populo huic, <l eID="gen23898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23899"/>qui dilexit movere pedes suos, <l eID="gen23899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23900"/>et non quievit, <l eID="gen23900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23901"/>et Domino non placuit : <l eID="gen23901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23902"/>Nunc recordabitur iniquitatum eorum, <l eID="gen23902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23903"/>et visitabit peccata eorum. <l eID="gen23903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9114"/><l level="1" sID="gen23904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9114"/>Et dixit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen23904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23905"/>Noli orare pro populo isto in bonum. <l eID="gen23905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9115"/><l level="1" sID="gen23906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9115"/>Cum jejunaverint, <l eID="gen23906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23907"/>non exaudiam preces eorum, <l eID="gen23907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23908"/>et si obtulerint holocautomata et victimas, <l eID="gen23908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23909"/>non suscipiam ea : <l eID="gen23909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23910"/>quoniam gladio, et fame, et peste consumam eos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:13
verses.text: Et dixi : <l eID="gen23910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23911"/>A, a, a, Domine Deus : <l eID="gen23911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23912"/>prophetæ dicunt eis : <l eID="gen23912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23913"/>Non videbitis gladium, <l eID="gen23913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23914"/>et fames non erit in vobis : <l eID="gen23914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23915"/>sed pacem veram dabit vobis in loco isto.

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:14
verses.text: Et dicit Dominus ad me : <l eID="gen23915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23916"/>Falso prophetæ vaticinantur in nomine meo : <l eID="gen23916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23917"/>non misi eos, et non præcepi eis, <l eID="gen23917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23918"/>neque locutus sum ad eos. <l eID="gen23918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23919"/>Visionem mendacem, et divinationem, <l eID="gen23919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23920"/>et fraudulentiam, et seductionem cordis sui, <l eID="gen23920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23921"/>prophetant vobis. <l eID="gen23921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:15
