verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9116"/><l level="1" sID="gen23922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9116"/>Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus <l eID="gen23922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23923"/>de prophetis qui prophetant in nomine meo, <l eID="gen23923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23924"/>quos ego non misi, dicentes : <l eID="gen23924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23925"/>Gladius et fames non erit in terra hac : <l eID="gen23925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23926"/>In gladio et fame consumentur prophetæ illi. <l eID="gen23926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9117"/><l level="1" sID="gen23927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9117"/>Et populi quibus prophetant <l eID="gen23927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23928"/>erunt projecti in viis Jerusalem <l eID="gen23928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23929"/>præ fame et gladio, <l eID="gen23929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23930"/>et non erit qui sepeliat eos : <l eID="gen23930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23931"/>ipsi et uxores eorum, <l eID="gen23931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23932"/>filii et filiæ eorum : <l eID="gen23932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23933"/>et effundam super eos malum suum. <l eID="gen23933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9118"/><l level="1" sID="gen23934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9118"/>Et dices ad eos verbum istud : <l eID="gen23934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23935"/>Deducant oculi mei lacrimam per noctem et diem, <l eID="gen23935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23936"/>et non taceant, <l eID="gen23936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23937"/>quoniam contritione magna <l eID="gen23937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23938"/>contrita est virgo filia populi mei, <l eID="gen23938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23939"/>plaga pessima vehementer. <l eID="gen23939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9119"/><l level="1" sID="gen23940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9119"/>Si egressus fuero ad agros, <l eID="gen23940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23941"/>ecce occisi gladio : <l eID="gen23941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23942"/>et si introiero in civitatem, <l eID="gen23942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23943"/>ecce attenuati fame. <l eID="gen23943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23944"/>Propheta quoque et sacerdos abierunt in terram quam ignorabant. <l eID="gen23944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9120"/><l level="1" sID="gen23945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9120"/>Numquid projiciens abjecisti Judam ? <l eID="gen23945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23946"/>aut Sion abominata est anima tua ? <l eID="gen23946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23947"/>quare ergo percussisti nos ita ut nulla sit sanitas ? <l eID="gen23947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23948"/>Exspectavimus pacem, <l eID="gen23948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23949"/>et non est bonum : <l eID="gen23949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23950"/>et tempus curationis, <l eID="gen23950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23951"/>et ecce turbatio. <l eID="gen23951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9121"/><l level="1" sID="gen23952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9121"/>Cognovimus, Domine, impietates nostras, <l eID="gen23952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23953"/>iniquitates patrum nostrorum, <l eID="gen23953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23954"/>quia peccavimus tibi. <l eID="gen23954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9122"/><l level="1" sID="gen23955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9122"/>Ne des nos in opprobrium, propter nomen tuum, <l eID="gen23955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23956"/>neque facias nobis contumeliam solii gloriæ tuæ : <l eID="gen23956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23957"/>recordare, ne irritum facias fœdus tuum nobiscum. <l eID="gen23957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9123"/><l level="1" sID="gen23958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9123"/>Numquid sunt in sculptilibus gentium qui pluant ? <l eID="gen23958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23959"/>aut cæli possunt dare imbres ? <l eID="gen23959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23960"/>nonne tu es Dominus Deus noster, quem exspectavimus ? <l eID="gen23960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23961"/>tu enim fecisti omnia hæc. <l eID="gen23961" level="1"/><lg eID="gen23865"/> <chapter eID="Jer.14"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:1
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : <div eID="gen23962" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen23963"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23964"/>Si steterit Moyses et Samuel coram me, <l eID="gen23964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23965"/>non est anima mea ad populum istum : <l eID="gen23965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23966"/>ejice illos a facie mea, et egrediantur. <l eID="gen23966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9124"/><l level="1" sID="gen23967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9124"/>Quod si dixerint ad te : Quo egrediemur ? <l eID="gen23967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23968"/>dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23969"/>Qui ad mortem, ad mortem, <l eID="gen23969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23970"/>et qui ad gladium, ad gladium, <l eID="gen23970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23971"/>et qui ad famem, ad famem, <l eID="gen23971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23972"/>et qui ad captivitatem, ad captivitatem. <l eID="gen23972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9125"/><l level="1" sID="gen23973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9125"/>Et visitabo super eos quatuor species, dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen23973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23974"/>gladium ad occisionem, <l eID="gen23974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23975"/>et canes ad lacerandum, <l eID="gen23975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23976"/>et volatilia cæli et bestias terræ <l eID="gen23976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23977"/>ad devorandum et dissipandum. <l eID="gen23977" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9126"/><l level="1" sID="gen23978"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9126"/>Et dabo eos in fervorem universis regnis terræ, <l eID="gen23978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23979"/>propter Manassen filium Ezechiæ regis Juda, <l eID="gen23979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23980"/>super omnibus quæ fecit in Jerusalem. <l eID="gen23980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9127"/><l level="1" sID="gen23981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9127"/>Quis enim miserebitur tui, Jerusalem, <l eID="gen23981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23982"/>aut quis contristabitur pro te ? <l eID="gen23982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23983"/>aut quis ibit ad rogandum pro pace tua ? <l eID="gen23983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9128"/><l level="1" sID="gen23984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9128"/>Tu reliquisti me, dicit Dominus ; <l eID="gen23984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23985"/>retrorsum abiisti : <l eID="gen23985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23986"/>et extendam manum meam super te, et interficiam te : <l eID="gen23986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23987"/>laboravi rogans. <l eID="gen23987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9129"/><l level="1" sID="gen23988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9129"/>Et dispergam eos ventilabro in portis terræ : <l eID="gen23988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23989"/>interfeci et disperdidi populum meum, <l eID="gen23989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23990"/>et tamen a viis suis non sunt reversi. <l eID="gen23990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9130"/><l level="1" sID="gen23991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9130"/>Multiplicatæ sunt mihi viduæ ejus super arenam maris : <l eID="gen23991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23992"/>induxi eis super matrem adolescentis vastatorem meridie : <l eID="gen23992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23993"/>misi super civitates repente terrorem. <l eID="gen23993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9131"/><l level="1" sID="gen23994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9131"/>Infirmata est quæ peperit septem ; <l eID="gen23994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23995"/>defecit anima ejus : <l eID="gen23995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23996"/>occidit ei sol cum adhuc esset dies : <l eID="gen23996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23997"/>confusa est, et erubuit : <l eID="gen23997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23998"/>et residuos ejus in gladium dabo <l eID="gen23998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen23999"/>in conspectu inimicorum eorum, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen23999" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9132"/><l level="1" sID="gen24000"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9132"/>Væ mihi, mater mea ! quare genuisti me, <l eID="gen24000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24001"/>virum rixæ, virum discordiæ in universa terra ? <l eID="gen24001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24002"/>Non fœneravi, nec fœneravit mihi quisquam : <l eID="gen24002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24003"/>omnes maledicunt mihi. <l eID="gen24003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9133"/><l level="1" sID="gen24004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9133"/>Dicit Dominus : Si non reliquiæ tuæ in bonum, <l eID="gen24004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24005"/>si non occurri tibi in tempore afflictionis, <l eID="gen24005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24006"/>et in tempore tribulationis adversus inimicum. <l eID="gen24006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9134"/><l level="1" sID="gen24007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9134"/>Numquid fœderabitur ferrum ferro ab aquilone, et æs ? <l eID="gen24007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9135"/><l level="1" sID="gen24008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9135"/>Divitias tuas et thesauros tuos in direptionem dabo gratis, <l eID="gen24008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24009"/>in omnibus peccatis tuis, et in omnibus terminis tuis. <l eID="gen24009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9136"/><l level="1" sID="gen24010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9136"/>Et adducam inimicos tuos de terra quam nescis, <l eID="gen24010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24011"/>quia ignis succensus est in furore meo : <l eID="gen24011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24012"/>super vos ardebit. <l eID="gen24012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9137"/><l level="1" sID="gen24013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9137"/>Tu scis, Domine : recordare mei, et visita me, <l eID="gen24013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24014"/>et tuere me ab his qui persequuntur me. <l eID="gen24014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24015"/>Noli in patientia tua suscipere me : <l eID="gen24015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24016"/>scito quoniam sustinui propter te opprobrium. <l eID="gen24016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9138"/><l level="1" sID="gen24017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9138"/>Inventi sunt sermones tui, et comedi eos : <l eID="gen24017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24018"/>et factum est mihi verbum tuum in gaudium <l eID="gen24018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24019"/>et in lætitiam cordis mei, <l eID="gen24019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24020"/>quoniam invocatum est nomen tuum super me, <l eID="gen24020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24021"/>Domine Deus exercituum. <l eID="gen24021" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9139"/><l level="1" sID="gen24022"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9139"/>Non sedi in concilio ludentium, <l eID="gen24022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24023"/>et gloriatus sum a facie manus tuæ : <l eID="gen24023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24024"/>solus sedebam, quoniam comminatione replesti me. <l eID="gen24024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9140"/><l level="1" sID="gen24025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9140"/>Quare factus est dolor meus perpetuus, <l eID="gen24025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24026"/>et plaga mea desperabilis renuit curari ? <l eID="gen24026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24027"/>facta est mihi quasi mendacium aquarum infidelium. <l eID="gen24027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9141"/><l level="1" sID="gen24028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9141"/>Propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24029"/>Si converteris, convertam te, <l eID="gen24029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24030"/>et ante faciem meam stabis : <l eID="gen24030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24031"/>et si separaveris pretiosum a vili, <l eID="gen24031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24032"/>quasi os meum eris : <l eID="gen24032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24033"/>convertentur ipsi ad te, <l eID="gen24033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24034"/>et tu non converteris ad eos. <l eID="gen24034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9142"/><l level="1" sID="gen24035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9142"/>Et dabo te populo huic in murum æreum fortem : <l eID="gen24035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24036"/>et bellabunt adversum te, et non prævalebunt, <l eID="gen24036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24037"/>quia ego tecum sum ut salvem te, et eruam te, dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24037" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 15:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9143"/><l level="1" sID="gen24038"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9143"/>et liberabo te de manu pessimorum, <l eID="gen24038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24039"/>et redimam te de manu fortium. <l eID="gen24039" level="1"/><lg eID="gen23963"/> <chapter eID="Jer.15"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen24040" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9144"/><lg sID="gen24041"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9144"/>Non accipies uxorem, <l eID="gen24042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24043"/>et non erunt tibi filii et filiæ in loco isto. <l eID="gen24043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9145"/><l level="1" sID="gen24044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9145"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus <l eID="gen24044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24045"/>super filios et filias qui generantur in loco isto, <l eID="gen24045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24046"/>et super matres eorum, quæ genuerunt eos, <l eID="gen24046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24047"/>et super patres eorum, de quorum stirpe sunt nati in terra hac : <l eID="gen24047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9146"/><l level="1" sID="gen24048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9146"/>Mortibus ægrotationum morientur : <l eID="gen24048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24049"/>non plangentur, et non sepelientur : <l eID="gen24049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24050"/>in sterquilinium super faciem terræ erunt, <l eID="gen24050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24051"/>et gladio et fame consumentur : <l eID="gen24051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24052"/>et erit cadaver eorum in escam volatilibus cæli et bestiis terræ. <l eID="gen24052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9147"/><l level="1" sID="gen24053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9147"/>Hæc enim dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24054"/>Ne ingrediaris domum convivii, <l eID="gen24054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24055"/>neque vadas ad plangendum, <l eID="gen24055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24056"/>neque consoleris eos, <l eID="gen24056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24057"/>quia abstuli pacem meam a populo isto, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24058"/>misericordiam et miserationes. <l eID="gen24058" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9148"/><l level="1" sID="gen24059"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9148"/>Et morientur grandes et parvi in terra ista : <l eID="gen24059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24060"/>non sepelientur, neque plangentur, <l eID="gen24060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24061"/>et non se incident, <l eID="gen24061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24062"/>neque calvitium fiet pro eis. <l eID="gen24062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9149"/><l level="1" sID="gen24063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9149"/>Et non frangent inter eos lugenti panem <l eID="gen24063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24064"/>ad consolandum super mortuo, <l eID="gen24064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24065"/>et non dabunt eis potum calicis <l eID="gen24065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24066"/>ad consolandum super patre suo et matre. <l eID="gen24066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9150"/><l level="1" sID="gen24067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9150"/>Et domum convivii non ingrediaris, <l eID="gen24067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24068"/>ut sedeas cum eis, et comedas, et bibas. <l eID="gen24068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9151"/><l level="1" sID="gen24069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9151"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen24069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24070"/>Ecce ego auferam de loco isto, <l eID="gen24070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24071"/>in oculis vestris, et in diebus vestris, <l eID="gen24071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24072"/>vocem gaudii et vocem lætitiæ, <l eID="gen24072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24073"/>vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ. <l eID="gen24073" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9152"/><l level="1" sID="gen24074"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9152"/>Et cum annuntiaveris populo huic omnia verba hæc, <l eID="gen24074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24075"/>et dixerint tibi : <l eID="gen24075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24076"/>Quare locutus est Dominus super nos omne malum grande istud ? <l eID="gen24076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24077"/>quæ iniquitas nostra, <l eID="gen24077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24078"/>et quod peccatum nostrum, <l eID="gen24078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24079"/>quod peccavimus Domino Deo nostro ? <l eID="gen24079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9153"/><l level="1" sID="gen24080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9153"/>dices ad eos : <l eID="gen24080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24081"/>Quia dereliquerunt me patres vestri, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen24081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24082"/>et abierunt post deos alienos, <l eID="gen24082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24083"/>et servierunt eis, et adoraverunt eos, <l eID="gen24083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24084"/>et me dereliquerunt, et legem meam non custodierunt. <l eID="gen24084" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9154"/><l level="1" sID="gen24085"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9154"/>Sed et vos pejus operati estis quam patres vestri : <l eID="gen24085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24086"/>ecce enim ambulat unusquisque post pravitatem cordis sui mali, <l eID="gen24086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24087"/>ut me non audiat. <l eID="gen24087" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9155"/><l level="1" sID="gen24088"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9155"/>Et ejiciam vos de terra hac <l eID="gen24088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24089"/>in terram quam ignoratis, <l eID="gen24089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24090"/>vos et patres vestri : <l eID="gen24090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24091"/>et servietis ibi diis alienis, die ac nocte, <l eID="gen24091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24092"/>qui non dabunt vobis requiem. <l eID="gen24092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9156"/><l level="1" sID="gen24093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9156"/>Propterea ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24094"/>et non dicetur ultra : <l eID="gen24094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24095"/>Vivit Dominus qui eduxit filios Israël de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen24095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9157"/><l level="1" sID="gen24096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9157"/>sed : Vivit Dominus qui eduxit filios Israël de terra aquilonis, <l eID="gen24096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24097"/>et de universis terris ad quas ejeci eos : <l eID="gen24097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24098"/>et reducam eos in terram suam, <l eID="gen24098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24099"/>quam dedi patribus eorum. <l eID="gen24099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9158"/><l level="1" sID="gen24100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9158"/>Ecce ego mittam piscatores multos, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24101"/>et piscabuntur eos : <l eID="gen24101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24102"/>et post hæc mittam eis multos venatores, <l eID="gen24102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24103"/>et venabuntur eos de omni monte, <l eID="gen24103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24104"/>et de omni colle, et de cavernis petrarum. <l eID="gen24104" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9159"/><l level="1" sID="gen24105"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9159"/>Quia oculi mei super omnes vias eorum : <l eID="gen24105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24106"/>non sunt absconditæ a facie mea, <l eID="gen24106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24107"/>et non fuit occultata iniquitas eorum ab oculis meis. <l eID="gen24107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9160"/><l level="1" sID="gen24108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9160"/>Et reddam primum duplices iniquitates et peccata eorum, <l eID="gen24108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24109"/>quia contaminaverunt terram meam in morticinis idolorum suorum, <l eID="gen24109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24110"/>et abominationibus suis impleverunt hæreditatem meam. <l eID="gen24110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9161"/><l level="1" sID="gen24111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9161"/>Domine, fortitudo mea, et robur meum, <l eID="gen24111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24112"/>et refugium meum in die tribulationis, <l eID="gen24112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24113"/>ad te gentes venient ab extremis terræ, et dicent : <l eID="gen24113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24114"/>Vere mendacium possederunt patres nostri, <l eID="gen24114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24115"/>vanitatem quæ eis non profuit. <l eID="gen24115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9162"/><l level="1" sID="gen24116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9162"/>Numquid faciet sibi homo deos, <l eID="gen24116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24117"/>et ipsi non sunt dii ? <l eID="gen24117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 16:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9163"/><l level="1" sID="gen24118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9163"/>Idcirco ecce ego ostendam eis per vicem hanc, <l eID="gen24118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24119"/>ostendam eis manum meam, et virtutem meam, <l eID="gen24119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24120"/>et scient quia nomen mihi Dominus.  <chapter eID="Jer.16"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:1
verses.text: Peccatum Juda scriptum est stylo ferreo <l eID="gen24121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24122"/>in ungue adamantino, <l eID="gen24122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24123"/>exaratum super latitudinem cordis eorum, <l eID="gen24123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24124"/>et in cornibus ararum eorum. <l eID="gen24124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9164"/><l level="1" sID="gen24125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9164"/>Cum recordati fuerint filii eorum ararum suarum, <l eID="gen24125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24126"/>et lucorum suorum, <l eID="gen24126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24127"/>lignorumque frondentium, <l eID="gen24127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24128"/>in montibus excelsis, <l eID="gen24128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9165"/><l level="1" sID="gen24129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9165"/>sacrificantes in agro : <l eID="gen24129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24130"/>fortitudinem tuam, et omnes thesauros tuos in direptionem dabo ; <l eID="gen24130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24131"/>excelsa tua propter peccata in universis finibus tuis. <l eID="gen24131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9166"/><l level="1" sID="gen24132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9166"/>Et relinqueris sola ab hæreditate tua, quam dedi tibi, <l eID="gen24132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24133"/>et servire te faciam inimicis tuis in terra quam ignoras : <l eID="gen24133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24134"/>quoniam ignem succendisti in furore meo : <l eID="gen24134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24135"/>usque in æternum ardebit. <l eID="gen24135" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9167"/><l level="1" sID="gen24136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9167"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24137"/>Maledictus homo qui confidit in homine, <l eID="gen24137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24138"/>et ponit carnem brachium suum, <l eID="gen24138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24139"/>et a Domino recedit cor ejus. <l eID="gen24139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9168"/><l level="1" sID="gen24140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9168"/>Erit enim quasi myricæ in deserto, <l eID="gen24140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24141"/>et non videbit cum venerit bonum : <l eID="gen24141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24142"/>sed habitabit in siccitate in deserto, <l eID="gen24142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24143"/>in terra salsuginis et inhabitabili. <l eID="gen24143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9169"/><l level="1" sID="gen24144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9169"/>Benedictus vir qui confidit in Domino, <l eID="gen24144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24145"/>et erit Dominus fiducia ejus. <l eID="gen24145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9170"/><l level="1" sID="gen24146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9170"/>Et erit quasi lignum quod transplantatur super aquas, <l eID="gen24146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24147"/>quod ad humorem mittit radices suas, <l eID="gen24147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24148"/>et non timebit cum venerit æstus : <l eID="gen24148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24149"/>et erit folium ejus viride, <l eID="gen24149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24150"/>et in tempore siccitatis non erit sollicitum, <l eID="gen24150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24151"/>nec aliquando desinet facere fructum. <l eID="gen24151" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9171"/><l level="1" sID="gen24152"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9171"/>Pravum est cor omnium, et inscrutabile : <l eID="gen24152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24153"/>quis cognoscet illud ? <l eID="gen24153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9172"/><l level="1" sID="gen24154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9172"/>Ego Dominus scrutans cor, <l eID="gen24154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24155"/>et probans renes : <l eID="gen24155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24156"/>qui do unicuique juxta viam suam, <l eID="gen24156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24157"/>et juxta fructum adinventionum suarum. <l eID="gen24157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9173"/><l level="1" sID="gen24158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9173"/>Perdix fovit quæ non peperit : <l eID="gen24158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24159"/>fecit divitias, et non in judicio : <l eID="gen24159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24160"/>in dimidio dierum suorum derelinquet eas, <l eID="gen24160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24161"/>et in novissimo suo erit insipiens. <l eID="gen24161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9174"/><l level="1" sID="gen24162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9174"/>Solium gloriæ altitudinis a principio, <l eID="gen24162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24163"/>locus sanctificationis nostræ. <l eID="gen24163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9175"/><l level="1" sID="gen24164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9175"/>Exspectatio Israël, Domine, <l eID="gen24164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24165"/>omnes qui te derelinquunt confundentur : <l eID="gen24165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24166"/>recedentes a te, in terra scribentur, <l eID="gen24166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24167"/>quoniam dereliquerunt venam aquarum viventium Dominum. <l eID="gen24167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9176"/><l level="1" sID="gen24168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9176"/>Sana me, Domine, et sanabor : <l eID="gen24168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24169"/>salvum me fac, et salvus ero : <l eID="gen24169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24170"/>quoniam laus mea tu es. <l eID="gen24170" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9177"/><l level="1" sID="gen24171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9177"/>Ecce ipsi dicunt ad me : <l eID="gen24171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24172"/>Ubi est verbum Domini ? veniat : <l eID="gen24172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9178"/><l level="1" sID="gen24173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9178"/>et ego non sum turbatus, te pastorem sequens : <l eID="gen24173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24174"/>et diem hominis non desideravi, tu scis : <l eID="gen24174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24175"/>quod egressum est de labiis meis, rectum in conspectu tuo fuit. <l eID="gen24175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9179"/><l level="1" sID="gen24176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9179"/>Non sis tu mihi formidini : <l eID="gen24176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24177"/>spes mea tu in die afflictionis. <l eID="gen24177" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9180"/><l level="1" sID="gen24178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9180"/>Confundantur qui me persequuntur, <l eID="gen24178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24179"/>et non confundar ego : <l eID="gen24179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24180"/>paveant illi, <l eID="gen24180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24181"/>et non paveam ego : <l eID="gen24181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24182"/>induc super eos diem afflictionis, <l eID="gen24182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24183"/>et duplici contritione contere eos. <l eID="gen24183" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen24041"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9181"/><div sID="gen24184" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9181"/>Hæc dicit Dominus ad me : Vade, et sta in porta filiorum populi, per quam ingrediuntur reges Juda, et egrediuntur, et in cunctis portis Jerusalem :

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:20
verses.text: et dices ad eos : <div eID="gen24184" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24185"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24186"/>Audite verbum Domini, <l eID="gen24186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24187"/>reges Juda, et omnis Juda, <l eID="gen24187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24188"/>cunctique habitatores Jerusalem, <l eID="gen24188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24189"/>qui ingredimini per portas istas. <l eID="gen24189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9182"/><l level="1" sID="gen24190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9182"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24191"/>Custodite animas vestras, <l eID="gen24191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24192"/>et nolite portare pondera in die sabbati, <l eID="gen24192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24193"/>nec inferatis per portas Jerusalem : <l eID="gen24193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9183"/><l level="1" sID="gen24194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9183"/>et nolite ejicere onera de domibus vestris in die sabbati, <l eID="gen24194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24195"/>et omne opus non facietis : <l eID="gen24195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24196"/>sanctificate diem sabbati, <l eID="gen24196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24197"/>sicut præcepi patribus vestris. <l eID="gen24197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9184"/><l level="1" sID="gen24198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9184"/>Et non audierunt, nec inclinaverunt aurem suam : <l eID="gen24198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24199"/>sed induraverunt cervicem suam, ne audirent me, <l eID="gen24199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24200"/>et ne acciperent disciplinam. <l eID="gen24200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9185"/><l level="1" sID="gen24201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9185"/>Et erit : si audieritis me, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24202"/>ut non inferatis onera per portas civitatis hujus in die sabbati : <l eID="gen24202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24203"/>et si sanctificaveritis diem sabbati, <l eID="gen24203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24204"/>ne faciatis in eo omne opus : <l eID="gen24204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9186"/><l level="1" sID="gen24205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9186"/>ingredientur per portas civitatis hujus reges et principes, <l eID="gen24205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24206"/>sedentes super solium David, <l eID="gen24206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24207"/>et ascendentes in curribus et equis, <l eID="gen24207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24208"/>ipsi et principes eorum, <l eID="gen24208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24209"/>viri Juda, et habitatores Jerusalem : <l eID="gen24209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24210"/>et habitabitur civitas hæc in sempiternum. <l eID="gen24210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9187"/><l level="1" sID="gen24211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9187"/>Et venient de civitatibus Juda, <l eID="gen24211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24212"/>et de circuitu Jerusalem, <l eID="gen24212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24213"/>et de terra Benjamin, <l eID="gen24213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24214"/>et de campestribus, et de montuosis, et ab austro, <l eID="gen24214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24215"/>portantes holocaustum, et victimam, <l eID="gen24215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24216"/>et sacrificium, et thus, <l eID="gen24216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24217"/>et inferent oblationem in domum Domini. <l eID="gen24217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 17:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9188"/><l level="1" sID="gen24218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9188"/>Si autem non audieritis me <l eID="gen24218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24219"/>ut sanctificetis diem sabbati, <l eID="gen24219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24220"/>et ne portetis onus, <l eID="gen24220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24221"/>et ne inferatis per portas Jerusalem in die sabbati, <l eID="gen24221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24222"/>succendam ignem in portis ejus, <l eID="gen24222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24223"/>et devorabit domos Jerusalem, <l eID="gen24223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24224"/>et non extinguetur. <l eID="gen24224" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24185"/> <chapter eID="Jer.17"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:2
verses.text: Surge, et descende in domum figuli, et ibi audies verba mea.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:3
verses.text: Et descendi in domum figuli, et ecce ipse faciebat opus super rotam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:4
verses.text: Et dissipatum est vas quod ipse faciebat e luto manibus suis : conversusque fecit illud vas alterum, sicut placuerat in oculis ejus ut faceret.

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:5
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen24225" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9189"/><lg sID="gen24226"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9189"/>Numquid sicut figulus iste, <l eID="gen24227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24228"/>non potero vobis facere, domus Israël ? ait Dominus : <l eID="gen24228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24229"/>ecce sicut lutum in manu figuli, <l eID="gen24229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24230"/>sic vos in manu mea, domus Israël. <l eID="gen24230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9190"/><l level="1" sID="gen24231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9190"/>Repente loquar adversum gentem et adversus regnum, <l eID="gen24231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24232"/>ut eradicem, et destruam, et disperdam illud : <l eID="gen24232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9191"/><l level="1" sID="gen24233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9191"/>si pœnitentiam egerit gens illa a malo suo <l eID="gen24233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24234"/>quod locutus sum adversus eam, <l eID="gen24234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24235"/>agam et ego pœnitentiam super malo <l eID="gen24235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24236"/>quod cogitavi ut facerem ei. <l eID="gen24236" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9192"/><l level="1" sID="gen24237"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9192"/>Et subito loquar de gente et de regno, <l eID="gen24237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24238"/>ut ædificem et plantem illud. <l eID="gen24238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9193"/><l level="1" sID="gen24239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9193"/>Si fecerit malum in oculis meis, <l eID="gen24239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24240"/>ut non audiat vocem meam, <l eID="gen24240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24241"/>pœnitentiam agam super bono quod locutus sum ut facerem ei. <l eID="gen24241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9194"/><l level="1" sID="gen24242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9194"/>Nunc ergo dic viro Juda, et habitatoribus Jerusalem, dicens : <l eID="gen24242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24243"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24244"/>Ecce ego fingo contra vos malum, <l eID="gen24244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24245"/>et cogito contra vos cogitationem : <l eID="gen24245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24246"/>revertatur unusquisque a via sua mala, <l eID="gen24246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24247"/>et dirigite vias vestras et studia vestra. <l eID="gen24247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9195"/><l level="1" sID="gen24248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9195"/>Qui dixerunt : Desperavimus : <l eID="gen24248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24249"/>post cogitationes enim nostras ibimus, <l eID="gen24249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24250"/>et unusquisque pravitatem cordis sui mali faciemus. <l eID="gen24250" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9196"/><l level="1" sID="gen24251"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9196"/>Ideo hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24252"/>Interrogate gentes : <l eID="gen24252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24253"/>Quis audivit talia horribilia, <l eID="gen24253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24254"/>quæ fecit nimis virgo Israël ? <l eID="gen24254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9197"/><l level="1" sID="gen24255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9197"/>Numquid deficiet de petra agri nix Libani ? <l eID="gen24255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24256"/>aut evelli possunt aquæ erumpentes frigidæ, et defluentes ? <l eID="gen24256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9198"/><l level="1" sID="gen24257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9198"/>Quia oblitus est mei populus meus, <l eID="gen24257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24258"/>frustra libantes, <l eID="gen24258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24259"/>et impingentes in viis suis, <l eID="gen24259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24260"/>in semitis sæculi, <l eID="gen24260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24261"/>ut ambularent per eas in itinere non trito, <l eID="gen24261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9199"/><l level="1" sID="gen24262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9199"/>ut fieret terra eorum in desolationem, <l eID="gen24262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24263"/>et in sibilum sempiternum : <l eID="gen24263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24264"/>omnis qui præterierit per eam obstupescet, <l eID="gen24264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24265"/>et movebit caput suum. <l eID="gen24265" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9200"/><l level="1" sID="gen24266"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9200"/>Sicut ventus urens dispergam eos coram inimico : <l eID="gen24266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24267"/>dorsum, et non faciem, ostendam eis in die perditionis eorum. <l eID="gen24267" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen24226"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9201"/><div sID="gen24268" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9201"/>Et dixerunt : <div eID="gen24268" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24269"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24270"/>Venite, et cogitemus contra Jeremiam cogitationes : <l eID="gen24270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24271"/>non enim peribit lex a sacerdote, <l eID="gen24271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24272"/>neque consilium a sapiente, <l eID="gen24272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24273"/>nec sermo a propheta : <l eID="gen24273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24274"/>venite, et percutiamus eum lingua, <l eID="gen24274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24275"/>et non attendamus ad universos sermones ejus. <l eID="gen24275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9202"/><l level="1" sID="gen24276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9202"/>Attende, Domine, ad me, <l eID="gen24276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24277"/>et audi vocem adversariorum meorum. <l eID="gen24277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9203"/><l level="1" sID="gen24278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9203"/>Numquid redditur pro bono malum, <l eID="gen24278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24279"/>quia foderunt foveam animæ meæ ? <l eID="gen24279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24280"/>Recordare quod steterim in conspectu tuo <l eID="gen24280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24281"/>ut loquerer pro eis bonum, <l eID="gen24281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24282"/>et averterem indignationem tuam ab eis. <l eID="gen24282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9204"/><l level="1" sID="gen24283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9204"/>Propterea da filios eorum in famem, <l eID="gen24283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24284"/>et deduc eos in manus gladii : <l eID="gen24284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24285"/>fiant uxores eorum absque liberis, et viduæ : <l eID="gen24285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24286"/>et viri earum interficiantur morte : <l eID="gen24286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24287"/>juvenes eorum confodiantur gladio in prælio : <l eID="gen24287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9205"/><l level="1" sID="gen24288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9205"/>audiatur clamor de domibus eorum : <l eID="gen24288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24289"/>adduces enim super eos latronem repente, <l eID="gen24289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24290"/>quia foderunt foveam ut caperent me, <l eID="gen24290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24291"/>et laqueos absconderunt pedibus meis. <l eID="gen24291" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 18:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9206"/><l level="1" sID="gen24292"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9206"/>Tu autem, Domine, scis omne consilium eorum <l eID="gen24292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24293"/>adversum me in mortem : <l eID="gen24293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24294"/>ne propitieris iniquitati eorum, <l eID="gen24294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24295"/>et peccatum eorum a facie tua non deleatur : <l eID="gen24295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24296"/>fiant corruentes in conspectu tuo ; <l eID="gen24296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24297"/>in tempore furoris tui abutere eis. <l eID="gen24297" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24269"/> <chapter eID="Jer.18"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : Vade, et accipe lagunculam figuli testeam a senioribus populi et a senioribus sacerdotum,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:2
verses.text: et egredere ad vallem filii Ennom, quæ est juxta introitum portæ fictilis : et prædicabis ibi verba quæ ego loquar ad te.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:3
verses.text: Et dices : <div eID="gen24298" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24299"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24300"/>Audite verbum Domini, <l eID="gen24300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24301"/>reges Juda, et habitatores Jerusalem. <l eID="gen24301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24302"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen24302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24303"/>Ecce ego inducam afflictionem super locum istum, <l eID="gen24303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24304"/>ita ut omnis qui audierit illam, tinniant aures ejus, <l eID="gen24304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9207"/><l level="1" sID="gen24305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9207"/>eo quod dereliquerint me, <l eID="gen24305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24306"/>et alienum fecerint locum istum, <l eID="gen24306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24307"/>et libaverunt in eo diis alienis quos nescierunt, <l eID="gen24307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24308"/>ipsi et patres eorum, et reges Juda : <l eID="gen24308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24309"/>et repleverunt locum istum sanguine innocentum, <l eID="gen24309" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9208"/><l level="1" sID="gen24310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9208"/>et ædificaverunt excelsa Baalim, <l eID="gen24310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24311"/>ad comburendos filios suos igni in holocaustum Baalim : <l eID="gen24311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24312"/>quæ non præcepi, nec locutus sum, <l eID="gen24312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24313"/>nec ascenderunt in cor meum. <l eID="gen24313" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9209"/><l level="1" sID="gen24314"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9209"/>Propterea ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24315"/>et non vocabitur amplius locus iste Topheth, <l eID="gen24315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24316"/>et vallis filii Ennom, <l eID="gen24316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24317"/>sed vallis occisionis. <l eID="gen24317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9210"/><l level="1" sID="gen24318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9210"/>Et dissipabo consilium Juda et Jerusalem in loco isto, <l eID="gen24318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24319"/>et subvertam eos gladio in conspectu inimicorum suorum, <l eID="gen24319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24320"/>et in manu quærentium animas eorum : <l eID="gen24320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24321"/>et dabo cadavera eorum escam volatilibus cæli et bestiis terræ. <l eID="gen24321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9211"/><l level="1" sID="gen24322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9211"/>Et ponam civitatem hanc in stuporem, et in sibilum : <l eID="gen24322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24323"/>omnis qui præterierit per eam obstupescet, <l eID="gen24323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24324"/>et sibilabit super universa plaga ejus. <l eID="gen24324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9212"/><l level="1" sID="gen24325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9212"/>Et cibabo eos carnibus filiorum suorum et carnibus filiarum suarum : <l eID="gen24325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24326"/>et unusquisque carnem amici sui comedet in obsidione, <l eID="gen24326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24327"/>et in angustia in qua concludent eos inimici eorum, <l eID="gen24327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24328"/>et qui quærunt animas eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:10
verses.text: Et conteres lagunculam in oculis virorum qui ibunt tecum,

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:11
verses.text: et dices ad eos : <l eID="gen24328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24329"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen24329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24330"/>Sic conteram populum istum, et civitatem istam, <l eID="gen24330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24331"/>sicut conteritur vas figuli, <l eID="gen24331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24332"/>quod non potest ultra instaurari : <l eID="gen24332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24333"/>et in Topheth sepelientur, <l eID="gen24333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24334"/>eo quod non sit alius locus ad sepeliendum. <l eID="gen24334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9213"/><l level="1" sID="gen24335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9213"/>Sic faciam loco huic, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen24335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24336"/>et habitatoribus ejus, <l eID="gen24336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24337"/>et ponam civitatem istam sicut Topheth. <l eID="gen24337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9214"/><l level="1" sID="gen24338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9214"/>Et erunt domus Jerusalem, <l eID="gen24338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24339"/>et domus regum Juda, <l eID="gen24339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24340"/>sicut locus Topheth, immundæ, <l eID="gen24340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24341"/>omnes domus in quarum domatibus sacrificaverunt omni militiæ cæli, <l eID="gen24341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24342"/>et libaverunt libamina diis alienis. <l eID="gen24342" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen24299"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9215"/><div sID="gen24343" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9215"/>Venit autem Jeremias de Topheth, quo miserat eum Dominus ad prophetandum, et stetit in atrio domus Domini, et dixit ad omnem populum :

verses.name: Jeremiah 19:15
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego inducam super civitatem hanc, et super omnes urbes ejus, universa mala quæ locutus sum adversum eam, quoniam induraverunt cervicem suam ut non audirent sermones meos.  <chapter eID="Jer.19"/> <div eID="gen24343" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:1
verses.text: Et audivit Phassur filius Emmer, sacerdos, qui constitutus erat princeps in domo Domini, Jeremiam prophetantem sermones istos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:2
verses.text: Et percussit Phassur Jeremiam prophetam, et misit eum in nervum quod erat in porta Benjamin superiori, in domo Domini.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:3
verses.text: Cumque illuxisset in crastinum, eduxit Phassur Jeremiam de nervo, et dixit ad eum Jeremias : Non Phassur vocavit Dominus nomen tuum, sed Pavorem undique.

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:4
verses.text: Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <div eID="gen24344" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24345"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24346"/>Ecce ego dabo te in pavorem, <l eID="gen24346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24347"/>te et omnes amicos tuos : <l eID="gen24347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24348"/>et corruent gladio inimicorum suorum, <l eID="gen24348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24349"/>et oculi tui videbunt : <l eID="gen24349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24350"/>et omnem Judam dabo in manum regis Babylonis, <l eID="gen24350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24351"/>et traducet eos in Babylonem, <l eID="gen24351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24352"/>et percutiet eos gladio. <l eID="gen24352" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9216"/><l level="1" sID="gen24353"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9216"/>Et dabo universam substantiam civitatis hujus, <l eID="gen24353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24354"/>et omnem laborem ejus, omneque pretium, <l eID="gen24354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24355"/>et cunctos thesauros regum Juda <l eID="gen24355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24356"/>dabo in manu inimicorum eorum : <l eID="gen24356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24357"/>et diripient eos, et tollent, <l eID="gen24357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24358"/>et ducent in Babylonem. <l eID="gen24358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9217"/><l level="1" sID="gen24359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9217"/>Tu autem, Phassur, et omnes habitatores domus tuæ, <l eID="gen24359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24360"/>ibitis in captivitatem : <l eID="gen24360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24361"/>et in Babylonem venies, <l eID="gen24361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24362"/>et ibi morieris, ibique sepelieris <l eID="gen24362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24363"/>tu, et omnes amici tui, <l eID="gen24363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24364"/>quibus prophetasti mendacium. <l eID="gen24364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9218"/><l level="1" sID="gen24365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9218"/>Seduxisti me, Domine, et seductus sum : <l eID="gen24365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24366"/>fortior me fuisti, et invaluisti : <l eID="gen24366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24367"/>factus sum in derisum tota die ; <l eID="gen24367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24368"/>omnes subsannant me. <l eID="gen24368" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9219"/><l level="1" sID="gen24369"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9219"/>Quia jam olim loquor, <l eID="gen24369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24370"/>vociferans iniquitatem, et vastitatem clamito : <l eID="gen24370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24371"/>et factus est mihi sermo Domini in opprobrium, <l eID="gen24371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24372"/>et in derisum tota die. <l eID="gen24372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9220"/><l level="1" sID="gen24373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9220"/>Et dixi : Non recordabor ejus, <l eID="gen24373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24374"/>neque loquar ultra in nomine illius : <l eID="gen24374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24375"/>et factus est in corde meo quasi ignis exæstuans, <l eID="gen24375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24376"/>claususque in ossibus meis, <l eID="gen24376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24377"/>et defeci, ferre non sustinens. <l eID="gen24377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9221"/><l level="1" sID="gen24378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9221"/>Audivi enim contumelias multorum, <l eID="gen24378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24379"/>et terrorem in circuitu : <l eID="gen24379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24380"/>Persequimini, et persequamur eum, <l eID="gen24380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24381"/>ab omnibus viris qui erant pacifici mei, <l eID="gen24381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24382"/>et custodientes latus meum : <l eID="gen24382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24383"/>si quomodo decipiatur, et prævaleamus adversus eum, <l eID="gen24383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24384"/>et consequamur ultionem ex eo. <l eID="gen24384" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9222"/><l level="1" sID="gen24385"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9222"/>Dominus autem mecum est, quasi bellator fortis : <l eID="gen24385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24386"/>idcirco qui persequuntur me cadent, <l eID="gen24386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24387"/>et infirmi erunt : <l eID="gen24387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24388"/>confundentur vehementer, <l eID="gen24388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24389"/>quia non intellexerunt opprobrium sempiternum, <l eID="gen24389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24390"/>quod numquam delebitur. <l eID="gen24390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9223"/><l level="1" sID="gen24391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9223"/>Et tu, Domine exercituum, probator justi, <l eID="gen24391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24392"/>qui vides renes et cor, <l eID="gen24392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24393"/>videam, quæso, ultionem tuam ex eis : <l eID="gen24393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24394"/>tibi enim revelavi causam meam. <l eID="gen24394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9224"/><l level="1" sID="gen24395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9224"/>Cantate Domino, <l eID="gen24395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24396"/>laudate Dominum, <l eID="gen24396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24397"/>quia liberavit animam pauperis de manu malorum. <l eID="gen24397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9225"/><l level="1" sID="gen24398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9225"/>Maledicta dies in qua natus sum ! <l eID="gen24398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24399"/>dies in qua peperit me mater mea <l eID="gen24399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24400"/>non sit benedicta ! <l eID="gen24400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9226"/><l level="1" sID="gen24401"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9226"/>Maledictus vir qui annuntiavit patri meo, <l eID="gen24401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24402"/>dicens : Natus est tibi puer masculus, <l eID="gen24402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24403"/>et quasi gaudio lætificavit eum ! <l eID="gen24403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9227"/><l level="1" sID="gen24404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9227"/>Sit homo ille ut sunt civitates quæ subvertit Dominus, <l eID="gen24404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24405"/>et non pœnituit eum : <l eID="gen24405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24406"/>audiat clamorem mane, <l eID="gen24406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24407"/>et ululatum in tempore meridiano, <l eID="gen24407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9228"/><l level="1" sID="gen24408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9228"/>qui non me interfecit a vulva, <l eID="gen24408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24409"/>ut fieret mihi mater mea sepulchrum, <l eID="gen24409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24410"/>et vulva ejus conceptus æternus ! <l eID="gen24410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 20:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9229"/><l level="1" sID="gen24411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9229"/>Quare de vulva egressus sum, <l eID="gen24411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24412"/>ut viderem laborem et dolorem, <l eID="gen24412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24413"/>et consumerentur in confusione dies mei ? <l eID="gen24413" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24345"/> <chapter eID="Jer.20"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, quando misit ad eum rex Sedecias Phassur filium Melchiæ, et Sophoniam filium Maasiæ sacerdotem, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:2
verses.text: Interroga pro nobis Dominum, quia Nabuchodonosor, rex Babylonis, præliatur adversum nos : si forte faciat Dominus nobiscum secundum omnia mirabilia sua, et recedat a nobis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:3
verses.text: Et dixit Jeremias ad eos : Sic dicetis Sedeciæ :

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:4
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Ecce ego convertam vasa belli quæ in manibus vestris sunt, et quibus vos pugnatis adversum regem Babylonis et Chaldæos qui obsident vos in circuitu murorum : et congregabo ea in medio civitatis hujus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:5
verses.text: Et debellabo ego vos in manu extenta, et in brachio forti, et in furore, et in indignatione, et in ira grandi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:6
verses.text: Et percutiam habitatores civitatis hujus : homines et bestiæ pestilentia magna morientur.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:7
verses.text: Et post hæc, ait Dominus, dabo Sedeciam regem Juda, et servos ejus, et populum ejus, et qui derelicti sunt in civitate hac a peste, et gladio, et fame, in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, et in manu inimicorum eorum, et in manu quærentium animam eorum : et percutiet eos in ore gladii, et non flectetur, neque parcet, nec miserebitur.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:8
verses.text: Et ad populum hunc dices : Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego do coram vobis viam vitæ, et viam mortis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:9
verses.text: Qui habitaverit in urbe hac morietur gladio, et fame, et peste : qui autem egressus fuerit, et transfugerit ad Chaldæos qui obsident vos, vivet, et erit ei anima sua quasi spolium.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:10
verses.text: Posui enim faciem meam super civitatem hanc in malum, et non in bonum, ait Dominus : in manu regis Babylonis dabitur, et exuret eam igni.

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:11
verses.text: Et domui regis Juda : <div eID="gen24414" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24415"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24416"/>Audite verba Domini, <l eID="gen24416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9230"/><l level="1" sID="gen24417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9230"/>domus David. <l eID="gen24417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24418"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24419"/>Judicate mane judicium, <l eID="gen24419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24420"/>et eruite vi oppressum de manu calumniantis, <l eID="gen24420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24421"/>ne forte egrediatur ut ignis indignatio mea, <l eID="gen24421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24422"/>et succendatur, et non sit qui extinguat, <l eID="gen24422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24423"/>propter malitiam studiorum vestrorum. <l eID="gen24423" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9231"/><l level="1" sID="gen24424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9231"/>Ecce ego ad te, habitatricem vallis solidæ atque campestris, <l eID="gen24424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24425"/>ait Dominus : <l eID="gen24425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24426"/>qui dicitis : Quis percutiet nos ? <l eID="gen24426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24427"/>et quis ingredietur domos nostras ? <l eID="gen24427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9232"/><l level="1" sID="gen24428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9232"/>Et visitabo super vos juxta fructum studiorum vestrorum, <l eID="gen24428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24429"/>dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24430"/>et succendam ignem in saltu ejus, <l eID="gen24430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24431"/>et devorabit omnia in circuitu ejus. <l eID="gen24431" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24415"/> <chapter eID="Jer.21"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : Descende in domum regis Juda, et loqueris ibi verbum hoc,

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:2
verses.text: et dices : <div eID="gen24432" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24433"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24434"/>Audi verbum Domini, rex Juda, <l eID="gen24434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24435"/>qui sedes super solium David : <l eID="gen24435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24436"/>tu et servi tui, et populus tuus, <l eID="gen24436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24437"/>qui ingredimini per portas istas. <l eID="gen24437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9233"/><l level="1" sID="gen24438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9233"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24439"/>Facite judicium et justitiam, <l eID="gen24439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24440"/>et liberate vi oppressum de manu calumniatoris : <l eID="gen24440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24441"/>et advenam, et pupillum, et viduam <l eID="gen24441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24442"/>nolite contristare, neque opprimatis inique, <l eID="gen24442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24443"/>et sanguinem innocentem ne effundatis in loco isto. <l eID="gen24443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9234"/><l level="1" sID="gen24444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9234"/>Si enim facientes feceritis verbum istud, <l eID="gen24444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24445"/>ingredientur per portas domus hujus <l eID="gen24445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24446"/>reges sedentes de genere David super thronum ejus, <l eID="gen24446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24447"/>et ascendentes currus et equos, <l eID="gen24447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24448"/>ipsi, et servi, et populus eorum. <l eID="gen24448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9235"/><l level="1" sID="gen24449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9235"/>Quod si non audieritis verba hæc : <l eID="gen24449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24450"/>in memetipso juravi, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24451"/>quia in solitudinem erit domus hæc. <l eID="gen24451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9236"/><l level="1" sID="gen24452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9236"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus super domum regis Juda : <l eID="gen24452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24453"/>Galaad, tu mihi caput Libani, <l eID="gen24453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24454"/>si non posuero te solitudinem, urbes inhabitabiles ! <l eID="gen24454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9237"/><l level="1" sID="gen24455"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9237"/>Et sanctificabo super te, interficientem virum et arma ejus : <l eID="gen24455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24456"/>et succident electas cedros tuas, <l eID="gen24456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24457"/>et præcipitabunt in ignem. <l eID="gen24457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9238"/><l level="1" sID="gen24458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9238"/>Et pertransibunt gentes multæ per civitatem hanc, <l eID="gen24458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24459"/>et dicet unusquisque proximo suo : <l eID="gen24459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24460"/>Quare fecit Dominus sic civitati huic grandi ? <l eID="gen24460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9239"/><l level="1" sID="gen24461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9239"/>Et respondebunt : <l eID="gen24461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24462"/>Eo quod dereliquerint pactum Domini Dei sui, <l eID="gen24462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24463"/>et adoraverint deos alienos, et servierint eis. <l eID="gen24463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9240"/><l level="1" sID="gen24464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9240"/>Nolite flere mortuum, <l eID="gen24464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24465"/>neque lugeatis super eum fletu : <l eID="gen24465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24466"/>plangite eum qui egreditur, <l eID="gen24466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24467"/>quia non revertetur ultra, <l eID="gen24467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24468"/>nec videbit terram nativitatis suæ. <l eID="gen24468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9241"/><l level="1" sID="gen24469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9241"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus ad Sellum, <l eID="gen24469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24470"/>filium Josiæ, regem Juda, <l eID="gen24470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24471"/>qui regnavit pro Josia patre suo, <l eID="gen24471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24472"/>qui egressus est de loco isto : <l eID="gen24472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24473"/>Non revertetur huc amplius, <l eID="gen24473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9242"/><l level="1" sID="gen24474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9242"/>sed in loco ad quem transtuli eum, ibi morietur, <l eID="gen24474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24475"/>et terram istam non videbit amplius. <l eID="gen24475" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9243"/><l level="1" sID="gen24476"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9243"/>Væ qui ædificat domum suam in injustitia, <l eID="gen24476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24477"/>et cœnacula sua non in judicio : <l eID="gen24477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24478"/>amicum suum opprimet frustra, <l eID="gen24478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24479"/>et mercedem ejus non reddet ei : <l eID="gen24479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9244"/><l level="1" sID="gen24480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9244"/>qui dicit : Ædificabo mihi domum latam, <l eID="gen24480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24481"/>et cœnacula spatiosa : <l eID="gen24481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24482"/>qui aperit sibi fenestras et facit laquearia cedrina, <l eID="gen24482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24483"/>pingitque sinopide. <l eID="gen24483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9245"/><l level="1" sID="gen24484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9245"/>Numquid regnabis quoniam confers te cedro ? <l eID="gen24484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24485"/>pater tuus numquid non comedit et bibit, <l eID="gen24485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24486"/>et fecit judicium et justitiam tunc cum bene erat ei ? <l eID="gen24486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9246"/><l level="1" sID="gen24487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9246"/>Judicavit causam pauperis et egeni in bonum suum : <l eID="gen24487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24488"/>numquid non ideo quia cognovit me ? dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9247"/><l level="1" sID="gen24489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9247"/>Tui vero oculi et cor ad avaritiam, <l eID="gen24489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24490"/>et ad sanguinem innocentem fundendum, <l eID="gen24490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24491"/>et ad calumniam, et ad cursum mali operis. <l eID="gen24491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:18
