verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9248"/><l level="1" sID="gen24492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9248"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus ad Joakim, <l eID="gen24492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24493"/>filium Josiæ, regem Juda : <l eID="gen24493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24494"/>Non plangent eum : Væ frater ! et væ soror ! <l eID="gen24494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24495"/>non concrepabunt ei : Væ domine ! et væ inclyte ! <l eID="gen24495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9249"/><l level="1" sID="gen24496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9249"/>Sepultura asini sepelietur, <l eID="gen24496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24497"/>putrefactus et projectus extra portas Jerusalem. <l eID="gen24497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9250"/><l level="1" sID="gen24498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9250"/>Ascende Libanum, et clama, <l eID="gen24498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24499"/>et in Basan da vocem tuam : <l eID="gen24499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24500"/>et clama ad transeuntes, <l eID="gen24500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24501"/>quia contriti sunt omnes amatores tui. <l eID="gen24501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9251"/><l level="1" sID="gen24502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9251"/>Locutus sum ad te in abundantia tua, <l eID="gen24502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24503"/>et dixisti : Non audiam : <l eID="gen24503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24504"/>hæc est via tua ab adolescentia tua, <l eID="gen24504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24505"/>quia non audisti vocem meam. <l eID="gen24505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9252"/><l level="1" sID="gen24506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9252"/>Omnes pastores tuos pascet ventus, <l eID="gen24506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24507"/>et amatores tui in captivitatem ibunt : <l eID="gen24507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24508"/>et tunc confunderis, <l eID="gen24508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24509"/>et erubesces ab omni malitia tua. <l eID="gen24509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9253"/><l level="1" sID="gen24510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9253"/>Quæ sedes in Libano, <l eID="gen24510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24511"/>et nidificas in cedris, <l eID="gen24511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24512"/>quomodo congemuisti cum venissent tibi dolores, <l eID="gen24512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24513"/>quasi dolores parturientis ? <l eID="gen24513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9254"/><l level="1" sID="gen24514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9254"/>Vivo ego, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24515"/>quia si fuerit Jechonias filius Joakim regis Juda <l eID="gen24515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24516"/>annulus in manu dextera mea, <l eID="gen24516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24517"/>inde evellam eum, <l eID="gen24517" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9255"/><l level="1" sID="gen24518"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9255"/>et dabo te in manu quærentium animam tuam, <l eID="gen24518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24519"/>et in manu quorum tu formidas faciem, <l eID="gen24519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24520"/>et in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, <l eID="gen24520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24521"/>et in manu Chaldæorum : <l eID="gen24521" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9256"/><l level="1" sID="gen24522"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9256"/>et mittam te, et matrem tuam quæ genuit te, <l eID="gen24522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24523"/>in terram alienam, in qua nati non estis, <l eID="gen24523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24524"/>ibique moriemini. <l eID="gen24524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9257"/><l level="1" sID="gen24525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9257"/>Et in terram ad quam ipsi levant animam suam ut revertantur illuc, <l eID="gen24525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24526"/>non revertentur. <l eID="gen24526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9258"/><l level="1" sID="gen24527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9258"/>Numquid vas fictile atque contritum <l eID="gen24527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24528"/>vir iste Jechonias ? <l eID="gen24528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24529"/>numquid vas absque omni voluptate ? <l eID="gen24529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24530"/>quare abjecti sunt ipse et semen ejus, <l eID="gen24530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24531"/>et projecti in terram quam ignoraverunt ? <l eID="gen24531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9259"/><l level="1" sID="gen24532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9259"/>Terra, terra, terra, audi sermonem Domini. <l eID="gen24532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 22:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9260"/><l level="1" sID="gen24533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9260"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24534"/>Scribe virum istum sterilem, <l eID="gen24534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24535"/>virum qui in diebus suis non prosperabitur : <l eID="gen24535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24536"/>nec enim erit de semine ejus vir <l eID="gen24536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24537"/>qui sedeat super solium David, <l eID="gen24537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24538"/>et potestatem habeat ultra in Juda.  <chapter eID="Jer.22"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:1
verses.text: Væ pastoribus qui disperdunt et dilacerant <l eID="gen24539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24540"/>gregem pascuæ meæ ! dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9261"/><l level="1" sID="gen24541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9261"/>Ideo hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël <l eID="gen24541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24542"/>ad pastores qui pascunt populum meum : <l eID="gen24542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24543"/>Vos dispersistis gregem meum, <l eID="gen24543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24544"/>et ejecistis eos, et non visitastis eos : <l eID="gen24544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24545"/>ecce ego visitabo super vos <l eID="gen24545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24546"/>malitiam studiorum vestrorum, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen24546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9262"/><l level="1" sID="gen24547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9262"/>Et ego congregabo reliquias gregis mei <l eID="gen24547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24548"/>de omnibus terris ad quas ejecero eos illuc : <l eID="gen24548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24549"/>et convertam eos ad rura sua, <l eID="gen24549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24550"/>et crescent et multiplicabuntur. <l eID="gen24550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9263"/><l level="1" sID="gen24551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9263"/>Et suscitabo super eos pastores, et pascent eos : <l eID="gen24551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24552"/>non formidabunt ultra, et non pavebunt, <l eID="gen24552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24553"/>et nullus quæretur ex numero, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9264"/><l level="1" sID="gen24554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9264"/>Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24555"/>et suscitabo David germen justum : <l eID="gen24555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24556"/>et regnabit rex, et sapiens erit, <l eID="gen24556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24557"/>et faciet judicium et justitiam in terra. <l eID="gen24557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9265"/><l level="1" sID="gen24558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9265"/>In diebus illis salvabitur Juda, <l eID="gen24558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24559"/>et Israël habitabit confidenter : <l eID="gen24559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24560"/>et hoc est nomen quod vocabunt eum : <l eID="gen24560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24561"/>Dominus justus noster. <l eID="gen24561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9266"/><l level="1" sID="gen24562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9266"/>Propter hoc ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24563"/>et non dicent ultra : Vivit Dominus, <l eID="gen24563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24564"/>qui eduxit filios Israël de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen24564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9267"/><l level="1" sID="gen24565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9267"/>sed : Vivit Dominus, <l eID="gen24565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24566"/>qui eduxit et adduxit semen domus Israël de terra aquilonis, <l eID="gen24566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24567"/>et de cunctis terris ad quas ejeceram eos illuc, <l eID="gen24567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24568"/>et habitabunt in terra sua. <l eID="gen24568" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen24433"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9268"/><div sID="gen24569" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9268"/>Ad prophetas : <div eID="gen24569" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24570"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24571"/>Contritum est cor meum in medio mei ; <l eID="gen24571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24572"/>contremuerunt omnia ossa mea : <l eID="gen24572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24573"/>factus sum quasi vir ebrius, <l eID="gen24573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24574"/>et quasi homo madidus a vino, <l eID="gen24574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24575"/>a facie Domini, <l eID="gen24575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24576"/>et a facie verborum sanctorum ejus. <l eID="gen24576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9269"/><l level="1" sID="gen24577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9269"/>Quia adulteris repleta est terra, <l eID="gen24577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24578"/>quia a facie maledictionis luxit terra, <l eID="gen24578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24579"/>arefacta sunt arva deserti : <l eID="gen24579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24580"/>factus est cursus eorum malus, <l eID="gen24580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24581"/>et fortitudo eorum dissimilis. <l eID="gen24581" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9270"/><l level="1" sID="gen24582"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9270"/>Propheta namque et sacerdos polluti sunt, <l eID="gen24582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24583"/>et in domo mea inveni malum eorum, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen24583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9271"/><l level="1" sID="gen24584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9271"/>Idcirco via eorum erit quasi lubricum in tenebris : <l eID="gen24584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24585"/>impellentur enim, et corruent in ea : <l eID="gen24585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24586"/>afferam enim super eos mala, <l eID="gen24586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24587"/>annum visitationis eorum, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen24587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9272"/><l level="1" sID="gen24588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9272"/>Et in prophetis Samariæ vidi fatuitatem : <l eID="gen24588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24589"/>prophetabant in Baal, <l eID="gen24589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24590"/>et decipiebant populum meum Israël. <l eID="gen24590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9273"/><l level="1" sID="gen24591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9273"/>Et in prophetis Jerusalem vidi similitudinem adulterantium, <l eID="gen24591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24592"/>et iter mendacii : <l eID="gen24592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24593"/>et confortaverunt manus pessimorum, <l eID="gen24593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24594"/>ut non converteretur unusquisque a malitia sua : <l eID="gen24594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24595"/>facti sunt mihi omnes ut Sodoma, <l eID="gen24595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24596"/>et habitatores ejus quasi Gomorrha. <l eID="gen24596" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9274"/><l level="1" sID="gen24597"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9274"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum ad prophetas : <l eID="gen24597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24598"/>Ecce ego cibabo eos absinthio, <l eID="gen24598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24599"/>et potabo eos felle : <l eID="gen24599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24600"/>a prophetis enim Jerusalem egressa est pollutio <l eID="gen24600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24601"/>super omnem terram. <l eID="gen24601" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9275"/><l level="1" sID="gen24602"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9275"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen24602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24603"/>Nolite audire verba prophetarum <l eID="gen24603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24604"/>qui prophetant vobis, et decipiunt vos : <l eID="gen24604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24605"/>visionem cordis sui loquuntur, <l eID="gen24605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24606"/>non de ore Domini. <l eID="gen24606" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9276"/><l level="1" sID="gen24607"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9276"/>Dicunt his qui blasphemant me : <l eID="gen24607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24608"/>Locutus est Dominus : Pax erit vobis : <l eID="gen24608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24609"/>et omni qui ambulat in pravitate cordis sui dixerunt : <l eID="gen24609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24610"/>Non veniet super vos malum. <l eID="gen24610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9277"/><l level="1" sID="gen24611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9277"/>Quis enim affuit in consilio Domini, <l eID="gen24611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24612"/>et vidit, et audivit sermonem ejus ? <l eID="gen24612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24613"/>quis consideravit verbum illius, et audivit ? <l eID="gen24613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9278"/><l level="1" sID="gen24614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9278"/>Ecce turbo Dominicæ indignationis egredietur, <l eID="gen24614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24615"/>et tempestas erumpens super caput impiorum veniet. <l eID="gen24615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9279"/><l level="1" sID="gen24616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9279"/>Non revertetur furor Domini, <l eID="gen24616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24617"/>usque dum faciat et usque dum compleat cogitationem cordis sui : <l eID="gen24617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24618"/>in novissimis diebus intelligetis consilium ejus. <l eID="gen24618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9280"/><l level="1" sID="gen24619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9280"/>Non mittebam prophetas, <l eID="gen24619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24620"/>et ipsi currebant : <l eID="gen24620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24621"/>non loquebar ad eos, <l eID="gen24621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24622"/>et ipsi prophetabant. <l eID="gen24622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9281"/><l level="1" sID="gen24623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9281"/>Si stetissent in consilio meo, <l eID="gen24623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24624"/>et nota fecissent verba mea populo meo, <l eID="gen24624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24625"/>avertissem utique eos a via sua mala, <l eID="gen24625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24626"/>et a cogitationibus suis pessimis. <l eID="gen24626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9282"/><l level="1" sID="gen24627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9282"/>Putasne Deus e vicino ego sum, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24628"/>et non Deus de longe ? <l eID="gen24628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9283"/><l level="1" sID="gen24629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9283"/>Si occultabitur vir in absconditis, <l eID="gen24629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24630"/>et ego non videbo eum ? dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24631"/>Numquid non cælum et terram ego impleo ? dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9284"/><l level="1" sID="gen24632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9284"/>Audivi quæ dixerunt prophetæ <l eID="gen24632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24633"/>prophetantes in nomine meo mendacium, <l eID="gen24633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24634"/>atque dicentes : Somniavi, somniavi. <l eID="gen24634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9285"/><l level="1" sID="gen24635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9285"/>Usquequo istud est in corde prophetarum vaticinantium mendacium, <l eID="gen24635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24636"/>et prophetantium seductiones cordis sui ? <l eID="gen24636" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9286"/><l level="1" sID="gen24637"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9286"/>Qui volunt facere ut obliviscatur populus meus nominis mei, <l eID="gen24637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24638"/>propter somnia eorum quæ narrat unusquisque ad proximum suum, <l eID="gen24638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24639"/>sicut obliti sunt patres eorum nominis mei propter Baal ? <l eID="gen24639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9287"/><l level="1" sID="gen24640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9287"/>Propheta qui habet somnium, <l eID="gen24640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24641"/>narret somnium : <l eID="gen24641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24642"/>et qui habet sermonem meum, <l eID="gen24642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24643"/>loquatur sermonem meum vere. <l eID="gen24643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24644"/>Quid paleis ad triticum ? dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9288"/><l level="1" sID="gen24645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9288"/>Numquid non verba mea sunt quasi ignis, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24646"/>et quasi malleus conterens petram ? <l eID="gen24646" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9289"/><l level="1" sID="gen24647"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9289"/>Propterea ecce ego ad prophetas, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen24647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24648"/>qui furantur verba mea unusquisque a proximo suo. <l eID="gen24648" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9290"/><l level="1" sID="gen24649"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9290"/>Ecce ego ad prophetas, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen24649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24650"/>qui assumunt linguas suas, et aiunt : Dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9291"/><l level="1" sID="gen24651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9291"/>Ecce ego ad prophetas somniantes mendacium, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen24651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24652"/>qui narraverunt ea, et seduxerunt populum meum <l eID="gen24652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24653"/>in mendacio suo et in miraculis suis, <l eID="gen24653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24654"/>cum ego non misissem eos, nec mandassem eis : <l eID="gen24654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24655"/>qui nihil profuerunt populo huic, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9292"/><l level="1" sID="gen24656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9292"/>Si igitur interrogaverit te populus iste, <l eID="gen24656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24657"/>vel propheta, aut sacerdos, dicens : <l eID="gen24657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24658"/>Quod est onus Domini ? <l eID="gen24658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24659"/>dices ad eos : Vos estis onus : <l eID="gen24659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24660"/>projiciam quippe vos, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9293"/><l level="1" sID="gen24661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9293"/>Et propheta, et sacerdos, et populus <l eID="gen24661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24662"/>qui dicit : Onus Domini : <l eID="gen24662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24663"/>visitabo super virum illum et super domum ejus. <l eID="gen24663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9294"/><l level="1" sID="gen24664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9294"/>Hæc dicetis unusquisque ad proximum, <l eID="gen24664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24665"/>et ad fratrem suum : <l eID="gen24665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24666"/>Quid respondit Dominus ? <l eID="gen24666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24667"/>et quid locutus est Dominus ? <l eID="gen24667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9295"/><l level="1" sID="gen24668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9295"/>Et onus Domini ultra non memorabitur : <l eID="gen24668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24669"/>quia onus erit unicuique sermo suus, <l eID="gen24669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24670"/>et pervertistis verba Dei viventis, <l eID="gen24670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24671"/>Domini exercituum, Dei nostri. <l eID="gen24671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9296"/><l level="1" sID="gen24672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9296"/>Hæc dices ad prophetam : <l eID="gen24672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24673"/>Quid respondit tibi Dominus ? <l eID="gen24673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24674"/>et quid locutus est Dominus ? <l eID="gen24674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9297"/><l level="1" sID="gen24675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9297"/>Si autem onus Domini dixeritis, <l eID="gen24675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24676"/>propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24677"/>Quia dixistis sermonem istum : Onus Domini, <l eID="gen24677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24678"/>et misi ad vos dicens : Nolite dicere : Onus Domini : <l eID="gen24678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9298"/><l level="1" sID="gen24679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9298"/>propterea ecce ego tollam vos portans, <l eID="gen24679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24680"/>et derelinquam vos, <l eID="gen24680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24681"/>et civitatem quam dedi vobis et patribus vestris, <l eID="gen24681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24682"/>a facie mea : <l eID="gen24682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 23:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9299"/><l level="1" sID="gen24683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9299"/>et dabo vos in opprobrium sempiternum, <l eID="gen24683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24684"/>et in ignominiam æternam, <l eID="gen24684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24685"/>quæ numquam oblivione delebitur. <l eID="gen24685" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24570"/> <chapter eID="Jer.23"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:1
verses.text: Ostendit mihi Dominus : et ecce duo calathi pleni ficis, positi ante templum Domini, postquam transtulit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis Jechoniam filium Joakim, regem Juda, et principes ejus, et fabrum, et inclusorem, de Jerusalem, et adduxit eos in Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:2
verses.text: Calathus unus ficus bonas habebat nimis, ut solent ficus esse primi temporis : et calathus unus ficus habebat malas nimis, quæ comedi non poterant eo quod essent malæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:3
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Quid tu vides, Jeremia ? Et dixi : Ficus, ficus bonas, bonas valde : et malas, malas valde, quæ comedi non possunt eo quod sint malæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:4
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen24686" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9300"/><lg sID="gen24687"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24688"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9300"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : <l eID="gen24688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24689"/>Sicut ficus hæ bonæ, <l eID="gen24689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24690"/>sic cognoscam transmigrationem Juda, <l eID="gen24690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24691"/>quam emisi de loco isto in terram Chaldæorum, in bonum. <l eID="gen24691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9301"/><l level="1" sID="gen24692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9301"/>Et ponam oculos meos super eos ad placandum, <l eID="gen24692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24693"/>et reducam eos in terram hanc : <l eID="gen24693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24694"/>et ædificabo eos, et non destruam : <l eID="gen24694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24695"/>et plantabo eos, et non evellam. <l eID="gen24695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9302"/><l level="1" sID="gen24696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9302"/>Et dabo eis cor ut sciant me, <l eID="gen24696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24697"/>quia ego sum Dominus : <l eID="gen24697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24698"/>et erunt mihi in populum, <l eID="gen24698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24699"/>et ego ero eis in Deum, <l eID="gen24699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24700"/>quia revertentur ad me in toto corde suo. <l eID="gen24700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9303"/><l level="1" sID="gen24701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9303"/>Et sicut ficus pessimæ quæ comedi non possunt eo quod sint malæ, <l eID="gen24701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24702"/>hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24703"/>Sic dabo Sedeciam regem Juda, <l eID="gen24703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24704"/>et principes ejus, et reliquos de Jerusalem, <l eID="gen24704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24705"/>qui remanserunt in urbe hac, <l eID="gen24705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24706"/>et qui habitant in terra Ægypti. <l eID="gen24706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9304"/><l level="1" sID="gen24707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9304"/>Et dabo eos in vexationem, <l eID="gen24707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24708"/>afflictionemque omnibus regnis terræ, <l eID="gen24708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24709"/>in opprobrium, et in parabolam, <l eID="gen24709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24710"/>et in proverbium, et in maledictionem <l eID="gen24710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24711"/>in universis locis ad quæ ejeci eos. <l eID="gen24711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 24:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9305"/><l level="1" sID="gen24712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9305"/>Et mittam in eis gladium, et famem, et pestem, <l eID="gen24712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24713"/>donec consumantur de terra quam dedi eis et patribus eorum. <l eID="gen24713" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24687"/> <chapter eID="Jer.24"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam, de omni populo Juda, in anno quarto Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda (ipse est annus primus Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis),

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:2
verses.text: quod locutus est Jeremias propheta ad omnem populum Juda, et ad universos habitatores Jerusalem, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:3
verses.text: A tertiodecimo anno Josiæ filii Amon regis Juda, usque ad diem hanc, iste tertius et vigesimus annus, factum est verbum Domini ad me, et locutus sum ad vos, de nocte consurgens et loquens, et non audistis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:4
verses.text: Et misit Dominus ad vos omnes servos suos prophetas, consurgens diluculo, mittensque : et non audistis, neque inclinastis aures vestras ut audiretis,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:5
verses.text: cum diceret : Revertimini unusquisque a via sua mala, et a pessimis cogitationibus vestris, et habitabitis in terra quam dedit Dominus vobis et patribus vestris, a sæculo et usque in sæculum :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:6
verses.text: et nolite ire post deos alienos, ut serviatis eis, adoretisque eos : neque me ad iracundiam provocetis in operibus manuum vestrarum, et non affligam vos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:7
verses.text: Et non audistis me, dicit Dominus, ut me ad iracundiam provocaretis in operibus manuum vestrarum, in malum vestrum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:8
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Pro eo quod non audistis verba mea,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:9
verses.text: ecce ego mittam et assumam universas cognationes aquilonis, ait Dominus, et Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis servum meum, et adducam eos super terram istam, et super habitatores ejus, et super omnes nationes quæ in circuitu illius sunt : et interficiam eos, et ponam eos in stuporem et in sibilum, et in solitudines sempiternas.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:10
verses.text: Perdamque ex eis vocem gaudii et vocem lætitiæ, vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ, vocem molæ et lumen lucernæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:11
verses.text: Et erit universa terra hæc in solitudinem, et in stuporem : et servient omnes gentes istæ regi Babylonis septuaginta annis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:12
verses.text: Cumque impleti fuerint septuaginta anni, visitabo super regem Babylonis et super gentem illam, dicit Dominus, iniquitatem eorum, et super terram Chaldæorum, et ponam illam in solitudines sempiternas.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:13
verses.text: Et adducam super terram illam omnia verba mea, quæ locutus sum contra eam, omne quod scriptum est in libro isto, quæcumque prophetavit Jeremias adversum omnes gentes :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:14
verses.text: quia servierunt eis, cum essent gentes multæ, et reges magni : et reddam eis secundum opera eorum, et secundum facta manuum suarum.  <div eID="gen24714" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9306"/><div sID="gen24715" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9306"/>Quia sic dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Sume calicem vini furoris hujus de manu mea, et propinabis de illo cunctis gentibus ad quas ego mittam te.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:16
verses.text: Et bibent, et turbabuntur et insanient a facie gladii quem ego mittam inter eos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:17
verses.text: Et accepi calicem de manu Domini, et propinavi cunctis gentibus ad quas misit me Dominus,

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:18
verses.text: Jerusalem, et civitatibus Juda, et regibus ejus, et principibus ejus, ut darem eos in solitudinem, et in stuporem, et in sibilum, et in maledictionem, sicut est dies ista :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:19
verses.text: Pharaoni regi Ægypti, et servis ejus, et principibus ejus, et omni populo ejus :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:20
verses.text: et universis generaliter : cunctis regibus terræ Ausitidis, et cunctis regibus terræ Philisthiim, et Ascaloni, et Gazæ, et Accaron, et reliquiis Azoti :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:21
verses.text: et Idumææ, et Moab, et filiis Ammon :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:22
verses.text: et cunctis regibus Tyri, et universis regibus Sidonis, et regibus terræ insularum qui sunt trans mare :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:23
verses.text: et Dedan, et Thema, et Buz, et universis qui attonsi sunt in comam :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:24
verses.text: et cunctis regibus Arabiæ, et cunctis regibus occidentis, qui habitant in deserto :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:25
verses.text: et cunctis regibus Zambri, et cunctis regibus Elam, et cunctis regibus Medorum :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:26
verses.text: cunctis quoque regibus aquilonis, de prope et de longe, unicuique contra fratrem suum : et omnibus regnis terræ quæ super faciem ejus sunt : et rex Sesach bibet post eos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:27
verses.text: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Bibite, et inebriamini, et vomite : et cadite, neque surgatis a facie gladii quem ego mittam inter vos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:28
verses.text: Cumque noluerint accipere calicem de manu tua ut bibant, dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Bibentes bibetis :

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:29
verses.text: quia ecce in civitate in qua invocatum est nomen meum ego incipiam affligere, et vos quasi innocentes et immunes eritis ? non eritis immunes : gladium enim ego voco super omnes habitatores terræ, dicit Dominus exercituum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:30
verses.text: Et tu prophetabis ad eos omnia verba hæc, et dices ad illos : <div eID="gen24715" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24716"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24717"/>Dominus de excelso rugiet, <l eID="gen24717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24718"/>et de habitaculo sancto suo dabit vocem suam : <l eID="gen24718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24719"/>rugiens rugiet super decorem suum : <l eID="gen24719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24720"/>celeuma quasi calcantium concinetur <l eID="gen24720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24721"/>adversus omnes habitatores terræ. <l eID="gen24721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9307"/><l level="1" sID="gen24722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9307"/>Pervenit sonitus usque ad extrema terræ, <l eID="gen24722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24723"/>quia judicium Domino cum gentibus : <l eID="gen24723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24724"/>judicatur ipse cum omni carne. <l eID="gen24724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24725"/>Impios tradidi gladio, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9308"/><l level="1" sID="gen24726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9308"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen24726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24727"/>Ecce afflictio egredietur de gente in gentem, <l eID="gen24727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24728"/>et turbo magnus egredietur a summitatibus terræ. <l eID="gen24728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9309"/><l level="1" sID="gen24729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9309"/>Et erunt interfecti Domini in die illa, <l eID="gen24729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24730"/>a summo terræ usque ad summum ejus : <l eID="gen24730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24731"/>non plangentur, et non colligentur, neque sepelientur : <l eID="gen24731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24732"/>in sterquilinium super faciem terræ jacebunt. <l eID="gen24732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9310"/><l level="1" sID="gen24733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9310"/>Ululate, pastores, et clamate, <l eID="gen24733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24734"/>et aspergite vos cinere, optimates gregis : <l eID="gen24734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24735"/>quia completi sunt dies vestri ut interficiamini, <l eID="gen24735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24736"/>et dissipationes vestræ : <l eID="gen24736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24737"/>et cadetis quasi vasa pretiosa. <l eID="gen24737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9311"/><l level="1" sID="gen24738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9311"/>Et peribit fuga a pastoribus, <l eID="gen24738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24739"/>et salvatio ab optimatibus gregis. <l eID="gen24739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9312"/><l level="1" sID="gen24740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9312"/>Vox clamoris pastorum, et ululatus optimatum gregis, <l eID="gen24740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24741"/>quia vastavit Dominus pascua eorum : <l eID="gen24741" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9313"/><l level="1" sID="gen24742"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9313"/>et conticuerunt arva pacis a facie iræ furoris Domini. <l eID="gen24742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 25:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9314"/><l level="1" sID="gen24743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9314"/>Dereliquit quasi leo umbraculum suum, <l eID="gen24743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24744"/>quia facta est terra eorum in desolationem <l eID="gen24744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24745"/>a facie iræ columbæ, <l eID="gen24745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24746"/>et a facie iræ furoris Domini. <l eID="gen24746" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24716"/> <chapter eID="Jer.25"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:1
verses.text: In principio regni Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda, factum est verbum istud a Domino, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:2
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : Sta in atrio domus Domini, et loqueris ad omnes civitates Juda, de quibus veniunt ut adorent in domo Domini universos sermones quos ego mandavi tibi ut loquaris ad eos : noli subtrahere verbum,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:3
verses.text: si forte audiant, et convertantur unusquisque a via sua mala, et pœniteat me mali quod cogito facere eis propter malitiam studiorum eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:4
verses.text: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus : Si non audieritis me, ut ambuletis in lege mea quam dedi vobis,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:5
verses.text: ut audiatis sermones servorum meorum prophetarum quos ego misi ad vos, de nocte consurgens, et dirigens, et non audistis :

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:6
verses.text: dabo domum istam sicut Silo, et urbem hanc dabo in maledictionem cunctis gentibus terræ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:7
verses.text: Et audierunt sacerdotes, et prophetæ, et omnis populus, Jeremiam loquentem verba hæc in domo Domini.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:8
verses.text: Cumque complesset Jeremias, loquens omnia quæ præceperat ei Dominus ut loqueretur ad universum populum, apprehenderunt eum sacerdotes, et prophetæ, et omnis populus, dicens : Morte moriatur.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:9
verses.text: Quare prophetavit in nomine Domini, dicens : Sicut Silo erit domus hæc, et urbs ista desolabitur eo quod non sit habitator ? Et congregatus est omnis populus adversus Jeremiam in domo Domini.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:10
verses.text: Et audierunt principes Juda verba hæc, et ascenderunt de domo regis in domum Domini, et sederunt in introitu portæ domus Domini novæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:11
verses.text: Et locuti sunt sacerdotes et prophetæ ad principes, et ad omnem populum, dicentes : Judicium mortis est viro huic, quia prophetavit adversus civitatem istam, sicut audistis auribus vestris.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:12
verses.text: Et ait Jeremias ad omnes principes, et ad universum populum, dicens : Dominus misit me ut prophetarem ad domum istam, et ad civitatem hanc, omnia verba quæ audistis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:13
verses.text: Nunc ergo bonas facite vias vestras et studia vestra, et audite vocem Domini Dei vestri, et pœnitebit Dominum mali quod locutus est adversum vos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:14
verses.text: Ego autem ecce in manibus vestris sum : facite mihi quod bonum et rectum est in oculis vestris.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:15
verses.text: Verumtamen scitote et cognoscite quod, si occideritis me, sanguinem innocentem tradetis contra vosmetipsos, et contra civitatem istam, et habitatores ejus : in veritate enim misit me Dominus ad vos, ut loquerer in auribus vestris omnia verba hæc.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:16
verses.text: Et dixerunt principes et omnis populus ad sacerdotes et ad prophetas : Non est viro huic judicium mortis, quia in nomine Domini Dei nostri locutus est ad nos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:17
verses.text: Surrexerunt ergo viri de senioribus terræ, et dixerunt ad omnem cœtum populi, loquentes :

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:18
verses.text: Michæas de Morasthi fuit propheta in diebus Ezechiæ regis Juda, et ait ad omnem populum Juda, dicens : <div eID="gen24747" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen24748"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24749"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen24749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24750"/>Sion quasi ager arabitur, <l eID="gen24750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24751"/>et Jerusalem in acervum lapidum erit, <l eID="gen24751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24752"/>et mons domus in excelsa silvarum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:19
verses.text: Numquid morte condemnavit eum Ezechias rex Juda, et omnis Juda ? numquid non timuerunt Dominum, et deprecati sunt faciem Domini, et pœnituit Dominum mali quod locutus fuerat adversum eos ? Itaque nos facimus malum grande contra animas nostras.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:20
verses.text: Fuit quoque vir prophetans in nomine Domini, Urias filius Semei de Cariathiarim, et prophetavit adversus civitatem istam, et adversus terram hanc, juxta omnia verba Jeremiæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:21
verses.text: Et audivit rex Joakim, et omnes potentes et principes ejus, verba hæc, et quæsivit rex interficere eum : et audivit Urias, et timuit, fugitque, et ingressus est Ægyptum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:22
verses.text: Et misit rex Joakim viros in Ægyptum, Elnathan filium Achobor, et viros cum eo, in Ægyptum,

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:23
verses.text: et eduxerunt Uriam de Ægypto, et adduxerunt eum ad regem Joakim, et percussit eum gladio, et projecit cadaver ejus in sepulchris vulgi ignobilis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 26:24
verses.text: Igitur manus Ahicam filii Saphan fuit cum Jeremia, ut non traderetur in manus populi, et interficerent eum. <l eID="gen24752" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24748"/> <chapter eID="Jer.26"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:1
verses.text: In principio regni Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda, factum est verbum istud ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:2
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus ad me : Fac tibi vincula et catenas, et pones eas in collo tuo,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:3
verses.text: et mittes eas ad regem Edom, et ad regem Moab, et ad regem filiorum Ammon, et ad regem Tyri, et ad regem Sidonis, in manu nuntiorum qui venerunt Jerusalem ad Sedeciam regem Juda.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:4
verses.text: Et præcipies eis ut ad dominos suos loquantur : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Hæc dicetis ad dominos vestros :

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:5
verses.text: Ego feci terram, et homines, et jumenta quæ sunt super faciem terræ, in fortitudine mea magna, et in brachio meo extento, et dedi eam ei qui placuit in oculis meis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:6
verses.text: Et nunc itaque ego dedi omnes terras istas in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis servi mei : insuper et bestias agri dedi ei, ut serviant illi :

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:7
verses.text: et servient ei omnes gentes, et filio ejus, et filio filii ejus, donec veniat tempus terræ ejus et ipsius : et servient ei gentes multæ et reges magni.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:8
verses.text: Gens autem et regnum quod non servierit Nabuchodonosor regi Babylonis, et quicumque non curvaverit collum suum sub jugo regis Babylonis, in gladio, et in fame, et in peste visitabo super gentem illam, ait Dominus, donec consumam eos in manu ejus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:9
verses.text: Vos ergo nolite audire prophetas vestros, et divinos, et somniatores, et augures, et maleficos, qui dicunt vobis : Non servietis regi Babylonis :

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:10
verses.text: quia mendacium prophetant vobis, ut longe vos faciant de terra vestra, et ejiciant vos, et pereatis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:11
verses.text: Porro gens quæ subjecerit cervicem suam sub jugo regis Babylonis, et servierit ei, dimittam eam in terra sua, dicit Dominus, et colet eam, et habitabit in ea.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:12
verses.text: Et ad Sedeciam regem Juda locutus sum secundum omnia verba hæc, dicens : Subjicite colla vestra sub jugo regis Babylonis, et servite ei et populo ejus, et vivetis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:13
verses.text: Quare moriemini, tu et populus tuus, gladio, et fame, et peste, sicut locutus est Dominus ad gentem quæ servire noluerit regi Babylonis ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:14
verses.text: Nolite audire verba prophetarum dicentium vobis : Non servietis regi Babylonis : quia mendacium ipsi loquuntur vobis :

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:15
verses.text: quia non misi eos, ait Dominus, et ipsi prophetant in nomine meo mendaciter, ut ejiciant vos, et pereatis, tam vos quam prophetæ qui vaticinantur vobis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:16
verses.text: Et ad sacerdotes, et ad populum istum, locutus sum, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus : Nolite audire verba prophetarum vestrorum, qui prophetant vobis, dicentes : Ecce vasa Domini revertentur de Babylone nunc cito : mendacium enim prophetant vobis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:17
verses.text: Nolite ergo audire eos : sed servite regi Babylonis, ut vivatis : quare datur hæc civitas in solitudinem ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:18
verses.text: Et si prophetæ sunt, et est verbum Domini in eis, occurrant Domino exercituum, ut non veniant vasa quæ derelicta fuerant in domo Domini, et in domo regis Juda, et in Jerusalem, in Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:19
verses.text: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum ad columnas, et ad mare, et ad bases, et ad reliqua vasorum quæ remanserunt in civitate hac,

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:20
verses.text: quæ non tulit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis cum transferret Jechoniam filium Joakim regem Juda de Jerusalem in Babylonem, et omnes optimates Juda et Jerusalem :

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:21
verses.text: quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, ad vasa quæ derelicta sunt in domo Domini, et in domo regis Juda et Jerusalem :

verses.name: Jeremiah 27:22
verses.text: In Babylonem transferentur, et ibi erunt usque ad diem visitationis suæ, dicit Dominus, et afferri faciam ea, et restitui in loco isto.  <chapter eID="Jer.27"/> <div eID="gen24753" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:1
verses.text: Et factum est in anno illo, in principio regni Sedeciæ regis Juda, in anno quarto, in mense quinto, dixit ad me Hananias filius Azur, propheta de Gabaon, in domo Domini, coram sacerdotibus et omni populo, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:2
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Contrivi jugum regis Babylonis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:3
verses.text: Adhuc duo anni dierum, et ego referri faciam ad locum istum omnia vasa domus Domini, quæ tulit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis de loco isto, et transtulit ea in Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:4
verses.text: Et Jechoniam filium Joakim regem Juda, et omnem transmigrationem Juda, qui ingressi sunt in Babylonem, ego convertam ad locum istum, ait Dominus : conteram enim jugum regis Babylonis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:5
verses.text: Et dixit Jeremias propheta ad Hananiam prophetam, in oculis sacerdotum, et in oculis omnis populi qui stabat in domo Domini :

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:6
verses.text: et ait Jeremias propheta : Amen ! sic faciat Dominus : suscitet Dominus verba tua quæ prophetasti, ut referantur vasa in domum Domini, et omnis transmigratio de Babylone ad locum istum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:7
verses.text: Verumtamen audi verbum hoc quod ego loquor in auribus tuis, et in auribus universi populi :

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:8
verses.text: prophetæ qui fuerunt ante me et ante te, ab initio, et prophetaverunt super terras multas et super regna magna de prælio, et de afflictione, et de fame :

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:9
verses.text: propheta qui vaticinatus est pacem, cum venerit verbum ejus, scietur propheta quem misit Dominus in veritate.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:10
verses.text: Et tulit Hananias propheta catenam de collo Jeremiæ prophetæ, et confregit eam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:11
verses.text: Et ait Hananias in conspectu omnis populi, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus : Sic confringam jugum Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, post duos annos dierum de collo omnium gentium.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:12
verses.text: Et abiit Jeremias propheta in viam suam. Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, postquam confregit Hananias propheta catenam de collo Jeremiæ prophetæ, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:13
verses.text: Vade, et dices Hananiæ : Hæc dicit Dominus : Catenas ligneas contrivisti, et facies pro eis catenas ferreas.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:14
verses.text: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Jugum ferreum posui super collum cunctarum gentium istarum, ut serviant Nabuchodonosor regi Babylonis, et servient ei : insuper et bestias terræ dedi ei.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:15
verses.text: Et dixit Jeremias propheta ad Hananiam prophetam : Audi, Hanania : non misit te Dominus, et tu confidere fecisti populum istum in mendacio.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:16
verses.text: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego mittam te a facie terræ : hoc anno morieris : adversum enim Dominum locutus es.

verses.name: Jeremiah 28:17
verses.text: Et mortuus est Hananias propheta in anno illo, mense septimo.  <chapter eID="Jer.28"/> <div eID="gen24754" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:1
verses.text: Et hæc sunt verba libri quem misit Jeremias propheta de Jerusalem ad reliquias seniorum transmigrationis, et ad sacerdotes, et ad prophetas, et ad omnem populum quem traduxerat Nabuchodonosor de Jerusalem in Babylonem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:2
verses.text: postquam egressus est Jechonias rex, et domina, et eunuchi, et principes Juda et Jerusalem, et faber et inclusor, de Jerusalem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:3
verses.text: in manu Elasa filii Saphan, et Gamariæ filii Helciæ, quos misit Sedecias rex Juda ad Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis in Babylonem, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:4
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, omni transmigrationi quam transtuli de Jerusalem in Babylonem :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:5
verses.text: Ædificate domos, et habitate : et plantate hortos, et comedite fructum eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:6
verses.text: Accipite uxores, et generate filios et filias : et date filiis vestris uxores, et filias vestras date viris, et pariant filios et filias : et multiplicamini ibi, et nolite esse pauci numero.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:7
verses.text: Et quærite pacem civitatis ad quam transmigrare vos feci, et orate pro ea ad Dominum, quia in pace illius erit pax vobis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:8
verses.text: Hæc enim dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Non vos seducant prophetæ vestri qui sunt in medio vestrum, et divini vestri, et ne attendatis ad somnia vestra quæ vos somniatis :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:9
verses.text: quia falso ipsi prophetant vobis in nomine meo, et non misi eos, dicit Dominus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:10
verses.text: Quia hæc dicit Dominus : Cum cœperint impleri in Babylone septuaginta anni, visitabo vos, et suscitabo super vos verbum meum bonum, ut reducam vos ad locum istum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:11
verses.text: Ego enim scio cogitationes quas ego cogito super vos, ait Dominus, cogitationes pacis et non afflictionis, ut dem vobis finem et patientiam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:12
verses.text: Et invocabitis me, et ibitis : et orabitis me, et ego exaudiam vos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:13
verses.text: Quæretis me, et invenietis, cum quæsieritis me in toto corde vestro.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:14
verses.text: Et inveniar a vobis, ait Dominus : et reducam captivitatem vestram, et congregabo vos de universis gentibus et de cunctis locis ad quæ expuli vos, dicit Dominus, et reverti vos faciam de loco ad quem transmigrare vos feci.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:15
verses.text: Quia dixistis : Suscitavit nobis Dominus prophetas in Babylone :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:16
verses.text: quia hæc dicit Dominus ad regem qui sedet super solium David, et ad omnem populum habitatorem urbis hujus, ad fratres vestros qui non sunt egressi vobiscum in transmigrationem :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:17
verses.text: hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ecce mittam in eos gladium, et famem, et pestem : et ponam eos quasi ficus malas, quæ comedi non possunt eo quod pessimæ sint :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:18
verses.text: et persequar eos in gladio, et in fame, et in pestilentia : et dabo eos in vexationem universis regnis terræ : in maledictionem, et in stuporem, et in sibilum, et in opprobrium cunctis gentibus ad quas ego ejeci eos,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:19
verses.text: eo quod non audierint verba mea, dicit Dominus, quæ misit ad eos per servos meos prophetas, de nocte consurgens et mittens : et non audistis, dicit Dominus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:20
verses.text: Vos ergo audite verbum Domini, omnis transmigratio quam emisi de Jerusalem in Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:21
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, ad Achab filium Coliæ, et ad Sedeciam filium Maasiæ, qui prophetant vobis in nomine meo mendaciter : Ecce ego tradam eos in manus Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, et percutiet eos in oculis vestris :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:22
verses.text: et assumetur ex eis maledictio omni transmigrationi Juda quæ est in Babylone, dicentium : Ponat te Dominus sicut Sedeciam et sicut Achab, quos frixit rex Babylonis in igne :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:23
verses.text: pro eo quod fecerint stultitiam in Israël, et mœchati sunt in uxores amicorum suorum, et locuti sunt verbum in nomine meo mendaciter, quod non mandavi eis. Ego sum judex et testis, dicit Dominus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:24
verses.text: Et ad Semeiam Nehelamiten dices :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:25
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Pro eo quod misisti in nomine tuo libros ad omnem populum qui est in Jerusalem, et ad Sophoniam filium Maasiæ sacerdotem, et ad universos sacerdotes, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:26
verses.text: Dominus dedit te sacerdotem pro Jojade sacerdote, ut sis dux in domo Domini, super omnem virum arreptitium et prophetantem, ut mittas eum in nervum et in carcerem :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:27
verses.text: et nunc quare non increpasti Jeremiam Anathothiten, qui prophetat vobis ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:28
verses.text: Quia super hoc misit in Babylonem ad nos, dicens : Longum est : ædificate domos, et habitate : et plantate hortos, et comedite fructus eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:29
verses.text: Legit ergo Sophonias sacerdos librum istum in auribus Jeremiæ prophetæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:30
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:31
verses.text: Mitte ad omnem transmigrationem, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus ad Semeiam Nehelamiten : Pro eo quod prophetavit vobis Semeias, et ego non misi eum, et fecit vos confidere in mendacio,

verses.name: Jeremiah 29:32
verses.text: idcirco hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego visitabo super Semeiam Nehelamiten, et super semen ejus : non erit ei vir sedens in medio populi hujus, et non videbit bonum quod ego faciam populo meo, ait Dominus, quia prævaricationem locutus est adversus Dominum.  <chapter eID="Jer.29"/> <div eID="gen24755" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:1
verses.text: Hoc verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:2
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël, dicens : Scribe tibi omnia verba quæ locutus sum ad te, in libro.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:3
verses.text: Ecce enim dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, et convertam conversionem populi mei Israël et Juda, ait Dominus : et convertam eos ad terram quam dedi patribus eorum, et possidebunt eam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:4
verses.text: Et hæc verba quæ locutus est Dominus ad Israël et ad Judam :  <div eID="gen24756" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9315"/><lg sID="gen24757"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9315"/>Quoniam hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24759"/>Vocem terroris audivimus : <l eID="gen24759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24760"/>formido, et non est pax. <l eID="gen24760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9316"/><l level="1" sID="gen24761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9316"/>Interrogate, et videte si generat masculus : <l eID="gen24761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24762"/>quare ergo vidi omnis viri manum <l eID="gen24762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24763"/>super lumbum suum, quasi parturientis, <l eID="gen24763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24764"/>et conversæ sunt universæ facies in auruginem ? <l eID="gen24764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9317"/><l level="1" sID="gen24765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9317"/>Væ ! quia magna dies illa, <l eID="gen24765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24766"/>nec est similis ejus : <l eID="gen24766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24767"/>tempusque tribulationis est Jacob, <l eID="gen24767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24768"/>et ex ipso salvabitur. <l eID="gen24768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9318"/><l level="1" sID="gen24769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9318"/>Et erit in die illa, ait Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen24769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24770"/>conteram jugum ejus de collo tuo, <l eID="gen24770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24771"/>et vincula ejus dirumpam, <l eID="gen24771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24772"/>et non dominabuntur ei amplius alieni : <l eID="gen24772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9319"/><l level="1" sID="gen24773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9319"/>sed servient Domino Deo suo, <l eID="gen24773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24774"/>et David regi suo, <l eID="gen24774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24775"/>quem suscitabo eis. <l eID="gen24775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9320"/><l level="1" sID="gen24776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9320"/>Tu ergo ne timeas, serve meus Jacob, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen24776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24777"/>neque paveas, Israël : <l eID="gen24777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24778"/>quia ecce ego salvabo te de terra longinqua, <l eID="gen24778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24779"/>et semen tuum de terra captivitatis eorum : <l eID="gen24779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24780"/>et revertetur Jacob, et quiescet, <l eID="gen24780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24781"/>et cunctis affluet bonis, et non erit quem formidet : <l eID="gen24781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9321"/><l level="1" sID="gen24782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9321"/>quoniam tecum ego sum, ait Dominus, ut salvem te. <l eID="gen24782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24783"/>Faciam enim consummationem in cunctis gentibus <l eID="gen24783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24784"/>in quibus dispersi te : <l eID="gen24784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24785"/>te autem non faciam in consummationem : <l eID="gen24785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24786"/>sed castigabo te in judicio, <l eID="gen24786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24787"/>ut non videaris tibi innoxius. <l eID="gen24787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9322"/><l level="1" sID="gen24788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9322"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24789"/>Insanabilis fractura tua ; <l eID="gen24789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24790"/>pessima plaga tua : <l eID="gen24790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9323"/><l level="1" sID="gen24791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9323"/>non est qui judicet judicium tuum ad alligandum : <l eID="gen24791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24792"/>curationum utilitas non est tibi. <l eID="gen24792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9324"/><l level="1" sID="gen24793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9324"/>Omnes amatores tui obliti sunt tui, <l eID="gen24793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24794"/>teque non quærent : <l eID="gen24794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24795"/>plaga enim inimici percussi te castigatione crudeli : <l eID="gen24795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24796"/>propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ dura facta sunt peccata tua. <l eID="gen24796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9325"/><l level="1" sID="gen24797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9325"/>Quid clamas super contritione tua ? <l eID="gen24797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24798"/>insanabilis est dolor tuus : <l eID="gen24798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24799"/>propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ, <l eID="gen24799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24800"/>et propter dura peccata tua, <l eID="gen24800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24801"/>feci hæc tibi. <l eID="gen24801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9326"/><l level="1" sID="gen24802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9326"/>Propterea omnes qui comedunt te devorabuntur, <l eID="gen24802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24803"/>et universi hostes tui in captivitatem ducentur : <l eID="gen24803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24804"/>et qui te vastant vastabuntur, <l eID="gen24804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24805"/>cunctosque prædatores tuos dabo in prædam. <l eID="gen24805" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9327"/><l level="1" sID="gen24806"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9327"/>Obducam enim cicatricem tibi, <l eID="gen24806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24807"/>et a vulneribus tuis sanabo te, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24808"/>Quia ejectam vocaverunt te, Sion : <l eID="gen24808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24809"/>hæc est, quæ non habebat requirentem. <l eID="gen24809" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9328"/><l level="1" sID="gen24810"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9328"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24811"/>Ecce ego convertam conversionem tabernaculorum Jacob, <l eID="gen24811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24812"/>et tectis ejus miserebor : <l eID="gen24812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24813"/>et ædificabitur civitas in excelso suo, <l eID="gen24813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24814"/>et templum juxta ordinem suum fundabitur : <l eID="gen24814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9329"/><l level="1" sID="gen24815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9329"/>et egredietur de eis laus, <l eID="gen24815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24816"/>voxque ludentium. <l eID="gen24816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24817"/>Et multiplicabo eos, et non minuentur : <l eID="gen24817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24818"/>et glorificabo eos, et non attenuabuntur. <l eID="gen24818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9330"/><l level="1" sID="gen24819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9330"/>Et erunt filii ejus sicut a principio, <l eID="gen24819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24820"/>et cœtus ejus coram me permanebit, <l eID="gen24820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24821"/>et visitabo adversum omnes qui tribulant eum. <l eID="gen24821" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9331"/><l level="1" sID="gen24822"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9331"/>Et erit dux ejus ex eo, <l eID="gen24822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24823"/>et princeps de medio ejus producetur : <l eID="gen24823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24824"/>et applicabo eum, et accedet ad me. <l eID="gen24824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24825"/>Quis enim iste est qui applicet cor suum <l eID="gen24825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24826"/>ut appropinquet mihi ? ait Dominus : <l eID="gen24826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9332"/><l level="1" sID="gen24827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9332"/>et eritis mihi in populum, et ego ero vobis in Deum. <l eID="gen24827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9333"/><l level="1" sID="gen24828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9333"/>Ecce turbo Domini, furor egrediens, procella ruens : <l eID="gen24828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24829"/>in capite impiorum conquiescet. <l eID="gen24829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9334"/><l level="1" sID="gen24830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9334"/>Non avertet iram indignationis Dominus, <l eID="gen24830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24831"/>donec faciat et compleat cogitationem cordis sui : <l eID="gen24831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24832"/>in novissimo dierum intelligetis ea.  <chapter eID="Jer.30"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:1
verses.text: In tempore illo, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24834"/>ero Deus universis cognationibus Israël, <l eID="gen24834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24835"/>et ipsi erunt mihi in populum. <l eID="gen24835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9335"/><l level="1" sID="gen24836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9335"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24837"/>Invenit gratiam in deserto populus qui remanserat a gladio : <l eID="gen24837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24838"/>vadet ad requiem suam Israël. <l eID="gen24838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9336"/><l level="1" sID="gen24839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9336"/>Longe Dominus apparuit mihi. <l eID="gen24839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24840"/>Et in caritate perpetua dilexi te : <l eID="gen24840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24841"/>ideo attraxi te, miserans. <l eID="gen24841" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9337"/><l level="1" sID="gen24842"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9337"/>Rursumque ædificabo te, et ædificaberis, virgo Israël : <l eID="gen24842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24843"/>adhuc ornaberis tympanis tuis, <l eID="gen24843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24844"/>et egredieris in choro ludentium. <l eID="gen24844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9338"/><l level="1" sID="gen24845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9338"/>Adhuc plantabis vineas in montibus Samariæ : <l eID="gen24845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24846"/>plantabunt plantantes, <l eID="gen24846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24847"/>et donec tempus veniat, non vindemiabunt. <l eID="gen24847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9339"/><l level="1" sID="gen24848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9339"/>Quia erit dies in qua clamabunt custodes in monte Ephraim : <l eID="gen24848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24849"/>Surgite, et ascendamus in Sion ad Dominum Deum nostrum. <l eID="gen24849" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9340"/><l level="1" sID="gen24850"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9340"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24851"/>Exsultate in lætitia, Jacob, <l eID="gen24851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24852"/>et hinnite contra caput gentium : <l eID="gen24852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24853"/>personate, et canite, et dicite : <l eID="gen24853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24854"/>Salva, Domine, populum tuum, reliquias Israël. <l eID="gen24854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9341"/><l level="1" sID="gen24855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9341"/>Ecce ego adducam eos de terra aquilonis, <l eID="gen24855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24856"/>et congregabo eos ab extremis terræ : <l eID="gen24856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24857"/>inter quos erunt cæcus et claudus, <l eID="gen24857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24858"/>prægnans et pariens simul, <l eID="gen24858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24859"/>cœtus magnus revertentium huc. <l eID="gen24859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9342"/><l level="1" sID="gen24860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9342"/>In fletu venient, <l eID="gen24860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24861"/>et in misericordia reducam eos : <l eID="gen24861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24862"/>et adducam eos per torrentes aquarum in via recta, <l eID="gen24862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24863"/>et non impingent in ea, <l eID="gen24863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24864"/>quia factus sum Israëli pater, <l eID="gen24864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24865"/>et Ephraim primogenitus meus est. <l eID="gen24865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9343"/><l level="1" sID="gen24866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9343"/>Audite verbum Domini, gentes, <l eID="gen24866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24867"/>et annuntiate in insulis quæ procul sunt, <l eID="gen24867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24868"/>et dicite : Qui dispersit Israël congregabit eum, <l eID="gen24868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24869"/>et custodiet eum sicut pastor gregem suum. <l eID="gen24869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9344"/><l level="1" sID="gen24870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9344"/>Redemit enim Dominus Jacob, <l eID="gen24870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24871"/>et liberavit eum de manu potentioris. <l eID="gen24871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9345"/><l level="1" sID="gen24872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9345"/>Et venient, et laudabunt in monte Sion : <l eID="gen24872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24873"/>et confluent ad bona Domini, <l eID="gen24873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24874"/>super frumento, et vino, et oleo, <l eID="gen24874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24875"/>et fœtu pecorum et armentorum : <l eID="gen24875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24876"/>eritque anima eorum quasi hortus irriguus, <l eID="gen24876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24877"/>et ultra non esurient. <l eID="gen24877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9346"/><l level="1" sID="gen24878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9346"/>Tunc lætabitur virgo in choro, <l eID="gen24878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24879"/>juvenes et senes simul : <l eID="gen24879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24880"/>et convertam luctum eorum in gaudium, <l eID="gen24880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24881"/>et consolabor eos, et lætificabo a dolore suo. <l eID="gen24881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9347"/><l level="1" sID="gen24882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9347"/>Et inebriabo animam sacerdotum pinguedine, <l eID="gen24882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24883"/>et populus meus bonis meis adimplebitur, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen24883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9348"/><l level="1" sID="gen24884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9348"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24885"/>Vox in excelso audita est lamentationis : <l eID="gen24885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24886"/>luctus, et fletus Rachel plorantis filios suos, <l eID="gen24886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24887"/>et nolentis consolari super eis, <l eID="gen24887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24888"/>quia non sunt. <l eID="gen24888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9349"/><l level="1" sID="gen24889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9349"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24890"/>Quiescat vox tua a ploratu, <l eID="gen24890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24891"/>et oculi tui a lacrimis, <l eID="gen24891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24892"/>quia est merces operi tuo, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen24892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24893"/>et revertentur de terra inimici : <l eID="gen24893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9350"/><l level="1" sID="gen24894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9350"/>et est spes novissimis tuis, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen24894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24895"/>et revertentur filii ad terminos suos. <l eID="gen24895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9351"/><l level="1" sID="gen24896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9351"/>Audiens audivi Ephraim transmigrantem : <l eID="gen24896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24897"/>Castigasti me, et eruditus sum, <l eID="gen24897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24898"/>quasi juvenculus indomitus : <l eID="gen24898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24899"/>converte me, et convertar, <l eID="gen24899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24900"/>quia tu Dominus Deus meus. <l eID="gen24900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9352"/><l level="1" sID="gen24901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9352"/>Postquam enim convertisti me, egi pœnitentiam : <l eID="gen24901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24902"/>et postquam ostendisti mihi, percussi femur meum. <l eID="gen24902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24903"/>Confusus sum, et erubui, <l eID="gen24903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24904"/>quoniam sustinui opprobrium adolescentiæ meæ. <l eID="gen24904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:20
