verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9353"/><l level="1" sID="gen24905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9353"/>Si filius honorabilis mihi Ephraim, <l eID="gen24905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24906"/>si puer delicatus ! <l eID="gen24906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24907"/>quia ex quo locutus sum de eo, <l eID="gen24907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24908"/>adhuc recordabor ejus. <l eID="gen24908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24909"/>Idcirco conturbata sunt viscera mea super eum : <l eID="gen24909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24910"/>miserans miserebor ejus, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen24910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9354"/><l level="1" sID="gen24911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9354"/>Statue tibi speculam ; <l eID="gen24911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24912"/>pone tibi amaritudines ; <l eID="gen24912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24913"/>dirige cor tuum in viam rectam in qua ambulasti : <l eID="gen24913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24914"/>revertere, virgo Israël, <l eID="gen24914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24915"/>revertere ad civitates tuas istas. <l eID="gen24915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9355"/><l level="1" sID="gen24916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9355"/>Usquequo deliciis dissolveris, filia vaga ? <l eID="gen24916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24917"/>quia creavit Dominus novum super terram : <l eID="gen24917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24918"/>femina circumdabit virum. <l eID="gen24918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9356"/><l level="1" sID="gen24919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9356"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen24919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24920"/>Adhuc dicent verbum istud <l eID="gen24920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24921"/>in terra Juda et in urbibus ejus, <l eID="gen24921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24922"/>cum convertero captivitatem eorum : <l eID="gen24922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24923"/>Benedicat tibi Dominus, pulchritudo justitiæ, mons sanctus : <l eID="gen24923" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9357"/><l level="1" sID="gen24924"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9357"/>et habitabunt in eo Judas et omnes civitates ejus simul, <l eID="gen24924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24925"/>agricolæ et minantes greges. <l eID="gen24925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9358"/><l level="1" sID="gen24926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9358"/>Quia inebriavi animam lassam, <l eID="gen24926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24927"/>et omnem animam esurientem saturavi. <l eID="gen24927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9359"/><l level="1" sID="gen24928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9359"/>Ideo quasi de somno suscitatus sum : <l eID="gen24928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24929"/>et vidi, et somnus meus dulcis mihi. <l eID="gen24929" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9360"/><l level="1" sID="gen24930"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9360"/>Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24931"/>et seminabo domum Israël et domum Juda <l eID="gen24931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24932"/>semine hominum et semine jumentorum. <l eID="gen24932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9361"/><l level="1" sID="gen24933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9361"/>Et sicut vigilavi super eos <l eID="gen24933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24934"/>ut evellerem, et demolirer, et dissiparem, <l eID="gen24934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24935"/>et disperderem, et affligerem, <l eID="gen24935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24936"/>sic vigilabo super eos <l eID="gen24936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24937"/>ut ædificem et plantem, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen24937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9362"/><l level="1" sID="gen24938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9362"/>In diebus illis non dicent ultra : <l eID="gen24938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24939"/>Patres comederunt uvam acerbam, <l eID="gen24939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24940"/>et dentes filiorum obstupuerunt. <l eID="gen24940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9363"/><l level="1" sID="gen24941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9363"/>Sed unusquisque in iniquitate sua morietur : <l eID="gen24941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24942"/>omnis homo qui comederit uvam acerbam, <l eID="gen24942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24943"/>obstupescent dentes ejus. <l eID="gen24943" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9364"/><l level="1" sID="gen24944"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9364"/>Ecce dies venient, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24945"/>et feriam domui Israël et domui Juda fœdus novum, <l eID="gen24945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9365"/><l level="1" sID="gen24946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9365"/>non secundum pactum quod pepigi cum patribus eorum <l eID="gen24946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24947"/>in die qua apprehendi manum eorum <l eID="gen24947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24948"/>ut educerem eos de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen24948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24949"/>pactum quod irritum fecerunt : <l eID="gen24949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24950"/>et ego dominatus sum eorum, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9366"/><l level="1" sID="gen24951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9366"/>Sed hoc erit pactum quod feriam cum domo Israël <l eID="gen24951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24952"/>post dies illos, dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24953"/>dabo legem meam in visceribus eorum, <l eID="gen24953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24954"/>et in corde eorum scribam eam, <l eID="gen24954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24955"/>et ero eis in Deum, <l eID="gen24955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24956"/>et ipsi erunt mihi in populum : <l eID="gen24956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9367"/><l level="1" sID="gen24957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9367"/>et non docebit ultra vir proximum suum <l eID="gen24957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24958"/>et vir fratrem suum, <l eID="gen24958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24959"/>dicens : Cognosce Dominum : <l eID="gen24959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24960"/>omnes enim cognoscent me, <l eID="gen24960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24961"/>a minimo eorum usque ad maximum, ait Dominus : <l eID="gen24961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24962"/>quia propitiabor iniquitati eorum, <l eID="gen24962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24963"/>et peccati eorum non memorabor amplius. <l eID="gen24963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9368"/><l level="1" sID="gen24964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9368"/>Hæc dicit Dominus qui dat solem in lumine diei, <l eID="gen24964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24965"/>ordinem lunæ et stellarum in lumine noctis : <l eID="gen24965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24966"/>qui turbat mare, et sonant fluctus ejus : <l eID="gen24966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24967"/>Dominus exercituum nomen illi : <l eID="gen24967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9369"/><l level="1" sID="gen24968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9369"/>Si defecerint leges istæ coram me, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24969"/>tunc et semen Israël deficiet, <l eID="gen24969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24970"/>ut non sit gens coram me cunctis diebus. <l eID="gen24970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9370"/><l level="1" sID="gen24971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9370"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen24971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24972"/>Si mensurari potuerint cæli sursum, <l eID="gen24972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24973"/>et investigari fundamenta terræ deorsum, <l eID="gen24973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24974"/>et ego abjiciam universum semen Israël, <l eID="gen24974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24975"/>propter omnia quæ fecerunt, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen24975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9371"/><l level="1" sID="gen24976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9371"/>Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen24976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24977"/>et ædificabitur civitas Domino, <l eID="gen24977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24978"/>a turre Hananeel usque ad portam anguli. <l eID="gen24978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9372"/><l level="1" sID="gen24979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9372"/>Et exibit ultra norma mensuræ <l eID="gen24979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24980"/>in conspectu ejus super collem Gareb, <l eID="gen24980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24981"/>et circuibit Goatha, <l eID="gen24981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 31:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9373"/><l level="1" sID="gen24982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9373"/>et omnem vallem cadaverum, et cineris, <l eID="gen24982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24983"/>et universam regionem mortis <l eID="gen24983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24984"/>usque ad torrentem Cedron, <l eID="gen24984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24985"/>et usque ad angulum portæ equorum orientalis, <l eID="gen24985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24986"/>Sanctum Domini : <l eID="gen24986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24987"/>non evelletur, et non destruetur ultra in perpetuum. <l eID="gen24987" level="1"/><lg eID="gen24757"/> <chapter eID="Jer.31"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, in anno decimo Sedeciæ regis Juda, ipse est annus decimusoctavus Nabuchodonosor.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:2
verses.text: Tunc exercitus regis Babylonis obsidebat Jerusalem, et Jeremias propheta erat clausus in atrio carceris qui erat in domo regis Juda.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:3
verses.text: Clauserat enim eum Sedecias rex Juda, dicens : Quare vaticinaris, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego dabo civitatem istam in manus regis Babylonis, et capiet eam :

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:4
verses.text: et Sedecias rex Juda non effugiet de manu Chaldæorum, sed tradetur in manus regis Babylonis : et loquetur os ejus cum ore illius, et oculi ejus oculos illius videbunt :

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:5
verses.text: et in Babylonem ducet Sedeciam, et ibi erit donec visitem eum, ait Dominus : si autem dimicaveritis adversum Chaldæos, nihil prosperum habebitis ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:6
verses.text: Et dixit Jeremias : Factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:7
verses.text: Ecce Hanameel filius Sellum, patruelis tuus, veniet ad te, dicens : Eme tibi agrum meum qui est in Anathoth, tibi enim competit ex propinquitate ut emas.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:8
verses.text: Et venit ad me Hanameel filius patrui mei, secundum verbum Domini, ad vestibulum carceris, et ait ad me : Posside agrum meum qui est in Anathoth, in terra Benjamin, quia tibi competit hæreditas, et tu propinquus es ut possideas. Intellexi autem quod verbum Domini esset :

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:9
verses.text: et emi agrum ab Hanameel filio patrui mei, qui est in Anathoth, et appendi ei argentum : septem stateres, et decem argenteos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:10
verses.text: Et scripsi in libro, et signavi, et adhibui testes, et appendi argentum in statera.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:11
verses.text: Et accepi librum possessionis signatum, et stipulationes, et rata, et signa forinsecus :

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:12
verses.text: et dedi librum possessionis Baruch filio Neri filii Maasiæ, in oculis Hanameel patruelis mei, in oculis testium qui scripti erant in libro emptionis, et in oculis omnium Judæorum qui sedebant in atrio carceris.

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:13
verses.text: Et præcepi Baruch coram eis, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:14
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Sume libros istos, librum emptionis hunc signatum, et librum hunc qui apertus est, et pone illos in vase fictili, ut permanere possint diebus multis :

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:15
verses.text: hæc enim dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Adhuc possidebuntur domus, et agri, et vineæ in terra ista.  <div eID="gen24988" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9374"/><div sID="gen24989" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9374"/>Et oravi ad Dominum, postquam tradidi librum possessionis Baruch filio Neri, dicens :  <div eID="gen24989" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9375"/><lg sID="gen24990"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9375"/>Heu ! heu ! heu ! Domine Deus, <l eID="gen24991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24992"/>ecce tu fecisti cælum et terram <l eID="gen24992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24993"/>in fortitudine tua magna, et in brachio tuo extento : <l eID="gen24993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24994"/>non erit tibi difficile omne verbum : <l eID="gen24994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9376"/><l level="1" sID="gen24995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9376"/>qui facis misericordiam in millibus, <l eID="gen24995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24996"/>et reddis iniquitatem patrum in sinum filiorum eorum post eos : <l eID="gen24996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24997"/>fortissime, magne, et potens, <l eID="gen24997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen24998"/>Dominus exercituum nomen tibi. <l eID="gen24998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9377"/><l level="1" sID="gen24999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9377"/>Magnus consilio, et incomprehensibilis cogitatu : <l eID="gen24999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25000"/>cujus oculi aperti sunt super omnes vias filiorum Adam, <l eID="gen25000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25001"/>ut reddas unicuique secundum vias suas, <l eID="gen25001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25002"/>et secundum fructum adinventionum ejus. <l eID="gen25002" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9378"/><l level="1" sID="gen25003"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9378"/>Qui posuisti signa et portenta <l eID="gen25003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25004"/>in terra Ægypti usque ad diem hanc, <l eID="gen25004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25005"/>et in Israël, et in hominibus, <l eID="gen25005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25006"/>et fecisti tibi nomen sicut est dies hæc. <l eID="gen25006" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9379"/><l level="1" sID="gen25007"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9379"/>Et eduxisti populum tuum Israël de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen25007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25008"/>in signis et in portentis, <l eID="gen25008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25009"/>et in manu robusta et in brachio extento, <l eID="gen25009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25010"/>et in terrore magno : <l eID="gen25010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9380"/><l level="1" sID="gen25011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9380"/>et dedisti eis terram hanc, <l eID="gen25011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25012"/>quam jurasti patribus eorum ut dares eis, <l eID="gen25012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25013"/>terram fluentem lacte et melle. <l eID="gen25013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9381"/><l level="1" sID="gen25014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9381"/>Et ingressi sunt, et possederunt eam, <l eID="gen25014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25015"/>et non obedierunt voci tuæ, <l eID="gen25015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25016"/>et in lege tua non ambulaverunt : <l eID="gen25016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25017"/>omnia quæ mandasti eis ut facerent non fecerunt, <l eID="gen25017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25018"/>et evenerunt eis omnia mala hæc. <l eID="gen25018" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9382"/><l level="1" sID="gen25019"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9382"/>Ecce munitiones exstructæ sunt adversum civitatem ut capiatur, <l eID="gen25019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25020"/>et urbs data est in manus Chaldæorum <l eID="gen25020" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25021"/>qui præliantur adversus eam, <l eID="gen25021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25022"/>a facie gladii, et famis, et pestilentiæ : <l eID="gen25022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25023"/>et quæcumque locutus es, acciderunt, <l eID="gen25023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25024"/>ut tu ipse cernis. <l eID="gen25024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9383"/><l level="1" sID="gen25025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9383"/>Et tu dicis mihi, Domine Deus : <l eID="gen25025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25026"/>Eme agrum argento, et adhibe testes, <l eID="gen25026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25027"/>cum urbs data sit in manus Chaldæorum ? <l eID="gen25027" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen24990"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9384"/><div sID="gen25028" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9384"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, dicens :  <div eID="gen25028" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9385"/><lg sID="gen25029"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9385"/>Ecce ego Dominus Deus universæ carnis : <l eID="gen25030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25031"/>numquid mihi difficile erit omne verbum ? <l eID="gen25031" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9386"/><l level="1" sID="gen25032"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9386"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25033"/>Ecce ego tradam civitatem istam in manus Chaldæorum, <l eID="gen25033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25034"/>et in manus regis Babylonis, <l eID="gen25034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25035"/>et capient eam. <l eID="gen25035" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9387"/><l level="1" sID="gen25036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9387"/>Et venient Chaldæi præliantes adversum urbem hanc, <l eID="gen25036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25037"/>et succendent eam igni, et comburent eam, <l eID="gen25037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25038"/>et domos in quarum domatibus sacrificabant Baal, <l eID="gen25038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25039"/>et libabant diis alienis libamina ad irritandum me. <l eID="gen25039" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9388"/><l level="1" sID="gen25040"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9388"/>Erant enim filii Israël et filii Juda <l eID="gen25040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25041"/>jugiter facientes malum in oculis meis ab adolescentia sua : <l eID="gen25041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25042"/>filii Israël, qui usque nunc exacerbant me <l eID="gen25042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25043"/>in opere manuum suarum, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen25043" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9389"/><l level="1" sID="gen25044"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9389"/>Quia in furore et in indignatione mea facta est mihi civitas hæc, <l eID="gen25044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25045"/>a die qua ædificaverunt eam <l eID="gen25045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25046"/>usque ad diem istam qua auferetur de conspectu meo, <l eID="gen25046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9390"/><l level="1" sID="gen25047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9390"/>propter malitiam filiorum Israël et filiorum Juda, <l eID="gen25047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25048"/>quam fecerunt ad iracundiam me provocantes, <l eID="gen25048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25049"/>ipsi et reges eorum, <l eID="gen25049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25050"/>principes eorum, et sacerdotes eorum, et prophetæ eorum, <l eID="gen25050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25051"/>viri Juda et habitatores Jerusalem. <l eID="gen25051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9391"/><l level="1" sID="gen25052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9391"/>Et verterunt ad me terga, et non facies, <l eID="gen25052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25053"/>cum docerem eos diluculo et erudirem, <l eID="gen25053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25054"/>et nollent audire, ut acciperent disciplinam. <l eID="gen25054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9392"/><l level="1" sID="gen25055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9392"/>Et posuerunt idola sua in domo in qua invocatum est nomen meum, <l eID="gen25055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25056"/>ut polluerent eam. <l eID="gen25056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9393"/><l level="1" sID="gen25057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9393"/>Et ædificaverunt excelsa Baal <l eID="gen25057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25058"/>quæ sunt in valle filii Ennom, <l eID="gen25058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25059"/>ut initiarent filios suos et filias suas Moloch, <l eID="gen25059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25060"/>quod non mandavi eis, <l eID="gen25060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25061"/>nec ascendit in cor meum ut facerent abominationem hanc : <l eID="gen25061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25062"/>et in peccatum deducerent Judam. <l eID="gen25062" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9394"/><l level="1" sID="gen25063"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9394"/>Et nunc propter ista, <l eID="gen25063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25064"/>hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël ad civitatem hanc, <l eID="gen25064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25065"/>de qua vos dicitis quod tradetur in manus regis Babylonis, <l eID="gen25065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25066"/>in gladio, et in fame, et in peste : <l eID="gen25066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9395"/><l level="1" sID="gen25067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9395"/>Ecce ego congregabo eos de universis terris ad quas ejeci eos <l eID="gen25067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25068"/>in furore meo, et in ira mea, et in indignatione grandi : <l eID="gen25068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25069"/>et reducam eos ad locum istum, <l eID="gen25069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25070"/>et habitare eos faciam confidenter : <l eID="gen25070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9396"/><l level="1" sID="gen25071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9396"/>et erunt mihi in populum, <l eID="gen25071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25072"/>et ego ero eis in Deum. <l eID="gen25072" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9397"/><l level="1" sID="gen25073"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9397"/>Et dabo eis cor unum, et viam unam, <l eID="gen25073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25074"/>ut timeant me universis diebus, <l eID="gen25074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25075"/>et bene sit eis, et filiis eorum post eos. <l eID="gen25075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9398"/><l level="1" sID="gen25076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9398"/>Et feriam eis pactum sempiternum, <l eID="gen25076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25077"/>et non desinam eis benefacere : <l eID="gen25077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25078"/>et timorem meum dabo in corde eorum, <l eID="gen25078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25079"/>ut non recedant a me. <l eID="gen25079" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9399"/><l level="1" sID="gen25080"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9399"/>Et lætabor super eis, cum bene eis fecero : <l eID="gen25080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25081"/>et plantabo eos in terra ista in veritate, <l eID="gen25081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25082"/>in toto corde meo et in tota anima mea. <l eID="gen25082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9400"/><l level="1" sID="gen25083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9400"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25084"/>Sicut adduxi super populum istum omne malum hoc grande, <l eID="gen25084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25085"/>sic adducam super eos <l eID="gen25085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25086"/>omne bonum quod ego loquor ad eos. <l eID="gen25086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9401"/><l level="1" sID="gen25087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9401"/>Et possidebuntur agri in terra ista, <l eID="gen25087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25088"/>de qua vos dicitis quod deserta sit, <l eID="gen25088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25089"/>eo quod non remanserit homo et jumentum, <l eID="gen25089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25090"/>et data sit in manus Chaldæorum. <l eID="gen25090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 32:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9402"/><l level="1" sID="gen25091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9402"/>Agri ementur pecunia, et scribentur in libro, <l eID="gen25091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25092"/>et imprimetur signum, et testis adhibebitur, <l eID="gen25092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25093"/>in terra Benjamin et in circuitu Jerusalem, <l eID="gen25093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25094"/>in civitatibus Juda, et in civitatibus montanis, <l eID="gen25094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25095"/>et in civitatibus campestribus, et in civitatibus quæ ad austrum sunt, <l eID="gen25095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25096"/>quia convertam captivitatem eorum, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25096" level="1"/><lg eID="gen25029"/> <chapter eID="Jer.32"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam secundo, cum adhuc clausus esset in atrio carceris, dicens :  <div eID="gen25097" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9403"/><lg sID="gen25098"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9403"/>Hæc dicit Dominus, qui facturus est, <l eID="gen25099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25100"/>et formaturus illud, et paraturus : <l eID="gen25100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25101"/>Dominus nomen ejus : <l eID="gen25101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9404"/><l level="1" sID="gen25102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9404"/>Clama ad me, et exaudiam te, <l eID="gen25102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25103"/>et annuntiabo tibi grandia et firma quæ nescis. <l eID="gen25103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9405"/><l level="1" sID="gen25104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9405"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël <l eID="gen25104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25105"/>ad domos urbis hujus, <l eID="gen25105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25106"/>et ad domos regis Juda, quæ destructæ sunt, <l eID="gen25106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25107"/>et ad munitiones, et ad gladium <l eID="gen25107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9406"/><l level="1" sID="gen25108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9406"/>venientium ut dimicent cum Chaldæis, <l eID="gen25108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25109"/>et impleant eas cadaveribus hominum <l eID="gen25109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25110"/>quos percussi in furore meo et in indignatione mea, <l eID="gen25110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25111"/>abscondens faciem meam a civitate hac, <l eID="gen25111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25112"/>propter omnem malitiam eorum : <l eID="gen25112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9407"/><l level="1" sID="gen25113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9407"/>Ecce ego obducam eis cicatricem et sanitatem, <l eID="gen25113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25114"/>et curabo eos, et revelabo illis deprecationem pacis et veritatis. <l eID="gen25114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9408"/><l level="1" sID="gen25115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9408"/>Et convertam conversionem Juda et conversionem Jerusalem, <l eID="gen25115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25116"/>et ædificabo eos sicut a principio. <l eID="gen25116" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9409"/><l level="1" sID="gen25117"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9409"/>Et emundabo illos ab omni iniquitate sua <l eID="gen25117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25118"/>in qua peccaverunt mihi, <l eID="gen25118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25119"/>et propitius ero cunctis iniquitatibus eorum, <l eID="gen25119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25120"/>in quibus dereliquerunt mihi et spreverunt me. <l eID="gen25120" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9410"/><l level="1" sID="gen25121"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9410"/>Et erit mihi in nomen, et in gaudium, <l eID="gen25121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25122"/>et in laudem, et in exsultationem <l eID="gen25122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25123"/>cunctis gentibus terræ, <l eID="gen25123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25124"/>quæ audierint omnia bona quæ ego facturus sum eis : <l eID="gen25124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25125"/>et pavebunt et turbabuntur in universis bonis, <l eID="gen25125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25126"/>et in omni pace quam ego faciam eis. <l eID="gen25126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9411"/><l level="1" sID="gen25127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9411"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25128"/>Adhuc audietur in loco isto <l eID="gen25128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25129"/>quem vos dicitis esse desertum, <l eID="gen25129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25130"/>eo quod non sit homo nec jumentum <l eID="gen25130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25131"/>in civitatibus Juda, et foris Jerusalem, <l eID="gen25131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25132"/>quæ desolatæ sunt, absque homine, <l eID="gen25132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25133"/>et absque habitatore, et absque pecore, <l eID="gen25133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9412"/><l level="1" sID="gen25134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9412"/>vox gaudii et vox lætitiæ, <l eID="gen25134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25135"/>vox sponsi et vox sponsæ, <l eID="gen25135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25136"/>vox dicentium : Confitemini Domino exercituum, <l eID="gen25136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25137"/>quoniam bonus Dominus, <l eID="gen25137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25138"/>quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus : <l eID="gen25138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25139"/>et portantium vota in domum Domini : <l eID="gen25139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25140"/>reducam enim conversionem terræ <l eID="gen25140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25141"/>sicut a principio, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen25141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9413"/><l level="1" sID="gen25142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9413"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen25142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25143"/>Adhuc erit in loco isto deserto, <l eID="gen25143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25144"/>absque homine et absque jumento, <l eID="gen25144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25145"/>et in cunctis civitatibus ejus, <l eID="gen25145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25146"/>habitaculum pastorum accubantium gregum. <l eID="gen25146" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9414"/><l level="1" sID="gen25147"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9414"/>In civitatibus montuosis, <l eID="gen25147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25148"/>et in civitatibus campestribus, <l eID="gen25148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25149"/>et in civitatibus quæ ad austrum sunt, <l eID="gen25149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25150"/>et in terra Benjamin, et in circuitu Jerusalem, <l eID="gen25150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25151"/>et in civitatibus Juda, <l eID="gen25151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25152"/>adhuc transibunt greges ad manum numerantis, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9415"/><l level="1" sID="gen25153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9415"/>Ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen25153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25154"/>et suscitabo verbum bonum quod locutus sum <l eID="gen25154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25155"/>ad domum Israël et ad domum Juda. <l eID="gen25155" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9416"/><l level="1" sID="gen25156"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9416"/>In diebus illis et in tempore illo <l eID="gen25156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25157"/>germinare faciam David germen justitiæ, <l eID="gen25157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25158"/>et faciet judicium et justitiam in terra : <l eID="gen25158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9417"/><l level="1" sID="gen25159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9417"/>in diebus illis salvabitur Juda, <l eID="gen25159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25160"/>et Jerusalem habitabit confidenter : <l eID="gen25160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25161"/>et hoc est nomen quod vocabunt eum : <l eID="gen25161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25162"/>Dominus justus noster. <l eID="gen25162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9418"/><l level="1" sID="gen25163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9418"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25164"/>Non interibit de David vir qui sedeat super thronum domus Israël : <l eID="gen25164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9419"/><l level="1" sID="gen25165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9419"/>et de sacerdotibus et de Levitis non interibit vir a facie mea, <l eID="gen25165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25166"/>qui offerat holocautomata, <l eID="gen25166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25167"/>et incendat sacrificum, <l eID="gen25167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25168"/>et cædat victimas omnibus diebus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:19
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, dicens : <l eID="gen25168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9420"/><l level="1" sID="gen25169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9420"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25170"/>Si irritum potest fieri pactum meum cum die, <l eID="gen25170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25171"/>et pactum meum cum nocte, <l eID="gen25171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25172"/>ut non sit dies et nox in tempore suo, <l eID="gen25172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9421"/><l level="1" sID="gen25173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9421"/>et pactum meum irritum esse poterit cum David servo meo, <l eID="gen25173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25174"/>ut non sit ex eo filius qui regnet in throno ejus, <l eID="gen25174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25175"/>et Levitæ et sacerdotes ministri mei. <l eID="gen25175" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9422"/><l level="1" sID="gen25176"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9422"/>Sicuti enumerari non possunt stellæ cæli, <l eID="gen25176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25177"/>et metiri arena maris, <l eID="gen25177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25178"/>sic multiplicabo semen David servi mei, <l eID="gen25178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25179"/>et Levitas ministros meos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:23
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, dicens : <l eID="gen25179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9423"/><l level="1" sID="gen25180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9423"/>Numquid non vidisti quid populus hic locutus sit, dicens : <l eID="gen25180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25181"/>Duæ cognationes quas elegerat Dominus abjectæ sunt ? <l eID="gen25181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25182"/>et populum meum despexerunt, <l eID="gen25182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25183"/>eo quod non sit ultra gens coram eis. <l eID="gen25183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9424"/><l level="1" sID="gen25184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9424"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25185"/>Si pactum meum inter diem et noctem, <l eID="gen25185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25186"/>et leges cælo et terræ non posui, <l eID="gen25186" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 33:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9425"/><l level="1" sID="gen25187"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9425"/>equidem et semen Jacob et David servi mei projiciam, <l eID="gen25187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25188"/>ut non assumam de semine ejus <l eID="gen25188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25189"/>principes seminis Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob : <l eID="gen25189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25190"/>reducam enim conversionem eorum, et miserebor eis. <l eID="gen25190" level="1"/><lg eID="gen25098"/> <chapter eID="Jer.33"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino quando Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, et omnis exercitus ejus, universaque regna terræ quæ erant sub potestate manus ejus, et omnes populi, bellabant contra Jerusalem, et contra omnes urbes ejus, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:2
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Vade, et loquere ad Sedeciam regem Juda, et dices ad eum : Hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego tradam civitatem hanc in manus regis Babylonis, et succendet eam igni :

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:3
verses.text: et tu non effugies de manu ejus, sed comprehensione capieris, et in manu ejus traderis : et oculi tui oculos regis Babylonis videbunt, et os ejus cum ore tuo loquetur, et Babylonem introibis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:4
verses.text: Attamen audi verbum Domini, Sedecia, rex Juda : Hæc dicit Dominus ad te : Non morieris in gladio,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:5
verses.text: sed in pace morieris : et secundum combustiones patrum tuorum, regum priorum qui fuerunt ante te, sic comburent te : et : Væ domine, plangent te : quia verbum ego locutus sum, dicit Dominus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:6
verses.text: Et locutus est Jeremias propheta ad Sedeciam regem Juda universa verba hæc in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:7
verses.text: Et exercitus regis Babylonis pugnabat contra Jerusalem, et contra omnes civitates Juda quæ reliquæ erant, contra Lachis et contra Azecha : hæ enim supererant de civitatibus Juda, urbes munitæ.  <div eID="gen25191" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9426"/><div sID="gen25192" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9426"/>Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino, postquam percussit rex Sedecias fœdus cum omni populo in Jerusalem, prædicans

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:9
verses.text: ut dimitteret unusquisque servum suum et unusquisque ancillam suam, Hebræum et Hebræam, liberos, et nequaquam dominarentur eis, id est, in Judæo et fratre suo.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:10
verses.text: Audierunt ergo omnes principes et universus populus qui inierant pactum ut dimitteret unusquisque servum suum et unusquisque ancillam suam liberos, et ultra non dominarentur eis : audierunt igitur, et dimiserunt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:11
verses.text: Et conversi sunt deinceps : et retraxerunt servos et ancillas suas quos dimiserant liberos, et subjugaverunt in famulos et famulas.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:12
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:13
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Ego percussi fœdus cum patribus vestris in die qua eduxi eos de terra Ægypti, de domo servitutis, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:14
verses.text: Cum completi fuerint septem anni, dimittat unusquisque fratrem suum Hebræum, qui venditus est ei : et serviet tibi sex annis, et dimittes eum a te liberum : et non audierunt patres vestri me, nec inclinaverunt aurem suam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:15
verses.text: Et conversi estis vos hodie, et fecistis quod rectum est in oculis meis, ut prædicaretis libertatem unusquisque ad amicum suum : et inistis pactum in conspectu meo, in domo in qua invocatum est nomen meum super eam :

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:16
verses.text: et reversi estis, et commaculastis nomen meum, et reduxistis unusquisque servum suum et unusquisque ancillam suam quos dimiseratis ut essent liberi et suæ potestatis, et subjugastis eos ut sint vobis servi et ancillæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:17
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus : Vos non audistis me, ut prædicaretis libertatem unusquisque fratri suo et unusquisque amico suo : ecce ego prædico vobis libertatem, ait Dominus, ad gladium, ad pestem, et ad famem, et dabo vos in commotionem cunctis regnis terræ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:18
verses.text: Et dabo viros qui prævaricantur fœdus meum, et non observaverunt verba fœderis quibus assensi sunt in conspectu meo, vitulum quem conciderunt in duas partes, et transierunt inter divisiones ejus,

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:19
verses.text: principes Juda et principes Jerusalem, eunuchi et sacerdotes, et omnis populus terræ, qui transierunt inter divisiones vituli :

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:20
verses.text: et dabo eos in manus inimicorum suorum, et in manus quærentium animam eorum, et erit morticinum eorum in escam volatilibus cæli et bestiis terræ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:21
verses.text: Et Sedeciam regem Juda, et principes ejus, dabo in manus inimicorum suorum, et in manus quærentium animas eorum, et in manus exercituum regis Babylonis, qui recesserunt a vobis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 34:22
verses.text: Ecce ego præcipio, dicit Dominus, et reducam eos in civitatem hanc, et præliabuntur adversus eam, et capient eam, et incendent igni : et civitates Juda dabo in solitudinem, eo quod non sit habitator.  <chapter eID="Jer.34"/> <div eID="gen25192" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino in diebus Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:2
verses.text: Vade ad domum Rechabitarum, et loquere eis, et introduces eos in domum Domini, in unam exedram thesaurorum, et dabis eis bibere vinum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:3
verses.text: Et assumpsi Jezoniam filium Jeremiæ filii Habsaniæ, et fratres ejus, et omnes filios ejus, et universam domum Rechabitarum,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:4
verses.text: et introduxi eos in domum Domini, ad gazophylacium filiorum Hanan filii Jegedeliæ hominis Dei, quod erat juxta gazophylacium principum, super thesaurum Maasiæ filii Sellum, qui erat custos vestibuli :

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:5
verses.text: et posui coram filiis domus Rechabitarum scyphos plenos vino, et calices, et dixi ad eos : Bibite vinum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:6
verses.text: Qui responderunt Non bibemus vinum, quia Jonadab filius Rechab, pater noster, præcepit nobis, dicens : Non bibetis vinum, vos et filii vestri, usque in sempiternum :

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:7
verses.text: et domum non ædificabitis, et sementem non seretis, et vineas non plantabitis, nec habebitis : sed in tabernaculis habitabitis cunctis diebus vestris, ut vivatis diebus multis super faciem terræ in qua vos peregrinamini.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:8
verses.text: Obedivimus ergo voci Jonadab filii Rechab, patris nostri, in omnibus quæ præcepit nobis, ita ut non biberemus vinum cunctis diebus nostris, nos, et mulieres nostræ, filii, et filiæ nostræ,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:9
verses.text: et non ædificaremus domos ad habitandum : et vineam, et agrum, et sementem non habuimus :

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:10
verses.text: sed habitavimus in tabernaculis, et obedientes fuimus juxta omnia quæ præcepit nobis Jonadab pater noster.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:11
verses.text: Cum autem ascendisset Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis ad terram nostram, diximus : Venite, et ingrediamur Jerusalem a facie exercitus Chaldæorum, et a facie exercitus Syriæ : et mansimus in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:12
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:13
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Vade, et dic viris Juda et habitatoribus Jerusalem : Numquid non recipietis disciplinam, ut obediatis verbis meis ? dicit Dominus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:14
verses.text: Prævaluerunt sermones Jonadab filii Rechab quos præcepit filiis suis ut non biberent vinum, et non biberunt usque ad diem hanc, quia obedierunt præcepto patris sui : ego autem locutus sum ad vos, de mane consurgens et loquens, et non obedistis mihi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:15
verses.text: Misique ad vos omnes servos meos prophetas, consurgens diluculo mittensque, et dicens : Convertimini unusquisque a via sua pessima, et bona facite studia vestra : et nolite sequi deos alienos, neque colatis eos, et habitabitis in terra quam dedi vobis et patribus vestris : et non inclinastis aurem vestram, neque audistis me.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:16
verses.text: Firmaverunt igitur filii Jonadab filii Rechab præceptum patris sui quod præceperat eis : populus autem iste non obedivit mihi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:17
verses.text: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego adducam super Juda et super omnes habitatores Jerusalem universam afflictionem quam locutus sum adversum illos, eo quod locutus sum ad illos, et non audierunt ; vocavi illos, et non responderunt mihi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:18
verses.text: Domui autem Rechabitarum dixit Jeremias : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Pro eo quod obedistis præcepto Jonadab patris vestri, et custodistis omnia mandata ejus, et fecistis universa quæ præcepit vobis,

verses.name: Jeremiah 35:19
verses.text: propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Non deficiet vir de stirpe Jonadab filii Rechab, stans in conspectu meo cunctis diebus.  <chapter eID="Jer.35"/> <div eID="gen25193" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:1
verses.text: Et factum est in anno quarto Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda, factum est verbum hoc ad Jeremiam a Domino, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:2
verses.text: Tolle volumen libri, et scribes in eo omnia verba quæ locutus sum tibi adversum Israël et Judam, et adversum omnes gentes, a die qua locutus sum ad te ex diebus Josiæ usque ad diem hanc :

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:3
verses.text: si forte, audiente domo Juda universa mala quæ ego cogito facere eis, revertatur unusquisque a via sua pessima, et propitius ero iniquitati et peccato eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:4
verses.text: Vocavit ergo Jeremias Baruch filium Neriæ : et scripsit Baruch ex ore Jeremiæ omnes sermones Domini quos locutus est ad eum, in volumine libri :

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:5
verses.text: et præcepit Jeremias Baruch, dicens : Ego clausus sum, nec valeo ingredi domum Domini.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:6
verses.text: Ingredere ergo tu, et lege de volumine in quo scripsisti ex ore meo verba Domini, audiente populo in domo Domini, in die jejunii : insuper et audiente universo Juda qui veniunt de civitatibus suis, leges eis,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:7
verses.text: si forte cadat oratio eorum in conspectu Domini, et revertatur unusquisque a via sua pessima : quoniam magnus furor et indignatio est quam locutus est Dominus adversus populum hunc.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:8
verses.text: Et fecit Baruch filius Neriæ juxta omnia quæ præceperat ei Jeremias propheta, legens ex volumine sermones Domini in domo Domini.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:9
verses.text: Factum est autem in anno quinto Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda, in mense nono : prædicaverunt jejunium in conspectu Domini omni populo in Jerusalem, et universæ multitudini quæ confluxerat de civitatibus Juda in Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:10
verses.text: Legitque Baruch ex volumine sermones Jeremiæ in domo Domini, in gazophylacio Gamariæ filii Saphan scribæ, in vestibulo superiori, in introitu portæ novæ domus Domini, audiente omni populo.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:11
verses.text: Cumque audisset Michæas filius Gamariæ filii Saphan omnes sermones Domini ex libro,

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:12
verses.text: descendit in domum regis, ad gazophylacium scribæ, et ecce ibi omnes principes sedebant : Elisama scriba, et Dalaias filius Semeiæ, et Elnathan filius Achobor, et Gamarias filius Saphan, et Sedecias filius Hananiæ, et universi principes :

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:13
verses.text: et nuntiavit eis Michæas omnia verba quæ audivit, legente Baruch ex volumine in auribus populi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:14
verses.text: Miserunt itaque omnes principes ad Baruch Judi filium Nathaniæ filii Selemiæ filii Chusi, dicentes : Volumen ex quo legisti, audiente populo, sume in manu tua, et veni. Tulit ergo Baruch filius Neriæ volumen in manu sua, et venit ad eos :

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:15
verses.text: et dixerunt ad eum : Sede, et lege hæc in auribus nostris. Et legit Baruch in auribus eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:16
verses.text: Igitur cum audissent omnia verba, obstupuerunt unusquisque ad proximum suum, et dixerunt ad Baruch : Nuntiare debemus regi omnes sermones istos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:17
verses.text: Et interrogaverunt eum, dicentes : Indica nobis quomodo scripsisti omnes sermones istos ex ore ejus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:18
verses.text: Dixit autem eis Baruch : Ex ore suo loquebatur quasi legens ad me omnes sermones istos, et ego scribebam in volumine atramento.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:19
verses.text: Et dixerunt principes ad Baruch : Vade, et abscondere, tu et Jeremias, et nemo sciat ubi sitis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:20
verses.text: Et ingressi sunt ad regem in atrium : porro volumen commendaverunt in gazophylacio Elisamæ scribæ, et nuntiaverunt, audiente rege, omnes sermones.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:21
verses.text: Misitque rex Judi ut sumeret volumen : qui tollens illud de gazophylacio Elisamæ scribæ, legit, audiente rege et universis principibus qui stabant circa regem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:22
verses.text: Rex autem sedebat in domo hiemali, in mense nono, et posita erat arula coram eo plena prunis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:23
verses.text: Cumque legisset Judi tres pagellas vel quatuor, scidit illud scalpello scribæ, et projecit in ignem qui erat super arulam, donec consumeretur omne volumen igni qui erat in arula.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:24
verses.text: Et non timuerunt, neque sciderunt vestimenta sua, rex et omnes servi ejus qui audierunt universos sermones istos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:25
verses.text: Verumtamen Elnathan, et Dalaias, et Gamarias, contradixerunt regi, ne combureret librum : et non audivit eos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:26
verses.text: Et præcepit rex Jeremiel filio Amelech, et Saraiæ filio Ezriel, et Selemiæ filio Abdeel, ut comprehenderent Baruch scribam, et Jeremiam prophetam : abscondit autem eos Dominus.  <div eID="gen25194" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9427"/><div sID="gen25195" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9427"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam, postquam combusserat rex volumen et sermones quos scripserat Baruch ex ore Jeremiæ, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:28
verses.text: Rursum tolle volumen aliud, et scribe in eo omnes sermones priores qui erant in primo volumine, quod combussit Joakim rex Juda.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:29
verses.text: Et ad Joakim regem Juda dices : Hæc dicit Dominus : Tu combussisti volumen illud, dicens : Quare scripsisti in eo annuntians : Festinus veniet rex Babylonis, et vastabit terram hanc, et cessare faciet ex illa hominem et jumentum ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:30
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus contra Joakim regem Juda : Non erit ex eo qui sedeat super solium David : et cadaver ejus projicietur ad æstum per diem, et ad gelu per noctem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:31
verses.text: Et visitabo contra eum, et contra semen ejus, et contra servos ejus, iniquitates suas : et adducam super eos, et super habitatores Jerusalem, et super viros Juda, omne malum quod locutus sum ad eos, et non audierunt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 36:32
verses.text: Jeremias autem tulit volumen aliud, et dedit illud Baruch filio Neriæ scribæ : qui scripsit in eo ex ore Jeremiæ omnes sermones libri quem combusserat Joakim rex Juda igni : et insuper additi sunt sermones multo plures quam antea fuerant.  <chapter eID="Jer.36"/> <div eID="gen25195" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:1
verses.text: Et regnavit rex Sedecias filius Josiæ pro Jechonia filio Joakim, quem constituit regem Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis in terra Juda :

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:2
verses.text: et non obedivit ipse, et servi ejus, et populus terræ, verbis Domini, quæ locutus est in manu Jeremiæ prophetæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:3
verses.text: Et misit rex Sedecias Juchal filium Selemiæ, et Sophoniam filium Maasiæ, sacerdotem, ad Jeremiam prophetam, dicens : Ora pro nobis Dominum Deum nostrum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:4
verses.text: Jeremias autem libere ambulabat in medio populi : non enim miserant eum in custodiam carceris. Igitur exercitus Pharaonis egressus est de Ægypto, et audientes Chaldæi qui obsidebant Jerusalem, hujuscemodi nuntium, recesserunt ab Jerusalem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:5
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:6
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Sic dicetis regi Juda, qui misit vos ad me interrogandum : Ecce exercitus Pharaonis, qui egressus est vobis in auxilium, revertetur in terram suam in Ægyptum :

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:7
verses.text: et redient Chaldæi, et bellabunt contra civitatem hanc, et capient eam, et succendent eam igni.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:8
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : Nolite decipere animas vestras, dicentes : Euntes abibunt, et recedent a nobis Chaldæi : quia non abibunt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:9
verses.text: Sed etsi percusseritis omnem exercitum Chaldæorum qui præliantur adversum vos, et derelicti fuerint ex eis aliqui vulnerati, singuli de tentorio suo consurgent, et incendent civitatem hanc igni.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:10
verses.text: Ergo cum recessisset exercitus Chaldæorum ab Jerusalem, propter exercitum Pharaonis,

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:11
verses.text: egressus est Jeremias de Jerusalem ut iret in terram Benjamin, et divideret ibi possessionem in conspectu civium.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:12
verses.text: Cumque pervenisset ad portam Benjamin, erat ibi custos portæ per vices, nomine Jerias filius Selemiæ filii Hananiæ : et apprehendit Jeremiam prophetam, dicens : Ad Chaldæos profugis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:13
verses.text: Et respondit Jeremias : Falsum est : non fugio ad Chaldæos. Et non audivit eum, sed comprehendit Jerias Jeremiam, et adduxit eum ad principes :

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:14
verses.text: quam ob rem irati principes contra Jeremiam, cæsum eum miserunt in carcerem qui erat in domo Jonathan scribæ : ipse enim præpositus erat super carcerem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:15
verses.text: Itaque ingressus est Jeremias in domum laci et in ergastulum : et sedit ibi Jeremias diebus multis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:16
verses.text: Mittens autem Sedecias rex, tulit eum : et interrogavit eum in domo sua abscondite, et dixit : Putasne est sermo a Domino ? Et dixit Jeremias : Est : et ait : In manus regis Babylonis traderis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:17
verses.text: Et dixit Jeremias ad regem Sedeciam : Quid peccavi tibi, et servis tuis, et populo tuo, quia misisti me in domum carceris ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:18
verses.text: ubi sunt prophetæ vestri, qui prophetabant vobis, et dicebant : Non veniet rex Babylonis super vos, et super terram hanc ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:19
verses.text: Nunc ergo audi, obsecro, domine mi rex : valeat deprecatio mea in conspectu tuo, et ne me remittas in domum Jonathan scribæ, ne moriar ibi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 37:20
verses.text: Præcepit ergo rex Sedecias ut traderetur Jeremias in vestibulo carceris, et daretur ei torta panis quotidie, excepto pulmento, donec consumerentur omnes panes de civitate : et mansit Jeremias in vestibulo carceris.  <chapter eID="Jer.37"/> <div eID="gen25196" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:1
verses.text: Audivit autem Saphatias filius Mathan, et Gedelias filius Phassur, et Juchal filius Selemiæ, et Phassur filius Melchiæ, sermones quos Jeremias loquebatur ad omnem populum, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:2
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : Quicumque manserit in civitate hac, morietur gladio, et fame, et peste : qui autem profugerit ad Chaldæos, vivet, et erit anima ejus sospes et vivens.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:3
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : Tradendo tradetur civitas hæc in manu exercitus regis Babylonis, et capiet eam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:4
verses.text: Et dixerunt principes regi : Rogamus ut occidatur homo iste : de industria enim dissolvit manus virorum bellantium qui remanserunt in civitate hac, et manus universi populi, loquens ad eos juxta verba hæc : siquidem homo iste non quærit pacem populo huic, sed malum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:5
verses.text: Et dixit rex Sedecias : Ecce ipse in manibus vestris est : nec enim fas est regem vobis quidquam negare.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:6
verses.text: Tulerunt ergo Jeremiam, et projecerunt eum in lacum Melchiæ filii Amelech, qui erat in vestibulo carceris : et submiserunt Jeremiam funibus in lacum, in quo non erat aqua, sed lutum : descendit itaque Jeremias in cœnum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:7
verses.text: Audivit autem Abdemelech Æthiops, vir eunuchus, qui erat in domo regis, quod misissent Jeremiam in lacum. Porro rex sedebat in porta Benjamin :

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:8
verses.text: et egressus est Abdemelech de domo regis, et locutus est ad regem, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:9
verses.text: Domine mi rex, male fecerunt viri isti omnia quæcumque perpetrarunt contra Jeremiam prophetam, mittentes eum in lacum, ut moriatur ibi fame : non sunt enim panes ultra in civitate.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:10
verses.text: Præcepit itaque rex Abdemelech Æthiopi, dicens : Tolle tecum hinc triginta viros, et leva Jeremiam prophetam de lacu, antequam moriatur.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:11
verses.text: Assumptis ergo Abdemelech secum viris, ingressus est domum regis, quæ erat sub cellario, et tulit inde veteres pannos, et antiqua quæ computruerant, et submisit ea ad Jeremiam in lacum per funiculos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:12
verses.text: Dixitque Abdemelech Æthiops ad Jeremiam : Pone veteres pannos, et hæc scissa et putrida, sub cubito manuum tuarum, et super funes. Fecit ergo Jeremias sic,

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:13
verses.text: et extraxerunt Jeremiam funibus, et eduxerunt eum de lacu : mansit autem Jeremias in vestibulo carceris.  <div eID="gen25197" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9428"/><div sID="gen25198" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9428"/>Et misit rex Sedecias, et tulit ad se Jeremiam prophetam ad ostium tertium quod erat in domo Domini : et dixit rex ad Jeremiam : Interrogo ego te sermonem, ne abscondas a me aliquid.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:15
verses.text: Dixit autem Jeremias ad Sedeciam : Si annuntiavero tibi, numquid non interficies me ? et si consilium dedero tibi, non me audies.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:16
verses.text: Juravit ergo rex Sedecias Jeremiæ clam, dicens : Vivit Dominus, qui fecit nobis animam hanc, si occidero te, et si tradidero te in manus virorum istorum qui quærunt animam tuam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:17
verses.text: Et dixit Jeremias ad Sedeciam : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Si profectus exieris ad principes regis Babylonis, vivet anima tua, et civitas hæc non succendetur igni : et salvus eris tu, et domus tua.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:18
verses.text: Si autem non exieris ad principes regis Babylonis, tradetur civitas hæc in manus Chaldæorum, et succendent eam igni : et tu non effugies de manu eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:19
verses.text: Et dixit rex Sedecias ad Jeremiam : Sollicitus sum propter Judæos qui transfugerunt ad Chaldæos, ne forte tradar in manus eorum, et illudant mihi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:20
verses.text: Respondit autem Jeremias : Non te tradent. Audi, quæso, vocem Domini, quam ego loquor ad te, et bene tibi erit, et vivet anima tua.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:21
verses.text: Quod si nolueris egredi, iste est sermo quem ostendit mihi Dominus :

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:22
verses.text: ecce omnes mulieres quæ remanserunt in domo regis Juda educentur ad principes regis Babylonis, et ipsæ dicent : Seduxerunt te, et prævaluerunt adversum te, viri pacifici tui : demerserunt in cœno et in lubrico pedes tuos, et recesserunt a te.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:23
verses.text: Et omnes uxores tuæ et filii tui educentur ad Chaldæos : et non effugies manus eorum, sed in manu regis Babylonis capieris, et civitatem hanc comburet igni.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:24
verses.text: Dixit ergo Sedecias ad Jeremiam : Nullus sciat verba hæc, et non morieris.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:25
verses.text: Si autem audierint principes quia locutus sum tecum, et venerint ad te, et dixerint tibi : Indica nobis quid locutus sis cum rege : ne celes nos, et non te interficiemus : et quid locutus est tecum rex :

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:26
verses.text: dices ad eos : Prostravi ego preces meas coram rege, ne me reduci juberet in domum Jonathan, et ibi morerer.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:27
verses.text: Venerunt ergo omnes principes ad Jeremiam, et interrogaverunt eum, et locutus est eis juxta omnia verba quæ præceperat ei rex : et cessaverunt ab eo : nihil enim fuerat auditum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 38:28
verses.text: Mansit vero Jeremias in vestibulo carceris usque ad diem quo capta est Jerusalem : et factum est ut caperetur Jerusalem.  <chapter eID="Jer.38"/> <div eID="gen25198" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:1
verses.text: Anno nono Sedeciæ regis Juda, mense decimo, venit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, et omnis exercitus ejus, ad Jerusalem, et obsidebant eam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:2
verses.text: Undecimo autem anno Sedeciæ, mense quarto, quinta mensis, aperta est civitas :

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:3
verses.text: et ingressi sunt omnes principes regis Babylonis, et sederunt in porta media : Neregel, Sereser, Semegarnabu, Sarsachim, Rabsares, Neregel, Sereser, Rebmag, et omnes reliqui principes regis Babylonis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:4
verses.text: Cumque vidisset eos Sedecias rex Juda, et omnes viri bellatores, fugerunt : et egressi sunt nocte de civitate per viam horti regis, et per portam quæ erat inter duos muros, et egressi sunt ad viam deserti.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:5
verses.text: Persecutus est autem eos exercitus Chaldæorum, et comprehenderunt Sedeciam in campo solitudinis Jerichontinæ, et captum adduxerunt ad Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis, in Reblatha, quæ est in terra Emath : et locutus est ad eum judicia.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:6
verses.text: Et occidit rex Babylonis filios Sedeciæ in Reblatha, in oculis ejus : et omnes nobiles Juda occidit rex Babylonis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:7
verses.text: Oculos quoque Sedeciæ eruit, et vinxit eum compedibus ut duceretur in Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:8
verses.text: Domum quoque regis et domum vulgi succenderunt Chaldæi igni, et murum Jerusalem subverterunt.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:9
verses.text: Et reliquias populi qui remanserant in civitate, et perfugas qui transfugerant ad eum, et superfluos vulgi qui remanserant, transtulit Nabuzardan, magister militum, in Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:10
verses.text: Et de plebe pauperum, qui nihil penitus habebant, dimisit Nabuzardan magister militum in terra Juda, et dedit eis vineas et cisternas in die illa.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:11
verses.text: Præceperat autem Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis de Jeremia Nabuzardan magistro militum, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:12
verses.text: Tolle illum, et pone super eum oculos tuos, nihilque ei mali facias : sed ut voluerit, sic facias ei.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:13
verses.text: Misit ergo Nabuzardan princeps militiæ, et Nabusezban, et Rabsares, et Neregel, et Sereser, et Rebmag, et omnes optimates regis Babylonis,

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:14
verses.text: miserunt, et tulerunt Jeremiam de vestibulo carceris, et tradiderunt eum Godoliæ filio Ahicam filii Saphan, ut intraret in domum, et habitaret in populo.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:15
verses.text: Ad Jeremiam autem factus fuerat sermo Domini, cum clausus esset in vestibulo carceris, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:16
verses.text: Vade, et dic Abdemelech Æthiopi, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego inducam sermones meos super civitatem hanc in malum, et non in bonum, et erunt in conspectu tuo in die illa.

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:17
verses.text: Et liberabo te in die illa, ait Dominus, et non traderis in manus virorum quos tu formidas :

verses.name: Jeremiah 39:18
verses.text: sed eruens liberabo te, et gladio non cades, sed erit tibi anima tua in salutem, quia in me habuisti fiduciam, ait Dominus.  <chapter eID="Jer.39"/> <div eID="gen25199" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:1
verses.text: Sermo qui factus est ad Jeremiam a Domino, postquam dimissus est a Nabuzardan magistro militiæ de Rama, quando tulit eum vinctum catenis in medio omnium qui migrabant de Jerusalem et Juda, et ducebantur in Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:2
verses.text: Tollens ergo princeps militiæ Jeremiam, dixit ad eum : Dominus Deus tuus locutus est malum hoc super locum istum :

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:3
verses.text: et adduxit, et fecit Dominus sicut locutus est, quia peccastis Domino, et non audistis vocem ejus : et factus est vobis sermo hic.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:4
verses.text: Nunc ergo ecce solvi te hodie de catenis quæ sunt in manibus tuis : si placet tibi ut venias mecum in Babylonem, veni, et ponam oculos meos super te : si autem displicet tibi venire mecum in Babylonem, reside : ecce omnis terra in conspectu tuo est : quod elegeris, et quo placuerit tibi ut vadas, illuc perge :

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:5
verses.text: et mecum noli venire, sed habita apud Godoliam filium Ahicam filii Saphan, quem præposuit rex Babylonis civitatibus Juda : habita ergo cum eo in medio populi : vel quocumque placuerit tibi ut vadas, vade. Dedit quoque ei magister militiæ cibaria et munuscula, et dimisit eum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:6
verses.text: Venit autem Jeremias ad Godoliam filium Ahicam in Masphath, et habitavit cum eo in medio populi qui relictus fuerat in terra.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:7
verses.text: Cumque audissent omnes principes exercitus, qui dispersi fuerant per regiones, ipsi et socii eorum, quod præfecisset rex Babylonis Godoliam filium Ahicam terræ, et quod commendasset ei viros, et mulieres, et parvulos, et de pauperibus terræ, qui non fuerant translati in Babylonem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:8
verses.text: venerunt ad Godoliam in Masphath, et Ismahel filius Nathaniæ, et Johanan et Jonathan filii Caree, et Sareas filius Thanehumeth, et filii Ophi, qui erant de Netophathi, et Jezonias filius Maachathi, ipsi et viri eorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:9
verses.text: Et juravit eis Godolias filius Ahicam filii Saphan, et comitibus eorum, dicens : Nolite timere servire Chaldæis : habitate in terra, et servite regi Babylonis, et bene erit vobis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:10
verses.text: Ecce ego habito in Masphath, ut respondeam præcepto Chaldæorum qui mittuntur ad nos : vos autem colligite vindemiam, et messem, et oleum, et condite in vasis vestris, et manete in urbibus vestris quas tenetis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:11
verses.text: Sed et omnes Judæi qui erant in Moab, et in filiis Ammon, et in Idumæa, et in universis regionibus, audito quod dedisset rex Babylonis reliquias in Judæa, et quod præposuisset super eos Godoliam filium Ahicam filii Saphan,

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:12
verses.text: reversi sunt, inquam, omnes Judæi de universis locis ad quæ profugerant, et venerunt in terram Juda ad Godoliam in Masphath, et collegerunt vinum et messem multam nimis.  <div eID="gen25200" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9429"/><div sID="gen25201" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9429"/>Johanan autem filius Caree, et omnes principes exercitus qui dispersi fuerant in regionibus, venerunt ad Godoliam in Masphath,

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:14
verses.text: et dixerunt ei : Scito quod Baalis, rex filiorum Ammon, misit Ismahel filium Nathaniæ percutere animam tuam. Et non credidit eis Godolias filius Ahicam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:15
verses.text: Johanan autem filius Caree dixit ad Godoliam seorsum in Masphath, loquens : Ibo, et percutiam Ismahel filium Nathaniæ, nullo sciente, ne interficiat animam tuam, et dissipentur omnes Judæi qui congregati sunt ad te, et peribunt reliquiæ Juda.

verses.name: Jeremiah 40:16
verses.text: Et ait Godolias filius Ahicam ad Johanan filium Caree : Noli facere verbum hoc : falsum enim tu loqueris de Ismahel.  <chapter eID="Jer.40"/> <div eID="gen25201" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:1
verses.text: Et factum est in mense septimo, venit Ismahel filius Nathaniæ filii Elisama, de semine regali, et optimates regis, et decem viri cum eo, ad Godoliam filium Ahicam, in Masphath, et comederunt ibi panes simul in Masphath.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:2
verses.text: Surrexit autem Ismahel filius Nathaniæ, et decem viri qui cum eo erant, et percusserunt Godoliam filium Ahicam filii Saphan gladio, et interfecerunt eum quem præfecerat rex Babylonis terræ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:3
verses.text: Omnes quoque Judæos qui erant cum Godolia in Masphath, et Chaldæos qui reperti sunt ibi, et viros bellatores, percussit Ismahel.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:4
verses.text: Secundo autem die postquam occiderat Godoliam, nullo adhuc sciente,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:5
verses.text: venerunt viri de Sichem, et de Silo, et de Samaria, octoginta viri, rasi barba, et scissis vestibus, et squallentes : et munera et thus habebant in manu, ut offerrent in domo Domini.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:6
verses.text: Egressus ergo Ismahel filius Nathaniæ in occursum eorum de Masphath, incedens et plorans ibat : cum autem occurrisset eis, dixit ad eos : Venite ad Godoliam filium Ahicam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:7
verses.text: Qui cum venissent ad medium civitatis, interfecit eos Ismahel filius Nathaniæ circa medium laci, ipse et viri qui erant cum eo.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:8
verses.text: Decem autem viri reperti sunt inter eos, qui dixerunt ad Ismahel : Noli occidere nos, quia habemus thesauros in agro, frumenti, et hordei, et olei, et mellis : et cessavit, et non interfecit eos cum fratribus suis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:9
verses.text: Lacus autem in quem projecerat Ismahel omnia cadavera virorum quos percussit propter Godoliam, ipse est quem fecit rex Asa propter Baasa regem Israël : ipsum replevit Ismahel filius Nathaniæ occisis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:10
verses.text: Et captivas duxit Ismahel omnes reliquias populi qui erant in Masphath, filias regis, et universum populum qui remanserat in Masphath, quos commendaverat Nabuzardan princeps militiæ, Godoliæ filio Ahicam : et cepit eos Ismahel filius Nathaniæ, et abiit ut transiret ad filios Ammon.  <div eID="gen25202" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9430"/><div sID="gen25203" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9430"/>Audivit autem Johanan filius Caree, et omnes principes bellatorum qui erant cum eo, omne malum quod fecerat Ismahel filius Nathaniæ,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:12
verses.text: et assumptis universis viris, profecti sunt ut bellarent adversum Ismahel filium Nathaniæ : et invenerunt eum ad aquas multas quæ sunt in Gabaon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:13
verses.text: Cumque vidisset omnis populus qui erat cum Ismahel Johanan filium Caree, et universos principes bellatorum qui erant cum eo, lætati sunt :

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:14
verses.text: et reversus est omnis populus quem ceperat Ismahel, in Masphath, reversusque abiit ad Johanan filium Caree.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:15
verses.text: Ismahel autem filius Nathaniæ fugit cum octo viris a facie Johanan, et abiit ad filios Ammon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:16
verses.text: Tulit ergo Johanan filius Caree, et omnes principes bellatorum qui erant cum eo, universas reliquias vulgi quas reduxerat ab Ismahel filio Nathaniæ de Masphath, postquam percussit Godoliam filium Ahicam : fortes viros ad prælium, et mulieres, et pueros, et eunuchos, quos reduxerat de Gabaon.

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:17
verses.text: Et abierunt, et sederunt peregrinantes in Chamaam, quæ est juxta Bethlehem, ut pergerent, et introirent Ægyptum,

verses.name: Jeremiah 41:18
verses.text: a facie Chaldæorum : timebant enim eos, quia percusserat Ismahel filius Nathaniæ Godoliam filium Ahicam, quem præposuerat rex Babylonis in terra Juda.  <chapter eID="Jer.41"/> <div eID="gen25203" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:1
verses.text: Et accesserunt omnes principes bellatorum, et Johanan filius Caree, et Jezonias filius Osaiæ, et reliquum vulgus, a parvo usque ad magnum,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:2
verses.text: dixeruntque ad Jeremiam prophetam : Cadat oratio nostra in conspectu tuo, et ora pro nobis ad Dominum Deum tuum, pro universis reliquiis istis, quia derelicti sumus pauci de pluribus, sicut oculi tui nos intuentur :

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:3
verses.text: et annuntiet nobis Dominus Deus tuus viam per quam pergamus, et verbum quod faciamus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:4
verses.text: Dixit autem ad eos Jeremias propheta : Audivi. Ecce ego oro ad Dominum Deum vestrum secundum verba vestra : omne verbum quodcumque responderit mihi indicabo vobis, nec celabo vos quidquam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:5
verses.text: Et illi dixerunt ad Jeremiam : Sit Dominus inter nos testis veritatis et fidei, si non juxta omne verbum in quo miserit te Dominus Deus tuus ad nos, sic faciemus :

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:6
verses.text: sive bonum est, sive malum, voci Domini Dei nostri, ad quem mittimus te, obediemus, ut bene sit nobis cum audierimus vocem Domini Dei nostri.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:7
verses.text: Cum autem completi essent decem dies, factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:8
