verses.text: vocavitque Johanan filium Caree, et omnes principes bellatorum qui erant cum eo, et universum populum, a minimo usque ad magnum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:9
verses.text: Et dixit ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël, ad quem misistis me ut prosternerem preces vestras in conspectu ejus :

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:10
verses.text: Si quiescentes manseritis in terra hac, ædificabo vos, et non destruam : plantabo, et non evellam : jam enim placatus sum super malo quod feci vobis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:11
verses.text: Nolite timere a facie regis Babylonis, quem vos pavidi formidatis : nolite metuere eum, dicit Dominus, quia vobiscum sum ego ut salvos vos faciam, et eruam de manu ejus :

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:12
verses.text: et dabo vobis misericordias, et miserebor vestri, et habitare vos faciam in terra vestra.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:13
verses.text: Si autem dixeritis vos : Non habitabimus in terra ista, nec audiemus vocem Domini Dei nostri,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:14
verses.text: dicentes : Nequaquam, sed ad terram Ægypti pergemus, ubi non videbimus bellum, et clangorem tubæ non audiemus, et famem non sustinebimus, et ibi habitabimus :

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:15
verses.text: propter hoc nunc audite verbum Domini, reliquiæ Juda : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Si posueritis faciem vestram ut ingrediamini Ægyptum, et intraveritis ut ibi habitetis,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:16
verses.text: gladius quem vos formidatis ibi comprehendet vos in terra Ægypti : et fames, pro qua estis solliciti, adhærebit vobis in Ægypto, et ibi moriemini.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:17
verses.text: Omnesque viri qui posuerunt faciem suam ut ingrediantur Ægyptum, ut habitent ibi, morientur gladio, et fame, et peste : nullus de eis remanebit, nec effugiet a facie mali quod ego afferam super eos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:18
verses.text: Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Sicut conflatus est furor meus et indignatio mea super habitatores Jerusalem, sic conflabitur indignatio mea super vos cum ingressi fueritis Ægyptum : et eritis in jusjurandum, et in stuporem, et in maledictum, et in opprobrium, et nequaquam ultra videbitis locum istum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:19
verses.text: Verbum Domini super vos, reliquiæ Juda : Nolite intrare Ægyptum : scientes scietis, quia obtestatus sum vos hodie,

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:20
verses.text: quia decepistis animas vestras. Vos enim misistis me ad Dominum Deum nostrum, dicentes : Ora pro nobis ad Dominum Deum nostrum, et juxta omnia quæcumque dixerit tibi Dominus Deus noster, sic annuntia nobis, et faciemus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:21
verses.text: Et annuntiavi vobis hodie, et non audistis vocem Domini Dei vestri super universis pro quibus misit me ad vos.

verses.name: Jeremiah 42:22
verses.text: Nunc ergo scientes scietis quia gladio, et fame, et peste moriemini in loco ad quem voluistis intrare ut habitaretis ibi.  <chapter eID="Jer.42"/> <div eID="gen25204" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:1
verses.text: Factum est autem, cum complesset Jeremias loquens ad populum universos sermones Domini Dei eorum, pro quibus miserat eum Dominus Deus eorum ad illos, omnia verba hæc,

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:2
verses.text: dixit Azarias filius Osaiæ, et Johanan filius Caree, et omnes viri superbi, dicentes ad Jeremiam : Mendacium tu loqueris : non misit te Dominus Deus noster, dicens : Ne ingrediamini Ægyptum ut habitetis illuc.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:3
verses.text: Sed Baruch filius Neriæ incitat te adversum nos, ut tradat nos in manus Chaldæorum, ut interficiat nos, et traduci faciat in Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:4
verses.text: Et non audivit Johanan filius Caree, et omnes principes bellatorum, et universus populus, vocem Domini, ut manerent in terra Juda.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:5
verses.text: Sed tollens Johanan filius Caree, et universi principes bellatorum, universos reliquiarum Juda, qui reversi fuerant de cunctis gentibus ad quas fuerant ante dispersi, ut habitarent in terra Juda,

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:6
verses.text: viros, et mulieres, et parvulos, et filias regis, et omnem animam quam reliquerat Nabuzardan princeps militiæ cum Godolia filio Ahicam filii Saphan, et Jeremiam prophetam, et Baruch filium Neriæ :

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:7
verses.text: et ingressi sunt terram Ægypti, quia non obedierunt voci Domini, et venerunt usque ad Taphnis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:8
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad Jeremiam in Taphnis, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:9
verses.text: Sume lapides grandes in manu tua, et abscondes eos in crypta quæ est sub muro latericio in porta domus Pharaonis in Taphnis, cernentibus viris Judæis :

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:10
verses.text: et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego mittam et assumam Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis, servum meum : et ponam thronum ejus super lapides istos quos abscondi, et statuet solium suum super eos :

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:11
verses.text: veniensque percutiet terram Ægypti, quos in mortem, in mortem, et quos in captivitatem, in captivitatem, et quos in gladium, in gladium :

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:12
verses.text: et succendet ignem in delubris deorum Ægypti, et comburet ea, et captivos ducet illos, et amicietur terra Ægypti sicut amicitur pastor pallio suo, et egredietur inde in pace :

verses.name: Jeremiah 43:13
verses.text: et conteret statuas domus solis quæ sunt in terra Ægypti, et delubra deorum Ægypti comburet igni.  <chapter eID="Jer.43"/> <div eID="gen25205" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:1
verses.text: Verbum quod factum est per Jeremiam ad omnes Judæos qui habitabant in terra Ægypti, habitantes in Magdalo, et in Taphnis, et in Memphis, et in terra Phatures, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:2
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Vos vidistis omne malum istud quod adduxi super Jerusalem, et super omnes urbes Juda : et ecce desertæ sunt hodie, et non est in eis habitator,

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:3
verses.text: propter malitiam quam fecerunt ut me ad iracundiam provocarent, et irent ut sacrificarent, et colerent deos alienos quos nesciebant, et illi, et vos, et patres vestri.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:4
verses.text: Et misi ad vos omnes servos meos prophetas, de nocte consurgens, mittensque et dicens : Nolite facere verbum abominationis hujuscemodi, quam odivi.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:5
verses.text: Et non audierunt, nec inclinaverunt aurem suam, ut converterentur a malis suis, et non sacrificarent diis alienis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:6
verses.text: Et conflata est indignatio mea et furor meus, et succensa est in civitatibus Juda, et in plateis Jerusalem : et versæ sunt in solitudinem et vastitatem secundum diem hanc.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:7
verses.text: Et nunc hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Quare vos facitis malum grande hoc contra animas vestras, ut intereat ex vobis vir et mulier, parvulus et lactens, de medio Judæ, nec relinquatur vobis quidquam residuum :

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:8
verses.text: provocantes me in operibus manuum vestrarum, sacrificando diis alienis in terra Ægypti, in quam ingressi estis ut habitetis ibi : et dispereatis, et sitis in maledictionem et in opprobrium cunctis gentibus terræ ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:9
verses.text: Numquid obliti estis mala patrum vestrorum, et mala regum Juda, et mala uxorum ejus, et mala vestra, et mala uxorum vestrarum, quæ fecerunt in terra Juda, et in regionibus Jerusalem ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:10
verses.text: Non sunt mundati usque ad diem hanc : et non timuerunt, et non ambulaverunt in lege Domini, et in præceptis meis quæ dedi coram vobis et coram patribus vestris.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:11
verses.text: Ideo hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : Ecce ego ponam faciem meam in vobis in malum : et disperdam omnem Judam.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:12
verses.text: Et assumam reliquias Judæ, qui posuerunt facies suas ut ingrederentur terram Ægypti, et habitarent ibi, et consumentur omnes in terra Ægypti : cadent in gladio, et in fame, et consumentur a minimo usque ad maximum : in gladio et in fame morientur, et erunt in jusjurandum, et in miraculum, et in maledictionem, et in opprobrium.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:13
verses.text: Et visitabo super habitatores terræ Ægypti sicut visitavi super Jerusalem, in gladio, et fame, et peste :

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:14
verses.text: et non erit qui effugiat, et sit residuus de reliquiis Judæorum qui vadunt ut peregrinentur in terra Ægypti, et revertantur in terram Juda, ad quam ipsi elevant animas suas ut revertantur, et habitent ibi : non revertentur, nisi qui fugerint.  <div eID="gen25206" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9431"/><div sID="gen25207" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9431"/>Responderunt autem Jeremiæ omnes viri scientes quod sacrificarent uxores eorum diis alienis, et universæ mulieres quarum stabat multitudo grandis, et omnis populus habitantium in terra Ægypti in Phatures, dicentes :

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:16
verses.text: Sermonem quem locutus es ad nos in nomine Domini, non audiemus ex te :

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:17
verses.text: sed facientes faciemus omne verbum quod egredietur de ore nostro, ut sacrificemus reginæ cæli, et libemus ei libamina, sicut fecimus nos et patres nostri, reges nostri et principes nostri, in urbibus Juda, et in plateis Jerusalem : et saturati sumus panibus, et bene nobis erat, malumque non vidimus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:18
verses.text: Ex eo autem tempore quo cessavimus sacrificare reginæ cæli, et libare ei libamina, indigemus omnibus, et gladio et fame consumpti sumus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:19
verses.text: Quod si nos sacrificamus reginæ cæli, et libamus ei libamina, numquid sine viris nostris fecimus ei placentas ad colendum eam, et libandum ei libamina ?  <div eID="gen25207" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9432"/><div sID="gen25208" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9432"/>Et dixit Jeremias ad omnem populum, adversum viros, et adversum mulieres, et adversum universam plebem, qui responderant ei verbum, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:21
verses.text: Numquid non sacrificium quod sacrificastis in civitatibus Juda, et in plateis Jerusalem, vos et patres vestri, reges vestri, et principes vestri, et populus terræ, horum recordatus est Dominus, et ascendit super cor ejus ?

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:22
verses.text: Et non poterat Dominus ultra portare propter malitiam studiorum vestrorum, et propter abominationes quas fecistis : et facta est terra vestra in desolationem, et in stuporem, et in maledictum, eo quod non sit habitator, sicut est dies hæc.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:23
verses.text: Propterea quod sacrificaveritis idolis, et peccaveritis Domino, et non audieritis vocem Domini, et in lege, et in præceptis, et in testimoniis ejus non ambulaveritis, idcirco evenerunt vobis mala hæc, sicut est dies hæc.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:24
verses.text: Dixit autem Jeremias ad omnem populum, et ad universas mulieres : Audite verbum Domini, omnis Juda qui estis in terra Ægypti.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:25
verses.text: Hæc inquit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, dicens : Vos et uxores vestræ locuti estis ore vestro, et manibus vestris implestis, dicentes : Faciamus vota nostra quæ vovimus, ut sacrificemus reginæ cæli, et libemus ei libamina. Implestis vota vestra, et opere perpetrastis ea.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:26
verses.text: Ideo audite verbum Domini, omnis Juda qui habitatis in terra Ægypti : Ecce ego juravi in nomine meo magno, ait Dominus, quia nequaquam ultra vocabitur nomen meum ex ore omnis viri Judæi, dicentis : Vivit Dominus Deus, in omni terra Ægypti.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:27
verses.text: Ecce ego vigilabo super eos in malum, et non in bonum : et consumentur omnes viri Juda qui sunt in terra Ægypti gladio et fame, donec penitus consumantur.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:28
verses.text: Et qui fugerint gladium, revertentur de terra Ægypti in terram Juda viri pauci : et scient omnes reliquiæ Juda, ingredientium terram Ægypti ut habitent ibi, cujus sermo compleatur, meus an illorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:29
verses.text: Et hoc vobis signum, ait Dominus, quod visitem ego super vos in loco isto, ut sciatis quia vere complebuntur sermones mei contra vos in malum :

verses.name: Jeremiah 44:30
verses.text: hæc dicit Dominus : Ecce ego tradam Pharaonem Ephree regem Ægypti in manu inimicorum ejus, et in manu quærentium animam illius, sicut tradidi Sedeciam regem Juda in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis inimici sui, et quærentis animam ejus.  <chapter eID="Jer.44"/> <div eID="gen25208" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:1
verses.text: Verbum quod locutus est Jeremias propheta ad Baruch filium Neriæ, cum scripsisset verba hæc in libro ex ore Jeremiæ, anno quarto Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda, dicens :

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:2
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël ad te, Baruch :

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:3
verses.text: Dixisti : Væ misero mihi ! quoniam addidit Dominus dolorem dolori meo : laboravi in gemitu meo, et requiem non inveni.

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:4
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : Sic dices ad eum : Ecce quos ædificavi, ego destruo, et quos plantavi, ego evello, et universam terram hanc :

verses.name: Jeremiah 45:5
verses.text: et tu quæris tibi grandia ? noli quærere, quia ecce ego adducam malum super omnem carnem, ait Dominus, et dabo tibi animam tuam in salutem in omnibus locis ad quæcumque perrexeris.  <chapter eID="Jer.45"/> <div eID="gen25209" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:1
verses.text: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam contra gentes.

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:2
verses.text: Ad Ægyptum, adversum exercitum Pharaonis Nechao regis Ægypti, qui erat juxta fluvium Euphraten in Charcamis, quem percussit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, in quarto anno Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda.  <div eID="gen25210" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9433"/><lg sID="gen25211"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9433"/>Præparate scutum et clypeum, <l eID="gen25212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25213"/>et procedite ad bellum. <l eID="gen25213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9434"/><l level="1" sID="gen25214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9434"/>Jungite equos, et ascendite, equites : <l eID="gen25214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25215"/>state in galeis, polite lanceas, induite vos loricis. <l eID="gen25215" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9435"/><l level="1" sID="gen25216"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9435"/>Quid igitur ? vidi ipsos pavidos, <l eID="gen25216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25217"/>et terga vertentes, <l eID="gen25217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25218"/>fortes eorum cæsos : <l eID="gen25218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25219"/>fugerunt conciti, nec respexerunt : <l eID="gen25219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25220"/>terror undique, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9436"/><l level="1" sID="gen25221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9436"/>Non fugiat velox, <l eID="gen25221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25222"/>nec salvari se putet fortis : <l eID="gen25222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25223"/>ad aquilonem juxta flumen Euphraten <l eID="gen25223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25224"/>victi sunt, et ruerunt. <l eID="gen25224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9437"/><l level="1" sID="gen25225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9437"/>Quis est iste, qui quasi flumen ascendit, <l eID="gen25225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25226"/>et veluti fluviorum intumescunt gurgites ejus ? <l eID="gen25226" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9438"/><l level="1" sID="gen25227"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9438"/>Ægyptus fluminis instar ascendit, <l eID="gen25227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25228"/>et velut flumina movebuntur fluctus ejus, <l eID="gen25228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25229"/>et dicet : Ascendens operiam terram : <l eID="gen25229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25230"/>perdam civitatem, et habitatores ejus. <l eID="gen25230" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9439"/><l level="1" sID="gen25231"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9439"/>Ascendite equos, <l eID="gen25231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25232"/>et exsultate in curribus, <l eID="gen25232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25233"/>et procedant fortes, <l eID="gen25233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25234"/>Æthiopia et Libyes tenentes scutum, <l eID="gen25234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25235"/>et Lydii arripientes et jacientes sagittas. <l eID="gen25235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9440"/><l level="1" sID="gen25236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9440"/>Dies autem ille Domini Dei exercituum dies ultionis, <l eID="gen25236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25237"/>ut sumat vindictam de inimicis suis : <l eID="gen25237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25238"/>devorabit gladius, et saturabitur, <l eID="gen25238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25239"/>et inebriabitur sanguine eorum : <l eID="gen25239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25240"/>victima enim Domini Dei exercituum <l eID="gen25240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25241"/>in terra aquilonis juxta flumen Euphraten. <l eID="gen25241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9441"/><l level="1" sID="gen25242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9441"/>Ascende in Galaad, et tolle resinam, <l eID="gen25242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25243"/>virgo filia Ægypti : <l eID="gen25243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25244"/>frustra multiplicas medicamina : <l eID="gen25244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25245"/>sanitas non erit tibi. <l eID="gen25245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9442"/><l level="1" sID="gen25246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9442"/>Audierunt gentes ignominiam tuam, <l eID="gen25246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25247"/>et ululatus tuus replevit terram : <l eID="gen25247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25248"/>quia fortis impegit in fortem, <l eID="gen25248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25249"/>et ambo pariter conciderunt. <l eID="gen25249" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen25211"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9443"/><div sID="gen25250" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9443"/>Verbum quod locutus est Dominus ad Jeremiam prophetam, super eo quod venturus esset Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, et percussurus terram Ægypti :  <div eID="gen25250" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9444"/><lg sID="gen25251"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9444"/>Annuntiate Ægypto, et auditum facite in Magdalo, <l eID="gen25252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25253"/>et resonet in Memphis, et in Taphnis : <l eID="gen25253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25254"/>dicite : Sta, et præpara te, <l eID="gen25254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25255"/>quia devorabit gladius ea quæ per circuitum tuum sunt. <l eID="gen25255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9445"/><l level="1" sID="gen25256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9445"/>Quare computruit fortis tuus ? <l eID="gen25256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25257"/>non stetit, quoniam Dominus subvertit eum. <l eID="gen25257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9446"/><l level="1" sID="gen25258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9446"/>Multiplicavit ruentes, <l eID="gen25258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25259"/>ceciditque vir ad proximum suum, et dicent : <l eID="gen25259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25260"/>Surge, et revertamur ad populum nostrum, <l eID="gen25260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25261"/>et ad terram nativitatis nostræ, <l eID="gen25261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25262"/>a facie gladii columbæ. <l eID="gen25262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9447"/><l level="1" sID="gen25263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9447"/>Vocate nomen Pharaonis regis Ægypti : <l eID="gen25263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25264"/>tumultum adduxit tempus. <l eID="gen25264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9448"/><l level="1" sID="gen25265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9448"/>Vivo ego, inquit Rex (Dominus exercituum nomen ejus), <l eID="gen25265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25266"/>quoniam sicut Thabor in montibus, <l eID="gen25266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25267"/>et sicut Carmelus in mari, veniet. <l eID="gen25267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9449"/><l level="1" sID="gen25268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9449"/>Vasa transmigrationis fac tibi, <l eID="gen25268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25269"/>habitatrix filia Ægypti : <l eID="gen25269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25270"/>quia Memphis in solitudinem erit, <l eID="gen25270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25271"/>et deseretur, et inhabitabilis erit. <l eID="gen25271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9450"/><l level="1" sID="gen25272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9450"/>Vitula elegans atque formosa Ægyptus, <l eID="gen25272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25273"/>stimulator ab aquilone veniet ei. <l eID="gen25273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9451"/><l level="1" sID="gen25274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9451"/>Mercenarii quoque ejus, <l eID="gen25274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25275"/>qui versabantur in medio ejus quasi vituli saginati, <l eID="gen25275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25276"/>versi sunt, et fugerunt simul, <l eID="gen25276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25277"/>nec stare potuerunt : <l eID="gen25277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25278"/>quia dies interfectionis eorum venit super eos, <l eID="gen25278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25279"/>tempus visitationis eorum. <l eID="gen25279" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9452"/><l level="1" sID="gen25280"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9452"/>Vox ejus quasi æris sonabit : <l eID="gen25280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25281"/>quoniam cum exercitu properabunt, <l eID="gen25281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25282"/>et cum securibus venient ei <l eID="gen25282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25283"/>quasi cædentes ligna. <l eID="gen25283" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9453"/><l level="1" sID="gen25284"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9453"/>Succiderunt saltum ejus, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25285"/>qui supputari non potest : <l eID="gen25285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25286"/>multiplicati sunt super locustas, <l eID="gen25286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25287"/>et non est eis numerus. <l eID="gen25287" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9454"/><l level="1" sID="gen25288"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9454"/>Confusa est filia Ægypti, <l eID="gen25288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25289"/>et tradita in manu populi aquilonis. <l eID="gen25289" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9455"/><l level="1" sID="gen25290"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9455"/>Dixit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen25290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25291"/>Ecce ego visitabo super tumultum Alexandriæ, <l eID="gen25291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25292"/>et super Pharaonem, et super Ægyptum, <l eID="gen25292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25293"/>et super deos ejus, et super reges ejus, <l eID="gen25293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25294"/>et super Pharaonem, et super eos qui confidunt in eo : <l eID="gen25294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9456"/><l level="1" sID="gen25295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9456"/>et dabo eos in manu quærentium animam eorum, <l eID="gen25295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25296"/>et in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, <l eID="gen25296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25297"/>et in manu servorum ejus : <l eID="gen25297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25298"/>et post hæc habitabitur sicut diebus pristinis, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9457"/><l level="1" sID="gen25299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9457"/>Et tu ne timeas, serve meus Jacob, <l eID="gen25299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25300"/>et ne paveas, Israël : <l eID="gen25300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25301"/>quia ecce ego salvum te faciam de longinquo, <l eID="gen25301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25302"/>et semen tuum de terra captivitatis tuæ : <l eID="gen25302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25303"/>et revertetur Jacob, et requiescet, <l eID="gen25303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25304"/>et prosperabitur, et non erit qui exterreat eum. <l eID="gen25304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 46:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9458"/><l level="1" sID="gen25305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9458"/>Et tu noli timere, serve meus Jacob, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25306"/>quia tecum ego sum : <l eID="gen25306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25307"/>quia ego consumam cunctas gentes ad quas ejeci te, <l eID="gen25307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25308"/>te vero non consumam : <l eID="gen25308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25309"/>sed castigabo te in judicio, <l eID="gen25309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25310"/>nec quasi innocenti parcam tibi. <l eID="gen25310" level="1"/><lg eID="gen25251"/> <chapter eID="Jer.46"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:1
verses.text: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam contra Palæstinos, antequam percuteret Pharao Gazam.  <div eID="gen25311" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9459"/><lg sID="gen25312"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9459"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25314"/>Ecce aquæ ascendunt ab aquilone, <l eID="gen25314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25315"/>et erunt quasi torrens inundans, <l eID="gen25315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25316"/>et operient terram et plenitudinem ejus, <l eID="gen25316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25317"/>urbem et habitatores ejus. <l eID="gen25317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25318"/>Clamabunt homines, <l eID="gen25318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25319"/>et ululabunt omnes habitatores terræ, <l eID="gen25319" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9460"/><l level="1" sID="gen25320"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9460"/>a strepitu pompæ armorum, et bellatorum ejus, <l eID="gen25320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25321"/>a commotione quadrigarum ejus, et multitudine rotarum illius. <l eID="gen25321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25322"/>Non respexerunt patres filios manibus dissolutis, <l eID="gen25322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9461"/><l level="1" sID="gen25323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9461"/>pro adventu diei in quo vastabuntur omnes Philisthiim, <l eID="gen25323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25324"/>et dissipabitur Tyrus et Sidon <l eID="gen25324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25325"/>cum omnibus reliquis auxiliis suis : <l eID="gen25325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25326"/>depopulatus est enim Dominus Palæstinos, <l eID="gen25326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25327"/>reliquias insulæ Cappadociæ. <l eID="gen25327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9462"/><l level="1" sID="gen25328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9462"/>Venit calvitium super Gazam ; <l eID="gen25328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25329"/>conticuit Ascalon, et reliquiæ vallis earum : <l eID="gen25329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25330"/>usquequo concideris ? <l eID="gen25330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9463"/><l level="1" sID="gen25331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9463"/>O mucro Domini, usquequo non quiesces ? <l eID="gen25331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25332"/>ingredere in vaginam tuam, <l eID="gen25332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25333"/>refrigerare, et sile. <l eID="gen25333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 47:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9464"/><l level="1" sID="gen25334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9464"/>Quomodo quiescet, <l eID="gen25334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25335"/>cum Dominus præceperit ei adversus Ascalonem, <l eID="gen25335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25336"/>et adversus maritimas ejus regiones, <l eID="gen25336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25337"/>ibique condixerit illi ? <l eID="gen25337" level="1"/><lg eID="gen25312"/> <chapter eID="Jer.47"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:1
verses.text: Ad Moab. <div eID="gen25338" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25339"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25340"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen25340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25341"/>Væ super Nabo, quoniam vastata est, et confusa ! <l eID="gen25341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25342"/>capta est Cariathaim, confusa est fortis, et tremuit. <l eID="gen25342" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9465"/><l level="1" sID="gen25343"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9465"/>Non est ultra exsultatio in Moab contra Hesebon : <l eID="gen25343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25344"/>cogitaverunt malum : Venite, et disperdamus eam de gente. <l eID="gen25344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25345"/>Ergo silens conticesces, sequeturque te gladius. <l eID="gen25345" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9466"/><l level="1" sID="gen25346"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9466"/>Vox clamoris de Oronaim, vastitas et contritio magna. <l eID="gen25346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9467"/><l level="1" sID="gen25347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9467"/>Contrita est Moab : annuntiate clamorem parvulis ejus. <l eID="gen25347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9468"/><l level="1" sID="gen25348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9468"/>Per ascensum enim Luith <l eID="gen25348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25349"/>plorans ascendet in fletu, <l eID="gen25349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25350"/>quoniam in descensu Oronaim <l eID="gen25350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25351"/>hostes ululatum contritionis audierunt. <l eID="gen25351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9469"/><l level="1" sID="gen25352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9469"/>Fugite, salvate animas vestras, <l eID="gen25352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25353"/>et eritis quasi myricæ in deserto : <l eID="gen25353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9470"/><l level="1" sID="gen25354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9470"/>pro eo enim quod habuisti fiduciam <l eID="gen25354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25355"/>in munitionibus tuis et in thesauris tuis, <l eID="gen25355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25356"/>tu quoque capieris : <l eID="gen25356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25357"/>et ibit Chamos in transmigrationem, <l eID="gen25357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25358"/>sacerdotes ejus et principes ejus simul. <l eID="gen25358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9471"/><l level="1" sID="gen25359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9471"/>Et veniet prædo ad omnem urbem, <l eID="gen25359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25360"/>et urbs nulla salvabitur : <l eID="gen25360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25361"/>et peribunt valles, <l eID="gen25361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25362"/>et dissipabuntur campestria, <l eID="gen25362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25363"/>quoniam dixit Dominus : <l eID="gen25363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9472"/><l level="1" sID="gen25364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9472"/>Date florem Moab, quia florens egredietur : <l eID="gen25364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25365"/>et civitates ejus desertæ erunt, et inhabitabiles. <l eID="gen25365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9473"/><l level="1" sID="gen25366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9473"/>Maledictus qui facit opus Domini fraudulenter, <l eID="gen25366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25367"/>et maledictus qui prohibet gladium suum a sanguine. <l eID="gen25367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9474"/><l level="1" sID="gen25368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9474"/>Fertilis fuit Moab ab adolescentia sua, <l eID="gen25368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25369"/>et requievit in fæcibus suis : <l eID="gen25369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25370"/>nec transfusus est de vase in vas, <l eID="gen25370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25371"/>et in transmigrationem non abiit : <l eID="gen25371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25372"/>idcirco permansit gustus ejus in eo, <l eID="gen25372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25373"/>et odor ejus non est immutatus. <l eID="gen25373" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9475"/><l level="1" sID="gen25374"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9475"/>Propterea ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen25374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25375"/>et mittam ei ordinatores et stratores laguncularum : <l eID="gen25375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25376"/>et sternent eum, et vasa ejus exhaurient, <l eID="gen25376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25377"/>et lagunculas eorum collident. <l eID="gen25377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9476"/><l level="1" sID="gen25378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9476"/>Et confundetur Moab a Chamos <l eID="gen25378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25379"/>sicut confusa est domus Israël a Bethel, <l eID="gen25379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25380"/>in qua habebat fiduciam. <l eID="gen25380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9477"/><l level="1" sID="gen25381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9477"/>Quomodo dicitis : Fortes sumus, <l eID="gen25381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25382"/>et viri robusti ad præliandum ? <l eID="gen25382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9478"/><l level="1" sID="gen25383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9478"/>Vastata est Moab, et civitates illius succiderunt, <l eID="gen25383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25384"/>et electi juvenes ejus descenderunt in occisionem, ait Rex : <l eID="gen25384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25385"/>Dominus exercituum nomen ejus. <l eID="gen25385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9479"/><l level="1" sID="gen25386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9479"/>Prope est interitus Moab ut veniat, <l eID="gen25386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25387"/>et malum ejus velociter accurret nimis. <l eID="gen25387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9480"/><l level="1" sID="gen25388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9480"/>Consolamini eum, omnes qui estis in circuitu ejus : <l eID="gen25388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25389"/>et universi qui scitis nomen ejus, dicite : <l eID="gen25389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25390"/>Quomodo confracta est virga fortis, <l eID="gen25390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25391"/>baculus gloriosus ? <l eID="gen25391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9481"/><l level="1" sID="gen25392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9481"/>Descende de gloria, et sede in siti, <l eID="gen25392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25393"/>habitatio filiæ Dibon, <l eID="gen25393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25394"/>quoniam vastator Moab ascendit ad te : <l eID="gen25394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25395"/>dissipavit munitiones tuas. <l eID="gen25395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9482"/><l level="1" sID="gen25396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9482"/>In via sta, et prospice, <l eID="gen25396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25397"/>habitatio Aroër : <l eID="gen25397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25398"/>interroga fugientem, <l eID="gen25398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25399"/>et ei qui evasit dic : Quid accidit ? <l eID="gen25399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9483"/><l level="1" sID="gen25400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9483"/>Confusus est Moab, quoniam victus est. <l eID="gen25400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25401"/>Ululate, et clamate : <l eID="gen25401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25402"/>annuntiate in Arnon, <l eID="gen25402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25403"/>quoniam vastata est Moab, <l eID="gen25403" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9484"/><l level="1" sID="gen25404"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9484"/>et judicium venit ad terram campestrem, <l eID="gen25404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25405"/>super Helon, et super Jasa, <l eID="gen25405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25406"/>et super Mephaath,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:22
verses.text: et super Dibon, <l eID="gen25406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25407"/>et super Nabo, et super domum Deblathaim, <l eID="gen25407" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9485"/><l level="1" sID="gen25408"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9485"/>et super Cariathaim, et super Bethgamul, <l eID="gen25408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25409"/>et super Bethmaon,

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:24
verses.text: et super Carioth, <l eID="gen25409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25410"/>et super Bosra, et super omnes civitates terræ Moab, <l eID="gen25410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25411"/>quæ longe et quæ prope sunt. <l eID="gen25411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9486"/><l level="1" sID="gen25412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9486"/>Abscissum est cornu Moab, <l eID="gen25412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25413"/>et brachium ejus contritum est, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9487"/><l level="1" sID="gen25414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9487"/>Inebriate eum, quoniam contra Dominum erectus est : <l eID="gen25414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25415"/>et allidet manum Moab in vomitu suo, <l eID="gen25415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25416"/>et erit in derisum etiam ipse. <l eID="gen25416" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9488"/><l level="1" sID="gen25417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9488"/>Fuit enim in derisum tibi Israël : <l eID="gen25417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25418"/>quasi inter fures reperisses eum : <l eID="gen25418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25419"/>propter verba ergo tua quæ adversum illum locutus es, <l eID="gen25419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25420"/>captivus duceris. <l eID="gen25420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9489"/><l level="1" sID="gen25421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9489"/>Relinquite civitates, et habitate in petra, habitatores Moab : <l eID="gen25421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25422"/>et estote quasi columba nidificans in summo ore foraminis. <l eID="gen25422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9490"/><l level="1" sID="gen25423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9490"/>Audivimus superbiam Moab : superbus est valde : <l eID="gen25423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25424"/>sublimitatem ejus, et arrogantiam, <l eID="gen25424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25425"/>et superbiam, et altitudinem cordis ejus. <l eID="gen25425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9491"/><l level="1" sID="gen25426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9491"/>Ego scio, ait Dominus, jactantiam ejus, <l eID="gen25426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25427"/>et quod non sit juxta eam virtus ejus, <l eID="gen25427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25428"/>nec juxta quod poterat conata sit facere. <l eID="gen25428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9492"/><l level="1" sID="gen25429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9492"/>Ideo super Moab ejulabo, <l eID="gen25429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25430"/>et ad Moab universam clamabo, <l eID="gen25430" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25431"/>ad viros muri fictilis lamentantes : <l eID="gen25431" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9493"/><l level="1" sID="gen25432"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9493"/>de planctu Jazer plorabo tibi, vinea Sabama. <l eID="gen25432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25433"/>Propagines tuæ transierunt mare ; <l eID="gen25433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25434"/>usque ad mare Jazer pervenerunt : <l eID="gen25434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25435"/>super messem tuam et vindemiam tuam prædo irruit. <l eID="gen25435" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9494"/><l level="1" sID="gen25436"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9494"/>Ablata est lætitia et exsultatio <l eID="gen25436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25437"/>de Carmelo et de terra Moab, <l eID="gen25437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25438"/>et vinum de torcularibus sustuli : <l eID="gen25438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25439"/>nequaquam calcator uvæ solitum celeuma cantabit. <l eID="gen25439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9495"/><l level="1" sID="gen25440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9495"/>De clamore Hesebon usque Eleale et Jasa, dederunt vocem suam ; <l eID="gen25440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25441"/>a Segor usque ad Oronaim, vitula conternante : <l eID="gen25441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25442"/>aquæ quoque Nemrim pessimæ erunt. <l eID="gen25442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9496"/><l level="1" sID="gen25443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9496"/>Et auferam de Moab, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25444"/>offerentem in excelsis, <l eID="gen25444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25445"/>et sacrificantem diis ejus. <l eID="gen25445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9497"/><l level="1" sID="gen25446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9497"/>Propterea cor meum ad Moab quasi tibiæ resonabit, <l eID="gen25446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25447"/>et cor meum ad viros muri fictilis dabit sonitum tibiarum : <l eID="gen25447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25448"/>quia plus fecit quam potuit, <l eID="gen25448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25449"/>idcirco perierunt. <l eID="gen25449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9498"/><l level="1" sID="gen25450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9498"/>Omne enim caput calvitium, <l eID="gen25450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25451"/>et omnis barba rasa erit : <l eID="gen25451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25452"/>in cunctis manibus colligatio, <l eID="gen25452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25453"/>et super omne dorsum cilicium : <l eID="gen25453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9499"/><l level="1" sID="gen25454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9499"/>super omnia tecta Moab, et in plateis ejus, <l eID="gen25454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25455"/>omnis planctus : <l eID="gen25455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25456"/>quoniam contrivi Moab <l eID="gen25456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25457"/>sicut vas inutile, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9500"/><l level="1" sID="gen25458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9500"/>Quomodo victa est, et ululaverunt ? <l eID="gen25458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25459"/>quomodo dejecit cervicem Moab, et confusus est ? <l eID="gen25459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25460"/>eritque Moab in derisum, et in exemplum omnibus in circuitu suo. <l eID="gen25460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9501"/><l level="1" sID="gen25461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9501"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25462"/>Ecce quasi aquila volabit, <l eID="gen25462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25463"/>et extendet alas suas ad Moab. <l eID="gen25463" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9502"/><l level="1" sID="gen25464"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9502"/>Capta est Carioth, et munitiones comprehensæ sunt : <l eID="gen25464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25465"/>et erit cor fortium Moab in die illa <l eID="gen25465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25466"/>sicut cor mulieris parturientis, <l eID="gen25466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9503"/><l level="1" sID="gen25467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9503"/>et cessabit Moab esse populus, <l eID="gen25467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25468"/>quoniam contra Dominum gloriatus est. <l eID="gen25468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9504"/><l level="1" sID="gen25469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9504"/>Pavor, et fovea, <l eID="gen25469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25470"/>et laqueus super te, <l eID="gen25470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25471"/>o habitator Moab, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen25471" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9505"/><l level="1" sID="gen25472"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9505"/>Qui fugerit a facie pavoris cadet in foveam, <l eID="gen25472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25473"/>et qui conscenderit de fovea capietur laqueo : <l eID="gen25473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25474"/>adducam enim super Moab annum visitationis eorum, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9506"/><l level="1" sID="gen25475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9506"/>In umbra Hesebon steterunt de laqueo fugientes, <l eID="gen25475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25476"/>quia ignis egressus est de Hesebon, <l eID="gen25476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25477"/>et flamma de medio Seon : <l eID="gen25477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25478"/>et devorabit partem Moab, <l eID="gen25478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25479"/>et verticem filiorum tumultus. <l eID="gen25479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9507"/><l level="1" sID="gen25480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9507"/>Væ tibi, Moab : <l eID="gen25480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25481"/>periisti, popule Chamos, <l eID="gen25481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25482"/>quia comprehensi sunt filii tui <l eID="gen25482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25483"/>et filiæ tuæ in captivitatem. <l eID="gen25483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 48:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9508"/><l level="1" sID="gen25484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9508"/>Et convertam captivitatem Moab in novissimis diebus, ait Dominus. Hucusque judicia Moab. <l eID="gen25484" level="1"/><lg eID="gen25339"/> <chapter eID="Jer.48"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:1
verses.text: Ad filios Ammon. <div eID="gen25485" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25486"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25487"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25488"/>Numquid non filii sunt Israël, <l eID="gen25488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25489"/>aut hæres non est ei ? <l eID="gen25489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25490"/>cur igitur hæreditate possedit Melchom Gad, <l eID="gen25490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25491"/>et populus ejus in urbibus ejus habitavit ? <l eID="gen25491" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9509"/><l level="1" sID="gen25492"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9509"/>Ideo ecce dies veniunt, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen25492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25493"/>et auditum faciam super Rabbath filiorum Ammon fremitum prælii, <l eID="gen25493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25494"/>et erit in tumultum dissipata, <l eID="gen25494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25495"/>filiæque ejus igni succendentur, <l eID="gen25495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25496"/>et possidebit Israël possessores suos, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9510"/><l level="1" sID="gen25497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9510"/>Ulula, Hesebon, quoniam vastata est Hai ; <l eID="gen25497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25498"/>clamate, filiæ Rabbath : <l eID="gen25498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25499"/>accingite vos ciliciis, <l eID="gen25499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25500"/>plangite et circuite per sepes, <l eID="gen25500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25501"/>quoniam Melchom in transmigrationem ducetur, <l eID="gen25501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25502"/>sacerdotes ejus et principes ejus simul. <l eID="gen25502" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9511"/><l level="1" sID="gen25503"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9511"/>Quid gloriaris in vallibus ? <l eID="gen25503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25504"/>defluxit vallis tua, filia delicata, <l eID="gen25504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25505"/>quæ confidebas in thesauris tuis, <l eID="gen25505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25506"/>et dicebas : Quis veniet ad me ? <l eID="gen25506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9512"/><l level="1" sID="gen25507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9512"/>Ecce ego inducam super te terrorem, <l eID="gen25507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25508"/>ait Dominus Deus exercituum, <l eID="gen25508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25509"/>ab omnibus qui sunt in circuitu tuo : <l eID="gen25509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25510"/>et dispergemini singuli a conspectu vestro, <l eID="gen25510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25511"/>nec erit qui congreget fugientes. <l eID="gen25511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9513"/><l level="1" sID="gen25512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9513"/>Et post hæc reverti faciam <l eID="gen25512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25513"/>captivos filiorum Ammon, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25513" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen25486"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9514"/><div sID="gen25514" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9514"/>Ad Idumæam. <div eID="gen25514" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25515"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25516"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen25516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25517"/>Numquid non ultra est sapientia in Theman ? <l eID="gen25517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25518"/>periit consilium a filiis ; <l eID="gen25518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25519"/>inutilis facta est sapientia eorum. <l eID="gen25519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9515"/><l level="1" sID="gen25520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9515"/>Fugite, et terga vertite ; <l eID="gen25520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25521"/>descendite in voraginem, habitatores Dedan : <l eID="gen25521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25522"/>quoniam perditionem Esau adduxi super eum, <l eID="gen25522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25523"/>tempus visitationis ejus. <l eID="gen25523" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9516"/><l level="1" sID="gen25524"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9516"/>Si vindemiatores venissent super te, <l eID="gen25524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25525"/>non reliquissent racemum : <l eID="gen25525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25526"/>si fures in nocte rapuissent quod sufficeret sibi. <l eID="gen25526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9517"/><l level="1" sID="gen25527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9517"/>Ego vero discooperui Esau : <l eID="gen25527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25528"/>revelavi abscondita ejus, <l eID="gen25528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25529"/>et celari non poterit : <l eID="gen25529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25530"/>vastatum est semen ejus, <l eID="gen25530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25531"/>et fratres ejus, et vicini ejus, et non erit. <l eID="gen25531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9518"/><l level="1" sID="gen25532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9518"/>Relinque pupillos tuos : ego faciam eos vivere : <l eID="gen25532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25533"/>et viduæ tuæ in me sperabunt. <l eID="gen25533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9519"/><l level="1" sID="gen25534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9519"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25535"/>Ecce quibus non erat judicium ut biberent calicem, <l eID="gen25535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25536"/>bibentes bibent : <l eID="gen25536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25537"/>et tu, quasi innocens relinqueris ? <l eID="gen25537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25538"/>non eris innocens, sed bibens bibes. <l eID="gen25538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9520"/><l level="1" sID="gen25539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9520"/>Quia per memetipsum juravi, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen25539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25540"/>quod in solitudinem, et in opprobrium, <l eID="gen25540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25541"/>et in desertum, et in maledictionem erit Bosra, <l eID="gen25541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25542"/>et omnes civitates ejus erunt in solitudines sempiternas. <l eID="gen25542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9521"/><l level="1" sID="gen25543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9521"/>Auditum audivi a Domino, <l eID="gen25543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25544"/>et legatus ad gentes missus est : <l eID="gen25544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25545"/>Congregamini, et venite contra eam, <l eID="gen25545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25546"/>et consurgamus in prælium. <l eID="gen25546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9522"/><l level="1" sID="gen25547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9522"/>Ecce enim parvulum dedi te in gentibus, <l eID="gen25547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25548"/>contemptibilem inter homines. <l eID="gen25548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9523"/><l level="1" sID="gen25549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9523"/>Arrogantia tua decepit te, <l eID="gen25549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25550"/>et superbia cordis tui, <l eID="gen25550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25551"/>qui habitas in cavernis petræ, <l eID="gen25551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25552"/>et apprehendere niteris altitudinem collis : <l eID="gen25552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25553"/>cum exaltaveris quasi aquila nidum tuum, <l eID="gen25553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25554"/>inde detraham te, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen25554" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9524"/><l level="1" sID="gen25555"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9524"/>Et erit Idumæa deserta : <l eID="gen25555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25556"/>omnis qui transibit per eam stupebit, <l eID="gen25556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25557"/>et sibilabit super omnes plagas ejus. <l eID="gen25557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9525"/><l level="1" sID="gen25558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9525"/>Sicut subversa est Sodoma et Gomorrha, <l eID="gen25558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25559"/>et vicinæ ejus, ait Dominus : <l eID="gen25559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25560"/>non habitabit ibi vir, <l eID="gen25560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25561"/>et non incolet eam filius hominis. <l eID="gen25561" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9526"/><l level="1" sID="gen25562"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9526"/>Ecce quasi leo ascendet <l eID="gen25562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25563"/>de superbia Jordanis ad pulchritudinem robustam, <l eID="gen25563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25564"/>quia subito currere faciam eum ad illam. <l eID="gen25564" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25565"/>Et quis erit electus, quem præponam ei ? <l eID="gen25565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25566"/>quis enim similis mei ? <l eID="gen25566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25567"/>et quis sustinebit me ? <l eID="gen25567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25568"/>et quis est iste pastor, qui resistat vultui meo ? <l eID="gen25568" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9527"/><l level="1" sID="gen25569"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9527"/>Propterea audite consilium Domini quod iniit de Edom, <l eID="gen25569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25570"/>et cogitationes ejus quas cogitavit de habitatoribus Theman : <l eID="gen25570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25571"/>si non dejecerint eos parvuli gregis, <l eID="gen25571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25572"/>nisi dissipaverint cum eis habitaculum eorum. <l eID="gen25572" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9528"/><l level="1" sID="gen25573"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9528"/>A voce ruinæ eorum commota est terra ; <l eID="gen25573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25574"/>clamor in mari Rubro auditus est vocis ejus. <l eID="gen25574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9529"/><l level="1" sID="gen25575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9529"/>Ecce quasi aquila ascendet, <l eID="gen25575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25576"/>et avolabit, et expandet alas suas super Bosran : <l eID="gen25576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25577"/>et erit cor fortium Idumææ in die illa <l eID="gen25577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25578"/>quasi cor mulieris parturientis. <l eID="gen25578" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen25515"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9530"/><div sID="gen25579" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9530"/>Ad Damascum. <div eID="gen25579" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25580"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25581"/>Confusa est Emath et Arphad, <l eID="gen25581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25582"/>quia auditum pessimum audierunt : <l eID="gen25582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25583"/>turbati sunt in mari ; <l eID="gen25583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25584"/>præ sollicitudine quiescere non potuit. <l eID="gen25584" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9531"/><l level="1" sID="gen25585"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9531"/>Dissoluta est Damascus, <l eID="gen25585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25586"/>versa est in fugam : <l eID="gen25586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25587"/>tremor apprehendit eam, <l eID="gen25587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25588"/>angustia et dolores tenuerunt eam quasi parturientem. <l eID="gen25588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9532"/><l level="1" sID="gen25589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9532"/>Quomodo dereliquerunt civitatem laudabilem, <l eID="gen25589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25590"/>urbem lætitiæ ? <l eID="gen25590" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9533"/><l level="1" sID="gen25591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9533"/>Ideo cadent juvenes ejus in plateis ejus, <l eID="gen25591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25592"/>et omnes viri prælii conticescent in die illa, <l eID="gen25592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25593"/>ait Dominus exercituum. <l eID="gen25593" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9534"/><l level="1" sID="gen25594"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9534"/>Et succendam ignem in muro Damasci, <l eID="gen25594" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25595"/>et devorabit mœnia Benadad. <l eID="gen25595" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen25580"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9535"/><div sID="gen25596" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9535"/>Ad Cedar, et ad regna Asor, quæ percussit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis. <div eID="gen25596" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen25597"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25598"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25599"/>Surgite, et ascendite ad Cedar, <l eID="gen25599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25600"/>et vastate filios orientis. <l eID="gen25600" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9536"/><l level="1" sID="gen25601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9536"/>Tabernacula eorum, et greges eorum capient : <l eID="gen25601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25602"/>pelles eorum, et omnia vasa eorum, <l eID="gen25602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25603"/>et camelos eorum tollent sibi, <l eID="gen25603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25604"/>et vocabunt super eos formidinem in circuitu. <l eID="gen25604" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9537"/><l level="1" sID="gen25605"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9537"/>Fugite, abite vehementer, in voraginibus sedete, <l eID="gen25605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25606"/>qui habitatis Asor, ait Dominus : <l eID="gen25606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25607"/>iniit enim contra vos Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis consilium, <l eID="gen25607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25608"/>et cogitavit adversum vos cogitationes. <l eID="gen25608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9538"/><l level="1" sID="gen25609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9538"/>Consurgite, et ascendite ad gentem quietam, <l eID="gen25609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25610"/>et habitantem confidenter, ait Dominus : <l eID="gen25610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25611"/>non ostia, nec vectes eis : soli habitant. <l eID="gen25611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9539"/><l level="1" sID="gen25612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9539"/>Et erunt cameli eorum in direptionem, <l eID="gen25612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25613"/>et multitudo jumentorum in prædam : <l eID="gen25613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25614"/>et dispergam eos in omnem ventum, <l eID="gen25614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25615"/>qui sunt attonsi in comam, <l eID="gen25615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25616"/>et ex omni confinio eorum adducam interitum super eos, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9540"/><l level="1" sID="gen25617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9540"/>Et erit Asor in habitaculum draconum, <l eID="gen25617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25618"/>deserta usque in æternum : <l eID="gen25618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25619"/>non manebit ibi vir, <l eID="gen25619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25620"/>nec incolet eam filius hominis. <l eID="gen25620" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen25597"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9541"/><div sID="gen25621" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9541"/>Quod facum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam adversus Ælam, in principio regni Sedeciæ regis Juda, dicens :  <div eID="gen25621" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9542"/><lg sID="gen25622"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9542"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen25623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25624"/>Ecce ego confringam arcum Ælam, <l eID="gen25624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25625"/>et summam fortitudinem eorum : <l eID="gen25625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9543"/><l level="1" sID="gen25626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9543"/>et inducam super Ælam quatuor ventos a quatuor plagis cæli, <l eID="gen25626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25627"/>et ventilabo eos in omnes ventos istos, <l eID="gen25627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25628"/>et non erit gens ad quam non perveniant profugi Ælam. <l eID="gen25628" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9544"/><l level="1" sID="gen25629"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9544"/>Et pavere faciam Ælam coram inimicis suis, <l eID="gen25629" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25630"/>et in conspectu quærentium animam eorum : <l eID="gen25630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25631"/>et adducam super eos malum, <l eID="gen25631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25632"/>iram furoris mei, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen25632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25633"/>et mittam post eos gladium donec consumam eos. <l eID="gen25633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9545"/><l level="1" sID="gen25634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9545"/>Et ponam solium meum in Ælam, <l eID="gen25634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25635"/>et perdam inde reges et principes, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 49:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9546"/><l level="1" sID="gen25636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9546"/>In novissimis autem diebus <l eID="gen25636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25637"/>reverti faciam captivos Ælam, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen25637" level="1"/><lg eID="gen25622"/> <chapter eID="Jer.49"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:1
verses.text: Verbum quod locutus est Dominus de Babylone et de terra Chaldæorum, in manu Jeremiæ prophetæ.  <div eID="gen25638" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9547"/><lg sID="gen25639"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9547"/>Annuntiate in gentibus, et auditum facite : <l eID="gen25640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25641"/>levate signum, prædicate, et nolite celare : <l eID="gen25641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25642"/>dicite : Capta est Babylon, <l eID="gen25642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25643"/>confusus est Bel, victus est Merodach, <l eID="gen25643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25644"/>confusa sunt sculptilia ejus, <l eID="gen25644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25645"/>superata sunt idola eorum. <l eID="gen25645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9548"/><l level="1" sID="gen25646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9548"/>Quoniam ascendit contra eam gens ab aquilone, <l eID="gen25646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25647"/>quæ ponet terram ejus in solitudinem, <l eID="gen25647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25648"/>et non erit qui habitet in ea ab homine usque ad pecus : <l eID="gen25648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25649"/>et moti sunt, et abierunt. <l eID="gen25649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9549"/><l level="1" sID="gen25650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9549"/>In diebus illis, et in tempore illo, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25651"/>venient filii Israël ipsi et filii Juda simul : <l eID="gen25651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25652"/>ambulantes et flentes properabunt, <l eID="gen25652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25653"/>et Dominum Deum suum quærent : <l eID="gen25653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9550"/><l level="1" sID="gen25654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9550"/>in Sion interrogabunt viam, huc facies eorum : <l eID="gen25654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25655"/>venient, et apponentur ad Dominum fœdere sempiterno, <l eID="gen25655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25656"/>quod nulla oblivione delebitur. <l eID="gen25656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9551"/><l level="1" sID="gen25657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9551"/>Grex perditus factus est populus meus : <l eID="gen25657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25658"/>pastores eorum seduxerunt eos, <l eID="gen25658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25659"/>feceruntque vagari in montibus : <l eID="gen25659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25660"/>de monte in collem transierunt ; <l eID="gen25660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25661"/>obliti sunt cubilis sui. <l eID="gen25661" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9552"/><l level="1" sID="gen25662"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9552"/>Omnes qui invenerunt comederunt eos, <l eID="gen25662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25663"/>et hostes eorum dixerunt : Non peccavimus : <l eID="gen25663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25664"/>pro eo quod peccaverunt Domino decori justitiæ, <l eID="gen25664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25665"/>et exspectationi patrum eorum Domino. <l eID="gen25665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9553"/><l level="1" sID="gen25666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9553"/>Recedite de medio Babylonis, <l eID="gen25666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25667"/>et de terra Chaldæorum egredimini, <l eID="gen25667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25668"/>et estote quasi hædi ante gregem. <l eID="gen25668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9554"/><l level="1" sID="gen25669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9554"/>Quoniam ecce ego suscito, <l eID="gen25669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25670"/>et adducam in Babylonem <l eID="gen25670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25671"/>congregationem gentium magnarum de terra aquilonis, <l eID="gen25671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25672"/>et præparabuntur adversus eam, et inde capietur : <l eID="gen25672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25673"/>sagitta ejus quasi viri fortis interfectoris : <l eID="gen25673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25674"/>non revertetur vacua. <l eID="gen25674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9555"/><l level="1" sID="gen25675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9555"/>Et erit Chaldæa in prædam : <l eID="gen25675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25676"/>omnes vastantes eam replebuntur, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9556"/><l level="1" sID="gen25677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9556"/>Quoniam exsultatis, et magna loquimini, <l eID="gen25677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25678"/>diripientes hæreditatem meam : <l eID="gen25678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25679"/>quoniam effusi estis sicut vituli super herbam, <l eID="gen25679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25680"/>et mugistis sicut tauri : <l eID="gen25680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9557"/><l level="1" sID="gen25681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9557"/>confusa est mater vestra nimis, <l eID="gen25681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25682"/>et adæquata pulveri, quæ genuit vos : <l eID="gen25682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25683"/>ecce novissima erit in gentibus, <l eID="gen25683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25684"/>deserta, invia, et arens. <l eID="gen25684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9558"/><l level="1" sID="gen25685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9558"/>Ab ira Domini non habitabitur, <l eID="gen25685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25686"/>sed redigetur tota in solitudinem : <l eID="gen25686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25687"/>omnis qui transibit per Babylonem stupebit, <l eID="gen25687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25688"/>et sibilabit super universis plagis ejus. <l eID="gen25688" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:14
