verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9559"/><l level="1" sID="gen25689"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9559"/>Præparamini contra Babylonem per circuitum, <l eID="gen25689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25690"/>omnes qui tenditis arcum : <l eID="gen25690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25691"/>debellate eam, non parcatis jaculis, <l eID="gen25691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25692"/>quia Domino peccavit. <l eID="gen25692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9560"/><l level="1" sID="gen25693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9560"/>Clamate adversus eam, <l eID="gen25693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25694"/>ubique dedit manum : <l eID="gen25694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25695"/>ceciderunt fundamenta ejus, <l eID="gen25695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25696"/>destructi sunt muri ejus, <l eID="gen25696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25697"/>quoniam ultio Domini est : <l eID="gen25697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25698"/>ultionem accipite de ea : <l eID="gen25698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25699"/>sicut fecit, facite ei. <l eID="gen25699" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9561"/><l level="1" sID="gen25700"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9561"/>Disperdite satorem de Babylone, <l eID="gen25700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25701"/>et tenentem falcem in tempore messis : <l eID="gen25701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25702"/>a facie gladii columbæ <l eID="gen25702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25703"/>unusquisque ad populum suum convertetur, <l eID="gen25703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25704"/>et singuli ad terram suam fugient. <l eID="gen25704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9562"/><l level="1" sID="gen25705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9562"/>Grex dispersus Israël : <l eID="gen25705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25706"/>leones ejecerunt eum. <l eID="gen25706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25707"/>Primus comedit eum rex Assur : <l eID="gen25707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25708"/>iste novissimus exossavit eum <l eID="gen25708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25709"/>Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis. <l eID="gen25709" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9563"/><l level="1" sID="gen25710"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9563"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen25710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25711"/>Ecce ego visitabo regem Babylonis et terram ejus, <l eID="gen25711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25712"/>sicut visitavi regem Assur : <l eID="gen25712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9564"/><l level="1" sID="gen25713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9564"/>et reducam Israël ad habitaculum suum : <l eID="gen25713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25714"/>et pascetur Carmelum et Basan, <l eID="gen25714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25715"/>et in monte Ephraim et Galaad saturabitur anima ejus. <l eID="gen25715" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9565"/><l level="1" sID="gen25716"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9565"/>In diebus illis, et in tempore illo, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25716" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25717"/>quæretur iniquitas Israël, et non erit, <l eID="gen25717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25718"/>et peccatum Juda, et non invenietur : <l eID="gen25718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25719"/>quoniam propitius ero eis quos reliquero. <l eID="gen25719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9566"/><l level="1" sID="gen25720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9566"/>Super terram dominantium ascende, <l eID="gen25720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25721"/>et super habitatores ejus visita : <l eID="gen25721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25722"/>dissipa, et interfice quæ post eos sunt, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25723"/>et fac juxta omnia quæ præcepi tibi. <l eID="gen25723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9567"/><l level="1" sID="gen25724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9567"/>Vox belli in terra, et contritio magna. <l eID="gen25724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9568"/><l level="1" sID="gen25725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9568"/>Quomodo confractus est et contritus malleus universæ terræ ? <l eID="gen25725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25726"/>quomodo versa est in desertum Babylon in gentibus ? <l eID="gen25726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9569"/><l level="1" sID="gen25727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9569"/>Illaqueavi te, et capta es, Babylon, <l eID="gen25727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25728"/>et nesciebas : <l eID="gen25728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25729"/>inventa es et apprehensa, <l eID="gen25729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25730"/>quoniam Dominum provocasti. <l eID="gen25730" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9570"/><l level="1" sID="gen25731"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9570"/>Aperuit Dominus thesaurum suum, <l eID="gen25731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25732"/>et protulit vasa iræ suæ, <l eID="gen25732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25733"/>quoniam opus est Domino Deo exercituum, <l eID="gen25733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25734"/>in terra Chaldæorum. <l eID="gen25734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9571"/><l level="1" sID="gen25735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9571"/>Venite ad eam ab extremis finibus ; <l eID="gen25735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25736"/>aperite ut exeant qui conculcent eam : <l eID="gen25736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25737"/>tollite de via lapides, et redigite in acervos : <l eID="gen25737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25738"/>et interficite eam, nec sit quidquam reliquum. <l eID="gen25738" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9572"/><l level="1" sID="gen25739"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9572"/>Dissipate universos fortes ejus : <l eID="gen25739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25740"/>descendant in occisionem : <l eID="gen25740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25741"/>væ eis, quia venit dies eorum, <l eID="gen25741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25742"/>tempus visitationis eorum ! <l eID="gen25742" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9573"/><l level="1" sID="gen25743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9573"/>Vox fugientium, <l eID="gen25743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25744"/>et eorum qui evaserunt de terra Babylonis, <l eID="gen25744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25745"/>ut annuntient in Sion ultionem Domini Dei nostri, <l eID="gen25745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25746"/>ultionem templi ejus. <l eID="gen25746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9574"/><l level="1" sID="gen25747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9574"/>Annuntiate in Babylonem plurimis, <l eID="gen25747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25748"/>omnibus qui tendunt arcum : <l eID="gen25748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25749"/>consistite adversus eam per gyrum, <l eID="gen25749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25750"/>et nullus evadat : <l eID="gen25750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25751"/>reddite ei secundum opus suum : <l eID="gen25751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25752"/>juxta omnia quæ fecit, facite illi, <l eID="gen25752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25753"/>quia contra Dominum erecta est, <l eID="gen25753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25754"/>adversum Sanctum Israël. <l eID="gen25754" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9575"/><l level="1" sID="gen25755"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9575"/>Idcirco cadent juvenes ejus in plateis ejus, <l eID="gen25755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25756"/>et omnes viri bellatores ejus conticescent in die illa, <l eID="gen25756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25757"/>ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25757" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9576"/><l level="1" sID="gen25758"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9576"/>Ecce ego ad te, superbe ! <l eID="gen25758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25759"/>dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : <l eID="gen25759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25760"/>quia venit dies tuus, <l eID="gen25760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25761"/>tempus visitationis tuæ. <l eID="gen25761" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9577"/><l level="1" sID="gen25762"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9577"/>Et cadet superbus, et corruet, <l eID="gen25762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25763"/>et non erit qui suscitet eum : <l eID="gen25763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25764"/>et succendam ignem in urbibus ejus, <l eID="gen25764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25765"/>et devorabit omnia in circuitu ejus. <l eID="gen25765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9578"/><l level="1" sID="gen25766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9578"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen25766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25767"/>Calumniam sustinent filii Israël, <l eID="gen25767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25768"/>et filii Juda simul : <l eID="gen25768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25769"/>omnes qui ceperunt eos, tenent : <l eID="gen25769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25770"/>nolunt dimittere eos. <l eID="gen25770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9579"/><l level="1" sID="gen25771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9579"/>Redemptor eorum fortis, <l eID="gen25771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25772"/>Dominus exercituum nomen ejus : <l eID="gen25772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25773"/>judicio defendet causam eorum, <l eID="gen25773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25774"/>ut exterreat terram, <l eID="gen25774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25775"/>et commoveat habitatores Babylonis. <l eID="gen25775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9580"/><l level="1" sID="gen25776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9580"/>Gladius ad Chaldæos, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25777"/>et ad habitatores Babylonis, <l eID="gen25777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25778"/>et ad principes, et ad sapientes ejus. <l eID="gen25778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9581"/><l level="1" sID="gen25779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9581"/>Gladius ad divinos ejus, qui stulti erunt : <l eID="gen25779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25780"/>gladius ad fortes illius, qui timebunt. <l eID="gen25780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9582"/><l level="1" sID="gen25781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9582"/>Gladius ad equos ejus, et ad currus ejus, <l eID="gen25781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25782"/>et ad omne vulgus quod est in medio ejus : <l eID="gen25782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25783"/>et erunt quasi mulieres : <l eID="gen25783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25784"/>gladius ad thesauros ejus, qui diripientur. <l eID="gen25784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9583"/><l level="1" sID="gen25785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9583"/>Siccitas super aquas ejus erit, et arescent, <l eID="gen25785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25786"/>quia terra sculptilium est, et in portentis gloriantur. <l eID="gen25786" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9584"/><l level="1" sID="gen25787"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9584"/>Propterea habitabunt dracones cum faunis ficariis, <l eID="gen25787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25788"/>et habitabunt in ea struthiones : <l eID="gen25788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25789"/>et non inhabitabitur ultra usque in sempiternum, <l eID="gen25789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25790"/>nec exstruetur usque ad generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen25790" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9585"/><l level="1" sID="gen25791"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9585"/>Sicut subvertit Dominus Sodomam et Gomorrham, <l eID="gen25791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25792"/>et vicinas ejus, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25793"/>non habitabit ibi vir, <l eID="gen25793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25794"/>et non incolet eam filius hominis. <l eID="gen25794" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9586"/><l level="1" sID="gen25795"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9586"/>Ecce populus venit ab aquilone, <l eID="gen25795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25796"/>et gens magna, et reges multi <l eID="gen25796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25797"/>consurgent a finibus terræ. <l eID="gen25797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9587"/><l level="1" sID="gen25798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9587"/>Arcum et scutum apprehendent : <l eID="gen25798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25799"/>crudeles sunt, et immisericordes : <l eID="gen25799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25800"/>vox eorum quasi mare sonabit, <l eID="gen25800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25801"/>et super equos ascendent, <l eID="gen25801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25802"/>sicut vir paratus ad prælium contra te, filia Babylon. <l eID="gen25802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9588"/><l level="1" sID="gen25803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9588"/>Audivit rex Babylonis famam eorum, <l eID="gen25803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25804"/>et dissolutæ sunt manus ejus : <l eID="gen25804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25805"/>angustia apprehendit eum, <l eID="gen25805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25806"/>dolor quasi parturientem. <l eID="gen25806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9589"/><l level="1" sID="gen25807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9589"/>Ecce quasi leo ascendet, <l eID="gen25807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25808"/>de superbia Jordanis ad pulchritudinem robustam, <l eID="gen25808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25809"/>quia subito currere faciam eum ad illam. <l eID="gen25809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25810"/>Et quis erit electus, quem præponam ei ? <l eID="gen25810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25811"/>quis est enim similis mei ? <l eID="gen25811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25812"/>et quis sustinebit me ? <l eID="gen25812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25813"/>et quis est iste pastor, qui resistat vultui meo ? <l eID="gen25813" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9590"/><l level="1" sID="gen25814"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9590"/>Propterea audite consilium Domini <l eID="gen25814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25815"/>quod mente concepit adversum Babylonem, <l eID="gen25815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25816"/>et cogitationes ejus <l eID="gen25816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25817"/>quas cogitavit super terram Chaldæorum : <l eID="gen25817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25818"/>nisi detraxerint eos parvuli gregum, <l eID="gen25818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25819"/>nisi dissipatum fuerit cum ipsis habitaculum eorum. <l eID="gen25819" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 50:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9591"/><l level="1" sID="gen25820"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9591"/>A voce captivitatis Babylonis commota est terra, <l eID="gen25820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25821"/>et clamor inter gentes auditus est.  <chapter eID="Jer.50"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25823"/>Ecce ego suscitabo super Babylonem et super habitatores ejus, <l eID="gen25823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25824"/>qui cor suum levaverunt contra me, <l eID="gen25824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25825"/>quasi ventum pestilentem : <l eID="gen25825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9592"/><l level="1" sID="gen25826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9592"/>et mittam in Babylonem ventilatores, <l eID="gen25826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25827"/>et ventilabunt eam et demolientur terram ejus, <l eID="gen25827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25828"/>quoniam venerunt super eam undique in die afflictionis ejus. <l eID="gen25828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9593"/><l level="1" sID="gen25829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9593"/>Non tendat qui tendit arcum suum, <l eID="gen25829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25830"/>et non ascendat loricatus : <l eID="gen25830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25831"/>nolite parcere juvenibus ejus ; <l eID="gen25831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25832"/>interficite omnem militiam ejus. <l eID="gen25832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9594"/><l level="1" sID="gen25833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9594"/>Et cadent interfecti in terra Chaldæorum, <l eID="gen25833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25834"/>et vulnerati in regionibus ejus. <l eID="gen25834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9595"/><l level="1" sID="gen25835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9595"/>Quoniam non fuit viduatus Israël et Juda <l eID="gen25835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25836"/>a Deo suo, Domino exercituum, <l eID="gen25836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25837"/>terra autem eorum repleta est delicto <l eID="gen25837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25838"/>a Sancto Israël. <l eID="gen25838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9596"/><l level="1" sID="gen25839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9596"/>Fugite de medio Babylonis, <l eID="gen25839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25840"/>et salvet unusquisque animam suam : <l eID="gen25840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25841"/>nolite tacere super iniquitatem ejus, <l eID="gen25841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25842"/>quoniam tempus ultionis est a Domino : <l eID="gen25842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25843"/>vicissitudinem ipse retribuet ei. <l eID="gen25843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9597"/><l level="1" sID="gen25844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9597"/>Calix aureus Babylon in manu Domini, <l eID="gen25844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25845"/>inebrians omnem terram : <l eID="gen25845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25846"/>de vino ejus biberunt gentes, <l eID="gen25846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25847"/>et ideo commotæ sunt. <l eID="gen25847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9598"/><l level="1" sID="gen25848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9598"/>Subito cecidit Babylon, et contrita est. <l eID="gen25848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25849"/>Ululate super eam : <l eID="gen25849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25850"/>tollite resinam ad dolorem ejus, <l eID="gen25850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25851"/>si forte sanetur. <l eID="gen25851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9599"/><l level="1" sID="gen25852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9599"/>Curavimus Babylonem, et non est sanata : <l eID="gen25852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25853"/>derelinquamus eam, et eamus unusquisque in terram suam : <l eID="gen25853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25854"/>quoniam pervenit usque ad cælos judicium ejus, <l eID="gen25854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25855"/>et elevatum est usque ad nubes. <l eID="gen25855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9600"/><l level="1" sID="gen25856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9600"/>Protulit Dominus justitias nostras : <l eID="gen25856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25857"/>venite, et narremus in Sion opus Domini Dei nostri. <l eID="gen25857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9601"/><l level="1" sID="gen25858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9601"/>Acuite sagittas, implete pharetras : <l eID="gen25858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25859"/>suscitavit Dominus spiritum regum Medorum : <l eID="gen25859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25860"/>et contra Babylonem mens ejus est ut perdat eam, <l eID="gen25860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25861"/>quoniam ultio Domini est, <l eID="gen25861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25862"/>ultio templi sui. <l eID="gen25862" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9602"/><l level="1" sID="gen25863"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9602"/>Super muros Babylonis levate signum, <l eID="gen25863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25864"/>augete custodiam, levate custodes, <l eID="gen25864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25865"/>præparate insidias : <l eID="gen25865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25866"/>quia cogitavit Dominus, <l eID="gen25866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25867"/>et fecit quæcumque locutus est contra habitatores Babylonis. <l eID="gen25867" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9603"/><l level="1" sID="gen25868"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9603"/>Quæ habitas super aquas multas, <l eID="gen25868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25869"/>locuples in thesauris : <l eID="gen25869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25870"/>venit finis tuus, pedalis præcisionis tuæ. <l eID="gen25870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9604"/><l level="1" sID="gen25871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9604"/>Juravit Dominus exercituum per animam suam : <l eID="gen25871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25872"/>Quoniam replebo te hominibus quasi brucho, <l eID="gen25872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25873"/>et super te celeuma cantabitur. <l eID="gen25873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9605"/><l level="1" sID="gen25874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9605"/>Qui fecit terram in fortitudine sua, <l eID="gen25874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25875"/>præparavit orbem in sapientia sua, <l eID="gen25875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25876"/>et prudentia sua extendit cælos. <l eID="gen25876" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9606"/><l level="1" sID="gen25877"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9606"/>Dante eo vocem, multiplicantur aquæ in cælo : <l eID="gen25877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25878"/>qui levat nubes ab extremo terræ, <l eID="gen25878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25879"/>fulgura in pluviam fecit, <l eID="gen25879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25880"/>et produxit ventum de thesauris suis. <l eID="gen25880" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9607"/><l level="1" sID="gen25881"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9607"/>Stultus factus est omnis homo a scientia ; <l eID="gen25881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25882"/>confusus est omnis conflator in sculptili : <l eID="gen25882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25883"/>quia mendax est conflatio eorum, <l eID="gen25883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25884"/>nec est spiritus in eis. <l eID="gen25884" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9608"/><l level="1" sID="gen25885"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9608"/>Vana sunt opera, et risu digna : <l eID="gen25885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25886"/>in tempore visitationis suæ peribunt. <l eID="gen25886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9609"/><l level="1" sID="gen25887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9609"/>Non sicut hæc, pars Jacob, <l eID="gen25887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25888"/>quia qui fecit omnia ipse est : <l eID="gen25888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25889"/>et Israël sceptrum hæreditatis ejus : <l eID="gen25889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25890"/>Dominus exercituum nomen ejus. <l eID="gen25890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9610"/><l level="1" sID="gen25891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9610"/>Collidis tu mihi vasa belli : <l eID="gen25891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25892"/>et ego collidam in te gentes, <l eID="gen25892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25893"/>et disperdam in te regna : <l eID="gen25893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9611"/><l level="1" sID="gen25894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9611"/>et collidam in te equum et equitem ejus : <l eID="gen25894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25895"/>et collidam in te currum et ascensorem ejus : <l eID="gen25895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9612"/><l level="1" sID="gen25896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9612"/>et collidam in te virum et mulierem : <l eID="gen25896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25897"/>et collidam in te senem et puerum : <l eID="gen25897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25898"/>et collidam in te juvenem et virginem : <l eID="gen25898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9613"/><l level="1" sID="gen25899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9613"/>et collidam in te pastorem et gregem ejus : <l eID="gen25899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25900"/>et collidam in te agricolam et jugales ejus : <l eID="gen25900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25901"/>et collidam in te duces et magistratus : <l eID="gen25901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9614"/><l level="1" sID="gen25902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9614"/>et reddam Babyloni, et cunctis habitatoribus Chaldææ, <l eID="gen25902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25903"/>omne malum suum quod fecerunt in Sion, <l eID="gen25903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25904"/>in oculis vestris, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9615"/><l level="1" sID="gen25905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9615"/>Ecce ego ad te, mons pestifer, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen25905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25906"/>qui corrumpis universam terram : <l eID="gen25906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25907"/>et extendam manum meam super te, <l eID="gen25907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25908"/>et evolvam te de petris, <l eID="gen25908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25909"/>et dabo te in montem combustionis : <l eID="gen25909" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9616"/><l level="1" sID="gen25910"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9616"/>et non tollent de te lapidem in angulum, <l eID="gen25910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25911"/>et lapidem in fundamenta : <l eID="gen25911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25912"/>sed perditus in æternum eris, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25912" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9617"/><l level="1" sID="gen25913"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9617"/>Levate signum in terra, <l eID="gen25913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25914"/>clangite buccina in gentibus, <l eID="gen25914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25915"/>sanctificate super eam gentes, <l eID="gen25915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25916"/>annuntiate contra illam regibus Ararat, Menni, et Ascenez : <l eID="gen25916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25917"/>numerate contra eam Taphsar, <l eID="gen25917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25918"/>adducite equum quasi bruchum aculeatum. <l eID="gen25918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9618"/><l level="1" sID="gen25919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9618"/>Sanctificate contra eam gentes, <l eID="gen25919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25920"/>reges Mediæ, duces ejus, et universos magistratus ejus, <l eID="gen25920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25921"/>cunctamque terram potestatis ejus. <l eID="gen25921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9619"/><l level="1" sID="gen25922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9619"/>Et commovebitur terra et conturbabitur, <l eID="gen25922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25923"/>quia evigilabit contra Babylonem cogitatio Domini, <l eID="gen25923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25924"/>ut ponat terram Babylonis desertam et inhabitabilem. <l eID="gen25924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9620"/><l level="1" sID="gen25925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9620"/>Cessaverunt fortes Babylonis a prælio ; <l eID="gen25925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25926"/>habitaverunt in præsidiis : <l eID="gen25926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25927"/>devoratum est robur eorum, <l eID="gen25927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25928"/>et facti sunt quasi mulieres : <l eID="gen25928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25929"/>incensa sunt tabernacula ejus, <l eID="gen25929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25930"/>contriti sunt vectes ejus. <l eID="gen25930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9621"/><l level="1" sID="gen25931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9621"/>Currens obviam currenti veniet, <l eID="gen25931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25932"/>et nuntius obvius nuntianti, <l eID="gen25932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25933"/>ut annuntiet regi Babylonis <l eID="gen25933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25934"/>quia capta est civitas ejus a summo usque ad summum. <l eID="gen25934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9622"/><l level="1" sID="gen25935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9622"/>Et vada præoccupata sunt, <l eID="gen25935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25936"/>et paludes incensæ sunt igni, <l eID="gen25936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25937"/>et viri bellatores conturbati sunt. <l eID="gen25937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9623"/><l level="1" sID="gen25938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9623"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël : <l eID="gen25938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25939"/>Filia Babylonis quasi area, <l eID="gen25939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25940"/>tempus trituræ ejus : <l eID="gen25940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25941"/>adhuc modicum, et veniet tempus messionis ejus. <l eID="gen25941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9624"/><l level="1" sID="gen25942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9624"/>Comedit me, devoravit me Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis : <l eID="gen25942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25943"/>reddidit me quasi vas inane, <l eID="gen25943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25944"/>absorbuit me quasi draco, <l eID="gen25944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25945"/>replevit ventrem suum teneritudine mea, et ejecit me. <l eID="gen25945" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9625"/><l level="1" sID="gen25946"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9625"/>Iniquitas adversum me <l eID="gen25946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25947"/>et caro mea super Babylonem, <l eID="gen25947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25948"/>dicit habitatio Sion : <l eID="gen25948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25949"/>et sanguis meus super habitatores Chaldææ, dicit Jerusalem. <l eID="gen25949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9626"/><l level="1" sID="gen25950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9626"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen25950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25951"/>Ecce ego judicabo causam tuam, <l eID="gen25951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25952"/>et ulciscar ultionem tuam : <l eID="gen25952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25953"/>et desertum faciam mare ejus, <l eID="gen25953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25954"/>et siccabo venam ejus. <l eID="gen25954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9627"/><l level="1" sID="gen25955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9627"/>Et erit Babylon in tumulos, <l eID="gen25955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25956"/>habitatio draconum, stupor et sibilus, <l eID="gen25956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25957"/>eo quod non sit habitator. <l eID="gen25957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9628"/><l level="1" sID="gen25958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9628"/>Simul ut leones rugient ; <l eID="gen25958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25959"/>excutient comas veluti catuli leonum. <l eID="gen25959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9629"/><l level="1" sID="gen25960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9629"/>In calore eorum ponam potus eorum, <l eID="gen25960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25961"/>et inebriabo eos ut sopiantur, <l eID="gen25961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25962"/>et dormiant somnum sempiternum, <l eID="gen25962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25963"/>et non consurgant, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen25963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9630"/><l level="1" sID="gen25964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9630"/>Deducam eos quasi agnos ad victimam, <l eID="gen25964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25965"/>et quasi arietes cum hædis. <l eID="gen25965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9631"/><l level="1" sID="gen25966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9631"/>Quomodo capta est Sesach, <l eID="gen25966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25967"/>et comprehensa est inclyta universæ terræ ! <l eID="gen25967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25968"/>quomodo facta est in stuporem Babylon inter gentes ! <l eID="gen25968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9632"/><l level="1" sID="gen25969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9632"/>Ascendit super Babylonem mare : <l eID="gen25969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25970"/>multitudine fluctuum ejus operta est. <l eID="gen25970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9633"/><l level="1" sID="gen25971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9633"/>Factæ sunt civitates ejus in stuporem, <l eID="gen25971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25972"/>terra inhabitabilis et deserta, <l eID="gen25972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25973"/>terra in qua nullus habitet, <l eID="gen25973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25974"/>nec transeat per eam filius hominis. <l eID="gen25974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9634"/><l level="1" sID="gen25975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9634"/>Et visitabo super Bel in Babylone, <l eID="gen25975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25976"/>et ejiciam quod absorbuerat de ore ejus : <l eID="gen25976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25977"/>et non confluent ad eum ultra gentes, <l eID="gen25977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25978"/>siquidem et murus Babylonis corruet. <l eID="gen25978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9635"/><l level="1" sID="gen25979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9635"/>Egredimini de medio ejus, populus meus, <l eID="gen25979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25980"/>ut salvet unusquisque animam suam ab ira furoris Domini, <l eID="gen25980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9636"/><l level="1" sID="gen25981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9636"/>et ne forte mollescat cor vestrum, <l eID="gen25981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25982"/>et timeatis auditum qui audietur in terra : <l eID="gen25982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25983"/>et veniet in anno auditio, <l eID="gen25983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25984"/>et post hunc annum auditio, <l eID="gen25984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25985"/>et iniquitas in terra, <l eID="gen25985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25986"/>et dominator super dominatorem. <l eID="gen25986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9637"/><l level="1" sID="gen25987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9637"/>Propterea ecce dies veniunt, <l eID="gen25987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25988"/>et visitabo super sculptilia Babylonis, <l eID="gen25988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25989"/>et omnis terra ejus confundetur, <l eID="gen25989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25990"/>et universi interfecti ejus cadent in medio ejus. <l eID="gen25990" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9638"/><l level="1" sID="gen25991"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9638"/>Et laudabunt super Babylonem cæli et terra, <l eID="gen25991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25992"/>et omnia quæ in eis sunt : <l eID="gen25992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25993"/>quia ab aquilone venient ei prædones, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen25993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9639"/><l level="1" sID="gen25994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9639"/>Et quomodo fecit Babylon, <l eID="gen25994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25995"/>ut caderent occisi in Israël, <l eID="gen25995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25996"/>sic de Babylone <l eID="gen25996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25997"/>cadent occisi in universa terra. <l eID="gen25997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9640"/><l level="1" sID="gen25998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9640"/>Qui fugistis gladium, venite, <l eID="gen25998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen25999"/>nolite stare : <l eID="gen25999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26000"/>recordamini procul Domini, <l eID="gen26000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26001"/>et Jerusalem ascendat super cor vestrum. <l eID="gen26001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9641"/><l level="1" sID="gen26002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9641"/>Confusi sumus, quoniam audivimus opprobrium : <l eID="gen26002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26003"/>operuit ignominia facies nostras, <l eID="gen26003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26004"/>quia venerunt alieni super sanctificationem domus Domini. <l eID="gen26004" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9642"/><l level="1" sID="gen26005"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9642"/>Propterea ecce dies veniunt, ait Dominus, <l eID="gen26005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26006"/>et visitabo super sculptilia ejus, <l eID="gen26006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26007"/>et in omni terra ejus mugiet vulneratus. <l eID="gen26007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9643"/><l level="1" sID="gen26008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9643"/>Si ascenderit Babylon in cælum, <l eID="gen26008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26009"/>et firmaverit in excelso robur suum, <l eID="gen26009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26010"/>a me venient vastatores ejus, ait Dominus. <l eID="gen26010" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9644"/><l level="1" sID="gen26011"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9644"/>Vox clamoris de Babylone, <l eID="gen26011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26012"/>et contritio magna de terra Chaldæorum : <l eID="gen26012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9645"/><l level="1" sID="gen26013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9645"/>quoniam vastavit Dominus Babylonem, <l eID="gen26013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26014"/>et perdidit ex ea vocem magnam : <l eID="gen26014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26015"/>et sonabunt fluctus eorum quasi aquæ multæ ; <l eID="gen26015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26016"/>dedit sonitum vox eorum : <l eID="gen26016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9646"/><l level="1" sID="gen26017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9646"/>quia venit super eam, id est super Babylonem, prædo, <l eID="gen26017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26018"/>et apprehensi sunt fortes ejus, <l eID="gen26018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26019"/>et emarcuit arcus eorum, <l eID="gen26019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26020"/>quia fortis ultor Dominus reddens retribuet. <l eID="gen26020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9647"/><l level="1" sID="gen26021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9647"/>Et inebriabo principes ejus, et sapientes ejus, <l eID="gen26021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26022"/>et duces ejus, et magistratus ejus, et fortes ejus : <l eID="gen26022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26023"/>et dormient somnum sempiternum, <l eID="gen26023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26024"/>et non expergiscentur, ait Rex <l eID="gen26024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26025"/>(Dominus exercituum nomen ejus). <l eID="gen26025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9648"/><l level="1" sID="gen26026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9648"/>Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : <l eID="gen26026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26027"/>Murus Babylonis ille latissimus suffossione suffodietur, <l eID="gen26027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26028"/>et portæ ejus excelsæ igni comburentur, <l eID="gen26028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26029"/>et labores populorum ad nihilum, <l eID="gen26029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26030"/>et gentium in ignem erunt, et disperibunt. <l eID="gen26030" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen25639"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9649"/><div sID="gen26031" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9649"/>Verbum quod præcepit Jeremias propheta Saraiæ filio Neriæ filii Maasiæ, cum pergeret cum Sedecia rege in Babylonem, in anno quarto regni ejus : Saraias autem erat princeps prophetiæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:60
verses.text: Et scripsit Jeremias omne malum quod venturum erat super Babylonem, in libro uno : omnia verba hæc quæ scripta sunt contra Babylonem.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:61
verses.text: Et dixit Jeremias ad Saraiam : Cum veneris in Babylonem, et videris, et legeris omnia verba hæc,

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:62
verses.text: dices : Domine, tu locutus es contra locum istum, ut disperderes eum, ne sit qui in eo habitet, ab homine usque ad pecus, et ut sit perpetua solitudo.

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:63
verses.text: Cumque compleveris legere librum istum, ligabis ad eum lapidem, et projicies illum in medium Euphraten,

verses.name: Jeremiah 51:64
verses.text: et dices : Sic submergetur Babylon, et non consurget a facie afflictionis quam ego adduco super eam, et dissolvetur. Hucusque verba Jeremiæ.  <chapter eID="Jer.51"/> <div eID="gen26031" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:1
verses.text: Filius viginti et unius anni erat Sedecias cum regnare cœpisset, et undecim annis regnavit in Jerusalem. Et nomen matris ejus Amital filia Jeremiæ de Lobna.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:2
verses.text: Et fecit malum in oculis Domini, juxta omnia quæ fecerat Joakim,

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:3
verses.text: quoniam furor Domini erat in Jerusalem et in Juda, usquequo projiceret eos a facie sua : et recessit Sedecias a rege Babylonis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:4
verses.text: Factum est autem in anno nono regni ejus, in mense decimo, decima mensis, venit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, ipse et omnis exercitus ejus, adversus Jerusalem : et obsederunt eam, et ædificaverunt contra eam munitiones in circuitu.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:5
verses.text: Et fuit civitas obsessa usque ad undecimum annum regis Sedeciæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:6
verses.text: Mense autem quarto, nona mensis, obtinuit fames civitatem, et non erant alimenta populo terræ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:7
verses.text: Et dirupta est civitas, et omnes viri bellatores ejus fugerunt, exieruntque de civitate nocte, per viam portæ quæ est inter duos muros, et ducit ad hortum regis, Chaldæis obsidentibus urbem in gyro, et abierunt per viam quæ ducit in eremum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:8
verses.text: Persecutus est autem Chadæorum exercitus regem, et apprehenderunt Sedeciam in deserto quod est juxta Jericho : et omnis comitatus ejus diffugit ab eo.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:9
verses.text: Cumque comprehendissent regem, adduxerunt eum ad regem Babylonis in Reblatha, quæ est in terra Emath, et locutus est ad eum judicia.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:10
verses.text: Et jugulavit rex Babylonis filios Sedeciæ in oculis ejus, sed et omnes principes Juda occidit in Reblatha.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:11
verses.text: Et oculos Sedeciæ eruit, et vinxit eum compedibus, et adduxit eum rex Babylonis in Babylonem, et posuit eum in domo carceris usque ad diem mortis ejus.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:12
verses.text: In mense autem quinto, decima mensis, ipse est annus nonusdecimus Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, venit Nabuzardan princeps militiæ, qui stabat coram rege Babylonis, in Jerusalem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:13
verses.text: et incendit domum Domini, et domum regis, et omnes domos Jerusalem : et omnem domum magnam igni combussit :

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:14
verses.text: et totum murum Jerusalem per circuitum destruxit cunctus exercitus Chaldæorum qui erat cum magistro militiæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:15
verses.text: De pauperibus autem populi, et de reliquo vulgo quod remanserat in civitate, et de perfugis qui transfugerant ad regem Babylonis, et ceteros de multitudine transtulit Nabuzardan princeps militiæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:16
verses.text: De pauperibus vero terræ reliquit Nabuzardan princeps militiæ vinitores et agricolas.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:17
verses.text: Columnas quoque æreas quæ erant in domo Domini, et bases, et mare æneum quod erat in domo Domini, confregerunt Chaldæi, et tulerunt omne æs eorum in Babylonem,

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:18
verses.text: et lebetes, et creagras, et psalteria, et phialas, et mortariola, et omnia vasa ærea quæ in ministerio fuerant, tulerunt :

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:19
verses.text: et hydrias, et thymiamateria, et urceos, et pelves, et candelabra, et mortaria, et cyathos, quotquot aurea, aurea, et quotquot argentea, argentea, tulit magister militiæ :

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:20
verses.text: et columnas duas, et mare unum, et vitulos duodecim æreos qui erant sub basibus quas fecerat rex Salomon in domo Domini. Non erat pondus æris omnium horum vasorum.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:21
verses.text: De columnis autem decem et octo cubiti altitudinis erant in columna una, et funiculus duodecim cubitorum circuibat eam : porro grossitudo ejus quatuor digitorum, et intrinsecus cava erat.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:22
verses.text: Et capitella super utramque ærea : altitudo capitelli unius quinque cubitorum, et retiacula et malogranata super coronam in circuitu, omnia ærea : similiter columnæ secundæ, et malogranata.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:23
verses.text: Et fuerunt malogranata nonaginta sex dependentia : et omnia malogranata centum, retiaculis circumdabantur.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:24
verses.text: Et tulit magister militiæ Saraiam sacerdotem primum, et Sophoniam sacerdotem secundum, et tres custodes vestibuli :

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:25
verses.text: et de civitate tulit eunuchum unum, qui erat præpositus super viros bellatores : et septem viros de his qui videbant faciem regis, qui inventi sunt in civitate : et scribam principem militum, qui probabat tyrones : et sexaginta viros de populo terræ, qui inventi sunt in medio civitatis.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:26
verses.text: Tulit autem eos Nabuzardan magister militiæ, et duxit eos ad regem Babylonis in Reblatha :

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:27
verses.text: et percussit eos rex Babylonis, et interfecit eos in Reblatha in terra Emath : et translatus est Juda de terra sua.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:28
verses.text: Iste est populus quem transtulit Nabuchodonosor : in anno septimo, Judæos tria millia et viginti tres :

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:29
verses.text: in anno octavodecimo Nabuchodonosor, de Jerusalem animas octingentas triginta duas :

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:30
verses.text: in anno vigesimo tertio Nabuchodonosor, transtulit Nabuzardan magister militiæ animas Judæorum septingentas quadraginta quinque. Omnes ergo animæ, quatuor millia sexcentæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:31
verses.text: Et factum est in trigesimo septimo anno transmigrationis Joachin regis Juda, duodecimo mense, vigesima quinta mensis, elevavit Evilmerodach rex Babylonis, ipso anno regni sui, caput Joachin regis Juda, et eduxit eum de domo carceris.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:32
verses.text: Et locutus est cum eo bona, et posuit thronum ejus super thronos regum qui erant post se in Babylone.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:33
verses.text: Et mutavit vestimenta carceris ejus, et comedebat panem coram eo semper cunctis diebus vitæ suæ.

verses.name: Jeremiah 52:34
verses.text: Et cibaria ejus, cibaria perpetua dabantur ei a rege Babylonis, statuta per singulos dies, usque ad diem mortis suæ, cunctis diebus vitæ ejus.  <div eID="gen26032" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="Jer.52"/> <div eID="gen22622" osisID="Jer" type="book"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9650"/><title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Aleph</foreign></title> <lg sID="gen26035"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26036"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9650"/>Quomodo sedet sola <l eID="gen26036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26037"/>civitas plena populo ! <l eID="gen26037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26038"/>Facta est quasi vidua <l eID="gen26038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26039"/>domina gentium ; <l eID="gen26039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26040"/>princeps provinciarum <l eID="gen26040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26041"/>facta est sub tributo. <l eID="gen26041" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26035"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Beth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9651"/><lg sID="gen26042"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9651"/>Plorans ploravit in nocte, <l eID="gen26043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26044"/>et lacrimæ ejus in maxillis ejus : <l eID="gen26044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26045"/>non est qui consoletur eam <l eID="gen26045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26046"/>ex omnibus caris ejus ; <l eID="gen26046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26047"/>omnes amici ejus spreverunt eam, <l eID="gen26047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26048"/>et facti sunt ei inimici. <l eID="gen26048" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26042"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ghimel</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9652"/><lg sID="gen26049"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9652"/>Migravit Judas propter afflictionem, <l eID="gen26050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26051"/>et multitudinem servitutis ; <l eID="gen26051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26052"/>habitavit inter gentes, <l eID="gen26052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26053"/>nec invenit requiem : <l eID="gen26053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26054"/>omnes persecutores ejus apprehenderunt eam <l eID="gen26054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26055"/>inter angustias. <l eID="gen26055" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26049"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Daleth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9653"/><lg sID="gen26056"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9653"/>Viæ Sion lugent, eo quod non sint <l eID="gen26057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26058"/>qui veniant ad solemnitatem : <l eID="gen26058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26059"/>omnes portæ ejus destructæ, <l eID="gen26059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26060"/>sacerdotes ejus gementes ; <l eID="gen26060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26061"/>virgines ejus squalidæ, <l eID="gen26061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26062"/>et ipsa oppressa amaritudine. <l eID="gen26062" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26056"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">He</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9654"/><lg sID="gen26063"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26064"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9654"/>Facti sunt hostes ejus in capite ; <l eID="gen26064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26065"/>inimici ejus locupletati sunt : <l eID="gen26065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26066"/>quia Dominus locutus est super eam <l eID="gen26066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26067"/>propter multitudinem iniquitatum ejus. <l eID="gen26067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26068"/>Parvuli ejus ducti sunt in captivitatem <l eID="gen26068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26069"/>ante faciem tribulantis. <l eID="gen26069" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26063"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Vau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9655"/><lg sID="gen26070"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9655"/>Et egressus est a filia Sion <l eID="gen26071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26072"/>omnis decor ejus ; <l eID="gen26072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26073"/>facti sunt principes ejus velut arietes <l eID="gen26073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26074"/>non invenientes pascua, <l eID="gen26074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26075"/>et abierunt absque fortitudine <l eID="gen26075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26076"/>ante faciem subsequentis. <l eID="gen26076" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26070"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Zain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9656"/><lg sID="gen26077"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9656"/>Recordata est Jerusalem dierum afflictionis suæ, <l eID="gen26078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26079"/>et prævaricationis, <l eID="gen26079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26080"/>omnium desiderabilium suorum, <l eID="gen26080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26081"/>quæ habuerat a diebus antiquis, <l eID="gen26081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26082"/>cum caderet populus ejus in manu hostili, <l eID="gen26082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26083"/>et non esset auxiliator : <l eID="gen26083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26084"/>viderunt eam hostes, <l eID="gen26084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26085"/>et deriserunt sabbata ejus. <l eID="gen26085" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26077"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Heth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9657"/><lg sID="gen26086"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9657"/>Peccatum peccavit Jerusalem, <l eID="gen26087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26088"/>propterea instabilis facta est ; <l eID="gen26088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26089"/>omnes qui glorificabant eam spreverunt illam, <l eID="gen26089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26090"/>quia viderunt ignominiam ejus : <l eID="gen26090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26091"/>ipsa autem gemens <l eID="gen26091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26092"/>conversa est retrorsum. <l eID="gen26092" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26086"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Teth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9658"/><lg sID="gen26093"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9658"/>Sordes ejus in pedibus ejus, <l eID="gen26094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26095"/>nec recordata est finis sui ; <l eID="gen26095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26096"/>deposita est vehementer, <l eID="gen26096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26097"/>non habens consolatorem. <l eID="gen26097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26098"/>Vide, Domine, afflictionem meam, <l eID="gen26098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26099"/>quoniam erectus est inimicus. <l eID="gen26099" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26093"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Jod</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9659"/><lg sID="gen26100"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26101"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9659"/>Manum suam misit hostis <l eID="gen26101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26102"/>ad omnia desiderabilia ejus, <l eID="gen26102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26103"/>quia vidit gentes <l eID="gen26103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26104"/>ingressas sanctuarium suum, <l eID="gen26104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26105"/>de quibus præceperas <l eID="gen26105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26106"/>ne intrarent in ecclesiam tuam. <l eID="gen26106" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26100"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Caph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9660"/><lg sID="gen26107"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9660"/>Omnis populus ejus gemens, <l eID="gen26108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26109"/>et quærens panem ; <l eID="gen26109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26110"/>dederunt pretiosa quæque pro cibo <l eID="gen26110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26111"/>ad refocillandam animam. <l eID="gen26111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26112"/>Vide, Domine, et considera <l eID="gen26112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26113"/>quoniam facta sum vilis ! <l eID="gen26113" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26107"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Lamed</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9661"/><lg sID="gen26114"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9661"/>O vos omnes qui transitis per viam, <l eID="gen26115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26116"/>attendite, et videte <l eID="gen26116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26117"/>si est dolor sicut dolor meus ! <l eID="gen26117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26118"/>quoniam vindemiavit me, <l eID="gen26118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26119"/>ut locutus est Dominus, <l eID="gen26119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26120"/>in die iræ furoris sui. <l eID="gen26120" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26114"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Mem</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9662"/><lg sID="gen26121"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9662"/>De excelso misit ignem in ossibus meis, <l eID="gen26122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26123"/>et erudivit me : <l eID="gen26123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26124"/>expandit rete pedibus meis, <l eID="gen26124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26125"/>convertit me retrorsum ; <l eID="gen26125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26126"/>posuit me desolatam, <l eID="gen26126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26127"/>tota die mœrore confectam. <l eID="gen26127" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26121"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Nun</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9663"/><lg sID="gen26128"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9663"/>Vigilavit jugum iniquitatum mearum ; <l eID="gen26129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26130"/>in manu ejus convolutæ sunt, <l eID="gen26130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26131"/>et impositæ collo meo. <l eID="gen26131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26132"/>Infirmata est virtus mea : <l eID="gen26132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26133"/>dedit me Dominus in manu <l eID="gen26133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26134"/>de qua non potero surgere. <l eID="gen26134" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26128"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Samech</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9664"/><lg sID="gen26135"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26136"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9664"/>Abstulit omnes magnificos meos Dominus <l eID="gen26136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26137"/>de medio mei ; <l eID="gen26137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26138"/>vocavit adversum me tempus <l eID="gen26138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26139"/>ut contereret electos meos. <l eID="gen26139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26140"/>Torcular calcavit Dominus <l eID="gen26140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26141"/>virgini filiæ Juda. <l eID="gen26141" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26135"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9665"/><lg sID="gen26142"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26143"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9665"/>Idcirco ego plorans, <l eID="gen26143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26144"/>et oculus meus deducens aquas, <l eID="gen26144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26145"/>quia longe factus est a me consolator, <l eID="gen26145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26146"/>convertens animam meam. <l eID="gen26146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26147"/>Facti sunt filii mei perditi, <l eID="gen26147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26148"/>quoniam invaluit inimicus. <l eID="gen26148" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26142"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Phe</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9666"/><lg sID="gen26149"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26150"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9666"/>Expandit Sion manus suas ; <l eID="gen26150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26151"/>non est qui consoletur eam. <l eID="gen26151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26152"/>Mandavit Dominus adversum Jacob <l eID="gen26152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26153"/>in circuitu ejus hostes ejus ; <l eID="gen26153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26154"/>facta est Jerusalem <l eID="gen26154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26155"/>quasi polluta menstruis inter eos. <l eID="gen26155" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26149"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sade</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9667"/><lg sID="gen26156"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26157"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9667"/>Justus est Dominus, <l eID="gen26157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26158"/>quia os ejus ad iracundiam provocavi. <l eID="gen26158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26159"/>Audite, obsecro, universi populi, <l eID="gen26159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26160"/>et videte dolorem meum : <l eID="gen26160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26161"/>virgines meæ et juvenes mei abierunt <l eID="gen26161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26162"/>in captivitatem. <l eID="gen26162" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26156"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Coph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9668"/><lg sID="gen26163"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9668"/>Vocavi amicos meos, <l eID="gen26164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26165"/>et ipsi deceperunt me ; <l eID="gen26165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26166"/>sacerdotes mei et senes mei <l eID="gen26166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26167"/>in urbe consumpti sunt, <l eID="gen26167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26168"/>quia quæsierunt cibum sibi <l eID="gen26168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26169"/>ut refocillarent animam suam. <l eID="gen26169" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26163"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Res</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9669"/><lg sID="gen26170"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26171"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9669"/>Vide, Domine, quoniam tribulor : <l eID="gen26171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26172"/>conturbatus est venter meus, <l eID="gen26172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26173"/>subversum est cor meum in memetipsa, <l eID="gen26173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26174"/>quoniam amaritudine plena sum. <l eID="gen26174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26175"/>Foris interfecit gladius, <l eID="gen26175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26176"/>et domi mors similis est. <l eID="gen26176" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26170"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sin</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9670"/><lg sID="gen26177"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26178"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9670"/>Audierunt quia ingemisco ego, <l eID="gen26178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26179"/>et non est qui consoletur me ; <l eID="gen26179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26180"/>omnes inimici mei audierunt malum meum, <l eID="gen26180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26181"/>lætati sunt quoniam tu fecisti : <l eID="gen26181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26182"/>adduxisti diem consolationis, <l eID="gen26182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26183"/>et fient similes mei. <l eID="gen26183" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26177"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Thau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9671"/><lg sID="gen26184"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26185"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9671"/>Ingrediatur omne malum eorum coram te : <l eID="gen26185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26186"/>et vindemia eos, sicut vindemiasti me <l eID="gen26186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26187"/>propter omnes iniquitates meas : <l eID="gen26187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26188"/>multi enim gemitus mei, <l eID="gen26188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26189"/>et cor meum mœrens. <l eID="gen26189" level="1"/><lg eID="gen26184"/> <chapter eID="Lam.1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9672"/><title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Aleph</foreign></title> <lg sID="gen26190"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26191"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9672"/>Quomodo obtexit caligine in furore suo <l eID="gen26191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26192"/>Dominus filiam Sion ; <l eID="gen26192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26193"/>projecit de cælo in terram <l eID="gen26193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26194"/>inclytam Israël, <l eID="gen26194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26195"/>et non est recordatus scabelli pedum suorum <l eID="gen26195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26196"/>in die furoris sui ! <l eID="gen26196" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26190"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Beth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9673"/><lg sID="gen26197"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9673"/>Præcipitavit Dominus, nec pepercit <l eID="gen26198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26199"/>omnia speciosa Jacob : <l eID="gen26199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26200"/>destruxit in furore suo <l eID="gen26200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26201"/>munitiones virginis Juda, <l eID="gen26201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26202"/>et dejecit in terram ; <l eID="gen26202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26203"/>polluit regnum et principes ejus. <l eID="gen26203" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26197"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ghimel</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9674"/><lg sID="gen26204"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9674"/>Confregit in ira furoris sui <l eID="gen26205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26206"/>omne cornu Israël ; <l eID="gen26206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26207"/>avertit retrorsum dexteram suam <l eID="gen26207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26208"/>a facie inimici, <l eID="gen26208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26209"/>et succendit in Jacob quasi ignem <l eID="gen26209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26210"/>flammæ devorantis in gyro. <l eID="gen26210" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26204"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Daleth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9675"/><lg sID="gen26211"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9675"/>Tetendit arcum suum quasi inimicus, <l eID="gen26212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26213"/>firmavit dexteram suam quasi hostis, <l eID="gen26213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26214"/>et occidit omne quod pulchrum erat visu <l eID="gen26214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26215"/>in tabernaculo filiæ Sion ; <l eID="gen26215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26216"/>effudit quasi ignem <l eID="gen26216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26217"/>indignationem suam. <l eID="gen26217" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26211"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">He</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9676"/><lg sID="gen26218"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9676"/>Factus est Dominus velut inimicus, <l eID="gen26219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26220"/>præcipitavit Israël : <l eID="gen26220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26221"/>præcipitavit omnia mœnia ejus, <l eID="gen26221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26222"/>dissipavit munitiones ejus, <l eID="gen26222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26223"/>et replevit in filia Juda <l eID="gen26223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26224"/>humiliatum et humiliatam. <l eID="gen26224" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26218"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Vau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9677"/><lg sID="gen26225"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26226"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9677"/>Et dissipavit quasi hortum tentorium suum ; <l eID="gen26226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26227"/>demolitus est tabernaculum suum. <l eID="gen26227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26228"/>Oblivioni tradidit Dominus in Sion <l eID="gen26228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26229"/>festivitatem et sabbatum ; <l eID="gen26229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26230"/>et in opprobrium, et in indignationem furoris sui, <l eID="gen26230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26231"/>regem et sacerdotem. <l eID="gen26231" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26225"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Zain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9678"/><lg sID="gen26232"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9678"/>Repulit Dominus altare suum ; <l eID="gen26233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26234"/>maledixit sanctificationi suæ : <l eID="gen26234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26235"/>tradidit in manu inimici <l eID="gen26235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26236"/>muros turrium ejus. <l eID="gen26236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26237"/>Vocem dederunt in domo Domini <l eID="gen26237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26238"/>sicut in die solemni. <l eID="gen26238" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26232"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Heth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9679"/><lg sID="gen26239"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9679"/>Cogitavit Dominus dissipare <l eID="gen26240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26241"/>murum filiæ Sion ; <l eID="gen26241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26242"/>tetendit funiculum suum, <l eID="gen26242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26243"/>et non avertit manum suam a perditione : <l eID="gen26243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26244"/>luxitque antemurale, <l eID="gen26244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26245"/>et murus pariter dissipatus est. <l eID="gen26245" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26239"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Teth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9680"/><lg sID="gen26246"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26247"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9680"/>Defixæ sunt in terra portæ ejus, <l eID="gen26247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26248"/>perdidit et contrivit vectes ejus ; <l eID="gen26248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26249"/>regem ejus et principes ejus in gentibus : <l eID="gen26249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26250"/>non est lex, <l eID="gen26250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26251"/>et prophetæ ejus non invenerunt <l eID="gen26251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26252"/>visionem a Domino. <l eID="gen26252" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26246"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Jod</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:10
