verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9681"/><lg sID="gen26253"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9681"/>Sederunt in terra, conticuerunt <l eID="gen26254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26255"/>senes filiæ Sion ; <l eID="gen26255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26256"/>consperserunt cinere capita sua, <l eID="gen26256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26257"/>accincti sunt ciliciis : <l eID="gen26257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26258"/>abjecerunt in terram capita sua <l eID="gen26258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26259"/>virgines Jerusalem. <l eID="gen26259" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26253"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Caph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9682"/><lg sID="gen26260"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9682"/>Defecerunt præ lacrimis oculi mei, <l eID="gen26261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26262"/>conturbata sunt viscera mea ; <l eID="gen26262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26263"/>effusum est in terra jecur meum <l eID="gen26263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26264"/>super contritione filiæ populi mei, <l eID="gen26264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26265"/>cum deficeret parvulus et lactens <l eID="gen26265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26266"/>in plateis oppidi. <l eID="gen26266" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26260"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Lamed</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9683"/><lg sID="gen26267"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9683"/>Matribus suis dixerunt : <l eID="gen26268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26269"/>Ubi est triticum et vinum ? <l eID="gen26269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26270"/>cum deficerent quasi vulnerati <l eID="gen26270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26271"/>in plateis civitatis, <l eID="gen26271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26272"/>cum exhalarent animas suas <l eID="gen26272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26273"/>in sinu matrum suarum. <l eID="gen26273" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26267"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Mem</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9684"/><lg sID="gen26274"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26275"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9684"/>Cui comparabo te, vel cui assimilabo te, <l eID="gen26275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26276"/>filia Jerusalem ? <l eID="gen26276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26277"/>cui exæquabo te, et consolabor te, <l eID="gen26277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26278"/>virgo, filia Sion ? <l eID="gen26278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26279"/>magna est enim velut mare contritio tua : <l eID="gen26279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26280"/>quis medebitur tui ? <l eID="gen26280" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26274"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Nun</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9685"/><lg sID="gen26281"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9685"/>Prophetæ tui viderunt tibi <l eID="gen26282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26283"/>falsa et stulta ; <l eID="gen26283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26284"/>nec aperiebant iniquitatem tuam, <l eID="gen26284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26285"/>ut te ad pœnitentiam provocarent ; <l eID="gen26285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26286"/>viderunt autem tibi assumptiones falsas, <l eID="gen26286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26287"/>et ejectiones. <l eID="gen26287" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26281"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Samech</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9686"/><lg sID="gen26288"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9686"/>Plauserunt super te manibus <l eID="gen26289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26290"/>omnes transeuntes per viam ; <l eID="gen26290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26291"/>sibilaverunt et moverunt caput suum <l eID="gen26291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26292"/>super filiam Jerusalem : <l eID="gen26292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26293"/>Hæccine est urbs, dicentes, perfecti decoris, <l eID="gen26293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26294"/>gaudium universæ terræ ? <l eID="gen26294" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26288"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Phe</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9687"/><lg sID="gen26295"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26296"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9687"/>Aperuerunt super te os suum <l eID="gen26296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26297"/>omnes inimici tui : <l eID="gen26297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26298"/>sibilaverunt, et fremuerunt dentibus, <l eID="gen26298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26299"/>et dixerunt : Devorabimus : <l eID="gen26299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26300"/>en ista est dies quam exspectabamus ; <l eID="gen26300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26301"/>invenimus, vidimus. <l eID="gen26301" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26295"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9688"/><lg sID="gen26302"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9688"/>Fecit Dominus quæ cogitavit ; <l eID="gen26303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26304"/>complevit sermonem suum, <l eID="gen26304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26305"/>quem præceperat a diebus antiquis : <l eID="gen26305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26306"/>destruxit, et non pepercit, <l eID="gen26306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26307"/>et lætificavit super te inimicum, <l eID="gen26307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26308"/>et exaltavit cornu hostium tuorum. <l eID="gen26308" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26302"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sade</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9689"/><lg sID="gen26309"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9689"/>Clamavit cor eorum ad Dominum <l eID="gen26310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26311"/>super muros filiæ Sion : <l eID="gen26311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26312"/>Deduc quasi torrentem lacrimas <l eID="gen26312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26313"/>per diem et noctem ; <l eID="gen26313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26314"/>non des requiem tibi, <l eID="gen26314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26315"/>neque taceat pupilla oculi tui. <l eID="gen26315" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26309"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Coph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9690"/><lg sID="gen26316"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9690"/>Consurge, lauda in nocte, <l eID="gen26317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26318"/>in principio vigiliarum ; <l eID="gen26318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26319"/>effunde sicut aquam cor tuum <l eID="gen26319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26320"/>ante conspectum Domini : <l eID="gen26320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26321"/>leva ad eum manus tuas <l eID="gen26321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26322"/>pro anima parvulorum tuorum, <l eID="gen26322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26323"/>qui defecerunt in fame <l eID="gen26323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26324"/>in capite omnium compitorum. <l eID="gen26324" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26316"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Res</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9691"/><lg sID="gen26325"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26326"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9691"/>Vide, Domine, et considera <l eID="gen26326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26327"/>quem vindemiaveris ita. <l eID="gen26327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26328"/>Ergone comedent mulieres fructum suum, <l eID="gen26328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26329"/>parvulos ad mensuram palmæ ? <l eID="gen26329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26330"/>si occiditur in sanctuario Domini <l eID="gen26330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26331"/>sacerdos et propheta ? <l eID="gen26331" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26325"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sin</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9692"/><lg sID="gen26332"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9692"/>Jacuerunt in terra foris <l eID="gen26333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26334"/>puer et senex ; <l eID="gen26334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26335"/>virgines meæ et juvenes mei <l eID="gen26335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26336"/>ceciderunt in gladio : <l eID="gen26336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26337"/>interfecisti in die furoris tui, <l eID="gen26337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26338"/>percussisti, nec misertus es. <l eID="gen26338" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26332"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Thau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9693"/><lg sID="gen26339"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26340"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9693"/>Vocasti quasi ad diem solemnem, <l eID="gen26340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26341"/>qui terrerent me de circuitu ; <l eID="gen26341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26342"/>et non fuit in die furoris Domini qui effugeret, <l eID="gen26342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26343"/>et relinqueretur : <l eID="gen26343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26344"/>quos educavi et enutrivi, <l eID="gen26344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26345"/>inimicus meus consumpsit eos. <l eID="gen26345" level="1"/><lg eID="gen26339"/> <chapter eID="Lam.2"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9694"/><title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Aleph</foreign></title> <lg sID="gen26346"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9694"/>Ego vir videns paupertatem meam <l eID="gen26347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26348"/>in virga indignationis ejus. <l eID="gen26348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9695"/><l level="1" sID="gen26349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9695"/>Me minavit, et adduxit in tenebras, <l eID="gen26349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26350"/>et non in lucem. <l eID="gen26350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9696"/><l level="1" sID="gen26351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9696"/>Tantum in me vertit et convertit <l eID="gen26351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26352"/>manum suam tota die. <l eID="gen26352" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26346"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Beth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9697"/><lg sID="gen26353"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9697"/>Vetustam fecit pellem meam et carnem meam ; <l eID="gen26354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26355"/>contrivit ossa mea. <l eID="gen26355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9698"/><l level="1" sID="gen26356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9698"/>Ædificavit in gyro meo, et circumdedit me <l eID="gen26356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26357"/>felle et labore. <l eID="gen26357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9699"/><l level="1" sID="gen26358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9699"/>In tenebrosis collocavit me, <l eID="gen26358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26359"/>quasi mortuos sempiternos. <l eID="gen26359" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26353"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ghimel</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9700"/><lg sID="gen26360"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9700"/>Circumædificavit adversum me, ut non egrediar ; <l eID="gen26361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26362"/>aggravavit compedem meum. <l eID="gen26362" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9701"/><l level="1" sID="gen26363"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9701"/>Sed et cum clamavero, et rogavero, <l eID="gen26363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26364"/>exclusit orationem meam. <l eID="gen26364" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9702"/><l level="1" sID="gen26365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9702"/>Conclusit vias meas lapidibus quadris ; <l eID="gen26365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26366"/>semitas meas subvertit. <l eID="gen26366" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26360"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Daleth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9703"/><lg sID="gen26367"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9703"/>Ursus insidians factus est mihi, <l eID="gen26368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26369"/>leo in absconditis. <l eID="gen26369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9704"/><l level="1" sID="gen26370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9704"/>Semitas meas subvertit, et confregit me ; <l eID="gen26370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26371"/>posuit me desolatam. <l eID="gen26371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9705"/><l level="1" sID="gen26372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9705"/>Tetendit arcum suum, et posuit me <l eID="gen26372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26373"/>quasi signum ad sagittam. <l eID="gen26373" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26367"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">He</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9706"/><lg sID="gen26374"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9706"/>Misit in renibus meis <l eID="gen26375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26376"/>filias pharetræ suæ. <l eID="gen26376" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9707"/><l level="1" sID="gen26377"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9707"/>Factus sum in derisum omni populo meo, <l eID="gen26377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26378"/>canticum eorum tota die. <l eID="gen26378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9708"/><l level="1" sID="gen26379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9708"/>Replevit me amaritudinibus ; <l eID="gen26379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26380"/>inebriavit me absinthio. <l eID="gen26380" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26374"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Vau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9709"/><lg sID="gen26381"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9709"/>Et fregit ad numerum dentes meos ; <l eID="gen26382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26383"/>cibavit me cinere. <l eID="gen26383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9710"/><l level="1" sID="gen26384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9710"/>Et repulsa est a pace anima mea ; <l eID="gen26384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26385"/>oblitus sum bonorum. <l eID="gen26385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9711"/><l level="1" sID="gen26386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9711"/>Et dixi : Periit finis meus, <l eID="gen26386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26387"/>et spes mea a Domino. <l eID="gen26387" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26381"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Zain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9712"/><lg sID="gen26388"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26389"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9712"/>Recordare paupertatis, et transgressionis meæ, <l eID="gen26389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26390"/>absinthii et fellis. <l eID="gen26390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9713"/><l level="1" sID="gen26391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9713"/>Memoria memor ero, et tabescet <l eID="gen26391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26392"/>in me anima mea. <l eID="gen26392" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9714"/><l level="1" sID="gen26393"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9714"/>Hæc recolens in corde meo, <l eID="gen26393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26394"/>ideo sperabo. <l eID="gen26394" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26388"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Heth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9715"/><lg sID="gen26395"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9715"/>Misericordiæ Domini, quia non sumus consumpti ; <l eID="gen26396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26397"/>quia non defecerunt miserationes ejus. <l eID="gen26397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9716"/><l level="1" sID="gen26398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9716"/>Novi diluculo, <l eID="gen26398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26399"/>multa est fides tua. <l eID="gen26399" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9717"/><l level="1" sID="gen26400"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9717"/>Pars mea Dominus, dixit anima mea ; <l eID="gen26400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26401"/>propterea exspectabo eum. <l eID="gen26401" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26395"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Teth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9718"/><lg sID="gen26402"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26403"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9718"/>Bonus est Dominus sperantibus in eum, <l eID="gen26403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26404"/>animæ quærenti illum. <l eID="gen26404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9719"/><l level="1" sID="gen26405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9719"/>Bonum est præstolari cum silentio <l eID="gen26405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26406"/>salutare Dei. <l eID="gen26406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9720"/><l level="1" sID="gen26407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9720"/>Bonum est viro cum portaverit jugum <l eID="gen26407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26408"/>ab adolescentia sua. <l eID="gen26408" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26402"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Jod</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9721"/><lg sID="gen26409"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9721"/>Sedebit solitarius, et tacebit, <l eID="gen26410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26411"/>quia levavit super se. <l eID="gen26411" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9722"/><l level="1" sID="gen26412"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9722"/>Ponet in pulvere os suum, <l eID="gen26412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26413"/>si forte sit spes. <l eID="gen26413" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9723"/><l level="1" sID="gen26414"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9723"/>Dabit percutienti se maxillam : <l eID="gen26414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26415"/>saturabitur opprobriis. <l eID="gen26415" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26409"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Caph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9724"/><lg sID="gen26416"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26417"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9724"/>Quia non repellet <l eID="gen26417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26418"/>in sempiternum Dominus. <l eID="gen26418" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9725"/><l level="1" sID="gen26419"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9725"/>Quia si abjecit, et miserebitur, <l eID="gen26419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26420"/>secundum multitudinem misericordiarum suarum. <l eID="gen26420" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9726"/><l level="1" sID="gen26421"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9726"/>Non enim humiliavit ex corde suo <l eID="gen26421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26422"/>et abjecit filios hominum. <l eID="gen26422" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26416"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Lamed</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9727"/><lg sID="gen26423"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26424"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9727"/>Ut conteret sub pedibus suis <l eID="gen26424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26425"/>omnes vinctos terræ. <l eID="gen26425" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9728"/><l level="1" sID="gen26426"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9728"/>Ut declinaret judicium viri <l eID="gen26426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26427"/>in conspectu vultus Altissimi. <l eID="gen26427" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9729"/><l level="1" sID="gen26428"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9729"/>Ut perverteret hominem in judicio suo ; <l eID="gen26428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26429"/>Dominus ignoravit. <l eID="gen26429" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26423"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Mem</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9730"/><lg sID="gen26430"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9730"/>Quis est iste qui dixit ut fieret, <l eID="gen26431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26432"/>Domino non jubente ? <l eID="gen26432" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9731"/><l level="1" sID="gen26433"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9731"/>Ex ore Altissimi non egredientur <l eID="gen26433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26434"/>nec mala nec bona ? <l eID="gen26434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9732"/><l level="1" sID="gen26435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9732"/>Quid murmuravit homo vivens, <l eID="gen26435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26436"/>vir pro peccatis suis ? <l eID="gen26436" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26430"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Nun</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9733"/><lg sID="gen26437"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9733"/>Scrutemur vias nostras, et quæramus, <l eID="gen26438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26439"/>et revertamur ad Dominum. <l eID="gen26439" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9734"/><l level="1" sID="gen26440"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9734"/>Levemus corda nostra cum manibus <l eID="gen26440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26441"/>ad Dominum in cælos. <l eID="gen26441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9735"/><l level="1" sID="gen26442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9735"/>Nos inique egimus, et ad iracundiam provocavimus ; <l eID="gen26442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26443"/>idcirco tu inexorabilis es. <l eID="gen26443" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26437"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Samech</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9736"/><lg sID="gen26444"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9736"/>Operuisti in furore, et percussisti nos ; <l eID="gen26445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26446"/>occidisti, nec pepercisti. <l eID="gen26446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9737"/><l level="1" sID="gen26447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9737"/>Opposuisti nubem tibi, <l eID="gen26447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26448"/>ne transeat oratio. <l eID="gen26448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9738"/><l level="1" sID="gen26449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9738"/>Eradicationem et abjectionem posuisti me <l eID="gen26449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26450"/>in medio populorum. <l eID="gen26450" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26444"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Phe</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9739"/><lg sID="gen26451"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9739"/>Aperuerunt super nos os suum <l eID="gen26452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26453"/>omnes inimici. <l eID="gen26453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9740"/><l level="1" sID="gen26454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9740"/>Formido et laqueus facta est nobis <l eID="gen26454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26455"/>vaticinatio, et contritio. <l eID="gen26455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9741"/><l level="1" sID="gen26456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9741"/>Divisiones aquarum deduxit oculus meus, <l eID="gen26456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26457"/>in contritione filiæ populi mei. <l eID="gen26457" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26451"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9742"/><lg sID="gen26458"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26459"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9742"/>Oculus meus afflictus est, nec tacuit, <l eID="gen26459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26460"/>eo quod non esset requies. <l eID="gen26460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:50
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9743"/><l level="1" sID="gen26461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9743"/>Donec respiceret et videret <l eID="gen26461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26462"/>Dominus de cælis. <l eID="gen26462" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:51
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9744"/><l level="1" sID="gen26463"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9744"/>Oculus meus deprædatus est animam meam <l eID="gen26463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26464"/>in cunctis filiabus urbis meæ. <l eID="gen26464" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26458"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sade</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:52
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9745"/><lg sID="gen26465"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26466"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9745"/>Venatione ceperunt me quasi avem <l eID="gen26466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26467"/>inimici mei gratis. <l eID="gen26467" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9746"/><l level="1" sID="gen26468"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9746"/>Lapsa est in lacum vita mea, <l eID="gen26468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26469"/>et posuerunt lapidem super me. <l eID="gen26469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:54
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9747"/><l level="1" sID="gen26470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9747"/>Inundaverunt aquæ super caput meum ; <l eID="gen26470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26471"/>dixi : Perii. <l eID="gen26471" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26465"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Coph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:55
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9748"/><lg sID="gen26472"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9748"/>Invocavi nomen tuum, Domine, <l eID="gen26473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26474"/>de lacu novissimo. <l eID="gen26474" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:56
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9749"/><l level="1" sID="gen26475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9749"/>Vocem meam audisti ; ne avertas aurem tuam <l eID="gen26475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26476"/>a singultu meo et clamoribus. <l eID="gen26476" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:57
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9750"/><l level="1" sID="gen26477"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9750"/>Appropinquasti in die quando invocavi te ; <l eID="gen26477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26478"/>dixisti : Ne timeas. <l eID="gen26478" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26472"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Res</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9751"/><lg sID="gen26479"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9751"/>Judicasti, Domine, causam animæ meæ, <l eID="gen26480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26481"/>redemptor vitæ meæ. <l eID="gen26481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9752"/><l level="1" sID="gen26482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9752"/>Vidisti, Domine, iniquitatem illorum adversum me : <l eID="gen26482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26483"/>judica judicium meum. <l eID="gen26483" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:60
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9753"/><l level="1" sID="gen26484"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9753"/>Vidisti omnem furorem, <l eID="gen26484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26485"/>universas cogitationes eorum adversum me. <l eID="gen26485" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26479"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sin</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:61
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9754"/><lg sID="gen26486"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9754"/>Audisti opprobrium eorum, Domine, <l eID="gen26487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26488"/>omnes cogitationes eorum adversum me. <l eID="gen26488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:62
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9755"/><l level="1" sID="gen26489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9755"/>Labia insurgentium mihi, et meditationes eorum <l eID="gen26489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26490"/>adversum me tota die. <l eID="gen26490" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:63
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9756"/><l level="1" sID="gen26491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9756"/>Sessionem eorum et resurrectionem eorum vide ; <l eID="gen26491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26492"/>ego sum psalmus eorum. <l eID="gen26492" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26486"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Thau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:64
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9757"/><lg sID="gen26493"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9757"/>Redes eis vicem, Domine, <l eID="gen26494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26495"/>juxta opera manuum suarum. <l eID="gen26495" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:65
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9758"/><l level="1" sID="gen26496"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9758"/>Dabis eis scutum cordis, <l eID="gen26496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26497"/>laborem tuum. <l eID="gen26497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 3:66
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9759"/><l level="1" sID="gen26498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9759"/>Persequeris in furore, et conteres eos <l eID="gen26498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26499"/>sub cælis, Domine. <l eID="gen26499" level="1"/><lg eID="gen26493"/> <chapter eID="Lam.3"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:1
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9760"/><title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Aleph</foreign></title> <lg sID="gen26500"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26501"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9760"/>Quomodo obscuratum est aurum, <l eID="gen26501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26502"/>mutatus est color optimus ! <l eID="gen26502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26503"/>dispersi sunt lapides sanctuarii <l eID="gen26503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26504"/>in capite omnium platearum ! <l eID="gen26504" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26500"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Beth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9761"/><lg sID="gen26505"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9761"/>Filii Sion inclyti, <l eID="gen26506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26507"/>et amicti auro primo : <l eID="gen26507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26508"/>quomodo reputati sunt in vasa testea, <l eID="gen26508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26509"/>opus manuum figuli ! <l eID="gen26509" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26505"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ghimel</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9762"/><lg sID="gen26510"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26511"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9762"/>Sed et lamiæ nudaverunt mammam, <l eID="gen26511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26512"/>lactaverunt catulos suos : <l eID="gen26512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26513"/>filia populi mei crudelis <l eID="gen26513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26514"/>quasi struthio in deserto. <l eID="gen26514" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26510"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Daleth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9763"/><lg sID="gen26515"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9763"/>Adhæsit lingua lactentis <l eID="gen26516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26517"/>ad palatum ejus in siti ; <l eID="gen26517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26518"/>parvuli petierunt panem, <l eID="gen26518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26519"/>et non erat qui frangeret eis. <l eID="gen26519" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26515"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">He</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9764"/><lg sID="gen26520"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26521"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9764"/>Qui vescebantur voluptuose, <l eID="gen26521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26522"/>interierunt in viis ; <l eID="gen26522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26523"/>qui nutriebantur in croceis, <l eID="gen26523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26524"/>amplexati sunt stercora. <l eID="gen26524" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26520"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Vau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9765"/><lg sID="gen26525"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9765"/>Et major effecta est iniquitas filiæ populi mei <l eID="gen26526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26527"/>peccato Sodomorum, <l eID="gen26527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26528"/>quæ subversa est in momento, <l eID="gen26528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26529"/>et non ceperunt in ea manus. <l eID="gen26529" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26525"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Zain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9766"/><lg sID="gen26530"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9766"/>Candidiores Nazaræi ejus nive, <l eID="gen26531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26532"/>nitidiores lacte, <l eID="gen26532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26533"/>rubicundiores ebore antiquo, <l eID="gen26533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26534"/>sapphiro pulchriores. <l eID="gen26534" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26530"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Heth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9767"/><lg sID="gen26535"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26536"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9767"/>Denigrata est super carbones facies eorum <l eID="gen26536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26537"/>et non sunt cogniti in plateis ; <l eID="gen26537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26538"/>adhæsit cutis eorum ossibus : <l eID="gen26538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26539"/>aruit, et facta est quasi lignum. <l eID="gen26539" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26535"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Teth</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9768"/><lg sID="gen26540"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9768"/>Melius fuit occisis gladio <l eID="gen26541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26542"/>quam interfectis fame, <l eID="gen26542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26543"/>quoniam isti extabuerunt consumpti <l eID="gen26543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26544"/>a sterilitate terræ. <l eID="gen26544" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26540"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Jod</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9769"/><lg sID="gen26545"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26546"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9769"/>Manus mulierum misericordium <l eID="gen26546" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26547"/>coxerunt filios suos ; <l eID="gen26547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26548"/>facti sunt cibus earum <l eID="gen26548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26549"/>in contritione filiæ populi mei. <l eID="gen26549" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26545"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Caph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9770"/><lg sID="gen26550"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9770"/>Complevit Dominus furorem suum, <l eID="gen26551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26552"/>effudit iram indignationis suæ : <l eID="gen26552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26553"/>et succendit ignem in Sion, <l eID="gen26553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26554"/>et devoravit fundamenta ejus. <l eID="gen26554" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26550"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Lamed</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9771"/><lg sID="gen26555"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26556"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9771"/>Non crediderunt reges terræ, <l eID="gen26556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26557"/>et universi habitatores orbis, <l eID="gen26557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26558"/>quoniam ingrederetur hostis et inimicus <l eID="gen26558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26559"/>per portas Jerusalem. <l eID="gen26559" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26555"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Mem</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9772"/><lg sID="gen26560"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26561"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9772"/>Propter peccata prophetarum ejus, <l eID="gen26561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26562"/>et iniquitates sacerdotum ejus, <l eID="gen26562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26563"/>qui effuderunt in medio ejus <l eID="gen26563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26564"/>sanguinem justorum. <l eID="gen26564" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26560"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Nun</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9773"/><lg sID="gen26565"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26566"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9773"/>Erraverunt cæci in plateis, <l eID="gen26566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26567"/>polluti sunt in sanguine ; <l eID="gen26567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26568"/>cumque non possent, <l eID="gen26568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26569"/>tenuerunt lacinias suas. <l eID="gen26569" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26565"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Samech</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9774"/><lg sID="gen26570"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9774"/>Recedite polluti, clamaverunt eis ; <l eID="gen26571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26572"/>recedite, abite, nolite tangere : <l eID="gen26572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26573"/>jurgati quippe sunt, et commoti dixerunt inter gentes : <l eID="gen26573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26574"/>Non addet ultra ut habitet in eis. <l eID="gen26574" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26570"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Phe</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9775"/><lg sID="gen26575"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26576"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9775"/>Facies Domini divisit eos, <l eID="gen26576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26577"/>non addet ut respiciat eos ; <l eID="gen26577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26578"/>facies sacerdotum non erubuerunt, <l eID="gen26578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26579"/>neque senum miserti sunt. <l eID="gen26579" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26575"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Ain</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9776"/><lg sID="gen26580"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9776"/>Cum adhuc subsisteremus, defecerunt oculi nostri <l eID="gen26581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26582"/>ad auxilium nostrum vanum ; <l eID="gen26582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26583"/>cum respiceremus attenti ad gentem <l eID="gen26583" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26584"/>quæ salvare non poterat. <l eID="gen26584" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26580"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sade</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9777"/><lg sID="gen26585"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9777"/>Lubricaverunt vestigia nostra <l eID="gen26586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26587"/>in itinere platearum nostrarum ; <l eID="gen26587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26588"/>appropinquavit finis noster, completi sunt dies nostri, <l eID="gen26588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26589"/>quia venit finis noster. <l eID="gen26589" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26585"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Coph</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9778"/><lg sID="gen26590"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26591"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9778"/>Velociores fuerunt persecutores nostri <l eID="gen26591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26592"/>aquilis cæli ; <l eID="gen26592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26593"/>super montes persecuti sunt nos, <l eID="gen26593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26594"/>in deserto insidiati sunt nobis. <l eID="gen26594" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26590"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Res</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9779"/><lg sID="gen26595"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26596"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9779"/>Spiritus oris nostri, christus Dominus, <l eID="gen26596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26597"/>captus est in peccatis nostris, <l eID="gen26597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26598"/>cui diximus : In umbra tua <l eID="gen26598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26599"/>vivemus in gentibus. <l eID="gen26599" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26595"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Sin</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9780"/><lg sID="gen26600"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26601"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9780"/>Gaude et lætare, filia Edom, <l eID="gen26601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26602"/>quæ habitas in terra Hus ! <l eID="gen26602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26603"/>ad te quoque perveniet calix : inebriaberis, <l eID="gen26603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26604"/>atque nudaberis. <l eID="gen26604" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26600"/> <title type="acrostic"><foreign xml:lang="hbo">Thau</foreign></title>

verses.name: Lamentations 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9781"/><lg sID="gen26605"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9781"/>Completa est iniquitas tua, filia Sion : <l eID="gen26606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26607"/>non addet ultra ut transmigret te. <l eID="gen26607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26608"/>Visitavit iniquitatem tuam, filia Edom ; <l eID="gen26608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26609"/>discooperuit peccata tua.  <chapter eID="Lam.4"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:1
verses.text: Recordare, Domine, quid acciderit nobis ; <l eID="gen26610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26611"/>intuere et respice opprobrium nostrum. <l eID="gen26611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9782"/><l level="1" sID="gen26612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9782"/>Hæreditas nostra versa est ad alienos, <l eID="gen26612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26613"/>domus nostræ ad extraneos. <l eID="gen26613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9783"/><l level="1" sID="gen26614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9783"/>Pupilli facti sumus absque patre, <l eID="gen26614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26615"/>matres nostræ quasi viduæ. <l eID="gen26615" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9784"/><l level="1" sID="gen26616"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9784"/>Aquam nostram pecunia bibimus ; <l eID="gen26616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26617"/>ligna nostra pretio comparavimus. <l eID="gen26617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9785"/><l level="1" sID="gen26618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9785"/>Cervicibus nostris minabamur, <l eID="gen26618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26619"/>lassis non dabatur requies. <l eID="gen26619" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9786"/><l level="1" sID="gen26620"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9786"/>Ægypto dedimus manum et Assyriis, <l eID="gen26620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26621"/>ut saturaremur pane. <l eID="gen26621" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9787"/><l level="1" sID="gen26622"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9787"/>Patres nostri peccaverunt, et non sunt : <l eID="gen26622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26623"/>et nos iniquitates eorum portavimus. <l eID="gen26623" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9788"/><l level="1" sID="gen26624"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9788"/>Servi dominati sunt nostri : <l eID="gen26624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26625"/>non fuit qui redimeret de manu eorum. <l eID="gen26625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9789"/><l level="1" sID="gen26626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9789"/>In animabus nostris afferebamus panem nobis, <l eID="gen26626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26627"/>a facie gladii in deserto. <l eID="gen26627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9790"/><l level="1" sID="gen26628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9790"/>Pellis nostra quasi clibanus exusta est, <l eID="gen26628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26629"/>a facie tempestatum famis. <l eID="gen26629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9791"/><l level="1" sID="gen26630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9791"/>Mulieres in Sion humiliaverunt, <l eID="gen26630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26631"/>et virgines in civitatibus Juda. <l eID="gen26631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9792"/><l level="1" sID="gen26632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9792"/>Principes manu suspensi sunt ; <l eID="gen26632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26633"/>facies senum non erubuerunt. <l eID="gen26633" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9793"/><l level="1" sID="gen26634"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9793"/>Adolescentibus impudice abusi sunt, <l eID="gen26634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26635"/>et pueri in ligno corruerunt. <l eID="gen26635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9794"/><l level="1" sID="gen26636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9794"/>Senes defecerunt de portis, <l eID="gen26636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26637"/>juvenes de choro psallentium. <l eID="gen26637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9795"/><l level="1" sID="gen26638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9795"/>Defecit gaudium cordis nostri ; <l eID="gen26638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26639"/>versus est in luctum chorus noster. <l eID="gen26639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9796"/><l level="1" sID="gen26640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9796"/>Cecidit corona capitis nostri : <l eID="gen26640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26641"/>væ nobis, quia peccavimus ! <l eID="gen26641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9797"/><l level="1" sID="gen26642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9797"/>Propterea mœstum factum est cor nostrum ; <l eID="gen26642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26643"/>ideo contenebrati sunt oculi nostri, <l eID="gen26643" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9798"/><l level="1" sID="gen26644"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9798"/>propter montem Sion quia disperiit ; <l eID="gen26644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26645"/>vulpes ambulaverunt in eo. <l eID="gen26645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9799"/><l level="1" sID="gen26646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9799"/>Tu autem, Domine, in æternum permanebis, <l eID="gen26646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26647"/>solium tuum in generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen26647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9800"/><l level="1" sID="gen26648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9800"/>Quare in perpetuum oblivisceris nostri, <l eID="gen26648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26649"/>derelinques nos in longitudine dierum ? <l eID="gen26649" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9801"/><l level="1" sID="gen26650"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9801"/>Converte nos, Domine, ad te, et convertemur ; <l eID="gen26650" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26651"/>innova dies nostros, sicut a principio. <l eID="gen26651" level="1"/>

verses.name: Lamentations 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9802"/><l level="1" sID="gen26652"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9802"/>Sed projiciens repulisti nos : <l eID="gen26652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26653"/>iratus es contra nos vehementer. <l eID="gen26653" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen26605"/> <chapter eID="Lam.5"/> <div eID="gen26033" osisID="Lam" type="book"/>

verses.name: Baruch 1:1
verses.text: Et hæc verba libri quæ scripsit Baruch filius Neriæ, filii Maasiæ, filii Sedeciæ, filii Sedei, filii Helciæ, in Babylonia,

verses.name: Baruch 1:2
verses.text: in anno quinto, in septimo die mensis, in tempore quo ceperunt Chaldæi Jerusalem, et succenderunt eam igni.

verses.name: Baruch 1:3
verses.text: Et legit Baruch verba libri hujus ad aures Jechoniæ filii Joakim regis Juda, et ad aures universi populi venientis ad librum,

verses.name: Baruch 1:4
verses.text: et ad aures potentium, filiorum regum, et ad aures presbyterorum, et ad aures populi, a minimo usque ad maximum eorum, omnium habitantium in Babylonia, ad flumen Sodi.

verses.name: Baruch 1:5
verses.text: Qui audientes plorabant, et jejunabant, et orabant in conspectu Domini.

verses.name: Baruch 1:6
verses.text: Et collegerunt pecuniam, secundum quod potuit uniuscujusque manus,

verses.name: Baruch 1:7
verses.text: et miserunt in Jerusalem ad Joakim filium Helciæ filii Salom sacerdotem, et ad sacerdotes, et ad omnem populum qui inventi sunt cum eo in Jerusalem :

verses.name: Baruch 1:8
verses.text: cum acciperet vasa templi Domini, quæ ablata fuerant de templo, revocare in terram Juda, decima die mensis Sivan, vasa argentea quæ fecit Sedecias filius Josiæ rex Juda,

verses.name: Baruch 1:9
verses.text: posteaquam cepisset Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis Jechoniam, et principes, et cunctos potentes, et populum terræ, ab Jerusalem, et duxit eos vinctos in Babylonem.

verses.name: Baruch 1:10
verses.text: Et dixerunt : Ecce misimus ad vos pecunias, de quibus emite holocautomata et thus : et facite manna, et offerte pro peccato, ad aram Domini Dei nostri :

verses.name: Baruch 1:11
verses.text: et orate pro vita Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, et pro vita Baltassar filii ejus, ut sint dies eorum sicut dies cæli super terram :

verses.name: Baruch 1:12
verses.text: et ut det Dominus virtutem nobis, et illuminet oculos nostros, ut vivamus sub umbra Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis, et sub umbra Baltassar filii ejus, et serviamus eis multis diebus, et inveniamus gratiam in conspectu eorum.

verses.name: Baruch 1:13
verses.text: Et pro nobis ipsis orate ad Dominum Deum nostrum, quia peccavimus Domino Deo nostro, et non est aversus furor ejus a nobis usque in hunc diem.

verses.name: Baruch 1:14
verses.text: Et legite librum istum quem misimus ad vos recitari in templo Domini, in die solemni et in die opportuno :

verses.name: Baruch 1:15
verses.text: et dicetis : <div eID="gen26655" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen26656"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26657"/>Domino Deo nostro justitia, <l eID="gen26657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26658"/>nobis autem confusio faciei nostræ, <l eID="gen26658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26659"/>sicut est dies hæc omni Juda, <l eID="gen26659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26660"/>et habitantibus in Jerusalem : <l eID="gen26660" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9803"/><l level="1" sID="gen26661"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9803"/>regibus nostris, et principibus nostris, <l eID="gen26661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26662"/>et sacerdotibus nostris, et prophetis nostris, <l eID="gen26662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26663"/>et patribus nostris. <l eID="gen26663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9804"/><l level="1" sID="gen26664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9804"/>Peccavimus ante Dominum Deum nostrum, <l eID="gen26664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26665"/>et non credidimus, diffidentes in eum : <l eID="gen26665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9805"/><l level="1" sID="gen26666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9805"/>et non fuimus subjectibiles illi, <l eID="gen26666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26667"/>et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri, <l eID="gen26667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26668"/>ut ambularemus in mandatis ejus, quæ dedit nobis. <l eID="gen26668" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9806"/><l level="1" sID="gen26669"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9806"/>A die qua eduxit patres nostros de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen26669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26670"/>usque ad diem hanc, <l eID="gen26670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26671"/>eramus incredibiles ad Dominum Deum nostrum : <l eID="gen26671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26672"/>et dissipati recessimus, ne audiremus vocem ipsius : <l eID="gen26672" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9807"/><l level="1" sID="gen26673"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9807"/>et adhæserunt nobis multa mala et maledictiones <l eID="gen26673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26674"/>quæ constituit Dominus Moysi servo suo, <l eID="gen26674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26675"/>qui eduxit patres nostros de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen26675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26676"/>dare nobis terram fluentem lac et mel, sicut hodierna die. <l eID="gen26676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 1:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9808"/><l level="1" sID="gen26677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9808"/>Et non audivimus vocem Domini Dei nostri, <l eID="gen26677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26678"/>secundum omnia verba prophetarum quos misit ad nos : <l eID="gen26678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9809"/><l level="1" sID="gen26679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9809"/>et abivimus unusquisque in sensum cordis nostri maligni, <l eID="gen26679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26680"/>operari diis alienis, <l eID="gen26680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26681"/>facientes mala ante oculos Domini Dei nostri.  <chapter eID="Bar.1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:1
verses.text: Propter quod statuit Dominus Deus noster verbum suum, <l eID="gen26682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26683"/>quod locutus est ad nos, <l eID="gen26683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26684"/>et ad judices nostros qui judicaverunt Israël, <l eID="gen26684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26685"/>et ad reges nostros, et ad principes nostros, <l eID="gen26685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26686"/>et ad omnem Israël et Juda : <l eID="gen26686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9810"/><l level="1" sID="gen26687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9810"/>ut adduceret Dominus super nos mala magna, <l eID="gen26687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26688"/>quæ non sunt facta sub cælo <l eID="gen26688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26689"/>quemadmodum facta sunt in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen26689" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26690"/>secundum quæ scripta sunt in lege Moysi, <l eID="gen26690" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9811"/><l level="1" sID="gen26691"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9811"/>et manducaret homo carnes filii sui et carnes filiæ suæ. <l eID="gen26691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9812"/><l level="1" sID="gen26692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9812"/>Et dedit eos sub manu regum omnium qui sunt in circuitu nostro, <l eID="gen26692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26693"/>in improperium et in desolationem in omnibus populis <l eID="gen26693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26694"/>in quibus nos dispersit Dominus : <l eID="gen26694" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9813"/><l level="1" sID="gen26695"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9813"/>et facti sumus subtus, et non supra, <l eID="gen26695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26696"/>quia peccavimus Domino Deo nostro, <l eID="gen26696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26697"/>non obaudiendo voci ipsius. <l eID="gen26697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9814"/><l level="1" sID="gen26698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9814"/>Domino Deo nostro justitia, <l eID="gen26698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26699"/>nobis autem et patribus nostris confusio faciei, <l eID="gen26699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26700"/>sicut est dies hæc : <l eID="gen26700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9815"/><l level="1" sID="gen26701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9815"/>quia locutus est Dominus super nos omnia mala hæc <l eID="gen26701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26702"/>quæ venerunt super nos : <l eID="gen26702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9816"/><l level="1" sID="gen26703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9816"/>et non sumus deprecati faciem Domini Dei nostri, <l eID="gen26703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26704"/>ut reverteremur unusquisque nostrum a viis nostris pessimis. <l eID="gen26704" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9817"/><l level="1" sID="gen26705"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9817"/>Et vigilavit Dominus in malis, <l eID="gen26705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26706"/>et adduxit ea super nos : <l eID="gen26706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26707"/>quia justus est Dominus in omnibus operibus suis <l eID="gen26707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26708"/>quæ mandavit nobis, <l eID="gen26708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9818"/><l level="1" sID="gen26709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9818"/>et non audivimus vocem ipsius <l eID="gen26709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26710"/>ut iremus in præceptis Domini, <l eID="gen26710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26711"/>quæ dedit ante faciem nostram. <l eID="gen26711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9819"/><l level="1" sID="gen26712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9819"/>Et nunc, Domine Deus Israël, <l eID="gen26712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26713"/>qui eduxisti populum tuum de terra Ægypti <l eID="gen26713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26714"/>in manu valida, et in signis, et in prodigiis, <l eID="gen26714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26715"/>et in virtute tua magna, et in brachio excelso, <l eID="gen26715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26716"/>et fecisti tibi nomen sicut est dies iste : <l eID="gen26716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9820"/><l level="1" sID="gen26717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9820"/>peccavimus, impie egimus, <l eID="gen26717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26718"/>inique gessimus, Domine Deus noster, <l eID="gen26718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26719"/>in omnibus justitiis tuis. <l eID="gen26719" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9821"/><l level="1" sID="gen26720"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9821"/>Avertatur ira tua a nobis, <l eID="gen26720" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26721"/>quia derelicti sumus pauci inter gentes ubi dispersisti nos. <l eID="gen26721" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9822"/><l level="1" sID="gen26722"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9822"/>Exaudi, Domine, preces nostras et orationes nostras, <l eID="gen26722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26723"/>et educ nos propter te, <l eID="gen26723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26724"/>et da nobis invenire gratiam ante faciem eorum qui nos abduxerunt : <l eID="gen26724" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9823"/><l level="1" sID="gen26725"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9823"/>ut sciat omnis terra quia tu es Dominus Deus noster, <l eID="gen26725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26726"/>et quia nomen tuum invocatum est super Israël, <l eID="gen26726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26727"/>et super genus ipsius. <l eID="gen26727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9824"/><l level="1" sID="gen26728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9824"/>Respice, Domine, de domo sancta tua in nos, <l eID="gen26728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26729"/>et inclina aurem tuam, et exaudi nos. <l eID="gen26729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9825"/><l level="1" sID="gen26730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9825"/>Aperi oculos tuos et vide : <l eID="gen26730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26731"/>quia non mortui qui sunt in inferno, <l eID="gen26731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26732"/>quorum spiritus acceptus est a visceribus suis, <l eID="gen26732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26733"/>dabunt honorem et justificationem Domino : <l eID="gen26733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9826"/><l level="1" sID="gen26734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9826"/>sed anima quæ tristis est super magnitudine mali, <l eID="gen26734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26735"/>et incedit curva et infirma, <l eID="gen26735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26736"/>et oculi deficientes, et anima esuriens, <l eID="gen26736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26737"/>dat tibi gloriam et justitiam Domino. <l eID="gen26737" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9827"/><l level="1" sID="gen26738"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9827"/>Quia non secundum justitias patrum nostrorum <l eID="gen26738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26739"/>nos fundimus preces et petimus misericordiam <l eID="gen26739" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26740"/>ante conspectum tuum, Domine Deus noster : <l eID="gen26740" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9828"/><l level="1" sID="gen26741"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9828"/>sed quia misisti iram tuam et furorem tuum super nos, <l eID="gen26741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26742"/>sicut locutus es in manu puerorum tuorum prophetarum, <l eID="gen26742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26743"/>dicens :

verses.name: Baruch 2:21
verses.text: Sic dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen26743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26744"/>Inclinate humerum vestrum et cervicem vestram, <l eID="gen26744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26745"/>et opera facite regi Babylonis, <l eID="gen26745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26746"/>et sedebitis in terra quam dedi patribus vestris. <l eID="gen26746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9829"/><l level="1" sID="gen26747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9829"/>Quod si non audieritis vocem Domini Dei vestri, <l eID="gen26747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26748"/>operari regi Babyloniæ, <l eID="gen26748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26749"/>defectionem vestram faciam de civitatibus Juda, <l eID="gen26749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26750"/>et a foris Jerusalem, <l eID="gen26750" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9830"/><l level="1" sID="gen26751"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9830"/>et auferam a vobis vocem jucunditatis et vocem gaudii, <l eID="gen26751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26752"/>et vocem sponsi et vocem sponsæ, <l eID="gen26752" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26753"/>et erit omnis terra sine vestigio ab inhabitantibus eam. <l eID="gen26753" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9831"/><l level="1" sID="gen26754"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9831"/>Et non audierunt vocem tuam, <l eID="gen26754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26755"/>ut operarentur regi Babylonis : <l eID="gen26755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26756"/>et statuisti verba tua, <l eID="gen26756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26757"/>quæ locutus es in manibus puerorum tuorum prophetarum, <l eID="gen26757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26758"/>ut transferrentur ossa regum nostrorum <l eID="gen26758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26759"/>et ossa patrum nostrorum de loco suo : <l eID="gen26759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9832"/><l level="1" sID="gen26760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9832"/>et ecce projecta sunt in calore solis et in gelu noctis, <l eID="gen26760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26761"/>et mortui sunt in doloribus pessimis, <l eID="gen26761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26762"/>in fame et in gladio, et in emissione. <l eID="gen26762" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9833"/><l level="1" sID="gen26763"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9833"/>Et posuisti templum in quo invocatum est nomen tuum in ipso <l eID="gen26763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26764"/>sicut hæc dies, <l eID="gen26764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26765"/>propter iniquitatem domus Israël et domus Juda. <l eID="gen26765" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9834"/><l level="1" sID="gen26766"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9834"/>Et fecisti in nobis, Domine Deus noster, <l eID="gen26766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26767"/>secundum omnem bonitatem tuam <l eID="gen26767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26768"/>et secundum omnem miserationem tuam illam magnam : <l eID="gen26768" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9835"/><l level="1" sID="gen26769"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9835"/>sicut locutus es in manu pueri tui Moysi, <l eID="gen26769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26770"/>in die qua præcepisti ei scribere legem tuam coram filiis Israël, <l eID="gen26770" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9836"/><l level="1" sID="gen26771"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9836"/>dicens : Si non audieritis vocem meam, <l eID="gen26771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26772"/>multitudo hæc magna convertetur in minimam inter gentes, <l eID="gen26772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26773"/>quo ego eos dispergam : <l eID="gen26773" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9837"/><l level="1" sID="gen26774"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9837"/>quia scio quod me non audiet populus : <l eID="gen26774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26775"/>populus est enim dura cervice. <l eID="gen26775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26776"/>Et convertetur ad cor suum in terra captivitatis suæ, <l eID="gen26776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9838"/><l level="1" sID="gen26777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9838"/>et scient quia ego sum Dominus Deus eorum : <l eID="gen26777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26778"/>et dabo eis cor, et intelligent ; <l eID="gen26778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26779"/>aures, et audient : <l eID="gen26779" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9839"/><l level="1" sID="gen26780"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9839"/>et laudabunt me in terra captivitatis suæ, <l eID="gen26780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26781"/>et memores erunt nominis mei, <l eID="gen26781" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9840"/><l level="1" sID="gen26782"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9840"/>et avertent se a dorso suo duro, <l eID="gen26782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26783"/>et a malignitatibus suis : <l eID="gen26783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26784"/>quia reminiscentur viam patrum suorum, <l eID="gen26784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26785"/>qui peccaverunt in me. <l eID="gen26785" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9841"/><l level="1" sID="gen26786"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9841"/>Et revocabo illos in terram quam juravi patribus eorum, <l eID="gen26786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26787"/>Abraham, Isaac, et Jacob : <l eID="gen26787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26788"/>et dominabuntur ejus, et multiplicabo eos, <l eID="gen26788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26789"/>et non minorabuntur : <l eID="gen26789" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 2:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9842"/><l level="1" sID="gen26790"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9842"/>et statuam illis testamentum alterum sempiternum, <l eID="gen26790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26791"/>ut sim illis in Deum, <l eID="gen26791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26792"/>et ipsi erunt mihi in populum : <l eID="gen26792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26793"/>et non movebo amplius populum meum, filios Israël, <l eID="gen26793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26794"/>a terra quam dedi illis.  <chapter eID="Bar.2"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:1
verses.text: Et nunc, Domine omnipotens, Deus Israël, <l eID="gen26795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26796"/>anima in angustiis, et spiritus anxius clamat ad te. <l eID="gen26796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:2
