verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9843"/><l level="1" sID="gen26797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9843"/>Audi, Domine, et miserere, <l eID="gen26797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26798"/>quia Deus es misericors : <l eID="gen26798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26799"/>et miserere nostri, quia peccavimus ante te : <l eID="gen26799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9844"/><l level="1" sID="gen26800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9844"/>quia tu sedes in sempiternum, <l eID="gen26800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26801"/>et nos, peribimus in ævum ? <l eID="gen26801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9845"/><l level="1" sID="gen26802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9845"/>Domine omnipotens, Deus Israël, <l eID="gen26802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26803"/>audi nunc orationem mortuorum Israël, <l eID="gen26803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26804"/>et filiorum ipsorum qui peccaverunt ante te, <l eID="gen26804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26805"/>et non audierunt vocem Domini Dei sui, <l eID="gen26805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26806"/>et agglutinata sunt nobis mala. <l eID="gen26806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9846"/><l level="1" sID="gen26807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9846"/>Noli meminisse iniquitatum patrum nostrorum, <l eID="gen26807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26808"/>sed memento manus tuæ et nominis tui in tempore isto : <l eID="gen26808" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9847"/><l level="1" sID="gen26809"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9847"/>quia tu es Dominus Deus noster, <l eID="gen26809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26810"/>et laudabimus te, Domine : <l eID="gen26810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9848"/><l level="1" sID="gen26811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9848"/>quia propter hoc dedisti timorem tuum in cordibus nostris, <l eID="gen26811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26812"/>et ut invocemus nomen tuum, <l eID="gen26812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26813"/>et laudemus te in captivitate nostra, <l eID="gen26813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26814"/>quia convertimur ab iniquitate patrum nostrorum, <l eID="gen26814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26815"/>qui peccaverunt ante te. <l eID="gen26815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9849"/><l level="1" sID="gen26816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9849"/>Et ecce nos in captivitate nostra sumus hodie, <l eID="gen26816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26817"/>qua nos dispersisti in improperium, <l eID="gen26817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26818"/>et in maledictum, et in peccatum, <l eID="gen26818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26819"/>secundum omnes iniquitates patrum nostrorum, <l eID="gen26819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26820"/>qui recesserunt a te, Domine Deus noster. <l eID="gen26820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9850"/><l level="1" sID="gen26821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9850"/>Audi, Israël, mandata vitæ : <l eID="gen26821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26822"/>auribus percipe, ut scias prudentiam. <l eID="gen26822" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9851"/><l level="1" sID="gen26823"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9851"/>Quid est, Israël, quod in terra inimicorum es, <l eID="gen26823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9852"/><l level="1" sID="gen26824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9852"/>inveterasti in terra aliena, <l eID="gen26824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26825"/>coinquinatus es cum mortuis, <l eID="gen26825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26826"/>deputatus es cum descendentibus in infernum ? <l eID="gen26826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9853"/><l level="1" sID="gen26827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9853"/>Dereliquisti fontem sapientiæ : <l eID="gen26827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9854"/><l level="1" sID="gen26828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9854"/>nam si in via Dei ambulasses, <l eID="gen26828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26829"/>habitasses utique in pace sempiterna. <l eID="gen26829" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9855"/><l level="1" sID="gen26830"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9855"/>Disce ubi sit prudentia, <l eID="gen26830" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26831"/>ubi sit virtus, ubi sit intellectus, <l eID="gen26831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26832"/>ut scias simul ubi sit longiturnitas vitæ et victus, <l eID="gen26832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26833"/>ubi sit lumen oculorum, et pax. <l eID="gen26833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9856"/><l level="1" sID="gen26834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9856"/>Quis invenit locum ejus ? <l eID="gen26834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26835"/>et quis intravit in thesauros ejus ? <l eID="gen26835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9857"/><l level="1" sID="gen26836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9857"/>Ubi sunt principes gentium, <l eID="gen26836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26837"/>et qui dominantur super bestias quæ sunt super terram ? <l eID="gen26837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9858"/><l level="1" sID="gen26838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9858"/>qui in avibus cæli ludunt, <l eID="gen26838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9859"/><l level="1" sID="gen26839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9859"/>qui argentum thesaurizant, et aurum, <l eID="gen26839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26840"/>in quo confidunt homines, <l eID="gen26840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26841"/>et non est finis acquisitionis eorum ? <l eID="gen26841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26842"/>qui argentum fabricant, et solliciti sunt, <l eID="gen26842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26843"/>nec est inventio operum illorum ? <l eID="gen26843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9860"/><l level="1" sID="gen26844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9860"/>Exterminati sunt, et ad inferos descenderunt, <l eID="gen26844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26845"/>et alii loco eorum surrexerunt. <l eID="gen26845" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9861"/><l level="1" sID="gen26846"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9861"/>Juvenes viderunt lumen, et habitaverunt super terram, <l eID="gen26846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26847"/>viam autem disciplinæ ignoraverunt, <l eID="gen26847" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9862"/><l level="1" sID="gen26848"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9862"/>neque intellexerunt semitas ejus, <l eID="gen26848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26849"/>neque filii eorum susceperunt eam : <l eID="gen26849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26850"/>a facie ipsorum longe facta est ; <l eID="gen26850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9863"/><l level="1" sID="gen26851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9863"/>non est audita in terra Chanaan, <l eID="gen26851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26852"/>neque visa est in Theman. <l eID="gen26852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9864"/><l level="1" sID="gen26853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9864"/>Filii quoque Agar, qui exquirunt prudentiam quæ de terra est, <l eID="gen26853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26854"/>negotiatores Merrhæ et Theman, <l eID="gen26854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26855"/>et fabulatores, et exquisitores prudentiæ et intelligentiæ : <l eID="gen26855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26856"/>viam autem sapientiæ nescierunt, <l eID="gen26856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26857"/>neque commemorati sunt semitas ejus. <l eID="gen26857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9865"/><l level="1" sID="gen26858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9865"/>O Israël, quam magna est domus Dei, <l eID="gen26858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26859"/>et ingens locus possessionis ejus ! <l eID="gen26859" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9866"/><l level="1" sID="gen26860"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9866"/>magnus est, et non habet finem : <l eID="gen26860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26861"/>excelsus, et immensus. <l eID="gen26861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9867"/><l level="1" sID="gen26862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9867"/>Ibi fuerunt gigantes nominati illi, qui ab initio fuerunt, <l eID="gen26862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26863"/>statura magna, scientes bellum. <l eID="gen26863" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9868"/><l level="1" sID="gen26864"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9868"/>Non hos elegit Dominus, <l eID="gen26864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26865"/>neque viam disciplinæ invenerunt : <l eID="gen26865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26866"/>propterea perierunt, <l eID="gen26866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9869"/><l level="1" sID="gen26867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9869"/>et quoniam non habuerunt sapientiam, <l eID="gen26867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26868"/>interierunt propter suam insipientiam. <l eID="gen26868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9870"/><l level="1" sID="gen26869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9870"/>Quis ascendit in cælum, et accepit eam, <l eID="gen26869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26870"/>et eduxit eam de nubibus ? <l eID="gen26870" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9871"/><l level="1" sID="gen26871"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9871"/>Quis transfretavit mare, et invenit illam, et attulit illam super aurum electum ? <l eID="gen26871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9872"/><l level="1" sID="gen26872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9872"/>Non est qui possit scire vias ejus, <l eID="gen26872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26873"/>neque qui exquirat semitas ejus : <l eID="gen26873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9873"/><l level="1" sID="gen26874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9873"/>sed qui scit universa novit eam, <l eID="gen26874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26875"/>et adinvenit eam prudentia sua <l eID="gen26875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26876"/>qui præparavit terram in æterno tempore : <l eID="gen26876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26877"/>et replevit eam pecudibus et quadrupedibus <l eID="gen26877" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9874"/><l level="1" sID="gen26878"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9874"/>qui emittit lumen, et vadit, <l eID="gen26878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26879"/>et vocavit illud, et obedit illi in tremore. <l eID="gen26879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9875"/><l level="1" sID="gen26880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9875"/>Stellæ autem dederunt lumen in custodiis suis, <l eID="gen26880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26881"/>et lætatæ sunt : <l eID="gen26881" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9876"/><l level="1" sID="gen26882"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9876"/>vocatæ sunt, et dixerunt : Adsumus, <l eID="gen26882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26883"/>et luxerunt ei cum jucunditate, qui fecit illas. <l eID="gen26883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9877"/><l level="1" sID="gen26884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9877"/>Hic est Deus noster, <l eID="gen26884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26885"/>et non æstimabitur alius adversus eum. <l eID="gen26885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9878"/><l level="1" sID="gen26886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9878"/>Hic adinvenit omnem viam disciplinæ, <l eID="gen26886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26887"/>et tradidit illam Jacob puero suo, <l eID="gen26887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26888"/>et Israël dilecto suo. <l eID="gen26888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 3:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9879"/><l level="1" sID="gen26889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9879"/>Post hæc in terris visus est, <l eID="gen26889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26890"/>et cum hominibus conversatus est.  <chapter eID="Bar.3"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:1
verses.text: Hic liber mandatorum Dei, <l eID="gen26891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26892"/>et lex quæ est in æternum : <l eID="gen26892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26893"/>omnes qui tenent eam pervenient ad vitam : <l eID="gen26893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26894"/>qui autem dereliquerunt eam, in mortem. <l eID="gen26894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9880"/><l level="1" sID="gen26895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9880"/>Convertere, Jacob, et apprehende eam : <l eID="gen26895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26896"/>ambula per viam ad splendorem ejus contra lumen ejus. <l eID="gen26896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9881"/><l level="1" sID="gen26897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9881"/>Ne tradas alteri gloriam tuam, <l eID="gen26897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26898"/>et dignitatem tuam genti alienæ. <l eID="gen26898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9882"/><l level="1" sID="gen26899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9882"/>Beati sumus, Israël, <l eID="gen26899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26900"/>quia quæ Deo placent manifesta sunt nobis. <l eID="gen26900" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9883"/><l level="1" sID="gen26901"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9883"/>Animæquior esto, populus Dei, memorabilis Israël : <l eID="gen26901" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9884"/><l level="1" sID="gen26902"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9884"/>venundati estis gentibus non in perditionem : <l eID="gen26902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26903"/>sed propter quod in ira ad iracundiam provocastis Deum, <l eID="gen26903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26904"/>traditi estis adversariis. <l eID="gen26904" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9885"/><l level="1" sID="gen26905"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9885"/>Exacerbastis enim eum qui fecit vos, Deum æternum, <l eID="gen26905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26906"/>immolantes dæmoniis, et non Deo. <l eID="gen26906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9886"/><l level="1" sID="gen26907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9886"/>Obliti enim estis Deum qui nutrivit vos, <l eID="gen26907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26908"/>et contristastis nutricem vestram Jerusalem. <l eID="gen26908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9887"/><l level="1" sID="gen26909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9887"/>Vidit enim iracundiam a Deo venientem vobis, et dixit : <l eID="gen26909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26910"/>Audite, confines Sion : <l eID="gen26910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26911"/>adduxit enim mihi Deus luctum magnum. <l eID="gen26911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9888"/><l level="1" sID="gen26912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9888"/>Vidi enim captivitatem populi mei, <l eID="gen26912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26913"/>filiorum meorum et filiarum, <l eID="gen26913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26914"/>quam superduxit illis Æternus. <l eID="gen26914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9889"/><l level="1" sID="gen26915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9889"/>Nutrivi enim illos cum jucunditate ; <l eID="gen26915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26916"/>dimisi autem illos cum fletu et luctu. <l eID="gen26916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9890"/><l level="1" sID="gen26917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9890"/>Nemo gaudeat super me viduam et desolatam : <l eID="gen26917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26918"/>a multis derelicta sum propter peccata filiorum meorum, <l eID="gen26918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26919"/>quia declinaverunt a lege Dei. <l eID="gen26919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9891"/><l level="1" sID="gen26920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9891"/>Justitias autem ipsius nescierunt, <l eID="gen26920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26921"/>nec ambulaverunt per vias mandatorum Dei, <l eID="gen26921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26922"/>neque per semitas veritatis ejus cum justitia ingressi sunt. <l eID="gen26922" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9892"/><l level="1" sID="gen26923"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9892"/>Veniant confines Sion, <l eID="gen26923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26924"/>et memorentur captivitatem filiorum et filiarum mearum, <l eID="gen26924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26925"/>quam superduxit illis Æternus. <l eID="gen26925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9893"/><l level="1" sID="gen26926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9893"/>Adduxit enim super illos gentem de longinquo, <l eID="gen26926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26927"/>gentem improbam, et alterius linguæ, <l eID="gen26927" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9894"/><l level="1" sID="gen26928"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9894"/>qui non sunt reveriti senem, <l eID="gen26928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26929"/>neque puerorum miserti sunt, <l eID="gen26929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26930"/>et abduxerunt dilectos viduæ, <l eID="gen26930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26931"/>et a filiis unicam desolaverunt. <l eID="gen26931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9895"/><l level="1" sID="gen26932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9895"/>Ego autem, quid possum adjuvare vos ? <l eID="gen26932" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9896"/><l level="1" sID="gen26933"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9896"/>qui enim adduxit super vos mala, <l eID="gen26933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26934"/>ipse vos eripiet de manibus inimicorum vestrorum. <l eID="gen26934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9897"/><l level="1" sID="gen26935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9897"/>Ambulate, filii, ambulate : <l eID="gen26935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26936"/>ego enim derelicta sum sola. <l eID="gen26936" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9898"/><l level="1" sID="gen26937"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9898"/>Exui me stola pacis, <l eID="gen26937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26938"/>indui autem me sacco obsecrationis, <l eID="gen26938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26939"/>et clamabo ad Altissimum in diebus meis. <l eID="gen26939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9899"/><l level="1" sID="gen26940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9899"/>Animæquiores estote, filii ; clamate ad Dominum, <l eID="gen26940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26941"/>et eripiet vos de manu principum inimicorum. <l eID="gen26941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9900"/><l level="1" sID="gen26942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9900"/>Ego enim speravi in æternum salutem vestram, <l eID="gen26942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26943"/>et venit mihi gaudium a Sancto, super misericordia <l eID="gen26943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26944"/>quæ veniet vobis ab æterno salutari nostro. <l eID="gen26944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9901"/><l level="1" sID="gen26945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9901"/>Emisi enim vos cum luctu et ploratu : <l eID="gen26945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26946"/>reducet autem vos mihi Dominus <l eID="gen26946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26947"/>cum gaudio et jucunditate in sempiternum. <l eID="gen26947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9902"/><l level="1" sID="gen26948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9902"/>Sicut enim viderunt vicinæ Sion captivitatem vestram a Deo, <l eID="gen26948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26949"/>sic videbunt et in celeritate salutem vestram a Deo, <l eID="gen26949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26950"/>quæ superveniet vobis cum honore magno et splendore æterno. <l eID="gen26950" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9903"/><l level="1" sID="gen26951"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9903"/>Filii, patienter sustinete iram quæ supervenit vobis : <l eID="gen26951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26952"/>persecutus est enim te inimicus tuus : <l eID="gen26952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26953"/>sed cito videbis perditionem ipsius, <l eID="gen26953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26954"/>et super cervices ipsius ascendes. <l eID="gen26954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9904"/><l level="1" sID="gen26955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9904"/>Delicati mei ambulaverunt vias asperas : <l eID="gen26955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26956"/>ducti sunt enim ut grex direptus ab inimicis. <l eID="gen26956" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9905"/><l level="1" sID="gen26957"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9905"/>Animæquiores estote, filii, et proclamate ad Dominum : <l eID="gen26957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26958"/>erit enim memoria vestra ab eo qui duxit vos. <l eID="gen26958" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9906"/><l level="1" sID="gen26959"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9906"/>Sicut enim fuit sensus vester ut erraretis a Deo, <l eID="gen26959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26960"/>decies tantum iterum convertentes requiretis eum : <l eID="gen26960" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9907"/><l level="1" sID="gen26961"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9907"/>qui enim induxit vobis mala, <l eID="gen26961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26962"/>ipse rursum adducet vobis sempiternam jucunditatem cum salute vestra. <l eID="gen26962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9908"/><l level="1" sID="gen26963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9908"/>Animæquior esto, Jerusalem : <l eID="gen26963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26964"/>exhortatur enim te, qui te nominavit. <l eID="gen26964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9909"/><l level="1" sID="gen26965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9909"/>Nocentes peribunt, qui te vexaverunt : <l eID="gen26965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26966"/>et qui gratulati sunt in tua ruina, punientur. <l eID="gen26966" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9910"/><l level="1" sID="gen26967"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9910"/>Civitates quibus servierunt filii tui, punientur, <l eID="gen26967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26968"/>et quæ accepit filios tuos. <l eID="gen26968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9911"/><l level="1" sID="gen26969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9911"/>Sicut enim gavisa est in tua ruina, et lætata est in casu tuo, <l eID="gen26969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26970"/>sic contristabitur in sua desolatione, <l eID="gen26970" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9912"/><l level="1" sID="gen26971"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9912"/>et amputabitur exsultatio multitudinis ejus, <l eID="gen26971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26972"/>et gaudimonium ejus erit in luctum. <l eID="gen26972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9913"/><l level="1" sID="gen26973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9913"/>Ignis enim superveniet ei ab Æterno in longiturnis diebus, <l eID="gen26973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26974"/>et habitabitur a dæmoniis in multitudine temporis. <l eID="gen26974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9914"/><l level="1" sID="gen26975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9914"/>Circumspice, Jerusalem, ad orientem, <l eID="gen26975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26976"/>et vide jucunditatem a Deo tibi venientem. <l eID="gen26976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 4:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9915"/><l level="1" sID="gen26977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9915"/>Ecce enim veniunt filii tui, quos dimisisti dispersos : <l eID="gen26977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26978"/>veniunt collecti ab oriente usque ad occidentem, in verbo Sancti, <l eID="gen26978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26979"/>gaudentes in honorem Dei.  <chapter eID="Bar.4"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:1
verses.text: Exue te, Jerusalem, stola luctus et vexationis tuæ, <l eID="gen26980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26981"/>et indue te decore, et honore ejus, <l eID="gen26981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26982"/>quæ a Deo tibi est, sempiternæ gloriæ. <l eID="gen26982" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9916"/><l level="1" sID="gen26983"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9916"/>Circumdabit te Deus diploide justitiæ, <l eID="gen26983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26984"/>et imponet mitram capiti honoris æterni. <l eID="gen26984" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9917"/><l level="1" sID="gen26985"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9917"/>Deus enim ostendet splendorem suum in te, <l eID="gen26985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26986"/>omni qui sub cælo est. <l eID="gen26986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9918"/><l level="1" sID="gen26987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9918"/>Nominabitur enim tibi nomen tuum a Deo in sempiternum : <l eID="gen26987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26988"/>pax justitiæ, et honor pietatis. <l eID="gen26988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9919"/><l level="1" sID="gen26989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9919"/>Exsurge, Jerusalem, et sta in excelso : <l eID="gen26989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26990"/>et circumspice ad orientem, <l eID="gen26990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26991"/>et vide collectos filios tuos ab oriente sole usque ad occidentem, <l eID="gen26991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26992"/>in verbo Sancti, <l eID="gen26992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26993"/>gaudentes Dei memoria. <l eID="gen26993" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9920"/><l level="1" sID="gen26994"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9920"/>Exierunt enim abs te pedibus ducti ab inimicis : <l eID="gen26994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26995"/>adducet autem illos Dominus ad te portatos in honore <l eID="gen26995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26996"/>sicut filios regni : <l eID="gen26996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9921"/><l level="1" sID="gen26997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9921"/>constituit enim Deus <l eID="gen26997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26998"/>humiliare omnem montem excelsum et rupes perennes, <l eID="gen26998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen26999"/>et convalles replere in æqualitatem terræ, <l eID="gen26999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27000"/>ut ambulet Israël diligenter in honorem Dei. <l eID="gen27000" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9922"/><l level="1" sID="gen27001"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9922"/>Obumbraverunt autem et silvæ, <l eID="gen27001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27002"/>et omne lignum suavitatis Israël <l eID="gen27002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27003"/>ex mandato Dei. <l eID="gen27003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Baruch 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9923"/><l level="1" sID="gen27004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9923"/>Adducet enim Deus Israël cum jucunditate in lumine majestatis suæ, <l eID="gen27004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27005"/>cum misericordia et justitia quæ est ex ipso. <l eID="gen27005" level="1"/><lg eID="gen26656"/> <chapter eID="Bar.5"/>

verses.name: Baruch 6:1
verses.text: Propter peccata quæ peccastis ante Deum, abducemini in Babyloniam captivi a Nabuchodonosor rege Babylonis.

verses.name: Baruch 6:2
verses.text: Ingressi itaque in Babylonem, eritis ibi annis plurimis, et temporibus longis, usque ad generationes septem : post hoc autem educam vos inde cum pace.

verses.name: Baruch 6:3
verses.text: Nunc autem videbitis in Babylonia deos aureos et argenteos, et lapideos et ligneos, in humeris portari, ostentantes metum gentibus.

verses.name: Baruch 6:4
verses.text: Videte ergo ne et vos similes efficiamini factis alienis, et metuatis, et metus vos capiat in ipsis.

verses.name: Baruch 6:5
verses.text: Visa itaque turba de retro et ab ante, adorantes dicite in cordibus vestris : Te oportet adorari, Domine.

verses.name: Baruch 6:6
verses.text: Angelus enim meus vobiscum est : ipse autem exquiram animas vestras.

verses.name: Baruch 6:7
verses.text: Nam lingua ipsorum polita a fabro ; ipsa etiam inaurata et inargentata : falsa sunt, et non possunt loqui.

verses.name: Baruch 6:8
verses.text: Et sicut virgini amanti ornamenta, ita accepto auro fabricati sunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:9
verses.text: Coronas certe aureas habent super capita sua dii illorum : unde subtrahunt sacerdotes ab eis aurum et argentum, et erogant illud in semetipsos.

verses.name: Baruch 6:10
verses.text: Dant autem et ex ipso prostitutis, et meretrices ornant : et iterum cum receperint illud a meretricibus, ornant deos suos.

verses.name: Baruch 6:11
verses.text: Hi autem non liberantur ab ærugine et tinea.

verses.name: Baruch 6:12
verses.text: Opertis autem illis veste purpurea, extergunt faciem ipsorum propter pulverem domus qui est plurimus inter eos.

verses.name: Baruch 6:13
verses.text: Sceptrum autem habet ut homo, sicut judex regionis, qui in se peccantem non interficit.

verses.name: Baruch 6:14
verses.text: Habet etiam in manu gladium et securim, se autem de bello et a latronibus non liberat. Unde vobis notum sit quia non sunt dii :

verses.name: Baruch 6:15
verses.text: non ergo timueritis eos. Sicut enim vas hominis confractum inutile efficitur, tales sunt et dii illorum.

verses.name: Baruch 6:16
verses.text: Constitutis illis in domo, oculi eorum pleni sunt pulvere a pedibus introëuntium.

verses.name: Baruch 6:17
verses.text: Et sicut alicui qui regem offendit circumseptæ sunt januæ, aut sicut ad sepulchrum adductum mortuum : ita tutantur sacerdotes ostia clausuris et seris, ne a latronibus expolientur.

verses.name: Baruch 6:18
verses.text: Lucernas accendunt illis, et quidem multas, ex quibus nullam videre possunt : sunt autem sicut trabes in domo.

verses.name: Baruch 6:19
verses.text: Corda vero eorum dicunt elingere serpentes qui de terra sunt, dum comedunt eos, et vestimentum ipsorum, et non sentiunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:20
verses.text: Nigræ fiunt facies eorum a fumo qui in domo fit.

verses.name: Baruch 6:21
verses.text: Supra corpus eorum et supra caput eorum volant noctuæ, et hirundines, et aves etiam, similiter et cattæ.

verses.name: Baruch 6:22
verses.text: Unde sciatis quia non sunt dii : ne ergo timueritis eos.  <div eID="gen27006" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Baruch 6:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9924"/><div sID="gen27007" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9924"/>Aurum etiam quod habent ad speciem est : nisi aliquis exterserit æruginem, non fulgebunt : neque enim dum conflarentur, sentiebant.

verses.name: Baruch 6:24
verses.text: Ex omni pretio empta sunt, in quibus spiritus non inest ipsis.

verses.name: Baruch 6:25
verses.text: Sine pedibus, in humeris portantur, ostentantes ignobilitatem suam hominibus : confundantur etiam qui colunt ea.

verses.name: Baruch 6:26
verses.text: Propterea si ceciderint in terram, a semetipsis non consurgunt : neque si quis eum statuerit rectum, per semetipsum stabit : sed sicut mortuis munera eorum illis apponentur.

verses.name: Baruch 6:27
verses.text: Hostias illorum vendunt sacerdotes ipsorum, et abutuntur : similiter et mulieres eorum decerpentes, neque infirmo, neque mendicanti, aliquid impertiunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:28
verses.text: De sacrificiis eorum fœtæ et menstruatæ contingunt. Sciens itaque ex his quia non sunt dii, ne timeatis eos.

verses.name: Baruch 6:29
verses.text: Unde enim vocantur dii ? quia mulieres apponunt diis argenteis, et aureis, et ligneis :

verses.name: Baruch 6:30
verses.text: et in domibus eorum sacerdotes sedent habentes tunicas scissas, et capita et barbam rasam, quorum capita nuda sunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:31
verses.text: Rugiunt autem clamantes contra deos suos sicut in cœna mortui.

verses.name: Baruch 6:32
verses.text: Vestimenta eorum auferunt sacerdotes, et vestiunt uxores suas et filios suos.

verses.name: Baruch 6:33
verses.text: Neque si quid mali patiuntur ab aliquo, neque si quid boni, poterunt retribuere : neque regem constituere possunt, neque auferre.

verses.name: Baruch 6:34
verses.text: Similiter neque dare divitias possunt, neque malum retribuere. Si quis illis votum voverit et non reddiderit, neque hoc requirunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:35
verses.text: Hominem a morte non liberant, neque infirmum a potentiori eripiunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:36
verses.text: Hominem cæcum ad visum non restituunt ; de necessitate hominem non liberabunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:37
verses.text: Viduæ non miserebuntur, neque orphanis benefacient.

verses.name: Baruch 6:38
verses.text: Lapidibus de monte similes sunt dii illorum, lignei, et lapidei, et aurei, et argentei : qui autem colunt ea, confundentur.

verses.name: Baruch 6:39
verses.text: Quomodo ergo æstimandum est aut dicendum illos esse deos ?

verses.name: Baruch 6:40
verses.text: Adhuc enim ipsis Chaldæis non honorantibus ea : qui cum audierint mutum non posse loqui, offerunt illud ad Bel, postulantes ab eo loqui :

verses.name: Baruch 6:41
verses.text: quasi possint sentire qui non habent motum ! Et ipsi, cum intellexerint, relinquent ea : sensum enim non habent ipsi dii illorum.

verses.name: Baruch 6:42
verses.text: Mulieres autem circumdatæ funibus in viis sedent, succendentes ossa olivarum :

verses.name: Baruch 6:43
verses.text: cum autem aliqua ex ipsis, attracta ab aliquo transeunte, dormierit cum eo, proximæ suæ exprobrat quod ea non sit digna habita, sicut ipsa, neque funis ejus diruptus sit.

verses.name: Baruch 6:44
verses.text: Omnia autem quæ illi fiunt, falsa sunt : quomodo æstimandum aut dicendum est illos esse deos ?  <div eID="gen27007" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Baruch 6:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9925"/><div sID="gen27008" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9925"/>A fabris autem et ab aurificibus facta sunt : nihil aliud erunt, nisi id quod volunt esse sacerdotes.

verses.name: Baruch 6:46
verses.text: Artifices etiam ipsi, qui ea faciunt, non sunt multi temporis : numquid ergo possunt ea, quæ fabricata sunt ab ipsis, esse dii ?

verses.name: Baruch 6:47
verses.text: Reliquerunt autem falsa et opprobrium postea futuris.

verses.name: Baruch 6:48
verses.text: Nam cum supervenerit illis prælium et mala, cogitant sacerdotes apud se ubi se abscondant cum illis.

verses.name: Baruch 6:49
verses.text: Quomodo ergo sentiri debeant quoniam dii sunt, qui nec de bello se liberant, neque de malis se eripiunt ?

verses.name: Baruch 6:50
verses.text: Nam cum sint lignea, inaurata et inargentata, scietur postea quia falsa sunt ab universis gentibus et regibus : quæ manifesta sunt quia non sunt dii, sed opera manuum hominum, et nullum Dei opus cum illis.

verses.name: Baruch 6:51
verses.text: Unde ergo notum est quia non sunt dii, sed opera manuum hominum, et nullum Dei opus in ipsis est.

verses.name: Baruch 6:52
verses.text: Regem regioni non suscitant, neque pluviam hominibus dabunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:53
verses.text: Judicium quoque non discernent, neque regiones liberabunt ab injuria, quia nihil possunt, sicut corniculæ inter medium cæli et terræ.

verses.name: Baruch 6:54
verses.text: Etenim cum inciderit ignis in domum deorum ligneorum, argenteorum et aureorum, sacerdotes quidem ipsorum fugient, et liberabuntur : ipsi vero sicut trabes in medio comburentur.

verses.name: Baruch 6:55
verses.text: Regi autem et bello non resistent. Quomodo ergo æstimandum est aut recipiendum quia dii sunt ?

verses.name: Baruch 6:56
verses.text: Non a furibus, neque a latronibus se liberabunt dii lignei, et lapidei, et inaurati, et inargentati : quibus hi qui fortiores sunt,

verses.name: Baruch 6:57
verses.text: aurum et argentum, et vestimentum quo operti sunt, auferent illis, et abibunt, nec sibi auxilium ferent.  <div eID="gen27008" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Baruch 6:58
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9926"/><div sID="gen27009" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9926"/>Itaque melius est esse regem ostentantem virtutem suam, aut vas in domo utile, in quo gloriabitur qui possidet illud, vel ostium in domo, quod custodit quæ in ipsa sunt, quam falsi dii.

verses.name: Baruch 6:59
verses.text: Sol quidem et luna ac sidera, cum sint splendida et emissa ad utilitates, obaudiunt :

verses.name: Baruch 6:60
verses.text: similiter et fulgur cum apparuerit, perspicuum est : idipsum autem et spiritus in omni regione spirat :

verses.name: Baruch 6:61
verses.text: et nubes, quibus cum imperatum fuerit a Deo perambulare universum orbem, perficiunt quod imperatum est eis :

verses.name: Baruch 6:62
verses.text: ignis etiam missus desuper, ut consumat montes et silvas, facit quod præceptum est ei : hæc autem neque speciebus, neque virtutibus, uni eorum similia sunt.

verses.name: Baruch 6:63
verses.text: Unde neque existimandum est, neque dicendum illos esse deos, quando non possunt neque judicium judicare, neque quidquam facere hominibus.

verses.name: Baruch 6:64
verses.text: Scientes itaque quia non sunt dii, ne ergo timueritis eos.

verses.name: Baruch 6:65
verses.text: Neque enim regibus maledicent, neque benedicent.

verses.name: Baruch 6:66
verses.text: Signa etiam in cælo gentibus non ostendunt : neque ut sol lucebunt, neque illuminabunt ut luna.

verses.name: Baruch 6:67
verses.text: Bestiæ meliores sunt illis, quæ possunt fugere sub tectum ac prodesse sibi.

verses.name: Baruch 6:68
verses.text: Nullo itaque modo nobis est manifestum quia sunt dii : propter quod ne timeatis eos.  <div eID="gen27009" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Baruch 6:69
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9927"/><div sID="gen27010" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9927"/>Nam sicut in cucumerario formido nihil custodit, ita sunt dii illorum lignei, et argentei, et inaurati.

verses.name: Baruch 6:70
verses.text: Eodem modo et in horto spina alba, supra quam omnis avis sedet, similiter et mortuo projecto in tenebris, similes sunt dii illorum lignei, et inaurati, et inargentati.

verses.name: Baruch 6:71
verses.text: A purpura quoque et murice, quæ supra illos tineant, scietis itaque quia non sunt dii : ipsi etiam postremo comeduntur, et erunt opprobrium in regione.

verses.name: Baruch 6:72
verses.text: Melior est homo justus qui non habet simulacra, nam erit longe ab opprobriis.  <div eID="gen27010" type="x-p"/> <chapter eID="Bar.6"/> <div eID="gen26654" osisID="Bar" type="book"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:1
verses.text: Et factum est in trigesimo anno, in quarto, in quinta mensis, cum essem in medio captivorum juxta fluvium Chobar, aperti sunt cæli, et vidi visiones Dei.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:2
verses.text: In quinta mensis, ipse est annus quintus transmigrationis regis Joachin,

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:3
verses.text: factum est verbum Domini ad Ezechielem filium Buzi sacerdotem, in terra Chaldæorum, secus flumen Chobar : et facta est super eum ibi manus Domini.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:4
verses.text: Et vidi, et ecce ventus turbinis veniebat ab aquilone, et nubes magna, et ignis involvens, et splendor in circuitu ejus : et de medio ejus, quasi species electri, id est, de medio ignis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:5
verses.text: et in medio ejus similitudo quatuor animalium. Et hic aspectus eorum, similitudo hominis in eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:6
verses.text: Quatuor facies uni, et quatuor pennæ uni.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:7
verses.text: Pedes eorum, pedes recti, et planta pedis eorum quasi planta pedis vituli : et scintillæ quasi aspectus æris candentis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:8
verses.text: Et manus hominis sub pennis eorum, in quatuor partibus : et facies et pennas per quatuor partes habebant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:9
verses.text: Junctæque erant pennæ eorum alterius ad alterum : non revertebantur cum incederent, sed unumquodque ante faciem suam gradiebatur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:10
verses.text: Similitudo autem vultus eorum, facies hominis et facies leonis a dextris ipsorum quatuor, facies autem bovis a sinistris ipsorum quatuor, et facies aquilæ desuper ipsorum quatuor.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:11
verses.text: Facies eorum et pennæ eorum extentæ desuper : duæ pennæ singulorum jungebantur, et duæ tegebant corpora eorum.  <div eID="gen27012" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9928"/><div sID="gen27013" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9928"/>Et unumquodque eorum coram facie sua ambulabat : ubi erat impetus spiritus, illuc gradiebantur, nec revertebantur cum ambularent.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:13
verses.text: Et similitudo animalium, aspectus eorum quasi carbonum ignis ardentium, et quasi aspectus lampadarum : hæc erat visio discurrens in medio animalium, splendor ignis, et de igne fulgur egrediens.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:14
verses.text: Et animalia ibant et revertebantur, in similitudinem fulguris coruscantis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:15
verses.text: Cumque aspicerem animalia, apparuit rota una super terram juxta animalia, habens quatuor facies.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:16
verses.text: Et aspectus rotarum et opus earum quasi visio maris : et una similitudo ipsarum quatuor : et aspectus earum et opera quasi sit rota in medio rotæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:17
verses.text: Per quatuor partes earum euntes ibant, et non revertebantur cum ambularent.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:18
verses.text: Statura quoque erat rotis, et altitudo, et horribilis aspectus : et totum corpus oculis plenum in circuitu ipsarum quatuor.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:19
verses.text: Cumque ambularent animalia, ambulabant pariter et rotæ juxta ea : et cum elevarentur animalia de terra, elevabantur simul et rotæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:20
verses.text: Quocumque ibat spiritus, illuc, eunte spiritu, et rotæ pariter elevabantur sequentes eum : spiritus enim vitæ erat in rotis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:21
verses.text: Cum euntibus ibant, et cum stantibus stabant : et cum elevatis a terra, pariter elevabantur et rotæ sequentes ea, quia spiritus vitæ erat in rotis.  <div eID="gen27013" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9929"/><div sID="gen27014" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9929"/>Et similitudo super capita animalium firmamenti, quasi aspectus crystalli horribilis, et extenti super capita eorum desuper.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:23
verses.text: Sub firmamento autem pennæ eorum rectæ alterius ad alterum : unumquodque duabus alis velabat corpus suum, et alterum similiter velabatur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:24
verses.text: Et audiebam sonum alarum, quasi sonum aquarum multarum, quasi sonum sublimis Dei : cum ambularent, quasi sonus erat multitudinis ut sonus castrorum : cumque starent, demittebantur pennæ eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:25
verses.text: Nam cum fieret vox super firmamentum quod erat super caput eorum, stabant, et submittebant alas suas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:26
verses.text: Et super firmamentum quod erat imminens capiti eorum, quasi aspectus lapidis sapphiri similitudo throni : et super similitudinem throni similitudo quasi aspectus hominis desuper.

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:27
verses.text: Et vidi quasi speciem electri, velut aspectum ignis, intrinsecus ejus per circuitum : a lumbis ejus et desuper, et a lumbis ejus usque deorsum, vidi quasi speciem ignis splendentis in circuitu,

verses.name: Ezekiel 1:28
verses.text: velut aspectum arcus cum fuerit in nube in die pluviæ. Hic erat aspectus splendoris per gyrum.  <chapter eID="Ezek.1"/> <div eID="gen27014" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:1
verses.text: Hæc visio similitudinis gloriæ Domini. Et vidi, et cecidi in faciem meam, et audivi vocem loquentis, et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, sta super pedes tuos, et loquar tecum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:2
verses.text: Et ingressus est in me spiritus postquam locutus est mihi, et statuit me supra pedes meos : et audivi loquentem ad me,

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:3
verses.text: et dicentem : Fili hominis, mitto ego te ad filios Israël, ad gentes apostatrices quæ recesserunt a me : ipsi et patres eorum prævaricati sunt pactum meum usque ad diem hanc :

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:4
verses.text: et filii dura facie et indomabili corde sunt, ad quos ego mitto te. Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus :

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:5
verses.text: si forte vel ipsi audiant, et si forte quiescant, quoniam domus exasperans est : et scient quia propheta fuerit in medio eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:6
verses.text: Tu ergo, fili hominis, ne timeas eos, neque sermones eorum metuas, quoniam increduli et subversores sunt tecum, et cum scorpionibus habitas. Verba eorum ne timeas, et vultus eorum ne formides, quia domus exasperans est.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:7
verses.text: Loqueris ergo verba mea ad eos, si forte audiant, et quiescant : quoniam irritatores sunt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:8
verses.text: Tu autem, fili hominis, audi quæcumque loquor ad te, et noli esse exasperans, sicut domus exasperatrix est : aperi os tuum, et comede quæcumque ego do tibi.

verses.name: Ezekiel 2:9
verses.text: Et vidi : et ecce manus missa ad me, in qua erat involutus liber : et expandit illum coram me, qui erat scriptus intus et foris : et scriptæ erant in eo lamentationes, et carmen, et væ.  <chapter eID="Ezek.2"/> <div eID="gen27015" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:1
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, quodcumque inveneris, comede : comede volumen istud, et vadens loquere ad filios Israël.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:2
verses.text: Et aperui os meum, et cibavit me volumine illo :

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:3
verses.text: et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, venter tuus comedet, et viscera tua complebuntur volumine isto quod ego do tibi. Et comedi illud, et factum est in ore meo sicut mel dulce.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:4
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, vade ad domum Israël, et loqueris verba mea ad eos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:5
verses.text: Non enim ad populum profundi sermonis et ignotæ linguæ tu mitteris ad domum Israël :

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:6
verses.text: neque ad populos multos profundi sermonis et ignotæ linguæ, quorum non possis audire sermones : et si ad illos mittereris, ipsi audirent te :

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:7
verses.text: domus autem Israël nolunt audire te, quia nolunt audire me : omnis quippe domus Israël attrita fronte est, et duro corde.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:8
verses.text: Ecce dedi faciem tuam valentiorem faciebus eorum, et frontem tuam duriorem frontibus eorum :

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:9
verses.text: ut adamantem et ut silicem dedi faciem tuam : ne timeas eos, neque metuas a facie eorum, quia domus exasperans est.  <div eID="gen27016" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9930"/><div sID="gen27017" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9930"/>Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, omnes sermones meos quos ego loquor ad te, assume in corde tuo, et auribus tuis audi :

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:11
verses.text: et vade, ingredere ad transmigrationem, ad filios populi tui, et loqueris ad eos : et dices eis : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : si forte audiant et quiescant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:12
verses.text: Et assumpsit me spiritus, et audivi post me vocem commotionis magnæ : Benedicta gloria Domini de loco suo :

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:13
verses.text: et vocem alarum animalium percutientium alteram ad alteram, et vocem rotarum sequentium animalia, et vocem commotionis magnæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:14
verses.text: Spiritus quoque levavit me, et assumpsit me : et abii amarus in indignatione spiritus mei : manus enim Domini erat mecum, confortans me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:15
verses.text: Et veni ad transmigrationem, ad acervum novarum frugum, ad eos qui habitabant juxta flumen Chobar : et sedi ubi illi sedebant, et mansi ibi septem diebus mœrens in medio eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:16
verses.text: Cum autem pertransissent septem dies, factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:17
verses.text: Fili hominis, speculatorem dedi te domui Israël, et audies de ore meo verbum, et annuntiabis eis ex me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:18
verses.text: Si, dicente me ad impium : Morte morieris, non annuntiaveris ei, neque locutus fueris ut avertatur a via sua impia et vivat, ipse impius in iniquitate sua morietur, sanguinem autem ejus de manu tua requiram.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:19
verses.text: Si autem tu annuntiaveris impio, et ille non fuerit conversus ab impietate sua et a via sua impia, ipse quidem in iniquitate sua morietur : tu autem animam tuam liberasti.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:20
verses.text: Sed et si conversus justus a justitia sua fuerit, et fecerit iniquitatem, ponam offendiculum coram eo : ipse morietur quia non annuntiasti ei. In peccato suo morietur, et non erunt in memoria justitiæ ejus quas fecit : sanguinem vero ejus de manu tua requiram.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:21
verses.text: Si autem tu annuntiaveris justo ut non peccet justus, et ille non peccaverit, vivens vivet, quia annuntiasti ei, et tu animam tuam liberasti.  <div eID="gen27017" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9931"/><div sID="gen27018" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9931"/>Et facta est super me manus Domini, et dixit ad me : Surgens egredere in campum, et ibi loquar tecum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:23
verses.text: Et surgens egressus sum in campum : et ecce ibi gloria Domini stabat, quasi gloria quam vidi juxta fluvium Chobar : et cecidi in faciem meam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:24
verses.text: Et ingressus est in me spiritus, et statuit me super pedes meos, et locutus est mihi, et dixit ad me : Ingredere, et includere in medio domus tuæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:25
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, ecce data sunt super te vincula, et ligabunt te in eis, et non egredieris de medio eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:26
verses.text: Et linguam tuam adhærere faciam palato tuo, et eris mutus, nec quasi vir objurgans, quia domus exasperans est.

verses.name: Ezekiel 3:27
verses.text: Cum autem locutus fuero tibi, aperiam os tuum, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Qui audit, audiat, et qui quiescit, quiescat : quia domus exasperans est.  <chapter eID="Ezek.3"/> <div eID="gen27018" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:1
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, sume tibi laterem, et pones eum coram te, et describes in eo civitatem Jerusalem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:2
verses.text: Et ordinabis adversus eam obsidionem, et ædificabis munitiones, et comportabis aggerem, et dabis contra eam castra, et pones arietes in gyro.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:3
verses.text: Et tu sume tibi sartaginem ferream, et pones eam in murum ferreum inter te et inter civitatem : et obfirmabis faciem tuam ad eam, et erit in obsidionem, et circumdabis eam : signum est domui Israël.  <div eID="gen27019" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9932"/><div sID="gen27020" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9932"/>Et tu dormies super latus tuum sinistrum, et pones iniquitates domus Israël super eo, numero dierum quibus dormies super illud : et assumes iniquitatem eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:5
verses.text: Ego autem dedi tibi annos iniquitatis eorum, numero dierum trecentos et nonaginta dies : et portabis iniquitatem domus Israël.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:6
verses.text: Et cum compleveris hæc, dormies super latus tuum dexterum secundo, et assumes iniquitatem domus Juda quadraginta diebus : diem pro anno, diem, inquam, pro anno, dedi tibi.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:7
verses.text: Et ad obsidionem Jerusalem convertes faciem tuam, et brachium tuum erit extentum : et prophetabis adversus eam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:8
verses.text: Ecce circumdedi te vinculis : et non te convertes a latere tuo in latus aliud, donec compleas dies obsidionis tuæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:9
verses.text: Et tu, sume tibi frumentum, et hordeum, et fabam, et lentem, et milium, et viciam : et mittes ea in vas unum, et facies tibi panes numero dierum quibus dormies super latus tuum : trecentis et nonaginta diebus comedes illud.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:10
verses.text: Cibus autem tuus, quo vesceris, erit in pondere viginti stateres in die : a tempore usque ad tempus comedes illud.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:11
verses.text: Et aquam in mensura bibes, sextam partem hin : a tempore usque ad tempus bibes illud.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:12
verses.text: Et quasi subcinericium hordeaceum comedes illud, et stercore quod egreditur de homine operies illud in oculis eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:13
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus : Sic comedent filii Israël panem suum pollutum inter gentes ad quas ejiciam eos. Et dixi :

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:14
verses.text: A, a, a, Domine Deus, ecce anima mea non est polluta : et morticinum, et laceratum a bestiis non comedi ab infantia mea usque nunc, et non est ingressa in os meum omnis caro immunda.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:15
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Ecce dedi tibi fimum boum pro stercoribus humanis, et facies panem tuum in eo.

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:16
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, ecce ego conteram baculum panis in Jerusalem, et comedent panem in pondere et in sollicitudine, et aquam in mensura et in angustia bibent,

verses.name: Ezekiel 4:17
verses.text: ut deficientibus pane et aqua, corruat unusquisque ad fratrem suum, et contabescant in iniquitatibus suis.  <chapter eID="Ezek.4"/> <div eID="gen27020" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:1
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, sume tibi gladium acutum, radentem pilos, et assumes eum et duces per caput tuum et per barbam tuam, et assumes tibi stateram ponderis et divides eos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:2
verses.text: Tertiam partem igni combures in medio civitatis, juxta completionem dierum obsidionis, et assumes tertiam partem, et concides gladio in circuitu ejus : tertiam vero aliam disperges in ventum, et gladium nudabo post eos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:3
verses.text: Et sumes inde parvum numerum, et ligabis eos in summitate pallii tui :

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:4
verses.text: et ex eis rursum tolles, et projicies eos in medio ignis, et combures eos igni, et ex eo egredietur ignis in omnem domum Israël.  <div eID="gen27021" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9933"/><div sID="gen27022" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9933"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ista est Jerusalem : in medio gentium posui eam, et in circuitu ejus terras.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:6
verses.text: Et contempsit judicia mea, ut plus esset impia quam gentes, et præcepta mea ultra quam terræ quæ in circuitu ejus sunt : judicia enim mea projecerunt, et in præceptis meis non ambulaverunt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:7
verses.text: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quia superastis gentes quæ in circuitu vestro sunt, et in præceptis meis non ambulastis, et judicia mea non fecistis, et juxta judicia gentium quæ in circuitu vestro sunt non estis operati,

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:8
verses.text: ideo hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego ad te, et ipse ego faciam in medio tui judicia in oculis gentium :

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:9
verses.text: et faciam in te quod non feci, et quibus similia ultra non faciam, propter omnes abominationes tuas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:10
verses.text: Ideo patres comedent filios in medio tui, et filii comedent patres suos : et faciam in te judicia, et ventilabo universas reliquias tuas in omnem ventum.  <div eID="gen27022" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9934"/><div sID="gen27023" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9934"/>Idcirco vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, nisi pro eo quod sanctum meum violasti in omnibus offensionibus tuis et in cunctis abominationibus tuis, ego quoque confringam : et non parcet oculus meus, et non miserebor.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:12
verses.text: Tertia pars tui peste morietur, et fame consumetur in medio tui, et tertia pars tui in gladio cadet in circuitu tuo : tertiam vero partem tuam in omnem ventum dispergam, et gladium evaginabo post eos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:13
verses.text: Et complebo furorem meum, et requiescere faciam indignationem meam in eis, et consolabor : et scient quia ego Dominus locutus sum in zelo meo, cum implevero indignationem meam in eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:14
verses.text: Et dabo te in desertum, et in opprobrium gentibus quæ in circuitu tuo sunt, in conspectu omnis prætereuntis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:15
verses.text: et eris opprobrium et blasphemia, exemplum et stupor in gentibus quæ in circuitu tuo sunt, cum fecero in te judicia in furore, et in indignatione, et in increpationibus iræ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:16
verses.text: Ego Dominus locutus sum : quando misero sagittas famis pessimas in eos, quæ erunt mortiferæ, et quas mittam ut disperdam vos : et famem congregabo super vos, et conteram in vobis baculum panis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 5:17
verses.text: et immittam in vos famem et bestias pessimas, usque ad internecionem : et pestilentia et sanguis transibunt per te, et gladium inducam super te. Ego Dominus locutus sum.  <chapter eID="Ezek.5"/> <div eID="gen27023" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam ad montes Israël, et prophetabis ad eos,

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:3
verses.text: et dices : <div eID="gen27024" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27025"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27026"/>Montes Israël, <l eID="gen27026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27027"/>audite verbum Domini Dei. <l eID="gen27027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27028"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus <l eID="gen27028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27029"/>montibus et collibus, <l eID="gen27029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27030"/>rupibus et vallibus : <l eID="gen27030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27031"/>Ecce ego inducam super vos gladium, <l eID="gen27031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27032"/>et disperdam excelsa vestra, <l eID="gen27032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9935"/><l level="1" sID="gen27033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9935"/>et demoliar aras vestras, <l eID="gen27033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27034"/>et confringentur simulacra vestra, <l eID="gen27034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27035"/>et dejiciam interfectos vestros <l eID="gen27035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27036"/>ante idola vestra : <l eID="gen27036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9936"/><l level="1" sID="gen27037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9936"/>et dabo cadavera filiorum Israël <l eID="gen27037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27038"/>ante faciem simulacrorum vestrorum, <l eID="gen27038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27039"/>et dispergam ossa vestra <l eID="gen27039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27040"/>circum aras vestras : <l eID="gen27040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9937"/><l level="1" sID="gen27041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9937"/>in omnibus habitationibus vestris <l eID="gen27041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27042"/>urbes desertæ erunt, <l eID="gen27042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27043"/>et excelsa demolientur et dissipabuntur : <l eID="gen27043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27044"/>et interibunt aræ vestræ, et confringentur, <l eID="gen27044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27045"/>et cessabunt idola vestra, <l eID="gen27045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27046"/>et conterentur delubra vestra, <l eID="gen27046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27047"/>et delebuntur opera vestra : <l eID="gen27047" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9938"/><l level="1" sID="gen27048"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9938"/>et cadet interfectus in medio vestri, <l eID="gen27048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27049"/>et scietis quia ego sum Dominus. <l eID="gen27049" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9939"/><l level="1" sID="gen27050"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9939"/>Et relinquam in vobis eos <l eID="gen27050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27051"/>qui fugerint gladium in gentibus, <l eID="gen27051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27052"/>cum dispersero vos in terris : <l eID="gen27052" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9940"/><l level="1" sID="gen27053"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9940"/>et recordabuntur mei liberati vestri in gentibus <l eID="gen27053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27054"/>ad quas captivi ducti sunt : <l eID="gen27054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27055"/>quia contrivi cor eorum <l eID="gen27055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27056"/>fornicans et recedens a me, <l eID="gen27056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27057"/>et oculos eorum fornicantes post idola sua : <l eID="gen27057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27058"/>et displicebunt sibimet super malis <l eID="gen27058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27059"/>quæ fecerunt in universis abominationibus suis. <l eID="gen27059" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9941"/><l level="1" sID="gen27060"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9941"/>Et scient quia ego Dominus non frustra locutus sum, <l eID="gen27060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27061"/>ut facerem eis malum hoc. <l eID="gen27061" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9942"/><l level="1" sID="gen27062"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9942"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27063"/>Percute manum tuam <l eID="gen27063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27064"/>et allide pedem tuum, <l eID="gen27064" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27065"/>et dic : Heu ! ad omnes abominationes malorum domus Israël : <l eID="gen27065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27066"/>quia gladio, fame et peste ruituri sunt. <l eID="gen27066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9943"/><l level="1" sID="gen27067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9943"/>Qui longe est, peste morietur : <l eID="gen27067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27068"/>qui autem prope, gladio corruet : <l eID="gen27068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27069"/>et qui relictus fuerit et obsessus, fame morietur : <l eID="gen27069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27070"/>et complebo indignationem meam in eis. <l eID="gen27070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9944"/><l level="1" sID="gen27071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9944"/>Et scietis quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen27071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27072"/>cum fuerint interfecti vestri in medio idolorum vestrorum, <l eID="gen27072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27073"/>in circuitu ararum vestrarum, <l eID="gen27073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27074"/>in omni colle excelso, <l eID="gen27074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27075"/>et in cunctis summitatibus montium, <l eID="gen27075" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27076"/>et subtus omne lignum nemorosum, <l eID="gen27076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27077"/>et subtus universam quercum frondosam, <l eID="gen27077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27078"/>locum ubi accenderunt thura redolentia universis idolis suis. <l eID="gen27078" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9945"/><l level="1" sID="gen27079"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9945"/>Et extendam manum meam super eos : <l eID="gen27079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27080"/>et faciam terram desolatam et destitutam, <l eID="gen27080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27081"/>a deserto Deblatha, in omnibus habitationibus eorum : <l eID="gen27081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27082"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27082" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27025"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.6"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:2
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, hæc dicit Dominus Deus terræ Israël : <div eID="gen27083" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27084"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27085"/>Finis venit : venit finis super quatuor plagas terræ. <l eID="gen27085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9946"/><l level="1" sID="gen27086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9946"/>Nunc finis super te, et immittam furorem meum in te : <l eID="gen27086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27087"/>et judicabo te juxta vias tuas, <l eID="gen27087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27088"/>et ponam contra te omnes abominationes tuas. <l eID="gen27088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9947"/><l level="1" sID="gen27089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9947"/>Et non parcet oculus meus super te, et non miserebor : <l eID="gen27089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27090"/>sed vias tuas ponam super te, et abominationes tuæ in medio tui erunt, <l eID="gen27090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27091"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9948"/><l level="1" sID="gen27092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9948"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27093"/>Afflictio una, afflictio ecce venit. <l eID="gen27093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9949"/><l level="1" sID="gen27094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9949"/>Finis venit, venit finis : <l eID="gen27094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27095"/>evigilavit adversum te, ecce venit. <l eID="gen27095" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9950"/><l level="1" sID="gen27096"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9950"/>Venit contritio super te, qui habitas in terra : <l eID="gen27096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27097"/>venit tempus, prope est dies occisionis, <l eID="gen27097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27098"/>et non gloriæ montium. <l eID="gen27098" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9951"/><l level="1" sID="gen27099"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9951"/>Nunc de propinquo effundam iram meam super te, <l eID="gen27099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27100"/>et complebo furorem meum in te : <l eID="gen27100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27101"/>et judicabo te juxta vias tuas, <l eID="gen27101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27102"/>et imponam tibi omnia scelera tua, <l eID="gen27102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9952"/><l level="1" sID="gen27103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9952"/>et non parcet oculus meus, <l eID="gen27103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27104"/>nec miserebor : <l eID="gen27104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27105"/>sed vias tuas imponam tibi, <l eID="gen27105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27106"/>et abominationes tuæ in medio tui erunt, <l eID="gen27106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27107"/>et scietis quia ego sum Dominus percutiens. <l eID="gen27107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9953"/><l level="1" sID="gen27108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9953"/>Ecce dies, ecce venit : <l eID="gen27108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27109"/>egressa est contritio, <l eID="gen27109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27110"/>floruit virga, germinavit superbia, <l eID="gen27110" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9954"/><l level="1" sID="gen27111"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9954"/>iniquitas surrexit in virga impietatis : <l eID="gen27111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27112"/>non ex eis, et non ex populo, <l eID="gen27112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27113"/>neque ex sonitu eorum : <l eID="gen27113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27114"/>et non erit requies in eis. <l eID="gen27114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9955"/><l level="1" sID="gen27115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9955"/>Venit tempus, appropinquavit dies : <l eID="gen27115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27116"/>qui emit, non lætetur, <l eID="gen27116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27117"/>et qui vendit, non lugeat : <l eID="gen27117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27118"/>quia ira super omnem populum ejus. <l eID="gen27118" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9956"/><l level="1" sID="gen27119"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9956"/>Quia qui vendit, ad id quod vendidit non revertetur : <l eID="gen27119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27120"/>et adhuc in viventibus vita eorum : <l eID="gen27120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27121"/>visio enim ad omnem multitudinem ejus non regredietur, <l eID="gen27121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27122"/>et vir in iniquitate vitæ suæ non confortabitur. <l eID="gen27122" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9957"/><l level="1" sID="gen27123"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9957"/>Canite tuba, præparentur omnes : <l eID="gen27123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27124"/>et non est qui vadat ad prælium : <l eID="gen27124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27125"/>ira enim mea super universum populum ejus. <l eID="gen27125" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9958"/><l level="1" sID="gen27126"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9958"/>Gladium foris, et pestis et fames intrinsecus : <l eID="gen27126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27127"/>qui in agro est, gladio morietur, <l eID="gen27127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27128"/>et qui in civitate, pestilentia et fame devorabuntur. <l eID="gen27128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9959"/><l level="1" sID="gen27129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9959"/>Et salvabuntur qui fugerint ex eis : <l eID="gen27129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27130"/>et erunt in montibus quasi columbæ convallium omnes trepidi, <l eID="gen27130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27131"/>unusquisque in iniquitate sua. <l eID="gen27131" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9960"/><l level="1" sID="gen27132"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9960"/>Omnes manus dissolventur, <l eID="gen27132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27133"/>et omnia genua fluent aquis. <l eID="gen27133" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9961"/><l level="1" sID="gen27134"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9961"/>Et accingent se ciliciis, <l eID="gen27134" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27135"/>et operiet eos formido : <l eID="gen27135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27136"/>et in omni facie confusio, <l eID="gen27136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27137"/>et in universis capitibus eorum calvitium. <l eID="gen27137" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9962"/><l level="1" sID="gen27138"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9962"/>Argentum eorum foras projicietur, <l eID="gen27138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27139"/>et aurum eorum in sterquilinium erit : <l eID="gen27139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27140"/>argentum eorum et aurum eorum <l eID="gen27140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27141"/>non valebit liberare eos in die furoris Domini : <l eID="gen27141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27142"/>animam suam non saturabunt, <l eID="gen27142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27143"/>et ventres eorum non implebuntur, <l eID="gen27143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27144"/>quia scandalum iniquitatis eorum factum est. <l eID="gen27144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:20
