verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9963"/><l level="1" sID="gen27145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9963"/>Et ornamentum monilium suorum in superbiam posuerunt, <l eID="gen27145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27146"/>et imagines abominationum suarum et simulacrorum fecerunt ex eo : <l eID="gen27146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27147"/>propter hoc dedi eis illud in immunditiam. <l eID="gen27147" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9964"/><l level="1" sID="gen27148"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9964"/>Et dabo illud in manus alienorum ad diripiendum, <l eID="gen27148" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27149"/>et impiis terræ in prædam, <l eID="gen27149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27150"/>et contaminabunt illud. <l eID="gen27150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9965"/><l level="1" sID="gen27151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9965"/>Et avertam faciem meam ab eis, <l eID="gen27151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27152"/>et violabunt arcanum meum : <l eID="gen27152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27153"/>et introibunt in illud emissarii, <l eID="gen27153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27154"/>et contaminabunt illud. <l eID="gen27154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9966"/><l level="1" sID="gen27155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9966"/>Fac conclusionem, <l eID="gen27155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27156"/>quoniam terra plena est judicio sanguinum, <l eID="gen27156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27157"/>et civitas plena iniquitate. <l eID="gen27157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9967"/><l level="1" sID="gen27158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9967"/>Et adducam pessimos de gentibus, <l eID="gen27158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27159"/>et possidebunt domos eorum : <l eID="gen27159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27160"/>et quiescere faciam superbiam potentium, <l eID="gen27160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27161"/>et possidebunt sanctuaria eorum. <l eID="gen27161" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9968"/><l level="1" sID="gen27162"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9968"/>Angustia superveniente, requirent pacem, <l eID="gen27162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27163"/>et non erit. <l eID="gen27163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9969"/><l level="1" sID="gen27164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9969"/>Conturbatio super conturbationem veniet, <l eID="gen27164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27165"/>et auditus super auditum : <l eID="gen27165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27166"/>et quærent visionem de propheta, <l eID="gen27166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27167"/>et lex peribit a sacerdote, <l eID="gen27167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27168"/>et consilium a senioribus. <l eID="gen27168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 7:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9970"/><l level="1" sID="gen27169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9970"/>Rex lugebit, et princeps induetur mœrore, <l eID="gen27169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27170"/>et manus populi terræ conturbabuntur : <l eID="gen27170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27171"/>secundum viam eorum faciam eis, <l eID="gen27171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27172"/>et secundum judicia eorum judicabo eos, <l eID="gen27172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27173"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27173" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27084"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.7"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:1
verses.text: Et factum est in anno sexto, in sexto mense, in quinta mensis, ego sedebam in domo mea, et senes Juda sedebant coram me, et cecidit ibi super me manus Domini Dei.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:2
verses.text: Et vidi : et ecce similitudo quasi aspectus ignis : ab aspectu lumborum ejus et deorsum, ignis : et a lumbis ejus et sursum, quasi aspectus splendoris, ut visio electri.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:3
verses.text: Et emissa similitudo manus apprehendit me in cincinno capitis mei, et elevavit me spiritus inter terram et cælum : et adduxit me in Jerusalem, in visione Dei, juxta ostium interius quod respiciebat ad aquilonem, ubi erat statutum idolum zeli ad provocandam æmulationem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:4
verses.text: Et ecce ibi gloria Dei Israël, secundum visionem quam videram in campo.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:5
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, leva oculos tuos ad viam aquilonis. Et levavi oculos meos ad viam aquilonis, et ecce ab aquilone portæ altaris idolum zeli in ipso introitu.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:6
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, putasne vides tu quid isti faciunt, abominationes magnas quas domus Israël facit hic, ut procul recedam a sanctuario meo ? et adhuc conversus videbis abominationes majores.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:7
verses.text: Et introduxit me ad ostium atrii, et vidi, et ecce foramen unum in pariete.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:8
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, fode parietem. Et cum fodissem parietem, apparuit ostium unum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:9
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Ingredere, et vide abominationes pessimas quas isti faciunt hic.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:10
verses.text: Et ingressus vidi, et ecce omnis similitudo reptilium et animalium, abominatio, et universa idola domus Israël, depicta erant in pariete in circuitu per totum :

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:11
verses.text: et septuaginta viri de senioribus domus Israël : et Jezonias filius Saphan stabat in medio eorum stantium ante picturas : et unusquisque habebat thuribulum in manu sua, et vapor nebulæ de thure consurgebat.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:12
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Certe vides, fili hominis, quæ seniores domus Israël faciunt in tenebris, unusquisque in abscondito cubiculi sui : dicunt enim : Non videt Dominus nos ; dereliquit Dominus terram.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:13
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Adhuc conversus videbis abominationes majores, quas isti faciunt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:14
verses.text: Et introduxit me per ostium portæ domus Domini quod respiciebat ad aquilonem, et ecce ibi mulieres sedebant plangentes Adonidem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:15
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Certe vidisti, fili hominis : adhuc conversus videbis abominationes majores his.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:16
verses.text: Et introduxit me in atrium domus Domini interius, et ecce in ostio templi Domini, inter vestibulum et altare, quasi viginti quinque viri dorsa habentes contra templum Domini, et facies ad orientem : et adorabant ad ortum solis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:17
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Certe vidisti, fili hominis : numquid leve est hoc domui Juda, ut facerent abominationes istas quas fecerunt hic, quia replentes terram iniquitate, conversi sunt ad irritandum me ? et ecce applicant ramum ad nares suas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 8:18
verses.text: Ergo et ego faciam in furore : non parcet oculus meus, nec miserebor : et cum clamaverint ad aures meas voce magna, non exaudiam eos.  <chapter eID="Ezek.8"/> <div eID="gen27174" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:1
verses.text: Et clamavit in auribus meis voce magna, dicens : Appropinquaverunt visitationes urbis, et unusquisque vas interfectionis habet in manu sua.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:2
verses.text: Et ecce sex viri veniebant de via portæ superioris, quæ respicit ad aquilonem, et uniuscujusque vas interitus in manu ejus : vir quoque unus in medio eorum vestitus erat lineis, et atramentarium scriptoris ad renes ejus : et ingressi sunt, et steterunt juxta altare æreum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:3
verses.text: Et gloria Domini Israël assumpta est de cherub, quæ erat super eum ad limen domus : et vocavit virum qui indutus erat lineis, et atramentarium scriptoris habebat in lumbis suis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:4
verses.text: et dixit Dominus ad eum : Transi per mediam civitatem, in medio Jerusalem, et signa thau super frontes virorum gementium et dolentium super cunctis abominationibus quæ fiunt in medio ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:5
verses.text: Et illis dixit, audiente me : Transite per civitatem sequentes eum, et percutite : non parcat oculus vester, neque misereamini :

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:6
verses.text: senem, adolescentulum et virginem, parvulum et mulieres interficite usque ad internecionem : omnem autem super quem videritis thau, ne occidatis : et a sanctuario meo incipite. Cœperunt ergo a viris senioribus, qui erant ante faciem domus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:7
verses.text: Et dixit ad eos : Contaminate domum, et implete atria interfectis ; egredimini. Et egressi sunt, et percutiebant eos qui erant in civitate.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:8
verses.text: Et cæde completa, remansi ego, ruique super faciem meam, et clamans aio : Heu ! heu ! heu ! Domine Deus : ergone disperdes omnes reliquias Israël, effundens furorem tuum super Jerusalem ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:9
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Iniquitas domus Israël et Juda magna est nimis valde, et repleta est terra sanguinibus, et civitas repleta est aversione : dixerunt enim : Dereliquit Dominus terram, et Dominus non videt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:10
verses.text: Igitur et meus non parcet oculus, neque miserebor : viam eorum super caput eorum reddam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 9:11
verses.text: Et ecce vir qui erat indutus lineis, qui habebat atramentarium in dorso suo, respondit verbum, dicens : Feci sicut præcepisti mihi.  <chapter eID="Ezek.9"/> <div eID="gen27175" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:1
verses.text: Et vidi : et ecce in firmamento quod erat super caput cherubim, quasi lapis sapphirus, quasi species similitudinis solii, apparuit super ea.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:2
verses.text: Et dixit ad virum qui indutus erat lineis, et ait : Ingredere in medio rotarum quæ sunt subtus cherubim, et imple manum tuam prunis ignis quæ sunt inter cherubim, et effunde super civitatem. Ingressusque est in conspectu meo.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:3
verses.text: Cherubim autem stabant a dextris domus cum ingrederetur vir, et nubes implevit atrium interius.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:4
verses.text: Et elevata est gloria Domini desuper cherub ad limen domus : et repleta est domus nube, et atrium repletum est splendore gloriæ Domini.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:5
verses.text: Et sonitus alarum cherubim audiebatur usque ad atrium exterius, quasi vox Dei omnipotentis loquentis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:6
verses.text: Cumque præcepisset viro qui indutus erat lineis, dicens : Sume ignem de medio rotarum quæ sunt inter cherubim : ingressus ille stetit juxta rotam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:7
verses.text: Et extendit cherub manum de medio cherubim ad ignem qui erat inter cherubim, et sumpsit, et dedit in manus ejus qui indutus erat lineis : qui accipiens egressus est.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:8
verses.text: Et apparuit in cherubim similitudo manus hominis subtus pennas eorum.  <div eID="gen27176" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9971"/><div sID="gen27177" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9971"/>Et vidi : et ecce quatuor rotæ juxta cherubim : rota una juxta cherub unum, et rota alia juxta cherub unum : species autem rotarum erat quasi visio lapidis chrysolithi :

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:10
verses.text: et aspectus earum similitudo una quatuor, quasi sit rota in medio rotæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:11
verses.text: Cumque ambularent, in quatuor partes gradiebantur, et non revertebantur ambulantes : sed ad locum ad quem ire declinabat quæ prima erat, sequebantur et ceteræ, nec convertebantur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:12
verses.text: Et omne corpus earum, et colla, et manus, et pennæ, et circuli, plena erant oculis in circuitu quatuor rotarum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:13
verses.text: Et rotas istas vocavit volubiles, audiente me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:14
verses.text: Quatuor autem facies habebat unum : facies una, facies cherub, et facies secunda, facies hominis : et in tertio facies leonis, et in quarto facies aquilæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:15
verses.text: Et elevata sunt cherubim : ipsum est animal quod videram juxta fluvium Chobar.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:16
verses.text: Cumque ambularent cherubim, ibant pariter et rotæ juxta ea : et cum elevarent cherubim alas suas ut exaltarentur de terra, non residebant rotæ, sed et ipsæ juxta erant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:17
verses.text: Stantibus illis stabant, et cum elevatis elevabantur : spiritus enim vitæ erat in eis.  <div eID="gen27177" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9972"/><div sID="gen27178" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9972"/>Et egressa est gloria Domini a limine templi, et stetit super cherubim.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:19
verses.text: Et elevantia cherubim alas suas, exaltata sunt a terra coram me : et illis egredientibus, rotæ quoque subsecutæ sunt : et stetit in introitu portæ domus Domini orientalis, et gloria Dei Israël erat super ea.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:20
verses.text: Ipsum est animal quod vidi subter Deum Israël juxta fluvium Chobar, et intellexi quia cherubim essent.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:21
verses.text: Quatuor vultus uni, et quatuor alæ uni : et similitudo manus hominis sub alis eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 10:22
verses.text: Et similitudo vultuum eorum, ipsi vultus quos videram juxta fluvium Chobar, et intuitus eorum, et impetus singulorum ante faciem suam ingredi.  <chapter eID="Ezek.10"/> <div eID="gen27178" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:1
verses.text: Et elevavit me spiritus, et introduxit me ad portam domus Domini orientalem, quæ respicit ad solis ortum : et ecce in introitu portæ viginti quinque viri : et vidi in medio eorum Jezoniam filium Azur, et Pheltiam filium Banaiæ, principes populi.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:2
verses.text: Dixitque ad me : Fili hominis, hi sunt viri qui cogitant iniquitatem, et tractant consilium pessimum in urbe ista,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:3
verses.text: dicentes : Nonne dudum ædificatæ sunt domus ? hæc est lebes, nos autem carnes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:4
verses.text: Idcirco vaticinare de eis, vaticinare, fili hominis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:5
verses.text: Et irruit in me spiritus Domini, et dixit ad me : Loquere : Hæc dicit Dominus : Sic locuti estis, domus Israël, et cogitationes cordis vestri ego novi.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:6
verses.text: Plurimos occidistis in urbe hac, et implestis vias ejus interfectis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:7
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Interfecti vestri, quos posuistis in medio ejus, hi sunt carnes, et hæc est lebes : et educam vos de medio ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:8
verses.text: Gladium metuistis, et gladium inducam super vos, ait Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:9
verses.text: Et ejiciam vos de medio ejus, daboque vos in manu hostium, et faciam in vobis judicia.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:10
verses.text: Gladio cadetis : in finibus Israël judicabo vos, et scietis quia ego Dominus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:11
verses.text: Hæc non erit vobis in lebetem, et vos non eritis in medio ejus in carnes : in finibus Israël judicabo vos,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:12
verses.text: et scietis quia ego Dominus : quia in præceptis meis non ambulastis, et judicia mea non fecistis, sed juxta judicia gentium quæ in circuitu vestro sunt estis operati.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:13
verses.text: Et factum est cum prophetarem, Pheltias filius Banaiæ mortuus est : et cecidi in faciem meam clamans voce magna, et dixi : Heu ! heu ! heu ! Domine Deus, consummationem tu facis reliquiarum Israël ?  <div eID="gen27179" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9973"/><div sID="gen27180" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9973"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:15
verses.text: Fili hominis, fratres tui, fratres tui, viri propinqui tui, et omnis domus Israël, universi quibus dixerunt habitatores Jerusalem : Longe recedite a Domino : nobis data est terra in possessionem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:16
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quia longe feci eos in gentibus, et quia dispersi eos in terris : ero eis in sanctificationem modicam in terris ad quas venerunt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:17
verses.text: Propterea loquere : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Congregabo vos de populis, et adunabo de terris in quibus dispersi estis, daboque vobis humum Israël.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:18
verses.text: Et ingredientur illuc, et auferent omnes offensiones, cunctasque abominationes ejus de illa.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:19
verses.text: Et dabo eis cor unum, et spiritum novum tribuam in visceribus eorum : et auferam cor lapideum de carne eorum, et dabo eis cor carneum,

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:20
verses.text: ut in præceptis meis ambulent, et judicia mea custodiant, faciantque ea, et sint mihi in populum, et ego sim eis in Deum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:21
verses.text: Quorum cor post offendicula et abominationes suas ambulat, horum viam in capite suo ponam, dicit Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:22
verses.text: Et elevaverunt cherubim alas suas, et rotæ cum eis, et gloria Dei Israël erat super ea :

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:23
verses.text: et ascendit gloria Domini de medio civitatis, stetitque super montem qui est ad orientem urbis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:24
verses.text: Et spiritus levavit me, adduxitque in Chaldæam ad transmigrationem, in visione, in spiritu Dei : et sublata est a me visio quam videram.

verses.name: Ezekiel 11:25
verses.text: Et locutus sum ad transmigrationem omnia verba Domini quæ ostenderat mihi.  <chapter eID="Ezek.11"/> <div eID="gen27180" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, in medio domus exasperantis tu habitas : qui oculos habent ad videndum, et non vident, et aures ad audiendum, et non audiunt : quia domus exasperans est.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:3
verses.text: Tu ergo, fili hominis, fac tibi vasa transmigrationis, et transmigrabis per diem coram eis. Transmigrabis autem de loco tuo ad locum alterum in conspectu eorum, si forte aspiciant, quia domus exasperans est :

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:4
verses.text: et efferes foras vasa tua quasi vasa transmigrantis per diem in conspectu eorum : tu autem egredieris vespere coram eis, sicut egreditur migrans.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:5
verses.text: Ante oculos eorum perfode tibi parietem, et egredieris per eum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:6
verses.text: In conspectu eorum in humeris portaberis ; in caligine effereris : faciem tuam velabis, et non videbis terram, quia portentum dedi te domui Israël.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:7
verses.text: Feci ergo sicut præceperat mihi Dominus : vasa mea protuli quasi vasa transmigrantis per diem, et vespere perfodi mihi parietem manu : et in caligine egressus sum, in humeris portatus in conspectu eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:8
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini mane ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:9
verses.text: Fili hominis, numquid non dixerunt ad te domus Israël, domus exasperans : Quid tu facis ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:10
verses.text: Dic ad eos : <div eID="gen27181" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27182"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27183"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27184"/>Super ducem onus istud, qui est in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen27184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27185"/>et super omnem domum Israël, quæ est in medio eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:11
verses.text: Dic : <l eID="gen27185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27186"/>Ego portentum vestrum : <l eID="gen27186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27187"/>quomodo feci, sic fiet illis : <l eID="gen27187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27188"/>in transmigrationem et in captivitatem ibunt. <l eID="gen27188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9974"/><l level="1" sID="gen27189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9974"/>Et dux qui est in medio eorum, <l eID="gen27189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27190"/>in humeris portabitur ; in caligine egredietur : <l eID="gen27190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27191"/>parietem perfodient, ut educant eum ; <l eID="gen27191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27192"/>facies ejus operietur, ut non videat oculo terram. <l eID="gen27192" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9975"/><l level="1" sID="gen27193"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9975"/>Et extendam rete meum super eum, <l eID="gen27193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27194"/>et capietur in sagena mea : <l eID="gen27194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27195"/>et adducam eum in Babylonem, in terram Chaldæorum, <l eID="gen27195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27196"/>et ipsam non videbit : <l eID="gen27196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27197"/>ibique morietur. <l eID="gen27197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9976"/><l level="1" sID="gen27198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9976"/>Et omnes qui circa eum sunt, <l eID="gen27198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27199"/>præsidium ejus, et agmina ejus, <l eID="gen27199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27200"/>dispergam in omnem ventum, <l eID="gen27200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27201"/>et gladium evaginabo post eos. <l eID="gen27201" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9977"/><l level="1" sID="gen27202"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9977"/>Et scient quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen27202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27203"/>quando dispersero illos in gentibus, <l eID="gen27203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27204"/>et disseminavero eos in terris. <l eID="gen27204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9978"/><l level="1" sID="gen27205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9978"/>Et relinquam ex eis viros paucos <l eID="gen27205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27206"/>a gladio, et fame, et pestilentia, <l eID="gen27206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27207"/>ut enarrent omnia scelera eorum <l eID="gen27207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27208"/>in gentibus ad quas ingredientur, <l eID="gen27208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27209"/>et scient quia ego Dominus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:17
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens : <l eID="gen27209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9979"/><l level="1" sID="gen27210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9979"/>Fili hominis, panem tuum in conturbatione comede, <l eID="gen27210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27211"/>sed et aquam tuam in festinatione et mœrore bibe. <l eID="gen27211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9980"/><l level="1" sID="gen27212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9980"/>Et dices ad populum terræ : <l eID="gen27212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27213"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus <l eID="gen27213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27214"/>ad eos qui habitant in Jerusalem, in terra Israël : <l eID="gen27214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27215"/>Panem suum in sollicitudine comedent, <l eID="gen27215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27216"/>et aquam suam in desolatione bibent : <l eID="gen27216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27217"/>ut desoletur terra a multitudine sua, <l eID="gen27217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27218"/>propter iniquitatem omnium qui habitant in ea. <l eID="gen27218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9981"/><l level="1" sID="gen27219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9981"/>Et civitates quæ nunc habitantur, desolatæ erunt, <l eID="gen27219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27220"/>terraque deserta, <l eID="gen27220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27221"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27221" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen27182"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9982"/><div sID="gen27222" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9982"/>Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen27222" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9983"/><lg sID="gen27223"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9983"/>Fili hominis, quod est proverbium istud <l eID="gen27224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27225"/>vobis in terra Israël, dicentium : <l eID="gen27225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27226"/>In longum differentur dies, <l eID="gen27226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27227"/>et peribit omnis visio ? <l eID="gen27227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9984"/><l level="1" sID="gen27228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9984"/>Ideo dic ad eos : <l eID="gen27228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27229"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27230"/>Quiescere faciam proverbium istud, <l eID="gen27230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27231"/>neque vulgo dicetur ultra in Israël : <l eID="gen27231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27232"/>et loquere ad eos quod appropinquaverint dies, <l eID="gen27232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27233"/>et sermo omnis visionis. <l eID="gen27233" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9985"/><l level="1" sID="gen27234"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9985"/>Non enim erit ultra omnis visio cassa, <l eID="gen27234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27235"/>neque divinatio ambigua in medio filiorum Israël : <l eID="gen27235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9986"/><l level="1" sID="gen27236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9986"/>quia ego Dominus loquar, <l eID="gen27236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27237"/>et quodcumque locutus fuero verbum, fiet, <l eID="gen27237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27238"/>et non prolongabitur amplius : <l eID="gen27238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27239"/>sed in diebus vestris, domus exasperans, <l eID="gen27239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27240"/>loquar verbum, et faciam illud, <l eID="gen27240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27241"/>dicit Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:26
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens : <l eID="gen27241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9987"/><l level="1" sID="gen27242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9987"/>Fili hominis, ecce domus Israël dicentium : <l eID="gen27242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27243"/>Visio quam hic videt, <l eID="gen27243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27244"/>in dies multos et in tempora longa iste prophetat. <l eID="gen27244" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 12:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9988"/><l level="1" sID="gen27245"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9988"/>Propterea dic ad eos : <l eID="gen27245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27246"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27247"/>Non prolongabitur ultra omnis sermo meus : <l eID="gen27247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27248"/>verbum quod locutus fuero, complebitur, <l eID="gen27248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27249"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27249" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27223"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.12"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, vaticinare ad prophetas Israël qui prophetant, et dices prophetantibus de corde suo : <div eID="gen27250" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27251"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27252"/>Audite verbum Domini. <l eID="gen27252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9989"/><l level="1" sID="gen27253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9989"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27254"/>Væ prophetis insipientibus, <l eID="gen27254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27255"/>qui sequuntur spiritum suum, <l eID="gen27255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27256"/>et nihil vident ! <l eID="gen27256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9990"/><l level="1" sID="gen27257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9990"/>Quasi vulpes in desertis prophetæ tui, Israël, erant. <l eID="gen27257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9991"/><l level="1" sID="gen27258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9991"/>Non ascendistis ex adverso, <l eID="gen27258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27259"/>neque opposuistis murum pro domo Israël, <l eID="gen27259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27260"/>ut staretis in prælio in die Domini. <l eID="gen27260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9992"/><l level="1" sID="gen27261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9992"/>Vident vana, et divinant mendacium, <l eID="gen27261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27262"/>dicentes : Ait Dominus, <l eID="gen27262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27263"/>cum Dominus non miserit eos : <l eID="gen27263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27264"/>et perseveraverunt confirmare sermonem. <l eID="gen27264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9993"/><l level="1" sID="gen27265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9993"/>Numquid non visionem cassam vidistis, <l eID="gen27265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27266"/>et divinationem mendacem locuti estis, <l eID="gen27266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27267"/>et dicitis : Ait Dominus, <l eID="gen27267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27268"/>cum ego non sim locutus ? <l eID="gen27268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9994"/><l level="1" sID="gen27269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9994"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27270"/>Quia locuti estis vana, et vidistis mendacium, <l eID="gen27270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27271"/>ideo ecce ego ad vos, dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9995"/><l level="1" sID="gen27272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9995"/>Et erit manus mea super prophetas <l eID="gen27272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27273"/>qui vident vana, et divinant mendacium : <l eID="gen27273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27274"/>in consilio populi mei non erunt, <l eID="gen27274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27275"/>et in scriptura domus Israël non scribentur, <l eID="gen27275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27276"/>nec in terram Israël ingredientur, <l eID="gen27276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27277"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27277" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9996"/><l level="1" sID="gen27278"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9996"/>eo quod deceperint populum meum, <l eID="gen27278" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27279"/>dicentes : Pax, et non est pax : <l eID="gen27279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27280"/>et ipse ædificabat parietem, <l eID="gen27280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27281"/>illi autem liniebant eum luto absque paleis. <l eID="gen27281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9997"/><l level="1" sID="gen27282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9997"/>Dic ad eos qui liniunt absque temperatura, quod casurus sit : <l eID="gen27282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27283"/>erit enim imber inundans, <l eID="gen27283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27284"/>et dabo lapides prægrandes desuper irruentes, <l eID="gen27284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27285"/>et ventum procellæ dissipantem. <l eID="gen27285" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9998"/><l level="1" sID="gen27286"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9998"/>Siquidem ecce cecidit paries : <l eID="gen27286" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27287"/>numquid non dicetur vobis : <l eID="gen27287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27288"/>Ubi est litura quam linistis ? <l eID="gen27288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv9999"/><l level="1" sID="gen27289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv9999"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27290"/>Et erumpere faciam spiritum tempestatum in indignatione mea, <l eID="gen27290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27291"/>et imber inundans in furore meo erit, <l eID="gen27291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27292"/>et lapides grandes in ira in consumptionem. <l eID="gen27292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10000"/><l level="1" sID="gen27293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10000"/>Et destruam parietem quem linistis absque temperamento, <l eID="gen27293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27294"/>et adæquabo eum terræ, <l eID="gen27294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27295"/>et revelabitur fundamentum ejus : <l eID="gen27295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27296"/>et cadet, et consumetur in medio ejus, <l eID="gen27296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27297"/>et scietis quia ego sum Dominus. <l eID="gen27297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10001"/><l level="1" sID="gen27298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10001"/>Et complebo indignationem meam in pariete, <l eID="gen27298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27299"/>et in his qui liniunt eum absque temperamento : <l eID="gen27299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27300"/>dicamque vobis : Non est paries, <l eID="gen27300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27301"/>et non sunt qui liniunt eum : <l eID="gen27301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10002"/><l level="1" sID="gen27302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10002"/>prophetæ Israël, qui prophetant ad Jerusalem, <l eID="gen27302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27303"/>et vident ei visionem pacis, et non est pax, <l eID="gen27303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27304"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27304" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen27251"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10003"/><div sID="gen27305" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10003"/>Et tu, fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra filias populi tui quæ prophetant de corde suo : et vaticinare super eas,

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:18
verses.text: et dic : <div eID="gen27305" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27306"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27307"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27308"/>Væ quæ consuunt pulvillos sub omni cubito manus, <l eID="gen27308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27309"/>et faciunt cervicalia sub capite universæ ætatis <l eID="gen27309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27310"/>ad capiendas animas : <l eID="gen27310" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27311"/>et cum caperent animas populi mei, <l eID="gen27311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27312"/>vivificabant animas eorum ! <l eID="gen27312" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10004"/><l level="1" sID="gen27313"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10004"/>Et violabant me ad populum meum <l eID="gen27313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27314"/>propter pugillum hordei, et fragmen panis, <l eID="gen27314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27315"/>ut interficerent animas quæ non moriuntur, <l eID="gen27315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27316"/>et vivificarent animas quæ non vivunt, <l eID="gen27316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27317"/>mentientes populo meo credenti mendaciis. <l eID="gen27317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10005"/><l level="1" sID="gen27318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10005"/>Propter hoc hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27319"/>Ecce ego ad pulvillos vestros, <l eID="gen27319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27320"/>quibus vos capitis animas volantes : <l eID="gen27320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27321"/>et dirumpam eos de brachiis vestris, <l eID="gen27321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27322"/>et dimittam animas quas vos capitis, <l eID="gen27322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27323"/>animas ad volandum. <l eID="gen27323" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10006"/><l level="1" sID="gen27324"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10006"/>Et dirumpam cervicalia vestra, <l eID="gen27324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27325"/>et liberabo populum meum de manu vestra, <l eID="gen27325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27326"/>neque erunt ultra in manibus vestris ad prædandum : <l eID="gen27326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27327"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10007"/><l level="1" sID="gen27328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10007"/>Pro eo quod mœrere fecistis cor justi mendaciter, <l eID="gen27328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27329"/>quem ego non contristavi, <l eID="gen27329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27330"/>et confortastis manus impii, <l eID="gen27330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27331"/>ut non reverteretur a via sua mala, et viveret : <l eID="gen27331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 13:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10008"/><l level="1" sID="gen27332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10008"/>propterea vana non videbitis, <l eID="gen27332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27333"/>et divinationes non divinabitis amplius, <l eID="gen27333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27334"/>et eruam populum meum de manu vestra : <l eID="gen27334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27335"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27335" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27306"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.13"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:1
verses.text: Et venerunt ad me viri seniorum Israël, et sederunt coram me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:2
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:3
verses.text: Fili hominis, viri isti posuerunt immunditias suas in cordibus suis, et scandalum iniquitatis suæ statuerunt contra faciem suam : numquid interrogatus respondebo eis ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:4
verses.text: Propter hoc loquere eis, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Homo, homo de domo Israël, qui posuerit immunditias suas in corde suo, et scandalum iniquitatis suæ statuerit contra faciem suam, et venerit ad prophetam interrogans per eum me : ego Dominus respondebo ei in multitudine immunditiarum suarum,

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:5
verses.text: ut capiatur domus Israël in corde suo, quo recesserunt a me in cunctis idolis suis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:6
verses.text: Propterea dic ad domum Israël : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Convertimini, et recedite ab idolis vestris, et ab universis contaminationibus vestris avertite facies vestras.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:7
verses.text: Quia homo, homo de domo Israël, et de proselytis quicumque advena fuerit in Israël, si alienatus fuerit a me, et posuerit idola sua in corde suo, et scandalum iniquitatis suæ statuerit contra faciem suam, et venerit ad prophetam ut interroget per eum me : ego Dominus respondebo ei per me :

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:8
verses.text: et ponam faciem meam super hominem illum, et faciam eum in exemplum et in proverbium, et disperdam eum de medio populi mei : et scietis quia ego Dominus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:9
verses.text: Et propheta cum erraverit, et locutus fuerit verbum, ego Dominus decepi prophetam illum, et extendam manum meam super illum, et delebo eum de medio populi mei Israël.

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:10
verses.text: Et portabunt iniquitatem suam : juxta iniquitatem interrogantis, sic iniquitas prophetæ erit :

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:11
verses.text: ut non erret ultra domus Israël a me, neque polluatur in universis prævaricationibus suis : sed sint mihi in populum, et ego sim eis in Deum, ait Dominus exercituum.  <div eID="gen27336" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10009"/><div sID="gen27337" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10009"/>Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen27337" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10010"/><lg sID="gen27338"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10010"/>Fili hominis, terra cum peccaverit mihi, <l eID="gen27339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27340"/>ut prævaricetur prævaricans, <l eID="gen27340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27341"/>extendam manum meam super eam, <l eID="gen27341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27342"/>et conteram virgam panis ejus, <l eID="gen27342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27343"/>et immittam in eam famem, <l eID="gen27343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27344"/>et interficiam de ea hominem et jumentum. <l eID="gen27344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10011"/><l level="1" sID="gen27345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10011"/>Et si fuerint tres viri isti in medio ejus, <l eID="gen27345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27346"/>Noë, Daniel, et Job, <l eID="gen27346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27347"/>ipsi justitia sua liberabunt animas suas, <l eID="gen27347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27348"/>ait Dominus exercituum. <l eID="gen27348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10012"/><l level="1" sID="gen27349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10012"/>Quod si et bestias pessimas induxero super terram <l eID="gen27349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27350"/>ut vastem eam, et fuerit invia, <l eID="gen27350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27351"/>eo quod non sit pertransiens propter bestias : <l eID="gen27351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10013"/><l level="1" sID="gen27352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10013"/>tres viri isti si fuerint in ea, <l eID="gen27352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27353"/>vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen27353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27354"/>quia nec filios nec filias liberabunt, <l eID="gen27354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27355"/>sed ipsi soli liberabuntur, <l eID="gen27355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27356"/>terra autem desolabitur. <l eID="gen27356" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10014"/><l level="1" sID="gen27357"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10014"/>Vel si gladium induxero super terram illam, <l eID="gen27357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27358"/>et dixero gladio : Transi per terram : <l eID="gen27358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27359"/>et interfecero de ea hominem et jumentum, <l eID="gen27359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10015"/><l level="1" sID="gen27360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10015"/>et tres viri isti fuerint in medio ejus : <l eID="gen27360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27361"/>vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen27361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27362"/>non liberabunt filios neque filias, <l eID="gen27362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27363"/>sed ipsi soli liberabuntur. <l eID="gen27363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10016"/><l level="1" sID="gen27364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10016"/>Si autem et pestilentiam immisero super terram illam, <l eID="gen27364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27365"/>et effudero indignationem meam super eam in sanguine, <l eID="gen27365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27366"/>ut auferam ex ea hominem et jumentum, <l eID="gen27366" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10017"/><l level="1" sID="gen27367"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10017"/>et Noë, et Daniel, et Job fuerint in medio ejus : <l eID="gen27367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27368"/>vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen27368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27369"/>quia filium et filiam non liberabunt, <l eID="gen27369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27370"/>sed ipsi justitia sua liberabunt animas suas. <l eID="gen27370" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10018"/><l level="1" sID="gen27371"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10018"/>Quoniam hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27372"/>Quod etsi quatuor judicia mea pessima, <l eID="gen27372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27373"/>gladium, et famem, ac bestias malas, et pestilentiam, <l eID="gen27373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27374"/>immisero in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen27374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27375"/>ut interficiam de ea hominem et pecus, <l eID="gen27375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10019"/><l level="1" sID="gen27376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10019"/>tamen relinquetur in ea salvatio educentium filios et filias : <l eID="gen27376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27377"/>ecce ipsi ingredientur ad vos, <l eID="gen27377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27378"/>et videbitis viam eorum et adinventiones eorum, <l eID="gen27378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27379"/>et consolabimini super malo quod induxi in Jerusalem, <l eID="gen27379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27380"/>in omnibus quæ importavi super eam. <l eID="gen27380" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 14:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10020"/><l level="1" sID="gen27381"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10020"/>Et consolabuntur vos, <l eID="gen27381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27382"/>cum videritis viam eorum <l eID="gen27382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27383"/>et adinventiones eorum : <l eID="gen27383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27384"/>et cognoscetis quod non frustra fecerim omnia quæ feci in ea, <l eID="gen27384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27385"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27385" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27338"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.14"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen27386" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10021"/><lg sID="gen27387"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10021"/>Fili hominis, quid fiet de ligno vitis, <l eID="gen27388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27389"/>ex omnibus lignis nemorum <l eID="gen27389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27390"/>quæ sunt inter ligna silvarum ? <l eID="gen27390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10022"/><l level="1" sID="gen27391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10022"/>numquid tolletur de ea lignum ut fiat opus, <l eID="gen27391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27392"/>aut fabricabitur de ea paxillus <l eID="gen27392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27393"/>ut dependeat in eo quodcumque vas ? <l eID="gen27393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10023"/><l level="1" sID="gen27394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10023"/>Ecce igni datum est in escam : <l eID="gen27394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27395"/>utramque partem ejus consumpsit ignis, <l eID="gen27395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27396"/>et medietas ejus redacta est in favillam : <l eID="gen27396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27397"/>numquid utile erit ad opus ? <l eID="gen27397" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10024"/><l level="1" sID="gen27398"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10024"/>Etiam cum esset integrum, <l eID="gen27398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27399"/>non erat aptum ad opus : <l eID="gen27399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27400"/>quanto magis cum illud ignis devoraverit et combusserit, <l eID="gen27400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27401"/>nihil ex eo fiet operis ? <l eID="gen27401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10025"/><l level="1" sID="gen27402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10025"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27403"/>Quomodo lignum vitis inter ligna silvarum, <l eID="gen27403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27404"/>quod dedi igni ad devorandum, <l eID="gen27404" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27405"/>sic tradam habitatores Jerusalem. <l eID="gen27405" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10026"/><l level="1" sID="gen27406"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10026"/>Et ponam faciem meam in eos : <l eID="gen27406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27407"/>de igne egredientur, <l eID="gen27407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27408"/>et ignis consumet eos : <l eID="gen27408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27409"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen27409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27410"/>cum posuero faciem meam in eos, <l eID="gen27410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 15:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10027"/><l level="1" sID="gen27411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10027"/>et dedero terram inviam et desolatam, <l eID="gen27411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27412"/>eo quod prævaricatores extiterint, <l eID="gen27412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27413"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27413" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27387"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.15"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, notas fac Jerusalem abominationes suas,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:3
verses.text: et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Jerusalem : Radix tua et generatio tua de terra Chanaan : pater tuus Amorrhæus, et mater tua Cethæa.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:4
verses.text: Et quando nata es, in die ortus tui non est præcisus umbilicus tuus, et aqua non es lota in salutem, nec sale salita, nec involuta pannis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:5
verses.text: Non pepercit super te oculus, ut faceret tibi unum de his, misertus tui : sed projecta es super faciem terræ in abjectione animæ tuæ in die qua nata es.  <div eID="gen27414" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10028"/><div sID="gen27415" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10028"/>Transiens autem per te, vidi te conculcari in sanguine tuo : et dixi tibi cum esses in sanguine tuo : Vive, dixi, inquam, tibi : in sanguine tuo vive.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:7
verses.text: Multiplicatam quasi germen agri dedi te : et multiplicata es, et grandis effecta, et ingressa es, et pervenisti ad mundum muliebrem : ubera tua intumuerunt, et pilus tuus germinavit : et eras nuda, et confusione plena.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:8
verses.text: Et transivi per te, et vidi te : et ecce tempus tuum, tempus amantium : et expandi amictum meum super te, et operui ignominiam tuam : et juravi tibi, et ingressus sum pactum tecum, ait Dominus Deus, et facta es mihi.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:9
verses.text: Et lavi te aqua, et emundavi sanguinem tuum ex te, et unxi te oleo.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:10
verses.text: Et vestivi te discoloribus, et calceavi te janthino, et cinxi te bysso, et indui te subtilibus :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:11
verses.text: et ornavi te ornamento, et dedi armillas in manibus tuis, et torquem circa collum tuum :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:12
verses.text: et dedi inaurem super os tuum, et circulos auribus tuis, et coronam decoris in capite tuo.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:13
verses.text: Et ornata es auro et argento, et vestita es bysso et polymito et multicoloribus : similam, et mel, et oleum comedisti : et decora facta es vehementer nimis, et profecisti in regnum.  <div eID="gen27415" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10029"/><div sID="gen27416" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10029"/>Et egressum est nomen tuum in gentes propter speciem tuam, quia perfecta eras in decore meo quem posueram super te, dicit Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:15
verses.text: Et habens fiduciam in pulchritudine tua, fornicata es in nomine tuo : et exposuisti fornicationem tuam omni transeunti, ut ejus fieres.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:16
verses.text: Et sumens de vestimentis tuis, fecisti tibi excelsa hinc inde consuta, et fornicata es super eis sicut non est factum, neque futurum est.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:17
verses.text: Et tulisti vasa decoris tui de auro meo atque argento meo, quæ dedi tibi, et fecisti tibi imagines masculinas, et fornicata es in eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:18
verses.text: Et sumpsisti vestimenta tua multicoloria, et operuisti illas, et oleum meum et thymiama meum posuisti coram eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:19
verses.text: Et panem meum quem dedi tibi, similam, et oleum, et mel, quibus enutrivi te, posuisti in conspectu eorum in odorem suavitatis : et factum est, ait Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:20
verses.text: Et tulisti filios tuos et filias tuas quas generasti mihi, et immolasti eis ad devorandum. Numquid parva est fornicatio tua ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:21
verses.text: Immolasti filios meos, et dedisti, illos consecrans, eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:22
verses.text: Et post omnes abominationes tuas et fornicationes, non es recordata dierum adolescentiæ tuæ, quando eras nuda et confusione plena, conculcata in sanguine tuo.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:23
verses.text: Et accidit post omnem malitiam tuam (væ, væ tibi ! ait Dominus Deus),

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:24
verses.text: et ædificasti tibi lupanar, et fecisti tibi prostibulum in cunctis plateis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:25
verses.text: Ad omne caput viæ ædificasti signum prostitutionis tuæ, et abominabilem fecisti decorem tuum : et divisisti pedes tuos omni transeunti, et multiplicasti fornicationes tuas :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:26
verses.text: et fornicata es cum filiis Ægypti, vicinis tuis, magnarum carnium : et multiplicasti fornicationem tuam ad irritandum me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:27
verses.text: Ecce ego extendam manum meam super te, et auferam justificationem tuam, et dabo te in animas odientium te filiarum Palæstinarum, quæ erubescunt in via tua scelerata.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:28
verses.text: Et fornicata es in filiis Assyriorum eo quod necdum fueris expleta : et postquam fornicata es, nec sic es satiata :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:29
verses.text: et multiplicasti fornicationem tuam in terra Chanaan cum Chaldæis, et nec sic satiata es.  <div eID="gen27416" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10030"/><div sID="gen27417" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10030"/>In quo mundabo cor tuum, ait Dominus Deus, cum facias omnia hæc opera mulieris meretricis et procacis ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:31
verses.text: Quia fabricasti lupanar tuum in capite omnis viæ, et excelsum tuum fecisti in omni platea : nec facta es quasi meretrix fastidio augens pretium,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:32
verses.text: sed quasi mulier adultera, quæ super virum suum inducit alienos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:33
verses.text: Omnibus meretricibus dantur mercedes : tu autem dedisti mercedes cunctis amatoribus tuis, et dona donabas eis, ut intrarent ad te undique ad fornicandum tecum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:34
verses.text: Factumque est in te contra consuetudinem mulierum in fornicationibus tuis, et post te non erit fornicatio : in eo enim quod dedisti mercedes, et mercedes non accepisti, factum est in te contrarium.  <div eID="gen27417" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10031"/><div sID="gen27418" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10031"/>Propterea, meretrix, audi verbum Domini.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:36
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Quia effusum est æs tuum et revelata est ignominia tua in fornicationibus tuis super amatores tuos, et super idola abominationum tuarum, in sanguine filiorum tuorum quos dedisti eis,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:37
verses.text: ecce ego congregabo omnes amatores tuos quibus commista es, et omnes quos dilexisti, cum universis quos oderas : et congregabo eos super te undique, et nudabo ignominiam tuam coram eis, et videbunt omnem turpitudinem tuam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:38
verses.text: Et judicabo te judiciis adulterarum, et effundentium sanguinem : et dabo te in sanguinem furoris et zeli.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:39
verses.text: Et dabo te in manus eorum, et destruent lupanar tuum, et demolientur prostibulum tuum : et denudabunt te vestimentis tuis, et auferent vasa decoris tui, et derelinquent te nudam, plenamque ignominia :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:40
verses.text: et adducent super te multitudinem, et lapidabunt te lapidibus, et trucidabunt te gladiis suis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:41
verses.text: et comburent domos tuas igni, et facient in te judicia in oculis mulierum plurimarum. Et desines fornicari, et mercedes ultra non dabis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:42
verses.text: et requiescet indignatio mea in te, et auferetur zelus meus a te : et quiescam, nec irascar amplius.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:43
verses.text: Eo quod non fueris recordata dierum adolescentiæ tuæ, et provocasti me in omnibus his, quapropter et ego vias tuas in capite tuo dedi, ait Dominus Deus, et non feci juxta scelera tua in omnibus abominationibus tuis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:44
verses.text: Ecce omnis qui dicit vulgo proverbium, in te assumet illud, dicens : Sicut mater, ita et filia ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:45
verses.text: Filia matris tuæ es tu, quæ projecit virum suum et filios suos : et soror sororum tuarum es tu, quæ projecerunt viros suos et filios suos : mater vestra Cethæa, et pater vester Amorrhæus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:46
verses.text: Et soror tua major, Samaria, ipsa et filiæ ejus, quæ habitant ad sinistram tuam : soror autem tua minor te, quæ habitat a dextris tuis, Sodoma, et filiæ ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:47
verses.text: Sed nec in viis earum ambulasti, neque secundum scelera earum fecisti pauxillum minus : pene sceleratiora fecisti illis in omnibus viis tuis.  <div eID="gen27418" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10032"/><div sID="gen27419" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10032"/>Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quia non fecit Sodoma soror tua, ipsa et filiæ ejus, sicut fecisti tu et filiæ tuæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:49
verses.text: Ecce hæc fuit iniquitas Sodomæ sororis tuæ : superbia, saturitas panis et abundantia, et otium ipsius et filiarum ejus : et manum egeno et pauperi non porrigebant :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:50
verses.text: et elevatæ sunt, et fecerunt abominationes coram me : et abstuli eas sicut vidisti.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:51
verses.text: Et Samaria dimidium peccatorum tuorum non peccavit : sed vicisti eas sceleribus tuis, et justificasti sorores tuas in omnibus abominationibus tuis quas operata es.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:52
verses.text: Ergo et tu porta confusionem tuam, quæ vicisti sorores tuas peccatis tuis, sceleratius agens ab eis : justificatæ sunt enim a te : ergo et tu confundere, et porta ignominiam tuam, quæ justificasti sorores tuas.  <div eID="gen27419" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:53
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10033"/><div sID="gen27420" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10033"/>Et convertam restituens eas conversione Sodomorum cum filiabus suis, et conversione Samariæ et filiarum ejus, et convertam reversionem tuam in medio earum,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:54
verses.text: ut portes ignominiam tuam, et confundaris in omnibus quæ fecisti consolans eas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:55
verses.text: Et soror tua Sodoma et filiæ ejus revertentur ad antiquitatem suam, et Samaria et filiæ ejus revertentur ad antiquitatem suam, et tu et filiæ tuæ revertemini ad antiquitatem vestram.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:56
verses.text: Non fuit autem Sodoma soror tua audita in ore tuo in die superbiæ tuæ,

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:57
verses.text: antequam revelaretur malitia tua, sicut hoc tempore in opprobrium filiarum Syriæ, et cunctarum in circuitu tuo filiarum Palæstinarum quæ ambiunt te per gyrum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:58
verses.text: Scelus tuum et ignominiam tuam tu portasti, ait Dominus Deus.  <div eID="gen27420" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:59
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10034"/><div sID="gen27421" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10034"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Et faciam tibi sicut despexisti juramentum, ut irritum faceres pactum :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:60
verses.text: et recordabor ego pacti mei tecum in diebus adolescentiæ tuæ, et suscitabo tibi pactum sempiternum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:61
verses.text: Et recordaberis viarum tuarum, et confunderis, cum receperis sorores tuas te majores cum minoribus tuis : et dabo eas tibi in filias, sed non ex pacto tuo.

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:62
verses.text: Et suscitabo ego pactum meum tecum, et scies quia ego Dominus :

verses.name: Ezekiel 16:63
verses.text: ut recorderis, et confundaris, et non sit tibi ultra aperire os præ confusione tua, cum placatus tibi fuero in omnibus quæ fecisti, ait Dominus Deus.  <chapter eID="Ezek.16"/> <div eID="gen27421" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, propone ænigma, et narra parabolam ad domum Israël,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:3
verses.text: et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Aquila grandis magnarum alarum, longo membrorum ductu, plena plumis et varietate, venit ad Libanum, et tulit medullam cedri.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:4
verses.text: Summitatem frondium ejus avulsit, et transportavit eam in terram Chanaan : in urbe negotiatorum posuit illam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:5
verses.text: Et tulit de semine terræ, et posuit illud in terra pro semine, ut firmaret radicem super aquas multas : in superficie posuit illud.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:6
verses.text: Cumque germinasset, crevit in vineam latiorem, humili statura, respicientibus ramis ejus ad eam, et radices ejus sub illa erant : facta est ergo vinea, et fructificavit in palmites, et emisit propagines.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:7
verses.text: Et facta est aquila altera grandis, magnis alis, multisque plumis : et ecce vinea ista quasi mittens radices suas ad eam, palmites suos extendit ad illam, ut irrigaret eam de areolis germinis sui.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:8
verses.text: In terra bona super aquas multas plantata est, ut faciat frondes, et portet fructum, ut sit in vineam grandem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:9
verses.text: Dic : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ergone prosperabitur ? nonne radices ejus evellet, et fructus ejus distringet, et siccabit omnes palmites germinis ejus, et arescet, et non in brachio grandi, neque in populo multo, ut evelleret eam radicitus ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:10
verses.text: Ecce plantata est : ergone prosperabitur ? nonne, cum tetigerit eam ventus urens, siccabitur, et in areis germinis sui arescet ?  <div eID="gen27422" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10035"/><div sID="gen27423" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10035"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:12
verses.text: Dic ad domum exasperantem : Nescitis quid ista significent ? Dic : Ecce venit rex Babylonis in Jerusalem, et assumet regem et principes ejus, et adducet eos ad semetipsum in Babylonem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:13
verses.text: Et tollet de semine regni, ferietque cum eo fœdus, et ab eo accipiet jusjurandum. Sed et fortes terræ tollet,

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:14
verses.text: ut sit regnum humile, et non elevetur, sed custodiat pactum ejus, et servet illud.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:15
verses.text: Qui recedens ab eo misit nuntios ad Ægyptum, ut daret sibi equos et populum multum : numquid prosperabitur, vel consequetur salutem, qui fecit hæc ? et qui dissolvit pactum, numquid effugiet ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:16
verses.text: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quoniam in loco regis qui constituit eum regem, cujus fecit irritum juramentum, et solvit pactum quod habebat cum eo, in medio Babylonis morietur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:17
verses.text: Et non in exercitu grandi, neque in populo multo, faciet contra eum Pharao prælium : in jactu aggeris, et in exstructione vallorum, ut interficiat animas multas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:18
verses.text: Spreverat enim juramentum, ut solveret fœdus, et ecce dedit manum suam : et cum omnia hæc fecerit, non effugiet.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:19
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Vivo ego, quoniam juramentum quod sprevit, et fœdus quod prævaricatus est, ponam in caput ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:20
verses.text: Et expandam super eum rete meum, et comprehendetur in sagena mea : et adducam eum in Babylonem, et judicabo eum ibi in prævaricatione qua despexit me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:21
verses.text: Et omnes profugi ejus, cum universo agmine suo, gladio cadent : residui autem in omnem ventum dispergentur : et scietis quia ego Dominus locutus sum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:22
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Et sumam ego de medulla cedri sublimis, et ponam : de vertice ramorum ejus tenerum distringam, et plantabo super montem excelsum et eminentem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:23
verses.text: In monte sublimi Israël plantabo illud, et erumpet in germen, et faciet fructum, et erit in cedrum magnam : et habitabunt sub ea omnes volucres, et universum volatile sub umbra frondium ejus nidificabit :

verses.name: Ezekiel 17:24
verses.text: et scient omnia ligna regionis quia ego Dominus humiliavi lignum sublime, et exaltavi lignum humile ; et siccavi lignum viride, et frondere feci lignum aridum. Ego Dominus locutus sum, et feci.  <chapter eID="Ezek.17"/> <div eID="gen27423" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:2
verses.text: Quid est quod inter vos parabolam vertitis in proverbium istud in terra Israël, dicentes : Patres comederunt uvam acerbam, et dentes filiorum obstupescunt ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:3
verses.text: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, si erit ultra vobis parabola hæc in proverbium in Israël.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:4
verses.text: Ecce omnes animæ meæ sunt : ut anima patris, ita et anima filii mea est : anima quæ peccaverit, ipsa morietur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:5
verses.text: Et vir si fuerit justus, et fecerit judicium et justitiam,

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:6
verses.text: in montibus non comederit, et oculos suos non levaverit ad idola domus Israël : et uxorem proximi sui non violaverit, et ad mulierem menstruatam non accesserit :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:7
verses.text: et hominem non contristaverit, pignus debitori reddiderit, per vim nihil rapuerit : panem suum esurienti dederit, et nudum operuerit vestimento :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:8
verses.text: ad usuram non commodaverit, et amplius non acceperit : ab iniquitate averterit manum suam, et judicium verum fecerit inter virum et virum :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:9
verses.text: in præceptis meis ambulaverit, et judicia mea custodierit, ut faciat veritatem : hic justus est ; vita vivet, ait Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:10
verses.text: Quod si genuerit filium latronem, effundentem sanguinem, et fecerit unum de istis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:11
verses.text: et hæc quidem omnia non facientem, sed in montibus comedentem, et uxorem proximi sui polluentem :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:12
verses.text: egenum et pauperem contristantem, rapientem rapinas, pignus non reddentem, et ad idola levantem oculos suos, abominationem facientem :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:13
verses.text: ad usuram dantem, et amplius accipientem : numquid vivet ? Non vivet : cum universa hæc detestanda fecerit, morte morietur ; sanguis ejus in ipso erit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:14
verses.text: Quod si genuerit filium, qui videns omnia peccata patris sui quæ fecit, timuerit, et non fecerit simile eis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:15
verses.text: super montes non comederit, et oculos suos non levaverit ad idola domus Israël, et uxorem proximi sui non violaverit :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:16
verses.text: et virum non contristaverit, pignus non retinuerit, et rapinam non rapuerit : panem suum esurienti dederit, et nudum operuerit vestimento :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:17
verses.text: a pauperis injuria averterit manum suam, usuram et superabundantiam non acceperit, judicia mea fecerit, in præceptis meis ambulaverit : hic non morietur in iniquitate patris sui, sed vita vivet.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:18
verses.text: Pater ejus, quia calumniatus est, et vim fecit fratri, et malum operatus est in medio populi sui, ecce mortuus est in iniquitate sua.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:19
verses.text: Et dicitis : Quare non portavit filius iniquitatem patris ? Videlicet quia filius judicium et justitiam operatus est, omnia præcepta mea custodivit, et fecit illa, vivet vita.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:20
verses.text: Anima quæ peccaverit, ipsa morietur : filius non portabit iniquitatem patris, et pater non portabit iniquitatem filii : justitia justi super eum erit, et impietas impii erit super eum.  <div eID="gen27424" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10036"/><div sID="gen27425" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10036"/>Si autem impius egerit pœnitentiam ab omnibus peccatis suis quæ operatus est, et custodierit omnia præcepta mea, et fecerit judicium et justitiam, vita vivet, et non morietur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:22
verses.text: Omnium iniquitatum ejus quas operatus est, non recordabor : in justitia sua quam operatus est, vivet.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:23
verses.text: Numquid voluntatis meæ est mors impii, dicit Dominus Deus, et non ut convertatur a viis suis, et vivat ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:24
verses.text: Si autem averterit se justus a justitia sua, et fecerit iniquitatem secundum omnes abominationes quas operari solet impius, numquid vivet ? Omnes justitiæ ejus quas fecerat, non recordabuntur : in prævaricatione qua prævaricatus est, et in peccato suo quod peccavit, in ipsis morietur.  <div eID="gen27425" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10037"/><div sID="gen27426" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10037"/>Et dixistis : Non est æqua via Domini ! Audite ergo, domus Israël : numquid via mea non est æqua, et non magis viæ vestræ pravæ sunt ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:26
verses.text: Cum enim averterit se justus a justitia sua, et fecerit iniquitatem, morietur in eis : in injustitia quam operatus est morietur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:27
verses.text: Et cum averterit se impius ab impietate sua quam operatus est, et fecerit judicium et justitiam, ipse animam suam vivificabit :

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:28
verses.text: considerans enim, et avertens se ab omnibus iniquitatibus suis quas operatus est, vita vivet, et non morietur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:29
verses.text: Et dicunt filii Israël : Non est æqua via Domini ! Numquid viæ meæ non sunt æquæ, domus Israël, et non magis viæ vestræ pravæ ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:30
verses.text: Idcirco unumquemque juxta vias suas judicabo, domus Israël, ait Dominus Deus. Convertimini, et agite pœnitentiam ab omnibus iniquitatibus vestris, et non erit vobis in ruinam iniquitas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:31
verses.text: Projicite a vobis omnes prævaricationes vestras in quibus prævaricati estis, et facite vobis cor novum, et spiritum novum : et quare moriemini, domus Israël ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 18:32
verses.text: Quia nolo mortem morientis, dicit Dominus Deus : revertimini, et vivite.  <chapter eID="Ezek.18"/> <div eID="gen27426" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:1
verses.text: Et tu assume planctum super principes Israël,

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:2
verses.text: et dices : <div eID="gen27427" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27428"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27429"/>Quare mater tua leæna inter leones cubavit ? <l eID="gen27429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27430"/>in medio leunculorum enutrivit catulos suos ? <l eID="gen27430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10038"/><l level="1" sID="gen27431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10038"/>Et eduxit unum de leunculis suis, <l eID="gen27431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27432"/>et leo factus est : <l eID="gen27432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27433"/>et didicit capere prædam, <l eID="gen27433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27434"/>hominemque comedere. <l eID="gen27434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10039"/><l level="1" sID="gen27435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10039"/>Et audierunt de eo gentes : <l eID="gen27435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27436"/>et non absque vulneribus suis ceperunt eum, <l eID="gen27436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27437"/>et adduxerunt eum in catenis in terram Ægypti. <l eID="gen27437" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10040"/><l level="1" sID="gen27438"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10040"/>Quæ cum vidisset quoniam infirmata est, <l eID="gen27438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27439"/>et periit exspectatio ejus, <l eID="gen27439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27440"/>tulit unum de leunculis suis ; <l eID="gen27440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27441"/>leonem constituit eum. <l eID="gen27441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10041"/><l level="1" sID="gen27442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10041"/>Qui incedebat inter leones, <l eID="gen27442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27443"/>et factus est leo : <l eID="gen27443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27444"/>et didicit prædam capere, <l eID="gen27444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27445"/>et homines devorare : <l eID="gen27445" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10042"/><l level="1" sID="gen27446"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10042"/>didicit viduas facere, <l eID="gen27446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27447"/>et civitates earum in desertum adducere : <l eID="gen27447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27448"/>et desolata est terra et plenitudo ejus a voce rugitus illius. <l eID="gen27448" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10043"/><l level="1" sID="gen27449"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10043"/>Et convenerunt adversus eum gentes undique de provinciis, <l eID="gen27449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27450"/>et expanderunt super eum rete suum : <l eID="gen27450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27451"/>in vulneribus earum captus est, <l eID="gen27451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10044"/><l level="1" sID="gen27452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10044"/>et miserunt eum in caveam : <l eID="gen27452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27453"/>in catenis adduxerunt eum ad regem Babylonis, <l eID="gen27453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27454"/>miseruntque eum in carcerem, <l eID="gen27454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27455"/>ne audiretur vox ejus ultra super montes Israël. <l eID="gen27455" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:10
