verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10045"/><l level="1" sID="gen27456"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10045"/>Mater tua quasi vinea in sanguine tuo super aquam plantata est : <l eID="gen27456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27457"/>fructus ejus et frondes ejus creverunt ex aquis multis. <l eID="gen27457" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10046"/><l level="1" sID="gen27458"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10046"/>Et factæ sunt ei virgæ solidæ in sceptra dominantium, <l eID="gen27458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27459"/>et exaltata est statura ejus inter frondes, <l eID="gen27459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27460"/>et vidit altitudinem suam in multitudine palmitum suorum. <l eID="gen27460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10047"/><l level="1" sID="gen27461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10047"/>Et evulsa est in ira, in terramque projecta, <l eID="gen27461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27462"/>et ventus urens siccavit fructum ejus : <l eID="gen27462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27463"/>marcuerunt et arefactæ sunt virgæ roboris ejus : <l eID="gen27463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27464"/>ignis comedit eam. <l eID="gen27464" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10048"/><l level="1" sID="gen27465"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10048"/>Et nunc transplantata est in desertum, <l eID="gen27465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27466"/>in terra invia et sitienti. <l eID="gen27466" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 19:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10049"/><l level="1" sID="gen27467"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10049"/>Et egressus est ignis de virga ramorum ejus, <l eID="gen27467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27468"/>qui fructum ejus comedit : <l eID="gen27468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27469"/>et non fuit in ea virga fortis, <l eID="gen27469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27470"/>sceptrum dominantium. Planctus est, et erit in planctum. <l eID="gen27470" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27428"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.19"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:1
verses.text: Et factum est in anno septimo, in quinto, in decima mensis, venerunt viri de senioribus Israël ut interrogarent Dominum, et sederunt coram me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:2
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:3
verses.text: Fili hominis, loquere senioribus Israël, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Numquid ad interrogandum me vos venistis ? vivo ego quia non respondebo vobis, ait Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:4
verses.text: Si judicas eos, si judicas, fili hominis, abominationes patrum eorum ostende eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:5
verses.text: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : In die qua elegi Israël, et levavi manum meam pro stirpe domus Jacob, et apparui eis in terra Ægypti, et levavi manum meam pro eis, dicens : Ego Dominus Deus vester :

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:6
verses.text: in die illa levavi manum meam pro eis ut educerem eos de terra Ægypti, in terram quam provideram eis, fluentem lacte et melle, quæ est egregia inter omnes terras.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:7
verses.text: Et dixi ad eos : Unusquisque offensiones oculorum suorum abjiciat, et in idolis Ægypti nolite pollui : ego Dominus Deus vester.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:8
verses.text: Et irritaverunt me, nolueruntque me audire : unusquisque abominationes oculorum suorum non projecit, nec idola Ægypti reliquerunt. Et dixi ut effunderem indignationem meam super eos, et implerem iram meam in eis, in medio terræ Ægypti.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:9
verses.text: Et feci propter nomen meum, ut non violaretur coram gentibus in quarum medio erant, et inter quas apparui eis ut educerem eos de terra Ægypti.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:10
verses.text: Ejeci ergo eos de terra Ægypti, et eduxi eos in desertum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:11
verses.text: Et dedi eis præcepta mea, et judicia mea ostendi eis, quæ faciens homo vivet in eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:12
verses.text: Insuper et sabbata mea dedi eis, ut essent signum inter me et eos, et scirent quia ego Dominus sanctificans eos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:13
verses.text: Et irritaverunt me domus Israël in deserto : in præceptis meis non ambulaverunt, et judicia mea projecerunt, quæ faciens homo vivet in eis, et sabbata mea violaverunt vehementer. Dixi ergo ut effunderem furorem meum super eos in deserto, et consumerem eos :

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:14
verses.text: et feci propter nomen meum, ne violaretur coram gentibus de quibus ejeci eos in conspectu earum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:15
verses.text: Ego igitur levavi manum meam super eos in deserto, ne inducerem eos in terram quam dedi eis, fluentem lacte et melle, præcipuam terrarum omnium :

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:16
verses.text: quia judicia mea projecerunt, et in præceptis meis non ambulaverunt, et sabbata mea violaverunt : post idola enim cor eorum gradiebatur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:17
verses.text: Et pepercit oculus meus super eos, ut non interficerem eos : nec consumpsi eos in deserto.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:18
verses.text: Dixi autem ad filios eorum in solitudine : In præceptis patrum vestrorum nolite incedere, nec judicia eorum custodiatis, nec in idolis eorum polluamini.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:19
verses.text: Ego Dominus Deus vester : in præceptis meis ambulate : judicia mea custodite, et facite ea,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:20
verses.text: et sabbata mea sanctificate, ut sint signum inter me et vos, et sciatis quia ego sum Dominus Deus vester.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:21
verses.text: Et exacerbaverunt me filii : in præceptis meis non ambulaverunt, et judicia mea non custodierunt ut facerent ea, quæ cum fecerit homo, vivet in eis, et sabbata mea violaverunt. Et comminatus sum ut effunderem furorem meum super eos, et implerem iram meam in eis in deserto.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:22
verses.text: Averti autem manum meam, et feci propter nomen meum, ut non violaretur coram gentibus de quibus ejeci eos in oculis earum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:23
verses.text: Iterum levavi manum meam in eos in solitudine, ut dispergerem illos in nationes, et ventilarem in terras,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:24
verses.text: eo quod judicia mea non fecissent, et præcepta mea reprobassent, et sabbata mea violassent, et post idola patrum suorum fuissent oculi eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:25
verses.text: Ergo et ego dedi eis præcepta non bona, et judicia in quibus non vivent.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:26
verses.text: Et pollui eos in muneribus suis, cum offerrent omne quod aperit vulvam, propter delicta sua : et scient quia ego Dominus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:27
verses.text: Quam ob rem loquere ad domum Israël, fili hominis, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Adhuc et in hoc blasphemaverunt me patres vestri, cum sprevissent me contemnentes,

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:28
verses.text: et induxissem eos in terram super quam levavi manum meam ut darem eis : viderunt omnem collem excelsum, et omne lignum nemorosum, et immolaverunt ibi victimas suas, et dederunt ibi irritationem oblationis suæ, et posuerunt ibi odorem suavitatis suæ, et libaverunt libationes suas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:29
verses.text: Et dixi ad eos : Quid est excelsum, ad quod vos ingredimini ? et vocatum est nomen ejus Excelsum usque ad hanc diem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:30
verses.text: Propterea dic ad domum Israël : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Certe in via patrum vestrorum vos polluimini, et post offendicula eorum vos fornicamini :

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:31
verses.text: et in oblatione donorum vestrorum, cum traducitis filios vestros per ignem, vos polluimini in omnibus idolis vestris usque hodie : et ego respondebo vobis, domus Israël ? Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quia non respondebo vobis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:32
verses.text: Neque cogitatio mentis vestræ fiet, dicentium : Erimus sicut gentes et sicut cognationes terræ, ut colamus ligna et lapides.  <div eID="gen27471" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10050"/><div sID="gen27472" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10050"/>Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, quoniam in manu forti, et in brachio extento, et in furore effuso, regnabo super vos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:34
verses.text: Et educam vos de populis, et congregabo vos de terris in quibus dispersi estis : in manu valida, et in brachio extento, et in furore effuso, regnabo super vos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:35
verses.text: Et adducam vos in desertum populorum, et judicabor vobiscum ibi facie ad faciem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:36
verses.text: Sicut judicio contendi adversum patres vestros in deserto terræ Ægypti, sic judicabo vos, dicit Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:37
verses.text: Et subjiciam vos sceptro meo, et inducam vos in vinculis fœderis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:38
verses.text: Et eligam de vobis transgressores et impios, et de terra incolatus eorum educam eos, et in terram Israël non ingredientur : et scietis quia ego Dominus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:39
verses.text: Et vos, domus Israël, hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Singuli post idola vestra ambulate, et servite eis. Quod si et in hoc non audieritis me, et nomen meum sanctum pollueritis ultra in muneribus vestris et in idolis vestris :

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:40
verses.text: in monte sancto meo, in monte excelso Israël, ait Dominus Deus, ibi serviet mihi omnis domus Israël : omnes, inquam, in terra in qua placebunt mihi : et ibi quæram primitias vestras, et initium decimarum vestrarum, in omnibus sanctificationibus vestris.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:41
verses.text: In odorem suavitatis suscipiam vos, cum eduxero vos de populis, et congregavero vos de terris in quas dispersi estis : et sanctificabor in vobis in oculis nationum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:42
verses.text: Et scietis quia ego Dominus, cum induxero vos ad terram Israël, in terram pro qua levavi manum meam ut darem eam patribus vestris.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:43
verses.text: Et recordabimini ibi viarum vestrarum, et omnium scelerum vestrorum, quibus polluti estis in eis : et displicebitis vobis in conspectu vestro, in omnibus malitiis vestris quas fecistis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:44
verses.text: Et scietis quia ego Dominus, cum benefecero vobis propter nomen meum, et non secundum vias vestras malas, neque secundum scelera vestra pessima, domus Israël, ait Dominus Deus.  <div eID="gen27472" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10051"/><div sID="gen27473" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10051"/>Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen27473" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10052"/><lg sID="gen27474"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27475"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10052"/>Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra viam austri, <l eID="gen27475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27476"/>et stilla ad africum, <l eID="gen27476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27477"/>et propheta ad saltum agri meridiani. <l eID="gen27477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10053"/><l level="1" sID="gen27478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10053"/>Et dices saltui meridiano : <l eID="gen27478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27479"/>Audi verbum Domini : <l eID="gen27479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27480"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27481"/>Ecce ego succendam in te ignem, <l eID="gen27481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27482"/>et comburam in te omne lignum viride, <l eID="gen27482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27483"/>et omne lignum aridum : <l eID="gen27483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27484"/>non extinguetur flamma succensionis : <l eID="gen27484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27485"/>et comburetur in ea omnis facies <l eID="gen27485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27486"/>ab austro usque ad aquilonem, <l eID="gen27486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10054"/><l level="1" sID="gen27487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10054"/>et videbit universa caro quia ego Dominus succendi eam, <l eID="gen27487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27488"/>nec extinguetur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 20:49
verses.text: Et dixi : A, a, a, Domine Deus : ipsi dicunt de me : Numquid non per parabolas loquitur iste ? <l eID="gen27488" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27474"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.20"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen27489" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10055"/><lg sID="gen27490"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27491"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10055"/>Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam ad Jerusalem, <l eID="gen27491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27492"/>et stilla ad sanctuaria, <l eID="gen27492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27493"/>et propheta contra humum Israël. <l eID="gen27493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10056"/><l level="1" sID="gen27494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10056"/>Et dices terræ Israël : <l eID="gen27494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27495"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27496"/>Ecce ego ad te, <l eID="gen27496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27497"/>et ejiciam gladium meum de vagina sua, <l eID="gen27497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27498"/>et occidam in te justum et impium. <l eID="gen27498" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10057"/><l level="1" sID="gen27499"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10057"/>Pro eo autem quod occidi in te justum et impium, <l eID="gen27499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27500"/>idcirco egredietur gladius meus de vagina sua <l eID="gen27500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27501"/>ad omnem carnem, ab austro usque ad aquilonem : <l eID="gen27501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10058"/><l level="1" sID="gen27502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10058"/>ut sciat omnis caro quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen27502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27503"/>eduxi gladium meum de vagina sua irrevocabilem. <l eID="gen27503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10059"/><l level="1" sID="gen27504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10059"/>Et tu, fili hominis, ingemisce in contritione lumborum, <l eID="gen27504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27505"/>et in amaritudinibus ingemisce coram eis. <l eID="gen27505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10060"/><l level="1" sID="gen27506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10060"/>Cumque dixerint ad te : Quare tu gemis ? <l eID="gen27506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27507"/>dices : Pro auditu : <l eID="gen27507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27508"/>quia venit, et tabescet omne cor, <l eID="gen27508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27509"/>et dissolventur universæ manus, <l eID="gen27509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27510"/>et infirmabitur omnis spiritus, <l eID="gen27510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27511"/>et per cuncta genua fluent aquæ : <l eID="gen27511" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27512"/>ecce venit, et fiet, ait Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:8
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:9
verses.text: Fili hominis, propheta, et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : loquere : <l eID="gen27512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27513"/>Gladius, gladius exacutus est, et limatus : <l eID="gen27513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10061"/><l level="1" sID="gen27514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10061"/>ut cædat victimas, exacutus est : <l eID="gen27514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27515"/>ut splendeat, limatus est : <l eID="gen27515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27516"/>qui moves sceptrum filii mei, succidisti omne lignum. <l eID="gen27516" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10062"/><l level="1" sID="gen27517"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10062"/>Et dedi eum ad levigandum, ut teneatur manu : <l eID="gen27517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27518"/>iste exacutus est gladius, et iste limatus est, <l eID="gen27518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27519"/>ut sit in manu interficientis. <l eID="gen27519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10063"/><l level="1" sID="gen27520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10063"/>Clama et ulula, fili hominis, <l eID="gen27520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27521"/>quia hic factus est in populo meo, <l eID="gen27521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27522"/>hic in cunctis ducibus Israël qui fugerant : <l eID="gen27522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27523"/>gladio traditi sunt cum populo meo : <l eID="gen27523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27524"/>idcirco plaude super femur,

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:13
verses.text: quia probatus est : <l eID="gen27524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27525"/>et hoc, cum sceptrum subverterit, et non erit, <l eID="gen27525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27526"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27526" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10064"/><l level="1" sID="gen27527"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10064"/>Tu ergo, fili hominis, propheta, <l eID="gen27527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27528"/>et percute manu ad manum : <l eID="gen27528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27529"/>et duplicetur gladius, <l eID="gen27529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27530"/>ac triplicetur gladius interfectorum : <l eID="gen27530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27531"/>hic est gladius occisionis magnæ, <l eID="gen27531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27532"/>qui obstupescere eos facit <l eID="gen27532" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10065"/><l level="1" sID="gen27533"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10065"/>et corde tabescere, <l eID="gen27533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27534"/>et multiplicat ruinas. <l eID="gen27534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27535"/>In omnibus portis eorum dedi conturbationem gladii acuti, <l eID="gen27535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27536"/>et limati ad fulgendum, <l eID="gen27536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27537"/>amicti ad cædem. <l eID="gen27537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10066"/><l level="1" sID="gen27538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10066"/>Exacuere, vade ad dexteram sive ad sinistram, <l eID="gen27538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27539"/>quocumque faciei tuæ est appetitus. <l eID="gen27539" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10067"/><l level="1" sID="gen27540"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10067"/>Quin et ego plaudam manu ad manum, <l eID="gen27540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27541"/>et implebo indignationem meam : <l eID="gen27541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27542"/>ego Dominus locutus sum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:18
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:19
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, pone tibi duas vias, ut veniat gladius regis Babylonis : de terra una egredientur ambæ : et manu capiet conjecturam ; in capite viæ civitatis conjiciet.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:20
verses.text: Viam pones ut veniat gladius ad Rabbath filiorum Ammon, et ad Judam in Jerusalem munitissimam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:21
verses.text: Stetit enim rex Babylonis in bivio, in capite duarum viarum, divinationem quærens, commiscens sagittas : interrogavit idola, exta consuluit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:22
verses.text: Ad dexteram ejus facta est divinatio super Jerusalem, ut ponat arietes, ut aperiat os in cæde, ut elevet vocem in ululatu, ut ponat arietes contra portas, ut comportet aggerem, ut ædificet munitiones.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:23
verses.text: Eritque quasi consulens frustra oraculum in oculis eorum, et sabbatorum otium imitans : ipse autem recordabitur iniquitatis ad capiendum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:24
verses.text: Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pro eo quod recordati estis iniquitatis vestræ, et revelastis prævaricationes vestras, et apparuerunt peccata vestra in omnibus cogitationibus vestris, pro eo, inquam, quod recordati estis, manu capiemini.

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:25
verses.text: Tu autem, profane, impie dux Israël, cujus venit dies in tempore iniquitatis præfinita :

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:26
verses.text: hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Aufer cidarim, tolle coronam : nonne hæc est quæ humilem sublevavit, et sublimem humiliavit ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:27
verses.text: Iniquitatem, iniquitatem, iniquitatem ponam eam : et hoc non factum est, donec veniret cujus est judicium, et tradam ei. <l eID="gen27542" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen27490"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10068"/><div sID="gen27543" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10068"/>Et tu, fili hominis, propheta, et dic : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus ad filios Ammon, et ad opprobrium eorum : et dices : <div eID="gen27543" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27544"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27545"/>Mucro, mucro, evaginate ad occidendum : <l eID="gen27545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27546"/>limate ut interficias et fulgeas : <l eID="gen27546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10069"/><l level="1" sID="gen27547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10069"/>cum tibi viderentur vana, <l eID="gen27547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27548"/>et divinarentur mendacia, <l eID="gen27548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27549"/>ut dareris super colla vulneratorum impiorum, <l eID="gen27549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27550"/>quorum venit dies in tempore iniquitatis præfinita. <l eID="gen27550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10070"/><l level="1" sID="gen27551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10070"/>Revertere ad vaginam tuam, <l eID="gen27551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27552"/>in loco in quo creatus es : <l eID="gen27552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27553"/>in terra nativitatis tuæ judicabo te. <l eID="gen27553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10071"/><l level="1" sID="gen27554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10071"/>Et effundam super te indignationem meam ; <l eID="gen27554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27555"/>in igne furoris mei sufflabo in te : <l eID="gen27555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27556"/>daboque te in manus hominum insipientium, <l eID="gen27556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27557"/>et fabricantium interitum. <l eID="gen27557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 21:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10072"/><l level="1" sID="gen27558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10072"/>Igni eris cibus ; <l eID="gen27558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27559"/>sanguis tuus erit in medio terræ ; <l eID="gen27559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27560"/>oblivioni traderis : <l eID="gen27560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27561"/>quia ego Dominus locutus sum. <l eID="gen27561" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27544"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.21"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:2
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, nonne judicas, nonne judicas civitatem sanguinum ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:3
verses.text: Et ostendes ei omnes abominationes suas, et dices : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Civitas effundens sanguinem in medio sui, ut veniat tempus ejus : et quæ fecit idola contra semetipsam, ut pollueretur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:4
verses.text: In sanguine tuo, qui a te effusus est, deliquisti, et in idolis tuis, quæ fecisti, polluta es : et appropinquare fecisti dies tuos, et adduxisti tempus annorum tuorum : propterea dedi te opprobrium gentibus, et irrisionem universis terris.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:5
verses.text: Quæ juxta sunt, et quæ procul a te, triumphabunt de te, sordida, nobilis, grandis interitu.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:6
verses.text: Ecce principes Israël singuli in brachio suo fuerunt in te, ad effundendum sanguinem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:7
verses.text: Patrem et matrem contumeliis affecerunt : in te advenam calumniati sunt in medio tui : pupillum et viduam contristaverunt apud te.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:8
verses.text: Sanctuaria mea sprevisti, et sabbata mea polluisti.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:9
verses.text: Viri detractores fuerunt in te ad effundendum sanguinem, et super montes comederunt in te : scelus operati sunt in medio tui.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:10
verses.text: Verecundiora patris discooperuerunt in te ; immunditiam menstruatæ humiliaverunt in te :

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:11
verses.text: et unusquisque in uxorem proximi sui operatus est abominationem, et socer nurum suam polluit nefarie : frater sororem suam, filiam patris sui, oppressit in te.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:12
verses.text: Munera acceperunt apud te ad effundendum sanguinem : usuram et superabundantiam accepisti, et avare proximos tuos calumniabaris : meique oblita es, ait Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:13
verses.text: Ecce complosi manus meas super avaritiam tuam quam fecisti, et super sanguinem qui effusus est in medio tui.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:14
verses.text: Numquid sustinebit cor tuum, aut prævalebunt manus tuæ, in diebus quos ego faciam tibi ? Ego Dominus locutus sum, et faciam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:15
verses.text: Et dispergam te in nationes, et ventilabo te in terras, et deficere faciam immunditiam tuam a te.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:16
verses.text: Et possidebo te in conspectu gentium : et scies quia ego Dominus.  <div eID="gen27562" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10073"/><div sID="gen27563" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10073"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:18
verses.text: Fili hominis, versa est mihi domus Israël in scoriam : omnes isti æs, et stannum, et ferrum, et plumbum in medio fornacis : scoria argenti facti sunt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:19
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Eo quod versi estis omnes in scoriam, propterea ecce ego congregabo vos in medio Jerusalem,

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:20
verses.text: congregatione argenti, et æris, et stanni, et ferri, et plumbi, in medio fornacis, ut succendam in ea ignem ad conflandum. Sic congregabo in furore meo, et in ira mea : et requiescam, et conflabo vos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:21
verses.text: Et congregabo vos, et succendam vos in igne furoris mei, et conflabimini in medio ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:22
verses.text: Ut conflatur argentum in medio fornacis, sic eritis in medio ejus : et scietis quia ego Dominus cum effuderim indignationem meam super vos.  <div eID="gen27563" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10074"/><div sID="gen27564" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10074"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:24
verses.text: Fili hominis, dic ei : Tu es terra immunda, et non compluta in die furoris.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:25
verses.text: Conjuratio prophetarum in medio ejus : sicut leo rugiens, rapiensque prædam, animas devoraverunt : opes et pretium acceperunt : viduas ejus multiplicaverunt in medio illius.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:26
verses.text: Sacerdotes ejus contempserunt legem meam, et polluerunt sanctuaria mea : inter sanctum et profanum non habuerunt distantiam, et inter pollutum et mundum non intellexerunt : et a sabbatis meis averterunt oculos suos, et coinquinabar in medio eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:27
verses.text: Principes ejus in medio illius quasi lupi rapientes prædam ad effundendum sanguinem, et ad perdendas animas, et avare ad sectanda lucra.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:28
verses.text: Prophetæ autem ejus liniebant eos absque temperamento, videntes vana, et divinantes eis mendacium, dicentes : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : cum Dominus non sit locutus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:29
verses.text: Populi terræ calumniabantur calumniam, et rapiebant violenter : egenum et pauperem affligebant, et advenam opprimebant calumnia absque judicio.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:30
verses.text: Et quæsivi de eis virum qui interponeret sepem, et staret oppositus contra me pro terra, ne dissiparem eam : et non inveni.

verses.name: Ezekiel 22:31
verses.text: Et effudi super eos indignationem meam ; in igne iræ meæ consumpsi eos : viam eorum in caput eorum reddidi, ait Dominus Deus.  <chapter eID="Ezek.22"/> <div eID="gen27564" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen27565" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10075"/><lg sID="gen27566"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27567"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10075"/>Fili hominis, duæ mulieres filiæ matris unius fuerunt : <l eID="gen27567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10076"/><l level="1" sID="gen27568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10076"/>et fornicatæ sunt in Ægypto, <l eID="gen27568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27569"/>in adolescentia sua fornicatæ sunt : <l eID="gen27569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27570"/>ibi subacta sunt ubera earum, <l eID="gen27570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27571"/>et fractæ sunt mammæ pubertatis earum. <l eID="gen27571" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10077"/><l level="1" sID="gen27572"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10077"/>Nomina autem earum, <l eID="gen27572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27573"/>Oolla major, et Ooliba soror ejus minor : <l eID="gen27573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27574"/>et habui eas, et pepererunt filios et filias. <l eID="gen27574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27575"/>Porro earum nomina, <l eID="gen27575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27576"/>Samaria Oolla, et Jerusalem Ooliba. <l eID="gen27576" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10078"/><l level="1" sID="gen27577"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10078"/>Fornicata est igitur super me Oolla, <l eID="gen27577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27578"/>et insanivit in amatores suos, <l eID="gen27578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27579"/>in Assyrios propinquantes, <l eID="gen27579" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10079"/><l level="1" sID="gen27580"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10079"/>vestitos hyacintho, <l eID="gen27580" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27581"/>principes et magistratus, <l eID="gen27581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27582"/>juvenes cupidinis, <l eID="gen27582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27583"/>universos equites, ascensores equorum. <l eID="gen27583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10080"/><l level="1" sID="gen27584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10080"/>Et dedit fornicationes suas super eos electos, <l eID="gen27584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27585"/>filios Assyriorum universos : <l eID="gen27585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27586"/>et in omnibus in quos insanivit, <l eID="gen27586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27587"/>in immunditiis eorum polluta est. <l eID="gen27587" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10081"/><l level="1" sID="gen27588"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10081"/>Insuper et fornicationes suas, quas habuerat in Ægypto, non reliquit : <l eID="gen27588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27589"/>nam et illi dormierunt cum ea in adolescentia ejus, <l eID="gen27589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27590"/>et illi confregerunt ubera pubertatis ejus, <l eID="gen27590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27591"/>et effuderunt fornicationem suam super eam. <l eID="gen27591" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10082"/><l level="1" sID="gen27592"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10082"/>Propterea tradidi eam in manus amatorum suorum, <l eID="gen27592" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27593"/>in manus filiorum Assur, <l eID="gen27593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27594"/>super quorum insanivit libidine. <l eID="gen27594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10083"/><l level="1" sID="gen27595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10083"/>Ipsi discooperuerunt ignominiam ejus, <l eID="gen27595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27596"/>filios et filias ejus tulerunt, <l eID="gen27596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27597"/>et ipsam occiderunt gladio : <l eID="gen27597" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27598"/>et factæ sunt famosæ mulieres, <l eID="gen27598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27599"/>et judicia perpetraverunt in ea. <l eID="gen27599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10084"/><l level="1" sID="gen27600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10084"/>Quod cum vidisset soror ejus Ooliba, <l eID="gen27600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27601"/>plus quam illa insanivit libidine, <l eID="gen27601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27602"/>et fornicationem suam super fornicationem sororis suæ : <l eID="gen27602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10085"/><l level="1" sID="gen27603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10085"/>ad filios Assyriorum præbuit impudenter, <l eID="gen27603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27604"/>ducibus et magistratibus ad se venientibus, <l eID="gen27604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27605"/>indutis veste varia, <l eID="gen27605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27606"/>equitibus qui vectabantur equis, <l eID="gen27606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27607"/>et adolescentibus forma cunctis egregia. <l eID="gen27607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10086"/><l level="1" sID="gen27608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10086"/>Et vidi quod polluta esset via una ambarum. <l eID="gen27608" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10087"/><l level="1" sID="gen27609"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10087"/>Et auxit fornicationes suas : <l eID="gen27609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27610"/>cumque vidisset viros depictos in pariete, <l eID="gen27610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27611"/>imagines Chaldæorum expressas coloribus, <l eID="gen27611" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10088"/><l level="1" sID="gen27612"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10088"/>et accinctos balteis renes, <l eID="gen27612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27613"/>et tiaras tinctas in capitibus eorum, <l eID="gen27613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27614"/>formam ducum omnium, <l eID="gen27614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27615"/>similitudinem filiorum Babylonis, <l eID="gen27615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27616"/>terræque Chaldæorum, in qua orti sunt, <l eID="gen27616" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10089"/><l level="1" sID="gen27617"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10089"/>insanivit super eos concupiscentia oculorum suorum, <l eID="gen27617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27618"/>et misit nuntios ad eos in Chaldæam. <l eID="gen27618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10090"/><l level="1" sID="gen27619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10090"/>Cumque venissent ad eam filii Babylonis ad cubile mammarum, <l eID="gen27619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27620"/>polluerunt eam stupris suis : <l eID="gen27620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27621"/>et polluta est ab eis, <l eID="gen27621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27622"/>et saturata est anima ejus ab illis. <l eID="gen27622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10091"/><l level="1" sID="gen27623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10091"/>Denudavit quoque fornicationes suas, <l eID="gen27623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27624"/>et discooperuit ignominiam suam : <l eID="gen27624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27625"/>et recessit anima mea ab ea, <l eID="gen27625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27626"/>sicut recesserat anima mea a sorore ejus : <l eID="gen27626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10092"/><l level="1" sID="gen27627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10092"/>multiplicavit enim fornicationes suas, <l eID="gen27627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27628"/>recordans dies adolescentiæ suæ, <l eID="gen27628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27629"/>quibus fornicata est in terra Ægypti. <l eID="gen27629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10093"/><l level="1" sID="gen27630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10093"/>Et insanivit libidine super concubitum eorum, <l eID="gen27630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27631"/>quorum carnes sunt ut carnes asinorum, <l eID="gen27631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27632"/>et sicut fluxus equorum fluxus eorum. <l eID="gen27632" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10094"/><l level="1" sID="gen27633"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10094"/>Et visitasti scelus adolescentiæ tuæ, <l eID="gen27633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27634"/>quando subacta sunt in Ægypto ubera tua, <l eID="gen27634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27635"/>et confractæ sunt mammæ pubertatis tuæ. <l eID="gen27635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10095"/><l level="1" sID="gen27636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10095"/>Propterea, Ooliba, hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27637"/>Ecce ego suscitabo omnes amatores tuos contra te, <l eID="gen27637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27638"/>de quibus satiata est anima tua, <l eID="gen27638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27639"/>et congregabo eos adversum te in circuitu : <l eID="gen27639" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10096"/><l level="1" sID="gen27640"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10096"/>filios Babylonis, et universos Chaldæos, <l eID="gen27640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27641"/>nobiles, tyrannosque, et principes, <l eID="gen27641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27642"/>omnes filios Assyriorum, <l eID="gen27642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27643"/>juvenes forma egregia, <l eID="gen27643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27644"/>duces et magistratus universos, <l eID="gen27644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27645"/>principes principum, et nominatos ascensores equorum : <l eID="gen27645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10097"/><l level="1" sID="gen27646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10097"/>et venient super te instructi curru et rota, <l eID="gen27646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27647"/>multitudo populorum : <l eID="gen27647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27648"/>lorica, et clypeo, et galea armabuntur contra te undique : <l eID="gen27648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27649"/>et dabo coram eis judicium, <l eID="gen27649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27650"/>et judicabunt te judiciis suis. <l eID="gen27650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10098"/><l level="1" sID="gen27651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10098"/>Et ponam zelum meum in te, <l eID="gen27651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27652"/>quem exercent tecum in furore : <l eID="gen27652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27653"/>nasum tuum et aures tuas præcident, <l eID="gen27653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27654"/>et quæ remanserint, gladio concident. <l eID="gen27654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27655"/>Ipsi filios tuos et filias tuas capient, <l eID="gen27655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27656"/>et novissimum tuum devorabitur igni : <l eID="gen27656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10099"/><l level="1" sID="gen27657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10099"/>et denudabunt te vestimentis tuis, <l eID="gen27657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27658"/>et tollent vasa gloriæ tuæ. <l eID="gen27658" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10100"/><l level="1" sID="gen27659"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10100"/>Et requiescere faciam scelus tuum de te, <l eID="gen27659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27660"/>et fornicationem tuam de terra Ægypti : <l eID="gen27660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27661"/>nec levabis oculos tuos ad eos, <l eID="gen27661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27662"/>et Ægypti non recordaberis amplius. <l eID="gen27662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10101"/><l level="1" sID="gen27663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10101"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27664"/>Ecce ego tradam te in manus eorum quos odisti, <l eID="gen27664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27665"/>in manus de quibus satiata est anima tua. <l eID="gen27665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10102"/><l level="1" sID="gen27666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10102"/>Et agent tecum in odio, <l eID="gen27666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27667"/>et tollent omnes labores tuos, <l eID="gen27667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27668"/>et dimittent te nudam et ignominia plenam : <l eID="gen27668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27669"/>et revelabitur ignominia fornicationum tuarum, <l eID="gen27669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27670"/>scelus tuum, et fornicationes tuæ. <l eID="gen27670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10103"/><l level="1" sID="gen27671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10103"/>Fecerunt hæc tibi, <l eID="gen27671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27672"/>quia fornicata es post gentes <l eID="gen27672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27673"/>inter quas polluta es in idolis earum. <l eID="gen27673" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10104"/><l level="1" sID="gen27674"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10104"/>In via sororis tuæ ambulasti, <l eID="gen27674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27675"/>et dabo calicem ejus in manu tua. <l eID="gen27675" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10105"/><l level="1" sID="gen27676"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10105"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27676" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27677"/>Calicem sororis tuæ bibes profundum et latum : <l eID="gen27677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27678"/>eris in derisum et in subsannationem quæ est capacissima. <l eID="gen27678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10106"/><l level="1" sID="gen27679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10106"/>Ebrietate et dolore repleberis : <l eID="gen27679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27680"/>calice mœroris et tristitiæ, <l eID="gen27680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27681"/>calice sororis tuæ Samariæ. <l eID="gen27681" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10107"/><l level="1" sID="gen27682"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10107"/>Et bibes illum, et epotabis usque ad fæces : <l eID="gen27682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27683"/>et fragmenta ejus devorabis, <l eID="gen27683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27684"/>et ubera tua lacerabis, <l eID="gen27684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27685"/>quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10108"/><l level="1" sID="gen27686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10108"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27687"/>Quia oblita es mei, <l eID="gen27687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27688"/>et projecisti me post corpus tuum, <l eID="gen27688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27689"/>tu quoque porta scelus tuum et fornicationes tuas. <l eID="gen27689" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen27566"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10109"/><div sID="gen27690" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10109"/>Et ait Dominus ad me, dicens : <div eID="gen27690" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27691"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27692"/>Fili hominis, numquid judicas Oollam et Oolibam, <l eID="gen27692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27693"/>et annuntias eis scelera earum ? <l eID="gen27693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10110"/><l level="1" sID="gen27694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10110"/>Quia adulteratæ sunt, et sanguis in manibus earum, <l eID="gen27694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27695"/>et cum idolis suis fornicatæ sunt : <l eID="gen27695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27696"/>insuper et filios suos quos genuerunt mihi, <l eID="gen27696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27697"/>obtulerunt eis ad devorandum. <l eID="gen27697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10111"/><l level="1" sID="gen27698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10111"/>Sed et hoc fecerunt mihi : <l eID="gen27698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27699"/>polluerunt sanctuarium meum in die illa, <l eID="gen27699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27700"/>et sabbata mea profanaverunt. <l eID="gen27700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:39
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10112"/><l level="1" sID="gen27701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10112"/>Cumque immolarent filios suos idolis suis, <l eID="gen27701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27702"/>et ingrederentur sanctuarium meum in die illa ut polluerent illud, <l eID="gen27702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27703"/>etiam hæc fecerunt in medio domus meæ. <l eID="gen27703" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:40
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10113"/><l level="1" sID="gen27704"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10113"/>Miserunt ad viros venientes de longe, <l eID="gen27704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27705"/>ad quos nuntium miserant : <l eID="gen27705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27706"/>itaque ecce venerunt quibus te lavisti, <l eID="gen27706" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27707"/>et circumlinisti stibio oculos tuos, <l eID="gen27707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27708"/>et ornata es mundo muliebri. <l eID="gen27708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:41
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10114"/><l level="1" sID="gen27709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10114"/>Sedisti in lecto pulcherrimo, <l eID="gen27709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27710"/>et mensa ornata est ante te : <l eID="gen27710" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27711"/>thymiama meum et unguentum meum posuisti super eam. <l eID="gen27711" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:42
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10115"/><l level="1" sID="gen27712"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10115"/>Et vox multitudinis exsultantis erat in ea : <l eID="gen27712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27713"/>et in viris, qui de multitudine hominum adducebantur, <l eID="gen27713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27714"/>et veniebant de deserto, <l eID="gen27714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27715"/>posuerunt armillas in manibus eorum, <l eID="gen27715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27716"/>et coronas speciosas in capitibus eorum. <l eID="gen27716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:43
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10116"/><l level="1" sID="gen27717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10116"/>Et dixi ei, quæ attrita est in adulteriis : <l eID="gen27717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27718"/>Nunc fornicabitur in fornicatione sua etiam hæc. <l eID="gen27718" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:44
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10117"/><l level="1" sID="gen27719"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10117"/>Et ingressi sunt ad eam quasi ad mulierem meretricem : <l eID="gen27719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27720"/>sic ingrediebantur ad Oollam et Oolibam, mulieres nefarias. <l eID="gen27720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:45
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10118"/><l level="1" sID="gen27721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10118"/>Viri ergo justi sunt : <l eID="gen27721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27722"/>hi judicabunt eas judicio adulterarum, <l eID="gen27722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27723"/>et judicio effundentium sanguinem : <l eID="gen27723" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27724"/>quia adulteræ sunt, <l eID="gen27724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27725"/>et sanguis in manibus earum. <l eID="gen27725" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:46
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10119"/><l level="1" sID="gen27726"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10119"/>Hæc enim dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27727"/>Adduc ad eas multitudinem, <l eID="gen27727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27728"/>et trade eas in tumultum et in rapinam. <l eID="gen27728" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:47
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10120"/><l level="1" sID="gen27729"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10120"/>Et lapidentur lapidibus populorum, <l eID="gen27729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27730"/>et confodiantur gladiis eorum : <l eID="gen27730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27731"/>filios et filias earum interficient, <l eID="gen27731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27732"/>et domos earum igne succendent. <l eID="gen27732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:48
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10121"/><l level="1" sID="gen27733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10121"/>Et auferam scelus de terra, <l eID="gen27733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27734"/>et discent omnes mulieres ne faciant secundum scelus earum. <l eID="gen27734" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 23:49
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10122"/><l level="1" sID="gen27735"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10122"/>Et dabunt scelus vestrum super vos, <l eID="gen27735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27736"/>et peccata idolorum vestrorum portabitis : <l eID="gen27736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27737"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27737" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27691"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.23"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me in anno nono, in mense decimo, decima die mensis, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, scribe tibi nomen diei hujus, in qua confirmatus est rex Babylonis adversum Jerusalem hodie.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:3
verses.text: Et dices per proverbium ad domum irritatricem parabolam, et loqueris ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Pone ollam ; pone, inquam, et mitte in eam aquam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:4
verses.text: Congere frusta ejus in eam, omnem partem bonam, femur et armum, electa et ossibus plena.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:5
verses.text: Pinguissimum pecus assume, compone quoque strues ossium sub ea : efferbuit coctio ejus, et discocta sunt ossa illius in medio ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:6
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Væ civitati sanguinum, ollæ cujus rubigo in ea est, et rubigo ejus non exivit de ea ! per partes et per partes suas ejice eam : non cecidit super eam sors.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:7
verses.text: Sanguis enim ejus in medio ejus est ; super limpidissimam petram effudit illum : non effudit illum super terram, ut possit operiri pulvere.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:8
verses.text: Ut superinducerem indignationem meam, et vindicta ulciscerer, dedi sanguinem ejus super petram limpidissimam, ne operiretur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:9
verses.text: Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Væ civitati sanguinum, cujus ego grandem faciam pyram !

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:10
verses.text: Congere ossa, quæ igne succendam : consumentur carnes, et coquetur universa compositio, et ossa tabescent.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:11
verses.text: Pone quoque eam super prunas vacuam, ut incalescat, et liquefiat æs ejus, et confletur in medio ejus inquinamentum ejus, et consumatur rubigo ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:12
verses.text: Multo labore sudatum est, et non exivit de ea nimia rubigo ejus, neque per ignem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:13
verses.text: Immunditia tua execrabilis, quia mundare te volui, et non es mundata a sordibus tuis : sed nec mundaberis prius, donec quiescere faciam indignationem meam in te.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:14
verses.text: Ego Dominus locutus sum : veniet, et faciam : non transeam, nec parcam, nec placabor : juxta vias tuas, et juxta adinventiones tuas judicabo te, dicit Dominus.  <div eID="gen27738" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10123"/><div sID="gen27739" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10123"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:16
verses.text: Fili hominis, ecce ego tollo a te desiderabile oculorum tuorum in plaga : et non planges, neque plorabis, neque fluent lacrimæ tuæ.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:17
verses.text: Ingemisce tacens : mortuorum luctum non facies : corona tua circumligata sit tibi, et calceamenta tua erunt in pedibus tuis : nec amictu ora velabis, nec cibos lugentium comedes.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:18
verses.text: Locutus sum ergo ad populum mane, et mortua est uxor mea vespere : fecique mane sicut præceperat mihi.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:19
verses.text: Et dixit ad me populus : Quare non indicas nobis quid ista significent quæ tu facis ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:20
verses.text: Et dixi ad eos : Sermo Domini factus est ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:21
verses.text: Loquere domui Israël : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego polluam sanctuarium meum, superbiam imperii vestri, et desiderabile oculorum vestrorum, et super quo pavet anima vestra : filii vestri et filiæ vestræ quas reliquistis, gladio cadent.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:22
verses.text: Et facietis sicut feci : ora amictu non velabitis, et cibos lugentium non comedetis :

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:23
verses.text: coronas habebitis in capitibus vestris, et calceamenta in pedibus : non plangetis, neque flebitis, sed tabescetis in iniquitatibus vestris, et unusquisque gemet ad fratrem suum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:24
verses.text: Eritque Ezechiel vobis in portentum : juxta omnia quæ fecit, facietis cum venerit istud : et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:25
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, ecce in die qua tollam ab eis fortitudinem eorum, et gaudium dignitatis, et desiderium oculorum eorum, super quo requiescunt animæ eorum, filios et filias eorum :

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:26
verses.text: in die illa, cum venerit fugiens ad te ut annuntiet tibi :

verses.name: Ezekiel 24:27
verses.text: in die, inquam illa, aperietur os tuum cum eo qui fugit, et loqueris, et non silebis ultra : erisque eis in portentum, et scietis quia ego Dominus.  <chapter eID="Ezek.24"/> <div eID="gen27739" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra filios Ammon, et prophetabis de eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:3
verses.text: Et dices filiis Ammon : <div eID="gen27740" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27741"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27742"/>Audite verbum Domini Dei. <l eID="gen27742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27743"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27744"/>Pro eo quod dixisti : Euge, euge, <l eID="gen27744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27745"/>super sanctuarium meum, quia pollutum est ; <l eID="gen27745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27746"/>et super terram Israël, quoniam desolata est ; <l eID="gen27746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27747"/>et super domum Juda, quoniam ducti sunt in captivitatem : <l eID="gen27747" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10124"/><l level="1" sID="gen27748"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10124"/>idcirco ego tradam te filiis orientalibus in hæreditatem : <l eID="gen27748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27749"/>et collocabunt caulas suas in te, <l eID="gen27749" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27750"/>et ponent in te tentoria sua : <l eID="gen27750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27751"/>ipsi comedent fruges tuas, <l eID="gen27751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27752"/>et ipsi bibent lac tuum. <l eID="gen27752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10125"/><l level="1" sID="gen27753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10125"/>Daboque Rabbath in habitaculum camelorum, <l eID="gen27753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27754"/>et filios Ammon in cubile pecorum : <l eID="gen27754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27755"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10126"/><l level="1" sID="gen27756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10126"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27757"/>Pro eo quod plausisti manu et percussisti pede, <l eID="gen27757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27758"/>et gavisa es ex toto affectu super terram Israël, <l eID="gen27758" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10127"/><l level="1" sID="gen27759"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10127"/>idcirco ecce ego extendam manum meam super te, <l eID="gen27759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27760"/>et tradam te in direptionem gentium, <l eID="gen27760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27761"/>et interficiam te de populis, <l eID="gen27761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27762"/>et perdam de terris, et conteram : <l eID="gen27762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27763"/>et scies quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10128"/><l level="1" sID="gen27764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10128"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27765"/>Pro eo quod dixerunt Moab et Seir : <l eID="gen27765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27766"/>Ecce sicut omnes gentes, domus Juda : <l eID="gen27766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10129"/><l level="1" sID="gen27767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10129"/>idcirco ecce ego aperiam humerum Moab de civitatibus, <l eID="gen27767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27768"/>de civitatibus, inquam, ejus, et de finibus ejus, <l eID="gen27768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27769"/>inclytas terræ Bethiesimoth, et Beelmeon, et Cariathaim, <l eID="gen27769" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10130"/><l level="1" sID="gen27770"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10130"/>filiis orientis cum filiis Ammon, <l eID="gen27770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27771"/>et dabo eam in hæreditatem, <l eID="gen27771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27772"/>ut non sit ultra memoria filiorum Ammon in gentibus. <l eID="gen27772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10131"/><l level="1" sID="gen27773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10131"/>Et in Moab faciam judicia, <l eID="gen27773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27774"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27774" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10132"/><l level="1" sID="gen27775"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10132"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27776"/>Pro eo quod fecit Idumæa ultionem ut se vindicaret de filiis Juda, <l eID="gen27776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27777"/>peccavitque delinquens, <l eID="gen27777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27778"/>et vindictam expetivit de eis : <l eID="gen27778" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10133"/><l level="1" sID="gen27779"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10133"/>idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27780"/>Extendam manum meam super Idumæam, <l eID="gen27780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27781"/>et auferam de ea hominem et jumentum, <l eID="gen27781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27782"/>et faciam eam desertam ab austro : <l eID="gen27782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27783"/>et qui sunt in Dedan, gladio cadent. <l eID="gen27783" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10134"/><l level="1" sID="gen27784"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10134"/>Et dabo ultionem meam super Idumæam <l eID="gen27784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27785"/>per manum populi mei Israël : <l eID="gen27785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27786"/>et facient in Edom juxta iram meam et furorem meum, <l eID="gen27786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27787"/>et scient vindictam meam, <l eID="gen27787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27788"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10135"/><l level="1" sID="gen27789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10135"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27790"/>Pro eo quod fecerunt Palæstini vindictam, <l eID="gen27790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27791"/>et ulti se sunt toto animo, <l eID="gen27791" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27792"/>interficientes, et implentes inimicitias veteres, <l eID="gen27792" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10136"/><l level="1" sID="gen27793"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10136"/>propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27793" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27794"/>Ecce ego extendam manum meam super Palæstinos, <l eID="gen27794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27795"/>et interficiam interfectores, <l eID="gen27795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27796"/>et perdam reliquias maritimæ regionis, <l eID="gen27796" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 25:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10137"/><l level="1" sID="gen27797"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10137"/>faciamque in eis ultiones magnas, <l eID="gen27797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27798"/>arguens in furore : <l eID="gen27798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27799"/>et scient quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen27799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27800"/>cum dedero vindictam meam super eos. <l eID="gen27800" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27741"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.25"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:1
verses.text: Et factum est in undecimo anno, prima mensis : factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen27801" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10138"/><lg sID="gen27802"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10138"/>Fili hominis, pro eo quod dixit Tyrus de Jerusalem : <l eID="gen27803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27804"/>Euge, confractæ sunt portæ populorum, <l eID="gen27804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27805"/>conversa est ad me : <l eID="gen27805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27806"/>implebor ; deserta est : <l eID="gen27806" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10139"/><l level="1" sID="gen27807"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10139"/>propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27807" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27808"/>Ecce ego super te, Tyre, <l eID="gen27808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27809"/>et ascendere faciam ad te gentes multas, <l eID="gen27809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27810"/>sicut ascendit mare fluctuans. <l eID="gen27810" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10140"/><l level="1" sID="gen27811"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10140"/>Et dissipabunt muros Tyri, <l eID="gen27811" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27812"/>et destruent turres ejus : <l eID="gen27812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27813"/>et radam pulverem ejus de ea, <l eID="gen27813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27814"/>et dabo eam in limpidissimam petram. <l eID="gen27814" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10141"/><l level="1" sID="gen27815"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10141"/>Siccatio sagenarum erit in medio maris, <l eID="gen27815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27816"/>quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27817"/>et erit in direptionem gentibus. <l eID="gen27817" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10142"/><l level="1" sID="gen27818"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10142"/>Filiæ quoque ejus quæ sunt in agro, <l eID="gen27818" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27819"/>gladio interficientur : <l eID="gen27819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27820"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen27820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10143"/><l level="1" sID="gen27821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10143"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27822"/>Ecce ego adducam ad Tyrum <l eID="gen27822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27823"/>Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis ab aquilone, <l eID="gen27823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27824"/>regem regum, <l eID="gen27824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27825"/>cum equis, et curribus, et equitibus, <l eID="gen27825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27826"/>et cœtu, populoque magno. <l eID="gen27826" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10144"/><l level="1" sID="gen27827"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10144"/>Filias tuas quæ sunt in agro, gladio interficiet, <l eID="gen27827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27828"/>et circumdabit te munitionibus, <l eID="gen27828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27829"/>et comportabit aggerem in gyro, <l eID="gen27829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27830"/>et elevabit contra te clypeum : <l eID="gen27830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10145"/><l level="1" sID="gen27831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10145"/>et vineas et arietes temperabit in muros tuos, <l eID="gen27831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27832"/>et turres tuas destruet in armatura sua. <l eID="gen27832" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10146"/><l level="1" sID="gen27833"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10146"/>Inundatione equorum ejus operiet te pulvis eorum : <l eID="gen27833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27834"/>a sonitu equitum, et rotarum, et curruum, movebuntur muri tui, <l eID="gen27834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27835"/>cum ingressus fuerit portas tuas quasi per introitum urbis dissipatæ. <l eID="gen27835" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10147"/><l level="1" sID="gen27836"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10147"/>Ungulis equorum suorum conculcabit omnes plateas tuas : <l eID="gen27836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27837"/>populum tuum gladio cædet, <l eID="gen27837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27838"/>et statuæ tuæ nobiles in terram corruent. <l eID="gen27838" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10148"/><l level="1" sID="gen27839"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10148"/>Vastabunt opes tuas, <l eID="gen27839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27840"/>diripient negotiationes tuas, <l eID="gen27840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27841"/>et destruent muros tuos, <l eID="gen27841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27842"/>et domos tuas præclaras subvertent : <l eID="gen27842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27843"/>et lapides tuos, et ligna tua, et pulverem tuum <l eID="gen27843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27844"/>in medio aquarum ponent. <l eID="gen27844" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10149"/><l level="1" sID="gen27845"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10149"/>Et quiescere faciam multitudinem canticorum tuorum : <l eID="gen27845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27846"/>et sonitus cithararum tuarum non audietur amplius. <l eID="gen27846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10150"/><l level="1" sID="gen27847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10150"/>Et dabo te in limpidissimam petram, <l eID="gen27847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27848"/>siccatio sagenarum eris, <l eID="gen27848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27849"/>nec ædificaberis ultra, <l eID="gen27849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27850"/>quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27850" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10151"/><l level="1" sID="gen27851"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10151"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Tyro : <l eID="gen27851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27852"/>Numquid non a sonitu ruinæ tuæ, <l eID="gen27852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27853"/>et gemitu interfectorum tuorum, <l eID="gen27853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27854"/>cum occisi fuerint in medio tui, <l eID="gen27854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27855"/>commovebuntur insulæ ? <l eID="gen27855" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10152"/><l level="1" sID="gen27856"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10152"/>Et descendent de sedibus suis omnes principes maris, <l eID="gen27856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27857"/>et auferent exuvias suas, <l eID="gen27857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27858"/>et vestimenta sua varia abjicient, <l eID="gen27858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27859"/>et induentur stupore : <l eID="gen27859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27860"/>in terra sedebunt, <l eID="gen27860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27861"/>et attoniti super repentino casu tuo admirabuntur : <l eID="gen27861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10153"/><l level="1" sID="gen27862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10153"/>et assumentes super te lamentum, dicent tibi : <l eID="gen27862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27863"/>Quomodo peristi, quæ habitas in mari, urbs inclyta, <l eID="gen27863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27864"/>quæ fuisti fortis in mari cum habitatoribus tuis, <l eID="gen27864" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27865"/>quos formidabant universi ? <l eID="gen27865" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10154"/><l level="1" sID="gen27866"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10154"/>Nunc stupebunt naves in die pavoris tui, <l eID="gen27866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27867"/>et turbabuntur insulæ in mari, <l eID="gen27867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27868"/>eo quod nullus egrediatur ex te. <l eID="gen27868" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10155"/><l level="1" sID="gen27869"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10155"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27870"/>Cum dedero te urbem desolatam, <l eID="gen27870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27871"/>sicut civitates quæ non habitantur ; <l eID="gen27871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27872"/>et adduxero super te abyssum, <l eID="gen27872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27873"/>et operuerint te aquæ multæ ; <l eID="gen27873" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10156"/><l level="1" sID="gen27874"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10156"/>et detraxero te cum his qui descendunt in lacum <l eID="gen27874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27875"/>ad populum sempiternum ; <l eID="gen27875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27876"/>et collocavero te in terra novissima sicut solitudines veteres, <l eID="gen27876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27877"/>cum his qui deducuntur in lacum, <l eID="gen27877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27878"/>ut non habiteris ; <l eID="gen27878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27879"/>porro cum dedero gloriam in terra viventium : <l eID="gen27879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 26:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10157"/><l level="1" sID="gen27880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10157"/>in nihilum redigam te, et non eris : <l eID="gen27880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27881"/>et requisita non invenieris ultra in sempiternum, <l eID="gen27881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27882"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen27882" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27802"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.26"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:2
verses.text: Tu ergo, fili hominis, assume super Tyrum lamentum :

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:3
verses.text: et dices Tyro, quæ habitat in introitu maris, negotiationi populorum ad insulas multas : <div eID="gen27883" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27884"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27885"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27886"/>O Tyre, tu dixisti : Perfecti decoris ego sum, <l eID="gen27886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10158"/><l level="1" sID="gen27887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10158"/>et in corde maris sita. <l eID="gen27887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27888"/>Finitimi tui qui te ædificaverunt, impleverunt decorem tuum : <l eID="gen27888" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:5
