verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10159"/><l level="1" sID="gen27889"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10159"/>abietibus de Sanir exstruxerunt te cum omnibus tabulatis maris : <l eID="gen27889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27890"/>cedrum de Libano tulerunt ut facerent tibi malum. <l eID="gen27890" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10160"/><l level="1" sID="gen27891"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10160"/>Quercus de Basan dolaverunt in remos tuos, <l eID="gen27891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27892"/>et transtra tua fecerunt tibi ex ebore indico, <l eID="gen27892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27893"/>et prætoriola de insulis Italiæ. <l eID="gen27893" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10161"/><l level="1" sID="gen27894"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10161"/>Byssus varia de Ægypto texta est tibi in velum <l eID="gen27894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27895"/>ut poneretur in malo : <l eID="gen27895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27896"/>hyacinthus et purpura de insulis Elisa <l eID="gen27896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27897"/>facta sunt operimentum tuum. <l eID="gen27897" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10162"/><l level="1" sID="gen27898"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10162"/>Habitatores Sidonis et Aradii fuerunt remiges tui : <l eID="gen27898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27899"/>sapientes tui, Tyre, facti sunt gubernatores tui. <l eID="gen27899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10163"/><l level="1" sID="gen27900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10163"/>Senes Giblii et prudentes ejus <l eID="gen27900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27901"/>habuerunt nautas ad ministerium variæ supellectilis tuæ : <l eID="gen27901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27902"/>omnes naves maris, et nautæ earum, <l eID="gen27902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27903"/>fuerunt in populo negotiationis tuæ. <l eID="gen27903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10164"/><l level="1" sID="gen27904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10164"/>Persæ, et Lydii, et Libyes erant in exercitu tuo <l eID="gen27904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27905"/>viri bellatores tui : <l eID="gen27905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27906"/>clypeum et galeam suspenderunt in te pro ornatu tuo. <l eID="gen27906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10165"/><l level="1" sID="gen27907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10165"/>Filii Aradii cum exercitu tuo erant super muros tuos in circuitu : <l eID="gen27907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27908"/>sed et Pigmæi qui erant in turribus tuis, <l eID="gen27908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27909"/>pharetras suas suspenderunt in muris tuis per gyrum : <l eID="gen27909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27910"/>ipsi compleverunt pulchritudinem tuam. <l eID="gen27910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10166"/><l level="1" sID="gen27911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10166"/>Carthaginenses negotiatores tui, <l eID="gen27911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27912"/>a multitudine cunctarum divitiarum, <l eID="gen27912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27913"/>argento, ferro, stanno, plumboque <l eID="gen27913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27914"/>repleverunt nundinas tuas. <l eID="gen27914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10167"/><l level="1" sID="gen27915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10167"/>Græcia, Thubal, et Mosoch, ipsi institores tui : <l eID="gen27915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27916"/>mancipia, et vasa ærea advexerunt populo tuo. <l eID="gen27916" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10168"/><l level="1" sID="gen27917"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10168"/>De domo Thogorma, equos, et equites, et mulos <l eID="gen27917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27918"/>adduxerunt ad forum tuum. <l eID="gen27918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10169"/><l level="1" sID="gen27919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10169"/>Filii Dedan negotiatores tui ; <l eID="gen27919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27920"/>insulæ multæ, negotiatio manus tuæ : <l eID="gen27920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27921"/>dentes eburneos et hebeninos commutaverunt in pretio tuo. <l eID="gen27921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10170"/><l level="1" sID="gen27922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10170"/>Syrus negotiator tuus propter multitudinem operum tuorum : <l eID="gen27922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27923"/>gemmam, et purpuram, et scutulata, <l eID="gen27923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27924"/>et byssum, et sericum, et chodchod <l eID="gen27924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27925"/>proposuerunt in mercatu tuo. <l eID="gen27925" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10171"/><l level="1" sID="gen27926"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10171"/>Juda et terra Israël, ipsi institores tui in frumento primo : <l eID="gen27926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27927"/>balsamum, et mel, et oleum, et resinam <l eID="gen27927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27928"/>proposuerunt in nundinis tuis. <l eID="gen27928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10172"/><l level="1" sID="gen27929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10172"/>Damascenus negotiator tuus in multitudine operum tuorum, <l eID="gen27929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27930"/>in multitudine diversarum opum, <l eID="gen27930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27931"/>in vino pingui, in lanis coloris optimi. <l eID="gen27931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10173"/><l level="1" sID="gen27932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10173"/>Dan, et Græcia, et Mosel, <l eID="gen27932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27933"/>in nundinis tuis proposuerunt ferrum fabrefactum : <l eID="gen27933" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27934"/>stacte et calamus in negotiatione tua. <l eID="gen27934" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10174"/><l level="1" sID="gen27935"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10174"/>Dedan institores tui in tapetibus ad sedendum. <l eID="gen27935" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10175"/><l level="1" sID="gen27936"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10175"/>Arabia et universi principes Cedar, <l eID="gen27936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27937"/>ipsi negotiatores manus tuæ : <l eID="gen27937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27938"/>cum agnis, et arietibus, et hædis, <l eID="gen27938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27939"/>venerunt ad te negotiatores tui. <l eID="gen27939" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10176"/><l level="1" sID="gen27940"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10176"/>Venditores Saba et Reema, ipsi negotiatores tui : <l eID="gen27940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27941"/>cum universis primis aromatibus, et lapide pretioso, et auro, <l eID="gen27941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27942"/>quod proposuerunt in mercatu tuo. <l eID="gen27942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10177"/><l level="1" sID="gen27943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10177"/>Haran, et Chene, et Eden, negotiatores tui ; <l eID="gen27943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27944"/>Saba, Assur, et Chelmad venditores tui. <l eID="gen27944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10178"/><l level="1" sID="gen27945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10178"/>Ipsi negotiatores tui multifariam, <l eID="gen27945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27946"/>involucris hyacinthi, et polymitorum, <l eID="gen27946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27947"/>gazarumque pretiosarum, <l eID="gen27947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27948"/>quæ obvolutæ et astrictæ erant funibus : <l eID="gen27948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27949"/>cedros quoque habebant in negotiationibus tuis. <l eID="gen27949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10179"/><l level="1" sID="gen27950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10179"/>Naves maris, principes tui in negotiatione tua : <l eID="gen27950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27951"/>et repleta es, et glorificata nimis in corde maris. <l eID="gen27951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10180"/><l level="1" sID="gen27952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10180"/>In aquis multis adduxerunt te remiges tui : <l eID="gen27952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27953"/>ventus auster contrivit te in corde maris. <l eID="gen27953" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10181"/><l level="1" sID="gen27954"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10181"/>Divitiæ tuæ, et thesauri tui, <l eID="gen27954" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27955"/>et multiplex instrumentum tuum : <l eID="gen27955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27956"/>nautæ tui et gubernatores tui, <l eID="gen27956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27957"/>qui tenebant supellectilem tuam, <l eID="gen27957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27958"/>et populo tuo præerant : <l eID="gen27958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27959"/>viri quoque bellatores tui, qui erant in te, <l eID="gen27959" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27960"/>cum universa multitudine tua quæ est in medio tui, <l eID="gen27960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27961"/>cadent in corde maris in die ruinæ tuæ : <l eID="gen27961" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10182"/><l level="1" sID="gen27962"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10182"/>a sonitu clamoris gubernatorum tuorum conturbabuntur classes. <l eID="gen27962" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10183"/><l level="1" sID="gen27963"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10183"/>Et descendent de navibus suis omnes qui tenebant remum : <l eID="gen27963" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27964"/>nautæ et universi gubernatores maris in terra stabunt. <l eID="gen27964" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10184"/><l level="1" sID="gen27965"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10184"/>Et ejulabunt super te voce magna : <l eID="gen27965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27966"/>et clamabunt amare, <l eID="gen27966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27967"/>et superjacient pulverem capitibus suis, <l eID="gen27967" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27968"/>et cinere conspergentur. <l eID="gen27968" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10185"/><l level="1" sID="gen27969"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10185"/>Et radent super te calvitium, <l eID="gen27969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27970"/>et accingentur ciliciis : <l eID="gen27970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27971"/>et plorabunt te in amaritudine animæ, ploratu amarissimo. <l eID="gen27971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10186"/><l level="1" sID="gen27972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10186"/>Et assument super te carmen lugubre, <l eID="gen27972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27973"/>et plangent te : <l eID="gen27973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27974"/>Quæ est ut Tyrus, quæ obmutuit in medio maris ? <l eID="gen27974" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10187"/><l level="1" sID="gen27975"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10187"/>Quæ in exitu negotiationum tuarum de mari <l eID="gen27975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27976"/>implesti populos multos : <l eID="gen27976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27977"/>in multitudine divitiarum tuarum, et populorum tuorum, <l eID="gen27977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27978"/>ditasti reges terræ. <l eID="gen27978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10188"/><l level="1" sID="gen27979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10188"/>Nunc contrita es a mari : <l eID="gen27979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27980"/>in profundis aquarum opes tuæ, <l eID="gen27980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27981"/>et omnis multitudo tua quæ erat in medio tui, ceciderunt. <l eID="gen27981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10189"/><l level="1" sID="gen27982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10189"/>Universi habitatores insularum obstupuerunt super te, <l eID="gen27982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27983"/>et reges earum omnes tempestate perculsi mutaverunt vultus. <l eID="gen27983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 27:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10190"/><l level="1" sID="gen27984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10190"/>Negotiatores populorum sibilaverunt super te : <l eID="gen27984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27985"/>ad nihilum deducta es, <l eID="gen27985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27986"/>et non eris usque in perpetuum. <l eID="gen27986" level="1"/><lg eID="gen27884"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.27"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, dic principi Tyri : <div eID="gen27987" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen27988"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27989"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen27989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27990"/>Eo quod elevatum est cor tuum, <l eID="gen27990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27991"/>et dixisti : Deus ego sum, <l eID="gen27991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27992"/>et in cathedra Dei sedi in corde maris, <l eID="gen27992" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27993"/>cum sis homo, et non deus : <l eID="gen27993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27994"/>et dedisti cor tuum quasi cor Dei : <l eID="gen27994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10191"/><l level="1" sID="gen27995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10191"/>ecce sapientior es tu Daniele : <l eID="gen27995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27996"/>omne secretum non est absconditum a te : <l eID="gen27996" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10192"/><l level="1" sID="gen27997"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10192"/>in sapientia et prudentia tua fecisti tibi fortitudinem, <l eID="gen27997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen27998"/>et acquisisti aurum et argentum in thesauris tuis : <l eID="gen27998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10193"/><l level="1" sID="gen27999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10193"/>in multitudine sapientiæ tuæ, <l eID="gen27999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28000"/>et in negotiatione tua multiplicasti tibi fortitudinem, <l eID="gen28000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28001"/>et elevatum est cor tuum in robore tuo : <l eID="gen28001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10194"/><l level="1" sID="gen28002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10194"/>propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28003"/>Eo quod elevatum est cor tuum quasi cor dei, <l eID="gen28003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10195"/><l level="1" sID="gen28004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10195"/>idcirco ecce ego adducam super te alienos, <l eID="gen28004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28005"/>robustissimos gentium : <l eID="gen28005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28006"/>et nudabunt gladios suos super pulchritudinem sapientiæ tuæ, <l eID="gen28006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28007"/>et polluent decorem tuum. <l eID="gen28007" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10196"/><l level="1" sID="gen28008"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10196"/>Interficient, et detrahent te : <l eID="gen28008" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28009"/>et morieris in interitu occisorum in corde maris. <l eID="gen28009" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10197"/><l level="1" sID="gen28010"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10197"/>Numquid dicens loqueris : Deus ego sum, <l eID="gen28010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28011"/>coram interficientibus te, <l eID="gen28011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28012"/>cum sis homo, et non deus, <l eID="gen28012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28013"/>in manu occidentium te ? <l eID="gen28013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10198"/><l level="1" sID="gen28014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10198"/>Morte incircumcisorum morieris in manu alienorum, <l eID="gen28014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28015"/>quia ego locutus sum, ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28015" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen27988"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10199"/><div sID="gen28016" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10199"/>Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens : Fili hominis, leva planctum super regem Tyri,

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:12
verses.text: et dices ei : <div eID="gen28016" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28017"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28018"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28019"/>Tu signaculum similitudinis, <l eID="gen28019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28020"/>plenus sapientia, et perfectus decore. <l eID="gen28020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10200"/><l level="1" sID="gen28021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10200"/>In deliciis paradisi Dei fuisti : <l eID="gen28021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28022"/>omnis lapis pretiosus operimentum tuum, <l eID="gen28022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28023"/>sardius, topazius, et jaspis, <l eID="gen28023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28024"/>chrysolithus, et onyx, et beryllus, <l eID="gen28024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28025"/>sapphirus, et carbunculus, et smaragdus : <l eID="gen28025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28026"/>aurum, opus decoris tui : <l eID="gen28026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28027"/>et foramina tua, in die qua conditus es, præparata sunt. <l eID="gen28027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10201"/><l level="1" sID="gen28028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10201"/>Tu cherub extentus, et protegens, <l eID="gen28028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28029"/>et posui te in monte sancto Dei : <l eID="gen28029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28030"/>in medio lapidum ignitorum ambulasti, <l eID="gen28030" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10202"/><l level="1" sID="gen28031"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10202"/>perfectus in viis tuis a die conditionis tuæ, <l eID="gen28031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28032"/>donec inventa est iniquitas in te. <l eID="gen28032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10203"/><l level="1" sID="gen28033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10203"/>In multitudine negotiationis tuæ <l eID="gen28033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28034"/>repleta sunt interiora tua iniquitate, et peccasti : <l eID="gen28034" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28035"/>et ejeci te de monte Dei, <l eID="gen28035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28036"/>et perdidi te, o cherub protegens, de medio lapidum ignitorum. <l eID="gen28036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10204"/><l level="1" sID="gen28037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10204"/>Et elevatum est cor tuum in decore tuo ; <l eID="gen28037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28038"/>perdidisti sapientiam tuam in decore tuo : <l eID="gen28038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28039"/>in terram projeci te ; <l eID="gen28039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28040"/>ante faciem regum dedi te ut cernerent te. <l eID="gen28040" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10205"/><l level="1" sID="gen28041"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10205"/>In multitudine iniquitatum tuarum, <l eID="gen28041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28042"/>et iniquitate negotiationis tuæ, <l eID="gen28042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28043"/>polluisti sanctificationem tuam : <l eID="gen28043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28044"/>producam ergo ignem de medio tui, qui comedat te, <l eID="gen28044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28045"/>et dabo te in cinerem super terram, <l eID="gen28045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28046"/>in conspectu omnium videntium te. <l eID="gen28046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10206"/><l level="1" sID="gen28047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10206"/>Omnes qui viderint te in gentibus, obstupescent super te : <l eID="gen28047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28048"/>nihili factus es, et non eris in perpetuum. <l eID="gen28048" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28017"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10207"/><div sID="gen28049" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10207"/>Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:21
verses.text: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra Sidonem, et prophetabis de ea :

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:22
verses.text: et dices : <div eID="gen28049" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28050"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28051"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28051" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28052"/>Ecce ego ad te, Sidon, <l eID="gen28052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28053"/>et glorificabor in medio tui : <l eID="gen28053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28054"/>et scient quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen28054" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28055"/>cum fecero in ea judicia, <l eID="gen28055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28056"/>et sanctificatus fuero in ea. <l eID="gen28056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10208"/><l level="1" sID="gen28057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10208"/>Et immittam ei pestilentiam, <l eID="gen28057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28058"/>et sanguinem in plateis ejus : <l eID="gen28058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28059"/>et corruent interfecti in medio ejus gladio per circuitum, <l eID="gen28059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28060"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10209"/><l level="1" sID="gen28061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10209"/>Et non erit ultra domui Israël offendiculum amaritudinis, <l eID="gen28061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28062"/>et spina dolorem inferens undique <l eID="gen28062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28063"/>per circuitum eorum qui adversantur eis : <l eID="gen28063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28064"/>et scient quia ego Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10210"/><l level="1" sID="gen28065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10210"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28066"/>Quando congregavero domum Israël <l eID="gen28066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28067"/>de populis in quibus dispersi sunt, <l eID="gen28067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28068"/>sanctificabor in eis coram gentibus : <l eID="gen28068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28069"/>et habitabunt in terra sua, <l eID="gen28069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28070"/>quam dedi servo meo Jacob : <l eID="gen28070" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 28:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10211"/><l level="1" sID="gen28071"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10211"/>et habitabunt in ea securi, <l eID="gen28071" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28072"/>et ædificabunt domos, et plantabunt vineas, <l eID="gen28072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28073"/>et habitabunt confidenter, <l eID="gen28073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28074"/>cum fecero judicia in omnibus qui adversantur eis per circuitum : <l eID="gen28074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28075"/>et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum. <l eID="gen28075" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28050"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.28"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:1
verses.text: In anno decimo, decimo mense, undecima die mensis, factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra Pharaonem regem Ægypti, et prophetabis de eo, et de Ægypto universa.

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:3
verses.text: Loquere, et dices : <div eID="gen28076" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28077"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28078"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28079"/>Ecce ego ad te, Pharao rex Ægypti, draco magne, <l eID="gen28079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28080"/>qui cubas in medio fluminum tuorum, et dicis : <l eID="gen28080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28081"/>Meus est fluvius, et ego feci memetipsum. <l eID="gen28081" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10212"/><l level="1" sID="gen28082"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10212"/>Et ponam frenum in maxillis tuis, <l eID="gen28082" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28083"/>et agglutinabo pisces fluminum tuorum squamis tuis, <l eID="gen28083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28084"/>et extraham te de medio fluminum tuorum, <l eID="gen28084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28085"/>et universi pisces tui squamis tuis adhærebunt. <l eID="gen28085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10213"/><l level="1" sID="gen28086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10213"/>Et projiciam te in desertum, <l eID="gen28086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28087"/>et omnes pisces fluminis tui : <l eID="gen28087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28088"/>super faciem terræ cades ; <l eID="gen28088" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28089"/>non colligeris, neque congregaberis : <l eID="gen28089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28090"/>bestiis terræ et volatilibus cæli dedi te ad devorandum. <l eID="gen28090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10214"/><l level="1" sID="gen28091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10214"/>Et scient omnes habitatores Ægypti quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen28091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28092"/>pro eo quod fuisti baculus arundineus domui Israël : <l eID="gen28092" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10215"/><l level="1" sID="gen28093"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10215"/>quando apprehenderunt te manu, et confractus es, <l eID="gen28093" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28094"/>et lacerasti omnem humerum eorum : <l eID="gen28094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28095"/>et innitentibus eis super te comminutus es, <l eID="gen28095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28096"/>et dissolvisti omnes renes eorum. <l eID="gen28096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10216"/><l level="1" sID="gen28097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10216"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28098"/>Ecce ego adducam super te gladium, <l eID="gen28098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28099"/>et interficiam de te hominem et jumentum. <l eID="gen28099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10217"/><l level="1" sID="gen28100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10217"/>Et erit terra Ægypti in desertum et in solitudinem : <l eID="gen28100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28101"/>et scient quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen28101" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28102"/>pro eo quod dixeris : Fluvius meus est, et ego feci eum. <l eID="gen28102" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10218"/><l level="1" sID="gen28103"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10218"/>Idcirco ecce ego ad te, et ad flumina tua : <l eID="gen28103" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28104"/>daboque terram Ægypti in solitudines, <l eID="gen28104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28105"/>gladio dissipatam, <l eID="gen28105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28106"/>a turre Syenes usque ad terminos Æthiopiæ. <l eID="gen28106" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10219"/><l level="1" sID="gen28107"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10219"/>Non pertransibit eam pes hominis, <l eID="gen28107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28108"/>neque pes jumenti gradietur in ea, <l eID="gen28108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28109"/>et non habitabitur quadraginta annis. <l eID="gen28109" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10220"/><l level="1" sID="gen28110"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10220"/>Daboque terram Ægypti desertam in medio terrarum desertarum, <l eID="gen28110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28111"/>et civitates ejus in medio urbium subversarum, <l eID="gen28111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28112"/>et erunt desolatæ quadraginta annis : <l eID="gen28112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28113"/>et dispergam Ægyptios in nationes, <l eID="gen28113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28114"/>et ventilabo eos in terras. <l eID="gen28114" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10221"/><l level="1" sID="gen28115"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10221"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28116"/>Post finem quadraginta annorum congregabo Ægyptum <l eID="gen28116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28117"/>de populis in quibus dispersi fuerant. <l eID="gen28117" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10222"/><l level="1" sID="gen28118"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10222"/>Et reducam captivitatem Ægypti, <l eID="gen28118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28119"/>et collocabo eos in terra Phathures, <l eID="gen28119" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28120"/>in terra nativitatis suæ, <l eID="gen28120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28121"/>et erunt ibi in regnum humile. <l eID="gen28121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10223"/><l level="1" sID="gen28122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10223"/>Inter cetera regna erit humillima, <l eID="gen28122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28123"/>et non elevabitur ultra super nationes, <l eID="gen28123" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28124"/>et imminuam eos ne imperent gentibus. <l eID="gen28124" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10224"/><l level="1" sID="gen28125"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10224"/>Neque erunt ultra domui Israël in confidentia, <l eID="gen28125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28126"/>docentes iniquitatem ut fugiant, et sequantur eos : <l eID="gen28126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28127"/>et scient quia ego Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28127" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28077"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10225"/><div sID="gen28128" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10225"/>Et factum est in vigesimo et septimo anno, in primo, in una mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen28128" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10226"/><lg sID="gen28129"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28130"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10226"/>Fili hominis, Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis <l eID="gen28130" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28131"/>servire fecit exercitum suum servitute magna adversum Tyrum : <l eID="gen28131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28132"/>omne caput decalvatum, et omnis humerus depilatus est : <l eID="gen28132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28133"/>et merces non est reddita ei, neque exercitui ejus, de Tyro, <l eID="gen28133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28134"/>pro servitute qua servivit mihi adversus eam. <l eID="gen28134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10227"/><l level="1" sID="gen28135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10227"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28136"/>Ecce ego dabo Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis in terra Ægypti : <l eID="gen28136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28137"/>et accipiet multitudinem ejus, <l eID="gen28137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28138"/>et deprædabitur manubias ejus, <l eID="gen28138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28139"/>et diripiet spolia ejus : <l eID="gen28139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28140"/>et erit merces exercitui illius, <l eID="gen28140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10228"/><l level="1" sID="gen28141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10228"/>et operi quo servivit adversus eam : <l eID="gen28141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28142"/>dedi ei terram Ægypti pro eo quod laboraverit mihi, <l eID="gen28142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28143"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28143" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 29:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10229"/><l level="1" sID="gen28144"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10229"/>In die illo pullulabit cornu domui Israël, <l eID="gen28144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28145"/>et tibi dabo apertum os in medio eorum, <l eID="gen28145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28146"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28146" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28129"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.29"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, propheta, et dic : <div eID="gen28147" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28148"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28149"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28150"/>Ululate : Væ, væ diei ! <l eID="gen28150" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10230"/><l level="1" sID="gen28151"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10230"/>quia juxta est dies, <l eID="gen28151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28152"/>et appropinquat dies Domini, dies nubis : <l eID="gen28152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28153"/>tempus gentium erit. <l eID="gen28153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10231"/><l level="1" sID="gen28154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10231"/>Et veniet gladius in Ægyptum, <l eID="gen28154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28155"/>et erit pavor in Æthiopia, <l eID="gen28155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28156"/>cum ceciderint vulnerati in Ægypto, <l eID="gen28156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28157"/>et ablata fuerit multitudo illius, <l eID="gen28157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28158"/>et destructa fundamenta ejus. <l eID="gen28158" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10232"/><l level="1" sID="gen28159"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10232"/>Æthiopia, et Libya, et Lydi, <l eID="gen28159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28160"/>et omne reliquum vulgus, <l eID="gen28160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28161"/>et Chub, et filii terræ fœderis, <l eID="gen28161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28162"/>cum eis gladio cadent. <l eID="gen28162" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10233"/><l level="1" sID="gen28163"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10233"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28164"/>Et corruent fulcientes Ægyptum, <l eID="gen28164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28165"/>et destruetur superbia imperii ejus : <l eID="gen28165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28166"/>a turre Syenes gladio cadent in ea, <l eID="gen28166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28167"/>ait Dominus Deus exercituum. <l eID="gen28167" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10234"/><l level="1" sID="gen28168"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10234"/>Et dissipabuntur in medio terrarum desolatarum, <l eID="gen28168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28169"/>et urbes ejus in medio civitatum desertarum erunt : <l eID="gen28169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10235"/><l level="1" sID="gen28170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10235"/>et scient quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen28170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28171"/>cum dedero ignem in Ægypto, <l eID="gen28171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28172"/>et attriti fuerint omnes auxiliatores ejus. <l eID="gen28172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10236"/><l level="1" sID="gen28173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10236"/>In die illa egredientur nuntii a facie mea in trieribus <l eID="gen28173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28174"/>ad conterendam Æthiopiæ confidentiam : <l eID="gen28174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28175"/>et erit pavor in eis in die Ægypti, <l eID="gen28175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28176"/>quia absque dubio veniet. <l eID="gen28176" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10237"/><l level="1" sID="gen28177"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10237"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28178"/>Cessare faciam multitudinem Ægypti <l eID="gen28178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28179"/>in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis. <l eID="gen28179" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10238"/><l level="1" sID="gen28180"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10238"/>Ipse et populus ejus cum eo, fortissimi gentium, <l eID="gen28180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28181"/>adducentur ad disperdendam terram : <l eID="gen28181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28182"/>et evaginabunt gladios suos super Ægyptum, <l eID="gen28182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28183"/>et implebunt terram interfectis. <l eID="gen28183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10239"/><l level="1" sID="gen28184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10239"/>Et faciam alveos fluminum aridos, <l eID="gen28184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28185"/>et tradam terram in manus pessimorum : <l eID="gen28185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28186"/>et dissipabo terram et plenitudinem ejus <l eID="gen28186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28187"/>manu alienorum : <l eID="gen28187" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28188"/>ego Dominus locutus sum. <l eID="gen28188" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10240"/><l level="1" sID="gen28189"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10240"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28190"/>Et disperdam simulacra, <l eID="gen28190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28191"/>et cessare faciam idola de Memphis : <l eID="gen28191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28192"/>et dux de terra Ægypti non erit amplius, <l eID="gen28192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28193"/>et dabo terrorem in terra Ægypti. <l eID="gen28193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10241"/><l level="1" sID="gen28194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10241"/>Et disperdam terram Phathures, <l eID="gen28194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28195"/>et dabo ignem in Taphnis, <l eID="gen28195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28196"/>et faciam judicia in Alexandria. <l eID="gen28196" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10242"/><l level="1" sID="gen28197"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10242"/>Et effundam indignationem meam super Pelusium, robur Ægypti, <l eID="gen28197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28198"/>et interficiam multitudinem Alexandriæ. <l eID="gen28198" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10243"/><l level="1" sID="gen28199"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10243"/>Et dabo ignem in Ægypto : <l eID="gen28199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28200"/>quasi parturiens dolebit Pelusium, <l eID="gen28200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28201"/>et Alexandria erit dissipata, <l eID="gen28201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28202"/>et in Memphis angustiæ quotidianæ. <l eID="gen28202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10244"/><l level="1" sID="gen28203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10244"/>Juvenes Heliopoleos et Bubasti gladio cadent, <l eID="gen28203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28204"/>et ipsæ captivæ ducentur. <l eID="gen28204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10245"/><l level="1" sID="gen28205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10245"/>Et in Taphnis nigrescet dies, <l eID="gen28205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28206"/>cum contrivero ibi sceptra Ægypti, <l eID="gen28206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28207"/>et defecerit in ea superbia potentiæ ejus : <l eID="gen28207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28208"/>ipsam nubes operiet, <l eID="gen28208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28209"/>filiæ autem ejus in captivitatem ducentur. <l eID="gen28209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10246"/><l level="1" sID="gen28210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10246"/>Et judicia faciam in Ægypto : <l eID="gen28210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28211"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28211" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28148"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10247"/><div sID="gen28212" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10247"/>Et factum est in undecimo anno, in primo mense, in septima mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen28212" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10248"/><lg sID="gen28213"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10248"/>Fili hominis, brachium Pharaonis regis Ægypti confregi, <l eID="gen28214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28215"/>et ecce non est obvolutum ut restitueretur ei sanitas, <l eID="gen28215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28216"/>ut ligaretur pannis, et fasciaretur linteolis, <l eID="gen28216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28217"/>ut recepto robore posset tenere gladium. <l eID="gen28217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10249"/><l level="1" sID="gen28218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10249"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28219"/>Ecce ego ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti, <l eID="gen28219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28220"/>et comminuam brachium ejus forte, sed confractum : <l eID="gen28220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28221"/>et dejiciam gladium de manu ejus, <l eID="gen28221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10250"/><l level="1" sID="gen28222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10250"/>et dispergam Ægyptum in gentibus, <l eID="gen28222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28223"/>et ventilabo eos in terris. <l eID="gen28223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10251"/><l level="1" sID="gen28224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10251"/>Et confortabo brachia regis Babylonis, <l eID="gen28224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28225"/>daboque gladium meum in manu ejus, <l eID="gen28225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28226"/>et confringam brachia Pharaonis, <l eID="gen28226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28227"/>et gement gemitibus interfecti coram facie ejus. <l eID="gen28227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10252"/><l level="1" sID="gen28228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10252"/>Et confortabo brachia regis Babylonis, <l eID="gen28228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28229"/>et brachia Pharaonis concident : <l eID="gen28229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28230"/>et scient quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen28230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28231"/>cum dedero gladium meum in manu regis Babylonis, <l eID="gen28231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28232"/>et extenderit eum super terram Ægypti. <l eID="gen28232" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 30:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10253"/><l level="1" sID="gen28233"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10253"/>Et dispergam Ægyptum in nationes, <l eID="gen28233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28234"/>et ventilabo eos in terras : <l eID="gen28234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28235"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28235" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28213"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.30"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:1
verses.text: Et factum est in anno undecimo, tertio mense, una mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, dic Pharaoni regi Ægypti et populo ejus : <div eID="gen28236" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28237"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28238"/>Cui similis factus es in magnitudine tua ? <l eID="gen28238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10254"/><l level="1" sID="gen28239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10254"/>ecce Assur quasi cedrus in Libano, <l eID="gen28239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28240"/>pulcher ramis, et frondibus nemorosus, excelsusque altitudine, <l eID="gen28240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28241"/>et inter condensas frondes elevatum est cacumen ejus. <l eID="gen28241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10255"/><l level="1" sID="gen28242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10255"/>Aquæ nutrierunt illum ; <l eID="gen28242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28243"/>abyssus exaltavit illum : <l eID="gen28243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28244"/>flumina ejus manabant in circuitu radicum ejus, <l eID="gen28244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28245"/>et rivos suos emisit ad universa ligna regionis. <l eID="gen28245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10256"/><l level="1" sID="gen28246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10256"/>Propterea elevata est altitudo ejus super omnia ligna regionis, <l eID="gen28246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28247"/>et multiplicata sunt arbusta ejus, <l eID="gen28247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28248"/>et elevati sunt rami ejus præ aquis multis. <l eID="gen28248" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10257"/><l level="1" sID="gen28249"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10257"/>Cumque extendisset umbram suam, <l eID="gen28249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28250"/>in ramis ejus fecerunt nidos omnia volatilia cæli : <l eID="gen28250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28251"/>et sub frondibus ejus genuerunt omnes bestiæ saltuum, <l eID="gen28251" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28252"/>et sub umbraculo illius habitabat cœtus gentium plurimarum. <l eID="gen28252" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10258"/><l level="1" sID="gen28253"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10258"/>Eratque pulcherrimus in magnitudine sua, <l eID="gen28253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28254"/>et in dilatatione arbustorum suorum : <l eID="gen28254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28255"/>erat enim radix illius juxta aquas multas. <l eID="gen28255" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10259"/><l level="1" sID="gen28256"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10259"/>Cedri non fuerunt altiores illo in paradiso Dei ; <l eID="gen28256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28257"/>abietes non adæquaverunt summitatem ejus, <l eID="gen28257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28258"/>et platani non fuerunt æquæ frondibus illius : <l eID="gen28258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28259"/>omne lignum paradisi Dei non est assimilatum illi, <l eID="gen28259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28260"/>et pulchritudini ejus. <l eID="gen28260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10260"/><l level="1" sID="gen28261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10260"/>Quoniam speciosum feci eum, <l eID="gen28261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28262"/>et multis condensisque frondibus, <l eID="gen28262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28263"/>et æmulata sunt eum omnia ligna voluptatis <l eID="gen28263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28264"/>quæ erant in paradiso Dei. <l eID="gen28264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10261"/><l level="1" sID="gen28265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10261"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28266"/>Pro eo quod sublimatus est in altitudine, <l eID="gen28266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28267"/>et dedit summitatem suam virentem atque condensam, <l eID="gen28267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28268"/>et elevatum est cor ejus in altitudine sua : <l eID="gen28268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10262"/><l level="1" sID="gen28269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10262"/>tradidi eum in manu fortissimi gentium : <l eID="gen28269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28270"/>faciens faciet ei : <l eID="gen28270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28271"/>juxta impietatem ejus ejeci eum. <l eID="gen28271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10263"/><l level="1" sID="gen28272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10263"/>Et succident eum alieni, <l eID="gen28272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28273"/>et crudelissimi nationum, <l eID="gen28273" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28274"/>et projicient eum super montes : <l eID="gen28274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28275"/>et in cunctis convallibus corruent rami ejus, <l eID="gen28275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28276"/>et confringentur arbusta ejus in universis rupibus terræ : <l eID="gen28276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28277"/>et recedent de umbraculo ejus omnes populi terræ, <l eID="gen28277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28278"/>et relinquent eum. <l eID="gen28278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10264"/><l level="1" sID="gen28279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10264"/>In ruina ejus habitaverunt omnia volatilia cæli, <l eID="gen28279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28280"/>et in ramis ejus fuerunt universæ bestiæ regionis. <l eID="gen28280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10265"/><l level="1" sID="gen28281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10265"/>Quam ob rem non elevabuntur in altitudine sua omnia ligna aquarum, <l eID="gen28281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28282"/>nec ponent sublimitatem suam inter nemorosa atque frondosa, <l eID="gen28282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28283"/>nec stabunt in sublimitate sua omnia quæ irrigantur aquis : <l eID="gen28283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28284"/>quia omnes traditi sunt in mortem ad terram ultimam, <l eID="gen28284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28285"/>in medio filiorum hominum, <l eID="gen28285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28286"/>ad eos qui descendunt in lacum. <l eID="gen28286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10266"/><l level="1" sID="gen28287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10266"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28288"/>In die quando descendit ad inferos, induxi luctum : <l eID="gen28288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28289"/>operui eum abysso, <l eID="gen28289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28290"/>et prohibui flumina ejus, <l eID="gen28290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28291"/>et coërcui aquas multas : <l eID="gen28291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28292"/>contristatus est super eum Libanus, <l eID="gen28292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28293"/>et omnia ligna agri concussa sunt. <l eID="gen28293" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10267"/><l level="1" sID="gen28294"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10267"/>A sonitu ruinæ ejus commovi gentes <l eID="gen28294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28295"/>cum deducerem eum ad infernum <l eID="gen28295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28296"/>cum his qui descendebant in lacum : <l eID="gen28296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28297"/>et consolata sunt in terra infima <l eID="gen28297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28298"/>omnia ligna voluptatis egregia atque præclara in Libano, <l eID="gen28298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28299"/>universa quæ irrigabantur aquis. <l eID="gen28299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10268"/><l level="1" sID="gen28300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10268"/>Nam et ipsi cum eo descendent in infernum ad interfectos gladio : <l eID="gen28300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28301"/>et brachium uniuscujusque sedebit sub umbraculo ejus <l eID="gen28301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28302"/>in medio nationum. <l eID="gen28302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 31:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10269"/><l level="1" sID="gen28303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10269"/>Cui assimilatus es, o inclyte atque sublimis inter ligna voluptatis ? <l eID="gen28303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28304"/>ecce deductus es cum lignis voluptatis ad terram ultimam : <l eID="gen28304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28305"/>in medio incircumcisorum dormies, <l eID="gen28305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28306"/>cum eis qui interfecti sunt gladio : <l eID="gen28306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28307"/>ipse est Pharao, et omnis multitudo ejus, <l eID="gen28307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28308"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28308" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28237"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.31"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:1
verses.text: Et factum est, duodecimo anno, in mense duodecimo, in una mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, assume lamentum super Pharaonem regem Ægypti, et dices ad eum : <div eID="gen28309" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28310"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28311"/>Leoni gentium assimilatus es, <l eID="gen28311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28312"/>et draconi qui est in mari : <l eID="gen28312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28313"/>et ventilabas cornu in fluminibus tuis, <l eID="gen28313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28314"/>et conturbabas aquas pedibus tuis, <l eID="gen28314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28315"/>et conculcabas flumina earum. <l eID="gen28315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10270"/><l level="1" sID="gen28316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10270"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28317"/>Expandam super te rete meum in multitudine populorum multorum, <l eID="gen28317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28318"/>et extraham te in sagena mea. <l eID="gen28318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10271"/><l level="1" sID="gen28319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10271"/>Et projiciam te in terram ; <l eID="gen28319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28320"/>super faciem agri abjiciam te : <l eID="gen28320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28321"/>et habitare faciam super te omnia volatilia cæli, <l eID="gen28321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28322"/>et saturabo de te bestias universæ terræ. <l eID="gen28322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10272"/><l level="1" sID="gen28323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10272"/>Et dabo carnes tuas super montes, <l eID="gen28323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28324"/>et implebo colles tuos sanie tua. <l eID="gen28324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10273"/><l level="1" sID="gen28325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10273"/>Et irrigabo terram fœtore sanguinis tui super montes, <l eID="gen28325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28326"/>et valles implebuntur ex te. <l eID="gen28326" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10274"/><l level="1" sID="gen28327"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10274"/>Et operiam, cum extinctus fueris, cælum, <l eID="gen28327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28328"/>et nigrescere faciam stellas ejus : <l eID="gen28328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28329"/>solem nube tegam, <l eID="gen28329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28330"/>et luna non dabit lumen suum. <l eID="gen28330" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10275"/><l level="1" sID="gen28331"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10275"/>Omnia luminaria cæli mœrere faciam super te, <l eID="gen28331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28332"/>et dabo tenebras super terram tuam, <l eID="gen28332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28333"/>dicit Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen28333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28334"/>cum ceciderint vulnerati tui in medio terræ, <l eID="gen28334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28335"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28335" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10276"/><l level="1" sID="gen28336"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10276"/>Et irritabo cor populorum multorum, <l eID="gen28336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28337"/>cum induxero contritionem tuam in gentibus super terras quas nescis. <l eID="gen28337" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10277"/><l level="1" sID="gen28338"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10277"/>Et stupescere faciam super te populos multos, <l eID="gen28338" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28339"/>et reges eorum horrore nimio formidabunt super te, <l eID="gen28339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28340"/>cum volare cœperit gladius meus super facies eorum : <l eID="gen28340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28341"/>et obstupescent repente singuli pro anima sua in die ruinæ tuæ. <l eID="gen28341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10278"/><l level="1" sID="gen28342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10278"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28343"/>Gladius regis Babylonis veniet tibi. <l eID="gen28343" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10279"/><l level="1" sID="gen28344"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10279"/>In gladiis fortium dejiciam multitudinem tuam : <l eID="gen28344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28345"/>inexpugnabiles omnes gentes hæ, <l eID="gen28345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28346"/>et vastabunt superbiam Ægypti, <l eID="gen28346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28347"/>et dissipabitur multitudo ejus. <l eID="gen28347" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10280"/><l level="1" sID="gen28348"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10280"/>Et perdam omnia jumenta ejus, <l eID="gen28348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28349"/>quæ erant super aquas plurimas : <l eID="gen28349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28350"/>et non conturbabit eas pes hominis ultra, <l eID="gen28350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28351"/>neque ungula jumentorum turbabit eas. <l eID="gen28351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10281"/><l level="1" sID="gen28352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10281"/>Tunc purissimas reddam aquas eorum, <l eID="gen28352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28353"/>et flumina eorum quasi oleum adducam, <l eID="gen28353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28354"/>ait Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen28354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10282"/><l level="1" sID="gen28355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10282"/>cum dedero terram Ægypti desolatam : <l eID="gen28355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28356"/>deseretur autem terra a plenitudine sua <l eID="gen28356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28357"/>quando percussero omnes habitatores ejus : <l eID="gen28357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28358"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28358" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10283"/><l level="1" sID="gen28359"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10283"/>Planctus est, et plangent eum : <l eID="gen28359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28360"/>filiæ gentium plangent eum : <l eID="gen28360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28361"/>super Ægyptum et super multitudinem ejus plangent eum, <l eID="gen28361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28362"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28362" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28310"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10284"/><div sID="gen28363" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10284"/>Et factum est in duodecimo anno, in quintadecima mensis : factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen28363" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10285"/><lg sID="gen28364"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28365"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10285"/>Fili hominis, cane lugubre super multitudinem Ægypti : <l eID="gen28365" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28366"/>et detrahe eam ipsam, et filias gentium robustarum, ad terram ultimam, <l eID="gen28366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28367"/>cum his qui descendunt in lacum. <l eID="gen28367" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10286"/><l level="1" sID="gen28368"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10286"/>Quo pulchrior es ? <l eID="gen28368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28369"/>descende, et dormi cum incircumcisis. <l eID="gen28369" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10287"/><l level="1" sID="gen28370"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10287"/>In medio interfectorum gladio cadent ; <l eID="gen28370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28371"/>gladius datus est : <l eID="gen28371" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28372"/>attraxerunt eam et omnes populos ejus. <l eID="gen28372" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10288"/><l level="1" sID="gen28373"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10288"/>Loquentur ei potentissimi robustorum de medio inferni, <l eID="gen28373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28374"/>qui cum auxiliatoribus ejus descenderunt, <l eID="gen28374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28375"/>et dormierunt incircumcisi interfecti gladio. <l eID="gen28375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10289"/><l level="1" sID="gen28376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10289"/>Ibi Assur, et omnis multitudo ejus : <l eID="gen28376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28377"/>in circuitu illius sepulchra ejus, <l eID="gen28377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28378"/>omnes interfecti, et qui ceciderunt gladio. <l eID="gen28378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10290"/><l level="1" sID="gen28379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10290"/>Quorum data sunt sepulchra in novissimis laci, <l eID="gen28379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28380"/>et facta est multitudo ejus per gyrum sepulchri ejus : <l eID="gen28380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28381"/>universi interfecti, cadentesque gladio, <l eID="gen28381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28382"/>qui dederant quondam formidinem in terra viventium. <l eID="gen28382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10291"/><l level="1" sID="gen28383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10291"/>Ibi Ælam, et omnis multitudo ejus per gyrum sepulchri sui : <l eID="gen28383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28384"/>omnes hi interfecti, ruentesque gladio, <l eID="gen28384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28385"/>qui descenderunt incircumcisi ad terram ultimam ; <l eID="gen28385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28386"/>qui posuerunt terrorem suum in terra viventium, <l eID="gen28386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28387"/>et portaverunt ignominiam suam cum his qui descendunt in lacum. <l eID="gen28387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10292"/><l level="1" sID="gen28388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10292"/>In medio interfectorum <l eID="gen28388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28389"/>posuerunt cubile ejus in universis populis ejus : <l eID="gen28389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28390"/>in circuitu ejus sepulchrum illius : <l eID="gen28390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28391"/>omnes hi incircumcisi, interfectique gladio. <l eID="gen28391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28392"/>Dederunt enim terrorem suum in terra viventium, <l eID="gen28392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28393"/>et portaverunt ignominiam suam cum his qui descendunt in lacum : <l eID="gen28393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28394"/>in medio interfectorum positi sunt. <l eID="gen28394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10293"/><l level="1" sID="gen28395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10293"/>Ibi Mosoch et Thubal, et omnis multitudo ejus : <l eID="gen28395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28396"/>in circuitu ejus sepulchra illius : <l eID="gen28396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28397"/>omnes hi incircumcisi, interfectique et cadentes gladio, <l eID="gen28397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28398"/>quia dederunt formidinem suam in terra viventium. <l eID="gen28398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10294"/><l level="1" sID="gen28399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10294"/>Et non dormient cum fortibus, <l eID="gen28399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28400"/>cadentibusque, et incircumcisis, <l eID="gen28400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28401"/>qui descenderunt ad infernum cum armis suis, <l eID="gen28401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28402"/>et posuerunt gladios suos sub capitibus suis, <l eID="gen28402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28403"/>et fuerunt iniquitates eorum in ossibus eorum : <l eID="gen28403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28404"/>quia terror fortium facti sunt in terra viventium. <l eID="gen28404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10295"/><l level="1" sID="gen28405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10295"/>Et tu ergo in medio incircumcisorum contereris, <l eID="gen28405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28406"/>et dormies cum interfectis gladio. <l eID="gen28406" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10296"/><l level="1" sID="gen28407"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10296"/>Ibi Idumæa, et reges ejus, et omnes duces ejus, <l eID="gen28407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28408"/>qui dati sunt cum exercitu suo cum interfectis gladio, <l eID="gen28408" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28409"/>et qui cum incircumcisis dormierunt, <l eID="gen28409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28410"/>et cum his qui descendunt in lacum. <l eID="gen28410" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10297"/><l level="1" sID="gen28411"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10297"/>Ibi principes aquilonis omnes, et universi venatores, <l eID="gen28411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28412"/>qui deducti sunt cum interfectis, paventes, <l eID="gen28412" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28413"/>et in sua fortitudine confusi : <l eID="gen28413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28414"/>qui dormierunt incircumcisi <l eID="gen28414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28415"/>cum interfectis gladio, <l eID="gen28415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28416"/>et portaverunt confusionem suam <l eID="gen28416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28417"/>cum his qui descendunt in lacum. <l eID="gen28417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10298"/><l level="1" sID="gen28418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10298"/>Vidit eos Pharao, et consolatus est <l eID="gen28418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28419"/>super universa multitudine sua, <l eID="gen28419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28420"/>quæ interfecta est gladio : <l eID="gen28420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28421"/>Pharao, et omnis exercitus ejus, <l eID="gen28421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28422"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 32:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10299"/><l level="1" sID="gen28423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10299"/>Quia dedi terrorem meum in terra viventium, <l eID="gen28423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28424"/>et dormivit in medio incircumcisorum cum interfectis gladio : <l eID="gen28424" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28425"/>Pharao, et omnis multitudo ejus, <l eID="gen28425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28426"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28426" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28364"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.32"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, loquere ad filios populi tui, et dices ad eos : Terra, cum induxero super eam gladium, et tulerit populus terræ virum unum de novissimis suis, et constituerit eum super se speculatorem :

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:3
verses.text: et ille viderit gladium venientem super terram, et cecinerit buccina, et annuntiaverit populo :

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:4
verses.text: audiens autem quisquis ille est sonitum buccinæ, et non se observaverit, veneritque gladius, et tulerit eum : sanguis ipsius super caput ejus erit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:5
verses.text: Sonum buccinæ audivit, et non se observavit : sanguis ejus in ipso erit. Si autem se custodierit, animam suam salvabit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:6
verses.text: Quod si speculator viderit gladium venientem, et non insonuerit buccina, et populus se non custodierit, veneritque gladius, et tulerit de eis animam : ille quidem in iniquitate sua captus est ; sanguinem autem ejus de manu speculatoris requiram.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:7
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, speculatorem dedi te domui Israël : audiens ergo ex ore meo sermonem, annuntiabis eis ex me.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:8
verses.text: Si me dicente ad impium : Impie, morte morieris : non fueris locutus ut se custodiat impius a via sua, ipse impius in iniquitate sua morietur ; sanguinem autem ejus de manu tua requiram.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:9
verses.text: Si autem annuntiante te ad impium ut a viis suis convertatur, non fuerit conversus a via sua, ipse in iniquitate sua morietur, porro tu animam tuam liberasti.  <div eID="gen28427" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10300"/><div sID="gen28428" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10300"/>Tu ergo, fili hominis, dic ad domum Israël : Sic locuti estis, dicentes : Iniquitates nostræ et peccata nostra super nos sunt, et in ipsis nos tabescimus : quomodo ergo vivere poterimus ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:11
verses.text: Dic ad eos : Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, nolo mortem impii, sed ut convertatur impius a via sua, et vivat. Convertimini, convertimini a viis vestris pessimis, et quare moriemini, domus Israël ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:12
verses.text: Tu itaque, fili hominis, dic ad filios populi tui : Justitia justi non liberabit eum, in quacumque die peccaverit, et impietas impii non nocebit ei, in quacumque die conversus fuerit ab impietate sua : et justus non poterit vivere in justitia sua, in quacumque die peccaverit.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:13
verses.text: Etiamsi dixero justo quod vita vivat, et confisus in justitia sua fecerit iniquitatem, omnes justitiæ ejus oblivioni tradentur, et in iniquitate sua quam operatus est, in ipsa morietur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:14
verses.text: Si autem dixero impio : Morte morieris : et egerit pœnitentiam a peccato suo, feceritque judicium et justitiam,

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:15
verses.text: et pignus restituerit ille impius, rapinamque reddiderit, in mandatis vitæ ambulaverit, nec fecerit quidquam injustum : vita vivet, et non morietur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:16
verses.text: Omnia peccata ejus quæ peccavit, non imputabuntur ei : judicium et justitiam fecit : vita vivet.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:17
verses.text: Et dixerunt filii populi tui : Non est æqui ponderis via Domini : et ipsorum via injusta est.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:18
