verses.text: Cum enim recesserit justus a justitia sua, feceritque iniquitates, morietur in eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:19
verses.text: Et cum recesserit impius ab impietate sua, feceritque judicium et justitiam, vivet in eis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:20
verses.text: Et dicitis : Non est recta via Domini. Unumquemque juxta vias suas judicabo de vobis, domus Israël.  <div eID="gen28428" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10301"/><div sID="gen28429" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10301"/>Et factum est in duodecimo anno, in decimo mense, in quinta mensis transmigrationis nostræ, venit ad me qui fugerat de Jerusalem, dicens : Vastata est civitas.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:22
verses.text: Manus autem Domini facta fuerat ad me vespere, antequam veniret qui fugerat : aperuitque os meum donec veniret ad me mane : et aperto ore meo, non silui amplius.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:23
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:24
verses.text: Fili hominis, qui habitant in ruinosis his super humum Israël, loquentes aiunt : Unus erat Abraham, et hæreditate possedit terram : nos autem multi sumus : nobis data est terra in possessionem.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:25
verses.text: Idcirco dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Qui in sanguine comeditis, et oculos vestros levatis ad immunditias vestras, et sanguinem funditis, numquid terram hæreditate possidebitis ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:26
verses.text: stetistis in gladiis vestris, fecistis abominationes, et unusquisque uxorem proximi sui polluit : et terram hæreditate possidebitis ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:27
verses.text: Hæc dices ad eos : Sic dicit Dominus Deus : Vivo ego, quia qui in ruinosis habitant, gladio cadent : et qui in agro est, bestiis tradetur ad devorandum : qui autem in præsidiis et speluncis sunt, peste morientur.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:28
verses.text: Et dabo terram in solitudinem et in desertum, et deficiet superba fortitudo ejus : et desolabuntur montes Israël, eo quod nullus sit qui per eos transeat :

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:29
verses.text: et scient quia ego Dominus, cum dedero terram eorum desolatam et desertam, propter universas abominationes suas quas operati sunt.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:30
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, filii populi tui, qui loquuntur de te juxta muros et in ostiis domorum, et dicunt unus ad alterum, vir ad proximum suum, loquentes : Venite, et audiamus quis sit sermo egrediens a Domino.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:31
verses.text: Et veniunt ad te, quasi si ingrediatur populus, et sedent coram te populus meus : et audiunt sermones tuos, et non faciunt eos : quia in canticum oris sui vertunt illos, et avaritiam suam sequitur cor eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:32
verses.text: Et es eis quasi carmen musicum, quod suavi dulcique sono canitur : et audiunt verba tua, et non faciunt ea.

verses.name: Ezekiel 33:33
verses.text: Et cum venerit quod prædictum est (ecce enim venit), tunc scient quod prophetes fuerit inter eos.  <chapter eID="Ezek.33"/> <div eID="gen28429" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:1
verses.text: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, propheta de pastoribus Israël : propheta, et dices pastoribus : <div eID="gen28430" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28431"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28432"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28433"/>Væ pastoribus Israël, qui pascebant semetipsos ! <l eID="gen28433" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28434"/>nonne greges a pastoribus pascuntur ? <l eID="gen28434" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10302"/><l level="1" sID="gen28435"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10302"/>Lac comedebatis, <l eID="gen28435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28436"/>et lanis operiebamini, <l eID="gen28436" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28437"/>et quod crassum erat occidebatis : <l eID="gen28437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28438"/>gregem autem meum non pascebatis. <l eID="gen28438" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10303"/><l level="1" sID="gen28439"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10303"/>Quod infirmum fuit non consolidastis, <l eID="gen28439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28440"/>et quod ægrotum non sanastis : <l eID="gen28440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28441"/>quod confractum est non alligastis, <l eID="gen28441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28442"/>et quod abjectum est non reduxistis, <l eID="gen28442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28443"/>et quod perierat non quæsistis : <l eID="gen28443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28444"/>sed cum austeritate imperabatis eis, et cum potentia. <l eID="gen28444" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10304"/><l level="1" sID="gen28445"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10304"/>Et dispersæ sunt oves meæ, eo quod non esset pastor : <l eID="gen28445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28446"/>et factæ sunt in devorationem omnium bestiarum agri, <l eID="gen28446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28447"/>et dispersæ sunt. <l eID="gen28447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10305"/><l level="1" sID="gen28448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10305"/>Erraverunt greges mei in cunctis montibus, <l eID="gen28448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28449"/>et in universo colle excelso : <l eID="gen28449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28450"/>et super omnem faciem terræ dispersi sunt greges mei, <l eID="gen28450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28451"/>et non erat qui requireret : <l eID="gen28451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28452"/>non erat, inquam, qui requireret. <l eID="gen28452" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10306"/><l level="1" sID="gen28453"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10306"/>Propterea, pastores, audite verbum Domini. <l eID="gen28453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10307"/><l level="1" sID="gen28454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10307"/>Vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen28454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28455"/>quia pro eo quod facti sunt greges mei in rapinam, <l eID="gen28455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28456"/>et oves meæ in devorationem omnium bestiarum agri, <l eID="gen28456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28457"/>eo quod non esset pastor : <l eID="gen28457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28458"/>neque enim quæsierunt pastores mei gregem meum, <l eID="gen28458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28459"/>sed pascebant pastores semetipsos, <l eID="gen28459" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28460"/>et greges meos non pascebant : <l eID="gen28460" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10308"/><l level="1" sID="gen28461"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10308"/>propterea, pastores, audite verbum Domini. <l eID="gen28461" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10309"/><l level="1" sID="gen28462"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10309"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28463"/>Ecce ego ipse super pastores : <l eID="gen28463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28464"/>requiram gregem meum de manu eorum, <l eID="gen28464" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28465"/>et cessare faciam eos, <l eID="gen28465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28466"/>ut ultra non pascant gregem, <l eID="gen28466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28467"/>nec pascant amplius pastores semetipsos : <l eID="gen28467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28468"/>et liberabo gregem meum de ore eorum, <l eID="gen28468" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28469"/>et non erit ultra eis in escam. <l eID="gen28469" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10310"/><l level="1" sID="gen28470"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10310"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28470" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28471"/>Ecce ego ipse requiram oves meas, <l eID="gen28471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28472"/>et visitabo eas. <l eID="gen28472" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10311"/><l level="1" sID="gen28473"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10311"/>Sicut visitat pastor gregem suum, <l eID="gen28473" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28474"/>in die quando fuerit in medio ovium suarum dissipatarum, <l eID="gen28474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28475"/>sic visitabo oves meas, <l eID="gen28475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28476"/>et liberabo eas de omnibus locis <l eID="gen28476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28477"/>in quibus dispersæ fuerant in die nubis et caliginis. <l eID="gen28477" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10312"/><l level="1" sID="gen28478"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10312"/>Et educam eas de populis, <l eID="gen28478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28479"/>et congregabo eas de terris, <l eID="gen28479" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28480"/>et inducam eas in terram suam, <l eID="gen28480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28481"/>et pascam eas in montibus Israël, <l eID="gen28481" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28482"/>in rivis, et in cunctis sedibus terræ. <l eID="gen28482" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10313"/><l level="1" sID="gen28483"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10313"/>In pascuis uberrimis pascam eas, <l eID="gen28483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28484"/>et in montibus excelsis Israël erunt pascua earum : <l eID="gen28484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28485"/>ibi requiescent in herbis virentibus, <l eID="gen28485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28486"/>et in pascuis pinguibus pascentur super montes Israël. <l eID="gen28486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10314"/><l level="1" sID="gen28487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10314"/>Ego pascam oves meas, et ego eas accubare faciam, <l eID="gen28487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28488"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28488" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10315"/><l level="1" sID="gen28489"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10315"/>Quod perierat requiram, <l eID="gen28489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28490"/>et quod abjectum erat reducam, <l eID="gen28490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28491"/>et quod confractum fuerat alligabo, <l eID="gen28491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28492"/>et quod infirmum fuerat consolidabo, <l eID="gen28492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28493"/>et quod pingue et forte custodiam : <l eID="gen28493" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28494"/>et pascam illas in judicio. <l eID="gen28494" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10316"/><l level="1" sID="gen28495"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10316"/>Vos autem, greges mei, hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28496"/>Ecce ego judico inter pecus et pecus, <l eID="gen28496" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28497"/>arietum et hircorum. <l eID="gen28497" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10317"/><l level="1" sID="gen28498"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10317"/>Nonne satis vobis erat pascua bona depasci ? <l eID="gen28498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28499"/>insuper et reliquias pascuarum vestrarum conculcastis pedibus vestris : <l eID="gen28499" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28500"/>et cum purissimam aquam biberetis, <l eID="gen28500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28501"/>reliquam pedibus vestris turbabatis : <l eID="gen28501" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10318"/><l level="1" sID="gen28502"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10318"/>et oves meæ his quæ conculcata pedibus vestris fuerant, pascebantur : <l eID="gen28502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28503"/>et quæ pedes vestri turbaverant, hæc bibebant. <l eID="gen28503" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10319"/><l level="1" sID="gen28504"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10319"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus ad vos : <l eID="gen28504" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28505"/>Ecce ego ipse judico inter pecus pingue et macilentum : <l eID="gen28505" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10320"/><l level="1" sID="gen28506"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10320"/>pro eo quod lateribus et humeris impingebatis, <l eID="gen28506" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28507"/>et cornibus vestris ventilabatis omnia infirma pecora, <l eID="gen28507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28508"/>donec dispergerentur foras, <l eID="gen28508" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10321"/><l level="1" sID="gen28509"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10321"/>salvabo gregem meum, <l eID="gen28509" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28510"/>et non erit ultra in rapinam, <l eID="gen28510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28511"/>et judicabo inter pecus et pecus. <l eID="gen28511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10322"/><l level="1" sID="gen28512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10322"/>Et suscitabo super eas pastorem unum qui pascat eas, <l eID="gen28512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28513"/>servum meum David : <l eID="gen28513" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28514"/>ipse pascet eas, <l eID="gen28514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28515"/>et ipse erit eis in pastorem. <l eID="gen28515" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10323"/><l level="1" sID="gen28516"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10323"/>Ego autem Dominus ero eis in Deum, <l eID="gen28516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28517"/>et servus meus David princeps in medio eorum : <l eID="gen28517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28518"/>ego Dominus locutus sum. <l eID="gen28518" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10324"/><l level="1" sID="gen28519"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10324"/>Et faciam cum eis pactum pacis, <l eID="gen28519" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28520"/>et cessare faciam bestias pessimas de terra : <l eID="gen28520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28521"/>et qui habitant in deserto, <l eID="gen28521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28522"/>securi dormient in saltibus. <l eID="gen28522" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10325"/><l level="1" sID="gen28523"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10325"/>Et ponam eos in circuitu collis mei benedictionem, <l eID="gen28523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28524"/>et deducam imbrem in tempore suo : <l eID="gen28524" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28525"/>pluviæ benedictionis erunt. <l eID="gen28525" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10326"/><l level="1" sID="gen28526"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10326"/>Et dabit lignum agri fructum suum, <l eID="gen28526" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28527"/>et terra dabit germen suum, <l eID="gen28527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28528"/>et erunt in terra sua absque timore : <l eID="gen28528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28529"/>et scient quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen28529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28530"/>cum contrivero catenas jugi eorum, <l eID="gen28530" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28531"/>et eruero eos de manu imperantium sibi. <l eID="gen28531" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10327"/><l level="1" sID="gen28532"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10327"/>Et non erunt ultra in rapinam in gentibus, <l eID="gen28532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28533"/>neque bestiæ terræ devorabunt eos : <l eID="gen28533" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28534"/>sed habitabunt confidenter absque ullo terrore. <l eID="gen28534" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10328"/><l level="1" sID="gen28535"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10328"/>Et suscitabo eis germen nominatum, <l eID="gen28535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28536"/>et non erunt ultra imminuti fame in terra, <l eID="gen28536" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28537"/>neque portabunt ultra opprobrium gentium. <l eID="gen28537" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10329"/><l level="1" sID="gen28538"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10329"/>Et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum cum eis, <l eID="gen28538" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28539"/>et ipsi populus meus domus Israël, <l eID="gen28539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28540"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28540" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 34:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10330"/><l level="1" sID="gen28541"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10330"/>Vos autem, greges mei, greges pascuæ meæ, <l eID="gen28541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28542"/>homines estis : <l eID="gen28542" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28543"/>et ego Dominus Deus vester, <l eID="gen28543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28544"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28544" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28431"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.34"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam adversum montem Seir, et prophetabis de eo, et dices illi :  <div eID="gen28545" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10331"/><lg sID="gen28546"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10331"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28548"/>Ecce ego ad te, mons Seir : <l eID="gen28548" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28549"/>et extendam manum meam super te, <l eID="gen28549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28550"/>et dabo te desolatum atque desertum. <l eID="gen28550" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10332"/><l level="1" sID="gen28551"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10332"/>Urbes tuas demoliar, <l eID="gen28551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28552"/>et tu desertus eris : <l eID="gen28552" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28553"/>et scies quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28553" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10333"/><l level="1" sID="gen28554"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10333"/>Eo quod fueris inimicus sempiternus, <l eID="gen28554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28555"/>et concluseris filios Israël in manus gladii <l eID="gen28555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28556"/>in tempore afflictionis eorum, <l eID="gen28556" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28557"/>in tempore iniquitatis extremæ : <l eID="gen28557" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10334"/><l level="1" sID="gen28558"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10334"/>propterea vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen28558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28559"/>quoniam sanguini tradam te, <l eID="gen28559" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28560"/>et sanguis te persequetur : <l eID="gen28560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28561"/>et cum sanguinem oderis, <l eID="gen28561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28562"/>sanguis persequetur te. <l eID="gen28562" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10335"/><l level="1" sID="gen28563"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10335"/>Et dabo montem Seir desolatum atque desertum, <l eID="gen28563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28564"/>et auferam de eo euntem et redeuntem. <l eID="gen28564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10336"/><l level="1" sID="gen28565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10336"/>Et implebo montes ejus occisorum suorum : <l eID="gen28565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28566"/>in collibus tuis, et in vallibus tuis atque in torrentibus, <l eID="gen28566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28567"/>interfecti gladio cadent. <l eID="gen28567" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10337"/><l level="1" sID="gen28568"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10337"/>In solitudines sempiternas tradam te, <l eID="gen28568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28569"/>et civitates tuæ non habitabuntur : <l eID="gen28569" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28570"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28570" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10338"/><l level="1" sID="gen28571"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10338"/>Eo quod dixeris : Duæ gentes et duæ terræ meæ erunt, <l eID="gen28571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28572"/>et hæreditate possidebo eas, <l eID="gen28572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28573"/>cum Dominus esset ibi : <l eID="gen28573" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10339"/><l level="1" sID="gen28574"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10339"/>propterea vivo ego, dicit Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen28574" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28575"/>quia faciam juxta iram tuam, et secundum zelum tuum, <l eID="gen28575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28576"/>quem fecisti odio habens eos : <l eID="gen28576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28577"/>et notus efficiar per eos, cum te judicavero. <l eID="gen28577" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10340"/><l level="1" sID="gen28578"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10340"/>Et scies quia ego Dominus audivi universa opprobria tua <l eID="gen28578" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28579"/>quæ locutus es de montibus Israël, dicens : <l eID="gen28579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28580"/>Deserti nobis ad devorandum dati sunt. <l eID="gen28580" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10341"/><l level="1" sID="gen28581"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10341"/>Et insurrexistis super me ore vestro, <l eID="gen28581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28582"/>et derogastis adversum me verba vestra : <l eID="gen28582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28583"/>ego audivi. <l eID="gen28583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10342"/><l level="1" sID="gen28584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10342"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28585"/>Lætante universa terra, <l eID="gen28585" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28586"/>in solitudinem te redigam : <l eID="gen28586" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 35:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10343"/><l level="1" sID="gen28587"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10343"/>sicuti gavisus es super hæreditatem domus Israël <l eID="gen28587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28588"/>eo quod fuerit dissipata, <l eID="gen28588" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28589"/>sic faciam tibi : <l eID="gen28589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28590"/>dissipatus eris, mons Seir, et Idumæa omnis : <l eID="gen28590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28591"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28591" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28546"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.35"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:1
verses.text: Tu autem, fili hominis, propheta super montes Israël, et dices : <div eID="gen28592" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28593"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28594"/>Montes Israël, audite verbum Domini. <l eID="gen28594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10344"/><l level="1" sID="gen28595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10344"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28596"/>Eo quod dixerit inimicus de vobis : Euge, <l eID="gen28596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28597"/>altitudines sempiternæ in hæreditatem datæ sunt nobis : <l eID="gen28597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10345"/><l level="1" sID="gen28598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10345"/>propterea vaticinare, et dic : <l eID="gen28598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28599"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28599" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28600"/>Pro eo quod desolati estis, et conculcati per circuitum, <l eID="gen28600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28601"/>et facti in hæreditatem reliquis gentibus, <l eID="gen28601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28602"/>et ascendistis super labium linguæ et opprobrium populi, <l eID="gen28602" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10346"/><l level="1" sID="gen28603"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10346"/>propterea, montes Israël, audite verbum Domini Dei. <l eID="gen28603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28604"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus montibus et collibus, <l eID="gen28604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28605"/>torrentibus, vallibusque et desertis, <l eID="gen28605" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28606"/>parietinis et urbibus derelictis, <l eID="gen28606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28607"/>quæ depopulatæ sunt et subsannatæ a reliquis gentibus per circuitum. <l eID="gen28607" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10347"/><l level="1" sID="gen28608"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10347"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28609"/>Quoniam in igne zeli mei locutus sum de reliquis gentibus, <l eID="gen28609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28610"/>et de Idumæa universa, <l eID="gen28610" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28611"/>quæ dederunt terram meam sibi in hæreditatem cum gaudio, <l eID="gen28611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28612"/>et toto corde et ex animo, <l eID="gen28612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28613"/>et ejecerunt eam ut vastarent : <l eID="gen28613" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10348"/><l level="1" sID="gen28614"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10348"/>idcirco vaticinare super humum Israël, <l eID="gen28614" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28615"/>et dices montibus et collibus, jugis et vallibus : <l eID="gen28615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28616"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28617"/>Ecce ego in zelo meo et in furore meo locutus sum, <l eID="gen28617" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28618"/>eo quod confusionem gentium sustinueritis. <l eID="gen28618" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10349"/><l level="1" sID="gen28619"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10349"/>Idcirco hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28620"/>Ego levavi manum meam, <l eID="gen28620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28621"/>ut gentes quæ in circuitu vestro sunt, <l eID="gen28621" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28622"/>ipsæ confusionem suam portent. <l eID="gen28622" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10350"/><l level="1" sID="gen28623"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10350"/>Vos autem, montes Israël, ramos vestros germinetis, <l eID="gen28623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28624"/>et fructum vestrum afferatis populo meo Israël : <l eID="gen28624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28625"/>prope enim est ut veniat. <l eID="gen28625" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10351"/><l level="1" sID="gen28626"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10351"/>Quia ecce ego ad vos, et convertar ad vos : <l eID="gen28626" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28627"/>et arabimini, et accipietis sementem. <l eID="gen28627" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10352"/><l level="1" sID="gen28628"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10352"/>Et multiplicabo in vobis homines, omnemque domum Israël : <l eID="gen28628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28629"/>et habitabuntur civitates, et ruinosa instaurabuntur. <l eID="gen28629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10353"/><l level="1" sID="gen28630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10353"/>Et replebo vos hominibus et jumentis, <l eID="gen28630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28631"/>et multiplicabuntur, et crescent : <l eID="gen28631" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28632"/>et habitare vos faciam sicut a principio, <l eID="gen28632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28633"/>bonisque donabo majoribus quam habuistis ab initio : <l eID="gen28633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28634"/>et scietis quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28634" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10354"/><l level="1" sID="gen28635"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10354"/>Et adducam super vos homines, populum meum Israël, <l eID="gen28635" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28636"/>et hæreditate possidebunt te : <l eID="gen28636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28637"/>et eris eis in hæreditatem, <l eID="gen28637" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28638"/>et non addes ultra ut absque eis sis. <l eID="gen28638" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10355"/><l level="1" sID="gen28639"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10355"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28640"/>Pro eo quod dicunt de vobis : <l eID="gen28640" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28641"/>Devoratrix hominum es, et suffocans gentem tuam : <l eID="gen28641" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10356"/><l level="1" sID="gen28642"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10356"/>propterea homines non comedes amplius, <l eID="gen28642" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28643"/>et gentem tuam non necabis ultra, <l eID="gen28643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28644"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28644" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10357"/><l level="1" sID="gen28645"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10357"/>Nec auditam faciam in te amplius confusionem gentium, <l eID="gen28645" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28646"/>et opprobrium populorum nequaquam portabis : <l eID="gen28646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28647"/>et gentem tuam non amittes amplius, <l eID="gen28647" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28648"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28648" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen28593"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10358"/><div sID="gen28649" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10358"/>Et factum est verbum Domini ad me, dicens :  <div eID="gen28649" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10359"/><lg sID="gen28650"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10359"/>Fili hominis, domus Israël habitaverunt in humo sua, <l eID="gen28651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28652"/>et polluerunt eam in viis suis et in studiis suis : <l eID="gen28652" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28653"/>juxta immunditiam menstruatæ facta est via eorum coram me. <l eID="gen28653" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10360"/><l level="1" sID="gen28654"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10360"/>Et effudi indignationem meam super eos <l eID="gen28654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28655"/>pro sanguine quem fuderunt super terram, <l eID="gen28655" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28656"/>et in idolis suis polluerunt eam. <l eID="gen28656" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10361"/><l level="1" sID="gen28657"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10361"/>Et dispersi eos in gentes, <l eID="gen28657" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28658"/>et ventilati sunt in terras : <l eID="gen28658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28659"/>juxta vias eorum et adinventiones eorum judicavi eos. <l eID="gen28659" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10362"/><l level="1" sID="gen28660"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10362"/>Et ingressi sunt ad gentes ad quas introierunt : <l eID="gen28660" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28661"/>et polluerunt nomen sanctum meum, <l eID="gen28661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28662"/>cum diceretur de eis : Populus Domini iste est, <l eID="gen28662" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28663"/>et de terra ejus egressi sunt. <l eID="gen28663" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10363"/><l level="1" sID="gen28664"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10363"/>Et peperci nomini sancto meo, <l eID="gen28664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28665"/>quod polluerat domus Israël in gentibus ad quas ingressi sunt. <l eID="gen28665" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10364"/><l level="1" sID="gen28666"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10364"/>Idcirco dices domui Israël : <l eID="gen28666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28667"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28667" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28668"/>Non propter vos ego faciam, domus Israël, <l eID="gen28668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28669"/>sed propter nomen sanctum meum, <l eID="gen28669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28670"/>quod polluistis in gentibus ad quas intrastis. <l eID="gen28670" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10365"/><l level="1" sID="gen28671"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10365"/>Et sanctificabo nomen meum magnum <l eID="gen28671" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28672"/>quod pollutum est inter gentes, <l eID="gen28672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28673"/>quod polluistis in medio earum : <l eID="gen28673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28674"/>ut sciant gentes quia ego Dominus, <l eID="gen28674" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28675"/>ait Dominus exercituum, <l eID="gen28675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28676"/>cum sanctificatus fuero in vobis coram eis. <l eID="gen28676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10366"/><l level="1" sID="gen28677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10366"/>Tollam quippe vos de gentibus, <l eID="gen28677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28678"/>et congregabo vos de universis terris, <l eID="gen28678" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28679"/>et adducam vos in terram vestram. <l eID="gen28679" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10367"/><l level="1" sID="gen28680"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10367"/>Et effundam super vos aquam mundam, <l eID="gen28680" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28681"/>et mundabimini ab omnibus inquinamentis vestris, <l eID="gen28681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28682"/>et ab universis idolis vestris mundabo vos. <l eID="gen28682" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10368"/><l level="1" sID="gen28683"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10368"/>Et dabo vobis cor novum, <l eID="gen28683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28684"/>et spiritum novum ponam in medio vestri : <l eID="gen28684" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28685"/>et auferam cor lapideum de carne vestra, <l eID="gen28685" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28686"/>et dabo vobis cor carneum. <l eID="gen28686" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10369"/><l level="1" sID="gen28687"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10369"/>Et spiritum meum ponam in medio vestri : <l eID="gen28687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28688"/>et faciam ut in præceptis meis ambuletis, <l eID="gen28688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28689"/>et judicia mea custodiatis et operemini. <l eID="gen28689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10370"/><l level="1" sID="gen28690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10370"/>Et habitabitis in terra quam dedi patribus vestris : <l eID="gen28690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28691"/>et eritis mihi in populum, <l eID="gen28691" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28692"/>et ego ero vobis in Deum. <l eID="gen28692" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10371"/><l level="1" sID="gen28693"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10371"/>Et salvabo vos ex universis inquinamentis vestris : <l eID="gen28693" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28694"/>et vocabo frumentum et multiplicabo illud, <l eID="gen28694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28695"/>et non imponam vobis famem. <l eID="gen28695" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10372"/><l level="1" sID="gen28696"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10372"/>Et multiplicabo fructum ligni, et genimina agri, <l eID="gen28696" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28697"/>ut non portetis ultra opprobrium famis in gentibus. <l eID="gen28697" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10373"/><l level="1" sID="gen28698"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10373"/>Et recordabimini viarum vestrarum pessimarum, <l eID="gen28698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28699"/>studiorumque non bonorum : <l eID="gen28699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28700"/>et displicebunt vobis iniquitates vestræ et scelera vestra. <l eID="gen28700" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10374"/><l level="1" sID="gen28701"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10374"/>Non propter vos ego faciam, ait Dominus Deus, notum sit vobis : <l eID="gen28701" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28702"/>confundimini, et erubescite super viis vestris, domus Israël. <l eID="gen28702" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:33
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10375"/><l level="1" sID="gen28703"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10375"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28704"/>In die qua mundavero vos ex omnibus iniquitatibus vestris, <l eID="gen28704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28705"/>et inhabitari fecero urbes, <l eID="gen28705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28706"/>et instauravero ruinosa, <l eID="gen28706" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:34
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10376"/><l level="1" sID="gen28707"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10376"/>et terra deserta fuerit exculta, <l eID="gen28707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28708"/>quæ quondam erat desolata in oculis omnis viatoris, <l eID="gen28708" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:35
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10377"/><l level="1" sID="gen28709"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10377"/>dicent : Terra illa inculta facta est ut hortus voluptatis : <l eID="gen28709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28710"/>et civitates desertæ, et destitutæ atque suffossæ, munitæ sederunt. <l eID="gen28710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:36
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10378"/><l level="1" sID="gen28711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10378"/>Et scient gentes quæcumque derelictæ fuerint in circuitu vestro, <l eID="gen28711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28712"/>quia ego Dominus ædificavi dissipata, plantavique inculta : <l eID="gen28712" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28713"/>ego Dominus locutus sim, et fecerim. <l eID="gen28713" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:37
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10379"/><l level="1" sID="gen28714"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10379"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28715"/>Adhuc in hoc invenient me domus Israël, ut faciam eis : <l eID="gen28715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28716"/>multiplicabo eos sicut gregem hominum, <l eID="gen28716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 36:38
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10380"/><l level="1" sID="gen28717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10380"/>ut gregem sanctum, <l eID="gen28717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28718"/>ut gregem Jerusalem in solemnitatibus ejus : <l eID="gen28718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28719"/>sic erunt civitates desertæ, plenæ gregibus hominum : <l eID="gen28719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28720"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28720" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28650"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.36"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:1
verses.text: Facta est super me manus Domini, et eduxit me in spiritu Domini, et dimisit me in medio campi qui erat plenus ossibus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:2
verses.text: Et circumduxit me per ea in gyro : erant autem multa valde super faciem campi, siccaque vehementer.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:3
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, putasne vivent ossa ista ? Et dixi : Domine Deus, tu nosti.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:4
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Vaticinare de ossibus istis, et dices eis : Ossa arida, audite verbum Domini.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:5
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus Deus ossibus his : Ecce ego intromittam in vos spiritum, et vivetis.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:6
verses.text: Et dabo super vos nervos, et succrescere faciam super vos carnes, et superextendam in vobis cutem, et dabo vobis spiritum, et vivetis : et scietis quia ego Dominus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:7
verses.text: Et prophetavi sicut præceperat mihi : factus est autem sonitus, prophetante me, et ecce commotio : et accesserunt ossa ad ossa, unumquodque ad juncturam suam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:8
verses.text: Et vidi, et ecce super ea nervi et carnes ascenderunt, et extenta est in eis cutis desuper : et spiritum non habebant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:9
verses.text: Et dixit ad me : Vaticinare ad spiritum : vaticinare, fili hominis, et dices ad spiritum : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : A quatuor ventis veni, spiritus, et insuffla super interfectos istos, et reviviscant.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:10
verses.text: Et prophetavi sicut præceperat mihi : et ingressus est in ea spiritus, et vixerunt : steteruntque super pedes suos, exercitus grandis nimis valde.  <div eID="gen28721" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10381"/><div sID="gen28722" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10381"/>Et dixit ad me : Fili hominis, ossa hæc universa, domus Israël est. Ipsi dicunt : Aruerunt ossa nostra, et periit spes nostra, et abscissi sumus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:12
verses.text: Propterea vaticinare, et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego aperiam tumulos vestros, et educam vos de sepulchris vestris, populus meus, et inducam vos in terram Israël.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:13
verses.text: Et scietis quia ego Dominus, cum aperuero sepulchra vestra, et eduxero vos de tumulis vestris, popule meus,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:14
verses.text: et dedero spiritum meum in vobis, et vixeritis : et requiescere vos faciam super humum vestram, et scietis quia ego Dominus locutus sum, et feci, ait Dominus Deus.  <div eID="gen28722" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10382"/><div sID="gen28723" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10382"/>Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:16
verses.text: Et tu, fili hominis, sume tibi lignum unum, et scribe super illud : Judæ, et filiorum Israël sociorum ejus : et tolle lignum alterum, et scribe super illud : Joseph, ligno Ephraim, et cunctæ domui Israël sociorumque ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:17
verses.text: Et adjunge illa unum ad alterum tibi in lignum unum : et erunt in unionem in manu tua.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:18
verses.text: Cum autem dixerint ad te filii populi tui, loquentes : Nonne indicas nobis quid in his tibi velis ?

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:19
verses.text: loqueris ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego assumam lignum Joseph, quod est in manu Ephraim, et tribus Israël, quæ sunt ei adjunctæ, et dabo eas pariter cum ligno Juda, et faciam eas in lignum unum : et erunt unum in manu ejus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:20
verses.text: Erunt autem ligna super quæ scripseris in manu tua in oculis eorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:21
verses.text: Et dices ad eos : Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : Ecce ego assumam filios Israël de medio nationum ad quas abierunt : et congregabo eos undique, et adducam eos ad humum suam.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:22
verses.text: Et faciam eos in gentem unam in terra in montibus Israël, et rex unus erit omnibus imperans : et non erunt ultra duæ gentes, nec dividentur amplius in duo regna,

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:23
verses.text: neque polluentur ultra in idolis suis, et abominationibus suis, et cunctis iniquitatibus suis : et salvos eos faciam de universis sedibus in quibus peccaverunt, et emundabo eos : et erunt mihi populus, et ego ero eis Deus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:24
verses.text: Et servus meus David rex super eos, et pastor unus erit omnium eorum. In judiciis meis ambulabunt, et mandata mea custodient, et facient ea :

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:25
verses.text: et habitabunt super terram quam dedi servo meo Jacob, in qua habitaverunt patres vestri : et habitabunt super eam ipsi, et filii eorum, et filii filiorum eorum, usque in sempiternum : et David servus meus princeps eorum in perpetuum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:26
verses.text: Et percutiam illis fœdus pacis : pactum sempiternum erit eis. Et fundabo eos, et multiplicabo, et dabo sanctificationem meam in medio eorum in perpetuum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:27
verses.text: Et erit tabernaculum meum in eis : et ero eis Deus, et ipsi erunt mihi populus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 37:28
verses.text: Et scient gentes quia ego Dominus sanctificator Israël, cum fuerit sanctificatio mea in medio eorum in perpetuum.  <chapter eID="Ezek.37"/> <div eID="gen28723" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:1
verses.text: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens :

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:2
verses.text: Fili hominis, pone faciem tuam contra Gog, terram Magog, principem capitis Mosoch et Thubal, et vaticinare de eo.

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:3
verses.text: Et dices ad eum : <div eID="gen28724" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28725"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28726"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28726" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28727"/>Ecce ego ad te, Gog, principem capitis Mosoch et Thubal. <l eID="gen28727" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10383"/><l level="1" sID="gen28728"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10383"/>Et circumagam te, et ponam frenum in maxillis tuis : <l eID="gen28728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28729"/>et educam te, et omnem exercitum tuum, <l eID="gen28729" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28730"/>equos et equites vestitos loricis universos, <l eID="gen28730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28731"/>multitudinem magnam, hastam et clypeum arripientium et gladium. <l eID="gen28731" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10384"/><l level="1" sID="gen28732"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10384"/>Persæ, Æthiopes, et Libyes cum eis, <l eID="gen28732" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28733"/>omnes scutati et galeati. <l eID="gen28733" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10385"/><l level="1" sID="gen28734"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10385"/>Gomer et universa agmina ejus, <l eID="gen28734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28735"/>domus Thogorma, latera aquilonis, <l eID="gen28735" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28736"/>et totum robur ejus, populique multi tecum. <l eID="gen28736" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10386"/><l level="1" sID="gen28737"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10386"/>Præpara et instrue te, <l eID="gen28737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28738"/>et omnem multitudinem tuam quæ coacervata est ad te : <l eID="gen28738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28739"/>et esto eis in præceptum. <l eID="gen28739" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10387"/><l level="1" sID="gen28740"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10387"/>Post dies multos visitaberis : <l eID="gen28740" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28741"/>in novissimo annorum venies ad terram quæ reversa est a gladio, <l eID="gen28741" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28742"/>et congregata est de populis multis ad montes Israël, <l eID="gen28742" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28743"/>qui fuerunt deserti jugiter : <l eID="gen28743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28744"/>hæc de populis educta est, <l eID="gen28744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28745"/>et habitabunt in ea confidenter universi. <l eID="gen28745" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10388"/><l level="1" sID="gen28746"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10388"/>Ascendens autem quasi tempestas venies, <l eID="gen28746" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28747"/>et quasi nubes, ut operias terram : <l eID="gen28747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28748"/>tu et omnia agmina tua, <l eID="gen28748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28749"/>et populi multi tecum. <l eID="gen28749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10389"/><l level="1" sID="gen28750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10389"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28751"/>In die illa, ascendent sermones super cor tuum, <l eID="gen28751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28752"/>et cogitabis cogitationem pessimam : <l eID="gen28752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10390"/><l level="1" sID="gen28753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10390"/>et dices : Ascendam ad terram absque muro : <l eID="gen28753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28754"/>veniam ad quiescentes habitantesque secure : <l eID="gen28754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28755"/>hi omnes habitant sine muro ; <l eID="gen28755" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28756"/>vectes et portæ non sunt eis : <l eID="gen28756" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10391"/><l level="1" sID="gen28757"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10391"/>ut diripias spolia, et invadas prædam ; <l eID="gen28757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28758"/>ut inferas manum tuam super eos qui deserti fuerant, et postea restituti, <l eID="gen28758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28759"/>et super populum qui est congregatus ex gentibus, <l eID="gen28759" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28760"/>qui possidere cœpit et esse habitator umbilici terræ. <l eID="gen28760" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10392"/><l level="1" sID="gen28761"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10392"/>Saba, et Dedan, et negotiatores Tharsis, <l eID="gen28761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28762"/>et omnes leones ejus, dicent tibi : <l eID="gen28762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28763"/>Numquid ad sumenda spolia tu venis ? <l eID="gen28763" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28764"/>ecce ad diripiendam prædam congregasti multitudinem tuam, <l eID="gen28764" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28765"/>ut tollas argentum et aurum, <l eID="gen28765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28766"/>et auferas supellectilem atque substantiam, <l eID="gen28766" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28767"/>et diripias manubias infinitas. <l eID="gen28767" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10393"/><l level="1" sID="gen28768"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10393"/>Propterea vaticinare, fili hominis, et dices ad Gog : <l eID="gen28768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28769"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28770"/>Numquid non in die illo, <l eID="gen28770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28771"/>cum habitaverit populus meus Israël confidenter, <l eID="gen28771" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28772"/>scies ? <l eID="gen28772" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10394"/><l level="1" sID="gen28773"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10394"/>Et venies de loco tuo a lateribus aquilonis, <l eID="gen28773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28774"/>tu et populi multi tecum, <l eID="gen28774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28775"/>ascensores equorum universi : <l eID="gen28775" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28776"/>cœtus magnus, et exercitus vehemens. <l eID="gen28776" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10395"/><l level="1" sID="gen28777"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10395"/>Et ascendes super populum meum Israël <l eID="gen28777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28778"/>quasi nubes, ut operias terram. <l eID="gen28778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28779"/>In novissimis diebus eris, <l eID="gen28779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28780"/>et adducam te super terram meam : <l eID="gen28780" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28781"/>ut sciant gentes me <l eID="gen28781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28782"/>cum sanctificatus fuero in te in oculis eorum, o Gog ! <l eID="gen28782" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10396"/><l level="1" sID="gen28783"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10396"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28784"/>Tu ergo ille es, de quo locutus sum in diebus antiquis <l eID="gen28784" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28785"/>in manu servorum meorum prophetarum Israël, <l eID="gen28785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28786"/>qui prophetaverunt in diebus illorum temporum, <l eID="gen28786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28787"/>ut adducerem te super eos. <l eID="gen28787" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10397"/><l level="1" sID="gen28788"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10397"/>Et erit in die illa, <l eID="gen28788" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28789"/>in die adventus Gog super terram Israël, <l eID="gen28789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28790"/>ait Dominus Deus, <l eID="gen28790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28791"/>ascendet indignatio mea in furore meo. <l eID="gen28791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10398"/><l level="1" sID="gen28792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10398"/>Et in zelo meo, in igne iræ meæ locutus sum, <l eID="gen28792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28793"/>quia in die illa erit commotio magna super terram Israël : <l eID="gen28793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10399"/><l level="1" sID="gen28794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10399"/>et commovebuntur a facie mea pisces maris, <l eID="gen28794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28795"/>et volucres cæli, et bestiæ agri, <l eID="gen28795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28796"/>et omne reptile quod movetur super humum, <l eID="gen28796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28797"/>cunctique homines qui sunt super faciem terræ : <l eID="gen28797" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28798"/>et subvertentur montes, et cadent sepes, <l eID="gen28798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28799"/>et omnis murus corruet in terram. <l eID="gen28799" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10400"/><l level="1" sID="gen28800"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10400"/>Et convocabo adversus eum in cunctis montibus meis gladium, <l eID="gen28800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28801"/>ait Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28801" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28802"/>gladius uniuscujusque in fratrem suum dirigetur. <l eID="gen28802" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10401"/><l level="1" sID="gen28803"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10401"/>Et judicabo eum peste, et sanguine, <l eID="gen28803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28804"/>et imbre vehementi, et lapidibus immensis : <l eID="gen28804" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28805"/>ignem et sulphur pluam super eum, <l eID="gen28805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28806"/>et super exercitum ejus, <l eID="gen28806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28807"/>et super populos multos qui sunt cum eo. <l eID="gen28807" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 38:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10402"/><l level="1" sID="gen28808"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10402"/>Et magnificabor, et sanctificabor, <l eID="gen28808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28809"/>et notus ero in oculis multarum gentium : <l eID="gen28809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28810"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28810" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28725"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.38"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:1
verses.text: Tu autem, fili hominis, vaticinare adversum Gog, et dices : <div eID="gen28811" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen28812"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28813"/>Hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28814"/>Ecce ego super te, Gog, <l eID="gen28814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28815"/>principem capitis Mosoch et Thubal. <l eID="gen28815" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10403"/><l level="1" sID="gen28816"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10403"/>Et circumagam te, et educam te, <l eID="gen28816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28817"/>et ascendere te faciam de lateribus aquilonis, <l eID="gen28817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28818"/>et adducam te super montes Israël. <l eID="gen28818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10404"/><l level="1" sID="gen28819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10404"/>Et percutiam arcum tuum in manu sinistra tua, <l eID="gen28819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28820"/>et sagittas tuas de manu dextera tua dejiciam. <l eID="gen28820" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10405"/><l level="1" sID="gen28821"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10405"/>Super montes Israël cades tu, et omnia agmina tua, <l eID="gen28821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28822"/>et populi tui qui sunt tecum : <l eID="gen28822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28823"/>feris, avibus, omnique volatili et bestiis terræ <l eID="gen28823" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28824"/>dedi te ad devorandum. <l eID="gen28824" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10406"/><l level="1" sID="gen28825"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10406"/>Super faciem agri cades, <l eID="gen28825" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28826"/>quia ego locutus sum, <l eID="gen28826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28827"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28827" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10407"/><l level="1" sID="gen28828"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10407"/>Et immittam ignem in Magog, <l eID="gen28828" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28829"/>et in his qui habitant in insulis confidenter : <l eID="gen28829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28830"/>et scient quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen28830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10408"/><l level="1" sID="gen28831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10408"/>Et nomen sanctum meum notum faciam in medio populi mei Israël, <l eID="gen28831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28832"/>et non polluam nomen sanctum meum amplius : <l eID="gen28832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28833"/>et scient gentes quia ego Dominus, Sanctus Israël. <l eID="gen28833" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10409"/><l level="1" sID="gen28834"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10409"/>Ecce venit, et factum est, <l eID="gen28834" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28835"/>ait Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28836"/>hæc est dies de qua locutus sum. <l eID="gen28836" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10410"/><l level="1" sID="gen28837"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10410"/>Et egredientur habitatores de civitatibus Israël, <l eID="gen28837" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28838"/>et succendent et comburent arma, <l eID="gen28838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28839"/>clypeum et hastas, arcum et sagittas, et baculos manuum et contos : <l eID="gen28839" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28840"/>et succendent ea igni septem annis. <l eID="gen28840" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10411"/><l level="1" sID="gen28841"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10411"/>Et non portabunt ligna de regionibus, <l eID="gen28841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28842"/>neque succident de saltibus : <l eID="gen28842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28843"/>quoniam arma succendent igni, <l eID="gen28843" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28844"/>et deprædabuntur eos quibus prædæ fuerant, <l eID="gen28844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28845"/>et diripient vastatores suos, <l eID="gen28845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28846"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28846" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10412"/><l level="1" sID="gen28847"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10412"/>Et erit in die illa : <l eID="gen28847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28848"/>dabo Gog locum nominatum sepulchrum in Israël, <l eID="gen28848" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28849"/>vallem viatorum ad orientem maris, <l eID="gen28849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28850"/>quæ obstupescere faciet prætereuntes : <l eID="gen28850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28851"/>et sepelient ibi Gog, et omnem multitudinem ejus, <l eID="gen28851" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28852"/>et vocabitur vallis multitudinis Gog. <l eID="gen28852" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10413"/><l level="1" sID="gen28853"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10413"/>Et sepelient eos domus Israël, <l eID="gen28853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28854"/>ut mundent terram septem mensibus. <l eID="gen28854" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10414"/><l level="1" sID="gen28855"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10414"/>Sepeliet autem eum omnis populus terræ : <l eID="gen28855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28856"/>et erit eis nominata dies in qua glorificatus sum, <l eID="gen28856" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28857"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28857" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10415"/><l level="1" sID="gen28858"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10415"/>Et viros jugiter constituent lustrantes terram, <l eID="gen28858" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28859"/>qui sepeliant et requirant eos qui remanserant super faciem terræ, <l eID="gen28859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28860"/>ut emundent eam : <l eID="gen28860" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28861"/>post menses autem septem quærere incipient. <l eID="gen28861" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10416"/><l level="1" sID="gen28862"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10416"/>Et circuibunt peragrantes terram : <l eID="gen28862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28863"/>cumque viderint os hominis, statuent juxta illud titulum, <l eID="gen28863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28864"/>donec sepeliant illud pollinctores in valle multitudinis Gog. <l eID="gen28864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10417"/><l level="1" sID="gen28865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10417"/>Nomen autem civitatis Amona : <l eID="gen28865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28866"/>et mundabunt terram. <l eID="gen28866" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10418"/><l level="1" sID="gen28867"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10418"/>Tu ergo, fili hominis, hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28868"/>Dic omni volucri, et universis avibus, <l eID="gen28868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28869"/>cunctisque bestiis agri : <l eID="gen28869" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28870"/>Convenite, properate, <l eID="gen28870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28871"/>concurrite undique ad victimam meam <l eID="gen28871" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28872"/>quam ego immolo vobis, <l eID="gen28872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28873"/>victimam grandem super montes Israël, <l eID="gen28873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28874"/>ut comedatis carnem, <l eID="gen28874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28875"/>et bibatis sanguinem. <l eID="gen28875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10419"/><l level="1" sID="gen28876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10419"/>Carnes fortium comedetis, <l eID="gen28876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28877"/>et sanguinem principum terræ bibetis : <l eID="gen28877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28878"/>arietum, et agnorum, et hircorum, <l eID="gen28878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28879"/>taurorumque et altilium, et pinguium omnium. <l eID="gen28879" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10420"/><l level="1" sID="gen28880"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10420"/>Et comedetis adipem in saturitatem, <l eID="gen28880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28881"/>et bibetis sanguinem in ebrietatem, <l eID="gen28881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28882"/>de victima quam ego immolabo vobis : <l eID="gen28882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10421"/><l level="1" sID="gen28883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10421"/>et saturabimini super mensam meam <l eID="gen28883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28884"/>de equo, et equite forti, <l eID="gen28884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28885"/>et de universis viris bellatoribus, <l eID="gen28885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28886"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28886" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10422"/><l level="1" sID="gen28887"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10422"/>Et ponam gloriam meam in gentibus : <l eID="gen28887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28888"/>et videbunt omnes gentes judicium meum quod fecerim, <l eID="gen28888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28889"/>et manum meam quam posuerim super eos. <l eID="gen28889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10423"/><l level="1" sID="gen28890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10423"/>Et scient domus Israël quia ego Dominus Deus eorum, <l eID="gen28890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28891"/>a die illa et deinceps. <l eID="gen28891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10424"/><l level="1" sID="gen28892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10424"/>Et scient gentes quoniam in iniquitate sua capta sit domus Israël, <l eID="gen28892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28893"/>eo quod dereliquerint me, <l eID="gen28893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28894"/>et absconderim faciem meam ab eis, <l eID="gen28894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28895"/>et tradiderim eos in manus hostium, <l eID="gen28895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28896"/>et ceciderint in gladio universi. <l eID="gen28896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10425"/><l level="1" sID="gen28897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10425"/>Juxta immunditiam eorum et scelus feci eis, <l eID="gen28897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28898"/>et abscondi faciem meam ab illis. <l eID="gen28898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10426"/><l level="1" sID="gen28899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10426"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen28899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28900"/>Nunc reducam captivitatem Jacob, <l eID="gen28900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28901"/>et miserebor omnis domus Israël, <l eID="gen28901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28902"/>et assumam zelum pro nomine sancto meo. <l eID="gen28902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10427"/><l level="1" sID="gen28903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10427"/>Et portabunt confusionem suam, <l eID="gen28903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28904"/>et omnem prævaricationem qua prævaricati sunt in me, <l eID="gen28904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28905"/>cum habitaverint in terra sua confidenter, <l eID="gen28905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28906"/>neminem formidantes : <l eID="gen28906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10428"/><l level="1" sID="gen28907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10428"/>et reduxero eos de populis, <l eID="gen28907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28908"/>et congregavero de terris inimicorum suorum, <l eID="gen28908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28909"/>et sanctificatus fuero in eis, <l eID="gen28909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28910"/>in oculis gentium plurimarum. <l eID="gen28910" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10429"/><l level="1" sID="gen28911"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10429"/>Et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum, <l eID="gen28911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28912"/>eo quod transtulerim eos in nationes, <l eID="gen28912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28913"/>et congregaverim eos super terram suam, <l eID="gen28913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28914"/>et non dereliquerim quemquam ex eis ibi. <l eID="gen28914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 39:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10430"/><l level="1" sID="gen28915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10430"/>Et non abscondam ultra faciem meam ab eis, <l eID="gen28915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28916"/>eo quod effuderim spiritum meum super omnem domum Israël, <l eID="gen28916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen28917"/>ait Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen28917" level="1"/><lg eID="gen28812"/> <chapter eID="Ezek.39"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:1
verses.text: In vigesimo quinto anno transmigrationis nostræ, in exordio anni, decima mensis, quartodecimo anno postquam percussa est civitas, in ipsa hac die, facta est super me manus Domini, et adduxit me illuc.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:2
verses.text: In visionibus Dei adduxit me in terram Israël, et dimisit me super montem excelsum nimis, super quem erat quasi ædificium civitatis vergentis ad austrum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:3
verses.text: Et introduxit me illuc : et ecce vir cujus erat species quasi species æris, et funiculus lineus in manu ejus, et calamus mensuræ in manu ejus : stabat autem in porta.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:4
verses.text: Et locutus est ad me idem vir : Fili hominis, vide oculis tuis, et auribus tuis audi, et pone cor tuum in omnia quæ ego ostendam tibi, quia ut ostendantur tibi adductus es huc. Annuntia omnia quæ tu vides domui Israël.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:5
verses.text: Et ecce murus forinsecus in circuitu domus undique : et in manu viri calamus mensuræ sex cubitorum et palmo : et mensus est latitudinem ædificii calamo uno, altitudinem quoque calamo uno.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:6
verses.text: Et venit ad portam quæ respiciebat viam orientalem, et ascendit per gradus ejus : et mensus est limen portæ calamo uno latitudinem, id est, limen unum calamo uno in latitudine.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:7
verses.text: Et thalamum uno calamo in longum, et uno calamo in latum : et inter thalamos, quinque cubitos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:8
verses.text: Et limen portæ, juxta vestibulum portæ intrinsecus, calamo uno.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:9
verses.text: Et mensus est vestibulum portæ octo cubitorum, et frontem ejus duobus cubitis : vestibulum autem portæ erat intrinsecus.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:10
verses.text: Porro thalami portæ ad viam orientalem, tres hinc et tres inde : mensura una trium, et mensura una frontium ex utraque parte.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:11
verses.text: Et mensus est latitudinem liminis portæ decem cubitorum, et longitudinem portæ tredecim cubitorum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:12
verses.text: Et marginem ante thalamos, cubiti unius, et cubitus unus finis utrimque : thalami autem sex cubitorum erant hinc et inde.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:13
verses.text: Et mensus est portam a tecto thalami usque ad tectum ejus, latitudinem viginti quinque cubitorum, ostium contra ostium.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:14
verses.text: Et fecit frontes per sexaginta cubitos, et ad frontem atrium portæ undique per circuitum.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:15
verses.text: Et ante faciem portæ quæ pertingebat usque ad faciem vestibuli portæ interioris, quinquaginta cubitos.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:16
verses.text: Et fenestras obliquas in thalamis et in frontibus eorum, quæ erant intra portam undique per circuitum : similiter autem erant et in vestibulis fenestræ per gyrum intrinsecus, et ante frontes pictura palmarum.  <div eID="gen28918" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10431"/><div sID="gen28919" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10431"/>Et eduxit me ad atrium exterius : et ecce gazophylacia, et pavimentum stratum lapide in atrio per circuitum : triginta gazophylacia in circuitu pavimenti.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:18
verses.text: Et pavimentum in fronte portarum, secundum longitudinem portarum erat inferius.

verses.name: Ezekiel 40:19
