verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10561"/><l level="1" sID="gen29203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10561"/>Et auferam nomina Baalim de ore ejus, <l eID="gen29203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29204"/>et non recordabitur ultra nominis eorum. <l eID="gen29204" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10562"/><l level="1" sID="gen29205"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10562"/>Et percutiam cum eis fœdus in die illa, cum bestia agri, <l eID="gen29205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29206"/>et cum volucre cæli, et cum reptili terræ ; <l eID="gen29206" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29207"/>et arcum, et gladium, et bellum conteram de terra, <l eID="gen29207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29208"/>et dormire eos faciam fiducialiter. <l eID="gen29208" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10563"/><l level="1" sID="gen29209"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10563"/>Et sponsabo te mihi in sempiternum ; <l eID="gen29209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29210"/>et sponsabo te mihi in justitia, et judicio, <l eID="gen29210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29211"/>et in misericordia, et in miserationibus. <l eID="gen29211" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10564"/><l level="1" sID="gen29212"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10564"/>Et sponsabo te mihi in fide ; <l eID="gen29212" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29213"/>et scies quia ego Dominus. <l eID="gen29213" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10565"/><l level="1" sID="gen29214"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10565"/>Et erit in die illa : <l eID="gen29214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29215"/>exaudiam, dicit Dominus, exaudiam cælos, <l eID="gen29215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29216"/>et illi exaudient terram. <l eID="gen29216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10566"/><l level="1" sID="gen29217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10566"/>Et terra exaudiet triticum, et vinum, et oleum, <l eID="gen29217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29218"/>et hæc exaudient Jezrahel. <l eID="gen29218" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10567"/><l level="1" sID="gen29219"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10567"/>Et seminabo eam mihi in terra, <l eID="gen29219" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29220"/>et miserebor ejus quæ fuit Absque misericordia. <l eID="gen29220" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10568"/><l level="1" sID="gen29221"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10568"/>Et dicam Non populo meo : Populus meus es tu ; <l eID="gen29221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29222"/>et ipse dicet : Deus meus es tu. <l eID="gen29222" level="1"/><lg eID="gen29146"/> <chapter eID="Hos.2"/>

verses.name: Hosea 3:1
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Adhuc vade, et dilige mulierem dilectam amico et adulteram, sicut diligit Dominus filios Israël, et ipsi respiciunt ad deos alienos, et diligunt vinacia uvarum.

verses.name: Hosea 3:2
verses.text: Et fodi eam mihi quindecim argenteis, et coro hordei, et dimidio coro hordæi.

verses.name: Hosea 3:3
verses.text: Et dixi ad eam : Dies multos exspectabis me ; non fornicaberis, et non eris viro ; sed et ego exspectabo te.

verses.name: Hosea 3:4
verses.text: Quia dies multos sedebunt filii Israël sine rege, et sine principe, et sine sacrificio, et sine altari, et sine ephod, et sine theraphim.

verses.name: Hosea 3:5
verses.text: Et post hæc revertentur filii Israël, et quærent Dominum Deum suum, et David regem suum : et pavebunt ad Dominum, et ad bonum ejus, in novissimo dierum.  <chapter eID="Hos.3"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:1
verses.text: Audite verbum Domini, filii Israël, <l eID="gen29225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29226"/>quia judicium Domino cum habitatoribus terræ : <l eID="gen29226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29227"/>non est enim veritas, et non est misericordia, <l eID="gen29227" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29228"/>et non est scientia Dei in terra. <l eID="gen29228" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10569"/><l level="1" sID="gen29229"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10569"/>Maledictum, et mendacium, <l eID="gen29229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29230"/>et homicidium, et furtum, et adulterium inundaverunt, <l eID="gen29230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29231"/>et sanguis sanguinem tetigit. <l eID="gen29231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10570"/><l level="1" sID="gen29232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10570"/>Propter hoc lugebit terra, <l eID="gen29232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29233"/>et infirmabitur omnis qui habitat in ea, <l eID="gen29233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29234"/>in bestia agri, et in volucre cæli ; <l eID="gen29234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29235"/>sed et pisces maris congregabuntur. <l eID="gen29235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10571"/><l level="1" sID="gen29236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10571"/>Verumtamen unusquisque non judicet, <l eID="gen29236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29237"/>et non arguatur vir : <l eID="gen29237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29238"/>populus enim tuus sicut hi qui contradicunt sacerdoti. <l eID="gen29238" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10572"/><l level="1" sID="gen29239"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10572"/>Et corrues hodie, <l eID="gen29239" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29240"/>et corruet etiam propheta tecum. <l eID="gen29240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29241"/>Nocte tacere feci matrem tuam. <l eID="gen29241" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10573"/><l level="1" sID="gen29242"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10573"/>Conticuit populus meus, <l eID="gen29242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29243"/>eo quod non habuerit scientiam : <l eID="gen29243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29244"/>quia tu scientiam repulisti, <l eID="gen29244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29245"/>repellam te, ne sacerdotio fungaris mihi ; <l eID="gen29245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29246"/>et oblita es legis Dei tui, <l eID="gen29246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29247"/>obliviscar filiorum tuorum et ego. <l eID="gen29247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10574"/><l level="1" sID="gen29248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10574"/>Secundum multitudinem eorum sic peccaverunt mihi : <l eID="gen29248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29249"/>gloriam eorum in ignominiam commutabo. <l eID="gen29249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10575"/><l level="1" sID="gen29250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10575"/>Peccata populi mei comedent, <l eID="gen29250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29251"/>et ad iniquitatem eorum sublevabunt animas eorum. <l eID="gen29251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10576"/><l level="1" sID="gen29252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10576"/>Et erit sicut populus, sic sacerdos ; <l eID="gen29252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29253"/>et visitabo super eum vias ejus, <l eID="gen29253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29254"/>et cogitationes ejus reddam ei. <l eID="gen29254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10577"/><l level="1" sID="gen29255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10577"/>Et comedent, et non saturabuntur ; <l eID="gen29255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29256"/>fornicati sunt, et non cessaverunt : <l eID="gen29256" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29257"/>quoniam Dominum dereliquerunt in non custodiendo. <l eID="gen29257" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10578"/><l level="1" sID="gen29258"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10578"/>Fornicatio, et vinum, et ebrietas auferunt cor. <l eID="gen29258" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10579"/><l level="1" sID="gen29259"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10579"/>Populus meus in ligno suo interrogavit, <l eID="gen29259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29260"/>et baculus ejus annuntiavit ei ; <l eID="gen29260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29261"/>spiritus enim fornicationum decepit eos, <l eID="gen29261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29262"/>et fornicati sunt a Deo suo. <l eID="gen29262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10580"/><l level="1" sID="gen29263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10580"/>Super capita montium sacrificabant, <l eID="gen29263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29264"/>et super colles ascendebant thymiama ; <l eID="gen29264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29265"/>subtus quercum, et populum, et terebinthum, <l eID="gen29265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29266"/>quia bona erat umbra ejus ; <l eID="gen29266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29267"/>ideo fornicabuntur filiæ vestræ, <l eID="gen29267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29268"/>et sponsæ vestræ adulteræ erunt. <l eID="gen29268" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10581"/><l level="1" sID="gen29269"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10581"/>Non visitabo super filias vestras cum fuerint fornicatæ, <l eID="gen29269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29270"/>et super sponsas vestras cum adulteraverint, <l eID="gen29270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29271"/>quoniam ipsi cum meretricibus conversabantur, <l eID="gen29271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29272"/>et cum effeminatis sacrificabant ; <l eID="gen29272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29273"/>et populus non intelligens vapulabit. <l eID="gen29273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10582"/><l level="1" sID="gen29274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10582"/>Si fornicaris tu, Israël, <l eID="gen29274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29275"/>non delinquat saltem Juda ; <l eID="gen29275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29276"/>et nolite ingredi in Galgala, <l eID="gen29276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29277"/>et ne ascenderitis in Bethaven, <l eID="gen29277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29278"/>neque juraveritis : Vivit Dominus ! <l eID="gen29278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10583"/><l level="1" sID="gen29279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10583"/>Quoniam sicut vacca lasciviens declinavit Israël ; <l eID="gen29279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29280"/>nunc pascet eos Dominus, quasi agnum in latitudine. <l eID="gen29280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10584"/><l level="1" sID="gen29281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10584"/>Particeps idolorum Ephraim : dimitte eum. <l eID="gen29281" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10585"/><l level="1" sID="gen29282"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10585"/>Separatum est convivium eorum ; <l eID="gen29282" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29283"/>fornicatione fornicati sunt : <l eID="gen29283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29284"/>dilexerunt afferre ignominiam protectores ejus. <l eID="gen29284" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 4:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10586"/><l level="1" sID="gen29285"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10586"/>Ligavit eum spiritus in alis suis, <l eID="gen29285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29286"/>et confundentur a sacrificiis suis.  <chapter eID="Hos.4"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:1
verses.text: Audite hoc, sacerdotes, <l eID="gen29287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29288"/>et attendite, domus Israël, <l eID="gen29288" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29289"/>et domus regis, auscultate : <l eID="gen29289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29290"/>quia vobis judicium est, <l eID="gen29290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29291"/>quoniam laqueus facti estis speculationi, <l eID="gen29291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29292"/>et rete expansum super Thabor. <l eID="gen29292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10587"/><l level="1" sID="gen29293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10587"/>Et victimas declinastis in profundum ; <l eID="gen29293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29294"/>et ego eruditor omnium eorum. <l eID="gen29294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10588"/><l level="1" sID="gen29295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10588"/>Ego scio Ephraim, <l eID="gen29295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29296"/>et Israël non est absconditus a me : <l eID="gen29296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29297"/>quia nunc fornicatus est Ephraim ; <l eID="gen29297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29298"/>contaminatus est Israël. <l eID="gen29298" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10589"/><l level="1" sID="gen29299"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10589"/>Non dabunt cogitationes suas ut revertantur ad Deum suum, <l eID="gen29299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29300"/>quia spiritus fornicationum in medio eorum, <l eID="gen29300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29301"/>et Dominum non cognoverunt. <l eID="gen29301" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10590"/><l level="1" sID="gen29302"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10590"/>Et respondebit arrogantia Israël in facie ejus, <l eID="gen29302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29303"/>et Israël et Ephraim ruent in iniquitate sua : <l eID="gen29303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29304"/>ruet etiam Judas cum eis. <l eID="gen29304" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10591"/><l level="1" sID="gen29305"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10591"/>In gregibus suis et in armentis suis vadent ad quærendum Dominum, <l eID="gen29305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29306"/>et non invenient : <l eID="gen29306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29307"/>ablatus est ab eis. <l eID="gen29307" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10592"/><l level="1" sID="gen29308"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10592"/>In Dominum prævaricati sunt, <l eID="gen29308" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29309"/>quia filios alienos genuerunt : <l eID="gen29309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29310"/>nunc devorabit eos mensis, cum partibus suis. <l eID="gen29310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10593"/><l level="1" sID="gen29311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10593"/>Clangite buccina in Gabaa, <l eID="gen29311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29312"/>tuba in Rama ; <l eID="gen29312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29313"/>ululate in Bethaven, <l eID="gen29313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29314"/>post tergum tuum, Benjamin. <l eID="gen29314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10594"/><l level="1" sID="gen29315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10594"/>Ephraim in desolatione erit in die correptionis ; <l eID="gen29315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29316"/>in tribubus Israël ostendi fidem. <l eID="gen29316" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10595"/><l level="1" sID="gen29317"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10595"/>Facti sunt principes Juda quasi assumentes terminum ; <l eID="gen29317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29318"/>super eos effundam quasi aquam iram meam. <l eID="gen29318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10596"/><l level="1" sID="gen29319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10596"/>Calumniam patiens est Ephraim, fractus judicio, <l eID="gen29319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29320"/>quoniam cœpit abire post sordes. <l eID="gen29320" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10597"/><l level="1" sID="gen29321"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10597"/>Et ego quasi tinea Ephraim, <l eID="gen29321" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29322"/>et quasi putredo domui Juda. <l eID="gen29322" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10598"/><l level="1" sID="gen29323"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10598"/>Et vidit Ephraim languorem suum, <l eID="gen29323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29324"/>et Juda vinculum suum ; <l eID="gen29324" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29325"/>et abiit Ephraim ad Assur, <l eID="gen29325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29326"/>et misit ad regem ultorem : <l eID="gen29326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29327"/>et ipse non poterit sanare vos, <l eID="gen29327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29328"/>nec solvere poterit a vobis vinculum. <l eID="gen29328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10599"/><l level="1" sID="gen29329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10599"/>Quoniam ego quasi leæna Ephraim, <l eID="gen29329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29330"/>et quasi catulus leonis domui Juda. <l eID="gen29330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29331"/>Ego, ego capiam, et vadam ; <l eID="gen29331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29332"/>tollam, et non est qui eruat. <l eID="gen29332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10600"/><l level="1" sID="gen29333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10600"/>Vadens revertar ad locum meum, <l eID="gen29333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29334"/>donec deficiatis, et quæratis faciem meam.  <chapter eID="Hos.5"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:1
verses.text: In tribulatione sua mane consurgent ad me : <l eID="gen29335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29336"/>Venite, et revertamur ad Dominum, <l eID="gen29336" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10601"/><l level="1" sID="gen29337"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10601"/>quia ipse cepit, et sanabit nos ; <l eID="gen29337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29338"/>percutiet, et curabit nos. <l eID="gen29338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10602"/><l level="1" sID="gen29339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10602"/>Vivificabit nos post duos dies ; <l eID="gen29339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29340"/>in die tertia suscitabit nos, <l eID="gen29340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29341"/>et vivemus in conspectu ejus. <l eID="gen29341" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29342"/>Sciemus, sequemurque ut cognoscamus Dominum : <l eID="gen29342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29343"/>quasi diluculum præparatus est egressus ejus, <l eID="gen29343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29344"/>et veniet quasi imber nobis temporaneus et serotinus terræ. <l eID="gen29344" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10603"/><l level="1" sID="gen29345"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10603"/>Quid faciam tibi, Ephraim ? <l eID="gen29345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29346"/>quid faciam tibi, Juda ? <l eID="gen29346" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29347"/>misericordia vestra quasi nubes matutina, <l eID="gen29347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29348"/>et quasi ros mane pertransiens. <l eID="gen29348" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10604"/><l level="1" sID="gen29349"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10604"/>Propter hoc dolavi in prophetis ; <l eID="gen29349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29350"/>occidi eos in verbis oris mei : <l eID="gen29350" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29351"/>et judicia tua quasi lux egredientur. <l eID="gen29351" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10605"/><l level="1" sID="gen29352"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10605"/>Quia misericordiam volui, et non sacrificium ; <l eID="gen29352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29353"/>et scientiam Dei plus quam holocausta. <l eID="gen29353" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10606"/><l level="1" sID="gen29354"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10606"/>Ipsi autem sicut Adam transgressi sunt pactum : <l eID="gen29354" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29355"/>ibi prævaricati sunt in me. <l eID="gen29355" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10607"/><l level="1" sID="gen29356"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10607"/>Galaad civitas operantium idolum, <l eID="gen29356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29357"/>supplantata sanguine. <l eID="gen29357" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10608"/><l level="1" sID="gen29358"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10608"/>Et quasi fauces virorum latronum, <l eID="gen29358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29359"/>particeps sacerdotum, in via interficientium pergentes de Sichem : <l eID="gen29359" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29360"/>quia scelus operati sunt. <l eID="gen29360" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10609"/><l level="1" sID="gen29361"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10609"/>In domo Israël vidi horrendum : <l eID="gen29361" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29362"/>ibi fornicationes Ephraim, <l eID="gen29362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29363"/>contaminatus est Israël. <l eID="gen29363" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10610"/><l level="1" sID="gen29364"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10610"/>Sed et Juda, pone messem tibi, <l eID="gen29364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29365"/>cum convertero captivitatem populi mei.  <chapter eID="Hos.6"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:1
verses.text: Cum sanare vellem Israël, <l eID="gen29366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29367"/>revelata est iniquitas Ephraim, <l eID="gen29367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29368"/>et malitia Samariæ, <l eID="gen29368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29369"/>quia operati sunt mendacium ; <l eID="gen29369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29370"/>et fur ingressus est spolians, <l eID="gen29370" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29371"/>latrunculus foris. <l eID="gen29371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10611"/><l level="1" sID="gen29372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10611"/>Et ne forte dicant in cordibus suis, <l eID="gen29372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29373"/>omnem malitiam eorum me recordatum, <l eID="gen29373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29374"/>nunc circumdederunt eos adinventiones suæ : <l eID="gen29374" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29375"/>coram facie mea factæ sunt. <l eID="gen29375" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10612"/><l level="1" sID="gen29376"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10612"/>In malitia sua lætificaverunt regem, <l eID="gen29376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29377"/>et in mendaciis suis principes. <l eID="gen29377" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10613"/><l level="1" sID="gen29378"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10613"/>Omnes adulterantes, <l eID="gen29378" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29379"/>quasi clibanus succensus a coquente ; <l eID="gen29379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29380"/>quievit paululum civitas a commistione fermenti, <l eID="gen29380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29381"/>donec fermentaretur totum. <l eID="gen29381" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10614"/><l level="1" sID="gen29382"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10614"/>Dies regis nostri : cœperunt principes furere a vino ; <l eID="gen29382" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29383"/>extendit manum suam cum illusoribus. <l eID="gen29383" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10615"/><l level="1" sID="gen29384"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10615"/>Quia applicuerunt quasi clibanum cor suum, <l eID="gen29384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29385"/>cum insidiaretur eis ; <l eID="gen29385" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29386"/>tota nocte dormivit coquens eos : <l eID="gen29386" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29387"/>mane ipse succensus quasi ignis flammæ. <l eID="gen29387" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10616"/><l level="1" sID="gen29388"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10616"/>Omnes calefacti sunt quasi clibanus, <l eID="gen29388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29389"/>et devoraverunt judices suos : <l eID="gen29389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29390"/>omnes reges eorum ceciderunt ; <l eID="gen29390" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29391"/>non est qui clamat in eis ad me. <l eID="gen29391" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10617"/><l level="1" sID="gen29392"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10617"/>Ephraim in populis ipse commiscebatur ; <l eID="gen29392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29393"/>Ephraim factus est subcinericius panis, qui non reversatur. <l eID="gen29393" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10618"/><l level="1" sID="gen29394"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10618"/>Comederunt alieni robur ejus, et ipse nescivit ; <l eID="gen29394" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29395"/>sed et cani effusi sunt in eo, et ipse ignoravit. <l eID="gen29395" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10619"/><l level="1" sID="gen29396"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10619"/>Et humiliabitur superbia Israël in facie ejus ; <l eID="gen29396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29397"/>nec reversi sunt ad Dominum Deum suum, <l eID="gen29397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29398"/>et non quæsierunt eum in omnibus his. <l eID="gen29398" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10620"/><l level="1" sID="gen29399"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10620"/>Et factus est Ephraim quasi columba seducta non habens cor. <l eID="gen29399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29400"/>Ægyptum invocabant ; ad Assyrios abierunt. <l eID="gen29400" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10621"/><l level="1" sID="gen29401"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10621"/>Et cum profecti fuerint, <l eID="gen29401" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29402"/>expandam super eos rete meum : <l eID="gen29402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29403"/>quasi volucrem cæli detraham eos ; <l eID="gen29403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29404"/>cædam eos secundum auditionem cœtus eorum. <l eID="gen29404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10622"/><l level="1" sID="gen29405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10622"/>Væ eis, quoniam recesserunt a me ! <l eID="gen29405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29406"/>vastabuntur, quia prævaricati sunt in me, <l eID="gen29406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29407"/>et ego redemi eos, <l eID="gen29407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29408"/>et ipsi locuti sunt contra me mendacia. <l eID="gen29408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10623"/><l level="1" sID="gen29409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10623"/>Et non clamaverunt ad me in corde suo, <l eID="gen29409" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29410"/>sed ululabant in cubilibus suis : <l eID="gen29410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29411"/>super triticum et vinum ruminabant ; <l eID="gen29411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29412"/>recesserunt a me. <l eID="gen29412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10624"/><l level="1" sID="gen29413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10624"/>Et ego erudivi eos, et confortavi brachia eorum, <l eID="gen29413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29414"/>et in me cogitaverunt malitiam. <l eID="gen29414" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10625"/><l level="1" sID="gen29415"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10625"/>Reversi sunt ut essent absque jugo ; <l eID="gen29415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29416"/>facti sunt quasi arcus dolosus : <l eID="gen29416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29417"/>cadent in gladio principes eorum, a furore linguæ suæ. <l eID="gen29417" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29418"/>Ista subsannatio eorum in terra Ægypti.  <chapter eID="Hos.7"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:1
verses.text: In gutture tuo sit tuba <l eID="gen29419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29420"/>quasi aquila super domum Domini, <l eID="gen29420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29421"/>pro eo quod transgressi sunt fœdus meum, <l eID="gen29421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29422"/>et legem meam prævaricati sunt. <l eID="gen29422" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10626"/><l level="1" sID="gen29423"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10626"/>Me invocabunt : Deus meus, <l eID="gen29423" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29424"/>cognovimus te Israël. <l eID="gen29424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10627"/><l level="1" sID="gen29425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10627"/>Projecit Israël bonum : <l eID="gen29425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29426"/>inimicus persequetur eum. <l eID="gen29426" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10628"/><l level="1" sID="gen29427"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10628"/>Ipsi regnaverunt, et non ex me ; <l eID="gen29427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29428"/>principes exstiterunt, et non cognovi : <l eID="gen29428" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29429"/>argentum suum et aurum suum fecerunt sibi idola, <l eID="gen29429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29430"/>ut interirent. <l eID="gen29430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10629"/><l level="1" sID="gen29431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10629"/>Projectus est vitulus tuus, Samaria ; <l eID="gen29431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29432"/>iratus est furor meus in eos. <l eID="gen29432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29433"/>Usquequo non poterunt emundari ? <l eID="gen29433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10630"/><l level="1" sID="gen29434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10630"/>Quia ex Israël et ipse est : <l eID="gen29434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29435"/>artifex fecit illum, et non est deus ; <l eID="gen29435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29436"/>quoniam in aranearum telas erit vitulus Samariæ. <l eID="gen29436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10631"/><l level="1" sID="gen29437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10631"/>Quia ventum seminabunt, <l eID="gen29437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29438"/>et turbinem metent : <l eID="gen29438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29439"/>culmus stans non est in eo ; <l eID="gen29439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29440"/>germen non faciet farinam : <l eID="gen29440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29441"/>quod etsi fecerit, alieni comedent eam. <l eID="gen29441" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10632"/><l level="1" sID="gen29442"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10632"/>Devoratus est Israël ; <l eID="gen29442" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29443"/>nunc factus est in nationibus quasi vas immundum. <l eID="gen29443" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10633"/><l level="1" sID="gen29444"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10633"/>Quia ipsi ascenderunt ad Assur, <l eID="gen29444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29445"/>onager solitarius sibi ; <l eID="gen29445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29446"/>Ephraim munera dederunt amatoribus. <l eID="gen29446" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10634"/><l level="1" sID="gen29447"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10634"/>Sed et cum mercede conduxerint nationes, <l eID="gen29447" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29448"/>nunc congregabo eos, <l eID="gen29448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29449"/>et quiescent paulisper ab onere regis et principum. <l eID="gen29449" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10635"/><l level="1" sID="gen29450"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10635"/>Quia multiplicavit Ephraim altaria ad peccandum ; <l eID="gen29450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29451"/>factæ sunt ei aræ in delictum. <l eID="gen29451" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10636"/><l level="1" sID="gen29452"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10636"/>Scribam ei multiplices leges meas, <l eID="gen29452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29453"/>quæ velut alienæ computatæ sunt. <l eID="gen29453" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10637"/><l level="1" sID="gen29454"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10637"/>Hostias offerent, <l eID="gen29454" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29455"/>immolabunt carnes et comedent, <l eID="gen29455" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29456"/>et Dominus non suscipiet eas : <l eID="gen29456" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29457"/>nunc recordabitur iniquitatis eorum, <l eID="gen29457" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29458"/>et visitabit peccata eorum : <l eID="gen29458" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29459"/>ipsi in Ægyptum convertentur. <l eID="gen29459" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 8:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10638"/><l level="1" sID="gen29460"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10638"/>Et oblitus est Israël factoris sui, <l eID="gen29460" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29461"/>et ædificavit delubra ; <l eID="gen29461" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29462"/>et Judas multiplicavit urbes munitas ; <l eID="gen29462" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29463"/>et mittam ignem in civitates ejus, <l eID="gen29463" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29464"/>et devorabit ædes illius.  <chapter eID="Hos.8"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:1
verses.text: Noli lætari, Israël ; <l eID="gen29465" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29466"/>noli exsultare sicut populi : <l eID="gen29466" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29467"/>quia fornicatus es a Deo tuo ; <l eID="gen29467" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29468"/>dilexisti mercedem super omnes areas tritici. <l eID="gen29468" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10639"/><l level="1" sID="gen29469"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10639"/>Area et torcular non pascet eos, <l eID="gen29469" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29470"/>et vinum mentietur eis : <l eID="gen29470" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10640"/><l level="1" sID="gen29471"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10640"/>non habitabunt in terra Domini. <l eID="gen29471" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29472"/>Reversus est Ephraim in Ægyptum, <l eID="gen29472" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29473"/>et in Assyriis pollutum comedit. <l eID="gen29473" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10641"/><l level="1" sID="gen29474"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10641"/>Non libabunt Domino vinum, <l eID="gen29474" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29475"/>et non placebunt ei. <l eID="gen29475" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29476"/>Sacrificia eorum quasi panis lugentium ; <l eID="gen29476" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29477"/>omnes qui comedent eum, contaminabuntur : <l eID="gen29477" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29478"/>quia panis eorum animæ ipsorum : <l eID="gen29478" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29479"/>non intrabit in domum Domini. <l eID="gen29479" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10642"/><l level="1" sID="gen29480"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10642"/>Quid facietis in die solemni, <l eID="gen29480" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29481"/>in die festivitatis Domini ? <l eID="gen29481" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10643"/><l level="1" sID="gen29482"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10643"/>Ecce enim profecti sunt a vastitate : <l eID="gen29482" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29483"/>Ægyptus congregabit eos ; <l eID="gen29483" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29484"/>Memphis sepeliet eos : <l eID="gen29484" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29485"/>desiderabile argentum eorum urtica hæreditabit, <l eID="gen29485" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29486"/>lappa in tabernaculis eorum. <l eID="gen29486" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10644"/><l level="1" sID="gen29487"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10644"/>Venerunt dies visitationis, <l eID="gen29487" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29488"/>venerunt dies retributionis. <l eID="gen29488" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29489"/>Scitote, Israël, <l eID="gen29489" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29490"/>stultum prophetam, <l eID="gen29490" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29491"/>insanum virum spiritualem, <l eID="gen29491" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29492"/>propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ, <l eID="gen29492" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29493"/>et multitudinem amentiæ. <l eID="gen29493" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10645"/><l level="1" sID="gen29494"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10645"/>Speculator Ephraim cum Deo meo, <l eID="gen29494" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29495"/>propheta laqueus ruinæ factus est super omnes vias ejus ; <l eID="gen29495" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29496"/>insania in domo Dei ejus. <l eID="gen29496" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10646"/><l level="1" sID="gen29497"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10646"/>Profunde peccaverunt, sicut in diebus Gabaa. <l eID="gen29497" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29498"/>Recordabitur iniquitatis eorum, <l eID="gen29498" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29499"/>et visitabit peccata eorum. <l eID="gen29499" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10647"/><l level="1" sID="gen29500"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10647"/>Quasi uvas in deserto inveni Israël, <l eID="gen29500" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29501"/>quasi prima poma ficulneæ in cacumine ejus vidi patres eorum : <l eID="gen29501" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29502"/>ipsi autem intraverunt ad Beelphegor, <l eID="gen29502" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29503"/>et abalienati sunt in confusionem, <l eID="gen29503" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29504"/>et facti sunt abominabiles sicut ea quæ dilexerunt. <l eID="gen29504" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10648"/><l level="1" sID="gen29505"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10648"/>Ephraim quasi avis avolavit ; <l eID="gen29505" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29506"/>gloria eorum a partu, et ab utero, et a conceptu. <l eID="gen29506" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10649"/><l level="1" sID="gen29507"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10649"/>Quod etsi enutrierint filios suos, <l eID="gen29507" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29508"/>absque liberis eos faciam in hominibus ; <l eID="gen29508" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29509"/>sed et væ eis cum recessero ab eis ! <l eID="gen29509" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10650"/><l level="1" sID="gen29510"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10650"/>Ephraim, ut vidi, Tyrus erat fundata in pulchritudine ; <l eID="gen29510" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29511"/>et Ephraim educet ad interfectorem filios suos. <l eID="gen29511" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10651"/><l level="1" sID="gen29512"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10651"/>Da eis, Domine. Quid dabis eis ? <l eID="gen29512" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29513"/>da eis vulvam sine liberis, et ubera arentia. <l eID="gen29513" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10652"/><l level="1" sID="gen29514"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10652"/>Omnes nequitiæ eorum in Galgal, <l eID="gen29514" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29515"/>quia ibi exosos habui eos. <l eID="gen29515" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29516"/>Propter malitiam adinventionum eorum, <l eID="gen29516" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29517"/>de domo mea ejiciam eos ; <l eID="gen29517" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29518"/>non addam ut diligam eos : <l eID="gen29518" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29519"/>omnes principes eorum recedentes. <l eID="gen29519" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10653"/><l level="1" sID="gen29520"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10653"/>Percussus est Ephraim ; <l eID="gen29520" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29521"/>radix eorum exsiccata est : <l eID="gen29521" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29522"/>fructum nequaquam facient, <l eID="gen29522" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29523"/>quod etsi genuerint, <l eID="gen29523" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29524"/>interficiam amantissima uteri eorum. <l eID="gen29524" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 9:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10654"/><l level="1" sID="gen29525"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10654"/>Abjiciet eos Deus meus, quia non audierunt eum, <l eID="gen29525" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29526"/>et erunt vagi in nationibus.  <chapter eID="Hos.9"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:1
verses.text: Vitis frondosa Israël, <l eID="gen29527" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29528"/>fructus adæquatus est ei : <l eID="gen29528" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29529"/>secundum multitudinem fructus sui multiplicavit altaria, <l eID="gen29529" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29530"/>juxta ubertatem terræ suæ exuberavit simulacris. <l eID="gen29530" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10655"/><l level="1" sID="gen29531"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10655"/>Divisum est cor eorum, nunc interibunt ; <l eID="gen29531" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29532"/>ipse confringet simulacra eorum, <l eID="gen29532" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29533"/>depopulabitur aras eorum. <l eID="gen29533" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10656"/><l level="1" sID="gen29534"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10656"/>Quia nunc dicent : Non est rex nobis, <l eID="gen29534" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29535"/>non enim timemus Dominum ; <l eID="gen29535" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29536"/>et rex quid faciet nobis ? <l eID="gen29536" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10657"/><l level="1" sID="gen29537"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10657"/>Loquimini verba visionis inutilis, et ferietis fœdus ; <l eID="gen29537" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29538"/>et germinabit quasi amaritudo judicium super sulcos agri. <l eID="gen29538" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10658"/><l level="1" sID="gen29539"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10658"/>Vaccas Bethaven coluerunt habitatores Samariæ ; <l eID="gen29539" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29540"/>quia luxit super eum populus ejus, <l eID="gen29540" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29541"/>et æditui ejus super eum exsultaverunt <l eID="gen29541" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29542"/>in gloria ejus, quia migravit ab eo. <l eID="gen29542" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10659"/><l level="1" sID="gen29543"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10659"/>Siquidem et ipse in Assur delatus est, <l eID="gen29543" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29544"/>munus regi ultori. <l eID="gen29544" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29545"/>Confusio Ephraim capiet, <l eID="gen29545" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29546"/>et confundetur Israël in voluntate sua. <l eID="gen29546" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10660"/><l level="1" sID="gen29547"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10660"/>Transire fecit Samaria regem suum <l eID="gen29547" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29548"/>quasi spumam super faciem aquæ. <l eID="gen29548" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10661"/><l level="1" sID="gen29549"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10661"/>Et disperdentur excelsa idoli, peccatum Israël ; <l eID="gen29549" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29550"/>lappa et tribulus ascendet super aras eorum : <l eID="gen29550" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29551"/>et dicent montibus : Operite nos, <l eID="gen29551" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29552"/>et collibus : Cadite super nos. <l eID="gen29552" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10662"/><l level="1" sID="gen29553"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10662"/>Ex diebus Gabaa peccavit Israël ; <l eID="gen29553" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29554"/>ibi steterunt. <l eID="gen29554" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29555"/>Non comprehendet eos in Gabaa <l eID="gen29555" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29556"/>prælium super filios iniquitatis. <l eID="gen29556" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10663"/><l level="1" sID="gen29557"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10663"/>Juxta desiderium meum corripiam eos : <l eID="gen29557" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29558"/>congregabuntur super eos populi, <l eID="gen29558" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29559"/>cum corripientur propter duas iniquitates suas. <l eID="gen29559" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10664"/><l level="1" sID="gen29560"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10664"/>Ephraim vitula docta diligere trituram, <l eID="gen29560" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29561"/>et ego transivi super pulchritudinem colli ejus : <l eID="gen29561" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29562"/>ascendam super Ephraim, <l eID="gen29562" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29563"/>arabit Judas ; <l eID="gen29563" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29564"/>confringet sibi sulcos Jacob. <l eID="gen29564" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10665"/><l level="1" sID="gen29565"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10665"/>Seminate vobis in justitia, <l eID="gen29565" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29566"/>et metite in ore misericordiæ. <l eID="gen29566" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29567"/>Innovate vobis novale ; <l eID="gen29567" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29568"/>tempus autem requirendi Dominum, <l eID="gen29568" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29569"/>cum venerit qui docebit vos justitiam. <l eID="gen29569" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10666"/><l level="1" sID="gen29570"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10666"/>Arastis impietatem, <l eID="gen29570" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29571"/>iniquitatem messuistis : <l eID="gen29571" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29572"/>comedistis frugem mendacii, <l eID="gen29572" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29573"/>quia confisus es in viis tuis, <l eID="gen29573" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29574"/>in multitudine fortium tuorum. <l eID="gen29574" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10667"/><l level="1" sID="gen29575"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10667"/>Consurget tumultus in populo tuo ; <l eID="gen29575" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29576"/>et omnes munitiones tuæ vastabuntur, <l eID="gen29576" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29577"/>sicut vastatus est Salmana a domo ejus qui judicavit Baal <l eID="gen29577" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29578"/>in die prælii, matre super filios allisa. <l eID="gen29578" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 10:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10668"/><l level="1" sID="gen29579"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10668"/>Sic fecit vobis Bethel, <l eID="gen29579" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29580"/>a facie malitiæ nequitiarum vestrarum.  <chapter eID="Hos.10"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:1
verses.text: Sicut mane transiit, pertransiit rex Israël. <l eID="gen29581" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29582"/>Quia puer Israël, et dilexi eum ; <l eID="gen29582" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29583"/>et ex Ægypto vocavi filium meum. <l eID="gen29583" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10669"/><l level="1" sID="gen29584"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10669"/>Vocaverunt eos, sic abierunt a facie eorum ; <l eID="gen29584" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29585"/>Baalim immolabant, et simulacris sacrificabant. <l eID="gen29585" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10670"/><l level="1" sID="gen29586"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10670"/>Et ego quasi nutritius Ephraim : <l eID="gen29586" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29587"/>portabam eos in brachiis meis, <l eID="gen29587" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29588"/>et nescierunt quod curarem eos. <l eID="gen29588" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10671"/><l level="1" sID="gen29589"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10671"/>In funiculis Adam traham eos, <l eID="gen29589" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29590"/>in vinculis caritatis ; <l eID="gen29590" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29591"/>et ero eis quasi exaltans jugum super maxillas eorum, <l eID="gen29591" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29592"/>et declinavi ad eum ut vesceretur. <l eID="gen29592" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10672"/><l level="1" sID="gen29593"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10672"/>Non revertetur in terram Ægypti, et Assur ipse rex ejus, <l eID="gen29593" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29594"/>quoniam noluerunt converti. <l eID="gen29594" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10673"/><l level="1" sID="gen29595"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10673"/>Cœpit gladius in civitatibus ejus, <l eID="gen29595" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29596"/>et consumet electos ejus, <l eID="gen29596" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29597"/>et comedet capita eorum. <l eID="gen29597" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10674"/><l level="1" sID="gen29598"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10674"/>Et populus meus pendebit ad reditum meum ; <l eID="gen29598" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29599"/>jugum autem imponetur eis simul, quod non auferetur. <l eID="gen29599" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10675"/><l level="1" sID="gen29600"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10675"/>Quomodo dabo te, Ephraim ? <l eID="gen29600" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29601"/>protegam te, Israël ? <l eID="gen29601" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29602"/>Quomodo dabo te sicut Adama, <l eID="gen29602" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29603"/>ponam te ut Seboim ? <l eID="gen29603" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29604"/>Conversum est in me cor meum, <l eID="gen29604" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29605"/>pariter conturbata est pœnitudo mea. <l eID="gen29605" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10676"/><l level="1" sID="gen29606"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10676"/>Non faciam furorem iræ meæ ; <l eID="gen29606" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29607"/>non convertar ut disperdam Ephraim, <l eID="gen29607" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29608"/>quoniam Deus ego, et non homo ; <l eID="gen29608" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29609"/>in medio tui sanctus, <l eID="gen29609" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29610"/>et non ingrediar civitatem. <l eID="gen29610" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10677"/><l level="1" sID="gen29611"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10677"/>Post Dominum ambulabunt ; <l eID="gen29611" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29612"/>quasi leo rugiet, <l eID="gen29612" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29613"/>quia ipse rugiet, <l eID="gen29613" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29614"/>et formidabunt filii maris. <l eID="gen29614" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10678"/><l level="1" sID="gen29615"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10678"/>Et avolabunt quasi avis ex Ægypto, <l eID="gen29615" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29616"/>et quasi columba de terra Assyriorum : <l eID="gen29616" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29617"/>et collocabo eos in domibus suis, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen29617" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 11:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10679"/><l level="1" sID="gen29618"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10679"/>Circumdedit me in negatione Ephraim, <l eID="gen29618" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29619"/>et in dolo domus Israël ; <l eID="gen29619" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29620"/>Judas autem testis descendit cum Deo, <l eID="gen29620" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29621"/>et cum sanctis fidelis.  <chapter eID="Hos.11"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:1
verses.text: Ephraim pascit ventum, <l eID="gen29622" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29623"/>et sequitur æstum ; <l eID="gen29623" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29624"/>tota die mendacium et vastitatem multiplicat : <l eID="gen29624" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29625"/>et fœdus cum Assyriis iniit, <l eID="gen29625" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29626"/>et oleum in Ægyptum ferebat. <l eID="gen29626" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10680"/><l level="1" sID="gen29627"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10680"/>Judicium ergo Domini cum Juda, <l eID="gen29627" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29628"/>et visitatio super Jacob : <l eID="gen29628" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29629"/>juxta vias ejus, et juxta adinventiones ejus reddet ei. <l eID="gen29629" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10681"/><l level="1" sID="gen29630"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10681"/>In utero supplantavit fratrem suum, <l eID="gen29630" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29631"/>et in fortitudine sua directus est cum angelo. <l eID="gen29631" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10682"/><l level="1" sID="gen29632"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10682"/>Et invaluit ad angelum, et confortatus est ; <l eID="gen29632" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29633"/>flevit, et rogavit eum. <l eID="gen29633" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29634"/>In Bethel invenit eum, <l eID="gen29634" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29635"/>et ibi locutus est nobiscum. <l eID="gen29635" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10683"/><l level="1" sID="gen29636"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10683"/>Et Dominus Deus exercituum, <l eID="gen29636" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29637"/>Dominus memoriale ejus. <l eID="gen29637" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10684"/><l level="1" sID="gen29638"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10684"/>Et tu ad Deum tuum converteris ; <l eID="gen29638" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29639"/>misericordiam et judicium custodi, <l eID="gen29639" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29640"/>et spera in Deo tuo semper. <l eID="gen29640" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10685"/><l level="1" sID="gen29641"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10685"/>Chanaan, in manu ejus statera dolosa, <l eID="gen29641" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29642"/>calumniam dilexit. <l eID="gen29642" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10686"/><l level="1" sID="gen29643"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10686"/>Et dixit Ephraim : Verumtamen dives effectus sum ; <l eID="gen29643" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29644"/>inveni idolum mihi : <l eID="gen29644" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29645"/>omnes labores mei non invenient mihi iniquitatem quam peccavi. <l eID="gen29645" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10687"/><l level="1" sID="gen29646"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10687"/>Et ego Dominus Deus tuus ex terra Ægypti : <l eID="gen29646" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29647"/>adhuc sedere te faciam in tabernaculis, sicut in diebus festivitatis. <l eID="gen29647" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10688"/><l level="1" sID="gen29648"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10688"/>Et locutus sum super prophetas, <l eID="gen29648" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29649"/>et ego visionem multiplicavi, <l eID="gen29649" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29650"/>et in manu prophetarum assimilatus sum. <l eID="gen29650" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10689"/><l level="1" sID="gen29651"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10689"/>Si Galaad idolum, ergo frustra erant in Galgal bobus immolantes ; <l eID="gen29651" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29652"/>nam et altaria eorum quasi acervi super sulcos agri. <l eID="gen29652" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10690"/><l level="1" sID="gen29653"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10690"/>Fugit Jacob in regionem Syriæ, <l eID="gen29653" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29654"/>et servivit Israël in uxorem, <l eID="gen29654" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29655"/>et in uxorem servavit. <l eID="gen29655" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10691"/><l level="1" sID="gen29656"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10691"/>In propheta autem eduxit Dominus Israël de Ægypto, <l eID="gen29656" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29657"/>et in propheta servatus est. <l eID="gen29657" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 12:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10692"/><l level="1" sID="gen29658"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10692"/>Ad iracundiam me provocavit Ephraim in amaritudinibus suis : <l eID="gen29658" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29659"/>et sanguis ejus super eum veniet, <l eID="gen29659" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29660"/>et opprobrium ejus restituet ei Dominus suus.  <chapter eID="Hos.12"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:1
verses.text: Loquente Ephraim, horror invasit Israël ; <l eID="gen29661" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29662"/>et deliquit in Baal, et mortuus est. <l eID="gen29662" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10693"/><l level="1" sID="gen29663"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10693"/>Et nunc addiderunt ad peccandum ; <l eID="gen29663" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29664"/>feceruntque sibi conflatile de argento suo <l eID="gen29664" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29665"/>quasi similitudinem idolorum : <l eID="gen29665" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29666"/>factura artificum totum est : <l eID="gen29666" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29667"/>his ipsi dicunt : Immolate homines, vitulos adorantes. <l eID="gen29667" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10694"/><l level="1" sID="gen29668"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10694"/>Idcirco erunt quasi nubes matutina, <l eID="gen29668" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29669"/>et sicut ros matutinus præteriens ; <l eID="gen29669" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29670"/>sicut pulvis turbine raptus ex area, <l eID="gen29670" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29671"/>et sicut fumus de fumario. <l eID="gen29671" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10695"/><l level="1" sID="gen29672"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10695"/>Ego autem Dominus Deus tuus, ex terra Ægypti ; <l eID="gen29672" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29673"/>et Deum absque me nescies, <l eID="gen29673" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29674"/>et salvator non est præter me. <l eID="gen29674" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10696"/><l level="1" sID="gen29675"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10696"/>Ego cognovi te in deserto, <l eID="gen29675" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29676"/>in terra solitudinis. <l eID="gen29676" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10697"/><l level="1" sID="gen29677"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10697"/>Juxta pascua sua adimpleti sunt et saturati sunt ; <l eID="gen29677" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29678"/>et levaverunt cor suum, et obliti sunt mei. <l eID="gen29678" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10698"/><l level="1" sID="gen29679"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10698"/>Et ego ero eis quasi leæna, <l eID="gen29679" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29680"/>sicut pardus in via Assyriorum. <l eID="gen29680" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10699"/><l level="1" sID="gen29681"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10699"/>Occurram eis quasi ursa raptis catulis, <l eID="gen29681" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29682"/>et dirumpam interiora jecoris eorum, <l eID="gen29682" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29683"/>et consumam eos ibi quasi leo : <l eID="gen29683" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29684"/>bestia agri scindet eos. <l eID="gen29684" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10700"/><l level="1" sID="gen29685"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10700"/>Perditio tua, Israël : tantummodo in me auxilium tuum. <l eID="gen29685" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10701"/><l level="1" sID="gen29686"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10701"/>Ubi est rex tuus ? <l eID="gen29686" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29687"/>maxime nunc salvet te in omnibus urbibus tuis ; <l eID="gen29687" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29688"/>et judices tui, de quibus dixisti : <l eID="gen29688" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29689"/>Da mihi regem et principes. <l eID="gen29689" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10702"/><l level="1" sID="gen29690"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10702"/>Dabo tibi regem in furore meo, <l eID="gen29690" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29691"/>et auferam in indignatione mea. <l eID="gen29691" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10703"/><l level="1" sID="gen29692"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10703"/>Colligata est iniquitas Ephraim ; <l eID="gen29692" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29693"/>absconditum peccatum ejus. <l eID="gen29693" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10704"/><l level="1" sID="gen29694"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10704"/>Dolores parturientis venient ei : <l eID="gen29694" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29695"/>ipse filius non sapiens : <l eID="gen29695" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29696"/>nunc enim non stabit in contritione filiorum. <l eID="gen29696" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10705"/><l level="1" sID="gen29697"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10705"/>De manu mortis liberabo eos ; <l eID="gen29697" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29698"/>de morte redimam eos. <l eID="gen29698" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29699"/>Ero mors tua, o mors ! <l eID="gen29699" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29700"/>morsus tuus ero, inferne ! <l eID="gen29700" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29701"/>consolatio abscondita est ab oculis meis. <l eID="gen29701" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 13:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10706"/><l level="1" sID="gen29702"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10706"/>Quia ipse inter fratres dividet : <l eID="gen29702" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29703"/>adducet urentem ventum Dominus de deserto ascendentem, <l eID="gen29703" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29704"/>et siccabit venas ejus, <l eID="gen29704" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29705"/>et desolabit fontem ejus : <l eID="gen29705" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29706"/>et ipse diripiet thesaurum omnis vasis desiderabilis.  <chapter eID="Hos.13"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:1
verses.text: Pereat Samaria, quoniam ad amaritudinem concitavit Deum suum ! <l eID="gen29707" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29708"/>in gladio pereant, <l eID="gen29708" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29709"/>parvuli eorum elidantur, <l eID="gen29709" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29710"/>et fœtæ ejus discindantur ! <l eID="gen29710" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10707"/><l level="1" sID="gen29711"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10707"/>Convertere, Israël, ad Dominum Deum tuum, <l eID="gen29711" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29712"/>quoniam corruisti in iniquitate tua. <l eID="gen29712" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10708"/><l level="1" sID="gen29713"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10708"/>Tollite vobiscum verba, <l eID="gen29713" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29714"/>et convertimini ad Dominum ; et dicite ei : <l eID="gen29714" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29715"/>Omnem aufer iniquitatem, accipe bonum, <l eID="gen29715" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29716"/>et reddemus vitulos labiorum nostrorum. <l eID="gen29716" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10709"/><l level="1" sID="gen29717"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10709"/>Assur non salvabit nos : <l eID="gen29717" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29718"/>super equum non ascendemus, <l eID="gen29718" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29719"/>nec dicemus ultra, Dii nostri opera manuum nostrarum : <l eID="gen29719" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29720"/>quia ejus, qui in te est, misereberis pupilli. <l eID="gen29720" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10710"/><l level="1" sID="gen29721"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10710"/>Sanabo contritiones eorum ; <l eID="gen29721" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29722"/>diligam eos spontanee : <l eID="gen29722" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29723"/>quia aversus est furor meus ab eis. <l eID="gen29723" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10711"/><l level="1" sID="gen29724"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10711"/>Ero quasi ros ; <l eID="gen29724" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29725"/>Israël germinabit sicut lilium, <l eID="gen29725" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29726"/>et erumpet radix ejus ut Libani. <l eID="gen29726" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10712"/><l level="1" sID="gen29727"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10712"/>Ibunt rami ejus, <l eID="gen29727" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29728"/>et erit quasi oliva gloria ejus, <l eID="gen29728" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29729"/>et odor ejus ut Libani. <l eID="gen29729" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10713"/><l level="1" sID="gen29730"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10713"/>Convertentur sedentes in umbra ejus ; <l eID="gen29730" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29731"/>vivent tritico, et germinabunt quasi vinea ; <l eID="gen29731" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29732"/>memoriale ejus sicut vinum Libani. <l eID="gen29732" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10714"/><l level="1" sID="gen29733"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10714"/>Ephraim, quid mihi ultra idola ? <l eID="gen29733" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29734"/>Ego exaudiam, et dirigam eum ego ut abietem virentem ; <l eID="gen29734" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29735"/>ex me fructus tuus inventus est. <l eID="gen29735" level="1"/>

verses.name: Hosea 14:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10715"/><l level="1" sID="gen29736"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10715"/>Quis sapiens, et intelliget ista ? intelligens, et sciet hæc ? <l eID="gen29736" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29737"/>quia rectæ viæ Domini, <l eID="gen29737" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29738"/>et justi ambulabunt in eis ; <l eID="gen29738" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29739"/>prævaricatores vero corruent in eis. <l eID="gen29739" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen29224"/> <chapter eID="Hos.14"/> <div eID="gen29142" osisID="Hos" type="book"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:1
verses.text: Verbum Domini, quod factum est ad Joël, filium Phatuel.  <div eID="gen29741" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10716"/><lg sID="gen29742"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29743"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10716"/>Audite hoc, senes, <l eID="gen29743" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29744"/>et auribus percipite, omnes habitatores terræ : <l eID="gen29744" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29745"/>si factum est istud in diebus vestris, <l eID="gen29745" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29746"/>aut in diebus patrum vestrorum ? <l eID="gen29746" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10717"/><l level="1" sID="gen29747"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10717"/>Super hoc filiis vestris narrate, <l eID="gen29747" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29748"/>et filii vestri filiis suis, <l eID="gen29748" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29749"/>et filii eorum generationi alteræ. <l eID="gen29749" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10718"/><l level="1" sID="gen29750"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10718"/>Residuum erucæ comedit locusta, <l eID="gen29750" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29751"/>et residuum locustæ comedit bruchus, <l eID="gen29751" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29752"/>et residuum bruchi comedit rubigo. <l eID="gen29752" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10719"/><l level="1" sID="gen29753"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10719"/>Expergiscimini, ebrii, <l eID="gen29753" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29754"/>et flete et ululate, omnes qui bibitis vinum in dulcedine, <l eID="gen29754" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29755"/>quoniam periit ab ore vestro. <l eID="gen29755" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10720"/><l level="1" sID="gen29756"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10720"/>Gens enim ascendit super terram meam, <l eID="gen29756" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29757"/>fortis et innumerabilis : <l eID="gen29757" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29758"/>dentes ejus ut dentes leonis, <l eID="gen29758" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29759"/>et molares ejus ut catuli leonis. <l eID="gen29759" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10721"/><l level="1" sID="gen29760"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10721"/>Posuit vineam meam in desertum, <l eID="gen29760" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29761"/>et ficum meam decorticavit ; <l eID="gen29761" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29762"/>nudans spoliavit eam, et projecit : <l eID="gen29762" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29763"/>albi facti sunt rami ejus. <l eID="gen29763" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10722"/><l level="1" sID="gen29764"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10722"/>Plange quasi virgo accincta sacco super virum pubertatis suæ. <l eID="gen29764" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10723"/><l level="1" sID="gen29765"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10723"/>Periit sacrificium et libatio de domo Domini ; <l eID="gen29765" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29766"/>luxerunt sacerdotes, ministri Domini. <l eID="gen29766" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:10
