verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10724"/><l level="1" sID="gen29767"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10724"/>Depopulata est regio, <l eID="gen29767" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29768"/>luxit humus, <l eID="gen29768" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29769"/>quoniam devastatum est triticum, <l eID="gen29769" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29770"/>confusum est vinum, <l eID="gen29770" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29771"/>elanguit oleum. <l eID="gen29771" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10725"/><l level="1" sID="gen29772"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10725"/>Confusi sunt agricolæ, <l eID="gen29772" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29773"/>ululaverunt vinitores <l eID="gen29773" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29774"/>super frumento et hordeo, <l eID="gen29774" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29775"/>quia periit messis agri. <l eID="gen29775" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10726"/><l level="1" sID="gen29776"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10726"/>Vinea confusa est, <l eID="gen29776" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29777"/>et ficus elanguit ; <l eID="gen29777" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29778"/>malogranatum, et palma, et malum, <l eID="gen29778" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29779"/>et omnia ligna agri aruerunt, <l eID="gen29779" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29780"/>quia confusum est gaudium a filiis hominum. <l eID="gen29780" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10727"/><l level="1" sID="gen29781"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10727"/>Accingite vos, et plangite, sacerdotes : <l eID="gen29781" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29782"/>ululate, ministri altaris ; <l eID="gen29782" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29783"/>ingredimini, cubate in sacco, ministri Dei mei, <l eID="gen29783" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29784"/>quoniam interiit de domo Dei vestri sacrificium et libatio. <l eID="gen29784" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10728"/><l level="1" sID="gen29785"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10728"/>Sanctificate jejunium, vocate cœtum, <l eID="gen29785" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29786"/>congregate senes, omnes habitatores terræ <l eID="gen29786" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29787"/>in domum Dei vestri, <l eID="gen29787" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29788"/>et clamate ad Dominum : <l eID="gen29788" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10729"/><l level="1" sID="gen29789"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10729"/>A, a, a, diei ! <l eID="gen29789" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29790"/>quia prope est dies Domini, <l eID="gen29790" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29791"/>et quasi vastitas a potente veniet. <l eID="gen29791" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10730"/><l level="1" sID="gen29792"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10730"/>Numquid non coram oculis vestris alimenta perierunt <l eID="gen29792" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29793"/>de domo Dei nostri, lætitia et exsultatio ? <l eID="gen29793" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10731"/><l level="1" sID="gen29794"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10731"/>Computruerunt jumenta in stercore suo, <l eID="gen29794" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29795"/>demolita sunt horrea, <l eID="gen29795" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29796"/>dissipatæ sunt apothecæ, <l eID="gen29796" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29797"/>quoniam confusum est triticum. <l eID="gen29797" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10732"/><l level="1" sID="gen29798"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10732"/>Quid ingemuit animal, <l eID="gen29798" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29799"/>mugierunt greges armenti ? <l eID="gen29799" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29800"/>quia non est pascua eis ; <l eID="gen29800" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29801"/>sed et greges pecorum disperierunt. <l eID="gen29801" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10733"/><l level="1" sID="gen29802"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10733"/>Ad te, Domine, clamabo, <l eID="gen29802" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29803"/>quia ignis comedit speciosa deserti, <l eID="gen29803" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29804"/>et flamma succendit omnia ligna regionis. <l eID="gen29804" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 1:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10734"/><l level="1" sID="gen29805"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10734"/>Sed et bestiæ agri, quasi area sitiens imbrem, suspexerunt ad te, <l eID="gen29805" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29806"/>quoniam exsiccati sunt fontes aquarum, <l eID="gen29806" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29807"/>et ignis devoravit speciosa deserti.  <chapter eID="Joel.1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:1
verses.text: Canite tuba in Sion, <l eID="gen29808" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29809"/>ululate in monte sancto meo, <l eID="gen29809" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29810"/>conturbentur omnes habitatores terræ : <l eID="gen29810" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29811"/>quia venit dies Domini, quia prope est. <l eID="gen29811" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10735"/><l level="1" sID="gen29812"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10735"/>Dies tenebrarum et caliginis, <l eID="gen29812" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29813"/>dies nubis et turbinis ; <l eID="gen29813" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29814"/>quasi mane expansum super montes <l eID="gen29814" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29815"/>populus multus et fortis : <l eID="gen29815" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29816"/>similis ei non fuit a principio, <l eID="gen29816" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29817"/>et post eum non erit <l eID="gen29817" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29818"/>usque in annos generationis et generationis. <l eID="gen29818" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10736"/><l level="1" sID="gen29819"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10736"/>Ante faciem ejus ignis vorans, <l eID="gen29819" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29820"/>et post eum exurens flamma. <l eID="gen29820" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29821"/>Quasi hortus voluptatis terra coram eo, <l eID="gen29821" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29822"/>et post eum solitudo deserti, <l eID="gen29822" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29823"/>neque est qui effugiat eum. <l eID="gen29823" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10737"/><l level="1" sID="gen29824"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10737"/>Quasi aspectus equorum, aspectus eorum ; <l eID="gen29824" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29825"/>et quasi equites, sic current. <l eID="gen29825" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10738"/><l level="1" sID="gen29826"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10738"/>Sicut sonitus quadrigarum super capita montium exilient, <l eID="gen29826" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29827"/>sicut sonitus flammæ ignis devorantis stipulam, <l eID="gen29827" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29828"/>velut populus fortis præparatus ad prælium. <l eID="gen29828" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10739"/><l level="1" sID="gen29829"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10739"/>A facie ejus cruciabuntur populi ; <l eID="gen29829" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29830"/>omnes vultus redigentur in ollam. <l eID="gen29830" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10740"/><l level="1" sID="gen29831"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10740"/>Sicut fortes current ; <l eID="gen29831" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29832"/>quasi viri bellatores ascendent murum : <l eID="gen29832" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29833"/>viri in viis suis gradientur, <l eID="gen29833" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29834"/>et non declinabunt a semitis suis. <l eID="gen29834" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10741"/><l level="1" sID="gen29835"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10741"/>Unusquisque fratrem suum non coarctabit, <l eID="gen29835" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29836"/>singuli in calle suo ambulabunt ; <l eID="gen29836" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29837"/>sed et per fenestras cadent, et non demolientur. <l eID="gen29837" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10742"/><l level="1" sID="gen29838"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10742"/>Urbem ingredientur, in muro current, <l eID="gen29838" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29839"/>domos conscendent, per fenestras intrabunt quasi fur. <l eID="gen29839" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10743"/><l level="1" sID="gen29840"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10743"/>A facie ejus contremuit terra, <l eID="gen29840" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29841"/>moti sunt cæli, <l eID="gen29841" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29842"/>sol et luna obtenebrati sunt, <l eID="gen29842" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29843"/>et stellæ retraxerunt splendorem suum. <l eID="gen29843" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10744"/><l level="1" sID="gen29844"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10744"/>Et Dominus dedit vocem suam ante faciem exercitus sui, <l eID="gen29844" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29845"/>quia multa sunt nimis castra ejus, <l eID="gen29845" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29846"/>quia fortia et facientia verbum ejus : <l eID="gen29846" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29847"/>magnus enim dies Domini, et terribilis valde, <l eID="gen29847" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29848"/>et quis sustinebit eum ? <l eID="gen29848" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10745"/><l level="1" sID="gen29849"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10745"/>Nunc ergo, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen29849" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29850"/>convertimini ad me in toto corde vestro, <l eID="gen29850" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29851"/>in jejunio, et in fletu, et in planctu. <l eID="gen29851" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10746"/><l level="1" sID="gen29852"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10746"/>Et scindite corda vestra, et non vestimenta vestra ; <l eID="gen29852" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29853"/>et convertimini ad Dominum Deum vestrum, <l eID="gen29853" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29854"/>quia benignus et misericors est, <l eID="gen29854" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29855"/>patiens et multæ misericordiæ, <l eID="gen29855" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29856"/>et præstabilis super malitia. <l eID="gen29856" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10747"/><l level="1" sID="gen29857"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10747"/>Quis scit si convertatur, et ignoscat, <l eID="gen29857" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29858"/>et relinquat post se benedictionem, sacrificium et libamen Domino Deo vestro ? <l eID="gen29858" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10748"/><l level="1" sID="gen29859"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10748"/>Canite tuba in Sion, <l eID="gen29859" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29860"/>sanctificate jejunium, vocate cœtum : <l eID="gen29860" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10749"/><l level="1" sID="gen29861"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10749"/>congregate populum, sanctificate ecclesiam, <l eID="gen29861" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29862"/>coadunate senes, congregate parvulos, et sugentes ubera ; <l eID="gen29862" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29863"/>egrediatur sponsus de cubili suo, <l eID="gen29863" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29864"/>et sponsa de thalamo suo. <l eID="gen29864" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10750"/><l level="1" sID="gen29865"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10750"/>Inter vestibulum et altare plorabunt sacerdotes, ministri Domini, <l eID="gen29865" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29866"/>et dicent : Parce, Domine, parce populo tuo ; <l eID="gen29866" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29867"/>et ne des hæreditatem tuam in opprobrium, <l eID="gen29867" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29868"/>ut dominentur eis nationes. <l eID="gen29868" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29869"/>Quare dicunt in populis : Ubi est Deus eorum ? <l eID="gen29869" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10751"/><l level="1" sID="gen29870"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10751"/>Zelatus est Dominus terram suam, <l eID="gen29870" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29871"/>et pepercit populo suo. <l eID="gen29871" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10752"/><l level="1" sID="gen29872"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10752"/>Et respondit Dominus, et dixit populo suo : <l eID="gen29872" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29873"/>Ecce ego mittam vobis frumentum, et vinum, et oleum, <l eID="gen29873" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29874"/>et replebimini eis ; <l eID="gen29874" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29875"/>et non dabo vos ultra opprobrium in gentibus. <l eID="gen29875" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10753"/><l level="1" sID="gen29876"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10753"/>Et eum qui ab aquilone est procul faciam a vobis, <l eID="gen29876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29877"/>et expellam eum in terram inviam et desertam : <l eID="gen29877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29878"/>faciem ejus contra mare orientale, <l eID="gen29878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29879"/>et extremum ejus ad mare novissimum : <l eID="gen29879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29880"/>et ascendet fœtor ejus, <l eID="gen29880" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29881"/>et ascendet putredo ejus, <l eID="gen29881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29882"/>quia superbe egit. <l eID="gen29882" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10754"/><l level="1" sID="gen29883"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10754"/>Noli timere, terra : <l eID="gen29883" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29884"/>exsulta, et lætare, <l eID="gen29884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29885"/>quoniam magnificavit Dominus ut faceret. <l eID="gen29885" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10755"/><l level="1" sID="gen29886"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10755"/>Nolite timere, animalia regionis, <l eID="gen29886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29887"/>quia germinaverunt speciosa deserti ; <l eID="gen29887" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29888"/>quia lignum attulit fructum suum, <l eID="gen29888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29889"/>ficus et vinea dederunt virtutem suam. <l eID="gen29889" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10756"/><l level="1" sID="gen29890"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10756"/>Et, filii Sion, exsultate, <l eID="gen29890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29891"/>et lætamini in Domino Deo vestro, <l eID="gen29891" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29892"/>quia dedit vobis doctorem justitiæ, <l eID="gen29892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29893"/>et descendere faciet ad vos imbrem matutinum et serotinum, <l eID="gen29893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29894"/>sicut in principio. <l eID="gen29894" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10757"/><l level="1" sID="gen29895"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10757"/>Et implebuntur areæ frumento, <l eID="gen29895" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29896"/>et redundabunt torcularia vino et oleo. <l eID="gen29896" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10758"/><l level="1" sID="gen29897"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10758"/>Et reddam vobis annos, quos comedit locusta, <l eID="gen29897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29898"/>bruchus, et rubigo, et eruca : <l eID="gen29898" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29899"/>fortitudo mea magna quam misi in vos. <l eID="gen29899" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:26
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10759"/><l level="1" sID="gen29900"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10759"/>Et comedetis vescentes, et saturabimini ; <l eID="gen29900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29901"/>et laudabitis nomen Domini Dei vestri, <l eID="gen29901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29902"/>qui fecit mirabilia vobiscum ; <l eID="gen29902" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29903"/>et non confundetur populus meus in sempiternum. <l eID="gen29903" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10760"/><l level="1" sID="gen29904"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10760"/>Et scietis quia in medio Israël ego sum, <l eID="gen29904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29905"/>et ego Dominus Deus vester, et non est amplius ; <l eID="gen29905" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29906"/>et non confundetur populus meus in æternum. <l eID="gen29906" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:28
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10761"/><l level="1" sID="gen29907"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10761"/>Et erit post hæc : <l eID="gen29907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29908"/>effundam spiritum meum super omnem carnem, <l eID="gen29908" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29909"/>et prophetabunt filii vestri et filiæ vestræ : <l eID="gen29909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29910"/>senes vestri somnia somniabunt, <l eID="gen29910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29911"/>et juvenes vestri visiones videbunt. <l eID="gen29911" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:29
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10762"/><l level="1" sID="gen29912"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10762"/>Sed et super servos meos et ancillas <l eID="gen29912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29913"/>in diebus illis effundam spiritum meum. <l eID="gen29913" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:30
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10763"/><l level="1" sID="gen29914"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10763"/>Et dabo prodigia in cælo et in terra, <l eID="gen29914" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29915"/>sanguinem, et ignem, et vaporem fumi. <l eID="gen29915" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:31
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10764"/><l level="1" sID="gen29916"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10764"/>Sol convertetur in tenebras, <l eID="gen29916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29917"/>et luna in sanguinem, <l eID="gen29917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29918"/>antequam veniat dies Domini magnus et horribilis. <l eID="gen29918" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 2:32
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10765"/><l level="1" sID="gen29919"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10765"/>Et erit : omnis qui invocaverit nomen Domini, salvus erit : <l eID="gen29919" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29920"/>quia in monte Sion et in Jerusalem <l eID="gen29920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29921"/>erit salvatio, sicut dixit Dominus, <l eID="gen29921" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29922"/>et in residuis quos Dominus vocaverit.  <chapter eID="Joel.2"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:1
verses.text: Quia ecce in diebus illis, et in tempore illo, <l eID="gen29923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29924"/>cum convertero captivitatem Juda et Jerusalem, <l eID="gen29924" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10766"/><l level="1" sID="gen29925"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10766"/>congregabo omnes gentes, <l eID="gen29925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29926"/>et deducam eas in vallem Josaphat ; <l eID="gen29926" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29927"/>et disceptabo cum eis ibi super populo meo, <l eID="gen29927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29928"/>et hæreditate mea Israël, <l eID="gen29928" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29929"/>quos disperserunt in nationibus, <l eID="gen29929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29930"/>et terram meam diviserunt. <l eID="gen29930" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10767"/><l level="1" sID="gen29931"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10767"/>Et super populum meum miserunt sortem ; <l eID="gen29931" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29932"/>et posuerunt puerum in prostibulo, <l eID="gen29932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29933"/>et puellam vendiderunt pro vino ut biberent. <l eID="gen29933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10768"/><l level="1" sID="gen29934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10768"/>Verum quid mihi et vobis, Tyrus et Sidon, <l eID="gen29934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29935"/>et omnis terminus Palæstinorum ? <l eID="gen29935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29936"/>numquid ultionem vos reddetis mihi ? <l eID="gen29936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29937"/>et si ulciscimini vos contra me, <l eID="gen29937" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29938"/>cito velociter reddam vicissitudinem vobis super caput vestrum. <l eID="gen29938" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10769"/><l level="1" sID="gen29939"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10769"/>Argentum enim meum et aurum tulistis, <l eID="gen29939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29940"/>et desiderabilia mea et pulcherrima intulistis in delubra vestra. <l eID="gen29940" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10770"/><l level="1" sID="gen29941"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10770"/>Et filios Juda et filios Jerusalem vendidistis filiis Græcorum, <l eID="gen29941" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29942"/>ut longe faceretis eos de finibus suis. <l eID="gen29942" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10771"/><l level="1" sID="gen29943"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10771"/>Ecce ego suscitabo eos de loco in quo vendidistis eos, <l eID="gen29943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29944"/>et convertam retributionem vestram in caput vestrum. <l eID="gen29944" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10772"/><l level="1" sID="gen29945"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10772"/>Et vendam filios vestros et filias vestras in manibus filiorum Juda, <l eID="gen29945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29946"/>et venundabunt eos Sabæis, genti longinquæ, <l eID="gen29946" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29947"/>quia Dominus locutus est. <l eID="gen29947" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10773"/><l level="1" sID="gen29948"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10773"/>Clamate hoc in gentibus, <l eID="gen29948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29949"/>sanctificate bellum, <l eID="gen29949" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29950"/>suscitate robustos : <l eID="gen29950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29951"/>accedant, ascendant omnes viri bellatores. <l eID="gen29951" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10774"/><l level="1" sID="gen29952"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10774"/>Concidite aratra vestra in gladios, <l eID="gen29952" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29953"/>et ligones vestros in lanceas. <l eID="gen29953" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29954"/>Infirmus dicat : Quia fortis ego sum. <l eID="gen29954" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10775"/><l level="1" sID="gen29955"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10775"/>Erumpite, et venite, omnes gentes de circuitu, <l eID="gen29955" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29956"/>et congregamini ; <l eID="gen29956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29957"/>ibi occumbere faciet Dominus robustos tuos. <l eID="gen29957" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10776"/><l level="1" sID="gen29958"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10776"/>Consurgant, et ascendant gentes in vallem Josaphat, <l eID="gen29958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29959"/>quia ibi sedebo ut judicem omnes gentes in circuitu. <l eID="gen29959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10777"/><l level="1" sID="gen29960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10777"/>Mittite falces, quoniam maturavit messis ; <l eID="gen29960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29961"/>venite, et descendite, <l eID="gen29961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29962"/>quia plenum est torcular, exuberant torcularia : <l eID="gen29962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29963"/>quia multiplicata est malitia eorum. <l eID="gen29963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10778"/><l level="1" sID="gen29964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10778"/>Populi, populi, in valle concisionis, <l eID="gen29964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29965"/>quia juxta est dies Domini in valle concisionis. <l eID="gen29965" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10779"/><l level="1" sID="gen29966"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10779"/>Sol et luna obtenebrati sunt, <l eID="gen29966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29967"/>et stellæ retraxerunt splendorem suum. <l eID="gen29967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10780"/><l level="1" sID="gen29968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10780"/>Et Dominus de Sion rugiet, <l eID="gen29968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29969"/>et de Jerusalem dabit vocem suam, <l eID="gen29969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29970"/>et movebuntur cæli et terra ; <l eID="gen29970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29971"/>et Dominus spes populi sui, <l eID="gen29971" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29972"/>et fortitudo filiorum Israël. <l eID="gen29972" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10781"/><l level="1" sID="gen29973"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10781"/>Et scietis quia ego Dominus Deus vester, <l eID="gen29973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29974"/>habitans in Sion monte sancto meo ; <l eID="gen29974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29975"/>et erit Jerusalem sancta, <l eID="gen29975" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29976"/>et alieni non transibunt per eam amplius. <l eID="gen29976" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10782"/><l level="1" sID="gen29977"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10782"/>Et erit in die illa : stillabunt montes dulcedinem, <l eID="gen29977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29978"/>et colles fluent lacte, <l eID="gen29978" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29979"/>et per omnes rivos Juda ibunt aquæ ; <l eID="gen29979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29980"/>et fons de domo Domini egredietur, <l eID="gen29980" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29981"/>et irrigabit torrentem spinarum. <l eID="gen29981" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10783"/><l level="1" sID="gen29982"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10783"/>Ægyptus in desolationem erit, <l eID="gen29982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29983"/>et Idumæa in desertum perditionis, <l eID="gen29983" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29984"/>pro eo quod inique egerint in filios Juda, <l eID="gen29984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29985"/>et effuderint sanguinem innocentem in terra sua. <l eID="gen29985" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10784"/><l level="1" sID="gen29986"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10784"/>Et Judæa in æternum habitabitur, <l eID="gen29986" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29987"/>et Jerusalem in generationem et generationem. <l eID="gen29987" level="1"/>

verses.name: Joel 3:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10785"/><l level="1" sID="gen29988"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10785"/>Et mundabo sanguinem eorum, quem non mundaveram ; <l eID="gen29988" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29989"/>et Dominus commorabitur in Sion. <l eID="gen29989" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen29742"/> <chapter eID="Joel.3"/> <div eID="gen29740" osisID="Joel" type="book"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:1
verses.text: Verba Amos, qui fuit in pastoribus de Thecue, quæ vidit super Israël in diebus Oziæ, regis Juda, et in diebus Jeroboam, filii Joas, regis Israël, ante duos annos terræmotus.  <div eID="gen29991" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10786"/><div sID="gen29992" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10786"/>Et dixit : <div eID="gen29992" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen29993"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29994"/>Dominus de Sion rugiet, <l eID="gen29994" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29995"/>et de Jerusalem dabit vocem suam ; <l eID="gen29995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29996"/>et luxerunt speciosa pastorum, <l eID="gen29996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29997"/>et exsiccatus est vertex Carmeli. <l eID="gen29997" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10787"/><l level="1" sID="gen29998"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10787"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen29998" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen29999"/>Super tribus sceleribus Damasci, <l eID="gen29999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30000"/>et super quatuor non convertam eum, <l eID="gen30000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30001"/>eo quod trituraverint in plaustris ferreis Galaad. <l eID="gen30001" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10788"/><l level="1" sID="gen30002"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10788"/>Et mittam ignem in domum Azaël, <l eID="gen30002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30003"/>et devorabit domos Benadad. <l eID="gen30003" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10789"/><l level="1" sID="gen30004"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10789"/>Et conteram vectem Damasci : <l eID="gen30004" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30005"/>et disperdam habitatorem de campo idoli, <l eID="gen30005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30006"/>et tenentem sceptrum de domo voluptatis : <l eID="gen30006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30007"/>et transferetur populus Syriæ Cyrenen, <l eID="gen30007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30008"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10790"/><l level="1" sID="gen30009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10790"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30010"/>Super tribus sceleribus Gazæ, <l eID="gen30010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30011"/>et super quatuor non convertam eum, <l eID="gen30011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30012"/>eo quod transtulerint captivitatem perfectam, <l eID="gen30012" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30013"/>ut concluderent eam in Idumæa. <l eID="gen30013" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10791"/><l level="1" sID="gen30014"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10791"/>Et mittam ignem in murum Gazæ, <l eID="gen30014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30015"/>et devorabit ædes ejus. <l eID="gen30015" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10792"/><l level="1" sID="gen30016"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10792"/>Et disperdam habitatorem de Azoto, <l eID="gen30016" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30017"/>et tenentem sceptrum de Ascalone : <l eID="gen30017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30018"/>et convertam manum meam super Accaron, <l eID="gen30018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30019"/>et peribunt reliqui Philisthinorum, <l eID="gen30019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30020"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen30020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10793"/><l level="1" sID="gen30021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10793"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30022"/>Super tribus sceleribus Tyri, <l eID="gen30022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30023"/>et super quatuor non convertam eum, <l eID="gen30023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30024"/>eo quod concluserint captivitatem perfectam in Idumæa, <l eID="gen30024" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30025"/>et non sint recordati fœderis fratrum. <l eID="gen30025" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10794"/><l level="1" sID="gen30026"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10794"/>Et mittam ignem in murum Tyri, <l eID="gen30026" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30027"/>et devorabit ædes ejus. <l eID="gen30027" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10795"/><l level="1" sID="gen30028"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10795"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30029"/>Super tribus sceleribus Edom, <l eID="gen30029" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30030"/>et super quatuor non convertam eum, <l eID="gen30030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30031"/>eo quod persecutus sit in gladio fratrem suum, <l eID="gen30031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30032"/>et violaverit misericordiam ejus, <l eID="gen30032" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30033"/>et tenuerit ultra furorem suum, <l eID="gen30033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30034"/>et indignationem suam servaverit usque in finem. <l eID="gen30034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10796"/><l level="1" sID="gen30035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10796"/>Mittam ignem in Theman, <l eID="gen30035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30036"/>et devorabit ædes Bosræ. <l eID="gen30036" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10797"/><l level="1" sID="gen30037"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10797"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30038"/>Super tribus sceleribus filiorum Ammon, <l eID="gen30038" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30039"/>et super quatuor non convertam eum, <l eID="gen30039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30040"/>eo quod dissecuerit prægnantes Galaad <l eID="gen30040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30041"/>ad dilatandum terminum suum. <l eID="gen30041" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10798"/><l level="1" sID="gen30042"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10798"/>Et succendam ignem in muro Rabba, <l eID="gen30042" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30043"/>et devorabit ædes ejus in ululatu in die belli, <l eID="gen30043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30044"/>et in turbine in die commotionis. <l eID="gen30044" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10799"/><l level="1" sID="gen30045"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10799"/>Et ibit Melchom in captivitatem, <l eID="gen30045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30046"/>ipse et principes ejus simul, <l eID="gen30046" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30047"/>dicit Dominus.  <chapter eID="Amos.1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:1
verses.text: Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30049"/>Super tribus sceleribus Moab, <l eID="gen30049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30050"/>et super quatuor non convertam eum, <l eID="gen30050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30051"/>eo quod incenderit ossa regis Idumææ usque ad cinerem. <l eID="gen30051" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10800"/><l level="1" sID="gen30052"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10800"/>Et mittam ignem in Moab, <l eID="gen30052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30053"/>et devorabit ædes Carioth : <l eID="gen30053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30054"/>et morietur in sonitu Moab, in clangore tubæ. <l eID="gen30054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10801"/><l level="1" sID="gen30055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10801"/>Et disperdam judicem de medio ejus, <l eID="gen30055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30056"/>et omnes principes ejus interficiam cum eo, <l eID="gen30056" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30057"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30057" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10802"/><l level="1" sID="gen30058"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10802"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30059"/>Super tribus sceleribus Juda, <l eID="gen30059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30060"/>et super quatuor non convertam eum, <l eID="gen30060" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30061"/>eo quod abjecerit legem Domini <l eID="gen30061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30062"/>et mandata ejus non custodierit : <l eID="gen30062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30063"/>deceperant enim eos idola sua, <l eID="gen30063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30064"/>post quæ abierant patres eorum. <l eID="gen30064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10803"/><l level="1" sID="gen30065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10803"/>Et mittam ignem in Juda, <l eID="gen30065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30066"/>et devorabit ædes Jerusalem. <l eID="gen30066" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10804"/><l level="1" sID="gen30067"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10804"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30068"/>Super tribus sceleribus Israël, <l eID="gen30068" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30069"/>et super quatuor non convertam eum, <l eID="gen30069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30070"/>pro eo quod vendiderit pro argento justum, <l eID="gen30070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30071"/>et pauperem pro calceamentis. <l eID="gen30071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10805"/><l level="1" sID="gen30072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10805"/>Qui conterunt super pulverem terræ capita pauperum, <l eID="gen30072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30073"/>et viam humilium declinant : <l eID="gen30073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30074"/>et filius ac pater ejus ierunt ad puellam, <l eID="gen30074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30075"/>ut violarent nomen sanctum meum. <l eID="gen30075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10806"/><l level="1" sID="gen30076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10806"/>Et super vestimentis pignoratis accubuerunt juxta omne altare, <l eID="gen30076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30077"/>et vinum damnatorum bibebant in domo Dei sui. <l eID="gen30077" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10807"/><l level="1" sID="gen30078"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10807"/>Ego autem exterminavi Amorrhæum a facie eorum, <l eID="gen30078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30079"/>cujus altitudo, cedrorum altitudo ejus, <l eID="gen30079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30080"/>et fortis ipse quasi quercus ; <l eID="gen30080" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30081"/>et contrivi fructum ejus desuper, <l eID="gen30081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30082"/>et radices ejus subter. <l eID="gen30082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10808"/><l level="1" sID="gen30083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10808"/>Ego sum qui ascendere vos feci de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen30083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30084"/>et duxi vos in deserto quadraginta annis, <l eID="gen30084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30085"/>ut possideretis terram Amorrhæi. <l eID="gen30085" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10809"/><l level="1" sID="gen30086"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10809"/>Et suscitavi de filiis vestris in prophetas, <l eID="gen30086" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30087"/>et de juvenibus vestris nazaræos. <l eID="gen30087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30088"/>Numquid non ita est, filii Israël ? dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10810"/><l level="1" sID="gen30089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10810"/>Et propinabitis nazaræis vinum, <l eID="gen30089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30090"/>et prophetis mandabitis, dicentes : <l eID="gen30090" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30091"/>Ne prophetetis. <l eID="gen30091" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10811"/><l level="1" sID="gen30092"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10811"/>Ecce ego stridebo subter vos, <l eID="gen30092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30093"/>sicut stridet plaustrum onustum fœno. <l eID="gen30093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10812"/><l level="1" sID="gen30094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10812"/>Et peribit fuga a veloce, <l eID="gen30094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30095"/>et fortis non obtinebit virtutem suam, <l eID="gen30095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30096"/>et robustus non salvabit animam suam : <l eID="gen30096" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10813"/><l level="1" sID="gen30097"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10813"/>et tenens arcum non stabit, <l eID="gen30097" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30098"/>et velox pedibus suis non salvabitur, <l eID="gen30098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30099"/>et ascensor equi non salvabit animam suam : <l eID="gen30099" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10814"/><l level="1" sID="gen30100"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10814"/>et robustus corde inter fortes nudus fugiet in illa die, <l eID="gen30100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30101"/>dicit Dominus.  <chapter eID="Amos.2"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:1
verses.text: Audite verbum quod locutus est Dominus super vos, filii Israël, <l eID="gen30102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30103"/>super omnem cognationem quam eduxi de terra Ægypti, dicens : <l eID="gen30103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10815"/><l level="1" sID="gen30104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10815"/>Tantummodo vos cognovi ex omnibus cognationibus terræ ; <l eID="gen30104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30105"/>idcirco visitabo super vos omnes iniquitates vestras. <l eID="gen30105" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10816"/><l level="1" sID="gen30106"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10816"/>Numquid ambulabunt duo pariter, <l eID="gen30106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30107"/>nisi convenerit eis ? <l eID="gen30107" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10817"/><l level="1" sID="gen30108"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10817"/>numquid rugiet leo in saltu, <l eID="gen30108" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30109"/>nisi habuerit prædam ? <l eID="gen30109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30110"/>numquid dabit catulus leonis vocem de cubili suo, <l eID="gen30110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30111"/>nisi aliquid apprehenderit ? <l eID="gen30111" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10818"/><l level="1" sID="gen30112"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10818"/>numquid cadet avis in laqueum terræ <l eID="gen30112" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30113"/>absque aucupe ? <l eID="gen30113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30114"/>numquid auferetur laqueus de terra <l eID="gen30114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30115"/>antequam quid ceperit ? <l eID="gen30115" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10819"/><l level="1" sID="gen30116"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10819"/>si clanget tuba in civitate, <l eID="gen30116" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30117"/>et populus non expavescet ? <l eID="gen30117" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30118"/>si erit malum in civitate, <l eID="gen30118" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30119"/>quod Dominus non fecerit ? <l eID="gen30119" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10820"/><l level="1" sID="gen30120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10820"/>Quia non facit Dominus Deus verbum, <l eID="gen30120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30121"/>nisi revelaverit secretum suum ad servos suos prophetas. <l eID="gen30121" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10821"/><l level="1" sID="gen30122"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10821"/>Leo rugiet, quis non timebit ? <l eID="gen30122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30123"/>Dominus Deus locutus est, quis non prophetabit ? <l eID="gen30123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10822"/><l level="1" sID="gen30124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10822"/>Auditum facite in ædibus Azoti, <l eID="gen30124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30125"/>et in ædibus terræ Ægypti, <l eID="gen30125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30126"/>et dicite : Congregamini super montes Samariæ, <l eID="gen30126" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30127"/>et videte insanias multas in medio ejus, <l eID="gen30127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30128"/>et calumniam patientes in penetralibus ejus. <l eID="gen30128" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10823"/><l level="1" sID="gen30129"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10823"/>Et nescierunt facere rectum, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen30129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30130"/>thesaurizantes iniquitatem et rapinas in ædibus suis. <l eID="gen30130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10824"/><l level="1" sID="gen30131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10824"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen30131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30132"/>Tribulabitur et circuietur terra : <l eID="gen30132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30133"/>et detrahetur ex te fortitudo tua, <l eID="gen30133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30134"/>et diripientur ædes tuæ. <l eID="gen30134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10825"/><l level="1" sID="gen30135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10825"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30136"/>Quomodo si eruat pastor de ore leonis <l eID="gen30136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30137"/>duo crura, aut extremum auriculæ, <l eID="gen30137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30138"/>sic eruentur filii Israël, qui habitant in Samaria <l eID="gen30138" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30139"/>in plaga lectuli, et in Damasci grabato. <l eID="gen30139" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10826"/><l level="1" sID="gen30140"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10826"/>Audite, et contestamini in domo Jacob, <l eID="gen30140" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30141"/>dicit Dominus Deus exercituum ; <l eID="gen30141" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10827"/><l level="1" sID="gen30142"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10827"/>quia in die cum visitare cœpero prævaricationes Israël, <l eID="gen30142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30143"/>super eum visitabo, et super altaria Bethel ; <l eID="gen30143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30144"/>et amputabuntur cornua altaris, et cadent in terram. <l eID="gen30144" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10828"/><l level="1" sID="gen30145"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10828"/>Et percutiam domum hiemalem cum domo æstiva, <l eID="gen30145" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30146"/>et peribunt domus eburneæ, <l eID="gen30146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30147"/>et dissipabuntur ædes multæ, <l eID="gen30147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30148"/>dicit Dominus.  <chapter eID="Amos.3"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:1
verses.text: Audite verbum hoc, vaccæ pingues, <l eID="gen30149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30150"/>quæ estis in monte Samariæ, <l eID="gen30150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30151"/>quæ calumniam facitis egenis <l eID="gen30151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30152"/>et confringitis pauperes ; <l eID="gen30152" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30153"/>quæ dicitis dominis vestris : Afferte, et bibemus. <l eID="gen30153" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10829"/><l level="1" sID="gen30154"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10829"/>Juravit Dominus Deus in sancto suo, <l eID="gen30154" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30155"/>quia ecce dies venient super vos, <l eID="gen30155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30156"/>et levabunt vos in contis, <l eID="gen30156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30157"/>et reliquias vestras in ollis ferventibus. <l eID="gen30157" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10830"/><l level="1" sID="gen30158"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10830"/>Et per aperturas exibitis altera contra alteram, <l eID="gen30158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30159"/>et projiciemini in Armon, <l eID="gen30159" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30160"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30160" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10831"/><l level="1" sID="gen30161"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10831"/>Venite ad Bethel, et impie agite ; <l eID="gen30161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30162"/>ad Galgalam, et multiplicate prævaricationem : <l eID="gen30162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30163"/>et afferte mane victimas vestras, <l eID="gen30163" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30164"/>tribus diebus decimas vestras. <l eID="gen30164" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10832"/><l level="1" sID="gen30165"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10832"/>Et sacrificate de fermentato laudem, <l eID="gen30165" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30166"/>et vocate voluntarias oblationes, et annuntiate ; <l eID="gen30166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30167"/>sic enim voluistis, filii Israël, <l eID="gen30167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30168"/>dicit Dominus Deus. <l eID="gen30168" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10833"/><l level="1" sID="gen30169"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10833"/>Unde et ego dedi vobis stuporem dentium in cunctis urbibus vestris, <l eID="gen30169" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30170"/>et indigentiam panum in omnibus locis vestris ; <l eID="gen30170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30171"/>et non estis reversi ad me, <l eID="gen30171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30172"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30172" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10834"/><l level="1" sID="gen30173"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10834"/>Ego quoque prohibui a vobis imbrem, <l eID="gen30173" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30174"/>cum adhuc tres menses superessent usque ad messem : <l eID="gen30174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30175"/>et plui super unam civitatem, <l eID="gen30175" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30176"/>et super alteram civitatem non plui ; <l eID="gen30176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30177"/>pars una compluta est, <l eID="gen30177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30178"/>et pars super quam non plui, aruit. <l eID="gen30178" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10835"/><l level="1" sID="gen30179"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10835"/>Et venerunt duæ et tres civitates ad unam civitatem <l eID="gen30179" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30180"/>ut biberent aquam, et non sunt satiatæ ; <l eID="gen30180" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30181"/>et non redistis ad me, <l eID="gen30181" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30182"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30182" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10836"/><l level="1" sID="gen30183"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10836"/>Percussi vos in vento urente, et in aurugine : <l eID="gen30183" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30184"/>multitudinem hortorum vestrorum et vinearum vestrarum, <l eID="gen30184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30185"/>oliveta vestra et ficeta vestra comedit eruca : <l eID="gen30185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30186"/>et non redistis ad me, <l eID="gen30186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30187"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10837"/><l level="1" sID="gen30188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10837"/>Misi in vos mortem in via Ægypti ; <l eID="gen30188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30189"/>percussi in gladio juvenes vestros, <l eID="gen30189" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30190"/>usque ad captivitatem equorum vestrorum, <l eID="gen30190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30191"/>et ascendere feci putredinem castrorum vestrorum in nares vestras : <l eID="gen30191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30192"/>et non redistis ad me, <l eID="gen30192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30193"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30193" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10838"/><l level="1" sID="gen30194"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10838"/>Subverti vos sicut subvertit Deus Sodomam et Gomorrham, <l eID="gen30194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30195"/>et facti estis quasi torris raptus ab incendio : <l eID="gen30195" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30196"/>et non redistis ad me, <l eID="gen30196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30197"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30197" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10839"/><l level="1" sID="gen30198"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10839"/>Quapropter hæc faciam tibi, Israël : <l eID="gen30198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30199"/>postquam autem hæc fecero tibi, <l eID="gen30199" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30200"/>præparare in occursum Dei tui, Israël. <l eID="gen30200" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 4:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10840"/><l level="1" sID="gen30201"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10840"/>Quia ecce formans montes, <l eID="gen30201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30202"/>et creans ventum, <l eID="gen30202" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30203"/>et annuntians homini eloquium suum, <l eID="gen30203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30204"/>faciens matutinam nebulam, <l eID="gen30204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30205"/>et gradiens super excelsa terræ : <l eID="gen30205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30206"/>Dominus Deus exercituum nomen ejus.  <chapter eID="Amos.4"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:1
verses.text: Audite verbum istud, <l eID="gen30207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30208"/>quod ego levo super vos planctum : <l eID="gen30208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30209"/>domus Israël cecidit, <l eID="gen30209" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30210"/>et non adjiciet ut resurgat. <l eID="gen30210" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10841"/><l level="1" sID="gen30211"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10841"/>Virgo Israël projecta est in terram suam, <l eID="gen30211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30212"/>non est qui suscitet eam. <l eID="gen30212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10842"/><l level="1" sID="gen30213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10842"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus Deus : <l eID="gen30213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30214"/>Urbs de qua egrediebantur mille, <l eID="gen30214" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30215"/>relinquentur in ea centum ; <l eID="gen30215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30216"/>et de qua egrediebantur centum, <l eID="gen30216" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30217"/>relinquentur in ea decem in domo Israël. <l eID="gen30217" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10843"/><l level="1" sID="gen30218"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10843"/>Quia hæc dicit Dominus domui Israël : <l eID="gen30218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30219"/>Quærite me, et vivetis. <l eID="gen30219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10844"/><l level="1" sID="gen30220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10844"/>Et nolite quærere Bethel, <l eID="gen30220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30221"/>et in Galgalam nolite intrare, <l eID="gen30221" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30222"/>et in Bersabee non transibitis, <l eID="gen30222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30223"/>quia Galgala captiva ducetur, <l eID="gen30223" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30224"/>et Bethel erit inutilis. <l eID="gen30224" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10845"/><l level="1" sID="gen30225"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10845"/>Quærite Dominum, et vivite <l eID="gen30225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30226"/>(ne forte comburatur ut ignis domus Joseph, et devorabit, <l eID="gen30226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30227"/>et non erit qui extinguat Bethel : <l eID="gen30227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10846"/><l level="1" sID="gen30228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10846"/>qui convertitis in absinthium judicium, <l eID="gen30228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30229"/>et justitiam in terra relinquitis) : <l eID="gen30229" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10847"/><l level="1" sID="gen30230"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10847"/>facientem Arcturum et Orionem, <l eID="gen30230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30231"/>et convertentem in mane tenebras, <l eID="gen30231" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30232"/>et diem in noctem mutantem ; <l eID="gen30232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30233"/>qui vocat aquas maris, <l eID="gen30233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30234"/>et effundit eas super faciem terræ ; <l eID="gen30234" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30235"/>Dominus nomen est ejus : <l eID="gen30235" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10848"/><l level="1" sID="gen30236"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10848"/>qui subridet vastitatem super robustum, <l eID="gen30236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30237"/>et depopulationem super potentem affert. <l eID="gen30237" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10849"/><l level="1" sID="gen30238"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10849"/>Odio habuerunt corripientem in porta, <l eID="gen30238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30239"/>et loquentem perfecte abominati sunt. <l eID="gen30239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10850"/><l level="1" sID="gen30240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10850"/>Idcirco, pro eo quod diripiebatis pauperem, <l eID="gen30240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30241"/>et prædam electam tollebatis ab eo, <l eID="gen30241" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30242"/>domos quadro lapide ædificabitis, <l eID="gen30242" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30243"/>et non habitabitis in eis ; <l eID="gen30243" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30244"/>vineas plantabis amantissimas, <l eID="gen30244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30245"/>et non bibetis vinum earum. <l eID="gen30245" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10851"/><l level="1" sID="gen30246"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10851"/>Quia cognovi multa scelera vestra, <l eID="gen30246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30247"/>et fortia peccata vestra : <l eID="gen30247" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30248"/>hostes justi, accipientes munus, <l eID="gen30248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30249"/>et pauperes deprimentes in porta. <l eID="gen30249" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10852"/><l level="1" sID="gen30250"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10852"/>Ideo prudens in tempore illo tacebit, <l eID="gen30250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30251"/>quia tempus malum est. <l eID="gen30251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10853"/><l level="1" sID="gen30252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10853"/>Quærite bonum, et non malum, ut vivatis ; <l eID="gen30252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30253"/>et erit Dominus Deus exercituum vobiscum, sicut dixistis. <l eID="gen30253" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10854"/><l level="1" sID="gen30254"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10854"/>Odite malum et diligite bonum, <l eID="gen30254" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30255"/>et constituite in porta judicium : <l eID="gen30255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30256"/>si forte misereatur Dominus Deus exercituum reliquiis Joseph. <l eID="gen30256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10855"/><l level="1" sID="gen30257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10855"/>Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum, dominator : <l eID="gen30257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30258"/>In omnibus plateis planctus ; <l eID="gen30258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30259"/>et in cunctis quæ foris sunt, dicetur : Væ, væ ! <l eID="gen30259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30260"/>et vocabunt agricolam ad luctum, <l eID="gen30260" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30261"/>et ad planctum eos qui sciunt plangere. <l eID="gen30261" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10856"/><l level="1" sID="gen30262"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10856"/>Et in omnibus vineis erit planctus, <l eID="gen30262" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30263"/>quia pertransibo in medio tui, <l eID="gen30263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30264"/>dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen30264" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10857"/><l level="1" sID="gen30265"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10857"/>Væ desiderantibus diem Domini ! <l eID="gen30265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30266"/>ad quid eam vobis ? <l eID="gen30266" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30267"/>Dies Domini ista, tenebræ, et non lux. <l eID="gen30267" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10858"/><l level="1" sID="gen30268"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10858"/>Quomodo si fugiat vir a facie leonis, <l eID="gen30268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30269"/>et occurrat ei ursus ; <l eID="gen30269" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30270"/>et ingrediatur domum, et innitatur manu sua super parietem, <l eID="gen30270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30271"/>et mordeat eum coluber. <l eID="gen30271" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10859"/><l level="1" sID="gen30272"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10859"/>Numquid non tenebræ dies Domini, et non lux ; <l eID="gen30272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30273"/>et caligo, et non splendor in ea ? <l eID="gen30273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:21
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10860"/><l level="1" sID="gen30274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10860"/>Odi, et projeci festivitates vestras, <l eID="gen30274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30275"/>et non capiam odorem cœtuum vestrorum. <l eID="gen30275" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:22
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10861"/><l level="1" sID="gen30276"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10861"/>Quod si obtuleritis mihi holocautomata, et munera vestra, <l eID="gen30276" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30277"/>non suscipiam ; <l eID="gen30277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30278"/>et vota pinguium vestrorum non respiciam. <l eID="gen30278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:23
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10862"/><l level="1" sID="gen30279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10862"/>Aufer a me tumultum carminum tuorum ; <l eID="gen30279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30280"/>et cantica lyræ tuæ non audiam. <l eID="gen30280" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:24
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10863"/><l level="1" sID="gen30281"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10863"/>Et revelabitur quasi aqua judicium, <l eID="gen30281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30282"/>et justitia quasi torrens fortis. <l eID="gen30282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:25
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10864"/><l level="1" sID="gen30283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10864"/>Numquid hostias et sacrificium obtulistis mihi <l eID="gen30283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30284"/>in deserto quadraginta annis, domus Israël ?

verses.name: Amos 5:26
verses.text: et portastis tabernaculum Moloch vestro, <l eID="gen30284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30285"/>et imaginem idolorum vestrorum, sidus dei vestri, <l eID="gen30285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30286"/>quæ fecistis vobis. <l eID="gen30286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 5:27
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10865"/><l level="1" sID="gen30287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10865"/>Et migrare vos faciam trans Damascum, dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30288"/>Deus exercituum nomen ejus.  <chapter eID="Amos.5"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:1
verses.text: Væ qui opulenti estis in Sion, <l eID="gen30289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30290"/>et confiditis in monte Samariæ : <l eID="gen30290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30291"/>optimates capita populorum, <l eID="gen30291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30292"/>ingredientes pompatice domum Israël ! <l eID="gen30292" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10866"/><l level="1" sID="gen30293"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10866"/>Transite in Chalane, et videte, <l eID="gen30293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30294"/>et ite inde in Emath magnam, <l eID="gen30294" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30295"/>et descendite in Geth Palæstinorum, <l eID="gen30295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30296"/>et ad optima quæque regna horum : <l eID="gen30296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30297"/>si latior terminus eorum termino vestro est. <l eID="gen30297" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10867"/><l level="1" sID="gen30298"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10867"/>Qui separati estis in diem malum, <l eID="gen30298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30299"/>et appropinquatis solio iniquitatis ; <l eID="gen30299" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10868"/><l level="1" sID="gen30300"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10868"/>qui dormitis in lectis eburneis, <l eID="gen30300" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30301"/>et lascivitis in stratis vestris ; <l eID="gen30301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30302"/>qui comeditis agnum de grege, <l eID="gen30302" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30303"/>et vitulos de medio armenti ; <l eID="gen30303" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10869"/><l level="1" sID="gen30304"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10869"/>qui canitis ad vocem psalterii, <l eID="gen30304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30305"/>sicut David putaverunt se habere vasa cantici, <l eID="gen30305" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10870"/><l level="1" sID="gen30306"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10870"/>bibentes vinum in phialis, <l eID="gen30306" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30307"/>et optimo unguento delibuti, <l eID="gen30307" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30308"/>et nihil patiebantur super contritione Joseph. <l eID="gen30308" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10871"/><l level="1" sID="gen30309"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10871"/>Quapropter nunc migrabunt in capite transmigrantium, <l eID="gen30309" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30310"/>et auferetur factio lascivientium. <l eID="gen30310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10872"/><l level="1" sID="gen30311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10872"/>Juravit Dominus Deus in anima sua, <l eID="gen30311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30312"/>dicit Dominus Deus exercituum : <l eID="gen30312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30313"/>Detestor ego superbiam Jacob, <l eID="gen30313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30314"/>et domos ejus odi, <l eID="gen30314" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30315"/>et tradam civitatem cum habitatoribus suis. <l eID="gen30315" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10873"/><l level="1" sID="gen30316"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10873"/>Quod si reliqui fuerint decem viri in domo una, <l eID="gen30316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30317"/>et ipsi morientur. <l eID="gen30317" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10874"/><l level="1" sID="gen30318"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10874"/>Et tollet eum propinquus suus, et comburet eum, <l eID="gen30318" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30319"/>ut efferat ossa de domo ; <l eID="gen30319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30320"/>et dicet ei, qui in penetralibus domus est : <l eID="gen30320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30321"/>Numquid adhuc est penes te ? <l eID="gen30321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10875"/><l level="1" sID="gen30322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10875"/>Et respondebit : Finis est. <l eID="gen30322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30323"/>Et dicet ei : Tace, <l eID="gen30323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30324"/>et non recorderis nominis Domini. <l eID="gen30324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10876"/><l level="1" sID="gen30325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10876"/>Quia ecce Dominus mandabit, <l eID="gen30325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30326"/>et percutiet domum majorem ruinis, <l eID="gen30326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30327"/>et domum minorem scissionibus. <l eID="gen30327" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10877"/><l level="1" sID="gen30328"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10877"/>Numquid currere queunt in petris equi, <l eID="gen30328" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30329"/>aut arari potest in bubalis ? <l eID="gen30329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30330"/>quoniam convertistis in amaritudinem judicium, <l eID="gen30330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30331"/>et fructum justitiæ in absinthium. <l eID="gen30331" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10878"/><l level="1" sID="gen30332"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10878"/>Qui lætamini in nihilo ; qui dicitis : <l eID="gen30332" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30333"/>Numquid non in fortitudine nostra assumpsimus nobis cornua ? <l eID="gen30333" level="1"/>

verses.name: Amos 6:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv10879"/><l level="1" sID="gen30334"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv10879"/>Ecce enim suscitabo super vos, domus Israël, <l eID="gen30334" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30335"/>dicit Dominus Deus exercituum, gentem, <l eID="gen30335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30336"/>et conteret vos ab introitu Emath usque ad torrentem deserti. <l eID="gen30336" level="1"/><lg eID="gen29993"/> <chapter eID="Amos.6"/>

verses.name: Amos 7:1
verses.text: Hæc ostendit mihi Dominus Deus : et ecce fictor locustæ in principio germinantium serotini imbris, et ecce serotinus post tonsionem regis.

verses.name: Amos 7:2
verses.text: Et factum est, cum consummasset comedere herbam terræ, dixi : Domine Deus, propitius esto, obsecro ; quis suscitabit Jacob, quia parvulus est ?

verses.name: Amos 7:3
verses.text: Misertus est Dominus super hoc : Non erit, dixit Dominus.

verses.name: Amos 7:4
verses.text: Hæc ostendit mihi Dominus Deus : et ecce vocabat judicium ad ignem Dominus Deus ; et devoravit abyssum multam, et comedit simul partem.

verses.name: Amos 7:5
verses.text: Et dixi : Domine Deus, quiesce, obsecro ; quis suscitabit Jacob, quia parvulus est ?

verses.name: Amos 7:6
verses.text: Misertus est Dominus super hoc : Sed et istud non erit, dixit Dominus Deus.

verses.name: Amos 7:7
verses.text: Hæc ostendit mihi Dominus : et ecce Dominus stans super murum litum, et in manu ejus trulla cæmentarii.

verses.name: Amos 7:8
verses.text: Et dixit Dominus ad me : Quid tu vides, Amos ? Et dixi : Trullam cæmentarii.
