verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11012"/><l level="1" sID="gen30875"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11012"/>Et custodisti præcepta Amri, <l eID="gen30875" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30876"/>et omne opus domus Achab, <l eID="gen30876" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30877"/>et ambulasti in voluntatibus eorum : <l eID="gen30877" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30878"/>ut darem te in perditionem, <l eID="gen30878" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30879"/>et habitantes in ea in sibilum, <l eID="gen30879" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30880"/>et opprobrium populi mei portabitis.  <chapter eID="Mic.6"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:1
verses.text: Væ mihi, quia factus sum sicut qui colligit in autumno racemos vindemiæ ! <l eID="gen30881" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30882"/>non est botrus ad comedendum, <l eID="gen30882" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30883"/>præcoquas ficus desideravit anima mea. <l eID="gen30883" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11013"/><l level="1" sID="gen30884"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11013"/>Periit sanctus de terra, <l eID="gen30884" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30885"/>et rectus in hominibus non est : <l eID="gen30885" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30886"/>omnes in sanguine insidiantur ; <l eID="gen30886" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30887"/>vir fratrem suum ad mortem venatur. <l eID="gen30887" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11014"/><l level="1" sID="gen30888"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11014"/>Malum manuum suarum dicunt bonum : <l eID="gen30888" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30889"/>princeps postulat, et judex in reddendo est ; <l eID="gen30889" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30890"/>et magnus locutus est desiderium animæ suæ, <l eID="gen30890" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30891"/>et conturbaverunt eam. <l eID="gen30891" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11015"/><l level="1" sID="gen30892"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11015"/>Qui optimus in eis est, quasi paliurus, <l eID="gen30892" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30893"/>et qui rectus, quasi spina de sepe. <l eID="gen30893" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30894"/>Dies speculationis tuæ, visitatio tua venit : <l eID="gen30894" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30895"/>nunc erit vastitas eorum. <l eID="gen30895" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11016"/><l level="1" sID="gen30896"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11016"/>Nolite credere amico, <l eID="gen30896" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30897"/>et nolite confidere in duce : <l eID="gen30897" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30898"/>ab ea quæ dormit in sinu tuo custodi claustra oris tui. <l eID="gen30898" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11017"/><l level="1" sID="gen30899"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11017"/>Quia filius contumeliam facit patri, <l eID="gen30899" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30900"/>et filia consurgit adversus matrem suam : <l eID="gen30900" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30901"/>nurus adversus socrum suam, <l eID="gen30901" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30902"/>et inimici hominis domestici ejus. <l eID="gen30902" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11018"/><l level="1" sID="gen30903"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11018"/>Ego autem ad Dominum aspiciam ; <l eID="gen30903" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30904"/>exspectabo Deum, salvatorem meum : <l eID="gen30904" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30905"/>audiet me Deus meus. <l eID="gen30905" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11019"/><l level="1" sID="gen30906"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11019"/>Ne læteris, inimica mea, super me, quia cecidi : <l eID="gen30906" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30907"/>consurgam cum sedero in tenebris : <l eID="gen30907" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30908"/>Dominus lux mea est. <l eID="gen30908" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11020"/><l level="1" sID="gen30909"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11020"/>Iram Domini portabo, <l eID="gen30909" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30910"/>quoniam peccavi ei, <l eID="gen30910" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30911"/>donec causam meam judicet, <l eID="gen30911" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30912"/>et faciat judicium meum. <l eID="gen30912" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30913"/>Educet me in lucem : <l eID="gen30913" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30914"/>videbo justitiam ejus. <l eID="gen30914" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11021"/><l level="1" sID="gen30915"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11021"/>Et aspiciet inimica mea, <l eID="gen30915" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30916"/>et operietur confusione, <l eID="gen30916" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30917"/>quæ dicit ad me : Ubi est Dominus Deus tuus ? <l eID="gen30917" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30918"/>Oculi mei videbunt in eam : <l eID="gen30918" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30919"/>nunc erit in conculcationem ut lutum platearum. <l eID="gen30919" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11022"/><l level="1" sID="gen30920"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11022"/>Dies, ut ædificentur maceriæ tuæ ; <l eID="gen30920" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30921"/>in die illa longe fiet lex. <l eID="gen30921" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11023"/><l level="1" sID="gen30922"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11023"/>In die illa et usque ad te veniet de Assur, <l eID="gen30922" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30923"/>et usque ad civitates munitas, <l eID="gen30923" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30924"/>et a civitatibus munitis usque ad flumen, <l eID="gen30924" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30925"/>et ad mare de mari, <l eID="gen30925" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30926"/>et ad montem de monte. <l eID="gen30926" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11024"/><l level="1" sID="gen30927"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11024"/>Et terra erit in desolationem propter habitatores suos, <l eID="gen30927" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30928"/>et propter fructum cogitationum eorum. <l eID="gen30928" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11025"/><l level="1" sID="gen30929"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11025"/>Pasce populum tuum in virga tua, <l eID="gen30929" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30930"/>gregem hæreditatis tuæ, habitantes solos, in saltu, in medio Carmeli. <l eID="gen30930" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30931"/>Pascentur Basan et Galaad juxta dies antiquos. <l eID="gen30931" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11026"/><l level="1" sID="gen30932"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11026"/>Secundum dies egressionis tuæ de terra Ægypti, <l eID="gen30932" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30933"/>ostendam ei mirabilia. <l eID="gen30933" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11027"/><l level="1" sID="gen30934"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11027"/>Videbunt gentes, <l eID="gen30934" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30935"/>et confundentur super omni fortitudine sua. <l eID="gen30935" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30936"/>Ponent manum super os, <l eID="gen30936" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30937"/>aures eorum surdæ erunt. <l eID="gen30937" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11028"/><l level="1" sID="gen30938"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11028"/>Lingent pulverem sicut serpentes ; <l eID="gen30938" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30939"/>velut reptilia terræ perturbabuntur in ædibus suis. <l eID="gen30939" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30940"/>Dominum Deum nostrum formidabunt, <l eID="gen30940" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30941"/>et timebunt te. <l eID="gen30941" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11029"/><l level="1" sID="gen30942"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11029"/>Quis, Deus, similis tui, <l eID="gen30942" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30943"/>qui aufers iniquitatem, <l eID="gen30943" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30944"/>et transis peccatum reliquiarum hæreditatis tuæ ? <l eID="gen30944" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30945"/>Non immittet ultra furorem suum, <l eID="gen30945" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30946"/>quoniam volens misericordiam est. <l eID="gen30946" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11030"/><l level="1" sID="gen30947"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11030"/>Revertetur, et miserebitur nostri ; <l eID="gen30947" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30948"/>deponet iniquitates nostras, <l eID="gen30948" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30949"/>et projiciet in profundum maris omnia peccata nostra. <l eID="gen30949" level="1"/>

verses.name: Micah 7:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11031"/><l level="1" sID="gen30950"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11031"/>Dabis veritatem Jacob, <l eID="gen30950" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30951"/>misericordiam Abraham, <l eID="gen30951" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30952"/>quæ jurasti patribus nostris a diebus antiquis. <l eID="gen30952" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen30578"/> <chapter eID="Mic.7"/> <div eID="gen30576" osisID="Mic" type="book"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:1
verses.text: Onus Ninive. Liber visionis Nahum Elcesæi.  <div eID="gen30954" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11032"/><lg sID="gen30955"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30956"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11032"/>Deus æmulator, et ulciscens Dominus : <l eID="gen30956" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30957"/>ulciscens Dominus, et habens furorem : <l eID="gen30957" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30958"/>ulciscens Dominus in hostes suos, <l eID="gen30958" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30959"/>et irascens ipse inimicis suis. <l eID="gen30959" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11033"/><l level="1" sID="gen30960"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11033"/>Dominus patiens, et magnus fortitudine, <l eID="gen30960" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30961"/>et mundans non faciet innocentem. <l eID="gen30961" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30962"/>Dominus in tempestate et turbine viæ ejus, <l eID="gen30962" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30963"/>et nebulæ pulvis pedum ejus. <l eID="gen30963" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11034"/><l level="1" sID="gen30964"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11034"/>Increpans mare, et exsiccans illud, <l eID="gen30964" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30965"/>et omnia flumina ad desertum deducens. <l eID="gen30965" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30966"/>Infirmatus est Basan et Carmelus, <l eID="gen30966" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30967"/>et flos Libani elanguit. <l eID="gen30967" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11035"/><l level="1" sID="gen30968"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11035"/>Montes commoti sunt ab eo, <l eID="gen30968" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30969"/>et colles desolati sunt : <l eID="gen30969" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30970"/>et contremuit terra a facie ejus, <l eID="gen30970" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30971"/>et orbis, et omnes habitantes in eo. <l eID="gen30971" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11036"/><l level="1" sID="gen30972"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11036"/>Ante faciem indignationis ejus quis stabit ? <l eID="gen30972" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30973"/>et quis resistet in ira furoris ejus ? <l eID="gen30973" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30974"/>Indignatio ejus effusa est ut ignis, <l eID="gen30974" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30975"/>et petræ dissolutæ sunt ab eo. <l eID="gen30975" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11037"/><l level="1" sID="gen30976"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11037"/>Bonus Dominus, <l eID="gen30976" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30977"/>et confortans in die tribulationis, <l eID="gen30977" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30978"/>et sciens sperantes in se. <l eID="gen30978" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11038"/><l level="1" sID="gen30979"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11038"/>Et in diluvio prætereunte consummationem faciet loci ejus, <l eID="gen30979" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30980"/>et inimicos ejus persequentur tenebræ. <l eID="gen30980" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11039"/><l level="1" sID="gen30981"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11039"/>Quid cogitatis contra Dominum ? <l eID="gen30981" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30982"/>Consummationem ipse faciet : <l eID="gen30982" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30983"/>non consurget duplex tribulatio, <l eID="gen30983" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11040"/><l level="1" sID="gen30984"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11040"/>quia sicut spinæ se invicem complectuntur, <l eID="gen30984" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30985"/>sic convivium eorum pariter potantium ; <l eID="gen30985" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30986"/>consumentur quasi stipula ariditate plena. <l eID="gen30986" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11041"/><l level="1" sID="gen30987"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11041"/>Ex te exibit cogitans contra Dominum malitiam, <l eID="gen30987" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30988"/>mente pertractans prævaricationem. <l eID="gen30988" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11042"/><l level="1" sID="gen30989"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11042"/>Hæc dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen30989" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30990"/>Si perfecti fuerint, et ita plures, <l eID="gen30990" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30991"/>sic quoque attondentur, et pertransibit : <l eID="gen30991" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30992"/>afflixi te, et non affligam te ultra. <l eID="gen30992" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11043"/><l level="1" sID="gen30993"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11043"/>Et nunc conteram virgam ejus de dorso tuo, <l eID="gen30993" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30994"/>et vincula tua disrumpam. <l eID="gen30994" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11044"/><l level="1" sID="gen30995"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11044"/>Et præcipiet super te Dominus ; <l eID="gen30995" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30996"/>non seminabitur ex nomine tuo amplius : <l eID="gen30996" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30997"/>de domo Dei tui interficiam sculptile, et conflatile ; <l eID="gen30997" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen30998"/>ponam sepulchrum tuum, quia inhonoratus es. <l eID="gen30998" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11045"/><l level="1" sID="gen30999"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11045"/>Ecce super montes pedes evangelizantis, <l eID="gen30999" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31000"/>et annuntiantis pacem. <l eID="gen31000" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31001"/>Celebra, Juda, festivitates tuas, <l eID="gen31001" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31002"/>et redde vota tua, <l eID="gen31002" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31003"/>quia non adjiciet ultra ut pertranseat in te Belial : <l eID="gen31003" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31004"/>universus interiit.  <chapter eID="Nah.1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:1
verses.text: Ascendit qui dispergat coram te, <l eID="gen31005" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31006"/>qui custodiat obsidionem : <l eID="gen31006" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31007"/>contemplare viam, conforta lumbos, <l eID="gen31007" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31008"/>robora virtutem valde. <l eID="gen31008" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11046"/><l level="1" sID="gen31009"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11046"/>Quia reddidit Dominus superbiam Jacob, <l eID="gen31009" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31010"/>sicut superbiam Israël ; <l eID="gen31010" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31011"/>quia vastatores dissipaverunt eos, <l eID="gen31011" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31012"/>et propagines eorum corruperunt. <l eID="gen31012" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11047"/><l level="1" sID="gen31013"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11047"/>Clypeus fortium ejus ignitus, <l eID="gen31013" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31014"/>viri exercitus in coccineis ; <l eID="gen31014" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31015"/>igneæ habenæ currus in die præparationis ejus, <l eID="gen31015" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31016"/>et agitatores consopiti sunt. <l eID="gen31016" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11048"/><l level="1" sID="gen31017"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11048"/>In itineribus conturbati sunt ; <l eID="gen31017" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31018"/>quadrigæ collisæ sunt in plateis : <l eID="gen31018" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31019"/>aspectus eorum quasi lampades, <l eID="gen31019" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31020"/>quasi fulgura discurrentia. <l eID="gen31020" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11049"/><l level="1" sID="gen31021"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11049"/>Recordabitur fortium suorum ; <l eID="gen31021" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31022"/>ruent in itineribus suis : <l eID="gen31022" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31023"/>velociter ascendent muros ejus, <l eID="gen31023" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31024"/>et præparabitur umbraculum. <l eID="gen31024" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11050"/><l level="1" sID="gen31025"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11050"/>Portæ fluviorum apertæ sunt, <l eID="gen31025" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31026"/>et templum ad solum dirutum. <l eID="gen31026" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11051"/><l level="1" sID="gen31027"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11051"/>Et miles captivus abductus est, <l eID="gen31027" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31028"/>et ancillæ ejus minabantur gementes ut columbæ, <l eID="gen31028" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31029"/>murmurantes in cordibus suis. <l eID="gen31029" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11052"/><l level="1" sID="gen31030"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11052"/>Et Ninive quasi piscina aquarum aquæ ejus ; <l eID="gen31030" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31031"/>ipsi vero fugerunt. State, state ! <l eID="gen31031" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31032"/>et non est qui revertatur. <l eID="gen31032" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11053"/><l level="1" sID="gen31033"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11053"/>Diripite argentum, diripite aurum : <l eID="gen31033" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31034"/>et non est finis divitiarum ex omnibus vasis desiderabilibus. <l eID="gen31034" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11054"/><l level="1" sID="gen31035"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11054"/>Dissipata est, et scissa, et dilacerata ; <l eID="gen31035" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31036"/>et cor tabescens, et dissolutio geniculorum, <l eID="gen31036" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31037"/>et defectio in cunctis renibus, <l eID="gen31037" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31038"/>et facies omnium eorum sicut nigredo ollæ. <l eID="gen31038" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11055"/><l level="1" sID="gen31039"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11055"/>Ubi est habitaculum leonum, <l eID="gen31039" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31040"/>et pascua catulorum leonum, <l eID="gen31040" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31041"/>ad quam ivit leo ut ingrederetur illuc catulus leonis, <l eID="gen31041" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31042"/>et non est qui exterreat ? <l eID="gen31042" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11056"/><l level="1" sID="gen31043"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11056"/>Leo cepit sufficienter catulis suis, <l eID="gen31043" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31044"/>et necavit leænis suis, <l eID="gen31044" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31045"/>et implevit præda speluncas suas, <l eID="gen31045" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31046"/>et cubile suum rapina. <l eID="gen31046" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11057"/><l level="1" sID="gen31047"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11057"/>Ecce ego ad te, dicit Dominus exercituum, <l eID="gen31047" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31048"/>et succendam usque ad fumum quadrigas tuas, <l eID="gen31048" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31049"/>et leunculos tuos comedet gladius, <l eID="gen31049" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31050"/>et exterminabo de terra prædam tuam, <l eID="gen31050" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31051"/>et non audietur ultra vox nuntiorum tuorum.  <chapter eID="Nah.2"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:1
verses.text: Væ civitas sanguinum, <l eID="gen31052" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31053"/>universa mendacii dilaceratione plena ! <l eID="gen31053" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31054"/>non recedet a te rapina. <l eID="gen31054" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11058"/><l level="1" sID="gen31055"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11058"/>Vox flagelli, et vox impetus rotæ, et equi frementis, <l eID="gen31055" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31056"/>et quadrigæ ferventis, et equitis ascendentis, <l eID="gen31056" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11059"/><l level="1" sID="gen31057"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11059"/>et micantis gladii, et fulgurantis hastæ, <l eID="gen31057" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31058"/>et multitudinis interfectæ, et gravis ruinæ ; <l eID="gen31058" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31059"/>nec est finis cadaverum, <l eID="gen31059" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31060"/>et corruent in corporibus suis. <l eID="gen31060" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11060"/><l level="1" sID="gen31061"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11060"/>Propter multitudinem fornicationum meretricis <l eID="gen31061" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31062"/>speciosæ, et gratæ, et habentis maleficia, <l eID="gen31062" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31063"/>quæ vendidit gentes in fornicationibus suis, <l eID="gen31063" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31064"/>et familias in maleficiis suis. <l eID="gen31064" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11061"/><l level="1" sID="gen31065"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11061"/>Ecce ego ad te, dicit Dominus exercituum, <l eID="gen31065" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31066"/>et revelabo pudenda tua in facie tua ; <l eID="gen31066" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31067"/>et ostendam gentibus nuditatem tuam, <l eID="gen31067" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31068"/>et regnis ignominiam tuam. <l eID="gen31068" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11062"/><l level="1" sID="gen31069"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11062"/>Et projiciam super te abominationes, <l eID="gen31069" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31070"/>et contumeliis te afficiam, <l eID="gen31070" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31071"/>et ponam te in exemplum. <l eID="gen31071" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11063"/><l level="1" sID="gen31072"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11063"/>Et erit : omnis qui viderit te resiliet a te, <l eID="gen31072" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31073"/>et dicet : Vastata est Ninive. <l eID="gen31073" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31074"/>Quis commovebit super te caput ? <l eID="gen31074" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31075"/>unde quæram consolatorem tibi ? <l eID="gen31075" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11064"/><l level="1" sID="gen31076"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11064"/>Numquid melior es Alexandria populorum, <l eID="gen31076" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31077"/>quæ habitat in fluminibus ? <l eID="gen31077" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31078"/>aquæ in circuitu ejus ; <l eID="gen31078" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31079"/>cujus divitiæ, mare ; <l eID="gen31079" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31080"/>aquæ, muri ejus. <l eID="gen31080" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11065"/><l level="1" sID="gen31081"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11065"/>Æthiopia fortitudo ejus, et Ægyptus, et non est finis ; <l eID="gen31081" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31082"/>Africa et Libyes fuerunt in auxilio tuo. <l eID="gen31082" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11066"/><l level="1" sID="gen31083"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11066"/>Sed et ipsa in transmigrationem ducta est in captivitatem : <l eID="gen31083" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31084"/>parvuli ejus elisi sunt in capite omnium viarum, <l eID="gen31084" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31085"/>et super inclytos ejus miserunt sortem, <l eID="gen31085" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31086"/>et omnes optimates ejus confixi sunt in compedibus. <l eID="gen31086" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11067"/><l level="1" sID="gen31087"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11067"/>Et tu ergo inebriaberis, et eris despecta : <l eID="gen31087" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31088"/>et tu quæres auxilium ab inimico. <l eID="gen31088" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11068"/><l level="1" sID="gen31089"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11068"/>Omnes munitiones tuæ sicut ficus cum grossis suis : <l eID="gen31089" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31090"/>si concussæ fuerint, cadent in os comedentis. <l eID="gen31090" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11069"/><l level="1" sID="gen31091"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11069"/>Ecce populus tuus mulieres in medio tui : <l eID="gen31091" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31092"/>inimicis tuis adapertione pandentur portæ terræ tuæ, <l eID="gen31092" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31093"/>devorabit ignis vectes tuos. <l eID="gen31093" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11070"/><l level="1" sID="gen31094"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11070"/>Aquam propter obsidionem hauri tibi : <l eID="gen31094" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31095"/>exstrue munitiones tuas, <l eID="gen31095" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31096"/>intra in lutum, et calca, <l eID="gen31096" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31097"/>subigens tene laterem. <l eID="gen31097" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11071"/><l level="1" sID="gen31098"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11071"/>Ibi comedet te ignis, <l eID="gen31098" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31099"/>peribis gladio, devorabit te ut bruchus : <l eID="gen31099" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31100"/>congregare ut bruchus, <l eID="gen31100" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31101"/>multiplicare ut locusta. <l eID="gen31101" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11072"/><l level="1" sID="gen31102"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11072"/>Plures fecisti negotiationes tuas quam stellæ sint cæli ; <l eID="gen31102" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31103"/>bruchus expansus est, et avolavit. <l eID="gen31103" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11073"/><l level="1" sID="gen31104"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11073"/>Custodes tui quasi locustæ, <l eID="gen31104" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31105"/>et parvuli tui quasi locustæ locustarum, <l eID="gen31105" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31106"/>quæ considunt in sepibus in die frigoris : <l eID="gen31106" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31107"/>sol ortus est, et avolaverunt, <l eID="gen31107" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31108"/>et non est cognitus locus earum ubi fuerint. <l eID="gen31108" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11074"/><l level="1" sID="gen31109"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11074"/>Dormitaverunt pastores tui, rex Assur, <l eID="gen31109" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31110"/>sepelientur principes tui : <l eID="gen31110" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31111"/>latitavit populus tuus in montibus, <l eID="gen31111" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31112"/>et non est qui congreget. <l eID="gen31112" level="1"/>

verses.name: Nahum 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11075"/><l level="1" sID="gen31113"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11075"/>Non est obscura contritio tua ; <l eID="gen31113" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31114"/>pessima est plaga tua. <l eID="gen31114" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31115"/>Omnes qui audierunt auditionem tuam compresserunt manum super te : <l eID="gen31115" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31116"/>quia super quem non transiit malitia tua semper ? <l eID="gen31116" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen30955"/> <chapter eID="Nah.3"/> <div eID="gen30953" osisID="Nah" type="book"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:1
verses.text: Onus quod vidit Habacuc propheta.  <div eID="gen31118" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11076"/><lg sID="gen31119"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31120"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11076"/>Usquequo, Domine, clamabo, <l eID="gen31120" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31121"/>et non exaudies ? <l eID="gen31121" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31122"/>vociferabor ad te, vim patiens, <l eID="gen31122" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31123"/>et non salvabis ? <l eID="gen31123" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11077"/><l level="1" sID="gen31124"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11077"/>Quare ostendisti mihi iniquitatem et laborem, <l eID="gen31124" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31125"/>videre prædam et injustitiam contra me ? <l eID="gen31125" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31126"/>Et factum est judicium, et contradictio potentior. <l eID="gen31126" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11078"/><l level="1" sID="gen31127"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11078"/>Propter hoc lacerata est lex, <l eID="gen31127" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31128"/>et non pervenit usque ad finem judicium ; <l eID="gen31128" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31129"/>quia impius prævalet adversus justum, <l eID="gen31129" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31130"/>propterea egreditur judicium perversum. <l eID="gen31130" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11079"/><l level="1" sID="gen31131"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11079"/>Aspicite in gentibus, et videte ; <l eID="gen31131" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31132"/>admiramini, et obstupescite : <l eID="gen31132" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31133"/>quia opus factum est in diebus vestris, <l eID="gen31133" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31134"/>quod nemo credet cum narrabitur. <l eID="gen31134" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11080"/><l level="1" sID="gen31135"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11080"/>Quia ecce ego suscitabo Chaldæos, <l eID="gen31135" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31136"/>gentem amaram et velocem, <l eID="gen31136" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31137"/>ambulantem super latitudinem terræ, <l eID="gen31137" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31138"/>ut possideat tabernacula non sua. <l eID="gen31138" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11081"/><l level="1" sID="gen31139"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11081"/>Horribilis et terribilis est : <l eID="gen31139" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31140"/>ex semetipsa judicium et onus ejus egredietur. <l eID="gen31140" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11082"/><l level="1" sID="gen31141"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11082"/>Leviores pardis equi ejus, <l eID="gen31141" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31142"/>et velociores lupis vespertinis : <l eID="gen31142" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31143"/>et diffundentur equites ejus : <l eID="gen31143" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31144"/>equites namque ejus de longe venient ; <l eID="gen31144" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31145"/>volabunt quasi aquila festinans ad comedendum. <l eID="gen31145" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11083"/><l level="1" sID="gen31146"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11083"/>Omnes ad prædam venient, <l eID="gen31146" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31147"/>facies eorum ventus urens ; <l eID="gen31147" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31148"/>et congregabit quasi arenam captivitatem. <l eID="gen31148" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11084"/><l level="1" sID="gen31149"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11084"/>Et ipse de regibus triumphabit, <l eID="gen31149" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31150"/>et tyranni ridiculi ejus erunt ; <l eID="gen31150" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31151"/>ipse super omnem munitionem ridebit, <l eID="gen31151" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31152"/>et comportabit aggerem, et capiet eam. <l eID="gen31152" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11085"/><l level="1" sID="gen31153"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11085"/>Tunc mutabitur spiritus, et pertransibit, et corruet : <l eID="gen31153" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31154"/>hæc est fortitudo ejus dei sui. <l eID="gen31154" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11086"/><l level="1" sID="gen31155"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11086"/>Numquid non tu a principio, <l eID="gen31155" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31156"/>Domine, Deus meus, sancte meus, <l eID="gen31156" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31157"/>et non moriemur ? <l eID="gen31157" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31158"/>Domine, in judicium posuisti eum, <l eID="gen31158" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31159"/>et fortem, ut corriperes, fundasti eum. <l eID="gen31159" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11087"/><l level="1" sID="gen31160"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11087"/>Mundi sunt oculi tui, ne videas malum, <l eID="gen31160" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31161"/>et respicere ad iniquitatem non poteris. <l eID="gen31161" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31162"/>Quare respicis super iniqua agentes, <l eID="gen31162" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31163"/>et taces devorante impio justiorem se ? <l eID="gen31163" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11088"/><l level="1" sID="gen31164"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11088"/>Et facies homines quasi pisces maris, <l eID="gen31164" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31165"/>et quasi reptile non habens principem. <l eID="gen31165" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11089"/><l level="1" sID="gen31166"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11089"/>Totum in hamo sublevavit, <l eID="gen31166" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31167"/>traxit illud in sagena sua, <l eID="gen31167" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31168"/>et congregavit in rete suum. <l eID="gen31168" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31169"/>Super hoc lætabitur, et exsultabit. <l eID="gen31169" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11090"/><l level="1" sID="gen31170"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11090"/>Propterea immolabit sagenæ suæ, <l eID="gen31170" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31171"/>et sacrificabit reti suo, <l eID="gen31171" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31172"/>quia in ipsis incrassata est pars ejus, <l eID="gen31172" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31173"/>et cibus ejus electus. <l eID="gen31173" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11091"/><l level="1" sID="gen31174"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11091"/>Propter hoc ergo expandit sagenam suam, <l eID="gen31174" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31175"/>et semper interficere gentes non parcet.  <chapter eID="Hab.1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:1
verses.text: Super custodiam meam stabo, <l eID="gen31176" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31177"/>et figam gradum super munitionem : <l eID="gen31177" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31178"/>et contemplabor ut videam quid dicatur mihi, <l eID="gen31178" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31179"/>et quid respondeam ad arguentem me. <l eID="gen31179" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen31119"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11092"/><div sID="gen31180" type="x-p"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11092"/>Et respondit mihi Dominus, et dixit : <div eID="gen31180" type="x-p"/> <lg sID="gen31181"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31182"/>Scribe visum, et explana eum super tabulas, <l eID="gen31182" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31183"/>ut percurrat qui legerit eum. <l eID="gen31183" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11093"/><l level="1" sID="gen31184"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11093"/>Quia adhuc visus procul ; <l eID="gen31184" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31185"/>et apparebit in finem, et non mentietur : <l eID="gen31185" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31186"/>si moram fecerit, exspecta illum, <l eID="gen31186" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31187"/>quia veniens veniet, et non tardabit. <l eID="gen31187" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11094"/><l level="1" sID="gen31188"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11094"/>Ecce qui incredulus est, non erit recta anima ejus in semetipso ; <l eID="gen31188" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31189"/>justus autem in fide sua vivet. <l eID="gen31189" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11095"/><l level="1" sID="gen31190"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11095"/>Et quomodo vinum potantem decipit, <l eID="gen31190" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31191"/>sic erit vir superbus, et non decorabitur : <l eID="gen31191" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31192"/>qui dilatavit quasi infernus animam suam, <l eID="gen31192" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31193"/>et ipse quasi mors, et non adimpletur : <l eID="gen31193" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31194"/>et congregabit ad se omnes gentes, <l eID="gen31194" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31195"/>et coacervabit ad se omnes populos. <l eID="gen31195" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11096"/><l level="1" sID="gen31196"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11096"/>Numquid non omnes isti super eum parabolam sument, <l eID="gen31196" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31197"/>et loquelam ænigmatum ejus, et dicetur : <l eID="gen31197" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31198"/>Væ ei qui multiplicat non sua ? <l eID="gen31198" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31199"/>usquequo et aggravat contra se densum lutum ? <l eID="gen31199" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11097"/><l level="1" sID="gen31200"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11097"/>Numquid non repente consurgent qui mordeant te, <l eID="gen31200" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31201"/>et suscitabuntur lacerantes te, <l eID="gen31201" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31202"/>et eris in rapinam eis ? <l eID="gen31202" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11098"/><l level="1" sID="gen31203"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11098"/>Quia tu spoliasti gentes multas, <l eID="gen31203" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31204"/>spoliabunt te omnes qui reliqui fuerint de populis, <l eID="gen31204" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31205"/>propter sanguinem hominis, <l eID="gen31205" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31206"/>et iniquitatem terræ, civitatis, et omnium habitantium in ea. <l eID="gen31206" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11099"/><l level="1" sID="gen31207"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11099"/>Væ qui congregat avaritiam malam domui suæ, <l eID="gen31207" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31208"/>ut sit in excelso nidus ejus, <l eID="gen31208" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31209"/>et liberari se putat de manu mali ! <l eID="gen31209" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11100"/><l level="1" sID="gen31210"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11100"/>Cogitasti confusionem domui tuæ ; <l eID="gen31210" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31211"/>concidisti populos multos, <l eID="gen31211" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31212"/>et peccavit anima tua. <l eID="gen31212" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11101"/><l level="1" sID="gen31213"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11101"/>Quia lapis de pariete clamabit, <l eID="gen31213" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31214"/>et lignum, quod inter juncturas ædificiorum est, respondebit. <l eID="gen31214" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11102"/><l level="1" sID="gen31215"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11102"/>Væ qui ædificat civitatem in sanguinibus, <l eID="gen31215" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31216"/>et præparat urbem in iniquitate ! <l eID="gen31216" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11103"/><l level="1" sID="gen31217"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11103"/>Numquid non hæc sunt a Domino exercituum ? <l eID="gen31217" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31218"/>laborabunt enim populi in multo igne, <l eID="gen31218" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31219"/>et gentes in vacuum, et deficient. <l eID="gen31219" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11104"/><l level="1" sID="gen31220"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11104"/>Quia replebitur terra, ut cognoscant gloriam Domini, <l eID="gen31220" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31221"/>quasi aquæ operientes mare. <l eID="gen31221" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11105"/><l level="1" sID="gen31222"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11105"/>Væ qui potum dat amico suo mittens fel suum, <l eID="gen31222" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31223"/>et inebrians ut aspiciat nuditatem ejus ! <l eID="gen31223" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11106"/><l level="1" sID="gen31224"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11106"/>Repletus es ignominia pro gloria ; <l eID="gen31224" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31225"/>bibe tu quoque, et consopire. <l eID="gen31225" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31226"/>Circumdabit te calix dexteræ Domini, <l eID="gen31226" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31227"/>et vomitus ignominiæ super gloriam tuam. <l eID="gen31227" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11107"/><l level="1" sID="gen31228"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11107"/>Quia iniquitas Libani operiet te, <l eID="gen31228" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31229"/>et vastitas animalium deterrebit eos <l eID="gen31229" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31230"/>de sanguinibus hominum, <l eID="gen31230" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31231"/>et iniquitate terræ, et civitatis, et omnium habitantium in ea. <l eID="gen31231" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11108"/><l level="1" sID="gen31232"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11108"/>Quid prodest sculptile, quia sculpsit illud fictor suus, <l eID="gen31232" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31233"/>conflatile, et imaginem falsam ? <l eID="gen31233" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31234"/>quia speravit in figmento fictor ejus, ut faceret simulacra muta. <l eID="gen31234" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11109"/><l level="1" sID="gen31235"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11109"/>Væ qui dicit ligno : Expergiscere ; <l eID="gen31235" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31236"/>Surge, lapidi tacenti ! <l eID="gen31236" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31237"/>Numquid ipse docere poterit ? <l eID="gen31237" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31238"/>ecce iste coopertus est auro et argento, <l eID="gen31238" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31239"/>et omnis spiritus non est in visceribus ejus. <l eID="gen31239" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 2:20
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11110"/><l level="1" sID="gen31240"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11110"/>Dominus autem in templo sancto suo : <l eID="gen31240" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31241"/>sileat a facie ejus omnis terra ! <l eID="gen31241" level="1"/><lg eID="gen31181"/> <chapter eID="Hab.2"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:1
verses.text: Oratio Habacuc prophetæ, pro ignorantiis.  <div eID="gen31242" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11111"/><lg sID="gen31243"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31244"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11111"/>Domine, audivi auditionem tuam, et timui. <l eID="gen31244" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31245"/>Domine, opus tuum, in medio annorum vivifica illud ; <l eID="gen31245" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31246"/>in medio annorum notum facies : <l eID="gen31246" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31247"/>cum iratus fueris, misericordiæ recordaberis. <l eID="gen31247" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11112"/><l level="1" sID="gen31248"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11112"/>Deus ab austro veniet, <l eID="gen31248" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31249"/>et Sanctus de monte Pharan : <l eID="gen31249" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31250"/>operuit cælos gloria ejus, <l eID="gen31250" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31251"/>et laudis ejus plena est terra. <l eID="gen31251" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11113"/><l level="1" sID="gen31252"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11113"/>Splendor ejus ut lux erit, <l eID="gen31252" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31253"/>cornua in manibus ejus : <l eID="gen31253" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31254"/>ibi abscondita est fortitudo ejus. <l eID="gen31254" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11114"/><l level="1" sID="gen31255"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11114"/>Ante faciem ejus ibit mors, <l eID="gen31255" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31256"/>et egredietur diabolus ante pedes ejus. <l eID="gen31256" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11115"/><l level="1" sID="gen31257"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11115"/>Stetit, et mensus est terram ; <l eID="gen31257" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31258"/>aspexit, et dissolvit gentes, <l eID="gen31258" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31259"/>et contriti sunt montes sæculi : <l eID="gen31259" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31260"/>incurvati sunt colles mundi ab itineribus æternitatis ejus. <l eID="gen31260" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11116"/><l level="1" sID="gen31261"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11116"/>Pro iniquitate vidi tentoria Æthiopiæ ; <l eID="gen31261" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31262"/>turbabuntur pelles terræ Madian. <l eID="gen31262" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11117"/><l level="1" sID="gen31263"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11117"/>Numquid in fluminibus iratus es, Domine ? <l eID="gen31263" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31264"/>aut in fluminibus furor tuus ? <l eID="gen31264" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31265"/>vel in mari indignatio tua ? <l eID="gen31265" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31266"/>Qui ascendes super equos tuos, et quadrigæ tuæ salvatio. <l eID="gen31266" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11118"/><l level="1" sID="gen31267"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11118"/>Suscitans suscitabis arcum tuum, <l eID="gen31267" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31268"/>juramenta tribubus quæ locutus es ; <l eID="gen31268" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31269"/>fluvios scindes terræ. <l eID="gen31269" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11119"/><l level="1" sID="gen31270"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11119"/>Viderunt te, et doluerunt montes ; <l eID="gen31270" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31271"/>gurges aquarum transiit : <l eID="gen31271" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31272"/>dedit abyssus vocem suam ; <l eID="gen31272" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31273"/>altitudo manus suas levavit. <l eID="gen31273" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11120"/><l level="1" sID="gen31274"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11120"/>Sol et luna steterunt in habitaculo suo : <l eID="gen31274" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31275"/>in luce sagittarum tuarum ibunt, <l eID="gen31275" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31276"/>in splendore fulgurantis hastæ tuæ. <l eID="gen31276" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11121"/><l level="1" sID="gen31277"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11121"/>In fremitu conculcabis terram ; <l eID="gen31277" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31278"/>in furore obstupefacies gentes. <l eID="gen31278" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11122"/><l level="1" sID="gen31279"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11122"/>Egressus es in salutem populi tui, <l eID="gen31279" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31280"/>in salutem cum christo tuo : <l eID="gen31280" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31281"/>percussisti caput de domo impii, <l eID="gen31281" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31282"/>denudasti fundamentum ejus usque ad collum. <l eID="gen31282" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11123"/><l level="1" sID="gen31283"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11123"/>Maledixisti sceptris ejus, <l eID="gen31283" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31284"/>capiti bellatorum ejus, <l eID="gen31284" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31285"/>venientibus ut turbo ad dispergendum me : <l eID="gen31285" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31286"/>exsultatio eorum, sicut ejus qui devorat pauperem in abscondito. <l eID="gen31286" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11124"/><l level="1" sID="gen31287"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11124"/>Viam fecisti in mari equis tuis, <l eID="gen31287" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31288"/>in luto aquarum multarum. <l eID="gen31288" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11125"/><l level="1" sID="gen31289"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11125"/>Audivi, et conturbatus est venter meus ; <l eID="gen31289" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31290"/>a voce contremuerunt labia mea. <l eID="gen31290" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31291"/>Ingrediatur putredo in ossibus meis, <l eID="gen31291" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31292"/>et subter me scateat : <l eID="gen31292" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31293"/>ut requiescam in die tribulationis, <l eID="gen31293" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31294"/>ut ascendam ad populum accinctum nostrum. <l eID="gen31294" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11126"/><l level="1" sID="gen31295"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11126"/>Ficus enim non florebit, <l eID="gen31295" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31296"/>et non erit germen in vineis ; <l eID="gen31296" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31297"/>mentietur opus olivæ, <l eID="gen31297" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31298"/>et arva non afferent cibum : <l eID="gen31298" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31299"/>abscindetur de ovili pecus, <l eID="gen31299" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31300"/>et non erit armentum in præsepibus. <l eID="gen31300" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11127"/><l level="1" sID="gen31301"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11127"/>Ego autem in Domino gaudebo ; <l eID="gen31301" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31302"/>et exsultabo in Deo Jesu meo. <l eID="gen31302" level="1"/>

verses.name: Habakkuk 3:19
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11128"/><l level="1" sID="gen31303"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11128"/>Deus Dominus fortitudo mea, <l eID="gen31303" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31304"/>et ponet pedes meos quasi cervorum : <l eID="gen31304" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31305"/>et super excelsa mea deducet me <l eID="gen31305" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31306"/>victor in psalmis canentem. <l eID="gen31306" level="1"/> <lg eID="gen31243"/> <chapter eID="Hab.3"/> <div eID="gen31117" osisID="Hab" type="book"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:1
verses.text: Verbum Domini quod factum est ad Sophoniam, filium Chusi, filii Godoliæ, filii Amariæ, filii Ezeciæ, in diebus Josiæ, filii Amon, regis Judæ.  <div eID="gen31308" type="x-p"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11129"/><lg sID="gen31309"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31310"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11129"/>Congregans congregabo omnia a facie terræ, dicit Dominus : <l eID="gen31310" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11130"/><l level="1" sID="gen31311"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11130"/>congregans hominem et pecus, <l eID="gen31311" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31312"/>congregans volatilia cæli et pisces maris : <l eID="gen31312" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31313"/>et ruinæ impiorum erunt, <l eID="gen31313" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31314"/>et disperdam homines a facie terræ, dicit Dominus. <l eID="gen31314" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11131"/><l level="1" sID="gen31315"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11131"/>Et extendam manum meam super Judam <l eID="gen31315" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31316"/>et super omnes habitantes Jerusalem : <l eID="gen31316" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31317"/>et disperdam de loco hoc reliquias Baal, <l eID="gen31317" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31318"/>et nomina ædituorum cum sacerdotibus ; <l eID="gen31318" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11132"/><l level="1" sID="gen31319"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11132"/>et eos qui adorant super tecta militiam cæli, <l eID="gen31319" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31320"/>et adorant et jurant in Domino, <l eID="gen31320" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31321"/>et jurant in Melchom ; <l eID="gen31321" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11133"/><l level="1" sID="gen31322"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11133"/>et qui avertuntur de post tergum Domini, <l eID="gen31322" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31323"/>et qui non quæsierunt Dominum, <l eID="gen31323" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31324"/>nec investigaverunt eum. <l eID="gen31324" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11134"/><l level="1" sID="gen31325"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11134"/>Silete a facie Domini Dei, <l eID="gen31325" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31326"/>quia juxta est dies Domini : <l eID="gen31326" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31327"/>quia præparavit Dominus hostiam ; <l eID="gen31327" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31328"/>sanctificavit vocatos suos. <l eID="gen31328" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11135"/><l level="1" sID="gen31329"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11135"/>Et erit : in die hostiæ Domini, <l eID="gen31329" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31330"/>visitabo super principes, <l eID="gen31330" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31331"/>et super filios regis, <l eID="gen31331" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31332"/>et super omnes qui induti sunt veste peregrina ; <l eID="gen31332" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11136"/><l level="1" sID="gen31333"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11136"/>et visitabo super omnem qui arroganter ingreditur super limen in die illa, <l eID="gen31333" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31334"/>qui complent domum Domini Dei sui iniquitate et dolo. <l eID="gen31334" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11137"/><l level="1" sID="gen31335"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11137"/>Et erit in die illa, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen31335" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31336"/>vox clamoris a porta piscium, <l eID="gen31336" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31337"/>et ululatus a Secunda, <l eID="gen31337" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31338"/>et contritio magna a collibus. <l eID="gen31338" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11138"/><l level="1" sID="gen31339"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11138"/>Ululate, habitatores Pilæ : <l eID="gen31339" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31340"/>conticuit omnis populus Chanaan, <l eID="gen31340" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31341"/>disperierunt omnes involuti argento. <l eID="gen31341" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11139"/><l level="1" sID="gen31342"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11139"/>Et erit in tempore illo : <l eID="gen31342" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31343"/>scrutabor Jerusalem in lucernis, <l eID="gen31343" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31344"/>et visitabo super viros defixos in fæcibus suis, <l eID="gen31344" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31345"/>qui dicunt in cordibus suis : <l eID="gen31345" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31346"/>Non faciet bene Dominus, et non faciet male. <l eID="gen31346" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11140"/><l level="1" sID="gen31347"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11140"/>Et erit fortitudo eorum in direptionem, <l eID="gen31347" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31348"/>et domus eorum in desertum : <l eID="gen31348" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31349"/>et ædificabunt domos, et non habitabunt ; <l eID="gen31349" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31350"/>et plantabunt vineas, et non bibent vinum earum. <l eID="gen31350" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11141"/><l level="1" sID="gen31351"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11141"/>Juxta est dies Domini magnus : <l eID="gen31351" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31352"/>juxta est, et velox nimis. <l eID="gen31352" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31353"/>Vox diei Domini amara : <l eID="gen31353" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31354"/>tribulabitur ibi fortis. <l eID="gen31354" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11142"/><l level="1" sID="gen31355"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11142"/>Dies iræ dies illa, <l eID="gen31355" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31356"/>dies tribulationis et angustiæ, <l eID="gen31356" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31357"/>dies calamitatis et miseriæ, <l eID="gen31357" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31358"/>dies tenebrarum et caliginis, <l eID="gen31358" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31359"/>dies nebulæ et turbinis, <l eID="gen31359" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:16
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11143"/><l level="1" sID="gen31360"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11143"/>dies tubæ et clangoris super civitates munitas, <l eID="gen31360" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31361"/>et super angulos excelsos. <l eID="gen31361" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:17
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11144"/><l level="1" sID="gen31362"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11144"/>Et tribulabo homines, et ambulabunt ut cæci, <l eID="gen31362" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31363"/>quia Domino peccaverunt ; <l eID="gen31363" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31364"/>et effundetur sanguis eorum sicut humus, <l eID="gen31364" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31365"/>et corpora eorum sicut stercora. <l eID="gen31365" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 1:18
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11145"/><l level="1" sID="gen31366"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11145"/>Sed et argentum eorum et aurum eorum non poterit liberare eos <l eID="gen31366" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31367"/>in die iræ Domini : <l eID="gen31367" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31368"/>in igne zeli ejus devorabitur omnis terra, <l eID="gen31368" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31369"/>quia consummationem cum festinatione faciet <l eID="gen31369" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31370"/>cunctis habitantibus terram.  <chapter eID="Zeph.1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:1
verses.text: Convenite, congregamini, gens non amabilis, <l eID="gen31371" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11146"/><l level="1" sID="gen31372"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11146"/>priusquam pariat jussio quasi pulverem transeuntem diem, <l eID="gen31372" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31373"/>antequam veniat super vos ira furoris Domini, <l eID="gen31373" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31374"/>antequam veniat super vos dies indignationis Domini. <l eID="gen31374" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11147"/><l level="1" sID="gen31375"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11147"/>Quærite Dominum, omnes mansueti terræ, <l eID="gen31375" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31376"/>qui judicium ejus estis operati ; <l eID="gen31376" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31377"/>quærite justum, quærite mansuetum, <l eID="gen31377" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31378"/>si quomodo abscondamini in die furoris Domini. <l eID="gen31378" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11148"/><l level="1" sID="gen31379"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11148"/>Quia Gaza destructa erit, <l eID="gen31379" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31380"/>et Ascalon in desertum : <l eID="gen31380" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31381"/>Azotum in meridie ejicient, <l eID="gen31381" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31382"/>et Accaron eradicabitur. <l eID="gen31382" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11149"/><l level="1" sID="gen31383"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11149"/>Væ qui habitatis funiculum maris, gens perditorum ! <l eID="gen31383" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31384"/>verbum Domini super vos, Chanaan, terra Philisthinorum ; <l eID="gen31384" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31385"/>et disperdam te, ita ut non sit inhabitator. <l eID="gen31385" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11150"/><l level="1" sID="gen31386"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11150"/>Et erit funiculus maris requies pastorum, et caulæ pecorum ; <l eID="gen31386" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11151"/><l level="1" sID="gen31387"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11151"/>et erit funiculus ejus qui remanserit de domo Juda : ibi pascentur, <l eID="gen31387" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31388"/>in domibus Ascalonis ad vesperam requiescent, <l eID="gen31388" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31389"/>quia visitabit eos Dominus Deus eorum, <l eID="gen31389" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31390"/>et avertet captivitatem eorum. <l eID="gen31390" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11152"/><l level="1" sID="gen31391"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11152"/>Audivi opprobrium Moab, <l eID="gen31391" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31392"/>et blasphemias filiorum Ammon, <l eID="gen31392" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31393"/>quæ exprobraverunt populo meo, <l eID="gen31393" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31394"/>et magnificati sunt super terminos eorum. <l eID="gen31394" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:9
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11153"/><l level="1" sID="gen31395"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11153"/>Propterea vivo ego, dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, <l eID="gen31395" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31396"/>quia Moab ut Sodoma erit, <l eID="gen31396" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31397"/>et filii Ammon quasi Gomorrha : <l eID="gen31397" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31398"/>siccitas spinarum, et acervi salis, <l eID="gen31398" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31399"/>et desertum usque in æternum : <l eID="gen31399" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31400"/>reliquiæ populi mei diripient eos, <l eID="gen31400" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31401"/>et residui gentis meæ possidebunt illos. <l eID="gen31401" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:10
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11154"/><l level="1" sID="gen31402"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11154"/>Hoc eis eveniet pro superbia sua, <l eID="gen31402" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31403"/>quia blasphemaverunt et magnificati sunt <l eID="gen31403" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31404"/>super populum Domini exercituum. <l eID="gen31404" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:11
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11155"/><l level="1" sID="gen31405"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11155"/>Horribilis Dominus super eos, <l eID="gen31405" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31406"/>et attenuabit omnes deos terræ : <l eID="gen31406" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31407"/>et adorabunt eum viri de loco suo, <l eID="gen31407" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31408"/>omnes insulæ gentium. <l eID="gen31408" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:12
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11156"/><l level="1" sID="gen31409"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11156"/>Sed et vos, Æthiopes, interfecti gladio meo eritis. <l eID="gen31409" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:13
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11157"/><l level="1" sID="gen31410"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11157"/>Et extendet manum suam super aquilonem, et perdet Assur, <l eID="gen31410" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31411"/>et ponet speciosam in solitudinem, <l eID="gen31411" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31412"/>et in invium, et quasi desertum. <l eID="gen31412" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:14
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11158"/><l level="1" sID="gen31413"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11158"/>Et accubabunt in medio ejus greges, omnes bestiæ gentium ; <l eID="gen31413" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31414"/>et onocrotalus et ericius in liminibus ejus morabuntur : <l eID="gen31414" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31415"/>vox cantantis in fenestra, <l eID="gen31415" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31416"/>corvus in superliminari, <l eID="gen31416" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31417"/>quoniam attenuabo robur ejus. <l eID="gen31417" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 2:15
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11159"/><l level="1" sID="gen31418"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11159"/>Hæc est civitas gloriosa habitans in confidentia, <l eID="gen31418" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31419"/>quæ dicebat in corde suo : <l eID="gen31419" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31420"/>Ego sum, et extra me non est alia amplius : <l eID="gen31420" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31421"/>quomodo facta est in desertum cubile bestiæ ? <l eID="gen31421" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31422"/>omnis qui transit per eam sibilabit, <l eID="gen31422" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31423"/>et movebit manum suam.  <chapter eID="Zeph.2"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:1
verses.text: Væ provocatrix, et redempta civitas, columba ! <l eID="gen31424" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:2
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11160"/><l level="1" sID="gen31425"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11160"/>non audivit vocem, <l eID="gen31425" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31426"/>et non suscepit disciplinam ; <l eID="gen31426" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31427"/>in Domino non est confisa, <l eID="gen31427" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31428"/>ad Deum suum non appropinquavit. <l eID="gen31428" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:3
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11161"/><l level="1" sID="gen31429"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11161"/>Principes ejus in medio ejus quasi leones rugientes ; <l eID="gen31429" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31430"/>judices ejus lupi vespere, non relinquebant in mane. <l eID="gen31430" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:4
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11162"/><l level="1" sID="gen31431"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11162"/>Prophetæ ejus vesani, viri infideles ; <l eID="gen31431" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31432"/>sacerdotes ejus polluerunt sanctum, <l eID="gen31432" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31433"/>injuste egerunt contra legem. <l eID="gen31433" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:5
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11163"/><l level="1" sID="gen31434"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11163"/>Dominus justus in medio ejus non faciet iniquitatem ; <l eID="gen31434" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31435"/>mane, mane judicium suum dabit in lucem, et non abscondetur ; <l eID="gen31435" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31436"/>nescivit autem iniquus confusionem. <l eID="gen31436" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:6
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11164"/><l level="1" sID="gen31437"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11164"/>Disperdidi gentes, <l eID="gen31437" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31438"/>et dissipati sunt anguli earum ; <l eID="gen31438" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31439"/>desertas feci vias eorum, <l eID="gen31439" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31440"/>dum non est qui transeat ; <l eID="gen31440" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31441"/>desolatæ sunt civitates eorum, <l eID="gen31441" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31442"/>non remanente viro, neque ullo habitatore. <l eID="gen31442" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:7
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11165"/><l level="1" sID="gen31443"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11165"/>Dixi : Attamen timebis me, <l eID="gen31443" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31444"/>suscipies disciplinam ; <l eID="gen31444" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31445"/>et non peribit habitaculum ejus, <l eID="gen31445" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31446"/>propter omnia in quibus visitavi eam : <l eID="gen31446" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31447"/>verumtamen diluculo surgentes corruperunt omnes cogitationes suas. <l eID="gen31447" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:8
verses.text: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11166"/><l level="1" sID="gen31448"/> <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11166"/>Quapropter exspecta me, dicit Dominus, <l eID="gen31448" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31449"/>in die resurrectionis meæ in futurum : <l eID="gen31449" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31450"/>quia judicium meum ut congregem gentes, <l eID="gen31450" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31451"/>et colligam regna, <l eID="gen31451" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31452"/>et effundam super eos indignationem meam, <l eID="gen31452" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31453"/>omnem iram furoris mei : <l eID="gen31453" level="1"/> <l level="1" sID="gen31454"/>in igne enim zeli mei devorabitur omnis terra. <l eID="gen31454" level="1"/>

verses.name: Zephaniah 3:9
